rows.original: You’re standing in a busy looking hospital filled with white cotton beds and draw curtains. Busy medical staff bustle back and forth, taking patients charts, checking supplies, and administering pain relief. Even though the architecture is scarred by conflict like everywhere else, the smell of disinfectant lingers here, and everyone’s wearing sterile gloves.
rows.translation: 你正站在一间繁忙的医院里，到处都是铺着白色棉布的病床和隔帘。忙碌的医务人员来回奔走，收取病历、检查物资并实施镇痛治疗。尽管这里的建筑也像其他地方一样留有战争创伤，空气中却仍弥漫着消毒剂的气味，每个人都戴着无菌手套。
rows.raw: "You’re standing in a busy looking hospital filled with white cotton beds and draw curtains. Busy medical staff bustle back and forth, taking patients charts, checking supplies, and administering pain relief. Even though the architecture is scarred by conflict like everywhere else, the smell of disinfectant lingers here, and everyone’s wearing sterile gloves."

rows.original: There are both red and gold myr patients here, being treated equally. A large banner hangs from the wall – white with a red lotus-looking flower. If you had to hazard a guess, it looks like the Scarlet Federation’s version of a green cross.
rows.translation: 这里既有红米尔病人，也有金米尔病人，双方受到同等治疗。墙上挂着一面巨大的旗帜——白底，绘有一朵类似红莲的花。大胆猜测的话，这大概是猩红联邦版本的绿十字标志。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere are both red and gold myr patients here, being treated equally. A large banner hangs from the wall – white with a red lotus-looking flower. If you had to hazard a guess, it looks like the Scarlet Federation’s version of a green cross."

rows.original: Monitors affixed to gray steel racks flank some of the beds, scrolling patient vitals in both English and Myrish. They are conspicuously devoid of any maker’s mark save for [silly|the word "FNORD"|an "M"] stamped on the cabinet.
rows.translation: 一些病床两侧立着固定在灰色钢架上的监护仪，以英语和米尔语滚动显示病人的生命体征。设备上明显没有任何制造商标记，只有机柜上印着[silly|“FNORD”一词|一个“M”]。

rows.original: You ask Anzhela about this ‘shell shock’ she mentioned. You’ve never heard of the condition before.
rows.translation: 你询问安热拉提到的“弹震症”。你从未听说过这种病。
rows.raw: "You ask Anzhela about this ‘shell shock’ she mentioned. You’ve never heard of the condition before."

rows.original: The chief doctor lets out a long, wearied sigh, running her finger around the edge of her cup. “...It’s a condition similar to a physical wound to the head, yet it occurs in those without any signs of injury.”
rows.translation: 首席医生疲惫地长叹，用手指沿杯沿画圈。“...这种病类似头部受到实质伤害，却会出现在没有任何受伤迹象的人身上。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe chief doctor lets out a long, wearied sigh, running her finger around the edge of her cup. “...It’s a condition similar to a physical wound to the head, yet it occurs in those without any signs of injury.”"

rows.original: “Our current theory is that it’s caused by the psychological trauma of battle, though some commanders still chalk it up to ‘cowardice’ or a ‘lack of moral fiber’.”
rows.translation: “目前理论认为，它源于战斗造成的心理创伤，但有些指挥官仍将其归咎于‘懦弱’或‘意志不坚’。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Our current theory is that it’s caused by the psychological trauma of battle, though some commanders still chalk it up to ‘cowardice’ or a ‘lack of moral fiber’.”"

rows.original: She taps the side of her glasses, “You can usually tell who’s got it by the ‘thousand yard stare’ they’ve got - the afflicted will just stare off into space, completely unaware of what’s going on around them. They make up the most habitual users of Ruby as well.”
rows.translation: 她敲敲眼镜侧边，“通常能通过‘千码凝视’认出患者——病人只会盯着虚空，完全意识不到周围发生的事情。他们也是最经常使用露比的群体。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe taps the side of her glasses, “You can usually tell who’s got it by the ‘thousand yard stare’ they’ve got - the afflicted will just stare off into space, completely unaware of what’s going on around them. They make up the most habitual users of Ruby as well.”"

rows.original: “In the worst cases, the patient loses all sense of reason and becomes utterly unpredictable. Quite a lot of them are put on trial for desertion or cowardice.”
rows.translation: “最严重时，病人会失去全部理智，变得完全无法预测。其中很多人会因逃兵或怯战罪受审。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“In the worst cases, the patient loses all sense of reason and becomes utterly unpredictable. Quite a lot of them are put on trial for desertion or cowardice.”"

rows.original: Leaning back in her chair, Anzhela looks up at the decaying office roof. “...Still, convincing a military court that a soldier is suffering from shell-shock is tricky business - assuming it gets to a court. Out in the field, there’s no physicians to vouch for their actions. It’s an issue that, like the trench-wives, High Command would prefer to ignore.”
rows.translation: 安热拉靠回椅背，抬头望着破败的办公室屋顶。“...不过，要说服军事法庭相信士兵患有弹震症十分棘手——前提是事情能闹上法庭。在战场上，没有医生能为他们的行为作证。和战壕妻子一样，这是最高指挥部更愿意忽视的问题。”
rows.raw: "\n\nLeaning back in her chair, Anzhela looks up at the decaying office roof. “...Still, convincing a military court that a soldier is suffering from shell-shock is tricky business - assuming it gets to a court. Out in the field, there’s no physicians to vouch for their actions. It’s an issue that, like the trench-wives, High Command would prefer to ignore.”"

rows.original: Anzhela then shakes her head and gives you a strained smile. “I’m sorry, I got a little maudlin there. It’s symptomatic of being in a mobile army surgery hospital. Thank you for lending an ear. It’s strange to be the one talking instead of listening for once.”
rows.translation: 安热拉随后摇摇头，勉强对你微笑。“抱歉，我刚才有点多愁善感。待在机动陆军外科医院就是会这样。谢谢你愿意倾听。难得有一次是我说而不是我听，感觉真奇怪。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnzhela then shakes her head and gives you a strained smile. “I’m sorry, I got a little maudlin there. It’s symptomatic of being in a mobile army surgery hospital. Thank you for lending an ear. It’s strange to be the one talking instead of listening for once.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You ask Anzhela about the addictions she’s been treating. The Reds seem so regimented; it’s hard to imagine them succumbing to substance abuse.
rows.translation: 你询问安热拉一直治疗的成瘾问题。红军看起来纪律严明，很难想象他们会受药物滥用所害。
rows.raw: "You ask Anzhela about the addictions she’s been treating. The Reds seem so regimented; it’s hard to imagine them succumbing to substance abuse."

rows.original: “During peacetime - or the closest to peace the Scarlet Federation gets - you’d be right. Drug abuse is a lot lower than in the civilian population. But after seven years of outright war and some terrible policies, that’s no longer the case.”
rows.translation: “和平时期——或者说猩红联邦最接近和平的时候——你说得没错。军中的药物滥用确实比平民少得多。但七年全面战争加上一些糟糕政策后，情况已不再如此。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“During peacetime - or the closest to peace the Scarlet Federation gets - you’d be right. Drug abuse is a lot lower than in the civilian population. But after seven years of outright war and some terrible policies, that’s no longer the case.”"

rows.original: You ask her what policies she’s referring to. Solemnly, she puts down her cup, and clasps her hands on her lap.
rows.translation: 你问她指的是哪些政策。她神情严肃地放下杯子，双手交握在膝上。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her what policies she’s referring to. Solemnly, she puts down her cup, and clasps her hands on her lap."

rows.original: “...Well, early on, High Command were looking for ways to capitalize on our knowledge of medicine to augment our troops. Back home, they cooked up a bunch of different steroids and performance enhancers, and had us dole them out to select groups of soldiers.”
rows.translation: “...嗯，战争初期，最高指挥部想利用我们的医学知识强化部队。他们在本土配制了各种类固醇与兴奋剂，让我们分发给选定的士兵群体。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...Well, early on, High Command were looking for ways to capitalize on our knowledge of medicine to augment our troops. Back home, they cooked up a bunch of different steroids and performance enhancers, and had us dole them out to select groups of soldiers.”"

rows.original: “At the time, the drugs seemed safe. Beneficial, even. But something that seems harmless can have very detrimental long term effects. For instance, one performance enhancer, Blaze, made our soldiers able to fight for three days straight and remain highly alert. The benefits to front-line soldiers were obvious.”
rows.translation: “当时那些药物看起来很安全，甚至颇有益处。但看似无害的东西也可能造成严重长期影响。例如一种名叫‘烈焰’的兴奋剂，能让士兵连续战斗三天并保持高度警觉。它对前线士兵的好处显而易见。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“At the time, the drugs seemed safe. Beneficial, even. But something that seems harmless can have very detrimental long term effects. For instance, one performance enhancer, Blaze, made our soldiers able to fight for three days straight and remain highly alert. The benefits to front-line soldiers were obvious.”"

rows.original: “However, Blaze was also highly addictive. It made soldiers edgy and too alert. We stopped using it years ago, but we’re still picking up the pieces,” she sighs. “Yet, there’s drugs we’re ordered to prescribe to soldiers.”
rows.translation: “然而，烈焰也极易成瘾。它让士兵紧张不安，而且过度警觉。我们几年前便停用了它，但现在仍在收拾残局。”她叹气道。“可还有一些药物，上级命令我们必须给士兵开。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“However, Blaze was also highly addictive. It made soldiers edgy and too alert. We stopped using it years ago, but we’re still picking up the pieces,” she sighs. “Yet, there’s drugs we’re ordered to prescribe to soldiers.”"

rows.original: “A lot of them we don’t know the long term effects. Of course, the worst addiction by far is the one we endorse the most - ourselves.”
rows.translation: “其中许多连我们都不知道长期影响。当然，最严重的瘾也是我们最为推崇的——我们自身。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A lot of them we don’t know the long term effects. Of course, the worst addiction by far is the one we endorse the most - ourselves.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Curious, you ask Anzela about the transformatives she mentioned.
rows.translation: 你好奇地询问安热拉所说的变形物品。
rows.raw: "Curious, you ask Anzela about the transformatives she mentioned."

rows.original: Anzhela runs a finger around the rim of her cup, her lips pursed. “...We’ve been receiving them from the war labs lately.. I’m meant to offer them to any soldier who wants them.”
rows.translation: 安热拉用手指绕着杯沿，双唇紧抿。“...最近战争实验室一直在送来这些东西。我应该把它们提供给每个愿意使用的士兵。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnzhela runs a finger around the rim of her cup, her lips pursed. “...We’ve been receiving them from the war labs lately.. I’m meant to offer them to any soldier who wants them.”"

rows.original: “Most of them are body enhancers, which increases muscle growth and physical strength - anything to give us an edge against the Golds.”
rows.translation: “其中大多是身体强化剂，能促进肌肉生长与体力——一切都是为了让我们对金军占据优势。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Most of them are body enhancers, which increases muscle growth and physical strength - anything to give us an edge against the Golds.”"

rows.original: You ask her why the army is liberally using the treatments. She mournfully smiles.
rows.translation: 你问军队为何大量使用这些疗程。她悲伤地笑了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her why the army is liberally using the treatments. She mournfully smiles."

rows.original: “...Because ‘if we don’t do it, the golds will’, of course. That, and a regular user of body enhancers can be a truly terrifying thing. With that many steroids coursing through them, they’re terrifyingly strong and fly into a rage at the brush of an antennae. It’s one of the reasons we have reinforced restraints on hand here.”
rows.translation: “...当然，因为‘如果我们不用，金军也会用’。此外，长期使用身体强化剂的人确实十分可怕。大量类固醇在体内奔流，令他们强壮得吓人，触角稍被擦碰便会暴怒。这也是我们手边备有强化束缚带的原因之一。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...Because ‘if we don’t do it, the golds will’, of course. That, and a regular user of body enhancers can be a truly terrifying thing. With that many steroids coursing through them, they’re terrifyingly strong and fly into a rage at the brush of an antennae. It’s one of the reasons we have reinforced restraints on hand here.”"

rows.original: You ask where these chemicals come from. Even though the Federation seems to have decent medical technology, having any kind of transformatives is probably beyond them. After all, they’re still using powder rifles and bi-planes!
rows.translation: 你询问这些化学品来自哪里。猩红联邦的医疗技术虽然还不错，但任何形式的变形物品大概都超出了他们的能力。毕竟他们还在使用火药步枪和双翼飞机！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask where these chemicals come from. Even though the Federation seems to have decent medical technology, having any kind of transformatives is probably beyond them. After all, they’re still using powder rifles and bi-planes!"

rows.original: “Honestly? The whole thing is rather secretive,” Anzhela openly answers, a worried look on her face. “Even though I administer the drugs, I only know very little about the whole thing,” she shrugs, then continues, “Rumor is that early in the war, there were stories about facilities where transformative treatments were being tested on volunteers, some kind of project to create the ‘perfect myr soldier’. Word is the results were impressive, but nothing like the technology your peoples display.”
rows.translation: “老实说？整件事相当神秘。”安热拉坦率回答，脸上带着忧虑。“虽然药物由我施用，但我对整件事所知甚少。”她耸耸肩继续道，“传闻战争早期，有些设施在志愿者身上测试变形疗程，试图制造‘完美米尔士兵’。据说结果很惊人，但远远比不上你们展示的技术。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Honestly? The whole thing is rather secretive,” Anzhela openly answers, a worried look on her face. “Even though I administer the drugs, I only know very little about the whole thing,” she shrugs, then continues, “Rumor is that early in the war, there were stories about facilities where transformative treatments were being tested on volunteers, some kind of project to create the ‘perfect myr soldier’. Word is the results were impressive, but nothing like the technology your peoples display.”"

rows.original: “Apparently the offshoots of those experiments are the drugs we use today. The list of side effects is still hideously long, yet we’re still authorized – no, encouraged – to administer them. It’s said that some company called ‘Xenogen’ slipped the Federation a ‘how-to’ guide on genetic manipulation in exchange for... something.” She shrugs again and sips her scova. “...Could be scuttlebutt, though, so make of that what you will.”
rows.translation: “显然，那些实验的衍生品就是我们今天使用的药物。副作用清单仍长得吓人，可我们依然获得授权——不，是受到鼓励——去施用它们。据说一家名叫‘异源生物科技’的公司给了联邦一份基因操纵‘指南’，以换取...某样东西。”她再次耸肩，啜饮斯科瓦。“...不过也可能只是流言，你自己判断吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Apparently the offshoots of those experiments are the drugs we use today. The list of side effects is still hideously long, yet we’re still authorized – no, encouraged – to administer them. It’s said that some company called ‘Xenogen’ slipped the Federation a ‘how-to’ guide on genetic manipulation in exchange for... something.” She shrugs again and sips her scova. “...Could be scuttlebutt, though, so make of that what you will.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You ask Anzhela about her and her team’s work at the central aid center. You’ve seen as many gold patients as red ones since you arrived.
rows.translation: 你向安热拉询问她和团队在中央救助中心的工作。抵达以来，你见到的金军病人与红军一样多。
rows.raw: "You ask Anzhela about her and her team’s work at the central aid center. You’ve seen as many gold patients as red ones since you arrived."

rows.original: “Well, there’s tending to the wounded, of course. Thankfully, there’s been hardly any critical injuries since the cease-fire - I wouldn’t have even had time to say ‘hello’ to you if you’d come in here several months ago,” she blows the steam off her scova, then continues, “...Most of the heavily wounded come from nyrea attacks, landmines, and scouts getting caught with their pants down.”
rows.translation: “当然，首先是照顾伤员。幸好停火后几乎没有重伤——若你几个月前来到这里，我甚至没时间跟你说‘你好’。”她吹散斯科瓦上的热气，继续道，“...大多数重伤来自尼瑞亚袭击、地雷，以及措手不及的侦察兵。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, there’s tending to the wounded, of course. Thankfully, there’s been hardly any critical injuries since the cease-fire - I wouldn’t have even had time to say ‘hello’ to you if you’d come in here several months ago,” she blows the steam off her scova, then continues, “...Most of the heavily wounded come from nyrea attacks, landmines, and scouts getting caught with their pants down.”"

rows.original: You think of the actual scout you found with her pants down just outside of Kressia. Does she mean literally, or...?
rows.translation: 你想到克雷西亚城外那个真的没穿裤子的侦察兵。她是字面意思，还是...？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou think of the actual scout you found with her pants down just outside of Kressia. Does she mean literally, or...?"

rows.original: Noticing the perplexed gaze in your eyes, Anzhela laughs and waves her hand dismissively, “Oh, no, not with their pants actually down - not normally! I mean, that HAS happened, but it’s an exception, not the rule. Mostly when two scouts are fooling around, or going somewhere for private time. Usually the wound to their pride - or their embarrassment - hurts more than the injury!”
rows.translation: 安热拉注意到你困惑的眼神，笑着摆手，“哦，不，不是说裤子真的脱了——通常不是！我是说，这种事确实发生过，但只是例外。大多是两个侦察兵在胡闹，或找地方独处。通常受伤更重的是自尊——或尴尬感——而不是身体！”
rows.raw: "\n\nNoticing the perplexed gaze in your eyes, Anzhela laughs and waves her hand dismissively, “Oh, no, not with their pants actually down - not normally! I mean, that HAS happened, but it’s an exception, not the rule. Mostly when two scouts are fooling around, or going somewhere for private time. Usually the wound to their pride - or their embarrassment - hurts more than the injury!”"

rows.original: “Most of my time is taken up with pain management from old injuries, treating shell shock and addiction, and lately, administering transformatives.”
rows.translation: “我的大部分时间都花在管理旧伤疼痛、治疗弹震症和成瘾上，最近还要施用变形物品。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Most of my time is taken up with pain management from old injuries, treating shell shock and addiction, and lately, administering transformatives.”"

rows.original: Is there something else about her work you would like to discuss?
rows.translation: 还有哪些工作话题想讨论？
rows.raw: "Is there something else about her work you would like to discuss?"

rows.translation: 询问旧伤和疼痛管理。

rows.translation: 弹震症

rows.translation: “弹震症”听起来很奇怪。那是什么？
rows.raw: "‘Shell Shock’ sounds like an odd term. What is it?"

rows.original: Addiction
rows.translation: 成瘾
rows.raw: "Addiction"

rows.original: Addiction
rows.translation: 成瘾
rows.raw: "Addiction"

rows.original: Addiction? The Reds seem so strict...
rows.translation: 成瘾？红军看起来那么严格...
rows.raw: "Addiction? The Reds seem so strict..."

rows.original: Alterants
rows.translation: 变形剂
rows.raw: "Alterants"

rows.original: Alterants
rows.translation: 变形剂
rows.raw: "Alterants"

rows.original: Administering transformatives? That sounds... dicey.
rows.translation: 施用变形物品？听起来...很冒险。
rows.raw: "Administering transformatives? That sounds... dicey."

rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.translation: 已禁用
rows.raw: "Disabled"

rows.translation: 已禁用

rows.original: You just spoke about this topic.
rows.translation: 你刚谈过这个话题。
rows.raw: "You just spoke about this topic."

rows.original: Her Work
rows.translation: 她的工作
rows.raw: "Her Work"

rows.original: Ask her about her work.
rows.translation: 询问她的工作。
rows.raw: "Ask her about her work."

rows.original: SCARMED
rows.translation: SCARMED
rows.raw: "SCARMED"

rows.original: You ask Anzhela about ‘SCARMED’, the organization she belongs to, and if it’s part of the military.
rows.translation: 你询问安热拉所属的“SCARMED”组织，以及它是否属于军队。
rows.raw: "You ask Anzhela about ‘SCARMED’, the organization she belongs to, and if it’s part of the military."

rows.original: “Yes and no. SCARMED is the Federal Army’s healthcare organization, but not a Federal Army command,” she explains between sips of her scova, “We’re split into medical and nursing corps; a pretty simple setup, really.”
rows.translation: “既是，也不是。SCARMED是联邦陆军的医疗组织，却不隶属联邦陆军指挥体系。”她啜饮斯科瓦的间隙解释道，“我们分为医疗队与护理队；结构其实很简单。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes and no. SCARMED is the Federal Army’s healthcare organization, but not a Federal Army command,” she explains between sips of her scova, “We’re split into medical and nursing corps; a pretty simple setup, really.”"

rows.original: “Under Surgeon-General Sasya, we’re assigned to different parts of the Federal Army. My chain of command is very different to the rank-and-file, though we all answer to the same people at the top. Though that’s changed a little since the new Field Marshal took command.”
rows.translation: “在外科总监萨夏的领导下，我们被派往联邦陆军各处。我的指挥链与普通士兵大不相同，不过顶层都听命于同一批人。只是新战地元帅接管后，这一点也稍有变化。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Under Surgeon-General Sasya, we’re assigned to different parts of the Federal Army. My chain of command is very different to the rank-and-file, though we all answer to the same people at the top. Though that’s changed a little since the new Field Marshal took command.”"

rows.original: Anzhela’s eyebrow twitches a little. Does she not like the current commander of Kressia’s armed forces?
rows.translation: 安热拉的眉毛微微抽动。她不喜欢克雷西亚武装部队现任指挥官吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nAnzhela’s eyebrow twitches a little. Does she not like the current commander of Kressia’s armed forces?"

rows.original: “SCARMED has existed almost as long as the Federal Army itself. It’s not just made up of field medics and nurses; there’s also dentists, optometrists, psychiatrists, physical therapists, pharmacists, toxicologists, podiatrists - you name it.”
rows.translation: “SCARMED几乎与联邦陆军本身一样历史悠久。组织成员不只有战地军医与护士；还有牙医、验光师、精神科医师、理疗师、药剂师、毒理学家、足病医生——应有尽有。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“SCARMED has existed almost as long as the Federal Army itself. It’s not just made up of field medics and nurses; there’s also dentists, optometrists, psychiatrists, physical therapists, pharmacists, toxicologists, podiatrists - you name it.”"

rows.original: “We’re as much for peace time as we are for war, though it’s hard to remember a time when we weren’t at war these days; either with the golds or the nyrea.”
rows.translation: “我们既服务于和平时期，也服务于战争，不过这些年很难记起我们没有打仗的时候；不是和金军，就是和尼瑞亚人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We’re as much for peace time as we are for war, though it’s hard to remember a time when we weren’t at war these days; either with the golds or the nyrea.”"

rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.translation: SCARMED

rows.translation: 询问她所属的组织。
rows.raw: "Ask her about the organization she belongs to."

rows.translation: 战地元帅
rows.raw: "F.Marshal"

rows.original: You observe that the CMO looked a little on edge at the mention of Field Marshal Sellera.
rows.translation: 你指出，提到战地元帅塞莱拉时，首席医疗官似乎有些紧张。
rows.raw: "You observe that the CMO looked a little on edge at the mention of Field Marshal Sellera."

rows.original: Anzhela’s expression looks strained. She presses her fingers against the sides of her cracked cup.
rows.translation: 安热拉神情僵硬，手指抵住裂纹杯子的两侧。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnzhela’s expression looks strained. She presses her fingers against the sides of her cracked cup."

rows.original: “The Field Marshal is - well - she has a lot of zeal. I have no doubt she spends every waking moment thinking about how to wipe the Gilden Republic off the face of the planet,” she carefully states, “...And probably every gold myr, as well.”
rows.translation: “战地元帅——嗯——她非常狂热。我毫不怀疑，她每个清醒时刻都在思考如何把吉尔登共和国从这个星球上抹去。”她谨慎地说道，“...而且大概也包括每一个金色米尔人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The Field Marshal is - well - she has a lot of zeal. I have no doubt she spends every waking moment thinking about how to wipe the Gilden Republic off the face of the planet,” she carefully states, “...And probably every gold myr, as well.”"

rows.original: “I’ve met her for some checkups. She’s got a lot of scars from seven years of non-stop war, not all of them visible on the surface.”
rows.translation: “我给她做过几次检查。七年不停歇的战争在她身上留下了许多伤疤，其中并非所有都能从外表看见。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ve met her for some checkups. She’s got a lot of scars from seven years of non-stop war, not all of them visible on the surface.”"

rows.original: You ask Anzhela if she dislikes the Field Marshal. Her brow furrows. It takes her a while to respond.
rows.translation: 你问安热拉是否讨厌战地元帅。她皱起眉头，过了一阵才回答。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask Anzhela if she dislikes the Field Marshal. Her brow furrows. It takes her a while to respond."

rows.original: “...I think she and I have learned different lessons from this war. Suffering can make you kind, or it can make you cruel. She’s a product of this war as much as anyone else.”
rows.translation: “...我想，我和她从这场战争中学到的教训不同。苦难能让人善良，也能让人残酷。她和其他人一样，都是这场战争的产物。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...I think she and I have learned different lessons from this war. Suffering can make you kind, or it can make you cruel. She’s a product of this war as much as anyone else.”"

rows.original: You sense she has more to say, but she holds her tongue. Perhaps she’s concerned about being seen as seditious–?
rows.translation: 你感觉她还有话想说，却保持沉默。也许她担心被视作煽动叛乱——？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sense she has more to say, but she holds her tongue. Perhaps she’s concerned about being seen as seditious–?"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: F.Marshal
rows.translation: 战地元帅
rows.raw: "F.Marshal"

rows.original: Ask her about her boss.
rows.translation: 询问她的上司。
rows.raw: "Ask her about her boss."

rows.original: Locked
rows.translation: 锁定
rows.raw: "Locked"

rows.original: Locked
rows.translation: 锁定
rows.raw: "Locked"

rows.original: You don’t know enough to ask about this topic. Maybe talk about some other things first.
rows.translation: 你了解得还不够，无法询问这个话题。也许先谈谈别的。
rows.raw: "You don’t know enough to ask about this topic. Maybe talk about some other things first."

rows.original: Anzhela
rows.translation: 安热拉
rows.raw: "Anzhela"

rows.original: You ask Anzhela a little bit about herself. She playfully smiles and looks up at you through her dark lashes, all the while blowing the steam off her cup.
rows.translation: 你向安热拉问起她自己的事情。她顽皮地微笑，一边吹散杯中热气，一边透过浓黑睫毛抬眼看你。
rows.raw: "You ask Anzhela a little bit about herself. She playfully smiles and looks up at you through her dark lashes, all the while blowing the steam off her cup."

rows.original: “Oh, about me-? I was going to ask some questions about you, but you beat me to it.”
rows.translation: “哦，关于我——？我本来还想问你的事，却被你抢先了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, about me-? I was going to ask some questions about you, but you beat me to it.”"

rows.original: Since you’re the one who got in first, you insist she start. The female doctor leans back into her chair, looking incredibly ponderous.
rows.translation: 既然是你先开口，你坚持让她先说。女医生靠回椅背，显得若有所思。
rows.raw: "\n\nSince you’re the one who got in first, you insist she start. The female doctor leans back into her chair, looking incredibly ponderous."

rows.original: “...What to start with? My full name, I suppose. I’m Anzhela Sh’en Vayalle. Usually there’s a ‘Doctor’ in front of that, but I think you’ve figured that out already,” she grins, flashing one of her tiny fangs. “I was born on the seventh day of Nylund, so that makes me a Clai, if you follow geo patterns.”
rows.translation: “...从哪里开始？我想先说全名吧。我叫安热拉·申·瓦亚尔。通常前面还有个‘医生’，不过我想你早就看出来了。”她咧嘴露出一颗小尖牙。“我出生在尼伦德第七日，所以按地相划分，我属于克莱。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...What to start with? My full name, I suppose. I’m Anzhela Sh’en Vayalle. Usually there’s a ‘Doctor’ in front of that, but I think you’ve figured that out already,” she grins, flashing one of her tiny fangs. “I was born on the seventh day of Nylund, so that makes me a Clai, if you follow geo patterns.”"

rows.original: Geo patterns? That sounds an awful lot like star signs. You describe them, then ask if they’re anything alike.
rows.translation: 地相？听起来很像星座。你描述了一番，随后问两者是否相似。
rows.raw: "\n\nGeo patterns? That sounds an awful lot like star signs. You describe them, then ask if they’re anything alike."

rows.original: “Well, we myr don’t look up to the stars a whole lot - what with living underground and all - but it does sound very similar. Geo patterns are to do with relationship between geology, the time you were born and how they might affect your personality.”
rows.translation: “嗯，我们米尔人不怎么仰望星空——毕竟一直住在地下——不过听起来确实非常相似。地相研究地质、出生时间之间的关系，以及它们可能怎样影响性格。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, we myr don’t look up to the stars a whole lot - what with living underground and all - but it does sound very similar. Geo patterns are to do with relationship between geology, the time you were born and how they might affect your personality.”"

rows.original: She sounds really lively when she’s talking about birth patterns. You ask her if she believes in them.
rows.translation: 谈起出生地相时，她显得非常活跃。你问她是否相信这些。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe sounds really lively when she’s talking about birth patterns. You ask her if she believes in them."

rows.original: The doctor coughs into her hand, her cheeks brightly flushed. “O-of course not-! It’s a common thing to answer when someone asks you about yourself, right?”
rows.translation: 医生用手掩嘴轻咳，双颊涨得通红。“当、当然不信！别人问起你的事时，回答这个很常见，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe doctor coughs into her hand, her cheeks brightly flushed. “O-of course not-! It’s a common thing to answer when someone asks you about yourself, right?”"

rows.original: She proceeds to loudly slurp her tea. “...Right. So. More about me. I’m thirty-one - thankfully no wrinkles yet, though there’s a lot of pressure from my folks to have kids. I was mostly safe until last year - now they’re getting insistent.”
rows.translation: 随后她大声啜饮茶水。“...好。那么，再说点我的事。我三十一岁——幸好还没有皱纹，不过家人一直催我生孩子。去年以前基本还算安全——现在他们越来越坚持了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe proceeds to loudly slurp her tea. “...Right. So. More about me. I’m thirty-one - thankfully no wrinkles yet, though there’s a lot of pressure from my folks to have kids. I was mostly safe until last year - now they’re getting insistent.”"

rows.original: You ask if that means she’s fertile. She nods and brushes back her hair. “Yup. I’m that one in two. Every so often I get a letter from the government telling me ‘pregnancy is my patriotic duty’,” she pauses, then adds, “I’m not against kids, mind you. I just don’t want to do it for my country.”
rows.translation: 你问这是否意味着她有生育能力。她点头，将头发向后拨。“对，我是那二分之一。政府时不时会来信告诉我‘怀孕是我的爱国义务’。”她停顿片刻，补充道，“我并不反对要孩子，只是不想为了国家而生。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask if that means she’s fertile. She nods and brushes back her hair. “Yup. I’m that one in two. Every so often I get a letter from the government telling me ‘pregnancy is my patriotic duty’,” she pauses, then adds, “I’m not against kids, mind you. I just don’t want to do it for my country.”"

rows.original: “I don’t think that’s a fair reason to the child, or children. You should have kids because you want to, not because your country told you to.”
rows.translation: “我觉得这对孩子并不公平。你应该因为自己想要才生，而不是因为国家命令你生。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t think that’s a fair reason to the child, or children. You should have kids because you want to, not because your country told you to.”"

rows.original: You ask her about her hobbies and interests. She smiles and looks up at you with a gleam in her eyes.
rows.translation: 你询问她的爱好和兴趣。她微笑着抬眼看你，眼中闪着光。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her about her hobbies and interests. She smiles and looks up at you with a gleam in her eyes."

rows.original: “Bad movies. Good tea and cocktails. Music and dancing. That’s my list. Now you know every one of my weaknesses,” she quirks an eyebrow. “...So, you’re going to tell me all of yours, right?”
rows.translation: “烂电影、好茶和鸡尾酒、音乐与跳舞。清单就这些。现在你知道我所有弱点了。”她扬起眉毛。“...所以你也会告诉我你所有的弱点，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bad movies. Good tea and cocktails. Music and dancing. That’s my list. Now you know every one of my weaknesses,” she quirks an eyebrow. “...So, you’re going to tell me all of yours, right?”"

rows.original: The CMO pesters you until you cough up more about yourself, making sure the conversation is tit for tat.
rows.translation: 首席医疗官不断纠缠，直到你也说出更多自己的事情，确保这场交流有来有往。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe CMO pesters you until you cough up more about yourself, making sure the conversation is tit for tat."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Anzhela
rows.translation: 安热拉
rows.raw: "Anzhela"

rows.original: Ask her about herself.
rows.translation: 询问她自己的事。
rows.raw: "Ask her about herself."

rows.original: Her Past
rows.translation: 她的过去
rows.raw: "Her Past"

rows.original: You ask Anzhela about her past. You’re curious to know how she ended up as an army doctor on the front line.
rows.translation: 你询问安热拉的过去，很想知道她如何成为前线军医。
rows.raw: "You ask Anzhela about her past. You’re curious to know how she ended up as an army doctor on the front line."

rows.original: She taps the side of her teacup. “...It’s been a long series of events. I mean, I’m from Esarra, and we don’t have a lot of doctors that far north. It’s a small mining town where everyone knows each other.”
rows.translation: 她敲敲茶杯侧面。“...这是一连串漫长事件。我来自埃萨拉，北方那么远的地方没有多少医生。那是座人人相识的采矿小镇。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe taps the side of her teacup. “...It’s been a long series of events. I mean, I’m from Esarra, and we don’t have a lot of doctors that far north. It’s a small mining town where everyone knows each other.”"

rows.original: “My mother was a doctor and my father a nurse - their practice was attached to our house. I grew up seeing the injured walk through our doors and my parents fix them up.”
rows.translation: “母亲是医生，父亲是护士——他们的诊所连着我们家。我从小看着伤员走进家门，再被父母治好。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My mother was a doctor and my father a nurse - their practice was attached to our house. I grew up seeing the injured walk through our doors and my parents fix them up.”"

rows.original: “It was like magic to me - seeing my parents make people better and put a smile back on their faces. Pretty easy to see why I wanted to become a doctor, right?”
rows.translation: “对我来说就像魔法——看着父母让人恢复健康，让笑容重新回到他们脸上。不难看出我为什么想当医生，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It was like magic to me - seeing my parents make people better and put a smile back on their faces. Pretty easy to see why I wanted to become a doctor, right?”"

rows.original: Anzhela lets out a long sigh and looks up at the ceiling. “...I aced my tests and went to the capital to study medicine. I wanted to be a non-military doctor, but then the war started just as I graduated.”
rows.translation: 安热拉长叹一声，抬头望向天花板。“...我以优异成绩通过考试，前往首都学习医学。我想当非军方医生，但战争恰好在我毕业时爆发。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnzhela lets out a long sigh and looks up at the ceiling. “...I aced my tests and went to the capital to study medicine. I wanted to be a non-military doctor, but then the war started just as I graduated.”"

rows.original: “Only ex-military got a say in what happened then. I remember being so angry about it - I decided to join SCARMED for two reasons. One was to treat the many war-wounded that would need my help.”
rows.translation: “那时只有退伍军人有发言权。我记得自己非常愤怒——我决定加入SCARMED有两个原因。一是治疗许多需要帮助的战争伤员。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Only ex-military got a say in what happened then. I remember being so angry about it - I decided to join SCARMED for two reasons. One was to treat the many war-wounded that would need my help.”"

rows.original: “The second was to be able to vote. My parents, even though they were upstanding citizens valued by their community, could never vote or take public office simply because they weren’t veterans.”
rows.translation: “二是获得投票权。我的父母都是社区重视的正直公民，却只因为并非退伍军人，就永远不能投票或担任公职。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The second was to be able to vote. My parents, even though they were upstanding citizens valued by their community, could never vote or take public office simply because they weren’t veterans.”"

rows.original: “Maybe... maybe if more people had been able to vote...” the doctor shakes her head, “Sorry. None of that matters now, right? We are where we are.”
rows.translation: “也许...如果有更多人能够投票，也许...”医生摇摇头，“抱歉。现在说这些都没有意义，对吧？事情已经如此。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Maybe... maybe if more people had been able to vote...” the doctor shakes her head, “Sorry. None of that matters now, right? We are where we are.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Her Past
rows.translation: 她的过去
rows.raw: "Her Past"

rows.original: Ask her about her past.
rows.translation: 询问她的过去。
rows.raw: "Ask her about her past."

rows.original: Trench Wives
rows.translation: 战壕妻子
rows.raw: "Trench Wives"

rows.original: You ask Anzhela what she thinks of trench wives. She narrows her dark eyes.
rows.translation: 你询问安热拉对战壕妻子的看法。她眯起黑色眼睛。
rows.raw: "You ask Anzhela what she thinks of trench wives. She narrows her dark eyes."

rows.original: “...Medical slavery. Getting a woman hooked on your venom without consent and then getting her to be grateful for your drug after the fact. I’ve never, ever seen a gold myr who has been happy with being made a trench wife where the alternative was not being buried six feet under.”
rows.translation: “...医疗奴役。未经同意便让女人对毒液上瘾，然后让她事后对给药者感恩戴德。我从没见过哪个金色米尔人会乐意成为战壕妻子，除非另一条路是被埋到六英尺深的地下。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...Medical slavery. Getting a woman hooked on your venom without consent and then getting her to be grateful for your drug after the fact. I’ve never, ever seen a gold myr who has been happy with being made a trench wife where the alternative was not being buried six feet under.”"

rows.original: Wow. She has really strong opinions on trench wives. You ask her how High Command feels about her views?
rows.translation: 哇，她对战壕妻子的看法真的十分强烈。你问最高指挥部如何看待她的观点？
rows.raw: "\n\nWow. She has really strong opinions on trench wives. You ask her how High Command feels about her views?"

rows.original: Anzhela leans back and lets out a long, deep sigh. “...Thankfully, High Command is on the fence on the matter. It’s a double edged sword - they don’t support the practice, so I’m allowed to speak my mind, at least in private. At the same time, they don’t decry it, so it still keeps happening as a ‘necessary evil’.”
rows.translation: 安热拉靠回椅背，长长深叹。“...幸好最高指挥部对此保持中立。这是一把双刃剑——他们不支持这种做法，所以至少私下里允许我表达意见。与此同时，他们也不谴责，因此这种‘必要之恶’仍在继续。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnzhela leans back and lets out a long, deep sigh. “...Thankfully, High Command is on the fence on the matter. It’s a double edged sword - they don’t support the practice, so I’m allowed to speak my mind, at least in private. At the same time, they don’t decry it, so it still keeps happening as a ‘necessary evil’.”"

rows.original: “It’s a necessary evil that only happens to the beautiful soldiers, mind you. Everyone else who’s not beautiful or of proper age ends up either biting a bullet or sent to camps. Obviously the old and the extremely young - namely civilians caught during the invasion of a city - can’t become trench wives.”
rows.translation: “请注意，这种必要之恶只会发生在漂亮士兵身上。其他不漂亮或年龄不合适的人，要么挨枪子，要么被送进营地。老人和年龄极小的人——也就是入侵城市时被俘的平民——显然无法成为战壕妻子。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s a necessary evil that only happens to the beautiful soldiers, mind you. Everyone else who’s not beautiful or of proper age ends up either biting a bullet or sent to camps. Obviously the old and the extremely young - namely civilians caught during the invasion of a city - can’t become trench wives.”"

rows.original: “I would probably still get in trouble if it wasn’t for the fact I’ve saved so many lives and I’m the CMO.”
rows.translation: “若非我救过许多人，又担任首席医疗官，大概仍会因此惹上麻烦。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I would probably still get in trouble if it wasn’t for the fact I’ve saved so many lives and I’m the CMO.”"

rows.original: The scarlet haired doctor smiles and brushes back her hair. “Sorry. I - I really get worked up when people talk about trench wives. Usually I hold my tongue when it comes to my own people, but since you’re an off-worlder, I kind of exploded all at once.”
rows.translation: 红发医生微笑着向后拨开头发。“抱歉。我、我谈到战壕妻子时真的很容易激动。涉及自己人时，我通常会忍住不说，但因为你是外星人，我一下全爆发出来了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe scarlet haired doctor smiles and brushes back her hair. “Sorry. I - I really get worked up when people talk about trench wives. Usually I hold my tongue when it comes to my own people, but since you’re an off-worlder, I kind of exploded all at once.”"

rows.original: “It’s probably because every day I have privates bringing in their drugged-up trench wives, either because they’ve overdosed or not dosed up enough. They’re a lot less careful and use higher amounts of venom on the golds because they’re prisoners, not people.”
rows.translation: “大概是因为每天都有士兵把中了毒的战壕妻子送来，不是过量，就是药量不足。他们对金军远没有那么小心，还会使用更多毒液，因为在他们眼里，对方是囚犯而不是人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s probably because every day I have privates bringing in their drugged-up trench wives, either because they’ve overdosed or not dosed up enough. They’re a lot less careful and use higher amounts of venom on the golds because they’re prisoners, not people.”"

rows.original: “If the wife-keepers cared about them as much as they claim - and it was consensual - they’d not use the venom on them at all from the get go. Take a venom suppressant and not get them hooked in the first place,” she sadly smiles, “...I don’t see many women lining up for that option. They’re not ‘wives’, they’re ‘sex slaves’.”
rows.translation: “如果妻主真的像声称的那样关心她们——而且这一切出于自愿——一开始就根本不会对她们用毒。服用毒液抑制剂，别让她们上瘾。”她悲伤地笑了，“...可我没见多少女人排队选择这种办法。她们不是‘妻子’，而是‘性奴’。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“If the wife-keepers cared about them as much as they claim - and it was consensual - they’d not use the venom on them at all from the get go. Take a venom suppressant and not get them hooked in the first place,” she sadly smiles, “...I don’t see many women lining up for that option. They’re not ‘wives’, they’re ‘sex slaves’.”"

rows.original: You ask her about her venom. Surely she has a similar effect on the people she kisses?
rows.translation: 你询问她自己的毒液。她亲吻别人时肯定也会产生类似效果吧？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her about her venom. Surely she has a similar effect on the people she kisses?"

rows.original: Anzhela shakes her head. “I regularly take a venom suppressant. It’s considered strange by my people, but I want someone to be hooked on me for me, not my venom,” She smiles a little saucily and adds, “It also allows me to work on my technique.”
rows.translation: 安热拉摇头。“我会定期服用毒液抑制剂。族人觉得这很奇怪，但我希望别人迷恋的是我，而不是我的毒液。”她略显挑逗地微笑，补充道，“这也让我能锻炼自己的技巧。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnzhela shakes her head. “I regularly take a venom suppressant. It’s considered strange by my people, but I want someone to be hooked on me for me, not my venom,” She smiles a little saucily and adds, “It also allows me to work on my technique.”"

rows.original: “Those girls who rely on their venom get sloppy, you know, and not in the fun way. If I want a gold girl to stick around, I can make it happen.”
rows.translation: “依赖毒液的姑娘会变得马虎，你懂的，而且不是有趣的那种马虎。如果我想让某个金军姑娘留下，我自然能做到。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Those girls who rely on their venom get sloppy, you know, and not in the fun way. If I want a gold girl to stick around, I can make it happen.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Trench Wives
rows.translation: 战壕妻子
rows.raw: "Trench Wives"

rows.original: Ask her about her opinion on trench wives.
rows.translation: 询问她对战壕妻子的看法。
rows.raw: "Ask her about her opinion on trench wives."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: Once you’ve finished having a cup of scova with the doctor, you thank her for it, then tell her it’s probably time for you to take off.
rows.translation: 和医生喝完一杯斯科瓦后，你向她道谢，随后表示自己大概该离开了。
rows.raw: "Once you’ve finished having a cup of scova with the doctor, you thank her for it, then tell her it’s probably time for you to take off."

rows.original: “Already? Drat, and I was hoping I could pin you down a while longer. Now I’ve got to go back to work!” Anzhela jokes, standing up herself.

rows.original: You stay and soak in the tub for a little while longer. Now that you’re totally clean, you don’t have much to do in the private bath. You wonder if anyone other than you actually pays to bathe alone, as the bath was truly meant to fit a party. After mulling for a little while longer, you decide to leave the bath. The air chills your naked body as you step out of the waters warm embrace, and you scramble for the cloth towel you were given.
rows.translation: 你留下来，在浴池中又泡了一会儿。如今已彻底洗净，私人浴池里也没什么可做了。浴池本就是为一群人而建，你不禁好奇，除了自己，是否真有人会花钱独自沐浴。又思索片刻后，你决定离开。走出温暖池水的怀抱时，空气令赤裸的身体一阵发冷，你连忙伸手去拿配发的布巾。

rows.original: The woman smiles warmly at you, clasping her four arms in front of herself. “Of course. I am Matron Oserre, headmistress of the girls here. The pleasure of our guests is my responsibility.”
rows.translation: 女人温暖地笑着，将四条手臂交叠在身前。“当然。我是奥瑟尔主母，也是这里姑娘们的女主管。让客人愉悦是我的职责。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman smiles warmly at you, clasping her four arms in front of herself. “Of course. I am Matron Oserre, headmistress of the girls here. The pleasure of our guests is my responsibility.”"

rows.original: She sweeps an arm around the lobby in a grand gesture, as if to indicate the whole of the building and every soul within it. “This bath house is a sacred place to our order. Nowhere on Myrellion will you find a place like it, so close to the scalding source of the hot springs beneath us, and so overseen by an order of maidens dedicated to the pleasure and service of those who wish to cleanse themselves in body and spirit.”
rows.translation: 她气势十足地挥臂环指大厅，仿佛要将整座建筑与其中每个人都纳入手势之中。“这座浴场是我们教团的圣地。在整个米瑞利昂，再也找不到如此接近地下滚烫温泉源头的地方，也找不到另一个由一群献身于愉悦与服侍、帮助客人净化身心的少女所管理的场所。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe sweeps an arm around the lobby in a grand gesture, as if to indicate the whole of the building and every soul within it. “This bath house is a sacred place to our order. Nowhere on Myrellion will you find a place like it, so close to the scalding source of the hot springs beneath us, and so overseen by an order of maidens dedicated to the pleasure and service of those who wish to cleanse themselves in body and spirit.”"

rows.original: Spiritual cleansing? “This order of yours is religious?”
rows.translation: 净化灵魂？“你们这个教团是宗教组织吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nSpiritual cleansing? “This order of yours is religious?”"

rows.original: “Spiritual,” the matron gently corrects. “We have been custodians of this spring for several centuries. Our order teaches us that in the same way that the body accumulates dirt and grime in the harshness of life, so too does the spirit accumulate a growing darkness over time. We must wash away the grime that gathers on the soul, don’t you think? My sisters and I exist to provide you and any who come through our doors with that cleansing: of the body, of course, but each of us is trained in many, many ways to impart spiritual quiescence upon those who call upon us.”
rows.translation: “是灵修组织，”主母柔声纠正道。“几个世纪以来，我们一直守护着这眼温泉。教义告诉我们：正如肉体会在艰苦生活中积累尘垢，灵魂也会随时间积累愈发深重的黑暗。我们必须洗去汇聚在灵魂上的污秽，你不觉得吗？我和姐妹们存在的意义，就是为你以及任何走进这里的人提供这种净化：当然包括身体，但我们每个人也都接受过多方面的训练，能以许许多多种方式，让召唤我们的客人获得灵魂的安宁。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Spiritual,” the matron gently corrects. “We have been custodians of this spring for several centuries. Our order teaches us that in the same way that the body accumulates dirt and grime in the harshness of life, so too does the spirit accumulate a growing darkness over time. We must wash away the grime that gathers on the soul, don’t you think? My sisters and I exist to provide you and any who come through our doors with that cleansing: of the body, of course, but each of us is trained in many, many ways to impart spiritual quiescence upon those who call upon us.”"

rows.original: Matron Oserre ends that thought with a decidedly sultry note, and the slight movements of her insectile arms draw your gaze to the tremendous swells of her honey-swollen bosom. Something tells you these “spiritual cleansings” on offer are going to involve you getting a very happy ending.
rows.translation: 奥瑟尔主母以明显撩人的语调结束这番话，她的昆虫手臂轻轻移动，将你的视线引向那对被蜜汁涨得硕大无比的乳峰。直觉告诉你，这里提供的“灵魂净化”会让你迎来非常快乐的结局。
rows.raw: "\n\nMatron Oserre ends that thought with a decidedly sultry note, and the slight movements of her insectile arms draw your gaze to the tremendous swells of her honey-swollen bosom. Something tells you these “spiritual cleansings” on offer are going to involve you getting a very happy ending."

rows.original: After giving you a moment to mull that over, Oserre continues, “We offer many services here, of course, and ask nothing more for them than a small donation to help us ensure the house remains in pristine condition for many centuries to come. The most common is the use of the public bath: there’s nothing truly special about that service beyond access to the hot springs, and the company of several dozen young women also enjoying our service. You can also ask for a private bath, of which we have several, if you prefer your privacy... or the company of one of my sisters in the order, who can perform her cleansing arts upon you. If your spirit is particularly heavy, several members of the house may tend to you at once...”
rows.translation: 奥瑟尔给你片刻时间思考，随后继续说道：“当然，我们这里提供许多服务，所求的不过是一笔小小捐款，以便确保这座浴场在未来许多个世纪里始终保持完美状态。最常见的是使用公共浴池：除了能享用温泉，以及与几十位同样享受服务的年轻女性相伴，确实没有什么特殊之处。若你偏爱清静，也可以申请使用我们几座私人浴池中的一座...或者请教团的一位姐妹作陪，让她对你施展净化技艺。如果你的灵魂格外沉重，浴场的几位成员可以同时照料你...”
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter giving you a moment to mull that over, Oserre continues, “We offer many services here, of course, and ask nothing more for them than a small donation to help us ensure the house remains in pristine condition for many centuries to come. The most common is the use of the public bath: there’s nothing truly special about that service beyond access to the hot springs, and the company of several dozen young women also enjoying our service. You can also ask for a private bath, of which we have several, if you prefer your privacy... or the company of one of my sisters in the order, who can perform her cleansing arts upon you. If your spirit is particularly heavy, several members of the house may tend to you at once...”"

rows.original: “You’re looking healthy and brimming with that distinct do-as-you-please attitude of yours,” Ara Kei says with a dry, not unfriendly curl of the lip. rows.translation: “你看起来气色不错，身上依旧洋溢着那股想做什么就做什么的独特劲头，”阿拉·凯嘴角一弯，语气淡淡的，却并无恶意。当[ara.his]那双硕大黑眼睛从你身上移开，重新望向[ara.him]周围的忙碌景象时，你发现自己终于呼出一口气。成为这位博斯里奥克大使唯一关注的对象，总让人隐隐不安。

rows.original: “That’s what I thought. You’re afraid. I understand, but you have no reason to fear. Let me show you something.” Ara Kei takes hold of your shoulders, hugging you close with both arms on that side as you’re turned to get a good look at the harem busily maintaining the embassy. It’s always a slight shock that bothrioc aren’t actually cold, for all that chitin. Ara Kei is as warm as anyone else, though you can’t quite place what [ara.his] scent is.
rows.translation: “果然如此。你在害怕。我能理解，但你没有理由恐惧。让我给你看样东西。”阿拉·凯抓住你的肩膀，用同侧两条手臂把你紧紧抱住，再将你转过去，好好看看忙着维持使馆运作的后宫成员。尽管披着甲壳，博斯里奥克其实并不冰冷，这一点每次都多少令人意外。阿拉·凯和其他人一样温暖，只是你说不上[ara.his]身上究竟是什么气味。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s what I thought. You’re afraid. I understand, but you have no reason to fear. Let me show you something.” Ara Kei takes hold of your shoulders, hugging you close with both arms on that side as you’re turned to get a good look at the harem busily maintaining the embassy. It’s always a slight shock that bothrioc aren’t actually cold, for all that chitin. Ara Kei is as warm as anyone else, though you can’t quite place what [ara.his] scent is."

rows.original: “Do you see this harem, Steele? They are my pride and joy. I love them more than life itself. They perform admirably at whatever I ask and I in turn provide for them. Master and servants are two halves to a whole, any sane dominatrix you meet will agree. What I’m trying to say is that you’re not losing yourself. They all can live healthy lives under me, and I’m sure when you find yours they’ll cherish you as I would.” After a moment, Ara Kei releases you. “Now, Steele. Do you understand my point?” You nod, slowly. “Good. Are you still afraid?” After some deliberation, you answer noncommittally. “We shall see what the future holds, then. Is there anything you need?”
rows.translation: “你看见这座后宫了吗，斯蒂尔？她们是我的骄傲与喜悦。我爱她们胜过自己的生命。她们出色地完成我的每一项要求，而我则负责供养她们。主人与仆从是一个整体的两半，任何神志正常的女支配者都会同意。我想说的是，你并没有失去自我。她们都能在我手下过上健康的生活；而当你找到自己的主人，我相信对方也会像我一样珍爱你。”片刻后，阿拉·凯放开了你。“那么，斯蒂尔。你明白我的意思了吗？”你缓缓点头。“很好。你还害怕吗？”你思量片刻，给出模棱两可的回答。“那么，就让我们看看未来会发生什么吧。你有什么需要吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Do you see this harem, Steele? They are my pride and joy. I love them more than life itself. They perform admirably at whatever I ask and I in turn provide for them. Master and servants are two halves to a whole, any sane dominatrix you meet will agree. What I’m trying to say is that you’re not losing yourself. They all can live healthy lives under me, and I’m sure when you find yours they’ll cherish you as I would.” After a moment, Ara Kei releases you. “Now, Steele. Do you understand my point?” You nod, slowly. “Good. Are you still afraid?” After some deliberation, you answer noncommittally. “We shall see what the future holds, then. Is there anything you need?”"

rows.original: “That’s enough,” says Ara Kei at length, and your flow immediately freezes. There’s a hardness to [ara.his] tone that slices straight through your blissful little cloud. “Amongst my people Steele, there are those who use the gift for more than shared happiness. Inveigle others into their harem before forcing them into mines, or prostitute them to nyrea. Such dommes, if they are discovered by other dommes, are killed, or driven far away. Far away, to a shack on the fringes of a failed world, perhaps. I do not know exactly how this Lane individual has developed a hold on you, Steele, but they bear you nothing but ill-will.”
rows.translation: “够了，”许久后，阿拉·凯说道，你的话流顿时冻结。[ara.his]语气中的冷硬划破了你那片幸福的小小云端。“斯蒂尔，在我的人民中，有些人利用这份馈赠谋求的远不止共享幸福。他们诱骗他人加入后宫，随后逼迫其下矿，或把他们卖给尼瑞亚卖淫。这种女主人一旦被其他女主人发现，就会遭到杀害，或被驱逐到遥远之地。或许是一个失败世界边缘的小屋，远得不能再远。我不清楚这个叫莱恩的人究竟如何控制了你，斯蒂尔，但对方对你只有恶意。”

rows.original: Lane? Ill-will? That’s nonsense. You love Lane and Lane loves you... but if the bothrioc dominant is saying something different, and with such emphasis... your brain feels like it’s going to burst. A small, animal sound of distress reaches your ears, and it takes you a groggy moment to realize it came from your own lips.
rows.translation: 莱恩？恶意？这太荒唐了。你爱莱恩，莱恩也爱你...可这位博斯里奥克强势者却如此斩钉截铁地说着另一套话...你的脑袋仿佛就要炸开。耳边传来一声野兽般微弱的痛苦哀鸣，你昏沉了片刻，才意识到那声音出自自己的嘴。

rows.original: “Yes Steele,” Ara Kei insists, and more agony knives into your skull. “I know it hurts, but sometimes pain is essential. I will not have you give yourself to this insidious, self-enriching parasite anymore. I DEMAND that, as your better and mentor. Do you understand?”

rows.original: It is rare for the sunny sensuality of being Treated to conflict with the calm, submissive peace of being an egg slut, but it does now. rows.original: “My word,” hoots Ara Kei, gleaming black glove to [ara.his] mouth, “what people. What paradises are built, what decadence is achieved when you have millennia of peace and elegant machines to do all the thinking for you! My main worry about an unattached incubator is a lack of focus; however I doubt even with the sternest of masters you would be particularly focused anyway. rows.raw: "\n\n“My word,” hoots Ara Kei, gleaming black glove to [ara.his] mouth, “what people. My main worry about an unattached incubator is a lack of focus; however I doubt even with the sternest of masters you would be particularly focused anyway. You cannot tell me that there’s no-one out there that isn’t willing to crack a whip and pump you full of eggs from time to time, because I know it isn’t true. I gave you an order, and now you truly are what you are, you know what that means, don’t you?”

rows.original: “I’m still not interested, Steele,” says Ara Kei with a wry smile, before you even open your mouth. “I know, after all you’ve done for us, and all that you have learned! But your knowledge of us is all in your brain, not in your soul. Not sunken into your skin. There are other ways of learning than merely observing, and still you do not submit to them. Until you have - no. I am far too busy, anyway.”
rows.translation: “我还是没兴趣，斯蒂尔，”你甚至还没开口，阿拉·凯便带着挖苦的微笑说道。“我知道，你为我们做了那么多，也学到了那么多！可你对我们的了解全在脑子里，不在灵魂中，也没有渗入皮肤。除了单纯观察，还有其他学习方式，可你仍不肯向它们屈服。在你真正屈服之前——不行。况且，我实在太忙了。”

rows.raw: "Ara Kei Enya is easily seven feet tall standing, but is currently squatted down amongst four relatively thin and nimble legs, serenely passing on orders to [ara.hisHer] many underlings. The legs end in feet that are like some sort of chitinous boot. It is segmented and jointed, but has the overall shapes of toe, ball, instep, and heel that you’re familiar with. It is a heeled boot thanks to an upward bite of the chitin, you’d hazard an adaptation for resting comfortably on a web. The chitin in question is black, but under the gas lamps that seem to be preferred in the bothrioc office, it shimmers with deep blue tones. A gauzy, elegant gray shift drapes down from the creature’s upper shoulders down to four gleaming thighs."

rows.original: The face is pale with an angular look to it that suggests predatory intent and is framed by long, loose pale-blue hair neatly tucked behind chitin-shelled ears. Not far behind the hairline is a pair of firm, unbending antennae. There aren’t any eyebrows, merely a ridge where you feel like they should be. Beneath that ridge are a pair of eyes that are slightly larger than human standard, but pulled tight. Somewhat unexpectedly, they do have eyelashes atop actual eyelids. The eyes, however, are black as pitch, the particular shade which makes it hard to identify their shape and depth. There’s nothing breaking up the distance between eyes and mouth. The distance isn’t quite as vast as it would normally be if there was a nose, which seems to be largely due to how big the eyes and mouth are. The mouth is thin, seemingly permanently compressed or pursed, but it is wide, and when Ara Kei speaks it splits open hugely, revealing a massive set of teeth and a long tongue.
rows.translation: 那张苍白而棱角分明的脸透着捕食者气息，松散的淡蓝长发整齐拢在甲壳包覆的耳后。发际线后方不远处立着一对坚硬笔直的触角。脸上没有眉毛，只有本该长眉的位置隆起一道脊。脊下的双眼略大于人类标准，却收得狭长。出人意料的是，真正的眼睑上还长着睫毛。然而那双眼漆黑如墨，黑得让人难以分辨形状与深度。眼睛与嘴之间没有任何结构阻隔；因为眼与嘴都很大，这段没有鼻子的距离倒不像平常那样宽阔。嘴唇纤薄，仿佛永远紧抿着，却十分宽大；阿拉·凯开口时，嘴会大幅裂开，露出满口巨齿与一条长舌。

Not far behind the hairline is a pair of firm, unbending antennae. There aren’t any eyebrows, merely a ridge where you feel like they should be. Beneath that ridge are a pair of eyes that are slightly larger than human standard, but pulled tight. Somewhat unexpectedly, they do have eyelashes atop actual eyelids. The eyes, however, are black as pitch, the particular shade which makes it hard to identify their shape and depth. There’s nothing breaking up the distance between eyes and mouth. The distance isn’t quite as vast as it would normally be if there was a nose, which seems to be largely due to how big the eyes and mouth are. The mouth is thin, seemingly permanently compressed or pursed, but it is wide, and when Ara Kei speaks it splits open hugely, revealing a massive set of teeth and a long tongue."

rows.original: Behind the pair of legs not facing you is the quadomme’s abdomen; at least as big as a gold myr’s, it is clad entirely in black, pliable latex-like chitin. The bothrioc could be described as toned, in the small expanse of stomach that is snow-white skin rather than chitin, unlike the rest of the lower body. Even that gives the impression of someone tuned for combat by genetics rather than training, however.
rows.translation: 四足型的腹部位于背向你的那对腿之后，至少与金米尔的一样大，完全覆盖着黑色、柔韧而如乳胶般的甲壳。除下半身其余部位外，博斯里奥克腹部有一小片雪白皮肤而非甲壳，看上去肌肉紧实。即便如此，那也给人一种由遗传而非训练塑造成战斗体质的感觉。

rows.original: “Farlanders are full of surprises. The myr tend to think of us as female, given their cultural obsession with the idea of female power. Perhaps the men are the powerful ones where you’re from, hm? Perhaps... ah, well, allow me to reintroduce myself. I am Ara Kei Enya. I am the master of this harem, and the ambassador of the bothrioc before the entire galaxy. My goal is to drag my species kicking and screaming into the light of civilization.”

rows.original: “That’s quite alright, let me help you settle the issue. Observe.” The delicate gray shift draped about Ara Kei’s wide hips is gently pulled aside by one of the lower arms, revealing a completely featureless, hairless mound, topped by a chitin plate that smoothly separates the legs. No genitals. At all. “There, see? Bothrioc don’t have genders or any of the charming parts that accompany them. We have a cloaca and an ovipositor, which makes us functional hermaphrodites. You’ll forgive my modesty if I don’t show them to you without even knowing your name, stranger. Has that helped you land upon an appropriate pronoun? Do let me know what you think it is. I always find it fascinating.”
rows.translation: “没关系，让我帮你解决这个问题。看好了。”一条下臂轻轻拨开披在阿拉·凯宽阔髋部上的精致灰色罩衣，露出一片完全平坦、没有毛发的隆起，顶部覆盖着一块将双腿平滑分隔开的甲壳板。完全没有生殖器。“看见了吗？博斯里奥克没有性别，也没有伴随性别而来的那些迷人部位。我们有泄殖腔与产卵器，因此在功能上属于雌雄同体。陌生人，在连你的名字都不知道时，我不愿向你展示它们，请原谅我的矜持。这能帮你选定合适的代词了吗？请告诉我你的看法。我向来觉得这很有趣。”

Observe.” The delicate gray shift draped about Ara Kei’s wide hips is gently pulled aside by one of the lower arms, revealing a completely featureless, hairless mound, topped by a chitin plate that smoothly separates the legs. rows.original: “Effective, isn’t it? Don’t worry, I’m not going to fill your head with lies, nor stuff your belly with spawn. Our reproductive system is unique though, and I readily admit is an easy source of fascination and revulsion.” The four-legged bothrioc makes a sweeping gesture that takes in everyone in the embassy. “As you can see, we all have an abdomen at the base of our torso. That is the ovipositor. It creates eggs and a fertilizing oil. We exchange the oil to fertilize eggs, and then plant the eggs in another’s orifices using the tube. Usually this is an intra-bothrioc matter, but we’re quite capable of both implanting in and being fertilized by others. That is where the fear and fascination a boogieman needs is sourced.”
rows.translation: “很有效，对吧？别担心，我不会往你脑中灌满谎言，也不会往你肚里塞满后代。不过我们的生殖系统确实独特，我也坦然承认，它很容易引发迷恋与厌恶。”四足的博斯里奥克用一个大幅手势指向大使馆里的所有人。“如你所见，我们躯干底部都有一个腹部，那就是产卵器。它会制造卵和受精油。我们交换油液使卵受精，再用管状器官把卵植入他人的孔洞。通常这是博斯里奥克内部的事情，但我们完全能给其他种族植卵，也能由其他种族使我们受精。梦魇所需的恐惧与迷恋，正来源于此。”

rows.original: Ara Kei coos down at the dutiful harem member still polishing [ara.his] leg chitin to a gleaming shine, pointing out a few spots that need special attention. “We can put life in barren soil, but to the other species, that life is alien. We can be a mother where mothers are slim, and a father where the inverse is true. However, because it doesn’t have their genes and their eggs it is somehow not theirs when they bear it. There would probably be a strong tendency to abandon our young if not for the other little peculiarity of our breeding.”
rows.translation: 阿拉·凯朝仍在尽职舔亮[ara.his]腿部甲壳的后宫成员发出柔声，指出几处需要特别照料的位置。“我们能让贫瘠土壤孕育生命，但对其他种族而言，那生命属于异族。我们可以在母亲稀少之处成为母亲，也能在相反的地方成为父亲。然而，因为后代没有他们的基因，也不是他们的卵，即便由他们孕育，似乎也不算属于他们。若非我们的繁殖还有另一个小特点，他们大概会强烈倾向于抛弃我们的幼体。”

We can be a mother where mothers are slim, and a father where the inverse is true. However, because it doesn’t have their genes and their eggs it is somehow not theirs when they bear it. There would probably be a strong tendency to abandon our young if not for the other little peculiarity of our breeding.”"

The look Ara Kei gives him is nothing short of venomous, and all the more backed up by the incredible chitinous physiology on display.
rows.translation: 房间另一边，那名忙着把文件山削成小丘的姜发人类拖长声吹了个口哨，显然是在说“重头戏来了”。阿拉·凯投向他的目光简直充满毒意，再配上眼前展现的惊人甲壳生理结构，威慑力更加强烈。

rows.original: “Yes,” sighs Ara Kei theatrically, “this is what has us classed by your thinking machines as not merely dangerous, but to be avoided at all costs. Our fertilizing slime has a variety of hormones in it. They serve to signal a bothrioc in submission that their time as a dominant is through. Their abdomens begin to swell more with fertile oil than eggs, that we may bathe larger batches of eggs in it, before depositing them. In species with biological sexes, it is feminizing, as the trigger to change to fertilization production is the same hormone mixture that turns girls into women. The real prize, however, is that it brings them to love their role as an incubator and to be naturally led by the dominant partners. It also tends to make them a bit absent-minded. If you watch closely, it takes my lovely harem here a good deal of concentration to handle all of this paperwork.”
rows.translation: “没错，”阿拉·凯夸张地叹息，“这正是你们的思考机器把我们列为不只是危险，而且必须不惜一切代价回避的原因。我们的受精黏液含有多种激素，能向处于顺从状态的博斯里奥克发出信号，表明其作为支配者的时期已经结束。腹部会开始积蓄更多可育油液而非卵，好让我们在植入大批卵之前，用油液浸泡它们。对于存在生理性别的物种，这会产生女性化效果，因为触发身体转而生产受精液的，正是令女孩变成女人的同一种激素混合物。不过真正的成果，是让他们爱上孵化器的职责，自然地听从支配伴侣的引导。这也往往会让他们有些健忘。仔细观察就会发现，我可爱的后宫成员需要十分集中精力，才能处理所有这些文书。”

rows.original: At [ara.his] invitation, you take in the harem a bit more closely. Charles is sharp and on tack, but the bothrioc around the place are, while certainly seemingly competent, also working very hard to be. One bothrioc is filling out forms with a tongue stuck out and their face inches from the paper, contorted in concentration. Another, seeming lost in thought, is gently pulled toward a back room while another is brought in to take their place. Ara Kei regards [ara.his] harem warmly.
rows.translation: 应[ara.his]邀请，你更加仔细地观察这座后宫。查尔斯头脑敏锐、做事利落；这里的博斯里奥克虽然显然也很能干，却必须付出极大努力才能维持。一名博斯里奥克吐着舌头填写表格，脸几乎贴在纸上，神情因专注而扭曲。另一名似乎陷入沉思，被轻轻拉向后室，另一人则被带来接替位置。阿拉·凯温暖地注视[ara.his]后宫。

Charles is sharp and on tack, but the bothrioc around the place are, while certainly seemingly competent, also working very hard to be. One bothrioc is filling out forms with a tongue stuck out and their face inches from the paper, contorted in concentration. Another, seeming lost in thought, is gently pulled toward a back room while another is brought in to take their place. Ara Kei regards [ara.his] harem warmly."

rows.original: “You see, the impression is that our oil makes you stupid. No, that is not the case. Rather, your priorities are reoriented, and between our love and our oil, you come to love your new place in life, to the point of excluding most other cares or concerns. My darlings are working so hard because this is important to me, and they wouldn’t be motivated by anything less.” This last statement is accompanied by an encompassing gesture of [ara.his] arms.
rows.translation: “你看，别人以为我们的油会让你变笨。不，并非如此。只是你的优先事项会重新排列；在我们的爱与油液作用下，你会爱上人生中的新位置，甚至排除大部分其他关切。我亲爱的人们如此努力，是因为这件事对我很重要；换作任何较轻的理由，都无法激励他们。”最后这句话伴随着[ara.his]双臂环指四周的动作。

Rather, your priorities are reoriented, and between our love and our oil, you come to love your new place in life, to the point of excluding most other cares or concerns. My darlings are working so hard because this is important to me, and they wouldn’t be motivated by anything less.” This last statement is accompanied by an encompassing gesture of [ara.his] arms."

rows.original: Turning [ara.his] gaze once more to you, Ara Kei adds, “And that is what you are told to fear. You see me before you, and I don’t attack you, or try to deceive you. However, the rules in the caverns we call home are not the ones I have embraced here, in order to state our case. Down there, the pidemmes and quadommes still consider any wanderer fair game. Consider that the real warning.”
rows.translation: 阿拉·凯再次把[ara.his]目光转向你，又补充道：“而这正是别人告诉你要恐惧的东西。你看见我站在面前，我没有攻击你，也没有试图欺骗你。然而，为陈述我们的立场，我在这里接受的规则并不适用于我们称作家园的洞穴。下面的双足型和四足型仍把任何游荡者都视作合理猎物。把这当成真正的警告吧。”

rows.original: on in louder tones. “When your U.G.C. first stepped down from the stars to greet us, I was at first elated, and not just because they postponed the myr destroying the world. Here, at last, was an opportunity to get my race equal representation on Myrellion - to speak for our needs and wishes, instead of living forever in helpless fear of what the myr might do next. For surely if I presented our plight to these enlightened beings, they would help us?”

rows.original: “Alas. It turns out aliens are turned just as cruel by bureaucracy and ulterior motive as the myr are. Did you know that your U.G.C’s legal protections for planetary sovereignty doesn’t merely require sapience? Merely existing and thinking do not satisfy the requirements for citizenship in this galaxy; it also requires a demonstration that the species has contributed meaningfully to the planet, through cultural or technological innovation. They tell me this clause exists to prevent warlike and savage species from being uplifted before they are capable of integration. From my brief exposure to this Xenogen organization and their fur-thing friends, however, I suspect the real reason is that it allows for the casual exploitation of races who are helpless to resist. Is that an unfair assumption to make, starwalker?”
rows.translation: “可惜，事实证明，异星人也会像米尔一样被官僚制度与隐藏动机变得残酷。你知道吗？你们星系联合政府对行星主权的法律保护，并不只要求智慧生命存在。单纯存在和思考不足以满足银河公民身份的要求；还必须证明该物种通过文化或技术创新，为行星作出了有意义的贡献。他们告诉我，这项条款旨在防止好战野蛮的种族在具备融入能力前得到提升。但从我与异种基因组织及其毛茸茸朋友的短暂接触来看，我怀疑真正的原因，是它让人能够随意剥削无力反抗的种族。星行者，这种推测不公平吗？”

Did you know that your U.G.C’s legal protections for planetary sovereignty doesn’t merely require sapience? rows.original: “Unfortunately, the bothrioc’s very nature means we have extremely little to show for our long history, and the myr leadership will not hesitate to see us bereft of those protections. Therefore, I am the ambassador for my people out of a necessity of which most aren’t even aware. Oh, if I could make them see how precarious it all is, that would surely unite them like nothing ever has.”
rows.translation: “不幸的是，博斯里奥克的本性意味着我们漫长历史中几乎没有可供展示的成果，而米尔领导层绝不会迟疑于让我们失去那些保护。因此，我出于大多数族人甚至毫不知情的必要性，成为了他们的大使。哦，要是我能让他们看清这一切有多岌岌可危，那一定能以前所未有的方式团结他们。”

rows.original: “Even before the farlanders arrived, I - that is to say, me and my harem - collected and scoured the records of both sets of myr, tracking down every single mention of our race that we could find. It has been fascinating - and incredibly frustrating.” A single index finger is pointed downwards. With a sigh of pleasure, the tongue polisher envelops it in their mouth. Ara Kei’s attention and fervency are entirely directed at you. “It is like a single bright thread woven into a vast garment, constantly disappearing from sight, reappearing where you wouldn’t expect - but definitively there. We had empires, you know. Bothrioc sometimes stood at the head of red myr armies. Some legends even had them as kings to gold myr queens. But it’s all so vague, so often contradictory, because of course the myr do not often waste print talking about us. WE are not THEY. Ah!”
rows.translation: “早在异乡人抵达之前，我；准确地说，是我和我的后宫；就开始收集并仔细查阅红、金两方米尔的记录，追查所有能找到的对我族的记载。这个过程非常迷人；也令人难以置信地沮丧。”一根食指向下指出。舔舐者满足地叹息，把它含入口中。阿拉·凯的注意力与热忱则完全投向你。“那就像一根织进巨大衣物的明亮丝线，不断消失于视野，又在意想不到之处重现；但它确实存在。我们曾拥有帝国。博斯里奥克有时统领红米尔军队；有些传说甚至把他们写成金米尔女王的国王。但一切都如此模糊，又经常相互矛盾，因为米尔当然很少浪费纸墨谈论我们。我们不是他们。啊！”

rows.original: “My people! So assured that they would forever be the top pods on Myrellion that they never even noticed the myr building, and developing, and growing, until their factories and palaces were being built right on top of them. Now the myr are bent on destroying the world, a world that we happen to be on, but have no say in the running of. I will not have it, Steele.”
rows.translation: “我的族人！他们确信自己会永远是迈瑞利恩最顶尖的产卵者，甚至没注意到米尔不断建设、发展、壮大，直到工厂与宫殿直接盖到他们头顶。如今米尔执意要毁灭世界，而我们恰好也生活在这个世界上，却对其治理毫无发言权。我绝不接受，斯蒂尔。”

Now the myr are bent on destroying the world, a world that we happen to be on, but have no say in the running of. I will not have it, Steele.” "

rows.original: a stern, spit-polished finger at you, as if you had disagreed. “The work I am doing here will prove the bothrioc are a distinct culture - one that deserves to be recognized and given a say in how this planet is developed. We shall not wallow in ignorance and shy away from the light, as the wetraxxal and the ganrael do; nor shall we bend our knees to the Federation, as some of the nyrea have chosen. We shall come to the galactic table on our own terms, as a result of our own hard work, with our heads held high!”

rows.original: “Got a soft spot a mile wide, haven’t I,” he replies with an affable shrug. “These people are doomed, all uvvem, unless we can get them ant lasses to give up their nooks. The more offworlders there are doon here, workin’ with the locals, the less likely things are gonna kick off. Even the most fanatic gold ‘n red leaders know killin’ farlanders is probably a bad idea.”
rows.translation: “我就是心太软，”他和善地耸耸肩回答。“除非能让那些蚂蚁姑娘放弃老窝，否则这里所有人都完蛋了。在下面与当地人合作的异乡人越多，事情爆发的可能性就越小。就连最狂热的金、红双方领袖也明白，杀死异乡人大概不是好主意。”

rows.original: “Every planet in the Rush’s gotty race like this,” the human says, gesturing at the room full of black-and-white arachnid people. “Some poor bastards who aren’t quite advanced enough, or weren’t in the right spot when the flyin’ saucers landed, so don’t get to be the U.G.C.’s favored sons ‘n daughters. Usually they get the absolute shite exploited out of ‘em by the corporations, scooped up by the thousands to be taken to gene labs, private zoos and knockin’ shops whilst their homes get built over by whoever the winners were. I ain’t gonny let that happen to the bothrioc. They’ve got a chance, see: A leader with a plan, who can talk to the U.G.C. in their own bureaucratese.”
rows.translation: “开拓区的每颗星球都有这种种族，”人类指向满屋黑白相间的蛛形人。“一些可怜人不够先进，或是飞碟降落时没待在正确地点，于是没能成为星系联合政府偏爱的子民。通常他们会被企业榨干价值，成千上万地抓去基因实验室、私人动物园和妓院，而家园则被胜利者覆盖建设。我不会让这种事发生在博斯里奥克身上。他们还有机会：他们有一位怀抱计划、又能用星系联合政府官僚语言交流的领袖。”

rows.original: “Yeah.” Charles stops writing for a moment to compose his thoughts. “It’s just the way they are. I don’t go in for their egg stuff, right? I prefer dealin’ with people as an equal. For the bothrioc though, bein’ equal is a bit like sufferin’. Like... bein’ in limbo, not knowin’ what you should be doing. So though I’ve made alluv that clear to Ara, she basically thinks I’m makin’ myself miserable for no reason. If only I went down into the caves and found meself a nice lass to shove her ovipositor up me jacksie... so yeah. Tragic.”
rows.translation: “对。”查尔斯停笔片刻，整理思绪。“他们天性如此。我不参与那些卵的事情，对吧？我更喜欢与人平等相处。但对博斯里奥克而言，平等有点像受苦。就像...悬在半空，不知道自己该做什么。所以，即使我已经向阿拉把一切说清楚，她还是觉得我毫无理由地折磨自己。要是我肯下到洞穴里，找个好姑娘把产卵器塞进我屁股...所以没错。悲悯。”
