rows.translation: 阿拉·凯
rows.raw: "Ara Kei"

rows.original: Ask him about the chief bothrioc.
rows.translation: 向他询问博斯里奥克首领。
rows.raw: "Ask him about the chief bothrioc."

rows.original: Fix?
rows.translation: 治疗？
rows.raw: "Fix?"

rows.original: “So - you have some sort of cure to bothrioc hormones?” you ask.
rows.translation: “所以；你有某种抵消博斯里奥克激素的解药？”你问。
rows.raw: "“So - you have some sort of cure to bothrioc hormones?” you ask."

rows.original: “Ehh, nothin’ as cut and dried as that, I’m afraid,” replies Charles, drawing his chair back to get at his bureau’s drawers. “But the myr do make this stuff - ‘Curdsonwhey’, they call it - which fights off the mental effects. Tae stop their males walkin’ off in a dream with the first bothrioc they happen tae meet, y’know.” He withdraws a medicinal bottle full of old-fashioned, oblong pills and stands it on the desk. “Two things though, mate. This stuff ain’t cheap. It’s made from sum rare as hell cave fungus, but more tae the point the golds I get it from really don’t want me to have it. On account of me workin’ in here, ‘n probably helpin’ the head spider witch there to brew up a counter to it. So I am chargin’ a premium for it, I’m afraid.”
rows.translation: “呃，恐怕没那么简单明确，”查尔斯回答，把椅子往后拉，好打开写字台抽屉。“不过米尔确实会制造这种东西；他们叫它‘凝乳乳清’；能抵抗精神影响。是为了防止他们的男性如梦游般跟着遇到的第一个博斯里奥克走掉，你懂吧。”他取出一个装满老式长圆药片的药瓶，放在桌上。“不过有两件事，伙计。这东西不便宜。它用一种稀有得要命的洞穴真菌制成；更关键的是，把药卖给我的金米尔真的不想让我拿到它。因为我在这里工作，而且大概正帮那边的蜘蛛女巫首领研制对抗药。所以恐怕我要收高价。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ehh, nothin’ as cut and dried as that, I’m afraid,” replies Charles, drawing his chair back to get at his bureau’s drawers. “But the myr do make this stuff - ‘Curdsonwhey’, they call it - which fights off the mental effects. Tae stop their males walkin’ off in a dream with the first bothrioc they happen tae meet, y’know.” He withdraws a medicinal bottle full of old-fashioned, oblong pills and stands it on the desk. “Two things though, mate. This stuff ain’t cheap. It’s made from sum rare as hell cave fungus, but more tae the point the golds I get it from really don’t want me to have it. On account of me workin’ in here, ‘n probably helpin’ the head spider witch there to brew up a counter to it. So I am chargin’ a premium for it, I’m afraid.”"

rows.original: He shakes a few lozenges out onto the wood and picks one up, looking you in the eye.
rows.translation: 他把几枚药片摇到木桌上，拿起一枚，直视你的眼睛。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe shakes a few lozenges out onto the wood and picks one up, looking you in the eye."

rows.original: “Second thing. It stops workin’ well after a certain point. You keep goin’ down to the caves and enjoyin’ the glow, it’ll have a permanent effect on you regardless of how many o’ these you take. And eventually... you won’t be able to take ‘em anyway.”
rows.translation: “第二件事。这东西过了某个阶段就不太管用了。要是你一直下洞穴享受那股暖意，不管吃多少药都会留下永久影响。最后...你甚至没法再吃药。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Second thing. It stops workin’ well after a certain point. You keep goin’ down to the caves and enjoyin’ the glow, it’ll have a permanent effect on you regardless of how many o’ these you take. And eventually... you won’t be able to take ‘em anyway.”"

rows.original: He proffers it to you.
rows.translation: 他把药递向你。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe proffers it to you."

rows.original: You reach across and accept it, frowning slightly. What on earth is he talking about? Will you not be able to swallow, or something? It seems a ridiculous warning.
rows.translation: 你伸手接过，微微皱眉。他到底在说什么？难道你会没法吞咽之类的？这警告听起来荒唐。
rows.raw: " You reach across and accept it, frowning slightly. What on earth is he talking about? Will you not be able to swallow, or something? It seems a ridiculous warning."

rows.original: “Just remember what I said,” Charles insists with a wry twist of his lip, plucking the pill back out of your hand.
rows.translation: “记住我说的话，”查尔斯撇嘴露出讥诮神情，坚持说道，又从你手里拿回药片。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Just remember what I said,” Charles insists with a wry twist of his lip, plucking the pill back out of your hand."

rows.original: You feel a dragging reluctance to take it - the innate knowledge that what is in his hand is frosty bleakness to the calm warmth inside you. Still, you reach across and accept the pill.
rows.translation: 你对服药感到一股沉重抗拒；你本能地知道，他手里的东西会给体内平静暖意带来冰冷荒芜。尽管如此，你仍伸手接下药片。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feel a dragging reluctance to take it - the innate knowledge that what is in his hand is frosty bleakness to the calm warmth inside you. Still, you reach across and accept the pill."

rows.original: “Just a wee bit difficult, isn’t it? Remember what I said,” Charles says with a wry twist of his lip, plucking it back out of your hand.
rows.translation: “有点困难，对吧？记住我说的话，”查尔斯撇嘴露出讥诮神情说道，又从你手里拿回药片。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Just a wee bit difficult, isn’t it? Remember what I said,” Charles says with a wry twist of his lip, plucking it back out of your hand."

rows.original: Something about the pill revolts you. It looks bad, you’re sure it will taste bad, and you’re absolutely certain it will make you deeply unhappy. You don’t understand why this nasty man is pressuring you to take it. Can’t he see how at peace you are with the world? Why would you want to change that? A slight sweat breaks out on your forehead, and you can’t help but look at the Caledonian with the deepest resentment, but you do force yourself to reach across and accept the pill.
rows.translation: 这枚药片的某些特征令你厌恶。它看起来糟糕，你确信味道也会糟糕，而且绝对会令你深感不幸。你不明白这个讨厌的男人为何逼你服药。他难道看不出你与世界相处得多么平静吗？你为什么会想改变这一点？额头渗出薄汗，你忍不住以最深的怨恨望向这个卡利登人，但仍迫使自己伸手接过药片。
rows.raw: "\n\nSomething about the pill revolts you. It looks bad, you’re sure it will taste bad, and you’re absolutely certain it will make you deeply unhappy. You don’t understand why this nasty man is pressuring you to take it. Can’t he see how at peace you are with the world? Why would you want to change that? A slight sweat breaks out on your forehead, and you can’t help but look at the Caledonian with the deepest resentment, but you do force yourself to reach across and accept the pill."

rows.original: “Difficult, isn’t it? Remember what I said,” Charles insists with a wry twist of his lip, plucking it back out of your hand.
rows.translation: “很困难，对吧？记住我说的话，”查尔斯撇嘴露出讥诮神情，坚持说道，又从你手里拿回药片。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Difficult, isn’t it? Remember what I said,” Charles insists with a wry twist of his lip, plucking it back out of your hand."

rows.original: Everything about the pill revolts you. It’s unnatural, and speaks against your very being. You know innately that what is being offered in that hand of his is unhappiness, doubt and loneliness. You don’t hate the Caledonian for offering it, because he’s incapable of understanding (and you’re incapable of hate) - but equally, there is nothing in the galaxy that will make you touch that pill. You calmly refuse it.
rows.translation: 药片的一切都令你厌恶。它违背自然，也违背你的存在本身。你本能地知道，他手中提供的是不幸、怀疑与孤独。你并不恨这个卡利登人，因为他无法理解，而你也无法憎恨；但同样，银河中没有任何东西能让你碰那枚药片。你平静地拒绝了。
rows.raw: "\n\nEverything about the pill revolts you. It’s unnatural, and speaks against your very being. You know innately that what is being offered in that hand of his is unhappiness, doubt and loneliness. You don’t hate the Caledonian for offering it, because he’s incapable of understanding (and you’re incapable of hate) - but equally, there is nothing in the galaxy that will make you touch that pill. You calmly refuse it."

rows.original: “Aye, I thought as much, lookin’ at you,” Charles sighs, stowing it and the bottle away. “You’re a bothrioc plaything for the long haul, mate. Hope you’re canny with that.”
rows.translation: “是啊，看你的样子我就猜到了，”查尔斯叹息着收起药片和药瓶。“伙计，往后很长时间你都会是博斯里奥克的玩物。希望你能明智面对。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aye, I thought as much, lookin’ at you,” Charles sighs, stowing it and the bottle away. “You’re a bothrioc plaything for the long haul, mate. Hope you’re canny with that.”"

rows.original: You cheerfully assure him that you are.
rows.translation: 你愉快地向他保证，自己确实能明智面对。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou cheerfully assure him that you are."

rows.original: Fix?
rows.translation: 治疗？
rows.raw: "Fix?"

rows.original: What’s all this about fixing?
rows.translation: 说的治疗究竟是什么？
rows.raw: "What’s all this about fixing?"

rows.original: Curdsonwhey
rows.raw: "Curdsonwhey"

rows.original: Fix
rows.translation: 治疗
rows.raw: "Fix"

rows.original: Fix
rows.translation: 治疗
rows.raw: "Fix"

rows.original: You are already under the effects of Curdsonwhey.
rows.translation: 你已经处于凝乳乳清的效果之下。
rows.raw: "You are already under the effects of Curdsonwhey."

rows.original: Fix
rows.translation: 治疗
rows.raw: "Fix"

rows.original: “Got some?” you query. By way of answer, Charles fetches the medicinal bottle out of his bureau drawer.
rows.translation: “有货吗？”你问。查尔斯没有回答，而是从写字台抽屉里拿出药瓶。
rows.raw: "“Got some?” you query. By way of answer, Charles fetches the medicinal bottle out of his bureau drawer."

rows.original: “Got the cash?” you asks in turn. “And the willing?”
rows.translation: “有钱吗？”他反问。“也有意愿吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Got the cash?” you asks in turn. “And the willing?”"

rows.original: Buy
rows.translation: 购买
rows.raw: "Buy"

rows.original: Buy
rows.translation: 购买
rows.raw: "Buy"

rows.original: Buy
rows.translation: 购买
rows.raw: "Buy"

rows.original: You don’t have enough credits.
rows.translation: 你的信用点不够。
rows.raw: "You don’t have enough credits."

rows.original: You take the brown pill.
rows.translation: 你服下棕色药片。
rows.raw: "You take the brown pill."

rows.original: “Stay frosty, Steele,” Charles grins at you, returning to his work.
rows.translation: “保持清醒，斯蒂尔，”查尔斯朝你笑笑，继续工作。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Stay frosty, Steele,” Charles grins at you, returning to his work."

rows.original: You feel a strange reluctance to take the pill you’ve bought - but you push that aside and pluck it out of Charles’s outstretched hand.
rows.translation: 你莫名不愿服下买来的药片；但还是压下抗拒，从查尔斯伸出的手中拿走它。
rows.raw: "You feel a strange reluctance to take the pill you’ve bought - but you push that aside and pluck it out of Charles’s outstretched hand."

rows.original: “Stay frosty, Steele,” Charles grins at you, before returning to his work.
rows.translation: “保持清醒，斯蒂尔，”查尔斯朝你笑笑，随后继续工作。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Stay frosty, Steele,” Charles grins at you, before returning to his work."

rows.original: You frown at the pill in Charles’s outstretched hand. Why are you doing this? Everything about that lozenge revolts you. It’s unnatural, and speaks against your very being. You know innately that what is being offered in that hand of his is unhappiness, doubt and lovelessness. You don’t hate the Caledonian for offering it, because he’s incapable of understanding (and you’re incapable of hate) - but equally, there is nothing in the galaxy that will make you touch that medicine. Calmly, you tell him you’ve changed your mind.
rows.translation: 你皱眉看着查尔斯手里的药片。为什么要这么做？这枚药片的一切都令你厌恶。它违背自然，也违背你的存在本身。你本能地知道，他手中提供的是不幸、怀疑与缺乏爱意。你并不恨这个卡利登人，因为他无法理解，而你也无法憎恨；但同样，银河中没有任何东西能让你碰那种药。你平静地告诉他，自己改变主意了。
rows.raw: "You frown at the pill in Charles’s outstretched hand. Why are you doing this? Everything about that lozenge revolts you. It’s unnatural, and speaks against your very being. You know innately that what is being offered in that hand of his is unhappiness, doubt and lovelessness. You don’t hate the Caledonian for offering it, because he’s incapable of understanding (and you’re incapable of hate) - but equally, there is nothing in the galaxy that will make you touch that medicine. Calmly, you tell him you’ve changed your mind."

rows.original: “Aye,” he says gravely, putting the bottle away, “I suspect you’ve changed your mind for guid. You’re a bothrioc plaything for the long haul now, mate. Hope you’re canny with that.”
rows.translation: “是啊，”他严肃地说着收起药瓶，“我怀疑你是永远改变主意了。伙计，往后很长时间你都会是博斯里奥克的玩物。希望你能明智面对。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aye,” he says gravely, putting the bottle away, “I suspect you’ve changed your mind for guid. You’re a bothrioc plaything for the long haul now, mate. Hope you’re canny with that.”"

rows.original: You cheerfully assure him that you are.
rows.translation: 你愉快地向他保证，自己确实能明智面对。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou cheerfully assure him that you are."

rows.original: It takes a huge amount of willpower to take the pill out of Charles’s outstretched hand - sweat breaks out on your brow, your soul seems to cry against it - but take it you do, despite how unhappy it makes you feel.
rows.translation: 从查尔斯伸出的手中拿走药片耗费了巨大意志力；额头渗出汗水，灵魂似乎在抗议；但你最终还是拿了，尽管这令你十分不快。
rows.raw: "It takes a huge amount of willpower to take the pill out of Charles’s outstretched hand - sweat breaks out on your brow, your soul seems to cry against it - but take it you do, despite how unhappy it makes you feel."

rows.original: “Doing the right thing, Steele,” Charles says gently. “Better tae have it under control, don’t you think?” He returns to his work.
rows.translation: “你做了正确的事，斯蒂尔，”查尔斯温和地说。“最好还是控制住它，你不觉得吗？”随后他继续工作。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Doing the right thing, Steele,” Charles says gently. “Better tae have it under control, don’t you think?” He returns to his work."

rows.original: Don’t
rows.translation: 不要
rows.raw: "Don’t"

rows.original: Fix
rows.translation: 治疗
rows.raw: "Fix"

rows.original: Buy some Curdsonwhey off the human.
rows.translation: 从这个人类手中购买一些凝乳乳清。
rows.raw: "Buy some Curdsonwhey off the human."

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: Bothrioc
rows.raw: "Bothrioc"

rows.original: Stepping into the bothrioc embassy is a fairly intimidating experience after crossing paths with the species before. There are so many scurrying about and performing various bureaucratic tasks that you’d struggle to count them. Not all of them are bothrioc, either.
rows.translation: 此前接触过这个种族之后，走进博斯里奥克大使馆便成了相当有压迫感的体验。这里有太多人来回疾走，执行各种官僚事务，多得令你难以计数。而且他们并不全是博斯里奥克。
rows.raw: "Stepping into the bothrioc embassy is a fairly intimidating experience after crossing paths with the species before. There are so many scurrying about and performing various bureaucratic tasks that you’d struggle to count them. Not all of them are bothrioc, either."

rows.original: Standing mostly to the fore and off to one side by a counter is an extremely tall bothrioc, who on account of having four legs seems to have skipped the customary bureaucrat’s office chair, opting instead to simply nestle down amidst their legs.
rows.translation: 柜台旁靠前的一侧站着一名极其高大的博斯里奥克。由于长着四条腿，对方似乎跳过了官僚惯用的办公椅，选择直接在自己的腿间安坐。
rows.raw: "\n\nStanding mostly to the fore and off to one side by a counter is an extremely tall bothrioc, who on account of having four legs seems to have skipped the customary bureaucrat’s office chair, opting instead to simply nestle down amidst their legs."

rows.original: If there were any remaining doubt that this is the person in charge, the sight of a submissive bothrioc carefully polishing the dominatrix’s legs with their tongue removes it. Moreover, they’ve already concluded the immediately pressing point of the paperwork they were handling, one of their arms gently setting it down, to regard you.
rows.translation: 若还怀疑谁在掌权，看到一名顺从的博斯里奥克正用舌头仔细擦亮女支配者的双腿，这份疑虑便会消失。此外，对方已经处理完手头最紧要的文书，一条手臂轻轻将其放下，转而注视你。
rows.raw: "\n\nIf there were any remaining doubt that this is the person in charge, the sight of a submissive bothrioc carefully polishing the dominatrix’s legs with their tongue removes it. Moreover, they’ve already concluded the immediately pressing point of the paperwork they were handling, one of their arms gently setting it down, to regard you."

rows.original: “Ah, no elaborate, loud warning about my species from a newcomer? Either you’ve got a better grasp of your thinking machine’s functions than the average offworlder or you’ve already met us. That is peculiar, as very few newcomers pass through without meeting me and I remember every last one of you. Regardless, I am Ara Kei Enya, and welcome to the Bothrioc Embassy. Don’t be shy.”
rows.translation: “哦，新来的人没有针对我族发出夸张响亮的警告？要么你比普通异乡人更了解思考机器的功能，要么你已经见过我们。这很奇怪，因为很少有新人会在没见过我的情况下经过，而每一个人我都记得。不管怎样，我是阿拉·凯·恩雅，欢迎来到博斯里奥克大使馆。别害羞。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, no elaborate, loud warning about my species from a newcomer? Either you’ve got a better grasp of your thinking machine’s functions than the average offworlder or you’ve already met us. That is peculiar, as very few newcomers pass through without meeting me and I remember every last one of you. Regardless, I am Ara Kei Enya, and welcome to the Bothrioc Embassy. Don’t be shy.”"

rows.original: As you step through the doorway of the main office, you’re greeted by a strange sight. Scurrying about are a bunch of insectile people, all of them androgynous and clearly not myr. Dominating the area is a seven foot tall blue-black member of the species, idly writing out something on a sheaf of paper as another member of the species polishes the bureaucrat’s four chitin-clad legs with their tongue. Your codex pipes up: “Bothrioc detected! Bothrioc are classified as extremely dangerous and should be avoided where possible. A full entry has been downloaded.”
rows.translation: 踏入主办公室门口时，一幅奇异景象迎接了你。一群昆虫般的人来回疾走，全都雌雄难辨，显然不是米尔人。区域中央是一名七英尺高、蓝黑相间的同族成员，正随意在一沓纸上书写；另一名同族则用舌头擦亮官僚的四条甲壳腿。你的百科终端出声：“检测到博斯里奥克！博斯里奥克被列为极度危险，应尽可能回避。完整条目已下载。”
rows.raw: "As you step through the doorway of the main office, you’re greeted by a strange sight. Scurrying about are a bunch of insectile people, all of them androgynous and clearly not myr. Dominating the area is a seven foot tall blue-black member of the species, idly writing out something on a sheaf of paper as another member of the species polishes the bureaucrat’s four chitin-clad legs with their tongue. Your codex pipes up: “Bothrioc detected! Bothrioc are classified as extremely dangerous and should be avoided where possible. A full entry has been downloaded.”"

rows.original: The dominant one laughs heartily, one of four hands partially covering a rather alarmingly wide smile. “My, my. Offworlder technology certainly has a lot to say about us. It is also loud and insensitive. Welcome to the Bothrioc Embassy. I am your host and chief diplomat, Ara Kei Enya. Don’t be shy.”
rows.translation: 那名支配者开怀大笑，四只手中的一只半掩着宽得惊人的笑容。“哎呀。异乡人的技术对我们可真有许多话说，而且既吵闹又不体贴。欢迎来到博斯里奥克大使馆。我是你们的东道主兼首席外交官阿拉·凯·恩雅。别害羞。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe dominant one laughs heartily, one of four hands partially covering a rather alarmingly wide smile. “My, my. Offworlder technology certainly has a lot to say about us. It is also loud and insensitive. Welcome to the Bothrioc Embassy. I am your host and chief diplomat, Ara Kei Enya. Don’t be shy.”"

rows.original: Bothrioc
rows.raw: "Bothrioc"

rows.original: You step once more into the Bothrioc Embassy, greeted again by the sight of the tall one called Ara Kei being attended by a gaggle of underlings. The ambassador regards you unblinkingly, perhaps a bit miffed by your prior decision to depart without saying a word? After a long moment, Ara Kei speaks first.
rows.translation: 你再次走进博斯里奥克大使馆，又看见高大的阿拉·凯被一群手下服侍。大使目不转睛地看着你，也许对你先前一言不发便离开的决定有些不满？漫长片刻后，阿拉·凯先开口。
rows.raw: "You step once more into the Bothrioc Embassy, greeted again by the sight of the tall one called Ara Kei being attended by a gaggle of underlings. The ambassador regards you unblinkingly, perhaps a bit miffed by your prior decision to depart without saying a word? After a long moment, Ara Kei speaks first."

rows.original: “Hello again, offworlder. Gotten over your fear of... Charles! What did you say we resemble?”
rows.translation: “又见面了，异乡人。你已经克服对...查尔斯！你说我们像什么来着？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hello again, offworlder. Gotten over your fear of... Charles! What did you say we resemble?”"

rows.original: A ginger head pops out from paperwork going on in the background.
rows.translation: 一颗姜发脑袋从后方的文书堆里探出来。
rows.raw: "\n\nA ginger head pops out from paperwork going on in the background."

rows.original: “Spiders. Wee eight-legged predators, trappers or ambushers.”
rows.translation: “蜘蛛。八条腿的小型捕食者，会设陷阱或伏击。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Spiders. Wee eight-legged predators, trappers or ambushers.”"

rows.original: The host nods, granting the young man a beaming smile for his thorough and quick explanation. “That’s the one. Yes. Welcome back to the spider’s web, offworlder.”
rows.translation: 主人点点头，因年轻人详尽而迅速的解释朝他灿烂一笑。“就是那个。没错。欢迎回到蜘蛛网，异乡人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe host nods, granting the young man a beaming smile for his thorough and quick explanation. “That’s the one. Yes. Welcome back to the spider’s web, offworlder.”"

rows.original: Stepping into the Bothrioc Embassy armed with your knowledge about the bothrioc is quite a different experience as you realize the vast majority of Ara Kei’s underlings scurrying about - mostly two-legged bothrioc, but some four-legged, some of the other native species, and even some offworlders - must in some way be a part of the gleaming dominatrix’s harem.
rows.translation: 带着对博斯里奥克的了解走进大使馆，体验便截然不同。你意识到阿拉·凯来回忙碌的绝大多数手下；主要是双足型博斯里奥克，也有一些四足型、其他本地种族，甚至还有异乡人；必定都以某种方式属于这位闪亮女支配者的后宫。
rows.raw: "Stepping into the Bothrioc Embassy armed with your knowledge about the bothrioc is quite a different experience as you realize the vast majority of Ara Kei’s underlings scurrying about - mostly two-legged bothrioc, but some four-legged, some of the other native species, and even some offworlders - must in some way be a part of the gleaming dominatrix’s harem."

rows.original: Standing for the most part head and shoulders above the crowd is Ara Kei [ara.himHer]self. If you couldn’t tell by the deference of the underlings, the faded blue hair cascading off [ara.his] head makes it unmistakable just which tall bothrioc is Ara Kei Enya, and [ara.his] pitch black eyes are instantly upon you with laser focus. You’d like to think that’s because Ara Kei wants to keep an eye on you, but it’s just as possible Ara Kei simply makes a point of identifying every visitor.
rows.translation: 阿拉·凯[ara.himHer]本人在人群中大多比其他人高出整整头肩。即使手下的恭敬不足以说明身份，[ara.his]头顶披散的褪色蓝发也清楚表明哪个高大博斯里奥克是阿拉·凯·恩雅，而[ara.his]漆黑双眼立刻如激光般锁定你。你愿意相信这是因为阿拉·凯想盯紧你，但也可能只是对方坚持辨认每一位访客。
rows.raw: "\n\nStanding for the most part head and shoulders above the crowd is Ara Kei [ara.himHer]self. If you couldn’t tell by the deference of the underlings, the faded blue hair cascading off [ara.his] head makes it unmistakable just which tall bothrioc is Ara Kei Enya, and [ara.his] pitch black eyes are instantly upon you with laser focus. You’d like to think that’s because Ara Kei wants to keep an eye on you, but it’s just as possible Ara Kei simply makes a point of identifying every visitor."

rows.original: “Hello again, Steele. Come to visit your favorite ambassador, have you? Come closer, let me get a good look at you.” Ara Kei chimes airily.
rows.translation: “又见面了，斯蒂尔。来拜访你最喜欢的大使了？靠近点，让我好好看看你。”阿拉·凯轻快地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hello again, Steele. Come to visit your favorite ambassador, have you? Come closer, let me get a good look at you.” Ara Kei chimes airily."

rows.original: You try to remain alert in your gloomy surroundings, scanning every object that looms into view carefully, keeping your ears pinned back for any faint sound. You still almost start out of your skin when a four-armed, black-chitined warrior bursts seemingly out of nowhere, whirling some sort of rope weapon over their head. They draw a rapier from the mass of belts wrapped around the swell of their hips with one set of arms, fling the spinning ropes at your [pc.legs] with the other and launch themselves at you, all in one vicious, fluid movement.
rows.translation: 你努力在昏暗环境中保持警觉，仔细扫视每个隐约浮现的物体，竖起耳朵留意任何细微声响。但一名四臂、黑色甲壳的战士仿佛凭空冲出，在头顶挥舞某种绳索武器时，你仍差点吓得跳起来。对方用一对手臂从缠在隆起髋部周围的大量腰带中抽出细剑，另一对手臂把旋转绳索掷向[pc.legs]，同时扑向你；所有动作凶狠流畅，一气呵成。

They draw a rapier from the mass of belts wrapped around the swell of their hips with one set of arms, fling the spinning ropes at your [pc.legs] with the other and launch themselves at you, all in one vicious, fluid movement."

rows.original: “As you wish,” it says. “Peace and true contentment aren’t for everyone, after all. You scurry along then, energetic little morsel. When you grow tired of the endless strife of the surface world, I will be waiting.” With a wriggle of its four hips, it disappears back into its hole.

rows.original: “Hmm,” it says. “It pains me a bit to see a submissive denying themselves, making themselves unhappy in some mistaken pursuit of dignity. On the other hand – it’s quite delicious too. Denying yourself, frustrating yourself, without me having to raise a hand.” It laughs, waving you away. “You toddle along then farlander, flagellate yourself good – every crack of your own proverbial whip pleases me. When you need release, your instincts will tell you where to go. Who knows, I might even give it to you without making you beg... too much.” With a wriggle of its four hips, it disappears back into its hole.
rows.translation: “嗯，”它说道。“看见一个顺从者拒绝自己的本性，为了错误理解的尊严而让自己痛苦，我多少有些心疼。另一方面——这也相当美味。拒绝自己，折磨自己，根本不用我动一根手指。”它笑着挥手赶你离开。“那就慢慢走吧，外乡人，好好鞭笞自己——你那根比喻之鞭每抽一下，都会令我愉悦。等你需要释放时，本能会告诉你该去哪里。谁知道呢，我甚至可能不让你乞求就给你... 太多。”它扭动四侧臀部，消失在洞穴深处。

rows.original: The weirdly beautiful (handsome?) androgyne hangs from a hole in the rock ceiling that is slathered in its translucent webs, incredibly sticky and strong gossamer that hangs ephemerally in the air all around you. If it were standing on the ground it would be about seven feet tall; it is a tall, lithe being that moves its four legs and four arms with an assured, eerie grace. Its limbs are encased in gleaming black chitin that is very reminiscent of latex, an association deepened by the way its legs end in toeless, boot-like feet. The severe tar-black of its limbs, shoulder-length hair and pupil-less eyes contrasts with the ghostly pale skin that stretches across its flat chest, supple bum and featureless groin, an uncompromising chiaroscuro that in the dim light seems flawless, untouchable. The only part of it that does not seem mercilessly well-calculated is the bulging insect abdomen situated above its behind. At least two feet in length, that chitin-encased oval, with its plump spinnerets and wet opening at its tip, speak of a bestial, arachnid lust lurking beneath the sheer, austere veneer of this creature.
rows.translation: 这个美得出奇（或者该说俊俏？）的双性体倒挂在岩顶的一处洞穴下，洞口涂满它半透明的蛛网；这些轻纱般飘在你周围空中的丝线黏性极强，也坚韧无比。若它站在地上，身高大约会有七英尺；它身形高挑纤细，四条腿和四只手臂的一举一动都带着自信而诡异的优雅。它的四肢包裹在闪亮的黑色甲壳中，酷似乳胶，而腿端没有脚趾、宛如长靴的足部更强化了这种印象。它焦油般漆黑的四肢、齐肩长发和没有瞳孔的眼睛，与覆盖平坦胸膛、柔软臀部和光滑胯部的幽白皮肤形成鲜明对比；在昏暗光线中，这种毫不妥协的明暗对照显得完美无瑕，令人不敢触碰。它身上唯一不像精心算计过的部分，是位于臀部上方那鼓胀的昆虫腹部。那枚裹着甲壳的椭圆腹部至少有两英尺长，末端丰满的吐丝器和湿润开口，透露出潜藏在这生物冷峻外表下的野性蛛类情欲。

rows.original: , and it makes the soft, eager-to-please part of you cringe to hear. You instinctively know you’re in the egg-giver’s bad books
rows.translation: ，听得你内心柔软而渴望取悦的部分畏缩起来。你本能地知道自己已经惹赐卵者不高兴
rows.raw: ", and it makes the soft, eager-to-please part of you cringe to hear. You instinctively know you’re in the egg-giver’s bad books"

rows.original: . “You fall into my webs, flaunting that young, supple, fertile body of yours, and when I pick you up, all ready to get rid of this aching burden of eggs, it turns out you’re already full up with another creature’s spawn. Such wantonness! Such loose morals! What do you have to say for yourself?”
rows.translation: 。“你落进我的蛛网，炫耀年轻、柔软、肥沃的身体；当我把你捡起，正准备摆脱这批令人酸胀的卵时，却发现你体内已经塞满了另一个生物的后代。何等放荡！何等不检点！你有什么要为自己辩解？”

rows.original: “Say it like you mean it!” the quadomme demands, in ringing, authoritative tones. “You will hang here until you do!”
rows.translation: “说得真诚些！”四足型以洪亮威严的声调命令。“在你做到之前，就一直挂在这里！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Say it like you mean it!” the quadomme demands, in ringing, authoritative tones. “You will hang here until you do!”"

rows.original: “I’m sorry!” you wail. You’re spanked again, on the other cheek, the reverberation carrying right through your gravid body. The pain feels good. “I’m such a bad [pc.boyGirl], egg-bearer! Please punish me until I’m not!”
rows.translation: “对不起！”你哀号道。另一边臀瓣又挨了一巴掌，震动一路传遍怀孕的身体。疼痛感觉很棒。“我是个坏[pc.boyGirl]，赐卵者！请惩罚我，直到我不再这么坏！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m sorry!” you wail. You’re spanked again, on the other cheek, the reverberation carrying right through your gravid body. The pain feels good. “I’m such a bad [pc.boyGirl], egg-bearer! Please punish me until I’m not!”"

rows.original: “I’m sorry!” you cry out. You can’t help let a note of resentment creep into your voice, and you immediately regret it. You’re spanked again on the other cheek, harder this time, the reverberation carrying right through your gravid body. “I’m sorry for being pregnant, la- si- Bothrioc Master,” you say, as contritely as you possibly can. “How can I make it up to you?”
rows.translation: “对不起！”你大喊。语气中忍不住混入一丝怨恨，随即立刻后悔。另一边臀瓣再次挨打，这次更加用力，震动传遍怀孕的身体。“对不起，我不该怀孕，女——先——博斯里奥克主人，”你尽可能悔恨地说道。“我要怎样才能补偿你？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m sorry!” you cry out. You can’t help let a note of resentment creep into your voice, and you immediately regret it. You’re spanked again on the other cheek, harder this time, the reverberation carrying right through your gravid body. “I’m sorry for being pregnant, la- si- Bothrioc Master,” you say, as contritely as you possibly can. “How can I make it up to you?”"

rows.original: This begets no response from the quadomme, except another firm slap against your [pc.butt]. You’re made to dangle there, being systematically spanked, the fleshy, shameful sound echoing away into the caverns, until your butt cheeks feel like they’re glowing.
rows.translation: 四足型没有回答，只是又用力拍了一下[pc.butt]。你被迫悬在那里，系统性地接受打屁股；肉体碰撞的羞耻声在洞穴中回荡，直到臀瓣仿佛灼灼发亮。
rows.raw: "\n\nThis begets no response from the quadomme, except another firm slap against your [pc.butt]. You’re made to dangle there, being systematically spanked, the fleshy, shameful sound echoing away into the caverns, until your butt cheeks feel like they’re glowing."

rows.original: “Now,” it says eventually, its tone no less forbidding. “What do you say?”
rows.translation: “现在，”它终于说道，语气依然严厉。“你该说什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now,” it says eventually, its tone no less forbidding. “What do you say?”"

rows.original: “Thank you for disciplining me, egg-bearer!” you reply, the grateful words spilling from your [pc.lips]. Oh, to hear just a single word of approval from the dominant after receiving this punishment... you might just cum on the spot. “I will try my hardest to have a warm, empty hole for you the next time we meet.”
rows.translation: “谢谢你管教我，赐卵者！”你回答，感激的话语从[pc.lips]不断涌出。噢，受罚后只要听见支配者一句赞许...你可能会当场高潮。“下次见面时，我会竭尽全力为你准备一个温暖空荡的穴口。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thank you for disciplining me, egg-bearer!” you reply, the grateful words spilling from your [pc.lips]. Oh, to hear just a single word of approval from the dominant after receiving this punishment... you might just cum on the spot. “I will try my hardest to have a warm, empty hole for you the next time we meet.”"

rows.original: “Th- thank you for disciplining me.” The humiliation burns on your [pc.skinFurScales], but you’ve wholly grasped how counterproductive to be angry about this is, and you’re glad that your voice comes out sounding thoroughly bitchified. “I will do better next time. Please may I go now?”
rows.translation: “谢——谢谢你管教我。”羞辱在[pc.skinFurScales]上燃烧，但你已完全明白为此生气只会适得其反，也很高兴自己的声音听起来彻底雌化而顺从。“下次我会做得更好。现在可以让我走了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Th- thank you for disciplining me.” The humiliation burns on your [pc.skinFurScales], but you’ve wholly grasped how counterproductive to be angry about this is, and you’re glad that your voice comes out sounding thoroughly bitchified. “I will do better next time. Please may I go now?”"

rows.original: “Hmm...” The bothrioc draws the rumination out in a whispery drone, sliding a finger up and down your spine as it does.
rows.translation: “嗯...”博斯里奥克拖着低沉气声思考，同时用一根手指沿你的脊椎上下滑动。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm...” The bothrioc draws the rumination out in a whispery drone, sliding a finger up and down your spine as it does."

rows.original: “Oh, very well. You do sound like you’ve learned your lesson, and I have other matters to attend to.” You are gradually lowered back down to the ground, and with a skillful crook of chitinous fingers the sticky silk binding your [pc.legs] and wrists is drawn away. You look up into the quadomme’s forbidding midnight eyes. “Be warned though, wanton farlander. This is no place for a pregnant egg-bearer to be waddling around on their own. Next time I may decide you need a more stringent lesson, if you don’t correct your behavior. Back to the surface with you!”
rows.translation: “噢，那好吧。听起来你确实吸取了教训，而我还有其他事情要处理。”你被逐渐放回地面，它熟练地弯动甲壳手指，抽走束缚[pc.legs]和手腕的黏性丝线。你抬头望进四足型严厉的午夜色眼眸。“不过放荡的外乡人，警告你，这里可不是怀孕负卵者独自蹒跚游荡的地方。若不改正行为，下次我或许会认定你需要更严厉的教训。回地表去！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, very well. You do sound like you’ve learned your lesson, and I have other matters to attend to.” You are gradually lowered back down to the ground, and with a skillful crook of chitinous fingers the sticky silk binding your [pc.legs] and wrists is drawn away. Next time I may decide you need a more stringent lesson, if you don’t correct your behavior. Back to the surface with you!”"

rows.raw: "\n\nIt retracts itself back into its hole in an eerie dance of limbs, leaving you to rub your sore buttocks and pick up your gear."

rows.original: You kind of feel like you did deserve a harsher punishment for disappointing the egg-giver. Oh well. They always know best.
rows.translation: 你隐约觉得，令赐卵者失望后，自己确实理应受到更严厉的惩罚。算了，它们总是最清楚。
rows.raw: " You kind of feel like you did deserve a harsher punishment for disappointing the egg-giver. Oh well. They always know best."

rows.original: You weirdly feel like you absolutely did deserve to get a good hard spanking there. And you’re definitely not coming down to the Deep Caves again, unless you’re ready to get bred. Wait, what? You shake the strange, alien thoughts away.
rows.translation: 你莫名觉得自己确实活该挨一顿狠揍。而且除非准备好受孕，否则绝不会再下到深层洞穴。等等，什么？你甩开这些古怪的异星念头。
rows.raw: " You weirdly feel like you absolutely did deserve to get a good hard spanking there. And you’re definitely not coming down to the Deep Caves again, unless you’re ready to get bred. Wait, what? You shake the strange, alien thoughts away."

rows.original: The nerve of that thing! Spanking you just because it couldn’t shove a bunch of eggs up you! Humiliation burns on your cheeks as you pull your stuff back on. You resolve not to let such an entitled creature get the jump on you again.
rows.translation: 那东西真厚颜无耻！只因为不能往你体内塞一堆卵就打屁股！你重新穿好东西时，羞辱感在双颊燃烧，并决心再也不让如此傲慢的生物偷袭。
rows.raw: " The nerve of that thing! Spanking you just because it couldn’t shove a bunch of eggs up you! Humiliation burns on your cheeks as you pull your stuff back on. You resolve not to let such an entitled creature get the jump on you again."

rows.original: “No. A payment is still due.” Your hanging body is slowly reeled upwards until your face is level with the quadomme’s. Its expression, such as you can tell, is stern. “You’re joining my harem for a day. Serve me well and uncomplainingly, and I shall consider the tribute fairly given.”
rows.translation: “不行。贡品依然欠着。”悬挂的身体被缓慢卷起，直到脸与四足型齐平。据你所能分辨，它表情严厉。“你要加入我的后宫一天。好好侍奉，不许抱怨，我就视为已经公平缴纳贡品。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No. A payment is still due.” Your hanging body is slowly reeled upwards until your face is level with the quadomme’s. Its expression, such as you can tell, is stern. “You’re joining my harem for a day. Serve me well and uncomplainingly, and I shall consider the tribute fairly given.”"

rows.original: This seems ridiculously out of proportion for the crime of not being able to be an incubator, but right now you can’t see a way out of this situation. Perhaps if you just do what it asks, it’ll get bored and let you go after an hour or so?
rows.translation: 只因为无法充当孵化器就受到这种处罚，似乎荒唐地罪罚不成比例，但眼下你看不出脱身办法。也许只要按它的要求去做，它过一个小时左右就会厌倦，然后放你离开？
rows.raw: " This seems ridiculously out of proportion for the crime of not being able to be an incubator, but right now you can’t see a way out of this situation. Perhaps if you just do what it asks, it’ll get bored and let you go after an hour or so?"

rows.original: You’d be lying if the prospect of becoming the egg-giver’s property for a while didn’t send a shuddering thrill up your spine. An embarrassingly large part of you thinks this is a way better outcome than a quick bout of sex.
rows.translation: 如果说暂时成为赐卵者的财产没有让脊椎窜过兴奋颤栗，那就是撒谎。令你尴尬的是，内心很大一部分甚至觉得这个结果比草草做一场爱好得多。
rows.raw: " You’d be lying if the prospect of becoming the egg-giver’s property for a while didn’t send a shuddering thrill up your spine. An embarrassingly large part of you thinks this is a way better outcome than a quick bout of sex."

rows.original: It takes a firm grip of you with its four gleaming black stilettos, and climbs with its prize back up into its tunnel; you shiver as you’re swallowed by it, the only light emanating from the ghostly gleam of the spider silk plastered over every inch of the rock. After only a short climb though, you enter a lit, spacious cave. It’s surprisingly well furnished: elegant carpets cover the flat, smooth floor and walls, there’s weird, spindly furniture, and ghostly lights hang from the ceiling by silk filigrees. Other... things... also dangle from the ceiling.
rows.translation: 它用四条闪亮黑色尖肢牢牢抓住你，带着战利品爬回隧道；你被隧道吞没时不禁颤抖，唯一光源来自覆盖岩石每一寸表面的蛛丝幽光。不过只爬了不远，你们便进入一座明亮宽敞的洞穴。这里陈设得出奇精美：优雅地毯覆盖平坦光滑的地面和墙壁，摆着古怪纤细的家具，幽灵般的灯由蛛丝花饰悬在洞顶。其他...东西...也从天花板垂下。

rows.original: “We are being joined today by this egg-bearing farlander,” the quadomme states authoritatively, two hard black hands slapping down on your shoulders. “Whilst [pc.he] recovers [pc.his] strength, you are to treat [pc.him] as one of us. Now - you three are working on the far gallery. You two, continue the ferment harvest. You, little one, are on nursery duty. You two - my boots haven’t been polished in minutes.”
rows.translation: “今天，这位怀着卵的外乡人将加入我们，”四足型威严宣布，两只坚硬黑手拍上你的肩膀。“在[pc.he]恢复[pc.his]体力期间，你们要把[pc.him]视作我们的一员。现在，你们三个去处理远端长廊；你们两个继续收获发酵物；小家伙，你负责育儿室。你们两个，我的靴子已经有足足几分钟没擦了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We are being joined today by this egg-bearing farlander,” the quadomme states authoritatively, two hard black hands slapping down on your shoulders. “Whilst [pc.he] recovers [pc.his] strength, you are to treat [pc.him] as one of us. Now - you three are working on the far gallery. You two, continue the ferment harvest. You, little one, are on nursery duty. You two - my boots haven’t been polished in minutes.”"

rows.original: It’s a bustle of activity, like a tiny village with one extremely obvious mayor. rows.translation: 它是个平胸的双性人形生物 – 至少上半身如此。四条漆黑闪亮、覆着甲壳的腿缠在蛛网中，与下方懒洋洋摇晃的四条手臂彼此呼应。焦油般漆黑的眼睛、眉毛和头发，与躯干及无特征胯间覆盖的幽灵般光滑皮肤形成鲜明对比。平坦胸膛和修长无鼻的脸庞轮廓清晰，洋溢着从容自信，隐约显出男性气质 – 但柔软屁股上方却有一只鼓胀无毛的昆虫腹部，长着丰满的吐丝器，顶端还有湿滑开口。在你看来，那代表着某种致命的女性气质。生物咧嘴灿笑，慵懒地伸展身体，肢体以诡异的切分节奏活动，让你饱览躯体的每一寸。
rows.raw: " It is a flatchested, androgynous humanoid – at least the upper part of it is. Tangled in its web are four black, glistening, chitin-clad legs, mirrored by a quartet of arms swinging lazily below it. Its tar-black eyes, brow and hair are contrasted by the ghostly, smooth skin stretched across its torso and featureless groin. Its flat chest and long, nose-less face, defined and drawn with easy self-confidence, vaguely suggest masculinity – but then there’s the bulging, hairless insect abdomen that rests above its soft butt, replete with plump spinnerets and a slick opening at the top. That says femininity to you, of a certain deadly kind. The creature grins widely and stretches languidly, moving its limbs in eerie syncopation, allowing you to drink in every inch of its frame."

rows.original: “We bothrioc are a magnificent people it’s true, so I will forgive your staring,” it says, running its long fingers through its shoulder-length black hair. Its smile turns teasing, sly. “But that’s just the beginning of the beauty that I can reveal to you, alien.”
rows.translation: “我们博斯里奥克确实是个辉煌的种族，所以我会原谅你的注视，”它说着，用修长手指梳过齐肩黑发。笑容变得戏谑而狡黠。“但那只是我能为你揭示的美丽之开端，外星人。”

rows.raw: " You remain on guard. You remember the sounds of its scurrying – this creature can really move when it wants to."

rows.original: “A virgin explorer of my territory, too fast and strong for my webs. That’s... interesting.” It proffers its other hands to you, smiling softly. “What a fine addition you would make to my harem. Come to me, farlander. Don’t be afraid – I’m not going to imprison you or anything silly like that. Those who devote themselves to me do it entirely of their own free will. Come to me, and I will show you why.”
rows.translation: “第一次探索我领地的处子，快而强壮，连蛛网都困不住。这可...真有意思。”它向你伸出另外两只手，温柔微笑。“你会成为我后宫的绝佳新成员。到我这里来，远方客。别害怕 – 我不会囚禁你，也不会做诸如此类的蠢事。献身于我的人，全都是出于自身自由意志。到我这里来，我会让你明白原因。”

rows.original: “I can tell you have already made the acquaintance of my race, farlander,” it says, making you jump and refocus on its face. Its grin is wider, knowing. “A sordid little altercation with one of my two-legged brethren, no doubt. They are so rude, aren’t they? Ah, but they aren’t beholden to the talents and sophistications us quadommes have as our birthright.” It opens its other pair of arms to you, a commanding expression on its long face. “Come to me, farlander. You need a firm, experienced hand to lead you along the glorious path you have found down here. It is hard now, yes – but you will soon see that where it ends is true fulfillment.”
rows.translation: “我看得出，你已经结识过我的种族了，远方客，”它说道，令你猛然一惊，把注意力重新投向它的脸。它的笑容更大了，满是了然。“想必是和我的某个双足同胞发生了一场肮脏的小冲突。他们真是粗鲁，对吧？啊，但他们天生就没有我们四足型与生俱来的才华与教养。”它向你张开另一双手臂，修长面孔上挂着命令般的神情。“到我这里来，远方客。你需要一只坚定而经验丰富的手，引领你沿着在此处发现的辉煌道路前进。现在很艰难，没错 – 但你很快就会看见，道路尽头乃是真正的满足。”

Let me take a good look at you, farlander.” It descends almost in a glide, moving into the dim light."

rows.original: The thing that has caught you is an alien sight for sure, but you cannot help but feel huge relief at the fact it’s not some sort of massive spider.
rows.translation: 抓住你的东西当然模样异质，但你还是不禁因为它并非某种巨型蜘蛛而大大松了一口气。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe thing that has caught you is an alien sight for sure, but you cannot help but feel huge relief at the fact it’s not some sort of massive spider."

rows.original: It’s an eight-limbed bothrioc, boot-legs clad in glistening black chitin and replete with bulging abdomen, similar in almost every respect to the ambassador you met on the surface. This one is looking at you with a considerably more predatory look in its tar-black eyes, though.
rows.translation: 它是一只八肢博斯里奥克，靴状腿裹着闪亮黑色甲壳，腹部鼓胀，几乎各方面都与地表见过的大使相似。不过这一只焦油般漆黑的眼睛里，显然带着更强的捕食意味。
rows.raw: " It’s an eight-limbed bothrioc, boot-legs clad in glistening black chitin and replete with bulging abdomen, similar in almost every respect to the ambassador you met on the surface. This one is looking at you with a considerably more predatory look in its tar-black eyes, though."

rows.original: It looks like a bothrioc – except this one has four chitin-clad legs tangled in its webs to match its quartet of arms. It seems bigger than the two legged ones you’ve run into too, particularly its bulging abdomen. Seeing you drinking it in, the androgyne smiles and lazily shifts its hips, displaying it to you so you can see the plump spinnerets on its underside. Its size and air of languid self-confidence all but spell out you’re dealing with some sort of alpha of the species.
rows.translation: 它看起来像一只博斯里奥克 – 但这一只除四条手臂外，还有四条覆着甲壳的腿缠在蛛网中。它似乎也比你遇见过的双足型更大，尤其是鼓胀的腹部。看到你目不转睛地欣赏，双性人微笑着懒洋洋地扭动臀部，把腹部展示给你，让你看清下侧丰满的吐丝器。它的体型与慵懒自信的气质几乎明白无误地告诉你，眼前是这个物种的某种支配者。

Its size and air of languid self-confidence all but spell out you’re dealing with some sort of alpha of the species."

rows.original: It is a flatchested, androgynous humanoid – at least the upper part of it is. Tangled in its web are four black, glistening, chitin-clad legs, mirrored by a quartet of arms swinging lazily below it. Its tar-black eyes, brow and hair are contrasted by the ghostly, smooth skin stretched across its torso and featureless groin. Its flat chest and long, nose-less face, defined and drawn with easy self-confidence, vaguely suggest masculinity – but then there’s the bulging, hairless insect abdomen that rests above its soft butt, replete with plump spinnerets and a slick opening at the top. That says femininity to you, of a certain deadly kind. The creature grins widely and stretches languidly, moving its limbs in eerie syncopation, allowing you to drink in every inch of its frame.

rows.original: “We bothrioc are a magnificent people it’s true, so I will forgive your staring,” it says, running its long fingers through its shoulder-length black hair. Its smile turns teasing, sly. “But that’s just the beginning of the beauty that I am going to reveal to you, alien.”
rows.translation: “我们博斯里奥克确实是个辉煌的种族，所以我会原谅你的注视，”它说着，用修长手指梳过齐肩黑发。笑容变得戏谑而狡黠。“但那只是我即将为你揭示的美丽之开端，外星人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We bothrioc are a magnificent people it’s true, so I will forgive your staring,” it says, running its long fingers through its shoulder-length black hair. Its smile turns teasing, sly. “But that’s just the beginning of the beauty that I am going to reveal to you, alien.”"

rows.original: It lolls elegantly downwards, propping its jaw up with one pair of hands as it gazes at you hungrily.
rows.translation: 它优雅地垂下身体，用一双手托住下巴，饥渴地注视你。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt lolls elegantly downwards, propping its jaw up with one pair of hands as it gazes at you hungrily."

rows.original: “I’m sorry for trapping you like this,” it breathes. “But being a top bothrioc means dealing with... certain urges. I get packed so full of eggs that my harem, as willing as they are, cannot cope with them all. So I have to cast my nets out for any juicy farlander ass that might be inadvisably wandering through my territory.” It is descending now, its gleaming legs working in syncopation to lower its tall, supple body towards you. “Don’t struggle, plaything. I am going to make it so good for you, and it will be all the better if you don’t make a silly fuss beforehand.”
rows.translation: “抱歉用这种方式困住你，”它轻声说道。“但作为一只上位博斯里奥克，就必须应付...某些冲动。我体内塞满了太多卵，就算后宫再怎么乐意，也无法承受全部。所以我不得不撒下蛛网，捕捉任何不明智地游荡进我领地的多汁远方客屁股。”它正在下降，闪亮双腿以切分节奏活动，把高挑柔韧的身体降向你。“别挣扎，玩物。我会让你舒服得不得了；只要你事先别愚蠢地大惊小怪，感觉还会更棒。”

rows.original: It lolls elegantly downwards, propping its jaw up with one pair of hands as it gazes at you with predatory interest. A hot blush descends on you as you return its stare – like the other bothrioc you have submitted to but bigger, more elegant and confident, concentrated. Your eyes keep being drawn to its insect abdomen – the fact that it is so big, packed tight with eggs. It feels like there’s a vein linking that sight and your loins, and every time you allow yourself to look at it a pulse of heat courses urgently through it into your [pc.groin], making your [pc.lips] open and practically forcing out a groan. Your [pc.lowerBody] feels weak and it is all you can do not to let go entirely, support your weight in the bothrioc’s bonds.
rows.translation: 它优雅地垂下身体，用一双手托住下巴，带着捕食般的兴趣注视你。你回望它时，炽热红晕覆上全身 – 它就像你曾臣服的另一只博斯里奥克，却更庞大、更优雅、更自信，仿佛这些特质的凝聚体。你的目光不断被它的昆虫腹部吸引 – 那里硕大无比，塞满了卵。仿佛有一根血管把这幅景象与你的下体连接起来，每次你任由自己望向那里，一股热流就会急切地沿它冲进[pc.groin]，令[pc.lips]张开，几乎强迫你发出呻吟。你的[pc.lowerBody]虚弱无力，光是忍住不彻底放松、把全身重量交给博斯里奥克的束缚，就已竭尽全力。

rows.original: “Goodness me, farlander,” it says, making you jump and refocus on its face. Its grin is wider, knowing. “You’ve obviously gotten to know my race quite well and yet this is the first time you’ve been in the presence of a true dominatrix? Poor thing. A hungry, succulent babe such as yourself, feeding off only the scraps that my two-legged brethren can provide.” It opens its other pair of arms to you, a commanding expression on its long, beautiful face. “Time to learn under a true master. Just relax, and let me take care of everything.”
rows.translation: “天哪，远方客，”它说道，令你猛然一惊，把注意力重新投向它的脸。它的笑容更大了，满是了然。“你显然已经相当了解我的种族，却是第一次置身于真正的女支配者面前？可怜的东西。像你这样饥渴多汁的宝贝，却只能依靠我那些双足同胞所能提供的残羹剩饭为食。”它向你张开另一双手臂，修长美丽的面孔上挂着命令般的神情。“是时候接受真正主人的教导了。放松下来，一切都交给我。”

rows.original: In the gloom and echoing spaces of Myrellion’s underground your depth perception seems to sometimes desert you, causing you to think objects and surfaces are closer or further away than they actually are. It makes you jumpy, intensely aware of how much noise you are generating, the grate and scrape of your progress funneling away into the still tunnels.
rows.translation: 米瑞利昂地下昏暗而空旷，回声不绝；你的深度知觉有时似乎会失灵，让你误以为物体与表面比实际更近或更远。这令你神经紧张，无比清楚自己制造了多少声响；前进时的摩擦刮擦声沿着寂静隧道不断远去。

rows.original: As you gaze off into the distance, straining your eyes for any sign of movement, something brushes your face. You swat it aside irritably. It sticks to your hand. Disgusted, you look at it. Gluey gossamer is plastered across your palm, almost completely translucent but – as you find out when you impulsively try to yank it off –as strong as steel wire.
rows.translation: 你凝视远处，眯起眼睛寻找任何动静，这时有东西擦过脸庞。你烦躁地挥手把它拨开。它却黏在了手上。你厌恶地看去。黏胶般的游丝铺满掌心，几乎完全透明，但 – 当你冲动地试图将它扯下时才发现 –坚韧得如同钢丝。

rows.original: Chilly understanding descends on you as you feel the stuff clinging to you in half a dozen places. Strings, weaves and thatches of gossamer glisten across the floor and walls, emerging from a large hole in the ceiling, only discernible to you now that you’re well and truly coated in it. You’ve blundered into a bothrioc’s trap! Desperately you attempt to yank yourself clear as from above you comes the busy skitter and clack of multiple feet...
rows.translation: 一股冰冷的领悟降临心头，你感觉那些东西黏住了身体足足六处。地面与墙壁上闪耀着游丝、织网与丝草，全都从天花板的一处大洞中延伸出来；直到彻底被它包裹，你才终于看清这一切。你误闯进了博斯里奥克的陷阱！上方传来多只脚忙碌奔行与敲击的声音...你绝望地试图将自己猛力挣脱。

rows.original: It doesn’t take you long to adapt to your new life as a bothrioc quadomme’s bottom bitch. This is partly to do with your harem-mates: a dozen assorted pidemmes and myr who are endlessly kind and generous towards you despite your alienness. This is because you share with them a warm, peaceful, communal sensuousness that pervades everything around you, and you slip into their ranks as if you’d known them forever.
rows.translation: 你没花多久就适应了作为博斯里奥克四足型头号母狗的新生活。这一部分要归功于后宫同伴：十几个形形色色的双足型和米尔；尽管你来自异族，他们仍始终对你无比友善慷慨。因为你与他们共享一种温暖、宁静而群体相连的感官愉悦，它渗透周遭万物；你就这样融入他们的行列，仿佛早已相识一生。

I’m very proud of you.” Its tone turns commanding. “Do exactly what I say, to the letter – and I will give you what you need.”"

rows.original: “What a strong and vigorous specimen you are,” it decides eventually. It spreads its arms and smiles softly at you. “I’m a big fan of it. Come to me, farlander. Don’t be afraid – I’m not going to imprison you or anything silly like that. Those who devote themselves to me do it entirely of their own free will. Come to me, and I will show you why.”

All you should be concentrating on right now is obedience. From that will stem bliss.” It opens its other pair of arms to you, a commanding expression on its long face. “Come to me, farlander. You need a firm, experienced hand to lead you along the glorious path you have found down here. It is hard now, yes – but you will soon see that where it ends is true fulfillment.”
rows.translation: “看见喜欢的东西了吗？”它说道，令你猛然一惊，把注意力重新投向它的脸。它的笑容更大了，满是了然。“这些崭新感觉让你既迷恋又困惑，对不对？可怜的东西。但像你这样的生灵不必担忧。现在唯一需要专注的事，就是服从。极乐将由此而生。”它向你张开另一双手臂，修长面孔上挂着命令般的神情。“到我这里来，外来者。你需要一只坚定而经验丰富的手，引领你沿着在此处发现的辉煌道路前进。现在很艰难，没错 – 但你很快就会看见，道路尽头乃是真正的满足。”

rows.original: “So then, farlander,” it says, making you jump and refocus on its face. Its grin is wider, knowing. “You are coming to understand your place in the grand scheme of things. It feels so good, being an obedient, egg-stuffed little slut doesn’t it? And yet still you struggle and rip yourself from my bonds. Like a child who doesn’t want to do his homework, despite the knowledge it imparts.” It opens its other pair of arms to you, a commanding expression on its long, beautiful face. “Your Master demands you set such silliness to one side. Come to me, farlander, and I will show you where you truly belong.”
rows.translation: “那么，远方客，”它说道，令你猛然一惊，把注意力重新投向它的脸。它的笑容更大了，满是了然。“你开始明白自己在宏大秩序中的位置了。当一条顺从、肚子塞满卵的小骚货，感觉那么美妙，对吧？可你依然挣扎，把自己从我的束缚中扯出去。就像不愿做功课的小孩子，哪怕那些功课能带来知识。”它向你张开另一双手臂，修长美丽的面孔上挂着命令般的神情。“你的主人命令你把这种愚蠢丢到一旁。到我这里来，远方客，我会让你明白自己真正的归宿。”

rows.original: “Oh my,” the tall, flat chested, eight-limbed androgyne laughs breathily when it emerges into the light. “I’ve caught a real prize this time, haven’t I?” It plays with the gluey strings in its gleaming black hands, twitching your limbs like a puppet. “I’m sorry for trapping you like this,” it goes on. “But being a top bothrioc means dealing with... certain urges. I get packed so full of eggs that my harem, as willing as they are, cannot cope with them all. So I have to cast my nets out for any juicy farlander ass that might be inadvisably wandering through my territory.” It is descending now, its gleaming legs working in syncopation to lower its tall, supple body towards you. “Don’t struggle, plaything. I am going to make it so good for you... so good that eventually, you’ll come to me of your own free will. And it will be all the better if you don’t make a silly fuss beforehand.”
rows.translation: “哎呀，”高挑平胸的八肢双性人在光线中现身时，轻声笑了起来。“看来这次我抓到了一份真正的珍宝，对吧？”它用闪亮黑手拨弄黏稠丝线，让你的四肢如木偶般抽动。“抱歉用这种方式困住你，”它继续说道。“但作为一只上位博斯里奥克，就必须应付...某些冲动。我体内塞满了太多卵，就算后宫再怎么乐意，也无法承受全部。所以我不得不撒下蛛网，捕捉任何不明智地游荡进我领地的多汁远方客屁股。”它正在下降，闪亮双腿以切分节奏活动，把高挑柔韧的身体降向你。“别挣扎，玩物。我会让你舒服得不得了...舒服到最后，你会出于自身自由意志来找我。只要你事先别愚蠢地大惊小怪，感觉还会更棒。”

rows.raw: "“Hey, are you just gonna sit over there and sulk or will you come introduce yourself?” comes a voice from the back of the cell, making you spin in surprise. For the first time you take note of your cell’s other inhabitants. The voice belongs to a raven haired red myr woman, dressed in a cloth shirt and sweatpants. She’s sporting a DD-cup chest and a fit frame, sitting in the corner of the cell with her legs crossed."

rows.original: The other corner is inhabited by a female gold myr dressed in a posh sundress and high heels, one of which has broken off at the base. She has long platinum blonde hair and a noticeable tan, with jewelry full of semiprecious stones. With looks like that you’re surprised to see her in the deep caves at all, let alone a jail cell. She hugs herself with both sets of arms and leers at both you and the red.
rows.translation: 另一边角落里是一名金米尔女性，身穿华丽太阳裙和高跟鞋，其中一只鞋跟已从根部折断。她留着铂金色长发，肤色明显晒黑，佩戴的珠宝镶满半宝石。以这样的外表，你很惊讶她会出现在深层洞穴，更别说牢房。她用两对手臂抱紧自己，怒视着你和那个红米尔。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe other corner is inhabited by a female gold myr dressed in a posh sundress and high heels, one of which has broken off at the base. She has long platinum blonde hair and a noticeable tan, with jewelry full of semiprecious stones. With looks like that you’re surprised to see her in the deep caves at all, let alone a jail cell. She hugs herself with both sets of arms and leers at both you and the red."

rows.original: “Don’t worry about her. It’s her first time and she’s still grumpy about having to stay here,” the dark haired ant explains, earning another glare from the disgruntled gold girl. You grin at the situation, easing up a bit despite your predicament.
rows.translation: “别担心她。她是第一次来，还在为必须待在这里闹脾气，”黑发蚁女解释道，惹来不满金米尔又一次瞪视。眼前情形令你咧嘴一笑，尽管身处困境，仍稍微放松下来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t worry about her. It’s her first time and she’s still grumpy about having to stay here,” the dark haired ant explains, earning another glare from the disgruntled gold girl. You grin at the situation, easing up a bit despite your predicament."

rows.original: “Easy for you to say, since you live here or something! My girlfriend is a queen’s handmaiden, I shouldn’t have to deal with this,” the rich woman snaps, tucking herself even more tightly into her corner. Her cellmate laughs at this, stretching out and getting to her feet in order to move closer to you.
rows.translation: “你当然说得轻松，你住在这里还是怎么的！我女朋友是女王侍女，我不该遭这种罪，”富家女厉声说道，把自己更紧地缩进角落。牢友因此笑了，伸展身体后站起，走近你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Easy for you to say, since you live here or something! My girlfriend is a queen’s handmaiden, I shouldn’t have to deal with this,” the rich woman snaps, tucking herself even more tightly into her corner. Her cellmate laughs at this, stretching out and getting to her feet in order to move closer to you."

rows.original: “So, what are you in here for? Richie rich over there tried to vaporize one of the knights with one of those fancy space-farer guns when she got separated from her cave tour group. I stole from the shop. Best way to get in without causing too much trouble,” she says with a wink, whispering the last part. You tell her about your fall down the tunnel and knocking over the building, earning a laugh that she tries - and fails - to suppress.
rows.translation: “所以，你是因为什么进来的？那边的有钱大小姐从洞穴旅行团走散后，用那种花哨的太空人枪械试图汽化一个骑士。我则偷了商店的东西。这是不会惹出太大麻烦又能进来的最好方法，”她眨眼说道，最后一句压低声音。你告诉她，自己从隧道摔下并撞倒建筑，引来一阵她试图压制却失败的笑声。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, what are you in here for? Richie rich over there tried to vaporize one of the knights with one of those fancy space-farer guns when she got separated from her cave tour group. I stole from the shop. Best way to get in without causing too much trouble,” she says with a wink, whispering the last part. You tell her about your fall down the tunnel and knocking over the building, earning a laugh that she tries - and fails - to suppress."

rows.original: “I’m sorry, but that’s pretty hilarious. Don’t worry though, even the most hardened looking offworlders fall sometimes. It’s a good thing you didn’t get hurt running into that building, I broke an arm the first time I ran into the ganrael. Luckily their crystals are just as useful as splints as they are for breaking things,” she says, smiling and rapping on one of the colorful bars. You ask her what miss princess meant when she talked about her living here.
rows.translation: “抱歉，可那真的太好笑了。不过别担心，即使外表最强硬的星外人有时也会摔倒。幸好你撞上那栋房子时没有受伤；我第一次遇上甘雷尔就摔断了一条手臂。好在她们的水晶既能打断东西，也同样适合充当夹板，”她笑着敲了敲一根彩色栏杆。你问她，那位公主小姐说她住在这里是什么意思。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m sorry, but that’s pretty hilarious. Don’t worry though, even the most hardened looking offworlders fall sometimes. It’s a good thing you didn’t get hurt running into that building, I broke an arm the first time I ran into the ganrael. Luckily their crystals are just as useful as splints as they are for breaking things,” she says, smiling and rapping on one of the colorful bars. You ask her what miss princess meant when she talked about her living here."

rows.original: “Let me put it this way: I have the choice to go back to a war torn city that might not have even been part of my country’s culture in the first place. I might have gotten drafted, guilted into service, or settled down to live a boring life. Or... I come down here, make a little bit of trouble or try to take some meaningless balls of slime. In a matter of minutes I’m sitting in a sizeable room with soft bedding and as many cave berries or mushrooms as I can eat. Not to mention the guards are a lot of fun, in a silly-goo-creature kind of way. I can’t be the only person who would pick that as the better option,” she says, her careless demeanor turning serious as she talks. When she’s finished she takes a deep breath before smiling again.
rows.translation: “这么说吧：我可以回到一座饱受战争蹂躏的城市，那里甚至可能从来就不属于我国文化。我可能被征召入伍，受内疚驱使服役，或安定下来过无聊生活。又或者...我来到这里，稍微惹点麻烦，尝试拿走几颗毫无意义的软泥球。几分钟后，我就坐在一间宽敞牢房里，有柔软床铺，还有吃不完的洞穴浆果和蘑菇。更别提守卫都很好玩，以那种傻乎乎凝胶生物的方式。我不可能是唯一认为后者更好的人，”她说道，原本漫不经心的神态随话语变得严肃。说完后，她深吸一口气，再次微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Let me put it this way: I have the choice to go back to a war torn city that might not have even been part of my country’s culture in the first place. I might have gotten drafted, guilted into service, or settled down to live a boring life. Or... I come down here, make a little bit of trouble or try to take some meaningless balls of slime. In a matter of minutes I’m sitting in a sizeable room with soft bedding and as many cave berries or mushrooms as I can eat. Not to mention the guards are a lot of fun, in a silly-goo-creature kind of way. I can’t be the only person who would pick that as the better option,” she says, her careless demeanor turning serious as she talks. When she’s finished she takes a deep breath before smiling again."

rows.original: “Anyway, I come down here all the time. I still go back and visit friends whenever I get out, and at least some of them know my general location when I disappear for a while. Little do they know I’m a repeat law-breaker in a crystal goo village,” she laughs, leaning back against the cell bars.
rows.translation: “总之，我一直都会来这里。每次出去后，我仍会回去看朋友；至少其中一些人在我消失一阵时，知道我大概去了哪里。她们却不知道，我是水晶史莱姆村庄里的惯犯，”她笑着靠上牢房栏杆。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyway, I come down here all the time. I still go back and visit friends whenever I get out, and at least some of them know my general location when I disappear for a while. Little do they know I’m a repeat law-breaker in a crystal goo village,” she laughs, leaning back against the cell bars."

rows.original: “That’s what will happen if her kind wins the war you know,” comes the voice of the gold from her corner. “Crime rates will jump up, and people’s wives will be stolen away by those sluts and their toxic spit that makes you crazy for sex! Our poor queens will be locked away forever.” The red myr twirls her black hair as she listens, giving you an incredulous glance once the tirade is over.
rows.translation: “你知道吗，如果她那一方赢得战争，事情就会变成这样，”角落里的金米尔说道。“犯罪率会飞涨，别人的妻子会被那些荡妇和使人疯狂渴求性爱的毒液抢走！我们可怜的女王会被永远关起来。”红米尔一边听，一边绕着黑发打转；长篇大论结束后，她难以置信地瞥了你一眼。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s what will happen if her kind wins the war you know,” comes the voice of the gold from her corner. “Crime rates will jump up, and people’s wives will be stolen away by those sluts and their toxic spit that makes you crazy for sex! Our poor queens will be locked away forever.” The red myr twirls her black hair as she listens, giving you an incredulous glance once the tirade is over."

rows.original: “I don’t know about them being locked up. I’m sure your queens would just love some of our delicious service,” she jokes, making an exaggerated show of licking her lips in the gold’s direction.
rows.translation: “我可不觉得她们会被关起来。你们的女王一定很喜欢我们美味的服务，”她开玩笑说道，故意朝金米尔方向夸张地舔了舔嘴唇。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t know about them being locked up. I’m sure your queens would just love some of our delicious service,” she jokes, making an exaggerated show of licking her lips in the gold’s direction."

rows.original: “That seems to be a big winner in gold propaganda; our saliva being an addictive chemical that brainwashes people into wanting sex all the time. It’s not that bad at all. Sure it works as an aphrodisiac, but the only people likely to get addicted to it are uptight snobs who can’t get pleasure in any other way,” she explains, whispering her response to you so the rich girl can’t hear.
rows.translation: “这似乎是金方宣传中很受欢迎的一套说辞：我们的唾液是成瘾化学品，会给人洗脑，让她们无时无刻不想做爱。根本没那么严重。没错，它确实有催情作用，但容易成瘾的只有那些在其他方面得不到快感、一本正经的势利鬼，”她向你解释，同时压低声音，以免富家女听见。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That seems to be a big winner in gold propaganda; our saliva being an addictive chemical that brainwashes people into wanting sex all the time. It’s not that bad at all. Sure it works as an aphrodisiac, but the only people likely to get addicted to it are uptight snobs who can’t get pleasure in any other way,” she explains, whispering her response to you so the rich girl can’t hear."

rows.original: “Of course we get propaganda that says all of their lot who aren’t posh higher ups are brainwashed into mindless slaves by their queens and have no sense of free will. I don’t believe a word of it. As much as she seems to prove them right, I’ve seen some perfectly willful individuals come out of those trenches only to be recruited directly to our side without much choice.”
rows.translation: “当然，我们也有宣传，说她们那边除华贵高层外的所有人都被女王洗脑成了无脑奴隶，完全没有自由意志。我一个字都不信。虽然她看起来很能证明这些说辞，但我也见过意志十分坚定的人从战壕出来，随后几乎没有选择就被直接征召到我们这一方。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course we get propaganda that says all of their lot who aren’t posh higher ups are brainwashed into mindless slaves by their queens and have no sense of free will. I don’t believe a word of it. As much as she seems to prove them right, I’ve seen some perfectly willful individuals come out of those trenches only to be recruited directly to our side without much choice.”"

rows.original: A racket from the door interrupts your conversation, and you turn to see an armored goo soldier opening the cage. He looks to be carrying a large platter, with a medium sized satchel draped over one of the gemstone plates on his arm. The platter is covered in an assortment of tiny mushrooms and dark berries, some occasionally pulsing with brighter colors.
rows.translation: 牢门传来一阵嘈杂，打断你们的交谈。你转身看见一名披甲凝胶士兵打开牢笼。他似乎端着一个大托盘，手臂某块宝石甲片上挂着中型挎包。托盘盛着各式小蘑菇和深色浆果，其中一些偶尔闪动更明亮的色彩。
rows.raw: "\n\nA racket from the door interrupts your conversation, and you turn to see an armored goo soldier opening the cage. He looks to be carrying a large platter, with a medium sized satchel draped over one of the gemstone plates on his arm. The platter is covered in an assortment of tiny mushrooms and dark berries, some occasionally pulsing with brighter colors."

rows.original: “Time to eat!” the guard exclaims in a jovial and surprisingly deep voice. He shuts the door behind him and strides over to your corner of the room, handing the platter to the red myr and the satchel to you.
rows.translation: “开饭了！”守卫用欢快而出乎意料地低沉的声音喊道。他在身后关门，大步走到房间角落，把托盘交给红米尔，把挎包递给你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Time to eat!” the guard exclaims in a jovial and surprisingly deep voice. He shuts the door behind him and strides over to your corner of the room, handing the platter to the red myr and the satchel to you."

rows.original: “There are foods from above in that. It was confiscated from that one so you can eat them since your offense was only minor,” he says, looking in the direction of the gold myr before prompting you to open the bag. She looks as if she wants to say something, but reconsiders when she meets his gaze. He turns to her again as he reaches the door.
rows.translation: “里面有地上的食物。它们是从那个人那里没收的；你的罪行比较轻，所以可以吃，”他说着望向金米尔，随后示意你打开袋子。她看起来想说些什么，却在和他对视后改变主意。他走向门口时又转向她。
rows.raw: "\n\n“There are foods from above in that. It was confiscated from that one so you can eat them since your offense was only minor,” he says, looking in the direction of the gold myr before prompting you to open the bag. She looks as if she wants to say something, but reconsiders when she meets his gaze. He turns to her again as he reaches the door."

rows.original: “Your punishment will be later tonight, you should eat before-hand,” he states sternly, closing the door behind him before returning to the village. As soon as he is out of sight the four-armed brat scoots as close as she can to the taller red girl, mumbling about how that was her food and that her life is terrible.
rows.translation: “你的惩罚将在今晚晚些时候进行，应该事先吃点东西，”他严厉说道，关上身后的门，返回村庄。他刚一消失，那个四臂小鬼就尽可能挪近较高大的红米尔，嘟囔那是她的食物，自己的人生有多么凄惨。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Your punishment will be later tonight, you should eat before-hand,” he states sternly, closing the door behind him before returning to the village. As soon as he is out of sight the four-armed brat scoots as close as she can to the taller red girl, mumbling about how that was her food and that her life is terrible."

rows.original: You open the pack to find a number of rations from a JoyCo standard exploration care package, each emblazoned with the company’s simple logo.
rows.translation: 你打开包裹，发现里面有好几份欢愉公司标准探索护理包中的口粮，每份都印着公司简洁标志。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou open the pack to find a number of rations from a JoyCo standard exploration care package, each emblazoned with the company’s simple logo. "

rows.original: Not wanting to incense her ill attitude, you hand the blonde ant one of the ration packs. She snatches it out of your hand, getting it halfway open before pausing and thanking you sheepishly.
rows.translation: 你不想进一步激怒她的坏脾气，便递给金发蚁女一包口粮。她一把从你手里夺走，拆到一半才停住，不好意思地向你道谢。
rows.raw: "Not wanting to incense her ill attitude, you hand the blonde ant one of the ration packs. She snatches it out of your hand, getting it halfway open before pausing and thanking you sheepishly."

rows.original: You hand the blonde ant one of the ration packs, yanking it away as she grasps for it before dropping it into her hands. A fierce blush covers her features as she opens it, eating the contents in silence.
rows.translation: 你递给金发蚁女一包口粮，在她伸手抓时把它抽走，随后才丢进她手里。她满脸涨红，打开包装，沉默地吃掉内容物。
rows.raw: "You hand the blonde ant one of the ration packs, yanking it away as she grasps for it before dropping it into her hands. A fierce blush covers her features as she opens it, eating the contents in silence."

rows.original: You open and devour one of the ration packs, not even looking in the blonde ant’s direction.
rows.translation: 你打开并吃光一包口粮，甚至没有朝金发蚁女看一眼。
rows.raw: "You open and devour one of the ration packs, not even looking in the blonde ant’s direction."

rows.original: The raven haired woman picks various berries and fungi to eat. She hands some to her cellmate as she picks through them, swatting the younger woman’s hand when she tries to reach for some herself.
rows.translation: 乌发女人挑选各种浆果和真菌食用。她在挑拣时分了一些给牢友，而年轻女人自己伸手去拿时，她便拍开对方的手。
rows.raw: " The raven haired woman picks various berries and fungi to eat. She hands some to her cellmate as she picks through them, swatting the younger woman’s hand when she tries to reach for some herself."

rows.original: “Those are poisonous! The crystal goo people try hard, but they aren’t exactly the best judges of what’s healthy. Just sit back and I’ll make sure you get fed,” she explains with a curt tone, passing over a handful of food. The pampered gold looks ashamed, eating her food slowly as she shifts around. The fair-skinned myr sighs, wrapping an arm around her counterpart.
rows.translation: “那些有毒！水晶史莱姆族很努力，可她们并不擅长判断什么东西健康。老实坐着，我会确保你能吃饱，”她语气生硬地解释，并递过去一把食物。娇生惯养的金米尔显得很惭愧，缓慢进食，同时不安地挪动。肤色白皙的米尔人叹了口气，用一条手臂搂住对方。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Those are poisonous! The crystal goo people try hard, but they aren’t exactly the best judges of what’s healthy. Just sit back and I’ll make sure you get fed,” she explains with a curt tone, passing over a handful of food. The pampered gold looks ashamed, eating her food slowly as she shifts around. The fair-skinned myr sighs, wrapping an arm around her counterpart."

rows.original: “Look, it’s not gonna be that bad. Their punishments won’t involve chopping you up or anything like that, and we’ll be here the whole time. I can’t tell you exactly what will happen, but I’m sure it’ll be over before you know it,” she says in a much more comforting voice. For the first time since you arrived the sun-tanned girl relaxes, sitting more comfortably while she finishes her meal.
rows.translation: “听着，事情不会太糟。她们的惩罚不会把你剁碎，也不会有类似的事情，而且我们会一直在这里。我不能准确告诉你将发生什么，但肯定一眨眼就结束了，”她用安慰许多的声音说道。自从你到来后，晒黑的女孩第一次放松下来，以更舒适的姿势坐着吃完饭。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Look, it’s not gonna be that bad. Their punishments won’t involve chopping you up or anything like that, and we’ll be here the whole time. I can’t tell you exactly what will happen, but I’m sure it’ll be over before you know it,” she says in a much more comforting voice. For the first time since you arrived the sun-tanned girl relaxes, sitting more comfortably while she finishes her meal."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Gardeford
rows.raw: "Gardeford"

rows.original: Goo Jail
rows.translation: 凝胶监狱
rows.raw: "Goo Jail"

rows.original: After the three of you have eaten, a group of five ganrael approach the door, entering and forming a circle around your corner. A fully naked goo-girl with hefty G-cups beckons the gold myr to come out, frowning with a seriousness that dispels any questions about her nudity. The ant-girl hugs her new found friend tightly, unsure of what to do.
rows.translation: 三人吃完饭后，五名甘雷尔接近牢门，进入牢房，在你们所在角落围成一圈。一个完全赤裸、拥有丰满G罩杯的凝胶女孩示意金米尔出来；她严肃皱眉，让人完全无心质疑她为何裸体。蚁女紧紧抱住新认识的朋友，不知该怎么办。
rows.raw: "After the three of you have eaten, a group of five ganrael approach the door, entering and forming a circle around your corner. A fully naked goo-girl with hefty G-cups beckons the gold myr to come out, frowning with a seriousness that dispels any questions about her nudity. The ant-girl hugs her new found friend tightly, unsure of what to do."

rows.original: “You have committed a severe crime against our people, so you will receive separate punishment from each of us in turn. If you do not comply your punishment will be more severe,” the lead guard warns, beckoning again for the girl to come forth. The four-armed myr looks about ready to panic, looking between the ganraen captors and the two of you. The red-chitined woman takes the initiative, pushing the nervous girl to her front and steadying her upper pair of arms.
rows.translation: “你对我们的人民犯下严重罪行，所以要依次接受我们每个人的单独惩罚。如果不配合，惩罚会更加严厉，”领头守卫警告，再次示意女孩上前。四臂米尔人看起来快要惊慌失措，目光在甘雷尔抓捕者和你们两人之间来回移动。红色甲壳的女人主动出手，把紧张女孩推到身前，扶稳她上方一对手臂。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You have committed a severe crime against our people, so you will receive separate punishment from each of us in turn. If you do not comply your punishment will be more severe,” the lead guard warns, beckoning again for the girl to come forth. The four-armed myr looks about ready to panic, looking between the ganraen captors and the two of you. The red-chitined woman takes the initiative, pushing the nervous girl to her front and steadying her upper pair of arms."

rows.original: “Here’s how this is gonna work. I’m gonna lift up my shirt, and you can suck on one of my tits while these goo creatures have their way with you. I’ll cover your ears so you can just imagine it’s that big important girlfriend of yours fucking you with a honey-coated dildo. I won’t ‘inject you with toxins’ or anything stupid like that,” she instructs matter-of-factly. The gilded myr looks confused for a moment before recognition seems to click inside her.
rows.translation: “事情这样办。我会掀起衬衫；这些凝胶生物随意处置你时，你可以吸我的一只乳房。我会捂住你的耳朵，你只要想象是你那位了不起的女朋友，用涂满蜂蜜的假阳具操你。我不会‘给你注射毒素’，也不会做任何那种蠢事，”她公事公办地吩咐道。镀金米尔困惑片刻，随后仿佛终于理解。

rows.original: “Thank you so much for what you did,” she says, her fair-sized bosom pressed into your [pc.chest]. Her high voice is rather choked. “I couldn’t sleep after I sent you to Kressia. I kept thinking that I’d sent one of my guests to face danger I wouldn’t have - for nothing at all. Fazian told me about what was going on in that place, and - you are brave and selfless beyond words, starwalker. I hope one day my people and the reds can join you above the sky, so we too can learn the lessons of nobility your race clearly have.”
rows.translation: “非常感谢你所做的一切，”她说道，丰满的胸脯贴在你的[pc.chest]上。她尖细的声音有些哽咽。“派你去克雷西亚之后我一直睡不着。我总在想，自己竟让一位客人去面对连我都不敢面对的危险——而且可能毫无意义。法兹安告诉了我那里发生的事，而你——你勇敢又无私，已经无法用言语形容，星行者。我希望有一天，我的人民与红米尔也能和你一起飞上天空，这样我们也能学习你的种族显然拥有的高尚品德。”

rows.raw: "\n\nThe male myr’s motions cause his loincloth to reveal a strapping, eight-inch cock that’s lengthening by the second. Someone’s happy to see you. “Dance, a drink, or ...” He shimmies closer, firmly holding your gaze in sable orbs. “...something else?”"

rows.original: Why not? You came in here to enjoy yourself, after all.
rows.translation: 为什么不呢？你来这里本来就是为了享受。
rows.raw: "Why not? You came in here to enjoy yourself, after all."

rows.original: “Thanks!” beams the myr as you hand her the credits. “My name is Hepane, by the way. I do the music. Go through and take a seat wherever you like.”
rows.translation: “谢谢！”你把信用点递给她，米尔喜笑颜开。“对了，我叫赫佩恩。我负责音乐。进去随便找个喜欢的位置坐吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thanks!” beams the myr as you hand her the credits. “My name is Hepane, by the way. I do the music. Go through and take a seat wherever you like.”"

rows.original: “Thanks!” beams Hepane as you hand her the credits. “Go through and take a seat wherever you like.”
rows.translation: “谢谢！”你把信用点递给赫佩恩，她喜笑颜开。“进去随便找个喜欢的位置坐吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thanks!” beams Hepane as you hand her the credits. “Go through and take a seat wherever you like.”"

rows.original: You never turn down a chance to see the myr and anat perform.
rows.translation: 你从不会错过观看米尔和阿纳特人表演的机会。
rows.raw: "You never turn down a chance to see the myr and anat perform."

rows.original: “Our favourite patron,” beams Hepane, taking your credits. “Where you like to sit is still free, if you get in there quick.”
rows.translation: “我们最喜欢的客人，”赫佩恩收下你的信用点，喜笑颜开。“你喜欢的座位还空着，动作快点就能坐到。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Our favourite patron,” beams Hepane, taking your credits. “Where you like to sit is still free, if you get in there quick.”"

rows.original: You duck under the curtain into a small, crimson-decorated, sparsely-lit theatre, furnished with round tables and a wooden stage at one end. It’s thronged with people; mostly gold myr, the air dense with their high, twittering voices and sweet smell, but you spot a smattering of other off-worlders here as well. You find yourself a seat near the front and make yourself comfortable. A few moments later, the lamps and conversation dip, and the stage lights come on.
rows.translation: 你从帘幕下钻进一间以深红色装饰、灯光昏暗的小剧场，里面摆着圆桌，尽头设有木制舞台。这里挤满了人；大多是金米尔，空气中充斥着她们高亢的叽喳声和甜美气味，但你也看见了零星几名外星来客。你在前排附近找了个座位，舒舒服服地坐下。片刻后，灯光与交谈声一同暗下，舞台灯亮了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou duck under the curtain into a small, crimson-decorated, sparsely-lit theatre, furnished with round tables and a wooden stage at one end. It’s thronged with people; mostly gold myr, the air dense with their high, twittering voices and sweet smell, but you spot a smattering of other off-worlders here as well. You find yourself a seat near the front and make yourself comfortable. A few moments later, the lamps and conversation dip, and the stage lights come on."
