rows.original: Hepane is sat next to a vertically arranged instrument that looks like a combination of a hookah and an upturned piano. She picks out a snaky bass rhythm on the round keys at the bottom; her other set of hands sit on the stem keys above, waiting. Her partner strides on.
rows.translation: 赫潘坐在一件竖直摆放的乐器旁，那东西看上去像水烟壶与倒置钢琴的结合体。她用下方的圆形琴键弹出蜿蜒的低音节奏；另一双手则停在上方的柄状琴键上静候。她的搭档大步登场。
rows.raw: "Hepane is sat next to a vertically arranged instrument that looks like a combination of a hookah and an upturned piano. She picks out a snaky bass rhythm on the round keys at the bottom; her other set of hands sit on the stem keys above, waiting. Her partner strides on."

rows.original: He’s an anat, immediately recognizable by his long, bone-mask face, his double-jointed legs and small, neat claws. His feather plumes are startling, though: rearing way out above his crown and elbows, they’re shades of aquamarine and magenta that continuously glitter and shift under the glare of the spotlights.
rows.translation: 他是名安纳泰人，那张狭长如骨面具般的脸、反关节双腿和小巧整齐的利爪让人一眼便能认出。不过，他的羽冠格外醒目：从头顶和肘部高高扬起，水蓝与品红色的羽毛在聚光灯下不断闪耀变幻。
rows.raw: "He’s an anat, immediately recognizable by his long, bone-mask face, his double-jointed legs and small, neat claws. His feather plumes are startling, though: rearing way out above his crown and elbows, they’re shades of aquamarine and magenta that continuously glitter and shift under the glare of the spotlights."

rows.original: Fazian the anat strides onto the stage; all rearing, flowing feathers, austere ivory and supple muscle.
rows.translation: 安纳泰人法齐安大步登上舞台；高扬飘动的羽毛、冷峻的象牙白骨面与柔韧的肌肉尽收眼底。
rows.raw: "Fazian the anat strides onto the stage; all rearing, flowing feathers, austere ivory and supple muscle."

rows.original: He’s dressed in a tight white shirt and long johns which are pretty conservative by strip-club standards - although when he flexes his balletic form so that his pert muscles bulge against the fabric, the audible intake of breath around the room informs you that it has an effect nonetheless.
rows.translation: 他穿着紧身白衬衫和长衬裤，以脱衣舞俱乐部的标准而言相当保守。不过，当他舒展那舞者般的身躯，让紧实的肌肉隔着布料隆起时，四周清晰可闻的吸气声说明这身打扮依然效果十足。
rows.raw: " He’s dressed in a tight white shirt and long johns which are pretty conservative by strip-club standards - although when he flexes his balletic form so that his pert muscles bulge against the fabric, the audible intake of breath around the room informs you that it has an effect nonetheless."

rows.original: Fazian clicks his finger-claws, gazing out over the crowd, his visage an unreadable mask over two blue, lively eyes. Hepane begins to sing wordlessly as she caresses the top keys of her instrument, introducing echoing piano-like chimes to her propulsive, itchy, upbeat tune. The anat clicks his fingers, swings his hips and stamps his feet with careless grace, affecting casualness but stamping his feet down right in time with Hepane, drum to her double instrument.
rows.translation: 法齐安弹响指爪，目光扫过人群；难以解读的面具脸上嵌着一双灵动的蓝眼睛。赫潘抚弄乐器上方的琴键，无词吟唱起来，为那股强劲、躁动而欢快的曲调添入钢琴般回荡的钟鸣。安纳泰人打着响指、摆动臀部、踏响双足，姿态从容优雅，看似漫不经心，落脚却始终精准踩在赫潘的节拍上，宛如为她的双重乐器配上鼓点。
rows.raw: "\n\nFazian clicks his finger-claws, gazing out over the crowd, his visage an unreadable mask over two blue, lively eyes. Hepane begins to sing wordlessly as she caresses the top keys of her instrument, introducing echoing piano-like chimes to her propulsive, itchy, upbeat tune. The anat clicks his fingers, swings his hips and stamps his feet with careless grace, affecting casualness but stamping his feet down right in time with Hepane, drum to her double instrument."

rows.original: You realize suddenly that it’s not just the anat creating the percussion. The rhythm reverberates around the room, and looking around you see almost every gold myr drumming their tables with four fingers, grinning and entranced, keeping time with the cocky, feathered dancer. The beat ratchets up and up, Hepane’s fingers working furiously, Fazian throws off more and more his nonchalance with each flex of his hips, until -
rows.translation: 你忽然意识到，打出节奏的并不只有这名安纳泰人。律动在房间里回荡，环顾四周，你发现几乎每个金米尔都在用四根手指敲击桌面。她们笑容满面、沉醉其中，配合着那名自信的羽族舞者维持节拍。节奏一再加快，赫潘十指疾舞，法齐安每一次摆胯都让那份漫不经心消退几分，直到——
rows.raw: "\n\nYou realize suddenly that it’s not just the anat creating the percussion. The rhythm reverberates around the room, and looking around you see almost every gold myr drumming their tables with four fingers, grinning and entranced, keeping time with the cocky, feathered dancer. The beat ratchets up and up, Hepane’s fingers working furiously, Fazian throws off more and more his nonchalance with each flex of his hips, until -"

rows.original: “QUARAMARTA!” cries Hepane. Every gold myr in the room brings all four hands down on the nearest table with a ringing slam. Brilliant red and blue feathers twist furiously on the stage.
rows.translation: “夸拉玛塔！”赫潘高声呐喊。房间里的每个金米尔都将四只手重重拍向最近的桌面，发出铿锵巨响。舞台上，鲜艳的红蓝羽毛疯狂旋舞。
rows.raw: "\n\n“QUARAMARTA!” cries Hepane. Every gold myr in the room brings all four hands down on the nearest table with a ringing slam. Brilliant red and blue feathers twist furiously on the stage."

rows.original: It goes on and on, loosening out after each “QUARAMARTA!” before the jam is tightened up again, each time headier and faster than the last, Fazian’s stomping, writhing dance becoming more and more intense and the rap of fingers around you louder and louder until it’s impossible not to get caught up in it. When he rips off his shirt for the crescendo, light sweat glossing his tight frame, it doesn’t feel stage-managed; it seems absolutely what he should do in that moment.
rows.translation: 表演久久不停，每次喊完“夸拉玛塔！”，即兴演奏都会稍稍舒缓，随后又再度收紧；每一轮都比上一轮更加迷醉、更为迅疾。法齐安跺足扭身的舞姿愈发激烈，四周手指的敲击声也越来越响，让人不由自主地沉浸其中。高潮到来时，他一把扯掉衬衫，紧实的身躯覆着薄汗；这并不像刻意安排的舞台动作，反倒像是那一刻他理所当然该做的事。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt goes on and on, loosening out after each “QUARAMARTA!” before the jam is tightened up again, each time headier and faster than the last, Fazian’s stomping, writhing dance becoming more and more intense and the rap of fingers around you louder and louder until it’s impossible not to get caught up in it. When he rips off his shirt for the crescendo, light sweat glossing his tight frame, it doesn’t feel stage-managed; it seems absolutely what he should do in that moment."

rows.original: “QUARAMARTA!” everyone in the room roars gleefully as he twirls into the air one last time, slamming their hands down so the walls shake, before standing up and applauding furiously. Eyes twinkling and chest heaving, Fazian bows with Hepane.
rows.translation: “夸拉玛塔！”法齐安最后一次旋身跃起时，房间里的所有人都欢快地齐声咆哮，重重拍下双手，震得墙壁都在颤动，随后起身热烈鼓掌。法齐安双眼闪亮、胸膛起伏，与赫潘一同鞠躬谢幕。
rows.raw: "\n\n“QUARAMARTA!” everyone in the room roars gleefully as he twirls into the air one last time, slamming their hands down so the walls shake, before standing up and applauding furiously. Eyes twinkling and chest heaving, Fazian bows with Hepane."

rows.original: You don’t know how they manage to applaud; your single pair of hands ache mightily. Nonetheless, you leave with the crowd feeling galvanized and feisty, grinning stupidly back at everyone else with whom, for a short while, you were a single, musical force.
rows.translation: 你不知道她们怎么还能鼓掌；你仅有的一双手已经酸痛得厉害。尽管如此，你仍随人群离开，心中振奋而斗志昂扬，对其他人露出傻乎乎的笑容。短短片刻间，你们曾融为一股统一的音乐力量。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou don’t know how they manage to applaud; your single pair of hands ache mightily. Nonetheless, you leave with the crowd feeling galvanized and feisty, grinning stupidly back at everyone else with whom, for a short while, you were a single, musical force."

rows.original: He’s dressed in a florid kimono and neck-tie type thing, presumably what passes for smart attire for a male Gildenite. He looks terrifically uncomfortable in it, constantly preening and re-preening his feathers, shooting looks left and right. He jumps when a gold myr with an upturned nose dressed in royal regalia strides onto the stage. The audience titters as another myr, dressed in a maid outfit, follows her closely, carrying a massive, cardboard abdomen.
rows.translation: 他穿着华丽的和服以及类似领带的东西，大概就是吉尔登男性所谓的正式服装。他穿得极不自在，不停梳理又重新梳理自己的羽毛，目光左右乱瞟。一名鼻尖上翘、身着王室华服的金米尔大步登台时，他吓得猛然一跳。观众窃笑起来，另一名女仆装米尔紧随其后，怀里抱着一个巨大的硬纸板腹部。
rows.raw: " He’s dressed in a florid kimono and neck-tie type thing, presumably what passes for smart attire for a male Gildenite. He looks terrifically uncomfortable in it, constantly preening and re-preening his feathers, shooting looks left and right. He jumps when a gold myr with an upturned nose dressed in royal regalia strides onto the stage. The audience titters as another myr, dressed in a maid outfit, follows her closely, carrying a massive, cardboard abdomen."

rows.original: It develops into a pretty standard boy-meets-girl, boy-gets-into-increasingly-farcical-scrapes-as-a-result-of-trying-to-impress-girl play, delivered silently except for Hepane’s expert vaudeville: twisting from mockingly serious martial beat to a panicked plinky-plonk as the mime demands. You’d have doubts about how well it translates to a myr audience, but you guess some things - the queen’s complete indifference to the suitor’s advances, the suitor’s crippling nervousness, his best friend’s sliminess - hit a universal chord, because the audience giggles and guffaws along. The actors’ naturalness helps. The biggest laugh of the evening comes when someone at the back drunkenly yells “Take it off!” After a moment’s pause, the anat fastidiously takes off his wrist cuffs and then carries on with what he was doing.
rows.translation: 故事发展成了一出颇为标准的男孩遇见女孩、男孩为了打动女孩而陷入一连串愈发荒唐窘境的戏剧。整场表演悄然无声，只有赫潘娴熟的杂耍戏配乐：随着默剧需要，从故作严肃的武打节拍转为慌乱的叮咚声。你原本怀疑米尔观众能否看懂，但有些东西大概举世相通：女王对追求者的示好全然漠不关心、追求者紧张得举步维艰、他最好的朋友又油滑不堪，因此观众始终笑声不断。演员自然的表演也功不可没。当晚最大的笑声来自后排某人醉醺醺的一句“脱掉！”短暂停顿后，安纳泰人一丝不苟地摘下腕饰，随后继续手头的表演。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt develops into a pretty standard boy-meets-girl, boy-gets-into-increasingly-farcical-scrapes-as-a-result-of-trying-to-impress-girl play, delivered silently except for Hepane’s expert vaudeville: twisting from mockingly serious martial beat to a panicked plinky-plonk as the mime demands. You’d have doubts about how well it translates to a myr audience, but you guess some things - the queen’s complete indifference to the suitor’s advances, the suitor’s crippling nervousness, his best friend’s sliminess - hit a universal chord, because the audience giggles and guffaws along. The actors’ naturalness helps. The biggest laugh of the evening comes when someone at the back drunkenly yells “Take it off!” After a moment’s pause, the anat fastidiously takes off his wrist cuffs and then carries on with what he was doing."

rows.original: It culminates in the anat somehow believing hanging a lot of dead vermin from a tree will win the queen’s heart - and then, when that ends terribly, marrying the huge predatory bird it does attract (is that a wetraxxal?). The actors all bow at the end and the audience clap enthusiastically.
rows.translation: 最后，安纳泰人不知怎地以为在树上挂满死掉的害兽便能赢得女王芳心；结果此举惨遭失败，他反而娶了被尸体引来的那只巨型猛禽，那是韦特拉克塞尔吗？落幕时，所有演员一同鞠躬，观众热烈鼓掌。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt culminates in the anat somehow believing hanging a lot of dead vermin from a tree will win the queen’s heart - and then, when that ends terribly, marrying the huge predatory bird it does attract (is that a wetraxxal?). The actors all bow at the end and the audience clap enthusiastically."

rows.original: It was all very silly, but leaving with the crowd you feel inspired and enlivened by how much was conveyed without a single word being used. Perhaps with the performance fresh in your mind, you’ll be more able to perceive things about the world and people around you.
rows.translation: 整场戏都荒唐透顶，但当你随人群离场时，想到他们不发一言便传达了如此丰富的内容，你仍感到备受启发、精神振奋。或许因为这场表演仍鲜活地留在脑海中，你会更敏锐地察觉周围世界与人们身上的细节。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt was all very silly, but leaving with the crowd you feel inspired and enlivened by how much was conveyed without a single word being used. Perhaps with the performance fresh in your mind, you’ll be more able to perceive things about the world and people around you."

rows.original: He’s an anat, immediately recognizable by his long, bone-mask face, his double-jointed legs and small, neat claws. His feather plumes are startling, though: rearing way out above his crown and elbows, they’re shades of aquamarine and magenta that continuously glitter and shift under the glare of the spotlights.
rows.translation: 他是名安纳泰人，那张狭长如骨面具般的脸、反关节双腿和小巧整齐的利爪让人一眼便能认出。不过，他的羽冠格外醒目：从头顶和肘部高高扬起，水蓝与品红色的羽毛在聚光灯下不断闪耀变幻。
rows.raw: "He’s an anat, immediately recognizable by his long, bone-mask face, his double-jointed legs and small, neat claws. His feather plumes are startling, though: rearing way out above his crown and elbows, they’re shades of aquamarine and magenta that continuously glitter and shift under the glare of the spotlights."

rows.original: Fazian the anat strides onto the stage; all rearing, flowing feathers, austere ivory and supple muscle.
rows.translation: 安纳泰人法齐安大步登上舞台；高扬飘动的羽毛、冷峻的象牙白骨面与柔韧的肌肉尽收眼底。
rows.raw: "Fazian the anat strides onto the stage; all rearing, flowing feathers, austere ivory and supple muscle."

rows.original: He is dressed... it is not obvious how he is dressed. In each claw he has a vast, feathered fan, and he holds them so they obscure most of his lean, balletic frame.
rows.translation: 他的穿着……你根本看不出他究竟穿了什么。每只爪中都握着一把巨大的羽扇，他用扇子遮住了自己大半精瘦而富有舞者美感的身躯。
rows.raw: " He is dressed... it is not obvious how he is dressed. In each claw he has a vast, feathered fan, and he holds them so they obscure most of his lean, balletic frame."

rows.original: Hepane begins to press the upper keys of her instrument, adding piano-like notes to her sultry bass, deep but upbeat. Fazian is still for a moment longer - gazing out over the room, an impassive mask over lively, blue eyes - before beginning to stride across the stage, first with arch casualness and then sudden, dazzling whirls of movement. Because of the way he intersperses them with slinky, slow down-times, his pirouettes and leaps seem uncontrolled bursts of savagery and passion - except during them he wields his long, fluffy fans expertly, keeping most of his tight musculature behind a bright whip of color. Bare hints of dance-toned hips, butt and subtle abs are hurled out and then whipped back behind the festival-like shimmy of feathers.
rows.translation: 赫潘开始按动乐器上方的琴键，在那性感、低沉而欢快的低音中加入钢琴般的音符。法齐安又静立片刻，目光扫过全场，灵动的蓝眼睛藏在毫无表情的面具之后，随后才在舞台上迈步。起初是刻意摆出的随意步态，紧接着却骤然化作炫目的旋舞。由于这些动作之间穿插着柔缓慵懒的停歇，他的旋转与腾跃仿佛野性和激情失控般爆发；然而动作之中，他始终娴熟地挥舞那对蓬松长扇，让紧实的肌肉大都藏在一道鲜艳的色彩长鞭之后。经过舞蹈锻炼的髋部、臀部和隐约可见的腹肌稍纵即逝，旋即又被节庆般摇曳的羽毛遮住。
rows.raw: "\n\nHepane begins to press the upper keys of her instrument, adding piano-like notes to her sultry bass, deep but upbeat. Fazian is still for a moment longer - gazing out over the room, an impassive mask over lively, blue eyes - before beginning to stride across the stage, first with arch casualness and then sudden, dazzling whirls of movement. Because of the way he intersperses them with slinky, slow down-times, his pirouettes and leaps seem uncontrolled bursts of savagery and passion - except during them he wields his long, fluffy fans expertly, keeping most of his tight musculature behind a bright whip of color. Bare hints of dance-toned hips, butt and subtle abs are hurled out and then whipped back behind the festival-like shimmy of feathers."

rows.original: In keeping with the rest of the performance, the anat’s focus seems to shift, at times seemingly lost in his own whirling dance and then, suddenly, focused intensely on a single area of the room, feathers shaking furiously. When he does this towards where you’re sitting, it’s as if there’s nobody sitting near you at all - his wintery eyes bore into yours, and they are at a center of a shaking kaleidoscope of reds and blues, a flower that moves just for you. Then he’s gone, folding it away and striding to another part of the stage, leaving you to wonder if he is actually naked under there, or...?
rows.translation: 一如整场表演，安纳泰人的注意力似乎不断转移。有时他仿佛完全沉浸在自己的旋舞中，下一刻却突然紧盯房间里的某个区域，羽毛剧烈颤动。当他朝你所在的位置做出这一动作时，你身旁仿佛再无他人；那双冰冷的眼睛直直钻入你的双眸，置身于红蓝色不断震颤的万花筒中央，宛如一朵只为你而动的花。随后他又离开了，收拢羽扇，大步走向舞台另一端，只留下你猜测他藏在下面的身体究竟是否一丝不挂，还是……？
rows.raw: "\n\nIn keeping with the rest of the performance, the anat’s focus seems to shift, at times seemingly lost in his own whirling dance and then, suddenly, focused intensely on a single area of the room, feathers shaking furiously. When he does this towards where you’re sitting, it’s as if there’s nobody sitting near you at all - his wintery eyes bore into yours, and they are at a center of a shaking kaleidoscope of reds and blues, a flower that moves just for you. Then he’s gone, folding it away and striding to another part of the stage, leaving you to wonder if he is actually naked under there, or...?"

rows.original: Hepane ratchets up the beat to a rave-like climax, and in response Fazian finishes the performance with several minutes of intense action, working in back-flips and full air twists, violent, giddy precision during which you think you can glimpse - just a glimpse - of what he’s packing between his tight hips, purple fronds... and then he’s finished, chest heaving and fans bent across his lower body, bowing with Hepane to rapturous applause.
rows.translation: 赫潘将节拍一路推向锐舞般的高潮，法齐安也以数分钟的激烈动作结束表演。他接连做出后空翻和空中转体，以狂暴、令人目眩却精准无比的姿态舞动；其间你觉得自己似乎瞥见了，只是一眼，他紧实双髋之间藏着的东西，几缕紫色饰羽……随后表演结束了。他胸膛剧烈起伏，双扇横遮下身，与赫潘一同鞠躬，迎接如痴如醉的掌声。
rows.raw: "\n\nHepane ratchets up the beat to a rave-like climax, and in response Fazian finishes the performance with several minutes of intense action, working in back-flips and full air twists, violent, giddy precision during which you think you can glimpse - just a glimpse - of what he’s packing between his tight hips, purple fronds... and then he’s finished, chest heaving and fans bent across his lower body, bowing with Hepane to rapturous applause."

rows.original: An unusual strip-tease to say the least. However, like Hepane suggested, you leave feeling frenetic and agitated, a desire to move your hips energetically in concert with someone else nagging at you. Going by the number of hands you can see creeping around waists and abdomens amongst the exiting crowd, you aren’t the only one.
rows.translation: 不管怎么说，这都是一场非同寻常的脱衣舞。不过，正如赫潘所说，你离开时感到躁动而亢奋，一股想与某人一同用力摆动臀部的欲望始终萦绕不去。从散场人群中那些悄悄搂上腰肢与腹部的手来看，有这种感觉的不只你一人。
rows.raw: "\n\nAn unusual strip-tease to say the least. However, like Hepane suggested, you leave feeling frenetic and agitated, a desire to move your hips energetically in concert with someone else nagging at you. Going by the number of hands you can see creeping around waists and abdomens amongst the exiting crowd, you aren’t the only one."

rows.original: As you approach, the ambassador adjusts his spectacles, which hang down from his high-sitting, rounded ears. “Name and ship registration please,” he says, extending a hand for your ship I.D. You give him your name and identification, which he quickly runs through a holo-terminal.
rows.translation: 你走近时，大使扶了扶挂在高高圆耳下方的眼镜。“请提供姓名与飞船登记信息，”他说着，伸手索要你的飞船证件。你把姓名和身份证明交给他，他很快在全息终端上进行了核查。
rows.raw: "As you approach, the ambassador adjusts his spectacles, which hang down from his high-sitting, rounded ears. “Name and ship registration please,” he says, extending a hand for your ship I.D. You give him your name and identification, which he quickly runs through a holo-terminal."

rows.original: Steele: this planet’s at war. Our arrival has caused something of a cease-fire between the red and gold-colored locals, but we’re still very much on the brink of a global nuclear exchange. Whatever business you have here, I suggest you conduct it quickly before the peace process breaks down. Xenogen can try and muddy their hands in this all they want, but if you ask me this planet’s going to be glassed within the year.”
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔：这个星球正在交战。我们的到来促使红色和金色的当地人达成了某种停火协议，但这里仍然处在全球核战争的边缘。不管你来这里办什么事，我都建议你尽快处理，免得和平进程破裂。异源生物科技想怎么趟这摊浑水都行，但要我说，这颗星球一年内就会被烧成玻璃。”
rows.raw: " Steele: this planet’s at war. Our arrival has caused something of a cease-fire between the red and gold-colored locals, but we’re still very much on the brink of a global nuclear exchange. Whatever business you have here, I suggest you conduct it quickly before the peace process breaks down. Xenogen can try and muddy their hands in this all they want, but if you ask me this planet’s going to be glassed within the year.”"

rows.original: He sighs, a long-suffering escape of breath. “If you want to get down to the myrmedion cities, you’ll need to talk to their ambassadors here to get the proper paperwork done: Lyralla with the gold myr,” he points to a golden-plated myr female sitting at the desk beside his: she looks like she’s made of more chrome than chitin, with several cybernetic parts awkwardly bolted onto her natural armor. Quite out of place compared to the rest of the tech here. “And Colonel Nehzara for the red myr,” he points across the thoroughfare to an open side door, leading out to what looks to be a warehouse. A pair of armed, red-chitined myr women stand on either side of the entrance, clad in heavy trench coats and gas masks.
rows.translation: 他长叹一声，仿佛受尽了折磨。“如果你想前往米尔米迪恩的城市，就得先和驻扎在这里的大使谈谈，办妥相关手续：金米尔这边找莱拉拉，”他指向旁边桌前坐着的一名金甲米尔女性。她身上的铬合金似乎比甲壳还多，几件义体部件生硬地固定在天然甲壳上，与这里其余技术相比显得相当突兀。“红米尔则找内扎拉上校，”他指向通道对面一扇敞开的侧门，门外似乎是座仓库。两名全副武装、披着红色甲壳的米尔女性分立入口两侧，身穿厚重的风衣，戴着防毒面具。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe sighs, a long-suffering escape of breath. “If you want to get down to the myrmedion cities, you’ll need to talk to their ambassadors here to get the proper paperwork done: Lyralla with the gold myr,” he points to a golden-plated myr female sitting at the desk beside his: she looks like she’s made of more chrome than chitin, with several cybernetic parts awkwardly bolted onto her natural armor. Quite out of place compared to the rest of the tech here. “And Colonel Nehzara for the red myr,” he points across the thoroughfare to an open side door, leading out to what looks to be a warehouse. A pair of armed, red-chitined myr women stand on either side of the entrance, clad in heavy trench coats and gas masks."

rows.translation: “那些家伙呢？”你指着他身后一小段距离外，正忙着擦洗、抛光一座大理石门廊的那些平胸、四臂、黑甲壳生物问道。

rows.original: Now that you’re an inch or two away from the door, there can be no doubt. It’s Lyralla’s voice on the other side, giggling out hushed, intimate whispers. A male voice answers her, talking in calmer, cooler tones laced with an undercurrent of barely-restrained excitement. The more you hear of it, the more sure you become of its identity. There’s no mistaking his measured timbre. It’s ambassador Juro, the kui-tan representative!
rows.translation: 现在你离门只有一两英寸，再也不可能弄错。门另一边正是莱拉的声音，咯咯笑着低声说出亲昵的悄悄话。一道男性嗓音回应她，语调更平静、更冷静，却掺杂着一股几乎压抑不住的兴奋。听得越多，你就越确信他的身份。那种沉稳的音色绝不会认错。是奎坦代表朱罗大使！
rows.raw: "Now that you’re an inch or two away from the door, there can be no doubt. It’s Lyralla’s voice on the other side, giggling out hushed, intimate whispers. A male voice answers her, talking in calmer, cooler tones laced with an undercurrent of barely-restrained excitement. The more you hear of it, the more sure you become of its identity. rows.original: “The myr?” the ambassador says when you ask. “You speak as if they’re one species. That’s a dangerous assumption on this world, likely to get you beaten in a back alley if nothing else. The Red and Gold Myr have a common ancestor, certainly, but they’ve evolved in markedly different ways. That both subspecies remain today is truly fascinating from a scientific standpoint. It’s the equivalent of the neanderthal and the Homo sapien evolving alongside each other on Earth, if you’ll accept the comparison. Only, the neanderthals developed nuclear weapons.”
rows.translation: “米尔？”你问起此事时，大使说道。“你说得仿佛她们是同一个物种。在这个世界，这种危险的假设就算不会带来别的麻烦，也很可能让你在后巷挨一顿打。红米尔和金米尔确实拥有共同祖先，但她们以截然不同的方式演化。如今两个亚种依然并存，从科学角度看实在令人着迷。如果你愿意接受这个比喻，那就相当于尼安德特人与智人在地球上并行演化，只不过尼安德特人研制出了核武器。”

It’s the equivalent of the neanderthal and the Homo sapien evolving alongside each other on Earth, if you’ll accept the comparison. Only, the neanderthals developed nuclear weapons.”"

rows.original: He chuckles at his own joke, though his smile quickly fades as an aide drops a stack of paperwork off on his desk. “Damn. At any rate, they’re both fundamentally warlike, aggressive, and highly territorial - though the Gold Myr will say anything to the contrary. The Reds, on the other hand, would tell you that you don’t know the half of it. The Reds are certainly the aggressor state here: they unified some hundred years back under the flag of a military dictatorship before starting a campaign of conquest against the Golds seven years ago. The junta in charge of the Scarlet Federation - well, that’s the best translation we’ve come up with for the Red government, anyway - are fairly brutal by galactic standards, though they have done a remarkable job of keeping a primitive planet-wide society together. Better than humans or ausar could do at a point of comparable technological and societal development.”
rows.translation: 他被自己的笑话逗笑了，但一名助手把一叠文件放到桌上时，笑容很快消失。“该死。总之，两个族群从根本上都好战、好斗，而且领地意识极强，尽管金米尔绝不会承认。另一方面，红米尔会告诉你，真实情况远比你想的更严重。这里的侵略国无疑是红米尔：大约一百年前，她们在军事独裁政权的旗帜下完成统一，七年前又对金米尔发动征服战争。统治猩红联邦的军政府相当残暴，至少按银河标准如此；对了，‘猩红联邦’只是我们为红米尔政府想出的最佳译名。不过，她们确实出色地维持住了一个遍及整颗原始星球的社会。在技术与社会发展程度相当的阶段，人类或奥萨尔都做不到这么好。”

rows.original: “The Gold Myr have been fighting a strategic withdrawal since the opening salvo. They’ll claim the moral high ground at every opportunity, though they were the first of the two to use chemical weapons,” the ambassador shakes his head sadly. “Barbaric... absolutely barbaric. Fortunately for them, the only airfield on the planet large enough for the U.G.C.’s purposes was immediately on top of their capital. Were it not for that, I have a sinking suspicion that the Fleet wouldn’t have minded overmuch if the Reds finished what they started.”
rows.translation: “从第一轮齐射开始，金米尔便一直进行战略撤退。她们逮到机会就会宣称自己占据道德制高点，尽管双方最先使用化学武器的正是她们，”大使悲伤地摇了摇头。“野蛮...实在太野蛮了。幸运的是，星球上唯一大到足以满足银河联合邦联需求的机场，正好紧邻她们的首都。若非如此，我隐隐怀疑，即便红米尔完成了她们开始的事业，舰队也不会太过介意。”

rows.original: The ambassador takes his glasses off and rubs one of the lenses on his suit, staring at the haze accumulating on them in the planet’s oppressive humidity. “At any rate, both of the myr races have attracted the attention of Xenogen, who are quickly taking control of the situation here on the planet. Both have interesting biological processes which the mega-corporations are keenly interested in. If only for that, we peacemakers have a duty to keep this planet from engulfing itself in nuclear fire, with the comforting guarantee that if we fail, the Fleet will avenge us on the few survivors of the native population.”

rows.original: The kui-tan gives you a wry smirk. “The humans have a charming expression for them... the ‘Sword of Damocles,’ I believe. Once Xenogen realized the potential for exploiting the locals - sorry, I mean, ‘investing in the success of more primitive species’ - they pulled enough muscle in Parliament to steam a small battle group into planetary orbit to ensure the safety of the embassy here. Or more accurately,” he laughs, “to ensure the local population doesn’t resort to weapons of mass destruction in their petty war while U.G.C. citizens are here on the planet’s surface. Both governments have been informed that if they do, whoever survives the nuclear fire has nothing to look forward to other than kinetic bombardment from the fleet.”
rows.translation: 这名狸猫露出一抹讥讽的微笑。“人类对它们有个很形象的说法...我记得是‘达摩克利斯之剑’。当赛诺基因意识到可以从当地人身上牟利——抱歉，我是说‘投资较原始物种的发展’——他们便在议会里动用了足够的影响力，让一支小型战斗群驶入行星轨道，以确保此地大使馆的安全。或者更准确地说，”他笑道，“是为了确保当地居民不会在联众公民仍身处行星表面时，在这场无聊的战争中动用大规模杀伤性武器。双方政府都已收到通知：一旦这么做，无论哪一方从核火中幸存下来，等待他们的都只有舰队的动能轰炸。”

rows.original: He shakes his head. “Not the most diplomatic of approaches, but unfortunately necessary. Our first scouts arrived in the Myrellion system the very day the Scarlet Federation was intending to unleash their first salvo of nuclear weapons. Luckily for them, extraterrestrial contact temporarily took more of their interest than eradicating all life on the planet.” With a sigh, the ambassador adds: “Hopefully the prefab space station I’ve requested from Colonial Affairs will arrive before that changes. A Steele Tech model, I’d like to add.”
rows.translation: 他摇了摇头。“这算不上最讲究外交手腕的做法，但很遗憾，这是必要的。我们的第一批侦察员抵达米瑞利昂星系的那一天，恰好就是猩红联邦准备发射第一轮核武器的日子。幸运的是，与外星文明接触暂时比消灭这颗星球上的一切生命更能吸引他们的注意。”大使叹了口气，又补充道：“希望我向殖民事务部申请的预制空间站能在局势再次变化前运到。顺便一提，我申请的是斯蒂尔科技的型号。”

rows.raw: "“Ah, of course. Planetary diplomacy is hardly an independent venture, is it?” the kui-tan chuckles, rubbing at one of his raccoon-like ears."

rows.original: “I’m lucky enough to be joined by two myrmedion ambassadors, one from each of the two subspecies. They’ve been indispensable in keeping the peace process alive. Lyralla is our ambassador to the Council of Queens,” he says, inclining his head to the cyber-modded Gold Myr in the desk nearest his. “I haven’t asked for specifics since she arrived, but I’m led to understand she was injured in a rocket or artillery blast immediately after First Contact. One of the medical officers from the Terran command ship saw it happen, and was kind enough to have her brought aboard and repaired. Myr medical technology is somewhat more advanced than that of a comparable period in human history, but her injuries were well beyond the capabilities of the locals nonetheless. She volunteered to work at the embassy here, between physical therapy and cybernetic tuning.”
rows.translation: “我很幸运，有两位米尔密狄翁大使与我共事，两个亚种各派了一位。她们对维系和平进程功不可没。莱拉是我们派驻女王议会的大使，”他说着，朝离自己最近那张办公桌旁、接受过义体改造的金米尔点了点头。“她抵达后我没有追问细节，不过据我了解，她是在第一次接触后不久，被火箭弹或炮击炸伤的。泰伦指挥舰上的一名医疗官亲眼目睹了此事，好心将她接上舰接受修复。米尔的医疗技术比人类历史上同一时期略为先进，但她的伤势仍远远超出当地人的救治能力。她主动申请到这里的大使馆工作，同时接受物理治疗和义体调试。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m lucky enough to be joined by two myrmedion ambassadors, one from each of the two subspecies. They’ve been indispensable in keeping the peace process alive. Lyralla is our ambassador to the Council of Queens,” he says, inclining his head to the cyber-modded Gold Myr in the desk nearest his. “I haven’t asked for specifics since she arrived, but I’m led to understand she was injured in a rocket or artillery blast immediately after First Contact. One of the medical officers from the Terran command ship saw it happen, and was kind enough to have her brought aboard and repaired. Myr medical technology is somewhat more advanced than that of a comparable period in human history, but her injuries were well beyond the capabilities of the locals nonetheless. She volunteered to work at the embassy here, between physical therapy and cybernetic tuning.”"

rows.original: “Lyralla’s a good woman. Dedicated, effective, and otherwise pleasant to work with. In the event we succeed in our mission of peace here on Myrellion, I sincerely hope she’ll consider joining the Confederate Diplomat Corps.” He smiles at that, casting an unprofessionally affectionate glance Lyralla’s way. She catches it and smiles back, though she’s quickly distracted by another offworlder. The ambassador continues: “On the other hand, we have Colonel Nehzara, representing the Scarlet Federation. If I’m to understand correctly, she’s the daughter of one of the Supreme Commanders in the Federation’s ruling body, though I wouldn’t assume she reached this position via nepotism. If you believe her boasting, she led the capture of seventeen different Council-controlled cities and fortifications, not to mention defeating several Gold Myr regiments in close combat. If military acumen is what the Reds respect, then they certainly hold Colonel Nehzara in high regard.”
rows.translation: “莱拉是个好女人。她尽职、高效，平日里也很好相处。如果我们能在米瑞利昂成功完成和平使命，我真心希望她会考虑加入邦联外交使团。”说到这里，他笑了笑，颇不专业地向莱拉投去一道含情脉脉的目光。她注意到后也回以微笑，不过很快就被另一名外星访客吸引了注意。大使继续说道：“另一方面，我们还有代表猩红联邦的内赫扎拉上校。据我所知，她是联邦统治机构中一位最高统帅的女儿，不过我不会因此认定她是靠裙带关系坐上这个位置的。若她的自夸可信，她曾率军攻占女王议会控制下的十七座城市与要塞，还在近身战中击败过数个金米尔团。如果红米尔敬重的是军事才干，那她们确实对内赫扎拉上校推崇备至。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Lyralla’s a good woman. Dedicated, effective, and otherwise pleasant to work with. In the event we succeed in our mission of peace here on Myrellion, I sincerely hope she’ll consider joining the Confederate Diplomat Corps.” He smiles at that, casting an unprofessionally affectionate glance Lyralla’s way. She catches it and smiles back, though she’s quickly distracted by another offworlder. The ambassador continues: “On the other hand, we have Colonel Nehzara, representing the Scarlet Federation. If you believe her boasting, she led the capture of seventeen different Council-controlled cities and fortifications, not to mention defeating several Gold Myr regiments in close combat. If military acumen is what the Reds respect, then they certainly hold Colonel Nehzara in high regard.”"

rows.original: The kui-tan gives a wary look across the way, toward the Commander’s office. “Of course, she and her government are holding the entire planet hostage, and she’s very well aware of the fact. Nehzara’s arrogant, ruthless, calculating. I’ll give her credit, though: she gets things done. I don’t want to look too deep into her methods, but whenever someone or something within the Federation threatens the peace process, she’s been quick to resolve the issue. More so than any of the Gold Myr I’ve worked with - even Lyralla.”
rows.translation: 狸猫警惕地朝另一边指挥官的办公室望去。“当然，她和她的政府正挟持着整颗星球，而她本人对此也非常清楚。内赫扎拉傲慢、冷酷、精于算计。不过这点我得承认：她办事很有效率。我不想深究她采用的手段，但每当联邦内部的某个人或某件事威胁到和平进程时，她总能迅速解决问题。比我合作过的任何金米尔都要迅速——甚至包括莱拉。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe kui-tan gives a wary look across the way, toward the Commander’s office. “Of course, she and her government are holding the entire planet hostage, and she’s very well aware of the fact. Nehzara’s arrogant, ruthless, calculating. I’ll give her credit, though: she gets things done. I don’t want to look too deep into her methods, but whenever someone or something within the Federation threatens the peace process, she’s been quick to resolve the issue. More so than any of the Gold Myr I’ve worked with - even Lyralla.”"

rows.original: Juro chuckles, and adjusts the glasses stuck atop his short little nose. “I’ll take that in the nicest possible light, and try not to be too offended. Yes, it’s true that the kui-tan are a relatively new race on the galactic scene, but given over a century of membership in the U.G.C., I think we’re more than up to the task of a little interplanetary diplomacy. Indeed, our home system had two inhabited planets with two different species. Not unlike the Myr, though happily we didn’t have any sort of land connection to worry about. No chance of war until well after we’d developed interplanetary flight, and by then our races were good enough friends by radio that it wasn’t an issue.”
rows.translation: 朱罗轻笑一声，扶了扶架在短小鼻梁上的眼镜。“我会尽量往好处理解这句话，免得太过冒犯。没错，狸猫确实是相对较晚登上银河舞台的种族，但我们加入联众已有一个多世纪，我认为应付一点星际外交绰绰有余。事实上，我们的母星系里有两颗宜居行星，分别生活着两个不同物种。这一点与米尔颇为相似，不过幸运的是，我们不必为任何陆地连接发愁。直到掌握星际航行之后，双方才有发生战争的可能，而那时两个种族通过无线电早已结为好友，所以根本不成问题。”

Yes, it’s true that the kui-tan are a relatively new race on the galactic scene, but given over a century of membership in the U.G.C., I think we’re more than up to the task of a little interplanetary diplomacy. No chance of war until well after we’d developed interplanetary flight, and by then our races were good enough friends by radio that it wasn’t an issue.”"

rows.original: Juro shakes his head wearily, shuffling some of the paperwork piled up on his desk. “At any rate, to answer your original question - or statement, as it were - I’m not ashamed to admit that my government has taken quite an interest in Myrellion. Enough of one to push the Confederate Diplomatic Corps to assign me here.”
rows.translation: 朱罗疲惫地摇了摇头，整理着堆在桌上的一些文件。“总之，回答你最初的问题，或者说你的陈述，我并不羞于承认，我的政府对米瑞利昂产生了浓厚兴趣。兴趣大到足以推动邦联外交使团把我派到这里。”
rows.raw: "\n\nJuro shakes his head wearily, shuffling some of the paperwork piled up on his desk. “At any rate, to answer your original question - or statement, as it were - I’m not ashamed to admit that my government has taken quite an interest in Myrellion. Enough of one to push the Confederate Diplomatic Corps to assign me here.”"

rows.original: “Why the interest?” you ask.
rows.translation: “为什么会感兴趣？”你问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Why the interest?” you ask."

rows.original: He shrugs in answer, taking a moment before saying, “Understand that kui-tan have some of the highest virility rates of any sapient species in the galaxy, and that both sexes have what you would consider masculine genitalia and the ability to father children. Myrellion has a dangerous lack of males, and a generations-old reproductive problem that has rendered most females sterile, and the population in a constant state of decline. An issue made dangerously clear in what I will optimistically label the aftermath of a seven year long global conflict. Even if this office succeeds in preventing the locals from obliterating themselves, it’s entirely likely that the Myr will simply die out in a few generations regardless. Mass casualties from the conflict have left both factions on the brink of permanent degradation in their genetic pools. In short, Myrellion is a prime candidate for a kui-tan colony once stability is ensured between the local governments, and given Xenogen Biotech’s mutual interest here, could be both a profitable and pleasant planet within a few generations.”
rows.translation: 他耸耸肩，停顿片刻后说道：“你得明白，狸猫的生育能力在银河系所有智慧物种中名列前茅，而且两种性别都拥有你们视为雄性的生殖器，也都能让别人怀孕。米瑞利昂严重缺乏男性，延续数代的生殖问题又导致大多数女性不育，人口始终不断下降。一场持续七年的全球战争所造成的后果，更是以极其危险的方式暴露了这一问题。即使这间办公室成功阻止当地人自我毁灭，米尔仍很可能在几代之后自然灭绝。战争造成的大量伤亡，使两大阵营的基因库都濒临永久衰退。简而言之，只要当地政府之间的局势趋于稳定，米瑞利昂就是建立狸猫殖民地的理想候选地；考虑到赛诺基因生物科技在这里也有共同利益，几代之后，这颗星球完全可以变得既有利可图又适宜居住。”

In short, Myrellion is a prime candidate for a kui-tan colony once stability is ensured between the local governments, and given Xenogen Biotech’s mutual interest here, could be both a profitable and pleasant planet within a few generations.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步

rows.translation: 米尔女人

rows.original: Juro flushes darkly as you speak, quickly fidgeting with his glasses and trying to both sit down and shift his legs at the same time. “Uh, well, you must understand that such an arrangement is beneficial both to the local population as well as for the kui-tan. We are best suited to helping the myr recover from their dwindling numbers, especially if Xenogen repairs the mass sterility that afflicts members of both factions. With my peoples’ help, the myr could be repopulated, or even be expanding, within the span of a generation or two.”
rows.translation: 听你说着，朱罗的脸色涨得更深，连忙摆弄眼镜，同时笨拙地试图坐下并调整双腿。“呃，这个，你必须明白，这种安排对当地居民和狸猫双方都有好处。我们最适合帮助米尔摆脱人口日益减少的困境，尤其是在赛诺基因解决困扰两大阵营成员的大规模不育问题之后。有了我族的帮助，米尔可以在一两代人的时间里恢复人口，甚至重新开始增长。”
rows.raw: "Juro flushes darkly as you speak, quickly fidgeting with his glasses and trying to both sit down and shift his legs at the same time. “Uh, well, you must understand that such an arrangement is beneficial both to the local population as well as for the kui-tan. With my peoples’ help, the myr could be repopulated, or even be expanding, within the span of a generation or two.”"

rows.original: You chuckle at the flustered kui-tan’s answer.
rows.translation: 你听着这名慌乱狸猫的回答，轻笑起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou chuckle at the flustered kui-tan’s answer."

rows.translation: 所以你的意思是...狸猫来这里是为了抢走米瑞利昂的女人？
rows.raw: "So what you mean is... the kui-tan are here to steal myrellion’s women?"

rows.original: “I’d like to talk to you about something, ambassador,” you say, bringing up McAllister’s data on your Codex.
rows.translation: “大使，我有件事想和你谈谈，”你说着，在自己的终端上调出麦卡利斯特的数据。
rows.raw: "“I’d like to talk to you about something, ambassador,” you say, bringing up McAllister’s data on your Codex."

rows.original: <i>“Of course,
rows.translation: <i>“当然可以，
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Of course, "

rows.original: Steele,” Juro says, motioning to the seat across from him. “What can I do for you?”
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔，”朱罗说着，示意你坐到他对面的座位上。“我能为你做些什么？”
rows.raw: " Steele,” Juro says, motioning to the seat across from him. “What can I do for you?”"

rows.original: You smile and place your Codex on the desk between the two of you, and say that you’re more interested in what you can do for him - or rather, for Myrellion at large. The kui-tan’s black nose fidgets, and he adjusts his glasses while he picks up the Codex and starts to read.
rows.translation: 你微笑着把终端放在两人之间的桌上，并说你更关心自己能为他做些什么，或者更准确地说，能为整个米瑞利昂做些什么。狸猫的黑鼻子抽动了一下，他拿起终端开始阅读，同时扶了扶眼镜。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou smile and place your Codex on the desk between the two of you, and say that you’re more interested in what you can do for him - or rather, for Myrellion at large. The kui-tan’s black nose fidgets, and he adjusts his glasses while he picks up the Codex and starts to read."

rows.original: “Hmm, what’s this? I’m not scientist, but this appears to be genetics information. A comparison between red and gold myrmedions at the genetic level, and... ah, hybridity,” he says, sighing slightly and setting your Codex aside. “I met what you’ve deemed here an ‘orange’ myr once already since arriving on this planet. A Federation officer came into the medical center here in the demilitarized zone perhaps two weeks after the First Contact fleet arrived, seeking advanced medical aid, much as many other myr like her. I’d not have paid her any particular attention, if she had not been carrying a young child in her arms. Three years old, I would say, and bundled up in a blanket that hid all but her face.”
rows.translation: “嗯，这是什么？我不是科学家，不过这似乎是遗传学资料。红米尔与金米尔在基因层面的对比，还有...啊，杂交性，”他说着，轻轻叹了口气，把你的终端放到一旁。“我来到这颗星球后，已经见过一次你在这里称作‘橙色’米尔的人。第一次接触舰队抵达大概两周后，一名联邦军官来到非军事区的医疗中心，和许多其他米尔一样寻求先进医疗援助。如果她怀里没有抱着一个年幼的孩子，我大概不会特别注意她。那孩子约莫三岁，裹在毯子里，只露出一张脸。”

I’d not have paid her any particular attention, if she had not been carrying a young child in her arms. Three years old, I would say, and bundled up in a blanket that hid all but her face.”"

rows.original: “While she waited for her turn with our doctors, this officer came to my desk and started talking to me. Again, I thought nothing of it at first: she questioned me about travel offworld, and the reception of alien races among my people, and other races in the Confederate core. Many myr have requested travel visas from us: I dare say the diplomatic corps will be backlogged with them for years to come. She was, however, the first Federation officer I had seen ask - many, many gold myr and some red deserters had filed for passage offworld, but never a uniformed Federation officer. Curious, I asked her why that was.”
rows.translation: “这名军官等待医生接诊时来到我的桌前，开始与我交谈。起初我仍没觉得有什么特别：她询问离开母星旅行的事，也问我的人民以及邦联核心区的其他种族会如何接纳外星种族。许多米尔都向我们申请了旅行签证，我敢说外交使团未来几年都会被这些申请压得喘不过气。然而，她是我见过第一个提出这种请求的联邦军官。许许多多金米尔和一些红米尔逃兵都申请过离开母星，却从未有过身穿制服的联邦军官。出于好奇，我问她为什么。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“While she waited for her turn with our doctors, this officer came to my desk and started talking to me. Again, I thought nothing of it at first: she questioned me about travel offworld, and the reception of alien races among my people, and other races in the Confederate core. Many myr have requested travel visas from us: I dare say the diplomatic corps will be backlogged with them for years to come. She was, however, the first Federation officer I had seen ask - many, many gold myr and some red deserters had filed for passage offworld, but never a uniformed Federation officer. Curious, I asked her why that was.”"

rows.original: Juro sighs and sits down, steepling his furry fingers. He’s silent for a moment, perhaps the longest pause you’ve heard the quick-talking ambassador take yet, before saying “She had her child, a daughter, in her lap at that moment. I’ll never forget the sadness and fear in her face when she unbundled her: the girl had a body of dark orange plates, a shock of red hair, two arms... and her mother informed me, was a naturally-born hermaphrodite of some description. The child was, in the eyes of gold and red, an abomination. A mutation caused by unnatural union between the races. She told me she had been attacked several times since giving birth, that she feared for her child’s safety.”
rows.translation: 朱罗叹了口气坐下，毛茸茸的手指交叠在一起。他沉默了片刻，这或许是你听这位语速飞快的大使停顿得最久的一次，随后说道：“那时她把自己的孩子，也就是女儿，抱在腿上。她解开毯子时，脸上的悲伤与恐惧令我永远无法忘记：女孩全身覆盖着深橙色甲片，长着一头鲜红的头发和两条手臂...据她母亲所说，还是某种天生的双性人。在金米尔与红米尔眼中，这孩子是个怪物，是两个种族不自然结合所产生的突变体。她告诉我，自己生下孩子后已遭到过数次袭击，她担心女儿的安全。”

The child was, in the eyes of gold and red, an abomination. A mutation caused by unnatural union between the races. She told me she had been attacked several times since giving birth, that she feared for her child’s safety.”"

rows.original: “That’s horrible,”
rows.translation: “太可怕了，”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s horrible,”"

rows.original: “Shit,”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shit,”"

rows.translation: 你说道。“她后来怎么样了？”

rows.original: “I arranged for her passage off world, diplomatic priority,” Juro says simply. “That’s beside the point, however. This formula... the people of Myrellion are not yet ready for integration. Neither the Republic nor the Federation would admit to it, of course. They both will claim they only want peace, that they have every intention of getting along with their sister race. But the fact of the matter is that hatred runs deep here,

rows.translation: 斯蒂尔。恐怕你的橙米尔方案弊大于利，尤其会伤害那些服用它的可怜姑娘。我可不想成为一场私刑的起因。”

rows.original: You grit your teeth and take your Codex back. “Come on, ambassador, it can’t be that bad. If it was, why are you even bothering to try and help?”
rows.translation: 你咬紧牙关，拿回自己的终端。“得了吧，大使，事情不可能有那么糟。如果真那么糟，你又何必费心帮助她们？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou grit your teeth and take your Codex back. “Come on, ambassador, it can’t be that bad. If it was, why are you even bothering to try and help?”"

rows.original: “Come on, ambassador. At least make it available to people. Even you have got to be able to see showing the myr how closely related they really are is a start towards peace. Sure, it’ll be a system shock to see hybrids out there, but the myr have got to find a common ground. Maybe an orange myr could be it.”
rows.translation: “得了吧，大使，至少让人们有机会使用它。即便是你也该看得出来，让米尔亲眼见识她们之间的血缘有多么接近，是迈向和平的起点。当然，看到混血儿出现会给社会带来冲击，但米尔必须找到共同点。也许橙米尔就能成为那个共同点。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Come on, ambassador. At least make it available to people. Even you have got to be able to see showing the myr how closely related they really are is a start towards peace. Sure, it’ll be a system shock to see hybrids out there, but the myr have got to find a common ground. Maybe an orange myr could be it.”"

rows.original: Juro sighs and rubs at his temples. “Doubtful, but... it would be unfair to the myrmedion not to give them that chance, I suppose. Please forward the data to my office, and I’ll ensure it makes its way to the medical staff here in the demilitarized zone. I make no promises for them, but I will at least make the data and whatever samples your company sends us available to the medical center.”
rows.translation: 朱罗叹了口气，揉着太阳穴。“希望渺茫，不过...我想，不给米尔密狄翁这个机会也确实不公平。请把数据转发到我的办公室，我会确保资料送到非军事区的医务人员手中。我无法替他们做出任何保证，但至少会让医疗中心能够取得这些数据，以及贵公司寄来的任何样本。”
rows.raw: "\n\nJuro sighs and rubs at his temples. “Doubtful, but... it would be unfair to the myrmedion not to give them that chance, I suppose. Please forward the data to my office, and I’ll ensure it makes its way to the medical staff here in the demilitarized zone. I make no promises for them, but I will at least make the data and whatever samples your company sends us available to the medical center.”"

rows.original: “U-um, I was wondering, if you’re free that is, if you’d maybe... like to go on a date with me--?” she shyly asks, squeezing your hands. You nod, and she wraps her arms around your neck. “R-really? Really, really? Yes! L-let me get changed, first, though.”
rows.translation: “那-那个，我想问，如果你有空的话，愿不愿意...和我约会--？”她害羞地问道，同时紧握着你的手。你点点头，她立刻用双臂搂住你的脖子。“真-真的？真的真的吗？太好了！不-不过先让我换身衣服。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“U-um, I was wondering, if you’re free that is, if you’d maybe... like to go on a date with me--?” she shyly asks, squeezing your hands. You nod, and she wraps her arms around your neck. “R-really? Really, really? Yes! L-let me get changed, first, though.”"

rows.original: You both head back to the Cappella, and [embry.name] goes to get changed. For once, though, she doesn’t let you watch. It’s pretty surprising considering how many times you’ve seen her naked. You wait out in the ship’s living area until she comes out.
rows.translation: 你们一起回到卡佩拉号，[embry.name]去换衣服了。不过这一次，她没有让你在旁边看。考虑到你已经见过她赤身裸体那么多次，这还挺令人意外的。你在飞船的起居区等着，直到她走出来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou both head back to the Cappella, and [embry.name] goes to get changed. For once, though, she doesn’t let you watch. It’s pretty surprising considering how many times you’ve seen her naked. You wait out in the ship’s living area until she comes out."

rows.original: When [embry.name] emerges, what she’s wearing is enough to take your breath away. She’s dressed up in a gorgeous white lace evening dress. It’s trimmed with silver and perfectly hugs her hourglass figure and curves; showing off just the right amount of skin while still being classy.
rows.translation: [embry.name]现身时，她的装扮美得令你屏住呼吸。她穿着一袭华美的白色蕾丝晚礼服，银色滚边精致地点缀其上，完美贴合她沙漏般的身材与曲线；既恰到好处地展露肌肤，又不失优雅。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen [embry.name] emerges, what she’s wearing is enough to take your breath away. She’s dressed up in a gorgeous white lace evening dress. It’s trimmed with silver and perfectly hugs her hourglass figure and curves; showing off just the right amount of skin while still being classy."

rows.original: Underneath, the simii girl is wearing a pair of white peep-toe pumps and she has a small spaghetti strap purse slung over her shoulder. Her pink monkey tail is poking through a hole in the back of her dress.
rows.translation: 这名西米女孩脚上穿着一双白色鱼嘴高跟鞋，肩头挂着一只细带小手提包。她粉色的猴尾从礼服背后的开口中伸了出来。
rows.raw: "\n\nUnderneath, the simii girl is wearing a pair of white peep-toe pumps and she has a small spaghetti strap purse slung over her shoulder. Her pink monkey tail is poking through a hole in the back of her dress."

rows.original: She walks up to you, and does an embarrassed little twirl. The skirt flares out a little as she spins, and her shoes clack against the ship’s floor. “U-um, what do you think? I spent some time sewing this together, s-so... I hope you like it?”
rows.translation: 她走到你面前，难为情地轻轻转了一圈。旋转时裙摆微微扬起，鞋跟敲在飞船地板上发出清脆声响。“那-那个，你觉得怎么样？我花了些时间才把它缝好，所-所以...希望你会喜欢？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe walks up to you, and does an embarrassed little twirl. The skirt flares out a little as she spins, and her shoes clack against the ship’s floor. “U-um, what do you think? I spent some time sewing this together, s-so... I hope you like it?”"

rows.translation: 这身衣服的材料一定花费不菲，缝制也耗去了她大量时间。看来她为了这场约会已经筹备了很久。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt must have cost quite a bit in materials and taken her a lot of time. She must have been planning this date for a while. "

rows.original: You raise your arm and she hooks her arm through it. You head down the great lift to Gildenmere, since there’s nowhere date-worthy on the surface. It takes a while, and a bit of walking, but you find somewhere nice to eat.
rows.translation: 你抬起手臂，她便挽了上来。由于地表没有适合约会的地方，你们乘坐大升降梯前往吉尔登米尔。路途花了不少时间，还走了一段路，不过你们最终找到了一家不错的餐厅。

rows.original: Over food, [embry.name] asks you a lot of questions about your life, and you both enjoy each other’s company. You hold hands and walk through the city, checking out the stores and the sights.
rows.translation: 用餐时，[embry.name]问了许多关于你生活的问题，你们都很享受彼此的陪伴。你们牵着手漫步在城市中，逛着商店，欣赏沿途风光。
rows.raw: "\n\nOver food, [embry.name] asks you a lot of questions about your life, and you both enjoy each other’s company. You hold hands and walk through the city, checking out the stores and the sights."

rows.original: When it gets late, you suggest returning to the DMZ, and [embry.name] squeezes your hand. “J-just one more place, okay--?” she pleads. You follow her lead, and she stops outside of a large looking hotel. She brushes back one of her bangs and takes a deep breath.
rows.translation: 夜色渐深时，你提议返回非军事区，[embry.name]却握紧了你的手。“再-再去一个地方就好，可以吗--？”她恳求道。你跟着她一路走，最后停在一间看起来十分气派的酒店外。她将一缕刘海拨到一旁，深吸了一口气。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen it gets late, you suggest returning to the DMZ, and [embry.name] squeezes your hand. “J-just one more place, okay--?” she pleads. You follow her lead, and she stops outside of a large looking hotel. She brushes back one of her bangs and takes a deep breath."

rows.original: “I, um, that is... I-I want to get a room--!” she nervously exclaims, all the while looking at you with an imploring gaze. “...I-I mean, I want... you... I want you to... And I, um... I-I had a speech, and I’ve forgotten it--!”
rows.translation: “我，那个，就是...我-我想开个房间--！”她紧张地叫道，同时用恳求的目光看着你。“...我-我的意思是，我想要...你...我想让你...然后我，呃...我-我本来准备了一段话，可我全忘了--！”

rows.translation: 恩布里恢复镇定后，声音渐渐低了下去。她只看了你一眼，似乎就失去了言语。她刻意移开视线，不去看你那

rows.translation: 中性化的

rows.original: features, and her cheeks are clearly flushed. “...Um, if there’s, you know... anything you want, j-just ask!” she finishes, her eyes on the table.
rows.translation: 五官，双颊明显泛红。“...呃，如果有什么，你知道的...任何想要的东西，尽、尽管开口！”她说完，目光落在桌面上。
rows.raw: " features, and her cheeks are clearly flushed. “...Um, if there’s, you know... anything you want, j-just ask!” she finishes, her eyes on the table."

rows.original: Simii
rows.raw: "Simii"

rows.original: Your codex beeps, informing you about the species Embry belongs to. You have unlocked the entry for Simii!
rows.translation: 你的百科终端发出提示音，告知你恩布里所属种族的信息。你已解锁西米族条目！
rows.raw: "\n\nYour codex beeps, informing you about the species Embry belongs to. You have unlocked the entry for Simii!"

rows.original: What else would you like to do with Embry?
rows.translation: 你还想和恩布里做些什么？
rows.raw: "What else would you like to do with Embry?"

rows.original: Sadly, in her attempt to leave, she doesn’t watch where she’s going, and collides into a myr customer. Both of them are sent sprawling to the floor. [embry.name] lands with her butt in the air, her long skirt flipped up to her ears.
rows.translation: 遗憾的是，她离开时没有看路，一头撞上了一名米尔顾客。两人都摔倒在地。[embry.name]屁股朝天地趴着，长裙一路翻到了耳边。
rows.raw: "\n\nSadly, in her attempt to leave, she doesn’t watch where she’s going, and collides into a myr customer. Both of them are sent sprawling to the floor. [embry.name] lands with her butt in the air, her long skirt flipped up to her ears."

rows.original: It’s hard not to notice the girly panties flashed at you and her cute butt poking up in the air. There’s something off, though, between her legs. You realize she has a modest bulge where her female parts should be!
rows.translation: 你很难不注意到她露出的少女内裤，以及翘在半空中的可爱屁股。然而，她两腿之间似乎有什么不对劲。你发现本该是女性下体的位置，竟然鼓起了一小团！
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s hard not to notice the girly panties flashed at you and her cute butt poking up in the air. There’s something off, though, between her legs. You realize she has a modest bulge where her female parts should be!"

rows.original: “Oh god, I’m so sorry!” [embry.name] pushes her skirt down and apologises profusely to the customer.
rows.translation: “天哪，真的很对不起！”[embry.name]把裙子拉下来，连连向那位顾客道歉。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh god, I’m so sorry!” [embry.name] pushes her skirt down and apologises profusely to the customer."

rows.original: After the damage is dealt with, she turns to you, looking rather mortified.
rows.translation: 处理完这场乱子后，她转向你，看起来羞窘到了极点。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter the damage is dealt with, she turns to you, looking rather mortified."

rows.original: “...You saw it, didn’t you? My thing...” she mumbles. Right now she looks like she’s going to die from embarrassment. “It wasn’t on purpose--I wasn’t flashing you! It wasn’t a sexual thing at all. Not that I DO sexual things. I’m actually a virgin... not that I... oh... my god.” [embry.name] then facepalms. Clearly she didn’t mean to say that.
rows.translation: “...你看见了，对吧？我的那个东西...”她低声嘟囔。此刻她看起来简直要羞死了。“我不是故意的--我没有在你面前暴露自己！那根本不是色情行为。我又不会做色情的事，其实我还是处女...不是说我...哦...天哪。”[embry.name]随即捂住了脸。显然她根本没打算说出这些。
rows.raw: "\n\n“...You saw it, didn’t you? My thing...” she mumbles. Right now she looks like she’s going to die from embarrassment. “It wasn’t on purpose--I wasn’t flashing you! It wasn’t a sexual thing at all. Not that I DO sexual things. I’m actually a virgin... not that I... oh... my god.” [embry.name] then facepalms. Clearly she didn’t mean to say that."

rows.original: “...What I meant to say is that... there’s a reason for it... I’m... I’m trans...” She looks at you with wide eyes, like she expects some kind of judgement. “I’d... you know, appreciate it if you didn’t tell anybody. I like when people treat me like a girl... I mean, I AM a girl... I’m just, you know, not physically. Yet.”
rows.translation: “...我真正想说的是...我这样是有原因的...我...我是跨性别者...”她睁大眼睛望着你，仿佛预料你会评判她。“我会...你知道的，很感激你别告诉任何人。我喜欢别人把我当成女孩...我的意思是，我本来就是女孩...只是，你知道，身体上还不是。暂时还不是。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...What I meant to say is that... there’s a reason for it... I’m... I’m trans...” She looks at you with wide eyes, like she expects some kind of judgement. “I’d... you know, appreciate it if you didn’t tell anybody. I like when people treat me like a girl... I mean, I AM a girl... I’m just, you know, not physically. Yet.”"

rows.original: “The myr girls around here go crazy for anything that looks like a guy so, please, don’t tell anyone...?”
rows.translation: “这里的米尔女孩只要看见像男人的人就会发疯，所以，求你别告诉别人...好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The myr girls around here go crazy for anything that looks like a guy so, please, don’t tell anyone...?”"

rows.original: Promise
rows.translation: 答应
rows.raw: "Promise"

rows.original: You promise not to tell anyone, and she lets out a visible sigh of relief.
rows.translation: 你答应不会告诉任何人，她明显如释重负地松了口气。
rows.raw: "You promise not to tell anyone, and she lets out a visible sigh of relief."

rows.original: “Thank you! I mean, n-not that I thought you would.” She flushes. “...Um, how about I get a drink for you? On the house.”
rows.translation: “谢谢！我是说，我、我不是觉得你一定会说出去。”她红着脸。“...呃，要不我给你拿杯饮料？我请客。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thank you! I mean, n-not that I thought you would.” She flushes. “...Um, how about I get a drink for you? On the house.”"

rows.original: She gets you a free drink, and places it down on the table. Shortly thereafter, though, you catch sight of her getting chewed out by her boss for not charging you. Busted!
rows.translation: 她免费为你拿来一杯饮料，放在桌上。然而没过多久，你就看到老板因为她没收你的钱而把她臭骂了一顿。被逮个正着！
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gets you a free drink, and places it down on the table. Shortly thereafter, though, you catch sight of her getting chewed out by her boss for not charging you. Busted!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Promise
rows.translation: 答应
rows.raw: "Promise"

rows.original: Tell her that you promise to keep her secret. She looks like she’s about to hyperventilate...
rows.translation: 你告诉她，自己保证会替她保守秘密。她看起来几乎快要过度换气了...
rows.raw: "Tell her that you promise to keep her secret. She looks like she’s about to hyperventilate..."

rows.original: Don’t Promise
rows.translation: 不答应
rows.raw: "Don’t Promise"

rows.original: You refuse to keep her secret. She looks terrified that you’re going to spread it around, and begins stammering madly. “...B-but you can’t--! Why would you even do that...?”
rows.translation: 你拒绝替她保守秘密。她害怕你会把这件事传得人尽皆知，开始疯狂地结巴起来。“...可、可你不能--！你为什么要这么做...？”
rows.raw: "You refuse to keep her secret. She looks terrified that you’re going to spread it around, and begins stammering madly. “...B-but you can’t--! Why would you even do that...?”"

rows.original: She runs away crying, and you’re left with a menu and no waitress.
rows.translation: 她哭着跑开了，只留下你、菜单，以及不见踪影的女侍者。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe runs away crying, and you’re left with a menu and no waitress."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Don’t Promise
rows.translation: 不作保证
rows.raw: "Don’t Promise"

rows.original: Tell her that you won’t keep her secret. Considering how nervous she is, and the pleading look in her eyes, this would probably be a dick move.
rows.translation: 告诉她你不会替她保守秘密。看她如此紧张，眼里又满是恳求，这么做大概挺混账的。
rows.raw: "Tell her that you won’t keep her secret. Considering how nervous she is, and the pleading look in her eyes, this would probably be a dick move."

rows.original: You sit down at an unoccupied table, and make yourself comfortable. You spot [embry.name] standing across the room. The moment she notices you, her cheeks suddenly flush.
rows.translation: 你在一张空桌旁坐下，让自己舒舒服服地安顿好。你看见[embry.name]站在房间另一头。她一注意到你，双颊顿时泛红。
rows.raw: "You sit down at an unoccupied table, and make yourself comfortable. You spot [embry.name] standing across the room. The moment she notices you, her cheeks suddenly flush."

rows.original: She shyly wanders over to your table, almost seeming to hide behind people, a menu clutched tightly to her flat chest.
rows.translation: 她羞怯地朝你的桌子走来，几乎一直躲在人群后面，双手把菜单紧紧抱在平坦的胸前。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe shyly wanders over to your table, almost seeming to hide behind people, a menu clutched tightly to her flat chest."

rows.original: “U-um, here’s your menu, so you can drink or eat. Eat the food on the menu - not the menu itself,” she rambles. “...If you’re hungry. I mean, you don’t have to. I’m not going to force feed you or anything.”
rows.translation: “呃、嗯，这是你的菜单，你可以点喝的或吃的。吃菜单上的食物——不是把菜单本身吃掉，”她语无伦次地说道。“...如果你饿了的话。我是说，你也不一定非吃不可。我不会强行喂你什么的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“U-um, here’s your menu, so you can drink or eat. Eat the food on the menu - not the menu itself,” she rambles. “...If you’re hungry. I mean, you don’t have to. I’m not going to force feed you or anything.”"

rows.original: When she finally does lean over and place the menu before you, the monkey girl drifts unusually close, so much so that you can smell her tickling, floral scent. Her wide blue eyes give you a long, searching look.
rows.translation: 等她终于俯身把菜单放到你面前时，这位猴女郎靠得异乎寻常地近，近到你能闻见她那撩人而带着花香的气息。她睁着一双蓝色大眼睛，久久地打量着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen she finally does lean over and place the menu before you, the monkey girl drifts unusually close, so much so that you can smell her tickling, floral scent. Her wide blue eyes give you a long, searching look."

rows.original: She’s close enough for you to feel her warm breath tickling your cheek. [embry.name] doesn’t seem to have noticed she’s lingering. Her hands have placed the menu down, but she hasn’t let go.
rows.translation: 她靠得如此之近，你甚至能感觉到她温热的呼吸轻拂脸颊。[embry.name]似乎没意识到自己还逗留在这里。她的手已经把菜单放下，却迟迟没有松开。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe’s close enough for you to feel her warm breath tickling your cheek. [embry.name] doesn’t seem to have noticed she’s lingering. Her hands have placed the menu down, but she hasn’t let go."

rows.original: “Y-your menu... here’s your menu...”
rows.translation: “你、你的菜单...这是你的菜单...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Y-your menu... here’s your menu...”"

rows.original: Thank
rows.translation: 道谢
rows.raw: "Thank"

rows.original: You courteously thank her, and discreetly avoid drawing attention to the situation. Instead, you take the menu from her hands.
rows.translation: 你礼貌地向她道谢，并不动声色地避免引人注意。随后，你从她手中接过菜单。
rows.raw: "You courteously thank her, and discreetly avoid drawing attention to the situation. Instead, you take the menu from her hands."

rows.original: However, when your fingers brush against hers, [embry.name] jumps back like she’s received an electric shock. You ask her if something’s wrong.
rows.translation: 然而，当你的手指擦过她的手指时，[embry.name]像触电般猛地退开。你问她是不是哪里不舒服。
rows.raw: "\n\nHowever, when your fingers brush against hers, [embry.name] jumps back like she’s received an electric shock. You ask her if something’s wrong."

rows.original: “N-no, I’m perfectly fine - I’ll leave you to your meal!” In what looks like an attempt to look casual, [embry.name] flicks her hair back, and turns on the spot.
rows.translation: “没、没有，我好得很——你慢慢用餐，我先走了！”像是想表现得若无其事，[embry.name]把头发向后一甩，原地转过身去。
rows.raw: "\n\n“N-no, I’m perfectly fine - I’ll leave you to your meal!” In what looks like an attempt to look casual, [embry.name] flicks her hair back, and turns on the spot."

rows.original: Joke
rows.translation: 开玩笑
rows.raw: "Joke"

rows.original: “Are you part of the menu? You know, since you’re attached to it.” You light-heartedly joke.
rows.translation: “难道你也是菜单的一部分吗？毕竟你一直粘着它不放。”你轻松地开了个玩笑。
rows.raw: "“Are you part of the menu? You know, since you’re attached to it.” You light-heartedly joke."

rows.original: [embry.name] blinks, and drops the menu like it’s on fire. “Oh, I didn’t mean–sorry–I’ll leave you to your meal!” She turns on the spot, and moves to dash off.
rows.translation: [embry.name]眨了眨眼，像菜单着火了似的把它扔下。“哦，我不是故意——对不起——你慢慢用餐，我先走了！”她原地转身，准备飞奔离开。
rows.raw: "\n\n[embry.name] blinks, and drops the menu like it’s on fire. “Oh, I didn’t mean–sorry–I’ll leave you to your meal!” She turns on the spot, and moves to dash off."

rows.original: Mock
rows.translation: 嘲弄
rows.raw: "Mock"

rows.original: “Wow, you’re really attached to the menu. Sure you want to let it go?” You openly mock her.
rows.translation: “哇，你还真舍不得这份菜单。确定愿意放手吗？”你毫不掩饰地嘲弄她。
rows.raw: "“Wow, you’re really attached to the menu. Sure you want to let it go?” You openly mock her."

rows.original: [embry.name] eyes start quiver as if she’s going to cry. She drops the menu, and pulls her hands up to her mouth. “...I’m – I didn’t mean to... I’m sorry!” She turns on the spot, and moves to dash off.
rows.translation: [embry.name]的眼睛开始颤动，仿佛就要哭出来。她扔下菜单，双手捂住嘴。“...我——我不是故意的...对不起！”她原地转身，准备飞奔离开。
rows.raw: "\n\n[embry.name] eyes start quiver as if she’s going to cry. She drops the menu, and pulls her hands up to her mouth. “...I’m – I didn’t mean to... I’m sorry!” She turns on the spot, and moves to dash off."

rows.original: You sit down at an unoccupied table, and [embry.name] comes up to take your order. She’s incredibly uncomfortable being in your presence.
rows.translation: 你在一张空桌旁坐下，[embry.name]过来为你点单。待在你身边让她显得极不自在。
rows.raw: "You sit down at an unoccupied table, and [embry.name] comes up to take your order. She’s incredibly uncomfortable being in your presence."

rows.original: “Anything I can get for you?” She asks. Seems she’s trying to keep things professional.
rows.translation: “有什么想要的吗？”她问道。看来她正努力保持职业态度。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anything I can get for you?” She asks. Seems she’s trying to keep things professional."

rows.original: You sit down at an unoccupied table, and [embry.name] immediately rushes up. She almost trips over her own feet trying to get to your table.
rows.translation: 你在一张空桌旁坐下，[embry.name]立刻冲了过来。她急着赶到你桌边，差点被自己的脚绊倒。
rows.raw: "You sit down at an unoccupied table, and [embry.name] immediately rushes up. She almost trips over her own feet trying to get to your table."

rows.original: “H-hi again! Anything I can get for you?”, she breathily asks. For some reason she’s blushing furiously and mostly looking at her feet while talking to you.
rows.translation: “又、又见面了！有什么想要的吗？”她气喘吁吁地问道。不知为何，她满脸通红，和你说话时大多盯着自己的脚。
rows.raw: "\n\n“H-hi again! Anything I can get for you?”, she breathily asks. For some reason she’s blushing furiously and mostly looking at her feet while talking to you."

rows.original: When you sit down at an unoccupied table, [embry.name] walks up to you. There is a bright smile on her face.
rows.translation: 你在一张空桌旁坐下，[embry.name]朝你走来。她脸上挂着灿烂的笑容。
rows.raw: "When you sit down at an unoccupied table, [embry.name] walks up to you. There is a bright smile on her face."

rows.original: “Hi, [pc.name]! A-anything I can get for you--?” she brushes a stray bang behind an ear.
rows.translation: “嗨，[pc.name]！有、有什么想要的吗——？”她把一缕散落的刘海拨到耳后。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hi, [pc.name]! A-anything I can get for you--?” she brushes a stray bang behind an ear."

rows.original: You sit down at an unoccupied table, and [embry.name] lets out an excited, girlish squeal when she sees you. She skips over to meet you
rows.translation: 你在一张空桌旁坐下，[embry.name]看见你后兴奋地发出少女般的尖叫。她蹦跳着过来迎接你
rows.raw: "You sit down at an unoccupied table, and [embry.name] lets out an excited, girlish squeal when she sees you. She skips over to meet you"

rows.original: , climbing into your lap, and wrapping her arms around your neck.
rows.translation: ，爬到你腿上，双臂环住你的脖子。
rows.raw: ", climbing into your lap, and wrapping her arms around your neck."

rows.original: and wraps her arms around your neck.
rows.translation: ，双臂环住你的脖子。
rows.raw: " and wraps her arms around your neck."

rows.original: Your [pc.face] is then littered with kisses.
rows.translation: 随后，她在你的[pc.face]上亲个不停。
rows.raw: " Your [pc.face] is then littered with kisses."

rows.original: “Hello, you! I’m so glad you’re here - and are you here long? Tell me you are-!” The simii girl gushes. Her tail can’t stop flicking about.
rows.translation: “你好呀！真高兴你来了——你会待很久吗？快告诉我你会——！”这位西米少女滔滔不绝地说道。她的尾巴兴奋得摆个不停。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hello, you! I’m so glad you’re here - and are you here long? Tell me you are-!” The simii girl gushes. Her tail can’t stop flicking about."

rows.original: You walk into the bar, and before you can sit down at a table, [embry.name] spots you. She skips up and wraps her arms around your neck. You both share a long, intimate kiss, and when you pull apart, her cheeks are gently flushed.
rows.translation: 你走进酒吧，还没来得及在桌旁坐下，[embry.name]就发现了你。她蹦跳着过来，双臂环住你的脖子。你们分享了一个漫长而亲密的吻；分开时，她的双颊微微泛红。
rows.raw: "You walk into the bar, and before you can sit down at a table, [embry.name] spots you. She skips up and wraps her arms around your neck. You both share a long, intimate kiss, and when you pull apart, her cheeks are gently flushed."

rows.original: “U-um... h-hey, you-!” The simii girl giddily greets. Her fingers gently clutch at your back. “I’m glad you’re here. Stopping in for long?” There’s a hopeful lilt at the end of the question.
rows.translation: “呃、嗯...嘿、嘿呀——！”这位西米少女兴奋地打招呼，手指轻轻抓着你的后背。“真高兴你来了。会待很久吗？”问题结尾带着一丝期待。
rows.raw: "\n\n“U-um... h-hey, you-!” The simii girl giddily greets. Her fingers gently clutch at your back. “I’m glad you’re here. Stopping in for long?” There’s a hopeful lilt at the end of the question."

rows.original: When you sit down at an unoccupied table, you can’t see [embry.name] about. After a few moments, you feel a pair of slender arms wrapping around your neck from behind, and a soft, shy kiss on your cheek.
rows.translation: 你在一张空桌旁坐下，却没看见[embry.name]。片刻之后，你感觉一双纤细的手臂从背后环住你的脖子，一个轻柔而羞怯的吻落在你的脸颊上。
rows.raw: "When you sit down at an unoccupied table, you can’t see [embry.name] about. After a few moments, you feel a pair of slender arms wrapping around your neck from behind, and a soft, shy kiss on your cheek."

rows.original: “H-hello you-!” The simii girl gives you an affectionate squeeze, before sitting opposite at the table. “...T-that was okay, right. You know, with the hug? I just wanted to hug you to much when I saw you, and I couldn’t help myself!”
rows.translation: “你、你好呀——！”这位西米少女亲昵地抱紧你一下，随后在桌子对面坐下。“...这、这样没关系吧？我是说这个拥抱？刚看到你时我实在太想抱你了，根本忍不住！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“H-hello you-!” The simii girl gives you an affectionate squeeze, before sitting opposite at the table. “...T-that was okay, right. You know, with the hug? I just wanted to hug you to much when I saw you, and I couldn’t help myself!”"

rows.original: [embry.name] is wearing a [embry.armor].
rows.translation: [embry.name]穿着一套[embry.armor]。
rows.raw: "\n\n[embry.name] is wearing a [embry.armor]."

rows.original: She’s all puff and frill.
rows.translation: 她全身都是蓬松的褶边。
rows.raw: " She’s all puff and frill."

rows.raw: "Spacer’s Row"

rows.original: You wake up in an alley some hours later, covered in vomit and regretting your life choices. When the hell did you become such an alcoholic? Damn.
rows.translation: 几个小时后，你在一条小巷里醒来，浑身都是呕吐物，对自己的人生选择后悔不已。你到底什么时候变成这种酒鬼了？该死。
rows.raw: "You wake up in an alley some hours later, covered in vomit and regretting your life choices. When the hell did you become such an alcoholic? Damn."

rows.original: You stagger up, barely restraining yourself from barfing again. You check yourself over
rows.translation: 你摇摇晃晃地站起来，好不容易才忍住没有再次吐出来。你检查了一下自己
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stagger up, barely restraining yourself from barfing again. You check yourself over"

rows.original: , and quickly realize you’ve been looted for five credits. Bastards!
rows.translation: ，很快发现自己被抢走了五信用点。混蛋！
rows.raw: ", and quickly realize you’ve been looted for five credits. Bastards!"

rows.original: and it looks like your stuff is still there. Maybe you didn’t have enough credits to bother stealing.
rows.translation: ，而且东西似乎还都在。也许你那点信用点少得根本不值得他们偷。
rows.raw: " and it looks like your stuff is still there. Maybe you didn’t have enough credits to bother stealing."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Well, you try to stagger back. Instead, you take one clumsy step and fall flat on your face, blacking out before you hit the deck.
rows.translation: 好吧，你试着摇摇晃晃地走回去。结果却只是笨拙地迈出一步，便脸朝下摔倒在地，还没撞上甲板就失去了意识。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, you try to stagger back. Instead, you take one clumsy step and fall flat on your face, blacking out before you hit the deck."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Your whole world goes topsy-turvey when you try to stand. You find yourself rushing for the bathroom, barely making it before you chuck. You spend the next few minutes firmly planted in the stall, puking your guts up.
rows.translation: 你试图站起来时，整个世界都天旋地转。你冲向洗手间，勉强及时赶到，然后大吐特吐。接下来的几分钟里，你牢牢守在隔间里，把肚子里的东西全吐了出来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour whole world goes topsy-turvey when you try to stand. You find yourself rushing for the bathroom, barely making it before you chuck. You spend the next few minutes firmly planted in the stall, puking your guts up."

rows.original: Ugh. You splash some water on your face and head back out into the tavern, carefully leaning on the walls as you go.
rows.translation: 呃。你往脸上泼了些水，然后走回酒馆，一路小心地扶着墙。
rows.raw: "\n\nUgh. You splash some water on your face and head back out into the tavern, carefully leaning on the walls as you go."

rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: You ask [embry.name] if she’d like to spend time with you after work, and she madly blinks at you.
rows.translation: 你问[embry.name]下班后愿不愿意和你待一会儿，她发疯似的眨着眼睛看你。
rows.raw: "You ask [embry.name] if she’d like to spend time with you after work, and she madly blinks at you."

rows.original: “Wait, what? You want to spend time with me--?” she asks. It seems you’ve floored her with your sudden request. “N-not that I’m saying no - I’m happy to! It’s just, there’s not a whole lot around to do that’s interesting, you know? I don’t want you to be bored.”
rows.translation: “等等，什么？你想和我一起待着——？”她问道。你突如其来的邀请似乎把她惊呆了。“不、不是说我不同意——我很乐意！只是，这附近实在没什么有趣的事情可做，你知道吧？我不想让你觉得无聊。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wait, what? You want to spend time with me--?” she asks. It seems you’ve floored her with your sudden request. “N-not that I’m saying no - I’m happy to! It’s just, there’s not a whole lot around to do that’s interesting, you know? I don’t want you to be bored.”"

rows.original: After she knocks off work, she ducks into the back to get changed, and then emerges in a white blouse and blue jeans. It seems like it took her a while to pick out what to wear, and there’s a definite flush to her cheeks.
rows.translation: 下班后，她钻进后面换衣服，随后穿着白色衬衫和蓝色牛仔裤走了出来。她似乎花了不少时间挑选穿着，脸颊也明显泛着红晕。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter she knocks off work, she ducks into the back to get changed, and then emerges in a white blouse and blue jeans. It seems like it took her a while to pick out what to wear, and there’s a definite flush to her cheeks."

rows.original: “Um... hopefully this is okay?” she seems very self conscious. The two of you go for a walk around the airfield, since everywhere else is cordoned off by fences and concertina wire.
rows.translation: “呃...这样还可以吗？”她显得非常不自在。由于其他地方都被围栏和蛇腹铁丝网封锁，你们便绕着机场散步。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Um... hopefully this is okay?” she seems very self conscious. The two of you go for a walk around the airfield, since everywhere else is cordoned off by fences and concertina wire."

rows.original: [embry.name] doesn’t complain once about the lack of sights or things to do. Instead she hovers close as you walk through the partially assembled planes and space freighters. A few spacers cat call at her, and she moves even closer to you.
rows.translation: 穿过那些组装到一半的飞机和太空货船时，[embry.name]一次也没抱怨景色贫乏或无事可做，而是始终贴近你。几个太空客冲她吹口哨，她便靠你更近了。
rows.raw: "\n\n[embry.name] doesn’t complain once about the lack of sights or things to do. Instead she hovers close as you walk through the partially assembled planes and space freighters. A few spacers cat call at her, and she moves even closer to you."

rows.original: “So, which one’s yours...?” she asks, and you point out your ship.
rows.translation: “所以，哪一艘是你的...？”她问道，于是你指出了自己的飞船。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, which one’s yours...?” she asks, and you point out your ship. "

rows.original: eyes go wide, and the monkey girl seems amazed by it.
rows.translation: 双眼睁得大大的，这位猴女似乎对它惊叹不已。
rows.raw: " eyes go wide, and the monkey girl seems amazed by it."

rows.original: “It must be wonderful to be a space captain. I mean, you get to fly anywhere you want, right, free as a bird? But... you know... a space bird,” she facepalms. The analogy ran off on her. “...How’d you get a ship, anyway?”
rows.translation: “当太空船长一定很棒。我的意思是，你想飞去哪儿就能飞去哪儿，对吧，像鸟一样自由？不过...你知道的...是太空鸟，”她捂住脸。这个比喻已经彻底失控了。“...话说，你是怎么得到飞船的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It must be wonderful to be a space captain. I mean, you get to fly anywhere you want, right, free as a bird? But... you know... a space bird,” she facepalms. The analogy ran off on her. “...How’d you get a ship, anyway?”"

rows.translation: 你
