rows.raw: "tell her that you actually got started with your father’s clunker before obtaining the one she sees now. She is"

rows.original: amazed. “Maybe you can show me through it sometime? I-I mean, if you’re not busy, or even here tomorrow. You’re a planet rusher, after all. You might rush off!”
rows.translation: 惊叹不已。“也许哪天你能带我参观一下？我、我是说，如果你不忙，或者明天还在这里的话。毕竟你是个行星淘金者，随时可能冲去别处！”
rows.raw: " amazed. “Maybe you can show me through it sometime? I-I mean, if you’re not busy, or even here tomorrow. You’re a planet rusher, after all. You might rush off!”"

rows.original: Clearly she doesn’t want to think about that, and instead boldly clings to your arm. Eventually you both tire of walking about, and she leads you to a partially dismantled transport, the Cappella, on the landing strip.
rows.translation: 显然她不愿去想那种可能，反而大胆地抱住你的手臂。最终，你们都走累了，她便领你前往停机坪上一艘拆了一半的运输船——卡佩拉号。
rows.raw: "\n\nClearly she doesn’t want to think about that, and instead boldly clings to your arm. Eventually you both tire of walking about, and she leads you to a partially dismantled transport, the Cappella, on the landing strip."

rows.original: “This is where I’m living, at least for now,” she explains, and buzzes in on the ship’s intercom. You are briefly introduced to her landlord - the Cappella’s owner - and she leads you to her cabin room. [embry.name] tells you the captain is renting out rooms, and even certain hallways, until the repairs are done.
rows.translation: “这里就是我住的地方，至少目前是，”她解释道，然后按响飞船的内部通讯器。她简单地把你介绍给她的房东——卡佩拉号的船主——随后带你去了自己的舱室。[embry.name]告诉你，维修完成之前，船长会把房间甚至某些走廊出租。
rows.raw: "\n\n“This is where I’m living, at least for now,” she explains, and buzzes in on the ship’s intercom. You are briefly introduced to her landlord - the Cappella’s owner - and she leads you to her cabin room. [embry.name] tells you the captain is renting out rooms, and even certain hallways, until the repairs are done."

rows.original: There’s not a whole lot in her room, but what is there is very [embry.name]. Frilly outfits hang up everywhere, and there’s an assorted collection of shiny rocks on a bench. There’s a bunch of worn notepads and scrunched up paper about. There’s a bed, though it’s very modest.
rows.translation: 她的房间里东西不多，但每一样都很有[embry.name]的风格。褶边衣服挂得到处都是，长凳上摆着各式各样亮晶晶的石头。周围还有一堆用旧的记事本和揉皱的纸。房间里也有床，不过非常朴素。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s not a whole lot in her room, but what is there is very [embry.name]. Frilly outfits hang up everywhere, and there’s an assorted collection of shiny rocks on a bench. There’s a bunch of worn notepads and scrunched up paper about. There’s a bed, though it’s very modest."

rows.original: A good chunk of the room is taken up by sewing equipment. Her desk is covered in measuring tools, spare cloth, decorations, and boxes of buttons. There’s an old but well maintained sewing machine. There’s also a handful of books ranging from sewing and writing guides, to romance novels.
rows.translation: 房间很大一部分被缝纫设备占据。她的书桌上堆满了测量工具、备用布料、装饰品和一盒盒纽扣。那里还有一台老旧但维护良好的缝纫机，以及几本从缝纫、写作指南到爱情小说不等的书。
rows.raw: "\n\nA good chunk of the room is taken up by sewing equipment. Her desk is covered in measuring tools, spare cloth, decorations, and boxes of buttons. There’s an old but well maintained sewing machine. There’s also a handful of books ranging from sewing and writing guides, to romance novels."

rows.original: “We simii can’t really get tipsy off regular alcohol anyway - our body breaks it down too fast. If you ever end up in a tavern on Omorii, my home planet, the drinks there knock most off-worlder’s socks off,” she tells you, sipping her raspberry tea. “...A lot of simii bartenders will still serve it to travellers, though, because they find it funny to watch.”
rows.translation: “反正我们西米人也不会被普通酒精灌醉——我们的身体分解酒精太快了。要是你哪天去了我的故乡欧莫里，在那里的酒馆喝酒，那些酒能把大多数外星人直接放倒，”她一边告诉你，一边啜饮树莓茶。“...不过很多西米酒保还是会把那种酒卖给旅客，因为他们觉得看客人出丑很好玩。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We simii can’t really get tipsy off regular alcohol anyway - our body breaks it down too fast. If you ever end up in a tavern on Omorii, my home planet, the drinks there knock most off-worlder’s socks off,” she tells you, sipping her raspberry tea. “...A lot of simii bartenders will still serve it to travellers, though, because they find it funny to watch.”"

rows.original: “...Wouldn’t they die of alcohol poisoning?” you ask. If it’s that powerful, they’d probably need their stomach - or stomachs - pumped afterwards.
rows.translation: “...他们不会死于酒精中毒吗？”你问道。要是酒劲真有那么强，他们事后大概得洗胃——或者清洗多个胃。
rows.raw: "\n\n“...Wouldn’t they die of alcohol poisoning?” you ask. If it’s that powerful, they’d probably need their stomach - or stomachs - pumped afterwards."

rows.original: “Sometimes. There’s not a whole lot of law on Omorii, other than what the sheriffs decide to enforce. There’s not a lot of love lost between my people and off-worlders,” the pink haired waitress explains.
rows.translation: “有时候会。欧莫里没多少法律，除了治安官决定执行的那些。我的族人和外星人之间也没多少好感，”粉发女服务员解释道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sometimes. There’s not a whole lot of law on Omorii, other than what the sheriffs decide to enforce. There’s not a lot of love lost between my people and off-worlders,” the pink haired waitress explains."

rows.original: Seems like you’ll need to watch the bartenders if you ever end up on Omorii.
rows.translation: 看来如果你哪天去了欧莫里，得小心那里的酒保。
rows.raw: "\n\nSeems like you’ll need to watch the bartenders if you ever end up on Omorii."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You decide to spend some time with [embry.name]. After work, she switches outfits, and you come back to the bar. After ordering drinks, you find a spare table, and sit down with her.
rows.translation: 你决定陪[embry.name]待一会儿。下班后，她换了身衣服，而你回到酒吧。点好饮料后，你找了张空桌和她一起坐下。
rows.raw: "You decide to spend some time with [embry.name]. After work, she switches outfits, and you come back to the bar. After ordering drinks, you find a spare table, and sit down with her."

rows.original: [embry.name] is playing with the umbrella in her drink - a sparkling raspberry tea. You ask her about her drink choice and she grins.
rows.translation: [embry.name]摆弄着饮料里的小伞——那是一杯冒泡的树莓茶。你问起她为什么选这杯饮料，她咧嘴笑了。
rows.raw: "\n\n[embry.name] is playing with the umbrella in her drink - a sparkling raspberry tea. You ask her about her drink choice and she grins."

rows.original: “O-oh, this? I don’t really drink. I love this drink, it’s got everything; fizz, fruit, and tea!” she excitedly tells you about her favorite drink. “...H-how about you? Do you drink?”
rows.translation: “哦、哦，这个？我其实不怎么喝酒。我喜欢这杯饮料，它什么都有：气泡、水果和茶！”她兴奋地向你介绍自己最喜欢的饮料。“...那、那你呢？你喝酒吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“O-oh, this? I don’t really drink. I love this drink, it’s got everything; fizz, fruit, and tea!” she excitedly tells you about her favorite drink. “...H-how about you? Do you drink?”"

rows.original: All The Time
rows.translation: 总是喝

rows.translation: 你告诉[embry.name]，你们是朋友，所以没必要紧张。她挠了挠后颈，发出一声紧张的笑。
rows.raw: "You tell [embry.name] you’re friends, so there’s no point being nervous. She scratches the back of her neck and lets out a nervous laugh."

rows.original: “R-right, friends--! I’m... um... not really used to having them? I left what few I had back on Omorii, so, I haven’t really made any new ones yet,” she awkwardly explains. “...I-it’s never really been my strength, you know?”
rows.translation: “对-对啊，朋友--！我...呃...不太习惯有朋友？我把为数不多的几个朋友都留在奥莫里了，所以还没交到什么新朋友，”她尴尬地解释道。“...我-我向来不太擅长这个，你懂吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“R-right, friends--! I’m... um... not really used to having them? I left what few I had back on Omorii, so, I haven’t really made any new ones yet,” she awkwardly explains. “...I-it’s never really been my strength, you know?”"

rows.original: You spend some time hanging out with [embry.name], and by the time you leave she seems a lot less awkward around you. You wave goodbye and she happily waves back. She looks thrilled to have a new friend, despite her very obvious crush on you.
rows.translation: 你花了些时间和[embry.name]相处，到你离开时，她在你身边已经没那么拘谨了。你挥手告别，她也开心地挥手回应。尽管显然暗恋着你，她看起来还是为交到新朋友而欣喜不已。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou spend some time hanging out with [embry.name], and by the time you leave she seems a lot less awkward around you. You wave goodbye and she happily waves back. She looks thrilled to have a new friend, despite her very obvious crush on you."

rows.raw: "You tell [embry.name] you’re just acquaintances, so there’s no point being nervous. She looks down at her hands and lets out a long sigh."

rows.original: “O-of course we are. S-silly me... you could never be interested in me; not with all the real girls out there, right?” she mumbles. Her back is hunched and her pink hair is covering her expression.
rows.translation: “当-当然只是这样。是-是我犯傻了...外面有那么多真正的女孩，你怎么可能对我感兴趣，对吧？”她喃喃道。她弓着背，粉色头发遮住了表情。
rows.raw: "\n\n“O-of course we are. S-silly me... you could never be interested in me; not with all the real girls out there, right?” she mumbles. Her back is hunched and her pink hair is covering her expression."

rows.original: When she looks up, though, she’s hiding her disappointment behind a strained smile. “R-right! I just wanted to, you know, thank you for keeping my secret! U-um... thank you.”
rows.translation: 然而，当她抬起头时，已经用勉强的笑容藏起了失望。“对-对！我只是想，你知道的，谢谢你替我保守秘密！呃-嗯...谢谢。”
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen she looks up, though, she’s hiding her disappointment behind a strained smile. “R-right! I just wanted to, you know, thank you for keeping my secret! U-um... thank you.”"

rows.original: You spend a little longer with [embry.name], though the awkward atmosphere persists until you leave. A pained expression briefly flickers over her face as you tell her you’re leaving, but she doesn’t stop you, instead waving you goodbye.
rows.translation: 你又陪了[embry.name]一会儿，但尴尬的气氛一直持续到你离开。当你说要走时，她脸上短暂闪过痛苦的神色，却没有挽留，只是挥手向你道别。

rows.original: She looks up at the roof with a reminiscent look in her eyes. “...You know... there’s a big mine not far from where I used to live, back on Omorii. It’s owned by Steele Industrial Technology and Production, but run and operated by locals. We call it the ‘Big Steele’ mine.”
rows.translation: 她抬头望着屋顶，眼中流露出追忆之色。“...你知道吗...在奥莫里，我以前住的地方附近有一座大矿场。它归斯蒂尔工业科技与生产公司所有，但由当地人经营管理。我们叫它‘大斯蒂尔’矿场。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe looks up at the roof with a reminiscent look in her eyes. “...You know... there’s a big mine not far from where I used to live, back on Omorii. It’s owned by Steele Industrial Technology and Production, but run and operated by locals. We call it the ‘Big Steele’ mine.”"

rows.original: “Most people who aren’t farmers on Omorii are miners. One of my uncles - my father’s brother - is actually a foreman in the mine. And here I am, talking to [pc.name]. Small galaxy, huh?”
rows.translation: “奥莫里不务农的人大多是矿工。我的一个叔叔——我父亲的弟弟——其实就是那座矿场的工头。而我现在居然在和[pc.name]聊天。银河系可真小，对吧？”

I’m eighteen, and I like sewing and collecting shiny rocks...” she trails off. “...Kind of lame, right? I told you, I’m not that special.”
rows.translation: 你又追问了几句，她终于让步。“呃...好吧。那就说我的全名？[embry.name]·帕尔。我来自奥莫里，一颗离这里不太远的星球。我十八岁，喜欢缝纫和收集闪亮的石头...”她的声音渐渐低了下去。“...挺无聊的，对吧？我说过了，我没什么特别的。”

rows.original: “The simii? We mostly live on frontier worlds. Um... we’ve got big ears, and flexible tails, but so do a lot of species.” she curls her pink tail about, showing it off to you.
rows.translation: “西米族？我们主要生活在边疆星球。呃...我们有大耳朵和灵活的尾巴，不过很多种族也有这些。”她卷动粉色的尾巴，向你展示起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“The simii? We mostly live on frontier worlds. Um... we’ve got big ears, and flexible tails, but so do a lot of species.” she curls her pink tail about, showing it off to you."

rows.original: You mention the similarities between the simii and terran primates, and [embry.name] nods.
rows.translation: 你提到西米族和地球灵长类动物之间的相似之处，[embry.name]点了点头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou mention the similarities between the simii and terran primates, and [embry.name] nods."

rows.original: “Oh, yeah--! We’re originally descended from them. Well, kind of. Humans took a bunch of human-like animals - primates - and experimented on them to make my ancestors. Then they, my ancestors, were launched into space to colonize new worlds.” [embry.name] sounds a little uncertain. “...I mean, that’s what I was taught in school, anyway.”
rows.translation: “哦，对啊--！我们最初就是它们的后裔。嗯，也不完全是。人类抓来了一批长得像人的动物——灵长类——进行实验，创造了我的祖先。然后他们，也就是我的祖先，被发射到太空去殖民新的世界。”[embry.name]听起来有些不确定。“...我是说，反正学校里就是这么教的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, yeah--! We’re originally descended from them. Well, kind of. Humans took a bunch of human-like animals - primates - and experimented on them to make my ancestors. Then they, my ancestors, were launched into space to colonize new worlds.” [embry.name] sounds a little uncertain. “...I mean, that’s what I was taught in school, anyway.”"

rows.original: “We’re independent now, of course, and humans rarely set foot on simii worlds. There were some wars for independence way before I was born. We have big parades every so often to celebrate them, and sometimes war reenactments.”
rows.translation: “当然，我们现在已经独立了，人类也很少踏足西米族的世界。在我出生很久以前发生过几场独立战争。我们偶尔会举行盛大游行来纪念，有时还会重演战争。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We’re independent now, of course, and humans rarely set foot on simii worlds. There were some wars for independence way before I was born. We have big parades every so often to celebrate them, and sometimes war reenactments.”"

rows.original: You ask if [embry.name] participated in any, and she flushed. “...Uh, no. I think... they’re kind of dorky. I mean, my dad liked them, but it just wasn’t my thing.”
rows.translation: 你问[embry.name]是否参加过，她脸红了。“...呃，没有。我觉得...那些活动有点傻气。我的意思是，我爸爸喜欢，但那不是我的爱好。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask if [embry.name] participated in any, and she flushed. “...Uh, no. I think... they’re kind of dorky. I mean, my dad liked them, but it just wasn’t my thing.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You ask [embry.name] how she came to be a waitress, and she tugs at the sides of her outfit.
rows.translation: 你问[embry.name]是怎么当上服务生的，她揪了揪制服两侧。
rows.raw: "You ask [embry.name] how she came to be a waitress, and she tugs at the sides of her outfit."

rows.original: “Um, it was the only job I could find once I got to Myrellion. Actually, I didn’t know the planet was so... uh... hostile,” she diplomatically states. “...Can you believe they fly prop rotors here? It’s crazy!”
rows.translation: “呃，这是我到迈瑞利恩后唯一能找到的工作。其实，我不知道这颗星球会这么...呃...充满敌意，”她委婉地说道。“...你能相信这里还用螺旋桨旋翼飞行吗？太疯狂了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Um, it was the only job I could find once I got to Myrellion. Actually, I didn’t know the planet was so... uh... hostile,” she diplomatically states. “...Can you believe they fly prop rotors here? It’s crazy!”"

rows.original: Realizing she’s getting off topic, she blushes, and continues. “I saw a sign, and I walked in to ask for a job. I was wearing this outfit, actually, and they told me to stop slacking off and get to work... I guess I must have looked like I already worked there. So... I just started waiting tables.”
rows.translation: 意识到自己跑题了，她红着脸继续说道。“我看到一块招牌，就走进去问有没有工作。其实我当时就穿着这身衣服，他们叫我别偷懒，赶紧干活...我猜自己看起来就像已经在那里工作一样。所以...我就开始端盘子了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nRealizing she’s getting off topic, she blushes, and continues. “I saw a sign, and I walked in to ask for a job. I was wearing this outfit, actually, and they told me to stop slacking off and get to work... I guess I must have looked like I already worked there. So... I just started waiting tables.”"

rows.original: You look at her outfit. She wore something like that before she got the job? You ask her why she didn’t correct them.
rows.translation: 你打量着她的衣服。她在得到这份工作以前就穿成这样？你问她为什么不纠正他们。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou look at her outfit. She wore something like that before she got the job? You ask her why she didn’t correct them."

rows.original: “Um... well, I kind of like being told what to do. It’s simpler, you know? And I was after the job anyway, so, no interview. Right?”
rows.translation: “呃...这个嘛，我其实挺喜欢别人告诉我该做什么。这样更简单，你懂吧？而且我本来就是来找工作的，所以不用面试。对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Um... well, I kind of like being told what to do. It’s simpler, you know? And I was after the job anyway, so, no interview. Right?”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You ask [embry.name] how she ended up on Myrellion, of all places. Surely there were more peaceful planets?
rows.translation: 你问[embry.name]怎么偏偏来到了迈瑞利恩。肯定有更和平的星球吧？
rows.raw: "You ask [embry.name] how she ended up on Myrellion, of all places. Surely there were more peaceful planets?"

rows.original: “W-well, yeah, but transport to Myrellion was all I could afford,” she lets out a little sigh, and continues, “I didn’t realise why it was so cheap at the time, I was just excited there were cheap flights off my home planet. I’m stuck here until I get enough money for passage off-world.”
rows.translation: “是-是啊，但我只付得起前往迈瑞利恩的船票，”她轻轻叹了口气，继续说道，“当时我没意识到为什么会这么便宜，只顾着为能买到离开家乡星球的廉价船票而兴奋。我得赚够离开这里的路费，才能摆脱困境。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“W-well, yeah, but transport to Myrellion was all I could afford,” she lets out a little sigh, and continues, “I didn’t realise why it was so cheap at the time, I was just excited there were cheap flights off my home planet. I’m stuck here until I get enough money for passage off-world.”"

rows.original: There are more jobs in Gildenmere than there are at the spaceport, and you say as much. [embry.name] flushes a bit and shakes her head.
rows.translation: 吉尔登米尔的工作机会比太空港多，你也这么说了。[embry.name]微微脸红，摇了摇头。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere are more jobs in Gildenmere than there are at the spaceport, and you say as much. [embry.name] flushes a bit and shakes her head."

rows.original: “What, are you crazy? I’m not moving further from the embassy than I need to. If war breaks out, at least they’ll give me free passage off world. Probably to Omorii, but that can’t be helped... it’s better than being taken as a prisoner of war.”
rows.translation: “什么，你疯了吗？我可不想离大使馆太远。要是战争爆发，他们至少会免费送我离开这颗星球。大概会送回奥莫里，不过那也没办法...总比被当成战俘好。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What, are you crazy? I’m not moving further from the embassy than I need to. If war breaks out, at least they’ll give me free passage off world. Probably to Omorii, but that can’t be helped... it’s better than being taken as a prisoner of war.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You ask [embry.name] about her hobby of collecting ‘shiny rocks’. Is it some kind of geology?
rows.translation: 你问[embry.name]收集‘闪亮石头’这一爱好。那算某种地质学吗？
rows.raw: "You ask [embry.name] about her hobby of collecting ‘shiny rocks’. Is it some kind of geology?"

rows.original: “N-nothing that special, like gems or anything. I just like collecting polished, colorful rocks, you know? Like the kind you can get at crystal shops.”
rows.translation: “没-没那么特别，不是什么宝石之类的。我只是喜欢收集打磨光滑、色彩鲜艳的石头，你懂吧？就是水晶商店里能买到的那种。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“N-nothing that special, like gems or anything. I just like collecting polished, colorful rocks, you know? Like the kind you can get at crystal shops.”"

rows.original: [embry.name] pulls one out of the pocket of her waitress outfit, and shows it to you. It’s a beautiful, smooth chameleon rock. It doesn’t look like it’s from Myrellion - perhaps her home planet?
rows.translation: [embry.name]从服务生制服的口袋里掏出一块给你看。那是一块美丽、光滑的变色龙石。看起来不像产自迈瑞利恩——也许来自她的家乡星球？
rows.raw: "\n\n[embry.name] pulls one out of the pocket of her waitress outfit, and shows it to you. It’s a beautiful, smooth chameleon rock. It doesn’t look like it’s from Myrellion - perhaps her home planet?"

rows.original: She strokes it softly with her fingers. “...When they’re polished up, I can spend hours turning them over and over in my hands, staring into them. I’m not sure if you could call it a hobby, but it makes me kind of happy.”
rows.translation: 她用手指轻柔地抚摸着它。“...把它们打磨光亮后，我可以花上好几个小时在手里反复翻看，凝视着它们。我不知道这算不算爱好，但它确实会让我有点开心。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe strokes it softly with her fingers. “...When they’re polished up, I can spend hours turning them over and over in my hands, staring into them. I’m not sure if you could call it a hobby, but it makes me kind of happy.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You ask [embry.name] about her sewing, and if she makes her own outfits.
rows.translation: 你问[embry.name]关于缝纫的事，还有她是否会自己做衣服。
rows.raw: "You ask [embry.name] about her sewing, and if she makes her own outfits."

rows.original: She nods happily, and grabs the hem of her dress. “Yup! This is my work. It’s nothing special - I’m not a siel or anything - but it’s cheaper than buying my own stuff.”
rows.translation: 她开心地点点头，抓住裙摆。“对呀！这是我做的。没什么特别的——我又不是什么希尔人——但总比自己买衣服便宜。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe nods happily, and grabs the hem of her dress. “Yup! This is my work. It’s nothing special - I’m not a siel or anything - but it’s cheaper than buying my own stuff.”"

rows.original: “Clothes are expensive when you’ve got an... um, unusual body shape. Especially here on Myrellion, where nobody seems to want to wear anything,” she blushes. “I don’t think I could bear walking around naked like
rows.translation: “要是身材...嗯，不太寻常，衣服就很贵。尤其是在密瑞利昂，这里好像根本没人想要 穿 衣服，”她红着脸说。“我觉得自己受不了像
rows.raw: "\n\n“Clothes are expensive when you’ve got an... um, unusual body shape. Especially here on Myrellion, where nobody seems to want to wear anything,” she blushes. “I don’t think I could bear walking around naked like "

rows.original: you do
rows.translation: 你这样
rows.raw: "you do"

rows.original: some of the myr do
rows.translation: 某些米尔人那样
rows.raw: "some of the myr do"

rows.original: “I like making things with frills, mostly. It makes me feel girly, and that makes me happy.”
rows.translation: “我主要喜欢做带褶边的东西。那会让我觉得很有少女气息，也会让我开心。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I like making things with frills, mostly. It makes me feel girly, and that makes me happy.”"

rows.original: You ask how she learned how to sew, and her eyes look a bit wistful. She looks like she’s recalling a fond memory.
rows.translation: 你问她是怎么学会缝纫的，她的眼神流露出一丝怀念。她似乎正在回忆一段美好的往事。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask how she learned how to sew, and her eyes look a bit wistful. She looks like she’s recalling a fond memory."

rows.original: “...Down the street from my house on Omorii, there was this kindly old kaithrit lady, Athilda, who taught me,” she smiles, and looks down at her hands. “...Most other simii didn’t understand that I wanted to be a girl - that I am a girl - but Athilda did.”
rows.translation: “...在奥莫里我家那条街上，住着一位和蔼的凯瑟瑞特老妇人，叫阿希尔达，是她教我的，”她微笑着低头看向双手。“...其他大多数西米人都不明白我想成为女孩——不明白我 就是 女孩——但阿希尔达明白。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...Down the street from my house on Omorii, there was this kindly old kaithrit lady, Athilda, who taught me,” she smiles, and looks down at her hands. “...Most other simii didn’t understand that I wanted to be a girl - that I am a girl - but Athilda did.”"

rows.original: “She helped me sew dresses, and let me try them on with her.” She pauses before continuing, “...It turns out she was trans like me. I only found out just before I left Omorii.”
rows.translation: “她帮我缝裙子，还让我和她一起试穿。”她停顿了一下才继续说道，“...后来我才知道，她和我一样也是跨性别者。直到离开奥莫里前不久我才发现。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“She helped me sew dresses, and let me try them on with her.” She pauses before continuing, “...It turns out she was trans like me. I only found out just before I left Omorii.”"

rows.original: You can hear the bittersweet affection in [embry.name]’s voice. It sounds like Athilda is someone very important to her.
rows.translation: 你能从[embry.name]的声音中听出那种苦乐参半的深情。听起来阿希尔达对她而言是个非常重要的人。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can hear the bittersweet affection in [embry.name]’s voice. It sounds like Athilda is someone very important to her."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You ask her about Omorii, her home planet, and what it’s like there.
rows.translation: 你问她的故乡奥莫里是什么样的地方。
rows.raw: "You ask her about Omorii, her home planet, and what it’s like there."

rows.original: [embry.name] brushes back her hair, and lets out a huff. “...Not that exciting, really. It’s the galactic boonies. Some people think it’s ‘authentic frontier living,’ but that’s a nice way of saying ‘nobody in their right mind lives here’.”
rows.translation: [embry.name]把头发拨到脑后，轻哼一声。“...其实没那么有趣。那里是银河系的穷乡僻壤。有些人觉得那叫‘原汁原味的边疆生活’，但这不过是‘脑子正常的人都不会住在这里’的好听说法。”
rows.raw: "\n\n[embry.name] brushes back her hair, and lets out a huff. “...Not that exciting, really. It’s the galactic boonies. Some people think it’s ‘authentic frontier living,’ but that’s a nice way of saying ‘nobody in their right mind lives here’.”"

rows.original: “Most of the planet is white, I mean, like, really white. It’s all like bleached ivory; the mountains, deserts, and grass. Most off-worlders can’t handle it without wearing eye protection. There’s settlements all over the planet, but each one has it’s own laws.”
rows.translation: “星球大部分地方都是白色的，我是说，真的 非常 白。山脉、沙漠和草地全都像漂白过的象牙。大多数外星人不戴护目镜就受不了。星球各处都有聚居地，但每一个都有自己的法律。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Most of the planet is white, I mean, like, really white. It’s all like bleached ivory; the mountains, deserts, and grass. Most off-worlders can’t handle it without wearing eye protection. There’s settlements all over the planet, but each one has it’s own laws.”"

rows.original: You ask how they deal with law breakers if they skip town, and [embry.name] smiles. “...We don’t. There’s lots of bandits living between our settlements, all tough as nails. Simii are wary of offworlders, because most of them are on Omorii to hide from the authorities.”
rows.translation: 你问如果违法者逃出城镇，他们会怎么处理，[embry.name]笑了。“...我们不处理。聚居地之间住着许多悍匪，一个个都硬得像钉子。西米人很提防外来者，因为他们大多是来奥莫里躲避执法机关的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask how they deal with law breakers if they skip town, and [embry.name] smiles. “...We don’t. There’s lots of bandits living between our settlements, all tough as nails. Simii are wary of offworlders, because most of them are on Omorii to hide from the authorities.”"

rows.original: If life is so tough on Omorii, you ask, how does anyone survive there?
rows.translation: 既然奥莫里的生活如此艰苦，你问，那大家究竟怎么活下去？
rows.raw: "\n\nIf life is so tough on Omorii, you ask, how does anyone survive there?"

rows.original: “We’ve got our ways. Protective domes, good irrigation, and lots and lots of hard work. My father was a farmer, actually, and so was my grandfather...” [embry.name] trails off a little bit, and looks guilty.
rows.translation: “我们自有办法。防护穹顶、良好的灌溉，还有大量、大量的辛勤劳动。其实我父亲是农民，我祖父也是...”[embry.name]的声音渐渐低了下去，神情有些愧疚。
rows.raw: "\n\n“We’ve got our ways. Protective domes, good irrigation, and lots and lots of hard work. My father was a farmer, actually, and so was my grandfather...” [embry.name] trails off a little bit, and looks guilty."

rows.original: “...I was meant to take over the family trade too, but I left. I just couldn’t stand life on Omorii any longer.”
rows.translation: “...我本来也应该继承家业，但我离开了。我再也忍受不了奥莫里的生活。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...I was meant to take over the family trade too, but I left. I just couldn’t stand life on Omorii any longer.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You ask [embry.name] about her family back on Omorii, and her expression becomes a little clouded.
rows.translation: 你问[embry.name]她在奥莫里的家人，她的神情蒙上了一层阴霾。
rows.raw: "You ask [embry.name] about her family back on Omorii, and her expression becomes a little clouded."

rows.original: “...My family? There’s not much to tell. I’m an only child, which is pretty unusual for we simii. My parents tried hard for a child, but all they got was me,” she sullenly looks downward. “I ran away from home as soon as I was able to. They’re probably cursing the fact I was ever born.”
rows.translation: “...我的家人？没什么好说的。我是独生子女，这对我们西米人来说很少见。父母很努力地想要孩子，结果只得到了我，”她闷闷不乐地低下头。“我一有能力就离家出走了。他们大概正在诅咒我为什么会出生吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...My family? There’s not much to tell. I’m an only child, which is pretty unusual for we simii. My parents tried hard for a child, but all they got was me,” she sullenly looks downward. “I ran away from home as soon as I was able to. They’re probably cursing the fact I was ever born.” "

rows.original: She sighs and brushes back her pink hair. “Sorry, I got all emo there for a second, didn’t I? My parents are really traditional, and they really, really wanted a boy. I couldn’t live up to their expectations, though. I didn’t even have the guts to tell them I was trans before I left.”
rows.translation: 她叹了口气，把粉色头发拨到脑后。“抱歉，我刚才突然多愁善感起来了，对吧？我的父母非常传统，他们真的、真的很想要一个儿子。但我没能达到他们的期望。我离开前甚至没勇气告诉他们我是跨性别者。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe sighs and brushes back her pink hair. “Sorry, I got all emo there for a second, didn’t I? My parents are really traditional, and they really, really wanted a boy. I couldn’t live up to their expectations, though. I didn’t even have the guts to tell them I was trans before I left.”"

rows.original: You blink, and ask if that means they think she’s missing? The monkey girl somberly nods, looking guilt-ridden.
rows.translation: 你眨眨眼，问这是否意味着他们以为她失踪了？猴女神情阴郁地点点头，满脸愧疚。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou blink, and ask if that means they think she’s missing? The monkey girl somberly nods, looking guilt-ridden."

rows.original: “...I know, I’m a coward. But I already know what they’d say - the looks of judgement in their eyes, and disappointment. My mother found one of my dresses once, and... s-she didn’t take it well,” she sadly stutters. “S-she cried for me, and my dad burnt it.”
rows.translation: “...我知道，我是个懦夫。但我已经知道他们会怎么说——知道他们眼中的评判与失望。妈妈有一次发现了我的一条裙子，然后...她、她无法接受，”她悲伤地结巴起来。“她、她为我哭了，爸爸则把裙子烧掉了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...I know, I’m a coward. But I already know what they’d say - the looks of judgement in their eyes, and disappointment. My mother found one of my dresses once, and... s-she didn’t take it well,” she sadly stutters. “S-she cried for me, and my dad burnt it.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You ask her about her transitioning. Surely it can’t be that hard to just get gender reassignment treatment?
rows.translation: 你问她的性别过渡。接受性别重置治疗应该没有那么难吧？
rows.raw: "You ask her about her transitioning. Surely it can’t be that hard to just get gender reassignment treatment?"

rows.original: [embry.name] looks down at her feet, and scuffs the ground with her foot. “For most folks, maybe. I’m a simii, and my species has really tough immune systems. Actually, most things don’t work on us - like viruses, transformatives, sedatives, and alcohol.”
rows.translation: [embry.name]低头看着双脚，用脚蹭着地面。“对大多数人来说也许是吧。我是西米人，我们这个种族的免疫系统非常强。其实大多数东西对我们都不起作用——比如病毒、变形物、镇静剂和酒精。”
rows.raw: "\n\n[embry.name] looks down at her feet, and scuffs the ground with her foot. “For most folks, maybe. I’m a simii, and my species has really tough immune systems. Actually, most things don’t work on us - like viruses, transformatives, sedatives, and alcohol.”"

rows.original: “The upside is we’re really hardy, but the downside is, medical treatment is near impossible. The drugs needed for me to transition are incredibly strong, and very expensive. They’re actually outlawed except in certain situations like mine, because they have pretty extreme effects on non-simii...”
rows.translation: “好处是我们非常强健，但坏处是，医疗几乎不可能奏效。让我完成过渡所需的药物强得惊人，也非常昂贵。除了像我这样的特定情况，它们其实都是违禁品，因为对非西米人的作用极其强烈...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The upside is we’re really hardy, but the downside is, medical treatment is near impossible. The drugs needed for me to transition are incredibly strong, and very expensive. They’re actually outlawed except in certain situations like mine, because they have pretty extreme effects on non-simii...”"

rows.original: You ask her what kind of effects, and she explains. “...Um, over-femification. Like, extreme breast tenderness and vaginal lubrication, ovulation goes through the roof, and your body over-emphasises all the feminine parts of your species.”
rows.translation: 你问会有什么作用，她解释道：“...嗯，过度女性化。比如乳房极度敏感、阴道分泌大量润滑液、排卵量暴增，而且身体会过分强化你所属种族的一切女性特征。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her what kind of effects, and she explains. “...Um, over-femification. Like, extreme breast tenderness and vaginal lubrication, ovulation goes through the roof, and your body over-emphasises all the feminine parts of your species.”"

rows.original: All that doesn’t sound so bad, and you say so. [embry.name] then shakes her head, “It’s not, but the symptom list is really long. The worst is a really bad case of estrus - mating heat - and lordosis. The latter is the part of your brain made for submitting to males for copulation, and why animals ‘present’ themselves. You know, when they p-put their butt up for a guy... to... do their thing.”
rows.translation: 听起来倒没那么糟，你也这么说了。[embry.name]随即摇头，“是没那么糟，但症状清单非常长。最严重的是极度发情——交配热——以及脊柱前凸反射。后者是大脑中为了服从雄性交配而形成的部分，也是动物为什么会‘摆出姿势’。你知道，就是它们会把、把屁股抬起来，让男人...做...那种事。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAll that doesn’t sound so bad, and you say so. [embry.name] then shakes her head, “It’s not, but the symptom list is really long. The worst is a really bad case of estrus - mating heat - and lordosis. The latter is the part of your brain made for submitting to males for copulation, and why animals ‘present’ themselves. You know, when they p-put their butt up for a guy... to... do their thing.”"

rows.original: It seems like [embry.name]’s done her research on her drugs. You ask her how far along she is with her treatment.
rows.translation: 看来[embry.name]对自己的药物做足了功课。你问她的治疗进行到什么程度了。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt seems like [embry.name]’s done her research on her drugs. You ask her how far along she is with her treatment."

rows.original: “...N-not far. I only had enough money for one round, and it just made me look a bit more girlish. My voice changed, which was great, because I hated my old boy voice,” she blushes a little. “...And, um, one part shrunk a bit. Not that it was that big to begin with.”
rows.translation: “...没、没多远。我的钱只够做一轮，它只是让我看起来更像女孩一点。我的声音变了，这很好，因为我讨厌以前的男孩嗓音，”她微微脸红。“...而且，嗯，有个部位 缩小 了一点。虽然它本来也没多大。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...N-not far. I only had enough money for one round, and it just made me look a bit more girlish. My voice changed, which was great, because I hated my old boy voice,” she blushes a little. “...And, um, one part shrunk a bit. Not that it was that big to begin with.”"

rows.original: “If I could afford the next round of treatment, my shoulders should become girlish, and less narrow. And... maybe I’ll grow breasts,” she touches her flat chest wistfully. “...I-I think if I had breasts, I’d really start to feel like a real girl, you know?”
rows.translation: “如果我付得起下一轮治疗，我的肩膀应该会变得更像女孩，也更窄一些。而且...也许我会长出乳房，”她怀念地抚摸着平坦的胸口。“...我、我觉得如果有了乳房，我才会真正开始觉得自己是个真正的女孩，你明白吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“If I could afford the next round of treatment, my shoulders should become girlish, and less narrow. And... maybe I’ll grow breasts,” she touches her flat chest wistfully. “...I-I think if I had breasts, I’d really start to feel like a real girl, you know?”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You ask [embry.name] what she’s always writing about on her pad, and her cheeks turn a bright shade of pink.
rows.translation: 你问[embry.name]她总在写字板上写些什么，她的双颊顿时变成了鲜艳的粉红色。
rows.raw: "You ask [embry.name] what she’s always writing about on her pad, and her cheeks turn a bright shade of pink."

rows.original: “N-nothing at all! O-orders - that’s what I’m writing!” she badly lies.
rows.translation: “什、什么都没写！订、订单——我写的是订单！”她拙劣地撒谎道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“N-nothing at all! O-orders - that’s what I’m writing!” she badly lies."

rows.original: You point out you’ve seen her writing on it even when she’s not taking food orders. She opens her mouth, then closes it again. It seems you’ve caught her out.
rows.translation: 你指出，即使不在记餐点订单时，你也见过她在上面写东西。她张开嘴，又闭了回去。看来你抓到她了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou point out you’ve seen her writing on it even when she’s not taking food orders. She opens her mouth, then closes it again. It seems you’ve caught her out."

rows.original: “L-l-look, I’ll tell you, just so long as you promise not to tell anyone, okay?” she swears you to secrecy before handing over her notepad to you.
rows.translation: “听、听着，我可以告诉你，但你得保证不告诉任何人，好吗？”她让你发誓保密，随后把记事本递给你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“L-l-look, I’ll tell you, just so long as you promise not to tell anyone, okay?” she swears you to secrecy before handing over her notepad to you."

rows.original: You flip through the pages. They’re half full of orders crowded in with snippets of dialogue and story ideas. Is she some kind of writer? You read some of it out loud.
rows.translation: 你翻阅着书页。上面一半是挤在一起的订单，另一半则夹杂着对话片段和故事构思。她难道是某种作家？你大声读出其中一段。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou flip through the pages. They’re half full of orders crowded in with snippets of dialogue and story ideas. Is she some kind of writer? You read some of it out loud."

rows.original: “The space pirate took Princess Nebula in his strong, tattooed arms, and against the backdrop of the exploding star, kissed her with a passion a thousand times more powerful,” you recite.
rows.translation: “太空海盗用强壮而布满纹身的双臂抱住星云公主，在爆炸恒星的映衬下，以强烈千倍的激情吻住了她，”你朗诵道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“The space pirate took Princess Nebula in his strong, tattooed arms, and against the backdrop of the exploding star, kissed her with a passion a thousand times more powerful,” you recite."

rows.original: [embry.name] snatches the pad from your hands, and hugs it possessively to her chest. Her face is bright red as she stammers, “D-don’t read it out loud!! I like writing cheesy space romance, okay--?”
rows.translation: [embry.name]从你手中抢走记事本，珍爱地紧紧抱在胸前。她满脸通红，结结巴巴地说：“不、不要大声念出来！！我就是喜欢写俗套的太空爱情故事，行了吧--？”
rows.raw: "\n\n[embry.name] snatches the pad from your hands, and hugs it possessively to her chest. Her face is bright red as she stammers, “D-don’t read it out loud!! I like writing cheesy space romance, okay--?”"

rows.original: No wonder she’s such a clumsy waitress. Half the time her head isn’t even in the game! You ask her if she’s published anything, and she shakes her head.
rows.translation: 难怪她是个如此笨拙的女服务员。她有一半时间根本心不在焉！你问她有没有发表过什么作品，她摇了摇头。
rows.raw: "\n\nNo wonder she’s such a clumsy waitress. Half the time her head isn’t even in the game! You ask her if she’s published anything, and she shakes her head."

rows.original: “N-not yet, I’m working on some stuff, but it’s not ready yet. I-I don’t really have enough experience, I think, so it’s slow going. You know, since I’ve never been in l-love.” she looks down at her pad, shyly averting her gaze. “Um, but I can dream about someone coming and sweeping me-- UH, I mean Princess Nebula - off her feet, and write that!”
rows.translation: “还、还没有，我正在写一些东西，但还没完成。我、我觉得自己没有足够的 经验，所以进展很慢。你知道的，因为我从来没恋、恋爱过。”她低头看着记事本，害羞地避开视线。“嗯，但我可以梦想某个人出现，把我——呃，我是说把星云公主——迷得神魂颠倒，然后把它写出来！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“N-not yet, I’m working on some stuff, but it’s not ready yet. I-I don’t really have enough experience, I think, so it’s slow going. You know, since I’ve never been in l-love.” she looks down at her pad, shyly averting her gaze. “Um, but I can dream about someone coming and sweeping me-- UH, I mean Princess Nebula - off her feet, and write that!”"

rows.original: It seems she’s got some way to go before she’s writing best sellers.
rows.translation: 看来她离成为畅销书作家还有很长的路要走。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt seems she’s got some way to go before she’s writing best sellers."

rows.translation: 她整张脸都失去了血色，看起来快要昏过去了。你纯粹靠震惊就让她动弹不得，她的双眼几乎要翻到脑后。
rows.raw: "Her whole face loses color, and she looks like she’s about to faint. You’ve paralyzed her from sheer shock, and her eyes are about to roll into the back of her head."

rows.translation: 怎么可能会对我感兴趣。不可能！”

rows.original: Even though she says she doesn’t believe it, she’s still fidgeting madly. She must believe it on some level, or she would have laughed it off.
rows.translation: 尽管她嘴上说不相信，身体却仍在疯狂地扭捏。她在某种程度上一定相信了，否则早就一笑置之。
rows.raw: "\n\nEven though she says she doesn’t believe it, she’s still fidgeting madly. She must believe it on some level, or she would have laughed it off."

rows.original: She blinks, and squirms a bit at your sudden, mysterious interest in her love life. “R-really? I can’t imagine anyone being curious about that. It’s not a riveting subject, or anything. Actually, there’s not much to tell.”
rows.translation: 她眨眨眼，因为你突然又神秘地对她的感情生活产生兴趣而有些坐立不安。“真、真的吗？我想不到会有人对此感兴趣。这又不是什么引人入胜的话题。其实也没什么可说的。”
rows.raw: "She blinks, and squirms a bit at your sudden, mysterious interest in her love life. “R-really? I can’t imagine anyone being curious about that. It’s not a riveting subject, or anything. Actually, there’s not much to tell.”"

rows.original: “...Um... that isn’t to say I won’t answer you though. I mean, since you’re interested.” She peeks up at you through her bubblegum fringe, blinking at you shyly.
rows.translation: “...嗯...不过，这并不是说我不会回答你。我的意思是，既然你感兴趣。”她透过泡泡糖色的刘海偷看着你，害羞地眨眨眼。
rows.raw: "\n\n“...Um... that isn’t to say I won’t answer you though. I mean, since you’re interested.” She peeks up at you through her bubblegum fringe, blinking at you shyly."

rows.original: “My experience is... none at all. Whatsoever. I’ve never been kissed, or even really hugged. So... yeah. I guess nobody wants to?” she shrugs shyly. “I mean, I’m kind of stuck between sexes, so I’m not sure who’d go for... you know... this. What I am.”
rows.translation: “我的经验是...完全没有。一点也没有。我从来没被人亲过，甚至都没真正被拥抱过。所以...就是这样。我猜没人想这么做吧？”她害羞地耸耸肩。“我是说，我有点卡在两种性别之间，所以我不知道谁会喜欢...你知道的...这样的我。我的这种样子。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My experience is... none at all. Whatsoever. I’ve never been kissed, or even really hugged. So... yeah. I guess nobody wants to?” she shrugs shyly. “I mean, I’m kind of stuck between sexes, so I’m not sure who’d go for... you know... this. What I am.”"

rows.original: Realizing that she’s being a bit down, she quickly tries to lighten the air. “T-that’s not to say I don’t want it! I do spend a lot of time thinking about love. Probably too much,” she blushes. “...I mean, you’ve seen my notepad. I haven’t given up totally!”
rows.translation: 意识到自己的话有些消沉，她赶紧试着缓和气氛。“这、这并不是说我不想要！我 确实 花了很多时间幻想爱情。大概想得太多了，”她红着脸说。“...我是说，你看过我的记事本。我还没有彻底放弃！”
rows.raw: "\n\nRealizing that she’s being a bit down, she quickly tries to lighten the air. “T-that’s not to say I don’t want it! I do spend a lot of time thinking about love. Probably too much,” she blushes. “...I mean, you’ve seen my notepad. I haven’t given up totally!”"

rows.translation: 你问[embry.name]她为何毫无经验——无论恋爱还是性爱方面——她顿时满脸通红。
rows.raw: "You ask [embry.name] about her lack of experience - both romantically and sexually - and she turns bright red."

rows.original: “Wh-what? Y-you want to know about my love life?” she stammers, and suddenly her body can’t stay still. Her tail is flicking about, and she’s fidgeting on the spot. “W-why would you want to know about something like that?!”
rows.translation: “什、什么？你、你想知道我的感情生活？”她结结巴巴地说，身体突然一刻也安静不下来。她的尾巴四处甩动，站在原地不停扭捏。“你、你为什么会想知道这种事？！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wh-what? Y-you want to know about my love life?” she stammers, and suddenly her body can’t stay still. Her tail is flicking about, and she’s fidgeting on the spot. “W-why would you want to know about something like that?!”"

rows.original: “W-wha--y-you, you can’t tip that much--!” she stammers out, her cheeks bright red. You silence her protests with a swift kiss. Her fingers grip at your chest, and when you pull away there’s a spaced out look in her eyes.
rows.translation: “什、什么--你、你不能给这么多小费--！”她结结巴巴地抗议，双颊通红。你用一个迅速的吻堵住了她的抗议。她的手指抓住你的胸口，当你退开时，她眼中一片恍惚。
rows.raw: "\n\n“W-wha--y-you, you can’t tip that much--!” she stammers out, her cheeks bright red. You silence her protests with a swift kiss. Her fingers grip at your chest, and when you pull away there’s a spaced out look in her eyes."

rows.original: “U-um, what were we talking about again--?” she spaceily asks. You grab her hand and slide her other hand - and the credit chip - inside her dress pocket, kissing her once more.
rows.translation: “呃、嗯，我们刚才在说什么来着--？”她迷迷糊糊地问。你抓住她的手，把她的另一只手——连同信用芯片——一起塞进她的裙子口袋，又吻了她一次。

By integrating modern shield projection technology into a bludgeoning staff, they transformed a melee armament into a defensive guard and tool at all the same time. rows.raw: "Crystal Shard"

rows.original: ten of those mischievous little gems.
rows.translation: 十颗调皮的小宝石。
rows.raw: " ten of those mischievous little gems."

rows.translation: 一颗

rows.original: gem.
rows.translation: 宝石。
rows.raw: " gem."

rows.original: Crystal Shard
rows.raw: "Crystal Shard"

rows.original: Taking the gem in hand
rows.translation: 她拿起宝石
rows.raw: "\n\nTaking the gem in hand"

rows.original: physique
rows.raw: "physique"

rows.original: Crystal Shard
rows.raw: "Crystal Shard"

rows.original: “What’s this?” Emmy asks, taking the cloudy green gemstone from your hand. She holds it to the light. “I haven’t seen a gem like this before... it looks like the emeralds that rich Terrans wear, but it’s so murky.”
rows.translation: “这是什么？”艾米问着，从你手中接过那颗浑浊的绿色宝石。她把它举到灯光下。“这种宝石我以前没见过……看起来像有钱的泰伦人佩戴的祖母绿，可它也太浑浊了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What’s this?” Emmy asks, taking the cloudy green gemstone from your hand. She holds it to the light. “I haven’t seen a gem like this before... it looks like the emeralds that rich Terrans wear, but it’s so murky.”"

rows.original: The shard slips from her fingers, describing a perfect double spiral until it hits the countertop with a light clatter. Instinctively, you step backwards
rows.translation: 碎片从她指间滑落，划出一道完美的双螺旋，随后轻响一声落在柜台上。你本能地向后退去
rows.raw: "\n\nThe shard slips from her fingers, describing a perfect double spiral until it hits the countertop with a light clatter. Instinctively, you step backwards"

rows.original: with a devilish grin of anticipation
rows.translation: ，脸上挂着满怀期待的坏笑
rows.raw: " with a devilish grin of anticipation"

rows.original: “Whoops!” Emmy says, grabbing up the crystal again. Before she can raise it to her face, a faint tinkling sound goes off, like a tiny window shattering. Her eyes widen in surprise as the shard visibly cracks and the pressurized fluid inside spurts forth... all over the unwitting girl’s breasts.
rows.translation: “哎呀！”艾米说着，再次抓起水晶。还没等她把水晶举到面前，一声细微的清脆碎响便传了出来，仿佛一扇小窗破裂。她惊讶地睁大双眼，只见碎片上出现清晰裂纹，里面受压的液体猛然喷出……全都溅在了毫无防备的姑娘乳房上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Whoops!” Emmy says, grabbing up the crystal again. Before she can raise it to her face, a faint tinkling sound goes off, like a tiny window shattering. Her eyes widen in surprise as the shard visibly cracks and the pressurized fluid inside spurts forth... all over the unwitting girl’s breasts."

rows.original: “Woah, what-” she blurts, as the slightly-viscous slime coats her outsized boobage with a lewd splatter that slops all over her tits and oozes down her body. The viridian goo quickly begins to crystallize as it thins and travels southward, until Emmy’s jumpsuit is sparkling with thousands of tiny, tacky gems. She looks like a sequined, furry casino girl.
rows.translation: “哇，什么——”她脱口叫道。略带黏稠的黏液淫靡地泼满她硕大的乳房，沿身体淌落。翠绿色黏液在变薄并向下流动的同时迅速结晶，直到艾米的连身服上闪烁起成千上万颗细小黏人的宝石。她看起来就像一位穿着亮片服的毛茸茸赌场女郎。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Woah, what-” she blurts, as the slightly-viscous slime coats her outsized boobage with a lewd splatter that slops all over her tits and oozes down her body. The viridian goo quickly begins to crystallize as it thins and travels southward, until Emmy’s jumpsuit is sparkling with thousands of tiny, tacky gems. She looks like a sequined, furry casino girl."

rows.original: The shopkeeper stares at you in narrow-eyed disbelief
rows.translation: 店主眯起眼，难以置信地瞪着你
rows.raw: "\n\nThe shopkeeper stares at you in narrow-eyed disbelief"

rows.original: and you can’t entirely suppress your juvenile titters.
rows.translation: ，而你完全压不住自己孩子气的窃笑
rows.raw: " and you can’t entirely suppress your juvenile titters."

rows.original: as you hoot with laughter.
rows.translation: ，你放声大笑起来
rows.raw: " as you hoot with laughter."

rows.original: “You think this is funny, do you?” she spits. She raises a hand in a scolding finger and leans in to tell you what she thinks... at least, she tries to lean. Her bust only wobbles a bit as her crystal-covered jumpsuit fails to bend.
rows.translation: 。“你觉得这很好笑，是吗？”她厉声说道。她举起一根手指训斥你，倾身想说说她的看法……至少她试图倾身。她的胸部只是晃动了一下，覆满水晶的连身服根本无法弯曲。
rows.raw: " “You think this is funny, do you?” she spits. She raises a hand in a scolding finger and leans in to tell you what she thinks... at least, she tries to lean. Her bust only wobbles a bit as her crystal-covered jumpsuit fails to bend."

rows.original: “How the hell...” Emmy says, lecture unremembered by this new emergency. She tries to tilt back and forth, but it merely causes her head and shoulders to wiggle atop the fused-stiff suit, like a life-sized Emmy bobblehead. Unable to control yourself any longer, you double over with the spectacle of it.
rows.translation: “这到底怎么……”艾米说道，新的紧急状况令她忘了刚才的训话。她试着前后倾斜身体，却只能让脑袋和肩膀在僵硬成一体的服装上方摇晃，活像真人大小的艾米摇头娃娃。你再也控制不住，被这副景象逗得弯下腰来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“How the hell...” Emmy says, lecture unremembered by this new emergency. She tries to tilt back and forth, but it merely causes her head and shoulders to wiggle atop the fused-stiff suit, like a life-sized Emmy bobblehead. Unable to control yourself any longer, you double over with the spectacle of it."

rows.original: “Oh, you’re a riot,” the angry jackaless growls. “Tell me this isn’t permanent.”
rows.translation: “哦，你可真会逗人开心，”愤怒的胡狼姑娘低吼道，“告诉我这不是永久的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, you’re a riot,” the angry jackaless growls. “Tell me this isn’t permanent.”"

rows.original: “Nah,” you say, through tears of laughter. “It lasts, like, twenty hours.”
rows.translation: “不是，”你一边笑出眼泪一边说道，“大概只会持续二十小时。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nah,” you say, through tears of laughter. “It lasts, like, twenty hours.”"

rows.original: “No, no,” you say, hurriedly mastering yourself. “Only lasts twenty hours, usually.”
rows.translation: “不，不会，”你说着，赶忙控制住自己，“通常只持续二十小时。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No, no,” you say, hurriedly mastering yourself. “Only lasts twenty hours, usually.”"

rows.original: “Bad news... so try to keep a stiff upper lip,” you gasp, sides aching with laughter. “It takes twenty hours minimum to wear off.”
rows.translation: “有个坏消息……所以尽量镇定一点，”你喘息着说道，笑得两肋生疼，“它至少要二十小时才会消退。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bad news... so try to keep a stiff upper lip,” you gasp, sides aching with laughter. “It takes twenty hours minimum to wear off.”"

rows.original: “TWENTY HOURS?” roars Emmy. “Why do you even have something like this?!”
rows.translation: “二十小时？”艾米怒吼道，“你为什么会带着这种东西？！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“TWENTY HOURS?” roars Emmy. “Why do you even have something like this?!”"

rows.original: Still shaking, you explain with occasional giggles where you got it and how it makes a useful armor hardener for hostile environments. Emmy’s long jaw grinds while you talk, but you can see the anger in her eyes eventually give way to ideas as you defend your offering.
rows.translation: 你仍然笑得浑身颤抖，不时咯咯笑着解释自己从哪里得到这东西，以及它如何在恶劣环境中充当实用的护甲硬化剂。艾米听你说话时磨着长长的下颌，不过当你为这份礼物辩解时，你能看到她眼中的怒火最终被灵感取代。
rows.raw: "\n\nStill shaking, you explain with occasional giggles where you got it and how it makes a useful armor hardener for hostile environments. Emmy’s long jaw grinds while you talk, but you can see the anger in her eyes eventually give way to ideas as you defend your offering."

rows.original: “Well... that is a useful property... and I will admit that I was surprised at how fast it set up,” she concedes. Emmy pauses for a moment, then folds her arms over her rock-hardened abs. “I know you were yanking me around, but let’s say I can think of some real uses for these toys - could you get more?”
rows.translation: “嗯……这个特性确实有用……而且我承认，它凝固的速度令我很惊讶，”她让步道。艾米停顿片刻，随后将双臂交叠在坚如岩石的腹部前。“我知道你是在捉弄我，不过就当我想到这些玩具有一些真正的用途——你还能弄到更多吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well... that is a useful property... and I will admit that I was surprised at how fast it set up,” she concedes. Emmy pauses for a moment, then folds her arms over her rock-hardened abs. “I know you were yanking me around, but let’s say I can think of some real uses for these toys - could you get more?”"

rows.original: “Um, probably?” you guess.
rows.translation: “呃，应该可以吧？”你猜测道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Um, probably?” you guess."

rows.original: “Maybe,” you shrug.
rows.translation: “也许吧，”你耸耸肩。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Maybe,” you shrug."

rows.original: “Even if armor hardening is the only thing they’re good for, that’s still a decent application with a lot of market value,” the proprietress says, thoughtful. She looks like she wants to lean in conspiratorially, but of course that’s out of the question for now. “But if we can reverse-engineer them to make them permanent, or change the formula slightly, we could have form-fitting spaceship hull patches or quick-printing semiconductor chips to market to the rushers.”
rows.translation: “哪怕它们唯一的作用就是硬化护甲，这也是一种具备可观市场价值的好用途，”女店主若有所思地说道。她看起来很想神秘兮兮地靠近你，可眼下这当然不可能。“但如果我们能逆向分析，让效果永久化，或者稍微改变配方，就能做出贴合船体的飞船补丁，或是向星球探索者销售的快速打印半导体芯片。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Even if armor hardening is the only thing they’re good for, that’s still a decent application with a lot of market value,” the proprietress says, thoughtful. She looks like she wants to lean in conspiratorially, but of course that’s out of the question for now. “But if we can reverse-engineer them to make them permanent, or change the formula slightly, we could have form-fitting spaceship hull patches or quick-printing semiconductor chips to market to the rushers.”"

rows.original: You nod
rows.translation: 你点点头
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod "

rows.original: politely as she continues hypothesizing well above your depth.
rows.translation: 礼貌地听着她继续提出那些远超你理解范围的假设。
rows.raw: "politely as she continues hypothesizing well above your depth."

rows.original: interestedly as she describes all sorts of life-improving tech breakthroughs with only the slightest grounding in reality.
rows.translation: 饶有兴趣地听她描述种种能改善生活的技术突破，尽管那些东西与现实只有一丁点联系。
rows.raw: "interestedly as she describes all sorts of life-improving tech breakthroughs with only the slightest grounding in reality."

rows.original: Emmy seems to take it as a sign of agreement - you can practically see the credit chits flashing in her eyes as she imagines KihaCorp performance bonuses and promotions.
rows.translation: 艾米似乎把这当成了赞同的信号——她想象着基哈公司的绩效奖金和升职，你几乎能看见信用点在她眼中闪烁。
rows.raw: " Emmy seems to take it as a sign of agreement - you can practically see the credit chits flashing in her eyes as she imagines KihaCorp performance bonuses and promotions."

rows.original: “Then, here’s our new deal,” she concludes, eagerly. “Instead of a gem, you bring me ten more of those shards, undamaged, so I can send them back for a lab workup. I’ll give you the reward I promised when you come back with them. Now get out. I need to change.”
rows.translation: “那么，我们重新谈个条件，”她迫不及待地总结道。“不要宝石了，你再给我带十块那种碎片，而且要完好无损，我好把它们送回实验室检测。你带回来后，我会把答应过的奖励给你。现在出去吧，我得换衣服了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Then, here’s our new deal,” she concludes, eagerly. “Instead of a gem, you bring me ten more of those shards, undamaged, so I can send them back for a lab workup. I’ll give you the reward I promised when you come back with them. Now get out. I need to change.”"

rows.original: She doesn’t move to eject you, but stands behind the counter, statuesque and wearing a stony expression. With no more talk forthcoming from her, you slip out the door - but before it closes completely, you sneak one last glance. Emmy has abandoned her sudden dignity and is awkwardly trying to about-face, rocking her arms side-to-side to get one unbending leg far enough off the ground that she can twist her hip forward without pitching her snout right into the floor, like a toy army man trying to walk on his fused plastic base.
rows.translation: 她没有动身赶你出去，只是雕像般站在柜台后面，神情冷峻。见她不再开口，你便溜出门去——但在门完全合上前，你又偷瞄了最后一眼。艾米已经抛下方才那突如其来的威严，正笨拙地尝试转身：她左右摇摆双臂，努力把一条僵直的腿抬离地面，好让自己能在长鼻子一头栽到地板上之前扭动髋部向前迈步，就像一个试图拖着熔在塑料底座上的双脚行走的玩具士兵。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe doesn’t move to eject you, but stands behind the counter, statuesque and wearing a stony expression. With no more talk forthcoming from her, you slip out the door - but before it closes completely, you sneak one last glance. Emmy has abandoned her sudden dignity and is awkwardly trying to about-face, rocking her arms side-to-side to get one unbending leg far enough off the ground that she can twist her hip forward without pitching her snout right into the floor, like a toy army man trying to walk on his fused plastic base."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Emmy carefully accepts the shards from you two at a time, packing them into a container. When you’ve passed over the last, you lean in for a look inside. The shards are spaced apart and cradled by a form-fitting packing foam that neatly sets atop a familiar white-and-red jumpsuit covered with dusty green crystals and residue... as well as a long, blackened gash, like it was cut off its wearer with a laser. Ouch.
rows.translation: 艾米每次小心接过两块碎片，将它们装进容器。等你递完最后一块，便凑近朝里面看去。碎片彼此隔开，由贴合形状的包装泡沫稳稳托住；泡沫下面是一件眼熟的红白连身服，上面覆盖着蒙尘的绿色晶体与残渣……还有一道长长的焦黑裂口，看起来像是用激光从穿戴者身上切下来的。真惨。
rows.raw: "\n\nEmmy carefully accepts the shards from you two at a time, packing them into a container. When you’ve passed over the last, you lean in for a look inside. The shards are spaced apart and cradled by a form-fitting packing foam that neatly sets atop a familiar white-and-red jumpsuit covered with dusty green crystals and residue... as well as a long, blackened gash, like it was cut off its wearer with a laser. Ouch."

rows.original: She shoos you away kindly and snaps a lid onto the package, then sighs like a bomb has been disarmed. With the shipment prepared, the weapon seller turns to a drawer and opens it up. “Crazy how no matter how much we know, there’s always something else out there waiting to surprise us. If I hadn’t met you, I never would’ve gotten tipped off to the gold mine just below Myrellion’s surface, and I damn sure wouldn’t be so happy about the idea of parting with this beaut. Here it is!” She slams the drawer closed with a heavy ‘thunk’ and straightens, balancing an expensive-looking weapon in front of the bullets of her nipples.
rows.translation: 她和气地挥手让你退开，把盖子扣在包裹上，随后如同拆除了一枚炸弹般松了口气。货物准备妥当后，武器商转身拉开抽屉。“真疯狂，无论我们知道多少，总有别的东西等着吓我们一跳。要不是遇见你，我永远不会得知米瑞利昂地表下就藏着一座金矿，更绝不会这么乐意割爱这件宝贝。就是它！” 她重重地“砰”一声关上抽屉，直起身来，把一件看起来价值不菲的武器平衡在两颗子弹般的乳头前。
rows.raw: " She shoos you away kindly and snaps a lid onto the package, then sighs like a bomb has been disarmed. With the shipment prepared, the weapon seller turns to a drawer and opens it up. “Crazy how no matter how much we know, there’s always something else out there waiting to surprise us. If I hadn’t met you, I never would’ve gotten tipped off to the gold mine just below Myrellion’s surface, and I damn sure wouldn’t be so happy about the idea of parting with this beaut. Here it is!” She slams the drawer closed with a heavy ‘thunk’ and straightens, balancing an expensive-looking weapon in front of the bullets of her nipples. "

rows.original: “You’ve probably seen the Salamander Pistols we stock, but this beaut is special. I fitted it with a smart-linked scope system that’ll interface with damn near any optical interface, even one of those fancy microsurgeon-based immune systems. You’ll be hard-pressed to find a more accurate pistol.”
rows.translation: “你大概见过我们店里的火蜥蜴手枪，但这件宝贝很特别。我给它装了一套智能联动瞄准镜，几乎能与任何光学接口配合，就连那种花哨的微型外科机器人免疫系统也行。你很难再找到比它更精准的手枪了。”
rows.raw: "“You’ve probably seen the Salamander Pistols we stock, but this beaut is special. I fitted it with a smart-linked scope system that’ll interface with damn near any optical interface, even one of those fancy microsurgeon-based immune systems. You’ll be hard-pressed to find a more accurate pistol.”"

rows.original: “You’ve probably seen the Lava Sabers we stock, but this beaut is special. I fitted the crossguard with miniaturized shield generators. They should supplement your shield belt’s defenses enough to give you an edge.”
rows.translation: “你大概见过我们店里的熔岩军刀，但这件宝贝很特别。我在护手上装了微型护盾发生器。它们应该能补强你护盾腰带的防御，让你占得先机。”
rows.raw: "“You’ve probably seen the Lava Sabers we stock, but this beaut is special. I fitted the crossguard with miniaturized shield generators. They should supplement your shield belt’s defenses enough to give you an edge.”"

rows.original: “You’ve probably seen a Salamander Rifle around the shop, but you haven’t seen this Salamander Rifle. I fitted it with a hotshot energy supply, replaced the regulator contacts, and gave it a better muzzle, much like myself.” She giggles and points to the dragon-headed design at the tip of the barrel. “It should be a piece of cake to land a critical blow with this monster.”
rows.translation: “你大概在店里见过火蜥蜴步枪，但你绝没见过这把火蜥蜴步枪。我给它装了高能供能装置，换掉了调节器触点，还给它换了个更好的枪口，就像我自己一样。”她咯咯笑着，指向枪管尖端的龙头造型。“用这头怪物打出致命一击简直易如反掌。”
rows.raw: "“You’ve probably seen a Salamander Rifle around the shop, but you haven’t seen this Salamander Rifle. I fitted it with a hotshot energy supply, replaced the regulator contacts, and gave it a better muzzle, much like myself.” She giggles and points to the dragon-headed design at the tip of the barrel. “It should be a piece of cake to land a critical blow with this monster.”"

rows.original: “You’ve probably seen a Jolthammer around the shop, but you haven’t seen this Jolthammer. I fiddled with the power source to try and boost the yield. It doesn’t always work, but when it does, the result is shocking.” She giggles at her own pun. “Just make sure not to touch the electric-ey end.”
rows.translation: “你大概在店里见过电震锤，但你绝没见过这把电震锤。我调整了能源，想提高输出。它不是每次都奏效，但奏效的时候，结果绝对震撼。”她为自己的双关笑出声来。“只要记得别碰会放电的那一头。”
rows.raw: "“You’ve probably seen a Jolthammer around the shop, but you haven’t seen this Jolthammer. I fiddled with the power source to try and boost the yield. It doesn’t always work, but when it does, the result is shocking.” She giggles at her own pun. “Just make sure not to touch the electric-ey end.”"

rows.original: “I really souped this one up. I swapped the barrel out for a wider one, but only because I also sprung for a better emitter and focusing crystals. I suppose I could’ve tried to tighten up the beam a little more, but I figure you’re going to want to put energy into the target, not burn a pin-sized hole through it. Just don’t waste it on any crystalline beings.”
rows.translation: “我可把这家伙大幅强化了。我把枪管换成了更宽的，不过那只是因为我还砸钱买了更好的发射器和聚焦晶体。我本来也能把光束再收窄一些，但我想你更希望把能量灌进目标，而不是只在上面烧出一个针尖大的洞。只是别拿它对付任何晶体生物。”
rows.raw: "“I really souped this one up. I swapped the barrel out for a wider one, but only because I also sprung for a better emitter and focusing crystals. I suppose I could’ve tried to tighten up the beam a little more, but I figure you’re going to want to put energy into the target, not burn a pin-sized hole through it. Just don’t waste it on any crystalline beings.”"

rows.original: <i>“I managed to get the whole blade replaced with one that had a more robust induction lattice. It’s not quite as strong as a retail model, but it can drain shields faster than I drain
rows.translation: <i>“我设法把整片刀刃换成了采用更坚固感应晶格的型号。它还没零售型号那么强，但吸干护盾的速度比我吸
rows.raw: "<i>“I managed to get the whole blade replaced with one that had a more robust induction lattice. It’s not quite as strong as a retail model, but it can drain shields faster than I drain "

rows.translation: 你的
rows.raw: "your"

rows.original: my
rows.translation: 我的
rows.raw: "my"

rows.original: dick.”
rows.translation: 肉棒还快。”
rows.raw: " dick.”"

rows.original: Placing the weapon on the table, the grinning Jackaless wiggles with unbounded excitement. “All yours, hero.”

These can only belong to your horny jackal girlfriend: Emmy.
rows.translation: 接着你打开盒子，里面正是那股气味的来源 - 一条丝滑的紫色内裤，裆部被严重撑松，上面还留着一夜欢愉后的湿润痕迹。灰白斑点与透明光泽争相占据滑溜溜的表面，这副模样和气味你都再熟悉不过。它只能属于你那欲火旺盛的雌豺女友：艾米。

rows.original: I can’t seem to stop thinking of you, especially since you’ve got your finger on the buttons to my new favorite toy, and I thought you could use something to remind you of me while you’re out in space. It sure must be lonely! So I got you one of my favorite pair of panties. Silly things, they seem so POINTLESS now. I mean who needs panties anyway? They just get in the way or get sticky or bunched up. But then I remembered all the dirty things we did together, and I thought, ‘what else would my beau want from [pc.hisHer] personal slut?’
rows.translation: 我好像怎么也停不下对你的思念，尤其是现在你还控制着我最喜欢的新玩具。所以我想，你在太空旅行时或许该有件东西来想起我。那里一定很孤单吧！于是我给你寄来了一条自己最喜欢的内裤。傻乎乎的东西，现在看来简直毫无意义。我的意思是，谁还需要内裤呀？它们只会碍事，变得黏糊糊，或是皱成一团。不过我又想起了我们一起做过的所有下流事，于是心想，‘我的爱人还能从[pc.hisHer]的专属骚货这里想要什么呢？’

rows.original: “Hey,” you say, sidling up to the lean, brightly-feathered alien at the bar. “You’re the dancer guy, right?”
rows.translation: “嘿，”你说着，凑近吧台边那个身材精瘦、羽毛鲜艳的异星人。“你就是那个跳舞的男人，对吧？”
rows.raw: "“Hey,” you say, sidling up to the lean, brightly-feathered alien at the bar. “You’re the dancer guy, right?”"

rows.original: “I hope so,” Fazian replies affably in clear, well-enunciated tones, taking a pull on the straw leading behind his mask. “Otherwise there’s some other anat around here making a fool of themselves.” He turns to look at you with increasing interest. You think. It’s really quite difficult to tell with anatae. “Hey, you’ve been to our performances, haven’t you? It’s great to see non-natives there, you know. It’s difficult to get unbiased views about the stuff we do from the myr.” He fiddles with the stem of his glass. “So... what did you think?”
rows.translation: “希望是吧，”法兹安友善地回答，吐字清晰而标准，同时吸了一口通向面具后方的吸管。“否则这里就还有另一个阿纳特人在出洋相。”他转过头来，似乎越来越有兴趣地看着你。大概吧。阿纳泰人的表情实在很难分辨。“嘿，你来看过我们的演出，对吧？你知道，能在那里看到外乡人真的很棒。我们很难从米尔人那里得到对自己作品的公正评价。”他摆弄着酒杯的杯脚。“所以...你觉得怎么样？”

rows.original: “It was good!” you say enthusiastically. “I like colors. And men. The two together! I’m a fan.”
rows.translation: “很棒！”你兴奋地说道。“我喜欢色彩，也喜欢男人。两者合在一起！我可太喜欢了。”
rows.raw: "“It was good!” you say enthusiastically. “I like colors. And men. The two together! I’m a fan.”"

rows.original: “It was good,” you say assertively. “Makes me wonder why you’re performing it in a strip joint in the middle of nowhere, rather than somewhere people’d really appreciate it.”
rows.translation: “很不错，”你笃定地说道。“不过我很好奇，你为什么要在这种偏僻地方的脱衣舞厅里表演，而不是去真正懂得欣赏它的地方。”
rows.raw: "“It was good,” you say assertively. “Makes me wonder why you’re performing it in a strip joint in the middle of nowhere, rather than somewhere people’d really appreciate it.”"

rows.original: “It was good!” you smile. “Not something I would have expected to see in a strip joint on the fringes of nowhere.”
rows.translation: “很棒！”你笑道。“真没想到能在这种偏僻边缘地带的脱衣舞厅里看到这样的表演。”
rows.raw: "“It was good!” you smile. “Not something I would have expected to see in a strip joint on the fringes of nowhere.”"

rows.original: Fazian listens intently, clear blue eyes fixed on you.
rows.translation: 法兹安专注地听着，清澈的蓝眼睛一刻不离地注视着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nFazian listens intently, clear blue eyes fixed on you."

rows.original: “That’s very kind of you to say,” he replies. He doesn’t sound like he quite believes you. “We’re just throwing ideas up on stage and seeing what works. It’s very difficult to reach an alien audience without just relying on brute physicality, and that’s the joy and frustration of it. It’s nice to hear someone off Myrellion liked it, though. What’s your name, per? Oh!”
rows.translation: “你这么说真是太好了，”他回答道。听起来，他似乎并不完全相信你的话。“我们只是在舞台上尝试各种想法，看看哪些行得通。若不单纯依赖肢体上的冲击力，要打动异族观众实在很难，而这也正是其中既令人愉悦又令人沮丧的地方。不过，听到有来自米瑞利昂之外的人喜欢它，还是很让人高兴。你叫什么名字，尊客？哦！”

It’s very difficult to reach an alien audience without just relying on brute physicality, and that’s the joy and frustration of it. It’s nice to hear someone off Myrellion liked it, though. rows.original: “You’re probably right,” he nods, tapping his claws on the wine-stained wood pensively. “It’s so difficult to pitch things to an alien audience without just relying on brute physicality, and the tone’s all over the place as a result. Thanks for not sugar coating it. I’m Fazian, by the way. How do you do? Oh!”
rows.translation: “你说得大概没错，”他点点头，若有所思地用爪子敲着被酒液染脏的木头。“若不单纯依赖肢体上的冲击力，要把作品推向异族观众实在太难，结果整体调性也变得摇摆不定。谢谢你没有粉饰太平。顺便一提，我叫法兹安。幸会！哦！”

rows.original: “So how did you come to be strutting your stuff all the way out here, then?” you ask.
rows.translation: “那么，你怎么会大老远跑到这里来大展身手？”你问道。
rows.raw: "“So how did you come to be strutting your stuff all the way out here, then?” you ask."

rows.original: “Do you want the official reason, per?” Fazian replies, looking at you sideways. “If you’re an anat, you’ve got to have a very good one to be wasting a first grade artistic license out on a human-corporate-owned frontier world. Well, you’ve got to have a very good reason to get a first grade artistic license in the first place. But I always wanted to be a dancer, and your parents and career officer can only shower you with so many engineering pamphlets before they have to give up. My people aren’t brutes or... autistic, they do know the value of the arts,” he goes on quickly, “But it’s so hard to measure the value of a painting next to a new live-ship or block of apartments on a colony world, y’know?”
rows.translation: “你想听官方理由吗，尊客？”法兹安侧眼看着你答道。“如果你是安纳泰人，想把一级艺术执照浪费在一个由人类企业掌控的边疆世界，就必须有个非常充分的理由。好吧，首先，要取得一级艺术执照本身就得有个非常充分的理由。但我一直想当舞者，而父母和职业指导官再怎么拿工程学宣传册往你身上堆，也总有不得不放弃的时候。我的族人并非野蛮人，也不是...不懂情趣；他们确实明白艺术的价值，”他很快接着说道，“可是在殖民世界上，一幅画的价值要怎么跟一艘新的活体飞船或一栋公寓相比呢，明白吧？”

Well, you’ve got to have a very good reason to get a first grade artistic license in the first place. But I always wanted to be a dancer, and your parents and career officer can only shower you with so many engineering pamphlets before they have to give up. My people aren’t brutes or... autistic, they do know the value of the arts,” he goes on quickly, “But it’s so hard to measure the value of a painting next to a new live-ship or block of apartments on a colony world, y’know?”"

rows.original: “And you’re here because...” you cajole.
rows.translation: “而你来到这里是因为...”你循循诱导道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And you’re here because...” you cajole."

rows.original: “Inspiration,” he answers, gesturing grandly at the dimly lit club. “It is accepted by the anatae administrata that artists need to travel and absorb experience, view the empire from outside as well as from within, to be able to properly express themselves. To be able to dance and - for it to seize and move and exhilarate people very different from you - that is a noble goal. And useful. Who knows! We could discover a race that only communicates through body language in this very rush.”
rows.translation: “寻找灵感，”他气势十足地指向灯光昏暗的俱乐部，回答道。“安纳泰管理局公认，艺术家需要旅行、汲取经验，从外部和内部审视帝国，才能恰当地表达自己。能够起舞，并让舞蹈抓住、打动、振奋那些与你截然不同的人，是一个崇高的目标，也很有用。谁知道呢！就在这次星球淘金热中，我们或许会发现一个只通过肢体语言交流的种族。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Inspiration,” he answers, gesturing grandly at the dimly lit club. “It is accepted by the anatae administrata that artists need to travel and absorb experience, view the empire from outside as well as from within, to be able to properly express themselves. To be able to dance and - for it to seize and move and exhilarate people very different from you - that is a noble goal. And useful. Who knows! We could discover a race that only communicates through body language in this very rush.”"

rows.original: “What’s the unofficial reason?” you ask. Fazian laughs, and looks at you shyly.
rows.translation: “那非官方的理由呢？”你问道。法兹安笑了笑，羞涩地看着你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What’s the unofficial reason?” you ask. Fazian laughs, and looks at you shyly."

rows.original: “How much do you know about our race, Steele?” he says. He shakes his head, feathers hissing softly, before you can answer. “I love women. All I want to do is make them laugh and smile and feel pleasure, as many of them as possible. To be on a world that has nothing but women who are desperately craving a good time - it is a dream come true for me.” He twiddles with his wine glass. “So much so that I am finding it difficult to move on. I hope the administrata are not keeping a very close eye on me, because otherwise I’m going to have some explaining to do when I do finally get back home.”
rows.translation: “你对我们种族了解多少，斯蒂尔？”他说。还没等你回答，他便摇了摇头，羽毛发出轻柔的沙沙声。“我爱女人。我只想让她们欢笑、微笑、感受快乐，越多越好。来到一个只有女人、而且她们都迫切渴望好好享乐的世界，对我而言简直美梦成真。”他拨弄着酒杯。“美好到让我很难继续上路。我希望管理局没有盯我盯得太紧，否则等我终于回家时，可得费一番口舌解释了。”
