All I want to do is make them laugh and smile and feel pleasure, as many of them as possible. To be on a world that has nothing but women who are desperately craving a good time - it is a dream come true for me.” He twiddles with his wine glass. “So much so that I am finding it difficult to move on. I hope the administrata are not keeping a very close eye on me, because otherwise I’m going to have some explaining to do when I do finally get back home.”"

rows.original: “Do all anatae have those?” you ask, gesturing at his crown plume.
rows.translation: “所有安纳泰人都有那个吗？”你指着他的冠羽问道。
rows.raw: "“Do all anatae have those?” you ask, gesturing at his crown plume."

rows.original: “All the males do,” replies Fazian, unfolding and craning his feathers with pride so they catch the bar’s dim lights. “Well, I mean. They have feathers. I had mine modified, colored them, made them fuller, tweaked them so I could move them around better, so I could involve them in my performances. Having an artistic license, I was able to jump a lot of the queue to get them done. As well as, uh, a couple of other things.” He shifts in his seat slightly.
rows.translation: “所有男性都有，”法兹安答道。他骄傲地舒展、扬起羽毛，让它们映着酒吧昏暗的灯光。“好吧，我是说，他们都有羽毛。我的羽毛经过改造和染色，变得更加丰满，也经过调整，让我能更灵活地操控它们、把它们融入表演。凭着艺术执照，我得以在改造的等候队伍里插到很前面。除此之外，呃，还有另外几处改造。”他在座位上微微挪动了一下。
rows.raw: "\n\n“All the males do,” replies Fazian, unfolding and craning his feathers with pride so they catch the bar’s dim lights. “Well, I mean. They have feathers. I had mine modified, colored them, made them fuller, tweaked them so I could move them around better, so I could involve them in my performances. Having an artistic license, I was able to jump a lot of the queue to get them done. As well as, uh, a couple of other things.” He shifts in his seat slightly."

rows.original: “You queue for gene-mods?” you say.
rows.translation: “你们做基因改造还要排队？”你说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You queue for gene-mods?” you say."

rows.original: “Yes,” answers Fazian stiffly. “Gene-mods are free to all under the anatae state - you just have to wait, based on your need. As opposed to them being immediately available to the ordinary person only if they are willing to sell a sizable part of their future away.” His tone does not encourage further inquiry.
rows.translation: “是的，”法兹安生硬地答道。“在安纳泰国家，所有人都能免费接受基因改造，只需根据需求程度等待。总好过普通人只有出卖自己未来的一大部分，才能立即获得改造。”他的语气显然不欢迎你继续追问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes,” answers Fazian stiffly. “Gene-mods are free to all under the anatae state - you just have to wait, based on your need. As opposed to them being immediately available to the ordinary person only if they are willing to sell a sizable part of their future away.” His tone does not encourage further inquiry."

rows.original: “There are a lot of differences between our cultures, I know,” he goes on, conciliatory, “I had to take a month long course in U.G.C. customs before I was allowed out here. Even then, there were many things... I found difficult to believe. The flesh and cream slaves on Tavros... the shuttling of newly discovered natives towards life on a lab slide in some corporate compound... next to such sights and sounds! Explosions on the senses! It was like being hit on the head with perfumed fireworks when I first arrived there per, let me tell you!” His eyes flash excitedly. The bright feathers at his elbows become more fanned out the more animated he gets.
rows.translation: “我知道，我们的文化之间有很多差异，”他以缓和的口吻继续说道，“获准来这里之前，我不得不参加一个月的U.G.C.习俗课程。即便如此，还是有许多事情...让我觉得难以置信。塔弗罗斯上的血肉与乳液奴隶...把新发现的原住民送去某个企业园区，成为实验室载玻片上的生命...而旁边却又有那样的景象与声响！感官彻底爆炸！尊客，我刚抵达那里时，简直像被芳香四溢的烟花砸中了脑袋，真的！”他的双眼兴奋地闪烁着。情绪越激动，他肘部鲜艳的羽毛便张得越开。
rows.raw: "\n\n“There are a lot of differences between our cultures, I know,” he goes on, conciliatory, “I had to take a month long course in U.G.C. customs before I was allowed out here. Even then, there were many things... I found difficult to believe. The flesh and cream slaves on Tavros... the shuttling of newly discovered natives towards life on a lab slide in some corporate compound... next to such sights and sounds! Explosions on the senses! It was like being hit on the head with perfumed fireworks when I first arrived there per, let me tell you!” His eyes flash excitedly. The bright feathers at his elbows become more fanned out the more animated he gets."

rows.original: “Per”
rows.translation: “尊客”
rows.raw: "“Per”"

rows.original: “Per. You keep saying that,” you observe. “What does it mean?”
rows.translation: “尊客。你一直在说这个词，”你指出。“它是什么意思？”
rows.raw: "“Per. You keep saying that,” you observe. “What does it mean?”"

rows.original: Fazian ducks his head and doesn’t immediately respond.
rows.translation: 法兹安低下头，没有立刻回答。
rows.raw: "\n\nFazian ducks his head and doesn’t immediately respond."

rows.original: “I... guess that isn’t coming through as a direct translation,” he says. You realize he thinks he’s embarrassed himself. He shuffles in his trouser pocket, brings out a miniature codex and flicks through it for a few moments. “‘Komm-rahd’? It’s telling me that’s a very archaic expression though.” He takes a long pull on his straw before going on, still looking rather uncomfortable.
rows.translation: “我...猜这个词没法直接翻译出来，”他说道。你意识到他觉得自己出了丑。他在裤兜里摸索一阵，拿出一台微型终端，翻查了片刻。“‘同-志’？不过它告诉我，这是一种非常古老的说法。”他用吸管深深喝了一口，才继续说下去，看起来依然颇为不自在。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I... guess that isn’t coming through as a direct translation,” he says. You realize he thinks he’s embarrassed himself. He shuffles in his trouser pocket, brings out a miniature codex and flicks through it for a few moments. “‘Komm-rahd’? It’s telling me that’s a very archaic expression though.” He takes a long pull on his straw before going on, still looking rather uncomfortable."

rows.original: “The anatae have an empire, right? The largest number of colonies in the known galaxy. But we don’t have a leader on top of it all. It’s all owned by us, the people. So... Per. We are all emperors. That’s the idea, anyway.”
rows.translation: “安纳泰拥有一个帝国，对吧？在已知银河中，我们的殖民地数量最多。但高高在上统领一切的人并不存在。它的一切都归我们、归人民所有。所以...尊客。我们每个人都是帝王。至少理念上是这样。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The anatae have an empire, right? The largest number of colonies in the known galaxy. But we don’t have a leader on top of it all. It’s all owned by us, the people. So... Per. We are all emperors. That’s the idea, anyway.”"

rows.original: “Per?”
rows.translation: “尊客？”

rows.original: Ask him what he means by that.
rows.translation: 问他这是什么意思。
rows.raw: "Ask him what he means by that."

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: “So you like dancing, then?” you grin.
rows.translation: “这么说，你很喜欢跳舞？”你咧嘴笑道。
rows.raw: "“So you like dancing, then?” you grin."

rows.original: “Do the myr like honey?” he replies, eyes flashing. He gesticulates passionately with his claws. “I love all forms of theatre, performance art, acting... I even tried galotian pollocking, when I was first starting out. But dancing, yes, above all. I don’t... I can’t always find the right words when I am talking to others. When I am dancing, I feel as if I am expressing everything I am about perfectly. And here, I can communicate to innocents who just want to drink it in. It’s so pure, the way art should be.”
rows.translation: “米尔人喜欢蜂蜜吗？”他双眼闪亮地反问，爪子充满激情地比划着。“我热爱各种形式的戏剧、行为艺术和表演...刚起步时，我甚至尝试过加洛提亚式泼洒画。但舞蹈，是的，舞蹈高于一切。我不...跟别人说话时，我并不总能找到恰当的词语。跳舞时，我觉得自己能完美表达自身的一切。而在这里，我能与那些只想全心领略它的纯真之人交流。这是如此纯粹，艺术本就该是这样。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Do the myr like honey?” he replies, eyes flashing. He gesticulates passionately with his claws. “I love all forms of theatre, performance art, acting... I even tried galotian pollocking, when I was first starting out. But dancing, yes, above all. I don’t... I can’t always find the right words when I am talking to others. When I am dancing, I feel as if I am expressing everything I am about perfectly. And here, I can communicate to innocents who just want to drink it in. It’s so pure, the way art should be.”"

rows.original: “You charge for your performances,” you point out.
rows.translation: “你的表演可是收费的，”你指出。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You charge for your performances,” you point out."

rows.original: “It all goes to Hepane, the other performers, and the club’s running,” he replies mildly, scratching his mask. “I have a food-facturer on my ship that will continue to function for another century. I mean, what it serves isn’t great,” he admits. “But then...” he takes a long pull of mead from his straw as way of finishing that sentence. “My people’s goal is to move towards post-scarcity - and why would I charge when I’m self-sufficient and doing what I love, anyway?”
rows.translation: “收入全都给了赫潘、其他表演者，以及用于俱乐部的运营，”他语气平和地回答，同时挠了挠面具。“我的飞船上有一台食物制造机，还能继续运转一个世纪。我是说，它做出来的东西不怎么好吃，”他承认道。“不过...”他用吸管长长地喝了一口蜂蜜酒，以此结束了这句话。“我的族人以迈向后稀缺社会为目标，而且我既能自给自足，又在做自己热爱的事，为什么还要收费呢？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It all goes to Hepane, the other performers, and the club’s running,” he replies mildly, scratching his mask. “I have a food-facturer on my ship that will continue to function for another century. I mean, what it serves isn’t great,” he admits. “But then...” he takes a long pull of mead from his straw as way of finishing that sentence. “My people’s goal is to move towards post-scarcity - and why would I charge when I’m self-sufficient and doing what I love, anyway?”"

rows.original: Teach Me
rows.translation: 教教我
rows.raw: "Teach Me"

rows.original: Teach Me?
rows.translation: 教教我？
rows.raw: "Teach Me?"

rows.original: You could ask if he’s willing to teach you some dance moves, but you are too sore to do any actual dancing...
rows.translation: 你可以问他是否愿意教你几个舞步，但你现在浑身酸痛，根本没法真的跳舞...
rows.raw: "You could ask if he’s willing to teach you some dance moves, but you are too sore to do any actual dancing..."

rows.original: Teach Me
rows.translation: 教教我
rows.raw: "Teach Me"

rows.original: “Alright, let’s say you’ve convinced me,” you smile. “Think you’ve got time to teach me some of your dance moves?”
rows.translation: “好吧，就当你说服我了，”你笑道。“有时间教我几招你的舞步吗？”
rows.raw: "“Alright, let’s say you’ve convinced me,” you smile. “Think you’ve got time to teach me some of your dance moves?”"

rows.original: Fazian stares at you. The tenseness in his frame, and then the way he quickly starts fiddling with his wine glass’s stem again, tells you he’s rather shocked by this proposition.
rows.translation: 法兹安盯着你。他身体先是一僵，接着很快又摆弄起酒杯的杯脚；从这些反应看来，他显然对这个提议相当震惊。
rows.raw: "\n\nFazian stares at you. The tenseness in his frame, and then the way he quickly starts fiddling with his wine glass’s stem again, tells you he’s rather shocked by this proposition."

rows.original: “I, um, I don’t know if I can... that is to say, I don’t think there’s anything I could teach you,” he mumbles. “Which isn’t to say I don’t want to,” he goes on. If his face had blood corpuscles in it, you imagine it would be glowing right now. “But you’re naturally... you don’t need to dance. Or not the kind of dancing I know. Like the myr, you own grace and beauty just by existing. My training is for those who need to work to achieve such things.”
rows.translation: “我，呃，我不知道自己能不能...我的意思是，我觉得没什么能教你的，”他含糊地说道。“这并不是说我不愿意，”他继续道。倘若他的脸上有血细胞，你觉得此刻一定已经红得发亮。“可你天生就...你不需要跳舞。至少不需要我所懂的那种舞蹈。你就像米尔人一样，光是存在便拥有优雅与美丽。我的训练是给那些必须努力才能获得这些特质的人准备的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I, um, I don’t know if I can... that is to say, I don’t think there’s anything I could teach you,” he mumbles. “Which isn’t to say I don’t want to,” he goes on. If his face had blood corpuscles in it, you imagine it would be glowing right now. “But you’re naturally... you don’t need to dance. Or not the kind of dancing I know. Like the myr, you own grace and beauty just by existing. My training is for those who need to work to achieve such things.”"

rows.original: There will be times when you will be let down harder in your life.
rows.translation: 你这一生还会遇到比这更沉重的打击。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere will be times when you will be let down harder in your life."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “You...? Sure, I guess,” shrugs Fazian. He nods with increasing enthusiasm for the idea as he mulls it over. “It’ll be fun! Come and see me after the evening performances. I don’t know how good a teacher I am, but I’m sure it wouldn’t take long to show you one or two things.” He finishes his glass of wine with a long pull. “Not doing anything right now, if you want to go backstage.”
rows.translation: “你想学...? 好吧，我想可以，”法兹安耸耸肩。仔细考虑后，他越发热情地点头赞同这个主意。“会很有趣的！晚场表演结束后过来找我吧。我不知道自己算不算好老师，但教你一两招肯定花不了多久。”他长长喝了一口，把杯中的酒喝完。“如果你想去后台，我现在正好没事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You...? Sure, I guess,” shrugs Fazian. He nods with increasing enthusiasm for the idea as he mulls it over. “It’ll be fun! Come and see me after the evening performances. I don’t know how good a teacher I am, but I’m sure it wouldn’t take long to show you one or two things.” He finishes his glass of wine with a long pull. “Not doing anything right now, if you want to go backstage.”"

rows.original: Dance
rows.translation: 舞蹈
rows.raw: "Dance"

rows.original: Dance
rows.translation: 舞蹈
rows.raw: "Dance"

rows.original: Go backstage and do some dance training with the anat.
rows.translation: 去后台跟这名安纳泰人学习舞蹈。
rows.raw: "Go backstage and do some dance training with the anat."

rows.original: Later
rows.translation: 稍后
rows.raw: "Later"

rows.original: “Later, maybe,” you say. The anat shrugs again and orders another glass of wine.
rows.translation: “也许晚点吧，”你说道。那名安纳泰人再次耸耸肩，又点了一杯酒。
rows.raw: "“Later, maybe,” you say. The anat shrugs again and orders another glass of wine."

rows.original: “As said, I’m free after the evening shows if you change your mind.”
rows.translation: “就像我说的，如果你改变主意，晚场表演后我都有空。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“As said, I’m free after the evening shows if you change your mind.”"

rows.original: Later
rows.translation: 稍后
rows.raw: "Later"

rows.original: Don’t start learning dance moves right now.
rows.translation: 现在先不要开始学舞步。
rows.raw: "Don’t start learning dance moves right now."

rows.original: Teach Me?
rows.translation: 教教我？
rows.raw: "Teach Me?"

rows.original: Ask if he’s willing to teach you some dance moves.
rows.translation: 问他是否愿意教你几个舞步。
rows.raw: "Ask if he’s willing to teach you some dance moves."

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: You guess you already know the answer to this, but surrounded by their orange softness and their high, twittering voices, it is the obvious question to ask.
rows.translation: 你觉得自己已经知道答案了，但被她们橙色的柔软身躯和高亢悦耳的声音包围着，这个问题实在再自然不过。
rows.raw: "You guess you already know the answer to this, but surrounded by their orange softness and their high, twittering voices, it is the obvious question to ask.\n\n"

rows.original: “What do you think of the myr?”
rows.translation: “你觉得米尔人怎么样？”
rows.raw: "“What do you think of the myr?”"

rows.original: “They’re wonderful,” says Fazian with happy, level conviction. “Such a welcoming, intelligent and peaceful race. Not just the golds. Oh, the reds armor themselves up with their conventions more, but beneath that - they are women. They are born to be caring, loving beings. Being around them, and performing for them, is a pleasure.” He takes a long pull on his glass of wine, blue eyes slightly misty.
rows.translation: “她们棒极了，”法兹安带着愉快而坚定的信念说道。“这是一个多么热情、聪慧而和平的种族。不只是金米尔。哦，红米尔更喜欢用她们的传统把自己武装起来，但在那层外壳之下，她们是女人。她们天生便是关怀他人、充满爱意的存在。能待在她们身边、为她们表演，实在是一种享受。”他用吸管长长地喝了一口酒，蓝眼睛微微湿润。
rows.raw: "\n\n“They’re wonderful,” says Fazian with happy, level conviction. “Such a welcoming, intelligent and peaceful race. Not just the golds. Oh, the reds armor themselves up with their conventions more, but beneath that - they are women. They are born to be caring, loving beings. Being around them, and performing for them, is a pleasure.” He takes a long pull on his glass of wine, blue eyes slightly misty."

rows.original: Even to your own love-swamped mind, this doesn’t sound quite right.
rows.translation: 即使是你这颗被爱意淹没的心，也觉得这话听起来不太对劲。
rows.raw: "\n\nEven to your own love-swamped mind, this doesn’t sound quite right."

rows.original: You don’t think you can let this go by entirely unchallenged.
rows.translation: 你觉得自己不能完全不加反驳地放过这番话。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou don’t think you can let this go by entirely unchallenged."

rows.original: “They, uh, did kill each other in the hundreds of thousands. And are now on the brink of nuclear war,” you point out.
rows.translation: “她们，呃，确实互相残杀了数十万人。而且现在正处于核战争的边缘，”你指出。
rows.raw: "\n\n“They, uh, did kill each other in the hundreds of thousands. And are now on the brink of nuclear war,” you point out."

rows.original: “It was a mistake,” the anat replies stubbornly, feathers rustling. “The whole war - it is a colossal mistake, caused by gender imbalance above and beyond anything else. You talk to any gold or red myr for long enough, it becomes obvious that what they are really craving is love or motherhood, and they never get enough opportunities for either.” He sucks on his straw determinedly.
rows.translation: “那是个错误，”这名安纳泰人固执地回答，羽毛沙沙作响。“整场战争都是一个天大的错误，最主要的成因便是性别失衡。只要跟任何金米尔或红米尔聊得够久，就会明显发现，她们真正渴望的是爱情或成为母亲，却始终没有足够的机会得到其中任何一样。”他坚定地吮吸着吸管。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It was a mistake,” the anat replies stubbornly, feathers rustling. “The whole war - it is a colossal mistake, caused by gender imbalance above and beyond anything else. You talk to any gold or red myr for long enough, it becomes obvious that what they are really craving is love or motherhood, and they never get enough opportunities for either.” He sucks on his straw determinedly."

rows.original: “You do not understand, Steele - I am told much of the U.G.C. is female-orientated as well, perhaps these things aren’t as obvious to you. I come from a society dominated by males. Hard lines, an obsession with physical goals, emotionality locked away, those are the orders of the day. Here, I can feel the opposite is waiting to burst through, if anyone is willing to give it a chance to. Perhaps the kui-tan? I don’t know. In the meantime, I will share myself and my art with the myr as much as I can. Try and give them the happiness that is their true birth-right.”
rows.translation: “你不明白，斯蒂尔。听说U.G.C.很大一部分地区也以女性为主，也许这些事对你来说并不那么明显。我来自一个由男性主导的社会。强硬的界限、对实际目标的执迷、封锁情感，这些才是那里奉行的准则。而在这里，我能感觉到完全相反的东西正等待着喷薄而出，只要有人愿意给它一个机会。也许奎坦人可以？我不知道。在那之前，我会尽可能多地与米尔人分享自己和我的艺术，努力把她们生来便有权享受的幸福带给她们。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You do not understand, Steele - I am told much of the U.G.C. is female-orientated as well, perhaps these things aren’t as obvious to you. I come from a society dominated by males. Hard lines, an obsession with physical goals, emotionality locked away, those are the orders of the day. Here, I can feel the opposite is waiting to burst through, if anyone is willing to give it a chance to. Perhaps the kui-tan? I don’t know. In the meantime, I will share myself and my art with the myr as much as I can. Try and give them the happiness that is their true birth-right.”"

rows.original: Even if you were minded to, you doubt you could persuade him otherwise.
rows.translation: 即使你有心反驳，也怀疑自己能否说服他改变想法。
rows.raw: "\n\nEven if you were minded to, you doubt you could persuade him otherwise."

rows.original: DANCE_SKILL_SUNWALKER
rows.raw: "DANCE_SKILL_SUNWALKER"

rows.original: DANCE_SKILL_EDOTTO
rows.raw: "DANCE_SKILL_EDOTTO"

rows.original: DANCE_SKILL_SUNWALKER
rows.raw: "DANCE_SKILL_SUNWALKER"

rows.original: DANCE_SKILL_EDOTTO
rows.raw: "DANCE_SKILL_EDOTTO"

rows.original: “I thought you’d go for that one,” laughs Fazian. “Don’t say I didn’t warn you! Position yourself like so, hands down at your side. Then bring them up, framing your chest...”
rows.translation: “我就知道你会选那个，”法兹安笑道。“别说我没提醒过你！像这样站好，双手垂在身体两侧。然后抬起来，框住胸口...”
rows.raw: "“I thought you’d go for that one,” laughs Fazian. “Don’t say I didn’t warn you! Position yourself like so, hands down at your side. Then bring them up, framing your chest...”"

rows.original: The anat drills you relentlessly for the next few hours, practicing the same couple of stances over and over again. It’s tough physical work and pretty tedious, however by the end you think you’ve got the opening moves down pat.
rows.translation: 接下来的几个小时里，这名安纳泰人毫不留情地操练你，让你一遍又一遍地练习同样的几个姿势。这是艰苦的体力活，也相当乏味，不过到最后，你觉得自己已经把起手动作练得烂熟。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe anat drills you relentlessly for the next few hours, practicing the same couple of stances over and over again. It’s tough physical work and pretty tedious, however by the end you think you’ve got the opening moves down pat."

rows.original: “Remember,” Fazian says as you leave, wiping sweat from your brow. “After you begin, lead with your chest. Try it out if you can, and come see me again when you’re ready for more.”
rows.translation: “记住，”你离开时，法兹安说道，而你正擦去额头上的汗水。“开始之后，要用胸部带动动作。有机会就试试，等你准备好继续学习时再来找我。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Remember,” Fazian says as you leave, wiping sweat from your brow. “After you begin, lead with your chest. Try it out if you can, and come see me again when you’re ready for more.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “Alright then Steele,” says Fazian. “Position yourself like so, hands on hips. It always starts with your hips...”
rows.translation: “那好吧，斯蒂尔，”法兹安说道。“像这样站好，双手叉腰。动作总是从胯部开始...”

“Bring it,” says Fazian simply, standing back. With no hesitation whatsoever you gesture with your arms, before throwing out shape after shape with easy confidence, finishing with a confident grab and pump. You’re stirred out of your final stance by a clatter of applause and amused whoops - the myr strippers stopped pretending they weren’t watching a while ago.
rows.translation: “来吧，”法兹安简单地说着，退后站定。你毫不迟疑地挥动手臂，轻松自信地接连摆出一个又一个姿势，最后自信地抓住裆部挺动。直到掌声和欢快的起哄声响起，你才从最后的姿势中回过神来——米尔脱衣舞者们早就不再假装自己没有偷看了。

rows.original: “There’s not much more I can teach you,” laughs Fazian. “But it’s easy to over-egg this dance. Bring it all back down, subtler and simpler, and then finish it off with your tail feather. It’s the perfect way to end - if you’ve done it right.”
rows.translation: “我已经没多少东西可以教你了，”法兹安笑道。“不过这支舞很容易做得太过火。把动作全部收回来，变得更含蓄、更简洁，然后以你的尾羽收尾。这是最完美的结束方式——前提是你之前的动作都做对了。”

Do it with confidence and no girl or guy in the galaxy will be able to resist you. Come back any time if you want to practice.”
rows.translation: “你掌握了，尊客！”法兹安眼中闪烁着笑意。“先用胸膛带动动作，再加入胯部动作，用胯部做出风格，挺一下裆部，最后以臀部收尾。只要充满自信地跳，银河系里就没有哪个姑娘或小伙能够抗拒你。想练习时随时回来。”

Do it with confidence and no girl or guy in the galaxy will be able to resist you. Come back any time if you want to practice.”"

rows.original: You leave, tired and sweaty but exultant.
rows.translation: 你离开了，虽然疲惫、浑身是汗，却也兴高采烈。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou leave, tired and sweaty but exultant."

rows.original: “Bring it,” says Fazian simply, standing back. With no hesitation whatsoever you snake into motion, throwing out shape after shape with easy confidence, finishing with an insouciant wiggle of the hips. You’re stirred out of your final stance by a clatter of applause and amused whoops - the myr strippers stopped pretending they weren’t watching a while ago.
rows.translation: “来吧，”法兹安简单地说着，退后站定。你毫不迟疑地灵活舞动，轻松自信地接连摆出一个又一个姿势，最后漫不经心地扭了扭胯。直到掌声和欢快的起哄声响起，你才从最后的姿势中回过神来——米尔脱衣舞者们早就不再假装自己没有偷看了。
rows.raw: "“Bring it,” says Fazian simply, standing back. With no hesitation whatsoever you snake into motion, throwing out shape after shape with easy confidence, finishing with an insouciant wiggle of the hips. You’re stirred out of your final stance by a clatter of applause and amused whoops - the myr strippers stopped pretending they weren’t watching a while ago."

rows.original: “There’s not much more I can teach you,” laughs Fazian. “You’ve just got to finish it all off with a good, old-fashioned crotch grab. Can’t get away with that unless you’ve already brought the house down! But you have, theoretically. Go on - you’ve earned it.”
rows.translation: “我已经没多少东西可以教你了，”法兹安笑道。“你只需要用一个老派而经典的抓裆动作收尾。除非你已经让全场为之沸腾，否则可不能这么做！不过理论上，你已经做到了。来吧——这是你应得的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“There’s not much more I can teach you,” laughs Fazian. “You’ve just got to finish it all off with a good, old-fashioned crotch grab. Can’t get away with that unless you’ve already brought the house down! But you have, theoretically. Go on - you’ve earned it.”"

rows.original: You go back to the drills, and each time you pull the whole sequence off, you learn the fine art of grasping your groin and pumping your hips.
rows.translation: 你重新开始练习，每当完整做完这一套动作，就练习抓住裆部并挺动胯部的精妙技巧。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou go back to the drills, and each time you pull the whole sequence off, you learn the fine art of grasping your groin and pumping your hips."

Do it with confidence and no girl or guy in the galaxy will be able to resist you. Come back any time if you want to practice.”

Do it with confidence and no girl or guy in the galaxy will be able to resist you. Come back any time if you want to practice.”"

rows.original: “You on for some dance training?” you say.
rows.translation: “要来点舞蹈训练吗？”你问道。
rows.raw: "“You on for some dance training?” you say."

rows.original: “Of course!”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course!”"

rows.original: Fazian scrapes his stool back, and you follow his bright, bobbing feathers through the thronged, dusky room to a door behind the main stage. A tough-looking gold myr stationed here gives you a menacing eyeball, but holds it open for both of you.
rows.translation: 法兹安把凳子往后一推，你跟着他明亮而上下晃动的羽毛，穿过拥挤昏暗的房间，来到主舞台后方的一扇门前。一名驻守在这里、看起来十分强悍的金米尔凶狠地瞪了你一眼，不过还是为你们俩扶住了门。
rows.raw: "\n\nFazian scrapes his stool back, and you follow his bright, bobbing feathers through the thronged, dusky room to a door behind the main stage. A tough-looking gold myr stationed here gives you a menacing eyeball, but holds it open for both of you."

rows.original: Backstage is a wooden, airy space sparsely populated by props, double-tiered chin-up bars and boxes stuffed with stripper gear. The few gold myr guys back here taking a break or doing their hair give you quizzical looks but otherwise leave you alone.
rows.translation: 后台是一处通风的木质空间，零星放着道具、双层引体向上杆和塞满脱衣舞装备的箱子。这里少数正在休息或整理头发的金米尔男人好奇地看了你几眼，除此之外并未打扰你。
rows.raw: "\n\nBackstage is a wooden, airy space sparsely populated by props, double-tiered chin-up bars and boxes stuffed with stripper gear. The few gold myr guys back here taking a break or doing their hair give you quizzical looks but otherwise leave you alone."

rows.original: “This’ll be... interesting,” says Fazian thoughtfully, clicking his claws as he looks you up and down.
rows.translation: “这会很...有意思，”法兹安若有所思地说，一边咔哒着爪子，一边上下打量你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“This’ll be... interesting,” says Fazian thoughtfully, clicking his claws as he looks you up and down."

rows.original: <i>“I can’t say I ever expected to teach someone with no legs how to dance.
rows.translation: <i>“我得说，我从没想过会教一个没有腿的人跳舞。
rows.raw: " <i>“I can’t say I ever expected to teach someone with no legs how to dance."

rows.original: “I mean, I imagine with all those legs you can dance, very well. But to begin with I’ll, uh, I’ll stand back a bit, if that’s alright.
rows.translation: “我是说，我想有这么多条腿，你肯定能跳得很好。不过一开始我还是，呃，还是退远一点吧，如果你不介意的话。
rows.raw: " “I mean, I imagine with all those legs you can dance, very well. But to begin with I’ll, uh, I’ll stand back a bit, if that’s alright."

rows.original: <i>“But you’ve got similar sort of limbs to me, so there’s that at least.
rows.translation: <i>“不过你的肢体和我差不多，至少这一点还好。
rows.raw: " <i>“But you’ve got similar sort of limbs to me, so there’s that at least."

rows.original: “Watching species with bent-forward knees walk around is so eery.
rows.translation: “看着膝盖向前弯曲的种族四处走动，实在是太诡异了。
rows.raw: " “Watching species with bent-forward knees walk around is so eery."

rows.original: Do you mind just moving around a bit? Let me see you strut your stuff.”
rows.translation: 你介意稍微活动一下吗？让我看看你的本事。”
rows.raw: " Do you mind just moving around a bit? Let me see you strut your stuff.”"

rows.original: Feeling self-conscious - particularly with an audience of ripped male myr watching you out of the corner of their eyes - you
rows.translation: 你感到有些难为情——尤其是一群肌肉结实的米尔男人正用眼角余光看着你——你开始
rows.raw: "\n\nFeeling self-conscious - particularly with an audience of ripped male myr watching you out of the corner of their eyes - you"

rows.translation: 走路
rows.raw: " walk"

rows.original: up and down on the boards in front of Fazian. He watches you intently, still clicking his claws as if listening to an invisible beat, his pale blue eyes flickering over where your muscles tighten up and where most of your weight lands.
rows.translation: ，在法兹安面前的木板地上来回移动。他目不转睛地观察着你，仍不断咔哒着爪子，仿佛在聆听某种无形的节拍；他浅蓝色的双眼扫过你肌肉绷紧的位置，以及身体大部分重量落下的地方。
rows.raw: " up and down on the boards in front of Fazian. He watches you intently, still clicking his claws as if listening to an invisible beat, his pale blue eyes flickering over where your muscles tighten up and where most of your weight lands."

rows.original: “Alright,” he says, bringing you to a halt. “There’s one thing above everything else you need to understand about dancing. It doesn’t matter who you’re doing it with, on what stage, for whatever reason. When you dance, you are communicating a universal: what all girls, and guys, find attractive about the masculine. What is that?”
rows.translation: “好了，”他说着，让你停下来。“关于舞蹈，有一件事比其他一切都更需要明白。无论你与谁共舞、站在哪个舞台上，又是出于什么原因，都无关紧要。跳舞时，你是在传达一种普遍共识：所有姑娘和小伙眼中，男性魅力究竟是什么。那是什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright,” he says, bringing you to a halt. “There’s one thing above everything else you need to understand about dancing. It doesn’t matter who you’re doing it with, on what stage, for whatever reason. When you dance, you are communicating a universal: what all girls, and guys, find attractive about the masculine. What is that?”"

rows.original: “Dick,” you say, with absolute certainty.
rows.translation: “鸡巴，”你无比笃定地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Dick,” you say, with absolute certainty."

rows.original: “Gallantry?” you suggest.
rows.translation: “侠义精神？”你猜道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Gallantry?” you suggest."

rows.original: “Obsessive behaviour and emotional ineptitude?” you suggest.
rows.translation: “偏执的行为和感情上的无能？”你猜道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Obsessive behaviour and emotional ineptitude?” you suggest."

rows.original: “Assertiveness,” you say.
rows.translation: “果断，”你说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Assertiveness,” you say."

rows.original: “Confidence, per,” Fazian corrects. He brings his snapping claws down to a gently swivelling hip. “You’ve got to say with your body that you’re going to get what you want, and you aren’t going to have to grab or act like a thug to do it - you just will, because look at you.” You’re slightly worried that the anat’s forgetting about you. He slaps his hands and does a little shimmy. “Get it wrong and they’ll laugh at you. Get it right and they’ll laugh too - with you. You’ve got to convince your audience you’re worth watching, and you do that by having absolute confidence in what you’re doing.” He whirls once and lands so he’s side-on to you, still considering intently.
rows.translation: “是自信，尊客，”法兹安纠正道。他把咔哒作响的爪子放到轻轻扭动的胯部。“你得用身体告诉别人，你会得到自己想要的东西，而且根本不必强抢或像个暴徒般行事——你就是会得到，因为看看你自己。”你有点担心这名安纳泰已经忘了你的存在。他拍了拍手，轻轻扭动起来。“做错了，他们会嘲笑你。做对了，他们也会笑——但会和你一起笑。你必须让观众相信你值得他们注目，而方法就是对自己所做的一切抱有绝对的自信。”他旋转一周，落地时侧身朝向你，仍在专注地打量。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Confidence, per,” Fazian corrects. He brings his snapping claws down to a gently swivelling hip. “You’ve got to say with your body that you’re going to get what you want, and you aren’t going to have to grab or act like a thug to do it - you just will, because look at you.” You’re slightly worried that the anat’s forgetting about you. He slaps his hands and does a little shimmy. “Get it wrong and they’ll laugh at you. Get it right and they’ll laugh too - with you. You’ve got to convince your audience you’re worth watching, and you do that by having absolute confidence in what you’re doing.” He whirls once and lands so he’s side-on to you, still considering intently."

rows.original: “I think there’s two dances that I could easily teach you. One’s a classic and fairly straightforward - the Edotto. The other’s a bit more, um, flamboyant. The Sunwalker. Opens you up to the audience a bit more, so greater risk, greater reward, potentially. Which grabs you?”
rows.translation: “我想有两支舞很容易教给你。一支是经典且相当直白的埃多托舞。另一支则更，呃，浮夸一些。日行舞。它会让你在观众面前更加敞开，所以风险更大，潜在回报也更大。哪一支更吸引你？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I think there’s two dances that I could easily teach you. One’s a classic and fairly straightforward - the Edotto. The other’s a bit more, um, flamboyant. The Sunwalker. Opens you up to the audience a bit more, so greater risk, greater reward, potentially. Which grabs you?”"

rows.original: “So, which will it be?” asks Fazian. Click, click, go his claws. “Edotto, or Sunwalker?”
rows.translation: “那么，你选哪一个？”法兹安问道。他的爪子咔哒、咔哒地响着。“埃多托舞，还是日行舞？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, which will it be?” asks Fazian. Click, click, go his claws. “Edotto, or Sunwalker?”"

rows.original: Fazian is a six foot tall anat, immediately recognizable as such by his digitigrade legs, four-clawed hands and flat, mask-like face. That impassive, ivory, vertical visage starts at his crown and tapers off to a dull point beyond where his chin would be, were he human. His dexterous... (Jaws? Mandibles? Beak?)... mouth-parts are not obvious when he’s facing you. Judging his mood and the impression your words have on him by his facial expression is clearly impossible; however, the anat has animated blue eyes and a restless body language which more than makes up for it.
rows.translation: 法兹安是一名六英尺高的安纳泰，他的趾行腿、四爪手掌和平坦如面具的脸让人一眼便能认出他的种族。那张毫无表情、象牙白色的竖直面孔从头顶开始延伸，并逐渐收窄；若他是人类，末端会越过下巴所在的位置，形成一个钝尖。他灵活的...（颚？大颚？喙？）...口器在正面对着你时并不明显。显然，想从他的面部表情判断情绪以及你的话给他留下了什么印象根本不可能；不过，这名安纳泰有一双灵动的蓝眼睛和丰富躁动的肢体语言，足以弥补这一点。
rows.raw: "Fazian is a six foot tall anat, immediately recognizable as such by his digitigrade legs, four-clawed hands and flat, mask-like face. That impassive, ivory, vertical visage starts at his crown and tapers off to a dull point beyond where his chin would be, were he human. His dexterous... (Jaws? Mandibles? Beak?)... mouth-parts are not obvious when he’s facing you. Judging his mood and the impression your words have on him by his facial expression is clearly impossible; however, the anat has animated blue eyes and a restless body language which more than makes up for it."

rows.original: His rough skin is a dark navy, a dullness that offsets his remarkable feather plumes. Rearing out by at least two feet from where his mask ends on his head, his crown-plume is a bouquet of striking aquamarine and magenta into which unearthly beads of light and undertones of other shades seem to have been worked. The tufts that emerge from his elbows are the same, only in miniature. He seems to have a remarkable amount of control over all of them, able to curl, stiffen and shake them into a mesmerizing display of shifting colors when he chooses. Here though, away from the stage, he keeps them down and carefully still.
rows.translation: 他的粗糙皮肤呈深海军蓝色，这种暗沉恰好衬托出他非凡的羽冠。羽冠从面具在头顶结束的位置向外伸出至少两英尺，宛如一束醒目的海蓝色与洋红色花束，其中似乎还编入了超凡脱俗的光珠和其他色调的暗纹。他肘部冒出的羽簇与之相同，只是缩小了许多。他似乎能出色地控制所有羽毛，可以随心所欲地让它们卷曲、挺直和抖动，呈现令人着迷的流转色彩。不过在这里，远离舞台的地方，他把羽毛压低，小心地保持静止。
rows.raw: "\n\nHis rough skin is a dark navy, a dullness that offsets his remarkable feather plumes. Rearing out by at least two feet from where his mask ends on his head, his crown-plume is a bouquet of striking aquamarine and magenta into which unearthly beads of light and undertones of other shades seem to have been worked. The tufts that emerge from his elbows are the same, only in miniature. He seems to have a remarkable amount of control over all of them, able to curl, stiffen and shake them into a mesmerizing display of shifting colors when he chooses. Here though, away from the stage, he keeps them down and carefully still."

rows.original: He has the lithe, tightly muscular body of a male ballet dancer, with the flat, dune-like chest and hard, pert butt to go with it. As with his feathers though, whilst he’s evidently happy to flaunt it all on-stage, here and now he’s dressed in a plain white shirt and denim long johns, almost ascetic-like. What he keeps in his trousers is anyone’s guess - although you imagine you wouldn’t have to ask around here for very long to find out.
rows.translation: 他有着男性芭蕾舞者般纤细而紧实的肌肉身材，平坦如沙丘的胸膛和结实挺翘的臀部也与之相配。不过如同他的羽毛一样，尽管他显然乐于在舞台上炫耀这一切，此时此地却穿着朴素的白衬衫和牛仔连体裤，几乎像个苦行者。至于裤子里藏着什么，谁也说不准——不过你想，在这里要打听出来大概用不了多久。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe has the lithe, tightly muscular body of a male ballet dancer, with the flat, dune-like chest and hard, pert butt to go with it. As with his feathers though, whilst he’s evidently happy to flaunt it all on-stage, here and now he’s dressed in a plain white shirt and denim long johns, almost ascetic-like. What he keeps in his trousers is anyone’s guess - although you imagine you wouldn’t have to ask around here for very long to find out."

rows.original: The anat is silent for a long time, twirling his wine glass around and around.
rows.translation: 这名安纳泰沉默了很久，一圈又一圈地晃动着酒杯。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe anat is silent for a long time, twirling his wine glass around and around."

rows.original: “I have learnt that it is wrong to assume whole races cannot be motivated by hatred, based purely on their gender,” he says at last. “By doing that, I was simply practicing a different form of racism against the myr. That was a hard lesson to learn - something positive I had always believed, disproven - and maybe I would never have learned it if Ehstraffe had not lured me into that horrible place.” He closes his eyes and curls his claws when he says the name.
rows.translation: “我明白了，仅凭性别就认定整个种族不可能受仇恨驱使是错误的，”他终于说道。“那样做只是在以另一种方式歧视米尔人。这一课很难接受——我一直坚信的一种美好观念被证明是错的——若不是埃斯特拉芙把我诱进那个可怕的地方，我或许永远都不会明白。”说出这个名字时，他闭上眼睛，蜷起爪子。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I have learnt that it is wrong to assume whole races cannot be motivated by hatred, based purely on their gender,” he says at last. “By doing that, I was simply practicing a different form of racism against the myr. That was a hard lesson to learn - something positive I had always believed, disproven - and maybe I would never have learned it if Ehstraffe had not lured me into that horrible place.” He closes his eyes and curls his claws when he says the name."

rows.original: “You still perform for them, though?” you say.
rows.translation: “可你仍然为她们表演？”你说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You still perform for them, though?” you say."

rows.original: “Yes. The red myr too, if they asked, and the offer was genuine. It is wrong to take away from the masses because of an individual’s crimes. I am just... more cautious now.” He sighs wearily. “It is so difficult to live in a world with shades of gray, y’know? I long to be that poor fool who knew all ant women meant well again.”
rows.translation: “是的。如果红米尔提出邀请，而且诚意可信，我也会为她们表演。因个人的罪行而剥夺大众的享受是不对的。我只是...现在更加谨慎了。”他疲惫地叹息。“生活在一个充满灰色地带的世界里太难了，你懂吗？我真怀念那个曾经坚信所有蚁族女人都心怀善意的可怜傻瓜。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes. The red myr too, if they asked, and the offer was genuine. It is wrong to take away from the masses because of an individual’s crimes. I am just... more cautious now.” He sighs wearily. “It is so difficult to live in a world with shades of gray, y’know? I long to be that poor fool who knew all ant women meant well again.”"

rows.original: “You told the authorities about what was going on there?” Fazian’s blue eyes turn flinty.
rows.translation: “你把那里发生的事情告诉当局了吗？”法兹安的蓝眼睛变得冷硬。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You told the authorities about what was going on there?” Fazian’s blue eyes turn flinty."

rows.original: “Yes. I have filed a report with the U.G.C. I have told the Nehzara woman at the port everything, and in no uncertain terms told her what I think of inveiglement, slavery and ethnic cleansing. I have attended an audience with the gold queens, and told them in no uncertain terms what I think of their negligence towards their subjects under foreign rule. No, none of them are happy, but I will not have them ignore me. I will not have them ignore them. Part of everything I earn here now goes towards helping the gold myr PoWs - as soon as I can work out a safe way of providing it to them. This is my fight, now.” He shakes his head, feathers rustling and laughs slightly.
rows.translation: “是的。我已经向联合银河邦联提交了报告。我把一切都告诉了港口那位内扎拉女人，还毫不含糊地说明了自己对诱骗、奴役和种族清洗的看法。我觐见了金米尔女王们，也毫不含糊地告诉她们，我对她们疏于照管外国统治下臣民一事有何看法。不，她们都不高兴，但我不会让她们无视我。我不会让她们无视她们。如今我在这里赚到的钱，有一部分会用来帮助金米尔战俘——只要我能找到安全地把物资送给她们的办法。这现在也是我的战斗。”他摇摇头，羽毛沙沙作响，轻轻笑了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes. I have filed a report with the U.G.C. I have told the Nehzara woman at the port everything, and in no uncertain terms told her what I think of inveiglement, slavery and ethnic cleansing. I have attended an audience with the gold queens, and told them in no uncertain terms what I think of their negligence towards their subjects under foreign rule. No, none of them are happy, but I will not have them ignore me. I will not have them ignore them. Part of everything I earn here now goes towards helping the gold myr PoWs - as soon as I can work out a safe way of providing it to them. This is my fight, now.” He shakes his head, feathers rustling and laughs slightly."

rows.original: “I have even updated the anatae administrata about my whereabouts, and what is happening here. They are equally unhappy about my having spent so much time here... but ironically if anything ever did happen to me now they’d be delighted, because it would mean they could come down like a ton of prefabs on Xenogen and the kui-tan.” He finishes his wine and gazes at you, merry, mischievous glint in his eye. “I am more cautious now, per.”
rows.translation: “我甚至把自己的下落以及这里发生的事情告知了安纳泰行政机关。他们同样不满我在这里逗留这么久...不过讽刺的是，如果现在真有任何事发生在我身上，他们反倒会很高兴，因为那意味着他们可以用成吨的预制建筑般的重压，狠狠砸向异源生物科技和奎坦。”他喝完酒，注视着你，眼中带着愉快而调皮的光芒。“我现在更加谨慎了，尊客。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I have even updated the anatae administrata about my whereabouts, and what is happening here. They are equally unhappy about my having spent so much time here... but ironically if anything ever did happen to me now they’d be delighted, because it would mean they could come down like a ton of prefabs on Xenogen and the kui-tan.” He finishes his wine and gazes at you, merry, mischievous glint in his eye. “I am more cautious now, per.”"

rows.original: Myr
rows.translation: 米尔
rows.raw: "Myr"

rows.original: Ask if his opinion of the myr has changed, after his experience.
rows.translation: 问问经历那件事后，他对米尔人的看法是否改变。
rows.raw: "Ask if his opinion of the myr has changed, after his experience."

rows.original: Myr
rows.translation: 米尔
rows.raw: "Myr"

rows.original: Dance
rows.translation: 舞蹈
rows.raw: "Dance"

rows.original: Dance
rows.translation: 舞蹈
rows.raw: "Dance"

rows.original: Your muscles are too sore to do that!
rows.translation: 你的肌肉太酸痛，做不了那个！
rows.raw: "Your muscles are too sore to do that!"

rows.original: Dance
rows.translation: 舞蹈
rows.raw: "Dance"

rows.original: Dance
rows.translation: 舞蹈
rows.raw: "Dance"

rows.original: Go backstage and do some dance training with the anat.
rows.translation: 去后台接受这名安纳泰的舞蹈训练。
rows.raw: "Go backstage and do some dance training with the anat."

rows.original: Dance
rows.translation: 舞蹈
rows.raw: "Dance"

rows.original: Appearance
rows.translation: 外貌
rows.raw: "Appearance"

rows.original: Appearance
rows.translation: 外貌
rows.raw: "Appearance"

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: “Per Steele!” Fazian’s eyes smile warmly at you as you sidle up to him at the bar. After only half a second’s pause, the anat dancer grasps your hand and shakes it, not so vigorously it might dislocate your wrist. He’s getting better at it.
rows.translation: “斯蒂尔尊客！”你靠到酒吧旁时，法兹安的眼睛朝你温暖地笑着。仅仅停顿了半秒，这名安纳泰舞者便握住你的手摇了摇，力道没有大到可能让你的手腕脱臼。他越来越熟练了。
rows.raw: "“Per Steele!” Fazian’s eyes smile warmly at you as you sidle up to him at the bar. After only half a second’s pause, the anat dancer grasps your hand and shakes it, not so vigorously it might dislocate your wrist. He’s getting better at it."

rows.original: Anatae
rows.raw: "Anatae"

rows.original: “The cabaret on?” you ask.
rows.translation: “歌舞表演还演吗？”你问道。
rows.raw: "“The cabaret on?” you ask."

rows.original: “No,” she replies distractedly, looking past you and wringing all four hands. “I... I don’t suppose you’ve seen Fazian anywhere?”
rows.translation: “不演，”她心不在焉地回答，越过你看向后方，四只手不安地绞在一起。“我...我想你大概没在什么地方见到法兹安吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No,” she replies distractedly, looking past you and wringing all four hands. “I... I don’t suppose you’ve seen Fazian anywhere?”"

rows.original: “He not around?”
rows.translation: “他不在吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“He not around?”"

rows.original: “He hasn’t shown up to the club for the last two nights running,” she says, unease etched on her pretty, pointed face. “I thought maybe he was feeling poorly last night... but now, nobody seems to know what’s happened to him. The port authorities won’t tell me anything, except that he’s not on his ship. If he were a myr I could ask the royal guard about it, but...” She looks helpless.
rows.translation: “他已经连续两个晚上没来俱乐部了，”她说道，漂亮尖俏的脸上刻满不安。“昨晚我以为他只是身体不舒服...可现在似乎没人知道他出了什么事。港口当局什么也不肯告诉我，只说他不在自己的船上。如果他是米尔人，我还能去问王家卫队，可是...”她显得束手无策。
rows.raw: "\n\n“He hasn’t shown up to the club for the last two nights running,” she says, unease etched on her pretty, pointed face. “I thought maybe he was feeling poorly last night... but now, nobody seems to know what’s happened to him. The port authorities won’t tell me anything, except that he’s not on his ship. If he were a myr I could ask the royal guard about it, but...” She looks helpless."

rows.original: Help
rows.translation: 帮助
rows.raw: "Help"

rows.original: “I’ll find him,” you say, with all the confidence you can muster. “Don’t worry about a thing. Just tell me where you saw him last.”
rows.translation: “我会找到他，”你竭力摆出充满信心的语气。“什么都别担心。只要告诉我你最后在哪里见到他。”
rows.raw: "“I’ll find him,” you say, with all the confidence you can muster. “Don’t worry about a thing. Just tell me where you saw him last.”"

rows.original: “I’ll find him, no problem,” you say, trying to lighten her mood. “No matter how well a bone-headed brightly-feathered dude blends into the crowd here. Where did you see him last?”
rows.translation: “我会找到他的，没问题，”你说着，试图让她轻松一点。“不管一个脑袋不灵光、羽毛鲜艳的家伙在这里的人群中有多显眼。你最后在哪里见到他的？”
rows.raw: "“I’ll find him, no problem,” you say, trying to lighten her mood. “No matter how well a bone-headed brightly-feathered dude blends into the crowd here. Where did you see him last?”"

rows.original: “He’ll have got himself involved in some orgy, forgotten all about you,” you say, rolling your eyes. Maybe you believe that, maybe you don’t; the point is to put the lady at ease. “I’ll find him, no problem. Slap some sense into him while I’m at it. Where did you see him last?”
rows.translation: “他肯定是参加什么乱交派对，彻底把你忘了，”你翻着白眼说道。也许你真这么想，也许并没有；重点是让这位女士安心。“我会找到他的，没问题。顺便把他打醒。你最后在哪里见到他的？”
rows.raw: "“He’ll have got himself involved in some orgy, forgotten all about you,” you say, rolling your eyes. Maybe you believe that, maybe you don’t; the point is to put the lady at ease. “I’ll find him, no problem. Slap some sense into him while I’m at it. Where did you see him last?”"

rows.original: “I last saw him a few nights ago,” says Hepane, brow crinkling in thought. “We did our usual performance, and then he went to the bar as usual. I didn’t really see him after that. I didn’t - I can’t remember anything unusual happening. He often goes off with other myr, it’s... we have a professional relationship.” Her tone suggests one half of the pair is happier with this arrangement than the other. “We usually do a rehearsal in the afternoon, and he didn’t turn up then. I haven’t seen him since.”
rows.translation: “我最后一次见到他是几晚前，”赫潘皱着眉回忆道。“我们照常完成表演，然后他照常去了酒吧。之后我就没怎么见到他。我没有——我想不起发生过任何异常。他常和其他米尔人一起离开，这...我们只是工作关系。”她的语气表明，两人中有一方对这种安排远比另一方满意。“我们通常会在下午排练，而那天他没有出现。此后我就再也没见过他。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I last saw him a few nights ago,” says Hepane, brow crinkling in thought. “We did our usual performance, and then he went to the bar as usual. I didn’t really see him after that. I didn’t - I can’t remember anything unusual happening. He often goes off with other myr, it’s... we have a professional relationship.” Her tone suggests one half of the pair is happier with this arrangement than the other. “We usually do a rehearsal in the afternoon, and he didn’t turn up then. I haven’t seen him since.”"

rows.original: “Try asking around?” she suggests after a heavy pause. “I already have, around the club at least, but maybe - you’re a starwalker, too. You must know sophisticated questions to ask, get people to open up more. If you find anything out, come back to me. I’ll wait here, in case he does show up in the meantime.”
rows.translation: “试着四处问问？”沉重地停顿后，她建议道。“我已经问过了，至少俱乐部周围都问过，可也许——你也是星行者。你肯定懂得如何巧妙提问，让人更愿意敞开心扉。如果打听到任何消息，就回来找我。我要留在这里，以防他这段时间出现。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Try asking around?” she suggests after a heavy pause. “I already have, around the club at least, but maybe - you’re a starwalker, too. You must know sophisticated questions to ask, get people to open up more. If you find anything out, come back to me. I’ll wait here, in case he does show up in the meantime.”"

rows.original: As you leave she grabs your hand. “Thank you for doing this,” the accompanist says tremulously. “I’d hate if something bad had happened to him. I think - I don’t think Fazian knows how bad this world can be.”
rows.translation: 你离开时，她抓住了你的手。“谢谢你愿意帮忙，”这名伴奏者颤声说道。“要是他遭遇了什么坏事，我会很难受。我觉得——我觉得法兹安并不知道这个世界能有多么险恶。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you leave she grabs your hand. “Thank you for doing this,” the accompanist says tremulously. “I’d hate if something bad had happened to him. I think - I don’t think Fazian knows how bad this world can be.”"

rows.original: You go to the Honey Nozzle’s bar and take stock. Who in the club, Gildenmere and the nearby spaceport might know where the gene-modded anat has gotten to?
rows.translation: 你走到蜜汁喷口的吧台前，盘算起来。俱乐部、吉尔登米尔以及附近太空港里，有谁可能知道这名接受过基因改造的安纳泰去了哪里？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou go to the Honey Nozzle’s bar and take stock. Who in the club, Gildenmere and the nearby spaceport might know where the gene-modded anat has gotten to?"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Help Out
rows.translation: 帮忙
rows.raw: "Help Out"

rows.original: Your intuition tells you to be careful here. It’s possible you could muck this up.
rows.translation: 你的直觉告诉你，在这里要谨慎行事。你确实有可能把事情搞砸。
rows.raw: "Your intuition tells you to be careful here. It’s possible you could muck this up."

rows.original: Delay
rows.translation: 推迟
rows.raw: "Delay"

rows.original: “I might be able to look for him,” you say. “Just give me some time, okay?”
rows.translation: “我或许能去找他，”你说道。“给我一点时间，好吗？”
rows.raw: "“I might be able to look for him,” you say. “Just give me some time, okay?”"

rows.original: “It would be wonderful if you could,” says Hepane, focusing on you at last. She reaches out to grasp your hand tightly. “Another starwalker might be able to... please hurry.”
rows.translation: “如果你愿意，那就太好了，”赫潘说道，终于把注意力放到你身上。她伸手紧紧握住你的手。“另一位星行者或许能够...请快一点。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It would be wonderful if you could,” says Hepane, focusing on you at last. She reaches out to grasp your hand tightly. “Another starwalker might be able to... please hurry.”"

rows.original: “He... he still hasn’t shown up,” says Hepane the moment you roll into view. Watching a gold myr wring her hands is mesmerizing, in its own way. “Can you help?”
rows.translation: “他...他还是没有出现，”你刚进入视野，赫潘便说道。看着一名金米尔绞动双手，以她自己的方式来说也颇为迷人。“你能帮忙吗？”
rows.raw: "“He... he still hasn’t shown up,” says Hepane the moment you roll into view. Watching a gold myr wring her hands is mesmerizing, in its own way. “Can you help?”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Delay
rows.translation: 推迟
rows.raw: "Delay"

rows.original: Perhaps you could help. A bit later, though.
rows.translation: 或许你能帮忙。不过要晚一点。
rows.raw: "Perhaps you could help. A bit later, though."

rows.original: Not My Prob
rows.translation: 不关我事
rows.raw: "Not My Prob"

rows.original: “Sorry to hear that,” you say. “Hope he turns up eventually.”
rows.translation: “听到这个消息我很遗憾，”你说道。“希望他最终会出现。”
rows.raw: "“Sorry to hear that,” you say. “Hope he turns up eventually.”"

rows.original: “Yes...” Hepane’s attention has already drifted past you to the entrance of the club again.
rows.translation: “是啊...”赫潘的注意力已经再次越过你，飘向俱乐部入口。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes...” Hepane’s attention has already drifted past you to the entrance of the club again."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Not My Problem
rows.translation: 不关我的事
rows.raw: "Not My Problem"

rows.original: If you choose this, it’s likely you’ll never see Fazian again.
rows.translation: 如果选择这个选项，你很可能再也见不到法兹安。
rows.raw: "If you choose this, it’s likely you’ll never see Fazian again."

rows.original: Gold Myr
rows.translation: 金米尔
rows.raw: "Gold Myr"

rows.original: GOLDMYR
rows.raw: "GOLDMYR"

rows.original: GOLDMYR
rows.raw: "GOLDMYR"

rows.original: GOLDMYR
rows.raw: "GOLDMYR"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “Excuse me ladies,” you say, breaking the tipsy chatter of the gold myr grouped near one of the strip poles, “but I wonder if any of you have seen the dancer Fazian? He’s got feathers, about yay high...”
rows.translation: “打扰一下，女士们，”你说道，打断了聚在一根钢管旁、已有醉意的金米尔们的闲聊。“我想知道，你们有人见过舞者法兹安吗？他长着羽毛，大概这么高...”
rows.raw: "“Excuse me ladies,” you say, breaking the tipsy chatter of the gold myr grouped near one of the strip poles, “but I wonder if any of you have seen the dancer Fazian? He’s got feathers, about yay high...”"

rows.original: “Ooh yes,” replies one immediately. “He’s a nice piece of honeycomb, isn’t he? Shame you have to pay to go see him.”
rows.translation: “哦，当然见过，”一人立刻回答。“他可真是块上好的蜜巢，对吧？可惜得付钱才能看他表演。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ooh yes,” replies one immediately. “He’s a nice piece of honeycomb, isn’t he? Shame you have to pay to go see him.”"

rows.original: “W’s up with that, anyway?” slurs another, trying to reach up and pinch the passing legs of a myr stripper. “Starwalker charging us. What - why - how could they need our money? Pointing their stalag-cannons at us all the while. S’isn’t right.”
rows.translation: “这到底是怎回事？”另一人含糊不清地说着，试图伸手捏住一名经过的米尔脱衣舞者的腿。“星行者还要收我们的钱。他们——为什么——怎么会需要我们的钱？同时还拿石笋炮指着我们。这不对。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“W’s up with that, anyway?” slurs another, trying to reach up and pinch the passing legs of a myr stripper. “Starwalker charging us. What - why - how could they need our money? Pointing their stalag-cannons at us all the while. S’isn’t right.”"

rows.original: “It’s to keep cheap, pinching wetra-wives like you away from the prime stock!” shrills another. They all dissolve into laughter.
rows.translation: “就是为了把你这种抠门的韦特拉老婆挡在顶级货色外面！”另一人尖声说道。她们全都大笑起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s to keep cheap, pinching wetra-wives like you away from the prime stock!” shrills another. They all dissolve into laughter."

rows.original: “The thing is, he’s gone missing,” you try.
rows.translation: “重点是，他失踪了，”你试图解释。
rows.raw: "\n\n“The thing is, he’s gone missing,” you try."

rows.original: “It does raise the question,” says a more bookish one, “about the universal nature of monetary exchange. To think that, for all their sophistication, starwalkers are still using a form of bargaining which is recognisable to us...”
rows.translation: “这确实提出了一个问题，”一名看起来更有学者气质的人说道，“也就是货币交换的普遍性。想想看，尽管星行者如此先进，却仍在使用一种我们能够理解的交易形式...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It does raise the question,” says a more bookish one, “about the universal nature of monetary exchange. To think that, for all their sophistication, starwalkers are still using a form of bargaining which is recognisable to us...”"

rows.original: “Oh here we go,” retorts the first. “She gets one study published in the Gildenglobe and suddenly she’s the expert.”
rows.translation: “又来了，”最先说话的人反驳道。“她不过在《吉尔登环球报》上发表了一篇研究，就突然成了专家。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh here we go,” retorts the first. “She gets one study published in the Gildenglobe and suddenly she’s the expert.”"

rows.original: “We’re here to have a good time!” wails another.
rows.translation: “我们是来寻开心的！”另一人哀号道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“We’re here to have a good time!” wails another."

rows.original: Good Cop
rows.translation: 好警察
rows.raw: "Good Cop"

rows.original: Gold Myr
rows.translation: 金米尔
rows.raw: "Gold Myr"

rows.original: GOLDMYR
rows.raw: "GOLDMYR"

rows.original: GOLDMYR
rows.raw: "GOLDMYR"

rows.original: GOLDMYR
rows.raw: "GOLDMYR"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “So where are you ladies from?” you say, pulling up a chair. “You all researchers?”
rows.translation: “那么，女士们是哪里人？”你拉过一把椅子说道。“你们都是研究员吗？”
rows.raw: "“So where are you ladies from?” you say, pulling up a chair. “You all researchers?”"

rows.original: Over the next hour or so you learn an awful lot about the current state of philosophical and economical debate in Gildenmere.
rows.translation: 接下来的一个小时左右，你了解了许多关于吉尔登米尔当前哲学和经济学争论状况的事情。
rows.raw: "\n\nOver the next hour or so you learn an awful lot about the current state of philosophical and economical debate in Gildenmere."

rows.original: You also get rather unsubtly groped and hit upon.
rows.translation: 你还遭到了相当露骨的摸索和调情。
rows.raw: " You also get rather unsubtly groped and hit upon."

rows.original: The party of gold myr exit the club eventually, blowing kisses at you and tittering into each other’s arms, leaving you with a minor headache and absolutely no further clue as to what happened to Fazian.
rows.translation: 这群金米尔最终离开了俱乐部，一边朝你飞吻，一边互相依偎着窃笑；她们只给你留下了轻微的头痛，却没有留下任何关于法兹安遭遇的进一步线索。
rows.raw: " The party of gold myr exit the club eventually, blowing kisses at you and tittering into each other’s arms, leaving you with a minor headache and absolutely no further clue as to what happened to Fazian."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Good Cop
rows.translation: 唱红脸
rows.raw: "Good Cop"

rows.original: Encourage them to keep talking. Maybe they’ll reveal something interesting.
rows.translation: 鼓励他们继续说下去。也许他们会透露一些有趣的消息。
rows.raw: "Encourage them to keep talking. Maybe they’ll reveal something interesting."

rows.original: Bad Cop
rows.translation: 唱白脸
rows.raw: "Bad Cop"

rows.original: Gold Myr
rows.translation: 金米尔
rows.raw: "Gold Myr"

rows.original: GOLDMYR
rows.raw: "GOLDMYR"

rows.original: GOLDMYR
rows.raw: "GOLDMYR"

rows.original: GOLDMYR
rows.raw: "GOLDMYR"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “Listen to me, dammit,” you bark, banging your fist on the table. “A young man who performs for you has gone missing. Would you be this careless if it was one of your own brothers? Stop taking the piss for a moment and think. When was the last time any of you saw him?”
rows.translation: “听我说，该死的，”你吼道，一拳砸在桌上。“一个给你们表演的年轻人失踪了。要是换成你们自己的兄弟，你们也会这么不上心吗？先别胡扯了，好好想想。你们最后一次见到他是什么时候？”
rows.raw: "“Listen to me, dammit,” you bark, banging your fist on the table. “A young man who performs for you has gone missing. Would you be this careless if it was one of your own brothers? Stop taking the piss for a moment and think. When was the last time any of you saw him?”"

rows.original: The table goes quiet.
rows.translation: 桌边顿时安静下来。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe table goes quiet."

rows.original: “Sorry, starwalker,” says one in a small voice. They all look at each other uneasily, antennae twitching.
rows.translation: “对不起，星行者，”其中一人小声说道。众人不安地面面相觑，触角微微抽动。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry, starwalker,” says one in a small voice. They all look at each other uneasily, antennae twitching."

rows.original: “We don’t know where he is,” goes on another. “But... if some gold myr had kidnapped him, we’d know about it.”
rows.translation: “我们不知道他在哪儿，”另一人接着说。“不过...要是某个金米尔绑走了他，我们肯定会听到风声。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We don’t know where he is,” goes on another. “But... if some gold myr had kidnapped him, we’d know about it.”"

rows.original: “Wouldn’t be able to keep that quiet around here,” agrees a third. “And everyone would be pissed. He’s the star performer of this place, no-one likes the cabaret being closed. Someone would roach.”
rows.translation: “这儿可瞒不住这种事，”第三人赞同道。“而且大家都会很火大。他是这里的头牌，没人喜欢歌舞厅关门。肯定会有人告密。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wouldn’t be able to keep that quiet around here,” agrees a third. “And everyone would be pissed. He’s the star performer of this place, no-one likes the cabaret being closed. Someone would roach.”"

rows.original: That’s something, at least. You thank the party stiffly and leave.
rows.translation: 至少这也算一点线索。你生硬地向这群人道谢，然后离开。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s something, at least. You thank the party stiffly and leave."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Bad Cop
rows.translation: 唱白脸
rows.raw: "Bad Cop"

rows.original: Insist they get back to the point, emphasizing how important this is.
rows.translation: 坚持让他们回到正题，强调这件事有多重要。
rows.raw: "Insist they get back to the point, emphasizing how important this is."

rows.original: GOLDMYR
rows.raw: "GOLDMYR"

rows.original: Barkeep
rows.translation: 酒保
rows.raw: "Barkeep"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: The barkeep eyes you as you sit down near her. For a gold myr, she’s pretty tough-looking; flat-nosed and drawn features. She gazes back at you impassively, cleaning two glasses at once.
rows.translation: 你在酒保附近坐下，她随即打量起你。以金米尔来说，她看上去相当强悍；鼻梁扁平，五官瘦削。她面无表情地回望着你，同时擦拭着两只酒杯。
rows.raw: "The barkeep eyes you as you sit down near her. For a gold myr, she’s pretty tough-looking; flat-nosed and drawn features. She gazes back at you impassively, cleaning two glasses at once."

rows.original: “You know the dancer Fazian, right?” you say. “Used to perform here. Have you seen him recently?”
rows.translation: “你认识舞者法兹安，对吧？”你说道。“以前在这里表演。最近见过他吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You know the dancer Fazian, right?” you say. “Used to perform here. Have you seen him recently?”"

rows.original: “Yes,” she replies. “No.”
rows.translation: “认识，”她答道。“没见过。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes,” she replies. “No.”"

rows.original: “Do you know anyone who might?” She snorts.
rows.translation: “那你知道谁可能见过吗？”她嗤了一声。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Do you know anyone who might?” She snorts."

rows.original: “Sure. Want me to sort you out with some red venom, too? Maybe one or two girls who’ll do anything if you can smuggle them off this world, while you’re waiting.” She examines one of the glasses in her hands critically. “Lot of business flows through here. Why? Because the staff don’t know and they don’t tell. Particularly not to some starwalker who got put up to it by the royal guard.”
rows.translation: “当然。还要我顺便给你弄点红毒液吗？也许再找一两个愿意为偷渡离开这个星球而做任何事的姑娘，让你等着的时候消遣一下。”她挑剔地审视着手中的一只酒杯。“这里有很多生意往来。为什么？因为员工不知道，也不会乱说。尤其不会告诉一个受皇家卫队指使的星行者。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure. Want me to sort you out with some red venom, too? Maybe one or two girls who’ll do anything if you can smuggle them off this world, while you’re waiting.” She examines one of the glasses in her hands critically. “Lot of business flows through here. Why? Because the staff don’t know and they don’t tell. Particularly not to some starwalker who got put up to it by the royal guard.”"

rows.original: Good Cop
rows.translation: 唱红脸
rows.raw: "Good Cop"

rows.original: GOLDMYR
rows.raw: "GOLDMYR"

rows.original: Barkeep
rows.translation: 酒保
rows.raw: "Barkeep"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “Okay. You got me right,” you say, quietly. “I am an outsider, looking for another outsider. You know what my interest is? Knowing how much it would suck to be lost and alone on an alien planet, without anyone looking for me. I don’t want to incriminate anyone. I just want to know where to look.”
rows.translation: “好吧。你说中了，”你轻声说道。“我是个外来者，正在找另一个外来者。你知道我为什么在意吗？因为我知道独自迷失在一颗陌生星球上、又没人来找自己会有多糟。我不想牵连任何人，只想知道该去哪里找。”
rows.raw: "“Okay. You got me right,” you say, quietly. “I am an outsider, looking for another outsider. You know what my interest is? Knowing how much it would suck to be lost and alone on an alien planet, without anyone looking for me. I don’t want to incriminate anyone. I just want to know where to look.”"

rows.original: The barkeep is silent for a time, turning the glass around and around in her hands. Her pupil-less eyes are unreadable.
rows.translation: 酒保沉默了一会儿，把酒杯在手中转来转去。她那没有瞳孔的眼睛让人看不出任何情绪。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe barkeep is silent for a time, turning the glass around and around in her hands. Her pupil-less eyes are unreadable."

rows.original: “If I were looking for that friend of yours...” she says at last. “...I would look in Kressia. I cannot say any more than that,
rows.translation: “如果是我在找你的那位朋友...”她终于说道。“...我会去克雷西亚找。我不能再说更多了，
rows.raw: "\n\n“If I were looking for that friend of yours...” she says at last. “...I would look in Kressia. I cannot say any more than that, "

rows.original: Mr.
rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "Mr."

rows.original: Mrs.
rows.translation: 女士
rows.raw: "Mrs."

rows.original: Outsider. Not without there being... repercussions.”
rows.translation: 外来者。否则会有...后果。”
rows.raw: " Outsider. Not without there being... repercussions.”"

rows.original: You cannot get anything more from her. Still, it’s something.
rows.translation: 你再也问不出更多。不过，这至少算条线索。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou cannot get anything more from her. Still, it’s something."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Good Cop
rows.translation: 唱红脸
rows.raw: "Good Cop"

rows.original: Appeal to empathy. Encourage her to open up a bit.
rows.translation: 诉诸同理心，鼓励她稍微敞开心扉。
rows.raw: "Appeal to empathy. Encourage her to open up a bit."

rows.original: Bad Cop
rows.translation: 唱白脸
rows.raw: "Bad Cop"

rows.original: GOLDMYR
rows.raw: "GOLDMYR"

rows.original: Barkeep
rows.translation: 酒保
rows.raw: "Barkeep"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “I know you know something,” you growl menacingly. “I suggest you cough up, or things are going to get real unpleasant in here.”
rows.translation: “我知道你知道些什么，”你充满威胁地低吼道。“我劝你老实交代，否则这里很快就会变得相当难看。”
rows.raw: "“I know you know something,” you growl menacingly. “I suggest you cough up, or things are going to get real unpleasant in here.”"

rows.original: She shakes her head disbelievingly.
rows.translation: 她难以置信地摇了摇头。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe shakes her head disbelievingly."

rows.original: “Trying to kick off a fight so you can charge me? Really?” she sneers. “You are beyond pathetic. If you have any proof whatsoever I’ve done something wrong, charge me. Because I know you don’t, you can get out of my face.” She strides off to serve someone at the other end of the bar. No amount of cajoling or threatening will get her to talk to you again.
rows.translation: “想挑起一场打斗，好让你有理由逮捕我？认真的？”她冷笑道。“你真是可悲透顶。要是你有任何证据证明我做错了什么，那就起诉我。既然我知道你根本没有，就从我面前滚开。”她大步走到吧台另一头招待客人去了。此后无论怎么哄骗或威胁，她都不肯再跟你说话。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Trying to kick off a fight so you can charge me? Really?” she sneers. “You are beyond pathetic. If you have any proof whatsoever I’ve done something wrong, charge me. Because I know you don’t, you can get out of my face.” She strides off to serve someone at the other end of the bar. No amount of cajoling or threatening will get her to talk to you again."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Bad Cop
rows.translation: 唱白脸
rows.raw: "Bad Cop"

rows.original: Force the information out of her.
rows.translation: 逼她交出情报。
rows.raw: "Force the information out of her."

rows.original: DALLY
rows.raw: "DALLY"

rows.original: Dally
rows.translation: 达莉
rows.raw: "Dally"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “Hey,” you say, sidling into a free space next to the myr stripper’s stage. “You must know Fazian, right? Feathered guy, used to do the cabaret. Do you know what’s happened to him?”
rows.translation: “嘿，”你说道，侧身挤进米尔脱衣舞者舞台旁的一处空位。“你肯定认识法兹安，对吧？那个长羽毛的家伙，以前在歌舞厅表演。你知道他出了什么事吗？”
rows.raw: "“Hey,” you say, sidling into a free space next to the myr stripper’s stage. “You must know Fazian, right? Feathered guy, used to do the cabaret. Do you know what’s happened to him?”"

rows.original: “You want to talk?” replies Dally breezily, not slowing down his slow gyration around his pole. “That is fine, I’ll talk with you. But it costs. Just the same as anything or anybody else.”
rows.translation: “你想聊天？”达利轻快地答道，绕着钢管缓慢扭动的动作丝毫未停。“没问题，我可以和你聊。但要收费，和其他任何东西、任何人都一样。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You want to talk?” replies Dally breezily, not slowing down his slow gyration around his pole. “That is fine, I’ll talk with you. But it costs. Just the same as anything or anybody else.”"

rows.original: Pay 250c
rows.translation: 支付250信用点
rows.raw: "Pay 250c"

rows.original: DALLY
rows.raw: "DALLY"

rows.original: Dally
rows.translation: 达莉
rows.raw: "Dally"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: You roll your eyes, but produce a credit chit.
rows.translation: 你翻了个白眼，但还是拿出一张信用点券。
rows.raw: "You roll your eyes, but produce a credit chit."

rows.original: “Thank you,” says Dally, squirreling it away and sitting down facing you with his legs dangling off the stage and his bulging abdomen on it. “Now come here. Don’t worry... don’t be tense...” He puts his smooth hands on either side of your head and brings his face close. “Now it looks professional, you see?” he murmurs. “Please don’t think I’m selfish. I don’t know who listens in here, who makes dancers disappear in the middle of the night. But I have some idea, yes.” You realize the male myr is quite scared.
rows.translation: “谢谢，”达利说道，把它藏好，然后面对你坐下，双腿悬在舞台边缘，隆起的腹部搁在台面上。“现在靠过来。别担心...别紧张...”他用光滑的双手捧住你的头，把脸凑近。“你看，这样就显得很专业了，对吧？”他低声说道。“请别觉得我自私。我不知道这里有谁在偷听，也不知道是谁让舞者半夜消失。但我的确有点头绪。”你意识到这名男性米尔相当害怕。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thank you,” says Dally, squirreling it away and sitting down facing you with his legs dangling off the stage and his bulging abdomen on it. “Now come here. Don’t worry... don’t be tense...” He puts his smooth hands on either side of your head and brings his face close. “Now it looks professional, you see?” he murmurs. “Please don’t think I’m selfish. I don’t know who listens in here, who makes dancers disappear in the middle of the night. But I have some idea, yes.” You realize the male myr is quite scared."

rows.original: “Your friend Fazian, he didn’t really get it. You’ve got to keep some professional distance if you’re a male performer here. If you don’t... you share yourself with everyone, you go off with just anyone who asks... you attract predators. The myr he was talking to, three nights ago? I would hide behind the curtains sooner than perform for that type. She does business. Lot of people want to get in and out of gold territory discretely - lot of people want other people to get in and out of gold territory discretely - and she can make that happen. I always warned Fazian - just generally, you know - but he just laughed. He didn’t get it...”
rows.translation: “你的朋友法兹安，他其实一直没弄明白。在这里当男性表演者，就得保持一点职业距离。否则...你把自己分享给所有人，谁来邀请都跟着走...就会招来捕食者。三天前和他说话的那个米尔？我宁愿躲在幕布后面，也不愿给那种人表演。她做的是生意。很多人想悄悄进出金方领地——也有很多人想让别人悄悄进出金方领地——而她能办到。我一直警告法兹安——只是泛泛地提醒，你懂的——但他只是一笑置之。他根本没明白...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Your friend Fazian, he didn’t really get it. You’ve got to keep some professional distance if you’re a male performer here. If you don’t... you share yourself with everyone, you go off with just anyone who asks... you attract predators. The myr he was talking to, three nights ago? I would hide behind the curtains sooner than perform for that type. She does business. Lot of people want to get in and out of gold territory discretely - lot of people want other people to get in and out of gold territory discretely - and she can make that happen. I always warned Fazian - just generally, you know - but he just laughed. He didn’t get it...”"

rows.original: “Know anything else?” you murmur. “What they talked about?”
rows.translation: “还知道别的吗？”你低声问道。“他们谈了什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Know anything else?” you murmur. “What they talked about?”"

rows.original: “I’m sorry, starwalker,” he replies softly. “Sounded like she was making him an offer. All I know is that myr hasn’t been around since. Fazian was there the night afterwards, and no-one at the club has seen him since. Good luck finding him - and be careful yourself.” He releases his gentle hold on your head and gets up, returning to his dancing with a final mournful look.
rows.translation: “对不起，星行者，”他轻声答道。“听起来像是她给了他一个提议。我只知道那个米尔从那以后再没出现过。法兹安第二天晚上还在，但自那以后俱乐部里就没人见过他了。祝你能找到他——你自己也要小心。”他松开轻轻捧住你头部的手，最后忧郁地看了你一眼，起身继续跳舞。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m sorry, starwalker,” he replies softly. “Sounded like she was making him an offer. All I know is that myr hasn’t been around since. Fazian was there the night afterwards, and no-one at the club has seen him since. Good luck finding him - and be careful yourself.” He releases his gentle hold on your head and gets up, returning to his dancing with a final mournful look."

rows.original: That sounded significant.
rows.translation: 这听起来很重要。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat sounded significant."

rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.translation: 不付钱

rows.original: Dally
