rows.raw: "Dally"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: You can barely believe this guy’s mercantilism.
rows.translation: 你简直不敢相信这家伙如此唯利是图。
rows.raw: "You can barely believe this guy’s mercantilism."

rows.original: “I don’t want - this is an investigation!” you cry, outraged. A few other myr look over. “I’m not paying you for that! Where did you see Fazian last?”
rows.translation: “我不想——这是调查！”你愤怒地喊道。附近几个米尔都看了过来。“我才不会为此付你钱！你最后一次在哪里见到法兹安？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t want - this is an investigation!” you cry, outraged. A few other myr look over. “I’m not paying you for that! Where did you see Fazian last?”"

rows.original: But Dally walls you completely, continuing on to where two gold myr are eagerly rubbing paper notes at him. Even when he’s finished with them, no amount of cajoling can bring him back to the subject.
rows.translation: 但达利完全把你拒之门外，继续走向两个正热切地拿纸钞在他身上摩擦的金米尔。即使他应付完了她们，无论怎么哄劝都无法让他再谈这个话题。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut Dally walls you completely, continuing on to where two gold myr are eagerly rubbing paper notes at him. Even when he’s finished with them, no amount of cajoling can bring him back to the subject."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: Gene
rows.translation: 吉恩
rows.raw: "Gene"

rows.original: GENE
rows.raw: "GENE"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “Did you know Fazian?” you ask. “Anat, bright feathers?”
rows.translation: “你认识法兹安吗？”你问道。“安纳泰人，羽毛鲜艳？”
rows.raw: "“Did you know Fazian?” you ask. “Anat, bright feathers?”"

rows.original: “‘Did?’,” repeats Gene, swishing his tails ponderously. “A portentous tense indeed! Has something befallen the kaleidoscopic popinjay?”
rows.translation: “‘认识过’？”吉恩拖着长音重复道，沉重地甩动着尾巴。“多么不祥的时态！那只色彩斑斓的花孔雀遭遇了什么不测吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“‘Did?’,” repeats Gene, swishing his tails ponderously. “A portentous tense indeed! Has something befallen the kaleidoscopic popinjay?”"

rows.original: “He’s gone missing,” you say. “Wondered if you knew anything about him, what might have happened to him.”
rows.translation: “他失踪了，”你说道。“我想知道你是否了解他，或者知道他可能出了什么事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“He’s gone missing,” you say. “Wondered if you knew anything about him, what might have happened to him.”"

rows.original: “Yes, I... knew... him,” rumbles Gene. “He came in here a few times to peruse my stock, talk about mods and how exactly we fellow emperors had washed up here. Nice chap but frightfully naive, both on the subject of myr and post-neocapitalist theory. As to what’s happened to him - Huh!”
rows.translation: “是的，我...认识...他，”吉恩低沉地说道。“他来过这里几次，翻看我的货品，聊各种模组，也聊我们这些同为帝王之人究竟是怎么流落到这里的。人不错，但无论谈到米尔还是后新资本主义理论，他都天真得可怕。至于他出了什么事——哈！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes, I... knew... him,” rumbles Gene. “He came in here a few times to peruse my stock, talk about mods and how exactly we fellow emperors had washed up here. Nice chap but frightfully naive, both on the subject of myr and post-neocapitalist theory. As to what’s happened to him - Huh!”"

rows.original: He snorts like a halting train.
rows.translation: 他像一列骤然刹停的火车般喷了喷鼻息。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe snorts like a halting train."

rows.original: “That is as obvious to me as it should be to you, dear Steele. Some group of myr, or maybe even nyrea, have had enough of his endless flirting and have snaffled him up to enjoy all for themselves. No doubt he is enjoying the hospitality of the peaceful, loving denizens of this planet even as we speak.” He shrugs.
rows.translation: “这对我来说显而易见，对你也该如此，亲爱的斯蒂尔。某群米尔，甚至也许是尼瑞亚人，受够了他没完没了的调情，把他掳去独享了。毫无疑问，就在我们说话的此刻，他正享受着这颗星球上和平友爱的居民们的款待。”他耸了耸肩。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That is as obvious to me as it should be to you, dear Steele. Some group of myr, or maybe even nyrea, have had enough of his endless flirting and have snaffled him up to enjoy all for themselves. No doubt he is enjoying the hospitality of the peaceful, loving denizens of this planet even as we speak.” He shrugs."

rows.original: “As to which flavor of sex-starved arthropod, I’m afraid I have no clue.” He taps his horn lips thoughtfully, though. “Hmm. He did drop by a few days ago. I wasn’t paying much attention to him because I was rather anticipating one of my favourite lady callers. What were we talking about? Fazian gets it into his head to criticize my method of delivering mods to the denizens of this planet. He comes at it so politely, each time from a new angle, the very model of the eager, unwavering proselytizer. So here I am, afire with anticipatory passion, wondering how in the galaxy I am going to swat aside this tiresome socialist in the fastest yet most graceful way possible...” His rich voice fills the shop’s space like an orchestra playing the opening chords of an extremely long aria.
rows.translation: “至于究竟是哪一种欲求不满的节肢动物，恐怕我毫无头绪。”不过，他若有所思地敲了敲角质嘴唇。“嗯。他几天前的确来过。我当时没怎么注意他，因为我正满怀期待地等着一位最喜欢的女访客。我们当时在聊什么来着？法兹安又开始批评我向这颗星球居民提供模组的方式。他说得那么客气，每次还都换一个新角度，简直就是热忱而坚定的传教士典范。于是我满腔期待的激情熊熊燃烧，一边思考着该怎样以最快却又最优雅的方式，把这个烦人的社会主义者搪塞过去...”他浑厚的声音充满整间商店，如同一支管弦乐团奏响一首极其漫长咏叹调的开篇和弦。
rows.raw: "\n\n“As to which flavor of sex-starved arthropod, I’m afraid I have no clue.” He taps his horn lips thoughtfully, though. “Hmm. He did drop by a few days ago. I wasn’t paying much attention to him because I was rather anticipating one of my favourite lady callers. What were we talking about? Fazian gets it into his head to criticize my method of delivering mods to the denizens of this planet. He comes at it so politely, each time from a new angle, the very model of the eager, unwavering proselytizer. So here I am, afire with anticipatory passion, wondering how in the galaxy I am going to swat aside this tiresome socialist in the fastest yet most graceful way possible...” His rich voice fills the shop’s space like an orchestra playing the opening chords of an extremely long aria."

rows.original: Listen
rows.translation: 听下去
rows.raw: "Listen"

rows.original: Gene
rows.translation: 吉恩
rows.raw: "Gene"

rows.original: GENE
rows.raw: "GENE"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “...which is why burgundy is the true stripe of masculinity, and not a splurge of gaudy rainbow, whatever other examples of avian sentience have to say on the matter,” Gene continues, some time later. He pauses finally, frowning. You stir, coming to your senses slightly.
rows.translation: “...所以，勃艮第红才是真正象征男子气概的条纹，而不是什么俗艳彩虹的泼洒，不管其他鸟类智慧生命对此有何高见，”过了一阵子，吉恩仍在继续。他终于停下来，皱起眉头。你动了动，稍稍回过神来。
rows.raw: "“...which is why burgundy is the true stripe of masculinity, and not a splurge of gaudy rainbow, whatever other examples of avian sentience have to say on the matter,” Gene continues, some time later. He pauses finally, frowning. You stir, coming to your senses slightly."

rows.original: “Now, what was it that he was wittering on about that day? Ah, yes! He said he had an invitation to do a private performance with some very select myr that night, after he finished at his club. I can’t tell you what kind of myr, or where... but it sounded as if he was preparing for a fair bit of travel.” He sniffs. “That’s all I know I’m afraid, Steele. Best of luck finding the silly little peacock.”
rows.translation: “那么，他那天究竟在喋喋不休些什么？啊，对了！他说自己收到了一份邀请，那晚在俱乐部表演结束后，要为几位极其尊贵的米尔做一场私人演出。我说不出是哪一类米尔，也不知道在哪里...但听起来他正准备走一段不短的路。”他吸了吸鼻子。“恐怕我知道的就这些了，斯蒂尔。祝你好运，找到那只傻乎乎的小孔雀。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now, what was it that he was wittering on about that day? Ah, yes! He said he had an invitation to do a private performance with some very select myr that night, after he finished at his club. I can’t tell you what kind of myr, or where... but it sounded as if he was preparing for a fair bit of travel.” He sniffs. “That’s all I know I’m afraid, Steele. Best of luck finding the silly little peacock.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Listen
rows.translation: 听下去
rows.raw: "Listen"

rows.original: Wait to see if he does, in the event, have anything worthwhile to say.
rows.translation: 等等看他最后是否真能说出什么有价值的东西。
rows.raw: "Wait to see if he does, in the event, have anything worthwhile to say."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: Gene
rows.translation: 吉恩
rows.raw: "Gene"

rows.original: GENE
rows.raw: "GENE"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “I’m sorry, Gene,” you interrupt. “But I’ve got to go.”
rows.translation: “抱歉，吉恩，”你打断道。“但我得走了。”
rows.raw: "“I’m sorry, Gene,” you interrupt. “But I’ve got to go.”"

rows.original: “Oh, of course,” blinks the fanfir, stopped mid-flow. “Best of luck finding the silly little peacock, I suppose.”
rows.translation: “哦，当然，”这名梵菲尔眨眨眼，话说到一半被打断。“那就祝你好运，找到那只傻乎乎的小孔雀吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, of course,” blinks the fanfir, stopped mid-flow. “Best of luck finding the silly little peacock, I suppose.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: Time is of the essence.
rows.translation: 时间至关重要。
rows.raw: "Time is of the essence."

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “Do you know Fazian?” you ask. “About yay tall, bright feathers. He lives on his ship, he must have walked past here most days.”
rows.translation: “你认识法兹安吗？”你问道。“大概这么高，羽毛鲜艳。他住在自己的飞船上，应该几乎每天都会从这里经过。”
rows.raw: "“Do you know Fazian?” you ask. “About yay tall, bright feathers. He lives on his ship, he must have walked past here most days.”"

rows.original: “The anat? Yes, I know him,” replies the kui-tan. He fiddles with his pile of paperwork distractedly. “I know him to look at, that is to say; difficult to miss. I don’t believe we’ve ever exchanged a word. Why?”
rows.translation: “那个安纳泰人？是的，我知道他，”这名奎坦答道。他心不在焉地摆弄着那堆文件。“我的意思是，我认得他的长相；毕竟很难错过。我不认为我们说过一句话。怎么了？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The anat? Yes, I know him,” replies the kui-tan. He fiddles with his pile of paperwork distractedly. “I know him to look at, that is to say; difficult to miss. I don’t believe we’ve ever exchanged a word. Why?”"

rows.original: “He’s gone missing,” you say. “Wondered if you had any idea what might have happened to him.”
rows.translation: “他失踪了，”你说道。“我想知道你是否知道他可能出了什么事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“He’s gone missing,” you say. “Wondered if you had any idea what might have happened to him.”"

rows.original: “Bluntly, no,” says Juro with an exasperated sigh. “I’ve got more than enough on my plate right now than to keep tabs on every adventurer who drifts through here, [pc.name] Steele.” He slides a file out of his teetering in-box. “I wouldn’t presume to pay too much attention to anatae at the best of times. They have this nasty tendency to pay attention back.”
rows.translation: “坦白说，不知道，”朱罗烦躁地叹了口气。“我眼下已经忙得不可开交，没空盯着每个漂到这里来的冒险者，[pc.name] 斯蒂尔。”他从摇摇欲坠的收件箱里抽出一份档案。“即便在最好的时候，我也不会自以为是地过分关注安纳泰人。他们有个讨厌的习惯——也会反过来关注你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bluntly, no,” says Juro with an exasperated sigh. “I’ve got more than enough on my plate right now than to keep tabs on every adventurer who drifts through here, [pc.name] Steele.” He slides a file out of his teetering in-box. “I wouldn’t presume to pay too much attention to anatae at the best of times. They have this nasty tendency to pay attention back.”"

rows.original: “You must have security footage of this spaceport,” you frown, looking around. “You wouldn’t mind me having a look, if you’re busy?”
rows.translation: “你们肯定有这个太空港的监控录像，”你皱着眉环顾四周。“既然你很忙，应该不介意让我自己看看吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You must have security footage of this spaceport,” you frown, looking around. “You wouldn’t mind me having a look, if you’re busy?”"

rows.original: “Goodness me. Hand that kind of data over to a non-affiliated with a missing friend story during an extremely precarious ceasefire?” he replies with a dry snort, scribbling away. “I would require a warrant from the empire itself if you wanted that. Do stop pestering me with this, Steele. I have absolutely no idea what happened to this Fazian of yours.”
rows.translation: “我的天。仅凭一个朋友失踪的故事，就要在这场极其脆弱的停火期间，把那种数据交给一个非隶属人员？”他干巴巴地嗤了一声，继续奋笔疾书。“你若想要那些东西，我需要帝国本身签发的搜查令。别再拿这事烦我了，斯蒂尔。我完全不知道你的那个法兹安出了什么事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Goodness me. Hand that kind of data over to a non-affiliated with a missing friend story during an extremely precarious ceasefire?” he replies with a dry snort, scribbling away. “I would require a warrant from the empire itself if you wanted that. Do stop pestering me with this, Steele. I have absolutely no idea what happened to this Fazian of yours.”"

rows.original: Make Scene
rows.translation: 大闹一场
rows.raw: "Make Scene"

rows.original: “Bullshit, Juro,” you say loudly, making the kui-tan jerk. “A U.G.C. citizen goes missing and your response is to hide behind a bunch of paper? If you aren’t going to help, at least stop getting in the way of someone who actually gives a fuck!”
rows.translation: “放屁，朱罗，”你大声说道，吓得这名奎坦一颤。“一名星系联合政府公民失踪了，你的反应就是躲在一堆文件后面？如果你不打算帮忙，至少别妨碍真正关心这件事的人！”
rows.raw: "“Bullshit, Juro,” you say loudly, making the kui-tan jerk. “A U.G.C. citizen goes missing and your response is to hide behind a bunch of paper? If you aren’t going to help, at least stop getting in the way of someone who actually gives a fuck!”"

rows.original: “That’s enough, friend,” says a voice behind you. You turn around and find a knot of uniformed gold myr guards has formed around you.
rows.translation: “够了，朋友，”身后传来一个声音。你转过身，发现一群身穿制服的金米尔卫兵已经围住了你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s enough, friend,” says a voice behind you. You turn around and find a knot of uniformed gold myr guards has formed around you."

rows.original: “Just... take [pc.himHer] back to their ship,” says Juro, slightly shakily. “Let [pc.himHer] cool off.”
rows.translation: “就...把[pc.himHer]送回飞船吧，”朱罗略显颤抖地说道。“让[pc.himHer]冷静一下。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Just... take [pc.himHer] back to their ship,” says Juro, slightly shakily. “Let [pc.himHer] cool off.”"

rows.original: There’s no arguing with them, and fighting will only make things a lot worse. You allow the gold myr to march you back to the boarding ramp of your ship.
rows.translation: 你没法和她们争辩，动手只会让事情变得更糟。你任由金米尔把你押回自己飞船的登船坡道。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s no arguing with them, and fighting will only make things a lot worse. You allow the gold myr to march you back to the boarding ramp of your ship."

rows.original: “This world’s got enough spare aggression flying around right now,” observes their officer, sympathetic but firm. “If you can’t manage yours, I’d suggest taking it elsewhere.”
rows.translation: “这个世界眼下已经有够多无处安放的敌意了，”她们的长官说道，语气同情却坚定。“如果你管不住自己的，我建议你把它带到别处去。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This world’s got enough spare aggression flying around right now,” observes their officer, sympathetic but firm. “If you can’t manage yours, I’d suggest taking it elsewhere.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Juro
rows.translation: 朱罗
rows.raw: "Juro"

rows.original: Try and fluster the kui-tan into giving you what you want.
rows.translation: 试着让这名奎坦慌乱起来，好让他交出你想要的东西。
rows.raw: "Try and fluster the kui-tan into giving you what you want."

rows.original: Anatae
rows.translation: 安纳泰人
rows.raw: "Anatae"

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: “Alright then, Juro,” you say with a heavy sigh. “I’ll go back to Tavros. I’ll find where the anatae commission is stationed. I’ll explain the situation to them and jump through whatever hoops they want. Then I’ll come back with your warrant. By then Fazian will be gone for good, and you know all that will be left? His people’s empire gaining a sudden interest in one obfuscating kui-tan bureaucrat, and the planet he is hoping to colonize.”
rows.translation: “好吧，朱罗，”你重重叹了口气。“我会回塔弗罗斯，找到安纳泰委员会的驻地，向他们说明情况，按他们的要求走完所有程序。然后我会带着你的搜查令回来。到那时，法兹安早就永远消失了，而你知道最后会剩下什么吗？他的人民所属的帝国突然开始关注一个百般阻挠的奎坦官僚，以及他希望殖民的这颗星球。”
rows.raw: "“Alright then, Juro,” you say with a heavy sigh. “I’ll go back to Tavros. I’ll find where the anatae commission is stationed. I’ll explain the situation to them and jump through whatever hoops they want. Then I’ll come back with your warrant. By then Fazian will be gone for good, and you know all that will be left? His people’s empire gaining a sudden interest in one obfuscating kui-tan bureaucrat, and the planet he is hoping to colonize.”"

rows.original: You lean forward on his desk and lower your voice. “A kui-tan who has a hopeless conflict of interests, given he’s fucking one of the local representatives.”
rows.translation: 你俯身撑在他的桌上，压低声音。“一个存在无可救药利益冲突的奎坦——因为他正和当地的一名代表上床。”
rows.raw: " You lean forward on his desk and lower your voice. “A kui-tan who has a hopeless conflict of interests, given he’s fucking one of the local representatives.”"

rows.original: You turn and begin to head eastwards towards your ship.
rows.translation: 你转过身，开始朝东边自己的飞船走去。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou turn and begin to head eastwards towards your ship."

rows.original: “Wait!” cries Juro after you’ve gotten ten feet. “Wait. Alright. You can look at the spaceport’s security footage. Just... don’t tell anyone, okay?” He gets up, heads into a back room, and comes back ten minutes later with a small, gray box. “And make it worthwhile, okay, Steele?” he parts gruffly.
rows.translation: “等等！”你走出十英尺后，朱罗在身后喊道。“等等。好吧，你可以看太空港的监控录像。只是...别告诉任何人，好吗？”他起身走进后屋，十分钟后拿着一个灰色小盒子回来。“还有，要让这一切值得，明白吗，斯蒂尔？”他粗声说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wait!” cries Juro after you’ve gotten ten feet. “Wait. Alright. You can look at the spaceport’s security footage. Just... don’t tell anyone, okay?” He gets up, heads into a back room, and comes back ten minutes later with a small, gray box. “And make it worthwhile, okay, Steele?” he parts gruffly."

rows.original: You settle yourself down in a quiet corner and fiddle around with the holographic projector, flicking moving images of the spaceport, captured by a flotilla of U.G.C. microbots, into the air around you. As you had guessed, Juro was being an ass; it doesn’t take five minutes to get the AI inside to provide you with the most recent footage of Fazian.
rows.translation: 你在一个安静的角落坐下，摆弄起全息投影仪，将由一支星系联合政府微型机器人队伍拍下的太空港活动影像投射到四周空气中。果然如你所料，朱罗只是在故意刁难；不到五分钟，你就让里面的人工智能调出了法兹安最近的录像。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou settle yourself down in a quiet corner and fiddle around with the holographic projector, flicking moving images of the spaceport, captured by a flotilla of U.G.C. microbots, into the air around you. As you had guessed, Juro was being an ass; it doesn’t take five minutes to get the AI inside to provide you with the most recent footage of Fazian."

rows.original: There he goes, fast-forwarding his technicolor feathers past the front desk every afternoon, usually returning to his ship in the very early hours. On the last night he’s seen, he goes past the front desk, and... simply doesn’t come back. It gives you a bit of a chill watching it, exactly because there’s nothing unusual about the scene at all. If the lean, mask-faced dancer knew what was going to happen to him he’s not showing it, strolling out of the microbot’s view looking as carefree as you can remember him.
rows.translation: 他在那里，每天下午让那身五彩斑斓的羽毛快步掠过前台，通常到凌晨才回到飞船。最后一次被拍到的那晚，他经过前台，然后...再也没有回来。看着这一幕让你感到一丝寒意，恰恰因为画面中完全没有任何异常。若那个身形精瘦、脸如面具的舞者知道自己将遭遇什么，他丝毫没有表现出来，只是像你记忆中一样无忧无虑地走出微型机器人的视野。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere he goes, fast-forwarding his technicolor feathers past the front desk every afternoon, usually returning to his ship in the very early hours. On the last night he’s seen, he goes past the front desk, and... simply doesn’t come back. It gives you a bit of a chill watching it, exactly because there’s nothing unusual about the scene at all. If the lean, mask-faced dancer knew what was going to happen to him he’s not showing it, strolling out of the microbot’s view looking as carefree as you can remember him."

rows.original: You frown and rewind to the previous night, when he comes back to his ship. Again, there’s nothing unusual. He walks past the ambassadors’ offices, glances at his codex’s screen, and heads towards his ship... he walks past the ambassadors’ offices, glances at his codex’s screen... he glances at his codex’s screen... you freeze the image.
rows.translation: 你皱着眉倒回前一晚他返回飞船的录像。同样，没有任何异常。他走过大使办公室，看了一眼自己的终端屏幕，然后朝飞船走去...他走过大使办公室，看了一眼终端屏幕...他看了一眼终端屏幕...你定格了画面。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou frown and rewind to the previous night, when he comes back to his ship. Again, there’s nothing unusual. He walks past the ambassadors’ offices, glances at his codex’s screen, and heads towards his ship... he walks past the ambassadors’ offices, glances at his codex’s screen... he glances at his codex’s screen... you freeze the image."

rows.original: “There’s something written on it,” you say aloud. “Do you think you can enlarge it and tell me what it is?”
rows.translation: “上面写了什么，”你自言自语道。“你能把它放大，告诉我内容吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“There’s something written on it,” you say aloud. “Do you think you can enlarge it and tell me what it is?”"

rows.original: “Ehm. Jay. Arr. Ehstraffe, 11 sharp,” the AI replies promptly.
rows.translation: “呃姆。杰。阿尔。伊丝特拉菲，十一点整，”人工智能立刻答道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ehm. Jay. Arr. Ehstraffe, 11 sharp,” the AI replies promptly."

rows.original: “Do you know any Ehstraffes?” you ask gingerly.
rows.translation: “你知道哪个伊丝特拉菲吗？”你谨慎地问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Do you know any Ehstraffes?” you ask gingerly."

rows.original: “Major Ehstraffe. Red myr officer. Female. Stationed in Kressia,” the tinny voice says.
rows.translation: “伊丝特拉菲少校。红米尔军官。女性。驻扎在克雷西亚，”尖细的声音说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Major Ehstraffe. Red myr officer. Female. Stationed in Kressia,” the tinny voice says."

rows.original: “What does she do?” you ask after a moment.
rows.translation: “她是做什么的？”片刻后你问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What does she do?” you ask after a moment."

rows.original: “That information is classified,” replies the AI sweetly.
rows.translation: “该信息属于机密，”人工智能甜甜地答道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That information is classified,” replies the AI sweetly."

rows.original: You turn it off and return it to Juro, your mind buzzing.
rows.translation: 你关掉设备，将它还给朱罗，脑中思绪翻涌。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou turn it off and return it to Juro, your mind buzzing."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Anatae
rows.translation: 安纳泰人
rows.raw: "Anatae"

rows.original: Threaten Juro with his own advice.
rows.translation: 用朱罗自己的忠告反过来威胁他。
rows.raw: "Threaten Juro with his own advice."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: Seeing that it is no use, you leave the kui-tan alone.
rows.translation: 见此毫无用处，你不再纠缠这名奎坦。
rows.raw: "Seeing that it is no use, you leave the kui-tan alone."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: He’s right, this is pointless. Leave him be.
rows.translation: 他说得对，这毫无意义。别再烦他了。
rows.raw: "He’s right, this is pointless. Leave him be."

rows.original: “Say you have lots of connections here on Myrellion don‘t you?” you ask. “Ever hear of Fazian? Anat, bright feathers, works at the cabaret...ring any bells?” “A pigeon cabaret dancer?” Velika snorts derisively. “Is that how you get your titillation these days, innie?” She tags a long drag on her cigarette, her brow furrowing as she considers your question. “Yeah I‘ve heard of him. Why do you ask?” “He‘s gone missing,” you clarify. “Know anything that might help me find him?” The cyborg‘s eyes flicker with something akin to surprise as her expression hardens. “Missing?” She leans forward, her breath her breath reeking of acrid smoke. “Listen...you didn‘t hear this from me but a Tarratch has been poking around Kressia lately. I‘m sure I don‘t have to tell you that the bugs are slavers...they might have had something to do with your friend disappearing.” She cocks her head, appraising you up and down. “You‘re plotting something reckless, aren‘t you? I won‘t try talking you out of it. Just...try not to get yourself killed, innie.”
rows.translation: “听说你在迈瑞利恩有很多门路，对吧？”你问道。“听说过法兹安吗？安纳泰人，羽毛鲜艳，在歌舞厅工作...有印象吗？” “一个鸽子歌舞厅舞者？”维莉卡轻蔑地哼了一声。“你现在就靠这个寻刺激吗，内圈人？”她深吸了一口香烟，考虑你的问题时眉头微微皱起。“对，我听说过他。怎么了？” “他失踪了，”你澄清道。“你知道什么能帮我找到他的消息吗？” 这个改造人的眼中闪过一丝近似惊讶的神色，表情随之变得严肃。“失踪了？” 她向前倾身，呼吸中满是刺鼻的烟味。“听着...别说是我告诉你的，但最近有个塔拉特人在克雷西亚附近活动。我想不用我提醒你，那些虫子是奴隶贩子...你朋友的失踪可能和他们有关。”她歪着头，上下打量着你。“你正计划做什么鲁莽的事，对吧？我不会劝你放弃。只是...尽量别把自己弄死，内圈人。”
rows.raw: " “Say you have lots of connections here on Myrellion don‘t you?” you ask. “Ever hear of Fazian? Anat, bright feathers, works at the cabaret...ring any bells?” “A pigeon cabaret dancer?” Velika snorts derisively. “Is that how you get your titillation these days, innie?” She tags a long drag on her cigarette, her brow furrowing as she considers your question. “Yeah I‘ve heard of him. Why do you ask?” “He‘s gone missing,” you clarify. “Know anything that might help me find him?” The cyborg‘s eyes flicker with something akin to surprise as her expression hardens. “Missing?” She leans forward, her breath her breath reeking of acrid smoke. “Listen...you didn‘t hear this from me but a Tarratch has been poking around Kressia lately. I‘m sure I don‘t have to tell you that the bugs are slavers...they might have had something to do with your friend disappearing.” She cocks her head, appraising you up and down. “You‘re plotting something reckless, aren‘t you? I won‘t try talking you out of it. Just...try not to get yourself killed, innie.” "

rows.original: “How did it go?” asks Hepane anxiously, standing up when she sees you coming. “Any idea where he’s gone?”
rows.translation: “结果怎么样？”赫潘一看到你回来便站起身，焦急地问道。“知道他去了哪里吗？”
rows.raw: "“How did it go?” asks Hepane anxiously, standing up when she sees you coming. “Any idea where he’s gone?”"

rows.original: You shrug.
rows.translation: 你耸了耸肩。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shrug."

rows.original: “I’ve got one or two, but...” You tell her about your interviews and the slivers of information you managed to picked up. Even to your ears, it’s desperately thin stuff. Hepane shakes her head miserably when you finish.
rows.translation: “有一两个想法，但...”你把自己的访谈，以及设法搜集到的零星信息告诉了她。就连你自己听来，这些线索也薄弱得令人绝望。你说完后，赫潘痛苦地摇了摇头。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ve got one or two, but...” You tell her about your interviews and the slivers of information you managed to picked up. Even to your ears, it’s desperately thin stuff. Hepane shakes her head miserably when you finish."

rows.original: “It’s not enough, I wouldn’t know where to start with that,” she says. She puts a hand on your shoulder. “Thank you for trying, starwalker. Maybe if... just the knowledge that someone is looking for him might cause him to resurface, you know?”
rows.translation: “这还不够，凭这些我根本不知道该从哪里找起，”她说道。她把一只手搭在你的肩上。“谢谢你愿意尝试，星行者。也许...仅仅知道有人在寻找他，就可能让他重新出现，你明白吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s not enough, I wouldn’t know where to start with that,” she says. She puts a hand on your shoulder. “Thank you for trying, starwalker. Maybe if... just the knowledge that someone is looking for him might cause him to resurface, you know?”"

rows.original: You privately doubt that, but there’s nothing to be gained from saying otherwise. Nothing at all.
rows.translation: 你私下对此深表怀疑，但说出来也不会有任何好处。丝毫没有。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou privately doubt that, but there’s nothing to be gained from saying otherwise. Nothing at all."

rows.original: You squeeze her hand and leave.
rows.translation: 你握了握她的手，随后离开。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou squeeze her hand and leave."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “He was lured out of Gildenmere and taken to Kressia,” you say. “Probably by some red myr.”
rows.translation: “他被引出了吉尔登米尔，带到了克雷西亚，”你说道。“很可能是某个红米尔干的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“He was lured out of Gildenmere and taken to Kressia,” you say. “Probably by some red myr.”"

rows.original: “A-are you sure?” replies Hepane hesitantly. “I think some people around here... if you asked them about someone missing, they might--”
rows.translation: “你、你确定吗？”赫潘迟疑地答道。“我觉得这附近有些人...如果你向他们打听某个失踪的人，他们或许会--”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A-are you sure?” replies Hepane hesitantly. “I think some people around here... if you asked them about someone missing, they might--”"

rows.original: You lay down your cards one after the other, going through each piece of information you wrangled out of your interviewees, showing her how everything points to your conclusion.
rows.translation: 你一张接一张地摊出手里的牌，逐一讲述从受访者口中套出的每条信息，向她说明这一切如何共同指向你的结论。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lay down your cards one after the other, going through each piece of information you wrangled out of your interviewees, showing her how everything points to your conclusion."

rows.original: “He was led into believing he was going to perform at a red myr function in Kressia,” you say crisply. “Pretty sure he journeyed there himself. The red myr are acting under one Major Ehstraffe, and presumably they’ve still got hold of him in Kressia. Why him? He was a lot easier to ensnare than any gold male, and far fewer people missed him. For what purpose? That I do not know. Kidnapping an alien to use as a sex slave seems extreme, but that’s the only motive that anyone has so far suggested.”
rows.translation: “有人让他以为自己要去克雷西亚参加一场红米尔活动，”你干脆地说道。“我很确定他是自己前往那里的。红米尔听命于一名叫伊斯特拉芙少校的人，而他大概至今仍被她们扣在克雷西亚。为什么选他？因为他比任何金米尔男性都更容易上钩，而且惦记他的人少得多。目的是什么？这我不知道。绑架一个外星人当性奴似乎过于极端，但目前也只有这个动机得到过任何人的推测。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“He was led into believing he was going to perform at a red myr function in Kressia,” you say crisply. “Pretty sure he journeyed there himself. The red myr are acting under one Major Ehstraffe, and presumably they’ve still got hold of him in Kressia. Why him? He was a lot easier to ensnare than any gold male, and far fewer people missed him. For what purpose? That I do not know. Kidnapping an alien to use as a sex slave seems extreme, but that’s the only motive that anyone has so far suggested.”"

rows.original: Hepane stares at you, mouth slightly ajar.
rows.translation: 赫潘盯着你，嘴巴微微张开。
rows.raw: "\n\nHepane stares at you, mouth slightly ajar."

rows.original: “You - you worked all that out by yourself?” she says. “How?”
rows.translation: “这——这些都是你自己查出来的？”她说道。“怎么做到的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You - you worked all that out by yourself?” she says. “How?”"

rows.original: You lay down your cards one after the other, going through each piece of information you wrangled out of your interviewees, showing her how everything points to your conclusion.
rows.translation: 你一张接一张地摊出手里的牌，逐一讲述从受访者口中套出的每条信息，向她说明这一切如何共同指向你的结论。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lay down your cards one after the other, going through each piece of information you wrangled out of your interviewees, showing her how everything points to your conclusion."

rows.original: “That - that does seem pretty undeniable,” Hepane agrees sorrowfully when you’re done. “I was hoping maybe he’d wandered off... or some gold myr had taken him. That would have been a lot easier to sort out than this...” She swallows and raises her chin. “I’m going to try and talk to some people I know in Kressia. See if I can’t find out a few things myself. I’ll be back in a day or so. I hope.”
rows.translation: “那——那听起来的确无可辩驳，”你说完后，赫潘伤心地表示赞同。“我原本还希望他只是自己走丢了...或者被某个金米尔带走了。那样可比现在这情况容易解决多了...”她咽了口唾沫，抬起下巴。“我要试着联系几个我在克雷西亚认识的人。看看能不能自己查出点什么。我一两天后就会回来。希望如此。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That - that does seem pretty undeniable,” Hepane agrees sorrowfully when you’re done. “I was hoping maybe he’d wandered off... or some gold myr had taken him. That would have been a lot easier to sort out than this...” She swallows and raises her chin. “I’m going to try and talk to some people I know in Kressia. See if I can’t find out a few things myself. I’ll be back in a day or so. I hope.”"

rows.original: She picks up her bag and exits the Honey Nozzle, determination and anxiety quickening the swing of her arms and bounce of her bosom. You should probably come back in a day or two to see if she finds out anything else.
rows.translation: 她拿起包离开蜜汁喷口，决心与焦虑让她的双臂摆得更快，胸脯也随之上下跃动。你最好过一两天再回来，看看她有没有查到其他消息。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe picks up her bag and exits the Honey Nozzle, determination and anxiety quickening the swing of her arms and bounce of her bosom. You should probably come back in a day or two to see if she finds out anything else."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “I know where he’s being held,” she says without preamble when you sit down opposite her. There’s a small pile of shredded tissue paper on the table. She’s working on fretfully destroying another napkin even as she starts talking.
rows.translation: “我知道他被关在哪里了，”你在她对面坐下时，她开门见山地说道。桌上堆着一小堆撕碎的纸巾。即便开始说话，她仍焦躁地撕扯着另一张餐巾。
rows.raw: "“I know where he’s being held,” she says without preamble when you sit down opposite her. There’s a small pile of shredded tissue paper on the table. She’s working on fretfully destroying another napkin even as she starts talking."

rows.original: “There’s some large warehouses on the southeast side of Kressia. They have been appropriated for use by the Federation. A sister of mine says she saw someone in a mask with bright antenna being led inside on the night he disappeared... and no-one’s seen anyone matching that description since.” Hepane’s pupil-less eyes lock with yours.
rows.translation: “克雷西亚东南边有几座大型仓库，已经被联邦征用。我的一个姐妹说，他失踪当晚，她看见一个戴着面具、触角鲜亮的人被带了进去...此后再也没人见过符合那种描述的人。”赫潘那没有瞳孔的双眼紧盯着你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“There’s some large warehouses on the southeast side of Kressia. They have been appropriated for use by the Federation. A sister of mine says she saw someone in a mask with bright antenna being led inside on the night he disappeared... and no-one’s seen anyone matching that description since.” Hepane’s pupil-less eyes lock with yours."

rows.original: “It’s... a bad place, [pc.name] Steele,” she says, with a slight quaver. “It took me a while to find anyone willing to tell me even that. Nobody knows what the Federation are doing there, but...” she trails off, and puts her hand on top of yours. “Please get him out of there. I don’t know who else to ask. My queen has no power over what happens in Kressia anymore, and your government does not seem to care. I can’t offer you anything except gratitude. Please.” She squeezes your hand. “And be careful if you do, kind starwalker. I think you are much less naive than Fazian, but... both of you going missing would be very hard to take.”
rows.translation: “那里...不是什么好地方，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”她略带颤音地说道。“我花了好一阵子才找到愿意告诉我这么点事的人。没人知道联邦在那里做什么，但是...”她没再说下去，把手覆在你的手上。“求你把他救出来。我不知道还能求谁。我的女王已经无权过问克雷西亚发生的事，而你们的政府似乎也不在乎。我除了感激，什么报酬都给不了你。求你了。”她握紧你的手。“如果你真要去，也请千万小心，善良的星行者。我觉得你远不像法兹安那样天真，可是...要是你们两个都失踪了，我真的承受不住。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s... a bad place, [pc.name] Steele,” she says, with a slight quaver. “It took me a while to find anyone willing to tell me even that. Nobody knows what the Federation are doing there, but...” she trails off, and puts her hand on top of yours. “Please get him out of there. I don’t know who else to ask. My queen has no power over what happens in Kressia anymore, and your government does not seem to care. I can’t offer you anything except gratitude. Please.” She squeezes your hand. “And be careful if you do, kind starwalker. I think you are much less naive than Fazian, but... both of you going missing would be very hard to take.”"

rows.original: She leaves you with a lot to think about.
rows.translation: 她离开了，留给你许多事情去思考。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe leaves you with a lot to think about."

rows.original: You are standing in a broad, well-lit entrance hall. There is a hubbub coming from the room opposite; the sound of many people moving around and... clapping? Peering carefully into the ajar door to your left you can see half a dozen red myr in military uniform sat around a table, playing some sort of game involving small crystals and counters. You are easily able to sneak past them, and open the door to the main chamber.
rows.translation: 你站在一间宽敞明亮的入口大厅里。对面的房间传来一阵喧闹声；许多人来回活动，还有...鼓掌声？你小心地从左侧半开的门缝望进去，看见六个穿军装的红米尔围坐在桌边，玩着某种使用小水晶与筹码的游戏。你轻而易举地从她们身边溜过，打开了通往主厅的门。
rows.raw: "You are standing in a broad, well-lit entrance hall. There is a hubbub coming from the room opposite; the sound of many people moving around and... clapping? Peering carefully into the ajar door to your left you can see half a dozen red myr in military uniform sat around a table, playing some sort of game involving small crystals and counters. You are easily able to sneak past them, and open the door to the main chamber."

rows.original: You are standing in a dim storeroom. Dusty industrial gear crowd the shelves. It’s obvious no-one’s used this room in a while.
rows.translation: 你站在一间昏暗的储藏室里。蒙尘的工业设备挤满货架。显然已经有一阵子没人使用这个房间了。
rows.raw: "You are standing in a dim storeroom. Dusty industrial gear crowd the shelves. It’s obvious no-one’s used this room in a while."

rows.original: You gingerly open the door opposite the back entrance, and find yourself in a brightly lit corridor. There is a hubbub coming from the room at the far end; the sound of many people moving around and... clapping? You quickly head down the corridor and open the door to the main chamber.
rows.translation: 你小心翼翼地打开后门对面的门，发现自己身处一条灯火通明的走廊。远端房间传来一阵喧闹声；许多人来回活动，还有...鼓掌声？你迅速沿走廊前进，打开了通往主厅的门。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou gingerly open the door opposite the back entrance, and find yourself in a brightly lit corridor. There is a hubbub coming from the room at the far end; the sound of many people moving around and... clapping? You quickly head down the corridor and open the door to the main chamber."

rows.original: Nonesuch
rows.raw: "Nonesuch"

rows.original: You slam your frame into the door again, and again, and - it opens, throwing you off balance.
rows.translation: 你一次又一次地用身体撞门，随后——门开了，害得你失去平衡。
rows.raw: "You slam your frame into the door again, and again, and - it opens, throwing you off balance."

rows.original: “What the hell,” says the red myr guard, glaring at you from behind the barrel of her semi-automatic, “do you think you’re doing?”
rows.translation: “搞什么鬼，”红米尔守卫从半自动武器的枪管后瞪着你，“你以为自己在做什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What the hell,” says the red myr guard, glaring at you from behind the barrel of her semi-automatic, “do you think you’re doing?”"

rows.original: “ - looking for the bathroom?” is the best you can come up with.
rows.translation: “——在找洗手间？”这是你能想出的最好借口。
rows.raw: "\n\n“ - looking for the bathroom?” is the best you can come up with."

rows.original: “You are trying to break into a military installation,” says the red myr slowly, as if speaking to a complete idiot. “If you leave immediately, and I never see you again, maybe you won’t spend the next ten years in prison.”
rows.translation: “你正在试图闯入一处军事设施，”红米尔缓慢地说道，仿佛在跟一个彻头彻尾的白痴讲话。“如果你立刻离开，而且以后再也别让我看见你，也许你不用在监狱里待上十年。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You are trying to break into a military installation,” says the red myr slowly, as if speaking to a complete idiot. “If you leave immediately, and I never see you again, maybe you won’t spend the next ten years in prison.”"

rows.original: Under the sharp gaze of the ant woman, you rather shamefacedly head back out to the road.
rows.translation: 在蚁女锐利的注视下，你颇为羞愧地回到了路边。
rows.raw: "\n\nUnder the sharp gaze of the ant woman, you rather shamefacedly head back out to the road."

rows.original: You’re going to have to try something different.
rows.translation: 你得换个办法。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re going to have to try something different."

rows.original: You smartly head over to some crates and duck behind them. Moments later the door swings open, and an angry-looking red myr peers out. You keep very still, and eventually, with one last suspicious glare towards the street, she slams the door shut. There’s the click and thunk of several locks being turned.

rows.original: You settle yourself down behind some crates near the door, keeping a close watch. At least, that’s what you set out to do - after about ten minutes have crawled by you take your codex out and begin to extranet surf. Another forty minutes drift by, the pins and needles in your [pc.lowerBody] getting steadily more annoying. You’re about to give up and head back to the street when the door bangs open.
rows.translation: 你在门附近的几只板条箱后面蹲下，密切监视着四周。至少你一开始是这么打算的——大约十分钟艰难爬过后，你掏出终端，开始浏览外联网。又有四十分钟悄然过去，你的[pc.lowerBody]麻得越来越难受。就在你准备放弃并返回街道时，门砰的一声打开了。
rows.raw: "You settle yourself down behind some crates near the door, keeping a close watch. At least, that’s what you set out to do - after about ten minutes have crawled by you take your codex out and begin to extranet surf. Another forty minutes drift by, the pins and needles in your [pc.lowerBody] getting steadily more annoying. You’re about to give up and head back to the street when the door bangs open."

rows.original: “ - shouldn’t do this, not on duty,” hisses one of the two red myr in uniform who come tip-tapping out. “Ehstraffe will kill us if she finds out.”
rows.translation: “——不该这么做，值勤时不行，”两个穿军装、踢踢踏踏走出来的红米尔中，一个低声说道。“要是伊斯特拉芙发现，她会杀了我们的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“ - shouldn’t do this, not on duty,” hisses one of the two red myr in uniform who come tip-tapping out. “Ehstraffe will kill us if she finds out.”"

rows.original: “She can sanction me, for all I care,” says the other, clutching the other’s hand. “I need a break from watching that, and I need... this.”
rows.translation: “她爱怎么处分就怎么处分，”另一个说道，同时紧握对方的手。“我得歇一歇，不能再看着那个了，而且我需要...这个。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“She can sanction me, for all I care,” says the other, clutching the other’s hand. “I need a break from watching that, and I need... this.”"

rows.original: She embraces the other myr passionately, spreading her hands across her fabric-stretching rump. Their lips meet, and the first slides her leg between the other’s thighs, the vertical lovemaking getting more urgent as the aphrodisiac hits.
rows.translation: 她热情地抱住另一个米尔，双手在对方把布料撑得紧绷的臀部上游走。两人的嘴唇贴在一起，前者把一条腿插进后者的双腿之间；随着催情剂生效，这场站立的性爱变得愈发急切。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe embraces the other myr passionately, spreading her hands across her fabric-stretching rump. Their lips meet, and the first slides her leg between the other’s thighs, the vertical lovemaking getting more urgent as the aphrodisiac hits."

rows.translation: 你尽可能不引人注意地从板条箱后溜出来，悄悄穿过敞开的门。说真的，就算你想弄出多大动静恐怕都无所谓；那两个家伙早已沉浸在自己的世界里。

rows.original: You make a show of apologetically putting your hands in the air and stepping back to the main road, nothing more than a clueless tourist having a nosey around. You walk off and loop back around, carefully approaching the vast warehouse from the side jutting out of the cavern wall.
rows.translation: 你装出一副歉意十足的样子，举起双手，退回主路，活像一个四处探头探脑、什么也不懂的游客。你走远后绕了一圈，小心地从这座伸出洞壁的巨大仓库侧面接近。

rows.original: For a building apparently repurposed by the Federation, security seems very lax indeed; you can only see the one guard stationed in front of the main doors. Perhaps it doesn’t need any more protection. You can’t see any more entrances here, except for a very sturdy-looking side door and a medium-sized window, twelve feet up. You can hear heavily muffled activity inside: what sounds like a lot of people moving around.
rows.translation: 一座显然被联邦改作他用的建筑，安保却着实松懈；你只看到正门前驻守着一名警卫。或许这里并不需要更多防护。除了看起来极为结实的侧门，以及离地十二英尺的一扇中型窗户外，你没看到其他入口。里面传来沉闷得厉害的动静，听起来像有许多人正在走动。
rows.raw: "\n\nFor a building apparently repurposed by the Federation, security seems very lax indeed; you can only see the one guard stationed in front of the main doors. Perhaps it doesn’t need any more protection. You can’t see any more entrances here, except for a very sturdy-looking side door and a medium-sized window, twelve feet up. You can hear heavily muffled activity inside: what sounds like a lot of people moving around."

rows.original: “Must be pretty thirsty work, guarding a door,” you suggest. “Unrewarding, too.”
rows.translation: “守着一扇门，应该挺容易口渴吧，”你试探道。“而且也没什么回报。”
rows.raw: "“Must be pretty thirsty work, guarding a door,” you suggest. “Unrewarding, too.”"

rows.original: “I don’t see why that would be any of your concern,” the guard deadpans.
rows.translation: “我看不出那跟你有什么关系，”警卫面无表情地说。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t see why that would be any of your concern,” the guard deadpans."

rows.original: “It isn’t,” you agree. You tap up a credit chit and push it into the lapel of her coat. “But maybe you could go address those personal concerns someplace else? Just for a bit.”
rows.translation: “确实没关系，”你表示同意。你调出一张信用凭条，塞进她的外套翻领里。“不过，也许你可以去别处处理一下自己的事？就离开一会儿。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It isn’t,” you agree. You tap up a credit chit and push it into the lapel of her coat. “But maybe you could go address those personal concerns someplace else? Just for a bit.”"

rows.translation: 警卫取出信用凭条，先看了看它，再看向你，最后面无表情地望向你身后的街道，仿佛过了整整一个世纪。

rows.original: “Ten minutes,” she says at last. “I have no idea who you are or how you got in.” She pockets the chit and hurries off.
rows.translation: “十分钟，”她终于说道。“我不知道你是谁，也不知道你是怎么进去的。”她把凭条装进口袋，匆匆离开。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ten minutes,” she says at last. “I have no idea who you are or how you got in.” She pockets the chit and hurries off."

rows.original: “Dance! You know what happens if you do not.” The anat heaves outwards - and then begins to tap out a steady rhythm on the boards with his hind talons. Slowly the gold myr’s attention turns back to him.

rows.original: “So...” you say slowly to the major. “You’re forcing a civilian to perform for the PoWs in your care to keep them sedated? Whilst you’re selling them off to alien slave traders.” The group of purple-armored, pale-skinned androgynes are stood quite still, watching you inscrutably with their black, pupil-less eyes, ruffs fluttering.
rows.translation: “所以...”你缓缓对少校说道。“你强迫一个平民为你看管的战俘表演，好让他们保持安分？同时还把他们卖给外星奴隶贩子。”那群身穿紫色装甲、皮肤苍白的双性人一动不动地站着，用没有瞳孔的黑眼睛高深莫测地注视着你，颈褶轻轻颤动。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So...” you say slowly to the major. “You’re forcing a civilian to perform for the PoWs in your care to keep them sedated? Whilst you’re selling them off to alien slave traders.” The group of purple-armored, pale-skinned androgynes are stood quite still, watching you inscrutably with their black, pupil-less eyes, ruffs fluttering."

rows.original: “You think this is easy?” replies Ehstraffe slowly, staring at you with her one good eye. “You think looking after tens of thousands of prisoners who despise you, with the lowest amount of food and personnel allotted in the entire Federation because fuck looking after gold soldiers before anyone else, is easy? To a starwalker who decided to edotto in here in order to be a fucking hero, I suppose it would. You didn’t have to preside over a prison riot every week for two months. You didn’t have to start making decisions in order to stop anyone else dying.” She snaps a chitin-gloved hand at the crowded pit.
rows.translation: “你以为这很容易吗？”埃斯特拉夫缓缓反问，独眼死死盯着你。“他们有数万人，全都恨你；而联邦给这里的食物和人手却是全境最少的，因为他妈的在照顾其他人之前谁会管金军俘虏。你以为照看他们很容易吗？对一个为了当该死的英雄而大摇大摆闯进来的星行者来说，大概很容易吧。你不必连续两个月每周主持镇压一次监狱暴动。你不必为了不让更多人死去而开始做出那些决定。”她戴着甲壳手套的手猛然指向拥挤的深坑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You think this is easy?” replies Ehstraffe slowly, staring at you with her one good eye. “You think looking after tens of thousands of prisoners who despise you, with the lowest amount of food and personnel allotted in the entire Federation because fuck looking after gold soldiers before anyone else, is easy? To a starwalker who decided to edotto in here in order to be a fucking hero, I suppose it would. You didn’t have to preside over a prison riot every week for two months. You didn’t have to start making decisions in order to stop anyone else dying.” She snaps a chitin-gloved hand at the crowded pit."

rows.original: “Former peasants, factory workers, mostly. Their land belongs to the Federation now. Their queens cannot support them, do not want them. Nothing remains for them here. The tarratch offered to buy them for supplies we can use immediately to keep the rest fed and secure, and more besides. It is the best solution. But no, I would not expect a starwalker like you to understand having to make such decisions.” Her face is as red as her chitin. “Not you, who quarter with the golds and lap up their tragedies, their poisonous tales about us. Not you, who send your artists and your money and your men and your science to their capital and spurn us, us, the conquerors, the barbarians.” She slaps her eye-patch furiously. “Where is MY mechanical eye? What happened to MY Lehnaza in the trenches?”
rows.translation: “他们大多曾是农民和工厂工人。如今他们的土地属于联邦。他们的女王养不起他们，也不想要他们。这里已经没有任何东西留给他们。塔拉特人提出用我们现在就能拿来让其他人吃饱、维持秩序的补给购买他们，而且还会给得更多。这是最好的解决办法。不过，我本就不指望你这种星行者能理解做出这种决定意味着什么。”她的脸红得像身上的甲壳。“你住在金米尔那边，照单全收她们的悲剧和诋毁我们的恶毒故事。你把艺术家、金钱、人员和科学都送往她们的首都，却唾弃我们——我们这些征服者，这些野蛮人。”她愤怒地拍着自己的眼罩。“我的机械眼睛在哪里？我的莱娜扎在战壕里遭遇了什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Former peasants, factory workers, mostly. Their land belongs to the Federation now. Their queens cannot support them, do not want them. Nothing remains for them here. The tarratch offered to buy them for supplies we can use immediately to keep the rest fed and secure, and more besides. It is the best solution. But no, I would not expect a starwalker like you to understand having to make such decisions.” Her face is as red as her chitin. “Not you, who quarter with the golds and lap up their tragedies, their poisonous tales about us. Not you, who send your artists and your money and your men and your science to their capital and spurn us, us, the conquerors, the barbarians.” She slaps her eye-patch furiously. “Where is MY mechanical eye? What happened to MY Lehnaza in the trenches?”"

rows.original: “Excuse me,” says a voice as smooth as oil on water. The tarratch who has strolled over smiles at you with a stall-owner’s geniality, hand in his (her?) pocket. “I think perhaps there has been a misunderstanding. Which I am sure our friend here, having listened to the good major’s explanation, is perfectly willing to resolve, starwalker to starwalker. I think what [pc.heShe] is looking for is a... let’s call it a finder’s fee. For the anat male. And [pc.hisHer] discretion in this matter, in perpetuity.”
rows.translation: “打扰一下，”一个如水上浮油般顺滑的声音说道。踱步过来的塔拉特人露出摊主般和善的微笑，一只手插在他（她？）的口袋里。“我想，这里或许有些误会。不过我相信，我们这位朋友听完好少校的解释后，完全愿意以星行者对星行者的方式解决此事。我想[pc.heShe]想要的是...姑且称作发现者酬金吧。为了那个安纳泰男性，以及[pc.hisHer]对此事永远保持沉默。”

rows.translation: 你在人群中奋力挤行，许多人正涌向各个出口，一边搏斗一边朝舞台推进。你能听见埃斯特拉夫在某处高声下令，却看不到那个塔拉特人...你的手碰到木板，刚爬上舞台，就看见一名金米尔抓住昏昏沉沉的法齐安肩膀，把他扶了起来。

You can hear Ehstraffe screaming out orders from somewhere - there’s no sign of the tarratch... your hands touch wood and you clamber up onto the stage, just in time to see a gold myr pick a groggy Fazian up by the shoulder."

rows.original: “Through the back,” she says. She’s missing an arm but looks exultant, a Federation beret skewed across her crown. Together you half carry, half lead the anat dancer out of the main warehouse and through the back entrance. Gold myr are streaming out of the main gateway in all directions, fighting red myr, being tackled to the ground, or simply running into Kressia or towards No Myr’s Land as fast as they possibly can. Keeping in the back alleys and close to the cavern wall, you limp northwards with Fazian and the gold myr. A siren wails over the sounds of the riot, followed by the crackle of open fire. Nobody stops you, though. Presumably to the red myr soldiers you glimpse charging past, your group looks like an alien who has been caught in the crossfire, his friend, and a helpful, Federation-affiliated local.

rows.raw: "\n\n“No warrant, no uniform, no squad of fur-things armed with death-torches,” she says to her fellows. “No correct information, either. We didn’t kidnap him. He came of his own free will, to perform exclusively for the poor PoWs in our care. Isn’t that right, Fazian?”"

rows.original: An iron whistle clatters into the dust as the red myr crumples to the ground, unconscious. You shoot a nervous look over both shoulders. Fortune is still with you; in this quiet corner of Kressia, nobody seems to have seen your assault. Or if they have, they’re gold, and quietly approve. Quickly you grab hold of the guard and drag her, limbs dangling, behind the warehouse and into the cover of some crates.
rows.translation: 铁哨掉进尘土里，叮当作响，红米尔瘫倒在地，失去了意识。你紧张地朝两边肩后看去。幸运仍眷顾着你；在克雷西亚这个安静角落，似乎没人看到你的袭击。即便有人看见了，那也是金米尔，而且在默默赞同。你迅速抓住守卫，把四肢无力垂落的她拖到仓库后方，藏进几只箱子的掩护中。
rows.raw: "An iron whistle clatters into the dust as the red myr crumples to the ground, unconscious. You shoot a nervous look over both shoulders. Fortune is still with you; in this quiet corner of Kressia, nobody seems to have seen your assault. Or if they have, they’re gold, and quietly approve. Quickly you grab hold of the guard and drag her, limbs dangling, behind the warehouse and into the cover of some crates."

rows.original: An iron whistle clatters into the dust as the red myr’s eyes cloud, her mouth hanging open.
rows.translation: 铁哨掉进尘土里，叮当作响，红米尔双眼失神，嘴巴微张。
rows.raw: "An iron whistle clatters into the dust as the red myr’s eyes cloud, her mouth hanging open."

rows.original: “G-goddess,” she groans, clutching herself between the legs. “Stop! Alright, I’ll let you in if - can we go around the back - ?”
rows.translation: “女、女神啊，”她呻吟着，双手捂住腿间。“停下！好吧，我让你进去，只要——我们能不能绕到后面去——？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“G-goddess,” she groans, clutching herself between the legs. “Stop! Alright, I’ll let you in if - can we go around the back - ?”"

rows.original: “Nope,” you reply, picking up her rifle and stunning her with a smart blow to the temple. You shoot a nervous look over both shoulders. Fortune is still with you; in this quiet corner of Kressia, nobody seems to have seen your assault. Or if they have, they’re gold, and quietly approve.
rows.translation: “不行，”你回答，捡起她的步枪，干脆利落地朝太阳穴一砸，将她击晕。你紧张地朝两边肩后看去。幸运仍眷顾着你；在克雷西亚这个安静角落，似乎没人看到你的袭击。即便有人看见了，那也是金米尔，而且在默默赞同。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nope,” you reply, picking up her rifle and stunning her with a smart blow to the temple. You shoot a nervous look over both shoulders. Fortune is still with you; in this quiet corner of Kressia, nobody seems to have seen your assault. Or if they have, they’re gold, and quietly approve."

rows.original: Quickly you grab hold of the guard and drag her, limbs dangling, behind the warehouse and into the cover of some crates.
rows.translation: 你迅速抓住守卫，把四肢无力垂落的她拖到仓库后方，藏进几只箱子的掩护中。
rows.raw: "\n\nQuickly you grab hold of the guard and drag her, limbs dangling, behind the warehouse and into the cover of some crates."

rows.original: Brushing yourself down, you head back to the front gate and sidle inside.
rows.translation: 你掸了掸身子，回到正门，侧身溜了进去。
rows.raw: "\n\nBrushing yourself down, you head back to the front gate and sidle inside."

rows.original: You can try fighting the entire red myr garrison, in which case your bullet-riddled corpse will fall to the ground in short order. You can try surrendering and arguing your case that another starwalker is being held in the warehouse, and you were just trying to rescue them. This will fall on unfavorable ears, both on the red myr and the U.G.C.’s side, given you assaulted a soldier in occupied territory during a fragile ceasefire. It will be many years before Steele Corp manage to wrangle a release for you from Kressia’s military prison. Whichever the case, your adventure is over.
rows.translation: 你可以试着与整支红米尔驻军交战，那样你很快就会被子弹打成筛子，尸体倒在地上。你也可以投降，辩称另一名星行者被关在仓库里，而你只是想救出对方。然而红米尔和银河联合邦联都不会接受这套说辞，毕竟你在脆弱的停火期间袭击了占领区内的一名士兵。斯蒂尔公司得花上许多年，才能设法让克雷西亚军事监狱释放你。不管选哪一条路，你的冒险都结束了。
rows.raw: "You can try fighting the entire red myr garrison, in which case your bullet-riddled corpse will fall to the ground in short order. You can try surrendering and arguing your case that another starwalker is being held in the warehouse, and you were just trying to rescue them. This will fall on unfavorable ears, both on the red myr and the U.G.C.’s side, given you assaulted a soldier in occupied territory during a fragile ceasefire. It will be many years before Steele Corp manage to wrangle a release for you from Kressia’s military prison. Whichever the case, your adventure is over."

rows.original: “Oh, delirious delights! Finally, a sapient of class and intelligence.” He lowers his voice to a more comfortable volume and puffs out what passes for his chest. “You now have the good fortune of conversating with Fair-shake Focalor, a tove who--if I do so humbleflatter myself--is as reknowned for his artistocomely appearance as for the equitability of his dealings, but let’s keep that between you and me. If word got out I was this pretty, I’d be disowned and discomissioned.” He winks, buffing his nails against his jacket. “Seriously though, if my dear, sweet mother - profits bless her revenerable webbed feet - finds out I haven’t struck the most parsimiserly deal possible, I really would be disowned... and probably defenestrated.” This time he winks with three eyes. “But enough about my own personage! Tell me about yourself, my refined, unfeathered friend. What’s your eponymoniker, and which of these cherrymint vessels will you be flying home in today?”
rows.translation: “哦，令人神魂颠倒的喜悦！终于来了一位有品位、有智慧的知性生物。”他把声音降低到更舒适的音量，挺起勉强算作胸膛的部位。“你如今有幸与公平交易·弗卡洛交谈。本人是一名托芙——容我如此谦逊地自我吹捧——不仅以艺术般俊美的外表闻名，也以交易公允著称，不过这件事可得你知我知。要是别人知道我这么漂亮，我会被逐出家门，还会遭到解雇。”他眨眨眼，用夹克擦亮指甲。“不过说真的，要是我亲爱的甜心母亲——愿利润保佑她那双可敬又可赚钱的蹼足——发现我没有谈成最极尽节省的交易，我确实会被逐出家门...大概还会被扔出窗外。”这次他同时眨了三只眼。“不过我的个人话题已经够多了！说说你自己吧，我高雅而无羽的朋友。你的名号称谓是什么？今天你又准备把哪艘崭新薄荷般清爽的飞船开回家？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, delirious delights! Finally, a sapient of class and intelligence.” He lowers his voice to a more comfortable volume and puffs out what passes for his chest. “You now have the good fortune of conversating with Fair-shake Focalor, a tove who--if I do so humbleflatter myself--is as reknowned for his artistocomely appearance as for the equitability of his dealings, but let’s keep that between you and me. If word got out I was this pretty, I’d be disowned and discomissioned.” He winks, buffing his nails against his jacket. “Seriously though, if my dear, sweet mother - profits bless her revenerable webbed feet - finds out I haven’t struck the most parsimiserly deal possible, I really would be disowned... and probably defenestrated.” This time he winks with three eyes. “But enough about my own personage! Tell me about yourself, my refined, unfeathered friend. What’s your eponymoniker, and which of these cherrymint vessels will you be flying home in today?”"

rows.original: “[pc.name],” you admit, trying to catch up with the fast-talking alien.
rows.translation: “[pc.name]，”你承认道，努力跟上这个异星人的语速。
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name],” you admit, trying to catch up with the fast-talking alien."

rows.original: “Perfectitastic! You sound like a [pc.manWoman] of means and determination.” Focalor smiles somehow, in spite of his beak. “Behold my heavenly stable of interstellar vessels, verifitable chariots of the non-denominational gods, and you’ll find yourself gratified to empty your proverbial wallet upon my humblest of altars. Aheheh,” he chuckles smugly. Two of his hands slap a black crate hard, and a holographic display full of prices springs up. “I promise. Ask any other Rusher, and they will sing hosannas to Fair-Shake Focalor. Now please, perusify the wares I have so painstakingly presentified for your perspicacious purchasing pleasure.”
rows.translation: “完美绝妙！听起来你是一位既有财力又有决心的[pc.manWoman]。”弗卡洛顶着鸟喙，不知怎么还是露出了笑容。“请看我这座天国般的星际舰船马厩，这些可是无宗派诸神名副其实的战车；你会乐于在我最谦卑的祭坛前倒空那只比喻意义上的钱包。啊嘿嘿，”他得意地轻笑。两只手用力拍在一个黑色箱子上，满是价格的全息显示随即亮起。“我保证。去问任何一名开拓者，他们都会向公平交易·弗卡洛高唱赞歌。现在，请尽情审阅这些由我煞费苦心展示、专供你慧眼选购的商品吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Perfectitastic! You sound like a [pc.manWoman] of means and determination.” Focalor smiles somehow, in spite of his beak. “Behold my heavenly stable of interstellar vessels, verifitable chariots of the non-denominational gods, and you’ll find yourself gratified to empty your proverbial wallet upon my humblest of altars. Aheheh,” he chuckles smugly. Two of his hands slap a black crate hard, and a holographic display full of prices springs up. “I promise. Ask any other Rusher, and they will sing hosannas to Fair-Shake Focalor. Now please, perusify the wares I have so painstakingly presentified for your perspicacious purchasing pleasure.”"

rows.original: You step up to Focalor’s mountain of crates with a smile and a wave. “I came back.”
rows.translation: 你微笑着挥挥手，走向弗卡洛堆积如山的箱子。“我回来了。”
rows.raw: "You step up to Focalor’s mountain of crates with a smile and a wave. “I came back.”"

rows.original: “You did say that, my beamish palaquaintance, and color me octarine, there you are!” Focalor’s four eyes radiate happiness. “Well frabjous day! That means you quantifitify for my regaloyalty returning customer rewards!” He kicks one of the crates, hard, and a holographic display springs into being, listing his inventory once more. The prices are exactly the same as before. Focalor must see the look spreading across your face, because he hastily adds, “Non-cash benefits, of course. Returning customers are imparted with platinum-level service and a warranty that’s good for more than 26 kiloflorps!”
rows.translation: “你的确这么说过，我光彩照人的熟人朋友；把我染成八色吧，你真的来了！”弗卡洛的四只眼睛洋溢着喜悦。“真是妙不可言的一天！这意味着你已达到皇家忠诚回头客奖励的资格！”他用力踢了一只箱子，一块全息显示浮现，再次列出库存。价格和之前一模一样。弗卡洛肯定看见了你脸上浮现的神情，因为他赶忙补充：“当然是非现金福利。回头客可以享受白金级服务，以及有效期超过二十六千弗洛普的保修！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You did say that, my beamish palaquaintance, and color me octarine, there you are!” Focalor’s four eyes radiate happiness. “Well frabjous day! That means you quantifitify for my regaloyalty returning customer rewards!” He kicks one of the crates, hard, and a holographic display springs into being, listing his inventory once more. The prices are exactly the same as before. Focalor must see the look spreading across your face, because he hastily adds, “Non-cash benefits, of course. Returning customers are imparted with platinum-level service and a warranty that’s good for more than 26 kiloflorps!”"

rows.original: You ask the gibbering tove if he could license his wares to be distributed to your home hangar, should you wish to browse from Tavros Station. “Excelcitements! A Rusher of salivatory taste and meanspifics!” The grinning Tove grins all the wider, thrilled at the possibility of laying the groundwork for future, easy profits. “Abscondify with information and our dealingsways are paved!” He produces a laminated business card. Somehow, it is stained with what looks like a coffee ring inside the laminate. Hardly official, but it has the information Vahn would need in order to offer Focalor’s ships for sale at home. You nod in thanks. “Futher utterances unrequired! ...But consider the meritocracies of thrilling your mechanator with a new ship!” He gestures broadly at his stock.
rows.translation: 你询问这个喋喋不休的托芙，能否授权他的商品在你的自家机库销售，以便你在塔弗罗斯空间站选购。 “令人兴奋绝顶！一位品味与财力都令人口水直流的开拓者！”咧嘴笑着的托芙笑得更开了，为能够给未来轻松赚取利润打下基础而欣喜若狂。“带走这些资料，我们的交易之路就铺平了！”他拿出一张覆膜名片。不知怎么回事，覆膜里面竟留着一圈像咖啡渍的痕迹。看起来不太正式，但上面的信息足以让瓦恩在家中出售弗卡洛的飞船。 你点头致谢。 “无需再多言！...不过，也请考虑用一艘新飞船取悦你的机械师！”他朝自己的库存大幅挥手。
