rows.translation: 你几乎看不清那些巨型水晶，甚至看不到它们反射的任何光芒。空气中弥漫着大小不一的白色孢子，看起来就像在清凉空气中飘浮的雪花。点缀洞壁的无数真菌发出暗淡蓝光，让水晶般的孢子在飘落时闪耀并反射光线。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can hardly see the titanic crystals, or any glow reflecting from them for that matter. The air is filled with white spores of varying sizes, looking almost like snowflakes floating in the cool air. The many fungi that dot the cave walls glow a dim blue, making the crystalline spores shine and reflect as they fall."

rows.original: At least you think that’s what they’re doing at first. The tiny balls of light seem to be falling, but upon closer inspection they simply fall a few feet before spinning in the air and curling around on a repeating loop. You note that none of them hit each other, spiraling in intricate swirls through the open space. The larger mushrooms shudder periodically, releasing a cloud of new spores that move to fill another area of the cave.
rows.translation: 至少起初你以为它们正在飘落。仔细观察后，你发现那些微小光球只会下落几英尺，随后在空中旋转、卷曲，沿着重复的环路运动。它们彼此从不相撞，而是在开阔空间中以复杂的螺旋轨迹穿行。较大的蘑菇会周期性地颤动，释放出一团新孢子，填满洞穴的另一片区域。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt least you think that’s what they’re doing at first. The tiny balls of light seem to be falling, but upon closer inspection they simply fall a few feet before spinning in the air and curling around on a repeating loop. You note that none of them hit each other, spiraling in intricate swirls through the open space. The larger mushrooms shudder periodically, releasing a cloud of new spores that move to fill another area of the cave."

rows.original: You
rows.translation: 你
rows.raw: "\n\nYou "

rows.original: move cautiously further into the cavern
rows.translation: 小心翼翼地继续深入洞穴
rows.raw: "move cautiously further into the cavern"

rows.original: . The agile spores alter their looping course slightly to avoid you as you walk by, moving like dancers out of your way. They resume their prior course when you leave their specific zone, so you pay them little attention, merely being careful not to touch them as you pass. You also make sure to avoid the scattered toadstools that litter the floor.
rows.translation: 。你经过时，灵活的孢子略微改变循环轨迹，像舞者般为你让路。等你离开各自的区域，它们又恢复原先的路线；因此你没有过多理会，只是经过时小心不去触碰。同时，你也避开散落在地面的毒蕈。
rows.raw: ". The agile spores alter their looping course slightly to avoid you as you walk by, moving like dancers out of your way. They resume their prior course when you leave their specific zone, so you pay them little attention, merely being careful not to touch them as you pass. You also make sure to avoid the scattered toadstools that litter the floor."

rows.original: The gems before you are obscured to some degree by the false snow, and you can only see a few parts of them at any given time. It isn’t long before you notice that you are walking between two of the colossal structures, their shining surfaces mostly devoid of intrusion by the fungus except at the creases. Softly glowing mushrooms spread tendrils into any opening
rows.translation: 眼前的宝石在一定程度上被假雪遮蔽，你每次只能看见其中一小部分。没过多久，你便发现自己正走在两座庞然结构之间；除了缝隙处，它们闪亮的表面几乎没有受到真菌侵入。发出柔光的蘑菇把菌丝伸进每一个开口
rows.raw: "\n\nThe gems before you are obscured to some degree by the false snow, and you can only see a few parts of them at any given time. It isn’t long before you notice that you are walking between two of the colossal structures, their shining surfaces mostly devoid of intrusion by the fungus except at the creases. Softly glowing mushrooms spread tendrils into any opening"

rows.original: As you approach the rear of the cavern a sound catches your attention. It sounds familiar, but difficult to place. It sounds like music, but unlike any you can describe. The words, if they can be called that, are not ones your mouth can make, and you find no answers in your Codex’s translator. You must be the first spacefarer to hear these noises, whatever they are.
rows.translation: 接近洞穴后方时，一阵声音引起你的注意。听来很熟悉，却难以辨认。它像是音乐，却与任何你能描述的曲调都不同。那些声音若能称为词句，也绝非你的嘴能够发出；Codex的翻译器同样找不到答案。不论那是什么，你一定是第一个听见这些声音的太空旅人。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you approach the rear of the cavern a sound catches your attention. It sounds familiar, but difficult to place. It sounds like music, but unlike any you can describe. The words, if they can be called that, are not ones your mouth can make, and you find no answers in your Codex’s translator. You must be the first spacefarer to hear these noises, whatever they are."

rows.original: A cloud of spores moves, allowing you to see a little further ahead, and you tense at the sight they reveal. A female gold myr sits on a chair sized mushroom, surrounded by a tiny whirlwind of spores that pulse with vibrant colors. She bobs in time with the sounds, her eyes totally blank and staring at nothing as the fantastic colors reflect in them. Her hair is a shining gold, looking as if it were literally dipped in the metal instead of the average blonde.
rows.translation: 一团孢子移开，让你得以看得更远；眼前显露的景象令你绷紧身体。一名金米尔女性坐在蘑菇形成的椅子上，四周环绕着一股微型孢子旋风，闪动着鲜艳色彩。她随着声音摆动，双眼完全失神，茫然凝视虚空，奇幻色彩映在眼中。她的头发闪耀着金光，仿佛不是普通金发，而是真的浸过金属。
rows.raw: "\n\nA cloud of spores moves, allowing you to see a little further ahead, and you tense at the sight they reveal. A female gold myr sits on a chair sized mushroom, surrounded by a tiny whirlwind of spores that pulse with vibrant colors. She bobs in time with the sounds, her eyes totally blank and staring at nothing as the fantastic colors reflect in them. Her hair is a shining gold, looking as if it were literally dipped in the metal instead of the average blonde."

rows.original: Beside her is the source of the noise. A tall, stark white figure stands a few feet from her reclining form. Standing might not be the most appropriate word for it though, as instead of feet she is simply anchored to a half sphere. Upon closer inspection the half sphere is actually the pregnant looking belly of a red myr, one who looks equally enraptured by the song as the other girl. The tall white woman is perfectly still atop her seemingly ecstatic host.
rows.translation: 她身旁正是声音的源头。一个高挑、雪白的身影站在她斜倚的身体几英尺外。不过，“站立”或许并不准确，因为她没有双脚，而是直接扎根在一个半球体上。仔细一看，那半球其实是一名红米尔人看似怀孕的腹部；她与另一名女孩一样，被歌声迷得神魂颠倒。高大的白色女人一动不动地立在那名似乎欣喜若狂的宿主身上。
rows.raw: "\n\nBeside her is the source of the noise. A tall, stark white figure stands a few feet from her reclining form. Standing might not be the most appropriate word for it though, as instead of feet she is simply anchored to a half sphere. Upon closer inspection the half sphere is actually the pregnant looking belly of a red myr, one who looks equally enraptured by the song as the other girl. The tall white woman is perfectly still atop her seemingly ecstatic host."

rows.original: Unlike the other fungal manifestations you’ve seen
rows.translation: 与你见过的其他真菌显化体不同
rows.raw: "\n\nUnlike the other fungal manifestations you’ve seen"

rows.original: (pictures of on the codex)
rows.translation: （以及Codex上的图片）
rows.raw: " (pictures of on the codex)"

rows.original: ROGUEBOT
rows.raw: "ROGUEBOT"

rows.original: Rogue Bot
rows.translation: 失控机器人
rows.raw: "Rogue Bot"

rows.original: Gardeford
rows.raw: "Gardeford"

rows.original: You collapse from the force of the giant’s attacks, looking up to see its menacing white eyes staring at your helpless form. A number of whirring clicks sound in its body before its flamethrower moves into your vision. The pilot flame glares menacingly, filling the air with the smell of burning fuel. The last thing you see is a flash of bright light as the high pressured blast of fire burns you into oblivion.
rows.translation: 巨人的攻击把你打倒在地。你抬头看见它凶恶的白色眼睛正盯着你无助的身体。它体内响起一连串嗡鸣与咔嗒声，随后火焰喷射器移入你的视野。引火焰恶狠狠地燃烧着，空气中弥漫着燃料燃烧的气味。你最后看到的是一道耀眼闪光，高压火焰将你烧得灰飞烟灭。
rows.raw: "You collapse from the force of the giant’s attacks, looking up to see its menacing white eyes staring at your helpless form. A number of whirring clicks sound in its body before its flamethrower moves into your vision. The pilot flame glares menacingly, filling the air with the smell of burning fuel. The last thing you see is a flash of bright light as the high pressured blast of fire burns you into oblivion."

rows.original: “Threat eliminated.”
rows.translation: “威胁已消除。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Threat eliminated.”"

rows.original: Gardeford
rows.raw: "Gardeford"

rows.original: The machine clicks and sputters a few times, its flamethrower releasing gouts of fuel with no flame. The lighting mechanism clicks but malfunctions, and the robot’s entire arm and torso explode in a pressurized pop. You stagger over to the area where the myr sisters are still sitting and check to make sure they are uninjured. The spores seem to have protected them from any burning.
rows.translation: 机器咔嗒作响、断续喷吐了几次，火焰喷射器只喷出燃料，却没有火焰。点火装置不断咔嗒，却发生故障，机器人的整条手臂与躯干在压力爆响中炸开。你踉跄着走到米尔姐妹仍坐着的地方，确认她们没有受伤。孢子似乎保护了她们，免遭灼烧。
rows.raw: "The machine clicks and sputters a few times, its flamethrower releasing gouts of fuel with no flame. The lighting mechanism clicks but malfunctions, and the robot’s entire arm and torso explode in a pressurized pop. You stagger over to the area where the myr sisters are still sitting and check to make sure they are uninjured. The spores seem to have protected them from any burning."

rows.original: You watch as all of the spores in the room zoom in and swirl around the gold myr, surrounding her until you can’t see her anymore. A bright flash of light forces you to shield your eyes for a few seconds, and when you can see again you see the red myr standing with the queen, now placed atop the gold myr. She turns to you, holding the red ant-girl’s hand to keep steady.
rows.translation: 你看着房间里所有孢子迅速聚拢，在金米尔人周围盘旋，直到将她完全遮住。一道耀眼闪光迫使你遮住双眼几秒；再次看清时，你发现红米尔人正与女王站在一起，而女王如今安坐在金米尔人身上。她转向你，握住红发蚁女的手以保持平衡。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou watch as all of the spores in the room zoom in and swirl around the gold myr, surrounding her until you can’t see her anymore. A bright flash of light forces you to shield your eyes for a few seconds, and when you can see again you see the red myr standing with the queen, now placed atop the gold myr. She turns to you, holding the red ant-girl’s hand to keep steady."

rows.original: “Thank you. You may take your material now. Please help this girl back to the surface, if you wouldn’t mind,” she says through the eager redhead. You walk behind her to find the material she was talking about. A few meters back is a small spire of crystalline rock. Your codex scans the formation and identifies it as crystallized sophinol, a prized fuel source. If that robot’s flames had touched it you might not be standing here right now. In a few minutes you’ve filed a claim on the fuel crystals through Steele Tech’s central servers.
rows.translation: “谢谢。你现在可以取走材料了。如果不介意的话，请帮这个女孩回到地表，”她借那名满怀期待的红发女人说道。你绕到她身后，寻找她所说的材料。几米外有一根小型水晶岩尖塔。Codex扫描了这座构造，确认它是结晶索菲诺，一种珍贵燃料。要是那个机器人的火焰碰到它，你现在恐怕已经无法站在这里。几分钟内，你便通过斯蒂尔科技的中央服务器登记了这批燃料水晶的所有权。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thank you. You may take your material now. Please help this girl back to the surface, if you wouldn’t mind,” she says through the eager redhead. You walk behind her to find the material she was talking about. A few meters back is a small spire of crystalline rock. Your codex scans the formation and identifies it as crystallized sophinol, a prized fuel source. If that robot’s flames had touched it you might not be standing here right now. In a few minutes you’ve filed a claim on the fuel crystals through Steele Tech’s central servers."

rows.original: While you walk through the caves, you want to ask her what her time as host to the queen was like, but the words do not come. She talks at great length about what she’s going to do to her sister when she next sees her, and how much of a lesson she’s going to give her. She could’ve gotten people killed because of her stupid misguided actions.
rows.translation: 穿行洞穴时，你很想问她成为女王宿主的感觉，但话到嘴边却说不出口。她滔滔不绝地讲着下次见到姐姐时要怎么收拾她，又要给她怎样的教训。她那愚蠢而误入歧途的行为差点害死人。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile you walk through the caves, you want to ask her what her time as host to the queen was like, but the words do not come. She talks at great length about what she’s going to do to her sister when she next sees her, and how much of a lesson she’s going to give her. She could’ve gotten people killed because of her stupid misguided actions."

rows.original: As you leave the cave there’s a commotion outside; a man in a biohazard safety suit moves up to you, grasping your shoulder. At first your hand goes for your weapon, but then he pulls off the mask, revealing an unassuming middle-aged man.
rows.translation: 离开洞穴时，外面一阵骚动；一个穿生化防护服的男人快步走来，抓住你的肩膀。起初你的手伸向武器，但他随即摘下面罩，露出一张平凡的中年男人面孔。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you leave the cave there’s a commotion outside; a man in a biohazard safety suit moves up to you, grasping your shoulder. At first your hand goes for your weapon, but then he pulls off the mask, revealing an unassuming middle-aged man."

rows.original: “You there! I work with KihaCorp’s interplanetary shipping department. I was looking at the books this morning and it seems one of our deconstruction units was sent here without permission. You wouldn’t happen to have seen one recently would you? It’s a spider-legged thing with a flamethrower and a big pnuematic hammer, kinda hard to miss,” he asks, looking thoroughly serious. You reply that you just destroyed one to stop it from igniting a cluster of fossilized fuel that might have altered a good amount of the caves infrastructure.
rows.translation: “你！我是基哈公司的星际运输部门员工。今天早上查账时，我发现我们的一台解构单元未经许可被送到了这里。你最近有没有见过？那东西长着蜘蛛腿，还有火焰喷射器和一把巨大的气动锤，很难错过，”他一脸严肃地问。你回答说，自己刚刚摧毁了一台，以免它点燃一簇化石燃料，否则洞穴的大部分结构恐怕都会遭到改变。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You there! I work with KihaCorp’s interplanetary shipping department. I was looking at the books this morning and it seems one of our deconstruction units was sent here without permission. You wouldn’t happen to have seen one recently would you? It’s a spider-legged thing with a flamethrower and a big pnuematic hammer, kinda hard to miss,” he asks, looking thoroughly serious. You reply that you just destroyed one to stop it from igniting a cluster of fossilized fuel that might have altered a good amount of the caves infrastructure."

rows.original: “Shit fucking... Fuck! Those things cost a fortune. Sorry, I’m just having waking nightmares imagining the paperwork I’m going to be filling out later. Well, I’ll send in a drone to recover the diamond bit. It sucks I’ll have to report this to the higher ups, but I’m sure they’ll be mollified when we find the fucker who sent it out. Don’t worry about getting charged for the damage or anything. It’ll be coming out of his or her paycheck,” he says, going back to a small shuttle that takes off toward the DMZ. You wonder if they’ll find him for a moment before continuing on your own way.
rows.translation: “该死的……操！那种东西贵得要命。抱歉，我只是一想到之后得填的文件，就开始做白日噩梦。好吧，我会派无人机去回收金刚石钻头。虽然得把这件事报告给上面很烦，但等我们找出那个擅自把它派出来的混蛋，他们肯定会消气。别担心赔偿损失之类的事，钱会从他或她的工资里扣，”他说着，回到一艘小型穿梭机上，朝非军事区起飞。你短暂地想了想他们能否找到那人，随后继续独自赶路。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shit fucking... Fuck! Those things cost a fortune. Sorry, I’m just having waking nightmares imagining the paperwork I’m going to be filling out later. Well, I’ll send in a drone to recover the diamond bit. It sucks I’ll have to report this to the higher ups, but I’m sure they’ll be mollified when we find the fucker who sent it out. Don’t worry about getting charged for the damage or anything. It’ll be coming out of his or her paycheck,” he says, going back to a small shuttle that takes off toward the DMZ. You wonder if they’ll find him for a moment before continuing on your own way."

rows.original: <b>You make
rows.translation: <b>你的矿产所有权为你赚得
rows.raw: "\n\n<b>You make "

rows.original: credits from your mineral claim!
rows.translation: 信用点！
rows.raw: " credits from your mineral claim!\n\n"

rows.original: Gardeford
rows.raw: "Gardeford"

rows.original: You tell the queen that you accept her terms, and will help her to fight the coming machine. She looks grateful, turning to the gold myr.
rows.translation: 你告诉蘑菇女王，你接受她的条件，愿意帮助她对抗即将到来的机器。她感激地转向金米尔人。
rows.raw: "You tell the queen that you accept her terms, and will help her to fight the coming machine. She looks grateful, turning to the gold myr."

rows.original: “Thank you. You help us more than you may know,” she says before her entire body begins to dissolve. The amount of spores in the room seems to double, thickly clouding the air and surrounding you like a tornado wherever you move. A similar barrier surrounds the gold myr and her sister, who now lies on the ground with a normal looking belly. From behind you comes an immense explosion, and you turn to find its source.
rows.translation: “谢谢。你给予我们的帮助比你想象得更多，”她说完，整个身体便开始消散。房间里的孢子数量仿佛翻了一倍，浓密地遮蔽空气，无论你走到哪里，都像龙卷风般环绕着你。金米尔人与她的姐姐周围也形成了类似屏障；后者如今躺在地上，腹部已经恢复正常。从身后传来一声巨响，你转身寻找来源。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thank you. You help us more than you may know,” she says before her entire body begins to dissolve. The amount of spores in the room seems to double, thickly clouding the air and surrounding you like a tornado wherever you move. A similar barrier surrounds the gold myr and her sister, who now lies on the ground with a normal looking belly. From behind you comes an immense explosion, and you turn to find its source."

rows.original: Flames wreath the corridor that leads to the cavern, and the mushrooms change from soothing blue to a panicked red strobe. A titanic construct walks through the fire on eight spidery legs, stopping at the door to stare at you. Its mechanical parts are covered in flashy plastic-looking tiles, but you can see a denser metal plating beneath them. A company label you don’t recognize is openly emblazoned on its shoulder, consisting of a number of erratic lightning bolts spreading from a thumbs up. A large flamethrower replaces a hand on one of its arms, while the other has a menacing diamond tipped pneumatic hammer. It notices you standing and releases what you assume is a prerecorded message.
rows.translation: 火焰包围了通往洞室的走廊，蘑菇由舒缓的蓝光变为惊慌的红色频闪。一台庞大构装体踩着八条蜘蛛般的腿穿过烈焰，在门口停下，凝视着你。它的机械部件覆着花哨的塑料状面板，但下方可见更致密的金属装甲。肩头醒目地印着一个你不认识的公司标志：数道杂乱闪电从一只竖起的拇指向外延伸。它的一条手臂以大型火焰喷射器取代手掌，另一条则装有令人胆寒的金刚石尖头气动锤。它注意到你仍站在那里，播放出一段你猜是预录的信息。
rows.raw: "\n\nFlames wreath the corridor that leads to the cavern, and the mushrooms change from soothing blue to a panicked red strobe. A titanic construct walks through the fire on eight spidery legs, stopping at the door to stare at you. Its mechanical parts are covered in flashy plastic-looking tiles, but you can see a denser metal plating beneath them. A company label you don’t recognize is openly emblazoned on its shoulder, consisting of a number of erratic lightning bolts spreading from a thumbs up. A large flamethrower replaces a hand on one of its arms, while the other has a menacing diamond tipped pneumatic hammer. It notices you standing and releases what you assume is a prerecorded message."

rows.original: “Innocent civilian. Move away from this area with haste. This Deconstruction Unit has been designated to purge all life in this section of the caves. If you stay, ERROR will hold no responsibility for your injuries,” it drones in a jovial voice. Afterwards it pauses, giving you time to leave. It’s too late for that now, so you ready your weapons and prepare to defend the queen’s ritual. The next time it talks it does so without the jovial warning tone.
rows.translation: “无辜平民。请迅速离开此区域。本解构单元已被指定清除洞穴本区段的一切生命。若您留下，错误将不对您的伤势承担责任，”它用欢快的声音机械说道。说完后，它停顿片刻，给你离开的机会。但现在已经太迟，你举起武器，准备保护女王的仪式。它再次开口时，欢快的警告语调已经消失。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Innocent civilian. Move away from this area with haste. This Deconstruction Unit has been designated to purge all life in this section of the caves. If you stay, ERROR will hold no responsibility for your injuries,” it drones in a jovial voice. Afterwards it pauses, giving you time to leave. It’s too late for that now, so you ready your weapons and prepare to defend the queen’s ritual. The next time it talks it does so without the jovial warning tone."

rows.original: “Brandishing weaponry against construction robots is a violation of U.G.C. property damage law, and this unit is authorized to engage in lethal self-defense. Engage and die,” it says, readying its tools to destroy you and your surroundings. The pilot flame of its arm bursts to life as a menacing addition to its statement. Suddenly a second voice joins in, apparently through a comm link attached to the machine.
rows.translation: “以武器威胁工程机器人违反联合银河邦联财产损害法，本单元获准采取致命自卫措施。交战，然后死亡，”它说着，举起工具，准备摧毁你和周围的一切。手臂上的引火焰猛然燃起，为宣言增添一抹威胁。突然，另一个声音插了进来，似乎来自连接在机器上的通讯链路。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Brandishing weaponry against construction robots is a violation of U.G.C. property damage law, and this unit is authorized to engage in lethal self-defense. rows.original: “When one of us has lived as long as I have the memories build up inside us, and eventually we must forget if we do not disperse. rows.translation: 你说想看看他有什么商品。 “这边请！”他气派地一挥手，回到柜台后面，示意你看固定在柜台上的触摸屏。以你的眼光来看，这东西同样显得颇为古旧笨重。
rows.raw: "You say you’d like to see what he’s got to sell.\n\n“Right this way!” he grandly sweeps back to his counter and directs you to a touch screen fastened to it. To your sensitivities it again looks rather antique and blocky."

rows.original: “Do not be over-awed by such technology, small one,” the shopkeeper suggests. “Once you’ve gotten over your initial fright of it, it becomes a gateway to everything you could ever dream of.”
rows.translation: “不要被如此高深的科技吓住了，小家伙，”店主建议道。“等你克服最初的恐惧，它就会成为通往你一切梦想的门户。”
rows.raw: " “Do not be over-awed by such technology, small one,” the shopkeeper suggests. “Once you’ve gotten over your initial fright of it, it becomes a gateway to everything you could ever dream of.”"

rows.original: Gene lazily spins a talon in the direction of the touch-screen.
rows.translation: 吉恩懒洋洋地转动一根爪尖，指向触摸屏。
rows.raw: "Gene lazily spins a talon in the direction of the touch-screen.\n"

rows.original: Gene is big. Like, really big. From the top of his head to the tip of one of his thin, bulbous-tipped twin tails, the maroon colored wyvern-shaped sentient reaches at least forty feet long. Most of that you can’t see when he is behind his counter, ivory wing-claws clutching the surface and looming over it; however the fans of those bat-like wings, folded away though they might be, are always evident. Fully unfurled his wing span must be more than ten yards. His skin is fairly smooth, closer to hairless mammalian than scaly reptilian, however he does not have nipples. He dresses in the remnants of an old space suit, carapace and tough, tight-fitting fabrics around the joints, bare on the arms. At a guess it’s from the 24th century. Quaint to your eyes, but you’d imagine breathtakingly futuristic to any native.
rows.translation: 吉恩很大。真的，非常大。从头顶到两条细长、末端膨大的尾巴尖，这个酒红色、形似飞龙的智慧生物至少有四十英尺长。他待在柜台后面时，你看不见其中大半；象牙色的翼爪抓着台面，庞大的身躯高高笼罩其上，但那对蝙蝠般的翅膀即使折叠起来，翼扇也始终清晰可见。完全展开时，他的翼展肯定超过十码。他的皮肤相当光滑，更接近无毛哺乳动物而非带鳞爬行动物，不过没有乳头。他穿着一套旧式太空服的残余部件，关节处覆着甲壳与坚韧贴身的织物，手臂则裸露在外。依你猜测，那东西来自二十四世纪。在你眼里颇为古朴，但任何本地人恐怕都会觉得它先进得令人屏息。
rows.raw: "Gene is big. Like, really big. From the top of his head to the tip of one of his thin, bulbous-tipped twin tails, the maroon colored wyvern-shaped sentient reaches at least forty feet long. Most of that you can’t see when he is behind his counter, ivory wing-claws clutching the surface and looming over it; however the fans of those bat-like wings, folded away though they might be, are always evident. Fully unfurled his wing span must be more than ten yards. His skin is fairly smooth, closer to hairless mammalian than scaly reptilian, however he does not have nipples. He dresses in the remnants of an old space suit, carapace and tough, tight-fitting fabrics around the joints, bare on the arms. At a guess it’s from the 24th century. Quaint to your eyes, but you’d imagine breathtakingly futuristic to any native."

rows.original: Facially Gene looks human enough - albeit a very large human, with horn plating his lips and chin. He has full, broad, straight nosed, shaven features that would not look out of place in some classical Persian epic. It would have to be one with a lot of jokes in it, because he never seems far from breaking out into a big, toothy grin, behind which a long, purple tongue is always waiting to wag. He has a mane of brown hair and yellow, hawkish eyes. Adder-like black squares pattern his heavily corded neck and shoulders.
rows.translation: 吉恩的脸看起来还算像人类 - 尽管是个极其巨大、嘴唇和下巴覆着角质甲片的人类。他五官饱满宽阔、鼻梁笔直、面庞光洁，放进某部古典波斯史诗里也毫不突兀。不过那史诗一定得充满笑料，因为他似乎随时都会咧开一张露齿大笑的嘴，而嘴后总有一条紫色长舌等着摇摆。他长着一头棕色鬃发和一双如鹰般锐利的黄色眼睛，粗壮结实的脖颈与肩膀上排列着蝰蛇般的黑色方斑。

He has full, broad, straight nosed, shaven features that would not look out of place in some classical Persian epic. It would have to be one with a lot of jokes in it, because he never seems far from breaking out into a big, toothy grin, behind which a long, purple tongue is always waiting to wag. He has a mane of brown hair and yellow, hawkish eyes. Adder-like black squares pattern his heavily corded neck and shoulders."

rows.original: Incongruous to his bestial, fleshy frame are his gray, synthetic, four fingered arms, connected to him via a harness around his lower torso. These are usually folded primly on the counter, and obviously allow the fanfir to do manual tasks he’d otherwise struggle with. He moves and gestures with them as easily as if they were his own.
rows.translation: 与他野兽般的血肉身躯格格不入的是一双灰色合成四指手臂，通过环绕下躯干的支架与身体相连。它们通常端端正正地叠放在柜台上，显然让这个凡菲尔得以完成原本很难处理的手工作业。他操纵并用它们比划时自然得就像那本来就是自己的手臂。

These are usually folded primly on the counter, and obviously allow the fanfir to do manual tasks he’d otherwise struggle with. He moves and gestures with them as easily as if they were his own."

rows.original: His carapace bottoms have a suggestively large codpiece.
rows.translation: 他的甲壳下装配着一个尺寸惹人遐想的护裆。
rows.raw: "\n\nHis carapace bottoms have a suggestively large codpiece."

rows.translation: 从他身体其他部位的尺寸来看，你猜那里装得相当壮观。

rows.translation: 在他紧实健壮的臀后，两条蜥蜴般的尾巴不安分地甩动，两个膨大的尾尖偶尔撞上物体，发出一声“啪嗒”。

rows.original: “This place, then.” You wave your hand at the curved roof of the shop. “Did you just ride in and set it up one day or what?”
rows.translation: “那么，说说这地方吧。”你朝商店弧形的屋顶挥了挥手。“你就是某天骑着什么东西过来，然后把它建起来了？”
rows.raw: "“This place, then.” You wave your hand at the curved roof of the shop. “Did you just ride in and set it up one day or what?”"

rows.original: “Well, I sought permission first.” Gene harrumphs as he turns and click-thud-clack-thumps his way around the oak-colored space, tails flicking, continuing to talk as he slides fastidious cybernetic fingers over cases and posters. “Discretely. After the kui-tan gave me permission to land and trade here, I approached a couple of gold myr civil servants about room in Gildenmere where I might safely build. It turned out there was quite a lot of that - vacant lots do have a tendency to spring up during the prosecution of lost wars. And they were quite happy, desperate even, to get fresh commerce in, particularly from the stars. Of course, I did not tell them about the nature of autossemblers. Nor that I was going to activate it during rush hour.”
rows.translation: “唔，我先征求了许可。”吉恩哼了一声，转身在橡木色的空间里咔哒、砰咚、喀啦地走动，尾巴不停甩着；一边让讲究的义体手指滑过陈列柜与海报，一边继续说道。“当然是谨慎地征求。在奎坦人准许我降落并在这里经商后，我又找了几名金米尔公务员，询问吉尔登米尔哪里有地方能让我安全施工。结果这样的地方相当多 - 败仗打久了，空地自然很容易冒出来。他们很高兴，甚至可以说迫不及待地想引入新商业，尤其是来自群星的商业。当然，我没告诉他们自动装配机的本质，也没说我要在交通高峰期启动它。”

After the kui-tan gave me permission to land and trade here, I approached a couple of gold myr civil servants about room in Gildenmere where I might safely build. It turned out there was quite a lot of that - vacant lots do have a tendency to spring up during the prosecution of lost wars. And they were quite happy, desperate even, to get fresh commerce in, particularly from the stars. Of course, I did not tell them about the nature of autossemblers. Nor that I was going to activate it during rush hour.”"

rows.original: He suddenly whips around to you, balancing himself on two creaking cabinets again, beaming down like a giant red lighthouse.
rows.translation: 他突然转身面向你，再次用两个嘎吱作响的柜子支撑身体，像一座巨大的红色灯塔般笑容满面地俯视着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe suddenly whips around to you, balancing himself on two creaking cabinets again, beaming down like a giant red lighthouse."

rows.original: “Imagine it,” he insists. “Put yourself in the shoes of your average gold myr. Worn and fraught by conflict, you and your people have been given a stay of execution by the arrival of extraterrestrial beings. Who are they, these mysterious, benevolent beings, what do they want, where, how...? And then, one morning.” He lowers his voice to a ominous hush, his cyber arms opening to the sky. “You are walking down the street to your place of work when a piece of technology of unknowable, wondrous design unfurls itself like a ceramic flower where a part of your shattered city once stood. In mere minutes, with impossible grace and speed, it unfolds piece by piece into a shining white building the likes of which you have never seen. Then - after the clouds have dissipated, and one or two more minutes have dragged by - ” One metal arm points to a corner. If you’re not very much mistaken, a dry ice machine is standing over there. “I emerge on the roof.” He unfolds his massive bat wings to their full extent, eyes fixed on the middle distance.
rows.translation: “想象一下，”他坚持道。“设身处地地想象一个普通金米尔。你和族人被战争折磨得疲惫不堪，而外星生物的到来让你们获得了暂缓处决的机会。这些神秘又仁慈的存在是谁，他们想要什么，又来自哪里、如何而来...? 然后，某一天清晨。”他把声音压成不祥的低语，义体双臂向天空张开。“你正沿街走向工作地点，忽然，一件设计神奇得无法理解的科技造物，在破碎城市原本的一角如陶瓷花朵般绽放。短短几分钟内，它以不可思议的优雅与速度一片片展开，化作一栋你从未见过的闪亮白色建筑。然后 - 待云雾散去，又有一两分钟缓缓流逝 - ”一条金属手臂指向角落。如果你没看错，那里摆着一台干冰机。“我出现在屋顶上。”他将巨大的蝙蝠翅膀完全展开，目光凝视着远方。

Worn and fraught by conflict, you and your people have been given a stay of execution by the arrival of extraterrestrial beings. Who are they, these mysterious, benevolent beings, what do they want, where, how...? And then, one morning.” He lowers his voice to a ominous hush, his cyber arms opening to the sky. “You are walking down the street to your place of work when a piece of technology of unknowable, wondrous design unfurls itself like a ceramic flower where a part of your shattered city once stood. In mere minutes, with impossible grace and speed, it unfolds piece by piece into a shining white building the likes of which you have never seen. Then - after the clouds have dissipated, and one or two more minutes have dragged by - ” One metal arm points to a corner. If you’re not very much mistaken, a dry ice machine is standing over there. “I emerge on the roof.” He unfolds his massive bat wings to their full extent, eyes fixed on the middle distance."

rows.original: “People of Gildenmere!” he roars, full-throated, making the room shake. You suddenly feel thrilled in a diffuse, indefinable way and perhaps, just for a moment, you are that gold myr, standing frozen in the street in awe. “For too long you have struggled under the yoke of war that is not your path. I come in peace, and to you I bring the fruits of a peace beyond your world that has lasted centuries beyond reckoning. Those brave enough to taste of them can become anything they wish - may break away from the cruel bonds of nature. The only limit is your imagination, o young people of art, thought and liberty. Become what you wish to be. Become the future!” He trumpets the last word like a cavalry charge, and then settles himself down to gaze at you smugly.
rows.translation: “吉尔登米尔的人民！”他放声咆哮，震得整个房间都在摇晃。你忽然感到一种弥漫而难以言喻的激动；也许只在那一瞬间，你就是那个金米尔，满怀敬畏地僵立街头。“长久以来，你们在并非自身道路的战争枷锁下苦苦挣扎。我为和平而来，并为你们带来超越这个世界、延续了无数世纪的和平果实。勇于品尝它们的人可以成为自己想成为的任何存在 - 可以挣脱自然残酷的束缚。唯一的限制就是你们的想象力，哦，艺术、思想与自由的年轻人民。成为你们想成为的存在。成为未来！”他像骑兵冲锋般高喊最后一个词，随后收敛下来，得意地望着你。

You suddenly feel thrilled in a diffuse, indefinable way and perhaps, just for a moment, you are that gold myr, standing frozen in the street in awe. “For too long you have struggled under the yoke of war that is not your path. I come in peace, and to you I bring the fruits of a peace beyond your world that has lasted centuries beyond reckoning. Those brave enough to taste of them can become anything they wish - may break away from the cruel bonds of nature. The only limit is your imagination, o young people of art, thought and liberty. Become what you wish to be. Become the future!” He trumpets the last word like a cavalry charge, and then settles himself down to gaze at you smugly."

rows.original: “I have not wanted for customers. I also understand every other off-worlder has been something of a disappointment, at least to those who were there that morning.”
rows.translation: “我的顾客从未短缺。我也听说，至少对那天早晨在场的人而言，其他每一个外来者都多少令人失望。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I have not wanted for customers. I also understand every other off-worlder has been something of a disappointment, at least to those who were there that morning.”"

rows.original: “Have you used any gene modifications on yourself, then?” you ask.
rows.translation: “那么，你在自己身上用过什么基因改造吗？”你问道。
rows.raw: "“Have you used any gene modifications on yourself, then?” you ask."

rows.original: “One or two things,” replies Gene. He thumps down from the counter and prowls around his shop like a looming shadow, allowing you to see the entirety of his curving frame as he talks. “I am not one of those specimens who got into modding because the form they were born with disgusts or frightens them, poor dears. But little flourishes and curlicues of biology, designed and carefully administered to amplify the joys of life and love... yes, those I do enjoy.”
rows.translation: “一两样吧，”吉恩回答。他从柜台上沉重地落下，像一道压迫感十足的阴影般在店里踱步，让你在他讲话时得以看清整个弯曲的身躯。“我可不是那种因为厌恶或惧怕天生形态才踏入改造领域的可怜家伙。不过，精心设计、谨慎施加，用来放大生活与爱之欢愉的生物小花饰和卷纹...没错，那些我的确很喜欢。”

But little flourishes and curlicues of biology, designed and carefully administered to amplify the joys of life and love... yes, those I do enjoy.”"

rows.original: He whips his two thin, serpentine tails around, narrowly avoiding knocking over a stand, considering them proudly. You notice that each has got a fleshy bulb at the end. “Naturally fanfir tails are wiry, unwieldy and finely haired. To aid with the business of flying, you know. With these I have much more control, sensitivity and can do, oh, all sorts of things. Plus they are simply a lot more fun to swing around.”
rows.translation: 他猛地甩动两条细长如蛇的尾巴，险些撞倒一个陈列架，随后骄傲地端详起来。你注意到每条尾巴末端都有一个肉质球茎。“凡菲尔天生的尾巴细韧、难以操控，还长着纤细毛发。你知道，那是为了帮助飞行。有了这些，我能获得更多控制力和敏感度，还能做，哦，各种各样的事情。而且挥起来也好玩得多。”

With these I have much more control, sensitivity and can do, oh, all sorts of things. Plus they are simply a lot more fun to swing around.”"

Deeply enjoyable and - right feeling. I must say it feels like my people should have been equipped with such tongues all along. And then, of course...”

rows.original: He leans backwards and waves a robotic hand at the generously sized cod-piece of his outfit. “Many are the native girls who like the look of a male fanfir’s genitalia, but few and far between are they that are willing to put them anywhere near their own. Quite understandable. So I invested in another, more modestly sized one.” He rocks back onto the balls of his feet. “I have always enjoyed the look of human sexual organs. No unnecessary adornments, no silly little bells and whistles - elegantly and concisely designed. A phallus, bold, blunt and ready. Next to my natural endowment, outrageous to most sensitivities, it is an excellent juxtaposition. Exactly how gene-mods should be used.”

rows.original: “Your arms, though.” you point at Gene’s two gray, synthetic arms, shadowed under his bulk. “Why haven’t you simply grown a pair?”
rows.translation: “不过，你的手臂呢。”你指向隐藏在吉恩庞大身躯阴影下的两条灰色合成手臂。“为什么不干脆长一对出来？”
rows.raw: "“Your arms, though.” you point at Gene’s two gray, synthetic arms, shadowed under his bulk. “Why haven’t you simply grown a pair?”"

rows.original: “An incisive enquiry,” rejoins the fanfir, stepping closer to let the hot liquid of his voice fill your ears. “Why indeed would a mutationist, who relies upon being able to palpably demonstrate his prowess, rely upon robotics? There are two reasons, [pc.short] Steele. The first, and this concern most fanfir share, is that a second pair of limbs rather impinges one’s ability to fly. In order for us to fly outside of our own world, you see, we need a second, anti-gravity harness. Whilst this synthetic aid may be easily shucked off and replaced with the other, a permanent set of arms places undue strain on it, and simply makes the business of flying clumsier besides. So the question is: do you sacrifice the occasional fleeting wonder that can be found in the air of alien worlds, the inexpressible delight of flight, for eternal manual dexterity?” He spreads his wings like a giant fan and bellows the answer at you. “No, no and NO!”

For a moment your heart is in your mouth; you honestly don’t know if you could deny those hot, honeyed words if they formed that demand. Gene shakes his head with a smile.
rows.translation: 交给凡菲尔的人，竟然是一笔惊人财富的继承人。那么，”他若有所思地继续说道，合拢的合成手指轻敲着唇边的角，低沉的话语盘旋着震动你的颅骨，“如果我命令你把它转让给我，会发生什么？”你仿佛冲过山头，突然看见一道飞速逼近的深渊，这才意识到处境有多危险。一时间，你的心提到了嗓子眼；若那甜美炽热的话语真的提出这种要求，你实在不知道自己能否拒绝。吉恩微笑着摇了摇头。

rows.original: “Relax.” You sag. “Do you think your master is that much of a sociopath? Honestly. Also, I rather suspect your father employed a lawyer or two who might raise their eyebrows somewhat if a fanfir swans up to Steele HQ, contract in hand. It’s enough,” he growls, sending heat shooting through your [pc.groin], “to know one of my treasures is of spectacular import, one that a whole people may know of, tantalizing not just in physical form but in cultural weight.” He grins at you lazily. “You run around the frontier, little one: increase your value, let many others see you, and forever burn with the knowledge of who truly owns you. I do so enjoy the way a prominently displayed case increases the value of the jewel within.”
rows.translation: “放松。”你的身体松垮下来。“你觉得自己的主人真有那么反社会吗？说真的。而且我很怀疑，你父亲雇的那一两个律师看到一名凡菲尔拿着合同大摇大摆走进斯蒂尔总部时，会不会扬起眉毛。”他低吼着，令热意直窜你的[pc.groin]，“知道我的一件珍宝如此重要，甚至可能为整个民族所知；不仅肉体令人垂涎，文化分量也同样诱人，这就够了。”他懒洋洋地朝你咧嘴一笑。“在边疆四处闯荡吧，小家伙：提升自己的价值，让更多人看见你，并永远为真正拥有你的人而灼烧。醒目陈列的展柜会抬高其中珠宝的价值，我非常喜欢这一点。”

It’s enough,” he growls, sending heat shooting through your [pc.groin], “to know one of my treasures is of spectacular import, one that a whole people may know of, tantalizing not just in physical form but in cultural weight.” He grins at you lazily. “You run around the frontier, little one: increase your value, let many others see you, and forever burn with the knowledge of who truly owns you. I do so enjoy the way a prominently displayed case increases the value of the jewel within.”"

rows.original: Gene looks mildly impressed by the time you’re done.
rows.translation: 等你说完时，吉恩似乎略感钦佩。
rows.raw: "\n\nGene looks mildly impressed by the time you’re done."

rows.original: “A man of the self for sure, but he forced his chosen heir to chase after their inheritance as a callow encore to his own exploits? Denying them the chance to find and follow their own journey so that they might suffer as he did, ensuring his legacy by molding you via experience into the self-same person? Brutal. Theatrical. Cunning. Rather fanfir-ish, in fact. Yes, I believe I would have liked your father.”
rows.translation: “毫无疑问，他是个奉行自我的男人，可他竟逼迫自己选中的继承人追逐遗产，把这当作自身冒险的一场青涩返场？剥夺继承人寻找并走上自己道路的机会，让其如他一般受苦，再借由经历把你塑造成与他一模一样的人，以此确保自己的传承？残酷。戏剧化。狡猾。事实上，颇有凡菲尔的作风。是的，我想我会喜欢你父亲。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A man of the self for sure, but he forced his chosen heir to chase after their inheritance as a callow encore to his own exploits? Denying them the chance to find and follow their own journey so that they might suffer as he did, ensuring his legacy by molding you via experience into the self-same person? Brutal. Theatrical. Cunning. Rather fanfir-ish, in fact. Yes, I believe I would have liked your father.”"

rows.original: “What do you think of the myr?”
rows.translation: “你怎么看米尔人？”
rows.raw: "“What do you think of the myr?”"

rows.original: “The variety I have chosen to house myself amongst, you mean?” Claws slide and clatter as Gene dismounts from the counter and pads from behind it, gazing at his display cases ruminatively. “Intelligent. Sensitive. Desperate. Made exquisitely beautiful by the precipice their culture is teetered upon. Had your Xenogen friends not intervened when they did, this city and the ideals it embodies would not exist, you know. They would have been subsumed by the Reds, lucky perhaps to survive as a despised slave caste. As is, they are akin to an enclosure of pandas, staring dolefully out at the red sea of venomous, vengeful, highly-evolved snakes surrounding them. It’s wonderfully perverse, don’t you think, that corporate greed has been bent to protect something precious and fragile?”
rows.translation: “你是指我选择栖身其间的那一类？”吉恩从柜台上跳下，利爪滑动着发出咔嗒声。他踱出柜台后方，沉思地凝望着陈列柜。“聪明。敏感。绝望。她们的文化正立于悬崖边缘，因而显得格外美丽。你知道，要不是你的异源生物科技朋友及时介入，这座城市及其体现的理想根本不会存在。她们早已被红米尔吞并，走运的话或许能作为受人鄙弃的奴隶阶层活下来。如今，她们就像围栏里的一群熊猫，悲戚地望着四周由剧毒、复仇心切且高度进化的蛇组成的红色海洋。企业贪欲竟被扭转来保护某种珍贵而脆弱的事物，这不是美妙地反常吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The variety I have chosen to house myself amongst, you mean?” Claws slide and clatter as Gene dismounts from the counter and pads from behind it, gazing at his display cases ruminatively. “Intelligent. Sensitive. Desperate. Made exquisitely beautiful by the precipice their culture is teetered upon. Had your Xenogen friends not intervened when they did, this city and the ideals it embodies would not exist, you know. They would have been subsumed by the Reds, lucky perhaps to survive as a despised slave caste. As is, they are akin to an enclosure of pandas, staring dolefully out at the red sea of venomous, vengeful, highly-evolved snakes surrounding them. It’s wonderfully perverse, don’t you think, that corporate greed has been bent to protect something precious and fragile?”"

rows.original: “Bit hypocritical, given you’re here trying to sell them mods,” you suggest. Gene harrumphs in affected indignation.
rows.translation: “考虑到你正试图向她们兜售改造品，这话有点虚伪吧，”你说道。吉恩故作愤慨地哼了一声。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bit hypocritical, given you’re here trying to sell them mods,” you suggest. Gene harrumphs in affected indignation."

rows.original: “Is it such a bad thing to sell dreams to a people that may not even be here next week? Gold myr culture emphasizes individuality, whilst their physicality mandates that only a tiny handful truly can be individuals. How is that for high tragedy?” He circles the shop floor, fingers and tails sliding lovingly over his cases and posters. “This shop is designed with them in mind, you know - as is this ridiculous outfit I’m wearing.” A synthetic hand plucks at the blocky space suit carapace. “To their eyes, these displays are breathtakingly futuristic - more right-looking, perversely, than up-to-date styles. To your eyes though, they are charmingly quaint. It works both ways, you see.” It’s all an act, you can see that - an extension of the fanfir himself, prowling and gesturing theatrically the way he does. Because he’s so invested in it though, and the way raw power occasionally seizes his words and form, it is kind of captivating.
rows.translation: “向一个下周可能就不复存在的民族兜售梦想，真有那么糟吗？金米尔文化强调个体性，可她们的生理结构注定只有极少数人真正能成为个体。这算不算一出宏大的悲剧？”他绕着店面踱步，手指和尾巴爱抚般滑过陈列柜与海报。“你知道，这家店就是以她们为目标设计的——我身上这套荒唐衣服也是。”一只合成手扯了扯方正的太空服甲壳。“在她们眼里，这些陈列品洋溢着令人屏息的未来感——反常的是，甚至比时下风格更显得理所当然。而在你眼中，它们却古雅得迷人。你看，这是双向奏效的。”你看得出来，这一切都是表演——是这名凡菲尔自身的延伸，正如他四处徘徊、戏剧化地比划那般。然而，他如此投入其中，原始力量又不时攫住他的话语与身形，所以确实颇为迷人。

Gold myr culture emphasizes individuality, whilst their physicality mandates that only a tiny handful truly can be individuals. How is that for high tragedy?” He circles the shop floor, fingers and tails sliding lovingly over his cases and posters. “This shop is designed with them in mind, you know - as is this ridiculous outfit I’m wearing.” A synthetic hand plucks at the blocky space suit carapace. “To their eyes, these displays are breathtakingly futuristic - more right-looking, perversely, than up-to-date styles. To your eyes though, they are charmingly quaint. It works both ways, you see.” It’s all an act, you can see that - an extension of the fanfir himself, prowling and gesturing theatrically the way he does. Because he’s so invested in it though, and the way raw power occasionally seizes his words and form, it is kind of captivating."

rows.original: “Even if the mods I sell them don’t work, the experience I provide, the belief of a better world and the sense of belonging and specialness if they give themselves entirely to me, THAT is priceless.”
rows.translation: “即使我卖给她们的改造品不起作用，我提供的体验、对更美好世界的信念，以及她们把自己完全交给我后获得的归属感与独特感，那才是无价之宝。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Even if the mods I sell them don’t work, the experience I provide, the belief of a better world and the sense of belonging and specialness if they give themselves entirely to me, THAT is priceless.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “What do you mean, if the mods don’t work?” Gene turns and pads slowly towards you in a predatory stance, huge wings slicing into the air, tails lashing.
rows.translation: “你说改造品不起作用，是什么意思？”吉恩转过身，以捕食者的姿态缓缓朝你走来，巨大的翅膀划破空气，尾巴猛烈甩动。
rows.raw: "“What do you mean, if the mods don’t work?” Gene turns and pads slowly towards you in a predatory stance, huge wings slicing into the air, tails lashing."

rows.original: “Why do you think there aren’t a hundred other gene-mod companies already here, merrily undercutting me?” he replies in the soft, deadly rumble of slowly shifting granite. “Aside from the possible inconvenience of nuclear annihilation, I mean. Nothing currently produced has been tested on myr physiology. I am all but certain, given their obvious similarities to other bipedal, warm-blooded races, that they will work; but no, not certain.” He rears up to his full height in front of you, the deep brass of his voice quaking through you. “This is the frontier, Steele. It is filled with danger, rogues and disrepute, and if you want to grasp the golden opportunities it offers, you must also take chances. There is no triumph if there was no possibility of terrible failure.”
rows.translation: “你以为为什么还没有一百家其他基因改造公司跑来这里，兴高采烈地用低价把我挤垮？”他以花岗岩缓缓移位般柔和而致命的低沉声响回答。“我是说，先不考虑核毁灭可能带来的不便。目前生产的任何产品都没有在米尔人的生理结构上测试过。鉴于她们与其他双足温血种族显而易见的相似之处，我几乎可以确定它们有效；但不，我并不完全确定。”他在你面前直起身，展现全部高度，黄铜般低沉的嗓音震颤着穿过你的身体。“这里是边疆，斯蒂尔。这里充满危险、恶徒和恶名；若想攫取它提供的黄金机遇，你也必须承担风险。若从未有过惨败的可能，就谈不上胜利。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Why do you think there aren’t a hundred other gene-mod companies already here, merrily undercutting me?” he replies in the soft, deadly rumble of slowly shifting granite. “Aside from the possible inconvenience of nuclear annihilation, I mean. Nothing currently produced has been tested on myr physiology. I am all but certain, given their obvious similarities to other bipedal, warm-blooded races, that they will work; but no, not certain.” He rears up to his full height in front of you, the deep brass of his voice quaking through you. “This is the frontier, Steele. It is filled with danger, rogues and disrepute, and if you want to grasp the golden opportunities it offers, you must also take chances. There is no triumph if there was no possibility of terrible failure.”"

rows.translation: 他凝视着
rows.raw: "\n\nHe gazes"

rows.translation: 你，黄色双眼里充满狂野的欲望。“我绝不会为真实的自己道歉——就像我也不会为想在此时此地得到你的每一寸而道歉。”一只象牙色利爪落在你的肩头

rows.translation: 可以

rows.translation: 不行

rows.translation: 不行

rows.original: Back Off!
rows.translation: 退后！
rows.raw: "Back Off!"

rows.original: Back Off!
rows.translation: 退后！

rows.original: You shrug the fanfir’s claw off and politely tell him not right now.
rows.translation: 你甩开凡菲尔的爪子，礼貌地告诉他现在不行。
rows.raw: "You shrug the fanfir’s claw off and politely tell him not right now."

rows.original: “As you wish, Steele,” replies Gene, giving you one last hungry, convivial look before turning back to his voluminous armor. “For now.”
rows.translation: “如你所愿，斯蒂尔，”吉恩回答，最后饥渴而愉悦地看了你一眼，随后转回他那体积庞大的护甲。“暂时如此。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“As you wish, Steele,” replies Gene, giving you one last hungry, convivial look before turning back to his voluminous armor. “For now.”"

rows.original: You shrug the fanfir’s claw off irritably.
rows.translation: 你烦躁地甩开凡菲尔的爪子。
rows.raw: "You shrug the fanfir’s claw off irritably."

rows.original: “It’s strange, I’m pretty certain I told you not to do that once,” you say. “And here I am telling you again. Next time you aren’t getting that paw of yours back.
rows.translation: “真奇怪，我很确定自己以前告诉过你别这么做，”你说道。“现在我又得说一遍。下次你可别想把那只爪子完好无损地拿回去。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s strange, I’m pretty certain I told you not to do that once,” you say. “And here I am telling you again. Next time you aren’t getting that paw of yours back."

rows.original: Fanfir
rows.raw: "Fanfir"

rows.original: And don’t think I don’t know what you’re trying to pull with that treacly voice of yours either.
rows.translation: 别以为我不知道你想用那甜得发腻的嗓音搞什么鬼。
rows.raw: " And don’t think I don’t know what you’re trying to pull with that treacly voice of yours either."

rows.original: So knock it off, alright?”
rows.translation: 所以收敛一点，明白吗？”
rows.raw: " So knock it off, alright?”"

rows.original: Gene looks stunned by this - and then, momentarily, thunderously angry. Finally though, he takes several steps back and groans theatrical despair at the ceiling.
rows.translation: 吉恩对此显得目瞪口呆——随后短暂地暴怒如雷。然而最后，他还是后退数步，对着天花板发出戏剧性的绝望呻吟。
rows.raw: "\n\nGene looks stunned by this - and then, momentarily, thunderously angry. Finally though, he takes several steps back and groans theatrical despair at the ceiling."

rows.original: “Thrown back by the enchantress herself!” he cries. “I have overplayed and over-reached, and paid the most terrible of prices for it!” He bows his head humbly to you, mournful pebbles raining out of his throat. “Your wish is my command, o aptly named Steele. No longer shall I pursue you, for no longer can I claim the right. Forever more I will gaze lovelorn at you from a distance, and pour my sorrow into composing paeans to your wondrous, wintry beauty.” He trudges back behind his counter in the manner of some great, crestfallen hound.
rows.translation: “竟被女术士亲手击退！”他高呼道。“我太过自信、太过冒进，并为此付出了最惨痛的代价！”他谦卑地向你低头，喉咙里如落下悲伤的石子般滚出话语。“你的愿望就是我的命令，哦，名副其实的斯蒂尔。我不会再追求你，因为我已无权如此。今后我只会从远处饱受相思地凝望你，将悲愁倾注于赞美你那奇妙、凛冬般美貌的颂歌之中。”他像一条庞大而垂头丧气的猎犬般跋涉回柜台后方。

No longer shall I pursue you, for no longer can I claim the right. Forever more I will gaze lovelorn at you from a distance, and pour my sorrow into composing paeans to your wondrous, wintry beauty.” He trudges back behind his counter in the manner of some great, crestfallen hound."

rows.original: “So what you’re doing here is not particularly legal,” you muse. You look Gene straight in the yellow eye. “Is there anything not particularly legal that isn’t on the main menu, strictly speaking?”
rows.translation: “所以说，你在这里做的事并不怎么合法，”你沉吟道。你直视吉恩的黄色眼睛。“严格来说，有没有什么不太合法、也没列在主菜单上的东西？”
rows.raw: "“So what you’re doing here is not particularly legal,” you muse. You look Gene straight in the yellow eye. “Is there anything not particularly legal that isn’t on the main menu, strictly speaking?”"

rows.original: “Mmm. Possibly,” replies the fanfir, drawing out his words in a low rumble. “When you are a famously open-minded mod entrepreneur of distinction, you are sometimes approached by independent chemists who wish to amaze the galaxy and make small fortunes with their cutting edge creations, without going through the suffocating, expensive rigmarole of officially testing them first. Gene-mod giants such as Xenogen will usually quickly create their own version in response and vigorously undercut you if you go through the proper channels, after all. Most of the DNA-attacking gloop that lands on my metaphorical doorstep is worthless, dangerous or both. Occasionally something interesting arrives, though...”
rows.translation: “嗯。也许有，”凡菲尔回答，低沉地拖长话音。“当你是一位声名远扬、思想开放且卓有声望的改造品企业家时，偶尔会有独立化学家找上门来。他们想凭尖端造物震撼银河、赚上一小笔财富，却不愿先经历正式测试那套令人窒息又烧钱的繁文缛节。毕竟，只要你走正规渠道，异源生物科技之类的基因改造巨头往往很快就会推出自己的版本，再用猛烈的低价竞争把你挤垮。落到我这扇比喻意义上的门前、会攻击DNA的黏糊物，大多毫无价值、危险，或两者兼有。不过偶尔也会送来些有趣的东西...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmm. Possibly,” replies the fanfir, drawing out his words in a low rumble. “When you are a famously open-minded mod entrepreneur of distinction, you are sometimes approached by independent chemists who wish to amaze the galaxy and make small fortunes with their cutting edge creations, without going through the suffocating, expensive rigmarole of officially testing them first. Gene-mod giants such as Xenogen will usually quickly create their own version in response and vigorously undercut you if you go through the proper channels, after all. Most of the DNA-attacking gloop that lands on my metaphorical doorstep is worthless, dangerous or both. Occasionally something interesting arrives, though...”"

rows.original: “Which is?” you cajole.
rows.translation: “比如什么？”你哄问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Which is?” you cajole."

rows.original: “Let us say, purely for the sake of argument, that there is a small group of modders operating independently on this very planet,” harrumphs Gene, gesticulating tersely with his synth arms. “Aiming to take advantage of Xenogen’s current fixation with the gold myr to experiment with one of Myrellion’s, ahem, less celebrated species. Splicing plant DNA with animal is a notoriously difficult art, so to find a specimen that ACTIVELY SEEKS OUT such a union is of great interest to modders. They believe that, using the DNA of Hydrus Constuprula, they have created a plant TF of awesome strength and viability; able to facilitate all manner of floral metamorphoses in a subject. Not only that: I don’t think they’re lying.”
rows.translation: “姑且纯粹为了讨论，假设就在这颗星球上，有一小群独立运作的改造师，”吉恩哼声说道，合成手臂简短地比划着。“他们打算利用异源生物科技目前对金米尔人的执着，拿密尔利昂某种，咳，不那么受推崇的物种做实验。把植物DNA与动物DNA拼接，是一门出了名困难的技艺；因此，发现一种会主动寻求这种结合的样本，对改造师来说极具吸引力。他们相信自己利用Hydrus Constuprula的DNA，创造出了一种强度与活性都惊人的植物转化物；它能促成受试者身上形形色色的植物性蜕变。不仅如此：我觉得他们没有撒谎。”

rows.original: You find yourself back in Gene’s airy, sandy-colored room, decorated with stands showing off various types of gene-mods, both modern and antique. The walls are covered with old poster and shifting-image advertisements for mods; to your eyes they look quaint, but you’d guess to myr eyes they would be the exact opposite. Other, more esoteric trinkets and objects hang from the ceiling and crowd the corners. Despite the clutter the place is hangar-sized, and everything is very widely spaced.
rows.translation: 你发现自己又回到了吉恩那间通风宽敞、沙色调的房间，里面摆着许多展架，陈列着现代和古董的各类基因改造品。墙上贴满老旧海报和活动影像式改造品广告；在你看来颇为古朴，但你猜在米尔人眼中正好相反。其他更为玄奥的小饰物和物件悬在天花板上，挤满各个角落。尽管东西杂乱，这地方却有机库那么大，所有物件之间都隔得极开。

rows.original: “And what do we have here?” inquires a rumbling, liquid voice from the back of the room. “A new customer, I warrant.” It takes a moment for your eyes to adjust to what you’re looking at, and it is with a slight fright you realize that what you assumed from your peripheral vision was the whole back wall of the shop is, in fact, the shopkeeper.

rows.original: The burgundy colored creature regards you with a relaxed, knowing grin on his broad, straight-nosed face, the claws to his vast, bat-like wings balanced on each end of his counter. And the counter must be, what, nine yards long? The rolling mass of his upper body combined with his slighter torso and legs makes him loom like nothing else; it’s like being in the same room as a gigantic hawk whose attention is solely on you. In the middle of the counter another pair of arms, gleaming metal and white synthetics attached to his midriff by a harness, are folded, incongruously neat and business-like in a vast hollow of bulging, red flesh. They brace themselves on the glass and his wing claws clack down onto the metal floor as he turns, his yellow, raptor eyes still on you as he allows you to see his whole curving profile, his two serpentine tails flicking into view. You take a small step back; it’s difficult not to be awed at seeing a beast of this size in motion, particularly after spending time around so many petite ant girls. From tip to tail he must be at least forty feet long. No wonder everything in here is widely spaced.
rows.translation: 那个酒红色的生物用一副轻松而了然的笑容打量着你；他宽阔、鼻梁笔直的脸上挂着笑意，巨大蝠翼的翼爪分别搭在柜台两端。而那柜台得有多长，九码？他上半身翻滚般隆起的庞大肌肉与较为纤细的躯干和双腿组合在一起，形成无与伦比的压迫感；仿佛你正与一只巨鹰共处一室，而它的注意力全都集中在你身上。柜台中央还有一双手臂，由闪亮的金属与白色合成材料制成，通过一具背带连接在他的腰腹处；它们整齐地交叠着，显得与这片鼓胀红肉形成的巨大凹谷格格不入，却又颇有商务气息。他用这双手撑住玻璃，转身时翼爪在金属地板上咔嗒落下；那双黄色猛禽眼始终盯着你，同时让你看清他整个弯曲的侧影，两条蛇形尾巴也甩入视野。你小小地后退一步；看着这般巨兽活动身体，很难不心生敬畏，尤其是在与那么多娇小的蚁族女孩相处过后。从头到尾，他至少有四十英尺长。难怪这里的一切都摆得如此宽松。

rows.original: “Don’t be afraid, petal of Myrellion,” he purrs, his heavy, full voice reverberating through you as he sinuously stalks out on all fours from behind his counter. Despite his approach, you do suddenly feel rather more relaxed. Even when he props his claws up on two glass cabinets to tower over you. His synthetic arms gesticulate with his words gracefully. “Everyone’s first encounter with an alien is always an overwhelming experience, is it not? Everything is so different, nothing in your nature or nurture prepares you for such a thing. But you came in here because you have a need, or a curiosity, to be different. To step outside the strictures of body your culture say you must accept. So ask, of Gene the very different, what it is you need.” He touches his upper lip with a long, purple tongue as he considers you. “Because it may be I have exactly that.”
rows.translation: “别害怕，米瑞利昂的花瓣，”他低声呢喃，浑厚饱满的嗓音在你体内回荡，同时从柜台后方四肢着地、蜿蜒优雅地踱出。尽管他正在靠近，你却忽然感觉放松了不少。即使他把翼爪撑在两座玻璃柜上，居高临下地俯视着你也是如此。他的合成手臂随着话语优雅地比划。“每个人第一次遇见外星人时，总会觉得难以承受，不是吗？一切都那么不同，无论天性还是教养，都无法让你为这样的经历做好准备。但你来到这里，是因为你有某种需求，或者怀着一种想让自己变得不同的好奇心。想要挣脱你的文化声称你必须接受的身体桎梏。那么就问问与众不同的吉恩吧，告诉我你需要什么。”他一边思量，一边用长长的紫色舌头碰了碰上唇。“因为我或许恰好就有那种东西。”

rows.original: “I guess that’s true, well if you want to know then I’m happy to tell,” he says, shrugging lightly. “I’m originally from Rosha, that’s the kaithrit homeworld if you didn’t know. My parents were kaithrit.”
rows.translation: “说得也是。好吧，既然你想知道，我很乐意告诉你，”他轻轻耸肩说道。“我来自罗莎。如果你不知道的话，那是凯斯里特人的母星。我的父母都是凯斯里特人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I guess that’s true, well if you want to know then I’m happy to tell,” he says, shrugging lightly. “I’m originally from Rosha, that’s the kaithrit homeworld if you didn’t know. My parents were kaithrit.”"

rows.original: “Wait, you were a kaithrit?”
rows.translation: “等等，你以前是凯斯里特人？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wait, you were a kaithrit?”"

rows.original: He chuckles softly. “Yeah, I left when I was sixteen because I hated it there. Kaithrit society is sexist towards men, viewing them as weak, and I wasn’t interested in being a trophy husband or being coddled just because I was a dude.”
rows.translation: 他轻声笑了笑。“是啊，我十六岁时离开了那里，因为我讨厌那个地方。凯斯里特社会对男性存在性别歧视，把他们视为弱者，而我既不想当个花瓶丈夫，也不想仅仅因为自己是男人就被人娇养。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe chuckles softly. “Yeah, I left when I was sixteen because I hated it there. Kaithrit society is sexist towards men, viewing them as weak, and I wasn’t interested in being a trophy husband or being coddled just because I was a dude.”"

rows.original: You can see how that’d be annoying.

rows.original: “So I snuck aboard a ship that was docked and hid until it took off. Eventually, I was discovered by the crew. Thankfully they didn’t turn back and take me home, even if that would have been the responsible choice. They decided to let me into their crew and their mechanic took me as his apprentice.”
rows.translation: “于是我偷偷登上一艘停靠的飞船，藏到它起飞为止。后来，船员发现了我。幸好他们没有掉头把我送回家，哪怕那样做才算负责任。他们决定让我加入船组，船上的机械师还收我做了学徒。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So I snuck aboard a ship that was docked and hid until it took off. Eventually, I was discovered by the crew. Thankfully they didn’t turn back and take me home, even if that would have been the responsible choice. They decided to let me into their crew and their mechanic took me as his apprentice.”"

rows.original: “That was one hell of a risk,” you muse, thinking of all the ways something like that could have gone wrong.
rows.translation: “那可真是冒了天大的风险，”你沉吟道，想着这种事可能会以多少种方式酿成灾难。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That was one hell of a risk,” you muse, thinking of all the ways something like that could have gone wrong."

rows.original: “Maybe, but it paid off,” he says with a shrug. “Although that didn’t help me when it came to female kaithrit I ran across, many of them still had the attitude I attempted to leave behind. Thinking that I couldn’t manage on my own because I was a male, and that they knew better how to maintain a spaceship. So I started buying mods to make myself appear something other than a kaithrit.”
rows.translation: “也许吧，但结果不错，”他耸肩说道。“不过，这对我后来遇到的凯斯里特女性没什么帮助。她们中的许多人仍抱着我试图摆脱的那种态度，认为我身为男性就无法照顾自己，还觉得她们比我更懂得怎样维护飞船。所以，我开始购买改造品，让自己看起来不像凯斯里特人。”

rows.original: “Well, the ceasefire isn’t exactly comforting; an actual peace treaty would make me more at ease, but there’s not much I can do about it. Aside from that, it’s decent, work is good, and most of the locals aren’t hostile.”
rows.translation: “嗯，停火状态并不能让人真正安心；要是能签订正式和平条约，我会放松得多，但这件事我也帮不上什么忙。除此以外，这里还不错，工作顺利，大多数当地人也没有敌意。”

rows.translation: “星球大开发中还有其他星球没有处在战争边缘。虽说海盗曾试图炸毁其中一颗，但总归还有更安全的星球。”

rows.original: “Maybe, but I came to Myrellion because there was a need for more mechanics to handle the workload of the Rush.” He gestures at the space field filled with space ships as he says that. “So lack of work wasn’t an issue. And now that I’m here I don’t intend to leave.”
rows.translation: “也许吧，但我来到米瑞利昂，是因为星球大开发带来的工作量需要更多机械师处理。”说着，他朝停满宇宙飞船的航天场示意。“所以我从不缺工作。而且既然已经来了，我就没打算离开。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Maybe, but I came to Myrellion because there was a need for more mechanics to handle the workload of the Rush.” He gestures at the space field filled with space ships as he says that. “So lack of work wasn’t an issue. And now that I’m here I don’t intend to leave.”"

Want to see some real change come to Myrellion.”
rows.translation: “我就说嘛，对吧？”她靠得更近，主动把身体贴上你。再次开口时，她把声音压到只比耳语稍高一点，在人群嘈杂声中勉强能听清。“你看来很清楚状况嘛，星行者。想不想见证米瑞利昂迎来真正的改变。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I know, right?” She leans closer, actively pressing herself against you. rows.translation: 你尽量和气地回答：“当然。”

rows.original: The crimson and gold myr grins. “Great. We’ll be meeting in the northwest corner of the city tomorrow at 23:30. If you show up, we could have a place for you. I promise, it’s gonna be explosive.” Her whole face lights up with glee.
rows.translation: 那名红金相间的米尔咧嘴一笑。“太好了。我们明晚23:30在城市西北角集合。你要是来，我们就能给你留个位置。我保证，绝对会很劲爆。”她整张脸都因欣喜而亮了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe crimson and gold myr grins. “Great. We’ll be meeting in the northwest corner of the city tomorrow at 23:30. If you show up, we could have a place for you. I promise, it’s gonna be explosive.” Her whole face lights up with glee."

rows.raw: "\n\n“Sounds like fun.” You meaningfully twiddle the radio in your pocket. “I’ll be there.”"

rows.original: “Awesome. Change is coming - I promise!” She twists away and into the crowd, losing herself in the sea of bodies before you can even ask her name.
rows.translation: “太棒了。改变就要来了——我保证！”她转身钻入人群，消失在身体组成的海洋里，快得让你连名字都来不及问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Awesome. Change is coming - I promise!” She twists away and into the crowd, losing herself in the sea of bodies before you can even ask her name."

rows.original: You stick out the rest of the rally, but nothing else of note happens. Aside from your crimson-bedecked friend, none of the golds seem truly, violently committed to any cause, paying lip service to ideals that wouldn’t survive first contact with reality.
rows.translation: 你留到集会结束，却没有发生其他值得注意的事。除了那位披挂猩红的朋友外，没有一个金米尔真正愿意为某种事业诉诸暴力；她们只是嘴上支持那些一旦接触现实便无法存续的理想。

rows.raw: "You key the transmit button on the primitive radio, listening to it pop and hiss as it starts up. To think this passes for state of the art here! Surely they could’ve spent some credits for some decent communicators."

rows.raw: "\n\nWhatever your reservations about the reporting method, you soon find yourself relaying information on a possible rebel cell to Irellia’s security forces. They thank you for report and close the connection without any fanfare."

rows.original: Irellia paces around you, nodding. “This could actually work...” She snaps her fingers, summoning an attendant with a primitive two-way radio. “Use this radio to call my security forces once you find the red sympathizers. They’ll take care of the rest.” Two of her hands fall on your shoulders, kneading gently. “And after? After you can have a private audience, if you like... and the credits, of course. Twenty thousand.”
rows.translation: 伊蕾莉娅绕着你踱步，边走边点头。“这或许可行...”她打了个响指，召来一名拿着原始双向无线电的侍从。“找到红方同情者后，用这台无线电呼叫我的安保部队。剩下的由她们处理。”她的两只手落在你肩上，轻柔地揉捏。“之后呢？之后你可以获得一次私人觐见，如果你愿意...当然，还有信用点。两万。”
rows.raw: "\n\nIrellia paces around you, nodding. “This could actually work...” She snaps her fingers, summoning an attendant with a primitive two-way radio. “Use this radio to call my security forces once you find the red sympathizers. They’ll take care of the rest.” Two of her hands fall on your shoulders, kneading gently. “And after? After you can have a private audience, if you like... and the credits, of course. Twenty thousand.”"

rows.original: Scalla actually giggles at that, and you find yourself wondering just how old these ‘queens’ actually are. An experienced head of state would not giggle quite so girlishly.
rows.translation: 斯卡拉听后竟咯咯笑了起来，让你不禁怀疑这些“女王”究竟有多大年纪。一位经验丰富的国家元首可不会笑得如此少女气。

rows.original: “Come on, Irellia, let us finish our council and let the star-walker take to [pc.hisHer] task. You can have all the private audiences you want once our children are safe.” Scalla smiles knowingly at you and Irellia.
rows.translation: “行了，伊蕾莉娅，让我们结束议事，让星行者去执行[pc.hisHer]的任务吧。等我们的孩子安全以后，你想要多少次私人觐见都行。”斯卡拉意味深长地朝你和伊蕾莉娅微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Come on, Irellia, let us finish our council and let the star-walker take to [pc.hisHer] task. You can have all the private audiences you want once our children are safe.” Scalla smiles knowingly at you and Irellia."

rows.original: The busty gold and blue queen pushes you away with a confusing mixture of gentleness and force. Her naked breasts jiggle outlandishly, drizzling honey-like nectar down her front. “Of course, sister. See you around... [pc.name].” She winks and returns to her conversation. Neither seems to pay you any further mind.
rows.translation: 这位丰满的金蓝色女王以一种温柔与强硬交织的方式将你推开。她赤裸的乳房夸张地晃动着，蜂蜜般的蜜液沿胸前滴淌。“当然，姐妹。回头见...[pc.name]。”她眨眨眼，回去继续交谈。两人似乎都不再理会你。

Her naked breasts jiggle outlandishly, drizzling honey-like nectar down her front. “Of course, sister. See you around... [pc.name].” She winks and returns to her conversation. Neither seems to pay you any further mind."

rows.original: A few guards eye you warily as you approach, but they do not try to bar your progress. Meanwhile, a smaller female myr scuttles past holding a freshly laid egg. The queens pay her no mind, continuing their discussion without pause, a lone birthing not worthy of comment.

rows.original: You take the chance to get a good look at them. They all share the same gigantic stature, necessary, you assume, to support their four bulging breasts and immense, egg-swollen abdomens. Every inch of them radiates a sort of royal poise, perched atop the knowing sensuality that can only come from frequent, repeated breeding. You see why the myr call them queens.
rows.translation: 你趁机仔细打量她们。她们都有同样高大的身材；你猜，这种体格是支撑四只隆起的乳房与因卵而胀大的巨腹所必需的。她们每一寸身体都散发着一种皇家气度，又建立在只有频繁反复交配才能形成的老练性感之上。你明白米尔为何称她们为女王了。

rows.original: “...oundries aren’t producing nearly enough. If the reds push agai-” The speaker cuts off, noticing your appearance. She takes a second to regard you, and you her. She doesn’t wear a single scrap of clothing, just jewelry - lots and lots of jewelry. Her hair is bound up in a gem-encrusted tiara, her four arms covered in jingling bangles. No part of her body is free of ornamentation; even her nipples are decked out in gleaming shields anchored by glittering piercings. When she speaks, it is as imperious as it is demanding. “Who invited you to this discussion?”
rows.translation: “...造厂的产量远远不够。如果红方再次进——”说话者注意到你的出现，戛然而止。她花了一秒打量你，你也在打量她。她身上一丝衣物也没有，只有珠宝——数不清的珠宝。头发盘在一顶镶满宝石的冠冕里，四条手臂上戴满叮当作响的手镯。她身体没有任何一处未受装饰；甚至乳头也套着闪亮的护罩，由璀璨的穿孔饰品固定。她开口时，语气既傲慢又强势。“是谁邀请你参加这场讨论的？”

rows.original: “Lay off, Marsail. Can’t you see [pc.heShe]’s an off-worlder? Their stations are not as easy to determine as our own. This one could rule a planet for all we know. Their ways are strange.” The speaker nods in your direction. She is as naked as her compatriot, though her chitin is painted in brilliant blue. Even her lips are decorated to match. It makes for a striking contrast with the orange-gold of her skin.
rows.translation: “别这样，玛塞尔。你看不出[pc.heShe]是外星人吗？他们的身份不像我们这样容易判断。说不定这位统治着一整颗星球。他们的做派确实奇怪。”说话者朝你点头示意。她和同伴一样赤裸，不过甲壳被涂成亮丽的蓝色，连嘴唇也装饰得与之相配。这与她橙金色的皮肤形成了醒目的对比。

rows.original: Marsail shrugs nonchalantly, sending her jewelry jangling. “Whatever you say, your highness. It is no business of mine if you wish to sabotage your council standing over this piece of... riff raff.” The jeweled queen turns to leave, her pregnancy-bloated abdomen dragging behind her. Similarly ornamented attendants chase after her, ready to collect any eggs that her journey might dislodge.
rows.translation: 玛塞尔满不在乎地耸耸肩，带得珠宝叮当作响。“随你吧，殿下。如果你想为了这块...乌合之众毁掉自己在议会中的地位，那也不关我的事。”珠光宝气的女王转身离开，因怀孕而胀大的腹部拖在身后。佩戴着相似饰品的侍从们紧随其后，随时准备接住她在途中可能排出的卵。

Similarly ornamented attendants chase after her, ready to collect any eggs that her journey might dislodge."

rows.original: Sighing heavily, the silk-clad queen turns her attention down to you. “Forgive Marsail. She’s still coming to terms with the idea of our own relative insignificance. Just a month ago, we saw ourselves as the greatest power and authority in all the cosmos. Now we must contend with aliens and their unimaginably advanced technology. It is quite a lot to take in.”
rows.translation: 身披丝绸的女王重重叹息，将注意力转向下方的你。“请原谅玛塞尔。她仍在努力接受我们其实无足轻重这个事实。就在一个月前，我们还把自己视作整个宇宙中最强大的力量与最高权威。如今却不得不面对外星人及其先进到难以想象的科技。要消化这些实在不容易。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSighing heavily, the silk-clad queen turns her attention down to you. “Forgive Marsail. She’s still coming to terms with the idea of our own relative insignificance. Just a month ago, we saw ourselves as the greatest power and authority in all the cosmos. Now we must contend with aliens and their unimaginably advanced technology. It is quite a lot to take in.”"

rows.original: Queen Irellia agrees, “Yes, quite a lot has changed. Do not let Marsail’s foul mood sully your opinion of us. We are pleased to make your acquaintance, [pc.name] Steele. If only our meeting occurred in fairer times.”
rows.translation: 伊蕾莉娅女王表示赞同：“是的，许多事都变了。别让玛塞尔的坏心情影响你对我们的看法。很高兴认识你，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。只可惜我们的会面没有发生在更太平的时期。”
rows.raw: "\n\nQueen Irellia agrees, “Yes, quite a lot has changed. Do not let Marsail’s foul mood sully your opinion of us. We are pleased to make your acquaintance, [pc.name] Steele. If only our meeting occurred in fairer times.”"

rows.original: The robed myr queen gives a soft, sad chuckle at that.
rows.translation: 身披长袍的米尔女王闻言轻轻发出一声悲伤的低笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe robed myr queen gives a soft, sad chuckle at that."

rows.original: Queen Irellia shakes her head, holding one of her uppermost hands against her forehead. “Would that it were so simple, [pc.name]. Just because the bombs and bullets have stopped falling does not mean that hostilities have ceased. Even now, agents of the Scarlet Federation stalk our streets in secret, enacting a campaign of fire and terror against our most peaceful citizens.” She gestures to the other remaining royal. “Queen Scalla’s sons and daughters have endured four separate bombings over the past week.”
rows.translation: 伊蕾莉娅女王摇摇头，将最上方的一只手按在额头上。“要是真有那么简单就好了，[pc.name]。炸弹和子弹不再落下，并不意味着敌意已经消失。即使此刻，猩红联邦的特工仍在暗中潜行于我们的街道，对最和平的市民发动纵火与恐怖行动。”她朝另一位留下的王族示意。“斯卡拉女王的儿女在过去一周已经遭受四次爆炸袭击。”
rows.raw: "\n\nQueen Irellia shakes her head, holding one of her uppermost hands against her forehead. “Would that it were so simple, [pc.name]. Just because the bombs and bullets have stopped falling does not mean that hostilities have ceased. Even now, agents of the Scarlet Federation stalk our streets in secret, enacting a campaign of fire and terror against our most peaceful citizens.” She gestures to the other remaining royal. “Queen Scalla’s sons and daughters have endured four separate bombings over the past week.”"

rows.original: Scalla pulls her finely woven silks closer about herself. “That is correct. I fear they may be targeting the younger, less secure queens, like Irellia, Marsail, and myself.”
rows.translation: 斯卡拉将织工精美的丝绸在身上拢得更紧。“没错。我担心她们正在针对像伊蕾莉娅、玛塞尔和我这样更年轻、防卫更薄弱的女王。”
rows.raw: "\n\nScalla pulls her finely woven silks closer about herself. “That is correct. I fear they may be targeting the younger, less secure queens, like Irellia, Marsail, and myself.”"

rows.original: You shrug and ask why you should care. Irellia smirks at you. “Because, star-walker, Lyralla has shared her thoughts on your kind with us. Even if honor and justice did not motivate you, the potential for coin would.” Her sapphire lipstick glitters as her smile broadens. “We could help each other.”
rows.translation: 你耸耸肩，问自己为何要在意。 伊蕾莉娅朝你坏笑。“因为，星行者，莱拉拉已经与我们分享过她对你们一族的看法。即使荣誉与正义无法驱使你，金钱的诱惑也可以。”她的蓝宝石色唇膏随着笑容扩大而闪闪发亮。“我们可以互相帮助。”
rows.raw: " You shrug and ask why you should care. Irellia smirks at you. “Because, star-walker, Lyralla has shared her thoughts on your kind with us. Even if honor and justice did not motivate you, the potential for coin would.” Her sapphire lipstick glitters as her smile broadens. “We could help each other.”"

rows.original: You look between them. No matter how black and unreadable their eyes may seem, they still manage to convey a sort of quiet desperation. Irellia explains, “Our security forces appear incapable of ending this. An outsider like yourself might be more successful than our own daughters.” As an afterthought, she adds, “I... we could pay you. What do you say?”
rows.translation: 你在她们之间来回打量。无论她们漆黑的双眼看起来多么难以解读，仍传达出一种无声的绝望。 伊蕾莉娅解释道：“我们的安保部队似乎无法终结此事。像你这样的外来者，或许会比我们的女儿更成功。”像是事后才想到，她又补充：“我...我们可以付钱给你。你意下如何？”

rows.original: “Super nice to meet you ladies! You can call me [pc.name] Steele, or just [pc.name]. It’s way easier to remember and stuff!” You pause, trying to recall what else you were going to say. “Oh yeah, I was just stopping in to like, say hi and see how everyone is doing, what with the war... and uh... war.” Marsail scowls. “Useless and empty headed.”
rows.translation: “超级高兴见到你们，女士们！你们可以叫我[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，或者就叫[pc.name]。这样好记多了什么的！”你顿了顿，努力回想自己还想说什么。“哦，对了，我就是顺路过来打个招呼，看看大家现在怎么样，毕竟战争...还有，呃...战争。” 玛塞尔皱起眉头。“没用又没脑子。”
rows.raw: "“Super nice to meet you ladies! You can call me [pc.name] Steele, or just [pc.name]. It’s way easier to remember and stuff!” You pause, trying to recall what else you were going to say. “Oh yeah, I was just stopping in to like, say hi and see how everyone is doing, what with the war... and uh... war.”\n\nMarsail scowls. “Useless and empty headed.”"

rows.original: “My name is [pc.name] Steele, and I thought it would be wise to seek out the city’s leadership to see how the war has been affecting Gildenmere.” You bow formally. “I did not mean any rudeness, I assure you.” Marsail folds her arms across her bust, scowling. “Intended or not, you are rude and unwelcome.”
rows.translation: “我叫[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。我认为拜访城市的领导者、了解战争对吉尔登米尔造成的影响才是明智之举。”你正式地鞠了一躬。“我无意冒犯，我向你保证。” 玛塞尔抱起双臂压在胸前，皱着眉头。“不管是否有意，你都很无礼，也不受欢迎。”
rows.raw: "“My name is [pc.name] Steele, and I thought it would be wise to seek out the city’s leadership to see how the war has been affecting Gildenmere.” You bow formally. “I did not mean any rudeness, I assure you.”\n\nMarsail folds her arms across her bust, scowling. “Intended or not, you are rude and unwelcome.”"

rows.original: “You can call me [pc.name] Steele, or just [pc.name] if it suits your fancy. I was just dropping by to say hi and get a feel for how the city was faring, but if I offended you, I don’t think I could’ve found a prettier woman to offend.” You bat your eyelashes as charmingly as you can manage. Marsail laughs. “Flattery does not make your impertinence less odious, [pc.name].”
rows.translation: “你可以叫我[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，或者如果你喜欢，直接叫[pc.name]也行。我只是顺路来打个招呼，看看城里的情况；不过，如果非得冒犯谁，我想自己找不到比你更漂亮的女人了。”你竭力迷人地眨眨眼。 玛塞尔笑了。“奉承不会让你的无礼变得没那么可憎，[pc.name]。”
rows.raw: "“You can call me [pc.name] Steele, or just [pc.name] if it suits your fancy. I was just dropping by to say hi and get a feel for how the city was faring, but if I offended you, I don’t think I could’ve found a prettier woman to offend.” You bat your eyelashes as charmingly as you can manage.\n\nMarsail laughs. “Flattery does not make your impertinence less odious, [pc.name].”"

rows.original: “I’m [pc.name] Steele. I was just trying to get a feel for the city and its populace. I guess I didn’t plan on having such a royal pain in my ass.” You glare at Marsail. rows.original: “Why are you so rude?” You gesture at Marsail while the assembled myr gasp. “Your city is perched on the edge of annihilation, and the only thing keeping it from tipping into nonexistence is the UGC’s good graces.” You shrug disarmingly and turn away, making to leave. “A single [pc.raceShort] with a decent starship could wipe out one of your armies in an afternoon. It’d be a shame if potential allies left after being so ill treated - potential allies like [pc.name] Steele.” A hand falls on your shoulder, stopping you. Maybe you managed to talk some sense into these royal twits. “You are as uncouth as you are impertinent. You are lucky we stand in house Uldred. Such slanderous speech would see you serving in a punishment detail if we stood in Nil’dor.” Marsail’s razor-edged scowl could cut glass.
rows.translation: “你为什么如此无礼？”你指向玛赛尔，周围聚集的米尔人纷纷倒吸一口凉气。“你们的城市正处在毁灭边缘，唯一阻止它坠入虚无的，是联合银河邦联的善意。”你无害地耸了耸肩，转身作势要走。“只要一个拥有像样星舰的[pc.raceShort]，一个下午就能消灭你们的一支军队。若潜在盟友因为受到这般恶劣对待而离开，那就太遗憾了，比如[pc.name]·斯蒂尔这样的潜在盟友。” 一只手落在你的肩上，拦住了你。也许你总算让这些王室蠢货听进了一点道理。 “你的粗野与你的傲慢不相上下。你该庆幸我们身处乌尔德雷德家族的地盘。若是在尼尔多，如此诽谤之言足以让你被编入惩戒队服役。”玛赛尔锋利如刃的怒视仿佛能割开玻璃。

rows.original: Scalla’s eyes twinkle knowingly as she separates from you. “She offered you a private audience, did she not? You are welcome in her chambers, now and in the future, should you wish her council. The events of the day have wearied her greatly.” A knowing, all too confident look spreads across her face. “For all your science and technology, you miss so many obvious things. Standing erect like this can be difficult for a queen. The eldest among us cannot even carry themselves, so large are their abdomens. Irellia means you no disrespect.”
rows.translation: 斯卡拉与你分开时，眼中闪烁着心照不宣的光芒。“她曾邀请你私下会面，不是吗？若你希望听取她的意见，现在以及今后都可以前往她的寝宫。今天发生的事情让她疲惫不堪。”她脸上浮现出一个了然而又过分自信的神情。“尽管你们拥有如此发达的科学技术，却仍会错过许多显而易见的事情。像这样直立站着对女王而言可能很困难。我们当中最年长者的腹部过于庞大，甚至无法自行移动。伊蕾莉娅无意怠慢你。”
