Half the guys you’d meet on his sites were his agents, see, and they’d scout out unsuspecting kids and spike the drinks of the prettiest ones. Next thing they know, they’re in a stockade being marched on stage for rich perverts to bid on.”
rows.translation: “没那么贵，”暗影眼中闪过一丝狡黠。“尤其是当你从一个在罗莎某颗卫星上活动的人渣奴隶贩子手里把它没收过来时。那个富有又傲慢的混蛋公然活动，把自己伪装成投资星网约会产业的亿万富翁。你在他网站上遇到的男人有一半都是他的手下；他们会物色毫无戒心的年轻人，再往最漂亮的那些人的酒里下药。等他们恢复意识，就已经被关进围栏，押上舞台供有钱的变态竞价了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not that bad,” Shade says with a mischievous glint in her eyes. “Especially when you claim it off of some sleazebag slaver operating off of one of Rosha’s moons. Rich, arrogant bastard operated right in the limelight, playing off as some kind of billionaire investor in extranet dating. Half the guys you’d meet on his sites were his agents, see, and they’d scout out unsuspecting kids and spike the drinks of the prettiest ones. Next thing they know, they’re in a stockade being marched on stage for rich perverts to bid on.”"

rows.original: “One of his goons picked the wrong girl, though: a pretty twenty-something that happened to be the daughter of Pyrite’s last president who’d lied about who she was on her profile. You can imagine the size of the reward that went out for her safe return... and the bounty for the fella who took her. Had to beat some answers out of her crooked date, and do a little hacking on the side, but I figured out what was going on before long.”
rows.translation: “不过，他有个手下挑错了姑娘：那是个二十来岁的漂亮女孩，碰巧是黄铁矿工业上一任总裁的女儿，只是在个人资料里隐瞒了身份。你可以想象，为了让她安全回来开出了多高的报酬...还有抓住绑架她的家伙能领到多高的赏金。我不得不从她那个卑鄙的约会对象嘴里揍出答案，顺便还做了点黑客工作，不过没多久我就弄清楚了情况。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“One of his goons picked the wrong girl, though: a pretty twenty-something that happened to be the daughter of Pyrite’s last president who’d lied about who she was on her profile. You can imagine the size of the reward that went out for her safe return... and the bounty for the fella who took her. Had to beat some answers out of her crooked date, and do a little hacking on the side, but I figured out what was going on before long.”"

rows.original: You cock an eyebrow. “Hacking?”
rows.translation: 你扬起一边眉毛。“黑客工作？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou cock an eyebrow. “Hacking?”"

rows.original: “What?” Shade says, scowling, “Just because I’m not a cutesy nerd with a comp-sci degree doesn’t mean I don’t know my way around a computer. Hell, half my job is tracking people down on the ‘net. Saves a lot of time versus beating the streets, especially between planets. I’m no master hacker like my mother was, but I can do a little computer wizardry.”
rows.translation: “怎么？”暗影皱起眉头说道，“我不是那种拿着计算机科学学位的可爱书呆子，不代表我不懂电脑。见鬼，我一半的工作都是在网上追踪别人。这比在街头四处打听省时多了，尤其是跨行星的时候。我不像我母亲那样是黑客大师，不过也会一点电脑魔法。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What?” Shade says, scowling, “Just because I’m not a cutesy nerd with a comp-sci degree doesn’t mean I don’t know my way around a computer. Hell, half my job is tracking people down on the ‘net. Saves a lot of time versus beating the streets, especially between planets. I’m no master hacker like my mother was, but I can do a little computer wizardry.”"

rows.original: “So I hacked my way into the site, figured out what was going down and who owned the thing. Turns out he had a gala going on that night, a charity thing to ‘raise awareness for the victims of cybercrime.’ What a crock. So naturally I invited myself, found the host, and batted my eyelashes at him until I was tumbling onto his yacht with my skirts falling off faster than I could blink. Lucky me, he didn’t find the stun gun slung on my thigh till after he locked us in his cabin.”
rows.translation: “于是我黑进了那个网站，弄清楚他们在搞什么、幕后老板是谁。原来那天晚上他正要举行一场晚宴，号称是为了‘提高人们对网络犯罪受害者的关注’而办的慈善活动。真是胡扯。所以我自然不请自来，找到主人，对他眨了几下眼；转眼间，我就跌跌撞撞上了他的游艇，裙子脱得比眨眼还快。幸运的是，直到他把我们锁进船舱后，他才发现绑在我大腿上的电击枪。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So I hacked my way into the site, figured out what was going down and who owned the thing. Turns out he had a gala going on that night, a charity thing to ‘raise awareness for the victims of cybercrime.’ What a crock. So naturally I invited myself, found the host, and batted my eyelashes at him until I was tumbling onto his yacht with my skirts falling off faster than I could blink. Lucky me, he didn’t find the stun gun slung on my thigh till after he locked us in his cabin.”"

rows.original: You laugh as Shade makes an exaggerated “ZAP” sound. “After that, well, let’s say I have my ways of making a naked, horny, and very confused kaithrit boy talk. Once I had a confession, I steered his ship right to his holding pens and saved the girl, all chivalrous like. I left the creep buck naked in his own slave pens for the cops to pick up. Not that there was much left of him by the time they got there.”
rows.translation: 暗影夸张地发出一声“滋啦”，逗得你笑了起来。“之后嘛，只能说，我自有办法让一个赤身裸体、欲火焚身又晕头转向的凯斯瑞特男孩开口。有了口供后，我直接把他的船开到关押奴隶的围场，像个骑士一样救出了那姑娘。我把那个混蛋一丝不挂地留在他自己的奴隶围栏里，等警察来收拾。不过等警察赶到时，他也没剩下多少了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou laugh as Shade makes an exaggerated “ZAP” sound. “After that, well, let’s say I have my ways of making a naked, horny, and very confused kaithrit boy talk. Once I had a confession, I steered his ship right to his holding pens and saved the girl, all chivalrous like. I left the creep buck naked in his own slave pens for the cops to pick up. Not that there was much left of him by the time they got there.”"

rows.original: Sounds like a happy ending
rows.translation: 听起来结局皆大欢喜
rows.raw: "Sounds like a happy ending"

rows.original: Sounds like he got what he deserved
rows.translation: 听起来他罪有应得
rows.raw: "Sounds like he got what he deserved"

rows.original: ,” you chuckle.
rows.translation: ，”你轻笑道。
rows.raw: ",” you chuckle."

rows.original: “More than you know. And let’s just say my new ship’s pleasure suite got plenty broken in before I got the girl back to her folks,” Shade says with a proud grin.
rows.translation: “你知道的还不止这些。只能说，在我把那姑娘送回家人身边之前，我的新船那间享乐套房已经被彻底开了苞，”暗影骄傲地笑道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“More than you know. And let’s just say my new ship’s pleasure suite got plenty broken in before I got the girl back to her folks,” Shade says with a proud grin."

rows.original: “So, you have any family, Shade? Other than Astra, that is.”
rows.translation: “所以，暗影，你还有家人吗？我是说，除了阿斯特拉以外。”
rows.raw: "“So, you have any family, Shade? Other than Astra, that is.”"

rows.original: “Everybody’s got family,” she chuckles. “I didn’t just grow out of a pod, you know.”
rows.translation: “人人都有家人，”她轻笑道。“你知道，我又不是从荚舱里长出来的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Everybody’s got family,” she chuckles. “I didn’t just grow out of a pod, you know.” "

rows.original: You
rows.translation: 你
rows.raw: "\n\nYou"

rows.original: roll your eyes
rows.translation: 翻了翻白眼
rows.raw: " roll your eyes"

rows.original: scowl
rows.translation: 皱起眉头
rows.raw: " scowl"

rows.original: and say that’s not what you mean.
rows.translation: ，说自己不是这个意思。
rows.raw: " and say that’s not what you mean."

rows.original: Shade smirks and leans back, crossing one leg over the other. “Fine, fine. You want to know, then it’s your funeral. Standard sob story: dad didn’t stick around when I was a kid, some rich playboy that seduced my mother. She was a hacker, a real extranet hound, ended up working e-security for CassTech to make ends meet while I was growing up.”
rows.translation: 暗影得意地笑着靠回去，把一条腿搭在另一条腿上。“好吧，好吧。既然你想知道，那就自找罪受吧。老套的悲情故事：我小时候，父亲没留下来；他是个勾引了我母亲的富家公子。她是个黑客，真正的星网猎手；我长大那段时间，她最后在卡斯科技做网络安全工作来维持生计。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShade smirks and leans back, crossing one leg over the other. “Fine, fine. You want to know, then it’s your funeral. Standard sob story: dad didn’t stick around when I was a kid, some rich playboy that seduced my mother. She was a hacker, a real extranet hound, ended up working e-security for CassTech to make ends meet while I was growing up.”"

rows.original: “Was,” Shade confirms. “Mom passed a couple years ago. Anyway, never knew my dad, but I didn’t miss him. My mother was a good woman, more than enough parent for me. Heh, I hope I was half as good a mom as she was... but I guess I know better.”
rows.translation: “曾经是，”暗影确认道。“妈妈几年前去世了。总之，我从没认识父亲，不过也不想念他。我母亲是个好女人，一个人就足以当好我的父母。嘿，我希望自己当母亲时能有她一半好...不过我想我心里清楚，自己并没有。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Was,” Shade confirms. “Mom passed a couple years ago. Anyway, never knew my dad, but I didn’t miss him. My mother was a good woman, more than enough parent for me. Heh, I hope I was half as good a mom as she was... but I guess I know better.”"

rows.original: Shade chuckles, then sighs. “I had my baby girl when I was real young. Barely past eighteen -- probably the only time my mom threatened to kill me. And I got plenty of shit bringing her up, too, since she’s half-ausar to boot. Between being so young, and having a job that kept me on the road... I wasn’t around as much as I’d have liked. Left most of the raising part to the Stormguard temple whenever I was off-world.”
rows.translation: 暗影轻笑一声，接着叹了口气。“我很年轻时就生下了女儿。刚过十八岁——那大概是我妈妈唯一一次威胁要杀了我。而且把她养大也让我吃了不少苦头，毕竟她还是半个奥萨人。我当时太年轻，工作又让我一直在外奔波...我陪在她身边的时间远没有自己希望的那么多。每当我要离开星球时，大多都是把她交给风暴卫士神殿抚养。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShade chuckles, then sighs. “I had my baby girl when I was real young. Barely past eighteen -- probably the only time my mom threatened to kill me. And I got plenty of shit bringing her up, too, since she’s half-ausar to boot. Between being so young, and having a job that kept me on the road... I wasn’t around as much as I’d have liked. Left most of the raising part to the Stormguard temple whenever I was off-world.”"

rows.original: Curious, you ask if Shade wouldn’t mind talking a little more about Astra’s father.
rows.translation: 你有些好奇，问暗影是否介意再多谈一点阿斯特拉的父亲。
rows.raw: "\n\nCurious, you ask if Shade wouldn’t mind talking a little more about Astra’s father."

rows.original: Shade flashes you a grin. “Her other mother you mean. Her sire, as terms go these days. Met her when I was just starting out in the hunter business; she was leading a crew of construction drones on a kaithrit colony, and they’d turned up my next lead while excavating: a body, buried in the jungle. Nasty business. She was older than me, and bigger, but just enough to take the lead and buy me a drink the next time I talked to her. One thing led to another, as they say, and by the time I’d brought in my quarry I was starting to show. One night, one time, without protection and look what happens. Still, I wouldn’t change a thing... I love my little girl and, I’ll be honest, I see her sire from time to time. We stay friends, though she was too much of a play-girl to commit more than that. Has a trail of bastards behind her other than mine, I hear.”
rows.translation: 莎德冲你咧嘴一笑。“你是说她的另一位母亲。照现在的说法，是她的生父。我刚开始干猎人这行时遇见了她；当时她正带着一队工程无人机在一个凯斯瑞特殖民地作业，他们挖掘时发现了我的下一条线索：一具埋在丛林里的尸体。真是桩棘手的差事。她比我年长，个头也更大，不过也只大到足以占据主动，还说好下次和我聊时请我喝一杯。就像人们常说的，一件事引出了另一件事，等我抓到猎物时，肚子已经开始显怀了。就一个晚上，一次没做防护，结果你也看到了。不过，我不会想改变任何事...我爱我的小姑娘，而且老实说，我偶尔还会见她的生父。我们一直是朋友，只是她太爱玩了，不肯作出更多承诺。听说除了我的孩子，她身后还留着一长串私生子。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShade flashes you a grin. “Her other mother you mean. Her sire, as terms go these days. Met her when I was just starting out in the hunter business; she was leading a crew of construction drones on a kaithrit colony, and they’d turned up my next lead while excavating: a body, buried in the jungle. Nasty business. She was older than me, and bigger, but just enough to take the lead and buy me a drink the next time I talked to her. One thing led to another, as they say, and by the time I’d brought in my quarry I was starting to show. One night, one time, without protection and look what happens. Still, I wouldn’t change a thing... I love my little girl and, I’ll be honest, I see her sire from time to time. We stay friends, though she was too much of a play-girl to commit more than that. Has a trail of bastards behind her other than mine, I hear.”"

rows.original: “Amara? Well, you’ve met her,” Shade chuckles, leaning back and rubbing at her tail’s crown. “She’s a huge bruiser of an ausar, bigger and taller and older than I am. Enough to take the lead when I met her, all those years ago... in more ways than one. For a woman as beautiful as she is, sure has a dominant streak. Must be what makes her such a great pirate lord.”
rows.translation: “阿玛拉？你已经见过她了，”莎德轻笑着向后靠去，揉了揉尾巴根部。“她是个体格魁梧得吓人的奥萨，块头比我更大、身高比我更高，年纪也比我大。多年前我们相遇时，足以占据主导...而且可不止一种意义上的主导。以她那样的美貌，却偏偏有那么强的支配欲。或许正是这一点让她成了那么出色的海盗领主。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Amara? Well, you’ve met her,” Shade chuckles, leaning back and rubbing at her tail’s crown. “She’s a huge bruiser of an ausar, bigger and taller and older than I am. Enough to take the lead when I met her, all those years ago... in more ways than one. For a woman as beautiful as she is, sure has a dominant streak. Must be what makes her such a great pirate lord.”"

rows.original: She laughs, then looks you in the eye. “You want to get to know her, you’ll have to talk to her again. Who knows -- if I put in a good word, she might not shoot you on sight.”
rows.translation: 她笑了笑，随后直视你的双眼。“你想了解她，就得再去和她谈谈。谁知道呢——要是我替你说几句好话，她也许不会一见面就开枪打你。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe laughs, then looks you in the eye. “You want to get to know her, you’ll have to talk to her again. Who knows -- if I put in a good word, she might not shoot you on sight.”"

rows.original: You can tell she’s teasing, but the subtle threat isn’t lost on you. You didn’t make any friends that day on Myrellion
rows.translation: 你看得出她是在开玩笑，但其中隐约的威胁意味也没有逃过你的耳朵。那天在米雷利昂，你可没交到什么朋友
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can tell she’s teasing, but the subtle threat isn’t lost on you. You didn’t make any friends that day on Myrellion"

rows.original: , even if you did turn on Kara in the end
rows.translation: ，即使你最后确实倒戈背叛了卡拉
rows.raw: ", even if you did turn on Kara in the end"

rows.original: . For the moment, though, you ask if Shade has anything she’d be willing to share nonetheless.
rows.translation: 。不过眼下，你还是问莎德有没有什么愿意透露的事情。
rows.raw: ". For the moment, though, you ask if Shade has anything she’d be willing to share nonetheless."

rows.original: “Hm. Alright, I’ll bite. What’s the harm? As far as she’s told me, Amara’s the granddaughter of one of the Void’s founders. Aldus or Aedus or something like that. Real big badass from centuries ago, made a fortune in the early Rushes. Practically established his own empire, the way Amara tells it. No idea who her parents are, though; never mentioned ‘em. At this point I assume she popped out of her grandpa’s head like Athena. She commanded a warship for a bit, a heavy cruiser, around the time I met her first. Masquerades as some kinda construction crew while she scouts out planets and ships to raid -- ‘course I didn’t know that then.”
rows.translation: “嗯。好吧，我就说说看。能有什么坏处？据她告诉我的，阿玛拉是黑暗虚空某位创始人的孙女。叫什么阿尔杜斯，或是艾杜斯之类的。几个世纪前了不得的大人物，在早期的星球淘金潮中发了大财。照阿玛拉的说法，他几乎建立了自己的帝国。不过她父母是谁，我完全不知道；她从没提过。到这个地步，我只能假定她像雅典娜一样，是从她爷爷脑袋里蹦出来的。我们初次见面前后，她指挥过一艘战舰，一艘重型巡洋舰。她会伪装成某种施工队，同时侦察可供劫掠的星球和飞船——当然，那时我并不知道。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hm. Alright, I’ll bite. What’s the harm? As far as she’s told me, Amara’s the granddaughter of one of the Void’s founders. Aldus or Aedus or something like that. Real big badass from centuries ago, made a fortune in the early Rushes. Practically established his own empire, the way Amara tells it. No idea who her parents are, though; never mentioned ‘em. At this point I assume she popped out of her grandpa’s head like Athena. She commanded a warship for a bit, a heavy cruiser, around the time I met her first. Masquerades as some kinda construction crew while she scouts out planets and ships to raid -- ‘course I didn’t know that then.”"

rows.original: Shade didn’t know Amara was a pirate when they first got together?
rows.translation: 莎德第一次和阿玛拉上床时，并不知道她是海盗？
rows.raw: "\n\nShade didn’t know Amara was a pirate when they first got together?"

rows.original: She snorts. “God, no. Never woulda touched her if I had. When we met, she was a smooth-talking, confident amazon. A real hunk of ausar. Heh, she knew how to treat a girl right, too... but no, I didn’t know. Just about had a heart attack when I found out... when I was seven months pregnant. Came this close to shooting her; instead, I made a choice for my baby girl. I guess it was the right one -- she loves Amara, and I wouldn’t deprive her of that for the world.”
rows.translation: 她哼了一声。“老天，当然不知道。我要是知道，绝不会碰她。我们相遇时，她是个能说会道、自信十足的女战士。一个货真价实的奥萨猛女。嘿，她也很懂得该怎么好好疼爱姑娘...但不，我不知道。发现真相时...我已经怀孕七个月，差点当场心脏病发作。我差一点就开枪打她了；但为了我的宝贝女儿，我作出了选择。我想那是正确的——她爱阿玛拉，而我绝不会为了任何事剥夺她的这份爱。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe snorts. “God, no. Never woulda touched her if I had. When we met, she was a smooth-talking, confident amazon. A real hunk of ausar. Heh, she knew how to treat a girl right, too... but no, I didn’t know. Just about had a heart attack when I found out... when I was seven months pregnant. Came this close to shooting her; instead, I made a choice for my baby girl. I guess it was the right one -- she loves Amara, and I wouldn’t deprive her of that for the world.”"

rows.original: “And before you ask... I worried about the influence Amara would have on our daughter, sure, but when you actually get to know her... she’s a decent woman, all in all. She does things I don’t think even she’s proud of, but when she’s off the clock, Amara’s as amicable and lovely as can be. If she’d just stick around for more than a day or two at a time, I’d almost call her a decent parent. Certainly not a bad influence. Maybe even a better one than I am.”
rows.translation: “免得你问...我当然担心过阿玛拉会给我们的女儿带来什么影响，可等你真正了解她之后...总体而言，她是个不错的女人。她做过一些连自己恐怕都不引以为傲的事，但不工作时，阿玛拉友善又可爱，简直无可挑剔。如果她每次肯多待上一两天，我几乎会称她为称职的家长。她肯定算不上坏榜样。也许甚至比我更称职。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And before you ask... I worried about the influence Amara would have on our daughter, sure, but when you actually get to know her... she’s a decent woman, all in all. She does things I don’t think even she’s proud of, but when she’s off the clock, Amara’s as amicable and lovely as can be. If she’d just stick around for more than a day or two at a time, I’d almost call her a decent parent. Certainly not a bad influence. Maybe even a better one than I am.”"

rows.original: Somehow, you find that hard to believe.
rows.translation: 不知为何，你觉得这很难相信。
rows.raw: "\n\nSomehow, you find that hard to believe."

rows.original: Shade shrugs. “What do you want me to say, kid? I’ll tolerate a pirate in my ranks if it means my daughter gets to grow up happier. It could be a lot worse.”
rows.translation: 莎德耸了耸肩。“你想让我说什么，孩子？只要能让我的女儿成长得更快乐，我可以容忍队伍里有个海盗。事情本可以糟糕得多。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShade shrugs. “What do you want me to say, kid? I’ll tolerate a pirate in my ranks if it means my daughter gets to grow up happier. It could be a lot worse.”"

rows.original: SAEN MET AT THE BAR
rows.raw: "SAEN MET AT THE BAR"

rows.original: “So, you have any family, Shade?”
rows.translation: “那么，莎德，你有什么家人吗？”
rows.raw: "“So, you have any family, Shade?”"

rows.original: “Everybody’s got family,” she chuckles. “I didn’t just grow out of a pod, you know.”
rows.translation: “谁都有家人，”她轻笑道。“你知道，我又不是从荚舱里长出来的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Everybody’s got family,” she chuckles. “I didn’t just grow out of a pod, you know.”"

rows.raw: "\n\nYou "

rows.original: and say that’s not what you mean.
rows.translation: 并说你不是这个意思。
rows.raw: " and say that’s not what you mean."

rows.original: Shade smirks and leans back, crossing one leg over the other. “Fine, fine. You want to know, then it’s your funeral. Standard sob story: dad didn’t stick around when I was a kid, some rich playboy that seduced my mother. She was a hacker, a real extranet hound, ended up working e-security for CassTech to make ends meet while I was growing up.”
rows.translation: 莎德坏笑着向后靠去，翘起一条腿搭在另一条腿上。“好吧，好吧。既然你想知道，那就自找罪受吧。标准的悲情故事：我小时候，父亲没有留下来，是个勾引了我母亲的有钱花花公子。她是个黑客，是个真正的外联网老手。为了在抚养我长大期间维持生计，最后去了卡斯科技做电子安全工作。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShade smirks and leans back, crossing one leg over the other. “Fine, fine. You want to know, then it’s your funeral. Standard sob story: dad didn’t stick around when I was a kid, some rich playboy that seduced my mother. She was a hacker, a real extranet hound, ended up working e-security for CassTech to make ends meet while I was growing up.”"

rows.original: “Was,” Shade confirms. “Mom passed a couple years ago. Anyway, never knew my dad, but I didn’t miss him. My mother was a good woman, more than enough parent for me. Heh, I hope I was half as good a mom as she was.”
rows.translation: “曾经，”莎德确认道。“妈妈几年前去世了。总之，我从没认识过父亲，但也没觉得缺了他。我的母亲是个好女人，一个人就足以给我完整的亲情。嘿，我希望自己能有她一半那么称职。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Was,” Shade confirms. “Mom passed a couple years ago. Anyway, never knew my dad, but I didn’t miss him. My mother was a good woman, more than enough parent for me. Heh, I hope I was half as good a mom as she was.”"

rows.original: You cock an eyebrow, and Shade chuckles. “I was getting to that, but yeah, I’ve got a girl of my own. She’s about your age, I’d guess, maybe a little younger. Had her real early, barely past eighteen - probably the only time my mom threatened to kill me. And I got plenty shit bringing her up, too, since she was half-ausar to boot.”
rows.translation: 你挑起一边眉毛，莎德轻笑起来。“我正要说到那里，不过没错，我有个自己的女儿。我猜她和你差不多大，也许稍微年轻一点。我很早就生下了她，刚过十八岁——那大概是我妈妈唯一一次威胁要杀了我。养大她时我也受了不少罪，尤其她还是个半奥萨。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou cock an eyebrow, and Shade chuckles. “I was getting to that, but yeah, I’ve got a girl of my own. She’s about your age, I’d guess, maybe a little younger. Had her real early, barely past eighteen - probably the only time my mom threatened to kill me. And I got plenty shit bringing her up, too, since she was half-ausar to boot.”"

rows.original: “Her father was an ausar?” you ask
rows.translation: “她父亲是奥萨？”你问道
rows.raw: "\n\n“Her father was an ausar?” you ask"

rows.original: , thinking back to Saendra and suddenly hoping you haven’t accidentally fucked both Shade and her daughter
rows.translation: ，回想起珊德拉，突然希望自己没有稀里糊涂地把莎德和她女儿都睡了
rows.raw: ", thinking back to Saendra and suddenly hoping you haven’t accidentally fucked both Shade and her daughter"

rows.original: Shade flashes you a grin. “Her other mother was, yeah. Met her when I was just starting out in the hunter business; she was leading a crew of construction drones on a kaithrit colony, and they’d turned up my next lead while excavating: a body, buried in the jungle. Nasty business. She was older than me, and bigger, but just enough to take the lead and buy me a drink the next time I talked to her. One thing led to another, as they say, and by the time I’d brought in my quarry I was starting to show. One night, one time, without protection and look what happens. Still, I wouldn’t change a thing... I love my little girl and, I’ll be honest, I see her sire from time to time. We stay close, though she was too much of a play-girl to commit more than that. Has a trail of bastards behind her other than mine, I hear.”
rows.translation: 莎德冲你咧嘴一笑。“她的另一位母亲是奥萨，没错。我刚开始干猎人这行时遇见了她；当时她正带着一队工程无人机在一个凯斯瑞特殖民地作业，他们挖掘时发现了我的下一条线索：一具埋在丛林里的尸体。真是桩棘手的差事。她比我年长，个头也更大，不过也只大到足以占据主动，还说好下次和我聊时请我喝一杯。就像人们常说的，一件事引出了另一件事，等我抓到猎物时，肚子已经开始显怀了。就一个晚上，一次没做防护，结果你也看到了。不过，我不会想改变任何事...我爱我的小姑娘，而且老实说，我偶尔还会见她的生父。我们一直很亲近，只是她太爱玩了，不肯作出更多承诺。听说除了我的孩子，她身后还留着一长串私生子。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShade flashes you a grin. “Her other mother was, yeah. Met her when I was just starting out in the hunter business; she was leading a crew of construction drones on a kaithrit colony, and they’d turned up my next lead while excavating: a body, buried in the jungle. Nasty business. She was older than me, and bigger, but just enough to take the lead and buy me a drink the next time I talked to her. One thing led to another, as they say, and by the time I’d brought in my quarry I was starting to show. One night, one time, without protection and look what happens. Still, I wouldn’t change a thing... I love my little girl and, I’ll be honest, I see her sire from time to time. We stay close, though she was too much of a play-girl to commit more than that. Has a trail of bastards behind her other than mine, I hear.”"

rows.translation: “顺便问一句，你这女儿有名字吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This daughter of yours have a name, by the way?”"

rows.translation: 你追问道，同时在桌子底下交叉手指祈求好运。

rows.translation: 好吧，至少不是珊德拉....

rows.original: “So, what’s up with the lightning motif?” you ask, pointing a finger at the lightning bolts and old-earth runes emblazoned on her blue duster.
rows.translation: “所以，这些闪电图案是怎么回事？”你问道，伸手指向她蓝色防尘大衣上绣着的闪电与古地球符文。
rows.raw: "“So, what’s up with the lightning motif?” you ask, pointing a finger at the lightning bolts and old-earth runes emblazoned on her blue duster."

rows.original: “It’s stylish as fuck, that’s what,” Shade laughs. “Picked the duster up from a leithan girl with the biggest tits I’ve ever seen while I was on New Texas for some, heh, R-and-R a few years back. Biggest lightning storm you’ve ever seen rolled in right after I got there, grounded all craft and tore the ranches up pretty nasty. Apparently it’s a regular thing around there, thanks to the rolling flat plains that stretch out forever. I bought this, stepped outside, and immediately got hit with lightning. I kid you not, two steps from the store and ZAP from heaven. Probably would have roasted me if I hadn’t been wearing this.”
rows.translation: “因为帅得要命，就是这么回事，”莎德笑道。“几年前我去新德州休，嘿，休养度假时，从一个胸部大得前所未见的莱坦姑娘手里买了这件大衣。我刚到不久，就遇上了你见过最猛烈的雷暴，所有飞行器都被迫停飞，牧场也被破坏得很惨。显然那里经常这样，都是那片一望无际、连绵不断的平坦原野造成的。我买下这件衣服，走到外面，立刻就被雷劈了。真没骗你，离商店才两步，天上就啪地劈下一道雷。要不是穿着这个，我大概已经被烤熟了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s stylish as fuck, that’s what,” Shade laughs. “Picked the duster up from a leithan girl with the biggest tits I’ve ever seen while I was on New Texas for some, heh, R-and-R a few years back. Biggest lightning storm you’ve ever seen rolled in right after I got there, grounded all craft and tore the ranches up pretty nasty. Apparently it’s a regular thing around there, thanks to the rolling flat plains that stretch out forever. I bought this, stepped outside, and immediately got hit with lightning. I kid you not, two steps from the store and ZAP from heaven. Probably would have roasted me if I hadn’t been wearing this.”"

rows.original: For emphasis, Shade rubs her knuckles across the smooth surface of the duster, indicating a pretty nasty scorch pattern around the shoulders. “Been a kind of lucky charm ever since. Plus its decent against stun guns and all sorts of zappers. Not too many people carry ‘em, but a little extra protection doesn’t hurt.
rows.translation: 为了强调，莎德用指关节蹭过防尘大衣光滑的表面，示意肩膀周围那片相当骇人的焦痕。“从那以后，它就成了某种幸运护符。而且对电击枪和各种放电武器的防护也不错。带这些东西的人不算多，但多一点防护总没有坏处。
rows.raw: "\n\nFor emphasis, Shade rubs her knuckles across the smooth surface of the duster, indicating a pretty nasty scorch pattern around the shoulders. “Been a kind of lucky charm ever since. Plus its decent against stun guns and all sorts of zappers. Not too many people carry ‘em, but a little extra protection doesn’t hurt."

rows.original: “As for the lightning gun,” she says, drawing the cannon from her hip with deliberate slowness and setting it out on the table between you. Your eyes are drawn instantly to the pattern of faintly-glowing runes engraved along the barrel, matching those on the fringe of her duster and vest. “Lothar Inc. Arc Caster. Experimental prototype I picked up on a job, took it off a target. Supposed to be for crowd control, totally non-lethal, but packs enough charge to burn through shields and knock a target out cold. Best thing about it, though, is the ‘arc’ part. Bolts jump from one target to another, if you aim it right. That got it disqualified from actual police work, but when you’re a solo hunter bagging bastards like I do, it’s a godsend. Solid gun, as long as I don’t run into somebody else with a lightning duster like mine. But I’ve got a six-mil holdout in reserve, just in case.”
rows.translation: “至于这把闪电枪，”她说道，故意缓慢地从腰间拔出那门手炮，放到你们之间的桌面上。你的目光立刻被枪管上那一排微微发光的符文吸引，它们与她防尘大衣和背心边缘的符文如出一辙。“洛萨公司电弧投射器。我在一次任务中从目标身上缴获的实验原型。按设计应该用于人群控制，完全非致命，但储存的电荷足以烧穿护盾，把目标直接电晕。不过它最棒的地方，是‘电弧’这一部分。只要瞄得准，电流就会从一个目标跳到另一个目标。正因如此，它没能通过真正的警用审核；但像我这样单枪匹马抓捕混蛋的猎人用起来，简直是天赐神器。是把可靠的好枪，只要别碰上另一个也穿着我这种闪电大衣的人。不过我还备着一把六毫米袖珍枪，以防万一。”

rows.original: “Suit yourself,” she says, reclining in her chair and waving a waitress over with a couple of drinks. “Have to go way back for this. I was... eighteen, maybe nineteen, just starting out as a bounty hunter. I thought I was at the end of my career, too. Thought my life was over, really. I’d just found out I was pregnant with Astra, her father was nowhere to be found, and my mother was threatening to disown me or kill me or whatever else. It was terrifying at the time.”
rows.translation: “随你便，”她说着靠回椅背，挥手叫来一名端着几杯酒的服务员。“这得从很久以前说起。那时我...十八，也许十九岁，刚开始当赏金猎人。我也以为自己的事业走到头了。说真的，我以为人生已经完了。我刚发现自己怀上了阿斯特拉，她的父亲不知所踪，我母亲还威胁要和我断绝关系、杀了我，或是别的什么。那时真的很可怕。”

I’d just found out I was pregnant with Astra, her father was nowhere to be found, and my mother was threatening to disown me or kill me or whatever else. It was terrifying at the time.”"

Scared shitless, really. Between my mother throwing me out, and the woman I thought was my lover abandoning me, I decided to stow away on a ship and just... leave. I had to get away from home. rows.original: Planet was lousy with them, all heavy-set and snowy-haired. I guess they must have been the main colonists, since there were only a few hundred humans I ever saw. No kaithrit in sight, but then, we tend to colonize in the opposite direction of the Federation if we can. Not much good blood between ausar and kaithrit... heh, says the woman with a half-ausar kid. Sorry, I’m rambling, I know. You wanted to know about these runes, right?
rows.translation: 那颗星球到处都是他们，一个个身材壮实、长着雪白的头发。我猜他们一定是主要殖民者，因为我见过的人类总共也只有几百个。凯斯瑞特倒是一个都没有，不过只要可以，我们本来就倾向于朝联邦相反的方向殖民。奥萨和凯斯瑞特之间可没什么好交情...嘿，瞧这话居然出自一个有半奥萨孩子的女人之口。抱歉，我知道自己扯远了。你是想知道这些符文，对吧？
rows.raw: "Planet was lousy with them, all heavy-set and snowy-haired. I guess they must have been the main colonists, since there were only a few hundred humans I ever saw. Sorry, I’m rambling, I know. You wanted to know about these runes, right?"

They told me the only way I’d ever get off the planet was by joining them, to squeeze through the same legal loopholes they did to exist on an otherwise locked-down world. I figured, ‘what the hell?’, and joined up.

rows.original: . So yeah, I stayed with them. For a couple of years, actually. I had Astra, then went in for their warrior training. When I decided to go, they sent me off with a feast and well wishes, loaded me down with rune-carved gear and presents for my little girl.”
rows.translation: 。所以没错，我留下来了。事实上待了好几年。我生下阿斯特拉，随后接受了他们的战士训练。训练极其艰苦，近乎军事化，完全强调纪律和在压力下保持冷静。我可以告诉你：那让我成为了更优秀的女人，等我再次出发时，也成了更优秀的猎人。等我决定离开，他们设宴为我送行，献上祝福，还让我带走了一大堆刻着符文的装备，以及送给我小女儿的礼物。”

A long duster flows down from around her shoulders, intricately patterned with faintly luminescent blue wires and lightning bolt patterns. The way she’s sitting, you can’t help but notice a heavy looking pistol slung on her hip.
rows.translation: 走近时，你仔细打量她：乍看之下，她就是标准的凯斯丽特猫女，银色头发凌乱地披散在肩头，头顶一对可爱的猫耳从发间探出。她比你在边疆遇到的大多数人年长一些，或许已近四十，举止间带着一种流露丰富阅历的冷峻坚定。长风衣从她肩头垂下，上面织着隐隐发光的蓝色线路与闪电图案。她这样的坐姿，让你无法不注意到她腰间挂着一把看起来沉甸甸的手枪。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take her in as you approach: at a glance, she’s your standard kaithrit cat-girl, with silver hair playing wildly around her shoulders, parted by a pair of cute feline ears atop her head. She’s a bit older than most folk you meet on the frontier, maybe in her late thirties, and holds herself with a grim determination that exudes experience. A long duster flows down from around her shoulders, intricately patterned with faintly luminescent blue wires and lightning bolt patterns. The way she’s sitting, you can’t help but notice a heavy looking pistol slung on her hip."

rows.original: She gives you a small but friendly nod as you approach. A single serpentine tail slithers up from behind her, covered in green scales rather than the usual kaithrit fur and ending in a wet-looking opening.
rows.translation: 你走近时，她友好地微微点头。一条蛇形尾巴从她身后蜿蜒而起，表面覆盖着绿色鳞片，而非凯斯丽特常见的毛皮，末端则是一个湿漉漉的开口。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gives you a small but friendly nod as you approach. A single serpentine tail slithers up from behind her, covered in green scales rather than the usual kaithrit fur and ending in a wet-looking opening."

rows.original: Your cunt-tail twitches at the sight of it, as if it can sense a kindred spirit.
rows.translation: 你的尾穴见状抽动起来，仿佛能感知到同类。
rows.raw: " Your cunt-tail twitches at the sight of it, as if it can sense a kindred spirit."

rows.original: Cunt Snakes
rows.raw: "Cunt Snakes"

rows.original: You can easily recognize an attached cunt snake when you see it.
rows.translation: 你一眼就能认出那是一条附生穴蛇。
rows.raw: " You can easily recognize an attached cunt snake when you see it."

rows.original: What do you do?
rows.translation: 你打算怎么做？
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat do you do? "

rows.original: Trip & Fall
rows.translation: 绊倒摔跤
rows.raw: "Trip & Fall"

rows.original: Kara & Shade
rows.translation: 卡拉与莎德
rows.raw: "Kara & Shade"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You saunter over towards the cat-girl, looking for your opportunity. You find it quickly: a waitress with an over-laden tray of drinks, making her way toward a table full of rowdy looking interstellar miners. You slow your pace, just enough to make sure you’re on a collision course with the overburdened waitress, and let her distraction take its course. She slams face-first into you, giving a startled yelp as her tray of glasses goes flying, crashing into the floor. You intentionally trip yourself over her leg, sending the both of you tumbling down in a wet heap on the deck.
rows.translation: 你漫步朝那名猫女走去，寻找机会。很快，你便发现了目标：一名端着满载饮品托盘的女服务员，正走向一桌看起来十分吵闹的星际矿工。你放慢脚步，恰到好处地确保自己会与不堪重负的服务员撞个正着，然后任由这场干扰自行展开。她一头撞进你怀里，惊叫一声，托盘上的玻璃杯四散飞出，摔在地板上。你故意被她的腿绊倒，让你们两人一同跌倒在甲板上，湿漉漉地叠成一团。
rows.raw: "You saunter over towards the cat-girl, looking for your opportunity. You find it quickly: a waitress with an over-laden tray of drinks, making her way toward a table full of rowdy looking interstellar miners. You slow your pace, just enough to make sure you’re on a collision course with the overburdened waitress, and let her distraction take its course. She slams face-first into you, giving a startled yelp as her tray of glasses goes flying, crashing into the floor. You intentionally trip yourself over her leg, sending the both of you tumbling down in a wet heap on the deck."

rows.original: All eyes in the bar seem to be on you, a quiet hush settling over the place as the sounds of shattering glass reverberate through the bar. “OhmyGodI’msorry!” the waitress babbles in a panic, trying to simultaneously wipe the beer splattered over you up with a rag and collect the couple of mugs still intact. You make a show of rubbing your head, looking dazed and confused, watching the waitress blush in embarrassment, suddenly aware of how many people are staring at the pair of you.
rows.translation: 酒馆里所有人的目光似乎都集中在你身上，玻璃破碎的回声在室内荡开，四周顿时安静下来。“天啊对不起！”女服务员慌乱地连声说道，一边试图用抹布擦掉溅在你身上的啤酒，一边又想捡起那几只尚且完好的酒杯。你装模作样地揉着脑袋，露出晕头转向的神情，看着她尴尬得涨红了脸，猛然意识到有多少人正在盯着你们俩。
rows.raw: "\n\nAll eyes in the bar seem to be on you, a quiet hush settling over the place as the sounds of shattering glass reverberate through the bar. “OhmyGodI’msorry!” the waitress babbles in a panic, trying to simultaneously wipe the beer splattered over you up with a rag and collect the couple of mugs still intact. You make a show of rubbing your head, looking dazed and confused, watching the waitress blush in embarrassment, suddenly aware of how many people are staring at the pair of you."

rows.original: Hopefully Kara got the hint and bugged out already. You look around at the bar full of staring faces, letting your gaze play around the place towards the silver-haired kaithrit hunter. You’ve got her full attention for the moment. Good. With a grunt of effort, you haul yourself to your [pc.feet] and give the embarrassed waitress a hand up, smiling and nodding at her stream of apologies. A quick glance towards the bar shows you a distinct absence of Kara - looks like she did slip out in the momentary confusion.
rows.translation: 希望卡拉领会了你的暗示，已经溜走了。你环顾酒馆里一张张盯着你的脸，视线顺势转向那名银发凯斯丽特猎手。此刻，她的注意力全在你身上。很好。你费力地哼了一声，撑起身体站到[pc.feet]上，又伸手扶起尴尬的服务员，微笑着朝她接连不断的道歉点头。你迅速瞥向吧台，那里已经不见卡拉的身影——看来她确实趁着短暂的混乱溜了出去。
rows.raw: "\n\nHopefully Kara got the hint and bugged out already. You look around at the bar full of staring faces, letting your gaze play around the place towards the silver-haired kaithrit hunter. You’ve got her full attention for the moment. Good. With a grunt of effort, you haul yourself to your [pc.feet] and give the embarrassed waitress a hand up, smiling and nodding at her stream of apologies. A quick glance towards the bar shows you a distinct absence of Kara - looks like she did slip out in the momentary confusion."

rows.original: Except not. You catch a flash of movement in the corner of your eye, turning just in time to see the huntress standing, drawing a big, bulky hand cannon from her belt. Kara’s across the span of the bar from her, twisting in place just in time to avoid an arc of lightning slamming across the bar and blasting into a wall. Kara dives to the side, kicking a table over and drawing a gun from under her cloak.
rows.translation: 然而并没有。眼角捕捉到一闪而过的动静，你及时转身，正看见那名女猎手站起身，从腰带上拔出一把硕大笨重的手炮。卡拉隔着酒馆与她遥遥相对，及时转身避开一道横扫吧台、轰进墙里的电弧。卡拉扑向一旁，踢翻一张桌子，从斗篷下拔出一把枪。
rows.raw: "\n\nExcept not. You catch a flash of movement in the corner of your eye, turning just in time to see the huntress standing, drawing a big, bulky hand cannon from her belt. Kara’s across the span of the bar from her, twisting in place just in time to avoid an arc of lightning slamming across the bar and blasting into a wall. Kara dives to the side, kicking a table over and drawing a gun from under her cloak."

rows.original: “[pc.name], help!” Kara shouts over the din of people running screaming from the bar, flooding out every door in the place. To the other kaithrit, she adds, “Shade! It’s not too late to stop this. We can both walk out of here.”
rows.translation: “[pc.name]，帮忙！”卡拉压过尖叫着逃离酒馆、涌向各个出口的人群喧嚣，大声喊道。她又对另一名凯斯丽特说道：“莎德！现在停手还不算晚。我们都可以活着离开这里。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name], help!” Kara shouts over the din of people running screaming from the bar, flooding out every door in the place. To the other kaithrit, she adds, “Shade! It’s not too late to stop this. We can both walk out of here.”"

rows.original: “You know how this goes, Kara. Cross the Void, and your life’s forfeit,” the silver-haired huntress, Shade, answers.
rows.translation: “你知道规矩，卡拉。背叛黑暗虚空，就得拿命来偿，”银发女猎手莎德回答道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You know how this goes, Kara. Cross the Void, and your life’s forfeit,” the silver-haired huntress, Shade, answers."

rows.original: The Void? As in Black Void? Uh-oh. That’s only the biggest cartel of space pirates and outlaws in the galaxy! And Kara’s managed to get on their bad side? That’s a tall order for one cat. Do you help her?
rows.translation: 虚空？是指黑暗虚空？糟糕。那可是银河系最大的太空海盗与不法之徒集团！卡拉居然惹上了他们？这对一只猫来说可真是个棘手的麻烦。你要帮助她吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Void? As in Black Void? Uh-oh. That’s only the biggest cartel of space pirates and outlaws in the galaxy! And Kara’s managed to get on their bad side? That’s a tall order for one cat. Do you help her?"

rows.original: Yes
rows.translation: 是
rows.raw: "Yes"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Kara & Shade
rows.translation: 卡拉与莎德
rows.raw: "Kara & Shade"

rows.original: You steel yourself and stand, ready to stand beside Kara.
rows.translation: 你下定决心站起身，准备与卡拉并肩作战。
rows.raw: "You steel yourself and stand, ready to stand beside Kara."

rows.original: “You brought friends?” Shade spits, taking a step back and leveling the lightning gun at you. “Big mistake, friend.”
rows.translation: “你还带了帮手？”莎德啐道，后退一步，把闪电枪对准你。“大错特错，朋友。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You brought friends?” Shade spits, taking a step back and leveling the lightning gun at you. “Big mistake, friend.”"

rows.original: Yes
rows.translation: 是
rows.raw: "Yes"

rows.original: Help Kara against Shade.
rows.translation: 帮助卡拉对付莎德。
rows.raw: "Help Kara against Shade."

rows.original: No
rows.translation: 否
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: Fuck This!
rows.translation: 去他的！
rows.raw: "Fuck This!"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Fuck this. You hop into the crowd of people fleeing, ducking out of the bar to the sounds you hear gunfire behind you.
rows.translation: 去他的。你混进逃跑的人群，猫着腰溜出酒馆，身后传来枪声。
rows.raw: "Fuck this. You hop into the crowd of people fleeing, ducking out of the bar to the sounds you hear gunfire behind you."

rows.original: You spend a few minutes in the crowd of people before myr security guards come rushing, weapons drawn, and charge into the bar. More gunfire ensues over another minute or so, until a guard steps outside and waves the people back in, saying that the issue has been resolved. Taking a peek in the doors, you see a great number of bullet holes in the walls and the back door hanging open. Looks like Kara and Shade booked it. You doubt you’ll see them again.
rows.translation: 你在人群中待了几分钟，随后米尔警卫持枪冲来，闯进酒馆。接下来一分多钟里又响起一阵枪声，直到一名警卫走到外面，挥手示意人们可以回去，并声称问题已经解决。你从门口朝里瞥了一眼，只见墙上布满弹孔，后门大开。看来卡拉与莎德都逃走了。你觉得自己大概不会再见到她们。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou spend a few minutes in the crowd of people before myr security guards come rushing, weapons drawn, and charge into the bar. More gunfire ensues over another minute or so, until a guard steps outside and waves the people back in, saying that the issue has been resolved. Taking a peek in the doors, you see a great number of bullet holes in the walls and the back door hanging open. Looks like Kara and Shade booked it. You doubt you’ll see them again."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: No
rows.translation: 否
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: Fuck this. She’s on her own.
rows.translation: 去他的。让她自己应付吧。
rows.raw: "Fuck this. She’s on her own."

rows.original: Trip & Fall
rows.translation: 绊倒摔跤
rows.raw: "Trip & Fall"

rows.original: Trip and make a mess right in front of the huntress; try and distract her with some good old-fashioned stoogery.
rows.translation: 就在女猎手面前绊倒，弄得一团糟；试着用老派的滑稽把戏分散她的注意力。
rows.raw: "Trip and make a mess right in front of the huntress; try and distract her with some good old-fashioned stoogery."

rows.original: Flirt
rows.translation: 调情
rows.raw: "Flirt"

rows.original: “Hey, there,” you say, sliding into the booth across from the cat-girl, casually putting your body directly between her seat and Kara’s. “Can I buy you a drink?”
rows.translation: “嗨，”你说着滑进猫女对面的卡座，若无其事地用身体直接挡住她的座位与卡拉之间的视线。“我请你喝一杯怎么样？”
rows.raw: "“Hey, there,” you say, sliding into the booth across from the cat-girl, casually putting your body directly between her seat and Kara’s. “Can I buy you a drink?”"

rows.original: The cat-girl flicks her gaze around the room, sighs, and waves over a gold-plated myr waitress. “Sure. I wouldn’t mind the distraction, to be honest. Rough day.”
rows.translation: 猫女的目光在房间里扫了一圈，叹了口气，招手叫来一名身披金甲的米尔女服务员。“好啊。说实话，我不介意分散一下注意力。今天真够糟的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe cat-girl flicks her gaze around the room, sighs, and waves over a gold-plated myr waitress. “Sure. I wouldn’t mind the distraction, to be honest. Rough day.”"

rows.original: Perfect. You order a couple of stiff drinks and ask her what’s making her day so rough.
rows.translation: 完美。你点了两杯烈酒，问她今天为何过得如此糟糕。
rows.raw: "\n\nPerfect. You order a couple of stiff drinks and ask her what’s making her day so rough."

rows.original: She chuckles, rubbing the back of her neck. “Oh, I’ve been tracking a quarry for the last couple of weeks. I’m a bounty hunter, right? Person I’m tracking came here to Myrellion, but it looks like I’ve lost track of her. Thought I saw her come into the bar here, hell of a lucky break, but I must have been seeing things. No sign of her anywhere.”
rows.translation: 她轻笑着揉了揉后颈。“哦，我这几周一直在追踪一个目标。我是赏金猎人，明白吧？我要追的人来了迈瑞利恩，可现在看来，我跟丢她了。本以为看见她进了这间酒馆，简直走了大运，可我肯定是看错了。到处都找不到她。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe chuckles, rubbing the back of her neck. “Oh, I’ve been tracking a quarry for the last couple of weeks. I’m a bounty hunter, right? Person I’m tracking came here to Myrellion, but it looks like I’ve lost track of her. Thought I saw her come into the bar here, hell of a lucky break, but I must have been seeing things. No sign of her anywhere.”"

rows.original: “A bounty hunter?” you say, starting to lay on the Steele charm. You carry it on as your drinks arrive, flirtatiously telling her how dangerous a profession that is - and how dangerous she must be. Sure enough, that does the trick, getting the huntress to open up to you, and give you her undivided attention. She’s more than happy to show off some of her tools and tricks: a lightning-shooting stun pistol, tranq dart launchers, net guns, and more. You can see why Kara wanted to avoid fighting her.
rows.translation: “赏金猎人？”你说道，开始施展斯蒂尔家的魅力。饮品送来后，你继续调情般地说这份职业有多危险——而她本人肯定也同样危险。果不其然，这一招奏效了，女猎手开始向你敞开心扉，把全部注意力都放在你身上。她十分乐意炫耀自己的工具与花招：能发射闪电的电击手枪、麻醉镖发射器、捕网枪等等。你现在明白卡拉为何想避免与她交战了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“A bounty hunter?” you say, starting to lay on the Steele charm. You carry it on as your drinks arrive, flirtatiously telling her how dangerous a profession that is - and how dangerous she must be. Sure enough, that does the trick, getting the huntress to open up to you, and give you her undivided attention. She’s more than happy to show off some of her tools and tricks: a lightning-shooting stun pistol, tranq dart launchers, net guns, and more. You can see why Kara wanted to avoid fighting her."

rows.original: A few minutes pass in surprisingly pleasant conversation, during which you can only assume Kara’s managed to slip away through the crowd. You start looking for a place to break off with the bounty hunter, but the conversation takes an unexpected turn:
rows.translation: 几分钟在出人意料的愉快交谈中度过，你只能假定卡拉已经趁机混在人群中溜走。你开始寻找结束与赏金猎人交谈的机会，可话题却出现了意外转折：
rows.raw: "\n\nA few minutes pass in surprisingly pleasant conversation, during which you can only assume Kara’s managed to slip away through the crowd. You start looking for a place to break off with the bounty hunter, but the conversation takes an unexpected turn:"

rows.original: “You know, I haven’t even gotten your name,” she laughs, reclining in her seat. Her arms slip around the back of her chair, which serves to thrust her big E-cups forward, straining the front of her T-shirt. “I’m Shade. Shade Irons.”
rows.translation: “说起来，我甚至还不知道你的名字，”她笑着靠回座位。双臂搭上椅背，这个动作将她硕大的E罩杯乳房挺向前方，把T恤前襟绷得紧紧的。“我叫莎德。莎德·艾恩斯。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You know, I haven’t even gotten your name,” she laughs, reclining in her seat. Her arms slip around the back of her chair, which serves to thrust her big E-cups forward, straining the front of her T-shirt. “I’m Shade. Shade Irons.”"

rows.original: “Steele,” you answer. “[pc.name] Steele.”
rows.translation: “斯蒂尔，”你答道。“[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Steele,” you answer. “[pc.name] Steele.”"

rows.original: She smiles at that, a twinkle in her eyes. “Steele, huh? Look, I don’t want to come off the wrong way here, but look: I’m a little drunk, I’m pretty sure I’ve lost the bitch I’ve been tracking, and you’ve been fun to talk to. My ship’s parked on the tarmac outside, and I could use some cheering up. What do you say we get out of here?”
rows.translation: 听到这个名字，她眼中闪着光，笑了起来。“斯蒂尔，是吗？听着，我不想让你误会，可你看：我有点醉了，八成也跟丢了那个一直追踪的贱人，而且和你聊天很开心。我的飞船就停在外面的停机坪上，我正需要有人让我振作一下。要不要一起离开这里？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe smiles at that, a twinkle in her eyes. “Steele, huh? Look, I don’t want to come off the wrong way here, but look: I’m a little drunk, I’m pretty sure I’ve lost the bitch I’ve been tracking, and you’ve been fun to talk to. My ship’s parked on the tarmac outside, and I could use some cheering up. What do you say we get out of here?”"

rows.original: That was unexpected. Maybe you laid on the charm a little harder than you’d expected. Either way, looks like Shade here’s looking for a little fun.
rows.translation: 这倒出乎意料。也许你施展魅力时比自己预想得更卖力。不管怎样，看来莎德正想找点乐子。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat was unexpected. Maybe you laid on the charm a little harder than you’d expected. Either way, looks like Shade here’s looking for a little fun."

rows.original: Sure
rows.translation: 当然
rows.raw: "Sure"

rows.original: “Sounds good,” you say, grinning. “Lead the way.”
rows.translation: “听起来不错，”你笑着说道。“带路吧。”
rows.raw: "“Sounds good,” you say, grinning. “Lead the way.”"

rows.original: She laughs. “I always do.”
rows.translation: 她笑了。“我向来如此。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe laughs. “I always do.”"

rows.original: You follow Shade out of the bar and back through the airfield, north towards one of the bigger hangars. She leads you over to a big, sleek MSXI with a pair of massive engines looming over the hull. The gangplank lowers automatically as you approach, and Shade flashes you a smile. Her long, reptilian tail flicks up, the wet tip caressing your arm as you follow her up. Its wandering crown slides down slowly, tickling your [pc.belly] before delving down to your [pc.crotch],
rows.translation: 你跟随莎德离开酒馆，穿过机场，向北走向一座较大的机库。她把你带到一艘硕大而流线型的MSXI旁，两台巨型引擎高高耸立在船体上方。你们走近时，舷梯自动降下，莎德朝你露出微笑。她那条长长的爬行动物尾巴扬起，湿润的尖端在你沿舷梯跟上时轻抚你的手臂。那游移的尾冠缓缓向下滑动，搔弄着你的[pc.belly]，随后探向你的[pc.crotch]，
rows.raw: "\n\nYou follow Shade out of the bar and back through the airfield, north towards one of the bigger hangars. She leads you over to a big, sleek MSXI with a pair of massive engines looming over the hull. The gangplank lowers automatically as you approach, and Shade flashes you a smile. Her long, reptilian tail flicks up, the wet tip caressing your arm as you follow her up. Its wandering crown slides down slowly, tickling your [pc.belly] before delving down to your [pc.crotch], "

rows.original: openly teasing your bare loins with its pussy-like lips
rows.translation: 用酷似阴户的唇瓣公然挑逗你裸露的下体
rows.raw: "openly teasing your bare loins with its pussy-like lips"

rows.original: teasing you through your clothes
rows.translation: 隔着衣服挑逗你
rows.raw: "teasing you through your clothes"

rows.translation: 她尾巴的动作从未停止，完全不受主人自信向前步伐的影响。覆盖鳞片的尾穴缠住你的腰与[pc.leg]，既调皮又诱人，甚至真的扯掉了你身上的一些装备。它灵巧得不可思议

rows.original: It’s a short trip to Shade’s bunk, but you’re buck naked by the time you reach it. The kaithrit huntress gives you a lascivious wink over her shoulder as she pops the door open and guides you through. Her quarters are cluttered, a random assortment of clothes, gun parts, and chunks of armor scattered across the floor beneath punk rock posters and kaithrit grav-balls. In one fluid motion, she faces you, slips her arms out of her jacket sleeves, and pulls her shirt off over her head, giving you an eyeful of big, E-cup tits barely restrained by a black sports bra. Shade takes a single step towards you, pressing herself tight against you, letting you feel those lush mounds compress against your [pc.chest]... before she gives you a rough shove onto the bed, sending you tumbling onto your back. Her pants hit the deck with an audible thump of a gunbelt clattering on steel before she hops in after you, straddling your [pc.hips] and slipping a hand under her bra to cup her breast, slipping the garment off to reveal the sun-kissed mounds beneath it.
rows.translation: 前往莎德铺位的路并不长，可抵达时你已经一丝不挂。凯斯丽特女猎手从肩后朝你抛来一个淫荡的媚眼，打开房门，引你进去。她的住处杂乱不堪，朋克摇滚海报与凯斯丽特重力球下方的地板上，随意散落着衣物、枪械零件和装甲碎片。她动作流畅地转身面对你，双臂从夹克袖子中抽出，再把上衣从头顶脱下，让你饱览那对几乎无法被黑色运动胸罩束缚的硕大E罩杯乳房。莎德朝你迈出一步，将身体紧紧贴上来，让你感受那对丰盈肉丘挤压着你的[pc.chest]...随后她粗暴地把你推到床上，让你仰面跌倒。她的裤子落到甲板上，枪带砸在钢板上发出清晰的砰声，随后她也跃上床，跨坐在你的[pc.hips]上，一只手伸进胸罩托住乳房，再将内衣脱下，露出下方被阳光晒成蜜色的肉丘。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s a short trip to Shade’s bunk, but you’re buck naked by the time you reach it. The kaithrit huntress gives you a lascivious wink over her shoulder as she pops the door open and guides you through. Her quarters are cluttered, a random assortment of clothes, gun parts, and chunks of armor scattered across the floor beneath punk rock posters and kaithrit grav-balls. In one fluid motion, she faces you, slips her arms out of her jacket sleeves, and pulls her shirt off over her head, giving you an eyeful of big, E-cup tits barely restrained by a black sports bra. Shade takes a single step towards you, pressing herself tight against you, letting you feel those lush mounds compress against your [pc.chest]... before she gives you a rough shove onto the bed, sending you tumbling onto your back. Her pants hit the deck with an audible thump of a gunbelt clattering on steel before she hops in after you, straddling your [pc.hips] and slipping a hand under her bra to cup her breast, slipping the garment off to reveal the sun-kissed mounds beneath it."

Her hunter looks from you to the bar, a slight smile playing across her full lips. “Nice. Saves me some work, friend. Name’s Shade, by the way. Who do I have to thank for the tip?”
rows.translation: 你点点头，悄悄示意卡拉藏身的半隐蔽座位；她正准备伺机逃跑。追捕她的女人从你看向吧台，丰满的嘴唇上浮现出一丝微笑。“不错，省了我不少工夫，朋友。顺便说一句，我叫谢德。这条线索得感谢谁？”

Her hunter looks from you to the bar, a slight smile playing across her full lips. “Nice. Saves me some work, friend. Name’s Shade, by the way. Who do I have to thank for the tip?”"

rows.original: “Steele. [pc.name] Steele,” you answer, offering a hand which she shakes vigorously.
rows.translation: “斯蒂尔。[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”你回答道，伸出手来；她用力握了握。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Steele. [pc.name] Steele,” you answer, offering a hand which she shakes vigorously."

rows.original: “Steele, huh?” she says, a flicker of mirth playing across her face as she speaks, as if savoring the word. “Well, you look like someone who can handle themselves, and the kitten over there’s going to be a bitch to wrangle. I’ll cut you in for a share of the bounty if you’ll get my back here.”
rows.translation: “斯蒂尔，是吗？”她说道，脸上闪过一丝笑意，仿佛正细细品味这个词。“嗯，你看起来挺能打的，而那边那只小猫肯定很难收拾。要是你在这儿替我照应后背，我就分你一份赏金。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Steele, huh?” she says, a flicker of mirth playing across her face as she speaks, as if savoring the word. “Well, you look like someone who can handle themselves, and the kitten over there’s going to be a bitch to wrangle. I’ll cut you in for a share of the bounty if you’ll get my back here.”"

rows.original: “Bounty?”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bounty?”"

rows.original: She grins. “Why do you think I’m after her? Black Void’s put a bounty on her head so high, every two-bit chump with a gun’s after her. Must have pissed somebody off pretty bad. Now, I’m pretty decent at slinging a gun, but Kara Volke’s put six hunters in the ground already. Wouldn’t mind sharing some of the reward to double my chances, capiche? So what do you say?”
rows.translation: 她咧嘴一笑。“不然你以为我为什么追她？黑暗虚空给她开出的赏金高得吓人，凡是有把枪的三流货色都在追她。她肯定把什么人惹得够呛。我枪法还算不错，但卡拉·沃尔克已经干掉六个猎人了。分出一部分报酬来让胜算翻倍，我并不介意，懂了吧？所以，你怎么说？”

rows.original: “You in some kind of trouble?”
rows.translation: “你惹上什么麻烦了吗？”
rows.raw: " “You in some kind of trouble?”"

rows.original: Kara leans back against the bar with a glint in her eye that’s hard to read: “I owe her money. A lot more than this grand. Can’t pay her back yet, and she’s going to kick my ass if she catches me. It’ll be awfully hard to get that money together with a couple of broken kneecaps. Understand?”
rows.translation: 卡拉靠回吧台，眼中闪过一道难以解读的光芒：“我欠她钱。欠的可比这一千信用点多得多。现在还不了，而她要是逮住我，肯定会把我揍惨。膝盖骨要是断了，想凑齐那笔钱可就难多了。明白吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nKara leans back against the bar with a glint in her eye that’s hard to read: “I owe her money. A lot more than this grand. Can’t pay her back yet, and she’s going to kick my ass if she catches me. It’ll be awfully hard to get that money together with a couple of broken kneecaps. Understand?”"

rows.original: Somehow, you’re not convinced the kaithrit’s telling you the truth.
rows.translation: 不知为何，你并不相信这个凯斯里特说的是实话。
rows.raw: "\n\nSomehow, you’re not convinced the kaithrit’s telling you the truth."

rows.original: Okay
rows.translation: 好吧
rows.raw: "Okay"

rows.original: Okay
rows.translation: 好吧
rows.raw: "Okay"

rows.original: Help Kara.
rows.translation: 帮助卡拉。
rows.raw: "Help Kara."

rows.original: Not Interested
rows.translation: 没兴趣
rows.raw: "Not Interested"

rows.original: Not Interested
rows.translation: 没兴趣
rows.raw: "Not Interested"

rows.original: Refuse her request.
rows.translation: 拒绝她的请求。
rows.raw: "Refuse her request."

rows.original: Why?
rows.translation: 为什么？
rows.raw: "Why?"

rows.original: Why?
rows.translation: 为什么？
rows.raw: "Why?"

rows.original: Are you serious? I just explained that to you.
rows.translation: 你是认真的吗？我刚才才向你解释过。
rows.raw: "Are you serious? I just explained that to you."

rows.original: Why?
rows.translation: 为什么？
rows.raw: "Why?"

rows.original: Why does she need you to distract somebody? What’re you getting yourself into here?
rows.translation: 她为什么需要你去分散别人的注意力？你这是要把自己卷进什么事情里？
rows.raw: "Why does she need you to distract somebody? What’re you getting yourself into here?"

rows.original: Ignore Her
rows.translation: 忽略她
rows.raw: "Ignore Her"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Fuck that. Knowing your luck, she probably just wants something from you. You resume your seat and knock back your drink, enjoying the view of the bartender working in her jean-shorts and blatantly nonexistent bra in front of you. By the time you finish your drink and stand up, the bothersome kitten is long gone.
rows.translation: 去他的吧。照你的运气，她多半只是想从你身上捞点什么。你重新坐下，把酒一饮而尽，一边欣赏酒保穿着牛仔短裤、胸前显然没有半点胸罩遮掩地在你面前忙活。等你喝完酒站起身时，那只烦人的小猫早已不见踪影。
rows.raw: "Fuck that. Knowing your luck, she probably just wants something from you. You resume your seat and knock back your drink, enjoying the view of the bartender working in her jean-shorts and blatantly nonexistent bra in front of you. By the time you finish your drink and stand up, the bothersome kitten is long gone."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Ignore Her
rows.translation: 忽略她
rows.raw: "Ignore Her"

rows.original: Ignore the cat-girl and enjoy your free drink.
rows.translation: 无视猫女，享用你的免费饮料。
rows.raw: "Ignore the cat-girl and enjoy your free drink. "

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Kara & Shade
rows.translation: 卡拉与谢德
rows.raw: "Kara & Shade"

rows.original: You head out of the bar, trying to put the strange kaithrit’s request out of your mind. You make it all the way to the batwing doors, ready to head out into the street when you hear a scream behind you.
rows.translation: 你走出酒吧，努力把那个古怪凯斯里特的请求抛到脑后。你一路走到蝙蝠翼门前，正准备上街，身后却传来一声尖叫。
rows.raw: "You head out of the bar, trying to put the strange kaithrit’s request out of your mind. You make it all the way to the batwing doors, ready to head out into the street when you hear a scream behind you."

rows.original: You cast a glance over your shoulder, just in time to brace yourself for a stream of people running for the doors, trying desperately to escape. Behind them, you can see a pair of kaithrit women standing in the middle of the bar leveling handguns at each other: Kara on one side, a woman dressed in a long duster that parts around a single reptilian tail behind her on the other.
rows.translation: 你回头一瞥，正好及时站稳脚步，迎接一股拼命冲向门口逃命的人潮。在他们身后，你看见两个凯斯里特女人站在酒吧中央，手枪彼此相向：一边是卡拉，另一边则是个穿着长风衣的女人，衣摆在身后分开，露出一条爬行动物般的尾巴。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou cast a glance over your shoulder, just in time to brace yourself for a stream of people running for the doors, trying desperately to escape. Behind them, you can see a pair of kaithrit women standing in the middle of the bar leveling handguns at each other: Kara on one side, a woman dressed in a long duster that parts around a single reptilian tail behind her on the other."

rows.original: “Shade! It’s not too late to stop this. We can both walk out of here.”
rows.translation: “谢德！现在停手还不算晚。我们两个都可以活着离开。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shade! It’s not too late to stop this. We can both walk out of here.”"

rows.original: “You know how this goes, Kara. Cross the Void, and your life’s forfeit,” the silver-haired huntress, Shade, answers.
rows.translation: “你知道规矩，卡拉。背叛虚空，性命就得赔上，”银发女猎人谢德答道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You know how this goes, Kara. Cross the Void, and your life’s forfeit,” the silver-haired huntress, Shade, answers."

rows.original: The Void? As in Black Void? Uh-oh. That’s only the biggest cartel of space pirates and outlaws in the galaxy! And Kara’s managed to get on their bad side? That’s a tall order for one cat.
rows.translation: 虚空？是指黑暗虚空？糟了。那可是银河系最大的太空海盗与亡命徒集团！卡拉居然惹到了他们？这对一只猫来说可不是件小事。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Void? As in Black Void? Uh-oh. That’s only the biggest cartel of space pirates and outlaws in the galaxy! And Kara’s managed to get on their bad side? That’s a tall order for one cat."

rows.original: Kara flashes a look your way, a pleading glint in her
rows.translation: 卡拉朝你这边看了一眼，
rows.raw: "\n\nKara flashes a look your way, a pleading glint in her "

rows.original: strange
rows.translation: 古怪的
rows.raw: "strange"

rows.original: artificial
rows.translation: 人造
rows.raw: "artificial"

rows.original: eyes. The other woman, Shade, follows her glance. Looking you up and down, she says, “You there. This woman has a pirates’ bounty on her. Help me bag her, and I’ll cut you in on it.”
rows.translation: 眼睛里闪着恳求的光。另一个女人谢德顺着她的目光看过来，上下打量你后说道：“那边的。这女人身上背着海盗悬赏。帮我抓住她，我就分你一份。”
rows.raw: " eyes. The other woman, Shade, follows her glance. Looking you up and down, she says, “You there. This woman has a pirates’ bounty on her. Help me bag her, and I’ll cut you in on it.”"

rows.original: “Please,” Kara shouts, taking a step back. “I can match what she’s paying. Easy.”
rows.translation: “求你了，”卡拉大喊着退了一步。“她出多少，我都能给同样的。轻而易举。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Please,” Kara shouts, taking a step back. “I can match what she’s paying. Easy.”"

rows.original: She scoffs. “Take it or leave it, friend. You can just walk away.”
rows.translation: 她嗤笑一声。“要么接受，要么算了，朋友。你也可以直接走人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe scoffs. “Take it or leave it, friend. You can just walk away.”"

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You spend a few minutes in the crowd of people before myr security guards come rushing, weapons drawn, and charge into the bar. More gunfire ensues over another minute or so, until a guard steps outside and waves the people back in, saying that the issue has been resolved. Taking a peek through the doorway, you see a great number of bullet holes in the walls and the back door hanging open. Looks like Kara and Shade booked it. You doubt you’ll see them again.
rows.translation: 你在人群里等了几分钟，随后米尔安保人员持枪冲来，闯进酒吧。接下来的一分多钟里又响起一阵枪声，直到一名守卫走出来，挥手让人群回去，并表示事情已经解决。你从门口往里一瞧，只见墙上布满弹孔，后门也敞开着。看来卡拉和谢德都逃了。你怀疑自己再也见不到她们。
rows.raw: "You spend a few minutes in the crowd of people before myr security guards come rushing, weapons drawn, and charge into the bar. More gunfire ensues over another minute or so, until a guard steps outside and waves the people back in, saying that the issue has been resolved. Taking a peek through the doorway, you see a great number of bullet holes in the walls and the back door hanging open. Looks like Kara and Shade booked it. You doubt you’ll see them again."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: Fuck this. You hop into the crowd of people fleeing, ducking out of the bar to sounds of gunfire behind you.
rows.translation: 去他的。你混进逃跑的人群，弯腰冲出酒吧，身后传来阵阵枪声。
rows.raw: "Fuck this. You hop into the crowd of people fleeing, ducking out of the bar to sounds of gunfire behind you."

rows.original: Help Shade
rows.translation: 帮助谢德
rows.raw: "Help Shade"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Kara & Shade
rows.translation: 卡拉与谢德
rows.raw: "Kara & Shade"

rows.original: Can’t argue with a little bounty work. You
rows.translation: 干点赏金活儿也没什么不好。你
rows.raw: "Can’t argue with a little bounty work. You "

rows.original: draw your weapon
rows.translation: 拔出武器
rows.raw: "draw your weapon"

rows.original: pick up a particularly vicious looking rock
rows.translation: 捡起一块看起来格外凶狠的石头
rows.raw: "pick up a particularly vicious looking rock"

rows.original: and step up beside the huntress. She gives you an approving nod as Kara looks around in a panic.
rows.translation: ，站到女猎人身旁。她赞许地朝你点点头，而卡拉则惊慌地环顾四周。
rows.raw: " and step up beside the huntress. She gives you an approving nod as Kara looks around in a panic."

rows.original: LAST_MINUTE_KARASHADE_HELPED:
rows.raw: "LAST_MINUTE_KARASHADE_HELPED:"

rows.original: Shade
rows.raw: "Shade"

rows.original: Help Shade
rows.translation: 帮助谢德
rows.raw: "Help Shade"

rows.original: Help out Shade, the bounty hunter.
rows.translation: 帮助赏金猎人谢德。
rows.raw: "Help out Shade, the bounty hunter."

rows.original: Help Kara
rows.translation: 帮助卡拉
rows.raw: "Help Kara"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Kara & Shade
rows.translation: 卡拉与谢德
rows.raw: "Kara & Shade"

rows.original: You can’t leave a damsel in distress, can you? You
rows.translation: 你总不能丢下一个身陷困境的姑娘不管，对吧？你
rows.raw: "You can’t leave a damsel in distress, can you? You "

rows.original: draw your weapon
rows.translation: 拔出武器
rows.raw: "draw your weapon"

rows.original: pick up a particularly vicious looking rock
rows.translation: 捡起一块看起来格外凶狠的石头
rows.raw: "pick up a particularly vicious looking rock"

rows.original: and step up beside Kara. The bounty hunter curses, waving her weapon between the two of you as she realizes things just took a turn for the worse.
rows.translation: ，站到卡拉身旁。赏金猎人咒骂一声，在你们两人之间来回移动枪口，意识到事情已经急转直下。
rows.raw: " and step up beside Kara. The bounty hunter curses, waving her weapon between the two of you as she realizes things just took a turn for the worse."

rows.original: LAST_MINUTE_KARASHADE_HELPED:
rows.raw: "LAST_MINUTE_KARASHADE_HELPED:"

rows.original: Kara
rows.raw: "Kara"

rows.original: Help Kara
rows.translation: 帮助卡拉
rows.raw: "Help Kara"

rows.original: Help Kara, the down on her luck kaithrit.
rows.translation: 帮助走投无路的凯斯里特卡拉。
rows.raw: "Help Kara, the down on her luck kaithrit."

rows.original: “You’re here,” Kara says, taking a step out of the shadows and lowers the hood down to her shoulders, letting her cobalt-blue cat ears peek out at you.
rows.translation: “你来了，”卡拉从阴影中走出，把兜帽拉到肩头，让钴蓝色的猫耳在你面前露了出来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re here,” Kara says, taking a step out of the shadows and lowers the hood down to her shoulders, letting her cobalt-blue cat ears peek out at you."

rows.original: “Finally! I thought you weren’t coming. Then again, maybe you did cum huh?
rows.translation: “终于！我还以为你不来了。不过话说回来，也许你已经来过了，嗯？
rows.raw: "\n\n“Finally! I thought you weren’t coming. Then again, maybe you did cum huh? "

rows.original: Looks like I made a good call with you. You’ve more than earned your reward.”
rows.translation: 看来我选你是选对了。你完全配得上这份报酬。”
rows.raw: "Looks like I made a good call with you. You’ve more than earned your reward.”"

rows.original: She produces a credit chit and hands it over to you. “You’re a lifesaver, [pc.name]. Thank you.”
rows.translation: 她取出一枚信用筹码递给你。“你救了我的命，[pc.name]。谢谢你。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe produces a credit chit and hands it over to you. “You’re a lifesaver, [pc.name]. Thank you.”"

rows.original: You smile and nod, pocketing the chit. Kara gives you a quick wink before pulling her hood back up and stepping past you, heading toward the spaceport.
rows.translation: 你微笑着点点头，把筹码收进口袋。卡拉迅速朝你眨了眨眼，重新戴上兜帽，从你身旁走过，朝太空港而去。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou smile and nod, pocketing the chit. Kara gives you a quick wink before pulling her hood back up and stepping past you, heading toward the spaceport."

rows.original: You get the distinct feeling you’ll see her again.
rows.translation: 你有一种强烈的预感，你还会再见到她。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou get the distinct feeling you’ll see her again."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “Hey, Steele,” Shade says, looking up from her holo data as you approach. “Thanks again for the help earlier. Been tracking Kara for weeks. Tough kitty, but we took her down.”
rows.translation: “嘿，斯蒂尔，”你走近时，暗影从全息数据上抬起头说道。“之前的事再谢谢你了。我追踪卡拉好几个星期了。那只猫挺难缠，不过我们还是拿下了她。”
rows.raw: "“Hey, Steele,” Shade says, looking up from her holo data as you approach. “Thanks again for the help earlier. Been tracking Kara for weeks. Tough kitty, but we took her down.”"

rows.original: She reaches into her duster and retrieves a credit stick. She tosses it to you with a wink, watching with mirth as you turn it over in your hand and read the number printed on it.
rows.translation: 她把手伸进防尘大衣，取出一根信用点棒。她眨眨眼，把它抛给你，饶有兴致地看着你在手里翻转它，读出印在上面的数字。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe reaches into her duster and retrieves a credit stick. She tosses it to you with a wink, watching with mirth as you turn it over in your hand and read the number printed on it."

rows.original: “Twenty thousand?”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Twenty thousand?”"

rows.original: “Heh. Told you she was worth a ransom,” Shade chuckles. “You earned it, kid.”
rows.translation: “嘿。我说过她值一大笔赎金，”暗影轻笑道。“这是你应得的，孩子。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Heh. Told you she was worth a ransom,” Shade chuckles. “You earned it, kid.”"

rows.original: You give the huntress an appreciative nod and tuck the chit away.
rows.translation: 你感激地朝女猎手点点头，把信用点棒收了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give the huntress an appreciative nod and tuck the chit away."

rows.original: Shade leans back in her seat, giving a slight nod to the chair across from her. “So, now that we’re square, what do you say you buy me a drink to celebrate - or do you have something else in mind?”
rows.translation: 暗影靠回座椅，朝对面的椅子轻轻点了点头。“既然现在两清了，你请我喝一杯庆祝一下怎么样——还是说，你另有打算？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShade leans back in her seat, giving a slight nod to the chair across from her. “So, now that we’re square, what do you say you buy me a drink to celebrate - or do you have something else in mind?”"

rows.original: A red myr woman in a long coat
rows.translation: 一位身穿长外套的红米尔女子
rows.raw: "A red myr woman in a long coat"

rows.original: Anarrie
rows.translation: 安娜莉
rows.raw: "Anarrie"

rows.original: is sitting behind the counter, alternating between helping customers who’re interested in some of the shop’s more militant wares and reading passages from an oversized, leather - bound tome whenever she can catch a moment’s respite.
rows.translation: 正坐在柜台后面，时而帮助对店里那些更具军事用途的商品感兴趣的顾客，时而趁着片刻闲暇，阅读一本硕大皮革装订典籍中的段落。
rows.raw: " is sitting behind the counter, alternating between helping customers who’re interested in some of the shop’s more militant wares and reading passages from an oversized, leather - bound tome whenever she can catch a moment’s respite."

rows.original: Seeing you browsing through the shop, Anarrie gives you a friendly nod.
rows.translation: 看到你在店里浏览商品，安娜莉友好地点了点头。
rows.raw: " Seeing you browsing through the shop, Anarrie gives you a friendly nod."

rows.original: Seeing you looking her way, Anarrie’s cheeks flush with a hint of crimson. She gives you a slight smile and a nod.
rows.translation: 看到你望向她，安娜莉的双颊泛起一抹绯红。她微微一笑，朝你点了点头。
rows.raw: " Seeing you looking her way, Anarrie’s cheeks flush with a hint of crimson. She gives you a slight smile and a nod."

rows.original: An extraordinarily busty gold myr girl
rows.translation: 一位胸部大得惊人的金米尔姑娘
rows.raw: "An extraordinarily busty gold myr girl"

rows.original: Shiare
rows.translation: 希娅蕾
rows.raw: "Shiare"

rows.original: is working behind the register, usually handling small silver and gold coins unless the occasional offworlder wanders through, forcing her to switch over to an oddly out-of-place electronic chit-reader sitting to her side. With every motion, the buxom ant’s enormous rack jiggles and bounces, barely constrained by her simple tank-top and the straining bra underneath.
rows.translation: 正在收银台后工作，通常处理小枚的银币和金币；偶尔有外星旅客进来时，她才不得不改用身旁那台显得格格不入的电子信用点读取器。这只丰满蚁女每动一下，那对硕大的乳房都会摇晃弹跳，简单的背心和下方绷紧的胸罩几乎束缚不住它们。
rows.raw: " is working behind the register, usually handling small silver and gold coins unless the occasional offworlder wanders through, forcing her to switch over to an oddly out-of-place electronic chit-reader sitting to her side. With every motion, the buxom ant’s enormous rack jiggles and bounces, barely constrained by her simple tank-top and the straining bra underneath."

rows.original: Shiare flashes you an oddly flirtatious wink while she works. The longer you look her way, the more her movements seem to favor making her oversized bust move suggestively.
rows.translation: 希娅蕾一边工作，一边朝你抛来一个莫名撩人的媚眼。你看得越久，她的动作就越像是在刻意让那对巨乳挑逗地摇晃。
rows.raw: " Shiare flashes you an oddly flirtatious wink while she works. The longer you look her way, the more her movements seem to favor making her oversized bust move suggestively."

rows.original: Catching your eye, the busty ant-babe wiggles her hips and curls one of her sets of arms under her bust to heft it up for your inspection. Her saucer-like nipples press against her clothing, tenting out her tank top in the most inviting way. Shiare gives you a sultry wink as your gaze wanders over all she’s got on display for you.
rows.translation: 发现你的目光后，丰满的蚁女扭了扭臀部，将一组手臂绕到胸下，把乳房托起来供你端详。碟子般的乳头抵着衣料，将背心顶出诱人的帐篷。你的目光扫过她为你展示的一切时，希娅蕾朝你妩媚地眨了眨眼。
rows.raw: " Catching your eye, the busty ant-babe wiggles her hips and curls one of her sets of arms under her bust to heft it up for your inspection. Her saucer-like nipples press against her clothing, tenting out her tank top in the most inviting way. Shiare gives you a sultry wink as your gaze wanders over all she’s got on display for you."

rows.original: Ant Girls
rows.translation: 蚁女们
rows.raw: "Ant Girls"

rows.original: You meander through the cozy little shop and up to the counter where the mis-matched pair of myr women are working. Seeing you approach, the red-plated one stands up - with effort, you notice, and leaning pretty heavily on a simple metal cane. Still, despite a momentary grimace while she was getting to her feet, the red myr woman gives you a disarmingly friendly smile.
rows.translation: 你漫步穿过这间舒适的小店，来到那对并不相称的米尔女子工作的柜台前。见你走近，披着红色甲壳的那位站起身来——你注意到她颇为吃力，而且很大程度上倚靠着一根简单的金属手杖。尽管起身时短暂地露出痛苦的表情，这位红米尔女子仍朝你绽放出令人放松戒心的友善笑容。
rows.raw: "You meander through the cozy little shop and up to the counter where the mis-matched pair of myr women are working. Seeing you approach, the red-plated one stands up - with effort, you notice, and leaning pretty heavily on a simple metal cane.
