rows.raw: "“So how about that tour?” you ask. “I wouldn’t mind learning more about the town.”"

rows.original: “Sure!” Lieve says with a smile. “You’ll feel just like a local by the time I’m done with you! Girls, think you’ll be alright on your own for a little bit?”
rows.translation: “当然！”莉芙微笑道。“等我带你逛完，你会觉得自己就像本地人一样！姑娘们，你们自己待一小会儿没问题吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure!” Lieve says with a smile. “You’ll feel just like a local by the time I’m done with you! Girls, think you’ll be alright on your own for a little bit?”"

rows.original: Mayren and Sierva nod amicably, with the buxom blonde adding, “Have fun!”
rows.translation: 梅伦和希尔瓦友好地点点头，胸部丰满的金发姑娘又补充道：“玩得开心！”
rows.raw: "\n\nMayren and Sierva nod amicably, with the buxom blonde adding, “Have fun!”"

rows.original: Lieve gives her a pat on the head and extends an arm to you, allowing you to loop yours with hers before she takes the lead, bringing you out of the bunker and back onto the dusty road out of the town. The two guards standing at the wire gate salute her and open it up, allowing the two of you to walk past.
rows.translation: 莉芙拍了拍她的头，向你伸出一条手臂，让你挽住她，随后领着你走出掩体，回到通往城外的尘土路上。铁丝网大门旁的两名守卫向她敬礼并打开大门，让你们二人通过。
rows.raw: "\n\nLieve gives her a pat on the head and extends an arm to you, allowing you to loop yours with hers before she takes the lead, bringing you out of the bunker and back onto the dusty road out of the town. The two guards standing at the wire gate salute her and open it up, allowing the two of you to walk past."

rows.original: “You can just leave your post like that?” you ask your guide, first and foremost.
rows.translation: “你就这样擅离岗位没问题吗？”你首先向导游问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You can just leave your post like that?” you ask your guide, first and foremost."

rows.original: You don’t want to get her in trouble, after all.
rows.translation: 毕竟，你可不想害她惹上麻烦。
rows.raw: " You don’t want to get her in trouble, after all."

rows.original: “This is my post!” Lieve insists. “Well, more or less. The only reason I’m out here and not, say, in the manor house with the other officers is to ‘help offworlders become acquainted with Federation society and bring them to understand our way of life in a positive and appealing manner.’ In other words, I’m a glorified tour guide. Not much else for me to do with the war on pause.”
rows.translation: “这就是我的岗位！”莉芙坚持道。“好吧，差不多吧。我之所以待在外面，而不是跟其他军官一起待在庄园里，是为了‘帮助外星来客熟悉联邦社会，并以积极且富有吸引力的方式让他们理解我们的生活方式。’换句话说，我就是个头衔好听点的导游。现在战争暂停了，也没多少别的事可做。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This is my post!” Lieve insists. “Well, more or less. The only reason I’m out here and not, say, in the manor house with the other officers is to ‘help offworlders become acquainted with Federation society and bring them to understand our way of life in a positive and appealing manner.’ In other words, I’m a glorified tour guide. Not much else for me to do with the war on pause.”"

rows.original: You suppose that answers that.
rows.translation: 看来这就算回答了你的疑问。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou suppose that answers that."

rows.original: “So!” Lieve starts out with a smile, her grip on your arm pulling you
rows.translation: “那么！”莉芙笑着开口，她挽着你的手臂，将你
rows.raw: "\n\n“So!” Lieve starts out with a smile, her grip on your arm pulling you"

rows.original: affectionately
rows.translation: 亲昵地
rows.raw: " affectionately"

rows.original: uncomfortably
rows.translation: 得很不舒服
rows.raw: " uncomfortably"

rows.original: As clean as you’re going to get, you follow Lieve out of the bath and collect a towel from a rack nearby. You and your guide wrap yourselves up, drying off and collecting your clothes. “Not a bad place to go after a hard day’s watch,” Lieve says as she pulls her pants up. “I ought to come here more often...”
rows.translation: 你已经洗得不能再干净了，于是跟着莉芙离开浴池，从附近的架子上拿来一条毛巾。你和导游各自裹上毛巾，擦干身体并收拾好衣服。“辛苦站岗一天之后来这里放松还真不错，”莉芙一边提上裤子一边说道。“我真该常来……”
rows.raw: "As clean as you’re going to get, you follow Lieve out of the bath and collect a towel from a rack nearby. You and your guide wrap yourselves up, drying off and collecting your clothes. “Not a bad place to go after a hard day’s watch,” Lieve says as she pulls her pants up. “I ought to come here more often...”"

rows.original: You reach down and grab the myr’s ass through her towel, saying you might just come with her some time.
rows.translation: 你伸手隔着毛巾抓住这名米尔人的屁股，说自己或许哪天会陪她一起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reach down and grab the myr’s ass through her towel, saying you might just come with her some time."

rows.original: “Anyway,” she laughs, buttoning up her shirt, “We’ve still got one more important place to see in town. Shall we?”
rows.translation: “总之，”她笑着扣好衬衫纽扣，“城里还有最后一个重要地点没带你看。走吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyway,” she laughs, buttoning up her shirt, “We’ve still got one more important place to see in town. Shall we?”"

rows.original: You finish getting your gear strapped down and nod, letting Lieve lead you back out of the bath house. The blind hostess bows again as you depart, thanking you for your patronage. As you’re leaving, you brush shoulders with a group of perhaps a half dozen Federation troops going in, all laughing and smiling, the scent of booze heavy on them. Lieve gives them a friendly nod, and in turn gets a few cat-calls from the rowdy bunch as they catch sight of you.
rows.translation: 你把装备全都系牢，点点头，让莉芙带你走出浴场。离开时，那名失明的女招待再次鞠躬，感谢你们光顾。你出门时与一群大约六名正要进去的联邦士兵擦肩而过；她们有说有笑，身上酒气浓重。莉芙友好地朝她们点头，那群喧闹的家伙看见你后，则用几声轻佻的口哨作了回应。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou finish getting your gear strapped down and nod, letting Lieve lead you back out of the bath house. The blind hostess bows again as you depart, thanking you for your patronage. As you’re leaving, you brush shoulders with a group of perhaps a half dozen Federation troops going in, all laughing and smiling, the scent of booze heavy on them. Lieve gives them a friendly nod, and in turn gets a few cat-calls from the rowdy bunch as they catch sight of you."

rows.original: “Cute girl, Scout Thyrsa!” one of them shouts over, raising a bottle of something that looks as viscous as syrup. “Find yourself a new trench wife?”
rows.translation: “姑娘挺可爱啊，瑟莎斥候！”其中一人举起一瓶黏稠得如同糖浆的东西，高声喊道。“给自己找了个新的战壕妻子？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Cute girl, Scout Thyrsa!” one of them shouts over, raising a bottle of something that looks as viscous as syrup. “Find yourself a new trench wife?”"

rows.original: Lieve makes a three-fingered gesture you assume is equivalent to flipping the other soldier the bird. “Only because I got tired of fucking all your sisters!”
rows.translation: 莉芙用三根手指比了个手势，你猜那相当于朝另一名士兵竖中指。“还不是因为操你们姐妹都操腻了！”
rows.raw: "\n\nLieve makes a three-fingered gesture you assume is equivalent to flipping the other soldier the bird. “Only because I got tired of fucking all your sisters!”"

rows.original: The soldier huffs, and her companions laugh and clap her on the back until they’re well through the doors. Lieve rolls her eyes and motions you onwards. “Don’t mind them. Everyone wants a piece of you offworld girls. And the guys, too, but I’m pretty sure Colonel Nehzara and the other officers suck all of them up before they get down to the troops. Or at least, suck them all off until they’re too tired to play.”
rows.translation: 那名士兵哼了一声，她的同伴们则笑着拍打她的后背，直到一行人全都走进门里。莉芙翻了个白眼，示意你继续前进。“别在意她们。谁都想尝尝你们这些外星姑娘。男人也一样，不过我很确定，他们还没下到普通士兵手里，就全被内扎拉上校和其他军官吸走了。至少，也会被她们全都吸到累得玩不动为止。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe soldier huffs, and her companions laugh and clap her on the back until they’re well through the doors. Lieve rolls her eyes and motions you onwards. “Don’t mind them. Everyone wants a piece of you offworld girls. And the guys, too, but I’m pretty sure Colonel Nehzara and the other officers suck all of them up before they get down to the troops. Or at least, suck them all off until they’re too tired to play.”"

rows.original: Lieve laughs heartily at her own wit, guiding you down to the road towards the northern part of town square.
rows.translation: 莉芙被自己的俏皮话逗得放声大笑，领着你走上通往城镇广场北部的道路。
rows.raw: "\n\nLieve laughs heartily at her own wit, guiding you down to the road towards the northern part of town square. "

rows.original: You follow her just a short distance eastwards along the main road until you come to a crossroads, and Lieve leads you north towards a wrought iron gate that separates the city cavern from a long, brightly-lit tunnel that snakes up towards a squat, wide manor house overlooking Kressia.
rows.translation: 你跟着她沿主路向东走了不远，来到一处十字路口。莉芙带你向北走向一道锻铁门；它将城市洞窟与一条灯火通明的长隧道隔开，隧道蜿蜒向上，通往一座俯瞰克雷西亚的低矮宽阔庄园。
rows.raw: "You follow her just a short distance eastwards along the main road until you come to a crossroads, and Lieve leads you north towards a wrought iron gate that separates the city cavern from a long, brightly-lit tunnel that snakes up towards a squat, wide manor house overlooking Kressia."

rows.original: “Last but not least, we’ve got the governor’s mansion. Originally belonged to a certain Goldie queen, but now it’s acting as the city’s command post. If you’re planning on staying in Kressia for a while, or maybe you want to do some serious business with us, you’ll want to talk to Marshal Sellera. She can get you travel visas, merchant papers, whatever you need. Plus, I hear she’s quite eager to meet powerful offworlders. She’s been hiring adventurer-types left and right when they come through. Could be work for you, if you’re interested. Even if not, you owe it to yourself to talk to her.”
rows.translation: “最后，但同样重要的，就是总督府。这里原本属于某位金米尔女王，现在则用作城市指挥部。如果你打算在克雷西亚待上一阵子，或者想跟我们做点正经生意，就该去找塞莱拉元帅。她能替你办理旅行签证、商人文件，或是其他任何所需的证件。另外，我听说她很想见见强大的外星人。每次有冒险者一类的人经过，她都四处招揽。要是你感兴趣，也许这里有适合你的工作。即便没兴趣，你也该为自己着想去跟她谈谈。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Last but not least, we’ve got the governor’s mansion. Originally belonged to a certain Goldie queen, but now it’s acting as the city’s command post. If you’re planning on staying in Kressia for a while, or maybe you want to do some serious business with us, you’ll want to talk to Marshal Sellera. She can get you travel visas, merchant papers, whatever you need. Plus, I hear she’s quite eager to meet powerful offworlders. She’s been hiring adventurer-types left and right when they come through. Could be work for you, if you’re interested. Even if not, you owe it to yourself to talk to her.”"

rows.original: As she’s talking, Lieve walks up to the gate and opens it up with a flourish. A couple of armed guards standing nearby nod to her as she passes through, waving you along after her. It’s a quick walk up the drive to the manor, where you find several armored vehicles circled around near the front door. Several officers are milling about, smoking what look like bright pink cigarettes - a local equivalent, you’re sure. Lieve snaps a salute to one of them, and receives a curt return and a slight nod from the black-chitined woman with what looks like a nine-pointed star on her cap.
rows.translation: 说话间，莉芙走到大门前，以夸张潇洒的动作将门打开。附近站岗的几名武装守卫在她通过时点头致意，又挥手示意你跟上。沿车道很快便走到了庄园，几辆装甲车围停在前门附近。数名军官在周围闲晃，抽着看似亮粉色的香烟——你敢肯定这是本地的同类产品。莉芙朝其中一人利落敬礼；那个甲壳乌黑的女人帽子上戴着一枚看似九芒星的徽章，她简短地回了礼，又微微点头。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs she’s talking, Lieve walks up to the gate and opens it up with a flourish. A couple of armed guards standing nearby nod to her as she passes through, waving you along after her. It’s a quick walk up the drive to the manor, where you find several armored vehicles circled around near the front door. Several officers are milling about, smoking what look like bright pink cigarettes - a local equivalent, you’re sure. Lieve snaps a salute to one of them, and receives a curt return and a slight nod from the black-chitined woman with what looks like a nine-pointed star on her cap."

rows.original: “Scout Thyrsa,” the officer says, taking a long drag from her cig. “I see you’re adapting well to your role as guide. Marshal Sellera’s occupied at the moment, I’m afraid. A few kids fresh out of the academy proved themselves quite... disappointing... on their first night of leave in town. Need to be punished.”
rows.translation: “瑟莎斥候，”那名军官深吸了一口烟，说道。“看来你已经很好地适应了导游这个角色。恐怕塞莱拉元帅现在正忙。几个刚从军校毕业的小家伙第一次进城休假，就表现得相当……令人失望……需要惩罚一下。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Scout Thyrsa,” the officer says, taking a long drag from her cig. “I see you’re adapting well to your role as guide. Marshal Sellera’s occupied at the moment, I’m afraid. A few kids fresh out of the academy proved themselves quite... disappointing... on their first night of leave in town. Need to be punished.”"

rows.original: “Is that right?” Lieve says, letting you hear the humor in her voice. “Well, good old marshal’s quite the disciplinarian, after all.”
rows.translation: “是吗？”莉芙说道，让你听出了她语气里的笑意。“嗯，毕竟我们亲爱的元帅可是个相当严厉的管教者。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is that right?” Lieve says, letting you hear the humor in her voice. “Well, good old marshal’s quite the disciplinarian, after all.”"

rows.original: You imagine so!
rows.translation: 想来也确实如此！
rows.raw: "You imagine so!"

rows.original: You’re picking up on some fairly blatant innuendo here, but opt not to push it with a group of strangers.
rows.translation: 你已经听出了相当露骨的弦外之音，不过面对一群陌生人，还是决定不再追问。
rows.raw: "You’re picking up on some fairly blatant innuendo here, but opt not to push it with a group of strangers."

rows.original: “Ah well,” Lieve says after a moment’s laugh. “So, any chance we could swing some honey wine from the basement? I’m
rows.translation: “好吧，”笑了一会儿后，莉芙说道。“那么，我们能不能从地下室顺点蜂蜜酒？我正
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah well,” Lieve says after a moment’s laugh. “So, any chance we could swing some honey wine from the basement? I’m"

rows.original: treating my girl here to a night on the town, understand?
rows.translation: 带我的姑娘在城里享受夜生活，明白吗？
rows.raw: " treating my girl here to a night on the town, understand?"

rows.original: trying to give Steele here a good first impression of our operation here.
rows.translation: 想让斯蒂尔对我们这里的运作留下个好印象。
rows.raw: " trying to give Steele here a good first impression of our operation here."

rows.original: “That so?” the officer says. “Go ahead. Stone knows we’ve got plenty of the swill lying around.”
rows.translation: “是吗？”那名军官说道。“去吧。天知道我们那里还堆着多少这种劣酒。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That so?” the officer says. “Go ahead. Stone knows we’ve got plenty of the swill lying around.”"

rows.original: Lieve gives her a smile and leads you in through the front door. Inside, you’re greeted by a huge open foyer, richly decorated with tapestries and landscape paintings. There were clearly more hanging on the walls once, now torn down by the new Red Myr occupants. Portraits of the queen who lived here once, perhaps. A wide staircase leads up to a second floor, where you can see several more officers and their attendants moving about, but Lieve leads you around back of the stairs to a small basement access. A smaller stone set of steps take you down under the manor, into a dimly-lit passage that opens into a wine cellar.
rows.translation: 莉芙朝她笑了笑，领着你从前门进入。里面是一座巨大开阔的门厅，挂毯和风景画将其装饰得富丽堂皇。显然墙上原本还挂着更多东西，只是如今已被新入驻的红米尔人扯了下来。也许那些是曾经住在这里的女王肖像。一道宽阔的楼梯通向二楼，你能看到更多军官及其侍从在楼上来回走动，不过莉芙领着你绕到楼梯后方的一处小型地下室入口。另一段较窄的石阶将你带到庄园下方，进入一条灯光昏暗的通道，尽头豁然开成一座酒窖。
rows.raw: "\n\nLieve gives her a smile and leads you in through the front door. Inside, you’re greeted by a huge open foyer, richly decorated with tapestries and landscape paintings. There were clearly more hanging on the walls once, now torn down by the new Red Myr occupants. Portraits of the queen who lived here once, perhaps. A wide staircase leads up to a second floor, where you can see several more officers and their attendants moving about, but Lieve leads you around back of the stairs to a small basement access. A smaller stone set of steps take you down under the manor, into a dimly-lit passage that opens into a wine cellar."

rows.original: “Take your pick,” Lieve says, ushering you in. “The queen who lived here was one of the most... productive... on the Council. They drank her tit-honey from one side of Gold country to the other. She kept enough down here to keep us swimming in honey for the rest of our lives, and our daughters’. To the victors go the spoils!”
rows.translation: “随便挑，”莉芙一边把你领进去一边说道。“以前住在这里的女王，是议会里最……高产……的成员之一。整个金米尔国度从这一头到另一头，都有人喝她乳房产的蜜。她在这里存了足够多的酒，足以让我们和我们的女儿余生都泡在蜂蜜里。战利品属于胜利者！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Take your pick,” Lieve says, ushering you in. “The queen who lived here was one of the most... productive... on the Council. They drank her tit-honey from one side of Gold country to the other. She kept enough down here to keep us swimming in honey for the rest of our lives, and our daughters’. To the victors go the spoils!”"

rows.original: You’ve got no idea how myr vintage their honey-booze, and so select a bottle at random from one of the many, many racks against the walls. The bottle’s clear, letting you see the thick yellow drink inside that sloshes viscously when you move it. Even through the cork, you can smell the sweetness in the air around it, making your nose tingle ever so slightly.
rows.translation: 你完全不知道米尔人是怎么给蜂蜜酒划分年份的，于是从墙边数不胜数的酒架上随手挑了一瓶。瓶身透明，让你能看见里面浓稠的黄色酒液；移动瓶子时，它会黏滞地晃荡起来。即便隔着软木塞，你也能闻到它周围空气里的甜香，令鼻尖微微发痒。
rows.raw:
"

You’ve got no idea how myr vintage their honey-booze, and so select a bottle at random from one of the many, many racks against the walls. The bottle’s clear, letting you see the thick yellow drink inside that sloshes viscously when you move it. Even through the cork, you can smell the sweetness in the air around it, making your nose tingle ever so slightly.

"

rows.original: FromBath
rows.raw: "FromBath"

rows.original: FromBath
rows.raw: "FromBath"

rows.original: FromBath
rows.raw: "FromBath"

rows.original: As you exit the wine cellar, you ask Lieve if she has anything left in this little tour of hers.
rows.translation: 离开酒窖时，你问莉芙，她这趟小小的导览还有没有剩下什么安排。
rows.raw: "As you exit the wine cellar, you ask Lieve if she has anything left in this little tour of hers."

rows.original: “That’s about it,” she admits,
rows.translation: “差不多就这些了，”她承认道，
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s about it,” she admits,"

rows.original: putting an arm around your shoulders
rows.translation: 一只手臂搂住你的肩膀
rows.raw: " putting an arm around your shoulders"

rows.original: stuffing her hands in her coat pockets
rows.translation: 将双手插进外套口袋
rows.raw: " stuffing her hands in her coat pockets"

rows.original: as the two of you make for the door. “At least for all the important places.”
rows.translation: 你们两人一同朝门口走去。“至少所有重要地点都看过了。”
rows.raw: " as the two of you make for the door. “At least for all the important places.”"

rows.original: You nod, and a companionable silence falls over you both as you return down to the path to Kressia, and start back towards Lieve’s bunker.
rows.translation: 你点点头。你们沿着通往克雷西亚的小路返回，并开始朝莉芙的掩体走去，一阵融洽的沉默笼罩着彼此。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, and a companionable silence falls over you both as you return down to the path to Kressia, and start back towards Lieve’s bunker."

rows.original: “So... yeah,” Lieve says, eyes low to the ground as you walk back. “So, uh, look... I know I’m not the best tour guide around. This sort of thing doesn’t exactly come naturally to me...”
rows.translation: “所以……嗯，”走在回程路上，莉芙垂眼望着地面说道。“那个，呃，听我说……我知道自己不是最好的导游。这种事对我来说并不怎么自然……”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So... yeah,” Lieve says, eyes low to the ground as you walk back. “So, uh, look... I know I’m not the best tour guide around. This sort of thing doesn’t exactly come naturally to me...”"

rows.original: “Acting as a guide, or...?”
rows.translation: “你是说当导游，还是……？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Acting as a guide, or...?”"

rows.original: Lieve fidgets a bit. “At, uh... at dating, I guess. I’d normally just bump something like this down to one of my scouts, but you... I just wanted to get to know you better. Have some fun, get a few drinks, maybe see where things go. I know today was kind of lame, but it was worth a try, you know?”
rows.translation: 莉芙有些坐立不安。“呃……我是说约会吧。平常这种事我会直接丢给手下某个斥候去做，可你……我只是想多了解你一点。一起找点乐子，喝几杯，也许再看看事情会发展到哪一步。我知道今天有点无聊，但总值得试试，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nLieve fidgets a bit. “At, uh... at dating, I guess. I’d normally just bump something like this down to one of my scouts, but you... I just wanted to get to know you better. Have some fun, get a few drinks, maybe see where things go. I know today was kind of lame, but it was worth a try, you know?”"

rows.original: You have to admit, the myr version of a date is very different than what you’re used to.
rows.translation: 你不得不承认，米尔人的约会跟你所习惯的非常不一样。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou have to admit, the myr version of a date is very different than what you’re used to."

rows.original: Your companion makes a grunting noise and rubs at one of her antenna. “I knew this was a terrible idea. Should never have let my wives talk me into it.”
rows.translation: 你的同伴咕哝一声，揉了揉自己的一根触角。“我就知道这是个糟糕透顶的主意。真不该听妻子们怂恿。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYour companion makes a grunting noise and rubs at one of her antenna. “I knew this was a terrible idea. Should never have let my wives talk me into it.”"

rows.original: You’re already at the edge of town by the time Lieve stops grumbling to herself. “Sorry for wasting your time, [pc.name]. I didn’t... well, look, I hope you at least got something out of all this. Maybe.”
rows.translation: 莉芙停止自言自语的抱怨时，你们已经来到城镇边缘。“抱歉浪费了你的时间，[pc.name]。我没……好吧，听着，我希望你至少从这一切里得到了一点什么。也许吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re already at the edge of town by the time Lieve stops grumbling to herself. “Sorry for wasting your time, [pc.name]. I didn’t... well, look, I hope you at least got something out of all this. Maybe.”"

rows.original: You tell Lieve that, if nothing else, it was a perfectly serviceable tour. She smiles at that, slapping you on the shoulder and turning towards the bunker just ahead. “Well, thanks for walking me back, [pc.name]. I know this wasn’t exactly the best night on the town, but if you aren’t completely tired of me by now, I know my girls would be devastated if the cutest offworlder to come through didn’t come visit again...”
rows.translation: 你告诉莉芙，别的不说，这至少算得上一次合格的导览。她听后笑了起来，拍了拍你的肩膀，转身朝近在前方的掩体走去。“嗯，谢谢你送我回来，[pc.name]。我知道今晚的城中夜游算不上多么精彩，不过如果你现在还没彻底厌烦我，那就记得再来看看；要是造访这里最可爱的外星人不再登门，我的姑娘们可是会伤心欲绝的……”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell Lieve that, if nothing else, it was a perfectly serviceable tour. She smiles at that, slapping you on the shoulder and turning towards the bunker just ahead. “Well, thanks for walking me back, [pc.name]. I know this wasn’t exactly the best night on the town, but if you aren’t completely tired of me by now, I know my girls would be devastated if the cutest offworlder to come through didn’t come visit again...”"

rows.original: She gives you a wan smile and steps through the bunker’s door.
rows.translation: 她勉强一笑，迈进掩体的大门。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gives you a wan smile and steps through the bunker’s door."

rows.original: “So, did you have fun?” Lieve asks as you walk back. “I know I did.”
rows.translation: “所以，你玩得开心吗？”走在回程路上时，莉芙问道。“反正我很开心。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, did you have fun?” Lieve asks as you walk back. “I know I did.”"

rows.original: You smile at your insectile companion and answer that you did. She returns the gesture, wrapping her arm around your shoulder as you walk.
rows.translation: 你朝这名昆虫般的同伴微笑，回答说自己也很开心。她也回以微笑，并在行走时用手臂搂住你的肩膀。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou smile at your insectile companion and answer that you did. She returns the gesture, wrapping her arm around your shoulder as you walk."

rows.original: “I’m glad. You know, I don’t usually do this whole... dating thing. My wives talked me into it; apparently Goldies do it all the time. Doesn’t come naturally to us reds, though. Normally we’re much more forward about this sort of thing. More aggressive. But still...” Lieve pulls you a little closer, letting her hand slip a bit further down your back. “I enjoyed that. Maybe you’ll let me take you out again sometime... or at least
rows.translation: “那就好。你知道，我平常不太会搞这种……约会之类的事。是我的妻子们劝我这么做的；显然金米尔人总是这样。不过我们红米尔人可不习惯。通常遇到这种事，我们会直接得多。也更强势。但即便如此……”莉芙将你拉得更近，让手顺着你的后背往下滑了一些。“我很享受。也许以后你愿意让我再带你出去一次……或者至少
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m glad. You know, I don’t usually do this whole... dating thing. My wives talked me into it; apparently Goldies do it all the time. Doesn’t come naturally to us reds, though. Normally we’re much more forward about this sort of thing. More aggressive. But still...” Lieve pulls you a little closer, letting her hand slip a bit further down your back. “I enjoyed that. Maybe you’ll let me take you out again sometime... or at least"

rows.original: back to
rows.translation: 回到
rows.raw: " back to"

rows.original: the bath house...”
rows.raw: " the bath house...”"

rows.original: By the time she’s done talking, you’re already at the door to Lieve’s bunker. She leans up against the concrete entrance and grins
rows.translation: 她说完时，你们已经来到莉芙掩体的门前。她倚在混凝土入口上，咧嘴
rows.raw: "\n\nBy the time she’s done talking, you’re already at the door to Lieve’s bunker. She leans up against the concrete entrance and grins"

rows.original: up
rows.translation: 抬头
rows.raw: " up"

rows.original: down
rows.translation: 低头
rows.raw: " down"

rows.original: at you. “So... wanna come in for a bit? Let the girls help us relax for a bit?”
rows.translation: 看着你。“所以……想进来坐会儿吗？让姑娘们帮我们放松一下？”
rows.raw: " at you. “So... wanna come in for a bit? Let the girls help us relax for a bit?”"

rows.original: Sure
rows.translation: 当然
rows.raw: "Sure"

rows.original: “Sounds like fun,” you say. Lieve grins, and leads you inside. Seeing your arrival, the two golden trench wives perk up immediately. The bustier of the two leans back in her cushioned seat, spreading her legs and groping one of her breasts until a trickle of honey comes out.
rows.translation: “听起来挺有趣，”你说道。莉芙咧嘴一笑，领你走了进去。看到你们回来，两名金米尔战壕妻子立刻来了精神。其中胸部更丰满的那个向后靠进软垫座椅，张开双腿，揉捏着自己的一只乳房，直到一缕蜂蜜流了出来。
rows.raw: "“Sounds like fun,” you say. Lieve grins, and leads you inside. Seeing your arrival, the two golden trench wives perk up immediately. The bustier of the two leans back in her cushioned seat, spreading her legs and groping one of her breasts until a trickle of honey comes out."

rows.original: “Welcome home, mistress,” she purrs.
rows.translation: “欢迎回家，女主人，”她娇声说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Welcome home, mistress,” she purrs."

rows.original: “And company,” Sierva adds, reaching over to stroke her companion’s other teat. “How was your date?”
rows.translation: “还带了客人，”希尔瓦补充道，伸手抚摸同伴的另一只乳房。“约会怎么样？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And company,” Sierva adds, reaching over to stroke her companion’s other teat. “How was your date?”"

rows.original: Lieve laughs and shrugs out of her coat, slowly making her way towards her trench wives. “I’m glad you two talked me into it. But now that I’ve done my part, it’s time to do yours.”
rows.translation: 莉芙笑着脱下外套，缓缓朝她的战壕妻子们走去。“真高兴你们俩说服了我。不过现在我已经完成了自己的任务，该轮到你们了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nLieve laughs and shrugs out of her coat, slowly making her way towards her trench wives. “I’m glad you two talked me into it. But now that I’ve done my part, it’s time to do yours.”"

rows.original: The golden girls coo and purr. “Our pleasure...”
rows.translation: 两名金色姑娘咕咕娇笑。“乐意效劳……”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe golden girls coo and purr. “Our pleasure...”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Sure
rows.translation: 当然
rows.raw: "Sure"

rows.original: Follow her in.
rows.translation: 跟她进去。
rows.raw: "Follow her in."

rows.original: Later
rows.translation: 稍后
rows.raw: "Later"

rows.original: “Maybe next time,” you answer.
rows.translation: “也许下次吧，”你回答。
rows.raw: "“Maybe next time,” you answer."

rows.original: Lieve sighs, but her smile doesn’t fade. “Next time, then, [pc.name]. See you!”
rows.translation: 莉芙叹了口气，脸上的笑容却没有消失。“那就下次吧，[pc.name]。再见！”
rows.raw: "\n\nLieve sighs, but her smile doesn’t fade. “Next time, then, [pc.name]. See you!”"

rows.original: You start to turn away from Lieve, but feel a pair of chitinous hands grab your arms, hauling you back around to face her. The red ant pulls you in close, running a plated finger across your cheek before pressing her lips to yours, much more gently than you would expect from the warrior woman, so tenderly you’d think she was afraid to break you. When she pulls back, she’s smiling from ear to ear, teasing one of her antennas with her fingers.
rows.translation: 你正要转身离开莉芙，却感到一双覆着甲壳的手抓住你的手臂，将你一把拉回去面对她。红蚁将你拥近，用覆甲的手指划过你的脸颊，然后将嘴唇贴上你的唇瓣；动作比你想象中这名女战士会有的温柔得多，轻柔得仿佛她害怕会弄坏你。她退开时笑得合不拢嘴，同时用手指逗弄着自己的一根触角。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou start to turn away from Lieve, but feel a pair of chitinous hands grab your arms, hauling you back around to face her. The red ant pulls you in close, running a plated finger across your cheek before pressing her lips to yours, much more gently than you would expect from the warrior woman, so tenderly you’d think she was afraid to break you. When she pulls back, she’s smiling from ear to ear, teasing one of her antennas with her fingers."

rows.original: Wordlessly, Lieve slips back into her home, leaving you with your [pc.lips] tingling with the aftershocks of her aphrodisiac venom.
rows.translation: 莉芙一言不发地溜回家中，只留下你的[pc.lips]因她催情毒液的余韵而阵阵酥麻。
rows.raw: "\n\nWordlessly, Lieve slips back into her home, leaving you with your [pc.lips] tingling with the aftershocks of her aphrodisiac venom."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Later
rows.translation: 稍后
rows.raw: "Later"

rows.original: Tell Lieve you’ve got places to be.
rows.translation: 告诉莉芙你还有事要办。
rows.raw: "Tell Lieve you’ve got places to be."

rows.original: You follow Lieve back to the town square, past the towering, bustling structure of the elevator terminal.
rows.translation: 你跟着莉芙回到城镇广场，经过高耸而繁忙的升降梯终端。
rows.raw: "You follow Lieve back to the town square, past the towering, bustling structure of the elevator terminal."

rows.original: “Let’s see... merchant row’s next!” your companion decides, leading you across a wide open plaza in the middle of town. On the way, you pass by the ruins of a large statue in the heart of a small park, surrounded with benches and a handful of more relaxed-looking Gold Myr than you’re used to seeing in Kressia. Some of them even look up as you and Lieve pass by and, while none of them smile, you don’t feel the same hostility you did back at the high-class bar.
rows.translation: “让我想想……下一站是商店街！”你的同伴做出决定，领你穿过城镇中央一片宽阔的露天广场。途中，你们经过一座位于小公园中心的大型雕像废墟，周围摆着长椅，还有几名看起来比你在克雷西亚通常所见更加放松的金米尔人。有些人甚至在你和莉芙经过时抬头看了过来；虽然无人露出笑容，但你没有感受到先前在高级酒吧里遭遇的那种敌意。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Let’s see... merchant row’s next!” your companion decides, leading you across a wide open plaza in the middle of town. On the way, you pass by the ruins of a large statue in the heart of a small park, surrounded with benches and a handful of more relaxed-looking Gold Myr than you’re used to seeing in Kressia. Some of them even look up as you and Lieve pass by and, while none of them smile, you don’t feel the same hostility you did back at the high-class bar."

rows.original: “So what’s the story here?” you ask, nodding towards the ruined statue - or what little is left of it: just the feet and, far above you, hands bracing the ceiling, severed at the wrists.
rows.translation: “这里发生过什么？”你朝雕像废墟——或者说仅存的那点残骸——点头问道：如今只剩一双脚，以及远在你头顶、撑着洞顶却从手腕处断开的双手。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So what’s the story here?” you ask, nodding towards the ruined statue - or what little is left of it: just the feet and, far above you, hands bracing the ceiling, severed at the wrists."

rows.original: Lieve shrugs, not slowing down. “Was a monument to some kind of Goldie leader. A queen born here in Kressia, I think - her tits and ass were big enough to be, anyway. We were supposed to leave it alone, up until some jackass resistance fighters decided to climb up inside it with scoped rifles and started raining fire down on us. Shootout lasted a few hours - they had almost total cover up there, and most of the troops in town were armed with nothing but their sidearms. Finally managed to round up a couple of the sharpshooters from the expeditionary army and deal with it.”
rows.translation: 莉芙耸耸肩，脚步丝毫未缓。“以前是某位金米尔领袖的纪念像。我猜是个出生在克雷西亚的女王——反正她的奶子和屁股大得够资格。我们本来应该任它留在这里，直到几个混蛋抵抗军爬进雕像内部，拿着带瞄准镜的步枪开始朝我们倾泻火力。交火持续了好几个小时——她们在上面几乎完全受掩护，而城里大部分士兵除了随身武器之外什么都没有。最后，我们总算从远征军里找来几个神枪手，把事情解决了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nLieve shrugs, not slowing down. “Was a monument to some kind of Goldie leader. A queen born here in Kressia, I think - her tits and ass were big enough to be, anyway. We were supposed to leave it alone, up until some jackass resistance fighters decided to climb up inside it with scoped rifles and started raining fire down on us. Shootout lasted a few hours - they had almost total cover up there, and most of the troops in town were armed with nothing but their sidearms. Finally managed to round up a couple of the sharpshooters from the expeditionary army and deal with it.”"

rows.original: “Of course, the rebels managed to set off some gunpowder charges before they died. Took out most of the statue, and sent rubble raining down on everybody.” Lieve shakes her head, you almost think sadly. “Killed more people with falling bits of statues than their guns. Mostly Goldies, too. Big rocks went slamming through roofs, storefronts, you name it. An absolute mess.”
rows.translation: “当然，叛军死前还是设法引爆了几包火药。大半座雕像被炸毁，碎石像雨一样砸向所有人。”莉芙摇摇头，你甚至觉得她显得有些悲伤。“被坠落的雕像碎片砸死的人比被她们枪杀的还多，而且大多是金米尔人。大块石头砸穿屋顶、店面，什么地方都有。简直一团糟。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course, the rebels managed to set off some gunpowder charges before they died. Took out most of the statue, and sent rubble raining down on everybody.” Lieve shakes her head, you almost think sadly. “Killed more people with falling bits of statues than their guns. Mostly Goldies, too. Big rocks went slamming through roofs, storefronts, you name it. An absolute mess.”"

rows.original: Curious, you ask where Lieve was during the fight.
rows.translation: 出于好奇，你问莉芙交战时人在何处。
rows.raw: "\n\nCurious, you ask where Lieve was during the fight."

rows.original: “Wasn’t in town,” she answers. “Everything but the reserves and guard forces were pushed into the trenches, getting ready for the big push on Gildenmere. My company was right on the vanguard. Only heard the story from my trench wives after the fact.”
rows.translation: “我当时不在城里，”她回答。“除了预备队和守卫部队，所有人都被推进战壕，为进攻吉尔登米尔的大规模攻势做准备。我的连队就在先锋位置。事后我才从战壕妻子们口中听说这件事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wasn’t in town,” she answers. “Everything but the reserves and guard forces were pushed into the trenches, getting ready for the big push on Gildenmere. My company was right on the vanguard. Only heard the story from my trench wives after the fact.”"

rows.original: She falls uncharacteristically silent for a little while after that, until you arrive at the promised merchant row on the western side of town. Suddenly, her cheer comes back with a vengeance as she announces: “Anyway! This is merchant row, where you can buy pretty much anything that’s not restricted. Not much in the way of weapons available, sorry, but clothes and general items are on offer. Most of the shops here in town square are open again, and even some offworlders are starting to come down and open businesses here. We’ve even got a captured Goldie queen who’s generously put her merchant collective at the city’s disposal.”
rows.translation: 此后，她一反常态地沉默了一阵，直到你们来到城镇西侧先前说好的商店街。她忽然恢复了十足的开朗劲头，宣布道：“总之！这里就是商店街，只要不是管制品，差不多什么都能买到。抱歉，这里没多少武器出售，不过衣服和日常用品都有。城镇广场的大部分店铺已经重新营业，甚至有些外星人也开始下来，在这里开店做生意。我们还俘获了一位金米尔女王，她慷慨地将自己的商人联合体交由本城调遣。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe falls uncharacteristically silent for a little while after that, until you arrive at the promised merchant row on the western side of town. Suddenly, her cheer comes back with a vengeance as she announces: “Anyway! This is merchant row, where you can buy pretty much anything that’s not restricted. Not much in the way of weapons available, sorry, but clothes and general items are on offer. Most of the shops here in town square are open again, and even some offworlders are starting to come down and open businesses here. We’ve even got a captured Goldie queen who’s generously put her merchant collective at the city’s disposal.”"

rows.original: Lieve gives you a mischievous wink at that, and nods to a very lavishly decorated storefront across the way. Several offworlders, mostly male, are eagerly making their way inside as you approach. “There’s also a great dress shop around here, run by some sort of alien, I think. Haven’t had a chance to go there myself, but Mayren and Sierva both raved about it last time I gave them some spending money - dresses were a little too skin-showing for me to wear, but I sure enjoyed seeing them in ‘em!”
rows.translation: 莉芙说到这里，调皮地朝你眨眨眼，又向对面一家装潢极尽奢华的店面点头示意。你们走近时，几名外星人——大多是男性——正兴冲冲地往里面走。“这附近还有一家很棒的服装店，老板好像是某种外星人。我自己还没机会去，不过上次我给梅伦和希尔瓦一些零花钱时，她们回来后可是赞不绝口——那些裙子对我来说露得有点太多了，但看她们穿上倒真是一种享受！”
rows.raw: "\n\nLieve gives you a mischievous wink at that, and nods to a very lavishly decorated storefront across the way. Several offworlders, mostly male, are eagerly making their way inside as you approach. “There’s also a great dress shop around here, run by some sort of alien, I think. Haven’t had a chance to go there myself, but Mayren and Sierva both raved about it last time I gave them some spending money - dresses were a little too skin-showing for me to wear, but I sure enjoyed seeing them in ‘em!”"

rows.original: You can’t help but chuckle at the lascivious myr’s lusty smile as she leads you on down the road. “Of course, the big attraction of this part of town is the bath house. We don’t have anything like it back in Federation territory: public baths, where everyone gets together to scrub down, socialize, just... relax, I guess. Being naked around strangers would normally be unthinkable to a red myr, it’s embarrassing and dishonoring - just for slaves and among lovers. But the Goldies, and some offworlders, seem to love it. My trench wives made me go after a while - well, talked me into it, really - and it was so different than anything I’d done before. I can definitely see why the Goldies flock to the place!”
rows.translation: 莉芙领着你沿街前进时，脸上那副色眯眯的淫荡笑容令你忍不住轻笑。“当然，这一带最大的看点还是浴场。联邦领土里没有这种地方：公共浴池，所有人聚在一起擦洗、交际，还有……我想，就是放松吧。对红米尔人来说，在陌生人面前裸体通常是无法想象的，既羞耻又有辱尊严——只有奴隶和恋人之间才会这样。不过金米尔人，还有一些外星人，似乎很喜欢。过了一阵，我的战壕妻子们非要我去——好吧，其实是说服我去——而那跟我以前做过的任何事都截然不同。我完全能理解金米尔人为什么会成群结队地涌到那里！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t help but chuckle at the lascivious myr’s lusty smile as she leads you on down the road. “Of course, the big attraction of this part of town is the bath house. We don’t have anything like it back in Federation territory: public baths, where everyone gets together to scrub down, socialize, just... relax, I guess. Being naked around strangers would normally be unthinkable to a red myr, it’s embarrassing and dishonoring - just for slaves and among lovers. But the Goldies, and some offworlders, seem to love it. My trench wives made me go after a while - well, talked me into it, really - and it was so different than anything I’d done before. I can definitely see why the Goldies flock to the place!”"

rows.original: After a moment’s thought, Lieve stops and turns to you, her eyes practically twinkling. “Hey, what do you say you and I hit the bath house? Shouldn’t be too crowded around now...”
rows.translation: 思索片刻后，莉芙停下脚步转向你，双眼简直闪闪发亮。“嘿，你觉得咱们俩去趟浴场怎么样？现在应该不会太挤……”
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a moment’s thought, Lieve stops and turns to you, her eyes practically twinkling. “Hey, what do you say you and I hit the bath house? Shouldn’t be too crowded around now...”"

rows.original: Bath House
rows.translation: 浴场
rows.raw: "Bath House"

rows.original: “Sounds like fun,” you answer, starting towards the great big white building your guide’s pointed out.

Divans and cushions line the chamber, creating an environment that looks more like some sultan’s harem chamber than a waiting room. A handful of gold and red myr are sitting around: the golds lounging nude or in loose-fitting robes and towels, the reds sitting in their uniforms with their backs rigid, trying not to stare at the half-bare bodies on display.

rows.translation: 在莉芙的带领下，你朝那个方向走去，沿途经过军用载具、街上的士兵，以及几个努力不引起占领者注意的金米尔平民。向导带你沿路走了一段，说道：“我听说这里是城里更阔气的区域。过了升降梯大楼便是庄园宅邸，还有许多为那些女王梦患者和商人之流服务的高档店铺。联邦炮击城市时，大部分店都关门了，不过现在战斗平息，已经有几家重新开张。来，我带你看看。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAt Lieve’s guidance, you find yourself walking that way, passing by military vehicles, soldiers on the street, and a handful of gold myr civilians trying not to be noticed by their occupiers. Your guide takes you down the road a ways, saying, “I gather this is the posher part of town. Past the elevator building are manor houses, a lot of high-class shops for the queen-wannabes and merchant types. Most of ‘em closed down when the Federation shelled the city, but a few are getting back to business now that the fighting’s wound down. Come on, I’ll show you.”"

rows.original: You find yourself weaving through progressively smaller, more crowded streets until Lieve spots a small shop at the end of an avenue and guides you into it, saying, “Best place for a drink in Kressia, bar none.” The little corner shop reminds you of a bistro or coffee shop back home at a glance, though the place is decorated with hanging paper-wrapped lamps and silky-looking, free-standing walls that separate the tables from one another. A handful of well-dressed gold myr women are sitting around, half-visible through the paper barriers, sipping on earthen cups and chatting quietly. When you and Lieve enter, though, a hush quickly falls over the store, and you shiver as you feel every eye in the place on you.
rows.translation: 你穿过越来越窄、越来越拥挤的街道，直到莉芙发现大道尽头的一家小店，领着你走进去，说道：“克雷西亚喝酒最棒的地方，没有之一。”这家小小的街角店铺乍看之下让你想起家乡的小餐馆或咖啡馆，不过店内悬挂着纸包灯笼，还立着丝绸般的独立隔墙，将一张张桌子分隔开来。几位衣着考究的金米尔女子坐在四周，身影半隐在纸屏后，啜饮陶杯里的饮品，轻声交谈。然而你和莉芙一进门，店内很快便鸦雀无声；你感觉每个人的目光都落在自己身上，不由得打了个寒战。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou find yourself weaving through progressively smaller, more crowded streets until Lieve spots a small shop at the end of an avenue and guides you into it, saying, “Best place for a drink in Kressia, bar none.” The little corner shop reminds you of a bistro or coffee shop back home at a glance, though the place is decorated with hanging paper-wrapped lamps and silky-looking, free-standing walls that separate the tables from one another. A handful of well-dressed gold myr women are sitting around, half-visible through the paper barriers, sipping on earthen cups and chatting quietly. When you and Lieve enter, though, a hush quickly falls over the store, and you shiver as you feel every eye in the place on you."

rows.original: Lieve either doesn’t notice, or makes a good show of ignoring it as she leads you over to the counter at the back of the store where a svelte, young gold myr girl is sitting. Lieve smiles at her, but the cashier all but recoils as she’s approached, casting her eyes down to her feet and mumbling a very wooden greeting.
rows.translation: 莉芙要么没有察觉，要么非常善于装作没看见。她领你来到店铺后方的柜台，那里坐着一位身材苗条的年轻金米尔女孩。莉芙朝她微笑，可收银员在她靠近时几乎整个人向后一缩，垂眼望向脚边，用极为僵硬的语气含糊问候。
rows.raw: "\n\nLieve either doesn’t notice, or makes a good show of ignoring it as she leads you over to the counter at the back of the store where a svelte, young gold myr girl is sitting. Lieve smiles at her, but the cashier all but recoils as she’s approached, casting her eyes down to her feet and mumbling a very wooden greeting."

rows.original: “Two from your dirtiest kegs,” Lieve says, taking the girl’s reaction in stride. She digs into her uniform coat’s pocket and presses a small silver coin onto the counter. After a moment’s hesitation, the gold myr snatches the coin and motions you towards a corner table. Again, Lieve smiles at her and leads you over to your assigned booth.
rows.translation: “来两杯你们最脏的桶里装的酒，”莉芙说道，对女孩的反应泰然处之。她伸手探进制服外套口袋，将一枚小银币按在柜台上。犹豫片刻后，金米尔一把抓走银币，示意你们去角落的一张桌子。莉芙再次朝她一笑，领你走向分配给你们的隔间。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Two from your dirtiest kegs,” Lieve says, taking the girl’s reaction in stride. She digs into her uniform coat’s pocket and presses a small silver coin onto the counter. After a moment’s hesitation, the gold myr snatches the coin and motions you towards a corner table. Again, Lieve smiles at her and leads you over to your assigned booth."

rows.original: Once you’re seated, Lieve pulls her coat off over the back of her chair and apologetically says, “Sorry about that, [pc.name]. People here are still... adjusting to the Federation being around. Turns out we’re still not the most popular girls in town.”
rows.translation: 落座后，莉芙脱下外套搭在椅背上，满怀歉意地说道：“抱歉，[pc.name]。这里的人还在...适应联邦的存在。事实证明，我们仍然不是镇上最受欢迎的姑娘。”
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce you’re seated, Lieve pulls her coat off over the back of her chair and apologetically says, “Sorry about that, [pc.name]. People here are still... adjusting to the Federation being around. Turns out we’re still not the most popular girls in town.”"

rows.original: She sighs and shakes her head. “It’s getting better, though. People are coming out of their houses more, talking to us. A few even trust us enough to let us do the policing, now. We’ve broken up a few brawls, stopped robbers and the like. The Goldies in cities we took years ago are all proper citizens of the Federation now, I’m told. The people living here will be too, in a year or two. They just need time to adjust, that’s all.”
rows.translation: 她叹了口气，摇摇头。“不过情况正在好转。人们越来越常走出家门，也开始和我们交谈。有些人甚至已经足够信任我们，愿意让我们维持治安。我们制止过几场斗殴，也抓过抢匪之类的人。我听说，多年前被我们拿下的城市里，那些金蚁人现在都已经成了联邦的正式公民。住在这里的人再过一两年也会如此。她们只是需要时间适应，仅此而已。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe sighs and shakes her head. “It’s getting better, though. People are coming out of their houses more, talking to us. A few even trust us enough to let us do the policing, now. We’ve broken up a few brawls, stopped robbers and the like. The Goldies in cities we took years ago are all proper citizens of the Federation now, I’m told. The people living here will be too, in a year or two. They just need time to adjust, that’s all.”"

rows.original: As Lieve’s speaking, the girl from the counter comes by and silently deposits two earthen mugs at your table, each full of a murky, bubbly liquid. Lieve raises her drink to you, smiling as the girl departs. You return the gesture and drink, following your companion’s example and holding the mug to your lips until it’s drained.
rows.translation: 莉芙说话间，柜台后的女孩走过来，默默在桌上放下两个陶杯，杯中都盛满浑浊、冒泡的液体。女孩离开时，莉芙笑着朝你举杯。你也举杯回应，学着同伴的样子，将杯口贴在唇边，一口气把酒喝干。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs Lieve’s speaking, the girl from the counter comes by and silently deposits two earthen mugs at your table, each full of a murky, bubbly liquid. Lieve raises her drink to you, smiling as the girl departs. You return the gesture and drink, following your companion’s example and holding the mug to your lips until it’s drained."

rows.original: The drink’s bitter and goes roughly down your throat, leaving you feeling scratched and hoarse. You fight down the urge to cough, and in exchange, find your cheeks reddening and eyes watering. It’s like the hardest moonshine you’ve ever tasted.
rows.translation: 酒液苦涩，粗暴地刮过喉咙，令你感觉嗓子被划伤一般沙哑。你强忍住咳嗽的冲动，却发现脸颊已经泛红，双眼也涌出泪水。这简直像你喝过最烈的私酿酒。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe drink’s bitter and goes roughly down your throat, leaving you feeling scratched and hoarse. You fight down the urge to cough, and in exchange, find your cheeks reddening and eyes watering. It’s like the hardest moonshine you’ve ever tasted."

rows.original: “Like I said, best drink in Kressia!” Lieve boasts, slamming her empty mug on the table loud enough to draw back the attention of the other patrons. “Right?”
rows.translation: “我早说了，这是克雷西亚最棒的酒！”莉芙自豪地说道，将空杯猛地砸在桌上，响声之大又引来了其他客人的目光。“对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Like I said, best drink in Kressia!” Lieve boasts, slamming her empty mug on the table loud enough to draw back the attention of the other patrons. “Right?”"

rows.original: Agree
rows.translation: 同意
rows.raw: "Agree"

rows.original: “Whew! That’s some strong stuff!” you agree, finishing off your drink with relish. God damn, that burns!
rows.translation: “呼！这酒可真烈！”你一边赞同，一边津津有味地喝完杯中酒。该死，真他妈烧喉咙！
rows.raw: "“Whew! That’s some strong stuff!” you agree, finishing off your drink with relish. God damn, that burns!"

rows.original: Lieve laughs and claps you on the shoulder, hard enough to make you sway in your seat. “I know, right? I’ve seen it bowl some of you offworlders right off their feet, too. Kicks like a wetraxxal, doesn’t it?”
rows.translation: 莉芙大笑着用力拍了拍你的肩膀，力道之大让你在座位上晃了一下。“我就说吧？我还见过它把你们这些外星人直接撂倒呢。踢起人来像韦特拉克塞尔一样狠，对不对？”
rows.raw: "\n\nLieve laughs and claps you on the shoulder, hard enough to make you sway in your seat. “I know, right? I’ve seen it bowl some of you offworlders right off their feet, too. Kicks like a wetraxxal, doesn’t it?”"

rows.original: Wetraxxal
rows.raw: "Wetraxxal"

rows.original: “What’s a wetraxxal?”
rows.translation: “韦特拉克塞尔是什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What’s a wetraxxal?”"

rows.original: Lieve just throws her head back and laughs some more.
rows.translation: 莉芙只是仰头笑得更加厉害。
rows.raw: "\n\nLieve just throws her head back and laughs some more. "

rows.original: “Alright, let’s get out of here. Plenty of things left to see!”
rows.translation: “好了，我们走吧。还有好多地方要看呢！”
rows.raw: "“Alright, let’s get out of here. Plenty of things left to see!”"

rows.original: You and Lieve stand and head for the door. Again, your host offers her arm to you, leading you down one of the streets back towards the town square.
rows.translation: 你和莉芙站起身，朝门口走去。你的东道主再次挽起你的手臂，领你沿着其中一条街走回城镇广场。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou and Lieve stand and head for the door. Again, your host offers her arm to you, leading you down one of the streets back towards the town square."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Agree
rows.translation: 同意
rows.raw: "Agree"

rows.original: Hell yeah!
rows.translation: 太棒了！
rows.raw: "Hell yeah!"

rows.original: Disagree
rows.translation: 反对
rows.raw: "Disagree"

rows.original: “Ugh. It tastes like piss,” you grunt, wiping the water from your eyes. Oh, that aftertaste is even worse.
rows.translation: “呃。尝起来像尿，”你咕哝着，擦去眼角的泪水。哦，那股回味甚至更糟。
rows.raw: "“Ugh. It tastes like piss,” you grunt, wiping the water from your eyes. Oh, that aftertaste is even worse."

rows.original: “That’s the point!” Lieve laughs, rolling her eyes. “What, don’t tell me you offworlders drink something like that sweet golden swill or something?”
rows.translation: “要的就是这个味！”莉芙大笑着翻了个白眼。“怎么，别告诉我你们外星人喝的是那种甜腻的金色泔水之类的东西？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s the point!” Lieve laughs, rolling her eyes. “What, don’t tell me you offworlders drink something like that sweet golden swill or something?”"

rows.original: You can practically feel every other customer in the place glowering at the two of you. “Eh, well, anyway. Let’s get out of here. Plenty more to see in town!” Lieve says, grabbing her coat and standing. You follow her all the way to the door, trying to ignore the unfriendly looks drilling into your back. Lieve sighs, rubbing one of her antennas before pointing out a street back towards the town square and leading you on down.
rows.translation: 你几乎能感觉到店里其他每位顾客都在怒视你们。“呃，好吧，总之我们走吧。镇上还有很多地方可看！”莉芙一边说，一边抓起外套站起身来。你一路跟着她走到门口，努力无视那些钻进后背的不友善目光。莉芙叹了口气，揉揉一根触角，随后指向通往城镇广场的街道，领着你继续前行。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can practically feel every other customer in the place glowering at the two of you. “Eh, well, anyway. Let’s get out of here. Plenty more to see in town!” Lieve says, grabbing her coat and standing. You follow her all the way to the door, trying to ignore the unfriendly looks drilling into your back. Lieve sighs, rubbing one of her antennas before pointing out a street back towards the town square and leading you on down."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Disagree
rows.translation: 反对
rows.raw: "Disagree"

rows.original: Yuck!
rows.translation: 真难喝！
rows.raw: "Yuck!"

rows.original: More!
rows.translation: 更多！
rows.raw: "More!"

rows.original: “Gah, it’s piss!” you laugh, hammering back the rest of your drink. “Let’s get another round!”
rows.translation: “哈，这简直是尿！”你笑着把剩下的酒一饮而尽。“再来一轮！”
rows.raw: "“Gah, it’s piss!” you laugh, hammering back the rest of your drink. “Let’s get another round!”"

rows.original: “That’s the spirit!” Lieve laughs, waving over a waitress and ordering again.
rows.translation: “就是这股劲！”莉芙笑着招来一名女侍，又点了一轮。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s the spirit!” Lieve laughs, waving over a waitress and ordering again."

rows.original: “I knew I liked you for a reason.”
rows.translation: “我就知道自己喜欢你是有原因的。”
rows.raw: " “I knew I liked you for a reason.”"

rows.original: Another pair of drinks comes quickly, and this time, you raise your glass to your companion in a Terran toast. She cocks an eyebrow at you, but follows suit after a moment. “Cheers!” you say, clinking your mugs together before knocking back your drink.
rows.translation: 另一对酒很快便送了上来，这次你按照地球人的方式向同伴举杯祝酒。她朝你挑起一边眉毛，但片刻后还是照做了。“干杯！”你说道，和她碰过酒杯，然后仰头喝了下去。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnother pair of drinks comes quickly, and this time, you raise your glass to your companion in a Terran toast. She cocks an eyebrow at you, but follows suit after a moment. “Cheers!” you say, clinking your mugs together before knocking back your drink."

rows.original: “Cheers!” Lieve answers, almost more of a question than a toast, but she downs her drink with a relish. You both hiss and groan as the burning liquor goes down, a little less painfully than before. Still, your voice comes as a croak when you try to thank Lieve for the drinks.
rows.translation: “干杯！”莉芙答道，听起来更像疑问而非祝酒，但她还是兴致盎然地喝干了酒。灼热的酒液滑下喉咙时，你们同时嘶声呻吟，不过这次比先前少了几分痛苦。即便如此，当你试图感谢莉芙请你喝酒时，声音依旧沙哑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Cheers!” Lieve answers, almost more of a question than a toast, but she downs her drink with a relish. You both hiss and groan as the burning liquor goes down, a little less painfully than before. Still, your voice comes as a croak when you try to thank Lieve for the drinks."

rows.original: She grins and digs another small coin out of her coat, placing it very deliberately where the girl at the counter can see it before standing and offering a hand up to you. “Come on. Can’t just sit here and get completely shit-faced, can we? Still have a tour to do!”
rows.translation: 她咧嘴一笑，从外套里又掏出一枚小硬币，刻意放在柜台女孩看得见的位置，随后站起身，朝你伸手。“来吧。我们总不能只坐在这里喝到烂醉，对吧？还有游览要继续呢！”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe grins and digs another small coin out of her coat, placing it very deliberately where the girl at the counter can see it before standing and offering a hand up to you. “Come on. Can’t just sit here and get completely shit-faced, can we? Still have a tour to do!”"

rows.original: While you wouldn’t mind just lounging around and getting wrecked, you suppose the locals wouldn’t be too happy putting up with a drunk offworlder and a rowdy red ant. You grab Lieve’s hand and let her haul you up.
rows.translation: 尽管你并不介意就这样闲坐着喝个酩酊大醉，但当地人大概不太乐意忍受一个醉醺醺的外星人和一只吵闹的红蚂蚁。你抓住莉芙的手，让她把你拉起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile you wouldn’t mind just lounging around and getting wrecked, you suppose the locals wouldn’t be too happy putting up with a drunk offworlder and a rowdy red ant. You grab Lieve’s hand and let her haul you up."

rows.original: She gives you a little wink before shifting her grip on your hand, locking her fingers with yours as she leads you back towards the door.
rows.translation: 她朝你眨了眨眼，随后调整握住你手的姿势，与你十指相扣，领你走回门口。
rows.raw: " She gives you a little wink before shifting her grip on your hand, locking her fingers with yours as she leads you back towards the door."

rows.original: You thank her and follow your guide towards the door.
rows.translation: 你向她道谢，跟随向导走向门口。
rows.raw: " You thank her and follow your guide towards the door."

rows.original: From there, it’s a short jaunt back to the town square.
rows.translation: 从那里出发，只需稍走一段便能回到城镇广场。
rows.raw: " From there, it’s a short jaunt back to the town square."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: More!
rows.translation: 更多！
rows.raw: "More!"

rows.original: Tour Town
rows.translation: 游览城镇
rows.raw: "Tour Town"

rows.original: Tour the Town
rows.translation: 游览城镇
rows.raw: "Tour the Town"

rows.original: Lieve’s already shown you around the town.
rows.translation: 莉芙已经带你游览过城镇了。
rows.raw: "Lieve’s already shown you around the town."

rows.original: Tour Town
rows.translation: 游览城镇
rows.raw: "Tour Town"

rows.original: Tour the Town
rows.translation: 游览城镇
rows.raw: "Tour the Town"

rows.original: Lieve probably isn’t all too interested in spending so much time with a dudely-dude.
rows.translation: 莉芙大概没兴趣和一个爷们气十足的纯爷们花这么长时间相处。
rows.raw: "Lieve probably isn’t all too interested in spending so much time with a dudely-dude."

rows.original: Appearance
rows.translation: 外貌
rows.raw: "Appearance"

rows.original: Appearance
rows.translation: 外貌
rows.raw: "Appearance"

rows.original: Documents
rows.translation: 文件
rows.raw: "Documents"

rows.original: Documents
rows.translation: 文件
rows.raw: "Documents"

rows.original: Hand over those documents you found in the remnant’s radio tower.
rows.translation: 把你在残余部队无线电塔中找到的那些文件交出来。
rows.raw: "Hand over those documents you found in the remnant’s radio tower."

rows.original: Stop Venom
rows.translation: 停用毒液
rows.raw: "Stop Venom"

rows.original: Stop Venom
rows.translation: 停用毒液
rows.raw: "Stop Venom"

rows.original: Lieve assumes you are okay with her using her venom on you. You can ask her to stop using it so freely.
rows.translation: 莉芙以为你不介意她对你使用毒液。你可以要求她别再这么随意地使用。
rows.raw: "Lieve assumes you are okay with her using her venom on you. You can ask her to stop using it so freely."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: You ask Lieve to go easy on the venom - your consumption has been getting out of hand.
rows.translation: 你要求莉芙少用些毒液——你的摄入量已经开始失控了。
rows.raw: "You ask Lieve to go easy on the venom - your consumption has been getting out of hand."

rows.original: You ask Lieve to stop using her venom on you - you’d rather stay away from the stuff.
rows.translation: 你要求莉芙别再对你使用毒液——你宁愿离那东西远一点。
rows.raw: "You ask Lieve to stop using her venom on you - you’d rather stay away from the stuff."

rows.original: She shrugs. “Sure.”
rows.translation: 她耸耸肩。“当然。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe shrugs. “Sure.”"

rows.original: Lieve Thyrsa is a prime example of a red myr woman. She stands at five feet seven inches, fairly average for her race, and sports a well-toned, athletic frame accented by distinctly feminine curves. You wouldn’t call Lieve muscular, but she carries herself with an unmistakable physicality. Like other myr, she has a pair of insectile antennas growing from her brow that twitch and turn seemingly of their own volition, always angling towards movement in her bunker.
rows.translation: 莉芙·瑟莎堪称赤米尔女性的典型代表。她身高五英尺七英寸，在自己的种族中相当普通，拥有一副锻炼有素、充满运动感的体格，并由鲜明的女性曲线加以点缀。你不会把莉芙称作肌肉女，但她的举手投足间无不流露出强烈的身体力量感。和其他米尔一样，她的额头长着一对昆虫般的触角，仿佛拥有自主意识般抽动、旋转，总会朝地堡里发生动静的方向偏转。
rows.raw: "Lieve Thyrsa is a prime example of a red myr woman. She stands at five feet seven inches, fairly average for her race, and sports a well-toned, athletic frame accented by distinctly feminine curves. You wouldn’t call Lieve muscular, but she carries herself with an unmistakable physicality. Like other myr, she has a pair of insectile antennas growing from her brow that twitch and turn seemingly of their own volition, always angling towards movement in her bunker."

rows.translation: 她身边的希尔瓦和梅伦毫不含蓄地调整姿势，好让自己对你显得更加诱人；她们挺起胸膛，张开双腿。被莉芙紧紧抱了一会儿后，你终于得到释放。你的爱人问道：“有什么特别需要的吗？还是说，”她微笑着补充道，“你只是想来陪我们待一会儿？”
rows.raw: "\n\nAround her, Sierva and Mayren unsubtly shift to make themselves look more appealing for you, sitting with chests out and legs spread. After spending a moment firmly held in Lieve’s arms, you’re released and your lover asks, “Need anything in particular? Or,” she adds, smiling, “did you just come to spend some time together?”"

rows.original: “Hey, [pc.name],” Lieve beams, grabbing you by your [pc.hips] as you approach and pulling you into a tight hug. After a moment, she lets go and brushes one of her hands against your cheek as she whispers, “Good to see you.”
rows.translation: “嘿，[pc.name]。”莉芙眉开眼笑，在你靠近时抓住你的[pc.hips]，将你拉进一个紧紧的拥抱。片刻后，她松开你，用一只手轻抚你的脸颊，低声说道：“见到你真好。”
rows.raw: "“Hey, [pc.name],” Lieve beams, grabbing you by your [pc.hips] as you approach and pulling you into a tight hug. After a moment, she lets go and brushes one of her hands against your cheek as she whispers, “Good to see you.”"

rows.original: Around her, Sierva and Mayren unsubtly shift to make themselves look more appealing for you, sitting with chests out and legs spread. After spending a moment firmly held in Lieve’s arms, you’re released and your lover asks, “Need anything in particular? Or,” she adds, smiling, “did you just come to spend some time together?”
rows.translation: 她身边的希尔瓦和梅伦毫不含蓄地调整姿势，好让自己对你显得更加诱人；她们挺起胸膛，张开双腿。被莉芙紧紧抱了一会儿后，你终于得到释放。你的爱人问道：“有什么特别需要的吗？还是说，”她微笑着补充道，“你只是想来陪我们待一会儿？”
rows.raw: "\n\nAround her, Sierva and Mayren unsubtly shift to make themselves look more appealing for you, sitting with chests out and legs spread. After spending a moment firmly held in Lieve’s arms, you’re released and your lover asks, “Need anything in particular? Or,” she adds, smiling, “did you just come to spend some time together?”"

rows.original: “Hey, [pc.name],” Lieve says, perking up as you approach. She gives you a big, friendly smile and motions you closer. Her harem girls look up and smile at you; there’s little subtlety in the way they shift to make themselves look more appealing and inviting for you, sitting with chests out and legs spread.
rows.translation: “嘿，[pc.name]。”莉芙说道，在你走近时精神一振。她朝你露出热情友好的笑容，示意你靠近。她的后宫姑娘抬头朝你微笑；她们毫不含蓄地调整姿势，让自己对你显得更为诱人、更具邀请意味，挺起胸膛，张开双腿。
rows.raw: "“Hey, [pc.name],” Lieve says, perking up as you approach. She gives you a big, friendly smile and motions you closer. Her harem girls look up and smile at you; there’s little subtlety in the way they shift to make themselves look more appealing and inviting for you, sitting with chests out and legs spread."

rows.original: “Need help with anything?” Lieve offers. “Or
rows.translation: “需要帮忙吗？”莉芙主动问道。“还是说
rows.raw: "\n\n“Need help with anything?” Lieve offers. “Or"

rows.original: did you have something else in mind?
rows.translation: 你另有打算？
rows.raw: " did you have something else in mind?"

rows.original: we could just hang out...
rows.translation: 我们也可以就这样待一会儿...
rows.raw: " we could just hang out..."

rows.original: SIERVA
rows.raw: "SIERVA"

rows.original: Sierva
rows.translation: 希尔瓦
rows.raw: "Sierva"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You head out of the bunker and back out in the cold, dank cavern leading out of Kressia. The guards standing at the city gate nod politely at you, giving no indication they know - or more likely, care - what you and Lieve have been up to. You turn away from the bunker, starting to decide on your next destination, when you hear a whispering voice behind you:
rows.translation: 你走出掩体，回到通往克雷西亚的阴冷潮湿洞穴。守在城门口的卫兵礼貌地朝你点头，完全没有表现出她们知道——或者更有可能是根本不在乎——你和莉芙刚才做了什么。你背对掩体，正准备决定下一个目的地，忽然听见身后传来低语声：
rows.raw: "You head out of the bunker and back out in the cold, dank cavern leading out of Kressia. The guards standing at the city gate nod politely at you, giving no indication they know - or more likely, care - what you and Lieve have been up to. You turn away from the bunker, starting to decide on your next destination, when you hear a whispering voice behind you:"

rows.original: “Steele. Wait.”
rows.translation: “斯蒂尔。等等。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Steele. Wait.”"

rows.original: You turn, looking over your shoulder back into the bunker’s doorway. One of Lieve’s wives is standing there - Sierva, the tall, dark-haired warrior myr. She’s clutching a blanket around her shoulders, more for warmth than modesty if all the cleavage on display is any indicator. She’s nowhere near as busty as her companion, Mayren, but now that you look at her, Sierva’s far from flat chested. She’d make most human girls jealous with those perfectly rounded D-cups, each tipped with a small copper point just hidden from sight by the blanket.
rows.translation: 你转过身，越过肩头看向掩体入口。莉芙的一名妻子站在那里——正是希尔瓦，那名高挑的乌发米尔战士。她用毯子裹住肩膀，与其说是为了遮羞，不如说是为了保暖；毕竟那片显露在外的深邃乳沟已经说明了一切。她远没有同伴梅伦那般丰满，但现在仔细一看，希尔瓦也绝对称不上平胸。那对浑圆完美的D罩杯足以令大多数人类姑娘嫉妒，每一只乳房顶端都有一枚小巧的铜色乳头，刚好藏在毯子后面。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou turn, looking over your shoulder back into the bunker’s doorway. One of Lieve’s wives is standing there - Sierva, the tall, dark-haired warrior myr. She’s clutching a blanket around her shoulders, more for warmth than modesty if all the cleavage on display is any indicator. She’s nowhere near as busty as her companion, Mayren, but now that you look at her, Sierva’s far from flat chested. She’d make most human girls jealous with those perfectly rounded D-cups, each tipped with a small copper point just hidden from sight by the blanket."

rows.original: Of course, she can’t hold a candle to your prodigious mounds!
rows.translation: 当然，她依旧远远比不上你那对硕大无朋的乳峰！
rows.raw: " Of course, she can’t hold a candle to your prodigious mounds!"

rows.original: While you’re paused, eyes wandering over her body, Sierva takes the opportunity to approach. As she steps out into the electrical lights hanging from the gate, you can see her face twisted into a mask of nervousness, completely unbecoming someone who was, mere moments ago, sitting naked with her body invitingly on display for you.
rows.translation: 你停下脚步，目光在她身上游移。希尔瓦趁机走近。她踏入悬在城门上的电灯光芒之中，你看见她紧张得五官都扭曲起来。这副模样完全不像一个不久前还赤身裸体、毫不掩饰地向你展示身体的人。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile you’re paused, eyes wandering over her body, Sierva takes the opportunity to approach. As she steps out into the electrical lights hanging from the gate, you can see her face twisted into a mask of nervousness, completely unbecoming someone who was, mere moments ago, sitting naked with her body invitingly on display for you."

rows.original: “Sierva? Are you alright?” you ask, brow furrowing with concern.
rows.translation: “希尔瓦？你还好吗？”你担忧地皱眉问道。
rows.raw: "“Sierva? Are you alright?” you ask, brow furrowing with concern."

rows.original: “You look like you’ve had better days,” you say.
rows.translation: “你看起来不太好。”你说。
rows.raw: "“You look like you’ve had better days,” you say."

rows.original: “What is it?” you ask impatiently.
rows.translation: “什么事？”你不耐烦地问。
rows.raw: "“What is it?” you ask impatiently."

rows.original: SIERVA
rows.raw: "SIERVA"

rows.original: Sierva
rows.translation: 希尔瓦
rows.raw: "Sierva"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Have you told Lieve about this?” you ask, eyeing the rod.
rows.translation: “这件事你告诉莉芙了吗？”你盯着那根石棒问道。
rows.raw: "“Have you told Lieve about this?” you ask, eyeing the rod."

rows.original: Sierva shakes her head. “Please! Don’t tell her!” she says, much louder than before, and quickly covers her mouth with two of her hands. She glances over your shoulder at the guards nearby, who thankfully don’t seem to have heard.
rows.translation: 希尔瓦摇摇头。“求你了！别告诉她！”她的声音比刚才大了许多，随即赶紧用两只手捂住嘴。她越过你的肩头瞥了一眼附近的卫兵，好在她们似乎没有听见。
rows.raw: "\n\nSierva shakes her head. “Please! Don’t tell her!” she says, much louder than before, and quickly covers her mouth with two of her hands. She glances over your shoulder at the guards nearby, who thankfully don’t seem to have heard."

rows.original: More quietly, Sierva says, “Please don’t. Trench wives aren’t allowed to send messages home. Lieve would be furious I even asked you. I might be sending home secrets about the Federal army, or enemy battle plans, or anything.”
rows.translation: 希尔瓦压低声音说道：“求你别说。战壕妻子不准给家乡传消息。莉芙要是知道我竟然求你帮忙，肯定会大发雷霆。我可能是在往家里传递联邦军队的秘密、敌人的作战计划，或者任何情报。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMore quietly, Sierva says, “Please don’t. Trench wives aren’t allowed to send messages home. Lieve would be furious I even asked you. I might be sending home secrets about the Federal army, or enemy battle plans, or anything.”"

rows.original: “Are you?”
rows.translation: “你是在这么做吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Are you?”"

rows.original: She balks. “N-no! I just want... I just want my somebody to know I’m still alive. That I’ll see her again someday.”
rows.translation: 她退缩了一下。“不——不是！我只是想...我只是想让我的某个人知道我还活着。知道总有一天我还会再见到她。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe balks. “N-no! I just want... I just want my somebody to know I’m still alive. That I’ll see her again someday.”"

rows.original: Lieve?
rows.translation: 莉芙？
rows.raw: "Lieve?"

rows.original: SIERVA
rows.raw: "SIERVA"

rows.original: Sierva
rows.translation: 希尔瓦
rows.raw: "Sierva"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Tell me about this friend of yours,” you prompt.
rows.translation: “跟我说说你这位朋友吧。”你催促道。
rows.raw: "“Tell me about this friend of yours,” you prompt."

rows.original: Again, Sierva avoids your gaze, seemingly hesitant. You stare
rows.translation: 希尔瓦再次避开你的目光，显得有些迟疑。你盯着她
rows.raw: "\n\nAgain, Sierva avoids your gaze, seemingly hesitant. You stare"

rows.original: up
rows.translation: 向上看
rows.raw: " up"

rows.original: down
rows.translation: 向下看
rows.raw: " down"

rows.original: at her until she breaks down and says, “My lover. Well, she was, before this awful war started. She was the music instructor at the thollum I taught at. Beautiful, charismatic, intelligent. I was smitten the moment I laid eyes on her.”
rows.translation: ，直到她终于招架不住，说道：“我的爱人。嗯，至少在这场可怕的战争开始前，她还是。她是我任教的托勒姆里的音乐教员。美丽、迷人又聪慧。我第一眼见到她就彻底迷上了。”
rows.raw: " at her until she breaks down and says, “My lover. Well, she was, before this awful war started. She was the music instructor at the thollum I taught at. Beautiful, charismatic, intelligent. I was smitten the moment I laid eyes on her.”"

rows.original: Oh, is that all?
rows.translation: 哦，就这件事？
rows.raw: "\n\nOh, is that all?"

rows.original: She blushes a dark, coppery color and chews on one of her chitinous fingers. “We met, really met, at a camp for the girls. Camping on the surface, not far from here, really. We hit it off wonderfully, and when we came back home...”
rows.translation: 她的脸染上深沉的铜红色，轻咬着自己一根覆有甲壳的手指。“我们相识，真正认识彼此，是在一次姑娘们的营地活动中。我们在地表露营，其实离这里不远。我们一拍即合，而等我们回到家乡之后...”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe blushes a dark, coppery color and chews on one of her chitinous fingers. “We met, really met, at a camp for the girls. Camping on the surface, not far from here, really. We hit it off wonderfully, and when we came back home...”"

rows.original: “I get it,” you say, not wanting
rows.translation: “我明白了。”你说道，不想
rows.raw: "\n\n“I get it,” you say, not wanting"

rows.original: to waste more time on her explanation
rows.translation: 在她的解释上继续浪费时间
rows.raw: " to waste more time on her explanation"

rows.original: to make her keep talking when she’s clearly uncomfortable
rows.translation: 明知她很不自在还逼她继续说下去
rows.raw: " to make her keep talking when she’s clearly uncomfortable"

rows.original: Sierva nods, relieved. “I just want her to know I’m still alive, Steele. If she even is. I was conscripted before she was, but the last letter I got from her said she was being shipped off to training, too. Maybe six months before Lieve captured me.”
rows.translation: 希尔瓦如释重负地点点头。“我只是想让她知道我还活着，斯蒂尔。前提是她也还活着。我比她更早被征召入伍，但我最后收到的那封信说，她也即将被送去受训。那大概是在莉芙俘虏我的六个月前。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSierva nods, relieved. “I just want her to know I’m still alive, Steele. If she even is. I was conscripted before she was, but the last letter I got from her said she was being shipped off to training, too. Maybe six months before Lieve captured me.”"

rows.original: Friend?
rows.translation: 朋友？
rows.raw: "Friend?"

rows.original: SIERVA
rows.raw: "SIERVA"

rows.original: Sierva
rows.translation: 希尔瓦
rows.raw: "Sierva"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “I’m not delivering this for you,” you say flatly
rows.translation: “我不会替你送这个。”你直截了当地说道
rows.raw: "“I’m not delivering this for you,” you say flatly"

rows.original: “I’m sorry, Sierva. I can’t help you,” you say
rows.translation: “抱歉，希尔瓦。我帮不了你。”你说道
rows.raw: "“I’m sorry, Sierva. I can’t help you,” you say"

rows.original: Her shoulder slump as you return the rod to her hands. “I understand. Please, don’t tell Lieve I tried this. She’ll... I don’t know what she’d do.”
rows.translation: 你把石棒放回她手中，她的肩膀随之垮了下来。“我明白。求你别告诉莉芙我试过这件事。她会...我不知道她会怎么处置我。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHer shoulder slump as you return the rod to her hands. “I understand. Please, don’t tell Lieve I tried this. She’ll... I don’t know what she’d do.”"

rows.original: You tell her you won’t
rows.translation: 你告诉她自己不会说
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her you won’t"

rows.original: , and add that she should go back inside before her owner misses her. Sierva sighs and does as you bid her, silently making her way back inside.
rows.translation: ，又补充说，她最好趁主人还没发现她不见了赶快回去。希尔瓦叹了口气，依言照办，默默地走回里面。
rows.raw: ", and add that she should go back inside before her owner misses her. Sierva sighs and does as you bid her, silently making her way back inside."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: SIERVA
rows.raw: "SIERVA"

rows.original: Sierva
rows.translation: 希尔瓦
rows.raw: "Sierva"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Alright, I’ll do it,” you say, putting the rod into your pack. “Now this friend of yours, how do I find her?”
rows.translation: “好吧，我会帮你。”你说着把石棒放进背包。“那么，你这位朋友，我该怎么找到她？”
rows.raw: "“Alright, I’ll do it,” you say, putting the rod into your pack. “Now this friend of yours, how do I find her?”"

rows.original: You can see a weight lifting off of Sier’s shoulders as she answers, “Thank you, Steele. Thank you so much. Her name is Iaya, and she lived in Gildenmere last time I wrote to her. She’s got the lushest orange hair you’ve ever seen, and a pair of antenna rings. You’ll know her when you see her, I promise.”
rows.translation: 你能看到希尔瓦肩上的重担随之卸下。她答道：“谢谢你，斯蒂尔。真的太感谢你了。她叫艾雅，我上次给她写信时，她住在吉尔登米尔。她有着你所见过最浓密的橙色头发，还戴着一对触角环。你看到她时一定能认出来，我保证。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can see a weight lifting off of Sier’s shoulders as she answers, “Thank you, Steele. Thank you so much. Her name is Iaya, and she lived in Gildenmere last time I wrote to her. She’s got the lushest orange hair you’ve ever seen, and a pair of antenna rings. You’ll know her when you see her, I promise.”"

rows.original: You suppose that’s enough to go on. A music-inclined, red-headed gold myr. You file that away, and tell Sierva to go back inside before she catches cold.
rows.translation: 你觉得这些线索应该足够了：一名热爱音乐、红头发的金米尔。你把这些记在心里，叫希尔瓦赶快回去，免得着凉。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou suppose that’s enough to go on. A music-inclined, red-headed gold myr. You file that away, and tell Sierva to go back inside before she catches cold."

rows.original: She nods at the instruction, but pauses long enough to plant a small, tender kiss on your cheek. “Thank you. I mean it.”
rows.translation: 她顺从地点点头，却又停下来，在你脸颊上落下轻柔的一吻。“谢谢你。我是认真的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe nods at the instruction, but pauses long enough to plant a small, tender kiss on your cheek. “Thank you. I mean it.”"

rows.original: You smile at her as she returns to her mistress.
rows.translation: 你微笑着目送她回到女主人身边。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou smile at her as she returns to her mistress."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: She steps up close to you, well inside your personal space - close enough that you almost think she’s going to kiss you - before one of her four arms slips out from the blanket. You take an instinctive step back when you see what she’s got, fearing for a split second she’s pulling a knife on you... until the handle turns out to be nothing more than a small stone cylinder, about the length of her hand.
rows.translation: 她走到离你很近的地方，完全闯入了你的私人空间——近得让你几乎以为她要吻你——随后，毯子下探出她的四条手臂之一。看见她手里的东西，你本能地后退一步，有那么一瞬间还以为她要拔刀对付你...但所谓的刀柄最终不过是一根小石圆柱，长度大约与她的手掌相当。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe steps up close to you, well inside your personal space - close enough that you almost think she’s going to kiss you - before one of her four arms slips out from the blanket. You take an instinctive step back when you see what she’s got, fearing for a split second she’s pulling a knife on you... until the handle turns out to be nothing more than a small stone cylinder, about the length of her hand."

rows.original: Sierva casts a nervous look between you and the handful of Federation soldiers at the gate before whispering, “Steele, I hate to ask. But after, you know, we’ve gotten closer than most people. I need a favor. I’ll beg you if I have to...”
rows.translation: 希尔瓦紧张地来回看了看你和城门口的几名联邦士兵，随后低声说道：“斯蒂尔，我实在不想开这个口。但是，在那之后，你知道的，我们已经比大多数人都亲近了。我需要你帮个忙。要是非得求你，我也会求的...”
rows.raw: "\n\nSierva casts a nervous look between you and the handful of Federation soldiers at the gate before whispering, “Steele, I hate to ask. But after, you know, we’ve gotten closer than most people. I need a favor. I’ll beg you if I have to...”"

rows.original: She seems to fight for words, and after a few moments, tries to press the stone rod into your hand. “You’re an offworlder. You can go anywhere you want, almost. Even... even Gildenmere, right?”
rows.translation: 她似乎在努力组织语言，片刻后试着把石棒塞进你手里。“你是外星人。你几乎想去哪里都可以。甚至...甚至能去吉尔登米尔，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe seems to fight for words, and after a few moments, tries to press the stone rod into your hand. “You’re an offworlder. You can go anywhere you want, almost. Even... even Gildenmere, right?”"

rows.original: You suppose you could. Both factions seem more than willing to let you into their territory. “I could,” you answer after a moment’s thought. “Why?”
rows.translation: 你想自己的确可以。双方势力似乎都非常乐意让你进入她们的领地。“我可以。”你思索片刻后回答。“为什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou suppose you could. Both factions seem more than willing to let you into their territory. “I could,” you answer after a moment’s thought. “Why?”"

rows.original: A touch of worry fades off Sierva’s face. “If you ever happen to, I suppose find yourself in Gildenmere... all I ask is that you give this to my...” she pauses, struggling to find the words. Finally, she says, “A friend of mine. Please. I’ll do anything you ask.”
rows.translation: 希尔瓦脸上的一丝忧虑消退了。“如果你碰巧，我是说，哪天到了吉尔登米尔...我只求你把这个交给我的...”她停下来，艰难地寻找措辞。最后，她说道：“我的一位朋友。求你了。你让我做什么都行。”
rows.raw: "\n\nA touch of worry fades off Sierva’s face. “If you ever happen to, I suppose find yourself in Gildenmere... all I ask is that you give this to my...” she pauses, struggling to find the words. Finally, she says, “A friend of mine. Please. I’ll do anything you ask.”"

rows.original: “A friend?” you ask, taking the stone rod from her. It’s a small thing, slender, carved with symbols that your nanomachines can’t make heads or tails of.
rows.translation: “一位朋友？”你接过她的石棒问道。这东西十分小巧纤细，上面刻着一些连你的纳米机器都完全看不懂的符号。
rows.raw: "\n\n“A friend?” you ask, taking the stone rod from her. It’s a small thing, slender, carved with symbols that your nanomachines can’t make heads or tails of."

rows.original: Sierva pointedly avoids your eyes. “More than that, but... please? She probably thinks I’m dead. Everyone back home does, I’m sure.”
rows.translation: 希尔瓦刻意避开你的目光。“不只是朋友，可是...求你了？她大概以为我已经死了。家乡的每个人肯定都是这么想的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSierva pointedly avoids your eyes. “More than that, but... please? She probably thinks I’m dead. Everyone back home does, I’m sure.”"

rows.translation: 莉芙对此怎么想？希尔瓦告诉过她的女主人吗？

rows.original: You approach the guards and show them Sier’s stone rod, asking them if they recognize it, or if they knew an orange-haired soldier by the name of Iaya. Some of the guards take the stone and look it over, but none of them can identify the markings, nor do they recognize the name and description.
rows.translation: 你走到卫兵面前，给她们看希尔瓦的石棒，询问她们是否认得这东西，或者是否认识一个名叫艾雅的橙发士兵。几名卫兵接过石棒仔细查看，但没有人能辨认上面的标记，也没人认得这个名字和相应的外貌描述。
rows.raw: "You approach the guards and show them Sier’s stone rod, asking them if they recognize it, or if they knew an orange-haired soldier by the name of Iaya. Some of the guards take the stone and look it over, but none of them can identify the markings, nor do they recognize the name and description."

rows.original: Sighing, you thank them for their time and move on.
rows.translation: 你叹了口气，谢过她们抽出时间，随后继续上路。
rows.raw: "\n\nSighing, you thank them for their time and move on."
