rows.original: You approach the guards, eying the strange crests on their vehicle. After a moment’s thought, a hint of recollection teases at your brain and you pull out the stone rod from your pack. Looking it over, you quickly match up one of the strange symbols on the rock to the one printed on the sides of the vehicles clustered around the barricade.
rows.translation: 你走近卫兵，打量着她们载具上那些奇怪的徽记。思索片刻后，一丝记忆在脑海中浮现，你从背包里取出那根石棒。仔细查看之下，你很快发现石头上的一个奇怪符号，与路障周围那些载具侧面印着的符号完全一致。
rows.raw: "You approach the guards, eying the strange crests on their vehicle. After a moment’s thought, a hint of recollection teases at your brain and you pull out the stone rod from your pack. Looking it over, you quickly match up one of the strange symbols on the rock to the one printed on the sides of the vehicles clustered around the barricade."

rows.original: A sentry standing a few paces away catches your gaze and stalks over, resting a tremendous warhammer on her shoulder with almost frightening ease. “Offworlders aren’t permitted past this checkpoint,” she informs you coolly. “Please step back.”
rows.translation: 几步外的一名哨兵察觉到你的目光，大步走来。她把一柄巨大的战锤扛在肩上，那副轻松自如的模样几乎令人胆寒。“外星人不得通过这道检查站。”她冷淡地告知你。“请退后。”
rows.raw: "\n\nA sentry standing a few paces away catches your gaze and stalks over, resting a tremendous warhammer on her shoulder with almost frightening ease. “Offworlders aren’t permitted past this checkpoint,” she informs you coolly. “Please step back.”"

rows.original: “Wait, wait,” you say, holding out the rod. “Do you know what this is?”
rows.translation: “等等，等一下。”你说着举起石棒。“你知道这是什么吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wait, wait,” you say, holding out the rod. “Do you know what this is?”"

rows.original: The soldier twitches her feelers at you and reaches one of her hands out to take it from you. She looks it over a second and says “It’s a soldier’s identification,” she says, using another of her hands to reach under her uniform’s collar and draw out one just like it, hanging from her neck by a small chain. “Where’d you get this?”
rows.translation: 士兵朝你抖动触角，伸出一只手接过石棒。她看了一会儿，说道：“这是士兵的身份证明。”她说着又用另一只手伸进制服领口，拉出一根一模一样的石棒，以细链挂在脖子上。“你从哪里弄到这个的？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe soldier twitches her feelers at you and reaches one of her hands out to take it from you. She looks it over a second and says “It’s a soldier’s identification,” she says, using another of her hands to reach under her uniform’s collar and draw out one just like it, hanging from her neck by a small chain. “Where’d you get this?”"

rows.original: You tell her that you’ve visited a Federation city and met one of the trench wives there, who gave it to you. The woman scrunches her nose when you mention the captive myr’s predicament, and she hands the tag back to you. “This belongs to Captain Sierva Marsail. I remember her... she used to command this company, but that was years ago. She was listed as killed in action.”
rows.translation: 你告诉她，自己曾去过一座联邦城市，并在那里遇到一名把这东西交给你的战壕妻子。听你提起那名被俘米尔的处境，女人皱起鼻子，随后把身份牌还给你。“这是希尔瓦·玛塞尔上尉的。我记得她...她以前指挥这个连，不过那已经是很多年前的事了。她被列为阵亡人员。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her that you’ve visited a Federation city and met one of the trench wives there, who gave it to you. The woman scrunches her nose when you mention the captive myr’s predicament, and she hands the tag back to you. “This belongs to Captain Sierva Marsail. I remember her... she used to command this company, but that was years ago. She was listed as killed in action.”"

rows.original: You assure her that Sierva is indeed alive, and looking to get a message to her lover - whose description you give her. “Yeah, I saw her once. Came looking for the captain a couple weeks after she went missing. I hate to give you bad news, offworlder, but I heard her whole unit got wiped out a few months ago. The reds steamrolled the battalion defending Kressia not long before First Contact and the cease fire.”
rows.translation: 你向她保证希尔瓦的确还活着，而且正想给自己的爱人捎个口信——你把对方的外貌描述告诉了她。“对，我见过她一次。上尉失踪几个星期后，她来这里找过人。我不想告诉你坏消息，外星人，但我听说她所在的整支部队几个月前都被歼灭了。就在第一次接触和停火前不久，红方碾过了守卫克雷西亚的那个营。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou assure her that Sierva is indeed alive, and looking to get a message to her lover - whose description you give her. “Yeah, I saw her once. Came looking for the captain a couple weeks after she went missing. I hate to give you bad news, offworlder, but I heard her whole unit got wiped out a few months ago. The reds steamrolled the battalion defending Kressia not long before First Contact and the cease fire.”"

rows.original: Wait, Iaya’s unit was defending Kressia? Shit...
rows.translation: 等等，艾雅的部队当时正在守卫克雷西亚？该死...
rows.raw: "\n\nWait, Iaya’s unit was defending Kressia? Shit..."

rows.translation: 就连你也无法对其中的讽刺意味笑出声来。
rows.raw: " even you can’t manage to laugh at the irony of it."

rows.original: “Sorry, star-walker,” the guard says. “If you end up back that way, tell the captain we’ll be coming to get her... someday. Stay strong.”
rows.translation: “抱歉，星行者，”守卫说道。“如果你最后又回到那边，告诉队长，我们会去接她的……总有一天。一定要坚强。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry, star-walker,” the guard says. “If you end up back that way, tell the captain we’ll be coming to get her... someday. Stay strong.”"

rows.translation: 你点点头，让女守卫回到自己的岗位上。

rows.original: You walk over to the light haired myrmedion, planning to ask her if she wants a drink. Her features are as fair as her hair, pale white skin with rosy cheeks and dark obsidian eyes. Her arms are hidden under a blanket that surrounds her body below the neck. The blanket prevents any detailed examination of her body, but judging by how tightly she’s hugging it to herself she could be quite curvaceous and you wouldn’t be able to tell. She retains her nervous look as you come closer, avoiding direct eye contact until you’re standing at her table.
rows.translation: 你走向那名浅发色的米尔米迪恩，打算问她要不要喝一杯。她的五官和头发一样白皙，苍白的皮肤上透着红润的双颊，一双眼睛如黑曜石般深邃。她脖子以下的身体都裹在一条毯子里，双臂也藏在其中。毯子让你无法仔细观察她的身材，不过从她紧紧抱住毯子的样子来看，就算她曲线丰盈，你也无从分辨。你走近时，她依然显得紧张，一直回避与你对视，直到你站到她桌旁。
rows.raw: "You walk over to the light haired myrmedion, planning to ask her if she wants a drink. Her features are as fair as her hair, pale white skin with rosy cheeks and dark obsidian eyes. Her arms are hidden under a blanket that surrounds her body below the neck. The blanket prevents any detailed examination of her body, but judging by how tightly she’s hugging it to herself she could be quite curvaceous and you wouldn’t be able to tell. She retains her nervous look as you come closer, avoiding direct eye contact until you’re standing at her table."

rows.original: “Hey there, could I buy you a-”
rows.translation: “你好，我能请你喝一——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey there, could I buy you a-”"

rows.original: “Please don’t report me! I’ll p-pay you,” she blurts out, throwing her arms out of the blanket and holding her hands up protectively. The cloth falls away in the process, revealing a thin but fit frame covered by the uniform of the gold myr military. An insignia detailing a wispy green cloud with folded angelic wings is emblazoned on its upper left shoulder. Its lower left shoulder is torn away, revealing a nasty looking surgical scar where her fourth arm is missing. Her voice was quiet enough that only you heard her words, but some closer bar patrons looked up for a moment before returning to their drinks and jovial talk. You sit down next to the shuddering myrmedion, cocking an eyebrow and asking what you would report her for. She looks about ready to break down crying, but manages to hold it together as she explains.
rows.translation: “请别举报我！我会付、付钱给你的，”她脱口而出，双臂从毯子里猛地伸出，防备地举起双手。毯子随之滑落，露出她纤瘦却健美的身躯，身上穿着金米尔军队的制服。左上臂处绣着一枚徽章，图案是一缕朦胧的绿色云雾，配有收拢的天使翅膀。左下方的袖子已经撕裂，露出她第四条手臂缺失处一道骇人的手术疤痕。她说话的声音很轻，只有你听见了，不过附近几名酒客还是抬头看了一眼，随即又继续饮酒谈笑。你在瑟瑟发抖的米尔米迪恩身旁坐下，挑起眉毛，问她究竟有什么可被举报的。她看起来几乎要哭出来，但还是强忍着情绪解释起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Please don’t report me! I’ll p-pay you,” she blurts out, throwing her arms out of the blanket and holding her hands up protectively. The cloth falls away in the process, revealing a thin but fit frame covered by the uniform of the gold myr military. An insignia detailing a wispy green cloud with folded angelic wings is emblazoned on its upper left shoulder. Its lower left shoulder is torn away, revealing a nasty looking surgical scar where her fourth arm is missing. Her voice was quiet enough that only you heard her words, but some closer bar patrons looked up for a moment before returning to their drinks and jovial talk. You sit down next to the shuddering myrmedion, cocking an eyebrow and asking what you would report her for. She looks about ready to break down crying, but manages to hold it together as she explains."

rows.original: “I-I ran away from the army. Usually you hear of people doing that and getting away with it. Before now there’s been too much chaos to prioritize hunting down deserters. But ever since the space people came the officers hire bounty hunters to bring in deserters for who knows what kind of punishment. I don’t want to go through anything like that. Then again they might just think I’m dead. Some deserters are found dead before they even got back to the cities,” she says, covering her face with her upper pair of hands. Her lower right one struggles to find its missing twin for a moment before balling into a fist and pressing into the table. After a few seconds of this she forces herself to relax, putting all of her hands palms down on the table and breathing deeply.
rows.translation: “我、我从军队里逃了。通常也会听说有人这么做而且成功逃脱。以前局势太混乱，根本顾不上追捕逃兵。可自从太空人来了以后，军官们就雇赏金猎人抓回逃兵，谁知道会受到什么惩罚。我不想经历那种事。话说回来，他们也可能只当我已经死了。有些逃兵甚至还没回到城市就被发现死在外面，”她说着，用上方的一双手捂住脸。她右下方的手臂下意识地寻找已经失去的另一只手，片刻后才握成拳头，抵在桌面上。过了几秒，她强迫自己放松，把所有手掌都平放在桌上，深深呼吸。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I-I ran away from the army. Usually you hear of people doing that and getting away with it. Before now there’s been too much chaos to prioritize hunting down deserters. But ever since the space people came the officers hire bounty hunters to bring in deserters for who knows what kind of punishment. I don’t want to go through anything like that. Then again they might just think I’m dead. Some deserters are found dead before they even got back to the cities,” she says, covering her face with her upper pair of hands. Her lower right one struggles to find its missing twin for a moment before balling into a fist and pressing into the table. After a few seconds of this she forces herself to relax, putting all of her hands palms down on the table and breathing deeply."

rows.original: “Sorry about that. I haven’t gotten a lot of sleep for the last couple days. I get scared from the smallest things and I don’t really have any place to go. I’ve been sleeping in the medical bay where people go for treatment from the space-faring races. I’m not sure whether to trust them, so I only ask for a bed. I’m afraid if I tell them too much they might turn me in to the military command,” she says, returning to fidgeting about halfway through. The longer she talks the more fearful she seems to get, and you put a hand on her shoulder to comfort her. She jumps at your touch, but then relaxes a little and smiles.
rows.translation: “对不起。我这几天一直没怎么睡好。一点小事都会吓到我，而且我也无处可去。我一直睡在医疗区，就是太空种族给人治病的地方。我不知道该不该相信他们，所以只求他们给我一张床。我怕自己说得太多，他们会把我交给军事指挥部，”她说道，讲到一半又开始坐立不安。她说得越久，看起来就越害怕；你把一只手放在她肩上安慰她。她被你的触碰吓得一颤，随后稍稍放松下来，露出微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry about that. I haven’t gotten a lot of sleep for the last couple days. I get scared from the smallest things and I don’t really have any place to go. I’ve been sleeping in the medical bay where people go for treatment from the space-faring races. I’m not sure whether to trust them, so I only ask for a bed. I’m afraid if I tell them too much they might turn me in to the military command,” she says, returning to fidgeting about halfway through. The longer she talks the more fearful she seems to get, and you put a hand on her shoulder to comfort her. She jumps at your touch, but then relaxes a little and smiles."

rows.original: “I don’t have the same kind of money as you have in space, but I could pay you in s-sex if you don’t tell anyone about me. My name is Liliana by the way, Liliana Aleszra” she says sheepishly, her rosy cheeks flushing scarlet. You reply with your name before contemplating your decision. You could have sex with her, or you could prod her to continue talking.
rows.translation: “我没有你们太空里用的那种钱，但只要你不把我的事告诉别人，我可以用性、性爱来付钱。顺便说，我叫莉莉安娜，莉莉安娜·阿莱兹拉。”她难为情地说道，红润的脸颊涨得绯红。你也报上自己的名字，随后考虑起该怎么选择。你可以和她上床，也可以追问下去，让她继续说。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t have the same kind of money as you have in space, but I could pay you in s-sex if you don’t tell anyone about me. My name is Liliana by the way, Liliana Aleszra” she says sheepishly, her rosy cheeks flushing scarlet. You reply with your name before contemplating your decision. You could have sex with her, or you could prod her to continue talking."

rows.original: You tell Liliana you’d like to hear about her time in the army and why she deserted. She looks earnest but hugs herself tightly. She seems happy to have someone to talk to, but apprehensive about the subject. You put one of your hands over hers, calming their erratic movements for the moment.
rows.translation: 你告诉莉莉安娜，你想听听她在军队里的经历，以及她为何逃走。她神情诚恳，却紧紧抱住自己。她似乎很高兴有人愿意听她倾诉，但对这个话题又颇为不安。你将一只手覆在她手上，暂时止住了那些慌乱的小动作。
rows.raw: "You tell Liliana you’d like to hear about her time in the army and why she deserted. She looks earnest but hugs herself tightly. She seems happy to have someone to talk to, but apprehensive about the subject. You put one of your hands over hers, calming their erratic movements for the moment."

rows.original: “Okay. I got drafted just a short time ago. At first I was scared. Who wouldn’t be going into war with a pretty low survival rating? I didn’t want to get chopped up into little pieces because I couldn’t hold the swords and axes they use. I got through training because the other girls were drafted too, and they were nice. I didn’t know any of them going into training, but I got so close to some of them that I didn’t want to be separated when it came to assignment time,” she says calmly. When the topic of her assignment comes up she pauses uncomfortably.
rows.translation: “好吧。我不久前才被征召入伍。起初我很害怕。要去打一场生还率很低的战争，谁会不怕呢？我不想因为拿不稳她们用的刀剑和斧头，就被剁成碎块。和我一起受训的女孩们也都是被征召来的，她们人都很好，所以我才熬过了训练。刚进训练营时，我一个人都不认识，可后来和其中一些人变得非常亲近，以至于分配岗位的时候，我一点也不想和她们分开，”她平静地说道。谈到自己的岗位时，她不安地停了下来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay. I got drafted just a short time ago. At first I was scared. Who wouldn’t be going into war with a pretty low survival rating? I didn’t want to get chopped up into little pieces because I couldn’t hold the swords and axes they use. I got through training because the other girls were drafted too, and they were nice. I didn’t know any of them going into training, but I got so close to some of them that I didn’t want to be separated when it came to assignment time,” she says calmly. When the topic of her assignment comes up she pauses uncomfortably."

rows.original: “So... even after training I still couldn’t use axes effectively, and to make it worse I can’t shoot very well. The army is desperate nowadays though, so they found me a position. I got a field promotion to chemical division less than a week after I got to the battlefield. The girls I was deployed with told me not to worry, because it’s really easy and they usually go in when there isn’t any shooting going on,” she continues, pointing to the emblem on her shoulder as if to elaborate before she pulls her blanket tighter around herself.
rows.translation: “所以……即便完成训练，我还是不会有效地使用斧头，更糟的是，我枪也打不好。不过军队现在非常缺人，所以还是给我安排了位置。我到战场还不到一周，就被临时提拔去了化学部。和我一起部署的女孩们叫我别担心，说那工作很容易，她们通常只在没有交火的时候出动，”她继续说道，指了指肩上的徽章，仿佛这样就能说明一切，随后又把毯子裹得更紧。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So... even after training I still couldn’t use axes effectively, and to make it worse I can’t shoot very well. The army is desperate nowadays though, so they found me a position. I got a field promotion to chemical division less than a week after I got to the battlefield. The girls I was deployed with told me not to worry, because it’s really easy and they usually go in when there isn’t any shooting going on,” she continues, pointing to the emblem on her shoulder as if to elaborate before she pulls her blanket tighter around herself."

rows.original: “I met one of the scientists that head the division on my first day there. She really made me feel at home, and told me some things about my equipment and duties in my new position. The chemical division wear these bulky air-tight suits hooked up to large oxygen and gas tanks. When we weren’t on the field we pretty much got to have free time in whatever cities were nearest to our deployment area, but when we went out we would clear the path for the other soldiers. Without us they would have had a much tougher time fighting the entrenched red soldiers.” she says. At the end of this portion of speech she clenches her fists so hard her knuckles turn white.
rows.translation: “到那里的第一天，我见到了一位负责这个部门的科学家。她真的让我觉得宾至如归，还告诉了我一些新岗位上的装备和职责。化学部要穿这种笨重的气密服，接上大型氧气罐和毒气罐。不出任务时，我们基本可以在离部署区最近的城市里自由活动；可一旦出动，就得为其他士兵清理道路。没有我们，她们要对付固守阵地的红方士兵会困难得多。”她说道。说完这一段时，她将拳头攥得太紧，指节都泛白了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I met one of the scientists that head the division on my first day there. She really made me feel at home, and told me some things about my equipment and duties in my new position. The chemical division wear these bulky air-tight suits hooked up to large oxygen and gas tanks. When we weren’t on the field we pretty much got to have free time in whatever cities were nearest to our deployment area, but when we went out we would clear the path for the other soldiers. Without us they would have had a much tougher time fighting the entrenched red soldiers.” she says. At the end of this portion of speech she clenches her fists so hard her knuckles turn white."

rows.original: “I got my first actual mission maybe two weeks after that. I had to go out in the middle of the night and gas a trench, that’s all. It was an area that had been deadlocked for months. The transport dropped me off at our trench, and I had to walk to the red side in my suit. It was very dark and the fog was thick, so I couldn’t see much of anything. The red trench wasn’t too far away. It felt like an eternity because of the darkness, but I suppose it helped when they couldn’t see me either. I got right up to the lookout’s post before they saw anything, and by then it was too late. They taught us in practice to start the gas going just before we reached the target, that way the enemy wouldn’t hear the mechanisms startup. The lookout took the gas first, and was out by the time she gasped to sound the alarm,” she says shakily. You’re afraid for a moment that she’ll hurt herself with how tense she is, but she notices her tightness and relaxes a little.
rows.translation: “大约两周后，我接到了第一次真正的任务。我只需要在半夜出去，往一条战壕里放毒气，仅此而已。那片区域已经僵持了好几个月。运输车把我送到我方战壕，我得穿着防护服徒步走到红方那边。天很黑，雾也很浓，我几乎什么都看不见。红方战壕其实并不远，但黑暗让那段路仿佛永无尽头。不过我想，敌人也看不见我，这反而有所帮助。我一直走到哨兵的岗位附近，她们才发现异常，可那时已经太迟了。训练时教官教我们，在抵达目标前就要开始释放毒气，这样敌人就听不到装置启动的声音。哨兵最先吸入毒气，等她喘着气想发出警报时，已经昏过去了，”她颤抖着说道。有一瞬间，你担心她会因为全身绷得太紧而伤到自己，不过她也察觉到了，稍稍放松下来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I got my first actual mission maybe two weeks after that. I had to go out in the middle of the night and gas a trench, that’s all. It was an area that had been deadlocked for months. The transport dropped me off at our trench, and I had to walk to the red side in my suit. It was very dark and the fog was thick, so I couldn’t see much of anything. The red trench wasn’t too far away. It felt like an eternity because of the darkness, but I suppose it helped when they couldn’t see me either. I got right up to the lookout’s post before they saw anything, and by then it was too late. They taught us in practice to start the gas going just before we reached the target, that way the enemy wouldn’t hear the mechanisms startup. The lookout took the gas first, and was out by the time she gasped to sound the alarm,” she says shakily. You’re afraid for a moment that she’ll hurt herself with how tense she is, but she notices her tightness and relaxes a little."

rows.original: “They call this new stuff Angel’s Breath, because the people it affects just go to sleep. The lookout kind of sighed and fell at the entrance to the trench, and then all I had to do was walk along the edge and let the gas do its work. The reds that weren’t already sleeping managed a glance at me before the gas reached their lungs. They all just fell where they were sitting, peaceful looks on their faces...” The poor ant-girl looks on the verge of a breakdown, and you
rows.translation: “这种新毒气叫作‘天使之息’，因为中招的人只会睡过去。哨兵像是叹了口气，倒在战壕入口，之后我只需要沿着边缘行走，让毒气发挥作用。那些还没睡着的红方士兵在毒气进入肺部前勉强看了我一眼。她们就那样倒在坐着的地方，脸上的表情十分安详……”这个可怜的蚁女几乎就要崩溃，你
rows.raw: "\n\n“They call this new stuff Angel’s Breath, because the people it affects just go to sleep. The lookout kind of sighed and fell at the entrance to the trench, and then all I had to do was walk along the edge and let the gas do its work. The reds that weren’t already sleeping managed a glance at me before the gas reached their lungs. They all just fell where they were sitting, peaceful looks on their faces...” The poor ant-girl looks on the verge of a breakdown, and you "

rows.original: gently squeeze her shoulder to calm her
rows.translation: 轻轻捏了捏她的肩膀，让她平静下来
rows.raw: "gently squeeze her shoulder to calm her"

rows.original: firmly grasp her shoulder to encourage her
rows.translation: 坚定地握住她的肩膀，鼓励她继续
rows.raw: "firmly grasp her shoulder to encourage her"

rows.original: . She takes a deep breath and continues her story.
rows.translation: 。她深吸一口气，继续讲述。
rows.raw: ". She takes a deep breath and continues her story."

rows.original: “By the time I got to the end, one of the red soldiers had managed to pull her weapon before the gas got to her. The suit I was in was too big and heavy for any kind of quick movement, or anything other than a slow walk. I couldn’t do anything to get out of the way before she shot. The bullet went right through the suit and lodged itself in my arm. Worse, some of the gas seeped through the hole and into my suit. I only had a few seconds to react before I breathed it in. It hurt so much I couldn’t think. I don’t know how many times I came back to consciousness only for that feeling to still be threading itself inside me,” she continues. All the tension has been sucked out of her body, as if even the memory of the events is too much to fight.
rows.translation: “等我走到尽头时，一名红方士兵在毒气侵袭她之前设法拔出了武器。我穿的防护服太过庞大沉重，根本做不了任何快速动作，只能缓慢行走。她开枪时，我完全来不及躲避。子弹直接穿透防护服，嵌进我的手臂。更糟的是，一些毒气从破洞渗进了防护服。我只剩几秒钟作出反应，随后便吸入了毒气。实在太痛了，我根本无法思考。我不知道自己清醒了多少次，每次醒来，那种感觉依然像丝线一样钻进我的身体，”她继续说道。她全身的紧张感都消失了，仿佛仅仅回忆这些经历，就已经让她无力抵抗。
rows.raw: "\n\n“By the time I got to the end, one of the red soldiers had managed to pull her weapon before the gas got to her. The suit I was in was too big and heavy for any kind of quick movement, or anything other than a slow walk. I couldn’t do anything to get out of the way before she shot. The bullet went right through the suit and lodged itself in my arm. Worse, some of the gas seeped through the hole and into my suit. I only had a few seconds to react before I breathed it in. It hurt so much I couldn’t think. I don’t know how many times I came back to consciousness only for that feeling to still be threading itself inside me,” she continues. All the tension has been sucked out of her body, as if even the memory of the events is too much to fight."

rows.original: “I don’t know how long I was there before someone came to get me. I don’t think they even came to get me, they just came to finish off the reds in the trench and found me there. Either way, the next time I was conscious was in the field hospital. My arm had gotten badly infected by the time they got me back, so the medics had to cut it off while I was out. They sent me here to the alien doctors because your medicine is better at dealing with infections like this. I got the medicine and have been using the beds there ever since. I don’t want to go back knowing that that’s what the other side of the conflict is feeling. I usually come here during the day. I’m not much of a drinker, but the ‘tee vee’ screens sometimes show fun things that I like to watch,” she says, her attitude getting a little brighter at the end.
rows.translation: “我不知道自己在那里躺了多久才有人来。我觉得她们甚至不是来救我的，只是来解决战壕里剩下的红方士兵，碰巧发现了我。不管怎样，下一次醒来时，我已经在野战医院了。她们把我带回去时，手臂已经严重感染，医护人员只能趁我昏迷时把它截掉。她们把我送到这里的外星医生这边，因为你们的医疗技术更擅长处理这种感染。我拿到了药，从那以后一直睡在这里的病床上。我不想回去，因为我已经知道冲突另一边的人承受着什么。我白天通常会来这里。我不太爱喝酒，不过那些‘电、电视’屏幕有时会播放我喜欢看的有趣节目，”她说到最后，情绪稍稍明朗起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t know how long I was there before someone came to get me. I don’t think they even came to get me, they just came to finish off the reds in the trench and found me there. Either way, the next time I was conscious was in the field hospital. My arm had gotten badly infected by the time they got me back, so the medics had to cut it off while I was out. They sent me here to the alien doctors because your medicine is better at dealing with infections like this. I got the medicine and have been using the beds there ever since. I don’t want to go back knowing that that’s what the other side of the conflict is feeling. I usually come here during the day. I’m not much of a drinker, but the ‘tee vee’ screens sometimes show fun things that I like to watch,” she says, her attitude getting a little brighter at the end."

rows.original: “The cuts have healed over now, and the infection is gone, but I still sometimes feel like my arm is still there. I’ll reach for things and wonder why I didn’t pick them up, or try to catch something that’s dropping. I’m glad for having two sets of arms so I can at least still hold things from both sides. Thanks for listening I guess,” she says, twirling a finger through her sandy gold hair.
rows.translation: “伤口现在已经愈合，感染也消失了，可有时候我还是会觉得那条手臂仍然存在。我会伸手去拿东西，然后纳闷自己为什么没拿起来，或是想接住正在掉落的东西。幸好我本来就有两对手臂，至少现在仍能从两边拿东西。谢谢你愿意听我说这些吧，”她说道，一根手指绕弄着沙金色的头发。
rows.raw: "\n\n“The cuts have healed over now, and the infection is gone, but I still sometimes feel like my arm is still there. I’ll reach for things and wonder why I didn’t pick them up, or try to catch something that’s dropping. I’m glad for having two sets of arms so I can at least still hold things from both sides. Thanks for listening I guess,” she says, twirling a finger through her sandy gold hair. "

rows.original: You tell her you were happy to listen.
rows.translation: 你告诉她，自己很乐意倾听。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her you were happy to listen."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You ask Liliana why she didn’t ask the doctors in the DMZ to fix her arm, as you’re sure they could do something to help. If they didn’t offer full regeneration, you’re sure they would be willing to replace it with a mechanical one. She looks embarrassed, as if she’s heard this question before. She rubs the scarred area with what would be the missing arm’s opposite.
rows.translation: 你问莉莉安娜，为什么不请非军事区的医生修复她的手臂；你相信他们肯定有办法帮忙。就算不能完整再生，应该也愿意替她安装一条机械手臂。她显得很难为情，仿佛以前已经被问过这个问题。她用与缺失手臂相对的那只手，揉了揉疤痕处。
rows.raw: "You ask Liliana why she didn’t ask the doctors in the DMZ to fix her arm, as you’re sure they could do something to help. If they didn’t offer full regeneration, you’re sure they would be willing to replace it with a mechanical one. She looks embarrassed, as if she’s heard this question before. She rubs the scarred area with what would be the missing arm’s opposite."

rows.original: “They told me they might be able to help when I first came, but I told them I wasn’t sure and they didn’t push it. People of all sorts come to this bar, some of them have arms like that. I’m not sure if I could go back to how I used to live if part of me was, well, alien. No offense,” she says, giving you a slightly ashamed glance when she pauses. You assure her that none was taken before asking what she means about not being able to go back.
rows.translation: “我刚来的时候，她们说或许可以帮忙，可我说自己还没想好，她们也就没再逼我。各种各样的人都会来这间酒吧，有些人的手臂就是那样的。我不确定，如果身体的一部分变成了外星造物，我还能不能回到从前的生活。无意冒犯，”她说道，停顿时略带歉意地看了你一眼。你向她保证自己并未介意，随后问她所谓无法回到从前是什么意思。
rows.raw: "\n\n“They told me they might be able to help when I first came, but I told them I wasn’t sure and they didn’t push it. People of all sorts come to this bar, some of them have arms like that. I’m not sure if I could go back to how I used to live if part of me was, well, alien. No offense,” she says, giving you a slightly ashamed glance when she pauses. You assure her that none was taken before asking what she means about not being able to go back."

rows.original: “On our planet you hear about people exploring in the deep caves and coming back with weird fungus creatures attached to them. I’ve never actually seen one of them for myself but I hear they’re treated as oddities. The space doctors told us that they might be dangerous, a ‘fungal infection’. I don’t know about dangerous, but they’re certainly treated differently than normal. I’m afraid if I get an arm like that I might be treated like they are. Like maybe part of me isn’t me anymore,” She says, her knuckles turning white as she grips the scarred portion of her side. You figure she could use some encouragement, since this doesn’t seem to be the healthiest thing to be dwelling on.
rows.translation: “在我们星球上，总能听说有人去深层洞穴探险，回来时身上附着着奇怪的真菌生物。我其实从没亲眼见过，但听说她们会被当成异类。太空医生说，那些东西可能很危险，是一种‘真菌感染’。我不知道究竟危不危险，可她们受到的待遇肯定与普通人不同。我担心如果装上那样的手臂，别人也会像对待她们一样对待我。仿佛我的一部分不再是我自己，”她说道，紧抓着身侧的疤痕，指节都变得惨白。你觉得她需要一些鼓励，因为一直纠结这种事显然并不健康。
rows.raw: "\n\n“On our planet you hear about people exploring in the deep caves and coming back with weird fungus creatures attached to them. I’ve never actually seen one of them for myself but I hear they’re treated as oddities. The space doctors told us that they might be dangerous, a ‘fungal infection’. I don’t know about dangerous, but they’re certainly treated differently than normal. I’m afraid if I get an arm like that I might be treated like they are. Like maybe part of me isn’t me anymore,” She says, her knuckles turning white as she grips the scarred portion of her side. You figure she could use some encouragement, since this doesn’t seem to be the healthiest thing to be dwelling on."

rows.original: You ask Liliana about the doctor you met, and smile when she nearly chokes on her drink. You ask her if she’s talked to her since she got her new arm.
rows.translation: 你向莉莉安娜问起自己见过的那位医生；看到她差点被饮料呛到，你不禁笑了起来。你问她，自从装上新手臂后，有没有和那位医生谈过。
rows.raw: "You ask Liliana about the doctor you met, and smile when she nearly chokes on her drink. You ask her if she’s talked to her since she got her new arm."

rows.original: “W-well, I kinda... I’m not... I don’t know if I should,” she says nervously, shrugging her shoulders and shrinking into her blanket. She looks somewhat down and unsure of herself. You ask her why she shouldn’t. After all, the doc told her it was okay to contact her.
rows.translation: “这、这个嘛，我有点……我不是……我不知道自己该不该去，”她紧张地说道，缩着肩膀，把自己藏进毯子里。她看起来有些低落，对自己也没有信心。你问她为什么不该去。毕竟那位医生说过，她可以去联系她。
rows.raw: "\n\n“W-well, I kinda... I’m not... I don’t know if I should,” she says nervously, shrugging her shoulders and shrinking into her blanket. She looks somewhat down and unsure of herself. You ask her why she shouldn’t. After all, the doc told her it was okay to contact her."

rows.original: “Yeah, but that was for emergencies. It’s not like she’s waiting for me to come see her,” she continues. You tell her she doesn’t need to be. Even on an edge world relief mission she still has to have some time off, and that’s when she should ask.
rows.translation: “是啊，可那是为了紧急情况。她又不会等着我去找她，”她继续说道。你告诉她，不需要有人等她。即使在边缘世界执行救援任务，她也一定会有休息时间，到那时去问就好。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, but that was for emergencies. It’s not like she’s waiting for me to come see her,” she continues. You tell her she doesn’t need to be. Even on an edge world relief mission she still has to have some time off, and that’s when she should ask."

rows.original: “I don’t know, do you think she’d like me? I don’t know if her race is into people of the same gender, let alone different races,” she says, still sounding discouraged. You tell her you know for a fact that most leithan aren’t opposed to relationships with other species, and as for gender she’ll have to ask her in person. You mention that even if it’s tough getting up the nerve to ask her, it’ll be worth it even if she gets turned down.
rows.translation: “我不知道，你觉得她会喜欢我吗？我不知道她的种族会不会喜欢同性，更别说不同种族了，”她说道，语气仍然十分沮丧。你告诉她，你很确定大多数莱萨人并不排斥与其他种族恋爱；至于性别，她只能当面去问。你还说，就算鼓起勇气开口很难，即使最后遭到拒绝，这次尝试也仍然值得。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t know, do you think she’d like me? I don’t know if her race is into people of the same gender, let alone different races,” she says, still sounding discouraged. You tell her you know for a fact that most leithan aren’t opposed to relationships with other species, and as for gender she’ll have to ask her in person. You mention that even if it’s tough getting up the nerve to ask her, it’ll be worth it even if she gets turned down."

rows.original: “Because it’s good practice? That sounds kinda dumb,” she replies skeptically. You tell her that’s part of it, but she’ll have gotten over some of her shyness, making it easier for her to ask other people. All of which is only hypothetical if Anilla accepts her offer. You remind her that she doesn’t have to ask about a relationship right away, she could just ask her out to lunch or dinner first.
rows.translation: “因为这样能积累经验？听起来有点蠢，”她怀疑地回答。你告诉她，这的确是一部分原因，但她也能借此克服一些羞怯，以后邀请别人就会更容易。当然，如果安妮拉接受她的邀约，这些都只是无须考虑的假设。你提醒她，不必一开始就提出交往，可以先约她共进午餐或晚餐。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Because it’s good practice? That sounds kinda dumb,” she replies skeptically. You tell her that’s part of it, but she’ll have gotten over some of her shyness, making it easier for her to ask other people. All of which is only hypothetical if Anilla accepts her offer. You remind her that she doesn’t have to ask about a relationship right away, she could just ask her out to lunch or dinner first."

rows.original: “Hmm. If you say so. I guess it’s worth a try,” she says, getting up with her blanket around her shoulders. She tells you she’s going to go ask if she’s on break or off time right now, so long as you don’t mind her leaving. You wish her the best of luck and send her on her way, smiling to yourself and hoping your matchmaking skills are as good as your flirting before returning to your previous endeavors.
rows.translation: “嗯。既然你这么说，我想值得试试，”她说道，披着毯子站起身。她告诉你，只要你不介意她先离开，她现在就去问问那位医生是否正在休息或已经下班。你祝她好运，目送她离去；你微笑着，希望自己的牵线本领和调情技巧一样高明，随后继续先前的活动。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm. If you say so. I guess it’s worth a try,” she says, getting up with her blanket around her shoulders. She tells you she’s going to go ask if she’s on break or off time right now, so long as you don’t mind her leaving. You wish her the best of luck and send her on her way, smiling to yourself and hoping your matchmaking skills are as good as your flirting before returning to your previous endeavors."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You put a hand over her strained fingers, and she jumps before relaxing. A hand-shaped mark is left over the smooth scar before it slowly fades back to a uniform waxy pink. You tell her if she really doesn’t want to fix the arm there’s no need to do so. She shouldn’t think about it so hard if it makes her this stressed. She still has three perfectly good arms, which is one more than you’ve got. Unless she’s decided on an offworld heavy lifting career while you were away, it’s fine. You also tell her that sometimes you wish you had even one extra arm to help with various tasks. She laughs at this and gives you a smile.
rows.translation: 你把一只手覆在她绷紧的手指上，她先是一惊，随即放松下来。光滑的疤痕上留下了一枚手掌形的印记，随后缓缓恢复成均匀的蜡粉色。你告诉她，如果她真的不想修复手臂，就没有必要这么做。如果这件事让她如此焦虑，就不该想得太沉重。她还有三条完全健全的手臂，比你还多一条。除非她趁你不在时决定去外星从事重体力劳动，否则根本没关系。你还告诉她，有时候自己也希望能多一条手臂，方便完成各种事情。她听后笑了，向你露出微笑。
rows.raw: "You put a hand over her strained fingers, and she jumps before relaxing. A hand-shaped mark is left over the smooth scar before it slowly fades back to a uniform waxy pink. You tell her if she really doesn’t want to fix the arm there’s no need to do so. She shouldn’t think about it so hard if it makes her this stressed. She still has three perfectly good arms, which is one more than you’ve got. Unless she’s decided on an offworld heavy lifting career while you were away, it’s fine. You also tell her that sometimes you wish you had even one extra arm to help with various tasks. She laughs at this and gives you a smile."

rows.original: “I guess you’re right. I’ve been so worried about what people would think if I did do it that I forgot leaving them like this was an option. I guess the phantom feelings made me feel like I needed to have it back. Thanks for helping me get a little of this stress out,” she says thankfully. You ask her if her planet has physical therapy for people with missing limbs. That might help with the phantom pains and tenseness.
rows.translation: “我想你说得对。我一直担心装上手臂后别人会怎么看我，反而忘了维持现状也是一种选择。或许是幻肢感让我觉得自己非得把它找回来。谢谢你帮我排解了一些压力，”她感激地说道。你问她的星球上是否有为肢体缺失者提供的物理治疗，那或许能缓解幻肢痛和紧绷感。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I guess you’re right. I’ve been so worried about what people would think if I did do it that I forgot leaving them like this was an option. I guess the phantom feelings made me feel like I needed to have it back. Thanks for helping me get a little of this stress out,” she says thankfully. You ask her if her planet has physical therapy for people with missing limbs. That might help with the phantom pains and tenseness."

rows.original: “I don’t know if there’s anything like that specifically, but I know there are a couple therapy places in the city I live in. Maybe after all this is over I could ask if they know any ways to help. I’m sure they wouldn’t mind trying even if it wasn’t their specialty,” she continues. Her mood seems to have markedly improved since you started talking with her.
rows.translation: “我不知道有没有专门做这种治疗的地方，不过我住的城市里有几家理疗机构。等这一切结束以后，我可以去问问她们是否知道什么办法。就算这不是她们的专长，我相信她们也不会介意试一试，”她继续说道。自从你开始和她交谈，她的情绪显然已经好转了许多。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t know if there’s anything like that specifically, but I know there are a couple therapy places in the city I live in. Maybe after all this is over I could ask if they know any ways to help. I’m sure they wouldn’t mind trying even if it wasn’t their specialty,” she continues. Her mood seems to have markedly improved since you started talking with her."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You bolt upright, causing the tensed ant-girl to nearly jump out of her covering. She follows as you grasp her arm, pulling her out of the bar. You’re going to help her get over her fears and have a new arm for her if you have to carry her to the relief hospital yourself. She blushes intensely at the mention of you carrying her, and begins to follow your gently tugging lead.
rows.translation: 你猛地站直身体，吓得紧张的蚁女差点从毯子里跳出来。你抓住她的手臂，把她拉出酒吧，她也跟了上来。你要帮她克服恐惧，替她弄到一条新手臂；哪怕必须亲自把她抱到救援医院也在所不惜。听到你说要抱她，她的脸一下子红透了，随后顺从你轻柔的牵引跟了上来。
rows.raw: "You bolt upright, causing the tensed ant-girl to nearly jump out of her covering. She follows as you grasp her arm, pulling her out of the bar. You’re going to help her get over her fears and have a new arm for her if you have to carry her to the relief hospital yourself. She blushes intensely at the mention of you carrying her, and begins to follow your gently tugging lead."

rows.original: You bring her out of the bar, drawing her toward the part of the DMZ that serves as the infirmary. A nurse at the waiting area tells you who you would talk to about lost limb recovery, pointing you down a hallway to a door on the right. You walk into the room to find
rows.translation: 你把她带出酒吧，领向非军事区内充当医务室的区域。等候区的一名护士告诉你，关于断肢恢复该去找谁，并指引你沿走廊前往右侧的一扇门。你走进房间，看见
rows.raw: "\n\nYou bring her out of the bar, drawing her toward the part of the DMZ that serves as the infirmary. A nurse at the waiting area tells you who you would talk to about lost limb recovery, pointing you down a hallway to a door on the right. You walk into the room to find "

rows.original: Leithans
rows.raw: "Leithans"

rows.original: a studious looking leithan doctor
rows.translation: 一位看起来很有学究气质的莱萨人医生
rows.raw: "a studious looking leithan doctor"

rows.original: a lizard-taur that your codex identifies as a leithan
rows.translation: 一位被你的资料库识别为莱萨人的蜥蜴半人马
rows.raw: "a lizard-taur that your codex identifies as a leithan"

rows.original: . The chitin-armored lady looks up when you enter, smiling but cocking an eyebrow at the situation.
rows.translation: 。这位身披几丁质甲壳的女士在你们进门时抬起头，面带微笑，却又因眼前的情形挑起眉毛。
rows.raw: ". The chitin-armored lady looks up when you enter, smiling but cocking an eyebrow at the situation."

rows.original: “May I help you?” she asks, stepping out from behind her desk. You gently prod Liliana until she’s in front of the doctor, and cough to encourage her to talk. She gawks for a moment, reminding you that this might be the first time she’s seen some of the races that aren’t from her planet. She attempts to shake the embarrassment off before answering the tauric doctor.
rows.translation: “我能帮你们吗？”她问道，从桌后走出来。你轻轻推了推莉莉安娜，让她站到医生面前，又咳嗽一声，鼓励她开口。她呆望了片刻，让你想起这或许是她第一次见到来自自己星球之外的种族。她试着甩掉尴尬，回答了这位半人马体型的医生。
rows.raw: "\n\n“May I help you?” she asks, stepping out from behind her desk. You gently prod Liliana until she’s in front of the doctor, and cough to encourage her to talk. She gawks for a moment, reminding you that this might be the first time she’s seen some of the races that aren’t from her planet. She attempts to shake the embarrassment off before answering the tauric doctor."

rows.original: “Uh... I... Arm. You see,” she mumbles, pointing to the tattered hole in her uniform. The doctor walks over to her and examines the hole. She touches the scar and pokes at various parts of the ant-girl’s body.
rows.translation: “呃……我……手臂。你看，”她含糊地说道，指着制服上的破洞。医生走近，检查那个洞口。她触摸疤痕，又按了按蚁女身体的各个部位。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uh... I... Arm. You see,” she mumbles, pointing to the tattered hole in her uniform. The doctor walks over to her and examines the hole. She touches the scar and pokes at various parts of the ant-girl’s body."

rows.original: “That doesn’t look comfortable. You look a bit thin... have you been eating right?” she asks as she continues, measuring the size of the scar beneath her left arm. Liliana, for her part, blushes a deeper red than the scar tissue that remains of her arm. She sheepishly replies that she has been eating her rations. The doctor examines her side for a few more seconds before motioning for you to join her in a corner.
rows.translation: “看起来很不舒服。你有点瘦……最近有好好吃饭吗？”她一边继续检查，一边测量莉莉安娜左臂下方疤痕的尺寸。莉莉安娜则羞得满脸通红，比残臂上的疤痕组织还要红。她难为情地回答，自己一直有在吃配给口粮。医生又检查了她身侧几秒，随后示意你到角落里谈。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That doesn’t look comfortable. You look a bit thin... have you been eating right?” she asks as she continues, measuring the size of the scar beneath her left arm. Liliana, for her part, blushes a deeper red than the scar tissue that remains of her arm. She sheepishly replies that she has been eating her rations. The doctor examines her side for a few more seconds before motioning for you to join her in a corner."

rows.original: “It’s going to cost you some money if you came to get this girl’s arm back. Because of the relief efforts we’ve got replacements at a heavy discount, but there’s still a cost. A robotic replacement would cost around two thousand credits; a full regeneration would cost about six thousand. That’s a steal compared to what a similar treatment would cost on the core worlds, but JoyCo really stepped up to the plate with the support here. Either way I can do the surgery, but robotics might be a bit longer of a wait,” she whispers, giving you a kind smile and a choice.
rows.translation: “如果你是来帮这女孩恢复手臂，那可得花些钱。因为救援工作，我们能以很大折扣拿到替代肢体，但仍然有成本。机械义肢大约需要两千信用点，完整再生则要六千左右。和核心世界同类治疗的价格相比，这简直便宜得像白送，不过欢乐公司确实为这里提供了很大支持。无论选择哪种手术，我都能做，只是机器人义肢可能要等得更久一些，”她低声说道，友善地微笑着，把选择交给你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s going to cost you some money if you came to get this girl’s arm back. Because of the relief efforts we’ve got replacements at a heavy discount, but there’s still a cost. A robotic replacement would cost around two thousand credits; a full regeneration would cost about six thousand. That’s a steal compared to what a similar treatment would cost on the core worlds, but JoyCo really stepped up to the plate with the support here. Either way I can do the surgery, but robotics might be a bit longer of a wait,” she whispers, giving you a kind smile and a choice."

rows.original: Robo Arm
rows.translation: 机械手臂
rows.raw: "Robo Arm"

rows.original: Robo Arm
rows.translation: 机械手臂
rows.raw: "Robo Arm"

rows.original:
Get Liliana a robotic arm.

Costs 2000 credits.
rows.translation:
为莉莉安娜装一条机械手臂。

花费2000信用点。
rows.raw: "Get Liliana a robotic arm.\n\nCosts 2000 credits."

rows.original: Real Arm
rows.translation: 真手臂
rows.raw: "Real Arm"

rows.original: Real Arm
rows.translation: 真手臂
rows.raw: "Real Arm"

rows.original:
Pay to have the doctor regenerate Lilian’s arm.

Costs 6000 credits.
rows.translation:
付钱让医生再生莉莉安娜的手臂。

花费6000信用点。
rows.raw: "Pay to have the doctor regenerate Lilian’s arm.\n\nCosts 6000 credits."

rows.translation: 真手臂
rows.raw: "Real Arm"

rows.original: Real Arm
rows.translation: 真手臂
rows.raw: "Real Arm"

rows.original:
You don’t have the credits to get her a real arm.

Costs 6000 credits.
rows.translation:
你的信用点不足，无法为她再生一条真手臂。

花费6000信用点。
rows.raw: "You don’t have the credits to get her a real arm.\n\nCosts 6000 credits."

rows.original: “Very good, the bill will be sent to your credit account,” she says before returning to the waiting ant-girl. Liliana stands uncomfortably, fidgeting with her three remaining hands as the doctor approaches her.
rows.translation: “很好，账单会记到你的信用账户上，”她说完，重新把注意力转向等待中的蚁女。莉莉安娜不安地站在那里，三只手不停摆弄着，医生则向她走去。
rows.raw: "“Very good, the bill will be sent to your credit account,” she says before returning to the waiting ant-girl. Liliana stands uncomfortably, fidgeting with her three remaining hands as the doctor approaches her."

rows.original: “Cheer up. By the time you leave here you’ll have a whole new arm, just like the old one. I’m doctor Anilla,” she tells the nervous girl with a disarming smile. She maneuvers to a cabinet at the back of the room, fishing through it until she pulls out a small, innocuous looking container. After some effort getting the lid open, she extracts a thick but short syringe from the container. Luckily the needle isn’t nearly as thick as the syringe itself. Liliana looks at the fluid inside with hope.
rows.translation: “振作起来。等你离开这里时，就会有一条和原来一模一样的新手臂了。我是安妮拉医生，”她带着让人放松的微笑，对紧张的女孩说道。她走到房间后方的柜子前，在里面翻找片刻，取出一个小巧而不起眼的容器。费了些力气打开盖子后，她从中取出一支粗短的注射器。幸好针头远没有针筒本身那么粗。莉莉安娜满怀希望地望着其中的液体。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Cheer up. By the time you leave here you’ll have a whole new arm, just like the old one. I’m doctor Anilla,” she tells the nervous girl with a disarming smile. She maneuvers to a cabinet at the back of the room, fishing through it until she pulls out a small, innocuous looking container. After some effort getting the lid open, she extracts a thick but short syringe from the container. Luckily the needle isn’t nearly as thick as the syringe itself. Liliana looks at the fluid inside with hope."

rows.original: “Sorry for being so disorganized. This stuff would normally be in a storage area, but we’re lacking space at the moment till the base additions arrive. I’ll need you to remove the top of your uniform before we continue: the tatters might get in the way of the new arm as it grows, and that can cause some painful side effects. We can have your friend sit outside if you’d be uncomfortable, but if you’d rather [pc.heShe] be here for emotional support, that’s perfectly fine,” she says calmly. The ant-girl ex-soldier indicates that she’d rather you stay before she begins unbuttoning and removing her top.
rows.translation: “抱歉，这里有点乱。这东西通常应该放在储藏区，不过在基地扩建部分运到之前，我们暂时缺少空间。继续之前，你得脱掉制服上衣：破布可能会妨碍新手臂生长，引起痛苦的副作用。如果你觉得不自在，可以让你的朋友坐在外面；但如果你希望[pc.heShe]留下来提供精神支持，也完全没问题，”她平静地说道。蚁女逃兵表示更希望你留下，随后开始解开上衣纽扣，把它脱下来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry for being so disorganized. This stuff would normally be in a storage area, but we’re lacking space at the moment till the base additions arrive. I’ll need you to remove the top of your uniform before we continue: the tatters might get in the way of the new arm as it grows, and that can cause some painful side effects. We can have your friend sit outside if you’d be uncomfortable, but if you’d rather [pc.heShe] be here for emotional support, that’s perfectly fine,” she says calmly. The ant-girl ex-soldier indicates that she’d rather you stay before she begins unbuttoning and removing her top."

rows.original: Apart from the nasty scar by her arm, her body is surprisingly unmarred. Her fit, if a little thin, frame has obvious muscle in the stomach and arms. A single band of cloth is enough to keep her pert A-cups in place, though you can see the slight impression of her nipples poking through. The leithan doctor steadies her and prepares her scar for the shot. She cleans it with antibacterial wipes and dries it before readying the needle.
rows.translation: 除了手臂旁那道骇人的疤痕，她的身体意外地几乎没有其他伤痕。她的身材虽略显纤瘦，却十分健美，腹部和手臂都有明显的肌肉线条。一条布带便足以固定她挺翘的A罩杯乳房，不过你仍能看见乳头从布料下微微顶出的轮廓。莱萨人医生稳住她的身体，为疤痕处注射做准备。她先用抗菌湿巾清洁，再擦干皮肤，随后准备好针头。
rows.raw: "\n\nApart from the nasty scar by her arm, her body is surprisingly unmarred. Her fit, if a little thin, frame has obvious muscle in the stomach and arms. A single band of cloth is enough to keep her pert A-cups in place, though you can see the slight impression of her nipples poking through. The leithan doctor steadies her and prepares her scar for the shot. She cleans it with antibacterial wipes and dries it before readying the needle."

rows.original: “Don’t worry, I had to get sh-ah-ots when I joined up with the army. Had to get all the routine antivirals and some more exotic ones,” she says, her voice jumping despite herself as the needle pierces her skin. It takes a good few seconds to drain the contents of the syringe into her, during which the doctor holds it with practiced steadiness. After the injection is finished and the needle removed, Liliana shivers and brushes unseen flutters away from her skin.
rows.translation: “别担心，我入伍时也得打、啊、打针。常规抗病毒针和一些更特殊的针都打过，”她说道；尽管极力克制，针头刺入皮肤时，她的声音还是猛地一颤。注射器里的药液足足过了好几秒才全部注入，医生则以娴熟而稳定的手法握着针筒。注射结束、针头拔出后，莉莉安娜打了个冷颤，挥手拂去皮肤上并不存在的麻痒感。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t worry, I had to get sh-ah-ots when I joined up with the army. Had to get all the routine antivirals and some more exotic ones,” she says, her voice jumping despite herself as the needle pierces her skin. It takes a good few seconds to drain the contents of the syringe into her, during which the doctor holds it with practiced steadiness. After the injection is finished and the needle removed, Liliana shivers and brushes unseen flutters away from her skin."

rows.original: “It should only be a few moments before it starts working,” Doctor Anilla explains as you wait for something to happen. Suddenly Liliana puts a hand to her head and begins to collapse. The doctor catches her without skipping a beat, cradling her to a desk chair near the door. The place where her scar used to be seems to shimmer before bursting open as a new arm extends from it. The new arm looks decidedly human, covered in a viscous goo. After a few seconds the gel rearranges itself and hardens into a chitinous guard for her forearm.
rows.translation: “只要等一会儿，它就会开始起效，”安妮拉医生解释道，你们则等待变化发生。莉莉安娜突然用手扶住脑袋，身体开始瘫倒。医生毫不迟疑地接住她，把她抱到门边的一张办公椅上。原本的疤痕处仿佛泛起微光，随即猛然裂开，一条新手臂从中伸展出来。新手臂明显呈人类外观，表面覆盖着黏稠胶液。几秒后，凝胶重新排列、硬化，在她前臂上形成一层几丁质护甲。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It should only be a few moments before it starts working,” Doctor Anilla explains as you wait for something to happen. Suddenly Liliana puts a hand to her head and begins to collapse. The doctor catches her without skipping a beat, cradling her to a desk chair near the door. The place where her scar used to be seems to shimmer before bursting open as a new arm extends from it. The new arm looks decidedly human, covered in a viscous goo. After a few seconds the gel rearranges itself and hardens into a chitinous guard for her forearm."

rows.original: “Sorry about that, I forgot to mention the dizziness... and how sudden the effects were,” she says with an apologetic look. After a brief stint of bewilderment, you figure out the cause: a pair of lengthy bayonets are uncomfortably close to your face, coming from two rifles held by soldiers at either side of the doorway, covered in a lot more of that blackened chitinous plate than the average myr. rows.original: Taking the invitation - and not wanting to provoke the eager guards any further - you stride into the room, taking a look along the walls at the wide variety of knick-knacks offered. You recognize some, actually; things from the core, like a few firearms or recreational goods. Not exactly something you’d expect to see on a “backwards” world torn apart by war. You don’t get a lot of time to look at the goods before another, more pleasing set of goods appears before you. The myr woman who summoned you in is completely topless, and she’s not bashful about drawing your attention to that fact. You spare a lingering glance at assets which ‘bounteous’ would be an understatement in describing, netting a knowing smirk from your host. Well. That’s a welcoming.

rows.original: Still resting on her probably less-than-comfortable padded perch, the queen glances up from her simple reading material before immediately tossing it aside haphazardly and putting on a big, golden smile. You’re not really sure if she was actually reading or just putting on a show for effect. “Valuable customer! Welcome. I hope our gracious Red hosts didn’t accost you too much today. Now then, how may I help you? My stock is, as always, on display and available. If it’s not on a shelf then I’m afraid it’s not prepared for purchase, for whatever reason - don’t ask about backroom things. As much as I enjoy conversation, I am running a business.”
rows.translation: 仍趴在那张恐怕不怎么舒服的软垫高台上，女王从朴素的读物上抬起头，立刻随手把它丢到一边，绽开灿烂耀眼的笑容。你实在不确定她刚才是真的在阅读，还是仅仅为了效果而装模作样。“尊贵的顾客！欢迎光临。希望我们慷慨的红方东道主今天没有太过为难你。那么，我能如何帮助你？我的库存一如既往地全部陈列在外，随时可以买。如果不在货架上，那恐怕就是因为某些原因尚未准备好出售——别问后屋里的东西。尽管我喜欢聊天，但我确实还在做生意。”

rows.original: You casually mention that you have yet to get the merchant queen’s name.
rows.translation: 你随口提到，自己还不知道商人女王的名字。
rows.raw: "You casually mention that you have yet to get the merchant queen’s name."

rows.original: “I realize. I never gave it to you on purpose. Don’t be offended, but you don’t really need to know.” The woman’s response is a level one, though you try to dig into it a little. Why? “I do business with all sorts of clientele. If I started to make a bit of a name for myself, things could start to collide. I have an awful lot of influence in things here and there... It might be all ruined if it was found out that the queen Fuzzlebottom was making great strides with our Red overlords or your precious Confederation. Among other things.”
rows.translation: “我知道。我是故意没告诉你的。别见怪，但你其实没必要知道。”女人的回答十分平静，不过你还是追问了一下。为什么？“我和各种各样的客户做生意。要是我开始有了点名气，各方面的事情就可能互相冲突。我在这里那里都有不少影响力...如果别人发现毛绒屁股女王正在我们红方统治者或你那宝贝邦联那里取得重大进展，一切都可能毁于一旦。更别提其他事情了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I realize. I never gave it to you on purpose. Don’t be offended, but you don’t really need to know.” The woman’s response is a level one, though you try to dig into it a little. Why? “I do business with all sorts of clientele. If I started to make a bit of a name for myself, things could start to collide. I have an awful lot of influence in things here and there... It might be all ruined if it was found out that the queen Fuzzlebottom was making great strides with our Red overlords or your precious Confederation. Among other things.”"

rows.original: Other things?
rows.translation: 其他事情？
rows.raw: "\n\nOther things?"

rows.original: “Inquisitive thing, aren’t you? Well. We’re in a time of constant war with quite a few new players making their debut. I am no small-time woman. People associating my name with certain other people could ruin me; worse, it may make them think I’m an enemy. Which I am anything but! I’m simply a merchant. It also allows me to... wander around more freely with my money. After all, if someone were to say ‘That Merchant Queen did something,’ well, they’d have to go through some forty other Gold queens who do much the same, named or otherwise.”
rows.translation: “真是个好奇的家伙，不是吗？好吧。我们正处于持续不断的战争时期，又有不少新角色刚刚登场。我可不是什么小人物。人们若把我的名字和某些人联系起来，可能会毁了我；更糟的是，他们也许会以为我是敌人。而我绝不是！我只是一名商人。没有名字也让我能带着钱更自由地... 四处活动。毕竟，如果有人说‘那个商人女王做了什么’，他们就得去调查另外四十来个做着同样事情的金米尔女王，无论有名还是没名。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Inquisitive thing, aren’t you? Well. We’re in a time of constant war with quite a few new players making their debut. I am no small-time woman. People associating my name with certain other people could ruin me; worse, it may make them think I’m an enemy. Which I am anything but! I’m simply a merchant. It also allows me to... wander around more freely with my money. After all, if someone were to say ‘That Merchant Queen did something,’ well, they’d have to go through some forty other Gold queens who do much the same, named or otherwise.”"

rows.original: So, she does have a name?
rows.translation: 所以，她确实有名字？
rows.raw: "\n\nSo, she does have a name?"

rows.original: “Of course. It’s not like we’re born with a number stamped to our head. However, only a special few are privy to that... And I can tell you this much: you’ll never be one of those special few.”
rows.translation: “当然。我们出生时脑门上又不会印着编号。不过，只有极少数特殊之人才有资格知道那个名字...而我可以告诉你：你永远不会成为那极少数人之一。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course. It’s not like we’re born with a number stamped to our head. However, only a special few are privy to that... And I can tell you this much: you’ll never be one of those special few.”"

rows.original: “Stuff? This is high-quality merchandise, I’ll tell you!” Despite her attempts at mock-outrage, the woman still holds a cheeky grin, betraying herself immediately. “I do business in all sorts of places, for all sorts of clients. I am one of the only people who jumped at the chance to do business with off-worlders, and among the first besides. Much of the material is probably stuff you’re familiar with, though I carry stock for people such as yourself, too, of course. Things native to Myrellion, that is.”
rows.translation: “东西？这可是上等货，我告诉你！”尽管她装出一副愤愤不平的样子，脸上却仍挂着顽皮的笑容，立刻暴露了自己。“我在各种地方同形形色色的客户做生意。我是少数几个一听说能和外星人交易就欣然接受的人之一，而且还是最早的一批。这里大部分材料大概都是你熟悉的东西，不过当然，我也为你这样的人备了货。也就是米瑞利昂本地的东西。”
rows.raw: "“Stuff? This is high-quality merchandise, I’ll tell you!” Despite her attempts at mock-outrage, the woman still holds a cheeky grin, betraying herself immediately. “I do business in all sorts of places, for all sorts of clients. I am one of the only people who jumped at the chance to do business with off-worlders, and among the first besides. Much of the material is probably stuff you’re familiar with, though I carry stock for people such as yourself, too, of course. Things native to Myrellion, that is.”"

rows.original: She pauses a moment, looking thoughtful. “Really, it’s not too hard to sell. Most off-worlders that come through here are adventurers - like yourself - that are taking part in your ‘Planet Rush’. Less novelty tourists and more people who need weapons and armor... With a people practically devoted to war-like industry, that isn’t a hard goal to meet.”
rows.translation: 她停顿片刻，若有所思。“说真的，这东西不难卖。大多数来到这里的外星人都是冒险者——就像你一样——来参加你们所谓的‘行星淘金热’。少了些猎奇游客，多了些需要武器和护甲的人……对于一个几乎全身心投入战争工业的民族而言，这个目标并不难实现。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe pauses a moment, looking thoughtful. “Really, it’s not too hard to sell. Most off-worlders that come through here are adventurers - like yourself - that are taking part in your ‘Planet Rush’. Less novelty tourists and more people who need weapons and armor... With a people practically devoted to war-like industry, that isn’t a hard goal to meet.”"

rows.original: “Royalty? Not... quite, no. It’s radically different from the term you’re used to. A queen is a member of our species - that is, the gold myr - who can give birth freely. And rather productively, too, in most circumstances. Though I do hold quite a bit of influence because of it... we’re rather well-revered creatures, I’ll have you know. Individual dynasties coming from a single queen-mother could be considered a ‘kingdom,’ or clan, in your sense of the word. Though we’re still part of the greater whole and it comes up rarely.”
rows.translation: “王族？不...不完全是。这个词的含义和你所习惯的截然不同。女王是我们种族——也就是金米尔——之中能够自由生育的成员。而且在大多数情况下，生育力也相当旺盛。不过，我确实因此拥有相当大的影响力...我得让你知道，我们可是相当受尊崇的存在。由一位女王母亲繁衍出的独立宗族，在你理解的意义上，可以被视为一个‘王国’或氏族。不过，我们仍是更大整体的一部分，所以这种说法很少会被提起。”
rows.raw: "“Royalty? Not... quite, no. It’s radically different from the term you’re used to. A queen is a member of our species - that is, the gold myr - who can give birth freely. And rather productively, too, in most circumstances. Though I do hold quite a bit of influence because of it... we’re rather well-revered creatures, I’ll have you know. Individual dynasties coming from a single queen-mother could be considered a ‘kingdom,’ or clan, in your sense of the word. Though we’re still part of the greater whole and it comes up rarely.”"

rows.original: So less ruler and more of a ‘breeder,’ then?
rows.translation: 所以，比起统治者，更像是个‘育种者’，对吧？
rows.raw: "\n\nSo less ruler and more of a ‘breeder,’ then?"

rows.original: “Mm... something like that, I suppose. The title of queen is a massive one, second only to the empresses themselves. It comes at a cost of practically being imprisoned, toiling away in constant labor to ensure our species thrives. That is, unless you’re like me. You see, I’m not exactly fertile; my ‘needle’ is a lot harder to thread, even if I have all the makings to. So instead I get all the authority, influence and so on without having to drag myself along the ground. It’s quite nice! But I have to keep up appearances and make up for... eh, inefficiency. All day long.”
rows.translation: “嗯... 大概是那样吧。女王的头衔分量极重，仅次于女皇本人。代价就是几乎等同于被囚禁，日复一日地辛勤劳作，以确保我们的种族繁衍兴旺。当然，除非你像我一样。你看，我并不算特别容易受孕；哪怕我样样俱全，我这根‘针’的针眼也难穿得多。所以我不必拖着身子在地上爬，却照样拥有所有权威、影响力之类的东西。感觉相当不错！不过我必须维持表象，还得弥补... 呃，效率不足的问题。从早到晚。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mm... something like that, I suppose. The title of queen is a massive one, second only to the empresses themselves. It comes at a cost of practically being imprisoned, toiling away in constant labor to ensure our species thrives. That is, unless you’re like me. You see, I’m not exactly fertile; my ‘needle’ is a lot harder to thread, even if I have all the makings to. So instead I get all the authority, influence and so on without having to drag myself along the ground. It’s quite nice! But I have to keep up appearances and make up for... eh, inefficiency. All day long.”"

rows.original: “Yes.” Well, that was rather abrupt. “Though no, I’m not literally ‘constantly going at it.’ Sometimes I sleep, after all. Or have to walk somewhere. Then my precious keepers sit on their dicks for a moment and settle down and I myself get a lovely break. Hmph. Some people envy me, you know, especially you off-worlders. It’s not great. When you have some upstart drone thrusting away at you day in and out you grow numb to it all. Honestly, it feels more like someone poking me at this point than sex, which is a pity, and the price of my position.”
rows.translation: “是的。”好吧，这回答还真突然。“不过也不是说我真的‘一直干个不停’。毕竟我有时也要睡觉，或是得走去别的地方。这时候我那些宝贝侍从就会暂时收起肉棒安分下来，我自己也能享受一段美好的休息。哼。有些人还羡慕我呢，尤其是你们这些外星人。其实一点都不好。某个不知天高地厚的雄蚁日复一日地在你身上抽插，迟早会让你对这一切变得麻木。说实话，如今那感觉更像是有人在戳我，而不是做爱，真是遗憾；这就是我这地位的代价。”
rows.raw: "“Yes.” Well, that was rather abrupt. “Though no, I’m not literally ‘constantly going at it.’ Sometimes I sleep, after all. Or have to walk somewhere. Then my precious keepers sit on their dicks for a moment and settle down and I myself get a lovely break. Hmph. Some people envy me, you know, especially you off-worlders. It’s not great. When you have some upstart drone thrusting away at you day in and out you grow numb to it all. Honestly, it feels more like someone poking me at this point than sex, which is a pity, and the price of my position.”"

rows.original: Maybe it’s because the sex is boring?
rows.translation: 也许是因为这种性爱太无聊了？
rows.raw: "\n\nMaybe it’s because the sex is boring?"

rows.original: “Of course it’s boring,” the queen rather immediately snaps. It sounds like she’s had this conversation in the past and has grown a bit weary of it. “If you find someone with the ability to ‘keep it fresh in the bedroom’ with the sole purpose of procreation after a week straight I’ll be rather surprised. That’s not to say I don’t have my individual pleasures here and there, but my sex-life isn’t the purview of some random off-worlder. Well. Save when they’re a part of it, anyway.”
rows.translation: “当然无聊，”女王几乎立刻厉声答道。听起来她过去已经谈过这个话题，也有些厌烦了。“如果你能找到一个只为繁殖、连续干上一整周后还有本事‘让床笫之事保持新鲜’的人，我可会相当惊讶。倒不是说我不会偶尔享受一点个人乐趣，但我的性生活还轮不到某个随机出现的外星人来过问。嗯，除非他们也参与其中。”

It sounds like she’s had this conversation in the past and has grown a bit weary of it. “If you find someone with the ability to ‘keep it fresh in the bedroom’ with the sole purpose of procreation after a week straight I’ll be rather surprised. That’s not to say I don’t have my individual pleasures here and there, but my sex-life isn’t the purview of some random off-worlder. Well. Save when they’re a part of it, anyway.”"

rows.original: Oh? There’s an interesting thought. The merchant responds to your mild surprise with a knowing grin of her own. Maybe there’s something you could do there...
rows.translation: 哦？这想法倒很有意思。你略显惊讶，商人则回以一个心照不宣的笑容。也许你真能在这方面做点什么...
rows.raw: "\n\nOh? There’s an interesting thought. The merchant responds to your mild surprise with a knowing grin of her own. Maybe there’s something you could do there..."

rows.original: The merchant nods solemnly, pausing in thought for a moment before simply shrugging her four arms lazily. “Every off-worlder asks about this. The curiosity is fair, I suppose... yes, there is a mess outside. It’s practically ruined Kressia, though it’s not like the war was for our benefit. Kressia was taken a while ago, so there’s been plenty of time to settle in with the occupation. For both sides. The threat and paranoia of military remnants hiding out in the ruins has gone away, and so have the constant searches and soldiers breathing down our necks. It’s still far from comfortable, though, just less... invasive. Which, for an invasion, is pretty good!” The queen cracks a quick grin at her own joke before continuing. “It’s all pretty heavy-handed, more like a police state. Aggressive curfews, nervous soldiers, random interrogations... I mean, it’s all a given. I can’t honestly blame their paranoia. A single fit gold myr could probably tear this building down in a few minutes with her bare hands! Domestic disputes are a bitch; we aren’t some squishy people like you off-worlders are. Firearms just let us kill each other slightly farther away.”
rows.translation: 商人神情严肃地点点头，沉思片刻后，只是懒洋洋地耸了耸四条手臂。“每个外星人都会问这个。好奇也很合理，我想... 是的，外面确实一团糟。克雷西亚几乎被毁了，不过这场战争本来也不是为了我们打的。克雷西亚早就失守了，所以双方都有充足时间适应占领状态。躲在废墟里的军事残部所带来的威胁和猜疑已经消退，没完没了的搜查以及在我们脖子后面盯着的士兵也少了。日子仍远称不上舒适，只是没那么... 侵犯隐私了。对一场入侵来说，这已经算不错了！”女王为自己的玩笑迅速咧嘴一笑，随后继续说道。“所有措施都相当强硬，更像是警察国家。严厉的宵禁、神经紧张的士兵、随机审讯... 我是说，这些都是必然的。我确实不能责怪他们疑神疑鬼。一个体格健壮的金米尔，光凭双手大概几分钟就能拆掉这栋楼！家庭纠纷可真要命；我们才不像你们外星人那么软弱。枪械不过是让我们能隔得稍远一点杀死彼此。”

The curiosity is fair, I suppose... yes, there is a mess outside. It’s practically ruined Kressia, though it’s not like the war was for our benefit. Kressia was taken a while ago, so there’s been plenty of time to settle in with the occupation. For both sides. The threat and paranoia of military remnants hiding out in the ruins has gone away, and so have the constant searches and soldiers breathing down our necks. It’s still far from comfortable, though, just less... invasive. Which, for an invasion, is pretty good!” The queen cracks a quick grin at her own joke before continuing. “It’s all pretty heavy-handed, more like a police state. Aggressive curfews, nervous soldiers, random interrogations... I mean, it’s all a given. I can’t honestly blame their paranoia. A single fit gold myr could probably tear this building down in a few minutes with her bare hands! Domestic disputes are a bitch; we aren’t some squishy people like you off-worlders are. Firearms just let us kill each other slightly farther away.”"

rows.original: “Food is probably a more pressing thing than trigger-happy guards, though. The Reds have to ship it through a war-torn hellhole to get here, so delays are pretty frequent. Rationing spurs up unrest much more than some strict rules backed by bullets... it’s all about food. Now, of course, I have people in my pocket. I’m practically exempt! That fact has allowed me to keep running things despite the occupation - that and you off-worlders, of course. The military cabinet is rather terrified of you. Like I said, though, the difference between a myr with and without a pistol is just a few meters, so it’s not worth the effort to police.”
rows.translation: “不过，比起那些动不动就开枪的卫兵，食物恐怕更紧迫。红方得把食物穿过饱受战火蹂躏的地狱运到这里，所以延误相当频繁。配给制度激起的骚乱远胜于子弹撑腰的严格规矩... 归根结底全是食物。当然，我在有关部门里有人。我几乎可以豁免！正是这一点让我在占领之下仍能继续经营——当然，你们这些外星人也功不可没。军事内阁很怕你们。不过就像我说的，带不带手枪的米尔，区别不过是几米的距离，根本不值得费力管制。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Food is probably a more pressing thing than trigger-happy guards, though. The Reds have to ship it through a war-torn hellhole to get here, so delays are pretty frequent. Rationing spurs up unrest much more than some strict rules backed by bullets... it’s all about food. Now, of course, I have people in my pocket. I’m practically exempt! That fact has allowed me to keep running things despite the occupation - that and you off-worlders, of course. The military cabinet is rather terrified of you. Like I said, though, the difference between a myr with and without a pistol is just a few meters, so it’s not worth the effort to police.”"

rows.original: Hm. Aren’t the queens pretty important, though? No one keeping an eye on her is pretty weird.
rows.translation: 嗯。可女王不是相当重要吗？居然没人监视她，实在有些奇怪。
rows.raw: "\n\nHm. Aren’t the queens pretty important, though? No one keeping an eye on her is pretty weird."

rows.original: “We are! Glad you noticed. We’re so important that if the army so much as touched us inappropriately the entire city would be up in arms in bloody rebellion. If much of anyone, let alone a soldier, started to give me trouble... even myr that aren’t my children would go into a frenzy about it... they’re all rather protective.” She chuckles darkly. “If anything, the Reds are stuck holding massive hand-fans and waiting on our every need. Not that I abuse such a thing, of course! It’s far too much of a bother.”
rows.translation: “当然重要！很高兴你注意到了。我们重要到军队只要对我们稍有不轨，整座城市就会揭竿而起，发动血腥叛乱。不管是谁，更别说士兵了，只要开始找我麻烦... 就连并非我孩子的米尔都会因此陷入狂怒... 她们全都相当护着我们。”她阴沉地笑了笑。“真要说起来，红方反倒只能举着巨大的手扇，随时伺候我们的每项需求。当然，我绝对没有滥用这种待遇！那也太麻烦了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We are! Glad you noticed. We’re so important that if the army so much as touched us inappropriately the entire city would be up in arms in bloody rebellion. If much of anyone, let alone a soldier, started to give me trouble... even myr that aren’t my children would go into a frenzy about it... they’re all rather protective.” She chuckles darkly. “If anything, the Reds are stuck holding massive hand-fans and waiting on our every need. Not that I abuse such a thing, of course! It’s far too much of a bother.”"

rows.original: “Although. They do steal away the drones. No one cares as much about them; it’s not like they’re getting mistreated. Just bred. It is pretty amusing to see an oh-so-holier-than-thou Red book it with some flailing sap over her shoulder while being chased by some half naked Gold, though.”
rows.translation: “不过，她们确实会把雄蚁偷走。没多少人在意他们；他们又没有受到虐待，只是被拿去配种罢了。看着某个自命清高的红方扛着一个手脚乱舞的倒霉蛋飞奔，后面还追着某个衣不蔽体的金方，倒确实相当有趣。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Although. They do steal away the drones. No one cares as much about them; it’s not like they’re getting mistreated. Just bred. It is pretty amusing to see an oh-so-holier-than-thou Red book it with some flailing sap over her shoulder while being chased by some half naked Gold, though.”"

rows.original: Rude.
rows.translation: 真没礼貌。
rows.raw: "\n\nRude."

rows.original: “Quite.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Quite.”"

rows.original: “I hold a lot of power on Myrellion, traveler. Many queens have a middling amount, enough to be the movers and shakers when they’re not practically crawling on the ground, fat with kids. But I’m a queen with money. I have more than just this hole in the wall, I assure you. I’m more proactive, shake hands. That sort of thing. Get to know people, Golds, off-worlders, and Reds alike. rows.original: You ask Lys a little bit about herself. She curls a finger around her wild locks, her other arms hugging under her voluptuous breasts.
rows.translation: 你向莉丝打听了一些她自己的事。她用一根手指卷着凌乱的发丝，其他手臂则环抱在丰满的乳房下方。
rows.raw: "You ask Lys a little bit about herself. She curls a finger around her wild locks, her other arms hugging under her voluptuous breasts."

rows.original: “I guess I can tell you a little bit about myself. After all, it’s not exactly like I have a lot better to do,” Lys chuckles. “Maybe I should start with my measurements, or are you after something a little bit more personal?”
rows.translation: “我想，我可以稍微介绍一下自己。反正我也没什么更好的事可做，”莉丝轻笑道。“也许我该从三围开始说起，还是你想知道更私人的事情？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I guess I can tell you a little bit about myself. After all, it’s not exactly like I have a lot better to do,” Lys chuckles. “Maybe I should start with my measurements, or are you after something a little bit more personal?”"

rows.original: “Let’s see... I’m twenty six years old and an ex-florist. I used to have a lovely garden and my own cosy home not far from where we are now. My wife and I sold the loveliest blue-green sydranas... at least until we were both conscripted.”
rows.translation: “让我想想...我二十六岁，以前是个花匠。我曾有一座美丽的花园，还有一栋舒适的房子，离我们现在的位置不远。我妻子和我售卖最漂亮的蓝绿色西德拉纳花...至少在我们俩都被征召入伍之前是这样。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Let’s see... I’m twenty six years old and an ex-florist. I used to have a lovely garden and my own cosy home not far from where we are now. My wife and I sold the loveliest blue-green sydranas... at least until we were both conscripted.”"

rows.original: She sighs and looks down at her assorted hands, lacing her fingers together. “...That was so long ago... four years? It feels like forever.”
rows.translation: 她叹了口气，低头看着自己形形色色的手，将手指交叠在一起。“...那已经是很久以前了...四年？感觉简直像过了一辈子。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe sighs and looks down at her assorted hands, lacing her fingers together. “...That was so long ago... four years? It feels like forever.”"

rows.original: “Needless to say, she’s dead, along with the rest of our platoon. Our house is in ruins - there’s barely anything left. I’ve got some seeds left, but the soil is so ruined they refuse to bloom.”
rows.translation: “不用说，她死了，我们排里的其他人也都死了。我们的房子成了一片废墟——几乎什么都没剩下。我还留着一些种子，可土地被毁得太严重，它们怎么也不开花。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Needless to say, she’s dead, along with the rest of our platoon. Our house is in ruins - there’s barely anything left. I’ve got some seeds left, but the soil is so ruined they refuse to bloom.”"

rows.original: “All I’m doing is wasting my time until someone hunts me down for desertion, or the world ends - whichever comes first.”
rows.translation: “我只是在浪费时间，等着有人因为逃兵罪来追杀我，或者等着世界毁灭——看哪个先发生。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“All I’m doing is wasting my time until someone hunts me down for desertion, or the world ends - whichever comes first.”"

rows.original: You ask Briha a little bit about herself. The amber-haired ant girl scratches her head, looking a little self-conscious.
rows.translation: 你向布里哈打听了一些她自己的事。琥珀发色的蚁族女孩挠了挠头，显得有些难为情。
rows.raw: "You ask Briha a little bit about herself. The amber-haired ant girl scratches her head, looking a little self-conscious."

rows.translation: “...我？不过是另一个被宣传话术骗进去的蠢姑娘，”她回答。“说真的，像我这样的姑娘不过是

rows.original: a dozen. I’m nothing that special.”
rows.translation: 一抓一大把。我没什么特别的。”
rows.raw: " a dozen. I’m nothing that special.”"

rows.original: Pushing her a little further, she gives you a bit more of an answer. “Oh, okay. Well, where to start? I’m a twenty-one year old ex-career soldier from Rivalle. I was a Sergeant before I went AWOL.”
rows.translation: 你又追问了一会儿，她才多说了一点。“哦，好吧。该从哪里说起呢？我二十一岁，来自里瓦尔，以前是职业军人。在我擅离职守之前，我是个中士。”
rows.raw: "\n\nPushing her a little further, she gives you a bit more of an answer. “Oh, okay. Well, where to start? I’m a twenty-one year old ex-career soldier from Rivalle. I was a Sergeant before I went AWOL.”"

rows.original: “I’m not all work - or rather, I wasn’t. I used to want to be a career dancer before the war started. I’m a bit too scarred for that now, though,” she smiles wryly. “Plus, I’m pretty sure we’re all going to get blown up before long... not that I can return home.”
rows.translation: “我也不只是埋头工作——或者说，我以前不是。战争爆发前，我曾想成为一名职业舞者。不过现在我身上的伤疤太多了，”她苦笑道。“而且我很确定，我们所有人不久后都会被炸上天...反正我也回不了家。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m not all work - or rather, I wasn’t. I used to want to be a career dancer before the war started. I’m a bit too scarred for that now, though,” she smiles wryly. “Plus, I’m pretty sure we’re all going to get blown up before long... not that I can return home.”"
