rows.original: Jim Thermic
rows.raw: "Jim Thermic"

rows.original: You ask Lys why she deserted the Gilden Republic. She sighs and looks at one of her fingers, rubbing it compulsively.
rows.translation: 你问莉丝为什么要逃离吉尔登共和国。她叹了口气，盯着自己的一根手指，神经质地反复摩挲着。
rows.raw: "You ask Lys why she deserted the Gilden Republic. She sighs and looks at one of her fingers, rubbing it compulsively."

rows.original: “...My wife. We were both conscripted early on during the war. She... I... well... same platoon,” she chokes up. Her black eyes become glassy with tears. “...Sorry. I really thought I could talk about it this time... but I just can’t.”
rows.translation: “...我的妻子。战争初期，我们俩都被征召入伍。她...我...那个...我们在同一个排，”她哽咽起来。她黑色的眼睛泛起泪光。“...对不起。我真的以为这次能说出口...可我就是做不到。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...My wife. We were both conscripted early on during the war. She... I... well... same platoon,” she chokes up. Her black eyes become glassy with tears. “...Sorry. I really thought I could talk about it this time... but I just can’t.”"

rows.original: Taking a deep breath, she tries to calm her trembling body. “...Whoooh. Right. So. When she left me, I ended up in a medical hospital for a little while. They put me back on the front line when the war effort started going south, though.”
rows.translation: 她深吸一口气，努力让颤抖的身体平静下来。“...呼。好了。是这样。她离开我之后，我在军医院里待了一阵子。不过后来战况开始恶化，他们又把我送回了前线。”
rows.raw: "\n\nTaking a deep breath, she tries to calm her trembling body. “...Whoooh. Right. So. When she left me, I ended up in a medical hospital for a little while. They put me back on the front line when the war effort started going south, though.”"

rows.original: “When the Reds took Kressia, I figured it wasn’t long before the End, what with the nukes. If I’m going to die, I wanted to do it near where our old house was, here in No Myr’s Land - not in some hopeless defense of the capital.”
rows.translation: “红军攻下克雷西亚时，我觉得离末日已经不远了，毕竟还有核武器。如果我注定要死，我想死在我们旧居附近，也就是这片无米尔之地——而不是在毫无希望的首都保卫战里送命。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“When the Reds took Kressia, I figured it wasn’t long before the End, what with the nukes. If I’m going to die, I wanted to do it near where our old house was, here in No Myr’s Land - not in some hopeless defense of the capital.”"

rows.original: “...So that’s it. I wander the wastes, stealing what I can, robbing strays, all so I can stay close to where she and I lived. I kind of feel like she’s there, you know?”
rows.translation: “...事情就是这样。我在荒野里游荡，能偷什么就偷什么，遇到落单的就抢，只为了能留在我和她曾经生活的地方附近。我总觉得她还在那里，你明白吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...So that’s it. I wander the wastes, stealing what I can, robbing strays, all so I can stay close to where she and I lived. I kind of feel like she’s there, you know?”"

rows.original: “I know I’m a terrible person, but the whole world is terrible. I don’t think there’s a single thing worth salvaging anymore - we’re all just a bunch of trampled flowers, struggling to grow on scorched earth.”
rows.translation: “我知道自己是个糟糕的人，可整个世界都糟透了。我觉得已经没有任何东西值得挽救——我们都不过是被踩烂的花朵，在焦土上挣扎着生长。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I know I’m a terrible person, but the whole world is terrible. I don’t think there’s a single thing worth salvaging anymore - we’re all just a bunch of trampled flowers, struggling to grow on scorched earth.”"

rows.original: You ask Briha why she deserted the Scarlet Federation. Her face screws up a little, but she still answers the question.
rows.translation: 你问布里哈为什么要逃离猩红联邦。她的脸微微扭曲，却还是回答了这个问题。
rows.raw: "You ask Briha why she deserted the Scarlet Federation. Her face screws up a little, but she still answers the question."

rows.original: “...I guess it’s the obvious question, right? I guess... I had an image of how things would be. I was going to be the glorious defender of my homeland, fighting back against the hypocritical Golds, who were going to stomp all over us if we didn’t do something.”
rows.translation: “...我想这是显而易见的问题，对吧？我猜...我曾经想象过事情会是什么样子。我会成为保卫家园的光荣战士，对抗那些虚伪的金米尔人；要是我们不做点什么，他们就会把我们踩在脚下。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...I guess it’s the obvious question, right? I guess... I had an image of how things would be. I was going to be the glorious defender of my homeland, fighting back against the hypocritical Golds, who were going to stomp all over us if we didn’t do something.”"

rows.original: “My dream of being a bold, adventurous heroine, delivering justice to the dirty Golds... I was so naive. I’ve shot and killed more people than I can count. Not just enemy soldiers, but civvies too. Sure, it was orders, but I was the one who pulled the trigger... or brought down the axe.”
rows.translation: “我曾梦想成为勇敢无畏的女英雄，向肮脏的金米尔人伸张正义...我那时太天真了。我开枪杀死的人多得数不清。不只是敌军，还有平民。没错，那是命令，可扣动扳机的人是我...挥下斧头的人也是我。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My dream of being a bold, adventurous heroine, delivering justice to the dirty Golds... I was so naive. I’ve shot and killed more people than I can count. Not just enemy soldiers, but civvies too. Sure, it was orders, but I was the one who pulled the trigger... or brought down the axe.”"

rows.original: She sighs and bites her fingernail. “...I was thinking about deserting for a while, but I couldn’t do it to my squad. When you desert, you burn your whole squad. When they all died, I was in anguish, but I was relieved... how sick is that?”
rows.translation: 她叹了口气，咬着指甲。“...我考虑逃跑有一阵子了，可我不能那样对自己的小队。一个人逃跑，整支小队都会受罚。他们全死后，我痛苦不堪，却又松了口气...这得有多病态？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe sighs and bites her fingernail. “...I was thinking about deserting for a while, but I couldn’t do it to my squad. When you desert, you burn your whole squad. When they all died, I was in anguish, but I was relieved... how sick is that?”"

rows.original: “When that happened, I left the front. It was easier than I thought. Now, I’m living out here in the middle of nowhere, scraping together what I can to survive. But you know what? It beats having to shoot any more defenseless people and call it justice.”
rows.translation: “那件事发生后，我离开了前线。比我想象中容易。现在我住在这片荒无人烟的地方，东拼西凑地找东西活下去。不过你知道吗？这总比继续射杀手无寸铁的人、再把它叫作正义要好。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“When that happened, I left the front. It was easier than I thought. Now, I’m living out here in the middle of nowhere, scraping together what I can to survive. But you know what? It beats having to shoot any more defenseless people and call it justice.”"

rows.original: You ask Lys about her scars; the one on her lower lip and on her belly.
rows.translation: 你问莉丝身上的伤疤是怎么来的：下唇上的那道，还有腹部的那道。
rows.raw: "You ask Lys about her scars; the one on her lower lip and on her belly."

rows.original: Lys laughs and rubs her lower lip. “...Well, you don’t spend time on the front without walking away with scars of one kind or another, right?”
rows.translation: 莉丝笑着揉了揉下唇。“...在前线待过的人，总会带着这样那样的伤疤离开，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nLys laughs and rubs her lower lip. “...Well, you don’t spend time on the front without walking away with scars of one kind or another, right?”"

rows.original: “The belly and the lip are actually connected. We were pushing forward to take an enemy trench. When we reached it, I looked over and a red shot me at point blank.”
rows.translation: “腹部和嘴唇上的伤其实是同一次造成的。我们当时正向前推进，准备夺取敌军战壕。抵达那里时，我探头一看，一个红米尔人在近距离朝我开了一枪。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The belly and the lip are actually connected. We were pushing forward to take an enemy trench. When we reached it, I looked over and a red shot me at point blank.”"

rows.original: She taps her belly, “...The bullet went right through me. Thankfully, it missed all the important stuff. But I was so shocked I toppled forward and fell face-first into the trench.”
rows.translation: 她拍了拍腹部，“...子弹直接穿过了我的身体。幸好没打中重要器官。可我震惊得向前栽倒，脸朝下摔进了战壕。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe taps her belly, “...The bullet went right through me. Thankfully, it missed all the important stuff. But I was so shocked I toppled forward and fell face-first into the trench.”"

rows.original: “When I hit the ground, one of my teeth dug into my lower lip and cut it in half. Good thing we took the trench, otherwise I wouldn’t be alive to laugh about it. The doctors stitched my lip and belly back together, but it scarred over - no room for cosmetics on the front.”
rows.translation: “落地时，我的一颗牙齿扎进下唇，把嘴唇割成了两半。幸好我们拿下了战壕，不然我也活不到今天拿这事开玩笑。医生把我的嘴唇和肚子缝了回去，可最后还是留下了疤——前线可没有做美容修复的条件。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“When I hit the ground, one of my teeth dug into my lower lip and cut it in half. Good thing we took the trench, otherwise I wouldn’t be alive to laugh about it. The doctors stitched my lip and belly back together, but it scarred over - no room for cosmetics on the front.”"

rows.original: You ask Briha about her scars; the one over her damaged eye and one to the side of her heart.
rows.translation: 你问起布里哈身上的疤痕；一处横在受伤的眼睛上，另一处则在心脏旁边。
rows.raw: "You ask Briha about her scars; the one over her damaged eye and one to the side of her heart."

rows.original: Briha touches her scarred eye self consciously. “...T-these? I suppose you would be curious,” she mumbles, “The eye I got early on in the war from being careless.”
rows.translation: 布里哈有些不自在地碰了碰那只留疤的眼睛。“...这、这些？我想你确实会好奇，”她咕哝道，“眼睛这道伤，是战争初期我大意时留下的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBriha touches her scarred eye self consciously. “...T-these? I suppose you would be curious,” she mumbles, “The eye I got early on in the war from being careless.”"

rows.original: “I’d taken a pot shot with a rifle at a gold scout. When I moved up to grab her hand-held, she damn near sliced my face open with a knife. We struggled for a bit before I smashed open her temple with her radio.”
rows.translation: “我用步枪朝一个金米尔侦察兵胡乱开了一枪。等我上前去抢她的手持武器时，她差点用刀把我的脸整个划开。我们扭打了一会儿，最后我用她的无线电砸开了她的太阳穴。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’d taken a pot shot with a rifle at a gold scout. When I moved up to grab her hand-held, she damn near sliced my face open with a knife. We struggled for a bit before I smashed open her temple with her radio.”"

rows.original: The red myr brings down her hand to rub the scar just next to her heart. “...This one’s a bit more painful. My squad and I ran into some wire entanglements. While trying to get through, we were herded into a machine gun.”
rows.translation: 这名红米尔放下手，揉了揉紧挨心脏的那道疤。“...这一处就痛苦多了。我和小队撞上了铁丝网。试着穿过去时，我们被赶进了一挺机枪的射界。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe red myr brings down her hand to rub the scar just next to her heart. “...This one’s a bit more painful. My squad and I ran into some wire entanglements. While trying to get through, we were herded into a machine gun.”"

rows.original: “Thankfully, a shelling took out the enemy gunner and I was dragged off the field. They stitched me up, and now I’ve got a scar and a story to tell off-worlders wandering through the wastes,” she bitterly smiles.
rows.translation: “幸好一轮炮击干掉了敌方机枪手，我也被拖下了战场。他们把我缝好，于是现在我既有一道疤，也有一个能讲给游荡在荒原上的外星人听的故事，”她苦涩地笑了笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thankfully, a shelling took out the enemy gunner and I was dragged off the field. They stitched me up, and now I’ve got a scar and a story to tell off-worlders wandering through the wastes,” she bitterly smiles."

rows.original: through a doorless entryway and into a large, cluttered building that reminds you of a warehouse, albeit a terribly organized one. Actually... looking around at all the boxes and parts lying around, that’s exactly what it seems to be. Several myrmedions of the “Red” variety are present, some standing guard with weapons at the ready while others mill about and busy themselves with what looks like cleaning. It doesn’t take a genius to deduce that this area was assigned to them rather recently and that they’re still moving in. You can see numerous individuals of other species moving to and fro: they’re mostly UGC personnel or other unaffiliated parties, since there are quite a few less Gold Myr here than elsewhere in the embassy. Half of the area is dominated by makeshift offices and rooms, and one doorway has two guards positioned on either side of it.
rows.translation: 进一处没有门的入口，来到一栋宽敞而杂乱的建筑里。这里让你想起仓库，只不过是个组织得一团糟的仓库。实际上...环顾四周堆得到处都是的箱子和零件，这里显然就是仓库。几名“红色”米尔米顿在场，有些持枪警戒，另一些则来回走动，忙着做看起来像是清扫的工作。不难推断，这片区域是最近才分配给她们的，而她们仍在搬迁布置。你还能看到许多其他种族的人来来往往：大多是UGC人员或其他无所属人士，因为这里的金米尔远比使馆其他地方少。半片区域都被临时办公室和房间占据，其中一处门口两侧各站着一名卫兵。

rows.original: You approach the pair of Red Myr standing watch over the nearest entrance, noting to yourself that they’re not wearing gasmasks like the pair outside the warehouse. For that matter, none of the Reds in here are covering their faces. One guard steps forward to stop you before you get within ten feet of the door, and she asks your name and reason for being here. She’s rather terse and straight to the point, but that’s a military girl for you. Standing around with a loaded weapon all day doesn’t engender politeness toward meddling strangers wandering about.
rows.translation: 你走向守在最近入口旁的两名红米尔，心里注意到她们并没有像仓库外那两人一样戴着防毒面具。事实上，这里的红方人员谁也没有遮住脸。你还没走到门口十英尺内，一名卫兵便上前拦住你，询问你的姓名和来意。她语气简短，直截了当，不过女军人就是这样。整天端着上膛的武器站岗，可培养不出对四处乱逛、爱管闲事的陌生人的礼貌。

rows.original: After you tell the sentry that you’re taking a look around since you just arrived on-world, she tersely nods and waves you along, telling you that most areas here are off-limits without clearance and most of the staff require appointments in order to meet with them. Doesn’t look like you’re going to be able to do much here at the moment, so it might be a good idea to get your bearings and find someone to talk to.
rows.translation: 你告诉哨兵，自己刚到这个星球，正在四处看看。她简短地点点头，挥手让你离开，并告诉你这里大部分区域未经许可不得进入，想见多数工作人员也必须预约。看来眼下你在这里做不了什么，最好先熟悉环境，找个人聊聊。

rows.original: After you give the sentry your name and explain who you are and why you’re here, she nods and opens the door to allow you through. You find that it leads into an office which looks to have been thrown up within the past few days, sparsely decorated but for an impressively large desk in the center of the room. A uniformed Red sits at it, and you have a brief window of time to look her over upon entering. The alien warrior’s uniform is far more intricate and appealing than that of the guards, looking showy and expressive when contrasted with the functional garb of the others. You assume that makes her an officer in dress uniform.
rows.translation: 你向哨兵报上姓名，说明自己的身份和来意后，她点点头，打开门让你进去。门后是一间显然在过去几天里才匆忙搭成的办公室，装饰十分简陋，只有房间中央那张大得惊人的办公桌格外显眼。一名穿制服的红米尔坐在桌后，你进门时有片刻时间打量她。这名异星战士的制服远比卫兵们复杂悦目；和其他人强调实用的服装相比，它显得华丽而富有表现力。你猜，这说明她是一名身着礼服的军官。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter you give the sentry your name and explain who you are and why you’re here, she nods and opens the door to allow you through. You find that it leads into an office which looks to have been thrown up within the past few days, sparsely decorated but for an impressively large desk in the center of the room. A uniformed Red sits at it, and you have a brief window of time to look her over upon entering. The alien warrior’s uniform is far more intricate and appealing than that of the guards, looking showy and expressive when contrasted with the functional garb of the others. You assume that makes her an officer in dress uniform."

rows.original: You have just enough time to also notice her inhumanly jet-black eyes glistening in the dim light, and then you find yourself staring right into them as the myr’s face turns up to acknowledge your presence. “Yes? Can I help you?” Her voice is a sharp alto, and the serious tone combined with her uniform and the pervading sense of militarism all around you evokes the image of her barking commands on a parade ground. “Oh,” she adds, straightening in her chair, “I don’t believe we’ve met before. Colonel Nehzara, appointed diplomatic and political representative of the Scarlet Federation to the UGC Embassy. I’m serving in an ambassadorial capacity while the Federation sorts out which general will be here full-time. In any case, the corporal wouldn’t have directed you in unless you had business here, so what do you require of me?” You get the impression she’s been sizing you up since she laid eyes on you.
rows.translation: 你也刚好来得及注意到她非人的漆黑双眼在昏暗灯光下闪烁，随后米尔人抬起脸来注意到你的存在，你便发现自己正直视着那双眼睛。“怎么？有什么事吗？”她的声音是尖锐的女中音，严肃的语调配上制服，以及四周无处不在的军事气息，让你不禁想象她在阅兵场上厉声下令的模样。 “哦，”她在椅子上坐直身子，又补充道，“我想我们以前没见过。我是内赫扎拉上校，被任命为绯红联邦派驻UGC使馆的外交和政治代表。在联邦决定由哪位将军长期驻任之前，我暂代大使职务。不管怎样，那名下士既然引你进来，就说明你有正事。那么，你需要我做什么？”你感觉她从看见你的第一眼起就在评估你。
rows.raw: " You have just enough time to also notice her inhumanly jet-black eyes glistening in the dim light, and then you find yourself staring right into them as the myr’s face turns up to acknowledge your presence. “Yes? Can I help you?” Her voice is a sharp alto, and the serious tone combined with her uniform and the pervading sense of militarism all around you evokes the image of her barking commands on a parade ground. “Oh,” she adds, straightening in her chair, “I don’t believe we’ve met before. Colonel Nehzara, appointed diplomatic and political representative of the Scarlet Federation to the UGC Embassy. I’m serving in an ambassadorial capacity while the Federation sorts out which general will be here full-time. In any case, the corporal wouldn’t have directed you in unless you had business here, so what do you require of me?” You get the impression she’s been sizing you up since she laid eyes on you."

rows.original: You introduce yourself and explain that you’re a star-traveler and heir to one of the larger corporations in the greater galaxy. Nehzara accepts this with a subtle nod and glances at a sheaf of paper on her desk. “Ah, yes. Steele. I was apprised of your arrival on our little world. One of the UGC staff dropped off a quick notice just a moment ago. You’re... quite the important person, it seems.” Her mouth quirks into a little smirk, and you could swear there’s a playful twinkle in those alien eyes of hers.
rows.translation: 你自我介绍，并说明自己是星际旅行者，也是大银河中一家大型企业的继承人。内赫扎拉不动声色地点头接受了这个说法，又瞥了一眼桌上的一叠文件。“啊，是的。斯蒂尔。我已经收到你抵达我们这个小小世界的通知。片刻前，一名UGC工作人员刚送来一份简报。看来你是个...相当重要的人物。”她的嘴角勾起一抹笑意，你敢说那双异星眼眸中闪过了一丝顽皮的光芒。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou introduce yourself and explain that you’re a star-traveler and heir to one of the larger corporations in the greater galaxy. Nehzara accepts this with a subtle nod and glances at a sheaf of paper on her desk. “Ah, yes. Steele. I was apprised of your arrival on our little world. One of the UGC staff dropped off a quick notice just a moment ago. You’re... quite the important person, it seems.” Her mouth quirks into a little smirk, and you could swear there’s a playful twinkle in those alien eyes of hers."

rows.original: One of the antennae atop her head twitches, and you get the feeling that the room just got a little warmer. Though her expression doesn’t change in the slightest, you can’t help but suspect that she’s looking you over the same way you’d stare at a four-course meal after a week without food.
rows.translation: 她头顶的一根触角抽动了一下，你感觉房间似乎突然暖和了一点。尽管她的表情丝毫未变，你却忍不住怀疑，她打量你的眼神就像一个饿了一星期的人盯着四道菜的大餐。
rows.raw: " One of the antennae atop her head twitches, and you get the feeling that the room just got a little warmer. Though her expression doesn’t change in the slightest, you can’t help but suspect that she’s looking you over the same way you’d stare at a four-course meal after a week without food."

rows.original: “So. Steele.” Nehzara leans forward, placing her elbows on the desk and steepling her fingers in a shockingly human fashion. “Unless you’re just taking a stroll to see the sights in the lovely tourist attraction that is the DMZ, you have business with me. I don’t believe I’ll be receiving visitors any time soon, so why don’t I do my job and answer any questions you have?”
rows.translation: “那么，斯蒂尔。”内赫扎拉向前俯身，把手肘撑在桌面上，以一种惊人地像人类的姿势将十指指尖相抵。“除非你只是来这处名为非军事区的美妙旅游胜地散步观光，否则你就是有事找我。我想近期也不会有什么访客，所以不如让我尽职回答你所有的问题吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So. Steele.” Nehzara leans forward, placing her elbows on the desk and steepling her fingers in a shockingly human fashion. “Unless you’re just taking a stroll to see the sights in the lovely tourist attraction that is the DMZ, you have business with me. I don’t believe I’ll be receiving visitors any time soon, so why don’t I do my job and answer any questions you have?”"

rows.original: You decide to go over and see how Nehzara’s handling the disappointment of watching her rival snatch a major accomplishment out from under her. You’ve never seen her so furious, and you’re sort of worried that she might do something drastic. She was a warrior long before she was a diplomat, after all.
rows.translation: 你决定过去看看内赫扎拉如何应对眼睁睁看着宿敌从她手里抢走一项重大成果的挫败。你从未见过她如此愤怒，甚至有点担心她会做出什么极端举动。毕竟，她成为外交官之前，曾经当了很久的战士。
rows.raw: "You decide to go over and see how Nehzara’s handling the disappointment of watching her rival snatch a major accomplishment out from under her. You’ve never seen her so furious, and you’re sort of worried that she might do something drastic. She was a warrior long before she was a diplomat, after all."

rows.original: “The goddamn nerve of that honey-guzzling bitch...” Nehzara’s grumbling to herself and has her arms crossed over her chest, just under her bust. You can’t help but notice that the pose she’s struck makes her bust look absolutely fantastic, though that’s probably the last thing on her mind.
rows.translation: “那个狂灌蜂蜜的贱人，胆子可真他妈大...”内赫扎拉抱着双臂，在胸口下方交叉，独自低声咒骂。你不禁注意到，这个姿势让她的胸部看起来棒极了，尽管这大概是她此刻最不会想到的事情。
rows.raw: "\n\n“The goddamn nerve of that honey-guzzling bitch...” Nehzara’s grumbling to herself and has her arms crossed over her chest, just under her bust. You can’t help but notice that the pose she’s struck makes her bust look absolutely fantastic, though that’s probably the last thing on her mind."

rows.original: Her face brightens when she sees you approaching. The change is subtle, but she definitely perks up a little once you’re there. “Steele,” she says by way of greeting. “No doubt you saw what just happened. That sorry excuse for an ambassador gets away with blatantly drugging a corporate representative and no one does a damn thing.”
rows.translation: 看到你走近，她的神情明亮了起来。变化很细微，但你一到场，她的精神显然振作了些。“斯蒂尔，”她以此作为招呼。“刚才发生的事你肯定看见了。那个不像样的大使明目张胆地给企业代表下药，居然没有任何人采取行动。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHer face brightens when she sees you approaching. The change is subtle, but she definitely perks up a little once you’re there. “Steele,” she says by way of greeting. “No doubt you saw what just happened. That sorry excuse for an ambassador gets away with blatantly drugging a corporate representative and no one does a damn thing.”"

rows.original: You decide not to mention that she’s the one with the lust-inducing venom on her side.
rows.translation: 你决定不提她这边才有能够诱发情欲的毒液。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou decide not to mention that she’s the one with the lust-inducing venom on her side."

rows.original: “Can’t be helped,” she continues with a sigh. “The Golds have never fought fair, and there’s no reason for me to expect them to start. Sorry you had to see that, Steele, but it’s the reality of this embassy. Just because we’re not shooting each other, that doesn’t mean the Golds aren’t trying to fuck us over however they can manage. Only difference is that now we can’t even retaliate in the way we’re best-suited for. The UGC likes to act as if they’re a neutral party, but every day sees them sucking up more and more to the Goldies. First they shoehorn us into this warehouse, and now they’re letting that vapid cunt schmooze visitors any way she feels like. Probably offered the degenerate fuck a drink straight from the damn tap of one of their honey-whores.” Her voice still drips with bile and contempt, but the tone is more one of exhaustion than active fury.
rows.translation: “没办法，”她叹了口气，继续说道。“金方从来不会公平竞争，我也没有理由期待她们现在开始讲规矩。抱歉让你看见这些，斯蒂尔，但这就是这座使馆的现实。我们没有互相开枪，并不代表金方不会想尽办法坑害我们。唯一的区别，是如今我们甚至不能用自己最擅长的方式反击。UGC总爱装成中立方，可他们每天都越来越会讨好那些金毛。先是把我们硬塞进这座仓库，现在又让那个空洞无脑的婊子随心所欲地讨好访客。她们大概直接从某个蜂蜜妓女的水龙头里接了一杯，端给那个堕落的混蛋。”她的声音依然满是恶意与轻蔑，但语气更多是疲惫，而非正在燃烧的怒火。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Can’t be helped,” she continues with a sigh. “The Golds have never fought fair, and there’s no reason for me to expect them to start. Sorry you had to see that, Steele, but it’s the reality of this embassy. Just because we’re not shooting each other, that doesn’t mean the Golds aren’t trying to fuck us over however they can manage. Only difference is that now we can’t even retaliate in the way we’re best-suited for. The UGC likes to act as if they’re a neutral party, but every day sees them sucking up more and more to the Goldies. First they shoehorn us into this warehouse, and now they’re letting that vapid cunt schmooze visitors any way she feels like. Probably offered the degenerate fuck a drink straight from the damn tap of one of their honey-whores.” Her voice still drips with bile and contempt, but the tone is more one of exhaustion than active fury."

rows.original: The lieutenant beside her, however, has not calmed down. “They’re leaving us high and dry, Colonel! We can’t just leave it at this! I say we give that tin-plated gimp a good-”
rows.translation: 然而，她身旁的中尉仍没有冷静下来。“她们把我们晾在这里不管，上校！我们不能就这么算了！我说该给那个裹铁皮的瘸子好好来一——”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe lieutenant beside her, however, has not calmed down. “They’re leaving us high and dry, Colonel! We can’t just leave it at this! I say we give that tin-plated gimp a good-”"

rows.original: “Lieutenant.” Nehzara’s voice is like a razor as she cuts off her subordinate. Where she’d been obviously irritated before, now she radiates an icy calm that’s actually kind of terrifying. The young officer’s eyes go wide at being interrupted, but Nehzara isn’t finished.
rows.translation: “中尉。”内赫扎拉的声音如剃刀般斩断了下属的话。先前她显然还很恼火，如今却散发着一种冰冷的平静，反而令人有些胆寒。年轻军官被打断后瞪大双眼，但内赫扎拉还没说完。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Lieutenant.” Nehzara’s voice is like a razor as she cuts off her subordinate. Where she’d been obviously irritated before, now she radiates an icy calm that’s actually kind of terrifying. The young officer’s eyes go wide at being interrupted, but Nehzara isn’t finished."

rows.original: “I will not tolerate speech like that again. A warrior’s scars are her pride, and I don’t have any inclination to listen to some upstart hatchling whose entire time in uniform has been spent licking the boots of her superiors like some nyrea’s bitch run her goddamn mouth about anyone who’s actually given her all in real combat. Do I make myself clear, Lieutenant?”
rows.translation: “我绝不容许你再说这种话。战士的伤疤是她的骄傲。我也没兴趣听一个穿上制服后只会像某个尼瑞亚人的母狗一样舔上级靴子的狂妄幼虫，在这里对任何真正为实战付出一切的人满嘴喷粪。听明白了吗，中尉？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I will not tolerate speech like that again. A warrior’s scars are her pride, and I don’t have any inclination to listen to some upstart hatchling whose entire time in uniform has been spent licking the boots of her superiors like some nyrea’s bitch run her goddamn mouth about anyone who’s actually given her all in real combat. Do I make myself clear, Lieutenant?”"

rows.original: Oh snap.
rows.translation: 好家伙。
rows.raw: "\n\nOh snap."

rows.original: The chastised officer is clearly having difficulty figuring out how to respond. Her entire body is tensed, and for a moment you think she might actually be about to strike her commanding officer. Instead, she finally swallows her rage and mutters a half-hearted “Yes, Colonel.” Nehzara coolly dismisses her, and the lieutenant delivers a snappy about-face and storms off.
rows.translation: 这名受训斥的军官显然不知道该如何回应。她全身紧绷，有那么一瞬间，你甚至以为她真的要对指挥官动手。最终，她还是咽下怒火，有气无力地咕哝了一句“是，上校。”内赫扎拉冷冷地让她退下，中尉利落地向后转，怒气冲冲地离开。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe chastised officer is clearly having difficulty figuring out how to respond. Her entire body is tensed, and for a moment you think she might actually be about to strike her commanding officer. Instead, she finally swallows her rage and mutters a half-hearted “Yes, Colonel.” Nehzara coolly dismisses her, and the lieutenant delivers a snappy about-face and storms off."

rows.original: The diplomat shakes her head and faces you again. “Once again, I’m sorry you had to see that. Today has just been one unpleasant interaction after another.” She leads you into her office and takes a seat in her normal chair. You can tell that she immediately feels more comfortable in the familiar setting of you standing before her desk like this. “So, Steele...” Her face softens when her lips form the familiar words. “Is there anything I can help you with?”
rows.translation: 这位外交官摇摇头，再次面向你。“我再说一次，抱歉让你看到这些。今天一场接一场，全都是令人不快的互动。”她领你进办公室，在惯常的椅子上坐下。你看得出来，回到熟悉的环境，让你像这样站在她桌前，她立刻自在了许多。“那么，斯蒂尔...”说出这个熟悉的名字时，她的神情柔和下来。“有什么是我能帮你的吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe diplomat shakes her head and faces you again. “Once again, I’m sorry you had to see that. Today has just been one unpleasant interaction after another.” She leads you into her office and takes a seat in her normal chair. You can tell that she immediately feels more comfortable in the familiar setting of you standing before her desk like this. “So, Steele...” Her face softens when her lips form the familiar words. “Is there anything I can help you with?”"

rows.original: into the cluttered warehouse which hosts much of the Scarlet Federation’s embassy staff, expecting to see the same busy scene that you’re normally greeted with. You get a bit of a shock when you find yourself witnessing a rather alarming argument in progress.
rows.translation: 进这座杂乱的仓库。绯红联邦的大部分使馆人员都在这里办公，你原本以为会看见平日那副忙碌景象，却震惊地发现眼前正在爆发一场令人不安的争吵。
rows.raw: " into the cluttered warehouse which hosts much of the Scarlet Federation’s embassy staff, expecting to see the same busy scene that you’re normally greeted with. You get a bit of a shock when you find yourself witnessing a rather alarming argument in progress."

rows.original: “You deliberately drugged him with that brain-rotting ooze of yours, and you know it!” Colonel Nehzara is in fine form: snapping, snarling, and looking as though she’s about to rip off the head of the woman standing in front of her... which would be Ambassador Lyralla.
rows.translation: “你故意用那种会把脑子泡烂的黏液给他下药，你心里清楚！”内赫扎拉上校火力全开：厉声呵斥、龇牙咆哮，看起来随时会把站在她面前的女人脑袋拧下来...而那个女人正是莱拉拉大使。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You deliberately drugged him with that brain-rotting ooze of yours, and you know it!” Colonel Nehzara is in fine form: snapping, snarling, and looking as though she’s about to rip off the head of the woman standing in front of her... which would be Ambassador Lyralla."

rows.original: “Hogwash! You Reds wouldn’t know hospitable diplomacy if it rubbed its honey-spouts in your faces, and that’s why you lost out on the deal!” The Gold ambassador looks equally confrontational, and you’re uncertain whether they’ll be able to restrain themselves for much longer. A fight could break out at any moment, and both of them are accompanied by numerous subordinates. No one’s armed, but you’re aware that myr are strong enough to cause plenty of damage without the aid of weaponry.
rows.translation: “胡说八道！就算有人把蜂蜜喷口往你们脸上蹭，你们红方也认不出什么叫好客外交，所以这笔交易才轮不到你们！”金方大使同样针锋相对，你不确定她们还能克制多久。战斗随时可能爆发，而且两人身边都跟着许多下属。没人携带武器，但你知道米尔人的力量即使不用武器也足以造成巨大破坏。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hogwash! You Reds wouldn’t know hospitable diplomacy if it rubbed its honey-spouts in your faces, and that’s why you lost out on the deal!” The Gold ambassador looks equally confrontational, and you’re uncertain whether they’ll be able to restrain themselves for much longer. A fight could break out at any moment, and both of them are accompanied by numerous subordinates. No one’s armed, but you’re aware that myr are strong enough to cause plenty of damage without the aid of weaponry."

rows.original: Fortunately, Ambassador Juro is on the scene as well, and he’s not alone either. UGC servicemembers of various races stand ready beside and behind him as he does his best to cool down the heated exchange and ease the mood. You breathe a sigh of relief. That wouldn’t have been a catfight: it would have been a disaster.
rows.translation: 幸好朱罗大使也在现场，而且并非孤身一人。各族UGC军人整装待命，站在他身旁和身后；他则尽力给这场激烈冲突降温，缓和气氛。你松了口气。那不会只是一场女人打架，而会演变成一场灾难。
rows.raw: "\n\nFortunately, Ambassador Juro is on the scene as well, and he’s not alone either. UGC servicemembers of various races stand ready beside and behind him as he does his best to cool down the heated exchange and ease the mood. You breathe a sigh of relief. That wouldn’t have been a catfight: it would have been a disaster."

rows.original: Once Juro’s done his job, the Golds move to the other side of the warehouse and the UGC personnel disperse. You learn from one as he passes by that Lyralla had recently signed an agreement with a major interstellar biotech corporation that strongly favored the Golds. It was the most drastic deal to date, and was only possible because the UGC had just loosened restrictions on outside parties dealing with Myrellion... and Nehzara had set her sights on attaining it. Lyralla went to meet with one of the Red legal consultants today, and Nehzara had confronted her as soon as she entered the Red area.
rows.translation: 朱罗完成调停后，金方人员移到仓库另一侧，UGC人员也各自散去。一名路过的军人告诉你，莱拉拉最近与一家大型星际生物科技企业签署了一项极度偏向金方的协议。这是迄今最激进的一笔交易，只有UGC刚刚放宽外部势力与密尔利昂交易的限制才可能达成...而内赫扎拉原本也瞄准了它。莱拉拉今天来见一名红方法律顾问，才踏进红方区域，内赫扎拉就与她正面交锋。
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce Juro’s done his job, the Golds move to the other side of the warehouse and the UGC personnel disperse. You learn from one as he passes by that Lyralla had recently signed an agreement with a major interstellar biotech corporation that strongly favored the Golds. It was the most drastic deal to date, and was only possible because the UGC had just loosened restrictions on outside parties dealing with Myrellion... and Nehzara had set her sights on attaining it. Lyralla went to meet with one of the Red legal consultants today, and Nehzara had confronted her as soon as she entered the Red area."

rows.original: You notice that Nehzara is standing by the door of her office and talking with a younger myr that your codex informs you is adorned with the trappings and insignia of a lieutenant. She looks to have calmed down somewhat, though the junior officer is still fuming. You could go talk to them, or you could decide to come back later.
rows.translation: 你注意到内赫扎拉站在办公室门边，正和一名年轻米尔人交谈。你的法典显示，后者佩戴着中尉的饰物与徽记。内赫扎拉看起来已经稍微平静下来，但那名低阶军官仍在怒火中烧。你可以过去找她们谈谈，也可以决定晚些再来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou notice that Nehzara is standing by the door of her office and talking with a younger myr that your codex informs you is adorned with the trappings and insignia of a lieutenant. She looks to have calmed down somewhat, though the junior officer is still fuming. You could go talk to them, or you could decide to come back later."

rows.original: Half of the area is dominated by makeshift offices and rooms, and one doorway has two guards positioned on either side of it. You can see numerous individuals of other species moving to and fro: they’re mostly UGC personnel or other unaffiliated parties, since there are quite a few less Gold Myr here than elsewhere in the embassy.
rows.translation: 这片区域有一半被临时搭建的办公室和房间占据，其中一扇门的两侧各站着一名警卫。你能看到许多其他种族的人来来往往：他们大多是联合银河邦联人员或其他无所属人士，因为这里的金米尔比使馆其他地方少了许多。

You can see numerous individuals of other species moving to and fro: they’re mostly UGC personnel or other unaffiliated parties, since there are quite a few less Gold Myr here than elsewhere in the embassy."

rows.original: One such office has a pair of sentries standing guard by its entrance. You recognize one of them from your last time here. If you wanted to go speak to Colonel Nehzara again, you could always go up to the guard and tell her so.
rows.translation: 其中一间办公室的入口旁有两名哨兵站岗。你认出其中一人就是上次来时见过的那位。如果你想再次与内赫扎拉上校交谈，随时可以上前告诉那名警卫。

rows.original: The normally composed diplomat is visibly shocked. “I...” she begins hesitantly, “I haven’t. Those of us who can... can bear young don’t really leave the cities very often at all. An old soldier like me wouldn’t know anything about it.” She looks up at you, those eyes of hers seeming sad for the first time that you can recall. There’s more she wants to say but never will. You doubt you could coerce her into spilling it if you tried.
rows.translation: 这位平日沉着的外交官明显吃了一惊。“我...”她迟疑地开口，“我没有。我们中那些能...能孕育后代的人，几乎从不会离开城市。像我这样的老兵对此一无所知。”她抬头看着你，那双眼睛第一次流露出你记忆中的哀伤。她还有更多想说、却永远不会说出口的话。你怀疑即使强迫她，也不可能让她吐露出来。

An old soldier like me wouldn’t know anything about it.” She looks up at you, those eyes of hers seeming sad for the first time that you can recall. There’s more she wants to say but never will. You doubt you could coerce her into spilling it if you tried."

rows.translation: 突如其来的一记胎动正迎上她的触碰，惊得内赫扎拉缩回手去，不过她很快又把手掌放回原处，好再感受一次胎动。你猜米尔人既然以卵生育，这对她来说一定更令人着迷
rows.raw: "sudden kick that meets her touch surprises Nehzara enough to make her withdraw, though she quickly places her palm back where it was so she can feel another kick. You guess that since the myr have egg-based births, this must be doubly fascinating for her"

rows.original: . The bewildered expression on her face isn’t one you’d normally expect to see, and you savor this rare moment while the disciplined officer’s guard is down.
rows.translation: 。她脸上那副茫然神情可不是你平时会见到的样子；趁这位纪律严明的军官卸下戒备，你细细品味着这难得的时刻。
rows.raw: ". The bewildered expression on her face isn’t one you’d normally expect to see, and you savor this rare moment while the disciplined officer’s guard is down."

rows.original: Nehzara pulls her hand away after a few seconds and settles back into her seat. With a barely audible sigh, she recomposes herself and looks up at you as if nothing had happened. “Thank you for that, Steele. Now... was there anything else you wanted of me?”
rows.translation: 几秒后，内赫扎拉收回手，在座位上重新坐稳。她发出一声几不可闻的叹息，恢复镇定，抬头看着你，仿佛什么都没发生过。“谢谢你，斯蒂尔。那么...你还有什么事需要我吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nNehzara pulls her hand away after a few seconds and settles back into her seat. With a barely audible sigh, she recomposes herself and looks up at you as if nothing had happened. “Thank you for that, Steele. Now... was there anything else you wanted of me?”"

rows.original: You decide to ignore your gravid state and broach another topic of discussion.
rows.translation: 你决定无视自己怀孕的状态，转而谈起另一个话题。
rows.raw: "You decide to ignore your gravid state and broach another topic of discussion."

rows.original: Once you’re in Nehzara’s office, the officer looks up to greet you. “Steele,” she says after a moment. You can tell she tried to make that sound like an offhand salutation, but there was something uncertain in her voice just then. That’s when you notice her stare lingering on your swollen belly. Ah. You recall that bearing children is a pretty big thing in both myr societies, and that most of them are completely infertile. You’d never asked Nehzara whether she was or not, but given her position....
rows.translation: 进入内赫扎拉的办公室后，这名军官抬头向你致意。“斯蒂尔，”片刻后她说道。你看得出来，她本想让这句招呼听起来漫不经心，可刚才的声音里却带着一丝迟疑。就在这时，你注意到她的目光一直停留在你隆起的腹部。啊。你想起无论在米尔哪一方的社会中，生育后代都是件大事，而她们绝大多数人都完全不育。你从未问过内赫扎拉是否也是如此，但考虑到她的职位....
rows.raw: "Once you’re in Nehzara’s office, the officer looks up to greet you. “Steele,” she says after a moment. You can tell she tried to make that sound like an offhand salutation, but there was something uncertain in her voice just then. That’s when you notice her stare lingering on your swollen belly. Ah. You recall that bearing children is a pretty big thing in both myr societies, and that most of them are completely infertile. You’d never asked Nehzara whether she was or not, but given her position...."

rows.original: Nehzara clears her throat, which shakes you out of your pensive reverie. “Is there anything I can help you with, Steele?” she asks, prompting you to decide whether to ignore her momentary display of envy or to pursue the subject.
rows.translation: 内赫扎拉清了清嗓子，将你从沉思中惊醒。“有什么我能帮你的吗，斯蒂尔？”她问道，促使你决定是无视她方才短暂流露出的羡慕，还是继续追问此事。
rows.raw: "\n\nNehzara clears her throat, which shakes you out of your pensive reverie. “Is there anything I can help you with, Steele?” she asks, prompting you to decide whether to ignore her momentary display of envy or to pursue the subject."

rows.original: Wanna Feel?
rows.translation: 想摸摸吗？
rows.raw: "Wanna Feel?"

rows.original: Wanna Feel?
rows.translation: 想摸摸吗？
rows.raw: "Wanna Feel?"

rows.original: She may not be able to bear children, but that doesn’t mean she can’t have the chance to experience the wonder of new life taking shape. You could offer to let her feel it and see what it’s like.
rows.translation: 她或许无法生育，但这并不意味着她不能有机会体验新生命成形的奇迹。你可以让她摸一摸，亲身感受那是什么样的。
rows.raw: "She may not be able to bear children, but that doesn’t mean she can’t have the chance to experience the wonder of new life taking shape. You could offer to let her feel it and see what it’s like."

rows.original: Ignore
rows.translation: 无视
rows.raw: "Ignore"

rows.original: Ignore
rows.translation: 无视
rows.raw: "Ignore"

rows.original: Continue on with business as usual.
rows.translation: 像往常一样继续谈正事。
rows.raw: "Continue on with business as usual."

rows.original: You enter the Red Myr diplomat’s office after the guard announces your presence, and Colonel Nehzara regards you with a level gaze and a subdued smile. That’s probably a downright friendly expression by her standards. “Steele,” she says coolly, “I can’t say I expected you to be back here. Did you have more questions?” She glances at the open door and lowers her voice to where you can barely hear her. “Or maybe there’s something else you need, hm?” Something tells you that at least one of the soldiers outside heard, but they’re both too tactful to give any indication of doing so. It’s so nice to be surrounded by professionals.
rows.translation: 警卫通报你到来后，你走进这位红米尔外交官的办公室。内赫扎拉上校以平静的目光和含蓄的微笑打量着你。按她的标准，那大概已经算得上十分友好了。“斯蒂尔，”她冷淡地说道，“没想到你还会回来。还有别的问题吗？”她瞥了一眼敞开的门，把声音压低到你几乎听不清的程度。“还是说，你有些别的需要，嗯？”你总觉得外面至少有一名士兵听见了，不过两人都足够识趣，没有表现出任何迹象。身边全是专业人士，感觉真好。
rows.raw: "You enter the Red Myr diplomat’s office after the guard announces your presence, and Colonel Nehzara regards you with a level gaze and a subdued smile. That’s probably a downright friendly expression by her standards. “Steele,” she says coolly, “I can’t say I expected you to be back here. Did you have more questions?” She glances at the open door and lowers her voice to where you can barely hear her. “Or maybe there’s something else you need, hm?” Something tells you that at least one of the soldiers outside heard, but they’re both too tactful to give any indication of doing so. It’s so nice to be surrounded by professionals."

rows.translation: 红米尔
rows.raw: "Red Myr"
