I was attacked by a giant badger-sapient in my youth and never quite got over it, either.”
rows.translation: “啊，那个嘛，嗯 ... 注意到这张鸟喙了吗，亲爱的智慧生物？”奥里克斯咔哒着鸟喙问道。“米尔似乎在遗传上对长喙的东西抱有某种不信任。我听说她们与某种陆生鸟类一同进化，而且只是刚刚抢先一步掌握了火与工具。托芙和它们毫无关系——我们来自一颗湿润得多的星球——但这已经足以让这些蚂蚁在我们身边非常紧张了。她们允许我设立赞助商摊艇，”他说着指向自己的高台，“但也仅此而已。其实也很难怪她们。我小时候曾被一个巨型獾类智慧生物袭击，至今也没完全走出来。”
rows.raw: "“Ah, that, well ... notice the beak, dear sapient?” Orryx asks, clicking his beak. “Well it seems that the myr have some kind of genetic distrust of things with beaks. I’ve heard they evolved alongside some kind of terrestrial bird species, and only JUST beat them to fire-and-tools. Toves aren’t related at all - we come from a much wetter planet, but it’s enough to make the ants very nervous around us. They let me set up my Sponsorstand,” he says, gesturing to his podium, “but that’s about it. Hard to hold it against them, really. I was attacked by a giant badger-sapient in my youth and never quite got over it, either.”"

rows.original: “But it does make any kind of business deal difficult, since they won’t actually talk to me at all,” he finishes. “And that’s where you come in, my sapient compadre.”
rows.translation: “但这确实让任何生意都很难谈成，因为她们根本不愿和我说话，”他总结道。“而这正是你要出场的地方，我的智慧生物伙伴。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But it does make any kind of business deal difficult, since they won’t actually talk to me at all,” he finishes. “And that’s where you come in, my sapient compadre.”"

rows.original: Count Me Out!
rows.translation: 不干了！
rows.raw: "Count Me Out!"

rows.original: Regulations
rows.translation: 相关规定
rows.raw: "Regulations"

rows.original: I’m in!
rows.translation: 我加入！
rows.raw: "I’m in!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “All toves are members of the Gyre Grand Camarilla, formerly, the GGC, currently The Camarilla, pending brand re-evaluation,” he explains. “We’re a united species government, except we actually get things done ... because we’re a corporation, you see. Every member pays membership, and membership grants votes, and the more membership you can afford, the more votes you get, and so on and so forth. I don’t want to bore you with the minutia of our inner workings.”
rows.translation: “所有托芙都是旋环大卡玛利拉的成员，前称GGC，现称卡玛利拉，品牌正在重新评估中，”他解释道。“我们是一个统一的种族政府，只不过我们确实能把事情办成 ... 因为你看，我们是一家公司。每个成员都要缴纳会费，会籍会赋予投票权；你买得起的会籍越多，拥有的票数也越多，如此等等。我可不想拿内部运作的琐碎细节烦你。”
rows.raw: "“All toves are members of the Gyre Grand Camarilla, formerly, the GGC, currently The Camarilla, pending brand re-evaluation,” he explains. “We’re a united species government, except we actually get things done ... because we’re a corporation, you see. Every member pays membership, and membership grants votes, and the more membership you can afford, the more votes you get, and so on and so forth. I don’t want to bore you with the minutia of our inner workings.”"

rows.original: “The thing is, while The Camarilla encourages productive competition and healthy, cutthroat business tactics, it draws the line at interference when there are actual wars occurring. It’s one thing for toves to sell weapons to other species, but it’s quite another when those weapons get used on toves!”
rows.translation: “问题在于，尽管卡玛利拉鼓励富有成效的竞争和健康而残酷的商业手段，但当真正的战争发生时，它不允许成员插手。托芙向其他种族出售武器是一回事，而那些武器被用来对付托芙就是另一回事了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The thing is, while The Camarilla encourages productive competition and healthy, cutthroat business tactics, it draws the line at interference when there are actual wars occurring. It’s one thing for toves to sell weapons to other species, but it’s quite another when those weapons get used on toves!”"

rows.original: “So as long as this Red versus Gold war goes on, I’m not allowed to directly deal with the myr,” he finishes. “But that’s where you come in, my good sapient.”
rows.translation: “所以，只要这场红方对金方的战争还在继续，我就不能直接和米尔做生意，”他总结道。“但这正是你要出场的地方，我亲爱的智慧生物。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So as long as this Red versus Gold war goes on, I’m not allowed to directly deal with the myr,” he finishes. “But that’s where you come in, my good sapient.”"

rows.original: Camarilla
rows.raw: "Camarilla"

rows.original: Count Me Out!
rows.translation: 不干了！
rows.raw: "Count Me Out!"

rows.original: Cultural Diffs
rows.translation: 文化差异
rows.raw: "Cultural Diffs"

rows.original: I’m in!
rows.translation: 我加入！
rows.raw: "I’m in!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “Phenomenal! Absolutely fantastic!” he chortles, blinking his eyes out of sync. “It’s not a dangerous mission at all. In fact, it’s the easiest thing in the world - for you, at least, not for me - I need Golden Honey.”
rows.translation: “太棒了！简直妙极了！”他咯咯笑着，四只眼睛不同步地眨动。“这任务一点也不危险。事实上，这是世界上最容易的事情——至少对你而言如此，对我可不是——我需要金色蜂蜜。”
rows.raw: "“Phenomenal! Absolutely fantastic!” he chortles, blinking his eyes out of sync. “It’s not a dangerous mission at all. In fact, it’s the easiest thing in the world - for you, at least, not for me - I need Golden Honey.”"

rows.original: You blink in surprise. From what you’ve seen of this city, the gold myr are lavishly free with the stuff.
rows.translation: 你惊讶地眨了眨眼。以你在这座城市里的所见，金米尔对这种东西慷慨得近乎随意。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou blink in surprise. From what you’ve seen of this city, the gold myr are lavishly free with the stuff."

rows.original: Orryx reads your expression surprisingly well. “Yes, but they won’t deal with me directly, and I’m not allowed to deal with them either. So I need a proxy to collect, say, five units of the stuff a day. The two Seeders - those are trading pods - in my Sponsorstand can’t transport much cargo at a time,” he continues, patting the side of his blinking stand. “She’s a beautiful skimmer, but I can’t wait until I’ve earned enough for my own wabeship.”
rows.translation: 奥里克斯出人意料地准确读懂了你的表情。“没错，但她们不会直接和我交易，而我也不被允许和她们交易。所以我需要一名代理人每天收集，比方说，五份这种东西。我的赞助商摊艇里有两个播种舱——那是交易舱——每次运不了多少货物，”他继续说道，拍了拍闪烁的摊艇侧面。“她是一艘漂亮的掠行艇，可我等不及赚够钱买下属于自己的韦布舰了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nOrryx reads your expression surprisingly well. “Yes, but they won’t deal with me directly, and I’m not allowed to deal with them either. So I need a proxy to collect, say, five units of the stuff a day. The two Seeders - those are trading pods - in my Sponsorstand can’t transport much cargo at a time,” he continues, patting the side of his blinking stand. “She’s a beautiful skimmer, but I can’t wait until I’ve earned enough for my own wabeship.”"

rows.original: “But that’s the deal, five units of Golden Honey equals a ridiculously easy pocketful of credits for you and a satisfactory profit for me. What do you say?”
rows.translation: “交易就是这样：五份金色蜂蜜，换你轻而易举赚到满满一口袋信用点，也让我获得令人满意的利润。你觉得如何？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But that’s the deal, five units of Golden Honey equals a ridiculously easy pocketful of credits for you and a satisfactory profit for me. What do you say?”"

rows.original: I’ll Pass
rows.translation: 我不干
rows.raw: "I’ll Pass"

rows.original: You decide to pass on Orryx’s business offer. “Well, I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t disappointed,” the tove says, his ears drooping. “But if you change your mind, you know where to find me!” he calls after you.
rows.translation: 你决定拒绝奥里克斯的生意。“如果我说自己不失望，那就是在撒谎，”托芙垂下耳朵说道。“不过，要是你改变主意，你知道去哪里找我！”他在你身后喊道。
rows.raw: "You decide to pass on Orryx’s business offer. “Well, I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t disappointed,” the tove says, his ears drooping. “But if you change your mind, you know where to find me!” he calls after you."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: It’s A Deal
rows.translation: 成交
rows.raw: "It’s A Deal"

rows.original: You agree to the tove’s simple business deal.
rows.translation: 你同意了托芙这笔简单的交易。
rows.raw: "You agree to the tove’s simple business deal."

rows.original: “Fantastic! Money for you, money for me, it’s what spins this entire universe around ...at least on one of her axis,” he says. “As soon as you have five units of Golden Honey, drop by, and I’ll trade ya.”
rows.translation: “太好了！你赚钱，我赚钱，这就是让整个宇宙转动的动力 ...至少在她的一条轴线上如此，”他说。“只要你有五份金色蜂蜜，就过来找我，我会跟你交易。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fantastic! Money for you, money for me, it’s what spins this entire universe around ...at least on one of her axis,” he says. “As soon as you have five units of Golden Honey, drop by, and I’ll trade ya.”"

rows.original: I Have It
rows.translation: 我有
rows.raw: "I Have It"

rows.original: I Have It
rows.translation: 我有
rows.raw: "I Have It"

rows.original: I Have It
rows.translation: 我有
rows.raw: "I Have It"

rows.original: You don’t have any.
rows.translation: 你一点也没有。
rows.raw: "You don’t have any."

rows.original: Farewell
rows.translation: 告别
rows.raw: "Farewell"

rows.original: You confirm that you’ll keep an eye out for Golden Honey and wave farewell to the excited, little creature.
rows.translation: 你确认自己会留意金色蜂蜜，随后挥手向兴奋的小生物告别。
rows.raw: "You confirm that you’ll keep an eye out for Golden Honey and wave farewell to the excited, little creature."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “I love it! I had a good feeling going into business with you, my good sapient,” Orryx says,winking one of his four eyes and tapping his beak with his talon.
rows.translation: “我太喜欢了！我就知道和你做生意准没错，我亲爱的智慧生物，”奥里克斯说着，眨了眨四只眼睛中的一只，并用爪尖敲了敲鸟喙。
rows.raw: "“I love it! I had a good feeling going into business with you, my good sapient,” Orryx says,winking one of his four eyes and tapping his beak with his talon."

rows.original: As you hand him the honey, he fiddles with the dials on his pocketwatch and you feel a buzz from your Codex.
rows.translation: 当你把蜂蜜交给他时，他拨弄起怀表的刻度盘，而你感觉到Codex传来一阵震动。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you hand him the honey, he fiddles with the dials on his pocketwatch and you feel a buzz from your Codex."

rows.original: “An easy 500 credits for you, and tidy profit for me,” he burbles happily. A glance at your Codex confirms the amount. “Remember, I can only ship one load of these per day, so come back again tomorrow with the same amount and I’ll be happy to take them off your hands!”
rows.translation: “你轻松赚到500信用点，我也赚了一笔漂亮利润，”他开心地咕哝道。瞥一眼Codex便确认了金额。“记住，我每天只能运一批这种货，所以明天带同样的数量再来，我会很乐意从你手上收走！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“An easy 500 credits for you, and tidy profit for me,” he burbles happily. A glance at your Codex confirms the amount. “Remember, I can only ship one load of these per day, so come back again tomorrow with the same amount and I’ll be happy to take them off your hands!”"

rows.original: You bid the tove farewell as you walk away.
rows.translation: 你一边离开，一边向托芙告别。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou bid the tove farewell as you walk away."

rows.original: “Yes! Hah-ha! I love it! I had a good feeling going into business with you, my good sapient,” Orryx says,winking one of his four eyes and tapping his beak with his talon.
rows.translation: “没错！哈-哈！我太喜欢了！我就知道和你做生意准没错，我亲爱的智慧生物，”奥里克斯说着，眨了眨四只眼睛中的一只，并用爪尖敲了敲鸟喙。
rows.raw: "“Yes! Hah-ha! I love it! I had a good feeling going into business with you, my good sapient,” Orryx says,winking one of his four eyes and tapping his beak with his talon."

rows.original: As you hand him the honeys, he fiddles with the dials on his pocketwatch and you feel a buzz from your Codex.
rows.translation: 当你把这些蜂蜜交给他时，他拨弄起怀表的刻度盘，而你感觉到Codex传来一阵震动。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you hand him the honeys, he fiddles with the dials on his pocketwatch and you feel a buzz from your Codex."

rows.original: “An easy 500 credits for you, and tidy profit for me,” he burbles happily. A glance at your Codex confirms the amount. “Remember, I can only ship one load of these per day, so come back again tomorrow with the same amount and I’ll be happy to take them off your hands!”
rows.translation: “你轻松赚到500信用点，我也赚了一笔漂亮利润，”他开心地咕哝道。瞥一眼Codex便确认了金额。“记住，我每天只能运一批这种货，所以明天带同样的数量再来，我会很乐意从你手上收走！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“An easy 500 credits for you, and tidy profit for me,” he burbles happily. A glance at your Codex confirms the amount. “Remember, I can only ship one load of these per day, so come back again tomorrow with the same amount and I’ll be happy to take them off your hands!”"

rows.original: You bid the tove farewell as you walk away.
rows.translation: 你一边离开，一边向托芙告别。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou bid the tove farewell as you walk away."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “Nothing yet? Well, keep trying. You look like the sort of sapient who knows how to get things done!” he says, smiling. “Was that encouraging enough? It’s number 412 on the list of ‘Ways to Stimulate Good Business Relationships’ textbook.”
rows.translation: “还是什么都没有？那就继续努力。你看起来就是那种知道该怎么把事情办成的智慧生物！”他微笑着说道。“这够鼓舞人了吗？出自《促进良好商业关系的方式》教科书第412条。”
rows.raw: "“Nothing yet? Well, keep trying. You look like the sort of sapient who knows how to get things done!” he says, smiling. “Was that encouraging enough? It’s number 412 on the list of ‘Ways to Stimulate Good Business Relationships’ textbook.”"

rows.original: “You might try speaking to one of the queens. I hear they have queens of some kind that can give you portable honey.”
rows.translation: “你可以试着和某位女王谈谈。我听说她们有某种女王，能给你便携的蜂蜜。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You might try speaking to one of the queens. I hear they have queens of some kind that can give you portable honey.”"

rows.original: You nod and bid farewell to the excitable creature.
rows.translation: 你点点头，向这个精力充沛的生物告别。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod and bid farewell to the excitable creature."

rows.original: “Thank you ever so much, my good sapient,” he beams, fiddling with his pocketwatch. “With the money that last shipment brought in, I’m one step closer to Sub-Mercantilist-Adept! Maybe someday I’ll make it all the way up to Eminience Gris!”
rows.translation: “实在太感谢了，我亲爱的智慧生物，”他喜笑颜开地拨弄着怀表。“上一批货带来的钱让我距离准商贸大师又近了一步！也许有朝一日，我能一路晋升为灰衣显贵！”
rows.raw: "“Thank you ever so much, my good sapient,” he beams, fiddling with his pocketwatch. “With the money that last shipment brought in, I’m one step closer to Sub-Mercantilist-Adept! Maybe someday I’ll make it all the way up to Eminience Gris!”"

rows.original: “You’ll forgive me if I don’t share the details of my profits with you. It’s considered very poor taste in my culture, and honestly, it just leaves everyone feeling worse off. But definitely come back tomorrow and I’ll happily buy another shipment from you!”
rows.translation: “如果我不和你分享具体利润，还请见谅。在我的文化中，这被认为非常失礼，而且说实话，只会让所有人感觉更糟。但明天一定要再来，我很乐意向你购买另一批货！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’ll forgive me if I don’t share the details of my profits with you. It’s considered very poor taste in my culture, and honestly, it just leaves everyone feeling worse off. But definitely come back tomorrow and I’ll happily buy another shipment from you!”"

rows.original: You nod and carry on your way.
rows.translation: 你点点头，继续赶路。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod and carry on your way."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “You’ve been such a boon to my business,” says Orryx. “I wanted to open up some further services to you,” he says with a benevolent smile.
rows.translation: “你为我的生意带来了太多帮助，”奥里克斯说道。“我想向你开放一些额外服务，”他带着和善的笑容说道。
rows.raw: "“You’ve been such a boon to my business,” says Orryx. “I wanted to open up some further services to you,” he says with a benevolent smile."

rows.original: “Now, the Gold Myr can’t know about it, and if they hear about it, I’ll simply emergency-launch it into low-orbit. But if you’re interested, I DO have a somewhat more ... shall we say, ‘crimson’ stock,” he says in a low voice.
rows.translation: “金米尔绝不能知道这件事；如果她们听到风声，我会直接把它紧急发射进低轨道。不过，如果你感兴趣，我确实有些更 ... 怎么说呢，‘猩红’的库存，”他压低声音说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now, the Gold Myr can’t know about it, and if they hear about it, I’ll simply emergency-launch it into low-orbit. But if you’re interested, I DO have a somewhat more ... shall we say, ‘crimson’ stock,” he says in a low voice."

rows.original: “I’ve got a supply of Red Venom. Enough pleasure and stimulation to shake the gametophytes from your gonopores. I’ve got a much more ready supply than I do with Golden Honey, and I have a few regulars who get their fix on a daily basis. What they do with it, I don’t ask. How I get it, YOU don’t ask. But you’ve been so good to me that I’d like to help you out in return -really, I’d be happy to. Just 100 credits - friends and family discount.” He winks each of his four eyes, one at a time.
rows.translation: “我有一批红色毒液。它带来的快感和刺激，足以把配子体从你的生殖孔里震出来。我的货源比金色蜂蜜充足得多，还有几个常客每天都来过瘾。他们拿去做什么，我不过问。我从哪里弄来，你也别问。不过你一直对我这么好，我也想回报你——真的，我很乐意。只要100信用点——亲友折扣。”他依次眨了眨四只眼睛。
rows.raw: "“I’ve got a supply of Red Venom. Enough pleasure and stimulation to shake the gametophytes from your gonopores. I’ve got a much more ready supply than I do with Golden Honey, and I have a few regulars who get their fix on a daily basis. What they do with it, I don’t ask. How I get it, YOU don’t ask. But you’ve been so good to me that I’d like to help you out in return -really, I’d be happy to. Just 100 credits - friends and family discount.” He winks each of his four eyes, one at a time."

rows.original: Buy R. Venom
rows.translation: 购买红色毒液
rows.raw: "Buy R. Venom"

rows.original: You nod and he taps the top of his podium lightly. Near your waist, a small panel opens up in one of the flashing screens, and a small vial of Red Venom rolls out into your waiting hand. Your Codex buzzes, informing you that you’ve paid out 100 credits.
rows.translation: 你点点头，他轻轻敲了敲高台顶部。你腰部附近的一块闪烁屏幕打开了小面板，一小瓶红色毒液滚入你等候的手中。你的Codex震动起来，通知你已经支付了100信用点。
rows.raw: "You nod and he taps the top of his podium lightly. Near your waist, a small panel opens up in one of the flashing screens, and a small vial of Red Venom rolls out into your waiting hand. Your Codex buzzes, informing you that you’ve paid out 100 credits."

rows.original: “Enjoy yourself, my good sapient,” he says with an unreadable smile.
rows.translation: “好好享受吧，我亲爱的智慧生物，”他带着难以解读的笑容说道。
rows.raw: " “Enjoy yourself, my good sapient,” he says with an unreadable smile. "

rows.original: Buy Red Venom
rows.translation: 购买红色毒液
rows.raw: "Buy Red Venom"

rows.original: Buy a dose of red venom. Credits: 100
rows.translation: 购买一剂红色毒液。 信用点：100
rows.raw: "Buy a dose of red venom.\n\nCredits: 100"

rows.translation: 购买红色毒液
rows.raw: "Buy R, Venom"

rows.translation: 购买红色毒液
rows.raw: "Buy Red Venom"

rows.translation: 你付不起这100
rows.raw: "You can’t afford the 100 "

rows.translation: 狗狗币
rows.raw: "dogecoin"

rows.original: credit
rows.translation: 信用点
rows.raw: "credit"

rows.original: price!
rows.translation: 的价格！
rows.raw: " price!"

rows.original: No Thanks
rows.translation: 不用了
rows.raw: "No Thanks"

rows.original: You pass on the offer of what sounds like a Red Myr drug, and Orryx’s conspiratorial expression vanishes. “No problem at all, my good sapient. But should you ever feel like it, just let me know!”
rows.translation: 你拒绝了这种听起来像是红米尔药物的东西，奥里克斯那副神秘兮兮的表情也随之消失。“完全没问题，我亲爱的智慧生物。不过你要是哪天想试试，只管告诉我！”
rows.raw: "You pass on the offer of what sounds like a Red Myr drug, and Orryx’s conspiratorial expression vanishes. “No problem at all, my good sapient. But should you ever feel like it, just let me know!”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You hear a buzzing noise from his vest.

rows.original: You wave in the shopkeeper’s direction, continuing to approach the counter. You have a look over the proprietor: tall, slender and robed in rich, purple velvet from head to toe. As you get closer, you can see what is clearly her face peaking out from under a hood, a pallid tone to her skin. You can only see below the nose but she seems rather pretty, her black-lipped mouth curved into a faint smile. She speaks first.
rows.translation: 你朝店主的方向挥了挥手，继续走向柜台，同时打量起这位老板：她身材高挑纤细，从头到脚都裹在华贵的紫色天鹅绒长袍里。走近之后，你能看见兜帽下露出的显然属于她的脸，皮肤呈苍白色。你只能看到鼻子以下的部分，但她似乎颇为漂亮，涂着黑色唇膏的嘴弯出一抹浅笑。她率先开口。
rows.raw: "You wave in the shopkeeper’s direction, continuing to approach the counter. You have a look over the proprietor: tall, slender and robed in rich, purple velvet from head to toe. As you get closer, you can see what is clearly her face peaking out from under a hood, a pallid tone to her skin. You can only see below the nose but she seems rather pretty, her black-lipped mouth curved into a faint smile. She speaks first."

rows.original: “Welcome, traveller! I am... The Seer. Welcome to this place, this cynosure of uncertainty: The Entite! A realm of dreamscapes and portents, myths and realities. All is known and yet, most certainly unknown! What you’ll find here, even I know not! Although I do provide all for a reasonable sum.”
rows.translation: “欢迎，旅人！我是...先知。欢迎来到这里，来到这座不确定性的焦点：实体界！这是由梦境与预兆、神话与现实构成的领域。一切皆为人所知，却又必然无人知晓！你会在这里发现什么，甚至连我自己也不知道！不过，只要价钱合理，我确实什么都能提供。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Welcome, traveller! I am... The Seer. Welcome to this place, this cynosure of uncertainty: The Entite! A realm of dreamscapes and portents, myths and realities. All is known and yet, most certainly unknown! What you’ll find here, even I know not! Although I do provide all for a reasonable sum.”"

rows.original: She curtsies, lifting her robe with her left hand. Well, if a shop’s a shop!

rows.original: You approach the counter although a nebulous feeling within wants to say that something or even some one is compelling you. Well, it’s you of course. Absolutely.

rows.original: Her mien is approachable enough aside from an unblinking amber eye peering from under the velvet hood. Her left hand strokes her right sleeve, as if petting a beloved cat.

rows.raw: "\n\nHer mien is approachable enough aside from an unblinking amber eye peering from under the velvet hood. Her left hand strokes her right sleeve, as if petting a beloved cat. "

rows.original: The Seer is a human female, judging purely by appearance. She stands at 5' 10" in height or thereabouts, a little taller than the Terran average. Her hair is shoulder length and jet black, slightly wavy but mostly a bit of a mess. Her face, something that’s often obscured by her hair and hood, could be described as cute or even pretty were it not at odds with her style and attire.
rows.translation: 单从外表判断，先知是一名人类女性。她身高约5英尺10英寸，比地球人平均身高稍高一些。她有一头及肩的乌黑长发，略带波浪，但大多时候显得有些凌乱。她的脸经常被头发和兜帽遮住；若不是与她的风格和衣着格格不入，倒可以称得上可爱，甚至漂亮。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Seer is a human female, judging purely by appearance. She stands at 5' 10\" in height or thereabouts, a little taller than the Terran average. Her hair is shoulder length and jet black, slightly wavy but mostly a bit of a mess. Her face, something that’s often obscured by her hair and hood, could be described as cute or even pretty were it not at odds with her style and attire."

rows.original: She has a button nose, long eye lashes and a Cupid’s bow lip shape. The Seer uses extensive makeup, at least as far as detail goes: thick, asymmetrical and angular eyeliner designs, black lipstick, eyeshadow that matches her purple robe and a faux-beauty spot on her right cheek.
rows.translation: 她有着一只小巧的鼻子、长长的睫毛和丘比特弓形的嘴唇。先知化着浓重而精细的妆：粗重、不对称且棱角分明的眼线，黑色唇膏，与紫色长袍相配的眼影，以及右脸颊上一颗画出来的美人痣。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe has a button nose, long eye lashes and a Cupid’s bow lip shape. The Seer uses extensive makeup, at least as far as detail goes: thick, asymmetrical and angular eyeliner designs, black lipstick, eyeshadow that matches her purple robe and a faux-beauty spot on her right cheek."

rows.original: The hood hides her amber eyes, pupils apparently permanently constricted. The sclera are marked with notable blood vessels, suggesting a habitual lack of sleep. She rarely seems to blink...
rows.translation: 兜帽遮住了她琥珀色的双眼，瞳孔似乎永远紧缩着。眼白上分布着明显的血丝，说明她长期缺乏睡眠。她似乎很少眨眼...
rows.raw: "\n\nThe hood hides her amber eyes, pupils apparently permanently constricted. The sclera are marked with notable blood vessels, suggesting a habitual lack of sleep. She rarely seems to blink..."

rows.original: Her skin is smooth and human but gray-white in color, almost sickly. It reminds you of the look of an insomniac or someone under extreme duress. She doesn’t seem to be physically ill, although that’s not accounting for her mannerisms, expressions, personality... pretty much everything else about her.
rows.translation: 她的皮肤光滑，具有人类特征，却呈灰白色，近乎病态。那副模样让你想起失眠者，或是承受着巨大压力的人。她看起来并没有身体上的疾病，不过这还没有考虑她的习惯动作、表情、性格...基本上还有她的一切。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer skin is smooth and human but gray-white in color, almost sickly. It reminds you of the look of an insomniac or someone under extreme duress. She doesn’t seem to be physically ill, although that’s not accounting for her mannerisms, expressions, personality... pretty much everything else about her."

rows.original: The whispering shopkeeper is still easy on the eyes. She has an hourglass frame with some natural curve in the right places. Her chest is given a generous range of cleavage thanks to her loose-fitting robes, leaving a large open V from neck to navel. You’d say she has E-cup breasts, buried under a layer of purple velvet. The robes themselves are quite loose but don’t drag on the floor, stopping just above her ankles. They conceal her hands when the sleeves are fully extended and the hood is more than enough to hide her face entirely if need be. She has a wide brown belt right underneath her bosom, a dulled-metal ring holding it all tightly together and emphasising her bust. On her feet are simple sandals, peeping out from under her robes.
rows.translation: 这位低声耳语的店主依然颇为养眼。她有着沙漏般的身材，该有曲线的地方也自然丰满。宽松的长袍在胸前敞开，从颈部一直露到肚脐，展现出相当诱人的乳沟。你估计她有一对E罩杯乳房，埋在一层紫色天鹅绒之下。长袍本身十分宽松，却不会拖到地面，下摆恰好停在脚踝上方。袖子完全垂下时会遮住她的双手，兜帽也足以在需要时把整张脸完全藏住。她的胸部正下方系着一条宽宽的棕色腰带，由一个色泽暗淡的金属环牢牢扣紧，更加凸显了她的胸围。脚上则穿着一双简单的凉鞋，从长袍下方露出一角。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe whispering shopkeeper is still easy on the eyes. She has an hourglass frame with some natural curve in the right places. Her chest is given a generous range of cleavage thanks to her loose-fitting robes, leaving a large open V from neck to navel. You’d say she has E-cup breasts, buried under a layer of purple velvet. The robes themselves are quite loose but don’t drag on the floor, stopping just above her ankles. rows.original: You’re sure that there’s not much else to her but you just can’t quite shake a nagging, ominous thought or two from your mind.
rows.translation: 你确信她身上应该没有别的东西了，可脑海中一两个挥之不去的不祥念头始终令你无法释怀。

rows.original: If you focus on her as a memory, you recall your experiences with the shopkeeper and what her true nature is.
rows.translation: 如果把注意力集中到关于她的记忆上，你便会回想起自己与这位店主的经历，以及她的真正本质。
rows.raw: "\n\nIf you focus on her as a memory, you recall your experiences with the shopkeeper and what her true nature is."

rows.original: Ah, of course! You remember why she has her right arm covered... and the reason is still stomach-turning. Underneath, instead of the expected human arm, there are three grayish-purple tentacle-like appendages that tightly wrap together. Near the ends, the writhing flesh stalks taper off to a soft, membranous point like octopus legs without the suckers. There’s a smaller appendage also near the middle of each main tentacle, essentially giving her ‘arm’ six ‘fingers.’ She has an extreme measure of control over them, as you’ve borne witness to before and they can extend to her entire body length if she chooses.The tenta-tips tend to ooze a strange fluid from unseen pores.
rows.translation: 啊，当然！你想起来她为什么把右臂遮住了...那个原因仍然令人反胃。衣袖下面没有预想中的人类手臂，取而代之的是三条灰紫色、宛如触手的附肢，彼此紧紧缠绕。靠近末端处，蠕动的肉茎逐渐收细，形成柔软的膜状尖端，就像没有吸盘的章鱼腿。每条主触手的中段附近还各有一条较小的附肢，实际上让她的‘手臂’拥有了六根‘手指’。她对它们拥有极强的控制力，你以前已经亲眼见识过；只要她愿意，它们可以伸展到与她整个人一样长。触手尖端往往会从看不见的毛孔中渗出一种奇怪的液体。
rows.raw: "\n\nAh, of course! You remember why she has her right arm covered... and the reason is still stomach-turning. rows.original: Appearance

rows.original: At least she’s nice to look at... and probably won’t even notice you doing it.
rows.translation: 至少她还挺养眼的...而且她大概根本不会注意到你在看。

rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: You’re curious about this ‘Seer’, about pretty much everything, especially this strange shop that you feel a sense of nostalgia for even though you’ve only been here the once. Or twice? Have you ever been here before...? When was the last time you left?!
rows.translation: 你对这位‘先知’感到好奇，几乎对一切都很好奇，尤其是这间古怪的商店。明明你只来过一次，却对它怀有一股怀旧之情。还是两次？你以前真的来过这里吗...? 你上一次离开又是什么时候？！
rows.raw: "You’re curious about this ‘Seer’, about pretty much everything, especially this strange shop that you feel a sense of nostalgia for even though you’ve only been here the once. Or twice? Have you ever been here before...? When was the last time you left?!"

rows.original: She seems to be on the same line of thinking, anticipating your intent.
rows.translation: 她似乎也想到了同一件事，预先料到了你的意图。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe seems to be on the same line of thinking, anticipating your intent."

rows.original: “Ah, you’re Steele, of course. Not to buy, no no, you want to... speak with me? Are you sure? Is he sure? She sure? I think they are. What do you wish to know of me?” She pre-empts in grandiose, semi-delirious phrasing.
rows.translation: “啊，你当然是斯蒂尔。不是来买东西，不不，你想要...跟我谈谈？你确定吗？他确定？她确定？我想他们都确定。你想从我这里知道什么？”她用夸张而半疯癫的措辞抢先说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, you’re Steele, of course. Not to buy, no no, you want to... speak with me? Are you sure? Is he sure? She sure? I think they are. What do you wish to know of me?” She pre-empts in grandiose, semi-delirious phrasing."

rows.original: Her
rows.translation: 她
rows.raw: "Her"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: You say you’re curious about her: What’s her history? Why Myrellion of all places?
rows.translation: 你说自己对她很好奇：她有什么来历？又为什么偏偏待在米瑞利恩？
rows.raw: "You say you’re curious about her: What’s her history? Why Myrellion of all places?"

rows.original: “Curious? I wonder if... yes, you would be, of course. Certainly!” she exclaims, her fingers tapping against her rounded chin.
rows.translation: “好奇？我想...是的，你当然会好奇。当然！”她惊呼道，手指轻敲着圆润的下巴。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Curious? I wonder if... yes, you would be, of course. Certainly!” she exclaims, her fingers tapping against her rounded chin."

rows.original: “I’m the Seer. Not this seer or that seer but the Seer! Seer of what? I’ve seen so much. More than I remember, more than I’m prepared for, more, more, more of you! You’ve seen things! But not the same things,” she rambles, her eyes darting around from under the hood. She seems to peer behind you, as if watching for a queue of customers.
rows.translation: “我是先知。不是这个先知，也不是那个先知，而是那位先知！预见什么？我见过太多。比我记得的更多，比我有所准备的更多，更多、更多、更多个你！你见过许多事！但不是同样的事，”她喋喋不休，双眼从兜帽下四处扫动。她似乎越过你向后张望，仿佛在等候一队顾客。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m the Seer. Not this seer or that seer but the Seer! Seer of what? I’ve seen so much. More than I remember, more than I’m prepared for, more, more, more of you! You’ve seen things! But not the same things,” she rambles, her eyes darting around from under the hood. She seems to peer behind you, as if watching for a queue of customers."

rows.original: “You agree, of course.”
rows.translation: “你当然同意。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You agree, of course.”"

rows.original: Do you? What?
rows.translation: 你同意吗？同意什么？
rows.raw: "\n\nDo you? What?"

rows.original: “Ah, oh, never mind,” she says, distracted by something else. “If I may say, I do hope that you don’t.”
rows.translation: “啊，哦，没关系，”她说道，注意力又被别的东西吸引。“如果可以这么说，我确实希望你不会那么做。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, oh, never mind,” she says, distracted by something else. “If I may say, I do hope that you don’t.”"

rows.original: Don’t? Don’t what? You ask her what she means.
rows.translation: 不会？不会做什么？你问她是什么意思。
rows.raw: "\n\nDon’t? Don’t what? You ask her what she means."

rows.original: “You must know, if I know then you must know, surely! You see?” She gestures erratically with her left hand to the shop’s entrance.
rows.translation: “你一定知道；如果我知道，那你肯定也知道！你看见了吗？”她用左手朝商店入口胡乱比划。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You must know, if I know then you must know, surely! You see?” She gestures erratically with her left hand to the shop’s entrance."

rows.original: There’s nothing there.
rows.translation: 那里什么也没有。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s nothing there."

rows.original: “Ah, I see. I see! I see.”
rows.translation: “啊，我明白了。我看见了！我看见了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, I see. I see! I see.”"

rows.original: Without much warning, she places her open palm to the top of your [pc.chest]. You’re taken aback but you’re compelled to not react, seeing as it’s a non-violent maneuver. She stares you down with those widened, piercing eyes.
rows.translation: 毫无预兆地，她将摊开的手掌按在你的[pc.chest]上。你吃了一惊，但鉴于这并非暴力动作，你克制住了反应。她睁大那双锐利的眼睛，直直盯着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nWithout much warning, she places her open palm to the top of your [pc.chest]. You’re taken aback but you’re compelled to not react, seeing as it’s a non-violent maneuver. She stares you down with those widened, piercing eyes."

rows.original: “You might not see but you hear, yes?”
rows.translation: “你或许看不见，但你听得见，对吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You might not see but you hear, yes?”"

rows.original: Hear what?
rows.translation: 听见什么？
rows.raw: "\n\nHear what?"

rows.original: Vum-vomm.
rows.raw: "\n\nVum-vomm."

rows.original: Vum-vomm. Vommm.
rows.raw: "\n\nVum-vomm. Vommm. "

rows.original: That’s unsettling.
rows.translation: 这令人不安。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s unsettling."

rows.original: It’s a heartbeat, the Seer’s perhaps? No, no. This rhythm sounds overwhelmingly huge. Something very distant, maybe even worlds away... but on an unfathomable scale.
rows.translation: 这是心跳声，或许是先知的？不，不对。这节奏听起来庞大得惊人。某种极其遥远的东西，甚至可能远在另一个世界...却有着无法估量的规模。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s a heartbeat, the Seer’s perhaps? No, no. This rhythm sounds overwhelmingly huge. Something very distant, maybe even worlds away... but on an unfathomable scale."

rows.original: Alarmed, you take a step back.
rows.translation: 你惊慌地后退一步。
rows.raw: "\n\nAlarmed, you take a step back."

rows.original: Her hand slides into its sleeve, the Seers expression being left as a vague smile. “Now you’ve heard, you’ll not do it.”
rows.translation: 她的手滑回袖中，先知脸上只剩下一抹模糊的微笑。“既然你已经听见，就不会那么做了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHer hand slides into its sleeve, the Seers expression being left as a vague smile. “Now you’ve heard, you’ll not do it.”"

rows.original: Do what?!
rows.translation: 做什么？！
rows.raw: "\n\nDo what?!"

rows.original: “That,” she says, pointing to a random candle near one of the displays.
rows.translation: “那个，”她说道，指向某个陈列架旁随便一根蜡烛。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That,” she says, pointing to a random candle near one of the displays."

rows.original: There’s nothing happening over there either.
rows.translation: 那里同样什么也没发生。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s nothing happening over there either."

rows.original: “How else may I help you, dear Steele?”
rows.translation: “我还能怎样帮助你呢，亲爱的斯蒂尔？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“How else may I help you, dear Steele?”"

rows.original: As well as not learning a single damn thing about her, you’re a little wary of accepting more ‘help’.

rows.raw: "The Shop"

rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: You ask her about her shop and how the business is.
rows.translation: 你问起她的商店，以及生意如何。
rows.raw: "You ask her about her shop and how the business is."

rows.original: “Ah, aha! Yes, they’d say that. They would... the shop is merely an extension of my being, so to speak. I see parts of me in all of its corners, the candles, the seclusion, the search for wonder! Were I to not see, this place would melt away and perhaps be a nice, clean wall that a set of yellow drapes would cover,” she says, cryptic as always but oddly sincere all the same.
rows.translation: “啊，啊哈！是的，他们会那么说。他们会...可以说，这间商店只是我自身的延伸。我在每个角落都能看见自己：蜡烛、与世隔绝，还有对奇迹的追寻！倘若我看不见，这地方就会消融，或许变成一面干净漂亮的墙，再由一套黄色帘布遮住，”她说道，一如既往地隐晦，却又同样真诚得出奇。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, aha! Yes, they’d say that. They would... the shop is merely an extension of my being, so to speak. I see parts of me in all of its corners, the candles, the seclusion, the search for wonder! Were I to not see, this place would melt away and perhaps be a nice, clean wall that a set of yellow drapes would cover,” she says, cryptic as always but oddly sincere all the same."

rows.original: She points to a wall of gemstones on shelves, some you could make a guess at - rubies, peridot, non-native pieces certainly - while others are so utterly alien and strange that you’re not even convinced they’re from the same galaxy. There’s a green orb of marble-like material that seems to float three inches off of the shelf on its own, while another gravel-like ring of stones constantly emits, refracts, then dulls with a baby blue glow.
rows.translation: 她指向墙边架子上的一排宝石。有些你还能猜出是什么——红宝石、橄榄石，显然还有些外星产物——另一些则陌生诡异至极，你甚至不相信它们来自同一个星系。一颗绿色、形似大理石的球体自行悬浮在架子上方三英寸处；另一圈仿佛碎石的石头则不断发出、折射婴儿蓝的光芒，随后又黯淡下去。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe points to a wall of gemstones on shelves, some you could make a guess at - rubies, peridot, non-native pieces certainly - while others are so utterly alien and strange that you’re not even convinced they’re from the same galaxy. There’s a green orb of marble-like material that seems to float three inches off of the shelf on its own, while another gravel-like ring of stones constantly emits, refracts, then dulls with a baby blue glow."

rows.original: “All these have a place in here and one out there. Only when the right key is found do they leave. Most are content with where they are, especially him,” she explains, pointing to a human-like idol near the counter.
rows.translation: “这里的每一件东西在里面都有位置，在外面也有位置。只有找到正确的钥匙，它们才会离开。大多数都满足于自己所在之处，尤其是他，”她解释道，指向柜台旁一尊类人的雕像。
rows.raw: "\n\n“All these have a place in here and one out there. Only when the right key is found do they leave. Most are content with where they are, especially him,” she explains, pointing to a human-like idol near the counter."

rows.original: “But for simpler needs, I much like these transformatives and mutationals. A little closer to a certain truth, perhaps. Plus, Envyoidics is a very sharp company and enjoys the arrangement we have,” she says with a smug tone of voice. Huh. Guess that’s some obscure brand that isn’t well known in U.G.C...
rows.translation: “不过若是更简单的需求，我很喜欢这些变形剂和突变剂。或许更接近某种真相。而且，恩维奥迪克斯是一家非常精明的公司，也很喜欢我们之间的安排，”她语带得意地说道。唔。看来那是个在U.G.C.里没什么名气的冷门品牌...
rows.raw: "\n\n“But for simpler needs, I much like these transformatives and mutationals. A little closer to a certain truth, perhaps. Plus, Envyoidics is a very sharp company and enjoys the arrangement we have,” she says with a smug tone of voice. Huh. Guess that’s some obscure brand that isn’t well known in U.G.C..."

rows.original: You ask her what makes them a particular supplier, keeping to the train of thought she made before she derails it herself.
rows.translation: 你顺着她刚才的思路追问，想赶在她自己把话题带偏之前，弄清为何偏偏选择他们作为供货商。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her what makes them a particular supplier, keeping to the train of thought she made before she derails it herself."

rows.original: “Oh, such history! A way of capturing what was and will be into what is. I am enthralled with this one, this ‘Illumorpheme’,” she exclaims, reaching for a small box inside the glass case behind the counter. She holds it in her palm: A fancy black box with a beautiful moth shape on top of it, an antiquated brass lock keeping it closed.
rows.translation: “哦，多么悠久的历史！一种将曾经与将来捕捉进当下的方法。我迷上了这个，这个‘幻光态’，”她惊呼着，从柜台后的玻璃柜中取出一个小盒子。她把它托在掌心：一只华美的黑盒，盒顶饰有漂亮的飞蛾图案，一把古旧的黄铜锁将其牢牢封住。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, such history! A way of capturing what was and will be into what is. I am enthralled with this one, this ‘Illumorpheme’,” she exclaims, reaching for a small box inside the glass case behind the counter. She holds it in her palm: A fancy black box with a beautiful moth shape on top of it, an antiquated brass lock keeping it closed."

rows.original: “Even this box, beauty incarnate to me. To you too, et tu? Maybe more so than me?”
rows.translation: “就连这个盒子，对我而言也是美的化身。对你也是，你也一样？或许比我更甚？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Even this box, beauty incarnate to me. To you too, et tu? Maybe more so than me?”"

rows.original: You can only give her a quizzical look back, shrugging at her question. You don’t even know what’s inside.
rows.translation: 你只能困惑地望着她，对这个问题耸了耸肩。你甚至不知道里面装着什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can only give her a quizzical look back, shrugging at her question. You don’t even know what’s inside."

rows.original: “Ahh a pity, truly, pitiful. A pitfall of yours but a picture I’ve already seen...”
rows.translation: “啊，真遗憾，实在可怜。是你的一处陷阱，却是一幅我早已见过的画面...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ahh a pity, truly, pitiful. A pitfall of yours but a picture I’ve already seen...”"

The Shop

rows.translation: 商店

rows.original: It seems odd that this place even exists at all, no one else has come in...
rows.translation: 这里居然存在本身就很奇怪，根本没有其他人进来过...
rows.raw: "It seems odd that this place even exists at all, no one else has come in..."

rows.translation: 奇异模组
rows.raw: "Odd Mods"

rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: You ask about the strange merchandise she sells behind the glass case. Some of it you could recognize in spite of their rarity, other things appear to be so obscure that they reek of potential illegality.
rows.translation: 你问起玻璃柜后那些奇怪的商品。其中有些尽管稀有，你仍认得出来；另一些则冷门得令人怀疑它们可能根本不合法。
rows.raw: "You ask about the strange merchandise she sells behind the glass case. Some of it you could recognize in spite of their rarity, other things appear to be so obscure that they reek of potential illegality."

rows.original: “It’s all history, all in the moment! All of it is needed. Or is some of it needed? Depends, for I don’t need any of it. I should think you... could?”
rows.translation: “这一切都是历史，也全都在这一刻！它们全都不可或缺。还是说只有一部分需要？看情况，因为我一样也不需要。我想你...可能需要？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s all history, all in the moment! All of it is needed. Or is some of it needed? Depends, for I don’t need any of it. I should think you... could?”"

rows.original: Can’t she just keep a straight answer for once? You point to the box labeled ‘Illumorpheme’. What could possibly be in there?
rows.translation: 她就不能哪怕一次好好回答吗？你指向标着‘幻光态’的盒子。里面究竟能装着什么？
rows.raw: "\n\nCan’t she just keep a straight answer for once? You point to the box labeled ‘Illumorpheme’. What could possibly be in there?"

rows.original: “Mm, a curious selection inside. Have you heard of... the Tear?”
rows.translation: “嗯，里面是一种有趣的选择。你听说过...裂隙吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mm, a curious selection inside. Have you heard of... the Tear?”"

rows.original: No...
rows.translation: 没有...

rows.original: “‘Tis but a fragment, mewling and mindless. The mothrine... they were too before they knew. But the Tear did not swallow them, they lived far before. They predicted it! Envyoidics is fascinated with history... they uncovered the remains of the mothrine. Organic, ancient, pious. Moths! Fluffy pretty moths with big eyes!” She explains, her tone shifting from explanatory to immersed then to playful in but a few words.
rows.translation: “那不过是一块碎片，啼哭着、毫无心智。莫瑟林...在知晓之前也曾如此。但裂隙并未吞噬他们；他们早在那之前便已存在。他们预见了它！恩维奥迪克斯痴迷于历史...他们发掘出了莫瑟林的遗骸。有机、古老、虔诚。飞蛾！毛茸茸、漂漂亮亮、有着大眼睛的飞蛾！”她解释着，短短几句话间，语气便从讲解转为沉浸，最后又变得俏皮。
rows.raw: "\n\n“‘Tis but a fragment, mewling and mindless. The mothrine... they were too before they knew. But the Tear did not swallow them, they lived far before. They predicted it! Envyoidics is fascinated with history... they uncovered the remains of the mothrine. Organic, ancient, pious. Moths! Fluffy pretty moths with big eyes!” She explains, her tone shifting from explanatory to immersed then to playful in but a few words."

rows.original: <i>“The mothrine were saved in that regard. Right here in a box like this!
rows.translation: <i>“从这一点来说，莫瑟林得救了。就保存在这样一只盒子里！
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“The mothrine were saved in that regard. Right here in a box like this! "

rows.original: credits! Or next best offer, I’m not too fussy.”
rows.translation: 点信用点！或者次优报价也行，我并不太挑。”
rows.raw: " credits! Or next best offer, I’m not too fussy.”"

rows.original: Her bewildering leap from history lesson to haggling leaves more questions than answers.
rows.translation: 她从历史课突然跳到讨价还价，留下的问题比答案还多。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer bewildering leap from history lesson to haggling leaves more questions than answers. "

rows.original: But what about the other things? What’s that inhaler-like device next to it?
rows.translation: 但其他东西呢？旁边那个像吸入器的装置又是什么？
rows.raw: "\n\nBut what about the other things? What’s that inhaler-like device next to it?"

rows.original: As if predicting your questions, the Seer takes out the inhaler and holds it in her palm.
rows.translation: 仿佛预见了你的问题，先知取出那个吸入器，托在掌心。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs if predicting your questions, the Seer takes out the inhaler and holds it in her palm."

rows.original: “Capraphorm!” She whispers with delight, her pupils almost constricting to pinprick dots. “Another ancient race from another ancient place, another container of history! How does one even begin... perhaps at the end. All that I can say is that these ancient beings worshipped thunder and sky like one needs the air to breathe...”
rows.translation: “羊化剂！”她欣喜地低声说道，瞳孔几乎缩成针尖般的小点。“又一个来自另一处古老之地的古老种族，又一个盛放历史的容器！该从何说起呢...或许从结局开始。我只能说，这些古老的存在崇拜雷霆与天空，就像人需要呼吸空气一样...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Capraphorm!” She whispers with delight, her pupils almost constricting to pinprick dots. “Another ancient race from another ancient place, another container of history! How does one even begin... perhaps at the end. All that I can say is that these ancient beings worshipped thunder and sky like one needs the air to breathe...”"

rows.original: Taking your averted gaze away from your codex, it appears the shopkeepers vision has become distracted with something in the corner of the room.
rows.translation: 你把从个人终端上移开的视线投回去，却发现店主的目光已经被房间角落里的某样东西吸引。
rows.raw: "\n\nTaking your averted gaze away from your codex, it appears the shopkeepers vision has become distracted with something in the corner of the room."

rows.original: “I wouldn’t... or would you? I think he should,” she mumbles.
rows.translation: “我不会...还是你会？我觉得他应该会，”她喃喃道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I wouldn’t... or would you? I think he should,” she mumbles."

rows.original: What?
rows.translation: 什么？
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat?"

rows.original: Mothrine
rows.raw: "Mothrine"

rows.original: Odd Mods
rows.translation: 奇异模组
rows.raw: "Odd Mods"

rows.original: Odd Mods
rows.translation: 奇异模组
rows.raw: "Odd Mods"

rows.original: Where’d she get all these
rows.translation: 她从哪弄来这么多
rows.raw: "Where’d she get all these "

rows.original: funnel cakes
rows.translation: 漏斗蛋糕
rows.raw: "funnel cakes"

rows.original: obscure mods
rows.translation: 冷门模组
rows.raw: "obscure mods"

rows.original: Lounge
rows.translation: 休息区
rows.raw: "Lounge"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: You ask her about the curtained off corner of the room, the one that glows in a sickly pink light.
rows.translation: 你问起房间里被帘幕隔开的角落，那里泛着病态的粉色光芒。
rows.raw: "You ask her about the curtained off corner of the room, the one that glows in a sickly pink light."

rows.original: “Ah, of course! All customers welcome, please come with me,” she starts, showing a rare moment of clarity. The Seer strides over to the drapes with her long staff in hand. She pulls one of the curtains just so with the bottom end of it, inviting you in. Well it’d be rude to turn her down now...
rows.translation: “啊，当然！欢迎所有顾客，请跟我来，”她开口说道，难得表现出片刻清醒。先知手持长杖走向帘幕，用杖尾恰到好处地挑开一片帘子，邀请你进去。事到如今，拒绝她可就太失礼了...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, of course! All customers welcome, please come with me,” she starts, showing a rare moment of clarity. The Seer strides over to the drapes with her long staff in hand. She pulls one of the curtains just so with the bottom end of it, inviting you in. Well it’d be rude to turn her down now..."

rows.original: You push the rest of the curtain aside, finding yourself in a round cubicle with plush seating. There’s velvety cushions, silks, and embroidery haphazardly organized into a curiously appealing arrangement on top. In the middle is a round stone table with a circular hole in the middle. The table is covered in abstract, geometric shapes and patterns. Circles upon circles and lines, arrangements that you’ve never seen before in contemporary mathematics. Odd.
rows.translation: 你推开余下的帘幕，发现自己来到一间带软座的圆形隔间。天鹅绒软垫、丝绸和刺绣杂乱地铺在上面，却组成了一种莫名悦目的陈设。中央是一张圆形石桌，正中开着圆孔。桌面布满抽象的几何形状和图案。圆套着圆，线条彼此排列，都是当代数学中从未见过的组合。真古怪。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou push the rest of the curtain aside, finding yourself in a round cubicle with plush seating. There’s velvety cushions, silks, and embroidery haphazardly organized into a curiously appealing arrangement on top. In the middle is a round stone table with a circular hole in the middle. The table is covered in abstract, geometric shapes and patterns. Circles upon circles and lines, arrangements that you’ve never seen before in contemporary mathematics. Odd."

rows.original: You slide onto the seat, sinking into the oh-so-comfortable material with ease. The Seer takes her staff and places it bottom-first into the hole in the table. Over the span of a few seconds, the pink glow that seemed to be self-generating focuses into the staff’s crystal tip. The crystal glows a pinkish white: A gentle, ambient light that becomes easier to look at the more you keep your eyes open. Any apprehension you have melts away as you feel your body completely relax.
rows.translation: 你滑坐到座位上，轻易陷入那舒适得不得了的材质中。先知拿起长杖，将底端插入桌上的孔洞。几秒之内，那仿佛自行生成的粉色光芒汇聚到杖顶的水晶尖端。水晶泛起粉白色光辉：柔和的环境光，你睁眼看得越久，便越容易直视。随着身体彻底放松，你心中的所有戒备都消融了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou slide onto the seat, sinking into the oh-so-comfortable material with ease. The Seer takes her staff and places it bottom-first into the hole in the table. Over the span of a few seconds, the pink glow that seemed to be self-generating focuses into the staff’s crystal tip. The crystal glows a pinkish white: A gentle, ambient light that becomes easier to look at the more you keep your eyes open. Any apprehension you have melts away as you feel your body completely relax."

rows.original: “Enjoying the seats, Steele? You all seem to agree, especially that one over there,” she states, pointing to an empty part of the couch. Ignoring that odd statement, you nod to her, reclining even further into the fabric. Hey, finally time to do something truly relaxing! You hadn’t even noticed the thin veil of mist filling the lounge! Wait, what?
rows.translation: “座位舒服吗，斯蒂尔？你们似乎都同意，尤其是那边那个，”她说道，指向沙发上一处空位。你无视这句怪话，向她点点头，更深地靠进布料里。嘿，终于能真正放松一下了！你甚至都没注意到休息区里正弥漫着一层薄雾！等等，什么？
rows.raw: "\n\n“Enjoying the seats, Steele? You all seem to agree, especially that one over there,” she states, pointing to an empty part of the couch. Ignoring that odd statement, you nod to her, reclining even further into the fabric. Hey, finally time to do something truly relaxing! You hadn’t even noticed the thin veil of mist filling the lounge! Wait, what?"

rows.original: The Seer is staring at you with a deadpan, wide-eyed smile as you feel your mind losing its grasp on consciousness. So sleepy... you just need to close your eyes for a few sec... maybe a min... mm, that sweet smelling mist...
rows.translation: 先知面无表情地睁大眼睛对你微笑，而你感觉意识正逐渐松脱。好困...你只需要闭眼几秒...或许一分钟...嗯，那甜香的雾气...
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Seer is staring at you with a deadpan, wide-eyed smile as you feel your mind losing its grasp on consciousness. So sleepy... you just need to close your eyes for a few sec... maybe a min... mm, that sweet smelling mist..."

rows.original: Sleep...
rows.translation: 睡吧...
rows.raw: "Sleep..."

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: You open your eyes.
rows.translation: 你睁开眼睛。
rows.raw: "You open your eyes."

rows.original: All around you is a veil of blackness. Complete abyssal darkness. So dark that your eyes start aching for even a hint of light. You stimulate your limbs in panic, realizing that they’re moving as if in water. It doesn’t matter either way: You can’t even see them.
rows.translation: 四周笼罩着一层黑暗。彻底、深渊般的漆黑。黑得让你的眼睛开始渴求哪怕一丝光亮。你惊慌地驱使四肢，却发现它们仿佛在水中移动。反正都无所谓：你连它们都看不见。
rows.raw: "\n\nAll around you is a veil of blackness. Complete abyssal darkness. So dark that your eyes start aching for even a hint of light. You stimulate your limbs in panic, realizing that they’re moving as if in water. It doesn’t matter either way: You can’t even see them."

rows.original: Without a physical reference, up is down and down is up, left and right have no bearing. You almost feel weightless: Drifting, static in the vast nothingness of... somewhere. Alone, unnoticed, unknown.
rows.translation: 没有实体作为参照，上即是下、下即是上，左右也毫无意义。你几乎感觉不到重量：漂浮着，静止在...某个地方的无尽虚无中。孤独、无人察觉、无人知晓。
rows.raw: "\n\nWithout a physical reference, up is down and down is up, left and right have no bearing. You almost feel weightless: Drifting, static in the vast nothingness of... somewhere. Alone, unnoticed, unknown."

rows.original: Your eyes twinge. Slowly but surely, infinitesimal white lights dot the black canvas around you in every direction. You can see the outline of your limbs against their distant glow.
rows.translation: 你的双眼刺痛。缓慢却确实地，无数微不可见的白色光点开始从各个方向点缀四周的黑色画布。借着遥远的微光，你能看见四肢的轮廓。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour eyes twinge. Slowly but surely, infinitesimal white lights dot the black canvas around you in every direction. You can see the outline of your limbs against their distant glow."

rows.original: Stars.
rows.translation: 星辰。
rows.raw: "\n\nStars."

rows.original: A thought that’s not your own repeats and echoes the word ‘stars’. A thought so immense in force and weight that you dare not even think. Stunned, you gaze into the endless space around you.
rows.translation: 一个不属于你的念头重复着‘星辰’一词，在脑海中回荡。那念头的力量与分量如此庞大，令你甚至不敢思考。你呆呆凝视着四周无尽的空间。
rows.raw: "\n\nA thought that’s not your own repeats and echoes the word ‘stars’. A thought so immense in force and weight that you dare not even think. Stunned, you gaze into the endless space around you."

rows.original: And then, an intense blaze of yellow blares from beneath you. It’s not strong enough to blind but it is completely encompassing, forcing you to gaze at its source from below...
rows.translation: 随后，一片强烈的黄色炽光从你下方轰然迸发。它还不至于使你失明，却完全包围了你，迫使你从上方俯视其源头...
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd then, an intense blaze of yellow blares from beneath you. It’s not strong enough to blind but it is completely encompassing, forcing you to gaze at its source from below..."

rows.original: Vum-vomm.
rows.raw: "\n\nVum-vomm."

rows.original: Dazzling displays of prismatic light form, reform and repeat all around, an omni-colored tide of nebulae spreading further and further ‘upwards’ to you and then far beyond you. In the center of the swirling madness of indescribable color, a singular subject sits: an eye. A gigantic eye, one that you would never comprehend of being able to hide from!
rows.translation: 棱镜般的耀眼光景在四周形成、重组、反复上演，万色星云组成的潮汐不断向你‘上方’蔓延，继而远远越过你。在这团难以描述的色彩狂乱漩涡中心，静坐着唯一的主体：一只眼睛。一只巨大得令你根本无法想象能逃过其注视的眼睛！
rows.raw: "\n\nDazzling displays of prismatic light form, reform and repeat all around, an omni-colored tide of nebulae spreading further and further ‘upwards’ to you and then far beyond you. In the center of the swirling madness of indescribable color, a singular subject sits: an eye. A gigantic eye, one that you would never comprehend of being able to hide from!"

rows.original: Whether it’s looking at you or not isn’t even on your mind: The size must be on planetary levels!
rows.translation: 它是否正看着你甚至都不重要：那尺寸必定达到了行星级别！
rows.raw: "\n\nWhether it’s looking at you or not isn’t even on your mind: The size must be on planetary levels!"

rows.original: [pc.name]...
rows.raw: "\n\n[pc.name]..."

rows.original: Another immense thought burns through your skull. You meekly try to cover your face with your arms, a primitive reaction to the force of power that draws nearer and nearer. The eye drives further, the light becoming painful and overwhelming even through your covered face! Closer and closer, until...!
rows.translation: 另一个庞大的念头灼穿你的头骨。你怯弱地用双臂遮住脸，这是面对不断逼近的强大力量所作出的原始反应。那只眼睛继续逼近，光芒即使隔着遮脸的双臂也变得刺痛而压倒一切！越来越近，直到...！
rows.raw: "\n\nAnother immense thought burns through your skull. You meekly try to cover your face with your arms, a primitive reaction to the force of power that draws nearer and nearer. The eye drives further, the light becoming painful and overwhelming even through your covered face! Closer and closer, until...!"

rows.original: Wake Up!
rows.translation: 醒来！
rows.raw: "Wake Up!"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: ...aaaAAHHH!
rows.translation: ...啊啊啊啊！
rows.raw: "...aaaAAHHH!"

rows.original: With a jolt, you wake up in the real world.
rows.translation: 你猛地一震，在现实世界中醒来。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith a jolt, you wake up in the real world."

rows.original: The Seer appears to be pressing herself right against you, her face only a few inches from your own. Her sizable chest is squeezed against your left shoulder.
rows.translation: 先知似乎正紧贴着你，她的脸离你只有几英寸。丰满的胸脯挤压着你的左肩。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Seer appears to be pressing herself right against you, her face only a few inches from your own. Her sizable chest is squeezed against your left shoulder."

rows.original: “You. Saw.”
rows.translation: “你。看见了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You. Saw.”"

rows.original: Her words are whispers, a certain undertone of dread being pushed through. Her amber eyes are locked to your face, wide and unblinking.
rows.translation: 她的话语只是耳语，其中透出某种被压抑的恐惧。琥珀色双眼锁定你的脸，睁得大大的，一眨不眨。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer words are whispers, a certain undertone of dread being pushed through. Her amber eyes are locked to your face, wide and unblinking."

rows.original: “S-saw what?” You stammer, the reality around you being slow to process.
rows.translation: “看、看见什么？”你结结巴巴地问，大脑仍迟迟无法处理周遭的现实。
rows.raw: "\n\n“S-saw what?” You stammer, the reality around you being slow to process."

rows.original: “Perhaps... but no. You saw. That is enough,” she says in a rhythmic phrasing. She leans in all the closer with her pretty dot of a nose mere millimetres from the [pc.skinFurScales] on your cheek. Oh what now...
rows.translation: “或许...但不。你看见了。这就够了，”她用富有节奏的措辞说道。她凑得更近，漂亮的小巧鼻尖离你脸颊上的[pc.skinFurScales]只有几毫米。哦，现在又要怎样...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Perhaps... but no. You saw. That is enough,” she says in a rhythmic phrasing. She leans in all the closer with her pretty dot of a nose mere millimetres from the [pc.skinFurScales] on your cheek. Oh what now..."

rows.original: Her left hand slides out of its sleeve, painted black nails on pallid finger flesh reaching for your [pc.thigh]. She holds it there with no other motion.
rows.translation: 她的左手从袖中滑出，苍白手指上涂黑的指甲伸向你的[pc.thigh]。她把手放在那里，再没有其他动作。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer left hand slides out of its sleeve, painted black nails on pallid finger flesh reaching for your [pc.thigh]. She holds it there with no other motion."

rows.original: “This has to be...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This has to be...”"

rows.original: She seems to freeze in place, her lower lip quivering.
rows.translation: 她似乎僵在原地，下唇微微颤抖。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe seems to freeze in place, her lower lip quivering."

rows.original: A few tense seconds pass.
rows.translation: 紧张的几秒过去了。
rows.raw: "\n\nA few tense seconds pass."

rows.original: The Seer slinks backwards, letting go of your [pc.leg]. Her gaze doesn’t falter but her face visibly relaxes.
rows.translation: 先知向后退去，松开了你的[pc.leg]。她的目光毫不动摇，但脸庞明显放松下来。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Seer slinks backwards, letting go of your [pc.leg]. Her gaze doesn’t falter but her face visibly relaxes."

rows.original: “You will forget this.”
rows.translation: “你会忘掉这一切。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You will forget this.”"

rows.original: Forget It? How would yo-
rows.translation: 忘掉它？你要怎-
rows.raw: "\n\nForget It? How would yo-"

rows.original: PFSSHHH!
rows.translation: 噗嘶！
rows.raw: "\n\nPFSSHHH!"

rows.original: A burst of light from the center of the table blurs your next thought!
rows.translation: 桌子中央迸发出一道亮光，令你接下来的思绪变得模糊！
rows.raw: "\n\nA burst of light from the center of the table blurs your next thought!"

rows.original: Wake Up!
rows.translation: 醒来！
rows.raw: "Wake Up!"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: Your eyes flutter open.
rows.translation: 你的双眼颤动着睁开。
rows.raw: "Your eyes flutter open."

rows.original: You’re standing on a path. Where is this, Gildenmere? Right, right. You were here for... something. Something that made you apprehensive. Finding dad’s probes! Or was it... ah, never mind.
rows.translation: 你正站在一条小路上。这是哪里，吉尔登米尔？对，对。你来这里是为了...某件事。某件让你感到不安的事。寻找老爸的探针！还是说...啊，算了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re standing on a path. Where is this, Gildenmere? Right, right. You were here for... something. Something that made you apprehensive. Finding dad’s probes! Or was it... ah, never mind."

rows.original: You take a look at your surroundings. Oh there’s a shop here!
rows.translation: 你环顾四周。哦，这里有家商店！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a look at your surroundings. Oh there’s a shop here!"

rows.original: “The En-tite...?” You say out loud. “Wait...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The En-tite...?” You say out loud. “Wait...”"

rows.original: Curious, your memory wants to tell you that you’ve been inside before. Well, it’s not like you had anything better to do! Or did you...
rows.translation: 奇怪的是，你的记忆似乎在告诉你，你以前进去过。反正你也没别的事可做！还是说你有来着...
rows.raw: "\n\nCurious, your memory wants to tell you that you’ve been inside before. Well, it’s not like you had anything better to do! Or did you..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Wake Up! Again!
rows.translation: 再次醒来！
rows.raw: "Wake Up! Again!"

rows.original: Oh come on now...
rows.translation: 哦，别这样...
rows.raw: " Oh come on now..."

rows.original: Wake Up!
rows.translation: 醒来！
rows.raw: "Wake Up!"

rows.original: Grababrushandputalittlemakeup!
rows.translation: 拿把刷子化点妆！
rows.raw: "Grababrushandputalittlemakeup!"

rows.original: ARRRH
rows.translation: 啊啊啊
rows.raw: "ARRRH"

rows.original: Sleep...
rows.translation: 睡吧...
rows.raw: "Sleep..."

rows.original: Better strap in kid, cuz you’re going on a trip.
rows.translation: 系好安全带，小鬼，因为你要去旅行了。
rows.raw: "Better strap in kid, cuz you’re going on a trip."

rows.original: Lounge
rows.translation: 休息室
rows.raw: "Lounge"

rows.original: Chill for a bit! Or at least, try to. Warning: Out of body experience.
rows.translation: 放松一会儿！或者至少试试看。警告：灵魂出窍体验。
rows.raw: "Chill for a bit! Or at least, try to. Warning: Out of body experience."

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: Talk
rows.translation: 交谈
rows.raw: "Talk"

rows.original: What’s her story? Do you even really want to know?
rows.translation: 她究竟有怎样的故事？你真的想知道吗？
rows.raw: "What’s her story? Do you even really want to know?"

rows.original: Sex
rows.translation: 性爱
rows.raw: "Sex"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: Although your memory is hazy, you’re certain that she made certain and consensual advances, and really, she is quite the looker. Why not?
rows.translation: 尽管你的记忆很模糊，但你确信她确实对你作出过明确且双方自愿的示好，而且她的确相当迷人。何乐而不为呢？
rows.raw: "Although your memory is hazy, you’re certain that she made certain and consensual advances, and really, she is quite the looker. Why not?"

rows.original: You wave a hand in front of her face to grab her attention. Her focus is drawn to you, as if you’d snapped her out of a daze. She gives you that thousand mile stare, the constricted, unblinking pupils mirroring your eyes contact. Burying her intimidation with confidence, you ask her to explain what that moment was post-mist induced headtrip.
rows.translation: 你在她面前挥了挥手，想引起她的注意。她的焦点转向你，仿佛被你从恍惚中唤醒。她用那种仿佛望向千里之外的目光盯着你，收缩而一眨不眨的瞳孔与你四目相对。你用自信压下她带来的威慑感，请她解释那阵迷雾引发的迷幻体验之后，那个瞬间究竟是怎么回事。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wave a hand in front of her face to grab her attention. Her focus is drawn to you, as if you’d snapped her out of a daze. She gives you that thousand mile stare, the constricted, unblinking pupils mirroring your eyes contact. Burying her intimidation with confidence, you ask her to explain what that moment was post-mist induced headtrip."

rows.original: <i>“Steele.
rows.translation: <i>“斯蒂尔。身为
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Steele. "

rows.original: Man
rows.translation: 男子
rows.raw: "Man"

rows.original: Woman
rows.translation: 女子

rows.original: of metal. Not literally, although sometimes... sometimes literally. I see you in many different ways. You have... many branches to your tree. I’m fascinated,” she explains, dousing her attempts at clarity in abstract phrases.
