rows.translation: 先知仿佛僵在了原地，那些抽动的触手附肢也完全定住。过了几秒，她试图从与你脸贴[pc.face]的拥抱中撑起身体，却...只能瘫倒在自己的背上。她那一簇紫色触手从你体内缩回，无力地滑回松软的休息姿态。你们两人都几乎无法忍受周围重新变凉的空气，而你的肺也才刚勉强恢复正常呼吸。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Seer seems to have frozen in place, her tentacular, twitching appendages locked in place. After several seconds, she tries to push herself up from your face-to-[pc.face] embrace but... only manages to slump herself onto her back. Her array of purplish tentacles recede from your body and limply slide themselves back to a flaccid resting position. Both of you can barely handle the freshness of the cooled air around you and your lungs have barely caught up with regular breathing as it is."

rows.original: The half-abomination has her head turned to yours. Those same amber eyes, once blazing in color, sit dimly under half-closed eyelids. Her pink tattoos are dulled in the same way. She says nothing to you but her relieved face says it all: She enjoyed you.
rows.translation: 这个半怪物将脑袋转向你。那双一度燃烧着色彩的琥珀色眼睛，如今黯淡地藏在半阖的眼皮下。她粉红色的纹身也同样失去了光彩。她什么都没对你说，可那如释重负的神情已经说明了一切：她很享受你。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe half-abomination has her head turned to yours. Those same amber eyes, once blazing in color, sit dimly under half-closed eyelids. Her pink tattoos are dulled in the same way. She says nothing to you but her relieved face says it all: She enjoyed you."

rows.original: Without her body heat on top of you, the room feels far colder than before. As if sensing this, your tentacular lover manages to pull her discard robes over the both of you. The snug velvet quickly warms your [pc.skinFurScales] and the sexual afterglow feels doubly pleasant. She idly plays with your [pc.hair], her thin fingers making slow and effortless movements.
rows.translation: 没有她的体温覆盖在你身上，房间比刚才冷了许多。仿佛察觉到了这一点，你的触手情人设法把丢在一旁的长袍拉过来，盖住你们两人。贴身的天鹅绒很快温暖了你的[pc.skinFurScales]，高潮后的余韵也变得加倍惬意。她漫不经心地拨弄着你的[pc.hair]，纤细的手指缓慢而轻松地移动。
rows.raw: "\n\nWithout her body heat on top of you, the room feels far colder than before. As if sensing this, your tentacular lover manages to pull her discard robes over the both of you. The snug velvet quickly warms your [pc.skinFurScales] and the sexual afterglow feels doubly pleasant. She idly plays with your [pc.hair], her thin fingers making slow and effortless movements."

rows.original: Some time passes...
rows.translation: 过了一段时间...
rows.raw: "\n\nSome time passes..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: The hazy, dreamy moments of peace spent with the Seer are broken by her speech.
rows.translation: 与先知共度的朦胧、梦幻而安宁的时光被她的话语打断。
rows.raw: "The hazy, dreamy moments of peace spent with the Seer are broken by her speech."

rows.original: “I wonder if you’d say yes... wouldn’t that be a turn?” She half-whispers, her voice audibly hoarse. She pushes back her ruffled onyx hair and pushes herself up from the table, robes and all.
rows.translation: “我在想，你会不会答应...那样岂不是很有意思？”她半是低语地说道，嗓音明显沙哑。她向后拢了拢凌乱的黑玉色头发，连同长袍一起从桌上撑起身体。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I wonder if you’d say yes... wouldn’t that be a turn?” She half-whispers, her voice audibly hoarse. She pushes back her ruffled onyx hair and pushes herself up from the table, robes and all."

rows.original: “Now that I’ve seen more... perhaps you would.”
rows.translation: “既然我已经看到了更多...也许你会答应。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now that I’ve seen more... perhaps you would.”"

rows.original: What do you mean? You try to verbalize but your [pc.tongue] is so dry and enervated that it comes out as murmurs.
rows.translation: 你是什么意思？你试图把问题说出口，可[pc.tongue]干燥又疲软，只发出一阵含混的低语。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat do you mean? You try to verbalize but your [pc.tongue] is so dry and enervated that it comes out as murmurs."

rows.original: “What I mean is...” replies the Seer, as if knowing what you wanted to say. “That you’re quite the picture when sprawled onto your back.”
rows.translation: “我的意思是...”先知回答道，仿佛知道你想说什么。“你仰面摊开时，还真是一幅美景。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What I mean is...” replies the Seer, as if knowing what you wanted to say. “That you’re quite the picture when sprawled onto your back.”"

rows.original: She giggles to herself.
rows.translation: 她独自轻笑起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe giggles to herself."

rows.original: “However... now you must forget.”
rows.translation: “不过...现在你必须忘记。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“However... now you must forget.”"

rows.original: Forget...? But...
rows.raw: "\n\nForget...? But..."

rows.original: “Forget.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Forget.”"

rows.original: No, I-
rows.translation: 不，我-
rows.raw: "\n\nNo, I-"

rows.original: Forget...
rows.raw: "\n\nForget..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: You wake up. Where are you? Where did the... pale lady go...
rows.translation: 你醒了过来。你在哪儿？那个……苍白的女人去哪儿了……
rows.raw: "You wake up. Where are you? Where did the... pale lady go..."

rows.original: Huh?
rows.translation: 咦？
rows.raw: "\n\nHuh?"

rows.original: You’re sitting against a wall in the streets of Gildenmere. Funny, you could’ve sworn that there was... ah yes! There’s that shop. You read the sign outside to remind yourself.
rows.translation: 你正靠坐在吉尔登米尔街头的一面墙边。奇怪，你明明记得那里曾经有家...啊，对了！那家店还在。你读了读门外的招牌，好提醒自己。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re sitting against a wall in the streets of Gildenmere. Funny, you could’ve sworn that there was... ah yes! There’s that shop. You read the sign outside to remind yourself."

rows.original: Ent...ite?
rows.translation: 恩...提特？
rows.raw: "\n\nEnt...ite?"

rows.original: En...tite?
rows.translation: 恩...提特？
rows.raw: "\n\nEn...tite?"

rows.original: You put a hand to your sternum: There’s a gnawing sense of apprehension knotting inside but you can’t place why. It feels like... a sense of loss.
rows.translation: 你把手按在胸骨上：心中盘踞着一股挥之不去的不安，却说不清缘由。感觉就像...失去了什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou put a hand to your sternum: There’s a gnawing sense of apprehension knotting inside but you can’t place why. It feels like... a sense of loss."

rows.original: Well, if it can’t be explained! You pick yourself up and get back to your business.
rows.translation: 唉，既然解释不了！你站起身，继续去忙自己的事。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, if it can’t be explained! You pick yourself up and get back to your business."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: LezDomme
rows.translation: 百合女王
rows.raw: "LezDomme"

rows.original: Girly fun! Fun being entirely subjective!
rows.translation: 女孩子之间的乐趣！当然，所谓乐趣完全因人而异！
rows.raw: "Girly fun! Fun being entirely subjective!"

rows.original: LezDomme
rows.translation: 百合女王
rows.raw: "LezDomme"

rows.original: LezDomme
rows.translation: 百合女王
rows.raw: "LezDomme"

rows.original: You must be female and not be a taur.
rows.translation: 你必须是女性，且不能拥有兽身。
rows.raw: "You must be female and not be a taur."

rows.original: Get Wisped
rows.translation: 吸入幽灵药
rows.raw: "Get Wisped"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: After holding you place for some time, the Seers amber eyes brighten up, even more so than usual.
rows.translation: 把你固定在原地一阵后，先知琥珀色的双眼亮了起来，比平时还要明亮。
rows.raw: "After holding you place for some time, the Seers amber eyes brighten up, even more so than usual."

rows.original: “What a plan, a perfect plan... imperfect in its perfection, oh I can barely contain myself,” she rambles, holding her wrist to her forehead like an overly dramatic actress.
rows.translation: “好计划，完美的计划...完美中的不完美，哦，我简直按捺不住自己，”她喋喋不休地说着，像个过分戏剧化的女演员般把手腕搭在额头上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What a plan, a perfect plan... imperfect in its perfection, oh I can barely contain myself,” she rambles, holding her wrist to her forehead like an overly dramatic actress."

rows.original: As you’re reeled in by her arm tentacles, she produces a
rows.translation: 她用手臂触手把你卷过去，同时从
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you’re reeled in by her arm tentacles, she produces a "

joinAfter.expression:
void 0 !== flags.USED_WISP
                                  ? "familiar amphora of Wiff-O-Wisp"
                                  : "a strange glass bottle of reddish liquid"

rows.original: familiar amphora of Wiff-O-Wisp
rows.translation: 那只熟悉的威夫幽灵药双耳瓶
rows.raw: "familiar amphora of Wiff-O-Wisp"

rows.original: a strange glass bottle of reddish liquid
rows.translation: 一只装着红色液体的古怪玻璃瓶
rows.raw: "a strange glass bottle of reddish liquid"

rows.original: from... somewhere. As you’re dragged in closer until you both touch - her E-cup chest pressing warmly against your [pc.skinFurScales] - she holds the amphora in between the two of you. Without a pause, she inhales deeply through her nose and thick vapours rise ex nihilo from the glass vial.
rows.translation: ...某个地方拿了出来。你被越拖越近，直到彼此相贴——她E罩杯的胸脯温暖地压在你的[pc.skinFurScales]上——而她把双耳瓶举在你们之间。她毫不停顿地用鼻子深吸一口气，浓厚的蒸气凭空从玻璃瓶中升起。
rows.raw: " from... somewhere. As you’re dragged in closer until you both touch - her E-cup chest pressing warmly against your [pc.skinFurScales] - she holds the amphora in between the two of you. Without a pause, she inhales deeply through her nose and thick vapours rise ex nihilo from the glass vial."

rows.original: Breathe
rows.translation: 呼吸
rows.raw: "\n\nBreathe"

rows.original: This thought reverberates through your mind, but one that’s not organic to your reaction. Was that... her voice? Breathe...? Should I...?
rows.translation: 这个念头在你脑海中回荡，却并非你自身反应所生。那是...她的声音？呼吸...？我该不该...？
rows.raw: "\n\nThis thought reverberates through your mind, but one that’s not organic to your reaction. Was that... her voice? Breathe...? Should I...?"

rows.original: Breathe.
rows.translation: 呼吸。
rows.raw: "\n\nBreathe."

rows.original: You’re compelled to do so: The ruby red fumes give off a tantalizing aroma... something warm and wonderous that you couldn’t describe without analysing it to the molecule.
rows.translation: 你被迫照做：宝石般鲜红的烟雾散发出诱人的香气...某种温暖而奇妙的味道，除非分析到分子层面，否则你根本无从形容。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re compelled to do so: The ruby red fumes give off a tantalizing aroma... something warm and wonderous that you couldn’t describe without analysing it to the molecule."

rows.original: You too inhale deeply - though hesitantly - through your [pc.nose], a warm ache filling your [pc.face].
rows.translation: 你也迟疑地用[pc.nose]深深吸气，一股温热的胀痛充满你的[pc.face]。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou too inhale deeply - though hesitantly - through your [pc.nose], a warm ache filling your [pc.face]. "

rows.original: That tell-tale scent of woodsmoke and spice triggers the memory of what’s to come next.
rows.translation: 那熟悉的柴烟与香料气味唤起了你对接下来会发生什么的记忆。
rows.raw: "That tell-tale scent of woodsmoke and spice triggers the memory of what’s to come next. "

rows.original: It feels akin to breathing in fresh woodsmoke or obscure incense. It’s pretty nice! You hadn’t even noticed that the room’s spinning!
rows.translation: 感觉就像吸入新鲜柴烟或某种冷门熏香。还挺舒服！你甚至没注意到整个房间已经开始旋转！
rows.raw: "It feels akin to breathing in fresh woodsmoke or obscure incense. It’s pretty nice! You hadn’t even noticed that the room’s spinning!"

rows.original: Oh boy, room’s already spinning...
rows.translation: 哦豁，房间已经转起来了...
rows.raw: "\n\nOh boy, room’s already spinning..."

rows.original: You feel your [pc.legs] start to give way as that same heat travels from head to toe in almost no time at all. Good thing those tightening tentacles were there to stop your fall! Wait, tightening...?
rows.translation: 同样的热意转瞬间从头传到脚，你感觉自己的[pc.legs]开始发软。幸好那些收紧的触手托住了你，才没让你摔倒！等等，收紧...？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feel your [pc.legs] start to give way as that same heat travels from head to toe in almost no time at all. Good thing those tightening tentacles were there to stop your fall! Wait, tightening...?"

rows.original: As your vision begins to blur and darken, you sense the tips of those fleshy feelers reaching for your [pc.lips] and see the blazing, amber eyes of the Seer...
rows.translation: 当你的视野开始模糊、变暗时，你感觉那些肉质触须的尖端伸向你的[pc.lips]，还看见了先知熊熊发亮的琥珀色双眼...
rows.raw: "\n\nAs your vision begins to blur and darken, you sense the tips of those fleshy feelers reaching for your [pc.lips] and see the blazing, amber eyes of the Seer..."

rows.original: Trip
rows.translation: 幻游
rows.raw: "Trip"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: Woozy
rows.raw: "Woozy"

rows.original: Ooo, these are some fancy colors. Your eyes start being able to see the past interactions you’ve had with every living thing in the past 24 hours. Not that you can actually tell who or what those things are as they take the form of amorphous gray blobs.
rows.translation: 哦哦，这些颜色可真绚丽。你的眼睛开始看见过去24小时里你与每一个生物的互动。不过你根本分不清它们是谁或是什么，因为它们全都化作了没有固定形状的灰色团块。
rows.raw: "Ooo, these are some fancy colors. Your eyes start being able to see the past interactions you’ve had with every living thing in the past 24 hours. Not that you can actually tell who or what those things are as they take the form of amorphous gray blobs."

rows.original: The imagery becomes more and more distorted, noise and static tearing away at the edges of your minds projected vision. Each new scene becomes darker, blurrier and more disorienting but at the same time you can feel yourself becoming a part of each scene as observer, director and participant!
rows.translation: 画面变得越来越扭曲，噪点与静电撕扯着你心灵投影视野的边缘。每个新场景都更加阴暗、模糊且令人迷失，可与此同时，你也感觉自己正成为每幕场景的观察者、导演和参与者！
rows.raw: "\n\nThe imagery becomes more and more distorted, noise and static tearing away at the edges of your minds projected vision. Each new scene becomes darker, blurrier and more disorienting but at the same time you can feel yourself becoming a part of each scene as observer, director and participant!"

rows.original: At the nadir of this dark and twisted world’s hold on you, you’re alone yet free: arms and legs floating and flying into a foggy abyss of what could be anything...
rows.translation: 当这个黑暗扭曲的世界对你的控制降至最深处时，你孤身一人却又无比自由：四肢漂浮着、飞向朦胧的深渊，而那里可能是一切...
rows.raw: "\n\nAt the nadir of this dark and twisted world’s hold on you, you’re alone yet free: arms and legs floating and flying into a foggy abyss of what could be anything..."

rows.original: But then, light.
rows.translation: 然后，出现了光。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut then, light."

rows.original: Soft light. Purple light. Amaranthine light...
rows.translation: 柔和的光。紫色的光。永不凋谢的光...
rows.raw: "\n\nSoft light. Purple light. Amaranthine light..."

rows.original: As a scene blurs into view, you can see... the Entite. You’re... up, somewhere. You can see the curtains of the lounge.
rows.translation: 一幅场景模糊地显现出来，你看见了...实体界。你身处...某个高处。你能看见休息厅的帘幕。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs a scene blurs into view, you can see... the Entite. You’re... up, somewhere. You can see the curtains of the lounge."

rows.original: Oh hey, you’re over there! But how can you be over here if you’re over there and... where’s the Seer?
rows.translation: 哦嘿，你在那边！可如果你在那边，自己又怎么会在这里，而且...先知去哪儿了？
rows.raw: "\n\nOh hey, you’re over there! But how can you be over here if you’re over there and... where’s the Seer?"

rows.original: A pair of amber, glowing orbs slowly move from the right into your field of view. Sharp static sounds come forth as they hover and blaze. And they move out of range...
rows.translation: 一对发着光的琥珀色圆球缓缓从右侧移入你的视野。它们悬浮燃亮时传来尖锐的静电声。接着又移出了视野...
rows.raw: "\n\nA pair of amber, glowing orbs slowly move from the right into your field of view. Sharp static sounds come forth as they hover and blaze. And they move out of range..."

rows.original: You try to look around you.
rows.translation: 你试着环顾四周。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou try to look around you."

rows.original: You’re on a... shelf?
rows.translation: 你在一块...架子上？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re on a... shelf?"

rows.original: Oh.
rows.translation: 哦。
rows.raw: "\n\nOh."

rows.original: You’ve become a curio along the walls of the Entite, destined to live out your days as a pair of eyes and nothing more.
rows.translation: 你已经成了实体界墙上的一件珍奇摆设，注定以一双眼睛的形态度过余生，再无其他。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve become a curio along the walls of the Entite, destined to live out your days as a pair of eyes and nothing more."

rows.original: Still, could be worse.
rows.translation: 不过，也可能更糟。
rows.raw: "\n\nStill, could be worse."

rows.original: Your vision doesn’t quite darken so much as falls, falling further and further away from those two amber spheres above you. A swirling cloud of black dust funnels around them, growing and spiralling to a greater size every second.
rows.translation: 你的视野并非变暗，而是在坠落，离头顶那两颗琥珀色圆球越来越远。一团旋转的黑尘在它们周围汇成漏斗，每一秒都变得更大、旋转得更猛烈。
rows.raw: "Your vision doesn’t quite darken so much as falls, falling further and further away from those two amber spheres above you. A swirling cloud of black dust funnels around them, growing and spiralling to a greater size every second."

rows.original: The further you ‘fall’, the blurrier those eyes become. Suddenly you hit a surface. It’s soft like sand but does little to cushion your impact. You feel that your limbs have spread out haphazardly, and the distant point from above has grown brighter with a whitish, sharp light. The light descends towards you, up to you, in to you, and then through you. It feels like nothing aside from a swift sensation of buoyancy that fades in a moments time. As you look around, the place you’ve landed at becomes clearer to see.
rows.translation: 你‘坠落’得越远，那双眼睛就越模糊。突然，你撞上了一片表面。它像沙子般柔软，却几乎没有缓冲冲击。你感觉四肢杂乱地摊开，而上方遥远的光点已经亮成了锐利的白光。那光向你降下，来到你面前，进入你体内，然后穿透你。除了短暂的漂浮感外什么也没有，而且片刻便消退了。你环顾四周，落脚之地逐渐清晰。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe further you ‘fall’, the blurrier those eyes become. Suddenly you hit a surface. It’s soft like sand but does little to cushion your impact. You feel that your limbs have spread out haphazardly, and the distant point from above has grown brighter with a whitish, sharp light. The light descends towards you, up to you, in to you, and then through you. It feels like nothing aside from a swift sensation of buoyancy that fades in a moments time. As you look around, the place you’ve landed at becomes clearer to see."

rows.original: A field of black stones, sands and plateaus mixed with gray-green grasses. Long, moonlit shadows form artistic patterns against the plane. The night sky is splattered with rich aurorae, pale green nebulae and the distant sight of a golden yellow star...
rows.translation: 一片由黑色岩石、沙地和台地组成的荒野，夹杂着灰绿色草丛。长长的月影在平原上织出艺术般的图案。夜空泼洒着浓艳极光、淡绿色星云，以及远处一颗金黄色恒星的光芒...
rows.raw: "\n\nA field of black stones, sands and plateaus mixed with gray-green grasses. Long, moonlit shadows form artistic patterns against the plane. The night sky is splattered with rich aurorae, pale green nebulae and the distant sight of a golden yellow star..."

rows.original: An alien world.
rows.translation: 一个异星世界。
rows.raw: "\n\nAn alien world."

rows.original: Oh how very original.
rows.translation: 哦，可真有创意。
rows.raw: " Oh how very original."

rows.original: Moving feels like moving through liquid: Slow, disorienting, floaty. Where can you go? What do you do? Logic can make sense of what is in front of you but where is a very different question...
rows.translation: 移动起来如同在液体中穿行：缓慢、迷乱、轻飘飘的。你能去哪儿？该做什么？理智还能理解眼前有什么，但它在哪里却完全是另一回事...
rows.raw: "\n\nMoving feels like moving through liquid: Slow, disorienting, floaty. Where can you go? What do you do? Logic can make sense of what is in front of you but where is a very different question..."

rows.original: Your eyes adjust to the odd flow of whitish light from where you ‘fell’ from. Its source appears to fly off into nothingness but the direction is towards that particularly prominent yellow star. How peculiar. The star, as if alerted to this thought with some sort of cognizance, grows brighter.
rows.translation: 你的眼睛适应了那股从你‘坠落’之处流下的古怪白光。它的源头似乎向虚无中飞去，方向却直指那颗格外醒目的黄色恒星。真奇怪。那颗恒星仿佛以某种认知察觉了这个念头，变得更加明亮。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour eyes adjust to the odd flow of whitish light from where you ‘fell’ from. Its source appears to fly off into nothingness but the direction is towards that particularly prominent yellow star. How peculiar. The star, as if alerted to this thought with some sort of cognizance, grows brighter."

rows.original: And brighter.
rows.translation: 越来越亮。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd brighter."

rows.original: The night sky soon becomes the early morning, the green-and-black canvas replaced with a faded orange. But it doesn’t stop, and is soon escalating from morning to day: The sky becoming a pale orange. The star gains detail... as if being drawn closer instead of merely growing brighter. You can make out a cascade of omni-colored particles and light waves bending, curving and swirling around it. This seems frightfully familiar...
rows.translation: 夜空很快变成清晨，绿黑色画布被褪色的橙色取代。但变化并未停止，清晨迅速推进到白昼：天空化作淡橙色。那颗恒星显露出更多细节...仿佛不是单纯变亮，而是在被拉近。你能看见五光十色的粒子瀑布和光波围绕它弯折、卷曲、旋转。这景象熟悉得令人害怕...
rows.raw: "\n\nThe night sky soon becomes the early morning, the green-and-black canvas replaced with a faded orange. But it doesn’t stop, and is soon escalating from morning to day: The sky becoming a pale orange. The star gains detail... as if being drawn closer instead of merely growing brighter. You can make out a cascade of omni-colored particles and light waves bending, curving and swirling around it. This seems frightfully familiar..."

rows.original: Then you see it.
rows.translation: 然后你看见了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThen you see it."

rows.original: That black, slit-shaped pupil.
rows.translation: 那道黑色的竖缝瞳孔。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat black, slit-shaped pupil."

rows.original: The star is no star but an eye. An immense, overwhelming eye surrounded by clouds and storms of arcing energy!
rows.translation: 那不是恒星，而是一只眼睛。一只庞大得令人无法承受、周围环绕着能量电弧云暴的巨眼！
rows.raw: "\n\nThe star is no star but an eye. An immense, overwhelming eye surrounded by clouds and storms of arcing energy!"

rows.original: It comes all the closer to the planet and you cannot look away. Where would you even look to? Even the black sand has a reflective sheen of gold radiating away.
rows.translation: 它越发逼近这颗行星，而你无法移开视线。你又能看向哪里？就连黑沙都泛着向外辐射的金色反光。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt comes all the closer to the planet and you cannot look away. Where would you even look to? Even the black sand has a reflective sheen of gold radiating away."

rows.original: As the eye draws closer, the light grows brighter and brighter! You lose your vision and then...!
rows.translation: 那只眼越靠近，光就变得越来越亮！你的视野彻底消失，然后...！
rows.raw: "\n\nAs the eye draws closer, the light grows brighter and brighter! You lose your vision and then...!"

rows.original: The world around you seems to be a visual liquid: Shapes and colors seem familiar but fluid, their corners bend and slough into awkward positions. The Seer is looking at you, her amber gaze
rows.translation: 你周围的世界仿佛化作了视觉上的液体：形状与色彩似曾相识，却不断流动，边角弯折、滑落到别扭的位置。先知正看着你，她琥珀色的目光
rows.raw: "The world around you seems to be a visual liquid: Shapes and colors seem familiar but fluid, their corners bend and slough into awkward positions. The Seer is looking at you, her amber gaze"

rows.original: ~BE THE GOD YOU WERE BORN TO BEEE~
rows.translation: ～成为你生来就该成为的神吧～
rows.raw: " ~BE THE GOD YOU WERE BORN TO BEEE~"

rows.original: the only fixed constant of normalcy in the blurry reality around you. Your face fixes to hers instinctively and it seems as if your surroundings are shifting...
rows.translation: 是周围模糊现实中唯一固定而正常的存在。你的脸本能地转向她，而四周似乎正在变化...
rows.raw: " the only fixed constant of normalcy in the blurry reality around you. Your face fixes to hers instinctively and it seems as if your surroundings are shifting..."

rows.original: However, you haven’t left the room. Your head comes to rest, so you believe, on to the Seers lap. Whatever true sensation you had before is replaced by an unsettling sense of lightness. Floating, perhaps. It’s hard to discern. Daring to try and make sense of what’s happening around you, you turn your head to the side...
rows.translation: 然而，你并未离开房间。你以为自己的脑袋靠在了先知腿上。先前真实的触感被一种令人不安的轻盈感取代。也许是漂浮。很难判断。你大胆尝试理解周围发生的事情，把头转向一旁...
rows.raw: "\n\nHowever, you haven’t left the room. Your head comes to rest, so you believe, on to the Seers lap. Whatever true sensation you had before is replaced by an unsettling sense of lightness. Floating, perhaps. It’s hard to discern. Daring to try and make sense of what’s happening around you, you turn your head to the side..."

rows.original: Huh? There’s another me over there... [pc.eyes], [pc.skinFurScales]... and another Seer?
rows.translation: 咦？那边还有另一个我...[pc.eyes]、[pc.skinFurScales]...还有另一个先知？
rows.raw: "\n\nHuh? There’s another me over there... [pc.eyes], [pc.skinFurScales]... and another Seer?"

rows.original: Another version of you both sits barely a few centimeters away. The exact same pose, features and state of nakedness save for some small details: The Seers hair is very short, your [pc.legs] have been replaced by some reptilian snake tail and you’re looking at a slight angle upwards...
rows.translation: 另一个版本的你们就坐在几厘米外。姿势、特征与裸体状态完全相同，只有一些细微差异：先知的头发很短，你的[pc.legs]变成了某种爬行动物般的蛇尾，而且你正以略微向上的角度看着...
rows.raw: "\n\nAnother version of you both sits barely a few centimeters away. The exact same pose, features and state of nakedness save for some small details: The Seers hair is very short, your [pc.legs] have been replaced by some reptilian snake tail and you’re looking at a slight angle upwards..."

rows.original: What in the tits?
rows.translation: 这他妈什么鬼？
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat in the tits?"

rows.original: AHA, HE SAID IT, AHA, OHO (SHRAPNEL)
rows.translation: 哈哈，他说出来了，哈哈，哦嚯（弹片）
rows.raw: " AHA, HE SAID IT, AHA, OHO (SHRAPNEL)"

rows.original: You turn your head to the other side: Another you, another Seer, another set of differences...
rows.translation: 你把头转向另一边：又一个你、又一个先知、又一组差异...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou turn your head to the other side: Another you, another Seer, another set of differences..."

rows.original: With slowness, you try to look at other places of the lounge: There could be up to thirteen versions of you and the Seer, all different in many aspects!
rows.translation: 你缓慢地尝试观察休息厅其他地方：这里可能有多达十三个版本的你和先知，而且各方面都不尽相同！
rows.raw: "\n\nWith slowness, you try to look at other places of the lounge: There could be up to thirteen versions of you and the Seer, all different in many aspects!"

rows.original: You’re certain that one of the Seers is actually just your dad with boobs, further conflicting your soul and sexual preferences.
rows.translation: 你确信其中一个先知其实只是长了胸部的你爸，让你的灵魂与性偏好更加纠结。
rows.raw: " You’re certain that one of the Seers is actually just your dad with boobs, further conflicting your soul and sexual preferences."

rows.original: Then, in some strangely hypnotic unison, all of the Seers start using their arm tentacles to tease at your [pc.lips]. There’s so little sense to what’s happening that your mouth doesn’t even react. One tentacle tip slides gently into your mouth, as if let in willingly. With it comes some sort of... wash of fluid down your throat. Your own [pc.tongue] instinctively laps and sucks on the strange juice, inadvertently brushing against the oozing tentacle within. Mm, that flavour... salty lemons?
rows.translation: 接着，所有先知以一种诡异而催眠般的整齐动作，用手臂触手挑逗你的[pc.lips]。发生的一切毫无道理，甚至让你的嘴都没有反应。一根触手尖端轻柔地滑入口中，仿佛你自愿放它进来。某种...液体随之流下你的喉咙。你的[pc.tongue]本能地舔吮着那古怪汁液，无意间擦过口中不断渗液的触手。嗯，那味道...咸柠檬？
rows.raw: "\n\nThen, in some strangely hypnotic unison, all of the Seers start using their arm tentacles to tease at your [pc.lips]. There’s so little sense to what’s happening that your mouth doesn’t even react. One tentacle tip slides gently into your mouth, as if let in willingly. With it comes some sort of... wash of fluid down your throat. Your own [pc.tongue] instinctively laps and sucks on the strange juice, inadvertently brushing against the oozing tentacle within. Mm, that flavour... salty lemons?"

rows.original: Fruity ginger root...? Something oddly delicious but unplaceable.
rows.translation: 果味姜根...？某种古怪而美味、却叫不出名字的味道。
rows.raw: "\n\nFruity ginger root...? Something oddly delicious but unplaceable."

rows.original: Doesn’t taste like any babybatter you’ve greedily swallowed before, that’s for sure...
rows.translation: 可以肯定的是，它不像你以往贪婪吞下的任何精液...
rows.raw: " Doesn’t taste like any babybatter you’ve greedily swallowed before, that’s for sure..."

rows.original: As it continues to flow into you at a slow but steady pace, your vision is just a few distorted edges away from turning into a colored, super dense smudge. There’s some sort of chanting hanging around, just lightly reaching into your [pc.ear] and tickling it. Tickling it just so. Yeah, right there...
rows.translation: 液体继续缓慢而稳定地流入体内，你的视野再扭曲几下就要化作一团浓密的彩色污迹。某种吟唱在周围萦绕，轻轻钻入你的[pc.ear]，挠动着它。就是这样。对，就在那里...
rows.raw: "\n\nAs it continues to flow into you at a slow but steady pace, your vision is just a few distorted edges away from turning into a colored, super dense smudge. There’s some sort of chanting hanging around, just lightly reaching into your [pc.ear] and tickling it. Tickling it just so. Yeah, right there..."

rows.original: It reaches into the base of your skull, forming pulses and rhythms. Polymetric oobs and dinks sculamble themselves together. So mesmachanting is this chorusade of wondrous sonicology that you get moranged in its baltiddlious duphlility.
rows.translation: 它钻入你的颅底，化作脉冲与节奏。多重拍号的呜卜与叮克胡乱拼接在一起。这支奇妙声学的合咏实在迷咒无比，让你在它斑橙般的巴尔提德利式杜芙重性中彻底沉沦。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt reaches into the base of your skull, forming pulses and rhythms. Polymetric oobs and dinks sculamble themselves together. So mesmachanting is this chorusade of wondrous sonicology that you get moranged in its baltiddlious duphlility."

rows.original: It’s dawned on you that the smudged edges of your vision are fading, darkening but ever so slowly... the strange rhythms beating away at your spine grow in complexity and density until-
rows.translation: 你忽然意识到，视野中模糊的边缘正在缓慢消退、变暗...敲击脊柱的古怪节奏越来越复杂、越来越密集，直到——
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s dawned on you that the smudged edges of your vision are fading, darkening but ever so slowly... the strange rhythms beating away at your spine grow in complexity and density until-"

rows.original: You close your eyelids instinctively, trying focus your mind before your vision.
rows.translation: 你本能地闭上眼皮，试图先集中精神，再聚焦视线。
rows.raw: "You close your eyelids instinctively, trying focus your mind before your vision."

rows.original: When you open them again, everything has changed.
rows.translation: 再次睁开眼睛时，一切都变了。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you open them again, everything has changed."

rows.original: No longer within the relative familiarity of the lounge, the ‘room’ has become a singular dark space with you standing in the middle of it. The only source of light is directly upwards: Two orbs of golden white that spotlight on your naked body.
rows.translation: 你不再身处休息厅那种相对熟悉的环境，‘房间’变成了一片单一的黑暗空间，而你站在正中央。唯一的光源就在正上方：两颗金白色圆球，把聚光灯投在你赤裸的身体上。
rows.raw: "\n\nNo longer within the relative familiarity of the lounge, the ‘room’ has become a singular dark space with you standing in the middle of it. The only source of light is directly upwards: Two orbs of golden white that spotlight on your naked body."

rows.original: You try to move your limbs. There’s a cuh-clink sound like a weighted chain from behind you and... oh. You’re cuffed to a slab of stone! Your [pc.legs] can’t even move: Double locked!
rows.translation: 你试着移动四肢。身后传来像沉重锁链般的咔—锵声，而且...哦。你被铐在一块石板上！你的[pc.legs]甚至动弹不得：双重锁死！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou try to move your limbs. There’s a cuh-clink sound like a weighted chain from behind you and... oh. You’re cuffed to a slab of stone! Your [pc.legs] can’t even move: Double locked!"

rows.original: Aside from this unsettling development, there appears to be nothing around you. No sound, no movement, no vague force of wind or some such: Just you, the stone slab and the light from above.
rows.translation: 除了这令人不安的新情况外，周围似乎空无一物。没有声音、没有动静，也没有任何模糊的风或类似东西：只有你、石板，以及头顶的光。
rows.raw: "\n\nAside from this unsettling development, there appears to be nothing around you. No sound, no movement, no vague force of wind or some such: Just you, the stone slab and the light from above."

rows.original: Time seems to pass by and yet you’ve no idea of how long you’ve been here. Your body being held in place means that you aren’t tired from standing, and there’s nothing entirely unpleasant about being chained up in such a way...
rows.translation: 时间似乎在流逝，你却完全不知道自己在这里待了多久。身体被固定住，意味着你不会因站立而疲惫，而且这样被锁住也没有什么完全令人生不快的地方...
rows.raw: "\n\nTime seems to pass by and yet you’ve no idea of how long you’ve been here. Your body being held in place means that you aren’t tired from standing, and there’s nothing entirely unpleasant about being chained up in such a way..."

rows.original: Then the whispers begin.
rows.translation: 然后，低语开始了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThen the whispers begin."

rows.original: “Not her?”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not her?”"

rows.original: “Yes, her...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes, her...”"

rows.original: Why not him...
rows.translation: 为什么不是他...
rows.raw: "\n\nWhy not him..."

rows.original: The phrasing seems eerily on point with a certain someone who just shoved substances up your nose. They’re all in the same hushed voice, some louder than others but some drawn out and slurred. Some are audible noises, some are thoughts pushing themselves into your mind...
rows.translation: 这种措辞与某个刚把药物塞进你鼻子的人诡异地吻合。它们全都使用同一种压低的声音，有的更响，有的拖得很长、含糊不清。有些是能听见的声响，有些则是强行挤入你脑海的念头...
rows.raw: "\n\nThe phrasing seems eerily on point with a certain someone who just shoved substances up your nose. They’re all in the same hushed voice, some louder than others but some drawn out and slurred. Some are audible noises, some are thoughts pushing themselves into your mind..."

rows.original: We should...
rows.translation: 我们应该...
rows.raw: "\n\nWe should..."

rows.original: “We should...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We should...”"

rows.original: They all say the same phrase in near unison, a chorus of the same words overtaking your senses from every angle! The room grows cooler and cooler, leaving a tingle in your [pc.skinFurScales].
rows.translation: 它们几乎齐声说出同一句话，相同词语组成的合唱从四面八方淹没你的感官！房间变得越来越冷，让你的[pc.skinFurScales]泛起一阵刺痒。
rows.raw: "\n\nThey all say the same phrase in near unison, a chorus of the same words overtaking your senses from every angle! The room grows cooler and cooler, leaving a tingle in your [pc.skinFurScales]."

rows.original: Then, movement.
rows.translation: 然后，有东西动了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThen, movement."

rows.original: Two small yellow orbs make themselves present in the darkness. They match you in height, slowly floating towards your naked form.
rows.translation: 两颗小小的黄色圆球出现在黑暗中。它们与你等高，缓缓飘向你赤裸的身体。
rows.raw: "\n\nTwo small yellow orbs make themselves present in the darkness. They match you in height, slowly floating towards your naked form."

rows.original: Something comes into view: A mist-shrouded... limb? It’s hard to tell: It’s as dark as the abyss around you and it bends and wavers like a... like a...
rows.translation: 某样东西显露出来：一条笼罩在雾中的...肢体？很难说清：它和周围的深渊一样漆黑，弯曲摇摆得像是...像是...
rows.raw: "\n\nSomething comes into view: A mist-shrouded... limb? It’s hard to tell: It’s as dark as the abyss around you and it bends and wavers like a... like a..."

rows.original: Uh oh
rows.translation: 糟糕
rows.raw: "\n\nUh oh"

rows.original: Several more ‘limbs’ appear, all of them squirming and writhing as more of them come into view. They slither and slide up and down your [pc.belly], seeming to focus on that part of your body.
rows.translation: 更多‘肢体’出现了，随着更多部分显形，它们全都扭动、蠕动。它们沿你的[pc.belly]上下滑行，似乎格外关注这个部位。
rows.raw: "\n\nSeveral more ‘limbs’ appear, all of them squirming and writhing as more of them come into view. They slither and slide up and down your [pc.belly], seeming to focus on that part of your body."

rows.original: Some brush against your [pc.pussy] in a most perverse and hungry way, and yet none dare to actually enter you...
rows.translation: 有些以极其淫秽而饥渴的方式擦过你的[pc.pussy]，却没有一根胆敢真正进入你...
rows.raw: "\n\nSome brush against your [pc.pussy] in a most perverse and hungry way, and yet none dare to actually enter you..."

rows.original: Some try to go for your [pc.multiCocks] but upon making contact, they recoil back into the shadows.
rows.translation: 有些试图伸向你的[pc.multiCocks]，但一接触便缩回阴影中。
rows.raw: "\n\nSome try to go for your [pc.multiCocks] but upon making contact, they recoil back into the shadows."

rows.original: The apprehension fueled by being on the verge of a tentacular violation makes you want to call for help, shout, no, scream! You yell at
rows.translation: 眼看就要遭到触手侵犯，恐惧让你想要求救、呼喊，不，是尖叫！你用
rows.raw: "\n\nThe apprehension fueled by being on the verge of a tentacular violation makes you want to call for help, shout, no, scream! You yell at "

joinAfter.expression:
isSillyModeEnabled()
                                          ? "THE TOP OF LUNGS"
                                          : "the highest level you can muster"

rows.original: THE TOP OF LUNGS
rows.translation: 肺部所能爆发的最大音量
rows.raw: "THE TOP OF LUNGS"

rows.original: the highest level you can muster
rows.translation: 自己能挤出的最高声音
rows.raw: "the highest level you can muster"

rows.original: again and again! You close your eyes, wishing for this unexplained madness to end, until-
rows.translation: 一遍又一遍地大喊！你闭上眼睛，祈愿这场莫名其妙的疯狂结束，直到——
rows.raw: " again and again! You close your eyes, wishing for this unexplained madness to end, until-"

rows.original: !SWITCH IS FUCKED BROSEF!
rows.translation: ！开关他妈坏了，老兄！
rows.raw: "\n\n!SWITCH IS FUCKED BROSEF!"

rows.original: Wake Up!
rows.translation: 醒来！
rows.raw: "Wake Up!"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: You open your eyes.
rows.translation: 你睁开眼睛。
rows.raw: "You open your eyes."

rows.original: There’s a mild fuzz at the edges of your vision, making things seem a bit unclear but... you can clearly observe the Seer looking down upon you.
rows.translation: 你的视野边缘泛着一层轻微的模糊，让一切看起来有些不清楚，但...你仍能清楚地看到先知正低头望着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a mild fuzz at the edges of your vision, making things seem a bit unclear but... you can clearly observe the Seer looking down upon you."

rows.original: You take a minute to assess your surroundings: This is still the lounge, you’re still naked, your head is lying in the Seer’s lap...
rows.translation: 你花了片刻打量周围：这里依然是休息室，你依然赤身裸体，脑袋依然枕在先知的腿上...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a minute to assess your surroundings: This is still the lounge, you’re still naked, your head is lying in the Seer’s lap..."

rows.original: And oh.
rows.translation: 而且，哦。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd oh."

rows.original: One of the seers fleshy appendages has lodged itself into your mouth. You suck down on the air, something else sliding down along the way. What is that, salted lemons...?
rows.translation: 先知的一根肉质附肢塞进了你的嘴里。你吸下一口空气，某种别的东西也随之滑下喉咙。那是什么，咸柠檬...？
rows.raw: "\n\nOne of the seers fleshy appendages has lodged itself into your mouth. You suck down on the air, something else sliding down along the way. What is that, salted lemons...?"

rows.original: You try to yank the thing out of your mouth but, as if predicting this, the fleshstalk slithers away from your mouth. It leaves a semi-clear trail of ooze across your [pc.lips] and [pc.face].
rows.translation: 你试图把那东西从嘴里拽出来，可那根肉茎仿佛早已预见到这一举动，迅速从你口中滑走，在你的[pc.lips]和[pc.face]上留下一道半透明的黏液痕迹。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou try to yank the thing out of your mouth but, as if predicting this, the fleshstalk slithers away from your mouth. It leaves a semi-clear trail of ooze across your [pc.lips] and [pc.face]."

rows.original: “Shhhh...” Whispers the Seer, her purple robe loosely hanging from her right shoulder. “You did so well...so well....”
rows.translation: “嘘...”先知低声说道，紫色长袍松松垮垮地挂在右肩上。“你做得真好...真好....”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shhhh...” Whispers the Seer, her purple robe loosely hanging from her right shoulder. “You did so well...so well....”"

rows.original: Her face is a picture of pure contentment. Those amber eyes - usually a piercing fixture that never change - are relaxed. Her eyelids droop lazily over them and her onyx lips are parted ever so slightly into a cute smile. What in the world did she...
rows.translation: 她脸上尽是心满意足。那双通常锐利而从不动摇的琥珀色眼睛此刻放松下来，眼皮懒洋洋地垂着，缟玛瑙般的嘴唇微微分开，勾出可爱的笑容。她到底做了什么...
rows.raw: "\n\nHer face is a picture of pure contentment. Those amber eyes - usually a piercing fixture that never change - are relaxed. Her eyelids droop lazily over them and her onyx lips are parted ever so slightly into a cute smile. What in the world did she..."

rows.original: As she slowly plays with your [pc.hair], you can’t help but feel a little sluggishness creeping over your sense of perception.
rows.translation: 她缓缓拨弄着你的[pc.hair]，你的感知中不由得渐渐爬上一股倦怠。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs she slowly plays with your [pc.hair], you can’t help but feel a little sluggishness creeping over your sense of perception."

rows.original: Forget.
rows.translation: 忘掉。
rows.raw: "\n\nForget."

rows.original: Forget...?
rows.raw: "\n\nForget...?"

rows.original: Forget
rows.translation: 忘掉
rows.raw: "\n\nForget"

rows.original: Forget...
rows.translation: 忘掉...
rows.raw: "\n\nForget..."

rows.original: Wake Up!
rows.translation: 醒来！
rows.raw: "Wake Up!"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: You come to against the side of a wall.
rows.translation: 你在一面墙边醒了过来。
rows.raw: "You come to against the side of a wall."

rows.original: Clambering for stability, you try to take in what you see: Warrens, streets... ants?
rows.translation: 你踉跄着稳住身体，努力看清眼前的景象：地道、街道...蚂蚁？
rows.raw: "\n\nClambering for stability, you try to take in what you see: Warrens, streets... ants?"

rows.original: That’s right, you’re in Gildenmere!
rows.translation: 没错，你在吉尔登米尔！
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s right, you’re in Gildenmere!"

rows.original: What were you here for again? Dad’s probes...?
rows.translation: 你来这里是为了什么来着？老爸的探针...？
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat were you here for again? Dad’s probes...?"

rows.original: Oh and hey, it’s that shop again. The one with the crazy owner and the... something. Your memory seems to want to pinpoint an image down but it never arrives.
rows.translation: 哦，还有，那家店又出现了。就是那个店主疯疯癫癫、还有那个...什么东西的店。你的记忆似乎想锁定某个画面，可它始终没有浮现。
rows.raw: "\n\nOh and hey, it’s that shop again. The one with the crazy owner and the... something. Your memory seems to want to pinpoint an image down but it never arrives."

rows.original: Inhaling deeply in an attempt to focus, you pick up a strange flavour at the back of your throat: Salt and... lemons?
rows.translation: 你深吸一口气，试图集中精神，却在喉咙深处尝到一股奇怪的味道：盐和...柠檬？
rows.raw: "\n\nInhaling deeply in an attempt to focus, you pick up a strange flavour at the back of your throat: Salt and... lemons?"

rows.original: Thinking nothing of it, you dust yourself down and get back to your business.
rows.translation: 你没把这当回事，拍了拍身上的灰，继续办自己的事。
rows.raw: "\n\nThinking nothing of it, you dust yourself down and get back to your business."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Get Wisped
rows.translation: 吸入幽灵药
rows.raw: "Get Wisped"

rows.original: Inhale something very illegal and see what happens.
rows.translation: 吸入某种极其违法的东西，看看会发生什么。
rows.raw: "Inhale something very illegal and see what happens."

rows.original: Sex
rows.translation: 做爱
rows.raw: "Sex"

rows.original: Apparently ‘it has to be’!
rows.translation: 据说‘非做不可’！
rows.raw: " Apparently ‘it has to be’!"

rows.original: Sex
rows.translation: 做爱
rows.raw: "Sex"

rows.original: Sex
rows.translation: 做爱
rows.raw: "Sex"

rows.original: That’s a bit of a nosedive, she hasn’t expressed interest... yet.
rows.translation: 这转折也太突然了，她还没表现出兴趣...暂时没有。
rows.raw: "That’s a bit of a nosedive, she hasn’t expressed interest... yet."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: There’s a familiarly Terran-looking shop just to your side. It’s old looking and the shop front seems medieval in design. Calligraphic letters spell out ‘The Entite’ in gold lettering over a purple sign that hangs above the solid wooden door. You get the feeling you’ve already been there before, maybe in another, more whimsical lifetime.
rows.translation: 你身旁有一家风格熟悉、颇具泰伦特色的商店。它看起来很古老，店面采用中世纪风格设计。紫色招牌悬在厚实的木门上方，金色的书法字体拼出‘实体界’。你总觉得自己以前来过这里，也许是在另一个更加奇妙的人生里。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a familiarly Terran-looking shop just to your side. It’s old looking and the shop front seems medieval in design. Calligraphic letters spell out ‘The Entite’ in gold lettering over a purple sign that hangs above the solid wooden door. You get the feeling you’ve already been there before, maybe in another, more whimsical lifetime."

rows.original: You feel a strange presence here... like there is supposed to be another shop front next to you... but obviously, there isn’t. Weird.
rows.translation: 你感觉这里有一股奇怪的存在感...仿佛你身旁本该还有另一间店面...但显然并没有。真怪。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feel a strange presence here... like there is supposed to be another shop front next to you... but obviously, there isn’t. Weird."

rows.original: It’s funny, you could’ve sworn that where you’re standing had a shop right next to you. Something purplish and... ah whatever, it’s probably just deja vu kicking you round the head again.
rows.translation: 真有意思，你明明发誓自己站的地方旁边曾有一家店。紫色的什么东西，而且...啊，算了，大概只是似曾相识的感觉又给了你脑袋一拳。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s funny, you could’ve sworn that where you’re standing had a shop right next to you. Something purplish and... ah whatever, it’s probably just deja vu kicking you round the head again."

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: What greets you when you enter the curious little shop is a heavy glow of amaranth light. It emanates in slightly different shades of flame from several black candles dotted about the place.
rows.translation: 走进这间古怪的小店时，迎接你的是浓郁的苋紫色光芒。店内散布着数支黑色蜡烛，火焰以略有差异的色调散发出这种光。
rows.raw: "What greets you when you enter the curious little shop is a heavy glow of amaranth light. It emanates in slightly different shades of flame from several black candles dotted about the place."

rows.original: There’s a counter at the far back of the room with a mechanical cash register on the right. Surrounding it is a patchwork arrangement of small plants, abstract gemstones, statues, and other curios that all have colored reflections from the purpled light sources.
rows.translation: 房间最里面有一张柜台，右侧摆着机械收银机。周围错落摆放着小型植物、抽象宝石、雕像和其他奇珍异物，无不映照着紫色光源投下的彩色反光。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a counter at the far back of the room with a mechanical cash register on the right. Surrounding it is a patchwork arrangement of small plants, abstract gemstones, statues, and other curios that all have colored reflections from the purpled light sources."

rows.original: A very fine mist wafts around the lower end
rows.translation: 一层极细的薄雾缭绕在下端
rows.raw: "\n\nA very fine mist wafts around the lower end"

rows.original: s
of your [pc.legs], one that’s vaguely warm and smelling of obscure incense.
rows.translation: ，围绕着你的[pc.legs]，带着若有若无的暖意和冷僻熏香的气味。
rows.raw: " of your [pc.legs], one that’s vaguely warm and smelling of obscure incense."

rows.original: There are some more familiar looking items lining the back shelf of the counter: bottles, pill packets and unusual containers of mods. They’re locked behind a large, horizontal glass case.
rows.translation: 柜台后方的架子上还陈列着一些更眼熟的物品：瓶子、药片包装和装着模组的奇特容器。它们都锁在一个大型横置玻璃柜后。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere are some more familiar looking items lining the back shelf of the counter: bottles, pill packets and unusual containers of mods. They’re locked behind a large, horizontal glass case."

rows.original: To your right, the furthest corner of the room is sectioned off by a wall of red velvet drapes. You can make out some wooden legs and cushions, suggesting a lounging area. It has a mild, sickly pink glow that bleeds through small gaps in the curtains.
rows.translation: 你的右侧，房间最远的角落被一面红色天鹅绒帘幕隔开。你能看见几条木腿和坐垫，那里似乎是休息区。病态的淡粉色微光从帘幕缝隙间渗出。
rows.raw: "\n\nTo your right, the furthest corner of the room is sectioned off by a wall of red velvet drapes. You can make out some wooden legs and cushions, suggesting a lounging area. It has a mild, sickly pink glow that bleeds through small gaps in the curtains."

rows.original: Behind the counter sits a cowled, robed figure, a long stick or staff of sorts by their side. It appears to just be a black rod save for a smooth ball of crystal at the end. It reminds you of something you would’ve heard of in ancient Earth tales of yore. The figure appears to be reading a particularly antique book, one with real leather binding and faded yellow-brown pages that they are turning in a very delicate manner.
rows.translation: 柜台后坐着一个戴兜帽、披长袍的身影，身旁靠着某种长棍或法杖。除末端嵌着一颗光滑水晶球外，它看起来只是一根黑色长杆，令你想起古老地球传说中的物件。那人似乎正在阅读一本格外古旧的书，书以真皮装订，泛黄褪色的书页被其极其小心地一页页翻动。
rows.raw: "\n\nBehind the counter sits a cowled, robed figure, a long stick or staff of sorts by their side. It appears to just be a black rod save for a smooth ball of crystal at the end. It reminds you of something you would’ve heard of in ancient Earth tales of yore. The figure appears to be reading a particularly antique book, one with real leather binding and faded yellow-brown pages that they are turning in a very delicate manner."

rows.original: The figure looks up as you amble towards the counter.
rows.translation: 当你缓步走向柜台时，那身影抬起头来。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe figure looks up as you amble towards the counter."

rows.original: “Customer... customer. Customer!” comes an exuberant, feminine voice. The figure rises to greet you, a thin-fingered left hand gracefully sliding out of its heavy sleeve. They don’t try to shake your hand, merely holding it in your direction. Their other arm is curled just above the waistline, the loose sleeve that covers it dangling with excess length.
rows.translation: “顾客...顾客。顾客！”一个兴高采烈的女性声音响起。那身影站起来迎接你，纤细的左手优雅地从厚重袖管中滑出。她没有试图与你握手，只是把手伸向你。另一条手臂弯在腰线上方，包裹着它的宽松衣袖长长地垂下。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Customer... customer. Customer!” comes an exuberant, feminine voice. The figure rises to greet you, a thin-fingered left hand gracefully sliding out of its heavy sleeve. They don’t try to shake your hand, merely holding it in your direction. Their other arm is curled just above the waistline, the loose sleeve that covers it dangling with excess length."

rows.original: Uh, Hey
rows.translation: 呃，你好
rows.raw: "Uh, Hey"

rows.original: The Entite seems to have drawn you into its being. You feel as if you’ve been here before... wait, you have been here before. You even remember what it looks like. It seems off though: was that candle always on that book stack? That statue staring at you? Both? But maybe neither?
rows.translation: 实体界似乎把你吸入了它的存在。你感觉自己以前来过这里...等等，你确实来过。你甚至还记得它的样子。可这里似乎不太对：那支蜡烛以前一直摆在那堆书上吗？那座雕像一直盯着你吗？两者都是？又或许都不是？
rows.raw: "The Entite seems to have drawn you into its being. You feel as if you’ve been here before... wait, you have been here before. You even remember what it looks like. It seems off though: was that candle always on that book stack? That statue staring at you? Both? But maybe neither?"

rows.original: The shopkeeper is behind the counter, which you’ve seen her do before. Possibly. Have you even met her before? What was her name again? Did she do anything to you last time? You’re sure something did, maybe.
rows.translation: 店主就在柜台后面，你以前见她这样待过。大概吧。你真的见过她吗？她叫什么来着？上次她对你做过什么吗？你确信某种东西做过，也许。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe shopkeeper is behind the counter, which you’ve seen her do before. Possibly. Have you even met her before? What was her name again? Did she do anything to you last time? You’re sure something did, maybe."

rows.original: Your body seems to remember: A strange sinking sensation rushes through you at an ephemeral pace when you glance at the shopkeeper.
rows.translation: 你的身体似乎还记得：当你看向店主时，一股奇怪的下沉感转瞬间席卷全身。
rows.raw: " Your body seems to remember: A strange sinking sensation rushes through you at an ephemeral pace when you glance at the shopkeeper."

rows.original: She rises to welcome you with her left hand outstretched.
rows.translation: 她站起身来欢迎你，左手向前伸出。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe rises to welcome you with her left hand outstretched."

rows.original: “Ahh, Steele! At least, that is what I have seen. Are you that Steele? Possibly. Possibly the other... and the others...” she mutters, returning to the counter to accept your custom.
rows.translation: “啊，斯蒂尔！至少，我看到的是如此。你是那个斯蒂尔吗？或许。或许是另一个...还有其他那些...”她喃喃自语着，回到柜台后招待你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ahh, Steele! At least, that is what I have seen. Are you that Steele? Possibly. Possibly the other... and the others...” she mutters, returning to the counter to accept your custom."

rows.original: “[pc.name]. A name known! Names known. Names replaced... names, nay, beings! Beings are being, named and not seen...” she mutters, returning to the counter to accept your custom.
rows.translation: “[pc.name]。已知之名！名字已知。名字被替换...名字，不，是存在！存在正在存在，有名却不可见...”她喃喃自语着，回到柜台后招待你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name]. A name known! Names known. Names replaced... names, nay, beings! Beings are being, named and not seen...” she mutters, returning to the counter to accept your custom."

rows.original: “Chest pounding, stomach burning, the lungs, they fail! Oh... but to see what was birthed. That is and that is not... and it is not you,” she mutters, returning to the counter to accept your custom.
rows.translation: “胸口狂跳，胃中灼烧，肺部，它们衰竭！哦...但看看诞生了什么。它是，也不是...而它不是你，”她喃喃自语着，回到柜台后招待你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Chest pounding, stomach burning, the lungs, they fail! Oh... but to see what was birthed. That is and that is not... and it is not you,” she mutters, returning to the counter to accept your custom."

rows.original: “Did you live that life? Watch it? Feel it? Die in it? Reborn... as something. That much is clear,” she mutters, returning to the counter to accept your custom.
rows.translation: “你经历过那一生吗？旁观过？感受过？死在其中？重生...成为某种东西。至少这一点很清楚，”她喃喃自语着，回到柜台后招待你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Did you live that life? Watch it? Feel it? Die in it? Reborn... as something. That much is clear,” she mutters, returning to the counter to accept your custom."

rows.original: The Seer
rows.translation: 先知
rows.raw: "The Seer"

rows.original: Trippy!
rows.translation: 迷幻极了！
rows.raw: "Trippy!"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: Ooo, that Wiff-O-Whatsit really made you drowsy. As sleep takes over, the darkness that comes is so total that all sense of perception becomes befuddled.
rows.translation: 哦哦，那个叫什么来着的烟雾真让你昏昏欲睡。睡意袭来，随之而至的黑暗如此彻底，令你的一切感知都陷入混乱。
rows.raw: "Ooo, that Wiff-O-Whatsit really made you drowsy. As sleep takes over, the darkness that comes is so total that all sense of perception becomes befuddled."

rows.original: A thousand images come and go in the space of seconds, none of which you could give a surety as to their meaning. A planet’s destruction, a gray tree blooming purple fruit in the middle of a brown ocean, thousands of aliens gravitating in a spiral towards an object of worship, a neon face mouthing something and then exploding into shards of red: all unrepresentative of each other with no interconnection.
rows.translation: 短短数秒内，成千上万个画面来来去去，没有一个能让你确定其含义。星球的毁灭；棕色海洋中央，一棵灰树开出紫色果实；成千上万名外星人沿螺旋轨迹聚向某个膜拜对象；一张霓虹面孔无声说着什么，随后爆成红色碎片：彼此毫无代表性，也没有任何联系。
rows.raw: "\n\nA thousand images come and go in the space of seconds, none of which you could give a surety as to their meaning. A planet’s destruction, a gray tree blooming purple fruit in the middle of a brown ocean, thousands of aliens gravitating in a spiral towards an object of worship, a neon face mouthing something and then exploding into shards of red: all unrepresentative of each other with no interconnection."

rows.original: However, some images and visions seem to repeat. Some of those can even then be interpreted despite their chaotic appearances...
rows.translation: 不过，有些影像和幻象反复出现。其中一些尽管外表混乱，甚至还能被解读...
rows.raw: "\n\nHowever, some images and visions seem to repeat. Some of those can even then be interpreted despite their chaotic appearances..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Tripping Balls
rows.translation: 嗨到飞起
rows.raw: "Tripping Balls"

rows.original: SoAndSo
rows.raw: "SoAndSo"

rows.original: Woozy
rows.raw: "Woozy"

rows.original: value1
rows.raw: "value1"

rows.original: value2
rows.raw: "value2"

rows.original: value3
rows.raw: "value3"

rows.original: A ceremony of some sort: heavy mountain ranges covering a plateau of hooded figures chanting in unison. The sky cracks with lightning and the chorus escalates in volume.
rows.translation: 某种仪式：连绵的沉重山脉环绕着一片高原，一群戴兜帽的人影齐声吟唱。天空被闪电撕裂，合唱声越发高亢。
rows.raw: "A ceremony of some sort: heavy mountain ranges covering a plateau of hooded figures chanting in unison. The sky cracks with lightning and the chorus escalates in volume."

rows.original: Primorditatts
rows.raw: "Primorditatts"

rows.original: This scene feels eerily familiar...
rows.translation: 这一幕有种诡异的熟悉感...
rows.raw: " This scene feels eerily familiar..."

rows.original: Two more prominent figures are the focus. You’re able to tell that they’re...Goats? One is small and pure white, the other is green, gold, and muscular. They appear to be locked into an awkward missionary position... oh. Something about the primal display before you awakens a deep lust in your mind. The sound of thunder and the sight of lightning adds an intangible sense of adrenaline with each crack of white light. But your enjoyment is cut short as the image fades and burns away to more random visual treats...
rows.translation: 两个更醒目的人影是画面的焦点。你看得出他们是...山羊？一个娇小而纯白，另一个绿色、金色且肌肉发达。他们似乎以尴尬的传教士体位纠缠在一起...哦。眼前这原始的景象唤醒了你心底深处的欲望。雷声与闪电每次炸出白光，都添上一股难以言喻的刺激感。但你的享受很快被打断，画面褪去、燃尽，化作更多杂乱的视觉奇景...
rows.raw: " Two more prominent figures are the focus. You’re able to tell that they’re...Goats? One is small and pure white, the other is green, gold, and muscular. They appear to be locked into an awkward missionary position... oh. Something about the primal display before you awakens a deep lust in your mind. The sound of thunder and the sight of lightning adds an intangible sense of adrenaline with each crack of white light. But your enjoyment is cut short as the image fades and burns away to more random visual treats..."

rows.original:
A verdant green planet dotted with oddly colored stone formations: Orange, white, black and cyan. A canopy of angular leaves covers a forest floor, which you appear to dive into...

Breaching through the purple wood of the trees, you see that the fauna is unlike anything you’ve ever seen: Green but oddly proportioned and consisting of straight lined-shapes, almost perfectly so. Unnatural nature.

There are humanoids walking along a vague path. Not human... moths? Moth people? They’re so graceful and alien, unlike any other race you can name. Their wings flitter and flutter behind them; then at once, all of the moth-people take to the skies in silent unison.

As the canopy shakes from the display, the image distorts, then fades away...
rows.translation:
一颗郁郁葱葱的绿色星球上点缀着颜色奇异的岩石构造：橙色、白色、黑色和青色。由棱角分明的叶片组成的树冠遮蔽森林地面，而你似乎正向其中俯冲...

穿过树木紫色的木质层，你发现这里的动物与自己见过的任何生物都不同：它们呈绿色，比例古怪，由几乎完美的直线形状构成。非自然的自然。

一些类人生物正沿着一条模糊的小径行走。不是人类...飞蛾？飞蛾人？他们如此优雅而陌生，不像你能说出名字的任何种族。翅膀在身后轻轻扑动；随后，所有飞蛾人一齐无声地飞向天空。

树冠因这番景象而摇晃，画面随之扭曲，然后消散...
rows.raw:
"A verdant green planet dotted with oddly colored stone formations: Orange, white, black and cyan. A canopy of angular leaves covers a forest floor, which you appear to dive into...

Breaching through the purple wood of the trees, you see that the fauna is unlike anything you’ve ever seen: Green but oddly proportioned and consisting of straight lined-shapes, almost perfectly so. Unnatural nature.

There are humanoids walking along a vague path. Not human... moths? Moth people? They’re so graceful and alien, unlike any other race you can name. Their wings flitter and flutter behind them; then at once, all of the moth-people take to the skies in silent unison.

As the canopy shakes from the display, the image distorts, then fades away..."

rows.original:
The world shifts to a strange location: The lip of a rock formation at the edge of a mountain.

It’s an Earth-like place, covered in grass with a crystal clear sky. You can’t feel much but there’s a definite force bouncing through the rocks... wind? Most certainly.

From it, you jump off.

And fly?

You see the ground below you and spy movement in the grasses below. A mouse?! You head straight for it, whatever it might be. Primal instinct causes you to dive downwards and your black talons extend like eight blades of indignant death!
rows.translation:
世界转变为一个奇怪的地点：山崖边缘的一处岩层顶部。

这里与地球相似，遍地青草，天空澄澈。你感觉不到太多东西，却能察觉一股明确的力量在岩石间跃动...风？毫无疑问。

你从那里一跃而下。

然后飞了起来？

你俯瞰下方地面，发现草丛里有动静。一只老鼠？！不管那是什么，你径直朝它冲去。原始本能令你向下俯冲，黑色利爪如同八柄愤怒的死亡之刃般伸出！
rows.raw:
"The world shifts to a strange location: The lip of a rock formation at the edge of a mountain.

It’s an Earth-like place, covered in grass with a crystal clear sky. You can’t feel much but there’s a definite force bouncing through the rocks... wind? Most certainly.

From it, you jump off.

And fly?

You see the ground below you and spy movement in the grasses below. A mouse?! You head straight for it, whatever it might be. Primal instinct causes you to dive downwards and your black talons extend like eight blades of indignant death!"

rows.original:
Somehow, the plane of existence morphs into a crystal void of refracted light. Sound and light bend off of each surface and each other, dazzling your mortal senses to the point of inertia. You fly amid stones of blues and greens, ones that form and reform ex nihilo in front of your very eyes like thick gel or liquid.

You find that your limbs aren’t responsive... for you have no limbs. This plane of existence then morphs violently, a twisting blurred mess of visual distortion adapting to something you still don’t recognize.

It happens a second and third time, the fourth eventually ‘bleeding’ away from your perception into another image...
rows.translation:
不知怎的，这个位面变成了一个由折射光线构成的水晶虚空。声音与光芒在每个表面和彼此之间弯折，令你的凡俗感官眼花缭乱，直至僵滞。你在蓝绿宝石之间飞行，它们如浓稠凝胶或液体一般，在你眼前凭空形成又重组。

你发现自己的四肢毫无反应...因为你根本没有四肢。这个位面随即猛烈变形，扭曲而模糊的视觉乱象适应成某种你仍无法辨认的东西。

这一切又发生了第二次和第三次，第四次最终从你的感知中‘渗出’，化作另一幅画面...

"Somehow, the plane of existence morphs into a crystal void of refracted light. Sound and light bend off of each surface and each other, dazzling your mortal senses to the point of inertia. No, maybe... laughter? Oh damn, that’s someone gettin’ it awn! And you ain’t been invited? Po-lease. Well color me horseraddish red now what do we have here? A moo cow! Why ya out here on ya lonesome, cutie? Break from work? Ain’t no fun without a second pair o’ hands! Now wait a sec, why’dya gotta start fadin’ like that, I wanted the moo cow...

Probably.

Everyone’s human.

And your clothes?

It’s all wrapped in wordless silence. Even the ambience of the room doesn’t exist. All you can hear is a faint but omnipresent whine that tickles the inner parts of your brain.

Where did all these clothes come from? So many different ones.

You’re cold, lets jump in them!

Oh no, there’s a belt buckle and you’ve got it trapped round your toes!

Better ahigafalugahayah....

As you approach, you note it must be another offworlder’s camp: a hauler drone and a little hovering camera drone are both in plain sight, plus a fairly beefy holo-projector set up where you might have found a fire pit in ages past, projecting flickering images of other Myrellion caverns and local wildlife: chitinous women, heavy-set males, and squirming vine creatures. The silent video is accompanied the faint sound of talking, a woman’s voice tinged with frustration.

rows.translation: 仍然令我印象深刻，[pc.name]，”泰芙拉笑道。“不过，自从俘获你的表亲后，我已经审问过[rival.hisHer]一番。你并不拥有这个……斯蒂尔科技。你并不能像自己声称的那样调动它的资源。除非拿到我的这枚探针，以及更多同类探针。”
rows.raw: " continues to impress me, [pc.name],” Taivra laughs. “Still, I have interrogated your cousin somewhat since [rival.hisHer] capture. You do not own this... Steele Tech. You don’t command its resources, as you claim. Not without this probe of mine, and many more like it.”"

rows.original: You try to keep your cool. “That’s right,” you grin, “exactly right. I need your help now, but once I have all of the probes...”
rows.translation: 你努力保持镇定。“没错，”你咧嘴一笑，“完全正确。我现在需要你的帮助，但等我集齐所有探针……”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou try to keep your cool. “That’s right,” you grin, “exactly right. I need your help now, but once I have all of the probes...”"

rows.original: <i>“Ha! What would compel you to return to me, once you’ve left? What proof do I have that you will honor your side of the bargain? As you no doubt know, I would have little recourse once you’d left... even outside of the deep caves here on the planet, my reach is greatly diminished. On another world, in the shadow of some distant star... would you even think of our bargain?
rows.translation: <i>“哈！等你离开后，还有什么能迫使你回来找我？我凭什么相信你会履行交易中属于你的那一部分？你无疑也知道，一旦你离开，我几乎没有任何追索手段……即便只是在这颗星球上、离开此处的深层洞穴，我的影响力也会大幅削弱。若是在另一个世界，在某颗遥远恒星的阴影之下……你还会记得我们的交易吗？
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Ha! What would compel you to return to me, once you’ve left? What proof do I have that you will honor your side of the bargain? As you no doubt know, I would have little recourse once you’d left... even outside of the deep caves here on the planet, my reach is greatly diminished. On another world, in the shadow of some distant star... would you even think of our bargain?"

rows.raw: "man"

rows.translation: 女人
rows.raw: "woman"

rows.original: of your word, yet I find it hard to believe a mere clan of cave dwellers such as us would matter compared to the wonders and dangers of your world.
rows.translation: ，也是个信守承诺的人，可我很难相信，与贵世界的奇观和危险相比，我们这样一支穴居氏族还能有什么分量。
rows.raw: " of your word, yet I find it hard to believe a mere clan of cave dwellers such as us would matter compared to the wonders and dangers of your world."

rows.original: She makes a good point, but the way she’s looking at you... the way she hasn’t called her bodyguard to start dismembering you... Queen Taivra knows this could be a good deal. She wants something from you, and you’re so close... but what more could you offer her?
rows.translation: 她说得有道理，可看她望着你的方式……看她始终没有叫保镖把你肢解……泰芙拉女王知道这可能是一笔好买卖。她想从你这里得到某样东西，而你已经如此接近目标……可你还能再给她什么？
rows.raw: "\n\nShe makes a good point, but the way she’s looking at you... the way she hasn’t called her bodyguard to start dismembering you... Queen Taivra knows this could be a good deal. She wants something from you, and you’re so close... but what more could you offer her?"

rows.original: Alliance
rows.translation: 结盟
rows.raw: "Alliance"

rows.original: Offer Queen Taivra an alliance. There’s not much you can do to cement it beyond your word at this point, but being the partner of an interstellar business mogul is a hell of an advantage when your world is on the brink, and you’re just a stone age tribe. Steele Tech could offer her help, protection...
rows.translation: 向泰芙拉女王提出结盟。目前除了你的承诺，几乎没有别的办法巩固盟约；但当她的世界濒临危机，而她统领的不过是一支石器时代部族时，成为一位星际商业巨头的伙伴无疑是巨大优势。斯蒂尔科技可以为她提供援助和保护……
rows.raw: "Offer Queen Taivra an alliance. There’s not much you can do to cement it beyond your word at this point, but being the partner of an interstellar business mogul is a hell of an advantage when your world is on the brink, and you’re just a stone age tribe. Steele Tech could offer her help, protection..."

rows.original: Partnership
rows.translation: 伴侣关系
rows.raw: "Partnership"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “I offered to partner up with you,” you suggest, taking a confident stride forward with your most charming smile on full display. “But a partnership goes both ways. Responsibility, vulnerability, power over the other. You interrogated my cousin, like you said. Surely that means you know just how wealthy and powerful I’ll be when my quest is done.”
rows.translation: “我提议与你成为伴侣，”你说道，自信地向前迈步，脸上展露出最迷人的笑容。“但伴侣关系是双向的。责任、弱点，以及彼此掌握的权力。你说过，你审问了我的表亲。那你肯定已经知道，等我的任务完成后，我会变得多么富有、多么强大。”
rows.raw: "“I offered to partner up with you,” you suggest, taking a confident stride forward with your most charming smile on full display. “But a partnership goes both ways. Responsibility, vulnerability, power over the other. You interrogated my cousin, like you said. Surely that means you know just how wealthy and powerful I’ll be when my quest is done.”"

rows.original: The queen smiles. “I do, yes. Though the thought of a stellar empire does boggle the mind...”
rows.translation: 女王微微一笑。“是的，我知道。不过，一个星际帝国的概念确实令人难以想象……”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe queen smiles. “I do, yes. Though the thought of a stellar empire does boggle the mind...”"

rows.original: “Hey, wait, what’re you doing!?” [rival.name] shrieks from [rival.hisHer] cage. “You can’t do this, [pc.name], are you insane? And it’s going to be my company anyway!”
rows.translation: “喂，等等，你在干什么！？”[rival.name]在[rival.hisHer]笼中尖叫。“你不能这么做，[pc.name]，你疯了吗？而且那家公司最后本来就该是我的！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, wait, what’re you doing!?” [rival.name] shrieks from [rival.hisHer] cage. “You can’t do this, [pc.name], are you insane? And it’s going to be my company anyway!”"

rows.original: “Shut up, [rival.name],” you say off-handed, barely looking your cousin’s way. A few more steps take you right to the edge of the queen’s dias, and you kneel down before the amazonian woman. She makes a slight gesture, and the prostrate bodies of her betas quickly clear out, scampering off out of the throne room. Her many tentacle cocks, still dripping with juice and seed, recoil under the arms of her throne, and Taivra leans forward with eager anticipation. You both know how this has to end, now, and the queen clearly appreciates every second of foreplay before you reveal your plan.
rows.translation: “闭嘴，[rival.name]，”你心不在焉地说，几乎没有朝表亲那边看。再走几步，你来到女王高台边缘，在这位亚马逊般的女人面前单膝跪下。她轻轻一挥手，那些匍匐在地的贝塔便迅速散开，仓皇离开王座厅。她那许多仍滴着汁液与精种的触手肉棒缩回王座扶手之下，泰芙拉满怀期待地前倾身体。你们都知道事情如今必须如何收场；而在你揭晓计划之前，女王显然很享受每一秒前戏。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shut up, [rival.name],” you say off-handed, barely looking your cousin’s way. A few more steps take you right to the edge of the queen’s dias, and you kneel down before the amazonian woman. She makes a slight gesture, and the prostrate bodies of her betas quickly clear out, scampering off out of the throne room. Her many tentacle cocks, still dripping with juice and seed, recoil under the arms of her throne, and Taivra leans forward with eager anticipation. You both know how this has to end, now, and the queen clearly appreciates every second of foreplay before you reveal your plan."

rows.original: <i>“Queen Taivra. Though this is the first time we’ve met, you’ve stuck me with awe of you beauty, your cunning, your regal power. I know that, together, a mega-corporation and a legion of nyrea could do great things - for us both. Your people have alphas and betas and harems, but among mine, we also have
rows.translation: <i>“泰芙拉女王。虽然这是我们第一次见面，但你的美貌、谋略与王者威严已经令我深深敬畏。我知道，一家巨型企业与一支尼瑞亚军团联手，能成就伟业——对我们双方都有好处。你们有阿尔法、贝塔和后宫，而在我的族群中，我们也有
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Queen Taivra. Though this is the first time we’ve met, you’ve stuck me with awe of you beauty, your cunning, your regal power. I know that, together, a mega-corporation and a legion of nyrea could do great things - for us both. Your people have alphas and betas and harems, but among mine, we also have "

rows.original: husbands and
rows.translation: 丈夫和
rows.raw: "husbands and "

rows.original: wives who share power equally. I-”
rows.translation: 妻子，彼此平等地分享权力。我——”
rows.raw: "wives who share power equally. I-”"

rows.original: “You are insane!” [rival.name] yells, until Queensguard slams her shield against your cousin’s cage. “What’re you...”
rows.translation: “你真的疯了！”[rival.name]大喊，直到女王卫士把盾牌猛撞在你表亲的笼子上。“你到底……”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You are insane!” [rival.name] yells, until Queensguard slams her shield against your cousin’s cage. “What’re you...”"

rows.original: “-don’t have a ring on me,” you continue, smiling up at the queen, “but the Codex here can make it official. Legal and binding. So, will you-”
rows.translation: “——身上没带戒指，”你继续说，抬头对女王微笑，“不过这台法典可以让它正式生效。合法且具有约束力。所以，你愿意——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“-don’t have a ring on me,” you continue, smiling up at the queen, “but the Codex here can make it official. Legal and binding. So, will you-”"

rows.translation: “哦，别再啰嗦了，”泰芙拉笑着，一把抓住你的

rows.translation: 衣领

rows.translation: 肩膀

rows.original: “RUN FOR IT!” a voice booms behind you, just as you and Taivra are about to seal the metaphorical deal. You scramble to your
rows.translation: “快跑！”就在你与泰芙拉即将敲定这桩比喻意义上的交易时，一个洪亮的声音从身后炸响。你赶紧用
rows.raw: "“RUN FOR IT!” a voice booms behind you, just as you and Taivra are about to seal the metaphorical deal. You scramble to your "

rows.raw: "[pc.feet]"
