rows.translation: 完整身高
rows.raw: "full height"

rows.original: and look back, just in time to see Dane lumbering to his full height, your cousin scrambling off behind him. The pair of huntresses standing behind the cages leap towards him, but are quickly swept aside by his bulging arms - thrown against the walls with heavy thuds.
rows.translation: 站起身并回头，正好看见戴恩挺起高大的身躯，而你的表亲则在他身后匆忙逃窜。守在笼子后的两名女猎手朝他扑去，却立刻被他粗壮的手臂扫到一旁，重重撞在墙上。
rows.raw: " and look back, just in time to see Dane lumbering to his full height, your cousin scrambling off behind him. The pair of huntresses standing behind the cages leap towards him, but are quickly swept aside by his bulging arms - thrown against the walls with heavy thuds."

rows.original: The alabaster ausar is utterly naked, stripped of his gear and bruised from his capture, but he’s grinning like a mad dog all the same. The veins on his arms bulge as he flexes his corded muscles, flipping the pieces of primitive weaponry down to his lower arms to hold like daggers. “You should’ve killed me when you had the chance. This time you won’t get a chance to jump me in the dark.”
rows.translation: 这个雪白毛发的奥萨人一丝不挂，装备全被剥走，身上还带着被俘后留下的淤伤，可他仍像条疯狗一样咧嘴狞笑。随着他绷紧结实的肌肉，手臂上的血管高高鼓起；他将断裂的原始武器碎片翻到下方两只手中，像匕首一样握着。“你有机会时就该杀了我。这次你可没机会在黑暗中偷袭我了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe alabaster ausar is utterly naked, stripped of his gear and bruised from his capture, but he’s grinning like a mad dog all the same. The veins on his arms bulge as he flexes his corded muscles, flipping the pieces of primitive weaponry down to his lower arms to hold like daggers. “You should’ve killed me when you had the chance. This time you won’t get a chance to jump me in the dark.”"

rows.original: “Slaves should learn their place,” Queensguard answers, lowering her shield into place and readying her sword. “If they cannot fathom that, then they will be fed to the deeps, piece by piece.” She advances steadily, one plated boot in front of the other warily moving to intercept Dane.
rows.translation: “奴隶就该学会自己的位置，”女王卫士回答着，放低盾牌摆好架势，同时举剑待战。“若是连这都无法理解，就该一块一块地拿去喂给深渊。”她稳步上前，覆甲长靴谨慎地交替迈进，准备拦住戴恩。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Slaves should learn their place,” Queensguard answers, lowering her shield into place and readying her sword. “If they cannot fathom that, then they will be fed to the deeps, piece by piece.” She advances steadily, one plated boot in front of the other warily moving to intercept Dane."

rows.original: “That’s all you’ve got? Not even a gun?” Dane grins, cracking a pair of his knuckles.
rows.translation: “你就只有这点东西？连把枪都没有？”戴恩咧嘴一笑，掰响了两根指关节。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s all you’ve got? Not even a gun?” Dane grins, cracking a pair of his knuckles."

rows.original: Confusion briefly crosses Queensguard’s face. “You are naked with naught but a broken weapon. I have no need of a dishonorable star-blaster.”
rows.translation: 女王卫士脸上短暂掠过一丝困惑。“你赤身裸体，手中只有一件破损的武器。我根本不需要什么有失荣誉的星际爆能枪。”
rows.raw: "\n\nConfusion briefly crosses Queensguard’s face. “You are naked with naught but a broken weapon. I have no need of a dishonorable star-blaster.”"

rows.original: “If you had a gun, you might have had a chance.”
rows.translation: “要是你有枪，或许还会有点机会。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“If you had a gun, you might have had a chance.”"

rows.original: You wouldn’t have thought a guy as big as Dane could lunge so far and so fast if you hadn’t tangled with him once already, and the armored nyrea clearly doesn’t share that experience. She only has time for her eyes to widen in surprise before Dane crashes into her in a flash of albino fur and pounding fists, driving her back half a pace. The broken haft of the spear shatters on impact with her armor-plated side, visibly denting the plate. Knuckles deflect off Queensguard’s helm, leaving lines of blood behind where the sharp metal ripped into Dane’s knuckles.
rows.translation: 倘若你之前没有和戴恩交过手，恐怕绝不会相信他这么高大的家伙竟能扑得如此远、如此快；而那个身披铠甲的尼瑞亚人显然也没有这种经验。她只来得及惊讶地睁大眼睛，戴恩便化作一团白化皮毛与重拳组成的疾影撞上她，将她逼退了半步。断裂的矛杆砸中她铠甲覆盖的侧身时碎裂开来，甲片上肉眼可见地凹了下去。拳头撞在女王卫士的头盔上偏开，锋利的金属割破戴恩的指节，在其上留下道道血痕。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wouldn’t have thought a guy as big as Dane could lunge so far and so fast if you hadn’t tangled with him once already, and the armored nyrea clearly doesn’t share that experience. She only has time for her eyes to widen in surprise before Dane crashes into her in a flash of albino fur and pounding fists, driving her back half a pace. The broken haft of the spear shatters on impact with her armor-plated side, visibly denting the plate. Knuckles deflect off Queensguard’s helm, leaving lines of blood behind where the sharp metal ripped into Dane’s knuckles."

rows.original: For all his power and speed, it’s clear that your cousin’s bodyguard is more a brawler than a trained fighter. He doesn’t try to avoid harrowing slashes from Queensguard’s sword, relying on the awkward positioning to rob the strength from her blows and his thick fur to keep her from cutting too deeply. Dane’s left forearms are soon matted red with blood from a half-dozen surface cuts, but none so deep as to stop him from grabbing hold of his foe’s shield in two hands, wrenching it powerfully to the side.
rows.translation: 尽管力量强大、速度惊人，你表亲的保镖显然更像个街头斗士，而不是训练有素的战士。他根本不试图躲避女王卫士长剑令人胆寒的劈砍，而是依靠别扭的站位削弱她出招的力道，再用厚实的毛皮避免伤口切得太深。戴恩左侧几条手臂很快便被六七道表层割伤流出的鲜血染红，但没有一道深到足以阻止他用两只手抓住对手的盾牌，强有力地将其扯向一旁。
rows.raw: "\n\nFor all his power and speed, it’s clear that your cousin’s bodyguard is more a brawler than a trained fighter. He doesn’t try to avoid harrowing slashes from Queensguard’s sword, relying on the awkward positioning to rob the strength from her blows and his thick fur to keep her from cutting too deeply. Dane’s left forearms are soon matted red with blood from a half-dozen surface cuts, but none so deep as to stop him from grabbing hold of his foe’s shield in two hands, wrenching it powerfully to the side."

rows.original: Queensguard is no brawler. She’s a fighter, used to tackling her Queen’s enemies in one-on-one confrontations. She lets her arm slide out of the shield’s strap and spins with the momentum, twisting around for a vicious, back-handed slice. A diagonal rent opens up across Dane’s chest, deep enough to reveal two or three blood-drenched bones but not quite deep enough to bring down the mighty ausar. His rage filled blood leaves steaming, crimson puddles on the ground between them.
rows.translation: 女王卫士并非街头斗士。她是一名战士，习惯在一对一的交锋中迎战女王的敌人。她任由手臂从盾牌绑带中滑脱，借着惯性旋身，使出狠辣的反手斩击。戴恩胸前被斜着劈开一道裂口，深得足以露出两三根浸满鲜血的骨头，却还不足以击倒这个强大的奥萨人。他那满载愤怒的鲜血在两人之间的地面上汇成冒着热气的猩红水洼。
rows.raw: "\n\nQueensguard is no brawler. She’s a fighter, used to tackling her Queen’s enemies in one-on-one confrontations. She lets her arm slide out of the shield’s strap and spins with the momentum, twisting around for a vicious, back-handed slice. A diagonal rent opens up across Dane’s chest, deep enough to reveal two or three blood-drenched bones but not quite deep enough to bring down the mighty ausar. His rage filled blood leaves steaming, crimson puddles on the ground between them."

rows.original: Dane staggers a half-step back from the pain, but he doesn’t drop the shield. He leans further back, sweeping the shield up and into the underside of Queensguard’s polished blade. The clang of metal on metal reverberates through the cavernous chamber as the two bodyguards struggle. The nyrea barely keeps her grip on her weapon, but Dane never needed to disarm her, just take away her biggest defense - the shield - and open her up to a strike.
rows.translation: 戴恩因疼痛踉跄着退了半步，却没有丢下盾牌。他把身体进一步向后仰，挥起盾牌撞向女王卫士那把锃亮长剑的下侧。金属撞击的铿锵声回荡在洞窟般宽阔的大厅里，两名保镖奋力角逐。尼瑞亚人勉强没有让武器脱手，可戴恩压根不需要夺走她的剑，只要拿走她最大的防御，也就是那面盾牌，让她门户大开，便足以发动攻击。
rows.raw: "\n\nDane staggers a half-step back from the pain, but he doesn’t drop the shield. He leans further back, sweeping the shield up and into the underside of Queensguard’s polished blade. The clang of metal on metal reverberates through the cavernous chamber as the two bodyguards struggle. The nyrea barely keeps her grip on her weapon, but Dane never needed to disarm her, just take away her biggest defense - the shield - and open her up to a strike."

rows.original: The metal spearpoint flashes as Dane’s fist carries it forward into the dented section of the nyrea’s armor. The impact reminds you of the sound of the industrial steel punches in one of your father’s factories. Dane’s hand comes away empty, the only evidence of his strike a rent in his foe’s armor and a protruding bit of wood. Thick purple blood oozes down the plate covering Queensguard’s legs, staining them with visible defeat.
rows.translation: 戴恩的拳头带着金属矛尖一闪而过，刺向尼瑞亚人铠甲上凹陷的部位。撞击声让你想起父亲某座工厂里的工业钢冲床。戴恩收回空空如也的手，只有敌人铠甲上破开的裂口和露在外面的一小截木头证明他刚才的攻击。浓稠的紫色鲜血沿着覆盖女王卫士双腿的甲片向下流淌，以肉眼可见的败象染污了它们。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe metal spearpoint flashes as Dane’s fist carries it forward into the dented section of the nyrea’s armor. The impact reminds you of the sound of the industrial steel punches in one of your father’s factories. Dane’s hand comes away empty, the only evidence of his strike a rent in his foe’s armor and a protruding bit of wood. Thick purple blood oozes down the plate covering Queensguard’s legs, staining them with visible defeat."

rows.original: “Told you that you should’ve brought a gun,” Dane snarls, kicking the nyrea square in the chest. She drops like a sack of bricks and curls into a ball, wincing from what must be terrible abdominal pain. “Musta ruptured something other than your sperm sacks, huh? I guess not all the male nyrea get off on penetration.”
rows.translation: “早说了你该带把枪，”戴恩咆哮着，一脚正中尼瑞亚人的胸口。她像一袋砖头似的倒下，蜷成一团，显然在忍受可怕的腹部剧痛。“看来除了储精囊之外，你还把别的什么东西弄破了，对吧？看来并非所有雄性尼瑞亚人都能从被插入中获得快感。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Told you that you should’ve brought a gun,” Dane snarls, kicking the nyrea square in the chest. She drops like a sack of bricks and curls into a ball, wincing from what must be terrible abdominal pain. “Musta ruptured something other than your sperm sacks, huh? I guess not all the male nyrea get off on penetration.”"

rows.original: Dane doesn’t look much better off, but he’s still standing, somehow. He slips the shield onto his lower left arm and turns to you. “Thanks for the distraction. A word of advice - don’t get into the bodyguarding game. Half the job is bleeding for the boss.”
rows.translation: 戴恩的情况看起来也好不到哪去，但不知怎的，他仍然站着。他把盾牌套到左下臂上，转向你。“多谢你帮忙吸引注意。给你个建议——别干保镖这行。工作有一半都是替老板流血。”
rows.raw: "\n\nDane doesn’t look much better off, but he’s still standing, somehow. He slips the shield onto his lower left arm and turns to you. “Thanks for the distraction. A word of advice - don’t get into the bodyguarding game. Half the job is bleeding for the boss.”"

rows.original: “Enough of this!” the shocked Queen cries, leaping to her feet and grabbing her spear. “I will lay you low myself!”
rows.translation: “够了！”震惊的女王高喊着跃起，抓住长矛。“我亲自把你打趴下！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Enough of this!” the shocked Queen cries, leaping to her feet and grabbing her spear. “I will lay you low myself!”"

rows.original: Dane looks ready to rumble, to face down your new mate - and you too, if need be. But a shrill cry from the stairwell draws his attention, and with a grunt Dane is forced to retreat, rushing to save his cowardly ward.
rows.translation: 戴恩已经摆好架势，准备迎战你的新伴侣——必要时连你也一起打。但楼梯间传来一声尖叫，吸引了他的注意；戴恩闷哼一声，只得撤退，冲去营救那个胆小的被保护人。
rows.raw: "\n\nDane looks ready to rumble, to face down your new mate - and you too, if need be. But a shrill cry from the stairwell draws his attention, and with a grunt Dane is forced to retreat, rushing to save his cowardly ward."

rows.original: “After him!” Taivra shouts at the handful of huntresses left in the room, who rush towards the stairs. The queen leaps up a moment later, but not to pursue your cousin or [rival.hisHer] brutal bodyguard: instead, she rushes to the side of the injured Queensguard, pressing her hands to her injured subject’s abdomen. “Damn them - damn them all,” Taivra grunts, ripping her cape off and tying it around the wounded knight’s injury. “Be still, dearest... the healers will be here soon.”
rows.translation: “追上他！”泰芙拉向房间里剩下的几名女猎手大喊，她们立刻冲向楼梯。女王紧接着也跃起，却不是追赶你的表亲或[rival.hisHer]凶悍保镖；她冲到受伤的女王卫士身旁，双手按住这名臣属受伤的腹部。“该死——他们全都该死，”泰芙拉闷哼着扯下披风，绑住负伤骑士的伤口。“别动，亲爱的……治疗师很快就会到。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“After him!” Taivra shouts at the handful of huntresses left in the room, who rush towards the stairs. The queen leaps up a moment later, but not to pursue your cousin or [rival.hisHer] brutal bodyguard: instead, she rushes to the side of the injured Queensguard, pressing her hands to her injured subject’s abdomen. “Damn them - damn them all,” Taivra grunts, ripping her cape off and tying it around the wounded knight’s injury. “Be still, dearest... the healers will be here soon.”"

rows.original: You hope so. The last thing you need is your partnership getting fucked up by your cousin - one more thorn in your side thanks to [rival.name]. While the going’s good, you hop over to the throne and touch your hand to the side of the probe, activating it. A holographic Steele Tech logo flashes across its flatscreen interface, followed by a data readout that your Codex parses into a download of coordinates - the next probe! You have what you need for your quest now, though you’ve signed away a little of yourself to get it. Maybe you should stick around and talk to your... your wife.
rows.translation: 但愿如此。你最不需要的，就是这段合作关系被表亲搞砸——[rival.name]又一次成了你眼中钉。趁局面尚可，你跳到王座旁，将手贴上探针侧面并启动它。全息斯蒂尔科技标志在平板界面上闪现，随后出现一组数据读数；你的法典将其解析为坐标下载——下一枚探针！如今你已经拿到完成任务所需的东西，尽管为此交出了自己的一小部分。也许你应该留下来，和你的……妻子谈谈。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hope so. The last thing you need is your partnership getting fucked up by your cousin - one more thorn in your side thanks to [rival.name]. While the going’s good, you hop over to the throne and touch your hand to the side of the probe, activating it. A holographic Steele Tech logo flashes across its flatscreen interface, followed by a data readout that your Codex parses into a download of coordinates - the next probe! You have what you need for your quest now, though you’ve signed away a little of yourself to get it. Maybe you should stick around and talk to your... your wife."

rows.original: Or get gone while the getting’s good.
rows.translation: 或者趁形势还好时赶紧离开。
rows.raw: "\n\nOr get gone while the getting’s good."

rows.original: (Perk Gained: Nyrean Royal - Reduces hostile nyrea attacks and deals increased tease damage to them!)
rows.translation: （获得专长：尼瑞亚王族——减少敌对尼瑞亚人的袭击，并提高对她们造成的挑逗伤害！）
rows.raw: "\n\n(Perk Gained: Nyrean Royal - Reduces hostile nyrea attacks and deals increased tease damage to them!)"

rows.original: Nyrean Royal
rows.raw: "Nyrean Royal"

rows.original: Reduces hostile nyrea attacks and deals increased tease damage to them!
rows.translation: 减少敌对尼瑞亚人的袭击，并提高对她们造成的挑逗伤害！
rows.raw: "Reduces hostile nyrea attacks and deals increased tease damage to them!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: and pulling you almost into her lap. “You have a remarkable dedication to peace, [pc.name]. Willing to give up so much power just to touch a stone... or have you just fallen in love at first sight, hmm?”
rows.translation: ，几乎将你拉进她怀中。“你对和平的执着真令人惊叹，[pc.name]。为了触碰一块石头，竟愿意放弃如此多的权力……还是说，你只是一见钟情了，嗯？”
rows.raw: " and pulling you almost into her lap. “You have a remarkable dedication to peace, [pc.name]. Willing to give up so much power just to touch a stone... or have you just fallen in love at first sight, hmm?”"

rows.original: You’re so close you could almost reach out and touch the probe. Instead, though, you cup the queen’s cheek and smile, drawing the two of you a little closer.
rows.translation: 你近得几乎伸手就能碰到探针。然而，你却捧住女王的脸颊，微笑着让彼此靠得更近。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re so close you could almost reach out and touch the probe. Instead, though, you cup the queen’s cheek and smile, drawing the two of you a little closer."

rows.original: “You are very impressive, [pc.name],” the nyrean queen smiles, letting you get as close as you like, until your [pc.lips] are almost touching her slender purple mouth. You feel her hand roaming across your body, exploring the form of her new lover for a moment before settling firmly on your crotch. “In many ways... so long as you will not begrudge me of my dalliances - and I of course will do the same - I believe we have an arrangement. One that, I hope, will be quite profitable... and pleasurable... for us both.”
rows.translation: “你确实令人印象深刻，[pc.name]，”尼瑞亚女王微笑着，任你想靠多近便靠多近，直到你的[pc.lips]几乎贴上她纤细的紫色嘴唇。你感觉她的手在你身上游走，片刻间探索着新情人的身体，最终牢牢停在你的胯间。“在许多方面都是……只要你不因我的风流韵事而怨恨我——我当然也会同样宽容你——那么我相信，我们已经达成协议。一份我希望能为双方带来丰厚利益……以及愉悦的协议。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You are very impressive, [pc.name],” the nyrean queen smiles, letting you get as close as you like, until your [pc.lips] are almost touching her slender purple mouth. You feel her hand roaming across your body, exploring the form of her new lover for a moment before settling firmly on your crotch. “In many ways... so long as you will not begrudge me of my dalliances - and I of course will do the same - I believe we have an arrangement. One that, I hope, will be quite profitable... and pleasurable... for us both.”"

rows.original: You lean in and kiss her, binding your fate with a woman you’ve only just met. You could have fought her, as you have many others before her. You might have even won. But somehow, you feel that you’ve found the lesser of every evil here today. And as Taivra said, you’ll be sure to make this relationship as pleasurable as you can - you think to yourself, as one of your hands snakes up her firm chest, dipping under the fur-lined mail of her top to squeeze a breast. Taivra moans softly, and your Codex chirps something about a new marriage license being ready at the nearest Confederate legal office. Wherever that is. For now, you’re content to enjoy the fruits of your new union.
rows.translation: 你倾身吻住她，将自己的命运与一个刚认识不久的女人绑在一起。你本可以像过去面对许多人那样与她战斗，甚至可能获胜。但不知为何，你觉得自己今天已经选中了诸多恶果中较轻的一个。正如泰芙拉所说，你会尽量让这段关系充满愉悦——你一边想着，一边把手探上她紧实的胸膛，伸进上衣带毛边的链甲下方，捏住一只乳房。泰芙拉轻声呻吟，你的法典则发出提示，表示最近的邦联法律事务所已经备好一份新婚姻许可。至于那事务所到底在哪儿，谁知道呢。此刻，你只想享受这场新结合的果实。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lean in and kiss her, binding your fate with a woman you’ve only just met. You could have fought her, as you have many others before her. You might have even won. But somehow, you feel that you’ve found the lesser of every evil here today. And as Taivra said, you’ll be sure to make this relationship as pleasurable as you can - you think to yourself, as one of your hands snakes up her firm chest, dipping under the fur-lined mail of her top to squeeze a breast. Taivra moans softly, and your Codex chirps something about a new marriage license being ready at the nearest Confederate legal office. Wherever that is. For now, you’re content to enjoy the fruits of your new union."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Partnership
rows.translation: 伴侣关系
rows.raw: "Partnership"

rows.original: Your father was the biggest interstellar playboy in the galaxy. He left a trail of lovers in his wake. What are you, if not your father’s child? You offered the nyrea partnership, so make it official: take Queen Taivra as your wife, with all the responsibility and vulnerability that brings.
rows.translation: 你的父亲是银河系里最大的星际花花公子，身后留下一长串情人。而你若不是父亲的孩子，又能是什么？你向尼瑞亚人提出了伴侣关系，那就让它正式生效：迎娶泰芙拉女王为妻，并承担随之而来的全部责任与弱点。
rows.raw: "Your father was the biggest interstellar playboy in the galaxy. He left a trail of lovers in his wake. What are you, if not your father’s child? You offered the nyrea partnership, so make it official: take Queen Taivra as your wife, with all the responsibility and vulnerability that brings."

rows.original: Princess
rows.translation: 公主
rows.raw: "Princess"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “How about I marry your daughter? She and I have already been introduced, and-”
rows.translation: “要不我娶你的女儿？我和她已经认识了，而且——”
rows.raw: "“How about I marry your daughter? She and I have already been introduced, and-”"

rows.original: “No,” Taivra snaps, narrowing her eyes. “Furthermore, I will have you flogged if you laid a hand on my daughter. Taivris may be the eldest of my brood, but as you may have noticed, [pc.name], I have a great many children. Several I will sire on you, in fact.”
rows.translation: “不行，”泰芙拉眯起眼睛，厉声打断。“再说，如果你碰过我女儿，我会下令鞭打你。泰芙瑞斯虽是我最年长的孩子，但你大概也注意到了，[pc.name]，我有许多子嗣。事实上，其中还会有几个由我在你身上播种。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No,” Taivra snaps, narrowing her eyes. “Furthermore, I will have you flogged if you laid a hand on my daughter. Taivris may be the eldest of my brood, but as you may have noticed, [pc.name], I have a great many children. Several I will sire on you, in fact.”"

rows.original: You blink.
rows.translation: 你眨了眨眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou blink."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Princess
rows.translation: 公主
rows.raw: "Princess"

rows.original: Offer to take the rambunctious princess under your care. Marry her, if you have to. Surely Taivra wouldn’t object to her daughter being at the side of a galactic super-star like you’ll soon be.
rows.translation: 提出照顾那位活泼莽撞的公主。必要的话，就娶了她。等你成为银河巨星后，让女儿陪在你身边，泰芙拉肯定不会反对。
rows.raw: "Offer to take the rambunctious princess under your care. Marry her, if you have to. Surely Taivra wouldn’t object to her daughter being at the side of a galactic super-star like you’ll soon be."

rows.original: Locked
rows.translation: 锁定
rows.raw: "Locked"

rows.original: Locked
rows.translation: 锁定
rows.raw: "Locked"

rows.original: You haven’t met who you need to meet to unlock this option.
rows.translation: 你还没有遇见解锁此选项所需的人。
rows.raw: "You haven’t met who you need to meet to unlock this option."

rows.original: Weapon
rows.translation: 武器
rows.raw: "Weapon"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “You’re a queen among a race that seems to me like it’s all about fighting. Fighting to mate, for dominance, for territory. Am I right?”
rows.translation: “你是一个似乎凡事都以战斗为中心的种族的女王。为交配而战、为支配权而战、为领地而战。我说得对吗？”
rows.raw: "“You’re a queen among a race that seems to me like it’s all about fighting. Fighting to mate, for dominance, for territory. Am I right?”"

rows.original: The queen gives you a slight, almost imperceptible nod. “I figured. But you carry spears and swords. The myrmedions above you have guns, they’ve got chemical weapons... even nukes, it looks like. That’s a hell of a difference in power. What if I arranged to have your people take delivery of a shipment of star-walker weapons: my father’s company has a whole line of non-military rifles and energy blades, perfectly legal for us to distribute to Rush-world races.”
rows.translation: 女王轻轻点头，动作小得几乎难以察觉。“我就知道。不过，你们用的是长矛和剑。你们头顶的密尔米顿人有枪，还有化学武器……看起来甚至有核武器。这力量差距可太大了。要是我安排你们的人接收一批星行者武器呢？我父亲的公司有一整条非军用步枪和能量刃产品线，完全可以合法分发给星球开拓潮世界的种族。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe queen gives you a slight, almost imperceptible nod. “I figured. But you carry spears and swords. The myrmedions above you have guns, they’ve got chemical weapons... even nukes, it looks like. That’s a hell of a difference in power. What if I arranged to have your people take delivery of a shipment of star-walker weapons: my father’s company has a whole line of non-military rifles and energy blades, perfectly legal for us to distribute to Rush-world races.”"

rows.original: Admittedly, you’ll be sacrificing your company payout from the probe for this, but hey. Better to leave heavily-armed friends behind than bitter enemies.
rows.translation: 诚然，你会为此放弃公司支付的探针回收报酬，不过无所谓。留下全副武装的朋友，总好过留下心怀怨恨的敌人。
rows.raw: "\n\nAdmittedly, you’ll be sacrificing your company payout from the probe for this, but hey. Better to leave heavily-armed friends behind than bitter enemies."

rows.original: “So how about it? I’ll need to take the probe, but after that, I think I can arrange a whole crate of laser pistols to be delivered to you. Sound good?”
rows.translation: “那么，意下如何？我得带走探针，但之后应该能安排人送一整箱激光手枪给你。听起来不错吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So how about it? I’ll need to take the probe, but after that, I think I can arrange a whole crate of laser pistols to be delivered to you. Sound good?”"

rows.original: The queen reclines, running a dark tongue across her purple lips. In his cage, Dane growls something about a “prime director” or some such, and how arming space barbarians with lasers will get you all killed.
rows.translation: 女王斜倚着，用深色舌头舔过紫色嘴唇。笼中的戴恩咕哝着什么“最高指令”之类的话，还说给太空蛮族配发激光武器会害死所有人。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe queen reclines, running a dark tongue across her purple lips. In his cage, Dane growls something about a “prime director” or some such, and how arming space barbarians with lasers will get you all killed."

rows.original: After a long moment of deliberation, the queen chuckles and clicks the butt of her spear against the stone dais under her. “You offer a compelling deal, but no. The moment this new government, the Scarlet Federation, hears about a group of nyrea with advanced weapons, we’ll have a battalion of soldiers knocking at our doors. They’ve pressganged thousands of nyrea from their home continent into service, as I understand. I can’t imagine they would make an exception for me, if they’ve already tamed more powerful nyrea warlords than me. I’d rather not draw attention to myself, at least not now.”
rows.translation: 女王沉思良久，随后轻笑一声，用长矛末端敲了敲身下高台的石面。“你的提议很诱人，但不行。这个新政府——猩红联邦——一旦听说有一群尼瑞亚人获得先进武器，就会有整营士兵找上门来。据我所知，他们已经强征了数千名尼瑞亚人离开故乡大陆服役。既然他们连比我更强大的尼瑞亚军阀都已驯服，我想不出他们会放过我的理由。我宁愿暂时不引人注目，至少现在如此。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a long moment of deliberation, the queen chuckles and clicks the butt of her spear against the stone dais under her. “You offer a compelling deal, but no. The moment this new government, the Scarlet Federation, hears about a group of nyrea with advanced weapons, we’ll have a battalion of soldiers knocking at our doors. They’ve pressganged thousands of nyrea from their home continent into service, as I understand. I can’t imagine they would make an exception for me, if they’ve already tamed more powerful nyrea warlords than me. I’d rather not draw attention to myself, at least not now.”"

rows.original: Damn, you were sure she’d go for that one...
rows.translation: 该死，你原以为她肯定会接受……
rows.raw: "\n\nDamn, you were sure she’d go for that one..."

rows.original: Weapons
rows.translation: 武器
rows.raw: "Weapons"

rows.original: Offer the nyrean queen futuristic weapons from Steele Tech. Imagine going from the literal stone age to rocking modern ray guns. Goodbye, balance of power... Though you’ll be trading your reward for recovering the probe in exchange for the guns.
rows.translation: 向尼瑞亚女王提供斯蒂尔科技的未来武器。想象一下，从货真价实的石器时代一跃拿起现代射线枪。力量平衡就此告别……不过，你会用回收探针的报酬换取这些枪械。
rows.raw: "Offer the nyrean queen futuristic weapons from Steele Tech. Imagine going from the literal stone age to rocking modern ray guns. Goodbye, balance of power... Though you’ll be trading your reward for recovering the probe in exchange for the guns."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: QUEENSGUARD
rows.raw: "QUEENSGUARD"

rows.original: Cage Distance
rows.raw: "Cage Distance"

rows.original: Icon_RadioSignal
rows.raw: "Icon_RadioSignal"

rows.original: You’re a good ways away from Dane and your cousin’s cage. It’ll take a lot of work to reposition yourself to break them out.
rows.translation: 你离戴恩和表亲的笼子相当远。若想重新移动到能救出他们的位置，得费上一番大力气。
rows.raw: "You’re a good ways away from Dane and your cousin’s cage. It’ll take a lot of work to reposition yourself to break them out."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: With a groan of pain, Queensguard collapses to a knee, barely keeping herself upright with all her weight on her blade. She glowers up at you through the slit in her visor, panting hard and coughing up blood into the steel helm.
rows.translation: 女王卫士痛苦地呻吟着跪倒在地，几乎把全身重量都压在剑上，才勉强维持直立。她透过面甲缝隙怒视着你，粗重喘息，咳出的鲜血溅进钢盔。
rows.raw: "With a groan of pain, Queensguard collapses to a knee, barely keeping herself upright with all her weight on her blade. She glowers up at you through the slit in her visor, panting hard and coughing up blood into the steel helm."

rows.original: “What... what are you!?” she stammers, trying and failing to stand again.
rows.translation: “你……你到底是什么！？”她结结巴巴地问，再次尝试站起，却仍未成功。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What... what are you!?” she stammers, trying and failing to stand again."

rows.original: Queensguard falls to her knees, the resistance bleeding out of her in pitiful moans as she clutches at her restrictive plate armor, trying to tear the metal from her flushed flesh.
rows.translation: 女王卫士跪倒在地，抵抗意志随着可怜的呻吟流逝。她抓扯着束缚身体的板甲，试图把金属从燥热的肌肤上扯下来。
rows.raw: "Queensguard falls to her knees, the resistance bleeding out of her in pitiful moans as she clutches at her restrictive plate armor, trying to tear the metal from her flushed flesh."

rows.original: “I... I can’t... I can’t...” she cries out, looking between you and her queen.
rows.translation: “我……我不行……我不能……”她哭喊着，目光在你与女王之间来回游移。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I... I can’t... I can’t...” she cries out, looking between you and her queen."

rows.original: “Enough!” Queen Taivra bellows, rising to her feet for the first time since you entered her throne room. Her towering longspear sweeps forward, levelling dead at your chest. The writhing mass of bodies surrounding Taivra’s throne all moan and cry out as the tentacle-cocks buried inside them shift with their queen.
rows.translation: “够了！”泰芙拉女王怒吼着，自你进入王座厅以来第一次站起身。她挥动高耸的长矛，矛尖直指你的胸膛。围绕泰芙拉王座纠缠成团的身体纷纷呻吟哭喊，因为埋在她们体内的触手肉棒随着女王一起移动。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Enough!” Queen Taivra bellows, rising to her feet for the first time since you entered her throne room. Her towering longspear sweeps forward, levelling dead at your chest. The writhing mass of bodies surrounding Taivra’s throne all moan and cry out as the tentacle-cocks buried inside them shift with their queen."

rows.original: The nyrea queen’s tentacles flare out behind her as she steps down from the dias. She gives her spear a menacing flourish, closing the distance with a fearsome confidence. <i>“Queensguard, stand down. It appears
rows.translation: 尼瑞亚女王走下高台，身后的触手扇形张开。她威吓般挥舞长矛，以令人胆寒的自信缩短距离。<i>“女王卫士，退下。看来
rows.raw: "\n\nThe nyrea queen’s tentacles flare out behind her as she steps down from the dias. She gives her spear a menacing flourish, closing the distance with a fearsome confidence. <i>“Queensguard, stand down. It appears "

rows.original: this off-worlder is too much for you.
rows.translation: 这个外来者对你而言太强了。
rows.raw: "this off-worlder is too much for you."

rows.original: these star-walkers truly have no honor.
rows.translation: 这些星行者果然毫无荣誉。
rows.raw: "these star-walkers truly have no honor."

rows.original: Very well, it’s been much too long since I’ve bloodied my spear.”
rows.translation: 很好，我的长矛已经太久没见血了。”
rows.raw: " Very well, it’s been much too long since I’ve bloodied my spear.”"

rows.original: “You won’t get the chance!” the over-sized ausar grunts.
rows.translation: “你不会有机会的！”那个身材魁梧的奥萨人闷声吼道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You won’t get the chance!” the over-sized ausar grunts."

rows.original: Cage Distance
rows.raw: "Cage Distance"

rows.original: TaivraFite
rows.raw: "TaivraFite"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: The queen stumbles back, jabbing the tip of her spear into the ground and leaning hard against it. “You... you fight like a beast,” the queen groans, barely standing. Her harem gasps in shock, clutching at the queen’s legs as Taivra struggles not to stumble.
rows.translation: 女王踉跄着后退，把矛尖扎进地面，重重倚在矛杆上。“你……你打起架来简直像头野兽，”女王呻吟着，勉强站立。她的后宫震惊地倒吸凉气，抱住泰芙拉的双腿，帮助她避免跌倒。
rows.raw: "The queen stumbles back, jabbing the tip of her spear into the ground and leaning hard against it. “You... you fight like a beast,” the queen groans, barely standing. Her harem gasps in shock, clutching at the queen’s legs as Taivra struggles not to stumble."

rows.original: “I yield, offworlder. I yield,” she sighs, letting her spear clatter to the ground at your [pc.footOrFeet]. Without the long shaft to support her, Taivra slumps to the ground, sitting down at the edge of her throne’s dais. All of a sudden, the once-proud warrior queen looks a lot less self-assured. Almost humble in her defeat.
rows.translation: “我投降，外来者。我投降，”她叹息着，任由长矛哐当落在你的[pc.footOrFeet]旁。失去长杆支撑，泰芙拉瘫坐在王座高台边缘。顷刻间，这位一度骄傲的战士女王显得不再那么自信，甚至在败北中透出几分谦卑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I yield, offworlder. I yield,” she sighs, letting her spear clatter to the ground at your [pc.footOrFeet]. Without the long shaft to support her, Taivra slumps to the ground, sitting down at the edge of her throne’s dais. All of a sudden, the once-proud warrior queen looks a lot less self-assured. Almost humble in her defeat."

rows.original: You hear a shout behind you. Grabbing your [pc.weapon], you spin around just in time to see Dane pulling [rival.name] through the curtain towards the palace’s gates. Shit! Some of the guards try and grab them, but the towering ausar throws them aside like grainsacks, and all you see is your erstwhile battle partner’s bare ass and tail bursting through the curtains.
rows.translation: 你听见身后传来一声喊叫。你抓起[pc.weapon]猛然转身，正好看见戴恩拉着[rival.name]穿过帘幕，朝宫殿大门逃去。该死！几名守卫试图抓住他们，可那个高大的奥萨人像扔谷物袋一样将她们甩开；你最后只看见昔日战友赤裸的屁股与尾巴冲出帘幕后消失。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hear a shout behind you. Grabbing your [pc.weapon], you spin around just in time to see Dane pulling [rival.name] through the curtain towards the palace’s gates. Shit! Some of the guards try and grab them, but the towering ausar throws them aside like grainsacks, and all you see is your erstwhile battle partner’s bare ass and tail bursting through the curtains."

rows.original: You sigh. Can’t leave the nyrea to go after them... not unless you want a repeat fight when you get back. You’ll have to settle up now, while you still can.
rows.translation: 你叹了口气。你不能把尼瑞亚人丢下去追他们……除非你想回来后再打一场。你必须趁现在把事情解决。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sigh. Can’t leave the nyrea to go after them... not unless you want a repeat fight when you get back. You’ll have to settle up now, while you still can."

rows.original: You turn back to Taivra, and find that she’s dragged her injured bodyguard over to her: she’s pulled Queensguard’s helmet off and rested the knight’s head in her lap, stroking her black hair with one hand and binding her wounds with the other.
rows.translation: 你转向泰芙拉，发现她已经把受伤的保镖拖到身旁：她摘下女王卫士的头盔，让骑士枕在自己腿上，一只手抚摸她的黑发，另一只手包扎伤口。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou turn back to Taivra, and find that she’s dragged her injured bodyguard over to her: she’s pulled Queensguard’s helmet off and rested the knight’s head in her lap, stroking her black hair with one hand and binding her wounds with the other."

rows.original: As you’re thinking of all the things you could do with the beaten queen, you hear a roar and the rending of steel behind you. You [pc.readyWeapon] and spin around, just in time to see Queensguard lurching to her feet with sword drawn... and Dane looming over her, putting himself between you and the nyrea and your cousin as [rival.heShe] makes a break for the door.
rows.translation: 就在你思考能对战败的女王做些什么时，身后传来怒吼与钢铁撕裂声。你[pc.readyWeapon]并转过身，正好看见女王卫士拔剑踉跄起身……而戴恩高高站在她面前，将自己挡在你、尼瑞亚人与你表亲之间；与此同时，[rival.heShe]正冲向门口逃跑。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you’re thinking of all the things you could do with the beaten queen, you hear a roar and the rending of steel behind you. You [pc.readyWeapon] and spin around, just in time to see Queensguard lurching to her feet with sword drawn... and Dane looming over her, putting himself between you and the nyrea and your cousin as [rival.heShe] makes a break for the door."

rows.original: The alabaster ausar is utterly naked, stripped of his gear and bruised from his capture, but he’s grinning like a mad dog all the same. The veins on his arms bulge as he flexes his corded muscles, holding torn bits of his cage like daggers. “You should’ve killed me when you had the chance. This time you won’t get a chance to jump me in the dark.”
rows.translation: 这个雪白毛发的奥萨人一丝不挂，装备全被剥走，身上还带着被俘后留下的淤伤，可他仍像条疯狗一样咧嘴狞笑。随着他绷紧结实的肌肉，手臂上的血管高高鼓起，手中像匕首一样握着从笼子上撕下的金属碎片。“你有机会时就该杀了我。这次你可没机会在黑暗中偷袭我了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe alabaster ausar is utterly naked, stripped of his gear and bruised from his capture, but he’s grinning like a mad dog all the same. The veins on his arms bulge as he flexes his corded muscles, holding torn bits of his cage like daggers. “You should’ve killed me when you had the chance. This time you won’t get a chance to jump me in the dark.”"

rows.original: “Slaves should learn their place,” Queensguard answers, lowering her shield into place and readying her sword. “If they cannot fathom that, then they will be fed to the deeps, piece by piece.” She advances steadily, one plated boot in front of the other warily moving to intercept Dane. Looks like she’s already recovered from your battle.
rows.translation: “奴隶就该学会自己的位置，”女王卫士回答着，放低盾牌摆好架势，同时举剑待战。“若是连这都无法理解，就该一块一块地拿去喂给深渊。”她稳步上前，覆甲长靴谨慎地交替迈进，准备拦住戴恩。看来她已经从与你的战斗中恢复了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Slaves should learn their place,” Queensguard answers, lowering her shield into place and readying her sword. “If they cannot fathom that, then they will be fed to the deeps, piece by piece.” She advances steadily, one plated boot in front of the other warily moving to intercept Dane. Looks like she’s already recovered from your battle."

rows.original: “That’s all you’ve got? Not even a gun?” Dane grins, cracking a pair of his knuckles.
rows.translation: “你就只有这点东西？连把枪都没有？”戴恩咧嘴一笑，掰响了两根指关节。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s all you’ve got? Not even a gun?” Dane grins, cracking a pair of his knuckles."

rows.original: Confusion briefly crosses Queensguard’s face. “You are naked with naught but a shard of steel. I have no need of a dishonorable star-blaster.”
rows.translation: 女王卫士脸上短暂掠过一丝困惑。“你赤身裸体，手中只有一块钢铁碎片。我根本不需要什么有失荣誉的星际爆能枪。”
rows.raw: "\n\nConfusion briefly crosses Queensguard’s face. “You are naked with naught but a shard of steel. I have no need of a dishonorable star-blaster.”"

rows.original: “If you had a gun, you might have had a chance.”
rows.translation: “要是你有枪，或许还会有点机会。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“If you had a gun, you might have had a chance.”"

rows.original: You wouldn’t have thought a guy as big as Dane could lunge so far and so fast if you hadn’t tangled with him once already, and the armored nyrea clearly doesn’t share that experience. She only has time for her eyes to widen in surprise before Dane crashes into her in a flash of albino fur and pounding fists, driving her back half a pace. The broken chunk of metal bends on impact with her armor-plated side, visibly denting the plate. Knuckles deflect off Queensguard’s helm, leaving lines of blood behind where the sharp metal ripped into Dane’s knuckles.
rows.translation: 倘若你之前没有和戴恩交过手，恐怕绝不会相信他这么高大的家伙竟能扑得如此远、如此快；而那个身披铠甲的尼瑞亚人显然也没有这种经验。她只来得及惊讶地睁大眼睛，戴恩便化作一团白化皮毛与重拳组成的疾影撞上她，将她逼退半步。断裂的金属块砸中她铠甲覆盖的侧身时弯曲变形，甲片上肉眼可见地凹了下去。拳头撞在女王卫士的头盔上偏开，锋利的金属割破戴恩的指节，在其上留下道道血痕。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wouldn’t have thought a guy as big as Dane could lunge so far and so fast if you hadn’t tangled with him once already, and the armored nyrea clearly doesn’t share that experience. She only has time for her eyes to widen in surprise before Dane crashes into her in a flash of albino fur and pounding fists, driving her back half a pace. The broken chunk of metal bends on impact with her armor-plated side, visibly denting the plate. Knuckles deflect off Queensguard’s helm, leaving lines of blood behind where the sharp metal ripped into Dane’s knuckles."

rows.original: For all his power and speed, it’s clear that your cousin’s bodyguard is more a brawler than a trained fighter. He doesn’t try to avoid harrowing slashes from Queensguard’s sword, relying on the awkward positioning to rob the strength from her blows and his thick fur to keep her from cutting too deeply. Dane’s left forearms are soon matted red with blood from a half-dozen surface cuts, but none so deep as to stop him from grabbing hold of his foe’s shield in two hands, wrenching it powerfully to the side.
rows.translation: 尽管力量强大、速度惊人，你表亲的保镖显然更像个街头斗士，而不是训练有素的战士。他根本不试图躲避女王卫士长剑令人胆寒的劈砍，而是依靠别扭的站位削弱她出招的力道，再用厚实的毛皮避免伤口切得太深。戴恩左侧几条手臂很快便被六七道表层割伤流出的鲜血染红，但没有一道深到足以阻止他用两只手抓住对手的盾牌，强有力地将其扯向一旁。
rows.raw: "\n\nFor all his power and speed, it’s clear that your cousin’s bodyguard is more a brawler than a trained fighter. He doesn’t try to avoid harrowing slashes from Queensguard’s sword, relying on the awkward positioning to rob the strength from her blows and his thick fur to keep her from cutting too deeply. Dane’s left forearms are soon matted red with blood from a half-dozen surface cuts, but none so deep as to stop him from grabbing hold of his foe’s shield in two hands, wrenching it powerfully to the side."

rows.original: Queensguard is no brawler. She’s a fighter, used to tackling her Queen’s enemies in one on one confrontations. She lets her arm slide out of the shield’s strap and spins with the momentum, twisting around for a vicious, back-handed slice. A diagonal rent opens up across Dane’s chest, deep enough to reveal two or three blood-drenched bones but not quite deep enough to bring down the mighty ausar. His rage filled blood leaves steaming, crimson puddles on the ground between them.
rows.translation: 女王卫士不是街头斗士。她是一名战士，习惯在一对一的交锋中迎战女王的敌人。她任由手臂从盾牌绑带中滑脱，借着惯性旋身，使出狠辣的反手斩击。戴恩胸前被斜着劈开一道裂口，深得足以露出两三根浸满鲜血的骨头，却还不足以击倒这个强大的奥萨人。他那满载愤怒的鲜血在两人之间的地面上汇成冒着热气的猩红水洼。
rows.raw: "\n\nQueensguard is no brawler. She’s a fighter, used to tackling her Queen’s enemies in one on one confrontations. She lets her arm slide out of the shield’s strap and spins with the momentum, twisting around for a vicious, back-handed slice. A diagonal rent opens up across Dane’s chest, deep enough to reveal two or three blood-drenched bones but not quite deep enough to bring down the mighty ausar. His rage filled blood leaves steaming, crimson puddles on the ground between them."

rows.original: Dane staggers a half-step back from the pain, but he doesn’t drop the shield. He leans further back, sweeping the shield up and into the underside of Queensguard’s polished blade. The clang of metal on metal reverberates through the cavernous chamber as the two bodyguards struggle. The nyrea barely keeps her grip on her weapon, but Dane never needed to disarm her, just take away her biggest defense - the shield - and open her up to a strike.
rows.translation: 戴恩因疼痛踉跄着退了半步，却没有丢下盾牌。他把身体进一步向后仰，挥起盾牌撞向女王卫士那把锃亮长剑的下侧。金属撞击的铿锵声回荡在洞窟般宽阔的大厅里，两名保镖奋力角逐。尼瑞亚人勉强没有让武器脱手，可戴恩压根不需要夺走她的剑，只要拿走她最大的防御，也就是那面盾牌，让她门户大开，便足以发动攻击。
rows.raw: "\n\nDane staggers a half-step back from the pain, but he doesn’t drop the shield. He leans further back, sweeping the shield up and into the underside of Queensguard’s polished blade. The clang of metal on metal reverberates through the cavernous chamber as the two bodyguards struggle. The nyrea barely keeps her grip on her weapon, but Dane never needed to disarm her, just take away her biggest defense - the shield - and open her up to a strike."

rows.original: The metal chunk flashes as Dane’s fist carries it forward into the dented section of the nyrea’s armor. The impact reminds you of the sound of the industrial steel punches in one of your father’s factories. Dane’s hand comes away empty, the only evidence of his strike a rent in his foe’s armor and a protruding bit of wood. Thick purple blood oozes down the plate covering Queensguard’s legs, staining them with visible defeat.
rows.translation: 戴恩的拳头带着金属碎片一闪而过，刺向尼瑞亚人铠甲上凹陷的部位。撞击声让你想起父亲某座工厂里的工业钢冲床。戴恩收回空空如也的手，只有敌人铠甲上破开的裂口和露在外面的一小截木头证明他刚才的攻击。浓稠的紫色鲜血沿着覆盖女王卫士双腿的甲片向下流淌，以肉眼可见的败象染污了它们。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe metal chunk flashes as Dane’s fist carries it forward into the dented section of the nyrea’s armor. The impact reminds you of the sound of the industrial steel punches in one of your father’s factories. Dane’s hand comes away empty, the only evidence of his strike a rent in his foe’s armor and a protruding bit of wood. Thick purple blood oozes down the plate covering Queensguard’s legs, staining them with visible defeat."

rows.original: “Told you that you should’ve brought a gun,” Dane snarls, kicking the nyrea square in the chest. She drops like a sack of bricks and curls into a ball, wincing from what must be terrible abdominal pain. “Musta ruptured something other than your sperm sacks, huh? I guess not all the male nyrea get off on penetration.”
rows.translation: “早说了你该带把枪，”戴恩咆哮着，一脚正中尼瑞亚人的胸口。她像一袋砖头似的倒下，蜷成一团，显然在忍受可怕的腹部剧痛。“看来除了储精囊之外，你还把别的什么东西弄破了，对吧？看来并非所有雄性尼瑞亚人都能从被插入中获得快感。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Told you that you should’ve brought a gun,” Dane snarls, kicking the nyrea square in the chest. She drops like a sack of bricks and curls into a ball, wincing from what must be terrible abdominal pain. “Musta ruptured something other than your sperm sacks, huh? I guess not all the male nyrea get off on penetration.”"

rows.original: Dane doesn’t look much better off, but he’s still standing, somehow. He slips the shield onto his lower left arm and starts backpedaling as the queen screams and her remaining betas leap towards the ausar with vengeance on their minds. Dane grunts and falls back, covering your cousin’s escape until they’re both through the curtain and out of sight.
rows.translation: 戴恩的情况看起来也好不到哪去，但不知怎的，他仍然站着。他把盾牌套到左下臂上，开始后退；女王发出尖叫，剩下的贝塔们满怀复仇之意扑向奥萨人。戴恩闷哼着向后退却，掩护你的表亲逃跑，直到两人都穿过帘幕，消失在视野中。
rows.raw: "\n\nDane doesn’t look much better off, but he’s still standing, somehow. He slips the shield onto his lower left arm and starts backpedaling as the queen screams and her remaining betas leap towards the ausar with vengeance on their minds. Dane grunts and falls back, covering your cousin’s escape until they’re both through the curtain and out of sight."

rows.original: You can’t even go after them - not unless you want a repeat fight when you get back. You’ll have to settle up now, and wait to deal with [rival.name] until another time...
rows.translation: 你甚至没法追赶他们——除非你想回来后再打一场。你必须先把这里的事情解决，等以后再处理[rival.name]……
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t even go after them - not unless you want a repeat fight when you get back. You’ll have to settle up now, and wait to deal with [rival.name] until another time..."

rows.original: Cursing, you put your weapon away and turn back to Taivra. She’s pulled Queensguard’s helmet off and rested the knight’s head in her lap, stroking her black hair with one hand and binding her wounds with the other.
rows.translation: 你咒骂着收起武器，转身回到泰芙拉身边。她已经摘下女王卫士的头盔，让骑士的脑袋枕在自己腿上，一手轻抚她的黑发，另一手包扎她的伤口。
rows.raw: "\n\nCursing, you put your weapon away and turn back to Taivra. She’s pulled Queensguard’s helmet off and rested the knight’s head in her lap, stroking her black hair with one hand and binding her wounds with the other."

rows.original: “Be still, dear,” the queen whispers to her bodyguard, stroking the warrior’s hair. “It’s not as bad as you think.”
rows.translation: “别动，亲爱的，”女王低声对她的护卫说道，轻抚着战士的秀发。“没你想的那么严重。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Be still, dear,” the queen whispers to her bodyguard, stroking the warrior’s hair. “It’s not as bad as you think.”"

rows.original: Glancing up at you, Taivra sighs wearily. “I clearly underestimated you, [pc.name]. And the ruthlessness of your cousin’s guardian. A mistake I will not make again. But for now, I am at your mercy. Let my people go unharmed, and I will do whatever you wish.”
rows.translation: 泰芙拉抬眼看向你，疲惫地叹息。“显然，我低估了你，[pc.name]。也低估了你表亲的守护者有多狠辣。这个错误我不会再犯。但现在，我任你处置。只要你不伤害我的人民，我愿意满足你的任何要求。”
rows.raw: "\n\nGlancing up at you, Taivra sighs wearily. “I clearly underestimated you, [pc.name]. And the ruthlessness of your cousin’s guardian. A mistake I will not make again. But for now, I am at your mercy. Let my people go unharmed, and I will do whatever you wish.”"

rows.original: First thing’s first: you step past the defeated nyrea and plant your hand on the probe, letting it read your DNA and confirm you as its rightful owner. Your Codex receives a data transfer a moment later, loaded out with the next set of coordinates you need to continue your quest! Now that you have what you need, what do you do with the nyrea...?
rows.translation: 首先要做的事显而易见：你跨过战败的尼瑞亚人，将手按在探测器上，让它读取你的DNA，确认你才是它的合法主人。片刻后，你的宝典收到一份数据传输，里面载有继续任务所需的下一组坐标！既然已经拿到需要的东西，你要怎么处置这些尼瑞亚人...？
rows.raw: "\n\nFirst thing’s first: you step past the defeated nyrea and plant your hand on the probe, letting it read your DNA and confirm you as its rightful owner. Your Codex receives a data transfer a moment later, loaded out with the next set of coordinates you need to continue your quest! Now that you have what you need, what do you do with the nyrea...?"

rows.original: Fuck Taivra
rows.translation: 干泰芙拉
rows.raw: "Fuck Taivra"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.translation: “当然，[pc.name]，”她翻身仰躺，低声说道。你瞥了她一眼，气势汹汹地抓起她的长矛——若有什么能让你的胜利更加确凿，那便是夺走对手的武器。你浑身精液，踉跄着朝门口走了几步，她终于在身后喊道，答应会履行你的要求。你笑了笑，转身离开。你一路走出宫殿，经过大门处的哨所，回到幽深洞穴，再也没有任何东西胆敢阻拦。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course, [pc.name],” she murmurs, rolling onto her back. You shoot her a look, and indignantly grab her spear - if there’s one thing to cement your victory, it’s capturing your opponent’s weapon. You take a few cum-sodden steps towards the door before she finally calls after you that she’ll honor your request. You smile, and out you go. Nothing else dares to oppose you as you make your way out of the palace, back past the guard post at the gate and out into the deep caves."

rows.original: Time to find out what your dad has in store for you next!
rows.translation: 该去看看父亲下一步为你准备了什么！
rows.raw:
"

Time to find out what your dad has in store for you next!

"

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “I don’t want anything from you,” you say simply, turning to leave.
rows.translation: “我什么都不想从你这里得到，”你简短地说道，转身离开。
rows.raw: "“I don’t want anything from you,” you say simply, turning to leave."

rows.original: “It didn’t have to end this way.”
rows.translation: “事情本不必变成这样。”
rows.raw: " “It didn’t have to end this way.”"

rows.original: “Surprising,” the queen says, her tone unreadable. “Thank you, [pc.name]. You are more... magnanimous than I would have expected. More than I would have been, in your shoes. I offer you my spear, if you’d have it. A token of my thanks. It has served me well through two decades of battle. May it find your cousin’s heart someday.”
rows.translation: “真令人意外，”女王说道，语气令人捉摸不透。“谢谢你，[pc.name]。你比我预想的更加...宽宏大量。若我身处你的境地，恐怕也做不到这一点。如果你愿意，我想把自己的长矛送给你，聊表谢意。它随我征战二十载，一直忠实可靠。愿有朝一日，它能刺进你堂亲的心脏。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Surprising,” the queen says, her tone unreadable. “Thank you, [pc.name]. You are more... magnanimous than I would have expected. More than I would have been, in your shoes. I offer you my spear, if you’d have it. A token of my thanks. It has served me well through two decades of battle. May it find your cousin’s heart someday.”"

rows.original: A generous gift indeed. You pick up Taivra’s spear from the dias and give it an experimental twirl before tucking it under your arm. A fine weapon, indeed.
rows.translation: 这的确是一份厚礼。你从高台上拿起泰芙拉的长矛，试着挥舞几圈后，将它夹在腋下。的确是一把好武器。
rows.raw: "\n\nA generous gift indeed. You pick up Taivra’s spear from the dias and give it an experimental twirl before tucking it under your arm. A fine weapon, indeed."

rows.original: “Have your people take the probe into the village. My company will retrieve it there,” you instruct.
rows.translation: “让你的人把探针送到村子里。我的队伍会在那里取走它，”你吩咐道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Have your people take the probe into the village. My company will retrieve it there,” you instruct."

rows.original: You give the queen a curt nod and stride out of the room, making your way back out of the nyrean palace and back to the deep caves.
rows.translation: 你朝女王简短地点了点头，大步离开房间，走出尼瑞安人的宫殿，回到幽深洞穴。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give the queen a curt nod and stride out of the room, making your way back out of the nyrean palace and back to the deep caves."

rows.original: Time to see what the next planet has in store!
rows.translation: 该看看下一颗星球为你准备了什么！
rows.raw:
"

Time to see what the next planet has in store!

"

rows.original: ACH_MYRELLIONPROBE
rows.raw: "ACH_MYRELLIONPROBE"

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: You don’t need anything else from the nyrea. Take your leave.
rows.translation: 你不再需要尼瑞亚人提供任何东西。转身离开。
rows.raw: "You don’t need anything else from the nyrea. Take your leave."

rows.original: QUEEN TAIVRA
rows.raw: "QUEEN TAIVRA"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You stagger back under the armored nyrea’s rain of blows, desperately dodging sword swipes and shield strikes until your [pc.foot] catches on an uneven stone and suddenly you’re falling back, screaming until your head cracks on the rocky floor. Your world spins, vision erupting in stars; your [pc.weapon] is kicked painfully from your hands by ruthless steel. When your vision clears, you see the lethal point of Queensguard’s blade leveled at your throat, a hair’s breadth from slicing you open.
rows.translation: 你在全副武装的尼瑞亚人狂风暴雨般的攻击下踉跄后退，拼命躲避剑砍盾击；直到你的[pc.foot]绊上凹凸不平的石块，整个人突然向后倒去，一路尖叫着让脑袋重重撞上岩石地面。你的世界天旋地转，视野中群星迸现；无情的钢铁一脚踢飞你的[pc.weapon]，痛得你手掌发麻。视线恢复清晰时，你看到王卫的剑尖正对准你的喉咙，离剖开你只差分毫。
rows.raw: "You stagger back under the armored nyrea’s rain of blows, desperately dodging sword swipes and shield strikes until your [pc.foot] catches on an uneven stone and suddenly you’re falling back, screaming until your head cracks on the rocky floor. Your world spins, vision erupting in stars; your [pc.weapon] is kicked painfully from your hands by ruthless steel. When your vision clears, you see the lethal point of Queensguard’s blade leveled at your throat, a hair’s breadth from slicing you open."

rows.original: “Yield,” she growls from beneath her helm. “Yield or die.”
rows.translation: “投降，”她在头盔下低吼。“投降，否则就死。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yield,” she growls from beneath her helm. “Yield or die.”"

rows.original: You raise your hands, admitting your defeat. Queensguard gives you a slight, almost imperceptible nod, and several of the queen’s other soldiers rush out from the shadows to grab your [pc.gear], stripping you of all your equipment. A moment later and you’re left completely naked, shivering in the subterranean cold. A pair of soldiers heft you up and drag you forward as Queensguard steps dutifully aside, leaving you to face the queen.
rows.translation: 你举起双手承认落败。王卫朝你微微点头，动作轻得几乎难以察觉；女王麾下另外几名士兵从阴影中冲出，夺走你的[pc.gear]，把所有装备尽数剥去。片刻后，你已浑身赤裸，在地下的寒冷中瑟瑟发抖。两名士兵架起你向前拖去，王卫尽职地退到一旁，让你独自面对女王。
rows.raw:
"

You raise your hands, admitting your defeat. Queensguard gives you a slight, almost imperceptible nod, and several of the queen’s other soldiers rush out from the shadows to grab your [pc.gear], stripping you of all your equipment. A moment later and you’re left completely naked, shivering in the subterranean cold. A pair of soldiers heft you up and drag you forward as Queensguard steps dutifully aside, leaving you to face the queen.

"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: The queen fights like a woman possessed ,driving you back with her spear until you’re tumbling off the dias, falling back with a scream. Your cousin shouts at you, but [rival.hisHer] words are lost as your head cracks on the stone, and a moment later, Taivra comes crashing down on you with her knee, pinning you down as her spear presses firmly against your throat.
rows.translation: 女王如同着了魔般战斗，用长矛逼得你连连后退，直到你从高台边缘翻落，尖叫着向后摔去。你的堂亲朝你大喊，但[rival.hisHer]的话语在你的脑袋撞上石面时消失无踪；片刻后，泰芙拉一膝重重压在你身上，把你按倒在地，长矛牢牢抵住你的喉咙。
rows.raw: "The queen fights like a woman possessed ,driving you back with her spear until you’re tumbling off the dias, falling back with a scream. Your cousin shouts at you, but [rival.hisHer] words are lost as your head cracks on the stone, and a moment later, Taivra comes crashing down on you with her knee, pinning you down as her spear presses firmly against your throat."

rows.original: “You fight well, [pc.name],” she purrs, her knee pushing painfully into your gut. “And honorably, too. You’ve impressed me, star-walker. More than I thought one of your kind could have.”
rows.translation: “你打得不错，[pc.name]，”她低声说道，膝盖痛苦地压进你的腹部。“而且也很光明磊落。你给我留下了深刻印象，星行者。远超我对你们这种人的预期。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You fight well, [pc.name],” she purrs, her knee pushing painfully into your gut. “And honorably, too. You’ve impressed me, star-walker. More than I thought one of your kind could have.”"

rows.original: She smiles, and her knees shift, moving to straddle you more than just pin you down. “There’s a place by my side in the harem I’ve never been able to fill. Yield to me, [pc.name]. Swear fealty, and I will guarantee you a kingly life at my side.”
rows.translation: 她微微一笑，移动双膝，不再只是把你压住，而是跨坐到了你身上。“我的后宫里一直有个我无法填补的位置，就在我身边。向我投降吧，[pc.name]。宣誓效忠，我保证让你在我身边过上王者般的生活。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe smiles, and her knees shift, moving to straddle you more than just pin you down. “There’s a place by my side in the harem I’ve never been able to fill. Yield to me, [pc.name]. Swear fealty, and I will guarantee you a kingly life at my side.”"

rows.original: Given the choice of death or nobility, the choice isn’t much of one at all. You let go of your weapon and show your empty hands to the queen. Her smile widens, and she rises to her feet. “A wise choice, [pc.name].” She offers you a hand up, and a moment later you’re being hauled up and into the queen’s arms. Her hands wrap around your [pc.hips], and you’re suddenly aware of the heat of her body pressing against you, the sweat-sheened flesh and polished chitin as alluring as they are intimidating.
rows.translation: 既然选择只有死亡或成为贵族，那其实根本算不上选择。你放开武器，向女王亮出空空的双手。她的笑容更加灿烂，随即站起身来。“明智的选择，[pc.name]。”她伸手拉你起来；片刻后，你便被她拽进怀中。她的双手环住你的[pc.hips]，你骤然感受到她贴上来的身体热度，覆着汗光的肌肤与光滑甲壳既诱人又令人胆寒。
rows.raw: "\n\nGiven the choice of death or nobility, the choice isn’t much of one at all. You let go of your weapon and show your empty hands to the queen. Her smile widens, and she rises to her feet. “A wise choice, [pc.name].” She offers you a hand up, and a moment later you’re being hauled up and into the queen’s arms. Her hands wrap around your [pc.hips], and you’re suddenly aware of the heat of her body pressing against you, the sweat-sheened flesh and polished chitin as alluring as they are intimidating."

rows.original: “A wise choice indeed,” Queen Taivra purrs, gesturing at her soldiers behind you. The nyrean guards grab Queensguard and drag her off to be tended to, and others gather around your cousin in [rival.hisHer] cage.
rows.translation: “确实是明智的选择，”泰芙拉女王低声说道，朝你身后的士兵做了个手势。尼瑞安守卫抓住王卫，把她拖走接受治疗；另一些人则围住[rival.hisHer]笼中的堂亲。
rows.raw: "\n\n“A wise choice indeed,” Queen Taivra purrs, gesturing at her soldiers behind you. The nyrean guards grab Queensguard and drag her off to be tended to, and others gather around your cousin in [rival.hisHer] cage."

rows.original: “Let go of me!” [rival.name] shrieks as [rival.heShe] is dragged out of the cage, kicking and screaming.
rows.translation: “放开我！”[rival.name]在[rival.heShe]被拖出笼子时尖声大喊，拼命踢打挣扎。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Let go of me!” [rival.name] shrieks as [rival.heShe] is dragged out of the cage, kicking and screaming."

rows.original: The queen turns to you, one of her fingers
rows.translation: 女王转向你，用一根手指
rows.raw: "\n\nThe queen turns to you, one of her fingers "

rows.original: wiping the blood from a small cut her dancing spear has left on your shoulder
rows.translation: 抹去她飞舞的长矛在你肩头留下的小伤口中的鲜血
rows.raw: "wiping the blood from a small cut her dancing spear has left on your shoulder"

rows.original: teasing across one of your [pc.lips], gently turning your attention towards your struggling cousin.
rows.translation: 挑逗般划过你的[pc.lips]，轻轻把你的注意力引向正在挣扎的堂亲。
rows.raw: "teasing across one of your [pc.lips], gently turning your attention towards your struggling cousin."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Kill [rival.himHer],” you say, sneering at your helpless cousin.
rows.translation: “杀了[rival.himHer]，”你冷笑着看向束手无策的堂亲，说道。
rows.raw: "“Kill [rival.himHer],” you say, sneering at your helpless cousin."

rows.original: Taivra chuckles and nods at a couple of her soldiers, who latch their arms on [rival.name]’s shoulder and start to pull [rival.himHer] away. “Good choice, my new mate... better to have your rivals killed than risk their coming back to harm you later. I’ll have gallows erected in the village, and we’ll dispose of this worm.”
rows.translation: 泰芙拉轻笑一声，朝两名士兵点头示意；她们牢牢扣住[rival.name]的肩膀，开始把[rival.himHer]拖走。“选得好，我的新配偶...与其冒险让对手日后回来伤害你，不如直接杀掉。我会命人在村里竖起绞架，处置掉这条虫子。”
rows.raw: "\n\nTaivra chuckles and nods at a couple of her soldiers, who latch their arms on [rival.name]’s shoulder and start to pull [rival.himHer] away. “Good choice, my new mate... better to have your rivals killed than risk their coming back to harm you later. I’ll have gallows erected in the village, and we’ll dispose of this worm.”"

rows.original: [rival.name] screams a host of profanities, but is helpless to resist as [rival.heShe]’s dragged away to [rival.hisHer] doom. Taivra’s hand tightens around your waist as your rival is dragged off, until it’s almost painful. “Now then, I believe it’s time you paid your fealty to me...”
rows.translation: [rival.name]破口大骂，却无力反抗，只能在[rival.heShe]被拖向[rival.hisHer]的末路时徒劳挣扎。你的对手被带走时，泰芙拉搂住你腰间的手越收越紧，几乎让你感到疼痛。“好了，我想现在该由你向我献上忠诚了...”
rows.raw: "\n\n[rival.name] screams a host of profanities, but is helpless to resist as [rival.heShe]’s dragged away to [rival.hisHer] doom. Taivra’s hand tightens around your waist as your rival is dragged off, until it’s almost painful. “Now then, I believe it’s time you paid your fealty to me...”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “You nyrea like planting your eggs in people, don’t you?” you say with a mischievous grin, looking your cousin’s lithe form up and down. “I think [rival.name] here would look a lot better with a belly full of eggs... for the rest of [rival.hisHer] life.”
rows.translation: “你们尼瑞亚人喜欢把卵种进别人体内，对吧？”你顽皮地咧嘴一笑，上下打量堂亲苗条的身体。“我觉得要是[rival.name]从此让[rival.hisHer]一辈子都挺着塞满虫卵的肚子...一定会好看得多。”
rows.raw: "“You nyrea like planting your eggs in people, don’t you?” you say with a mischievous grin, looking your cousin’s lithe form up and down. “I think [rival.name] here would look a lot better with a belly full of eggs... for the rest of [rival.hisHer] life.”"

rows.original: Taivra chuckles, <i>“
rows.translation: 泰芙拉轻笑道：<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nTaivra chuckles, <i>“"

rows.original: Many sired by you, I’m sure.
rows.translation: 我相信其中许多都会由你播种。
rows.raw: "Many sired by you, I’m sure."

rows.original: Perhaps you’d rather your cousin bear your burden of eggs? A fitting fate, I suppose.
rows.translation: 还是说，你更希望让堂亲替你承担孕育虫卵的重任？我想这也算是个合适的结局。
rows.raw: "Perhaps you’d rather your cousin bear your burden of eggs? A fitting fate, I suppose."

rows.original: Very well, I will order [rival.himHer] bathed and set aside with the rest of my favored incubators. A better life that that worm deserves, but one that is at least productive. You are both wise and magnanimous, my mate.”
rows.translation: 很好，我会命人替[rival.himHer]沐浴，再安置到我宠爱的其他孵化者身边。这种生活比那条虫子应得的好上太多，但至少还有些用处。我的配偶，你既明智又宽宏大量。”
rows.raw: " Very well, I will order [rival.himHer] bathed and set aside with the rest of my favored incubators. A better life that that worm deserves, but one that is at least productive. You are both wise and magnanimous, my mate.”"

rows.original: [rival.name] screams a host of profanities, but is helpless to resist as [rival.heShe]’s dragged away to [rival.hisHer] doom. Taivra’s hand tightens around your waist as your rival is dragged off, until it’s almost painful. “Now then, I believe it’s time you paid your fealty to me...”
rows.translation: [rival.name]破口大骂，却无力反抗，只能在[rival.heShe]被拖向[rival.hisHer]的末路时徒劳挣扎。你的对手被带走时，泰芙拉搂住你腰间的手越收越紧，几乎让你感到疼痛。“好了，我想现在该由你向我献上忠诚了...”
rows.raw: "\n\n[rival.name] screams a host of profanities, but is helpless to resist as [rival.heShe]’s dragged away to [rival.hisHer] doom. Taivra’s hand tightens around your waist as your rival is dragged off, until it’s almost painful. “Now then, I believe it’s time you paid your fealty to me...”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “I want [rival.himHer],” you say simply, drinking in your cousin’s lithe form. You’ve spent too long chasing that piece of tail across the galaxy, and now [rival.heShe]’s in your grasp. No way you’re letting an opportunity like this pass... sorry, Dad.
rows.translation: “我要[rival.himHer]，”你简短地说道，目光贪婪地扫过堂亲苗条的身体。你追着这个尤物横跨银河已经太久了，如今[rival.heShe]终于落入掌中。你绝不会放过这样的机会...抱歉了，老爸。
rows.raw: "“I want [rival.himHer],” you say simply, drinking in your cousin’s lithe form. You’ve spent too long chasing that piece of tail across the galaxy, and now [rival.heShe]’s in your grasp. No way you’re letting an opportunity like this pass... sorry, Dad."

rows.original: Well, Dad’s gene pool was pretty messed up before, so there’s not much more damage you can do.
rows.translation: 不过，父亲的基因库本来就已经够乱了，你也不可能再造成多少伤害。
rows.raw: " Well, Dad’s gene pool was pretty messed up before, so there’s not much more damage you can do."

rows.original: “Ah, a warrior after my own heart,” Taivra chuckles, her predatory smile only widening. “A defeated foe is only as good as they can service you in bed, don’t you agree? A fate you’ll learn yourself, but for now, I will allow you this choice.” She turns her attention to [rival.name] and motions to a couple of her soldiers. The nyrea grab [rival.name], ripping at [rival.hisHer] clothes and dragging [rival.himHer] towards the curtain at the foot of the throne room.
rows.translation: “啊，真是位与我志趣相投的战士，”泰芙拉轻笑着，掠食者般的笑容愈发灿烂。“败敌仅剩的价值，就是在床上服侍你，你不也这么认为吗？你自己很快也会明白这种命运，不过现在，我准许你做出这个选择。”她把注意力转向[rival.name]，朝两名士兵示意。尼瑞亚人抓住[rival.name]，撕扯着[rival.hisHer]的衣服，将[rival.himHer]拖向王座厅末端的帷幕。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, a warrior after my own heart,” Taivra chuckles, her predatory smile only widening. “A defeated foe is only as good as they can service you in bed, don’t you agree? A fate you’ll learn yourself, but for now, I will allow you this choice.” She turns her attention to [rival.name] and motions to a couple of her soldiers. The nyrea grab [rival.name], ripping at [rival.hisHer] clothes and dragging [rival.himHer] towards the curtain at the foot of the throne room."

rows.original: “I’ll have your cousin bathed and prepared for you,” Taivra promises. “I hope your first mating will be as pleasant as ours shall.”
rows.translation: “我会让人替你的堂亲沐浴，做好准备，”泰芙拉保证道。“希望你们的第一次交配能像我们的那次一样愉快。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ll have your cousin bathed and prepared for you,” Taivra promises. “I hope your first mating will be as pleasant as ours shall.”"

rows.original: You feel one of the queen’s hands brush over your [pc.butt] at that, giving you just enough of a push towards the door to get you moving. It looks like your new queen is going to take advantage of your surrender sooner rather than later.
rows.translation: 话音落下，你感觉女王的一只手拂过你的[pc.butt]，轻轻一推，刚好让你朝门口迈开脚步。看来你的新女王准备尽早享用你投降的成果。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feel one of the queen’s hands brush over your [pc.butt] at that, giving you just enough of a push towards the door to get you moving. It looks like your new queen is going to take advantage of your surrender sooner rather than later."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Yarasta smiles - not a prim, instructor’s smile this time, but the happy grin of a girl who’s flattered someone’s taking an interest. “I don’t have much free time,” says the myr, smoothing her silken blouse over her petite breasts. “Ten hours a day are spent with the girls, divided into two five-hour sessions. Three hours are allotted for three meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner, though I usually grab them to go so I can work. Curfew is at 21:00, and I need to be in my room to catch any girls that try to sneak by. We’re supposed to use from curfew until we sleep for recreation and socializing, but if I can’t get the next day’s lesson ready in the two hours between evening meal and then, or if I had to issue paperwork, I have to take the materials back to my room and keep working.”
rows.translation: 雅拉斯塔笑了。这次不是教师端庄矜持的微笑，而是一个女孩发现有人对自己感兴趣时受宠若惊的开心笑容。“我的空闲时间不多，”米尔一边说，一边抚平娇小乳房上的丝质衬衫。“每天要和女孩们相处十个小时，分成两节，每节五小时。早餐、午餐和晚餐一共分配了三个小时，不过我通常会把饭带走，边工作边吃。宵禁时间是21:00，我必须待在房间里，抓住任何试图溜过去的女孩。按规定，从宵禁到睡觉的时间应该用来娱乐和社交，但如果晚餐后到宵禁之间的两个小时不够我准备好第二天的课程，或者我还得填写文件，我就必须把材料带回房间继续工作。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYarasta smiles - not a prim, instructor’s smile this time, but the happy grin of a girl who’s flattered someone’s taking an interest. “I don’t have much free time,” says the myr, smoothing her silken blouse over her petite breasts. “Ten hours a day are spent with the girls, divided into two five-hour sessions. Three hours are allotted for three meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner, though I usually grab them to go so I can work. Curfew is at 21:00, and I need to be in my room to catch any girls that try to sneak by. We’re supposed to use from curfew until we sleep for recreation and socializing, but if I can’t get the next day’s lesson ready in the two hours between evening meal and then, or if I had to issue paperwork, I have to take the materials back to my room and keep working.”"

rows.original: It takes you a while to visualize the clock. Yarasta decides to guess your response from your face and continue without you.
rows.translation: 你花了一会儿才在脑海中理清这些时间。雅拉斯塔决定从你的表情猜测反应，不等你回答便继续说下去。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt takes you a while to visualize the clock. Yarasta decides to guess your response from your face and continue without you."

rows.original: “Does that happen often?”
rows.translation: “这种情况经常发生吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Does that happen often?”"

rows.original: “No fun allowed. Got it.”
rows.translation: “不准娱乐。明白了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No fun allowed. Got it.”"

rows.original: “Holy shit, lady.”
rows.translation: “我靠，女士。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Holy shit, lady.”"

rows.original: “Indeed. I’ve spend most of my recent nights looking at workbooks. Truthfully, there’s too much to do now. The classes are too large and there aren’t enough prefects... the best outcomes result from no more than one hundred fifty girls per class. Studies have been done. But the expedited breeding and the arrival of the refugees mean forcing more in, which hurts us and hurts the children. Though, with the war, there aren’t a lot of best outcomes left for us. Speaking of schedules....” She glances at a timepiece. “I’d love to hit the city and relax, but I have to take opportunities for fun as they come to me. Unfortunately, as much as I’m enjoying indulging your interest, I should probably wrap up. I’d be glad to speak again
rows.translation: “确实如此。最近大多数夜晚，我都在查看练习册。说实话，现在要做的事太多了。班级人数过多，学监又不够...研究已经证明，每班不超过一百五十名女孩时，教学成果最佳。但加速繁育和难民涌入迫使我们塞进更多学生，这既伤害我们，也伤害孩子们。不过战争当前，我们也没剩下多少追求最佳成果的余地了。说到日程....”她瞥了一眼计时器。“我很想去城里放松一下，但只能抓住送上门的娱乐机会。遗憾的是，尽管我很享受满足你的好奇心，现在大概也该结束了。我很乐意再和你聊聊
rows.raw: "\n\n“Indeed. I’ve spend most of my recent nights looking at workbooks. Truthfully, there’s too much to do now. The classes are too large and there aren’t enough prefects... the best outcomes result from no more than one hundred fifty girls per class. Studies have been done. But the expedited breeding and the arrival of the refugees mean forcing more in, which hurts us and hurts the children. Though, with the war, there aren’t a lot of best outcomes left for us. Speaking of schedules....” She glances at a timepiece. “I’d love to hit the city and relax, but I have to take opportunities for fun as they come to me. Unfortunately, as much as I’m enjoying indulging your interest, I should probably wrap up. I’d be glad to speak again"

rows.original: , if you can watch your language
rows.translation: ，只要你能注意一下措辞
rows.raw: ", if you can watch your language"

rows.translation: 显然，她没时间追求恋情。同样明显的是，她喜欢你的陪伴。你不禁想，自己是否也算一个‘机会’——要试着和她调情吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nClearly she has no time to chase romance. Just as clearly, she likes your company. You wonder if you might qualify as an ‘opportunity’ - do you try flirting with her?"

rows.original: Flirt

rows.translation: 问问亚拉斯塔是否想来点成人娱乐。
rows.raw: "Ask Yarasta if she’d like to have some adult fun."

rows.original: The prefect wouldn’t be interested in your lack of sexual endowments.
rows.translation: 你的性禀赋不足，学监不会感兴趣。
rows.raw: "The prefect wouldn’t be interested in your lack of sexual endowments."

rows.original: No
rows.translation: 否
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: “Did you require anything else?” Yarasta asks, demurely.
rows.translation: “你还需要别的什么吗？”亚拉斯塔矜持地问道。
rows.raw: "“Did you require anything else?” Yarasta asks, demurely."

rows.original: “Did you want something else?”
rows.translation: “你还想要别的什么吗？”
rows.raw: "“Did you want something else?”"

rows.original: “So, like... uh... what do you think about stuff?” you open, gesturing grandly with your hands to indicate ‘everything’.
rows.translation: “所以，那个...呃...你对各种事情怎么看？”你开口问道，双手夸张地比画，表示‘所有事情’。
rows.raw: "“So, like... uh... what do you think about stuff?” you open, gesturing grandly with your hands to indicate ‘everything’."

rows.original: “To what are you referring?” asks Yarasta. “The war? The alien contact? The possibility of thermonuclear annihilation?”
rows.translation: “你指什么？”亚拉斯塔问道。“战争？外星接触？还是热核毁灭的可能性？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“To what are you referring?” asks Yarasta. “The war? The alien contact? The possibility of thermonuclear annihilation?”"

rows.original: “Yeah!” you agree.
rows.translation: “对！”你表示赞同。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah!” you agree."

rows.original: Yarasta sighs and rubs her forehead.
rows.translation: 亚拉斯塔叹了口气，揉了揉额头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYarasta sighs and rubs her forehead."

rows.original: “So, like, hit me up with some knowledge,” you open.
rows.translation: “所以，那个，给我讲点知识吧，”你开口道。
rows.raw: "“So, like, hit me up with some knowledge,” you open."

rows.original: “About?” Yarasta challenges.
rows.translation: “关于什么？”亚拉斯塔反问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“About?” Yarasta challenges."

rows.original: “I dunno. Pretty crazy times, though, right? What, uh, what do you think?”
rows.translation: “不知道。最近挺疯狂的，对吧？呃，你怎么看？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I dunno. Pretty crazy times, though, right? What, uh, what do you think?”"

rows.original: She laughs mirthfully with a ladylike hand over her mouth at your attempt to seem cosmopolitan.
rows.translation: 她用淑女般的手掩着嘴，愉快地笑起你装作见多识广的模样。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe laughs mirthfully with a ladylike hand over her mouth at your attempt to seem cosmopolitan."

rows.original: “I’m curious what you think of the recent developments around here.”
rows.translation: “我很好奇你如何看待这里最近的事态发展。”
rows.raw: "“I’m curious what you think of the recent developments around here.”"

rows.original: Yarasta’s glasses flash as she pushes them up, transforming her into her inner academic.
rows.translation: 亚拉斯塔推了推眼镜，镜片闪过一道光，她内心的学者顿时显露出来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYarasta’s glasses flash as she pushes them up, transforming her into her inner academic."

rows.original: “Surely an armchair diplomat like you has some insights on recent developments,” you goad, hoping for an interesting discussion.
rows.translation: “像你这样的扶手椅外交家，肯定对最近的事态发展有些高见吧，”你激将道，希望能听到一番有趣的讨论。
rows.raw: "“Surely an armchair diplomat like you has some insights on recent developments,” you goad, hoping for an interesting discussion."

rows.original: Yarasta turns toward you and folds her legs. “As a matter of fact...”
rows.translation: 亚拉斯塔转向你，交叠起双腿。“事实上...”
rows.raw: "\n\nYarasta turns toward you and folds her legs. “As a matter of fact...”"

rows.original: You shift to sit comfortably for the anticipated lecture.
rows.translation: 你调整姿势舒服地坐好，准备聆听预料中的长篇讲解。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shift to sit comfortably for the anticipated lecture."

rows.original: “I’ve been thinking a lot about the U.G.C. and their technology. Myrellion may not be the straight-forward assimilation into the galactic economy that everyone seems to assume.” The pretty myr tucks her left two arms under the others and taps her fine cheekbones - a strange sight, since her two right index fingers tap in alternating rhythm. “Of course, it would be nice if it were absorbed into the U.G.C. without incident and everyone could benefit according to their station. But consider some of the medical breakthroughs you take for granted. For example...”
rows.translation: “我一直在思考银河联合邦联及其科技。米瑞利昂未必会像大家以为的那样，顺理成章地融入银河经济。”这位漂亮的米尔人把左侧两只手臂收在另外两只下方，轻敲精致的颧骨——那景象颇为奇特，因为她右侧的两根食指交替敲击。“当然，如果米瑞利昂能平安并入银河联合邦联，让每个人都依照自身地位受益，那自然很好。但想想那些你习以为常的医学突破。例如...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ve been thinking a lot about the U.G.C. and their technology. Myrellion may not be the straight-forward assimilation into the galactic economy that everyone seems to assume.” The pretty myr tucks her left two arms under the others and taps her fine cheekbones - a strange sight, since her two right index fingers tap in alternating rhythm. “Of course, it would be nice if it were absorbed into the U.G.C. without incident and everyone could benefit according to their station. But consider some of the medical breakthroughs you take for granted. For example...”"

rows.original: You nod politely when she looks at you, and she continues, holding her hands palm-up to suggest an offering of knowledge. <i>“...we see already that Queen Irellia’s desire for more power has prompted a risky, untested gene manipulation that allows her to breed and lay simultaneously, an advantage which surely must have the other queens thinking. What if other such procedures are adapted? For instance, suppose next is introduced a treatment to turn any myrmedion into a functional hermaphrodite
rows.translation: 她看向你时，你礼貌地点点头。她双掌朝上，仿佛献出知识一般继续说道：<i>“...我们已经看到，伊蕾莉娅女王对更大权力的渴望，促使她接受一种危险且未经检验的基因改造，让她能够同时受孕和产卵；这项优势肯定会令其他女王深思。若类似技术也得到应用呢？例如，假设下一步推出一种能把任何米尔米迪恩变成功能健全的双性体的改造
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod politely when she looks at you, and she continues, holding her hands palm-up to suggest an offering of knowledge. <i>“...we see already that Queen Irellia’s desire for more power has prompted a risky, untested gene manipulation that allows her to breed and lay simultaneously, an advantage which surely must have the other queens thinking. What if other such procedures are adapted? For instance, suppose next is introduced a treatment to turn any myrmedion into a functional hermaphrodite"

rows.original: expression with a knowing glance. “Conversely, suppose that the next advancement is a treatment that bestows fertility upon the infertile. This would help the Scarlet Federation, yes, but it would help the Republic even more.” Yarasta clutches with her hands, as if grappling with metaphorical weights. “Normal citizens like you, sorry, not you, but me, would be able to become queens with an outlay of capital, capable of producing hundreds or thousands of children yearly. In effect, the only remaining barriers to political power under the current system would be the treatment fee and the costs of excavating a territory, allowing any private citizen rich enough to sue the Republic’s ruling council for admission. The political climate would change, of necessity. I think a Terran word suits that scenario of citizen rule best: ‘democracy’.”
rows.translation: 表情，她则回以了然的一瞥。“反过来说，假设下一项进步是一种能让不孕者获得生育能力的改造。没错，这会帮助猩红联邦，但对共和国的帮助更大。”亚拉斯塔双手紧握，仿佛正与无形的重物角力。“像你这样的普通公民——抱歉，不是你，是像我这样的——只要投入资本就能成为女王，每年生下数百乃至数千个孩子。实际上，在现行制度下，通往政治权力仅剩的门槛就是改造费用和开掘领地的成本；任何足够富裕的私人公民，都可以向共和国统治议会提起诉讼，要求获准加入。政治环境必然会改变。我认为有一个泰伦词最适合这种公民统治的情形：‘民主’。”

This would help the Scarlet Federation, yes, but it would help the Republic even more.” Yarasta clutches with her hands, as if grappling with metaphorical weights. “Normal citizens like you, sorry, not you, but me, would be able to become queens with an outlay of capital, capable of producing hundreds or thousands of children yearly. In effect, the only remaining barriers to political power under the current system would be the treatment fee and the costs of excavating a territory, allowing any private citizen rich enough to sue the Republic’s ruling council for admission. The political climate would change, of necessity. I think a Terran word suits that scenario of citizen rule best: ‘democracy’.”"

rows.original: “So, as we can see, either or both advancements could lead to a major imbalance of power among the myr,” she concludes, proud of her little presentation.
rows.translation: “所以我们可以看出，其中任何一项或两项进步都可能导致米尔人之间的权力严重失衡，”她总结道，对自己的小演讲颇为自豪。
rows.raw: "“So, as we can see, either or both advancements could lead to a major imbalance of power among the myr,” she concludes, proud of her little presentation."
