rows.original: Yarasta smiles a grim smile. “I thought you might mention that. The cease-fire, even should it hold, is only binding while U.G.C. assets are here to enforce it and the powers are in balance. As soon as the economic situation on Myrellion stabilizes and the U.G.C.’s attention turns to the next discovered planet, there’s little to stop the first power to develop a major advantage from quietly ignoring the agreement and permanently removing the other, as long as the flow of goods and information isn’t interrupted.”
rows.translation: 亚拉斯塔露出阴沉的微笑。“我就知道你可能会提到这一点。即使停火协议能够维持，它也只在银河联合邦联的力量仍驻留此地执行协议、而双方势力保持平衡时才有约束力。一旦米瑞利昂的经济局势稳定，银河联合邦联把注意力转向下一颗新发现的星球，那么首先取得重大优势的一方几乎不会受到什么阻碍；只要货物和信息流通不中断，她们完全可以悄悄无视协议，永久消灭另一方。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYarasta smiles a grim smile. “I thought you might mention that. The cease-fire, even should it hold, is only binding while U.G.C. assets are here to enforce it and the powers are in balance. As soon as the economic situation on Myrellion stabilizes and the U.G.C.’s attention turns to the next discovered planet, there’s little to stop the first power to develop a major advantage from quietly ignoring the agreement and permanently removing the other, as long as the flow of goods and information isn’t interrupted.”"

rows.original: “That’s sooo depressing!” you exclaim, pursing your lip in a pout.
rows.translation: “那也太——让人沮丧了！”你噘起嘴惊呼道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s sooo depressing!” you exclaim, pursing your lip in a pout."

rows.original: “That’s so harsh,” you reply.
rows.translation: “这也太残酷了，”你回答。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s so harsh,” you reply."

rows.original: “You paint a bleak picture,” you grumble.
rows.translation: “你描绘的前景真够灰暗，”你抱怨道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You paint a bleak picture,” you grumble."

rows.original: “Sounds delightful,” you say sarcastically.
rows.translation: “听起来真令人愉快，”你讽刺地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sounds delightful,” you say sarcastically."

rows.original: The prefect snaps out of her lecturer’s trance and sheepishly folds her hands behind her head. “Well, it might not happen like that. I could just be imagining outcomes that match my mood as of late,” she considers.
rows.translation: 学监从讲师般的忘我状态中回过神来，有些不好意思地把双手交叠在脑后。“嗯，事情也未必会那样发展。我可能只是因为最近的心情，才设想出与之相符的结局，”她思忖道。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe prefect snaps out of her lecturer’s trance and sheepishly folds her hands behind her head. “Well, it might not happen like that. I could just be imagining outcomes that match my mood as of late,” she considers."

rows.original: Cued by her somewhat nervous demeanor, you lean in close.
rows.translation: 她略显紧张的举止给了你暗示，你凑近了些。
rows.raw: "\n\nCued by her somewhat nervous demeanor, you lean in close."

rows.original: “I’ve been grappling with some concerns over the outcome of the war,” she admits. “Particularly the refugees.”
rows.translation: “我一直在为战争的结果担忧，”她承认道。“尤其是难民问题。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ve been grappling with some concerns over the outcome of the war,” she admits. “Particularly the refugees.”"

rows.original: You vamp. “Yeah?”
rows.translation: 你敷衍着接话。“是吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou vamp. “Yeah?”"

rows.original: “Well, let me start by saying I strongly believe that we have a duty to help our sisters in their time of need,” she says diplomatically. “But in truth, the Kressian refugees and rescues have presented a problem that the Gilden Republic was not prepared to handle. Take the young girls, for example. Their birth queens in Kressia are lost, but the adopting queens can’t agree on jurisdiction. All the Gildenmere queens would like to foster the refugees since it would provide an instant boost to their numbers - yet until an agreement is reached, the girls aren’t actually protected under the auspices of any queen. Some citizens are hesitant to provide services, even essential services, to them, not knowing whom to bill. Fees that are charged to them don’t get paid, and collect interest... if they reach adulthood without being claimed by a queen’s family, they become personally liable for the debts that accrued while they were minors. Thankfully, the queens have at least agreed to add the girls to the collectively-funded thollums until the issue can be settled, instead of leaving them in limbo.”
rows.translation: “首先我要说明，我坚信我们有责任在姐妹们需要时帮助她们，”她圆滑地说道。“但事实上，来自克雷西亚的难民和获救者造成了吉尔登共和国毫无准备应对的问题。以那些小女孩为例。她们在克雷西亚的生身女王已经失联，但准备收养她们的女王无法就管辖权达成一致。吉尔登米尔的所有女王都想收养难民，因为这会立刻增加自己的人口——然而在协议达成前，这些女孩实际上并不受任何女王的庇护。有些公民不愿为她们提供服务，甚至连基本服务也不愿提供，因为不知道该向谁收费。向她们收取的费用无人支付，还会不断累积利息...如果她们成年前仍未被某位女王的家族认领，就必须亲自承担未成年期间积累的债务。所幸，女王们至少同意，在问题解决前把这些女孩送进集体出资的托勒姆，而不是让她们一直悬而未决。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, let me start by saying I strongly believe that we have a duty to help our sisters in their time of need,” she says diplomatically. “But in truth, the Kressian refugees and rescues have presented a problem that the Gilden Republic was not prepared to handle. Take the young girls, for example. Their birth queens in Kressia are lost, but the adopting queens can’t agree on jurisdiction. All the Gildenmere queens would like to foster the refugees since it would provide an instant boost to their numbers - yet until an agreement is reached, the girls aren’t actually protected under the auspices of any queen. Some citizens are hesitant to provide services, even essential services, to them, not knowing whom to bill. Fees that are charged to them don’t get paid, and collect interest... if they reach adulthood without being claimed by a queen’s family, they become personally liable for the debts that accrued while they were minors. Thankfully, the queens have at least agreed to add the girls to the collectively-funded thollums until the issue can be settled, instead of leaving them in limbo.”"

rows.raw: "hy not just split them up?”"

rows.original: Yarasta nods eagerly, glad to know you’re following. “Yes, that’s the thinking. But the queens are hung up on the method of division. Some want the girls to be split evenly among the council, giving lesser queens a relative advantage. Others, particularly the most powerful, argue that each queen should take on refugees in proportion to her current holdings. This would maintain the current balance. The votes are, as yet, even.”
rows.translation: 亚拉斯塔热切地点点头，很高兴你跟上了她的思路。“是的，大家就是这么想的。但女王们在分配方式上争执不下。有些希望把女孩平均分给议会成员，让实力较弱的女王获得相对优势。另一些女王，尤其是最有权势的那些，则主张每位女王应按现有领地规模接收相应比例的难民，以维持当前平衡。到目前为止，双方票数持平。”

rows.original: She pursues a different tangent. “Trouble follows the adults, too. Because many of them arrived in Gildenmere partially or completely addicted to red myr venom, Kressian refugees are considered at high risk of becoming venom junkies, distributing venom, being sold in myrmedion trafficking, and associating with a degenerate underground pro-Federation movement that operates in these gray and black markets and has lately claimed responsibility for several terrorist attacks. This has caused a public backlash against them that affects even legal immigrants who have been in good standing for decades.”
rows.translation: 她转向另一个话题。“成年人也麻烦不断。许多人抵达吉尔登米尔时，已经部分或完全对红米尔毒液成瘾，因此克雷西亚难民被视为极易沦为毒液瘾君子、贩卖毒液、被卖进米尔米迪恩人口贩运，以及与一个堕落的地下亲联邦运动来往。该运动活跃于这些灰色和黑色市场，最近还宣称对数起恐怖袭击负责。这引发了公众对难民的抵触，甚至波及那些数十年来一直守法合规的合法移民。”

This has caused a public backlash against them that affects even legal immigrants who have been in good standing for decades.”"

rows.original: Yarasta stops talking, studying you as she decides whether to delve further into the subject. After a moment, she resumes. “Many refugees from Kressia’s now-closed thollums applied to join the staff here when they first arrived. To a myr, they were refused on the grounds of supposed pragamtism. The queens and the thollum administration both consider the risk of addicts and Federation apologists infiltrating the thollum staff to be too great. I can understand their argument. But with the many, many refugee children and the additional breeding, the number of girls in the thollums is now past what the prefects can handle - I can attest to that being the case here, too. Without accepting accredited teachers from Kressia, the only choices are to increase the class sizes or relax hiring standards, either of which will hurt the Republic far more in the long run than pro-red sentiment.”
rows.translation: 亚拉斯塔停下话头，端详着你，斟酌是否要更深入地谈论此事。片刻后，她继续说道：“克雷西亚现已关闭的托勒姆里，有许多难民刚抵达时申请加入这里的职员队伍。她们无一例外都被拒绝了，理由据称是务实考虑。女王和托勒姆管理层都认为，让瘾君子和联邦同情者渗入职员队伍的风险太大。我能理解她们的论点。但难民儿童太多，繁育人数也在增加，托勒姆里的女孩数量已经超出学监们的应对能力——我可以作证，这里的情况也是如此。如果不接纳来自克雷西亚的持证教师，我们就只能扩大班级规模或放宽招聘标准；无论哪一种，长远来看对共和国的伤害都会远大于亲红派情绪。”

To a myr, they were refused on the grounds of supposed pragamtism. But with the many, many refugee children and the additional breeding, the number of girls in the thollums is now past what the prefects can handle - I can attest to that being the case here, too. Without accepting accredited teachers from Kressia, the only choices are to increase the class sizes or relax hiring standards, either of which will hurt the Republic far more in the long run than pro-red sentiment.”"

rows.original: Color rises in her face as she concludes. “It’s already happening, in fact! There are so many girls that we don’t have enough sumins to feed them all, so the teenagers with high honey production are being pulled from classes to spend half-days in the milking room. In effect, they’re trading a current problem for a future one, because these girls are missing the most crucial part of their educations - you can’t go anywhere professionally without good scores in your adult assessments! We can’t keep them here as sumins after graduation unless they score highly, so pulling them all but guarantees that they’re relegated to permanent careers in private sector food service.”
rows.translation: 她说到最后，脸上泛起红晕。“事实上，这已经发生了！女孩实在太多，苏明不够给所有人喂食，所以蜂蜜产量高的青少年被从课堂抽调出来，每天有半天待在挤奶室。实际上，她们是在用未来的问题换取眼前的解决，因为这些女孩错过了教育中最关键的部分——成年考核拿不到好成绩，职业上就没有出路！除非毕业成绩优异，否则我们不能把她们留下来担任苏明；抽调上课时间几乎注定会把她们永久限制在私营食品服务行业。”

rows.translation: 托勒姆

rows.original: “I saw some stuff on the tour but, like, I still can’t get over how many kids you have. This school is totally crazy! How does it even work?” you ask.
rows.translation: “我参观时看到了一些东西，可是，那个，我还是无法相信你们有这么多孩子。这所学校简直太疯狂了！它到底是怎么运作的？”你问道。
rows.raw: "“I saw some stuff on the tour but, like, I still can’t get over how many kids you have. This school is totally crazy! How does it even work?” you ask."

rows.original: “I saw some stuff on the tour but, like, I still can’t get over how many kids you have. Would you tell me more about the school?” you ask.
rows.translation: “我参观时看到了一些东西，可是，那个，我还是无法相信你们有这么多孩子。能再多和我讲讲这所学校吗？”你问道。
rows.raw: "“I saw some stuff on the tour but, like, I still can’t get over how many kids you have. Would you tell me more about the school?” you ask."

rows.original: “You know I didn’t birth them, of course?” she replies. You nod vigorously, and she continues, “The children are indeed tiring, but rewarding. Most of the girls are very polite and obedient, but there are always some that disrupt the classes or resist authority. Usually I can get them in line with the group, but sometimes I lose whole half-days because the focus is gone. And then there are some that can only think about sex, like you.”
rows.translation: “你当然知道，她们不是我生的吧？”她回答。你用力点头，她继续说道：“这些孩子确实让人疲惫，但也很值得。大多数女孩都很有礼貌、服从管教，不过总会有人扰乱课堂或抗拒权威。通常我能让她们跟上集体，但有时注意力一散，我就会浪费整个半天。还有些人满脑子只想着性，就像你一样。”

Most of the girls are very polite and obedient, but there are always some that disrupt the classes or resist authority. Usually I can get them in line with the group, but sometimes I lose whole half-days because the focus is gone. And then there are some that can only think about sex, like you.”"

rows.original: Your attention snaps back from her smooth thighs, jarred into the conversation. The prefect laughs merrily.
rows.translation: 你的注意力猛然从她光滑的大腿上收回来，被拽回谈话之中。学监愉快地笑了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour attention snaps back from her smooth thighs, jarred into the conversation. The prefect laughs merrily."

rows.original: “Tell me more about the thollum,” you request. “I haven’t seen child-rearing like it anywhere else.”
rows.translation: “再和我讲讲托勒姆吧，”你请求道。“我在别处从未见过这样的育儿方式。”
rows.raw: "“Tell me more about the thollum,” you request. “I haven’t seen child-rearing like it anywhere else.”"

rows.original: “Why, because of the numbers?” she asks. “Controlling peer pressure is essential with a group of that size, as is maintaining a dominant position. I’m sure you know of the phenomenon where people in large groups lose the ability to go against the group’s decisions? The children have to know that they are unquestionably accountable to the adults, and the adults that they must be absolutely authoritarian toward the children, or else a child can usurp the leadership and it becomes a madhouse. It can be stressful.”
rows.translation: “怎么，因为人数吗？”她问道。“对这么庞大的群体而言，控制同伴压力和维持主导地位都至关重要。我相信你知道，大群体中的人会丧失反对群体决定的能力，对吧？孩子们必须明白，她们毫无疑问要对成年人负责；成年人也必须明白，自己必须对孩子们保持绝对权威，否则某个孩子就可能夺取领导权，让整个地方变成疯人院。这会很有压力。”

I’m sure you know of the phenomenon where people in large groups lose the ability to go against the group’s decisions? The children have to know that they are unquestionably accountable to the adults, and the adults that they must be absolutely authoritarian toward the children, or else a child can usurp the leadership and it becomes a madhouse. It can be stressful.”"

rows.original: “So you have to be on watch all the time?”
rows.translation: “所以你得时刻盯着她们？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So you have to be on watch all the time?”"

rows.original: “And sometimes lock the doors,” she affirms. “I dread field trips and work study, because it’s easy for a few girls to decide they don’t want to pay attention and wander off to shoplift or go drone-hunting. And do you suppose that when underaged myrmedions are caught ripping off Silken Serenity or sneaking into The Honey Nozzle and returned to us by the police, they’re the only ones in trouble?”
rows.translation: “有时候还得锁门，”她肯定道。“我很怕校外活动和勤工学习，因为几个女孩很容易决定不听话，跑去商店行窃或猎捕雄蜂。你觉得，未成年的米尔米迪恩从丝绸宁静偷东西，或者溜进蜜汁喷口，被警察送回来时，只有她们自己会有麻烦吗？”

And do you suppose that when underaged myrmedions are caught ripping off Silken Serenity or sneaking into The Honey Nozzle and returned to us by the police, they’re the only ones in trouble?”"

rows.original: “I’d like to hear your perspective on the thollum. For instance, what’s it like overseeing your own private army?” you ask.
rows.translation: “我想听听你对托勒姆的看法。比如说，统领自己的私人军队是什么感觉？”你问道。
rows.raw: "“I’d like to hear your perspective on the thollum. For instance, what’s it like overseeing your own private army?” you ask."

rows.original: “A constant pain,” answers Yarasta, with a tinkly laugh. “How hard it is to keep them marching in step! And of course, just as you get the most restive little girls to finally trust you as a capable adult, they become hormonal teenagers and start rebelling for entirely different reasons.”
rows.translation: “没完没了的麻烦，”亚拉斯塔清脆地笑着回答。“要让她们步调一致可太难了！而且，等你终于让那些最坐立不安的小女孩相信你是个称职的成年人时，她们又会变成荷尔蒙旺盛的青少年，开始出于完全不同的理由反抗。”

And of course, just as you get the most restive little girls to finally trust you as a capable adult, they become hormonal teenagers and start rebelling for entirely different reasons.”"

rows.translation: “即使没有男性？”

rows.original: shakes her head. “Challenging the lead female is one of those things that young women do instinctively when they’re trying to find their place - I’ve raised girls so aggressive that I suspected they were queens who got false negatives on the test. Sometimes I wonder if maybe a drone wouldn’t have an easier time keeping them obedient. But then, they’d never learn anything even if they watched him all day.”
rows.translation: 摇了摇头。“挑战领头雌性，是年轻女性在寻找自身位置时本能会做的事情——我养育过攻击性强到让我怀疑检测结果是假阴性的女孩，她们可能其实是女王。有时我会想，也许雄蜂反倒更容易让她们服从。但那样一来，就算她们整天盯着他，也什么都学不到。”

rows.original: “Tell me about the thollum. How do you stand it?” you ask.
rows.translation: “和我讲讲托勒姆吧。你是怎么忍受下来的？”你问道。
rows.raw: "“Tell me about the thollum. How do you stand it?” you ask."

rows.original: “Stand it? You mean, because of the children?” replies Yarasta. “Well, I’ll grant that no child is perfect, but on the whole, they’re quite polite and eager to learn. They rarely have a chance to become too distracted, since we keep them away from stores, outsiders, and especially drones.”
rows.translation: “忍受？你是说，因为这些孩子吗？”亚拉斯塔回答。“好吧，我承认没有哪个孩子是完美的，但总体而言，她们很有礼貌，也渴望学习。她们很少有机会分心太久，因为我们让她们远离商店、外人，尤其是雄蜂。”

They rarely have a chance to become too distracted, since we keep them away from stores, outsiders, and especially drones.”"

rows.original: “Seeing no men is weird,” you rejoin.
rows.translation: “见不到男人很奇怪，”你接话道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Seeing no men is weird,” you rejoin."

rows.original: “I suppose you’re accustomed to them. It’s widely regarded as a positive since our sex drives get quite high in adolescence. Although,” she says, lost in academic mode, “there was a breakaway school of education theory that proposed adding one drone to each class after puberty as an aide - thinking being, he could be brought in sparingly to derail arguments and used as incentive to lure the girls to perform better.”
rows.translation: “我想你已经习惯他们了。由于我们的性欲会在青春期变得相当旺盛，大家普遍认为不接触男性是件好事。不过，”她沉浸在学术模式中说道，“教育理论曾出现一个脱离主流的学派，主张在青春期后给每个班级配备一名雄蜂作为助教——其构想是，只在必要时让他出现以平息争执，并把他当作诱因，鼓励女孩们表现得更好。”

rows.original: “So, like, I know we talked about it before, but could you go over the thollum again?” you ask, feeling like you’re back in school.
rows.translation: “所以，那个，我知道我们以前谈过，但你能再讲一遍托勒姆吗？”你问道，感觉自己仿佛又回到了学校。

rows.original: “Certainly,” Yarasta answers.
rows.translation: “当然，”亚拉斯塔回答。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Certainly,” Yarasta answers."

rows.original: “Refresh me on the thollum,” you say.
rows.translation: “帮我复习一下托勒姆吧，”你说道。
rows.raw: "“Refresh me on the thollum,” you say."

rows.original: “Very well,” Yarasta replies.
rows.translation: “好吧，”亚拉斯塔回答。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Very well,” Yarasta replies."

rows.original: Yarasta pauses here to wipe her glasses on her blouse as she plots out the important points of the subject in her head. “The basic principle is that we prefects are assigned a group of girls and escort said girls from shortly after birth to productive adulthood - hence the colored vests and skirts with the easily-seen emblems, each for a specific prefect’s class. By being with them the entire time, we can see deficiencies and talents as they take shape. With help from the sumins, we are able to guide the girls toward careers that make the best of their individual abilities and personalities and give extra attention to any critical skills they lack. Once the girls graduate, we take up a new class fresh out of the nursery and begin again.”
rows.translation: 亚拉斯塔在这里停下来，用衬衫擦拭眼镜，同时在脑中梳理这个主题的要点。“基本原则是，我们学监会被分配一群女孩，从她们出生不久起一路陪伴到成为有生产力的成年人——因此才有带醒目标志的彩色背心和短裙，每一种都对应某位学监的班级。始终陪伴她们，让我们能在缺陷和天赋逐渐显现时及时发现。在苏明的帮助下，我们可以引导女孩选择最适合个人能力与性格的职业，并对她们欠缺的关键技能给予额外关注。女孩们毕业后，我们再接手一个刚离开育婴室的新班级，从头开始。”

By being with them the entire time, we can see deficiencies and talents as they take shape. With help from the sumins, we are able to guide the girls toward careers that make the best of their individual abilities and personalities and give extra attention to any critical skills they lack. rows.original: “It’s not a secret!” she insists. “My transfer records are available for anyone who requests them. I just don’t see any reason to encourage people to do so.” She gets a bit prickly; a bit defensive. “I do my job well and I’m loyal to Queen Irellia - should I be harassed because a few idiots hear a Kressian name and immediately assume it must belong to an addict and a traitor?”
rows.translation: “这不是秘密！”她坚持道。“任何提出申请的人都能查到我的调动记录。我只是认为没必要鼓励别人那么做。”她有些恼火，也有些戒备。“我工作尽责，也忠于伊蕾莉娅女王——难道就因为几个白痴听到克雷西亚式的名字，马上认定那人肯定是瘾君子和叛徒，我就活该受人骚扰吗？”

rows.translation: 两名尼瑞安女猎手站在高耸的石门前，头顶一对装满蓝色发光真菌的“火把”洒下光芒。除了标志性的比基尼链甲外，这两名女子身上还披着一道道金属护甲，各自手握一杆长矛。她们面无表情地看着你，却没有做出攻击的举动。
rows.raw: "\n\nA pair of nyrea huntresses stand in front of the towering stone gates, under the light of a pair of “torches” filled with glowing blue fungus. The pair of women are clad in bands of metal armor in addition to their trademark bikini mail, and each holds a long spear in her hands. They look impassively at you, but make no move to attack."

rows.original: Approach
rows.translation: 接近
rows.raw: "Approach"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “I’m going in. Like it or not,” you tell the guards, [pc.readyingWeapon].
rows.translation: “不管你们乐不乐意，我都要进去，”你一边对守卫说道，一边[pc.readyingWeapon]。
rows.raw: "“I’m going in. Like it or not,” you tell the guards, [pc.readyingWeapon]."

rows.original: The guards lower their spears at you, and one of them grabs a rope behind her, leading into the wall. A bell resounds inside, and a moment later the gate is creaking open and several more nyrean huntresses are pouring out. And suddenly, your odds look a little less great...
rows.translation: 守卫放低长矛对准你，其中一人抓住身后一根通入墙内的绳索。里面随即响起钟声，片刻之后，大门吱呀作响地打开，又有几名尼瑞安女猎手蜂拥而出。你的胜算顿时显得没那么大了...
rows.raw: "\n\nThe guards lower their spears at you, and one of them grabs a rope behind her, leading into the wall. A bell resounds inside, and a moment later the gate is creaking open and several more nyrean huntresses are pouring out. And suddenly, your odds look a little less great..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “No,” one of the guards scowls when you offer to let them have their way with you. “We’ve an entire village of virile males down below. Exotic... and attractive... as you are, pleasures of the flesh aren’t worth the queen’s ire.”
rows.translation: “不行，”你提出任由她们摆布时，其中一名守卫皱起眉头。“我们下面有一整个村子的精壮雄性。你虽然异域...又迷人...但这点肉欲之欢还不值得惹怒女王。”
rows.raw: "“No,” one of the guards scowls when you offer to let them have their way with you. “We’ve an entire village of virile males down below. Exotic... and attractive... as you are, pleasures of the flesh aren’t worth the queen’s ire.”"

rows.original: “If that’s the best you have to offer, begone,” the other guard says.
rows.translation: “如果这就是你能拿出的最好条件，那就滚吧，”另一名守卫说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“If that’s the best you have to offer, begone,” the other guard says."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You pull out your credit stick invitingly, only to receive confused looks from the guards. “What’s that?” one asks, snatching it and looking it over. “Some kind of weapon?”
rows.translation: 你颇具诱惑意味地掏出信用棒，却只换来守卫困惑的目光。“这是什么？”其中一人问道，一把夺过去翻看起来。“某种武器吗？”
rows.raw: "You pull out your credit stick invitingly, only to receive confused looks from the guards. “What’s that?” one asks, snatching it and looking it over. “Some kind of weapon?”"

rows.original: “No, no,” you say, condensing an economics lesson into as few words as possible: you tell her that credits are star-walker money, and they can buy whatever they want that way.
rows.translation: “不，不是，”你说道，尽可能言简意赅地给她上了一堂经济课：你告诉她，信用点是星行者的货币，用它们可以买到任何想要的东西。
rows.raw: "\n\n“No, no,” you say, condensing an economics lesson into as few words as possible: you tell her that credits are star-walker money, and they can buy whatever they want that way."

rows.original: The other guard grabs the credstick out of the first’s hand and shoves it back into yours. “Your money isn’t worth much down here,” she says. “We trade in gemstones and precious minerals. Not... imaginary money.”
rows.translation: 另一名守卫从第一名守卫手中夺过信用棒，又塞回你的手里。“你们的钱在下面不值什么，”她说道。“我们用宝石和珍贵矿物交易，而不是...虚构出来的钱。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe other guard grabs the credstick out of the first’s hand and shoves it back into yours. “Your money isn’t worth much down here,” she says. “We trade in gemstones and precious minerals. Not... imaginary money.”"

rows.original: Gemstones? Minerals?
rows.translation: 宝石？矿物？
rows.raw: "\n\nGemstones? Minerals? "

rows.original: Platinum 190
rows.raw: "Platinum 190"

rows.original: Oh, is that what they want...?
rows.translation: 哦，原来她们想要的是这个...?
rows.raw: "Oh, is that what they want...?"

rows.original: Plat. 190
rows.translation: 铂金190
rows.raw: "Plat. 190"

rows.original: Plat. 190
rows.translation: 铂金190
rows.raw: "Plat. 190"

rows.original: Offer your chunk of Platinum 190. Surely these ladies can appreciate the rare beauty of precious metals!
rows.translation: 献出你的铂金190矿块。这些女士肯定懂得欣赏贵金属罕见的美丽！
rows.raw: "Offer your chunk of Platinum 190. Surely these ladies can appreciate the rare beauty of precious metals!"

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: Where’re you going to get some of those?
rows.translation: 你要去哪里弄到那些东西？
rows.raw: "Where’re you going to get some of those?"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You take out a pouch
rows.translation: 你取出一个小袋子
rows.raw: "You take out a pouch "

rows.original: laden with gemstones
rows.translation: 装满宝石
rows.raw: "laden with gemstones"

rows.original: with a gemstone
rows.translation: 装着一颗宝石
rows.raw: "with a gemstone"

rows.original: and offer them to the guards, hoping to appeal to their avarice. The guards approach, their dark eyes glinting with greed as you reveal your briberous payload. When they get a good look at the stones, though, their lips curl, and the lead guard plants her hands on her hips.
rows.translation: ，递给守卫，希望能勾起她们的贪欲。守卫走近，看到你亮出用来行贿的东西时，黑色眼眸闪烁着贪婪光芒。然而等她们看清这些石头后，嘴角却撇了下来；领头的守卫双手叉腰。
rows.raw: " and offer them to the guards, hoping to appeal to their avarice. The guards approach, their dark eyes glinting with greed as you reveal your briberous payload. When they get a good look at the stones, though, their lips curl, and the lead guard plants her hands on her hips."

rows.original: “Is that it?” she scowls, squinting at your offering. “No, no, I’m not going to risk Queen Taivra’s wrath for that,” she scoffs, shoving your hand back.
rows.translation: “就这？”她眯眼盯着你的贡品，皱眉道。“不，不行，我可不会为了这个冒着激怒泰芙拉女王的风险，”她嗤笑着，把你的手推了回去。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is that it?” she scowls, squinting at your offering. “No, no, I’m not going to risk Queen Taivra’s wrath for that,” she scoffs, shoving your hand back."

rows.original: “We can get those anywhere,” the other nyrea says. “Come on, if you want to buy your way in, cough up something really unique. Something special!”
rows.translation: “这种东西哪里都能弄到，”另一个尼瑞娅说道。“拜托，你要想花钱买路，就拿出真正独一无二的东西。特别一点的！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We can get those anywhere,” the other nyrea says. “Come on, if you want to buy your way in, cough up something really unique. Something special!”"

rows.original: Something special, huh? Maybe some precious metals or gems from another world would suit them better...
rows.translation: 特别的东西，是吗？也许来自另一个世界的贵金属或宝石会更合她们胃口...
rows.raw: "\n\nSomething special, huh? Maybe some precious metals or gems from another world would suit them better..."

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.translation: 你取出一个袋子，里面
rows.raw: "You take out a pouch "

rows.original: laden with gemstones
rows.translation: 装满宝石
rows.raw: "laden with gemstones"

rows.original: with a gemstone
rows.translation: 装着一颗宝石
rows.raw: "with a gemstone"

rows.translation: ，递给守卫，希望能勾起她们的贪欲。守卫走近，看到你亮出用来行贿的东西时，黑色眼眸闪烁着贪婪光芒。然而等她们看清这些石头后，嘴角却撇了下来；领头的守卫双手叉腰。
rows.raw: " and offer them to the guards, hoping to appeal to their avarice. The guards approach, their dark eyes glinting with greed as you reveal your briberous payload. When they get a good look at the stones, though, their lips curl, and the lead guard plants her hands on her hips."

rows.original: “Is that it?” she scowls, squinting at your offering. “No, no, I’m not going to risk Queen Taivra’s wrath for that,” she scoffs, shoving your hand back.
rows.translation: “就这？”她眯眼盯着你的贡品，皱眉道。“不，不行，我可不会为了这个冒着激怒泰芙拉女王的风险，”她嗤笑着，把你的手推了回去。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is that it?” she scowls, squinting at your offering. “No, no, I’m not going to risk Queen Taivra’s wrath for that,” she scoffs, shoving your hand back."

rows.original: “We can get gemstones anywhere,” the other nyrea says. “Come on, if you want to buy your way in, cough up something really unique. Something special!”
rows.translation: “宝石这种东西哪里都能弄到，”另一个尼瑞娅说道。“拜托，你要想花钱买路，就拿出真正独一无二的东西。特别一点的！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We can get gemstones anywhere,” the other nyrea says. “Come on, if you want to buy your way in, cough up something really unique. Something special!”"

rows.original: Something special, huh? Maybe a truly precious metal would suit them better...
rows.translation: 特别的东西，是吗？也许真正贵重的金属会更合她们胃口...
rows.raw: "\n\nSomething special, huh? Maybe a truly precious metal would suit them better..."

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “How about this?” you ask, taking the chunk of gleaming platinum out of your pack.
rows.translation: “这个怎么样？”你问着，从背包里取出闪闪发亮的铂金块。
rows.raw: "“How about this?” you ask, taking the chunk of gleaming platinum out of your pack."

rows.original: The huntresses’ eyes go wide, and one of them takes hold of the shard of ore and looks it over. “It’s beautiful,” she says, waving her comrade over. “Where did you get this?”
rows.translation: 女猎手们瞪大眼睛，其中一人抓住矿石碎块仔细端详。“真漂亮，”她说着，招呼同伴过来。“你从哪儿弄到的？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe huntresses’ eyes go wide, and one of them takes hold of the shard of ore and looks it over. “It’s beautiful,” she says, waving her comrade over. “Where did you get this?”"

rows.original: You grin and explain that you found the shard in the heart of a dead, alien planet that had been sewn together from two other half-planets. It’s a rare and awesomely expensive isotope of platinum - surely it would fetch a good price down here in the depths, or if they try to sell it to an off-worlder.
rows.translation: 你咧嘴一笑，解释说这块碎片是在一颗死寂的外星行星核心找到的，那颗行星由两颗残缺星球缝合而成。这是一种稀有而昂贵得惊人的铂同位素——无论在这片深处，还是卖给外星来客，都肯定能换来好价钱。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou grin and explain that you found the shard in the heart of a dead, alien planet that had been sewn together from two other half-planets. It’s a rare and awesomely expensive isotope of platinum - surely it would fetch a good price down here in the depths, or if they try to sell it to an off-worlder."

rows.original: “This will do nicely,” one of the guards smiles, slipping the platinum shard into a pouch on her belt. “Very well, follow us. We can take you to the queen’s chambers, but I cannot guarantee she’ll want to listen to whatever you have to say.”
rows.translation: “这个很合适，”其中一名守卫微笑着，把铂金碎块塞进腰带上的小袋。“很好，跟我们来。我们可以带你去女王的寝宫，但我不能保证她愿意听你说的任何话。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This will do nicely,” one of the guards smiles, slipping the platinum shard into a pouch on her belt. “Very well, follow us. We can take you to the queen’s chambers, but I cannot guarantee she’ll want to listen to whatever you have to say.”"

rows.original: “Follow us,” the other says, pushing the front gate open and beckoning you on.
rows.translation: “跟我们来，”另一人说着，推开前门，招手示意你跟上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Follow us,” the other says, pushing the front gate open and beckoning you on."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Platinum 190
rows.raw: "Platinum 190"

rows.original: PLAT190 USED AS NYREA BRIBE
rows.raw: "PLAT190 USED AS NYREA BRIBE"

rows.original: Gems
rows.translation: 宝石
rows.raw: "Gems"

rows.translation: 宝石

rows.translation: 你没有任何宝石。

rows.translation: 宝石
rows.raw: "Gem"

rows.translation: 宝石

rows.translation: 献出你携带的宝石。
rows.raw: "Offer the gem you’re carrying."

rows.translation: 也许她们会对你携带的某颗宝石感兴趣...
rows.raw: "Maybe they’d be interested in one of the gems you’re carrying..."

rows.original: Exotic Gems
rows.translation: 异域宝石
rows.raw: "Exotic Gems"

rows.original: Exotic Gems
rows.translation: 异域宝石
rows.raw: "Exotic Gems"

rows.original: You don’t have any exotic gems.
rows.translation: 你没有任何异域宝石。
rows.raw: "You don’t have any exotic gems."

rows.original: Exotic Gem
rows.translation: 异域宝石
rows.raw: "Exotic Gem"

rows.original: Exotic Gem
rows.translation: 异域宝石
rows.raw: "Exotic Gem"

rows.original: Offer the exotic gem you’re carrying.
rows.translation: 献上你携带的异域宝石。
rows.raw: "Offer the exotic gem you’re carrying."

rows.original: Exotic Gems
rows.translation: 异域宝石
rows.raw: "Exotic Gems"

rows.original: ExoticGems
rows.translation: 异域宝石
rows.raw: "ExoticGems"

rows.original: Maybe they’d be interested in one of the exotic gems you’re carrying...
rows.translation: 也许她们会对你携带的某颗异域宝石感兴趣...
rows.raw: "Maybe they’d be interested in one of the exotic gems you’re carrying..."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Come on, can’t we work something out?” you ask, putting on your most diplomatic smile.
rows.translation: “拜托，就不能商量一下吗？”你摆出最具外交风范的笑容问道。
rows.raw: "“Come on, can’t we work something out?” you ask, putting on your most diplomatic smile."

rows.original: The two guards exchange a glance, and one of them puts a hand on her hip. “Hmm, at least this one understands parley. Very well, perhaps we could convince the queen to see you. If you have something of sufficient value...”
rows.translation: 两名守卫对视一眼，其中一人单手叉腰。“嗯，至少这家伙懂得谈判。很好，也许我们能说服女王接见你。只要你有足够贵重的东西...”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two guards exchange a glance, and one of them puts a hand on her hip. “Hmm, at least this one understands parley. Very well, perhaps we could convince the queen to see you. If you have something of sufficient value...”"

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: Sex
rows.translation: 性交
rows.raw: "Sex"

rows.original: Sex
rows.translation: 性交
rows.raw: "Sex"

rows.original: Sacrifice your dignity for diplomacy... fuck the guards to get in.
rows.translation: 为了外交牺牲尊严...操守卫来换取入内。
rows.raw: "Sacrifice your dignity for diplomacy... fuck the guards to get in."

rows.original: Credits
rows.translation: 信用点
rows.raw: "Credits"

rows.original: Credits
rows.translation: 信用点
rows.raw: "Credits"

rows.original: Offer to give the guards some credits. Surely they like good old bribery down here...
rows.translation: 提出给守卫一些信用点。她们在地底下肯定也喜欢传统的贿赂...
rows.raw: "Offer to give the guards some credits. Surely they like good old bribery down here..."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You walk over to the guards, hoping to talk to them. Instead, the guardswomen plant their feet and cross their spears over the heavy stone gate, an unnecessary but obvious sign that you’re about to be refused passage.
rows.translation: 你走向守卫，希望能与她们谈谈。可女守卫们却站稳脚跟，将长矛交叉挡在沉重的石门前。这动作虽然多余，却明确表示她们准备拒绝你通过。
rows.raw: "You walk over to the guards, hoping to talk to them. Instead, the guardswomen plant their feet and cross their spears over the heavy stone gate, an unnecessary but obvious sign that you’re about to be refused passage."

rows.original: “Turn back, star-walker,” one of the women says; the other twists her black lips into a distinct frown. “Queen Taivra has decreed no more offworlders are to be permitted in the palace. Your kind have done us enough insult.”
rows.translation: “回去吧，星行者，”其中一名女子说道；另一人则抿起黑色嘴唇，明显皱起眉头。“泰芙拉女王已经下令，不得再让任何外星人进入宫殿。你们已经给了我们足够多的侮辱。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Turn back, star-walker,” one of the women says; the other twists her black lips into a distinct frown. “Queen Taivra has decreed no more offworlders are to be permitted in the palace. Your kind have done us enough insult.”"

rows.original: “What?” you ask. Definitely weren’t expecting that answer.
rows.translation: “什么？”你问道。这个答案实在出乎意料。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What?” you ask. Definitely weren’t expecting that answer."

rows.original: The other guard grunts. “Our queen was attacked by one of you space-creatures. One who said [rival.heShe] wished to talk diplomacy. We will not suffer such an insult again... your kind is no longer welcome here.”
rows.translation: 另一名守卫哼了一声。“我们的女王遭到了你们太空生物之一的袭击。那人声称[rival.heShe]想要展开外交会谈。我们不会再忍受这样的侮辱...你们不再受这里欢迎。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe other guard grunts. “Our queen was attacked by one of you space-creatures. One who said [rival.heShe] wished to talk diplomacy. We will not suffer such an insult again... your kind is no longer welcome here.”"

rows.original: Shit. Something tells you this sociopathic star-walker they’re talking about just might be your dear cousin [rival.name]...
rows.translation: 该死。直觉告诉你，她们口中那个反社会的星行者，很可能就是你亲爱的表亲[rival.name]...
rows.raw: "\n\nShit. Something tells you this sociopathic star-walker they’re talking about just might be your dear cousin [rival.name]..."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: Attack
rows.translation: 攻击
rows.raw: "Attack"

rows.original: Attack
rows.translation: 攻击
rows.raw: "Attack"

rows.original: Unfortunately for these bitches, you need to get into that palace. If your cousin’s inside, so too must be the probe...
rows.translation: 这些婊子很不走运，因为你必须进入那座宫殿。如果你的表亲在里面，探针肯定也在那里...
rows.raw: "Unfortunately for these bitches, you need to get into that palace. If your cousin’s inside, so too must be the probe..."

rows.original: Persuade
rows.translation: 说服
rows.raw: "Persuade"

rows.original: Persuade
rows.translation: 说服
rows.raw: "Persuade"

rows.original: Try and talk your way into the nyrean camp. Surely the three of you could work something out...
rows.translation: 试着说服她们让你进入奈瑞亚营地。你们三个肯定能谈出个办法...
rows.raw: "Try and talk your way into the nyrean camp. Surely the three of you could work something out..."

rows.original: Approach
rows.translation: 接近
rows.raw: "Approach"

rows.original: Talk to the nyrea guards and see if you can get passage past the gate. You’re almost sure the coordinates you got for Dad’s probe lead to a position right near here...
rows.translation: 与奈瑞亚守卫交谈，看看能不能获准通过大门。你几乎可以确定，父亲探针的坐标就指向这附近的某个位置...
rows.raw: "Talk to the nyrea guards and see if you can get passage past the gate. You’re almost sure the coordinates you got for Dad’s probe lead to a position right near here..."

rows.original: The queen’s bodyguard seems to have recovered and are prepared to fight you off again!
rows.translation: 女王的贴身护卫似乎已经恢复过来，准备再次把你击退！
rows.raw: "\n\nThe queen’s bodyguard seems to have recovered and are prepared to fight you off again!"

rows.original: Fight
rows.translation: 战斗
rows.raw: "Fight"

rows.translation: 你朝戴恩咯咯一笑。“还有力气再来一个吗，大块头？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou giggle at Dane. “Got time for one more, hunk?”"

rows.original: You smile at Dane. “Ever taken down a queen before?”
rows.translation: 你对戴恩微微一笑。“以前放倒过女王吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou smile at Dane. “Ever taken down a queen before?”"

rows.original: You favor Dane with a roguish grin. “Don’t bleed out yet. There’s still a queen to take care of, remember?”
rows.translation: 你朝戴恩露出一个无赖般的坏笑。“先别流血流死了。别忘了，还有个女王要收拾呢。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou favor Dane with a roguish grin. “Don’t bleed out yet. There’s still a queen to take care of, remember?”"

rows.original: You glance Dane’s way. “You owe me. Think you can keep from passing out long enough to depose some royalty?”
rows.translation: 你朝戴恩瞥了一眼。“你欠我一个人情。能不能撑着别昏过去，先把某位王室成员赶下台？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou glance Dane’s way. “You owe me. Think you can keep from passing out long enough to depose some royalty?”"

rows.original: Dane rolls his shoulders and silently nods, his cold glare locking on the creature responsible for his imprisonment. “Yeah, I’m game.”
rows.translation: 戴恩活动了一下肩膀，默默点头，冰冷的目光锁定了那个害他遭到囚禁的生物。“好啊，我奉陪。”
rows.raw: "\n\nDane rolls his shoulders and silently nods, his cold glare locking on the creature responsible for his imprisonment. “Yeah, I’m game.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You’ve got a clear shot at Dane’s cage now, and the ausar knows it. “Get me out of here!” he growls, eyeing Taivra dangerously. “C’mon already!”
rows.translation: 现在你能清楚地打中戴恩的牢笼了，那个奥萨人也明白这一点。“快放我出去！”他低吼着，危险地瞪着泰芙拉。“快点啊！”
rows.raw: "You’ve got a clear shot at Dane’s cage now, and the ausar knows it. “Get me out of here!” he growls, eyeing Taivra dangerously. “C’mon already!”"

rows.original: You take aim at the lock and strike!
rows.translation: 你瞄准锁头，发动攻击！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take aim at the lock and strike!"

rows.original: As soon as you destroy the cage’s primitive lock, Dane is surging into action. The big ausar combat rolls into the door, smashing it fully open with his muscular bulk. His hands wrap around the haft of his warden’s spear, and with a simple tug, the weapon is liberated from the gape-mouthed nyrea. As big as Dane is, the spear looks like a toothpick in his hammer-thick hands. He growls, deep in his throat and snaps it in two, simultaneously backhanding the surprised cave-dweller into the wall with one of his free hands.
rows.translation: 你刚摧毁笼子原始的锁具，戴恩便猛然行动起来。高大的奥萨人战术翻滚着撞上笼门，以肌肉虬结的魁梧身躯将门彻底砸开。他双手握住看守长矛的矛杆，只随手一扯，武器便从目瞪口呆的尼瑞亚人手中脱落。戴恩身材如此庞大，那柄长矛握在他锤头般粗壮的手中简直像根牙签。他从喉咙深处发出低吼，将矛一折为二，同时用一只空手反手把吃惊的洞穴居民抽到墙上。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs soon as you destroy the cage’s primitive lock, Dane is surging into action. The big ausar combat rolls into the door, smashing it fully open with his muscular bulk. His hands wrap around the haft of his warden’s spear, and with a simple tug, the weapon is liberated from the gape-mouthed nyrea. As big as Dane is, the spear looks like a toothpick in his hammer-thick hands. He growls, deep in his throat and snaps it in two, simultaneously backhanding the surprised cave-dweller into the wall with one of his free hands."

rows.original: The alabaster ausar is utterly naked, stripped of his gear and bruised from his capture, but he’s grinning like a mad dog all the same. The veins on his arms bulge as he flexes his corded muscles, flipping the pieces of primitive weaponry down to his lower arms to hold like daggers. “You should’ve killed me when you had the chance. This time you won’t get a chance to have your pets jump me in the dark. Come on, [pc.name]. Let’s take her.”
rows.translation: 这个雪白毛发的奥萨人一丝不挂，装备全被剥走，身上还带着被俘后留下的淤伤，可他仍像条疯狗一样咧嘴狞笑。随着他绷紧结实的肌肉，手臂上的血管高高鼓起；他将断裂的原始武器碎片翻到下方两只手中，像匕首一样握着。“你有机会时就该杀了我。这次你可没机会让宠物们在黑暗里偷袭我了。来吧，[pc.name]。我们一起放倒她。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe alabaster ausar is utterly naked, stripped of his gear and bruised from his capture, but he’s grinning like a mad dog all the same. The veins on his arms bulge as he flexes his corded muscles, flipping the pieces of primitive weaponry down to his lower arms to hold like daggers. “You should’ve killed me when you had the chance. This time you won’t get a chance to have your pets jump me in the dark. Come on, [pc.name]. Let’s take her.”"

rows.original: Queensguard valiantly struggles to her feet to interpose herself between her mistress and the near-rabid ausar, but she earns little more than a stunning backhand for her effort. Together you can bring down the Queen!
rows.translation: 女王卫士英勇地挣扎着起身，想挡在女主人与近乎狂暴的奥萨人之间，可她的努力只换来一记把人打懵的反手耳光。 你们可以合力击败女王！
rows.raw: " Queensguard valiantly struggles to her feet to interpose herself between her mistress and the near-rabid ausar, but she earns little more than a stunning backhand for her effort. Together you can bring down the Queen!"

rows.original: Cage Distance
rows.raw: "Cage Distance"

rows.original: TaivraFite
rows.raw: "TaivraFite"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “So, who’s in charge these days?” you ask, glancing at the group of armed huntresses near the middle of the small village.
rows.translation: “所以，现在是谁在当家？”你问道，瞥向小村中央附近那群武装起来的女猎手。
rows.raw: "“So, who’s in charge these days?” you ask, glancing at the group of armed huntresses near the middle of the small village."

rows.original: Seifyn sighs heavily, wrapping her arms around herself. “Taivra’s eldest daughter. She’s the heir, after all... but she’s locked herself in the palace, surrounded by her elite guard. Barely comes out now, except to send soldiers to take mates or bring in food.”
rows.translation: 赛芬沉重地叹了口气，双臂环抱住自己。“泰芙拉的大女儿。毕竟她是继承人...但她把自己锁在宫殿里，身边围满了精锐卫队。现在几乎从不露面，只会派士兵去抓伴侣或者运食物进来。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSeifyn sighs heavily, wrapping her arms around herself. “Taivra’s eldest daughter. She’s the heir, after all... but she’s locked herself in the palace, surrounded by her elite guard. Barely comes out now, except to send soldiers to take mates or bring in food.”"

rows.original: Sounds like the princess has become something of a recluse since your door kicking adventures. “So, how does she stack up to Taivra?”
rows.translation: 看来，自从你那次破门而入的冒险之后，公主就变得有些离群索居了。“那么，她和泰芙拉比起来怎么样？”
rows.raw: "\n\nSounds like the princess has become something of a recluse since your door kicking adventures. “So, how does she stack up to Taivra?”"

rows.original: “I wouldn’t know. She hasn’t... chosen me yet. But I hear she’s brutal, a real tyrant. I’m just trying to keep my head down, [pc.name]. I don’t want any trouble from her. I know I miss her mom, though. Wish it was one of mine that was on the throne... at least then I’d probably get to live in the palace. Definitely wouldn’t have to get mated again. Would be nice to choose my own for once, but I guess that’s not happening any time soon.”
rows.translation: “我怎么会知道。她还没有...选中我。不过我听说她很残暴，是个真正的暴君。我只想低调过日子，[pc.name]。我不想招惹她的麻烦。但我确实很想念她妈妈。真希望坐上王座的是我的某个女儿...至少那样我大概就能住进宫殿了。肯定也不用再被配种。要是能自己选择一次就好了，可我想短期内不会有这种机会。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I wouldn’t know. She hasn’t... chosen me yet. But I hear she’s brutal, a real tyrant. I’m just trying to keep my head down, [pc.name]. I don’t want any trouble from her. I know I miss her mom, though. Wish it was one of mine that was on the throne... at least then I’d probably get to live in the palace. Definitely wouldn’t have to get mated again. Would be nice to choose my own for once, but I guess that’s not happening any time soon.”"

rows.original: Siefyn sighs wistfully and rests her chin on her hands. “Anyway... something else I can help you with, [pc.name]?”
rows.translation: 赛芬惆怅地叹了口气，双手托住下巴。“总之...还有什么是我能帮你的，[pc.name]？”
rows.raw: "\n\nSiefyn sighs wistfully and rests her chin on her hands. “Anyway... something else I can help you with, [pc.name]?”"

rows.original: “So, how’s the queen doing?” you ask with a grin, shooting a glance to the sealed doors of the palace.
rows.translation: “那么，女王最近怎么样？”你咧嘴问道，朝宫殿紧闭的大门瞥了一眼。
rows.raw: "“So, how’s the queen doing?” you ask with a grin, shooting a glance to the sealed doors of the palace."

rows.original: “You mean after you kicked her ass?” Siefyn says, crossing her arms. “She told us what happened. Gathered everyone up, said offworlders made a fool of her. Hurt her bodyguard. Something told me you might have been the one.”
rows.translation: “你是说被你痛揍一顿之后？”赛芬抱起双臂说道。“她把事情都告诉我们了。召集所有人，说天外来客让她出了洋相，还伤了她的保镖。我就觉得那个人可能是你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You mean after you kicked her ass?” Siefyn says, crossing her arms. “She told us what happened. Gathered everyone up, said offworlders made a fool of her. Hurt her bodyguard. Something told me you might have been the one.”"

rows.original: You
rows.translation: 你
rows.raw: "\n\nYou "

joinAfter.expression:
pc.isMischievous()
                      ? "shrug noncommittally. Maybe it was, maybe it wasn’t."
                      : "admit that it was, yes."

rows.original: shrug noncommittally. Maybe it was, maybe it wasn’t.
rows.translation: 不置可否地耸了耸肩。也许是你，也许不是。
rows.raw: "shrug noncommittally. Maybe it was, maybe it wasn’t."

rows.original: admit that it was, yes.
rows.translation: 承认没错，确实是你。
rows.raw: "admit that it was, yes."

rows.original: Siefyn nods slowly. “Well, she’s locked herself in her palace now. Says she doesn’t want anything else to do with off-worlders. I can see why, but... we need the trade. I don’t want to be the one with sticks and stones when the myr have magic guns from space.”
rows.translation: 赛芬缓缓点头。“好吧，她现在把自己锁在宫殿里。说再也不想和外星人打交道。我能理解，可是...我们需要贸易。我可不想在米尔人已经拿到来自太空的魔法枪械时，自己手里还只有棍棒和石头。”
rows.raw: " Siefyn nods slowly. “Well, she’s locked herself in her palace now. Says she doesn’t want anything else to do with off-worlders. I can see why, but... we need the trade. I don’t want to be the one with sticks and stones when the myr have magic guns from space.”"

rows.original: “So Taivra doesn’t want you trading with us now?”
rows.translation: “所以泰芙拉现在不想让你们和我们做生意？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So Taivra doesn’t want you trading with us now?”"

rows.original: “No, but...” Siefyn chuckles, flicking back a stray lock of hair. “You’re way too valuable to turn away.”
rows.translation: “不想，但是...”赛芬轻笑一声，把一缕散落的头发拨回去。“你们实在太有价值了，不能拒之门外。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No, but...” Siefyn chuckles, flicking back a stray lock of hair. “You’re way too valuable to turn away.”"

rows.original: Uh-huh. You’re sure that’s what she says to all the star-walkers...
rows.translation: 哦，是吗。你敢肯定她对每个星行者都是这么说的...
rows.raw: "\n\nUh-huh. You’re sure that’s what she says to all the star-walkers..."

rows.original: Siefyn sighs wistfully and rests her chin on her hands. “Anyway... something else I can help you with, [pc.name]?”
rows.translation: 赛芬惆怅地叹了口气，双手托住下巴。“总之...还有什么是我能帮你的，[pc.name]？”
rows.raw: "\n\nSiefyn sighs wistfully and rests her chin on her hands. “Anyway... something else I can help you with, [pc.name]?”"

rows.original: Steele Tech
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔科技
rows.raw: "Steele Tech"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Rather eager to return to Taivra with the marvel of new technology you ordered, you start crossing the tarmac at a quick pace, eager to see her reaction to it.
rows.translation: 你急着带着自己订购的新科技奇物回去见泰芙拉，便快步穿过停机坪，迫不及待想看看她会有什么反应。
rows.raw: "Rather eager to return to Taivra with the marvel of new technology you ordered, you start crossing the tarmac at a quick pace, eager to see her reaction to it."

rows.original: With your victory over the nyrea - and your cousin - fresh on your mind, you start crossing the tarmac with a relative skip in your step, eager to see what the next leg of your voyage has in store for you.
rows.translation: 战胜尼瑞亚人和你表亲的经历仍记忆犹新，你脚步颇为轻快地穿过停机坪，迫不及待想看看旅程下一段会有什么在等待着你。
rows.raw: "With your victory over the nyrea - and your cousin - fresh on your mind, you start crossing the tarmac with a relative skip in your step, eager to see what the next leg of your voyage has in store for you."

rows.original: You pause, though, when you see a Steele Tech freighter parked on the airfield beside your own vessel. Its cargo doors are down, and a pair of crewmen in the familiar black and yellow company jumpsuit are inspecting a familiar glossy-black hunk of space junk: your dad’s probe! The company made good time in retrieving it, no doubt about it. You walk over and give the two burly men a wave, and head over to check in with them.
rows.translation: 不过，当你看到一艘斯蒂尔科技货船停在自己的飞船旁边时，脚步停了下来。它的货舱门已经放下，两名身穿熟悉黑黄公司连体服的船员正在检查一块眼熟的亮黑色太空垃圾，也就是你父亲的探测器！公司回收它的速度确实很快，这一点毋庸置疑。你走过去，朝两个身材壮实的男人挥了挥手，上前向他们了解情况。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou pause, though, when you see a Steele Tech freighter parked on the airfield beside your own vessel. Its cargo doors are down, and a pair of crewmen in the familiar black and yellow company jumpsuit are inspecting a familiar glossy-black hunk of space junk: your dad’s probe! The company made good time in retrieving it, no doubt about it. You walk over and give the two burly men a wave, and head over to check in with them."

rows.original: <i>“Ah,
Mr.
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔先生
rows.raw: "Mr."

rows.original: Ms.
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔女士
rows.raw: "Ms."

rows.original: Steele,” one of the pilots says with a grin, tipping his cap to you. “Good work finding this old bird. The techs back at headquarters will have her shooting through the stars again in no time. Probably rewire her as an explorer or comm relay, I reckon.”
rows.translation: ⁠，”其中一名飞行员咧嘴说道，朝你抬帽致意。“这只老家伙找得好。总部的技术人员用不了多久就能让她重新穿梭星海。估计会重新接线，把她改成探索器或通信中继站吧。”
rows.raw: " Steele,” one of the pilots says with a grin, tipping his cap to you. “Good work finding this old bird. The techs back at headquarters will have her shooting through the stars again in no time. Probably rewire her as an explorer or comm relay, I reckon.”"

rows.original: That’s good to hear. If there’s one thing that makes Steele Tech great, its that the company never lets anything go to waste. The company pilots chuckle when you mention it, and one jokes that he’s fairly certain
rows.translation: 听到这个消息真不错。若要说有什么成就了斯蒂尔科技，那就是公司从不让任何东西白白浪费。你提起这点时，公司飞行员们笑了起来，其中一人开玩笑说，他相当确定
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s good to hear. If there’s one thing that makes Steele Tech great, its that the company never lets anything go to waste. The company pilots chuckle when you mention it, and one jokes that he’s fairly certain "

rows.original: that starship next to theirs must be old Tricky Vic’s original
rows.translation: 他们旁边的那艘星舰肯定就是老狡猾维克原来的飞船
rows.raw: "that starship next to theirs must be old Tricky Vic’s original"

rows.original: that old Tricky Vic’s original is still flying out there, somewhere
rows.translation: 老狡猾维克原来的飞船依然在外面的某处飞行
rows.raw: "that old Tricky Vic’s original is still flying out there, somewhere"

rows.original: . You just grin.
rows.translation: 。你只是咧嘴一笑。
rows.raw: ". You just grin."

rows.original: <i>“Alright,
rows.translation: <i>“好了，
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Alright, "

rows.original: Mr.
rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "Mr."

rows.original: Ms.
rows.translation: 女士
rows.raw: "Ms."

rows.original: Steele,” one of them says, taking out a Codex just like yours. “There’s an outstanding bounty on these old probes, as you know. Let’s get you paid up, huh?”
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔，”其中一人边说边拿出一台与你的一模一样的终端。“你也知道，这些旧探针还有一笔尚未领取的赏金。咱们把钱付给你，怎么样？”
rows.raw: " Steele,” one of them says, taking out a Codex just like yours. “There’s an outstanding bounty on these old probes, as you know. Let’s get you paid up, huh?”"

rows.original: A moment later and your own device beeps happily, alerting you to a new deposit of <b>
rows.translation: 片刻后，你自己的设备欢快地响了一声，提醒你有一笔新的<b>
rows.raw: "\n\nA moment later and your own device beeps happily, alerting you to a new deposit of <b>"

rows.original: credits into your bank account. Score!
rows.translation: 星币存入了银行账户。赚到了！
rows.raw: " credits into your bank account. Score!"

rows.original: “No idea why you wanted this other one, but with the alterations to it and the value of the case still, looks like it’ll all wash out.” He gestures to an identical probe being wheeled out of their vessel, one that has the expensive scanning tech removed and some expensive comfortability baked in.
rows.translation: “不知道你为什么想要另一台，不过算上对它的改装和外壳本身剩余的价值，最后差不多能抵平。”他指向一台正从他们飞船里运出来的同款探针；昂贵的扫描设备已被拆除，取而代之的是一些同样昂贵的舒适化改装。
rows.raw: "\n\n“No idea why you wanted this other one, but with the alterations to it and the value of the case still, looks like it’ll all wash out.” He gestures to an identical probe being wheeled out of their vessel, one that has the expensive scanning tech removed and some expensive comfortability baked in."

rows.original: You thank the pair for their work and turn to start hauling the remodeled piece of throne down to the deep caves.
rows.translation: 你感谢两人的工作，转身开始把这件改装过的王座运往深层洞穴。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou thank the pair for their work and turn to start hauling the remodeled piece of throne down to the deep caves."

rows.original: You thank the pair and turn to leave.
rows.translation: 你向两人道谢，转身离开。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou thank the pair and turn to leave."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: ...and just save yourself from face-planting into a familiar pair of breasts barely held back by a ballistic vest.
rows.translation: ...并及时稳住了自己，才没有一头栽进那对熟悉的、几乎被防弹背心兜不住的乳房里。
rows.raw: "...and just save yourself from face-planting into a familiar pair of breasts barely held back by a ballistic vest."

rows.original: “Woah, easy there,” Shade laughs, giving you a gentle push out of her personal space. “Going somewhere, kid?”
rows.translation: “哇哦，小心点，”莎德笑道，轻轻把你推出她的私人空间。“要去哪儿啊，小鬼？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Woah, easy there,” Shade laughs, giving you a gentle push out of her personal space. “Going somewhere, kid?”"

rows.original: You laugh off the near-collision and say that you just found one of your dad’s probes, loaded with the coordinates you need for the next leg of your quest.
rows.translation: 你笑着化解了这场险些发生的碰撞，说自己刚找到父亲的一台探针，里面载有你下一段旅程所需的坐标。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou laugh off the near-collision and say that you just found one of your dad’s probes, loaded with the coordinates you need for the next leg of your quest."

rows.original: “Well, good for you,” she smiles with a playful punch on your shoulder. “Guess that means you’re done with this war-torn shithole of a planet, huh?”
rows.translation: “那可真不错，”她笑着在你肩上俏皮地捶了一拳。“这么说，你在这颗饱受战争蹂躏的破烂星球上已经没事了，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, good for you,” she smiles with a playful punch on your shoulder. “Guess that means you’re done with this war-torn shithole of a planet, huh?”"

rows.original: “It’s not that bad,” you riposte, smiling at the amazonian cat-girl. “It’s got some good people on it.”
rows.translation: “这里没那么糟，”你笑着反驳这位亚马逊般的猫女。“这里还是有些好人的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s not that bad,” you riposte, smiling at the amazonian cat-girl. “It’s got some good people on it.”"

rows.original: She rolls her eyes at the obvious flirtation, but her arms settle under her impressive bust, subtly emphasizing the way her button-up shirt strains around it. <i>“Yeah, well, looks like I’m off, too.
rows.translation: 她对这句露骨的调情翻了个白眼，但双臂却在傲人的胸脯下交叠起来，悄然凸显出纽扣衬衫被撑得紧绷的模样。<i>“是啊，不过看来我也要走了。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe rolls her eyes at the obvious flirtation, but her arms settle under her impressive bust, subtly emphasizing the way her button-up shirt strains around it. <i>“Yeah, well, looks like I’m off, too. "

rows.original: Now that I’ve nailed that blue-haired bounty of mine, there’s not much reason to stick around. Turns out the locals don’t want off-world hunters rounding up military deserters like I’d thought.
rows.translation: 既然我已经抓住那个蓝头发的悬赏目标，就没什么理由继续待下去了。事实证明，当地人并不像我原先以为的那样，希望外来猎人帮他们抓捕逃兵。
rows.raw: "Now that I’ve nailed that blue-haired bounty of mine, there’s not much reason to stick around. Turns out the locals don’t want off-world hunters rounding up military deserters like I’d thought."

rows.original: I just can’t find that stupid blue-haired bombshell I’m supposed to be tracking. Lost track of how long I’ve been looking for her, now... Guess I’ll phone it in.
rows.translation: 我就是找不到那个该死的蓝发美人悬赏目标。都不记得找她找了多久了...看来我只能打电话汇报了。
rows.raw: "I just can’t find that stupid blue-haired bombshell I’m supposed to be tracking. Lost track of how long I’ve been looking for her, now... Guess I’ll phone it in."

rows.original: I think I’ve earned some R&R after all this time, maybe I’ll head back home for a couple weeks.”
rows.translation: 我想这么久以来自己也该享受点休息娱乐了，也许会回家住上几周。”
rows.raw: " I think I’ve earned some R&R after all this time, maybe I’ll head back home for a couple weeks.”"

rows.original: “Home?”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Home?”"

rows.original: <i>“Uveto VII. I’ve got a house there, a little place in Irestead I managed to buy. I sort of fell in love with the planet the first time I was there, decided to put down roots... at least as much as somebody in my line of work can.
rows.translation: <i>“乌维托七号。我在那里有栋房子，是我设法在伊尔斯泰德买下的一处小地方。我第一次到那里时就有点爱上了那颗星球，于是决定扎下根来...至少像我这种工作的人能扎多深就扎多深。
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Uveto VII. I’ve got a house there, a little place in Irestead I managed to buy. I sort of fell in love with the planet the first time I was there, decided to put down roots... at least as much as somebody in my line of work can. "

rows.original: You should drop by sometime. I’ll show you around, make you dinner... maybe give you a few reasons to stay a while.
rows.translation: 你有空应该来看看。我会带你四处逛逛，给你做晚餐...也许再给你几个留下来多住一阵的理由。
rows.raw: "You should drop by sometime. I’ll show you around, make you dinner... maybe give you a few reasons to stay a while."

rows.original: You’ve got skills, you know, [pc.name]. You should swing by sometime. I could show you a few things, get you some training at the Stormguard temple. You could be a real badass hunter if you put your mind to it.
rows.translation: 你很有本事，[pc.name]。有空应该来一趟。我可以教你几招，让你在风暴卫士神殿接受些训练。只要有心，你完全能成为一个真正厉害的猎人。
rows.raw: "You’ve got skills, you know, [pc.name]. You should swing by sometime. I could show you a few things, get you some training at the Stormguard temple. You could be a real badass hunter if you put your mind to it."

rows.original: If you’re ever on-planet, look me up. I’ll buy you a drink.
rows.translation: 如果你哪天到了那颗星球，就来找我。我请你喝一杯。
rows.raw: "If you’re ever on-planet, look me up. I’ll buy you a drink."

rows.original: My daughter, Astra, lives there, too. I’ll introduce you: something tells me you’d get along.
rows.translation: 我的女儿阿斯特拉也住在那里。我会介绍你们认识：我有种感觉，你们会很合得来。
rows.raw: " My daughter, Astra, lives there, too. I’ll introduce you: something tells me you’d get along."

rows.original: You remind me of her quite a bit
rows.translation: 你让我想起了她不少地方
rows.raw: "You remind me of her quite a bit"

rows.original: As she’s speaking, Shade leans aside onto the Steele Tech probe, giving the pair of pilots a respectful nod. They start to return the gesture, right up until the probe bleeps and its screens start glowing.
rows.translation: 说话间，莎德侧身倚在斯蒂尔科技探针上，向两名飞行员礼貌地点了点头。他们刚要回礼，探针却发出哔哔声，屏幕也亮了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs she’s speaking, Shade leans aside onto the Steele Tech probe, giving the pair of pilots a respectful nod. They start to return the gesture, right up until the probe bleeps and its screens start glowing."

rows.original: “Uh...” Shade gulps, staring at the probe. “Did I do something?”
rows.translation: “呃...”莎德咽了口唾沫，盯着探针。“我做了什么吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uh...” Shade gulps, staring at the probe. “Did I do something?”"

rows.original: One of the Steele Tech pilots jogs over, pulling his Codex back out. <i>“Hey, weren’t these things only supposed to turn on for you,
rows.translation: 一名斯蒂尔科技飞行员小跑过来，再次掏出终端。<i>“喂，这些东西不是应该只会为你启动吗，
rows.raw: "\n\nOne of the Steele Tech pilots jogs over, pulling his Codex back out. <i>“Hey, weren’t these things only supposed to turn on for you, "

rows.original: Mr.
rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "Mr."

rows.original: Ms.
rows.translation: 女士
rows.raw: "Ms."

rows.original: Steele?”
rows.translation: 斯蒂尔？”
rows.raw: " Steele?”"

rows.original: “Yeah,” you admit. “Me or anybody with enough of my Dad’s DNA.”
rows.translation: “是啊，”你承认道。“只有我，或者任何拥有足够多我父亲DNA的人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah,” you admit. “Me or anybody with enough of my Dad’s DNA.”"

rows.original: “Oh, shit,” Shade says, forcing a chuckle. “That’s a hell of a bug.
rows.translation: “哦，见鬼，”莎德说着，勉强挤出一声轻笑。“这漏洞可真够离谱的。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, shit,” Shade says, forcing a chuckle. “That’s a hell of a bug."

rows.original: kaithrit
rows.raw: "kaithrit"

rows.original: What, does it think I’m your mom or something?
rows.translation: 怎么，它把我当成你妈了还是怎么的？
rows.raw: " What, does it think I’m your mom or something?"

rows.original: What, does it think I’m your long-lost sister or something?
rows.translation: 怎么，它把我当成你失散多年的姐妹了还是怎么的？
rows.raw: " What, does it think I’m your long-lost sister or something?"

rows.original: The company pilot punches a few buttons on his Codex and waves its scanner over the banged-up old probe, mumbling about that specific model of probe and software hiccups. After a moment, though, he scratches his stubbly chin and furrows his brow. You and Shade both look at him expectantly, but rather than assuring you it’s just some random bug in the century-old probe, he pushes another button and turns the scanner towards Shade.
rows.translation: 公司飞行员在终端上按了几下，又挥动扫描仪扫过那台伤痕累累的旧探针，嘴里嘟囔着这种特定型号的探针和软件故障。片刻后，他却挠着胡茬密布的下巴，皱起了眉头。你和莎德都满怀期待地看向他，但他没有保证这只是百年老探针的随机故障，反而又按下一个按钮，把扫描仪转向莎德。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe company pilot punches a few buttons on his Codex and waves its scanner over the banged-up old probe, mumbling about that specific model of probe and software hiccups. After a moment, though, he scratches his stubbly chin and furrows his brow. You and Shade both look at him expectantly, but rather than assuring you it’s just some random bug in the century-old probe, he pushes another button and turns the scanner towards Shade."

rows.original: “Hey,” Shade scowls. “What gives?”
rows.translation: “喂，”莎德皱眉道。“搞什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey,” Shade scowls. “What gives?”"

rows.original: You feel a knot forming in your gut as the pilot’s Codex beeps at him, its screen flashing in his face.
rows.translation: 飞行员的终端朝他哔了一声，屏幕在他面前闪烁起来，你感觉胃里渐渐打了个结。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feel a knot forming in your gut as the pilot’s Codex beeps at him, its screen flashing in his face."

rows.original: Gulping, you reach over and take your lover’s hand, assuring her it’s probably just a bug... right?
rows.translation: 你咽了口唾沫，伸手握住爱人的手，向她保证这大概只是个故障...对吧？
rows.raw: " Gulping, you reach over and take your lover’s hand, assuring her it’s probably just a bug... right?"

rows.original: After a couple more moments, the pilot makes a perplexed grunt and flips the Codex over and hands it to you screen-down. That alone is enough to make you worry - what the hell is going on? You take a peek at the Codex’s screen, where you see a bio-scanner readout showing your
rows.translation: 又过了片刻，飞行员困惑地哼了一声，把终端翻过来，屏幕朝下递给你。光是这个动作就足以令你担忧——到底发生了什么？你瞥了一眼终端屏幕，看见一份生物扫描报告，上面显示着你的
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a couple more moments, the pilot makes a perplexed grunt and flips the Codex over and hands it to you screen-down. That alone is enough to make you worry - what the hell is going on? You take a peek at the Codex’s screen, where you see a bio-scanner readout showing your "

rows.original: kaithrit friend
rows.translation: 凯瑟瑞特朋友
rows.raw: "kaithrit friend"

rows.original: lover
rows.translation: 恋人
rows.raw: "lover"

rows.original: and all sorts of privacy-invading data: her age, blood type, a racial blurb about kaithrit... and a DNA analysis. Several computer-generated pinpoints cover the analysis, comparing several points on hers to your father’s - and yours. A red data readout in the corner gives what, to your untrained mind, is a meaningless series of compatibility notes summarized in big, bold capitals: Chance of Close Relation: 98.356%. Uh-oh...
rows.translation: 以及各种侵犯隐私的数据：她的年龄、血型、一段关于凯瑟瑞特的种族简介...还有DNA分析。分析结果上布满了数个电脑生成的标记，将她的多个位点与你父亲以及你的对应位点进行比较。角落里一行红色数据显示着一串在未经训练的你看来毫无意义的相容性备注，最后用又大又粗的字母总结为：近亲关系概率：98.356%。糟糕...
rows.raw: " and all sorts of privacy-invading data: her age, blood type, a racial blurb about kaithrit... and a DNA analysis. Several computer-generated pinpoints cover the analysis, comparing several points on hers to your father’s - and yours. A red data readout in the corner gives what, to your untrained mind, is a meaningless series of compatibility notes summarized in big, bold capitals: Chance of Close Relation: 98.356%. Uh-oh..."

rows.original: You curse your randy father under your breath, suddenly realizing what’s happened
rows.translation: 你低声咒骂自己那个风流成性的父亲，突然意识到发生了什么
rows.raw: "\n\nYou curse your randy father under your breath, suddenly realizing what’s happened"

rows.original: ... and what you’ve done
rows.translation: ...还有你做过什么
rows.raw: "... and what you’ve done"

rows.original: . Why the hell couldn’t he have left a list of all his bastards somewhere!?
rows.translation: 。他为什么就不能在什么地方留下一份所有私生子的名单！？
rows.raw: ". Why the hell couldn’t he have left a list of all his bastards somewhere!?"

rows.original: Then again, maybe you should have seen this coming. She did say her father was a wealthy, mystery playboy. Even if she’s a full kaithrit, your dad never spent long as any one race. He could easily have been a cat-boy forty years ago or so, well before he started to get sick...
rows.translation: 不过也许你早该料到这种事。她确实说过，自己的父亲是个富有而神秘的花花公子。即使她是纯血凯瑟瑞特，你父亲也从不会长时间维持同一种族。他完全可能在四十年前左右当过猫男，那远在他开始生病之前...
rows.raw: " Then again, maybe you should have seen this coming. She did say her father was a wealthy, mystery playboy. Even if she’s a full kaithrit, your dad never spent long as any one race. He could easily have been a cat-boy forty years ago or so, well before he started to get sick..."

rows.original: With a sigh, you look between the revelatory Codex screen and Shade, sitting against the side of the probe with a hint of concern betrayed on her face. What do you say?
rows.translation: 你叹了口气，目光在揭露真相的终端屏幕和莎德之间来回移动。她倚坐在探针侧面，脸上泄露出一丝担忧。你该怎么说？
rows.raw: "\n\nWith a sigh, you look between the revelatory Codex screen and Shade, sitting against the side of the probe with a hint of concern betrayed on her face. What do you say?"

rows.original: Reveal
rows.translation: 坦白
rows.raw: "Reveal"

rows.original: Reveal
rows.translation: 坦白
rows.raw: "Reveal"

rows.original: Tell Shade the truth. She was able to activate the probe because, like you and [rival.name], she carries your father’s genes. More importantly, though, the two of you have been unknowingly incestuous.
rows.translation: 把真相告诉莎德。她能启动探针，是因为她和你以及[rival.name]一样，都携带着你父亲的基因。更重要的是，你们两人一直在不知情的情况下乱伦。
rows.raw: "Tell Shade the truth. She was able to activate the probe because, like you and [rival.name], she carries your father’s genes. More importantly, though, the two of you have been unknowingly incestuous."

rows.original: Reveal
rows.translation: 坦白
rows.raw: "Reveal"

rows.translation: 坦白
rows.raw: "Reveal"

rows.translation: 把真相告诉莎德。她能启动探针，是因为她和你以及[rival.name]一样，都携带着你父亲的基因。
rows.raw: "Tell Shade the truth. She was able to activate the probe because, like you and [rival.name], she carries your father’s genes."

rows.original: Hide
rows.translation: 躲起来
rows.raw: "Hide"

rows.original: Hide
rows.translation: 躲起来
rows.raw: "Hide"

rows.original: Don’t tell Shade what your employee’s uncovered. No need to rock the cat-girl’s boat like that. Especially if you want to keep your affair with your newfound sister going.
rows.translation: 别把你的雇员发现的事情告诉莎德。没必要这样搅乱这个猫女的生活。尤其是如果你还想继续和新发现的姐妹保持情人关系。
rows.raw: "Don’t tell Shade what your employee’s uncovered. No need to rock the cat-girl’s boat like that. Especially if you want to keep your affair with your newfound sister going."

rows.translation: 躲起来
rows.raw: "Hide"

rows.translation: 躲起来

rows.translation: 别把你的雇员发现的事情告诉莎德。没必要这样搅乱这个猫女的生活。
rows.raw: "Don’t tell Shade what your employee’s uncovered. No need to rock the cat-girl’s boat like that."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Stygs
rows.raw: "Stygs"

rows.original: As you slowly open your eyes, you realize that the room has become a lot darker than you remember. The only light now seems to stem from some fungi patches on the wall, filling the chamber with an eerie gloom. While trying to figure out what happened, you suddenly become aware of someone else moving next to you.
rows.translation: 当你缓缓睁开双眼时，发现房间比记忆中暗了许多。如今唯一的光似乎来自墙上的几片真菌，令房间笼罩在诡异的昏暗之中。你正试图弄清发生了什么，突然察觉到身旁还有人在动。
rows.raw: "As you slowly open your eyes, you realize that the room has become a lot darker than you remember. The only light now seems to stem from some fungi patches on the wall, filling the chamber with an eerie gloom. While trying to figure out what happened, you suddenly become aware of someone else moving next to you."

rows.original: “Ah, [pc.name]. Finally awake?” says a familiar voice in the gloom right next to you. Shifting around, you see the silhouette of Queen Taivra lying in the silken blankets besides you, an old book in her hands and a smile on her face.
rows.translation: “啊，[pc.name]。终于醒了？”黑暗中，一个熟悉的声音就在你身边响起。你动了动，看见泰芙拉女王的轮廓正躺在你旁边的丝绸毯子里，手里拿着一本旧书，脸上带着微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, [pc.name]. Finally awake?” says a familiar voice in the gloom right next to you. Shifting around, you see the silhouette of Queen Taivra lying in the silken blankets besides you, an old book in her hands and a smile on her face."

rows.original: “I have to admit, you star walkers have a surprisingly deep sleep.” she says, putting the book away and slowly turning to face you. “I feared I would have had to leave again before you woke up.”
rows.translation: “不得不说，你们星行者睡得出奇地沉。”她一边说，一边把书放到一旁，缓缓转身面向你。“我还担心自己又得在你醒来之前离开。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I have to admit, you star walkers have a surprisingly deep sleep.” she says, putting the book away and slowly turning to face you. “I feared I would have had to leave again before you woke up.”"

rows.original: You tell her you are surprised to see her read a book. “Oh, that?” the nyrean queen suddenly breaks into laughter. “Don’t tell me you’re surprised I can read? Did you think we were illiterate savages just because we live underground?”
rows.translation: 你说没想到她会看书。“哦，那个？”这位尼瑞亚女王突然大笑起来。“别告诉我你很惊讶我识字？就因为我们住在地下，你就以为我们是目不识丁的野蛮人？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her you are surprised to see her read a book. “Oh, that?” the nyrean queen suddenly breaks into laughter. “Don’t tell me you’re surprised I can read? Did you think we were illiterate savages just because we live underground?” "

rows.original: She pauses for a moment before she continues, now a somber tone in her voice. “To be truthful, most of my private library stems from the myr, traded or raided from the surface. As far as I can tell, our people never cared much about writing or the arts.”
rows.translation: 她停顿片刻才继续，声音里如今带上了阴沉的语调。“说实话，我私人图书馆里的大部分藏书都来自米尔人，是通过贸易从地表换来或劫来的。据我所知，我们的人民从来不怎么在意写作或艺术。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe pauses for a moment before she continues, now a somber tone in her voice. “To be truthful, most of my private library stems from the myr, traded or raided from the surface. As far as I can tell, our people never cared much about writing or the arts.”"

rows.original: You quickly apologize and explain that you didn’t intend to insult her; you just didn’t expect her to be able to read in the darkness.
rows.translation: 你赶紧道歉，并解释自己并非有意冒犯她；你只是没想到她能在黑暗中阅读。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou quickly apologize and explain that you didn’t intend to insult her; you just didn’t expect her to be able to read in the darkness."

rows.original: It takes her a moment to note the confused look on your face.
rows.translation: 过了一会儿，她才注意到你脸上困惑的神情。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt takes her a moment to note the confused look on your face."

rows.original: “Ah, of course” your lover answers, “I tend to forget that offworlders are not as adapted to the twilight of the caves as we are.”
rows.translation: “啊，当然，”你的爱人答道，“我总会忘记，外来者不像我们这样适应洞穴里的微光。”
rows.raw: " “Ah, of course” your lover answers, “I tend to forget that offworlders are not as adapted to the twilight of the caves as we are.”"

rows.original: Without a further word, Taivra gets up and steps over to a lantern in the center of the room, opening its blinds. In a moment’s notice, the chamber is flooded with a pleasant blue light. “Better now, my dear? Can’t have you stumbling around in the dark.”
rows.translation: 泰芙拉一言不发地起身，走向房间中央的一盏灯，拉开灯罩。转眼间，宜人的蓝光便洒满了房间。“现在好些了吗，亲爱的？可不能让你在黑暗中跌跌撞撞。”
rows.raw: "\n\nWithout a further word, Taivra gets up and steps over to a lantern in the center of the room, opening its blinds. In a moment’s notice, the chamber is flooded with a pleasant blue light. “Better now, my dear? Can’t have you stumbling around in the dark.”"

rows.original: With the light illuminating her now, you can’t fail to notice that she isn’t wearing any of her usual attire – nor can you fail to notice the quivering tentacles behind her, giving away her excitement despite the otherwise calm demeanor.
rows.translation: 如今灯光照亮了她，你不可能注意不到她没穿平常的任何衣物——也不可能注意不到她身后微微颤动的触手；尽管她神态平静，那些触手却泄露了她的兴奋。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith the light illuminating her now, you can’t fail to notice that she isn’t wearing any of her usual attire – nor can you fail to notice the quivering tentacles behind her, giving away her excitement despite the otherwise calm demeanor."

rows.original: A moment later she’s back to lying beside you with a lecherous smile on her face. “So, [pc.name], I hope you’re not planning on leaving anytime soon.” she coos, slowly cupping one of her breasts to accentuate her statement while one of her tentacles starts wrapping around your [pc.legOrLegs]. It’s pretty obvious what she expects from you are this point.
rows.translation: 片刻后，她又躺回你身旁，脸上挂着淫荡的笑容。“那么，[pc.name]，我希望你没有打算很快离开。”她低声娇吟，一边缓缓托起一只乳房来强调自己的话，一根触手则开始缠上你的[pc.legOrLegs]。她此刻期待你做什么已经再明显不过了。
rows.raw: "\n\nA moment later she’s back to lying beside you with a lecherous smile on her face. “So, [pc.name], I hope you’re not planning on leaving anytime soon.” she coos, slowly cupping one of her breasts to accentuate her statement while one of her tentacles starts wrapping around your [pc.legOrLegs]. It’s pretty obvious what she expects from you are this point."

rows.translation: 那么，你想怎样与自己高贵的
rows.raw: "\n\nSo, how do you want to make love to your royal "

rows.translation: 配偶做爱？
rows.raw: "spouse?"

rows.translation: 伴侣做爱？

rows.original: An enormous, weatherbeaten stone complex, the thollum, stands around you. This is an institution that processes the hundreds of female gold myr children born to Irellia every year - housing, rearing, education, and job placement are all handled inside this labyrinthine structure. Guards stand posted in the main foyer you’re currently at, and it’s a safe bet that there are more in the other rooms.

rows.original: The other nods, and you are led into the thollum. The foyer that you enter is very large, with a wide open floor flanked by unexpected columns, capped ovoids in a surprisingly Doric variant of the myr style. Gold myr of many shapes and ages, all female, come and go through these arteries. The cavern is discolored and distressed inside as well, though instead of the natural chips of the exterior stones, the interior has clearly been explored by hundreds of thousands of small, curious hands - the perfect forms and clean lines of proud craftsmen are still evident where the walls and fixtures meet the ceiling, up where children and their colored chalks cannot reach. Despite the eye-level disfigurements, the sheer scale and impressive, temple-like plan fill you with a sense of being somewhere immeasurably sophisticated and important.
rows.translation: 另一人点点头，你随即被领进托勒姆。踏入的前厅十分宽阔，开阔的地面两侧排列着出人意料的柱子；柱顶呈卵形，竟是米尔风格的多立克变体。形形色色、年龄各异的金米尔女人在这些通道间来来往往。洞穴内部同样褪色而斑驳，不过外墙是天然石块上的缺口，内墙显然则受过成千上万双好奇小手的探索——在墙壁与设施接近天花板、孩子和她们的彩色粉笔够不到的高处，骄傲工匠留下的完美形制与利落线条仍清晰可见。尽管视线高度处满是涂画，这里宏大的规模与庄严如神殿的规划，依然让你感到自己置身于一个精密得难以估量、且意义重大的场所。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe other nods, and you are led into the thollum. The foyer that you enter is very large, with a wide open floor flanked by unexpected columns, capped ovoids in a surprisingly Doric variant of the myr style. Gold myr of many shapes and ages, all female, come and go through these arteries. The cavern is discolored and distressed inside as well, though instead of the natural chips of the exterior stones, the interior has clearly been explored by hundreds of thousands of small, curious hands - the perfect forms and clean lines of proud craftsmen are still evident where the walls and fixtures meet the ceiling, up where children and their colored chalks cannot reach. Despite the eye-level disfigurements, the sheer scale and impressive, temple-like plan fill you with a sense of being somewhere immeasurably sophisticated and important."

rows.original: “Big, isn’t it?” asks your companion. A note of pride sounds in her voice. Well, this is probably her alma mater, after all. “Did you have a particular place you needed to be, or are you just here to see the grounds?”
rows.translation: “很大，对吧？”你的同伴问道，声音里透着一丝自豪。毕竟这里大概就是她的母校。“你有特定要去的地方，还是只想参观一下校园？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Big, isn’t it?” asks your companion. A note of pride sounds in her voice. Well, this is probably her alma mater, after all. “Did you have a particular place you needed to be, or are you just here to see the grounds?”"
