rows.original: “Aren’t you a cop? You have to tell me if you’re a cop,” you reply.
rows.translation: “你不是警察吗？如果你是警察就必须告诉我，”你回答道。
rows.raw: "“Aren’t you a cop? You have to tell me if you’re a cop,” you reply."

rows.original: “You? I mean, not a staff member?” you ask, surprised.
rows.translation: “你？我是说，不是工作人员来吗？”你惊讶地问道。
rows.raw: "“You? I mean, not a staff member?” you ask, surprised."

rows.original: “Oh, are you not just a random bodybuilder? The gym teacher, perhaps?” you gibe gently.
rows.translation: “哦，你不是随便哪个健身爱好者吗？体育老师之类的？”你温和地揶揄道。
rows.raw: "“Oh, are you not just a random bodybuilder? The gym teacher, perhaps?” you gibe gently."

rows.original: “Seriously?” you snort, batting the hand away. “You? You’re not going to pass me off to the damn staff, at least?”
rows.translation: “认真的？”你哼了一声，拍开她的手。“就你？你至少不该把我交给该死的工作人员吗？”
rows.raw: "“Seriously?” you snort, batting the hand away. “You? You’re not going to pass me off to the damn staff, at least?”"

rows.original: “Quite astute,” the woman replies. “I’m an officer of the Gildenmere police, but I will be escorting you. The actual staff are all a bit busy watching thousands of young to babysit a single curious offworlder.” She favors you with a jovial smirk.
rows.translation: “观察得很敏锐，”女人回答。“我是吉尔登米尔警察局的警官，不过将由我护送你。真正的工作人员都忙着照看成千上万名幼童，没空专门照看一个好奇的外星访客。”她愉快地冲你坏笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Quite astute,” the woman replies. “I’m an officer of the Gildenmere police, but I will be escorting you. The actual staff are all a bit busy watching thousands of young to babysit a single curious offworlder.” She favors you with a jovial smirk."

rows.original: “And please don’t use profanity in the thollum.”
rows.translation: “另外，请不要在托勒姆里说脏话。”
rows.raw: " “And please don’t use profanity in the thollum.”"

rows.original: “Uh... could you show me around again? I forgot some stuff.”
rows.translation: “呃...能再带我参观一遍吗？我忘了些东西。”
rows.raw: "“Uh... could you show me around again? I forgot some stuff.”"

rows.original: “I could use a refresher on the grounds,” you say.
rows.translation: “我需要重新熟悉一下校园，”你说道。
rows.raw: "“I could use a refresher on the grounds,” you say."

rows.original: “Sure,” the myr cop answers.
rows.translation: “当然，”米尔警察回答。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure,” the myr cop answers."

rows.original: The buff myr leads you through the foyer, heading toward the large courtyard door. Your eyes are drawn in many directions at once
rows.translation: 强壮的米尔带你穿过前厅，朝那扇通往大院子的门走去。你的视线同时被许多事物吸引
rows.raw: "\n\nThe buff myr leads you through the foyer, heading toward the large courtyard door. Your eyes are drawn in many directions at once"

rows.original: , not least because of the rampant children perpetrating tiny mayhems
rows.translation: ，尤其是那些四处制造小小混乱的孩子
rows.raw: ", not least because of the rampant children perpetrating tiny mayhems"

rows.original: . Murals cover the floor and depict historical topics with a kid-friendly, cartoony style, bright or faded in places according to the nearness of footpaths. Drawings in more childish hands decorate the walls and columns, done with chalk and, judging by incompleteness, often interrupted by an approaching adult. “The thollum is somewhat extensive, so please remain at my side and do not wander off,” says the guard, interrupting your study of the ‘art’.
rows.translation: 。地板上铺满以适合儿童的卡通风格描绘历史题材的壁画，靠近通行路线的部分或鲜艳、或褪色。墙壁和柱子上则装饰着更显稚嫩的粉笔画；从未完成的模样来看，它们往往因为有成年人走近而被迫中断。“托勒姆占地颇广，所以请待在我身边，不要擅自走开，”守卫说道，打断了你对这些‘艺术品’的观察。
rows.raw: ". Murals cover the floor and depict historical topics with a kid-friendly, cartoony style, bright or faded in places according to the nearness of footpaths. Drawings in more childish hands decorate the walls and columns, done with chalk and, judging by incompleteness, often interrupted by an approaching adult. “The thollum is somewhat extensive, so please remain at my side and do not wander off,” says the guard, interrupting your study of the ‘art’."

rows.original: “Right,” you
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right,” you "

rows.original: gripe, sarcastically
rows.translation: 讽刺地抱怨
rows.raw: "gripe, sarcastically"

rows.original: agree
rows.translation: 表示同意
rows.raw: "agree"

rows.original: “This is the main foyer, as I’m sure you’ve guessed. The rooms of the thollum connect here, and visitors are received here as well.” She continues forward, opening the large door. “Through here is the thollum courtyard.”
rows.translation: “这里是主前厅，我想你已经猜到了。托勒姆的各个房间都与这里相连，访客也在这里接待。”她继续向前，推开那扇大门。“穿过这里就是托勒姆的院子。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This is the main foyer, as I’m sure you’ve guessed. The rooms of the thollum connect here, and visitors are received here as well.” She continues forward, opening the large door. “Through here is the thollum courtyard.”"

rows.original: The cavern beyond is carpeted with short, colorful caps that feel springy and resilient under your [pc.feet] when the guard walks you to the center. The flexible, blunted mushrooms must make this place a natural romper room
rows.translation: 门后的洞穴铺满低矮而多彩的菌盖；守卫带你走向中央时，它们在你的[pc.feet]下显得柔韧而富有弹性。这些可弯曲、顶端钝圆的蘑菇，想必让这里成了天然的嬉戏室
rows.raw: "\n\nThe cavern beyond is carpeted with short, colorful caps that feel springy and resilient under your [pc.feet] when the guard walks you to the center. The flexible, blunted mushrooms must make this place a natural romper room"

rows.original: , particularly since hundreds of myr children are taking their leisure here, dirtying their clothes in rough games and lounging about. A few are even eating the mushrooms, though this could be more by eccentricity than design
rows.translation: ，尤其是此刻有数百名米尔孩子正在这里休息玩乐：有的在粗野游戏中弄脏衣服，有的悠闲地躺着。甚至还有几个孩子在吃蘑菇，不过这或许只是个人怪癖，并非原本用途
rows.raw: ", particularly since hundreds of myr children are taking their leisure here, dirtying their clothes in rough games and lounging about. A few are even eating the mushrooms, though this could be more by eccentricity than design"

rows.original: . Along the walls are fenced-off sections containing much larger fungi and plants, along with tools and bags that are recognizable as gardening supplies even at this distance
rows.translation: 。墙边设有用围栏隔开的区域，里面种着大得多的真菌和植物，还有一些工具与袋子；即便隔着这段距离，你也认得出那是园艺用品
rows.raw: ". Along the walls are fenced-off sections containing much larger fungi and plants, along with tools and bags that are recognizable as gardening supplies even at this distance"

rows.original: , and the stalks in one section near the door are even several inches higher than the rest.
rows.translation: ，门边其中一块区域的菌柄甚至比其余地方高出好几英寸。
rows.raw: ", and the stalks in one section near the door are even several inches higher than the rest."

rows.original: , and one familiar section near the door has stalks almost a foot higher than the rest, suggesting it’s been getting nutrition from what you do there.
rows.translation: ，门边有一块眼熟的区域，其菌柄比其他地方高出将近一英尺，显然从你在那里做的事情中得到了养分。
rows.raw: ", and one familiar section near the door has stalks almost a foot higher than the rest, suggesting it’s been getting nutrition from what you do there."

rows.original: , and one overgrown, familiar section near the door is dense with two- and three-foot variants and large fallen stalks, the products of your and Yarasta’s tandem ‘gardening’.
rows.translation: ，门边那块杂乱疯长、颇为眼熟的区域，挤满了两三英尺高的变种和倒下的巨大菌柄，都是你与雅拉斯塔联手‘园艺’的成果。
rows.raw: ", and one overgrown, familiar section near the door is dense with two- and three-foot variants and large fallen stalks, the products of your and Yarasta’s tandem ‘gardening’."

rows.original: , and the ridiculously jungly section where you and Yarasta meet is woodsy with mushroom caps thanks to your spilled cum.
rows.translation: ，而你和雅拉斯塔见面的那片区域已经荒唐地长成丛林；多亏你洒下的精液，那里布满了木质般粗壮的菌盖。
rows.raw: ", and the ridiculously jungly section where you and Yarasta meet is woodsy with mushroom caps thanks to your spilled cum."

rows.original: , and the shrooms nourished on your jizz under have grown into a thick, shadowy, fungus jungle whose caps stretch to the ceiling under Yarasta’s ‘care’. Lights hang on the foot-wide trunks to keep girls from wandering in and getting lost.
rows.translation: ，在你精液滋养下生长的蘑菇，已经在雅拉斯塔的‘照料’下变成一片浓密阴暗的真菌丛林，菌盖一路伸至天花板。足有一英尺粗的菌干上挂着灯，免得女孩们误入其中迷路。
rows.raw: ", and the shrooms nourished on your jizz under have grown into a thick, shadowy, fungus jungle whose caps stretch to the ceiling under Yarasta’s ‘care’. Lights hang on the foot-wide trunks to keep girls from wandering in and getting lost."

rows.original: A breath of hot, dry air alleviates the suffocating mugginess you’d expect from a giant fungus farm, suggesting a vent to the surface is hidden somewhere. “The mushroom carpet creates a suitable play area where the children can burn off their built-up energy before sleeping. The alcoves on the walls are here for lessons in botany and agriculture,” explains the guard, confirming your guesses. She leads you back toward the door.
rows.translation: 一股灼热干燥的气流缓解了巨型真菌农场本应有的窒闷湿气，说明某处藏着通往地表的通风口。 “蘑菇地毯为孩子们提供了合适的玩耍区域，让她们在睡觉前消耗积攒的精力。墙边的凹室则用于植物学和农业课程，”守卫解释道，证实了你的猜测。她带你朝门口走回去。
rows.raw: " A breath of hot, dry air alleviates the suffocating mugginess you’d expect from a giant fungus farm, suggesting a vent to the surface is hidden somewhere.\n\n“The mushroom carpet creates a suitable play area where the children can burn off their built-up energy before sleeping. The alcoves on the walls are here for lessons in botany and agriculture,” explains the guard, confirming your guesses. She leads you back toward the door."

rows.original: On your way back, you notice a myr woman that you missed on your walk to the garden center, sitting and taking a meal while working in several books. The woman is clearly a teacher of some kind.
rows.translation: 回去的路上，你注意到一名来时漏看的米尔女人；她坐在那里一边吃饭，一边翻阅几本书做事。这个女人显然是某种教师。
rows.raw: "On your way back, you notice a myr woman that you missed on your walk to the garden center, sitting and taking a meal while working in several books. The woman is clearly a teacher of some kind."

rows.original: “Afternoon, Yarasta,” says your escort as you pass by.
rows.translation: “下午好，雅拉斯塔，”你的护卫经过时说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Afternoon, Yarasta,” says your escort as you pass by."

rows.original: “Oh, hello,” she says, hurriedly getting to her feet. “I didn’t see you.”
rows.translation: “哦，你好，”她匆忙站起来说道。“我没看见你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, hello,” she says, hurriedly getting to her feet. “I didn’t see you.” "

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original:
The myr woman in front of you is tall for her species - probably 5' 8" - and looks decidedly academic. Her brown hair is tucked and pinned into a tidy bun, displaced only by her obligatory antennae. A sky blue long-sleeved button-down blouse in a classic Terran style covers her chest and arms, albeit with notably myrrish highlights like the softly wavy collar reminiscent of poured honey. Her mid-length, sheer black skirt has a gently-slanted hemline, showing just a bit of thigh and knee on her left leg before her chitin boot begins, and a half-slit up the back allows her abdomen to move naturally.

Her eyes are gray, unusual for myr but not unheard of. Most noticeably, a pair of silver half-frame glasses rests on her nose, suggesting, more than anything else, that she would be the person to ask about getting a library card. She’s rather thin and her breasts are quite small for her race, large A-cups at best, but her body plan sports similar curves to the bustier myr you’ve seen. If you had to guess, you’d wager that she grew up normally and then lost a lot of weight.
rows.translation:
你面前的米尔女人以她的种族而言相当高挑——大概有5' 8"——而且一看就是学者。棕色头发整齐地盘起并用发簪固定，只有那对必不可少的触角打破了发髻的规整。她身穿经典泰伦风格的天蓝色长袖纽扣衬衫，遮住胸口与双臂，不过衣服也带有明显的米尔特色，例如让人联想到流淌蜂蜜的柔和波浪领。中等长度的半透明黑裙有着微斜的下摆，露出左腿少许大腿与膝盖，再往下便是甲壳靴；裙后开了半衩，让她的腹部能够自然活动。

她的眼睛是灰色的，这在米尔中少见但并非闻所未闻。最显眼的是鼻梁上架着一副银色半框眼镜，怎么看都像是最适合向她询问图书证的人。她相当纤瘦，乳房以她的种族而言也很小，最多只有丰满的A罩杯，不过她的身形依然拥有你在那些更丰满的米尔身上见过的相似曲线。要你猜的话，你会认为她原本正常发育，后来才瘦了许多。
rows.raw: "The myr woman in front of you is tall for her species - probably 5' 8\" - and looks decidedly academic. Her brown hair is tucked and pinned into a tidy bun, displaced only by her obligatory antennae. A sky blue long-sleeved button-down blouse in a classic Terran style covers her chest and arms, albeit with notably myrrish highlights like the softly wavy collar reminiscent of poured honey. Her mid-length, sheer black skirt has a gently-slanted hemline, showing just a bit of thigh and knee on her left leg before her chitin boot begins, and a half-slit up the back allows her abdomen to move naturally.\n\nHer eyes are gray, unusual for myr but not unheard of. Most noticeably, a pair of silver half-frame glasses rests on her nose, suggesting, more than anything else, that she would be the person to ask about getting a library card. She’s rather thin and her breasts are quite small for her race, large A-cups at best, but her body plan sports similar curves to the bustier myr you’ve seen. If you had to guess, you’d wager that she grew up normally and then lost a lot of weight."

rows.original: myr
rows.raw: "myr"

rows.original: She holds out a hand in a foreign, myrmedion gesture, probably a greeting.
rows.translation: 她以一种陌生的密尔米顿手势伸出手来，大概是在问候。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe holds out a hand in a foreign, myrmedion gesture, probably a greeting."

rows.original: She holds out a hand in a familiar Terran gesture.
rows.translation: 她以熟悉的泰伦手势伸出手来。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe holds out a hand in a familiar Terran gesture."

rows.original: “Very pleased to meet you. I’m Yarasta, a prefect at the thollum.”
rows.translation: “很高兴认识你。我是雅拉斯塔，托勒姆的一名级长。”
rows.raw: " “Very pleased to meet you. I’m Yarasta, a prefect at the thollum.”"

rows.original: “[pc.name],” you respond, taking the proffered hand.
rows.translation: “[pc.name]，”你回答，同时握住她伸来的手。
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name],” you respond, taking the proffered hand."

rows.original: “Um, did you say ‘perfect’?”
rows.translation: “呃，你刚才说的是‘完美’吗？”
rows.raw: " “Um, did you say ‘perfect’?”"

rows.original: “Did you say ‘prefect’?”
rows.translation: “你刚才说的是‘级长’吗？”
rows.raw: "“Did you say ‘prefect’?”"

rows.original: myr
rows.raw: "myr"

rows.original: Yarasta looks quite confused as you shake hands. The police at your side elucidates. “[pc.HeShe]’s an offworlder.”
rows.translation: 雅拉斯塔对你握手的动作显得十分困惑。你身旁的警察解释道：“[pc.HeShe]是外星访客。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYarasta looks quite confused as you shake hands. The police at your side elucidates. “[pc.HeShe]’s an offworlder.”"

rows.original: The woman’s huge smile is positively geeky. <i>“
rows.translation: 女人露出一个极其书呆子气的灿烂笑容。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman’s huge smile is positively geeky. <i>“"

rows.original: myr
rows.raw: "myr"

rows.original: Oh, you’re not myrmedion. Such an uncanny resemblance!
rows.translation: 哦，你不是密尔米顿人。长得真是像得不可思议！
rows.raw: "Oh, you’re not myrmedion. Such an uncanny resemblance!"

rows.original: Not actually.
rows.translation: 其实不是。
rows.raw: "Not actually."

rows.original: What I said was ‘maer stediosa’,” she answers, enunciating each syllable and then pausing to baffle your translators. “Which translates to ‘knowledgeable elder student’. The U.G.C. translator software renders it as ‘prefect’, which I understand has a similar meaning. Wonderfully interesting.”
rows.translation: 我刚才说的是‘maer stediosa’，”她逐个音节清晰发音，随后停下来，让你的翻译器陷入困惑。“意思是‘博学的年长学生’。UGC翻译软件将它译为‘级长’，据我了解，两者含义相近。真是有趣极了。”
rows.raw: " What I said was ‘maer stediosa’,” she answers, enunciating each syllable and then pausing to baffle your translators. “Which translates to ‘knowledgeable elder student’. The U.G.C. translator software renders it as ‘prefect’, which I understand has a similar meaning. Wonderfully interesting.”"

rows.original: <i>“So
rows.translation: <i>“所以
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“So"

rows.original: , like,
rows.translation: ，那个，
rows.raw: ", like,"

rows.original: what’s a ‘prefect’ do?”
rows.translation: ‘级长’是做什么的？”
rows.raw: " what’s a ‘prefect’ do?”"

rows.original: “We’re the highest-ranking educators in the thollum below the administrative level,” Yarasta explains. “Together with the tasty boobs, we’re responsible for the rearing of the children.”
rows.translation: “我们是托勒姆里行政层级以下职位最高的教育者，”雅拉斯塔解释道。“我们和美味的乳房一起负责抚养孩子。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We’re the highest-ranking educators in the thollum below the administrative level,” Yarasta explains. “Together with the tasty boobs, we’re responsible for the rearing of the children.”"

rows.original: “What?” you interrupt, not sure you heard right.
rows.translation: “什么？”你打断她，不确定自己有没有听错。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What?” you interrupt, not sure you heard right."

rows.original: “I said, we’re responsible for the rearing of the children, together with the yummy breasts.”
rows.translation: “我说，我们和可口的乳房一起负责抚养孩子。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I said, we’re responsible for the rearing of the children, together with the yummy breasts.”"

rows.original: “Yummy breasts?”
rows.translation: “可口的乳房？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yummy breasts?”"

rows.original: The prefect points at another myr adult nearby, a voluptuous woman with a big, honey-swollen bosom. “There’s one.” Well, they’re definitely yummy.
rows.translation: 级长指向附近另一名成年米尔，那是个体态丰腴的女人，胸前有一对被蜂蜜撑得鼓胀的丰满乳房。“那边就有一位。”好吧，确实很可口。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe prefect points at another myr adult nearby, a voluptuous woman with a big, honey-swollen bosom. “There’s one.” Well, they’re definitely yummy."

rows.original: “May I?” interjects your muscly escort. “I’ve noticed this before. The word we use means something like ‘breast for eating’ and the U.G.C. software spits out a literal translation.”
rows.translation: “我来解释一下，可以吗？”你那位肌肉发达的护卫插话道。“我以前也注意到过。我们使用的那个词，大概是‘供人食用的乳房’之意，而UGC软件给出的是直译。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“May I?” interjects your muscly escort. “I’ve noticed this before. The word we use means something like ‘breast for eating’ and the U.G.C. software spits out a literal translation.”"

rows.original: “Oh my,” replies Yarasta, as you take out your codex and punch in an override for the translators in your brain. “How cool is that? I must write it down.”
rows.translation: “天哪，”雅拉斯塔答道；你拿出法典，在脑内翻译器中输入一项覆盖设置。“这太有意思了吧？我一定要记下来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh my,” replies Yarasta, as you take out your codex and punch in an override for the translators in your brain. “How cool is that? I must write it down.”"

rows.original: “Once more,” you request.
rows.translation: “再说一遍，”你请求道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Once more,” you request."

rows.original: “Soo-mins,” the prefect says. “Sumins. We work with the sumins to raise the girls.” She waits for you to acknowledge before continuing. “They’re just below us in rank. They do work like serving food, individual tutoring, and helping to grade papers.”
rows.translation: “苏—敏斯，”级长说道。“苏明斯。我们和苏明斯一起抚养女孩们。”她等你表示明白后继续道：“她们的等级仅次于我们，负责分发食物、个别辅导和协助批改作业之类的工作。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Soo-mins,” the prefect says. “Sumins. We work with the sumins to raise the girls.” She waits for you to acknowledge before continuing. “They’re just below us in rank. They do work like serving food, individual tutoring, and helping to grade papers.”"

rows.original: “Hey, aren’t you gonna run behind if you stand around talking all day?” asks the guard, politely.
rows.translation: “喂，你要是整天站在这里聊天，不会落下进度吗？”守卫礼貌地问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, aren’t you gonna run behind if you stand around talking all day?” asks the guard, politely."

rows.original: Yarasta takes a timepiece from her blouse pocket and examines it. “Oh, dear yes. At this rate, my schedule will be in tatters. I enjoyed speaking with you, [pc.name]. Let’s continue our conversation sometime later.”
rows.translation: 雅拉斯塔从衬衫口袋里拿出计时器看了看。“哦，天哪，确实如此。照这样下去，我的日程会乱成一团。很高兴与你交谈，[pc.name]。我们改天再继续聊吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYarasta takes a timepiece from her blouse pocket and examines it. “Oh, dear yes. At this rate, my schedule will be in tatters. I enjoyed speaking with you, [pc.name]. Let’s continue our conversation sometime later.”"

rows.original: You bid her farewell and move on with your escort.
rows.translation: 你向她道别，随后与护卫继续前行。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou bid her farewell and move on with your escort."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: MYR_GOLD_SOLDIER
rows.raw: "MYR_GOLD_SOLDIER"

rows.original: Gold Myr Guard
rows.translation: 金米尔守卫
rows.raw: "Gold Myr Guard"

rows.original: The Tour
rows.translation: 导览
rows.raw: "The Tour"

rows.original: The myr guard takes you back through the foyer, enroute to the classrooms. As you enter the connecting hallway, your attention is drawn to the central feature of each room: lacking holo- or chalk-boards, the myr apparently do their demonstrations in a pit of fine sand. Cushions surround it, doubtless places for the girls to sit.
rows.translation: 米尔守卫带你重新穿过前厅，朝教室走去。进入相连的走廊时，你的注意力被每个房间的中心设施吸引：这里没有全息板或黑板，米尔人显然是在一坑细沙上进行演示。沙坑周围摆着软垫，无疑是女孩们落座的位置。
rows.raw: "The myr guard takes you back through the foyer, enroute to the classrooms. As you enter the connecting hallway, your attention is drawn to the central feature of each room: lacking holo- or chalk-boards, the myr apparently do their demonstrations in a pit of fine sand. Cushions surround it, doubtless places for the girls to sit."

rows.original: The classes are full right now, packed with girls in color-coded vests and skirts trying to learn.
rows.translation: 现在教室里坐满了学生，穿着不同颜色背心与裙子的女孩们挤在一起努力学习。
rows.raw: " The classes are full right now, packed with girls in color-coded vests and skirts trying to learn."

rows.original: The girls are absent right now; only a few adults linger in the halls and classrooms.
rows.translation: 女孩们现在不在，只有少数成年人留在走廊和教室里。
rows.raw: " The girls are absent right now; only a few adults linger in the halls and classrooms."

rows.original: “These are the classrooms, as I’m sure is obvious. I’m equally sure you know what a classroom is,” says your escort, dryly. “Girls without other responsibilities, such as the garden alcoves, do their learning here.”
rows.translation: “这些是教室，我想这很明显。我也同样确信你知道教室是什么，”你的护卫干巴巴地说道。“没有其他职责，例如不必照料花园凹室的女孩，就在这里学习。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“These are the classrooms, as I’m sure is obvious. I’m equally sure you know what a classroom is,” says your escort, dryly. “Girls without other responsibilities, such as the garden alcoves, do their learning here.”"

rows.original: One myr in particular is busily working in her open classroom. Your guard stops by the door and knocks politely, causing her to look up.
rows.translation: 其中一名米尔正在敞开的教室里忙碌。你的守卫停在门边，礼貌地敲了敲门，引得她抬起头来。
rows.raw: " One myr in particular is busily working in her open classroom. Your guard stops by the door and knocks politely, causing her to look up."

rows.original: Morning
rows.translation: 上午
rows.raw: "Morning"

rows.original: Evening
rows.translation: 晚上
rows.raw: "Evening"

rows.original: , Yarasta,” says your escort.
rows.translation: ，雅拉斯塔，”你的护卫说道。
rows.raw: ", Yarasta,” says your escort."

rows.original: The myr stands up and stretches, then comes to the door. “Hi there.”
rows.translation: 米尔女人站起身伸了个懒腰，随后走到门口。“你好。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe myr stands up and stretches, then comes to the door. “Hi there.”"

rows.original: One room is deathly quiet; passing by the door, you can see that the poor girls within are in the middle of some kind of examination, scratching at papers atop slates laid over their laps. The woman in charge looks to be idle; she happens to glance over, and your escort waves. You can hear her make a short announcement, though you have to guess at its content, and then she steps outside to greet you.
rows.translation: 其中一间教室安静得可怕；经过门口时，你看见里面那些可怜的女孩正在进行某种考试，伏在架于腿上石板的纸张上奋笔疾书。负责的女人似乎正闲着；她碰巧朝这边看了一眼，你的护卫便挥手示意。你听见她做了个简短宣布，虽说你只能猜测内容，随后她便走出教室来迎接你。
rows.raw: " One room is deathly quiet; passing by the door, you can see that the poor girls within are in the middle of some kind of examination, scratching at papers atop slates laid over their laps. The woman in charge looks to be idle; she happens to glance over, and your escort waves. You can hear her make a short announcement, though you have to guess at its content, and then she steps outside to greet you."

rows.original: “Hi, Yarasta,” says your strapping companion.
rows.translation: “你好，雅拉斯塔，”你那位健壮的同伴说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hi, Yarasta,” says your strapping companion."

rows.original: “Hello,” the new myr replies, before turning to look you over.
rows.translation: “你好，”新来的米尔回答，随后转身打量你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hello,” the new myr replies, before turning to look you over."

rows.original: The myr guard turns around and leads you back through the foyer again, this time heading for the stairs. She nods to the security officers posted there, who nod back and allow you to descend. Another long hallway stretches out before you, this one twice as long as and half as wide as the one leading to the classrooms. Doorways dot the walls, opening into rooms with tens of bedrolls arrayed barracks-style, and smaller hallways branch from the main one at intervals, leading to yet more doors.
rows.translation: 米尔守卫转过身，再次带你穿过前厅，这次朝楼梯走去。她向驻守在那里的保安点头，对方也点头回应，允许你下楼。另一条长走廊在面前延伸开来，其长度是通往教室那条的两倍，宽度却只有一半。墙壁上散布着门洞，通往一间间以兵营形式排列着数十张铺盖的房间；较小的走廊每隔一段便从主走廊分出，通向更多房门。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe myr guard turns around and leads you back through the foyer again, this time heading for the stairs. She nods to the security officers posted there, who nod back and allow you to descend. Another long hallway stretches out before you, this one twice as long as and half as wide as the one leading to the classrooms. Doorways dot the walls, opening into rooms with tens of bedrolls arrayed barracks-style, and smaller hallways branch from the main one at intervals, leading to yet more doors."

rows.original: “This is the dormitory,” your guide says. “As you saw, it’s usually off-limits to visitors. Staff rooms are at the foot of the stairs and the corners, with girls further down. There’s also a nursery at the end.
rows.translation: “这里是宿舍，”你的向导说道。“你刚才也看到了，这里通常不对访客开放。教职工房间在楼梯脚下和各个角落，女孩们住在更里面。尽头还有一间育儿室。
rows.raw: "\n\n“This is the dormitory,” your guide says. “As you saw, it’s usually off-limits to visitors. Staff rooms are at the foot of the stairs and the corners, with girls further down. There’s also a nursery at the end."

rows.original: The girls are in bed now, so please be quiet.
rows.translation: 女孩们现在已经睡了，请保持安静。
rows.raw: " The girls are in bed now, so please be quiet."

rows.original: Unnoticed by you, a myr woman has come to the doorway of the room by the stairs.
rows.translation: 你没有注意到，一名米尔女性已经来到楼梯旁房间的门口。
rows.raw: "\n\nUnnoticed by you, a myr woman has come to the doorway of the room by the stairs."

rows.original: “Giving a tour,” she observes. Your attention snaps to her and the bedroom behind, which obviously doubles as an improvised study from the books piled everywhere.
rows.translation: “带人参观呢，”她评论道。你的注意力立刻转向她，以及她身后的卧室；从四处堆放的书来看，那显然还兼作临时书房。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Giving a tour,” she observes. Your attention snaps to her and the bedroom behind, which obviously doubles as an improvised study from the books piled everywhere."

rows.original: The myr guard acknowledges her. “Hey, Yarasta. Yeah.”
rows.translation: 米尔守卫向她打了声招呼。“嘿，雅拉斯塔。是啊。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe myr guard acknowledges her. “Hey, Yarasta. Yeah.”"

rows.original: The newcomer turns to you and looks you over.
rows.translation: 新来的人转向你，将你上下打量了一番。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe newcomer turns to you and looks you over."

rows.original: The guard leads you to one last location in the sub-basement: a large room replete with benches and pillars. More posters are hung around the room on the walls and pillars, jugs are stacked or resting against odd walls, and an open door at the opposite end leads to what looks like a machinery room, full of hoses and apparatus. The entire area smells of stale honey.
rows.translation: 守卫带你来到地下二层的最后一个地点：一间摆满长凳和立柱的大房间。墙壁和柱子上贴着更多海报，水罐成堆摆放，或靠在各处墙边；对面敞开的门通向一间看似机械室的地方，里面满是软管和设备。整片区域都弥漫着陈旧蜂蜜的气味。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe guard leads you to one last location in the sub-basement: a large room replete with benches and pillars. More posters are hung around the room on the walls and pillars, jugs are stacked or resting against odd walls, and an open door at the opposite end leads to what looks like a machinery room, full of hoses and apparatus. The entire area smells of stale honey."

rows.original: Children and adults mill everywhere, taking their meals. Many children have a big cup of honey to go with their food, which they only occasionally spill all over their vests.
rows.translation: 孩子和成人来来往往，到处都有人在用餐。许多孩子吃饭时还配着一大杯蜂蜜，只是偶尔会把蜂蜜洒得背心上到处都是。
rows.raw: " Children and adults mill everywhere, taking their meals. Many children have a big cup of honey to go with their food, which they only occasionally spill all over their vests."

rows.original: “This is the cafeteria,” explains the guard. “Food and honey rations are served here at mealtimes. The honey is gathered in-house, of course.” She points to the machinery room, which you now understand must be a milking station.
rows.translation: “这里是食堂，”守卫解释道。“用餐时间会在这里供应食物和蜂蜜配给。蜂蜜当然是在设施内部采集的。”她指向机械室，你这才明白那里必定是一处挤奶站。
rows.raw: " “This is the cafeteria,” explains the guard. “Food and honey rations are served here at mealtimes. The honey is gathered in-house, of course.” She points to the machinery room, which you now understand must be a milking station."

rows.original: “That’s it; that’s the tour,” your guide announces. “If you’ll come with me, I’ll take you back to the foyer.”
rows.translation: “好了，参观到此结束，”你的向导宣布道。“请跟我来，我带你回门厅。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s it; that’s the tour,” your guide announces. “If you’ll come with me, I’ll take you back to the foyer.”"

rows.original: THOLLUM_TOURED
rows.raw: "THOLLUM_TOURED"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: MYR_GOLD_SOLDIER
rows.raw: "MYR_GOLD_SOLDIER"

rows.original: Gold Myr Guard
rows.translation: 金米尔守卫
rows.raw: "Gold Myr Guard"

rows.original: Thollum Foyer
rows.translation: 托勒姆门厅
rows.raw: "Thollum Foyer"

rows.original: The guards stop you. “You’ll have to check in before you are free to roam the facility.”
rows.translation: 守卫拦住了你。“你必须先登记，之后才能在设施内自由走动。”
rows.raw: "The guards stop you. “You’ll have to check in before you are free to roam the facility.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: The thollum’s yard isn’t much of a yard; grass doesn’t really grow this deep underground. Nonetheless, a faint breeze blows through, likely piped down from the surface. Along the fringes there are several plots of tall fungi and even a few plants in various states of health, with gardening tools and supplies nearby. These must be practice gardens for agriculture students. A carpet of soft-capped mushrooms has grown over the rest of the area
rows.translation: 托勒姆的院子其实算不上什么院子；在如此深的地下，草根本长不起来。尽管如此，仍有一阵微风轻轻吹过，大概是从地表输送下来的。边缘分布着几块高大真菌组成的苗圃，甚至还有几株健康状况不一的植物，旁边摆着园艺工具和用品。这些一定是农业学生的练习园地。其余区域则铺满了一层菌盖柔软的蘑菇
rows.raw: "The thollum’s yard isn’t much of a yard; grass doesn’t really grow this deep underground. Nonetheless, a faint breeze blows through, likely piped down from the surface. Along the fringes there are several plots of tall fungi and even a few plants in various states of health, with gardening tools and supplies nearby. These must be practice gardens for agriculture students. A carpet of soft-capped mushrooms has grown over the rest of the area"

rows.original: ; the stalks in one section near the door are even several inches higher than the rest for some reason.
rows.translation: ；靠近门边的一片菌柄不知为何甚至比其他地方高出好几英寸。
rows.raw: "; the stalks in one section near the door are even several inches higher than the rest for some reason."

rows.original: ; one familiar section near the door has stalks almost a foot higher than the rest, suggesting it gets much more nutrition somehow.
rows.translation: ；靠近门边那片熟悉区域的菌柄几乎比其余地方高出一英尺，看来它以某种方式获得了更多养分。
rows.raw: "; one familiar section near the door has stalks almost a foot higher than the rest, suggesting it gets much more nutrition somehow."

rows.original: ; one overgrown, familiar section near the door is practically rank with two- and three-foot variants, and you think you know what ‘fertilizer’ they’ve been getting.
rows.translation: ；靠近门边那片杂乱而熟悉的区域，几乎挤满了两三英尺高的变种，而你大概知道它们得到的“肥料”是什么。
rows.raw: "; one overgrown, familiar section near the door is practically rank with two- and three-foot variants, and you think you know what ‘fertilizer’ they’ve been getting."

rows.original: ; the ridiculously jungly section where Yarasta usually sits is practically a thicket of mushroom caps thanks to your spilled cum.
rows.translation: ；雅拉斯塔通常坐着的那片荒唐茂密区域，因为你洒下的精液，菌盖几乎长成了一片灌木丛。
rows.raw: "; the ridiculously jungly section where Yarasta usually sits is practically a thicket of mushroom caps thanks to your spilled cum."

rows.original: ; the mushrooms at the cum-flooded rendezvous shared by you and Yarasta have grown into an umbrageously dense, fungus-redwood forest whose caps bend against the cavern ceiling - the staff have even started hanging lights on the foot-wide trunks to keep girls from getting lost in them.
rows.translation: ；你和雅拉斯塔那处被精液淹过的幽会地点，已经长成一片阴翳浓密、宛如真菌红杉林般的森林，菌盖都顶弯在洞穴天花板上——工作人员甚至开始在一英尺粗的菌柄上挂灯，免得女孩们迷失其中。
rows.raw: "; the mushrooms at the cum-flooded rendezvous shared by you and Yarasta have grown into an umbrageously dense, fungus-redwood forest whose caps bend against the cavern ceiling - the staff have even started hanging lights on the foot-wide trunks to keep girls from getting lost in them."

rows.original: The garden mushrooms don’t glow, but they are spongy and tough enough to endure
rows.translation: 院子里的蘑菇不会发光，但它们富有弹性又足够坚韧，经得起
rows.raw: "\n\nThe garden mushrooms don’t glow, but they are spongy and tough enough to endure "

rows.original: the hundred or so uniformed myr children currently playing. Some of them are engaged in a game involving a spherical rock and white, wood-like shields. It’s very physical and reminiscent of a more medieval form of rugby.
rows.translation: 眼下大约一百名身穿制服的米尔儿童在上面玩耍。其中一些正在玩一种使用球形石块和白色木质盾牌的游戏。这项运动身体对抗非常激烈，像是更加中世纪风格的橄榄球。
rows.raw: "the hundred or so uniformed myr children currently playing. Some of them are engaged in a game involving a spherical rock and white, wood-like shields. It’s very physical and reminiscent of a more medieval form of rugby."

rows.original: the plodding feet of students moving to and fro, working on their gardens under the supervision of a few adult myr.
rows.translation: 学生们沉重的脚步来来往往；他们在几名成年米尔的监督下照料自己的园圃。
rows.raw: "the plodding feet of students moving to and fro, working on their gardens under the supervision of a few adult myr."

rows.original: children’s feet. The courtyard is deserted right now, except for a few myr tidying.
rows.translation: 孩子们的脚步。此刻庭院空无一人，只有几名米尔在收拾整理。
rows.raw: "children’s feet. The courtyard is deserted right now, except for a few myr tidying."

rows.original: A myr spots and approaches you. “Excuse me, but visitors aren’t allowed in the thollum after lights out. Please come with me.”
rows.translation: 一名米尔发现你后走了过来。“抱歉，熄灯后访客不得进入托勒姆。请跟我来。”
rows.raw: "\n\nA myr spots and approaches you. “Excuse me, but visitors aren’t allowed in the thollum after lights out. Please come with me.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Yarasta is here, enjoying the ‘fresh’ air and working in some books as she takes her meal.
rows.translation: 雅拉斯塔正在这里一边享受“新鲜”空气，一边吃饭并处理书本上的事务。
rows.raw: "\n\nYarasta is here, enjoying the ‘fresh’ air and working in some books as she takes her meal."

rows.original: Yarasta
rows.translation: 雅拉斯塔
rows.raw: "Yarasta"

rows.original: MYR_GOLD_SOLDIER
rows.raw: "MYR_GOLD_SOLDIER"

rows.original: Gold Myr Guard
rows.translation: 金米尔守卫
rows.raw: "Gold Myr Guard"

rows.original: Thollum Foyer
rows.translation: 托勒姆门厅
rows.raw: "Thollum Foyer"

rows.original: The guards stop you. “You’ll have to check in before you are free to roam the facility.”
rows.translation: 守卫拦住了你。“你必须先登记，之后才能在设施内自由走动。”
rows.raw: "The guards stop you. “You’ll have to check in before you are free to roam the facility.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: This long, wide hallway connects to several rooms that are unmistakably classrooms, even without any desks. Instead, the myr have arranged a multitude of cushions on the floor of each one around a thin sand pit. A long-handled cane lies next to it alongside a rake. They must use that instead of a holo-board. Educational posters on the wall show warnings about everything from “chitin itch” to how to identify Scarlet Federation landmines. A few guards stand watch in the hallway, looking quite relaxed at their comparatively dull posts.
rows.translation: 这条又长又宽的走廊连接着几间显然是教室的房间，即便里面没有任何课桌也不难辨认。米尔们在每间教室的地板上围着一道浅沙坑摆放了许多坐垫。沙坑旁放着一根长柄教鞭和一把耙子。她们想必用这套东西代替全息板。墙上的教学海报警告着各种危险，从“甲壳瘙痒”到如何辨认猩红联邦地雷都有。几名守卫在走廊里站岗，面对这份相对枯燥的差事，她们显得十分放松。
rows.raw: "This long, wide hallway connects to several rooms that are unmistakably classrooms, even without any desks. Instead, the myr have arranged a multitude of cushions on the floor of each one around a thin sand pit. A long-handled cane lies next to it alongside a rake. They must use that instead of a holo-board. Educational posters on the wall show warnings about everything from “chitin itch” to how to identify Scarlet Federation landmines. A few guards stand watch in the hallway, looking quite relaxed at their comparatively dull posts."

rows.original: The rooms are currently empty. All the myr are elsewhere.
rows.translation: 现在各个房间都是空的。所有米尔都去了别处。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe rooms are currently empty. All the myr are elsewhere."

rows.original: A guard approaches you politely. “Excuse me, but the school is restricted after lights out. I’ll need to show you back to the entrance.”
rows.translation: 一名守卫礼貌地向你走来。“抱歉，熄灯后学校属于限制区域。我得带你回入口。”
rows.raw: " A guard approaches you politely. “Excuse me, but the school is restricted after lights out. I’ll need to show you back to the entrance.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Teachers and students are audible through the doors
rows.translation: 门后传来教师和学生的声音
rows.raw: "\n\nTeachers and students are audible through the doors"

rows.original: , Yarasta among them
rows.translation: ，其中也有雅拉斯塔
rows.raw: ", Yarasta among them"

rows.original: Yarasta
rows.translation: 雅拉斯塔
rows.raw: "Yarasta"

rows.original: . The children are surprisingly quiet for their lessons, considering there must be upwards of a thousand here.
rows.translation: 。考虑到这里肯定有上千名孩子，他们上课时安静得令人惊讶。
rows.raw: ". The children are surprisingly quiet for their lessons, considering there must be upwards of a thousand here."

rows.original: A few adults are in the rooms, working or taking quick meals, but the children are elsewhere.
rows.translation: 几名成人正在房间里工作或匆匆吃饭，但孩子们都去了别处。
rows.raw: "\n\nA few adults are in the rooms, working or taking quick meals, but the children are elsewhere."

rows.original: Yarasta is among those that remain.
rows.translation: 雅拉斯塔也是留下的人之一。
rows.raw: " Yarasta is among those that remain."

rows.original: Yarasta
rows.translation: 雅拉斯塔
rows.raw: "Yarasta"

rows.original: Zeikfried
rows.raw: "Zeikfried"

rows.original: “I wanted to, um, see the school,” you announce.
rows.translation: “我想，呃，参观一下学校，”你说道。
rows.raw: "“I wanted to, um, see the school,” you announce."

rows.original: Lyralla pauses, perhaps expecting more explanation. “And... why?”
rows.translation: 莱拉拉顿了一下，似乎在等你进一步解释。“然后呢...为什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla pauses, perhaps expecting more explanation. “And... why?”"

rows.original: “Cuz it’s interesting? Like, I mean, teaching hundreds of kids at once sounds totally crazy to start with.” You give her the most innocent face you can.
rows.translation: “因为这里很有趣？我的意思是，一次教几百个孩子，光想想就完全疯了。”你摆出一副最无辜的表情。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Cuz it’s interesting? Like, I mean, teaching hundreds of kids at once sounds totally crazy to start with.” You give her the most innocent face you can."

rows.original: “Could I get a pass to see the thollum?” you ask.
rows.translation: “我能拿到参观托勒姆的通行许可吗？”你问道。
rows.raw: "“Could I get a pass to see the thollum?” you ask."

rows.original: Lyralla considers this. “Perhaps. Why do you wish to visit?”
rows.translation: 莱拉拉思索了一下。“或许可以。你为什么想去参观？”
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla considers this. “Perhaps. Why do you wish to visit?”"

rows.original: “I’m curious,” you explain. “It must be pretty strange to handle a hundred or more children at once.”
rows.translation: “我很好奇，”你解释道。“同时照看一百个甚至更多孩子，肯定很不寻常。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m curious,” you explain. “It must be pretty strange to handle a hundred or more children at once.”"

rows.original: “Like to visit the thollum, if you don’t mind.”
rows.translation: “如果你不介意，我想参观托勒姆。”
rows.raw: "“Like to visit the thollum, if you don’t mind.”"

rows.original: Lyralla’s eyebrow raises quizzically. “I probably don’t, but let’s find out: what’s the purpose of your visit?”
rows.translation: 莱拉拉疑惑地挑起眉毛。“我大概不会介意，不过还是先问清楚：你此行的目的是什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla’s eyebrow raises quizzically. “I probably don’t, but let’s find out: what’s the purpose of your visit?”"

rows.original: “I love to watch young hearts at play,” you quip. “So I can only imagine the chaos when hundreds of them are playing at the same time.”
rows.translation: “我喜欢看年轻的心灵嬉戏，”你打趣道。“所以我只能想象几百个孩子同时玩耍会有多混乱。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I love to watch young hearts at play,” you quip. “So I can only imagine the chaos when hundreds of them are playing at the same time.”"

rows.original: “I want to enter the school - the thollum,” you say, bluntly.
rows.translation: “我想进学校——托勒姆，”你直截了当地说道。
rows.raw: "“I want to enter the school - the thollum,” you say, bluntly."

rows.original: Lyralla’s lips tighten to a thin line. “That’s unexpected. Why?”
rows.translation: 莱拉拉的双唇抿成一条细线。“真出乎意料。为什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla’s lips tighten to a thin line. “That’s unexpected. Why?”"

rows.original: “Why does it matter?” you ask. She doesn’t budge, so you exasperatedly add, “Because I don’t believe that you can possibly handle such large numbers of children the way you claim.”
rows.translation: “这重要吗？”你问道。她丝毫不为所动，于是你不耐烦地补充道：“因为我不相信你们真能像自己声称的那样照顾如此多的孩子。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Why does it matter?” you ask. She doesn’t budge, so you exasperatedly add, “Because I don’t believe that you can possibly handle such large numbers of children the way you claim.”"

rows.original: “I suppose it would seem that way, to an outsider,” she concedes. “Very well. You’re to be on your best behavior and follow all instructions given to you by security or staff while on thollum grounds. If you accept those conditions, I can upgrade you to the pass we give to visiting lecturers.”
rows.translation: “我想在外人看来确实如此，”她承认道。“好吧。进入托勒姆场地后，你必须举止得体，并服从安保人员或教职工给出的所有指示。如果你接受这些条件，我可以把你的权限升级为授予来访讲师的通行证。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I suppose it would seem that way, to an outsider,” she concedes. “Very well. You’re to be on your best behavior and follow all instructions given to you by security or staff while on thollum grounds. If you accept those conditions, I can upgrade you to the pass we give to visiting lecturers.”"

rows.original: You toss your Gildenmere city pass on the desk.
rows.translation: 你把自己的吉尔登米尔城市通行证扔到桌上。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou toss your Gildenmere city pass on the desk."

rows.original: “Cool beans.”
rows.raw: " “Cool beans.”"

rows.original: “Sure.”
“Whatever you say.”
rows.translation: “你说了算。”
rows.raw: " “Whatever you say.”"

rows.original: Lyralla pulls out a small stamp and places one in the bottom left corner of your pass before sliding it back to you. “Be mindful of the rules and do as you’re told, or your city pass will be revoked. Is there anything else you’d like to discuss?”
rows.translation: 莱拉拉拿出一枚小印章，在通行证左下角盖了一下，然后把它推还给你。“务必遵守规定，并按指示行事，否则你的城市通行证会被吊销。还有其他事情想讨论吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla pulls out a small stamp and places one in the bottom left corner of your pass before sliding it back to you. “Be mindful of the rules and do as you’re told, or your city pass will be revoked. Is there anything else you’d like to discuss?”"

rows.original: Gildenmere Pass
rows.raw: "Gildenmere Pass"

rows.original: “Hey, [pc.name]!” Siefyn says, flashing you a broad, blue-painted smile as you approach. “Welcome back. I’ve got a full stock for you today: weapons, armor, drugs, anything you need! Take a look and tell me if anything piques your interest!”
rows.translation: “嘿，[pc.name]！”赛芬说道，在你走近时露出灿烂的蓝唇笑容。“欢迎回来。今天货物齐全：武器、护甲、药物，你需要什么都有！看看吧，发现感兴趣的东西就告诉我！”
rows.raw: "“Hey, [pc.name]!” Siefyn says, flashing you a broad, blue-painted smile as you approach. “Welcome back. I’ve got a full stock for you today: weapons, armor, drugs, anything you need! Take a look and tell me if anything piques your interest!”"

rows.original: Shop
rows.translation: 购物
rows.raw: "Shop"

rows.original: “You wanna buy something? Great! Take a look around, let me know if anything catches your interest!”
rows.translation: “想买点东西？太好了！随便看看，有什么感兴趣的就告诉我！”
rows.raw: "“You wanna buy something? Great! Take a look around, let me know if anything catches your interest!”\n"

rows.original: Talk
rows.translation: 交谈
rows.raw: "Talk"

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: When you broach the subject of credits, Siefyn gets a huge smile and reaches under her stall’s counter, producing a huge, bulky cash register that’s had some kind of Confederate-tier tech bolted onto the side. “I stole this from some gold myr shop,” she announces proudly, patting the register’s tin top. “My friends and I found this when we went up to the myr tunnels to loot. You can find all sorts of cool stuff the myr leave behind, especially back when they were fighting all the time. We found a shop that got abandoned near the edge of a town. Must have been recent; there were these glowing figures floating above - star-walker technology! Still had this sitting inside it, and I figured it might be useful if any of your star-walkers ever made it down here. Guess I was right!”
rows.translation: 你提起信用点的话题后，赛芬露出灿烂笑容，伸手探到摊位柜台下面，搬出一台巨大笨重的收银机，侧面还加装了某种联邦级科技。“这是我从一家金米尔商店偷来的，”她自豪地宣布，同时拍了拍收银机的铁皮顶盖。“我和朋友去米尔隧道搜刮时发现了它。米尔们会留下各种好东西，尤其是以前她们天天打仗的时候。我们在一座城镇边缘发现了一家被遗弃的商店。肯定是不久前才废弃的；上方还漂浮着发光的人影——星行者科技！里面还放着这台机器，我觉得要是有你们这样的星行者来到这里，它或许能派上用场。看来我猜对了！”
rows.raw: "When you broach the subject of credits, Siefyn gets a huge smile and reaches under her stall’s counter, producing a huge, bulky cash register that’s had some kind of Confederate-tier tech bolted onto the side. “I stole this from some gold myr shop,” she announces proudly, patting the register’s tin top. “My friends and I found this when we went up to the myr tunnels to loot. You can find all sorts of cool stuff the myr leave behind, especially back when they were fighting all the time. We found a shop that got abandoned near the edge of a town. Must have been recent; there were these glowing figures floating above - star-walker technology! Still had this sitting inside it, and I figured it might be useful if any of your star-walkers ever made it down here. Guess I was right!”"

rows.original: Interesting, though that still doesn’t explain how she actually gets any use out of it.
rows.translation: 有点意思，不过这仍然没有解释她究竟如何使用这东西。
rows.raw: "\n\nInteresting, though that still doesn’t explain how she actually gets any use out of it."

rows.original: “Oh, well, I trade them with some of the explorers and traders that work in the upper caves. They can spend your credits when they go back up, and I get first dibs on star-walker items they bring back. It’s a really good deal!” she grins, waving a hand over a small collection of modern knick-knacks on her shelves. “I’ve never been up to the surface myself, but a lot of the huntresses get close. Some of them can trade with the red myr - they’ve got some nyrea from another continent in their army, I guess, and they don’t mind doing business with us.”
rows.translation: “哦，我会拿信用点跟在上层洞穴活动的探险者和商人交易。她们回去后能花掉你们的信用点，而她们带回来的星行者物品则优先卖给我。这交易特别划算！”她咧嘴笑着，抬手扫过货架上一小批现代小玩意。“我自己从没去过地表，不过很多女猎手会靠近那里。有些人能跟红米尔交易——我猜她们军队里有一些来自另一块大陆的尼瑞亚人，而那些人并不介意跟我们做生意。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, well, I trade them with some of the explorers and traders that work in the upper caves. They can spend your credits when they go back up, and I get first dibs on star-walker items they bring back. It’s a really good deal!” she grins, waving a hand over a small collection of modern knick-knacks on her shelves. “I’ve never been up to the surface myself, but a lot of the huntresses get close. Some of them can trade with the red myr - they’ve got some nyrea from another continent in their army, I guess, and they don’t mind doing business with us.”"

rows.original: Out of curiosity, you ask, “What kind of currency do you normally use down here?”
rows.translation: 出于好奇，你问道：“你们在这里通常使用什么货币？”
rows.raw: "\n\nOut of curiosity, you ask, “What kind of currency do you normally use down here?”"

rows.original: Siefyn shrugs. <i>“Barter, mostly. A lot of us trade in gemstones and crystals, and everybody likes gold and platinum, though we don’t have a proper mine anywhere nearby. Every time we find one, one of the stupid myr armies rushes down and kicks us out. Queen Taivra
rows.translation: 赛芬耸了耸肩。<i>“主要还是以物易物。我们许多人会用宝石和水晶交易，大家也都喜欢黄金和铂金，不过附近没有真正的矿场。每当我们发现一座，某支愚蠢的米尔军队就会冲下来把我们赶走。泰芙拉女王
rows.raw: "\n\nSiefyn shrugs. <i>“Barter, mostly. A lot of us trade in gemstones and crystals, and everybody likes gold and platinum, though we don’t have a proper mine anywhere nearby. Every time we find one, one of the stupid myr armies rushes down and kicks us out. Queen Taivra "

rows.original: has been
rows.translation: 一直在
rows.raw: "has been"

rows.original: was
rows.translation: 曾经
rows.raw: "was"

rows.original: pushing for us to make coins, like the myr do, but a lot of the huntresses
rows.translation: 推动我们像米尔一样铸造硬币，但很多女猎手
rows.raw: " pushing for us to make coins, like the myr do, but a lot of the huntresses "

rows.original: are still resisting her rule
rows.translation: 仍在反抗她的统治
rows.raw: "are still resisting her rule"

rows.original: resisted her rule right to the bitter end
rows.translation: 直到最后一刻仍在反抗她的统治
rows.raw: "resisted her rule right to the bitter end"

rows.original: . I guess we’ll just keep trading for now.”
rows.translation: 。我想我们暂时还是会继续以物易物。”
rows.raw: ". I guess we’ll just keep trading for now.”"

rows.original: “Mind if I ask you about the nyrea?” you ask.
rows.translation: “介意我问问尼瑞亚人的事情吗？”你问道。
rows.raw: "“Mind if I ask you about the nyrea?” you ask."

rows.original: “Sure, I guess,” Siefyn says, resting her elbows on the counter and her chin in her hands.
rows.translation: “当然可以，我想，”赛芬说着，把手肘撑在柜台上，双手托住下巴。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure, I guess,” Siefyn says, resting her elbows on the counter and her chin in her hands."

rows.original: “Though if you want to know about our town, you should probably ask Queen Taivra.”
rows.translation: “不过如果你想了解我们的城镇，或许应该去问泰芙拉女王。”
rows.raw: " “Though if you want to know about our town, you should probably ask Queen Taivra.”"

rows.original: You drag your eyes off the tops of her breasts peeking through between her arms and ask your first question that pops into your head. “So how come none of you are attacking me? All the nyrea outside have been pretty hostile.”
rows.translation: 你把目光从她双臂间露出的乳房上缘移开，问出脑海中冒出的第一个问题。“为什么你们没有攻击我？外面的尼瑞亚人可都相当敌视我。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou drag your eyes off the tops of her breasts peeking through between her arms and ask your first question that pops into your head. “So how come none of you are attacking me? All the nyrea outside have been pretty hostile.”"

rows.original: She pouts, pursing her blue lips at you. “We’re not all like that, you know. I mean, a lot of us are - especially the females. Some of them can be kind of crazy - but not all of us. Queen Taivra
rows.translation: 她噘起蓝色嘴唇，不高兴地看着你。“我们又不全是那样。我的意思是，我们中很多人确实如此——尤其是女性。有些人可能有点疯狂——但不是所有人都那样。泰芙拉女王
rows.raw: "\n\nShe pouts, pursing her blue lips at you. “We’re not all like that, you know. I mean, a lot of us are - especially the females. Some of them can be kind of crazy - but not all of us. Queen Taivra "

rows.original: has made a real town out of us. Spent years gathering us all into her harem before settling down here, and put us to work making a village we could all be proud of!
rows.translation: 把我们建设成了一座真正的城镇。她花了多年把我们全都收进后宫，然后在这里定居，让我们齐心建造一座人人都能引以为傲的村庄！”
rows.raw: "has made a real town out of us. Spent years gathering us all into her harem before settling down here, and put us to work making a village we could all be proud of!"

rows.original: tried to make a town out of us. Spent years gathering us all into her harem before settling down here, and put us to work making a village we could all be proud of!
rows.translation: 曾试图把我们建设成一座城镇。她花了多年把我们全都收进后宫，然后在这里定居，让我们齐心建造一座人人都能引以为傲的村庄！”
rows.raw: "tried to make a town out of us. Spent years gathering us all into her harem before settling down here, and put us to work making a village we could all be proud of!"

rows.original: Wait a second. You’d chalk that up to a translator microbe error, but... “Do you mean you’re not a female?” you ask, glancing down at the nyrea’s girl’s full chest.
rows.translation: 等一下。你本想把这归咎于翻译微生物的错误，可是...“你的意思是，你不是女性？”你问道，同时低头看向这名尼瑞亚女孩丰满的胸部。
rows.raw: "\n\nWait a second. You’d chalk that up to a translator microbe error, but... “Do you mean you’re not a female?” you ask, glancing down at the nyrea’s girl’s full chest."

rows.original: “Oh! I-I guess you’ve never met a nyrean male, have you?” she chuckles nervously, running a hand through her long, spine-like hair. “Yeah, I’m a male. Sorry, sometimes I forget most other races work, um... differently.”
rows.translation: “哦！我-我想你从没见过尼瑞亚男性，对吧？”她紧张地轻笑着，用手理了理自己细长如刺的头发。“对，我是男性。抱歉，我有时会忘记大多数其他种族的情况，呃...不太一样。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh! I-I guess you’ve never met a nyrean male, have you?” she chuckles nervously, running a hand through her long, spine-like hair. “Yeah, I’m a male. Sorry, sometimes I forget most other races work, um... differently.”"

rows.original: Nyrea
rows.raw: "Nyrea"

rows.original: So, does that mean she has a dick?
rows.translation: 那么，这意味着她有阴茎吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nSo, does that mean she has a dick?"

rows.original: “Ew, no!” Siefyn grimaces, waving her hands. “Dicks are for girls!”
rows.translation: “呃，才没有！”赛芬皱着脸，挥了挥手。“阴茎是女孩才有的！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ew, no!” Siefyn grimaces, waving her hands. “Dicks are for girls!”"

rows.original: “So, how exactly do nyrea work, then?” you press, hoping you’re not about to offend the only merchant who can do business with you for miles around.
rows.translation: “那么尼瑞亚人究竟是怎么繁殖的？”你追问道，希望自己不会冒犯方圆数英里内唯一能和你做生意的商人。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, how exactly do nyrea work, then?” you press, hoping you’re not about to offend the only merchant who can do business with you for miles around."

rows.original: You see a faint red blush rise on the merchant-girl... boy’s?... cheeks. “Um, uh... wow, I don’t think I’ve ever been asked that by anybody but my daughters. O-okay, if you don’t know...”
rows.translation: 你看到这位商人女孩...男孩？...的脸颊泛起淡淡红晕。“呃，嗯...哇，除了我的女儿们，还从来没有别人问过我这个问题。好-好吧，既然你不知道...”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou see a faint red blush rise on the merchant-girl... boy’s?... cheeks. “Um, uh... wow, I don’t think I’ve ever been asked that by anybody but my daughters. O-okay, if you don’t know...”"

rows.original: She blushes even darker, prompting you to tell her she doesn’t have to explain if she doesn’t want to. You could always read your Codex...
rows.translation: 她脸红得更加厉害，于是你告诉她，如果不愿意就不必解释。你随时可以阅读自己的终端百科...
rows.raw: "\n\nShe blushes even darker, prompting you to tell her she doesn’t have to explain if she doesn’t want to. You could always read your Codex..."

rows.original: “No, no, it’s okay!” she says, forcing a laugh. “Well, um, like I said, I’m a nyrean male. It’s fine to talk about us males with ‘she’ and ‘her’ and all that, by the way. That’s how our language treats us, anyway. So, males like me have a, uh, genital slit between our legs...”
rows.translation: “不，不，没关系！”她强笑着说道。“嗯，就像我说的，我是尼瑞亚男性。顺便说一句，用‘她’之类的称呼来谈论我们男性完全没问题。我们的语言本来就是这样称呼我们的。所以，像我这样的男性两腿之间有一道，呃，生殖缝...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No, no, it’s okay!” she says, forcing a laugh. “Well, um, like I said, I’m a nyrean male. It’s fine to talk about us males with ‘she’ and ‘her’ and all that, by the way. That’s how our language treats us, anyway. So, males like me have a, uh, genital slit between our legs...”"

rows.original: As she’s speaking, Siefyn crosses her legs, brushing a hand along her skirt from just below the band and up along her stomach, tracing her long fingernails across the dark tan plates of her corset. “Near our stomachs, we’ve got a bunch of sperm sacs, kind of like where someone like a wetraxxel might have her womb. The sacs get ruptured during sex, and the female sucks up the sperm by the bucketful. A lot of females make us use our sac stores to incubate their eggs, too. They’ll oviposit us at the same time they’re draining our sperm, use the sacs that’re left like cushions to protect the eggs we’ve just fertilized.”
rows.translation: 说话间，赛芬交叠双腿，一只手从裙腰下方沿着裙子向上滑过腹部，长指甲划过束腹深棕色的甲片。“我们腹部附近有许多储精囊，有点像维特拉克塞尔的子宫所在位置。交配时这些囊会破裂，女性会一桶一桶地吸走精液。许多女性还会让我们用储精囊孵化她们的卵。她们在榨取精液的同时把卵产进我们体内，并把剩下的囊当作软垫，保护那些刚刚由我们受精的卵。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAs she’s speaking, Siefyn crosses her legs, brushing a hand along her skirt from just below the band and up along her stomach, tracing her long fingernails across the dark tan plates of her corset. “Near our stomachs, we’ve got a bunch of sperm sacs, kind of like where someone like a wetraxxel might have her womb. The sacs get ruptured during sex, and the female sucks up the sperm by the bucketful. A lot of females make us use our sac stores to incubate their eggs, too. They’ll oviposit us at the same time they’re draining our sperm, use the sacs that’re left like cushions to protect the eggs we’ve just fertilized.”"

rows.original: “That sounds... incredibly painful.”
rows.translation: “听起来...痛得难以置信。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That sounds... incredibly painful.”"

rows.original: “It’s not!” Seifyn assures you, now laying her hand flat across her belly. “Most females aren’t very gentle about it... and usually don’t give us little males much of a choice about it... but it’s still the most amazing feeling in the world. I’ve never felt so... so complete as when I’ve been with a belly full of eggs. And the pleasure of the act is overwhelming. I’ve lost consciousness more than once when a female’s decided to ‘gift’ me with her get. I just wish more females were kind about it. So many of them are like Queen Taivra: they don’t take no for an answer.”
rows.translation: “才不会！”赛芬向你保证，此时她的手掌正平贴在腹部。“大多数女性下手都不怎么温柔...通常也不会给我们这些小男性多少选择...但那仍是世上最美妙的感觉。腹中装满卵时，我从未感到如此...如此完整。过程中的快感更是压倒一切。女性决定用她的后代‘馈赠’我时，我不止一次失去意识。我只希望更多女性能温柔一点。她们中太多人都像泰芙拉女王一样：根本不接受拒绝。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s not!” Seifyn assures you, now laying her hand flat across her belly. “Most females aren’t very gentle about it... and usually don’t give us little males much of a choice about it... but it’s still the most amazing feeling in the world. This species’ females are known to be extremely hostile, and may attempt to use unsuspecting travelers as breeding stock or as incubation space for her eggs. rows.original: The way she’s leaning over her stall’s counter, you’re treated to a good look at the insectile woman: she’s a being of cream-pale skin and dark tan chitin that forms long gloves and leggings for her, and a natural corset that hefts up her handsome little C-cups. She’s wearing only a fur-padded chainmail bra and a short cloth skirt that doesn’t quite reach her knees... and is probably giving the people behind her a particularly excellent view while she’s leaned forward.
rows.translation: 她俯身倚在摊位柜台上，让你得以仔细打量这名有着昆虫特征的女人：她的皮肤呈乳白色，深棕褐色甲壳如同长手套和长袜般覆盖四肢，还形成一件天然束腰，将她匀称小巧的C罩杯乳房托起。她身上只穿着一件毛皮衬垫的锁甲胸罩和一条不到膝盖的布短裙...而她这样向前俯身，想必让身后的人饱览了一番绝佳景色。

rows.original: She’s got a head of pitch black spiny hair pulled back into a ponytail down her back, and a pair of very long, tapered ears that play host to almost a dozen piercings each. The woman smiles brightly as you walk up to her stall.
rows.translation: 她有一头乌黑如墨的尖刺状头发，在脑后扎成垂至背部的马尾；一对修长而尖削的耳朵上，各自戴着近十枚穿孔饰物。你走近摊位时，她露出了明快的笑容。

rows.original: “Hey, you’re new!” she chirps, setting the curved blade on the counter and crossing her arms. “One of those star-walkers, right? C’mon over, I bet I’ve got just the thing for you!”
rows.translation: “嘿，你是新来的！”她欢快地说道，把弯刀放到柜台上，双臂抱胸。“你是那些星行者之一，对吧？快过来，我敢说这里正好有适合你的东西！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, you’re new!” she chirps, setting the curved blade on the counter and crossing her arms. “One of those star-walkers, right? C’mon over, I bet I’ve got just the thing for you!”"

rows.original: The nyrea girl makes a sweeping gesture towards her array of wares: primitive weapons, vials of liquids ranging from clear to sludge-like and opaque, and even a small rack of clothes and jewelry. She’s got a little of everything, it looks like.
rows.translation: 尼瑞亚女孩大手一挥，示意你看她陈列的货品：原始武器、装有各种液体的小瓶——从透明液体到黏稠浑浊的浆液都有——甚至还有一小架衣服和珠宝。看起来，她这里什么都有一点。

rows.original: “I’m Seifyn, by the way,” she says, black eyes following you as you peruse her wares. “I buy and sell pretty much anything. Weapons, armor, drugs... anything you need, I’ve got. Or can get, anyway.”
rows.translation: “顺便说一句，我叫赛芬，”她说道。你浏览商品时，她的黑色双眼始终跟随着你。“我几乎什么都收，什么都卖。武器、护甲、药物...凡是你需要的，我都有。就算现在没有，反正也能弄到。”

rows.original: Velika regards you fixedly as you approach, her mechanical eyes bright with calculation. “You know, I can’t tell if you’ve been deliberately trying to impress as of late, or if you just have a certain natural charm to you, [pc.name]. Either way...” she leans in close, pitching her voice into a heated whisper as she trails a prosthetic digit along the line of your jaw. “I find myself wanting more and more of you. In fact... I want to make you my personal plaything. Don’t you want that too, innie? Don’t you want to be mine?”
rows.translation: 维莉卡目不转睛地打量着走近的你，机械眼眸中闪烁着算计的光芒。“你知道吗，[pc.name]，我说不准你最近是不是一直在故意吸引我的注意，还是你天生就有某种独特魅力。不管怎样...”她靠近你，义肢手指沿着你的下颌线划过，压低声音热切地耳语道。“我发现自己越来越想要你了。事实上...我想让你成为我的私人玩物。你不也想这样吗，内圈人？不想成为我的人吗？”

rows.original: A spark of interest enlivens the woman’s features as you approach. “Well, well, if it isn’t the famous innie,” she purrs. “To what do I owe the pleasure?” “Innie, huh? I take it you’re from the outer rim?” Like any well-traveled spacer, you’ve heard your fair share of outer rim peccadillos over the years. ‘Innie’ is one of the nicer things she could have opened with. “Something like that.” She retrieves a credit chit from her pocket and plays with it pensively. “You look like you’re more capable than most of the tourists on this rock. Mind doing a girl a favor?” [pc.cl smuggler |You glance about quickly, then lean in. “What sort of favor?” |You cock your head. “What kind of favor are we talking about miss...?” ] “Call me Velika,” she says, favoring you with mocking half-bow. “[pc.name] Steele,” you reply. Her eyebrows arch and she gives you a look, but continues with the introduction all the same. “I’m just a simple girl trying to make ends meet by working for Xenogen. If somebody like you happened to put in a good word for me with my boss, well, I’d be in your debt.” [pc.libidoRange 75 |Her hand moves to the collar of her tunic and pushes it open, revealing a hint of cleavage as she smirks. “In more ways than one...” ] [flags.MET_MCALLISTER |“Dr. Byron McAllister. He runs the Xenogen outpost topside.” “Yes, I know who you’re talking about,” you reply. “We’ve met.” The cyborg raises an eyebrow. “You’re a real go-getter aren’t you? So much the better. I trust you know exactly what to do then.” She pauses, puffing out the last of her cigarette. “Now, if there’s nothing else?” |“A man by the name of Dr. Byron McAllister. He runs the Xenogen outpost topside.” The cyborg purses her lips. “Getting to him might be a bit of an issue. I’m afraid the myr are keeping him rather ‘preoccupied’ nowadays. Still, if someone like you were to make enough noise around the outpost he’d be bound to take notice. The good doctor never passes up an opportunity to brownnose after all.” She pauses, puffing out the last of her cigarette. “Now, if there’s nothing else?” ]

The cyborg regards you for a long moment before shaking her head. “No, I don’t think I will.” You begin to protest only for her to cup your face between her palms, gazing deeply into your [pc.eyes] as she draws you in close. “You’re sweet, [pc.name]. Family holds you back in a lot of ways.” Her lips quirk into a knowing smile. “Something both you and your cousin can attest to.” “Do you not miss your parents at all?” you ask “I didn’t come all this way just to start pining after mom and dad,” Velika says, shrugging. “Take it from me, [pc.name]: [pc.cl mercenary |in our line of work, you can’t afford to be bogged down with emotional baggage |the fewer personal ties you have to hold you back, the better ].” ] "

rows.translation: [var0 |“哦？你是不是觉得自己的内圈人资历还不够格？确实，你最近舔靴子的本事没给我留下多少印象。也许我可以把你提拔成荣誉外圈人。”她停下来，若有所思地用手指敲着下巴。“问题是...你身上还是有股泰拉味，小[pc.boy]。那么天真、那么幼稚...对我这种穷凶极恶的外圈人来说，你简直就是个活靶子。”她的义眼以诡异的强烈光芒闪烁了片刻，随后柔和下来。“不过别担心，[pc.name]。你也许是内圈人，但你是我的内圈人。我会保护你的。” |[flags.VELIKA_TLK_INNIE |“‘内圈人’这个词可没什么好含义。你讨厌内缘的人吗？” 维莉卡笑了。“我？讨厌内圈人？你把我当成什么了，偏执狂吗？不，我的感觉更像是...怜悯。”她敲了敲你的胸骨。“我见过在企业净化塔里长大会把人变成什么样。你们很早就被训练得服从。棱角被磨平，本能变迟钝。”她的手指停留片刻才收回。“这不是你的错，但确实让你变得...很好预测。”她扬起眉毛，仔细观察你的表情。“毕竟，”她轻描淡写地补充，“你本来也不是什么意外产物。你是委员会设计出来的。” |[pc.raMulti gryvain half-gryvain kui-tan half-kui-tan suula half-sula |“你为什么老叫我内圈人？难道不知道格莱温是边缘星域的原生种族吗？”你问。 维莉卡发出低沉的轻笑。“你们这些蜥蜴一直认为自己属于中缘，觉得自己和奎坦之类更亲近，而不是我们外圈人。再说，你听起来也不像腹地人。要我猜的话，你是在泰拉或某个核心世界长大的。”她打了个寒颤。“节哀。” |“你为什么老叫我内圈人？难道不知道格莱温是边缘星域的原生种族吗？”你问。 维莉卡发出低沉的轻笑。“你们这些蜥蜴一直认为自己属于中缘，觉得自己和奎坦之类更亲近，而不是我们外圈人。再说，你听起来也不像腹地人。要我猜的话，你是在泰拉或某个核心世界长大的。”她打了个寒颤。“节哀。” |“你为什么老叫我内圈人？我的种族来自中缘！”你抗议道。 这名半机械人的脸上掠过狡黠的笑容。“真的吗？差点就把我骗过去了。内圈官员只要朝奎坦人打个喷嚏，他们就会竭尽全力地讨好。我们楼上那位共同的朋友”她朝大使朱罗办公室的方向比了比，“就是最好的证明。”她停下来，若有所思地盯着你。“不过你听起来可不像土生土长的狸猫。要我猜的话，你是在泰拉或某个核心世界长大的。”她打了个寒颤。“节哀。” |“你为什么老叫我内圈人？我的种族来自中缘！”你抗议道。 这名半机械人的脸上掠过狡黠的笑容。“真的吗？差点就把我骗过去了。内圈官员只要朝奎坦人打个喷嚏，他们就会竭尽全力地讨好。我们楼上那位共同的朋友”她朝大使朱罗办公室的方向比了比，“就是最好的证明。”她停下来，若有所思地盯着你。“不过你听起来可不像土生土长的狸猫。要我猜的话，你是在泰拉或某个核心世界长大的。”她打了个寒颤。“节哀。” |“你为什么老叫我内圈人？难道不知道苏拉人是边缘星域的原生种族吗？”你问。 这名半机械人听完后发出低沉而轻蔑的嗤笑。“你们的种族在四轮星球淘金潮前吃过炮舰外交那一套，自那以后就彻底臣服于内圈人了。再说，你听起来也不像来自瓦尔德拉。要我猜的话，你是在泰拉或某个核心世界长大的。”她打了个寒颤。“节哀。” |“你为什么老叫我内圈人？难道不知道苏拉人是边缘星域的原生种族吗？”你问。 这名半机械人听完后发出低沉而轻蔑的嗤笑。“你们的种族在四轮星球淘金潮前吃过炮舰外交那一套，自那以后就彻底臣服于内圈人了。再说，你听起来也不像来自瓦尔德拉。要我猜的话，你是在泰拉或某个核心世界长大的。”她打了个寒颤。“节哀。” |“你为什么老叫我内圈人？你怎么知道我不是在外缘出生的？”你问。 维莉卡耸耸肩。“走路像内圈人，说话也像内圈人，那在我看来你就是内圈人。” ] 你好奇究竟是什么区分了内圈人与外圈人，于是请维莉卡详细说明。 “从我的口音你大概也听得出来，主要区别在语言上，”维莉卡解释道。“一般来说，外圈人从小说话的方式会有那么一点不同，足以让人听出来。只要听一个外圈人怎么发R音，我通常就能把他的故乡星系定位在几秒差距以内。”她停下来，若有所思地用手指按着脸颊。“除此之外，其他差别大多归结为举止和观念的不同。忠诚与荣誉——大多数内圈人视为理所当然的品质——在边缘星域就是一切。任何背弃债务和责任的外圈人都会被彻底抛弃。至于大多数内圈人，”维莉卡撇了撇嘴，“可很难说也适用同一套标准。” ] ]

rows.original: [flags.VELIKA_TLK_XENOGEN |The cyborg clicks her tongue. “If I didn’t know any better, I’d say you’re trying to get me into trouble. Me chatting with the future head of Steele Tech is suspicious enough as it is, without my employer being brought up.” You inform Velika that wasn’t your intent; you’re merely curious about her job. “Mhmm, I suppose babysitting eggheads and guarding labs isn’t all that bad,” she muses aloud. “It’s not particularly glamorous unless you’re assigned to a HVT, sure, but it’s not uncomfortable. Plus, on occasion the opportunity presents itself for me to intimidate a civvy. That always makes for a good laugh.” You ask Velika about her previous employers, prompting her chuckle. “Oh? You wanna see my CV or something, innie?” She takes a long drag on her cigarette. “I’ve done work for Nova Securities and several other smaller outfits and companies. Although...” She cocks her head, furnishing you with a sly smile. “I’ve yet to have the pleasure of working for Steele Tech. Maybe you could help me rectify that in the future? Mining companies are always in need of boots on the ground, after all.” |Velika shrugs. “They had the good sense to hire me, so their personnel department can’t be completely incompetent. Their pay rates aren’t bad either – provided you know how to work their system a bit, that is.” She smiles, furnishing you with a knowing look. You venture an opinion, commenting on her apparent dislike for Dr. McAllister. “I would never badmouth my gracious and well-connected superior,” the cyborg replies, her tone one of studied indifference. “But if, hypothetically, a researcher were to spend most of his time attending lavish parties with oleaginous aliens instead of actually working, well, it wouldn’t be unfair to call that researcher’s character into question now would it?” She looks you up and down, sizing you up as if considering how much information to give you. “And, still speaking hypothetically of course, those same aliens could extort all sorts of favors from a researcher thoroughly plied with sex and booze. Favors which might not always align with the company’s interests.” ]
rows.translation: [flags.VELIKA_TLK_XENOGEN |这名半机械人咂了咂舌。“不知道的人还以为你想害我惹上麻烦。我跟斯蒂尔科技未来的掌门人聊天已经够可疑了，更别说还把我的雇主扯进来。” 你告诉维莉卡你没这个意思，只是对她的工作好奇。 “嗯，照看书呆子、守卫实验室也不算太糟，”她自言自语道。“除非被派去保护高价值目标，不然确实算不上光鲜，但也不难受。况且偶尔我还能找到机会吓唬平民。那总能让人笑上一阵。” 你问起维莉卡以前的雇主，惹得她轻笑。 “哦？你想看我的履历还是怎么着，内圈人？”她深吸了一口烟。“我给诺瓦安保和其他几家规模较小的机构与公司干过活。不过...”她歪着头，露出狡黠的笑容。“我还没享受过为斯蒂尔科技效力的乐趣。也许将来你能帮我弥补这个遗憾？毕竟矿业公司总需要地面人员。” |维莉卡耸耸肩。“他们有眼光雇用我，所以人事部门不至于完全无能。薪水也不差——前提是你懂得稍微钻一钻他们制度的空子。”她笑着，向你投来心照不宣的目光。 你发表看法，提到她显然不喜欢麦卡利斯特医生。 “我绝不会说我那位慷慨又人脉广泛的上司坏话，”这名半机械人以刻意漠然的语气回答。“不过，假如某位研究员把大部分时间都花在参加油滑外星人的奢华派对上，而不是真正工作，那么质疑那位研究员的人品也不算不公平，对吧？”她上下打量着你，像是在权衡该告诉你多少。“而且，当然仍只是假设，那些外星人可以从一个被性爱和酒精灌得烂醉的研究员身上勒索各种好处。那些好处可不一定总符合公司的利益。” ]

rows.original: [flags.VELIKA_TLK_RED |“If I had a few thousand red myr under my command... well, let’s just say I’d make the Planet Rush a hell of a lot more interesting.” Velika sighs, flexing her shoulders. [silly |“The dream to awaken our world...” |“A girl can dream...” ] “You’ve spoken pretty highly of the reds but is there anything in particular you dislike about them?” you ask. “Trenches wives.” The words curl from her mouth as though they produced physical distaste. “The way the reds turn POWs into sex slaves is nothing short of disgusting. Being shot or sent to a labor camp is a far better fate than winding up as someone’s permanent bitch.” “Do you really believe that?” you ask. “Of course I do.” The cyborg appears genuinely surprised. “Slavery is prolonged cruelty. rows.translation: [flags.VELIKA_TLK_RED |“如果我手下有几千名红米尔...这么说吧，我会让星球淘金潮变得有趣得多。”维莉卡叹了口气，活动着肩膀。[silly |“唤醒我们世界的梦想...” |“姑娘总可以做梦...” ] “你把红米尔夸得很高，但有什么地方是你特别不喜欢的吗？”你问。 “战壕妻子。”这几个字从她嘴里吐出，仿佛带着实质的厌恶。“红米尔把战俘变成性奴的做法，简直恶心得无以复加。被枪毙或送进劳改营，都比永远沦为某人的母狗强。” “你真这么认为？”你问。 “当然。”这名半机械人显得真心惊讶。“奴役是漫长的残酷。真正的专业人士会迅速完成自己的暴行。”说完，她陷入沉默，只顾深吸一口香烟。 |[silly |“我钦佩他们的纯粹，”维莉卡承认。“军国主义者...不受自由主义、悔恨或国际关系中理想主义妄想的蒙蔽。” |[pc.ra red_myr |“我钦佩他们，”维莉卡停了一下，唇边浮起狡黠的笑容。“从你这身行头看，你也一样。他们是严肃的民族，被母星糟糕的生态环境塑造，却凭不可动摇的意志变得强大。某种意义上，他们甚至比目前住在边缘星域的一半娘娘腔更像‘外圈人’。” |“我钦佩他们，”维莉卡承认。“他们是严肃的民族，被母星糟糕的生态环境塑造，却凭不可动摇的意志变得强大。某种意义上，他们甚至比目前住在边缘星域的一半娘娘腔更像‘外圈人’。” ] ] “我遇到的大多数其他外星人，对红米尔的评价可远没这么正面。”你评论道。 “软弱的内圈游客和西装客，”维莉卡嗤之以鼻。“他们大多可能连该怎么跟红米尔说话都不知道。难怪回来时印象不怎么样。” “这是什么意思？”你问。 “红米尔首先是士兵，[pc.name]，”维莉卡解释道。[pc.cl mercenary |“我想所有人里最不用我提醒的就是你， |众所周知， ]士兵有自己的行话。随口加几句有军队特色的说法，红米尔马上就会对你热络起来。或者请他们喝一杯这里勉强算酒的东西也行。”她窃笑起来。 ]

rows.translation: [flags.VELIKA_TLK_GOLD |[pc.ra gold_myr |“看来你早就对他们拿定主意了，[pc.name]，”这名半机械人看着你改造过的身体回答。“不过要我说，他们完全不可信。” |“就像我说的，我不信任他们，”维莉卡回答。“任何急着讨好别人的种族，肯定都藏着什么。” ] [pc.isNice |“你有没有考虑过，他们可能是真心想友善待人？”你问。 “哈！”维莉卡忍不住发出愉快的笑声。“听着，只要跟他们那些女王多待一阵，你很快就不会再以为金米尔都是天真善良的圣母了。相信我。” |“你平时就这么多疑，还是今天情况特殊？”你打趣道。 维莉卡翻了个白眼。“只要跟他们那些女王多待一阵，你很快就会明白我的‘多疑’并非全无依据。相信我。” ] |[var0 |维莉卡久久打量着你，随后开口。“我猜你已经跟他们打过交道了？难道不觉得他们有点...谄媚吗？未免太急着讨好人了吧？我怀疑他们远比表现出来的阴险。” |维莉卡专注地向前倾身，压低声音耳语。“私下说？他们那套和平蜜罐的把戏，我一个字也不信。我怀疑他们远比表现出来的阴险。” ] 你歪了歪头。“为什么这么说？” “经验。邦联在边缘星域执行维和任务时，犯罪率通常都会上升，最后反而让本地武装获利。金米尔也许表现得一本正经，但他们几乎肯定在借几个走私者之手，用各种非法科技和武器填满自己的口袋。” “假设我相信你，”你回答。“联合银河邦联最终不会察觉吗？” [pc.cl smuggler |“你很想知道，对吧？”维莉卡唇边浮起狡黠的笑容。“我只能告诉你：众所周知，金米尔——这么说吧——更容易受企业影响。也许正因如此，这类事情他们可以不受追究。” 这种事又不是第一次发生，你暗自思忖，想起几次联合银河邦联几乎为你铺好红毯的走私行动。不过还有一个问题萦绕心头。 |“最终察觉？他们十有八九完全清楚发生了什么。你看，[pc.name]，”维莉卡微笑着，显然很享受给你上课的机会，“只要身处军火或生物科技行业，你的产品就免不了落到各种不法分子和政府手中。联合银河邦联明白这一点。只要走私规模维持在可接受范围，他们就不愿危及核心世界的收益。至于米瑞利昂，本地原始人弄到几面护盾或几件能量武器，对他们来说根本无关痛痒。” 她说得没错，你暗自思忖，回想起遇到原始人拿着现代科技到处乱跑的种种情形。不过还有一个问题萦绕心头。 ] “红米尔就毫不知情吗？”你问。 维莉卡耸耸肩。“我怀疑红米尔自己也没那么干净。如果他们知道，大概也不愿因大吵大闹而引来别人关注自己的行动。”她停下来，专注地看了你片刻。“这块石头上的每个人都是骗子，[pc.name]。你最好记住这一点。” “也包括你吗？”你打趣道。 “我更喜欢把自己看成有前瞻性的安保承包商。”她掏出一根香烟，熟练地点燃，惬意地吸了一口。 ]

rows.original: “Ah yes your little pet project,” Velika’s features ripple with distaste. “I heard about it from Dr. McAllister. In my experience, foisting radical changes on primitives rarely ends well.” She pauses and inclines her head as if to let you in on a big secret. “But... seeing as the genie is already out of the bottle... how about you do your old pal Velika a solid and share your research data?” She leans forward, bringing her face within a few inches of yours. “I promise I’ll put it to good use.”
rows.translation: “啊，没错，你那个小宠物项目，”维莉卡的面容因厌恶而扭曲。“我从麦卡利斯特医生那里听说了。以我的经验，把激进变革强加给原始人，几乎从来不会有好结果。”她停了一下，歪过脑袋，仿佛要告诉你一个天大的秘密。“不过...既然精灵已经从瓶子里跑出来了...要不帮你的老朋友维莉卡一个忙，把研究数据分享给我？”她向前倾身，让脸靠近到离你只有几英寸。“我保证会善加利用。”

rows.original: “Oh? Still curious about my augs, innie?” Velika asks with an amused smile, placing her hand on her hip. “I guess I can oblige you. What in particular did you want to know?” You clarify that you’d like to know why Velika became a cyborg, to which she nods in response. “In this age of biotech, everyone assumes ‘borgs like myself are either victims of tragic accidents or weirdo enthusiasts.” Her lips twist into a grin. “And in my case they’d be right, I’m an aug fiend. The truth is, [pc.name], that metal is still better than meat when it comes to raw performance. I voluntarily choose to become a cyborg based on that fact alone. It wasn’t easy or something I’d recommend to everyone. Still,” she flexes her prosthetic arm, “the results speak for themselves.”
rows.translation: “哦？还在好奇我的改造体吗，内圈人？”维莉卡一手叉腰，带着愉快的笑容问道。“我可以满足你。你具体想知道什么？” 你说明自己想知道维莉卡为何成为半机械人，她点头回应。 “在这个生物科技时代，人人都以为像我这样的‘半机械人’不是悲惨事故的受害者，就是古怪的狂热分子。”她咧嘴一笑。“就我而言，他们猜对了。我是个改造狂。事实是，[pc.name]，论纯粹性能，金属仍然胜过血肉。我自愿选择成为半机械人，唯一的理由就是这个。这并不容易，我也不会推荐所有人都这么做。不过，”她弯起义肢手臂，“成果不言自明。”
rows.raw: " “Oh? Still curious about my augs, innie?” Velika asks with an amused smile, placing her hand on her hip. “I guess I can oblige you. What in particular did you want to know?” You clarify that you’d like to know why Velika became a cyborg, to which she nods in response. “In this age of biotech, everyone assumes ‘borgs like myself are either victims of tragic accidents or weirdo enthusiasts.” Her lips twist into a grin. “And in my case they’d be right, I’m an aug fiend. The truth is, [pc.name], that metal is still better than meat when it comes to raw performance. I voluntarily choose to become a cyborg based on that fact alone. It wasn’t easy or something I’d recommend to everyone. Still,” she flexes her prosthetic arm, “the results speak for themselves.” "

rows.original:
You take a deep breath and stare at the cyborg fixedly. Her eyes seem to widen as your consciousness surges forward, gently skimming the surface of her mind with psionic feelers.
	
	Velika’s surface thoughts prove to be cloudy and muddled, her mind revealing nothing save for a soupçon of confusion regarding your intense gaze. It’s clear that her brain is more machine than nerve at this point. You keep at it, delving deeper and deeper, pushing past her nicotine cravings until you finally tumble into a stream of comprehensible thought:
	
	<i>Why the hell is [pc.name] looking at me that way? Are my eyes maybe on the fritz? I just had those fuckers checked... \[Run diagnostic: cyberoptics\] just to be sure...I shouldn’t be so on edge... only Nehzara knows... besides [pc.him]
rows.translation:
你深吸一口气，目不转睛地盯着这名半机械人。随着你的意识向前涌去，用灵能触须轻轻掠过她心智的表层，她的眼睛似乎微微睁大。
	
	维莉卡的表层思绪浑浊而混乱，除了对你强烈凝视的一丝困惑外，她的心智什么也没透露。显然，她的大脑如今与其说是神经，不如说更接近机器。你坚持下去，越来越深入，越过她对尼古丁的渴望，直到终于跌入一股能够理解的思绪：
	
	<i>[pc.name]到底为什么那样盯着我？难道我的眼睛又出故障了？我才刚让人检查过这群混蛋... \[Run diagnostic: cyberoptics\]以防万一...我不该这么紧张...只有内赫扎拉知道...况且[pc.him]

rows.original: You decide to play along, telling Velika that sounds like an excellent idea. A broad grin touches her lips as she takes your arm and guides you through Gildenmere’s streets. She pushes through the door of a dimly-lit bar reeking of cheap booze and even cheaper cigarettes. The cyborg claims a corner table, her augmetics gleaming as she watches you sit. The usual buzz of conversation dies the moment you’re both settled. “We’ve got another victim!” Velika announces to the room. The crowd converges before you can ask what the hell she means. A knife appears in her hand. Military issue. The edge catches in the light as she spins it once. “Hand on the table, [pc.name]. Fingers spread.” “Wait, what-?” “What’s wrong, Captain Steele?” Her smile sharpens. “Don’t tell me you’re afraid of a simple parlor trick.” Laughter ripples through the crowd. She’s backed you into a corner and she knows it. You exhale sharply through your nose and flatten your palm against the scarred wood, fingers splayed. “Good [pc.mf|boy|girl].” The knife descends. Thwack- between thumb and forefinger. Thwack — between index and middle. Each impact vibrates up through the table. You watch her wrist, trying to predict the pattern. Then she speeds up. The knife becomes a blur. You lose track of the pattern — thumb, pinkie, middle, ring — it’s too fast now, the impacts blending into a continuous staccato thunkthunkthunkthunk that makes your teeth clench. With a final resounding thunk, she buries the knife between your index and middle fingers. You yank your hand back, heart hammering, and force yourself to inspect each finger. No cuts. Not even a nick. The crowd erupts into cheers and jeers in equal measure as credits change hands. “That enough of a demonstration for you, [pc.name]?” Velika asks, sliding the knife back into her belt. Being a rhetorical question, you don’t bother answering. With the laughter of the bar’s patrons filling the air, you shake off the experience and make your way back out onto the streets.
rows.translation: 你决定顺着她的意思玩下去，告诉维莉卡这主意听起来棒极了。她唇边绽开灿烂的笑容，挽住你的手臂，领着你穿过吉尔登米尔的街道。 她推开一家昏暗酒吧的大门，里面弥漫着廉价酒水和更加廉价的香烟味。这个改造人占下一张角落里的桌子，义体在灯光下闪闪发亮，注视着你落座。你们刚坐稳，四周寻常的交谈声便戛然而止。 “我们又有一个受害者了！”维莉卡朝整间酒吧宣布。 你还没来得及问她到底是什么意思，人群便围了上来。她手中出现了一把刀。军用品。她旋转刀身时，刀刃映着灯光一闪。“手放到桌上，[pc.name]。手指张开。” “等等，什么-？” “怎么了，斯蒂尔船长？”她的笑容变得锋利。“别告诉我你害怕一个简单的酒桌把戏。”笑声在人群中荡开。她把你逼入了死角，而且她心知肚明。 你从鼻中重重呼出一口气，把手掌平按在伤痕累累的木桌上，五指张开。 “好[pc.mf|孩子|姑娘]。” 刀锋落下。咚-落在拇指和食指之间。咚 — 落在食指和中指之间。每一下撞击都沿着桌面震上传来。你盯着她的手腕，试图预判规律。 接着她加快了速度。 刀子化作一道残影。你再也跟不上规律 — 拇指、小指、中指、无名指 — 现在实在太快了，一下下撞击融合成连续的咚咚咚咚声，逼得你牙关紧咬。 最后一声震耳的闷响中，她把刀扎在你的食指和中指之间。你猛地抽回手，心脏狂跳，强迫自己逐根检查手指。没有割伤。甚至连一道划痕都没有。人群同时爆发出喝彩和嘘声，一笔笔信用点随之易手。 “这样的示范够了吗，[pc.name]？”维莉卡问道，把刀滑回腰带。 既然这只是个反问，你也懒得作答。酒吧顾客的笑声充斥四周，你甩开这段经历，重新走上街头。

rows.original: “Well you’re no fun,” Velika pouts. “Still, I guess I can oblige you.” The cyborg draws her frame to its full height, resting her hands on her hips while striking a classic modeling pose. “As you might have already noticed, I have prosthetics in place of my arms and eyes. My limbs aren’t all that much stronger than those of a regular thraggen athlete, ‘sides being able to punch holes through walls without hurting my hands. Having too much strength packed into your augs tends to be a liability if you want to do anything other than crack skulls.” “My eyes are a different story: infrared, long distance, low-light... the works. All that input is processed by my cyberbrain.” She turns her head, briefly showcasing the cluster of sockets doting her nape. “As for the other hardware I’m packing, well... a girl can’t reveal all her secrets.”
rows.translation: “你可真没意思，”维莉卡撅起嘴。“不过，我想我还是可以满足你。”这个改造人挺直身体，双手叉腰，摆出经典的模特姿势。“你或许已经注意到了，我的双臂和双眼都装着义体。我的四肢并不比普通的斯拉根运动员强壮多少，除了能够一拳打穿墙壁而不伤到手。要是你还想做砸碎脑袋以外的事，给义体塞进太多力量往往只会成为累赘。” “我的眼睛则完全不同：红外、远距离、微光...应有尽有。所有输入都由我的电子脑处理。”她转过头，短暂展示后颈上密布的一簇接口。“至于我身上的其他硬件嘛...姑娘可不能透露自己所有的秘密。”
