rows.original: “Oh?” Velika leans in close, dropping her voice to a low, husky whisper as she gently cups your face. “Did you doubt me when I said I would make you mine, innie? Did you think I gave up interest so easily?” She rests her lips directly against your ear. “I want you, [pc.name]. I will break you in time and make you mine, utterly and completely. Nothing would give me greater pleasure.” She draws back, affecting the most innocent air possible as she giggles. “But I’m a busy woman. Stay alive for me in the meantime won’t you? It’d be terribly disappointing if you bit the dust before I could play with you properly.”
rows.translation: “哦？”维莉卡贴近过来，一边轻轻捧住你的脸，一边把声音压成低沉沙哑的耳语。“内圈人，我说过要让你属于我的时候，你怀疑过我吗？你以为我这么容易就失去兴趣了？”她把双唇直接贴到你的耳边。“我想要你，[pc.name]。我迟早会驯服你，让你彻彻底底属于我。没有什么能比这更让我愉悦。” 她退开，装出最天真无邪的模样咯咯轻笑。“不过我是个大忙人。在那之前替我好好活着，好吗？要是我还没来得及好好玩弄你，你就先一命呜呼了，那可太令人失望了。”

rows.original: Velika goes very still at your words. For a split second, something unreadable flickers in her eyes. “I see,” she says at last, her voice carefully measured. “I had suspected as much. But never in my wildest dreams did I think an innie aristocrat would say such a thing.” She leans forward, pressing her lips to the underside of your jaw. “Don’t be a stranger, outie.”
rows.translation: 听到你的话，维莉卡一动不动。短短一瞬间，她眼中闪过某种难以解读的情绪。“我明白了，”她终于开口，声音经过小心控制。“我多少有所怀疑。但我做梦也没想到，一位内圈贵族会说出这种话。”她俯身向前，将嘴唇贴在你下颌的底侧。“别变成陌生人，外圈人。”

rows.original: “She’s been exceptionally polite,” McAllister responds, fingering his beard. “A welcome surprise given her, shall we say, upbringing.” You cock your head. “I take it you don’t approve of outers?” “For every civilized one you meet, another ten are thugs and rabble-rousers,” McAllister sniffs. “You’d do well to treat her kind with caution, [pc.name].”
rows.translation: “她一直格外礼貌，”麦卡利斯特一边回答，一边捻着胡须。“考虑到她的——姑且这么说吧——成长环境，这倒是个令人欣喜的意外。” 你歪了歪头。“这么说，你不喜欢外圈人？” “每遇见一个文明人，就会有另外十个暴徒和煽动者，”麦卡利斯特哼道。“你最好谨慎对待她那一类人，[pc.name]。”

rows.original: You detail a fictitious occasion in which Velika went out of her way to show you around Gildenmere, intimating that she was the very picture of helpfulness and a good reflection of the Xenogen brand. McAllister squints at you thoughtfully. “It’s gratifying to hear of such civility from a lowly contractor. If only I could get my staff to be so helpful,” He chuckles, seemingly unaware of the palpable chagrin emanating from several nearby assistants. “Rest assured I’ll put in a good word for your friend with corporate.”
rows.translation: 你详细讲述了一件虚构的往事，说维莉卡曾特意带你游览吉尔登米尔，暗示她简直就是乐于助人的典范，也为异源生物科技的品牌形象增光不少。 麦卡利斯特若有所思地眯眼看着你。“能从一个卑微的承包商身上见到这般礼数，实在令人欣慰。要是我也能让手下这么热心就好了，”他轻笑道，似乎完全没察觉附近几名助理身上散发出的明显懊恼。“放心，我会在公司那边替你朋友美言几句。”

rows.original: The cyborg gives her hair a flick and grins, downing the rest of her drink at your approach. “Found your way to the local watering hole, eh? About time.” She leans forward, her lips brushing against your ear as she whispers. [velika.fucked |“I’m eager for us to... catch up.” |“It’s good to see a familiar face.” ]
rows.translation: 那名义体人甩了甩头发，咧嘴一笑，在你走近时一口喝光余下的酒。“终于找到本地酒馆了，嗯？早该来了。”她俯身靠近，双唇擦过你的耳朵，低声说道：[velika.fucked |“我很期待我们...好好叙旧。” |“能看到熟面孔真不错。” ]

rows.original: Velika fixes her attention to some far off-point as you slide in next to her, seemingly lost in thought. “I assume you’ve heard about Myrellion getting a mushroom cloud sendoff?” She asks abruptly, squeezing her forearms to relieve tension. [silly |“I wasn’t prepared to see posadism in action |“I wasn’t prepared for it ]... the sheer animal panic that broke out just before the bombs. I barely got out in time...” She pauses, taking a long drag on her cigarette. “If it’s all the same to you, it’s something I’d rather not discuss... ever.” She stands up, slapping a credit chit onto the bar. “I’m going to call it a day, [pc.name]. I need time to... process things.” She turns about and saunters away, leaving you alone with your thoughts.
rows.translation: 你在维莉卡身旁坐下时，她的目光仍落在远处某一点，仿佛陷入了沉思。 “我猜你已经听说密尔利昂以一朵蘑菇云谢幕了吧？”她突然问道，同时捏着前臂缓解紧张。[silly |“我没想到会亲眼见到波萨达主义付诸实践 |“我完全没做好面对这一切的准备 ]...炸弹落下前爆发的那种纯粹的动物性恐慌。我差一点没能及时逃出来...” 她停下来，深吸了一口烟。“如果你不介意，我宁愿不谈这件事...永远都不谈。” 她站起身，将一张信用点卡拍在吧台上。“我今天就到这里了，[pc.name]。我需要些时间来...消化这一切。”她转身摇曳着离去，留下你独自沉思。

rows.original: She glances about quickly, then leans in. “They’re way more competent than your average group of heavily-armed lunatics, I’ll give them that. But I can’t say I’m a fan of them.” You press Velika to elaborate on her distaste and she obliges. “Try asking one of them what it is they actually believe. Chances are they’ll start throwing around words like ‘self-empowerment’ and ‘struggle’ instead of talking about a thunder god. I’d respect them a lot more if they just nixed all the Nietzschean mumbo jumbo and just admitted they like fighting and want to do so alongside people who aren’t unreliable assholes.” You ask Velika if she holds any religious beliefs of her own, prompting her to shrug. “I’d like to believe at least some of what the Church of the One God preaches is true. But then again, if they’re right that means the big man upstairs isn’t too fond of my kind.” She taps the ash off her cigarette using a prosthetic digit.
rows.translation: 她迅速环顾四周，随后凑近。“他们可比一般那群全副武装的疯子能干多了，这点我承认。但我不能说自己喜欢他们。” 你追问维莉卡为何反感他们，她也满足了你的好奇。“随便问其中一个他们到底信奉什么。十有八九，他们会开始把‘自我赋权’和‘斗争’之类的词挂在嘴边，而不是谈什么雷神。要是他们干脆删掉所有尼采式的胡言乱语，直接承认自己喜欢打架，而且想和那些靠得住的人并肩作战，我反倒会尊重他们得多。” 你问维莉卡自己是否有什么宗教信仰，她耸了耸肩。 “我愿意相信唯一神教会宣扬的至少有一部分是真的。可话说回来，要是他们说得对，那就意味着楼上那位大人物不太喜欢我这种人。”她用一根义体手指弹掉香烟上的灰。

rows.original: “The T? What, you’re looking to score or something?” She leans forward, her ample bosom straining against the fabric of her tunic as she props her chin up with a fist and rests her elbow against the countertop. “She’s married, you know.” [var0 |[var1 |You smirk and cheerfully inform her |You quietly inform her that ] that you have in fact ‘scored’ with Mrs Reasner, prompting her to nearly choke on her cigarette. “You...? Ahem, well that’s impressive really. I didn’t take you for such a smooth operator, innie...” ] You refocus on the topic, inquiring how Velika feels about Mrs. Reasner more generally. “Eh, I guess she’s alright for a T.” She raises her glass to her lips, taking a small sip. “Personable, polite, straight-laced... as far as innies go, she’s tolerable.” “Careful, you almost sound like you’re complimenting her,” your tease, unable to resist riling Velika up. “Yeah, yeah,” she scoffs, a hint of a smile playing on her lips. “Just keep that sort of thing under wraps, okay? I have a reputation to maintain.”
rows.translation: “那个T？怎么，你想得手还是怎么着？”她俯身向前，一手托着下巴，手肘抵在台面上，丰满的胸脯将束腰外衣的布料绷得紧紧的。“你知道她已经结婚了吧。” [var0 |[var1 |你坏笑着愉快地告诉她 |你平静地告诉她 ]，事实上你已经和里斯纳夫人‘得手’了，害得她差点被香烟呛到。 “你...? 咳，嗯，这确实很厉害。我还真没看出你是这么会勾人的高手，内圈人...” ] 你把话题拉回来，询问维莉卡对里斯纳夫人总体上怎么看。 “呃，作为一个T，她还算可以吧。”她将酒杯举到唇边，浅饮一口。“亲切、有礼、循规蹈矩...以一个内圈人来说，她还算能忍。” “小心点，你听起来都快像是在夸她了，”你忍不住逗她，故意把维莉卡惹恼。 “是啊，是啊，”她嗤笑一声，唇边带着一丝笑意。“这话别传出去，好吗？我还得维护自己的名声。”

rows.original: Velika sits up and listens in absolute silence as you fill her in regarding Pyrite and the siege of Korg’ii Hold, her prosthetic hands steepled. Finally, she nods. “Mhmm, I can’t say I’m surprised Pyrite would try something like that. Though arming the Milodan with equipment proudly stamped with their logo is a little brazen even by their sleazy standards...” She shakes her head to cut off the current train of thought. “You did a noble thing, [pc.name]. And I appreciate you taking the time to fill me in on such... interesting tidbits.” [velika.lovesPC |She leans in, pressing a slow, tender kiss against your cheek. ]
rows.translation: 你向维莉卡说明黄铁工业和科格伊要塞围攻战的情况时，她挺直身子，义手指尖相抵，一言不发地听着。最后，她点了点头。“嗯哼，我不能说黄铁工业做出这种事让我很惊讶。不过，把印着自家标志的装备交给米洛丹人，就算按他们那种卑劣标准来看，也未免太明目张胆了...” 她摇摇头，打断当前的思路。“你做了一件高尚的事，[pc.name]。也谢谢你特意告诉我这些...有趣的小道消息。”[velika.lovesPC |她凑近，在你脸颊上缓慢而温柔地吻了一下。 ]

rows.translation: [flags.VELIKA_TLK_DRINK |“还要请酒？你是想讨好我？让我对你有好感？”她俯身在你耳边低语，纤细的义体手指在你的[pc.clothes]上轻快游走。“因为这招很管用。继续请，内圈人。” |你俯身把手臂支在吧台上，问维莉卡能不能请她喝一杯。 她挑起一边眉毛，涂着唇彩的嘴角浮现狡黠笑意。“你请客，嗯？免费的酒我从不会拒绝。威士忌，或者这地方拿来冒充威士忌的东西，加冰，而且别停。” ] [rand |维莉卡一杯接一杯地灌下琥珀色液体，似乎毫无影响，随后挑剔地盯着你。“怎么，有话要说吗，内圈人？准备给我上一堂节制饮酒课还是怎么着？”[pc.isAss |她望进你的双眼，嘴角微微上扬，像是马上就要笑出来。“不...你不是那种爱操心的老母鸡...要是我真想喝到英年早逝，你大概会站在旁边任我去。说真的，我很欣赏这一点。想照看我这种人毫无意义...” |她轻蔑地哼了一声。“这些话我早听腻了。在我看来，喝酒和抽烟就是我健康的宣泄方式。”她喝光剩下的苏格兰酒，把杯子猛地砸在桌上，目光始终没有离开你。“不过，我想你还没彻底变成一个愤世嫉俗的混蛋，这倒挺好。大多数星球淘金者可做不到...” ] 你觉得自己和维莉卡变得更亲近了... |维莉卡喝完第六杯苏格兰酒时，闻起来活像一座酿酒厂。“这就是我的宝贝，”她毫无征兆地说道，怜爱地拍了拍手枪套。“它陪我经历了风风雨雨。从轻型脱壳弹到你能想到的任何+P飞镖，它都能可靠发射。至于人体工学？当然，我其实不太需要什么人体工学...毕竟有义体手。不过内圈人，让我告诉你：她有着最顺滑的...” 你任由维莉卡继续这番关于枪械的小演讲。你觉得自己不仅学到了东西，也和她变得更亲近了。 |维莉卡喝光第三杯酒时，脸上泛起淡淡红晕。“我认得那个眼神...你正要开始审问我，用你臭名昭著的‘关于你自己的二十个问题’把我过一遍...”她伸出手，用一根手指划过你的下颌，触碰轻如羽毛，却仿佛带着电流。“不如这次换我审问你？让你稍微坐立不安一下？” 维莉卡接连抛出关于你旅行和爱好的问题，随后凑得更近，呼吸化作密谋般的低语。“你经历了很多，内圈人。但我想知道...自从踏上星球淘金热之后，你的喜好改变了多少？”她咧嘴一笑，牙齿洁白而完美。“你可以告诉我...” 尽管谈话转向了露骨的方向（或许正因如此），你觉得自己和她变得更亲近了。 |维莉卡接连灌下几杯酒，叹息着靠回凳子。“我真不该装强化肝脏，”她抱怨道，“现在想喝个烂醉都难。” 她深吸一口烟，把烟雾吹向一旁，随后挑剔地看着你。“告诉我，[pc.mister]大亨，等你接管斯蒂尔科技后，到底打算做什么？别告诉我你准备成为一个无所事事的富人。” 你花了些时间详述可能采取的商业策略，维莉卡专注倾听，偶尔插入一些她在多次佣兵服役期间积累的相关事实。 你觉得自己不仅学到了东西，也和她变得更亲近了。 |金发女人一口喝掉半杯酒，双眼始终没有离开你。“从没想过我会和一个内圈贵族混在一起。看来这个宇宙仍然会抛出意外。”她轻笑一声。“你喜欢和贱民打成一片？来这里满足廉价刺激？不然真想不出你为何要屈尊来这种地方。”她叹了口气，慵懒地伸展身体。“你有没有觉得自己像活死人？仿佛早就活过了本该属于你的时限？我认识很多比我优秀的士兵。大多数人已经长眠地下十英尺，而我还在这里喝酒。”维莉卡歪着头打量你。“该死，我真扫兴。换个话题怎么样？你有没有当着后宫的面把德赞阿尔法弄哭过？有一次...” 你花了些时间听维莉卡讲故事，也插入几段自己的经历。你觉得自己不仅学到了东西，也和她变得更亲近了。 ]
rows.raw: " [flags.VELIKA_TLK_DRINK |“More drinks? Are you trying to butter me up? Get on my good side?” She leans forward and murmurs in your ear, her slender prosthetic fingers dancing across your [pc.clothes]. “Because it’s working. Keep them coming, innie.” |Leaning forward in your seat, you prop your arm up onto the counter and ask Velika if you could buy her a drink. She raises an eyebrow, a sly grin playing across her painted lips. “You’re buying, huh? Well I’m never in the mood to say no to free booze. Whisky. Or whatever passes for whisky in this joint, on the rocks, and keep it coming.” ] [rand |Velika drains glass after glass of amber liquid seemingly to no effect before eyeing you critically. “What, got something to say, innie? Going to lecture me on moderation or something?” [pc.isAss |She looks into your eyes, the corner of her mouth twitching up as if on the verge of a smile. “No... you’re not the mother hen type... you’d probably stand back and let me drink myself into an early grave if I were so inclined. Honestly I respect that. There’s no sense in trying to babysit someone like me...” |She snorts derisively. “I’ve heard it all before. As far as I’m concerned, drinking and cigs ARE my healthy outlet.” She downs the rest of her scotch and slams the glass onto the table, her gaze never leaving yours. “Still, I guess it’s nice that you’re not a complete jaded asshole yet. I can’t say the same about most rushers...” ] You feel as if you and Velika have grown closer... |Velika smells like a distillery by the time she’s downed her sixth glass of scotch. “This here is my baby,” she remarks unprompted, tapping her pistol holster affectionately. “Been with me through thick and thin. Reliably feeds everything from light sabots to whatever +P dart you can think of. And the ergonomics? Not that I need much in the way of ergonomics of course... cybernetic hands and all that... But innie, let me tell ya: she’s got the smoothest...” You let Velika go on her little gun rant. You feel as if you two have grown closer on top of having learned something. |A slight flush creeps across Velika’s face as she drains her third glass. “I know that look... you’re about to run me through the wringer, your infamous twenty-questions-about-yourself...” She reaches out and trails a finger along your jawline, her touch feather-light yet electric. “How about I interrogate you for once? Make you squirm a little?” Velika bombards you with questions pertaining to your travels and hobbies before leaning in closer, her breath dropping to a conspiratorial whisper. “You’ve been through a lot, innie. But I wonder... have your tastes changed much since you set out on the Planet Rush?” She grins, her teeth white and perfect. “You can tell me...” Despite the lurid turn in conversation (or perhaps because of it) you feel as if you two have grown closer. |Velika knocks back several drinks in short order before sighing, leaning back in her stool. “I shouldn’t have gotten an enhanced liver,” she grumbles, “I can barely get shitfaced anymore.” She takes a long drag of her cigarette, blowing the smoke out to the side before casting you with a critical eye. “Tell me [pc.mister] Tycoon, have you given any thought as to what you’ll actually do once you take over Steele Tech? Don’t tell me you plan on becoming one of the idle rich.” You spend a bit of time detailing potential business strategies as Velika listens intently, occasionally interjecting pertinent facts she accumulated over the course of her many tours as a mercenary. You feel as if you two have grown closer on top of having learned something. |The blonde downs half her glass in one gulp, her eyes never leaving yours as she does. “Never thought I’d be palling around with an innie aristocrat. I guess the ‘verse is still capable of throwing curveballs.” She chuckles. “You enjoy mingling with the plebs? Getting your fill of cheap thrills? Can’t imagine why else you’d be slumming it.” She sighs, stretching languidly. “You ever feel like you’re part of the living dead? Like you’ve managed to cling on well past your allotted time? I’ve known plenty of soldiers better than me. Most of them are taking a ten foot dirt nap while here I am drinking.” Velika cocks her head, studying you. “Damn I’m a buzzkill. How about we talk about something else? Ever make a dzaan alpha cry in front of their harem? There was this one time...” You spend some time listening to Velika’s stories and chime in with a few of your own. You feel as if you two have grown closer on top of having learned something. ] "

rows.original: Velika favors you with the toothiest of grins as you transfer the survey data over to her, clapping her hands together. “Wonderful! Just wonderful. Thank you, [pc.name]. And I have something for you as well.” She rummages in her tunic before producing a cluster of savicite. [pc.cl engineer |“So, about the probe... I know an old SIGINT model when I see one. Why would Xenogen use that sort of tech for environmental research?” “Oh? This is news to me. But then again I’m just a mercenary. And the first rule of being a mercenary is never look into anything you don’t have to. I’m sure corporate had perfectly valid reasons for using a SIGINT model and wouldn’t appreciate us sticking our noses in their affairs.” She pauses, studying you for any reaction. “Anyway, thanks again for your help, [velika.lovesPC |lover [pc.boy] |innie ].” |“So, about the probe... why did Xenogen send such an old model?” you inquire. “It had to be at least three hundred years old.” “Hell if I know,” the cyborg replies, shrugging. “I’m just a contractor. Maybe they bought an old warehouse full of them and decided to empty out their inventory or something.” She pauses, studying your face. “Anyway, thanks again for your help, [velika.lovesPC |lover [pc.boy] |innie ].” ]
rows.translation: 你把勘测数据传给维莉卡时，她露出最灿烂的咧嘴笑容，双手拍在一起。“太好了！真是太好了。谢谢你，[pc.name]。我也有东西给你。”她在束腰外衣里翻找一阵，取出一簇萨维石。 [pc.cl engineer |“关于那台探测器...老式信号情报型号我一眼就能认出来。异源生物科技为什么会用这种技术进行环境研究？” “哦？这我倒是第一次听说。不过话说回来，我只是个佣兵。而当佣兵的第一条规矩，就是绝不调查任何没必要调查的事。我相信公司使用信号情报型号一定有完全正当的理由，也不会喜欢我们把鼻子伸进他们的事务。”她停顿下来，观察你有何反应。“总之，再次感谢你的帮助，[velika.lovesPC |亲爱的[pc.boy] |内圈人 ]。” |“关于那台探测器...异源生物科技为什么要派这么老的型号？”你问道。“它至少有三百年历史了。” “鬼知道，”那名义体人耸肩答道。“我只是个承包商。也许他们买下了一整仓库旧货，决定清空库存之类的。”她停下来观察你的脸色。“总之，再次感谢你的帮助，[velika.lovesPC |亲爱的[pc.boy] |内圈人 ]。” ]

rows.original: You take up the trail, aware that the rising gale might soon obscure the boot prints entirely. Your efforts pay off: just as you finish navigating a rocky slope you catch sight of a metallic gleam out of the corner of your eye. [pc.reflexesRange 66 |You wheel about in an instant, readying your [pc.weapon] as you sweep the area. No target. Operating on pure instinct, you double back only to find a pair of gray, prosthetic eyes staring at you over the barrel of a flechetter. They look eerily like the eyes of- |You wheel about in an instant, readying your [pc.weapon], only to find a pair of gray prosthetic eyes staring at you over the barrel of a flechetter. They look eerily like the eyes of- ] “[pc.name]?” Velika asks, slowly lowering her weapon. “What the hell are you... forget it... wandering around frozen hellscapes is exactly the sort of thing you’d do.” “It’s right up your alley too, apparently,” you quip. “What exactly are you doing out here?” “Company business.” She looks you up and down before leaning forward, a smile tugging at the corner of her lips. “Say... care to help a girl out again? I’m on a bit of a search and recovery mission, you see. Things would go a lot quicker if I had a little help from my favorite innie.” She turns her back toward you, gesturing toward her exposed neck sockets. [silly |[var0 |“Synch with me Date.” |“Synch with me, Date, ahem, I mean [pc.name].” ] |“Go ahead and jack your codex into me. C’mon don’t be shy.” ] You carefully notch your codex into one of her sockets. Lines of color slide into existence on your display, knitting the image of what is unmistakably an old survey probe. “Part of Xenogen’s environmental research,” Velika explains. “For whatever reason, this one is on the fritz and isn’t transmitting its coordinates properly. Still, I’ve managed to narrow down its location to this general area.” She flips her hair and grins. “Seeing as you have so much experience tracking your father’s ridiculous probes down this should be a cinch for you.” [pc.intelligenceRange 50 |Did you tell her about those? You must have, right? How else would she know about the probes. ]
rows.translation: 你循着足迹前进，明白愈发猛烈的狂风很快可能彻底掩去这些靴印。你的努力得到了回报：刚走完一段岩石斜坡，眼角余光便捕捉到一道金属闪光。 [pc.reflexesRange 66 |你瞬间转身，举起[pc.weapon]扫视周围。没有目标。你完全凭本能折返回去，只见一双灰色义眼正从飞针枪的枪管上方盯着你。那双眼睛诡异地像是- |你瞬间转身，举起[pc.weapon]，却发现一双灰色义眼正从飞针枪的枪管上方盯着你。那双眼睛诡异地像是- ] “[pc.name]？”维莉卡问道，缓缓放低武器。“你到底在这里...算了...在冰冻地狱里四处乱逛，正是你会做的事。” “显然这也很合你的胃口，”你打趣道。“你到底在这里做什么？” “公司事务。”她上下打量你，随后俯身靠近，嘴角浮现笑意。“话说...愿意再帮姑娘一个忙吗？你看，我正在执行一项搜索与回收任务。要是我最喜欢的内圈人能搭把手，事情会快得多。”她背对你，指了指裸露的颈部接口。[silly |[var0 |“和我同步吧，达特。” |“和我同步吧，达特，咳，我是说[pc.name]。” ] |“来，把你的法典插进我这里。别害羞。” ] 你小心地把法典卡入她的一个接口。彩色线条在显示屏上浮现，编织出一幅毫无疑问属于旧式勘测探测器的图像。 “异源生物科技环境研究的一部分，”维莉卡解释道。“不知为何，这台出了故障，无法正确传输坐标。不过我已经把位置缩小到这片大致区域。”她甩了甩头发，咧嘴一笑。“既然你在追踪你父亲那些荒唐探测器方面经验丰富，这对你来说应该轻而易举。” [pc.intelligenceRange 50 |你告诉过她那些事吗？一定说过，对吧？不然她怎么会知道探测器的事。 ]

rows.original: “I’m an attack dog; I go where corporate tells me.” She pauses, frowning. “Though lately they’ve been bouncing me around less than desirable locales: first Myrellion and now this hole. Either I have bad luck or I’ve pissed someone higher up the chain of command.” She sighs. “It’s not all bad here though. Plenty of booze and modern conveniences to make things bearable back at Irestead.”
rows.translation: “我是条攻击犬；公司让我去哪儿，我就去哪儿。”她顿了顿，皱起眉头。“不过最近，他们总把我往不怎么讨喜的地方调：先是米瑞利恩，现在又是这个鬼地方。要么是我运气不好，要么就是得罪了指挥链上更高层的人。”她叹了口气。“这里也不全是坏处。回到伊尔斯泰德后，有的是酒和现代便利设施，至少能让日子好过些。”

rows.original: “I got your message. What exactly did you want to discuss with me?” you ask. The cyborg leans in, a strand of her hair falling forward, brushing against your cheek as she speaks. “I’ve gotten myself into a bit of a bind and, as much as it pains me to admit, I need help from someone I can trust. I’d prefer if we discussed the details somewhere more private, if you don’t mind.” Velika squeezes your arm, her fingers sinking into your [pc.armor] before leading you to an aging vessel emblazoned with a Rod of Asclepius. rows.original: The chittering of a nearby voice rouses you from a fitful slumber. You reach upward to rub at your eyes only to find your movement impeded by several straps tightly wound across your body. A pit forms in your stomach as awareness of your surroundings finally percolates through your mental haze: you are strapped to an operating table in the middle of a medbay. Wires trail from a coif-like device affixed to your head and upper back, feeding information to a bank of glowing screens lining the walls. “Oh? finally awake?” Your attention snaps to a figure whom you instantly recognize as Velika. Her lips crease into a wicked grin as she caresses your cheek with one hand. “I was wondering if we’d get a chance to talk.” A cold trickle of sweat works its way down your brow as your stomach knots itself in fear. “What the hell did you do to me?” you ask while tensing at your bonds. “Nothing yet. Relax, innie.” You wince as her dainty fingers trace a path down to your neck. “Soon this will all just be a bad dream — a figment of your overactive imagination.” Questions race through the corridors of your mind, threatening to overwhelm you before you finally give voice to the most basic one: why? “Why?” The cyborg chuckles mirthlessly. “You mean you don’t know? You’re a weapon, [pc.name].” “What?” “Those nanomachines in your blood aren’t just for curing diseases. They’re just a few modifications away from being a bioweapon: the newest iteration in the galactic arms race.” Velika watches you closely as she explains this, her robotic eyes searching your face. “It’s winner-takes-all when it comes to politics. I’m just making sure the outer rim can defend itself from the likes of you.” “That’s insane,” you reply, vehemently denying being part of any sort of conspiracy against the ‘rim. “You might not have it in for us. But Steele Tech does. It’s part of the core world imperial regime. You can’t afford to let us wriggle out from under you. Literally. Your father made his fortune by exploiting the mineral wealth of the ‘rim, after all.” The cyborg runs her fingers [pc.hasHair |through your [pc.hair] |across the top of your head ]. [velika.lovesPC |“I want you to know that this isn’t personal, innie. For what it’s worth, I enjoyed our time together. You just happened to be born on the wrong side of the galaxy.” She regards you for a long moment before pulling a slender cable from her neck and slotting it into the console. |“But I’m not one to heap the sins of the father onto the [pc.mf |son |daughter ]. If you cooperate, I promise no lasting harm will come to you.” She pulls a slender cable from her neck and slots it into the console. ] “Nighty, nighty, [pc.name].”
rows.translation: 附近传来的吱吱说话声将你从不安的睡眠中唤醒。你抬手想揉眼睛，却发现身体被数条绑带紧紧缠住，动弹不得。随着周围环境终于穿透意识的迷雾，你的胃里陡然一沉：你被绑在医疗舱中央的一张手术台上。固定在头部和上背的兜帽状装置伸出一根根导线，将信息输送到沿墙排列、泛着光芒的一排屏幕。 “哦？终于醒了？”你的注意力猛地转向那个一眼就认出的身影——维莉卡。她嘴角挤出邪恶的笑，一只手轻抚你的脸颊。“我还在想我们有没有机会谈谈呢。” 冰冷的汗珠沿着眉间滑下，恐惧让你的胃绞成一团。 “你到底对我做了什么？”你绷紧束缚，质问道。 “还什么都没做。放松，尊客。”她纤细的手指沿着你的身体滑向颈部，你不禁瑟缩。“很快，这一切就只会是一场噩梦——你那过度活跃的想象力制造的幻影。” 无数疑问在脑海走廊中飞驰，几乎要把你淹没，最后你终于问出了最根本的那个问题：为什么？ “为什么？”这名改造人毫无笑意地轻笑。“你是说你不知道？你是一件武器，[pc.name]。” “什么？” “你血液里的纳米机械可不只是用来治病。只要稍加改造，它们就能成为生物武器：银河军备竞赛中的最新一代产品。”维莉卡解释时密切观察着你，机械眼睛在你脸上搜寻反应。“政治向来是赢家通吃。我只是确保外环有能力抵御你们这种人。” “这太疯狂了，”你回答，坚决否认自己参与了任何针对外环的阴谋。 “你也许没有恶意，但斯蒂尔科技有。它是核心世界帝国体系的一部分。你们不能容许我们从脚下挣脱出去。字面意义上也是。毕竟，你父亲正是靠剥削外环的矿产财富发家的。” 这名改造人的手指[pc.hasHair |穿过你的[pc.hair] |抚过你的头顶 ]。[velika.lovesPC |“我希望你明白，这不是私人恩怨，尊客。不管怎样，我很享受我们共度的时光。你只是碰巧生在了银河错误的一边。”她久久凝视着你，随后从颈部抽出一根细长电缆，插进控制台。 |“但我不会把父亲的罪过堆到[pc.mf |儿子 |女儿 ]身上。只要你合作，我保证不会给你留下永久伤害。”她从颈部抽出一根细长电缆，插进控制台。 ] “晚安，晚安，[pc.name]。”

rows.original: Pain throbs downward from the back of your skull, emptying your world of everything save for Velika’s gleaming prosthetic eyes and the mechanical bite of the brain probe. You can feel the alien logic of the machine battering incessantly at your mind, methodically erasing your consciousness through its relentless interrogation. The cyborg smirks, straddling you so that her legs are on either side of your hips before leaning forward, her breath ghosting against your [pc.skin] as she speaks. “It’ll all be over soon, innie.” You can feel a swirling in your psyche, the pain coursing down your spine giving way to a twisted, feverish desire for her. “Just relax. I’ll take good care of you.” Her hair falls like a curtain around you as she favors you with a triumphant smirk. White static claws at the edge of your vision as your body thrums with artificially-induced ecstasy, threatening to overwhelm you. As you close your eyes, you hear a whispering female voice. Velika’s voice. Your mind wakes in bliss. Prosthetic fingers slip beneath the waistband of your fatigues, fingers gliding through the slick, swollen folds of your pussy. Your fingers begin to pulse and vibrate against your sex. “By far the best aug I ever paid for,” you think to yourself, a soft, contented moan escaping from your lips. When was the last time you were unable to unwind like this? You can’t remember. The monotony of garrison life makes each day blur into the next. Your mind drifts towards the image of taunt uniforms stretching across the chests of the new conscripts as you delve deeper into yourself, the mechanical stimulation of your digits sending bolts of pleasure shooting throughout your core. You won’t be seeing much of them in the near future. But who cares? Being selected to go abroad... now that’s something. Your free hand comes up to maul your own breasts as your sex clenches and flutters around your intruding fingers, gripping them like a hot, wet fist. Hardly anyone gets to do so these days and the damn war-scare has only made things worse. You hope you’ll be shipped off somewhere sickeningly blue, sunny, and more than a few parsecs between yourself and your old CO. As your eyes come to rest on the emblem on your livery you feel a strange tightness in your head that soon gives way to an aching throb. Dammit... you rub your temples. Why the hell did you have to get a headache now of all times? If one of your augs is on the fritz- You force yourself to look down at the insignia again before wincing, a fresh rod of pain driving its way through your skull. “Yes there’s no mistaking it... something has tripped my Infosec system. I’ll have to-” You blink, and the scene before you shifts to that of cigarette smoke and a long, rosewood table crowded by over half-a dozen technocrats. Real heavy hitters. Your chest constricts in nervousness. You feel like a damn schoolgirl, being put on the spot by a particularly overbearing teacher. But this isn’t a reprimand. You ought to feel pleased with yourself: a clap on the shoulders and a few surreptitious fingernail scrapings were all it took to get your hands on Steele’s prototype immune system. Or at least parts of it... the nanites didn’t take too well to cultivation so far. Might be bad luck. Might have been some programmed failsafe. You can’t be the only one looking to reverse engineer tech after all. Still, if what the doctors claim is true... if the technology really does have military applications... You purse your lips. You never did trust all the corporate propaganda Steele Tech churns out. Mining has always been a dirty business: blood diamonds, coups, death squads... you name it, some mining corp has tried it... or at the very least sat back and watched it happen. Still, to think that Steele Tech might turn to bioweapons... could [pc.name] really be in on such a thing? Who’s to say [pc.he] isn’t just a useful idiot? You rub your temples, groaning slightly as an insistent throbbing overtakes you. That damn machine... you never heard of a nerve stapler bouncing back on its cybernetic operator. Damn your superiors for making you go through with this. You have to cut the connection. You have to- Agony shivers through your skull as you feel a horrible tugging sensation, as if someone was trying to fish your brain out of your skull. You scream at the top of your lungs and- You bolt upright, your sweat-soaked [pc.upperGarmentOuter] hugging your frame as your eyes flit about your surroundings. Velika is nowhere to be found; a nest of fiber optic cables and an overturned monitor being the only clues of her egress. You take a deep, quieting breath before searching for your belongings, finding your [pc.gear] stashed in a pull-out body drawer in what you presume to be a morgue. You grip your [pc.weapon] as you march forward, unsure of where you are or what you might encounter.
rows.translation: 疼痛从后脑一路向下搏动，你的世界被掏空，只剩维莉卡闪亮的义眼，以及脑探针机械般的啃咬。你能感到机器陌生的逻辑不断轰击心智，通过无休止的审问，有条不紊地抹去你的意识。这名改造人冷笑着跨坐在你身上，双腿分列在你臀部两侧，随后俯身靠近，说话时呼吸轻拂你的[pc.skin]。“很快就结束了，尊客。”你的精神深处泛起漩涡，沿脊柱奔流的疼痛渐渐化成对她扭曲而灼热的渴望。“放松。我会好好照顾你的。”她的头发像帘幕般垂落在你周围，脸上挂着胜利的冷笑。 白色静电抓挠着视野边缘，人工诱发的狂喜让你的身体嗡鸣，几乎要将你吞没。闭上双眼时，你听见一个女人的低语。维莉卡的声音。 你的意识在极乐中苏醒。义肢手指滑进作战裤腰带下，穿过湿滑肿胀的阴唇褶皱。你的手指开始贴着私处搏动、震颤。“这是我花钱买过最值的强化体，”你心想，嘴里逸出满足的轻吟。 上一次如此放松是什么时候？你想不起来。驻防生活的单调让每一天都混成一团。当手指更深地探入自己时，你的思绪飘向新兵制服绷紧胸膛的画面，机械手指的刺激让一道道快感贯穿下腹。接下来一段时间恐怕见不到他们了。不过谁在乎？能被选中派往海外……那才叫机会。 另一只手抬起，粗暴揉弄自己的乳房，私处围绕侵入的手指收缩颤动，像滚烫湿润的拳头般紧紧攥住。如今几乎没人能得到这种机会，该死的战争恐慌只让情况更糟。你希望自己会被派往某个蓝得令人作呕、阳光普照的地方，最好与你那个老指挥官隔着不止几个秒差距。 当视线落到制服徽记上时，你的脑中突然绷紧，紧接着化成阵阵抽痛。该死……你揉着太阳穴。为什么偏偏现在头痛？要是某个强化体出了故障——你强迫自己再次看向徽章，却痛得缩起身体，又一根剧痛的尖刺贯穿头骨。“没错，不会有错……有什么触发了我的信息安全系统。我必须——” 你眨眨眼，眼前景象忽然变成烟雾缭绕的房间，一张长长的红木桌旁挤着六七名以上的技术官僚。全是举足轻重的大人物。紧张令你的胸口发紧。 你觉得自己像个该死的女学生，被一个格外专横的老师当众点名。但这不是训斥。你本该为自己感到得意：拍拍肩膀，再偷偷刮下几片指甲，就足以让你拿到斯蒂尔的原型免疫系统。至少拿到了其中一部分……到目前为止，那些纳米机器不太适应培养。可能只是运气不好，也可能是某种预设的保险机制。毕竟，想逆向破解技术的人肯定不止你一个。不过，要是医生们说的是真的……如果这项技术真有军事用途…… 你抿紧嘴唇。你从未相信斯蒂尔科技炮制的那些公司宣传。采矿从来都是肮脏生意：血钻、政变、敢死队……随便说一种，总有矿业公司干过……至少也曾坐视它发生。可斯蒂尔科技竟可能转向生物武器……[pc.name]真的参与其中吗？谁能保证[pc.he]不只是个有利用价值的白痴？ 你揉着太阳穴，持续的搏动压过一切，令你低声呻吟。那台该死的机器……你从没听说过神经钉合器会反噬它的机械操作者。该死的上级竟逼你这么做。你必须切断连接。你必须——痛苦震颤着贯穿头骨，你感到一股可怕的拉扯，仿佛有人正试图把大脑从颅腔里钓出去。你放声尖叫，然后—— 你猛地坐起，汗水浸透的[pc.upperGarmentOuter]紧贴身体，双眼飞快扫视周围。维莉卡不见踪影；地上一窝光纤线缆和一台翻倒的显示器，是她离开的唯一痕迹。你深深吸气，努力平复心绪，随后寻找自己的东西，最终在一具可拉出的尸体冷藏柜里找到被收好的[pc.gear]——这里大概是间停尸房。你握紧[pc.weapon]向前走去，不知道身在何处，也不知道会遇上什么。
rows.raw: " Pain throbs downward from the back of your skull, emptying your world of everything save for Velika’s gleaming prosthetic eyes and the mechanical bite of the brain probe. You can feel the alien logic of the machine battering incessantly at your mind, methodically erasing your consciousness through its relentless interrogation. The cyborg smirks, straddling you so that her legs are on either side of your hips before leaning forward, her breath ghosting against your [pc.skin] as she speaks. “It’ll all be over soon, innie.” You can feel a swirling in your psyche, the pain coursing down your spine giving way to a twisted, feverish desire for her. “Just relax. I’ll take good care of you.” Her hair falls like a curtain around you as she favors you with a triumphant smirk. White static claws at the edge of your vision as your body thrums with artificially-induced ecstasy, threatening to overwhelm you. As you close your eyes, you hear a whispering female voice. Velika’s voice. Your mind wakes in bliss. Prosthetic fingers slip beneath the waistband of your fatigues, fingers gliding through the slick, swollen folds of your pussy. Your fingers begin to pulse and vibrate against your sex. “By far the best aug I ever paid for,” you think to yourself, a soft, contented moan escaping from your lips. When was the last time you were unable to unwind like this? You can’t remember. The monotony of garrison life makes each day blur into the next. Your mind drifts towards the image of taunt uniforms stretching across the chests of the new conscripts as you delve deeper into yourself, the mechanical stimulation of your digits sending bolts of pleasure shooting throughout your core. You won’t be seeing much of them in the near future. But who cares? Being selected to go abroad... now that’s something. Your free hand comes up to maul your own breasts as your sex clenches and flutters around your intruding fingers, gripping them like a hot, wet fist. Hardly anyone gets to do so these days and the damn war-scare has only made things worse. You hope you’ll be shipped off somewhere sickeningly blue, sunny, and more than a few parsecs between yourself and your old CO. As your eyes come to rest on the emblem on your livery you feel a strange tightness in your head that soon gives way to an aching throb. Dammit... you rub your temples. Why the hell did you have to get a headache now of all times? If one of your augs is on the fritz- You force yourself to look down at the insignia again before wincing, a fresh rod of pain driving its way through your skull. “Yes there’s no mistaking it... something has tripped my Infosec system. I’ll have to-” You blink, and the scene before you shifts to that of cigarette smoke and a long, rosewood table crowded by over half-a dozen technocrats. Real heavy hitters. Your chest constricts in nervousness. You feel like a damn schoolgirl, being put on the spot by a particularly overbearing teacher. But this isn’t a reprimand. You ought to feel pleased with yourself: a clap on the shoulders and a few surreptitious fingernail scrapings were all it took to get your hands on Steele’s prototype immune system. Or at least parts of it... the nanites didn’t take too well to cultivation so far. Might be bad luck. Might have been some programmed failsafe. You can’t be the only one looking to reverse engineer tech after all. Still, if what the doctors claim is true... if the technology really does have military applications... You purse your lips. You never did trust all the corporate propaganda Steele Tech churns out. Mining has always been a dirty business: blood diamonds, coups, death squads... you name it, some mining corp has tried it... or at the very least sat back and watched it happen. Still, to think that Steele Tech might turn to bioweapons... could [pc.name] really be in on such a thing? Who’s to say [pc.he] isn’t just a useful idiot? You rub your temples, groaning slightly as an insistent throbbing overtakes you. That damn machine... you never heard of a nerve stapler bouncing back on its cybernetic operator. Damn your superiors for making you go through with this. You have to cut the connection. You have to- Agony shivers through your skull as you feel a horrible tugging sensation, as if someone was trying to fish your brain out of your skull. You scream at the top of your lungs and- You bolt upright, your sweat-soaked [pc.upperGarmentOuter] hugging your frame as your eyes flit about your surroundings. Velika is nowhere to be found; a nest of fiber optic cables and an overturned monitor being the only clues of her egress. You take a deep, quieting breath before searching for your belongings, finding your [pc.gear] stashed in a pull-out body drawer in what you presume to be a morgue. You grip your [pc.weapon] as you march forward, unsure of where you are or what you might encounter. "

Ms. Velika Gutkind? She’s been part of my security detail on occasion. Not that I have much need of one on a planet like Myrellion,” he chuckles. “The queens would be up in arms if any harm came to me. Anyway, what of her?”

rows.original: All of her...? You suddenly realize there’s more of her body hidden behind the clothes rack, and peer warily past her curvaceous hips. As promised, the Siel pulls it out... and out... and out. Void, how much of her IS there?
rows.translation: 她的全部...? 你忽然意识到，她还有更多身体藏在衣架后面，于是警惕地越过她曲线丰盈的臀部望去。如她所言，这名希尔人把身体拉了出来...又出来...还在出来。虚空在上，她到底还有多少身体？
rows.raw: "\n\nAll of her...? You suddenly realize there’s more of her body hidden behind the clothes rack, and peer warily past her curvaceous hips. As promised, the Siel pulls it out... and out... and out. Void, how much of her IS there?"

rows.original: When you finally get a good look at her, you realize she has six more sets of legs - eight in total - all clad in lacy black stockings. They’re attached to a long bulbous body that resembles that of a giant blue caterpillar. She wears a second set of underwear on her hindquarters. A segmented tail with a slit on the end is jutting out from her rump.
rows.translation: 当你终于看清她的全貌时，才发现她还有六对腿 - 总共八对 - 全都裹着黑色蕾丝长袜。那些腿连接着一具修长而鼓胀、酷似巨大蓝色毛虫的身体。她在后半身还穿着第二条内裤。一条分节尾巴从臀后伸出，末端有一道裂缝。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you finally get a good look at her, you realize she has six more sets of legs - eight in total - all clad in lacy black stockings. They’re attached to a long bulbous body that resembles that of a giant blue caterpillar. She wears a second set of underwear on her hindquarters. A segmented tail with a slit on the end is jutting out from her rump."

rows.original: Noticing your puzzlement, realization dawns on the alien woman. “Oh! It’s your first time meeting a siel. And here I was thinking you were just that interested... what a shame.”
rows.translation: 注意到你的困惑，异星女人顿时明白过来。“哦！这是你第一次见到希尔人。而我还以为你只是对我那么感兴趣呢...真可惜。”
rows.raw: "\n\nNoticing your puzzlement, realization dawns on the alien woman. “Oh! It’s your first time meeting a siel. And here I was thinking you were just that interested... what a shame.”"

rows.original: The siel woman then moves past you, making sure to brush against your side. There, right near your ear, she stops for a brief moment and leans in to whisper. “...If you are, though, I’ll just have to do something about that. I really do excel at ‘customer service’.”
rows.translation: 希尔女人随即从你身旁走过，还故意用身体蹭过你的侧身。她在你耳边停顿片刻，凑近低声说道。“...不过，如果你确实感兴趣，那我只好为此做点什么了。我真的很擅长‘顾客服务’。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe siel woman then moves past you, making sure to brush against your side. There, right near your ear, she stops for a brief moment and leans in to whisper. “...If you are, though, I’ll just have to do something about that. I really do excel at ‘customer service’.”"

rows.original: As if she hadn’t uttered a single word, the siel slips behind the nearby counter, leaving the smell of fresh rain in her wake. Turning to you, she sweeps back a lock of her hair and flashes you a brilliant smile.
rows.translation: 仿佛刚才什么也没说过似的，希尔女人溜到附近的柜台后面，身后留下一股清新雨水的气息。她转向你，拨开一绺头发，向你绽放出灿烂笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs if she hadn’t uttered a single word, the siel slips behind the nearby counter, leaving the smell of fresh rain in her wake. Turning to you, she sweeps back a lock of her hair and flashes you a brilliant smile."

rows.original: “Welcome to the Silken Serenity! My name is Xanthe. Please, check our wares. I’m sure you’ll find something to my tastes.” She coughs, and corrects herself. “...I mean, your tastes.”
rows.translation: “欢迎光临丝绸宁静！我叫珊瑟。请随便看看我们的商品。我相信你一定能找到合我口味的东西。”她咳了一声，随即改口。“...我是说，合你口味的东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Welcome to the Silken Serenity! My name is Xanthe. Please, check our wares. I’m sure you’ll find something to my tastes.” She coughs, and corrects herself. “...I mean, your tastes.”"

rows.original: Xanthe seems to be peering at you rather intently, as if she’s trying to figure something out. Those electric blues of hers are even more intense than usual.
rows.translation: 珊瑟似乎正格外专注地打量着你，好像在试图弄清什么。她那双电蓝色眼睛比平时更加锐利。
rows.raw: "Xanthe seems to be peering at you rather intently, as if she’s trying to figure something out. Those electric blues of hers are even more intense than usual."

rows.original: “...Now where have I seen you before...?” she muses aloud. Suddenly, realization sets in, and her eyebrows shoot up. “Oh, by Zyi! You’re [pc.fullName], aren’t you...?”
rows.translation: “...我到底在哪里见过你呢...？”她自言自语地沉思。忽然，她恍然大悟，眉毛猛地扬起。“哦，兹伊在上！你是[pc.fullName]，对吧...？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...Now where have I seen you before...?” she muses aloud. Suddenly, realization sets in, and her eyebrows shoot up. “Oh, by Zyi! You’re [pc.fullName], aren’t you...?”"

rows.original: You blink and wonder how she knows who you are. Peering closer, you don’t think you’ve screwed her before. But your memory is kind of fuzzy, and you sleep around a lot - it’s hard to keep track, right? You don’t like not knowing, so you just ask.
rows.translation: 你眨了眨眼，不明白她怎么会认识你。凑近仔细一看，你觉得自己以前应该没上过她。不过你的记忆有些模糊，而且你经常到处留情 - 要把每个人都记清楚可不容易，对吧？你不喜欢蒙在鼓里，于是直接开口问她。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou blink and wonder how she knows who you are. Peering closer, you don’t think you’ve screwed her before. But your memory is kind of fuzzy, and you sleep around a lot - it’s hard to keep track, right? You don’t like not knowing, so you just ask."

rows.original: Xanthe smiles at your words. There’s a distinctive little glitter in her eyes, as if warmed by your kind words. “It is. You wouldn’t think it was all weave, actually, except for all the colors!
rows.translation: 珊瑟听到你的话后露出微笑。她眼中闪烁着独特的光彩，仿佛因你的赞美而感到温暖。“确实如此。要不是颜色如此丰富，你根本想不到那里的一切都是织出来的！

rows.original: She then picks up a brilliantly colored garment, showing it to you. “You can get a lot of fine detail in siel silk; literally thousands of different colored threads in a single meter. Our cities are made like that for hundreds of miles, they’re true works of art.”
rows.translation: 接着她拿起一件色彩鲜艳的衣服，展示给你看。“希尔丝绸能织出极其精细的细节；短短一米之内就能包含成千上万种不同颜色的丝线。我们的城市绵延数百英里，都是这样织成的，是真正的艺术品。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe then picks up a brilliantly colored garment, showing it to you. “You can get a lot of fine detail in siel silk; literally thousands of different colored threads in a single meter. Our cities are made like that for hundreds of miles, they’re true works of art.”"

rows.original: You observe that Xanthe sounds quite proud of them, as if she’d been involved herself. She shakes her head and gives a light smile.
rows.translation: 你注意到，珊瑟谈起那些城市时十分自豪，仿佛自己也曾参与其中。她摇摇头，淡淡一笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou observe that Xanthe sounds quite proud of them, as if she’d been involved herself. She shakes her head and gives a light smile."

rows.original: “No, I just feel their pride as a fellow artisan. A siel who specializes in silk weaving - be it building, architecture, or clothes - is truly expressed through their work. It’s literally woven from our silk sacs, and therefore from our bodies.”
rows.translation: “不，我只是身为同道的工匠，能体会到他们的自豪。专精丝织的希尔人 - 无论织的是建筑、结构还是衣服 - 都会通过作品真正表达自己。那些作品实实在在地由我们的丝囊织成，也就是由我们的身体织成。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No, I just feel their pride as a fellow artisan. A siel who specializes in silk weaving - be it building, architecture, or clothes - is truly expressed through their work. It’s literally woven from our silk sacs, and therefore from our bodies.”"

rows.original: “In a sense, our work is part of us, and through it we gain immortality. Our cities are precious things, built from the silk of those who came before.”
rows.translation: “从某种意义上说，我们的作品就是我们的一部分，而我们也借此获得永生。我们的城市弥足珍贵，是由先人的丝绸建造起来的。”

rows.original: “Sounds kind of... flammable.” You remark. Wouldn’t someone just drop a match and the whole thing go up?

rows.original: Xanthe shakes her head and lets out a chastising noise. “Of course not! Even though it can naturally burn, it’s very slow to do so, and often a fire puts itself out. We douse our silk in different fire retardants to preserve it and stop that from happening. A siel city is no more flammable than any other.”
rows.translation: 珊瑟摇摇头，发出责备的咂舌声。“当然不会！虽然丝绸本身确实能燃烧，但烧得很慢，火焰往往会自行熄灭。我们会用不同的阻燃剂浸泡丝绸，以保护它并阻止这种情况发生。希尔城市并不比其他城市更易燃。”
rows.raw: "\n\nXanthe shakes her head and lets out a chastising noise. “Of course not! Even though it can naturally burn, it’s very slow to do so, and often a fire puts itself out. We douse our silk in different fire retardants to preserve it and stop that from happening. A siel city is no more flammable than any other.”"

rows.original: “Besides, destruction of property is a terrible crime on Xhixia. It doesn’t even occur to all but the sickest of siel. We’re much stricter on it than most species are.”
rows.translation: “况且，在希夏，破坏财产是一项极其严重的罪行。除了病得最厉害的希尔人，其他人根本不会产生这种念头。我们在这方面比大多数种族严格得多。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Besides, destruction of property is a terrible crime on Xhixia. It doesn’t even occur to all but the sickest of siel. We’re much stricter on it than most species are.”"

rows.original: You ask exactly why that is. After all, isn’t it easier for siel to repair property? They’ve got silk sacs that naturally produce repair materials.

rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask exactly why that is. After all, isn’t it easier for siel to repair property? They’ve got silk sacs that naturally produce repair materials."

rows.original: “It’s not about having the materials to replace it. A siel who specializes in silk weaving - be it building, architecture, or clothes - is truly expressed through their work. rows.translation: “重点不在于有没有材料去替换它。专精丝织的希尔人 - 无论织的是建筑、结构还是衣服 - 都会通过作品真正表达自己。那些作品实实在在地由我们的丝囊织成，也就是由我们的身体织成。”珊瑟解释道，同时拿起一块织工精细的布料展示给你。

rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, that’s easy. All our cities and towns are high above the ground. They’re woven out of siel silk; lots and lots of it until it becomes ‘solid’ like mineral rock.”"

rows.original: Siel silk? You ask her about that, and she turns her caterpillar-like tail to face forward. From her tail tip, she shoots a thin strand of a white substance and catches it in her hand.
rows.translation: 西尔族丝线？你向她问起这件事，她便把毛毛虫般的尾巴转到前方，从尾端射出一缕白色物质，再用手接住。
rows.raw: "\n\nSiel silk? You ask her about that, and she turns her caterpillar-like tail to face forward. From her tail tip, she shoots a thin strand of a white substance and catches it in her hand."

rows.original: In mere seconds she’s woven it between her fingers to form a set of pretty star formations. “This is siel silk. All siel naturally produce it from their silk spinners located in our... well, our rumps. We can produce lots of it; pretty much as thick, sticky, or malleable as we want.”
rows.translation: 仅仅几秒，她就在指间把丝线织成了一组漂亮的星形图案。“这就是西尔族丝线。所有西尔族都能从位于……呃，位于臀部的吐丝器里自然产出它。我们能产出很多，粗细、黏度和延展性几乎都能随心控制。”
rows.raw: "\n\nIn mere seconds she’s woven it between her fingers to form a set of pretty star formations. “This is siel silk. All siel naturally produce it from their silk spinners located in our... well, our rumps. We can produce lots of it; pretty much as thick, sticky, or malleable as we want.”"

rows.original: “Actually, almost all the clothes in the store are made from my silk. There’s artificial coloring of course, and some have a few baubles. Otherwise, most pieces are 100 per cent made from me.”
rows.translation: “事实上，店里的衣服几乎全是用我的丝制成的。当然还用了人工染料，有些也加了几件小饰物。除此之外，大部分衣物都是百分之百由我制成的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Actually, almost all the clothes in the store are made from my silk. There’s artificial coloring of course, and some have a few baubles. Otherwise, most pieces are 100 per cent made from me.”"

rows.original: “Oh wow, so like, all this stuff is made from your butt or whatever? That’s so cool!” you genuinely exclaim. You wish you could make stuff out of your ass. Not that your butt doesn’t make people happy in other ways. You look back at it and let out a giggle.
rows.translation: “哇哦，所以这些东西都是从你的屁股之类的地方做出来的？太酷了！”你由衷地惊叹。真希望自己也能用屁股做东西。不过你的屁股当然也会用别的方式让人开心。你回头看了看它，咯咯笑了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh wow, so like, all this stuff is made from your butt or whatever? That’s so cool!” you genuinely exclaim. You wish you could make stuff out of your ass. Not that your butt doesn’t make people happy in other ways. You look back at it and let out a giggle."

rows.original: “So does that mean all your cities are kind of, y’know, bouncy? Like boobs?” You imagine it’s kind of like a trampoline, and trampolines are fun. They make boobs bounce even more.
rows.translation: “那是不是说，你们所有的城市都有点那种弹弹的感觉，你懂吧？就像奶子一样？”你想象那里大概像蹦床，而蹦床很好玩，还能让奶子弹得更厉害。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So does that mean all your cities are kind of, y’know, bouncy? Like boobs?” You imagine it’s kind of like a trampoline, and trampolines are fun. They make boobs bounce even more."

rows.original: You look around. It’s definitely different to hear someone claim they’ve made almost an entire shop’s worth of stock from their own body. Xanthe makes it sound like it’s the most natural thing in the world.
rows.translation: 你环顾四周。听一个人宣称，几乎整家店的货物都出自她自己的身体，感觉确实很不一样。珊瑟却说得仿佛这是世上最自然不过的事。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou look around. It’s definitely different to hear someone claim they’ve made almost an entire shop’s worth of stock from their own body. Xanthe makes it sound like it’s the most natural thing in the world."

rows.original: “The silk that makes up our cities is different. This stuff is thin, whereas that silk is packed tightly together and interwoven until it’s hard as rock. It’s actually rather beautiful.
rows.translation: “构成我们城市的丝线不太一样。这种丝很细，而建城用的丝会被紧紧压实、彼此交织，直到坚如岩石。其实非常漂亮。
rows.raw: "\n\n“The silk that makes up our cities is different. This stuff is thin, whereas that silk is packed tightly together and interwoven until it’s hard as rock. It’s actually rather beautiful."

rows.original: “I’ve yet to see any non-siel city that is as colorful as those on Xhixia. Gildenmere is lovely, but nowhere near as aesthetically pleasing.”
rows.translation: “我还没见过哪座非西尔族城市，能像希夏的城市那样色彩斑斓。吉尔登米尔很漂亮，但审美上远远比不上那里。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ve yet to see any non-siel city that is as colorful as those on Xhixia. Gildenmere is lovely, but nowhere near as aesthetically pleasing.”"

rows.original: Beautiful
rows.translation: 漂亮
rows.raw: "Beautiful"

rows.translation: 未解锁

rows.raw: "Flammable"

rows.translation: 什么都不说
rows.raw: "Say Nothing"

rows.original: Xanthe
rows.translation: 珊瑟
rows.raw: "Xanthe"

rows.original: You want to know about Xanthe, because she’s pretty and interesting. You don’t need any other reason to ask, right?
rows.translation: 你想了解珊瑟，因为她既漂亮又有趣。提问还需要别的理由吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou want to know about Xanthe, because she’s pretty and interesting. You don’t need any other reason to ask, right?"

rows.original: “Tell me about yourself! I’m really interested,” you look at her with big wide eyes. “Pleaaassseee?”
rows.translation: “跟我讲讲你自己吧！我真的很感兴趣，”你睁大眼睛看着她。“拜托嘛啊啊？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Tell me about yourself! I’m really interested,” you look at her with big wide eyes. “Pleaaassseee?”"

rows.original: You ask Xanthe about herself. You’re interested to hear a bit more about
rows.translation: 你向珊瑟询问她自己的事。你很想进一步了解
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask Xanthe about herself. You’re interested to hear a bit more about "

rows.original: your Mistress
rows.translation: 你的女主人
rows.raw: "your Mistress"

rows.original: the mysterious siel woman
rows.translation: 这位神秘的西尔族女子
rows.raw: "the mysterious siel woman"

rows.original: The husky voiced alien sounds quite flattered at your interest, going so far as to place her gloved fingers on her chest in mock astonishment.
rows.translation: 听到你对她感兴趣，这位嗓音沙哑的外星人似乎颇感受用，甚至故作惊讶地把戴着手套的手指按在胸口。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe husky voiced alien sounds quite flattered at your interest, going so far as to place her gloved fingers on her chest in mock astonishment."

rows.original: “You want to know about little old me? I’m not sure there’s anything to tell. I’m a regular wallflower, really. Nothing special at all.”
rows.translation: “你想了解平凡的我？我可不确定有什么好说的。我其实只是个普通的壁花，完全没什么特别之处。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You want to know about little old me? I’m not sure there’s anything to tell. I’m a regular wallflower, really. Nothing special at all.”"

rows.original: “What? You’ve got those wonderful boobs sticking out. You’re not, like, a boring modest person!” You exclaim. Those kind of people are the worst!
rows.translation: “什么？你那对漂亮的奶子都露在外面了。你才不是什么无聊又保守的人呢！”你大声反驳。那种人最讨厌了！
rows.raw: "\n\n“What? You’ve got those wonderful boobs sticking out. You’re not, like, a boring modest person!” You exclaim. Those kind of people are the worst!"

rows.original: You cough and look at her six fingers pressing against her voluminous blue breasts. Her frilly lingerie and boldly exposed bosom don’t really scream modesty.
rows.translation: 你轻咳一声，看着她六根手指压在丰满的蓝色乳房上。她那缀满褶边的内衣和大胆裸露的胸脯，怎么看都谈不上端庄。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou cough and look at her six fingers pressing against her voluminous blue breasts. Her frilly lingerie and boldly exposed bosom don’t really scream modesty."

rows.original: “Oh, but for a siel, this is modest! From my people’s point of view, wearing too much clothing is considered inappropriate. It’s most of the other species who have things backwards. The gold myr have the right idea, though. They know how to dress respectfully.”
rows.translation: “哦，但对西尔族来说，这就是端庄！在我们看来，穿得太多才是不合体统。是其他大多数种族把事情弄反了。不过金米尔的观念倒是正确，她们知道怎样穿着才算得体。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, but for a siel, this is modest! From my people’s point of view, wearing too much clothing is considered inappropriate. It’s most of the other species who have things backwards. The gold myr have the right idea, though. They know how to dress respectfully.”"

rows.original: You realize things have gotten a little off topic, and you say as much. She coughs and nods, fully agreeing with you.
rows.translation: 你意识到话题有些跑偏，便直言指出。她咳了一声，点头表示完全赞同。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou realize things have gotten a little off topic, and you say as much. She coughs and nods, fully agreeing with you."

rows.original: “Ah yes, enough about gratuitous concealment! Where to start, really? My full name is Xanthe O’Anyalicia, and I was born in the planet capital of Rhian.”
rows.translation: “啊，对，别再谈那些毫无必要的遮掩了！该从哪里讲起呢？我的全名是珊瑟·奥安雅莉西亚，出生在瑞安星的首都。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah yes, enough about gratuitous concealment! Where to start, really? My full name is Xanthe O’Anyalicia, and I was born in the planet capital of Rhian.”"

rows.original: “I’m the sixteenth daughter of a family of twenty four. I’ve got a lot of sisters. My mother is a Xhixian senior senate advisor, and my father is a senate clerk. Needless to say, that’s how they first met.”
rows.translation: “我是家里二十四个女儿中的第十六个，有非常多姐妹。母亲是希夏高级参议院顾问，父亲则是参议院书记员。不用说，他们就是这样认识的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m the sixteenth daughter of a family of twenty four. I’ve got a lot of sisters. My mother is a Xhixian senior senate advisor, and my father is a senate clerk. Needless to say, that’s how they first met.”"

rows.original: Xanthe seems to take a moment to think about what to add, pressing a fingertip against her chin. “...I’m 82 years old - still pretty young for a siel. Never had a clutch of my own. Graduated from Rhian University with one Masters degree in cloth weaving and another in being a Mistress.”
rows.translation: 珊瑟似乎花了片刻思考还该补充些什么，一根指尖抵在下巴上。“...我八十二岁，对西尔族而言还很年轻。我从未产下过自己的一窝卵。我毕业于瑞安大学，拥有织物编织硕士学位，以及另一个女主人专业的硕士学位。”
rows.raw: "\n\nXanthe seems to take a moment to think about what to add, pressing a fingertip against her chin. “...I’m 82 years old - still pretty young for a siel. Never had a clutch of my own. Graduated from Rhian University with one Masters degree in cloth weaving and another in being a Mistress.”"

rows.original: A Mistress? You ask if she means like ‘being the other woman’ in a marriage, or something else?
rows.translation: 女主人？你问她指的是婚姻里的“第三者”之类，还是别的意思？
rows.raw: "\n\nA Mistress? You ask if she means like ‘being the other woman’ in a marriage, or something else?"

rows.original: That question seems to leave the seamstress in stitches, laughing so hard she grabs her side. “No, no, not THAT kind of Mistress! The kind that ties you up and calls you names. I know, I know, my folks are traditional. I really am a model siel girl.”
rows.translation: 这个问题把裁缝逗得前仰后合，她笑得捂住了肚子。“不，不，不是那种女主人！是把你绑起来、用各种称呼使唤你的那种。我知道，我知道，我家里人很传统。我的确是个模范西尔族姑娘。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThat question seems to leave the seamstress in stitches, laughing so hard she grabs her side. “No, no, not THAT kind of Mistress! The kind that ties you up and calls you names. I know, I know, my folks are traditional. I really am a model siel girl.” "

rows.original: She lets out a sigh and twists a lock of hair around a finger. “No rebellious youth of wearing baggy overalls and un-bound sex for me. Guess I missed that particular teen phase, so to speak. I’m even a Zyist, which makes me even more of a straight arrow.”
rows.translation: 她叹了口气，把一绺头发绕在指间。“我年轻时可没叛逆到穿宽松工装裤、进行不加束缚的性爱。可以说，我错过了那个青春阶段。我甚至还是个兹伊教徒，这让我变得更加循规蹈矩。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe lets out a sigh and twists a lock of hair around a finger. “No rebellious youth of wearing baggy overalls and un-bound sex for me. Guess I missed that particular teen phase, so to speak. I’m even a Zyist, which makes me even more of a straight arrow.”"

rows.original: “I don’t regret being perfectly average, though. I’ve always wanted to sew things, tie people up in my silk, make people lick my toes and call me ‘Mistress’. I left Xhixia to stand out a bit more, hence me being here on Myrellion.”
rows.translation: “不过，我并不后悔自己如此普通。我一直想缝制东西，用自己的丝把人绑起来，让别人舔我的脚趾并称我为‘女主人’。我离开希夏，就是想让自己显得特别一点，所以才来到了迈雷利恩。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t regret being perfectly average, though. I’ve always wanted to sew things, tie people up in my silk, make people lick my toes and call me ‘Mistress’. I left Xhixia to stand out a bit more, hence me being here on Myrellion.”"

rows.original: “Of course it’s totally my style to pick somewhere where people dress traditionally, not somewhere completely outrageous. Even when I try to rebel and switch things up, I’m still completely tame.”
rows.translation: “当然，我还是很符合自己的作风，挑了一个人们穿着传统的地方，而不是某个离经叛道之地。即便我试着反抗传统、换换花样，也依旧温顺得很。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course it’s totally my style to pick somewhere where people dress traditionally, not somewhere completely outrageous. Even when I try to rebel and switch things up, I’m still completely tame.”"

rows.original: “I mean, I’ve still yet to try sex where I don’t tie someone up and ream them from behind, or something really kinky like missionary style.” She gives a thrilled little shiver. “The good girl in me totally gets off on the idea of being THAT bad, even though I love doing it old school.”
rows.translation: “我是说，我甚至还没试过不把对方绑起来、再从后面狠狠干的性爱，也没试过传教士体位这种真正变态的玩法。”她兴奋地轻颤了一下。“虽然我喜欢老派做法，但我内心的乖女孩一想到自己能坏到那种程度，就兴奋得不得了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I mean, I’ve still yet to try sex where I don’t tie someone up and ream them from behind, or something really kinky like missionary style.” She gives a thrilled little shiver. “The good girl in me totally gets off on the idea of being THAT bad, even though I love doing it old school.”"

rows.original: Xanthe gives a light little shrug, “...I’d say I’m pretty easy going, a bit playful, and I LOVE teasing people. Other than that, I’m just your everyday panty making Domme.”
rows.translation: 珊瑟轻轻耸肩，“...我觉得自己很随和，有点爱玩，而且非常喜欢挑逗别人。除此之外，我就只是个随处可见、专门制作内裤的女王。”
rows.raw: "\n\nXanthe gives a light little shrug, “...I’d say I’m pretty easy going, a bit playful, and I LOVE teasing people. Other than that, I’m just your everyday panty making Domme.”"

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.translation: “你是这家店的老板吗？我喜欢这里这些暴露的东西，”你咯咯笑道。尤其是那几对乳贴流苏，看起来棒极了！
rows.raw: "“Are you the store owner? I like all the skimpy things here,” you giggle. The nipple tassels look especially nice!"

rows.original: about her store The Silken Serenity, and if she’s the owner. After all, she’s clearly an off-worlder.
rows.translation: 问起她的商店“丝绸宁静”，以及她是不是店主。毕竟，她显然来自外星。
rows.raw: " about her store The Silken Serenity, and if she’s the owner. After all, she’s clearly an off-worlder."

rows.original: The lingerie-clad siel woman seems very proud of it, and gives a distinct nod. “Yes, I’m the owner, and everything in here - bar one or two items - is my hand-crafted work. It took me some time to set up, but now it’s probably the most renowned garment store in Gildenmere!”
rows.translation: 身穿内衣的西尔女人对此显得十分自豪，郑重地点了点头。“没错，我就是店主，而且这里的一切——除了一两件之外——都是我亲手制作的。开店花了我一些时间，不过现在这里大概已经是吉尔登米尔最负盛名的服装店了！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe lingerie-clad siel woman seems very proud of it, and gives a distinct nod. “Yes, I’m the owner, and everything in here - bar one or two items - is my hand-crafted work. It took me some time to set up, but now it’s probably the most renowned garment store in Gildenmere!”"

rows.original: “Wha... REALLY? That’s amazing.” You stare at her in complete shock. There must be a lot of people like you who like her skimpy stuff!
rows.translation: “什……真的？太厉害了。”你震惊地盯着她。一定有很多像你一样喜欢她这些暴露服饰的人！
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wha... REALLY? That’s amazing.” You stare at her in complete shock. There must be a lot of people like you who like her skimpy stuff!"

rows.original: That’s a pretty bold claim, though it does have a prime position and a nice look. That said, it’s almost like a labyrinth inside and you haven’t seen swarms of customers.
rows.translation: 这话相当大胆，不过店铺位置绝佳，外观也很漂亮。话虽如此，里面简直像座迷宫，而且你并没有看到顾客蜂拥而至。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s a pretty bold claim, though it does have a prime position and a nice look. That said, it’s almost like a labyrinth inside and you haven’t seen swarms of customers."

rows.original: “Ahem, you shouldn’t judge things by appearances. My store is really upscale - not just anyone buys clothes here, you know!” Xanthe huffs and crosses her glove clad arms.
rows.translation: “咳，你可不该以貌取人。我的店非常高档——可不是什么人都会来这里买衣服，明白吗！”珊西哼了一声，抱起戴着手套的双臂。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ahem, you shouldn’t judge things by appearances. My store is really upscale - not just anyone buys clothes here, you know!” Xanthe huffs and crosses her glove clad arms."

rows.original: “I’ll have you know I’ve woven several sets of undergarments for a few myr queens. My reputation is quite impeccable.”
rows.translation: “告诉你吧，我还为好几位米尔女王织过成套内衣。我的声誉可是无可挑剔。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ll have you know I’ve woven several sets of undergarments for a few myr queens. My reputation is quite impeccable.”"

rows.original: “...Right now, the rulers of Gildenmere - some say Goddesses - are creaming themselves in panties literally woven from my body. Pretty neat, hmm?”
rows.translation: “……就在此刻，吉尔登米尔的统治者——有些人甚至称她们为女神——正穿着由我的身体亲手织成的内裤，把自己弄得一塌糊涂。挺不错的，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...Right now, the rulers of Gildenmere - some say Goddesses - are creaming themselves in panties literally woven from my body. Pretty neat, hmm?”"

rows.original: The thought of a bunch of myr queens creaming themselves in their panties gets you hot and bothered, and you let out a little moan. A second later, you realize something doesn’t add up. “...But, like, your clothes don’t seem that expensive to me. I mean, I can afford them.”
rows.translation: 想到一群米尔女王穿着内裤把自己弄得淫液横流，你顿时欲火中烧，轻轻呻吟了一声。片刻后，你意识到有些地方说不通。“……可是，你的衣服对我来说好像并没有那么贵。我的意思是，我买得起。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe thought of a bunch of myr queens creaming themselves in their panties gets you hot and bothered, and you let out a little moan. A second later, you realize something doesn’t add up. “...But, like, your clothes don’t seem that expensive to me. I mean, I can afford them.”"

rows.original: That’s another bold claim! Sure, there’s no price tags on anything, but everything you’ve asked about has been very affordable. Surely her clothes can’t be that exclusive.
rows.translation: 这又是个大胆的说法！没错，所有商品都没有价签，但凡是你问过的东西都相当实惠。她的衣服不可能真有那么高端。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s another bold claim! Sure, there’s no price tags on anything, but everything you’ve asked about has been very affordable. Surely her clothes can’t be that exclusive."

rows.original: With a conspiratorial gleam in her electric blue colored eyes, Xanthe grins at you. “Oh, but my dear, they ARE expensive. I always give a special ninety per cent discount to the especially cute ones...”

rows.translation: 你催促她继续。既然有人愿意听她抱怨，她显然很乐意奉陪。“要我说，这很蠢。他认定蜜罐蚁会成为女性美容基因改造的下一个热门：银河系里的每个姑娘都会排队改造，让自己的乳房不断被乳汁、蜂蜜还是什么东西撑大，直到大得动弹不得。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou urge her to continue. Given an open ear to complain at, she seems quite happy to oblige. “It’s dumb, if you ask me. He’s convinced the honeypot ants are going to be the next big thing in cosmetic gene-mods for chicks: every babe in the galaxy will line up to make it so her tits are constantly swelling with milk or honey or whatever until they’re so big she can’t move.”"

rows.original: After a moment’s consideration, Nevrie laughs and adds, “Well, I’d take a pass on it, anyway. Wouldn’t mind getting my hands on a couple of girls modded like that for my harem. Uh, if I had a harem, anyway. Someday!”
rows.translation: 思考片刻后，内芙莉笑着补充道：“不过我自己会放弃这种改造。倒是不介意弄到几个改造成那样的女孩，塞进我的后宫。呃，如果我有后宫的话。总有一天！”
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a moment’s consideration, Nevrie laughs and adds, “Well, I’d take a pass on it, anyway. Wouldn’t mind getting my hands on a couple of girls modded like that for my harem. Uh, if I had a harem, anyway. Someday!”"

rows.original: She gives a dreamy sigh and leans back in her chair, crossing a leg over the other. “I don’t know when Doc. McAllister’s gonna be back. And when he does, he probably won’t stick around long. Keeps saying he can’t find one of the red ants to get samples from. Don’t know how he expects to find a red myr between a goldie Queen’s tits, but whatever. I guess the hospital and the Red embassy don’t feel like helping.”
rows.translation: 她梦幻般地叹了口气，靠回椅中，把一条腿搭到另一条上。“我不知道麦卡利斯特医生什么时候回来。就算回来，他大概也不会待太久。总说自己找不到红米尔来取样。我不知道他要怎么在金米尔女王的乳房之间找到红米尔，不过随便吧。我猜医院和红米尔大使馆都不想帮忙。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gives a dreamy sigh and leans back in her chair, crossing a leg over the other. “I don’t know when Doc. McAllister’s gonna be back. And when he does, he probably won’t stick around long. Keeps saying he can’t find one of the red ants to get samples from. Don’t know how he expects to find a red myr between a goldie Queen’s tits, but whatever. I guess the hospital and the Red embassy don’t feel like helping.”"

rows.original: “If you want to talk to Doc. McAllister, maybe you should go find the stupid samples. Otherwise, I guess I’ll just have to sit here getting paid to do nothing all day. Woe is me.”

rows.raw: "\n\n“If you want to talk to Doc. McAllister, maybe you should go find the stupid samples. Otherwise, I guess I’ll just have to sit here getting paid to do nothing all day. Woe is me.”"

rows.translation: 你点点头。内芙莉从椅子上跳起来；在你的记忆里，这似乎还是你认识她以来的第一次。她消失在后门里，过了一会儿，你听见机器嗡嗡作响、哔哔鸣叫，随后吐出了什么东西。之后内芙莉面带笑容地回来，胳膊下夹着一块数据板。

rows.original: “Everything checks out, [pc.name]. This sample should be more than enough for Doc. McAllister to synthesize for his precious mod. He’ll be back in a couple hours, I guess. rows.original: “Finished enough for testing!” McAllister declares proudly. “Likely still a few tweaks to make, but nothing to be done before I see it in action. It’s certainly safe for human consumption... and for myr consumption as well. Ah, and here, take this as well.”
rows.translation: “已经完善到足以测试了！”麦卡利斯特骄傲地宣布。“很可能还需要做几处调整，不过在亲眼看到它起效前也没什么可改的。人类服用肯定安全...米尔人服用也一样。啊，还有，这个也拿着。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Finished enough for testing!” McAllister declares proudly. “Likely still a few tweaks to make, but nothing to be done before I see it in action. It’s certainly safe for human consumption... and for myr consumption as well. Ah, and here, take this as well.”"

rows.original: The doctor hands you a data chit, and explains that it’s loaded with the full specifications to reproduce the orange myr gene mod he’s made for you. Any geneticist could easily use the data there to start mass producing the pills.
rows.translation: 医生递给你一枚数据芯片，并解释说里面载有他为你制作的橙米尔基因模组的全部复现规格。任何遗传学家都能轻易利用其中的数据开始批量生产这些药丸。

rows.original: You thank the good doctor and jab the data chit into your Codex and upload its contents to the Steele Tech server, with an attached “suggestion” that the company consider getting into the xeno-genemod business.
rows.translation: 你谢过这位好医生，把数据芯片插进法典，将内容上传到斯蒂尔科技的服务器，并附上一条“建议”，提议公司考虑进军异种基因模组产业。

rows.original: “Steele!” McAllister booms as you approach, vigorously shaking your hand. “What can I do for you, eh?”
rows.translation: “斯蒂尔！”你走近时，麦卡利斯特声如洪钟地喊道，同时用力握着你的手。“有什么能为你效劳的，嗯？”
rows.raw: "“Steele!” McAllister booms as you approach, vigorously shaking your hand. “What can I do for you, eh?”"

rows.original: Myr TFs

rows.original: “So, how’s work on the myr mods going?”
rows.translation: “那么，米尔模组的工作进展得怎么样了？”
rows.raw: "“So, how’s work on the myr mods going?”"

rows.original: “Brilliantly!” McAllister grins, motioning to one of his research assistants. She walks over to the far wall and pushes a buzzer, which causes a shutter to rise beside her. An adjacent room is revealed behind it, spartan and clinically white. Several machines are surrounding a bed in its center, where a pair of nude young women are sitting: one red myr, and one gold. Another pair of researchers are standing over them, busily working on datapads and checking the machines.
rows.translation: “好极了！”麦卡利斯特咧嘴笑着，向一名研究助理示意。她走到远处的墙边按下蜂鸣器，旁边的一扇百叶窗随之升起，露出后方一间简朴、洁白得具有临床感的房间。房间中央的床四周摆着几台机器，床上坐着两名赤裸的年轻女人：一个红米尔人，一个金米尔人。另有两名研究员站在她们身边，正忙着操作数据板并检查机器。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Brilliantly!” McAllister grins, motioning to one of his research assistants. She walks over to the far wall and pushes a buzzer, which causes a shutter to rise beside her. An adjacent room is revealed behind it, spartan and clinically white. Several machines are surrounding a bed in its center, where a pair of nude young women are sitting: one red myr, and one gold. Another pair of researchers are standing over them, busily working on datapads and checking the machines."

rows.original: After a second, you notice the two myr girls are holding hands.
rows.translation: 片刻后，你注意到两个米尔姑娘正牵着手。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a second, you notice the two myr girls are holding hands."

rows.original: “Our first two volunteers,” McAllister explains. “The drug’s still in the earliest stages, of course, but the results are beyond even my expectations. I don’t mean to brag, but it’s damn fine work if I do say so myself.”
rows.translation: “我们的第一批两名志愿者，”麦卡利斯特解释道。“当然，这种药还处于最初阶段，但效果甚至超出了我的预期。我不是想自夸，不过要我说，这活儿干得真他妈漂亮。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Our first two volunteers,” McAllister explains. “The drug’s still in the earliest stages, of course, but the results are beyond even my expectations. I don’t mean to brag, but it’s damn fine work if I do say so myself.”"

rows.original: You have to admit, it’s incredibly convincing work.
rows.translation: 你不得不承认，这成果逼真得惊人。

rows.original: “So I’ve been thinking,” you say, glancing towards the one-way mirror. “Would it be possible to combine the red and gold myr mods?”
rows.translation: “我一直在想，”你望向单向镜说道。“有没有可能把红米尔和金米尔的模组结合起来？”
rows.raw: "“So I’ve been thinking,” you say, glancing towards the one-way mirror. “Would it be possible to combine the red and gold myr mods?”"

rows.original: “Combine them?” he echoes, eyes blinking wide, like the question had come completely out of left field. Truth be told, you’d have thought McAllister would have thought of it first. “Well... I suppose you could. That would be a custom job, though, not just mirroring an existing species. Takes a little more work, you know. Although I suppose the myr probably were one race originally, split off several millennia ago. If that is in fact the case, hybridizing their genetics shouldn’t be that difficult. I did notice an overwhelming similarity between the two while I was working, too...”
rows.translation: “把它们结合起来？”他重复道，双眼惊讶地睁大，仿佛这个问题完全出乎意料。老实说，你还以为麦卡利斯特会先想到这点。“嗯...我想是可以的。不过那会是一项定制作业，而不只是仿照一个现有种族。你知道，这得多费些工夫。虽说米尔人最初很可能确实属于同一个种族，只是在几千年前分化了。如果真是这样，杂交她们的遗传基因应该不会太困难。我工作时也注意到两者极其相似...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Combine them?” he echoes, eyes blinking wide, like the question had come completely out of left field. Truth be told, you’d have thought McAllister would have thought of it first. “Well... I suppose you could. That would be a custom job, though, not just mirroring an existing species. Takes a little more work, you know. Although I suppose the myr probably were one race originally, split off several millennia ago. If that is in fact the case, hybridizing their genetics shouldn’t be that difficult. I did notice an overwhelming similarity between the two while I was working, too...”"

rows.original: McAllister blinks, looking at you as if snapping out a trance. “Say, what brought this on anyway? And before you ask, this is technically a research lab. You’ll have to talk to an actual company rep if you want designed mods worked out.”
rows.translation: 麦卡利斯特眨了眨眼，望向你，仿佛刚从恍惚中清醒。“话说回来，你怎么会突然想到这个？先说明，这里严格来说是研究实验室。如果想让人设计模组，你得去找真正的公司代表谈。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMcAllister blinks, looking at you as if snapping out a trance. “Say, what brought this on anyway? And before you ask, this is technically a research lab. You’ll have to talk to an actual company rep if you want designed mods worked out.”"

rows.original: “No, no,” you assure him. A designer mod isn’t exactly what you had in mind... Instead, you spend a few minutes explaining your take on your meet and greet with his two test subjects: that you saw a red and gold myr making love like they were the best of friends. No coercion, no drugs, nothing but sex-drive and passion brought them together. That, and a little gene work by Doctor McAllister.
rows.translation: “不，不，”你向他保证。定制模组并不完全是你的本意...接着，你花了几分钟解释自己对与两名受试者见面交流的看法：你亲眼看到一名红米尔人和一名金米尔人像最亲密的朋友般做爱。没有强迫，没有药物，只有性欲与激情让她们走到一起。当然，还有麦卡利斯特医生做的一点基因工作。
rows.raw: "\n\n“No, no,” you assure him. A designer mod isn’t exactly what you had in mind... No coercion, no drugs, nothing but sex-drive and passion brought them together. That, and a little gene work by Doctor McAllister."

rows.original: “Ah, yes,” the big man says with a growing grin, stroking his bushy beard. “I think I see what you’re getting at, [pc.name]. Think you can show these myr how moronic their little war is if they see just how similar they really are? Eh, that’s a very... simplistic take on things, don’t you think? As someone who’s spent several weeks in the company of gold myr queens, the local politics are a little more complex than that, I assure you.”
rows.translation: “啊，是的，”大个子咧嘴笑着说道，同时抚摸着浓密的胡须。“我想我明白你的意思了，[pc.name]。你觉得，只要让这些米尔人看到彼此其实有多么相似，就能让她们明白那场小战争有多愚蠢？嗯，这种看法是不是有点...太简单了？作为一个与金米尔女王们相处过好几个星期的人，我向你保证，当地政治远比那复杂。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, yes,” the big man says with a growing grin, stroking his bushy beard. “I think I see what you’re getting at, [pc.name]. Think you can show these myr how moronic their little war is if they see just how similar they really are? Eh, that’s a very... simplistic take on things, don’t you think? As someone who’s spent several weeks in the company of gold myr queens, the local politics are a little more complex than that, I assure you.”"

rows.original: Is that so? Surely, though - as someone who spends a great deal of quality time with the queens - the good doctor would want to do everything he can to help Myrellion.
rows.translation: 是这样吗？不过，这位好医生既然花了那么多宝贵时间陪伴女王们，肯定会想尽己所能帮助米瑞利恩吧。
rows.raw: "\n\nIs that so? Surely, though - as someone who spends a great deal of quality time with the queens - the good doctor would want to do everything he can to help Myrellion."

rows.original: McAllister sighs and runs his hand through his beard, glancing between you and the gaggle of female assistants at his heels, all waiting with bated breath for his response. “I do, believe me. But if - if - I were to sit down, design, and produce some sort of... hybrid myr treatment... you have to understand that process isn’t cheap. Mostly because I couldn’t do it on Xenogen’s time; I’ve got other responsibilities with the company now that the two main myr transformatives are finished, and more than one of my superiors are starting to talk about moving me to a lab on another world already. I’d effectively have to rent my own lab space from the company.”
rows.translation: 麦卡利斯特叹了口气，用手梳过胡须，目光在你和紧跟在他身后的那群女助手之间来回移动；她们全都屏息等待着他的回答。“我当然想，相信我。但如果——如果——我要坐下来设计并生产某种...混血米尔治疗剂...你必须明白，这个过程并不便宜。主要是因为我不能占用异源生物科技的工作时间来做；既然两种主要米尔变形剂已经完成，我在公司里还有其他职责，而且已经不止一个上司开始谈论要把我调到另一个世界的实验室了。实际上，我得向公司租用自己的实验室空间。”

I’d effectively have to rent my own lab space from the company.”"

rows.original: “More importantly, though, you’d have problems of distribution and education.” McAllister says, an almost venomous hiss on the last word. He glances in the direction of the Federation embassy, and adds, “Most myr wouldn’t take it just because, you know. They’ve had seven years to entrench themselves in racial jingoism, especially the reds. Even if you convinced enough myr to take the therapy, you’d actually have to distribute it, and neither of us have the resources to mass produce and distribute expensive gene mods on our own dime.”
rows.translation: “更重要的是，你还会遇到经销和教育方面的问题。”麦卡利斯特说道，最后一个词几乎带着恶毒的嘶声。他朝联邦大使馆的方向瞥了一眼，又补充道：“你知道，大多数米尔人不会仅仅因为有这种东西就去服用。她们花了七年时间让种族沙文主义根深蒂固，红米尔尤其如此。就算你说服了足够多的米尔人接受治疗，也还得真正把它经销出去，而我们两个谁都没有资源自掏腰包去大规模生产并经销昂贵的基因模组。”

He glances in the direction of the Federation embassy, and adds, “Most myr wouldn’t take it just because, you know. Even if you convinced enough myr to take the therapy, you’d actually have to distribute it, and neither of us have the resources to mass produce and distribute expensive gene mods on our own dime.”"

rows.original: The doctor’s eyes widen, and he lets out a croaking laugh. “Ha! I thought you were different than your run of the mill rusher... yeah, if you can get Steele Tech to sponsor the therapy, we’re golden. Assuming Xenogen doesn’t take offense to me doing a little work for the competition, anyway. Heck, it’s a mega corp., it barely remembers I exist unless it needs me. I think I can swing a few off days to work. Tell you what, have your chief of research get in touch me with me and-”
rows.translation: 医生瞪大了眼睛，发出一阵沙哑的笑声。“哈！我就知道你和那些普通的行星淘金客不一样...对，如果你能让斯蒂尔科技赞助这项疗法，我们就万事大吉了。当然，前提是异源生物科技不会介意我替竞争对手干点活。见鬼，那可是家超级企业，除非有事找我，否则几乎都不记得我这个人。我想我还是能挤出几天休假来工作的。这样吧，让你们的研究主管联系我，然后-”

rows.original: The decon. chamber’s computer beeps at you as it seals up. “Please remove all clothing and equipment and place them in the bin.”
rows.translation: 净化舱密封后，电脑朝你发出提示音。“请脱下所有衣物与装备，并将其放入收纳箱。”

rows.raw: "\n\nTaking a breath to steady yourself, you turn away from them and start to disrobe. You quickly pull off your [pc.gear] and the rest of your equipment, stuffing it all into a bin that appears in the side of the chamber."

rows.original: As you’re working, you can’t help but catch a few sidelong looks at the burly doctor beside you. He really does look more like a lumberjack than a science nerd: broad-chested, hairy as hell, with arms and legs bulging with muscle. And then, of course, there’s the member hanging down between his legs. McAllister must have had some modwork done to make that monster: it’s easily a foot long at half mast, fundamentally human in shape but bestial in size. You easily imagine him satisfying the titans that are the gold queens who constantly proposition him.
rows.translation: 忙活的时候，你忍不住斜眼打量身旁那位魁梧的医生。他确实更像伐木工而非科学宅：胸膛宽阔，浑身毛发浓密，四肢肌肉虬结。当然，还有垂在双腿之间的那根家伙。麦卡利斯特肯定接受过某些改造才弄出这头怪物：半勃起时就足有一英尺长，形状基本和人类一样，尺寸却如同野兽。你很容易想象他如何满足那些总向他求欢、如泰坦般高大的金米尔女王。

When its finished, a second bin opens on the other side of the chamber. McAllister takes out a simple white robe from the bin, pulls it on, and tosses another to you. The garment automatically adjusts to your body as you pull it on,

rows.original: One of the researchers hovering nearby scribbles something down on her datapad. “Everything seems alright, Doctor McAllister. Vitals are normal, no rejection of the therapy. We have noticed some... interesting side effects, however.”
rows.translation: 一名守在附近的研究员在数据板上记了些什么。“一切似乎都很正常，麦卡利斯特医生。生命体征正常，也没有排斥疗法。不过，我们确实注意到一些...有趣的副作用。”

rows.translation: 麦卡利斯特爽朗地笑了。“是这样吗？嗯，我相信第二种症状可以纠正，其他几种倒可能算有益效果。在我桌上留张便条，提醒我设法把那些次要效果从主要疗法中分离出来。”
