rows.raw: "\n\nHe nods. “The golds need men and more queens, of course. The reds as well, perhaps even more desperately, and part of the terms of the cease fire necessitate that both red and gold therapies be worked on concurrently. Hence the delay in work until you intervened. I’m not sure if both sides were stonewalling it, or hoping we’d cave and just make one of their mods closer. I can’t imagine - isn’t having the mods done what they both wanted?”"

rows.original: McAllister sighs and shakes his head. “But yes, in the end, it’s all about rebuilding their populations. I should think I’m offering a better way than what Ambassador Juro wants, turning Myrellion into a kui-tan colony where the furry bastards can put a race full of cocks to use on a race almost completely lacking them. As much as I’d like to see the kui-tan spread, the myr should be protected as they are, not used as breeding stock for other species.”
rows.translation: 麦卡利斯特叹了口气，摇摇头。“不过没错，归根结底，一切都是为了重建她们的人口。我想，我提供的办法总比朱罗大使的主张好。他想把密瑞利昂变成奎坦殖民地，让那些毛茸茸的混蛋把一个满是肉棒的种族用在一个几乎没有肉棒的种族身上。尽管我乐见奎坦开枝散叶，米尔人也应该保持她们本来的样子受到保护，而不是被其他物种当作繁殖牲畜。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMcAllister sighs and shakes his head. “But yes, in the end, it’s all about rebuilding their populations. I should think I’m offering a better way than what Ambassador Juro wants, turning Myrellion into a kui-tan colony where the furry bastards can put a race full of cocks to use on a race almost completely lacking them. As much as I’d like to see the kui-tan spread, the myr should be protected as they are, not used as breeding stock for other species.”"

rows.original: “What do you think about the red myr?”
rows.translation: “你怎么看红米尔？”
rows.raw: "“What do you think about the red myr?”"

rows.original: “Not much to tell,” McAllister responds, lacking his prior jovialness. “At least, not that you probably haven’t gathered already. The reds are the aggressor race in this world war we’ve stopped. Violent by nature, value dispassion and determination over expression and artistry. Heh, that sounds awfully condemning when I say it out loud, doesn’t it? I’m sure they’re not that bad, but there’s little enough for me to latch onto with them. I’m sure their natural venom, lethargic and lust-inducing as it is, will make an excellent modification. They’re also considerably stronger, physically, than gold myr - who themselves are stronger than humans on average. Finding a way to harness their strength would certainly be popular, perhaps have military applications.”
rows.translation: “没什么可说的，”麦卡利斯特回答，语气不复先前的欢快。“至少没有什么是你大概还不知道的。红米尔是这场被我们制止的世界大战中的侵略方。她们天性暴力，比起表达和艺术，更重视冷静与决心。呵，这话说出口还真像是在严厉谴责她们，对吧？我相信她们没那么糟，只是她们身上实在没多少能让我产生共鸣的东西。她们的天然毒液既能使人倦怠又能激发情欲，肯定能成为优秀的改造项目。她们的体力也远强于金米尔，而金米尔的平均体力本就强于人类。找到利用她们力量的方法肯定会很受欢迎，或许还有军事用途。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not much to tell,” McAllister responds, lacking his prior jovialness. “At least, not that you probably haven’t gathered already. The reds are the aggressor race in this world war we’ve stopped. Violent by nature, value dispassion and determination over expression and artistry. Heh, that sounds awfully condemning when I say it out loud, doesn’t it? I’m sure they’re not that bad, but there’s little enough for me to latch onto with them. I’m sure their natural venom, lethargic and lust-inducing as it is, will make an excellent modification. They’re also considerably stronger, physically, than gold myr - who themselves are stronger than humans on average. Finding a way to harness their strength would certainly be popular, perhaps have military applications.”"

rows.original: “All thanks to you, of course.”
rows.translation: “当然，这全是你的功劳。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“All thanks to you, of course.”"

rows.original: Curious, you ask “What was stopping you from getting a red myr’s blood anyway? There’s a whole embassy of them just down the street.”
rows.translation: 你心生好奇，问道：“不过，究竟是什么让你连红米尔的血都弄不到？整条街外就有一座她们的大使馆。”
rows.raw: "\n\nCurious, you ask “What was stopping you from getting a red myr’s blood anyway? There’s a whole embassy of them just down the street.”"

rows.original: He laughs at that, crossing his burly arms across his chest. “They stonewalled me. Hard. That Nehzara would barely talk to me, said I was ‘in league’ with the Gilden Republic. Save a woman’s planet, and look at the gratitude she shows. Ha! Even the Golds couldn’t help with it, said they couldn’t force a prisoner of war into it. Something tells me they’d just rather not have a galaxy full of wanna-be Reds running around. Can hardly blame them.”
rows.translation: 他闻言大笑起来，将粗壮的双臂交叉在胸前。“她们拼命阻挠我。那个涅赫扎拉几乎连话都不肯跟我说，还说我‘与’吉尔登共和国‘勾结’。拯救了一个女人的星球，瞧瞧她给我的谢意。哈！就连金米尔也帮不上忙，说她们不能强迫战俘参与。总觉得她们只是不想看到银河里到处跑着一群想变成红米尔的人。倒也很难怪她们。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe laughs at that, crossing his burly arms across his chest. “They stonewalled me. Hard. That Nehzara would barely talk to me, said I was ‘in league’ with the Gilden Republic. Save a woman’s planet, and look at the gratitude she shows. Ha! Even the Golds couldn’t help with it, said they couldn’t force a prisoner of war into it. Something tells me they’d just rather not have a galaxy full of wanna-be Reds running around. Can hardly blame them.”"

rows.original: Delightfully racist.
rows.translation: 真是令人愉快的种族偏见。
rows.raw: "\n\nDelightfully racist."

rows.original: “So, any redeeming traits you can see in the Reds?” you ask.
rows.translation: 你问道：“所以，你在红米尔身上看得到什么可取之处吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, any redeeming traits you can see in the Reds?” you ask."

rows.original: McAllister grunts and runs a hand through his curly red beard. “As I said, they’re strong, and their venom will be a popular cosmetic treatment... maybe have some medical uses. But of the people themselves? They’re hard workers, make no mistake, and loyal to a fault. I’ve never heard one speak ill of her kin or country. First I thought they’d all been, I suppose brainwashed, but... I don’t believe that’s the case. Be it culture or nature, they are remarkably loyal and steadfast creatures. Admirable, I suppose, in their way.”
rows.translation: 麦卡利斯特哼了一声，用手捋过卷曲的红胡须。“就像我说的，她们很强壮，她们的毒液也会成为很受欢迎的美容疗法...也许还有某些医疗用途。但说到她们这个民族？她们勤劳肯干，毫无疑问，而且忠诚得近乎过头。我从未听过任何一个红米尔说自己的同胞或国家半句坏话。一开始我以为她们全都被某种方式洗脑了，但...我不认为事实如此。无论源于文化还是天性，她们都是极其忠诚、坚定的生物。以她们自己的方式来说，或许值得钦佩。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMcAllister grunts and runs a hand through his curly red beard. “As I said, they’re strong, and their venom will be a popular cosmetic treatment... maybe have some medical uses. But of the people themselves? They’re hard workers, make no mistake, and loyal to a fault. I’ve never heard one speak ill of her kin or country. First I thought they’d all been, I suppose brainwashed, but... I don’t believe that’s the case. Be it culture or nature, they are remarkably loyal and steadfast creatures. Admirable, I suppose, in their way.”"

rows.original: “What do you think about the gold myr? Nevrie mentioned you’re quite fond of them.”
rows.translation: “你怎么看金米尔？内芙莉提过，你相当喜欢她们。”
rows.raw: "“What do you think about the gold myr? Nevrie mentioned you’re quite fond of them.”"

rows.original: McAllister chuckles, and several of his research assistants suddenly look rather uncomfortable. “I suppose I am! To say they’re grateful to me would be quite the understatement. After all, I saved their nation - their world, really. Every Queen in the republic is trying to honor me in her own way: feasts and galas and all but begging me to sire offspring with them. I’m the toast of Gildenmere now.”
rows.translation: 麦卡利斯特轻笑起来，几名研究助理顿时显得颇为不自在。“我想确实如此！说她们对我心怀感激，实在太轻描淡写了。毕竟我拯救了她们的国家，实际上是她们的整个世界。共和国里的每位女王都在以自己的方式向我致敬：宴会、庆典，还有近乎恳求我与她们繁育后代。如今我可是吉尔登米尔的大红人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMcAllister chuckles, and several of his research assistants suddenly look rather uncomfortable. “I suppose I am! To say they’re grateful to me would be quite the understatement. After all, I saved their nation - their world, really. Every Queen in the republic is trying to honor me in her own way: feasts and galas and all but begging me to sire offspring with them. I’m the toast of Gildenmere now.”"

rows.original: With a chuckle, he adds “No wonder the damn Reds hate me.”
rows.translation: 他轻笑着补充道：“难怪那些该死的红米尔恨我。”
rows.raw: "\n\nWith a chuckle, he adds “No wonder the damn Reds hate me.”"

rows.original: “The Golds really must love you,” you say
rows.translation: “金米尔一定非常爱戴你，”你说道
rows.raw: "\n\n“The Golds really must love you,” you say"

rows.original: a bit jealous of those offers the queens have made him
rows.translation: ，对那些女王向他提出的邀约有些嫉妒
rows.raw: " a bit jealous of those offers the queens have made him"

rows.original: “Like I said, I saved their race. With a little help from Xenogen, and then the Confederate fleet. The Golds were on the verge of total defeat before the First Contact fleet found them, and gave both sides enough of a pause to stop them from going nuclear. They’ve been losing this war of theirs for seven years, getting crushed by the Red Federation’s onslaught. City after city fell, until they were pushed back to the walls of their capital. We’re standing on top of the last bastion of Gold civilization, you know. The last real stronghold they have left.”
rows.translation: “就像我说的，我拯救了她们的种族。异种基因帮了点忙，后来还有邦联舰队。首次接触舰队发现她们时，金米尔已濒临彻底战败；舰队让双方都暂时停手，才阻止她们走向核战争。她们在这场战争中连败了七年，被红色联邦的攻势打得节节败退。一座又一座城市陷落，直到她们被逼退至首都城墙。你知道，我们现在就站在金米尔文明最后的堡垒之上，这是她们仅存的真正据点。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Like I said, I saved their race. With a little help from Xenogen, and then the Confederate fleet. The Golds were on the verge of total defeat before the First Contact fleet found them, and gave both sides enough of a pause to stop them from going nuclear. They’ve been losing this war of theirs for seven years, getting crushed by the Red Federation’s onslaught. City after city fell, until they were pushed back to the walls of their capital. We’re standing on top of the last bastion of Gold civilization, you know. The last real stronghold they have left.”"

rows.original: He sighs, and scratches at his beard. “I pity them, really. The gold myr have an amazing culture, as much about sensuality and passion as it is artistry and camaraderie. Imagine, a race with no mothers and fathers as we’d understand them, only brothers and sisters that raise each other generation by generation. It’s quite fascinating, the culture and social structure they’ve developed around generational and sibling bonds. I can only imagine the Confederacy’s sociologists are going to have a field day when things calm down here.”
rows.translation: 他叹了口气，抓了抓胡须。“说真的，我很同情她们。金米尔拥有非凡的文化，感官享受与激情的重要性不亚于艺术和情谊。试想一下，一个没有我们所理解的母亲和父亲的种族，只有一代又一代彼此抚养的兄弟姐妹。围绕世代与手足纽带形成的文化和社会结构实在令人着迷。等这里的局势平静下来，邦联的社会学家肯定会兴奋得忙个不停。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe sighs, and scratches at his beard. “I pity them, really. The gold myr have an amazing culture, as much about sensuality and passion as it is artistry and camaraderie. Imagine, a race with no mothers and fathers as we’d understand them, only brothers and sisters that raise each other generation by generation. It’s quite fascinating, the culture and social structure they’ve developed around generational and sibling bonds. I can only imagine the Confederacy’s sociologists are going to have a field day when things calm down here.”"

rows.original: Of that, you have no doubt.
rows.translation: 对此，你毫不怀疑。
rows.raw: "\n\nOf that, you have no doubt."

rows.original: “Tell me a little about Xenogen,” you prompt, glancing around the high-tech lab as you do so. This pre-fab research outpost looks about as well-stocked as any of the labs your toured back at Steele Tech in the core. Impressive, to say the least.
rows.translation: 你提示道：“给我介绍一下异种基因吧。”说话间，你环顾这座高科技实验室。这座预制研究前哨的设备之齐全，不输你在核心区斯蒂尔科技参观过的任何实验室。至少可以说，相当令人印象深刻。
rows.raw: "“Tell me a little about Xenogen,” you prompt, glancing around the high-tech lab as you do so. This pre-fab research outpost looks about as well-stocked as any of the labs your toured back at Steele Tech in the core. Impressive, to say the least."

rows.original: He smiles broadly, though you can see a couple of the research assistants clustered around him roll their eyes with exasperation. “Xenogen’s the largest and most advanced xenobiology research firm, and produces the highest-quality gene therapy modifications in the galaxy. We produce cosmetics, of course, but also more meaningful therapies: treatments to cure ailments, help colonists adjust to alien habitats and strange new worlds, ways for people to fit their mental images of themselves they otherwise never would. That’s all the reward in the world right there, isn’t it ladies?”
rows.translation: 他露出灿烂的笑容，不过你看到聚在他身边的几名研究助理无奈地翻了翻眼睛。“异种基因是银河系规模最大、技术最先进的异种生物学研究企业，也生产品质最高的基因疗法改造产品。我们当然生产美容产品，但也研发更有实际意义的疗法：治疗疾病，帮助殖民者适应外星环境和陌生世界，让人们得以实现原本永远无法实现的自我形象。这本身就是世上最丰厚的回报，对吧，姑娘们？”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe smiles broadly, though you can see a couple of the research assistants clustered around him roll their eyes with exasperation. “Xenogen’s the largest and most advanced xenobiology research firm, and produces the highest-quality gene therapy modifications in the galaxy. We produce cosmetics, of course, but also more meaningful therapies: treatments to cure ailments, help colonists adjust to alien habitats and strange new worlds, ways for people to fit their mental images of themselves they otherwise never would. That’s all the reward in the world right there, isn’t it ladies?”"

rows.original: His gaggle of female assistants dutifully nod their heads.
rows.translation: 他身边那群女助理尽职地一齐点头。
rows.raw: "\n\nHis gaggle of female assistants dutifully nod their heads."

rows.original: “In all seriousness, Xenogen is the company that makes sure young worlds like Mhen’ga and Myrellion have a fair chance. They don’t have a lot to offer the galaxy at large, at least without being exploited, but the recent trend in cosmetic gene therapies means every race has something the rest of the galaxy wants: their appearance. People will pay top dollar back in the core to look like these newly-discovered races: it’s something of a fad amongst the wealthy, and every therapy we design broadens the horizon for everyone’s self-fulfillment. If you want to mix fanfir draconic traits with honey-laden myr and the tremendous musculature of a thraggen, then that’s your right.”
rows.translation: “说正经的，异种基因确保了门加和密瑞利昂这样的年轻世界拥有公平的机会。至少在不受剥削的前提下，它们没多少东西可以提供给整个银河；但近年来美容基因疗法蔚然成风，这意味着每个种族都有整个银河想要的东西：她们的外貌。核心区的富人会花大价钱把自己变成这些新发现种族的模样，这在富裕阶层中已经成为一种潮流，而我们设计的每种疗法都拓宽了所有人实现自我的可能。如果你想把凡菲尔的龙类特征、满载蜂蜜的米尔特征和斯拉根惊人的肌肉结合起来，那就是你的权利。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“In all seriousness, Xenogen is the company that makes sure young worlds like Mhen’ga and Myrellion have a fair chance. They don’t have a lot to offer the galaxy at large, at least without being exploited, but the recent trend in cosmetic gene therapies means every race has something the rest of the galaxy wants: their appearance. People will pay top dollar back in the core to look like these newly-discovered races: it’s something of a fad amongst the wealthy, and every therapy we design broadens the horizon for everyone’s self-fulfillment. If you want to mix fanfir draconic traits with honey-laden myr and the tremendous musculature of a thraggen, then that’s your right.”"

rows.original: Cheekily, you ask if that’s why there’s a fleet in orbit around Myrellion.
rows.translation: 你半开玩笑地问，密瑞利昂轨道上的舰队是否正是为此而来。
rows.raw: "Cheekily, you ask if that’s why there’s a fleet in orbit around Myrellion."

rows.original: “So is that why there’s a fleet in orbit?”
rows.translation: “所以，轨道上那支舰队就是为这个来的？”
rows.raw: "“So is that why there’s a fleet in orbit?”"

rows.original: McAllister balks at that, but quickly turns that into a boisterous laugh. “I suppose it is! I was part of the first team that discovered Myrellion here, just on the brink of nuclear war. The two races were ready to destroy each other - there wouldn’t be much for us to study, to mimic in cosmetics, if they managed to glass the planet, would there? The corporate executives jumped on the idea to sell the public we’re saving the myr race, of course, after I convinced them the gold myr could provide a smash hit gene therapy. I didn’t expect that much of a response - the whole fleet business - but it’s certainly kept the peace. That’s a net good, isn’t it?”
rows.translation: 麦卡利斯特闻言一愣，却很快转为豪爽的大笑。“我想确实如此！我是第一批发现密瑞利昂的团队成员，当时这里正处在核战争边缘。两个种族已准备彼此毁灭；如果她们真把星球烧成玻璃，我们还会剩下多少东西可以研究、可以仿制成美容产品呢？我说服公司高层相信金米尔能带来一款轰动性的基因疗法后，他们自然立刻抓住了向公众宣传我们正在拯救米尔种族的点子。我没料到会有这么大的反应，也就是整支舰队这回事，但它确实维持了和平。总体而言是件好事，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nMcAllister balks at that, but quickly turns that into a boisterous laugh. “I suppose it is! I was part of the first team that discovered Myrellion here, just on the brink of nuclear war. The two races were ready to destroy each other - there wouldn’t be much for us to study, to mimic in cosmetics, if they managed to glass the planet, would there? The corporate executives jumped on the idea to sell the public we’re saving the myr race, of course, after I convinced them the gold myr could provide a smash hit gene therapy. I didn’t expect that much of a response - the whole fleet business - but it’s certainly kept the peace. That’s a net good, isn’t it?”"

rows.original: You suppose that’s true.
rows.translation: 你想，这话倒也没错。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou suppose that’s true."

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: Pexiga Help
rows.translation: 帮助佩克西加
rows.raw: "Pexiga Help"

rows.original: Adjatha
rows.raw: "Adjatha"

rows.original: Leaning against the big, burly man and running your fingers through his bushy beard, you mention your poor little pexiga. “Surely somebody as smart and handsome as the big Dr. Byron can help,” you murmur into his ear.
rows.translation: 你靠在这个高大魁梧的男人身上，手指穿过他浓密的胡须，向他提起你那可怜的小佩克西加。你在他耳边低声说道：“像拜伦医生这样既聪明又英俊的大人物，肯定能帮上忙。”
rows.raw: "Leaning against the big, burly man and running your fingers through his bushy beard, you mention your poor little pexiga. “Surely somebody as smart and handsome as the big Dr. Byron can help,” you murmur into his ear."

rows.original: You mention the pitiful plight of the pexiga to Dr. McAllister, and the burly man runs his fingers through his bushy beard in thought.
rows.translation: 你向麦卡利斯特医生讲述佩克西加的悲惨处境，魁梧的男人若有所思地用手指梳理着浓密的胡须。
rows.raw: "You mention the pitiful plight of the pexiga to Dr. McAllister, and the burly man runs his fingers through his bushy beard in thought."

rows.original: “Hrm! Yes, yes I see what you mean. A nasty hand fate dealt those poor creatures. I suppose once my affairs have concluded on Myrellion, I could certainly petition my superiors to take a look at these pexiga.”
rows.translation: “嗯！是，是，我明白你的意思。命运给那些可怜生物发了一手烂牌。我想，等我在密瑞利昂的事务结束后，完全可以请求上级研究一下这些佩克西加。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hrm! Yes, yes I see what you mean. A nasty hand fate dealt those poor creatures. I suppose once my affairs have concluded on Myrellion, I could certainly petition my superiors to take a look at these pexiga.”"

rows.original: You mention that you have one onboard your ship. Would it be possible for him to do some tests right now?
rows.translation: 你告诉他，自己的飞船上就有一只。他现在能不能先做些检测？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou mention that you have one onboard your ship. Would it be possible for him to do some tests right now?"

rows.original: The normally jolly man now wears a look of concern. He rests a mitt-sized hand on your shoulder in sympathy and sadly shakes his head. <i>“My
rows.translation: 一向快活的男人此刻面露忧色。他同情地把蒲扇般的大手放在你的肩上，悲伤地摇了摇头。<i>“我的
rows.raw: "\n\nThe normally jolly man now wears a look of concern. He rests a mitt-sized hand on your shoulder in sympathy and sadly shakes his head. <i>“My "

rows.original: boy
rows.translation: 小伙子
rows.raw: "boy"

rows.original: girl
rows.translation: 姑娘
rows.raw: "girl"

rows.original: , if you’re looking for treatment, I’m not the man you want. Not only do I need to conduct numerous preliminary tests and review my findings with colleagues and superiors, but there are also ethical questions to consider.”
rows.translation: ，如果你想找的是治疗，那我不是你该找的人。我不仅需要进行大量初步检测，与同事和上级共同审查研究结果，还必须考虑伦理问题。”
rows.raw: ", if you’re looking for treatment, I’m not the man you want. Not only do I need to conduct numerous preliminary tests and review my findings with colleagues and superiors, but there are also ethical questions to consider.”"

rows.original: Ugh, you groan internally. Why are all the pretty ones so dumb? “It’s just like helping the ants on this planet - you see somebody, you help them! Like, what even ARE ethics?”
rows.translation: 呃，你在心里呻吟。为什么漂亮的人都这么笨？“这就像帮助这个星球上的蚂蚁一样。看到有人需要帮助，就帮助她们！伦理到底又是什么东西？”
rows.raw: "Ugh, you groan internally. Why are all the pretty ones so dumb? “It’s just like helping the ants on this planet - you see somebody, you help them! Like, what even ARE ethics?”"

rows.original: But what about the myr, you insist. Where were his concerns about the ethics of involvement there?
rows.translation: 你坚持问道，那米尔人又算什么？他插手米尔事务时，对伦理的顾虑在哪里？
rows.raw: "But what about the myr, you insist. Where were his concerns about the ethics of involvement there?"

rows.original: Dr. McAllister pulls up a stool and perches his massive frame atop it. “It’s true. Perhaps I went a little beyond the scope of normal scientific diligence. But this was a matter of millions of lives. I would very much like to help your friend, but there’s just nothing I can do. Ethical science takes time.”
rows.translation: 麦卡利斯特医生拉来一张凳子，将庞大的身躯坐在上面。“确实如此。或许我有些超出了正常科学审慎原则的范围。但那关系到数百万条生命。我非常想帮助你的朋友，可我确实无能为力。符合伦理的科学需要时间。”
rows.raw: "\n\nDr. McAllister pulls up a stool and perches his massive frame atop it. “It’s true. Perhaps I went a little beyond the scope of normal scientific diligence. But this was a matter of millions of lives. I would very much like to help your friend, but there’s just nothing I can do. Ethical science takes time.”"

rows.original: You try puppy dog eyes, but nothing seems to get through to him. What a disappointment! If these scientists are so smart, how come they can’t help? Brains are overrated!
rows.translation: 你试着摆出小狗般可怜兮兮的眼神，但似乎什么都打动不了他。真令人失望！这些科学家既然这么聪明，为什么就是帮不上忙？脑子根本没那么重要！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou try puppy dog eyes, but nothing seems to get through to him. What a disappointment! If these scientists are so smart, how come they can’t help? Brains are overrated!"

rows.original: As you feared, someone like Dr. McAllister just won’t be able to help with all his principles getting in the way. You’re going to need somebody with a looser definition of ‘scientific ethics.’
rows.translation: 正如你担心的那样，麦卡利斯特医生这种人会被自己的原则束缚，根本帮不上忙。你需要找一个对‘科学伦理’定义更宽松的人。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you feared, someone like Dr. McAllister just won’t be able to help with all his principles getting in the way. You’re going to need somebody with a looser definition of ‘scientific ethics.’"

rows.original: “Alright. I’ll upload the coordinates to one of the transports. Just swipe your credit stick here and head out back.”

rows.raw: "“Alright. I’ll upload the coordinates to one of the transports. Just swipe your credit stick here and head out back.”"

rows.original: You do so, transferring your payment to the Scout Authority and walking out into the back lot behind the structure. Several small hover-cars are arrayed there, all jungle-patterned and manned by simplistic drone pilots. One of them hails you with a wave of its mechanical arm. You slip into the car, and a moment later you’re on your way, zipping across the blasted surface of Myrellion, towards one of the subterranean entrances you need.
rows.translation: 你照做了，把款项转给侦察局，随后走到建筑后方的停车场。那里整齐停着几辆小型悬浮车，全都涂着丛林迷彩，并由功能简单的无人驾驶员操控。其中一辆挥动机械臂向你招手。你钻进车里，片刻后便启程了，飞驰穿过米雷利恩饱受摧残的地表，前往你所需的某处地下入口。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou do so, transferring your payment to the Scout Authority and walking out into the back lot behind the structure. Several small hover-cars are arrayed there, all jungle-patterned and manned by simplistic drone pilots. One of them hails you with a wave of its mechanical arm. You slip into the car, and a moment later you’re on your way, zipping across the blasted surface of Myrellion, towards one of the subterranean entrances you need."

rows.original: Not long after, you arrive at your destination, a large crack in the ground allowing entrance. Carefully, your drone pilot lowers the car down into the blackness of Myrellion’s heart. You have to take a jump out, though, dropping down the last few feet into the uneven ground. The hover-car zips away a minute later, leaving you behind.
rows.translation: 没过多久，你便抵达目的地：地面上一道巨大的裂缝，可供进入。无人驾驶员小心地操控车辆下降，没入米雷利恩腹地的黑暗中。不过最后几英尺你只能跳下车，落在崎岖不平的地面上。一分钟后，悬浮车疾驰而去，把你独自留在这里。
rows.raw: "\n\nNot long after, you arrive at your destination, a large crack in the ground allowing entrance. Carefully, your drone pilot lowers the car down into the blackness of Myrellion’s heart. You have to take a jump out, though, dropping down the last few feet into the uneven ground. The hover-car zips away a minute later, leaving you behind."

rows.original:
You send a databurst to the local Scout Authority base, requesting a shuttle pickup. It only takes a few minutes for the shuttle to arrive, slipping precariously through the crack in the cavern ceiling and puttering down to your level. The door pops open and the robot driver inside beckons you in; moments later you’re racing through the desert skyline over Myrellion, headed back to the DMZ.

You’re dropped off just behind the Scout office, and make your way inside.
rows.translation:
你向当地侦察局基地发送一串数据脉冲，请求穿梭机接送。几分钟后，穿梭机便抵达了；它惊险地穿过洞穴顶上的裂缝，突突作响着降到你所在的高度。舱门弹开，里面的机器人驾驶员招手让你上车；片刻后，你便在米雷利恩的沙漠天际飞驰，返回非军事区。

你在侦察局办公室后方下车，随后走了进去。
rows.raw: "You send a databurst to the local Scout Authority base, requesting a shuttle pickup. It only takes a few minutes for the shuttle to arrive, slipping precariously through the crack in the cavern ceiling and puttering down to your level. The door pops open and the robot driver inside beckons you in; moments later you’re racing through the desert skyline over Myrellion, headed back to the DMZ.\n\nYou’re dropped off just behind the Scout office, and make your way inside."

rows.original: You send a databurst to the Scout Authority, requesting transit. You receive what amounts to a Morse code affirmation over the radio in return, and spend the next few minutes waiting for your ride.
rows.translation: 你向侦察局发送一串数据脉冲，请求交通工具。作为回应，电台传回了一段近似莫尔斯电码的确认信号，接下来的几分钟里，你一直等着车来。
rows.raw: "You send a databurst to the Scout Authority, requesting transit. You receive what amounts to a Morse code affirmation over the radio in return, and spend the next few minutes waiting for your ride."

rows.original: The robot-driven shuttle dives down through the crack in the roof quickly enough, parking just outside with open doors. You hop aboard and zoom off to your destination. If only it didn’t cost you 150 credits for the luxury of it all.
rows.translation: 机器人驾驶的穿梭机很快从顶部的裂缝俯冲而下，舱门敞开着停在外面。你跳上车，疾驰前往目的地。要是享受这一切不用花150信用点就好了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe robot-driven shuttle dives down through the crack in the roof quickly enough, parking just outside with open doors. You hop aboard and zoom off to your destination. If only it didn’t cost you 150 credits for the luxury of it all."

rows.original: You do a little basic techno-wizardry: using your Codex to look up the Scout Authority’s emergency radio frequency, tuning the radio to it, and sending a databurst from your Codex to the computer at the DMZ. You should be able to bring in a taxi drone now - assuming somebody at the Scouts knows how to read morse code in this day and age.
rows.translation: 你施展了一点基础的科技魔法：用终端查出侦察局的紧急无线电频率，把电台调到那个频段，再从终端向非军事区的电脑发送一串数据脉冲。现在应该能叫来一架出租无人机了——前提是这个年代的侦察员里还有人看得懂莫尔斯电码。
rows.raw: "You do a little basic techno-wizardry: using your Codex to look up the Scout Authority’s emergency radio frequency, tuning the radio to it, and sending a databurst from your Codex to the computer at the DMZ. You should be able to bring in a taxi drone now - assuming somebody at the Scouts knows how to read morse code in this day and age."

rows.raw: "’ve never ridden on an old-school airplane before"

rows.raw: "’ll never get used to these old-school airplanes"

rows.original: . The plane rocks and shudders seemingly at random, making you and every ant-girl aboard sway uneasily. Engines roar deafeningly outside, and your [pc.ears] keep popping with the random changes in pressure. A couple of times, other passengers get visibly ill, and go for small paper bags tucked in the seats ahead of them.
rows.translation: 。飞机毫无规律地摇晃、震颤，让你和机上每个蚁女都不安地左右摇摆。引擎在外面震耳欲聋地咆哮，气压时不时变化，弄得你的[pc.ears]不停发闷。有几次，其他乘客明显感到不适，伸手去拿前排座椅里塞着的小纸袋。
rows.raw: ". The plane rocks and shudders seemingly at random, making you and every ant-girl aboard sway uneasily. Engines roar deafeningly outside, and your [pc.ears] keep popping with the random changes in pressure. A couple of times, other passengers get visibly ill, and go for small paper bags tucked in the seats ahead of them."

rows.original: You mumble a curse for the red myr not having a spaceport of their own and put a hand to your own stomach, trying not to puke too. Miserable things, these old planes. Absolutely miserable...
rows.translation: 你低声咒骂红米尔人没有自己的太空港，一手按住胃，努力不让自己也吐出来。这些老飞机真是要命。简直要命...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou mumble a curse for the red myr not having a spaceport of their own and put a hand to your own stomach, trying not to puke too. Miserable things, these old planes. Absolutely miserable..."

rows.original: It’s a blessed relief when the plane lands, even if you’re nearly certain the bucket of bolts with rattle itself apart when it skids down the runway. But finally, the ride comes to an end and the plane’s crew chief kicks the ramp down, letting you and the other passengers shuffle off.
rows.translation: 飞机终于着陆时，你如蒙大赦，尽管它在跑道上滑行时，你几乎确信这只破铁桶会把自己震散架。不过这趟旅程总算结束了，机组长踢下舷梯，让你和其他乘客拖着脚步走下飞机。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s a blessed relief when the plane lands, even if you’re nearly certain the bucket of bolts with rattle itself apart when it skids down the runway. But finally, the ride comes to an end and the plane’s crew chief kicks the ramp down, letting you and the other passengers shuffle off."

rows.original:
You hop onto a diplomatically-marked plane idling on the runway, bound for the Demilitarized Zone deep in Republic territory. It’s only a few minutes of waiting before the captain arrives and the rest of the seats fill up with red myr troops and other offworlders heading back to their ships. The plane takes off punctually, sending you hurtling through the sky towards your destination.

The plane rocks and shudders seemingly at random, making you and every ant-girl aboard sway uneasily. Engines roar deafeningly outside, and your [pc.ears] keep popping with the random changes in pressure. A couple of times, other passengers get visibly ill, and go for small paper bags tucked in the seats ahead of them.

You mumble a curse for the red myr not having a spaceport of their own and put a hand to your own stomach, trying not to puke too. Miserable things, these old planes. Absolutely miserable....

It’s a blessed relief when the plane lands, even if you’re nearly certain the bucket of bolts with rattle itself apart when it skids down the runway. But finally, the ride comes to an end and the plane’s crew chief kicks the ramp down, letting you and the other passengers shuffle off.
rows.translation:
你登上一架停在跑道上、带有外交标识的飞机，目的地是共和国领土深处的非军事区。只等了几分钟，机长便已抵达，其余座位也坐满了返回飞船的红米尔士兵和其他外星人。飞机准时起飞，载着你冲入天空，驶向目的地。

飞机毫无规律地摇晃、震颤，让你和机上每个蚁女都不安地左右摇摆。引擎在外面震耳欲聋地咆哮，气压时不时变化，弄得你的[pc.ears]不停发闷。有几次，其他乘客明显感到不适，伸手去拿前排座椅里塞着的小纸袋。

你低声咒骂红米尔人没有自己的太空港，一手按住胃，努力不让自己也吐出来。这些老飞机真是要命。简直要命....

飞机终于着陆时，你如蒙大赦，尽管它在跑道上滑行时，你几乎确信这只破铁桶会把自己震散架。不过这趟旅程总算结束了，机组长踢下舷梯，让你和其他乘客拖着脚步走下飞机。

It’s only a few minutes of waiting before the captain arrives and the rest of the seats fill up with red myr troops and other offworlders heading back to their ships. The plane takes off punctually, sending you hurtling through the sky towards your destination.

The plane rocks and shudders seemingly at random, making you and every ant-girl aboard sway uneasily. Engines roar deafeningly outside, and your [pc.ears] keep popping with the random changes in pressure. A couple of times, other passengers get visibly ill, and go for small paper bags tucked in the seats ahead of them.

It’s a blessed relief when the plane lands, even if you’re nearly certain the bucket of bolts with rattle itself apart when it skids down the runway. But finally, the ride comes to an end and the plane’s crew chief kicks the ramp down, letting you and the other passengers shuffle off."

rows.raw: "\n\nYou stow the device when a few of the women nervously point their weapons - old fashioned lever-actions - at you. A few tense moments later, though, the pilot that waved at you saunters up with a slight grin, nodding for the guards to lower their weapons."

rows.original: “Welcome to Myrellion, offworlder,” she says, giving you a slight nod. Two of her arms point toward the largest of the hangers as she says, “Please check in with your government’s embassy there. They’ll brief you and get you cleared to go through to the cities.”
rows.translation: “欢迎来到密尔利昂，外星人，”她略一点头说道。她的两条手臂指向最大的一座机库，同时说道：“请到那里的贵国大使馆报到。他们会为你说明情况，并批准你进入城市。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Welcome to Myrellion, offworlder,” she says, giving you a slight nod. Two of her arms point toward the largest of the hangers as she says, “Please check in with your government’s embassy there. They’ll brief you and get you cleared to go through to the cities.”"

rows.original: “Cities?” you ask. “I didn’t see any on the way in.”
rows.translation: “城市？”你问。“我飞来的路上没看到任何城市。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Cities?” you ask. “I didn’t see any on the way in.”"

rows.original: She chuckles. “Myr build underground. You’re standing on top of the Gold Myr capital, Gildenmere. The elevator access is just through the embassy - we’ll see you down below.”
rows.translation: 她轻笑一声。“米尔把城市建在地下。你现在正站在金米尔首都吉尔登米尔上方。电梯入口就在大使馆里面——我们地下见。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe chuckles. “Myr build underground. You’re standing on top of the Gold Myr capital, Gildenmere. The elevator access is just through the embassy - we’ll see you down below.”"

rows.original: With that, she gives a signal to the guards, who follow her away towards another hangar building.
rows.translation: 说完，她向守卫打了个手势，众人跟着她走向另一座机库建筑。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith that, she gives a signal to the guards, who follow her away towards another hangar building."

rows.original: Well, this is certainly different.
rows.translation: 好吧，这里确实与众不同。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, this is certainly different."

rows.original: MYR_GOLD_PILOT
rows.raw: "MYR_GOLD_PILOT"

rows.original: Myr Escort
rows.translation: 米尔护航队
rows.raw: "Myr Escort"

rows.original: Flying to Myrellion is no quick jaunt down the road, but before you know it, you’re guiding your ship back through the atmosphere for a flawless landing on the tarmac, escorted by a squadron of myr pilots in old-timey biplanes.
rows.translation: 飞往密尔利昂绝非开车沿路跑一小段那么简单，但转眼间，你已经再次驾船穿过大气层，在米尔飞行员驾驶的老式双翼机中队护送下，完美降落在停机坪上。
rows.raw: "Flying to Myrellion is no quick jaunt down the road, but before you know it, you’re guiding your ship back through the atmosphere for a flawless landing on the tarmac, escorted by a squadron of myr pilots in old-timey biplanes."

rows.original: After making sure you are docked properly, you prepare your things
rows.translation: 确认飞船已经妥善停靠后，你整理好随身物品
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter making sure you are docked properly, you prepare your things"

rows.original: and step out of your ship.
rows.translation: 并走出飞船。
rows.raw: " and step out of your ship."

rows.original: Myrellion
rows.translation: 迈瑞利恩
rows.raw: "Myrellion"

rows.original: Flying to Myrellion is no quick jaunt down the road--however, this time, there are no myr biplanes to guide you. In fact, the sky is thick with dark clouds and the ground below seems completely deserted, almost spookily... like a land comprised of ghosts. It is hard to make out the hangar with all the dirt and debris in the air, but your guiding instruments help you with that.
rows.translation: 飞往密尔利昂绝非开车沿路跑一小段那么简单--然而这一次，没有米尔双翼机前来引导。事实上，天空乌云密布，下方地面彻底荒无人烟，近乎诡异...仿佛一片由幽灵组成的土地。空气中到处是泥土和碎屑，很难辨认机库的位置，好在导航仪器帮了你的忙。
rows.raw: "Flying to Myrellion is no quick jaunt down the road--however, this time, there are no myr biplanes to guide you. In fact, the sky is thick with dark clouds and the ground below seems completely deserted, almost spookily... like a land comprised of ghosts. It is hard to make out the hangar with all the dirt and debris in the air, but your guiding instruments help you with that."

rows.original: After making sure you are docked properly, you prepare your things and head towards the airlock--but suddenly, your ship’s radioactivity alarms start blaring, causing you to freeze instantaneously. The planet has been glassed and is surrounded by several levels of radiation. How you even ended up here is anyone’s guess, but you probably shouldn’t leave your ship to venture off into a nuclear wasteland if you know what’s good for you...
rows.translation: 确认飞船停靠妥当后，你整理好物品，朝气闸走去--可就在这时，飞船的辐射警报突然尖声大作，让你瞬间僵住。这颗星球已被烧成玻璃，周围笼罩着多层辐射。你究竟怎么会来到这里，谁也说不清；不过，只要你还懂得趋利避害，最好别离开飞船，跑进核废土里冒险...
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter making sure you are docked properly, you prepare your things and head towards the airlock--but suddenly, your ship’s radioactivity alarms start blaring, causing you to freeze instantaneously. The planet has been glassed and is surrounded by several levels of radiation. How you even ended up here is anyone’s guess, but you probably shouldn’t leave your ship to venture off into a nuclear wasteland if you know what’s good for you..."

rows.original: Red Myr
rows.raw: "Red Myr"

rows.original: Gold Myr
rows.raw: "Gold Myr"

rows.original: MYRELLION
rows.raw: "MYRELLION"

rows.original: Myrellion
rows.translation: 迈瑞利恩
rows.raw: "Myrellion"

rows.original: Emmy
rows.raw: "Emmy"

rows.original: You recognize Shade’s ship, a purple MS-XI with “Mirage” painted in bold white letters across its bow, parked next to one of the hangers here.
rows.translation: 你认出了莎德的飞船，一艘紫色MS-XI型飞船，舰艏以醒目的白色字母写着“海市蜃楼”，正停在这里的一座机库旁。
rows.raw: " You recognize Shade’s ship, a purple MS-XI with “Mirage” painted in bold white letters across its bow, parked next to one of the hangers here."

rows.original: myrellion
rows.raw: "myrellion"

rows.original: Kara’s standing in a dark alley down at the end of the street to the south, almost out of sight.
rows.translation: 卡拉正站在南边街道尽头的一条昏暗小巷里，几乎隐没在视线之外。
rows.raw: " Kara’s standing in a dark alley down at the end of the street to the south, almost out of sight."

rows.original: A sign has been posted outside the Xenogen outpost, reading in big, bold red letters: THE DOCTOR IS OUT!
rows.translation: 异种基因前哨站外立着一块告示牌，上面用巨大、醒目的红字写着：医生不在！
rows.raw: "\n\nA sign has been posted outside the Xenogen outpost, reading in big, bold red letters: THE DOCTOR IS OUT!"

rows.original: where Kara is hiding.
rows.translation: 卡拉藏身的地方。
rows.raw: " where Kara is hiding."

rows.original: Not much to see here.
rows.translation: 没什么可看的。
rows.raw: " Not much to see here."

rows.original: ANTRIAS
rows.raw: "ANTRIAS"

rows.original: Antrias
rows.translation: 安特里亚斯
rows.raw: "Antrias"

rows.original: Approach
rows.translation: 接近
rows.raw: "Approach"

rows.original: ANTRIAS
rows.raw: "ANTRIAS"

rows.original: Antrias
rows.translation: 安特里亚斯
rows.raw: "Antrias"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Ho there, what can I do for you?” the man asks, sitting up straight as you approach. “Comm arrays are coming online in places we can get you, so where do you want to go, friend? Only 150 credits a trip!”
rows.translation: “嘿，那边的，我能为你做什么？”你走近时，那个男人坐直身体问道。“我们能联系到的地方，通讯阵列正陆续上线。朋友，你想去哪儿？每趟只要150信用点！”
rows.raw: "“Ho there, what can I do for you?” the man asks, sitting up straight as you approach. “Comm arrays are coming online in places we can get you, so where do you want to go, friend? Only 150 credits a trip!”"

rows.original: You step up to the desk and get the man’s attention. He blinks at you. “Sorry, friend, we’re just getting set up here. No comm buoys are online yet, I’m afraid. Haven’t managed to bring in the drill-shot probes to do it properly. Come back later, yeah?”
rows.translation: 你走到桌前，引起那男人的注意。他眨了眨眼。“抱歉，朋友，我们才刚在这里安顿下来。恐怕目前还没有通讯浮标上线。我们还没能把钻射探针运来，没法按正规方式布设。晚点再来，好吗？”
rows.raw: "You step up to the desk and get the man’s attention. He blinks at you. “Sorry, friend, we’re just getting set up here. No comm buoys are online yet, I’m afraid. Haven’t managed to bring in the drill-shot probes to do it properly. Come back later, yeah?”"

rows.original: “Ah. Sorry to bother you,” you say, turning to leave.
rows.translation: “啊。抱歉打扰了，”你说着，转身准备离开。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah. Sorry to bother you,” you say, turning to leave."

rows.original: “Hey, if you manage to find any old communications arrays, even basic local tech, try and bring it online. Every little bit helps, ya know.”
rows.translation: “嘿，要是你找到任何旧通讯阵列，哪怕只是本地基础技术，也试着把它启动起来。每一点帮助都很重要，明白吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, if you manage to find any old communications arrays, even basic local tech, try and bring it online. Every little bit helps, ya know.”"

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: What could have been a small military bunker sits here, tucked away almost imperceptibly against the far wall of the cavern. The only reason you’d notice it at all is the huge tear in the earth overhead, letting in beams of sunlight which reveal the pillbox’s firing port, now devoid of armament. There’s no indication of who built it or why its been abandoned, but a quick look inside reveals a beat up old radio sitting against a back wall, hooked up to several wires that lead all the way up to the surface.
rows.translation: 这里坐落着一座可能曾是小型军事掩体的建筑，几乎难以察觉地贴在洞穴远端的墙边。你能注意到它，完全是因为头顶地面裂开了一道巨大豁口，阳光从中照下，显露出碉堡的射击孔，如今里面已没有武器。这里没有任何迹象表明是谁建造了它，又为何遭到遗弃；不过简单查看内部后，你发现后墙边摆着一台破旧无线电，连接着数条一路通往地表的电线。
rows.raw: "What could have been a small military bunker sits here, tucked away almost imperceptibly against the far wall of the cavern. The only reason you’d notice it at all is the huge tear in the earth overhead, letting in beams of sunlight which reveal the pillbox’s firing port, now devoid of armament. There’s no indication of who built it or why its been abandoned, but a quick look inside reveals a beat up old radio sitting against a back wall, hooked up to several wires that lead all the way up to the surface."

rows.original: You might be able to use your Codex to tune it into the Scout’s comm network and set up a taxi beacon here.
rows.translation: 你或许可以用资料库把它调到侦察兵的通讯网络，并在这里设置出租车信标。
rows.raw: " You might be able to use your Codex to tune it into the Scout’s comm network and set up a taxi beacon here."

rows.original: Fix Radio
rows.translation: 修理无线电
rows.raw: "Fix Radio"

rows.original: The radio is currently beeping rhythmically, sending coordinates to the Scout base at the DMZ.
rows.translation: 无线电目前正有节奏地发出哔声，将坐标发送至非军事区的侦察兵基地。
rows.raw: " The radio is currently beeping rhythmically, sending coordinates to the Scout base at the DMZ."

rows.original: Taxi
rows.translation: 出租车
rows.raw: "Taxi"

rows.original: Taxi
rows.translation: 出租车
rows.raw: "Taxi"

rows.original: Call a taxi, though you’ll pay 150 credits for the convenience.
rows.translation: 呼叫出租车，不过你得为这份便利支付150信用点。
rows.raw: "Call a taxi, though you’ll pay 150 credits for the convenience."

rows.original: Search
rows.translation: 搜索
rows.raw: "Search"

rows.original: Search
rows.translation: 搜索
rows.raw: "Search"

rows.original: Spend a little time scavenging. Maybe there’s something worthwhile here?
rows.translation: 花点时间搜刮。说不定这里有什么值钱的东西？
rows.raw: "Spend a little time scavenging. Maybe there’s something worthwhile here?"

rows.original: Rifle
rows.translation: 步枪
rows.raw: "Rifle"

rows.original: Rifle
rows.translation: 步枪
rows.raw: "Rifle"

rows.original: Take the old rifle.
rows.translation: 拿走旧步枪。
rows.raw: "Take the old rifle."

rows.original: Search
rows.translation: 搜索
rows.raw: "Search"

rows.original: Search
rows.translation: 搜索
rows.raw: "Search"

rows.original: You’ve already searched this location.
rows.translation: 你已经搜查过这个地点了。
rows.raw: "You’ve already searched this location."

rows.original: Searching...
rows.translation: 搜索中...
rows.raw: "Searching..."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You spend a few minutes poking around in the old bunker, looking for anything salvageable. The place is an absolute wreck, and the closer you look, the more you realize why: there are scorch marks all along the entrance chambers, and several bullet holes in the concrete. This place has seen its share of action, and you’d imagine some of that involved a flamethrower. You do find one piece of equipment still intact, though: buried underneath a bit of collapsed roof, you’re able to dig out a beat up old rifle. Looks like it’s been sat here for months if not years, but with a little cleaning, it might still work.
rows.translation: 你花了几分钟在旧掩体里翻找任何能够回收的东西。这里简直是一片废墟，而你越仔细观察，就越明白原因：入口各处都是焦痕，混凝土上还有好几个弹孔。这里经历过不少战斗，你猜其中一些甚至动用了火焰喷射器。不过，你确实找到了一件仍然完好的装备：在一小片坍塌的屋顶下，你挖出了一把破旧步枪。它看起来已经在这里放了几个月，甚至几年，但稍加清理后，也许仍能使用。
rows.raw: "You spend a few minutes poking around in the old bunker, looking for anything salvageable. The place is an absolute wreck, and the closer you look, the more you realize why: there are scorch marks all along the entrance chambers, and several bullet holes in the concrete. This place has seen its share of action, and you’d imagine some of that involved a flamethrower. You do find one piece of equipment still intact, though: buried underneath a bit of collapsed roof, you’re able to dig out a beat up old rifle. Looks like it’s been sat here for months if not years, but with a little cleaning, it might still work.\n\n"

rows.original: The beacon sits silent, an ominous red glow flashing across its top like a metronome.
rows.translation: 信标静静矗立着，顶部闪烁着不祥的红光，宛如节拍器。
rows.raw: " The beacon sits silent, an ominous red glow flashing across its top like a metronome."

rows.original: Still, it seems functional enough. You could probably activate it, setting up a taxi pick-up point.
rows.translation: 不过，它看起来功能尚且完好。你大概可以启动它，在这里设置出租车接送点。
rows.raw: "\n\nStill, it seems functional enough. You could probably activate it, setting up a taxi pick-up point."

rows.original: Activate
rows.translation: 启动
rows.raw: "Activate"

rows.original: You give the beacon a kick, and it buzzes to life. That was easy. Should be able to call in a taxi from here, now, thanks to the fuck-off huge hole it made landing here.
rows.translation: 你踢了信标一脚，它便嗡鸣着启动了。真简单。多亏它降落时砸出的那个大得离谱的洞，现在应该可以从这里呼叫出租车了。
rows.raw: "You give the beacon a kick, and it buzzes to life. That was easy. Should be able to call in a taxi from here, now, thanks to the fuck-off huge hole it made landing here."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Activate
rows.translation: 启动
rows.raw: "Activate"

rows.original: Get the old beacon working again.
rows.translation: 让旧信标重新运作。
rows.raw: "Get the old beacon working again."

rows.original: The beacon is beeping softly, ready to be used to send a message to the Scouts’ taxi service.
rows.translation: 信标正轻轻发出哔声，随时可以用来向侦察兵的出租车服务发送消息。
rows.raw: " The beacon is beeping softly, ready to be used to send a message to the Scouts’ taxi service."

rows.original: Taxi
rows.translation: 出租车
rows.raw: "Taxi"

rows.original: Taxi
rows.translation: 出租车
rows.raw: "Taxi"

rows.original: Call a taxi, though you’ll pay 150 credits for the convenience.
rows.translation: 呼叫出租车，不过你得为这份便利支付150信用点。
rows.raw: "Call a taxi, though you’ll pay 150 credits for the convenience."

rows.original: A door stands open near you,
rows.translation: 你附近有一扇门敞开着，
rows.raw: "A door stands open near you,"

rows.original: from which can be heard a series of very soft moans and giggles
rows.translation: 门内传出一连串极轻的呻吟与咯咯笑声
rows.raw: " from which can be heard a series of very soft moans and giggles"

rows.original: and you can hear Lieve having a bit of fun inside
rows.translation: 你还能听见莉芙正在里面寻欢
rows.raw: " and you can hear Lieve having a bit of fun inside"

rows.original: As you’re passing by, a young woman with short, almost punkish purple hair pokes her head out of firing port. “Hey you!” she calls, “Come talk to me if you’re going out there. You don’t want to be heading into the trenches blind.”
rows.translation: 你经过时，一个留着紫色短发、造型近乎朋克的年轻女人从射击孔里探出头来。“嘿，你！”她喊道，“如果你要去外面，就来和我谈谈。你可不想对战壕一无所知地闯进去。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you’re passing by, a young woman with short, almost punkish purple hair pokes her head out of firing port. “Hey you!” she calls, “Come talk to me if you’re going out there. You don’t want to be heading into the trenches blind.”"

rows.original: Before you can answer, she pops back into the bunker, pulled in by a pair of gold-chitined hands. Giggles echo out through the port after her.
rows.translation: 你还没来得及回答，她就被一双覆盖金色甲壳的手拉回了掩体。随后，咯咯笑声从射击孔里回荡出来。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore you can answer, she pops back into the bunker, pulled in by a pair of gold-chitined hands. Giggles echo out through the port after her."

rows.original: You’d be tempted to offer to help if you had any idea what the hell that behemoth even is.
rows.translation: 要是你知道那头巨兽到底是什么鬼东西，或许还会想主动帮忙。
rows.raw: " You’d be tempted to offer to help if you had any idea what the hell that behemoth even is."

rows.original: A red myr trooper checks your papers and identification again before waving you through the checkpoint and telling you to hurry aboard if you want to go to the DMZ where your ride is parked.
rows.translation: 一名红米尔士兵再次检查你的文件和身份证明，随后挥手让你通过检查站，并告诉你，要是想去停放座驾的非军事区，就赶紧登机。
rows.raw: "\n\nA red myr trooper checks your papers and identification again before waving you through the checkpoint and telling you to hurry aboard if you want to go to the DMZ where your ride is parked."

rows.original: Enter Plane
rows.translation: 登上飞机
rows.raw: "Enter Plane"

rows.original: Enter Plane
rows.translation: 登上飞机
rows.raw: "Enter Plane"

rows.original: Hop on a plane for a quick trip back to the DMZ.
rows.translation: 搭乘飞机，快速返回非军事区。
rows.raw: "Hop on a plane for a quick trip back to the DMZ."

rows.original: myrellion
rows.raw: "myrellion"

rows.original: Kressia Pass
rows.raw: "Kressia Pass"

rows.original: A red myr trooper checks your papers and identification again before waving you through the checkpoint and telling you to hurry aboard if you want to go to Kressia, the closest of the Red’s cities.
rows.translation: 一名红米尔士兵再次检查你的文件和身份证明，随后挥手让你通过检查站，并告诉你，要是想去距离最近的红方城市克雷西亚，就赶紧登机。
rows.raw: "\n\nA red myr trooper checks your papers and identification again before waving you through the checkpoint and telling you to hurry aboard if you want to go to Kressia, the closest of the Red’s cities."

rows.original: Enter Plane
rows.translation: 登上飞机
rows.raw: "Enter Plane"

rows.original: Enter Plane
rows.translation: 登上飞机
rows.raw: "Enter Plane"

rows.original: Hop on a plane for a quick trip to Kressia.
rows.translation: 搭乘飞机，快速前往克雷西亚。
rows.raw: "Hop on a plane for a quick trip to Kressia."

rows.original: You’ll need clearance to visit Kressia before you can depart. You should check with the red myr diplomat on station.
rows.translation: 你必须获得前往克雷西亚的许可才能出发。你应该去找驻地里的红米尔外交官。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ll need clearance to visit Kressia before you can depart. You should check with the red myr diplomat on station."

rows.original: Enter Plane
rows.translation: 登上飞机
rows.raw: "Enter Plane"

rows.original: Kressia Pass
rows.raw: "Kressia Pass"

rows.original: You’re forced to wait while they check your clearance. They wave you through after a minute or two.
rows.translation: 他们检查你的通行许可时，你不得不等候。一两分钟后，他们挥手让你通过。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re forced to wait while they check your clearance. They wave you through after a minute or two."

rows.original: You’re forced to wait while they check your clearance. When it comes up negative, you’re ordered to walk back into the caves or into a hail of bullets. You’ll take the caves.
rows.translation: 他们检查你的通行许可时，你不得不等候。结果显示无效后，他们命令你要么走回洞穴，要么迎接枪林弹雨。你还是选择洞穴。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re forced to wait while they check your clearance. When it comes up negative, you’re ordered to walk back into the caves or into a hail of bullets. You’ll take the caves."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: It’s still chaos around here. Red myr soldiers are running back and forth around the warehouse and the surrounding buildings, shouting at each other and into blocky communication devices. A line of crestfallen gold myr are being led back inside. The smell of saltpetre and burning is on the air. There does not seem to be any sign of Major Ehstraffe fortunately, and the reds either ignore you or impatiently tell you to get out of the way.

There does not seem to be any sign of Major Ehstraffe fortunately, and the reds either ignore you or impatiently tell you to get out of the way."

rows.original: Myrellion’s native Xukwood comes from a type of subterranian fungus, not a tree, but its fibrous, metal-dense organic structure produces an extremely durable (and heavy) wood-like substance. This Xukwood staff was made with hammer-like tips on each end for heavy, brutal striking, presumably a ceremonial weapon for a ranking military officer in one of the planet’s fueding factions. You wouldn’t want to be on the other end of a strike.
rows.translation: 米瑞利昂原生的旭克木并非来自树木，而是一种地下真菌；但它富含金属的纤维状有机结构能形成一种极为耐用（而且沉重）的类木物质。这根旭克木杖的两端都制成了锤头形状，适合施展沉重而凶狠的打击，想必是这颗星球某个交战派系中高级军官使用的仪仗武器。你绝不会想挨上它的一击。

rows.original: The landing zone your ship’s been assigned is a busy affair, cram-packed with freighters, stripped-down civilian starfighters, and even a light frigate dominating one of the runways. Several pioneers are milling around, loading cargo or repairing their vessels. A few of the braver planet rushers try flirting with the myrmedion guards on the tarmac, though they don’t have much luck.
rows.translation: 分配给你飞船的着陆区一片繁忙，挤满了货船、拆除多余配置的民用星际战斗机，甚至还有一艘轻型护卫舰占据着其中一条跑道。几名先驱者在四处忙碌，或装载货物，或维修飞船。少数更为大胆的行星开拓者试着和停机坪上的米尔米迪恩守卫调情，不过没什么效果。

Several pioneers are milling around, loading cargo or repairing their vessels. A few of the braver planet rushers try flirting with the myrmedion guards on the tarmac, though they don’t have much luck."

rows.original: The central part of the airfield is just as crowded as the rest, with ships vying for tarmac space to land. One of the runways here has been cleared off, though, allowing the locals at least some ability to launch their own aircraft still. To the west, you can see the largest hangar has been left open, with several pioneers and U.G.C. troops coming in and out. A sign reading “EMBASSY” has been nailed over the door.
rows.translation: 机场中央和其他地方一样拥挤，各艘飞船争抢着陆的停机坪空间。不过这里有一条跑道被清空了，至少让当地人仍有机会起飞自己的飞行器。西边最大的机库敞开着，几名先驱者和银河联合邦联士兵进进出出。门上方钉着一块写有“使馆”的牌子。

One of the runways here has been cleared off, though, allowing the locals at least some ability to launch their own aircraft still. To the west, you can see the largest hangar has been left open, with several pioneers and U.G.C. troops coming in and out. A sign reading “EMBASSY” has been nailed over the door."

rows.original: The northern part of the airfield is mostly devoted to several partially-assembled myr planes, with a large garage to the east working to repair damaged or faulty aircraft. A few rusher ships have parked here, including a particularly sleek looking KihaCorp ship with several laser batteries mounted on its hull.
rows.translation: 机场北部主要停放着几架尚未组装完毕的米尔飞机，东边还有一座大型修理库，负责维修损坏或故障的飞行器。几艘淘金者飞船也停在这里，其中包括一艘外形格外流畅的基哈公司飞船，船体上装有数座激光炮组。

A few rusher ships have parked here, including a particularly sleek looking KihaCorp ship with several laser batteries mounted on its hull."

rows.original: The United Galactic Confederacy embassy is a chaotic swirl of bureaucracy and diplomacy stuffed into an airplane hangar too small to fit even a small freighter. Dozens of workers are hurriedly trying to process all the pioneers and rushers coming through. The eastern doors have been left wide open, allowing for streams of people both coming and going. Another set of doors to the west have guards stationed at them who are vigorously inspecting papers held by anyone trying to get through.
rows.translation: 银河联合邦联使馆是一片由官僚事务与外交活动交织而成的混乱漩涡，被硬塞进一座连小型货船都容纳不下的飞机库里。数十名工作人员正匆忙处理所有来访的先驱者和冲袭者。东边的大门完全敞开，人流不断进出。西边另一组门前则驻守着卫兵，严格检查每个试图通过者持有的文件。

rows.original: The security here is tight and well organized, with both red and gold-armored myr standing at attention at every door. A passage to the north is marked “Airstrip: Kressia”. The western door is labeled “The Great Elevator”. To the south, you can see a long row of wide, squat buildings. A sign designates the street between them as “Spacer’s Row”. The nearest building looks like one of the airfield’s barracks has been turned into a tavern, where several pioneers and off-duty myr have gathered.
rows.translation: 这里戒备森严、组织严密，每扇门前都有身着红色与金色盔甲的米尔人立正站岗。北边一条通道标有“机场：克雷西亚”。西门上写着“大升降梯”。南边可以看到一长排宽阔低矮的建筑。标牌将建筑之间的街道命名为“太空客街”。最近的建筑似乎是由机场营房改建而成的酒馆，几名先驱者和休班的米尔人聚集其中。

One of the airfield’s barracks has been hastily converted into a standard watering hole, the same type you see in every spaceport on every damn planet. A rough sign declares it to be “The Golden Peak”. The sounds of music, revelry, and the smell of booze waft out of the open batwing doors.

Across the road from the Golden Peak is a small office bearing the logo of the Xenogen Biotech corporation. It’s a sleek, white building probably brought in prefabricated from the core, with all the modern conveniences that entails.

机场的一座营房被匆忙改造成了普通酒馆，和每颗该死的星球上每座太空港里随处可见的酒馆别无二致。一块粗糙的招牌宣称这里叫“黄金之巅”。音乐、欢闹声与酒气从敞开的蝙蝠翼式大门中飘出。

rows.translation: 异源生物科技的实验室宽敞、整洁且极具现代感。几名研究助理都在工作；你注意到她们全是女性，而且相当迷人。每个人都在贴身的异源生物科技连体服外穿着白大褂。每一处空闲墙面和台面都被数字读数器与全息投影仪占满，显示着各种各样的数据，毫无疑问都与离它们最近的在研项目有关。你完全看不懂其中任何一项。
rows.raw: "The Xenogen lab is sleek, large, and ultra-modern. Several research assistants -- all women, you note, and rather attractive -- are working, all clad in white lab coats over form-fitting Xenogen jumpsuits. Every spare wall and counter space is covered with digital readouts and holo-projectors displaying all manner of data, doubtless related to whatever project’s underway nearest them. You can’t make heads or tails of any of them."

rows.original: Spacer’s Row
rows.raw: "Spacer’s Row"

rows.original: KIHASHOP
rows.raw: "KIHASHOP"

rows.original: The familiar emblem of the U.G.C. Scout Authority is bolted onto the door of the building to the east. Several pioneers are gathered around just in the doors, and there’s a constant stream of people coming and going. On the other side of the alleyway stands the graceful curves of a modern, coreward structure. A street heads north and south from here: north back to the airfield, and south towards a dank alleyway
rows.translation: 银河联合邦联侦察管理局熟悉的徽记被固定在东边建筑的大门上。几名先驱者聚在门内，人流不断进出。小巷另一边矗立着一栋具有核心区现代建筑优雅曲线的房屋。一条街道从这里向南北延伸：向北返回机场，向南通往一条阴暗潮湿的小巷
rows.raw: "The familiar emblem of the U.G.C. Scout Authority is bolted onto the door of the building to the east. Several pioneers are gathered around just in the doors, and there’s a constant stream of people coming and going. On the other side of the alleyway stands the graceful curves of a modern, coreward structure. A street heads north and south from here: north back to the airfield, and south towards a dank alleyway"

rows.original: KIHASHOP
rows.raw: "KIHASHOP"

rows.original: KihaCorp Shop
rows.raw: "KihaCorp Shop"

rows.original: The shop’s interior is pristine, even on the edge of a potential nuclear warzone. Flashy holograms and lights paint every piece of merchandise in the best light, and the sales terminal is a glitzy, modern thing that seems more hardlight than metal. Even the wares themselves look bright and new, machined with exquisite care for the best possible ergonomics. This place houses an awful lot of guns, swords, and hammers for a place in a DMZ.
rows.translation: 即使身处潜在核战区的边缘，这家商店内部依然一尘不染。炫目的全息影像和灯光将每件商品最出彩的一面展现出来，销售终端华丽而现代，看起来硬光成分甚至比金属还多。就连货品本身也显得光鲜崭新，制作极为精细，尽可能符合人体工学。这地方明明位于非军事区，却收藏着多得离谱的枪械、刀剑和锤子。
rows.raw: "The shop’s interior is pristine, even on the edge of a potential nuclear warzone. Flashy holograms and lights paint every piece of merchandise in the best light, and the sales terminal is a glitzy, modern thing that seems more hardlight than metal. Even the wares themselves look bright and new, machined with exquisite care for the best possible ergonomics. This place houses an awful lot of guns, swords, and hammers for a place in a DMZ."

rows.original: Spacer’s Row
rows.raw: "Spacer’s Row"

rows.original: This is a dank, dark alleyway at the end of Spacer’s Row. The only way out is either over a fence topped with concertina wire that surrounds the active military parts of the airfield, or else back north towards the embassies.
rows.translation: 这里是太空客街尽头一条阴暗潮湿的小巷。唯一的出路，要么是翻过一道顶端缠有蛇腹形铁丝网、围住机场现役军事区域的栅栏，要么是向北返回使馆区。
rows.raw: "This is a dank, dark alleyway at the end of Spacer’s Row. The only way out is either over a fence topped with concertina wire that surrounds the active military parts of the airfield, or else back north towards the embassies."

rows.original: The Golden Peak
rows.raw: "The Golden Peak"

rows.original: What might have once been a myr barracks has been cleared out by the pioneers who’ve taken over this airfield and turned it into an almost respectable establishment. A long wooden bar and stools have been set up along one wall, and several makeshift tables are scattered through the wide room. Batwing doors swing creakily as spacers come and go; several dozen of them cluster around the table and bar in thick throngs. Several waitresses of various races and genders move around the place, and a half-ausar bartender is desperately trying to keep up with demand.
rows.translation: 一座或许曾经是米尔军营的建筑已经被占领这座机场的先驱者清空，改造成了一家还算体面的店铺。一侧墙边安放着长木吧台和高脚凳，宽阔房间里散落着几张临时拼凑的桌子。太空客进进出出，蝙蝠翼式门扉吱呀摆动；几十个人密密麻麻地聚在桌边和吧台旁。不同种族、不同性别的几名女服务员在店内穿梭，一位半奥萨尔酒保则拼命应付着顾客的需求。
rows.raw: "What might have once been a myr barracks has been cleared out by the pioneers who’ve taken over this airfield and turned it into an almost respectable establishment. A long wooden bar and stools have been set up along one wall, and several makeshift tables are scattered through the wide room. Batwing doors swing creakily as spacers come and go; several dozen of them cluster around the table and bar in thick throngs. Several waitresses of various races and genders move around the place, and a half-ausar bartender is desperately trying to keep up with demand."

rows.original: Scout Authority
rows.raw: "Scout Authority"

rows.original: The U.G.C. Scout base on Myr is bigger than most, but frankly spartan compared the nearly hunting-lodge feel of many you’ve seen in the past. Several pioneers and spacers are checking out maps, mineral scans, and species indices. A bored-looking human sits behind the desk.
rows.translation: 米尔星上的银河联合邦联侦察员基地比大多数基地都大，但坦白说，与过去见过的许多近似狩猎小屋的基地相比，这里十分简朴。几名先驱者和太空客正在查看地图、矿物扫描图和物种索引。一名神情无聊的人类坐在柜台后。
rows.raw: "The U.G.C. Scout base on Myr is bigger than most, but frankly spartan compared the nearly hunting-lodge feel of many you’ve seen in the past. Several pioneers and spacers are checking out maps, mineral scans, and species indices. A bored-looking human sits behind the desk."

rows.original: Great Elevator
rows.raw: "Great Elevator"

rows.original: Down
rows.raw: "Down"

rows.original: They weren’t kidding when they labeled this the Great Elevator. The car’s nearly fifty feet wide, loaded down with crates, myr, and pioneers looking to get into or out of Gildenmere. While the doors remain open, people and cargo busily stream on and off the elevator.
rows.translation: 他们把这里称作大升降梯可一点也不夸张。轿厢足有将近五十英尺宽，挤满了货箱、米尔人，以及想要进出吉尔登米尔的先驱者。大门敞开时，人群与货物不断涌入、涌出升降梯。
rows.raw: "They weren’t kidding when they labeled this the Great Elevator. The car’s nearly fifty feet wide, loaded down with crates, myr, and pioneers looking to get into or out of Gildenmere. While the doors remain open, people and cargo busily stream on and off the elevator."

rows.original: Kressia Airstrip
rows.raw: "Kressia Airstrip"

rows.original: The airstrip set behind the embassy is completely locked down by red myr troops, all in dark crimson trench coats with gas masks on. A handful of pioneers and cargo hover-loaders are being directed onto and off of a heavy-duty cargo plane sitting on the tarmac, its engines running and ready to take off.
rows.translation: 使馆后方的机场已被红米尔部队全面封锁，所有人都穿着暗绯色风衣并戴着防毒面具。几名先驱者与货运悬浮装载机正接受引导，在停机坪上一架重型货机旁装卸货物；货机引擎已经启动，随时准备起飞。
rows.raw: "The airstrip set behind the embassy is completely locked down by red myr troops, all in dark crimson trench coats with gas masks on. A handful of pioneers and cargo hover-loaders are being directed onto and off of a heavy-duty cargo plane sitting on the tarmac, its engines running and ready to take off."

rows.original: Red Myr Embassy
rows.raw: "Red Myr Embassy"

rows.original: Great Elevator
rows.raw: "Great Elevator"

rows.original: Up
rows.raw: "Up"

rows.original: The elevator isn’t an enclosed chamber like those you’d encounter in a ship, skyscraper, or space station. Instead, it’s a simple platform with hinged rails that are mechanically raised just before the car begins to move. A control panel on the west side of the platform houses the big, obvious command buttons. Most are gold, but there is a large red one. It’s purpose is obvious, even with indecipherable alien script. You hope you won’t have to hit the emergency stop.
rows.translation: 这座升降梯不像飞船、摩天大楼或空间站中的那样拥有封闭轿厢。它只是一块带有铰接护栏的简单平台，轿厢即将移动前，护栏会由机械装置升起。平台西侧的控制面板上排列着醒目硕大的指令按钮。大部分按钮是金色的，但其中有一个巨大的红色按钮。即使外星文字难以辨认，它的用途也一目了然。你希望自己用不着按下紧急停止按钮。
rows.raw: "The elevator isn’t an enclosed chamber like those you’d encounter in a ship, skyscraper, or space station. Instead, it’s a simple platform with hinged rails that are mechanically raised just before the car begins to move. A control panel on the west side of the platform houses the big, obvious command buttons. Most are gold, but there is a large red one. It’s purpose is obvious, even with indecipherable alien script. You hope you won’t have to hit the emergency stop."

rows.original: Mushroom Park
rows.raw: "Mushroom Park"

rows.original: Mushrooms of all shapes and sizes grow wildly around the main lift. Most are huge, tree-sized growths that cast a flickering blue incandescence over the surrounding area. The obsidian paver stones beneath you glitter entrancingly from the otherworldly light. A clear north-south path is maintained through the park to allow for shipment to and from the massive elevator at the core. You could follow it south out of the park.
rows.translation: 主升降梯周围肆意生长着各种形状、各种大小的蘑菇。大多是树木般巨大的菌株，在周围投下摇曳的蓝色荧光。脚下的黑曜石铺路砖在异世光芒中迷人地闪烁。公园里留出了一条清晰的南北向道路，方便货物往返位于中心的巨型升降梯。你可以沿路向南走出公园。
rows.raw: "Mushrooms of all shapes and sizes grow wildly around the main lift. Most are huge, tree-sized growths that cast a flickering blue incandescence over the surrounding area. The obsidian paver stones beneath you glitter entrancingly from the otherworldly light. A clear north-south path is maintained through the park to allow for shipment to and from the massive elevator at the core. You could follow it south out of the park."

rows.original: Mushroom Park
rows.raw: "Mushroom Park"

rows.original: The stalk of a giant mushroom overshadows a number of backless benches in this part of the park. There are no pavestones here, just hard earth packed by the foot traffic of hundreds of gold myr. Right now a group of younglings are here as well, gathered around the gigantic stalk as part of a biology lesson. The great elevator lies northwest, the park wrapping around it to the north and west.
rows.translation: 一株巨型蘑菇的菌柄笼罩着公园这一带的几张无靠背长椅。这里没有铺路砖，只有被数百名金米尔人踩得坚硬的泥土。眼下还有一群幼童来到这里，作为生物课的一部分围在巨大的菌柄旁。大升降梯位于西北方，公园从北面和西面环绕着它。
rows.raw: "The stalk of a giant mushroom overshadows a number of backless benches in this part of the park. There are no pavestones here, just hard earth packed by the foot traffic of hundreds of gold myr. Right now a group of younglings are here as well, gathered around the gigantic stalk as part of a biology lesson. The great elevator lies northwest, the park wrapping around it to the north and west."

rows.original: Mushroom Park
rows.raw: "Mushroom Park"

rows.original: Gleaming onyx pavestones bridge between the otherworldly beauty of Gildenmere’s mushroom park and the smoothly-rounded shapes of the greater city’s structures. The air is comfortably warm and a little humid, spiced with surprisingly pleasant aromas from the mushrooms’ benign spores. At least... you hope they’re benign. The myr don’t seem to mind them, enjoying them the same way that one might a fragrant flower’s pollen. Your codex isn’t chirping any warnings.
rows.translation: 闪亮的缟玛瑙铺路砖连接着吉尔登米尔蘑菇公园的异世美景与大城中轮廓圆润流畅的建筑。空气温暖舒适，略带湿气，蘑菇无害孢子散发的气味出人意料地宜人。至少……你希望它们无害。米尔人似乎毫不介意，享受这些孢子时，就像有人享受芳香花朵的花粉一样。你的电子书也没有发出任何警报。
rows.raw: "Gleaming onyx pavestones bridge between the otherworldly beauty of Gildenmere’s mushroom park and the smoothly-rounded shapes of the greater city’s structures. The air is comfortably warm and a little humid, spiced with surprisingly pleasant aromas from the mushrooms’ benign spores. At least... you hope they’re benign. The myr don’t seem to mind them, enjoying them the same way that one might a fragrant flower’s pollen. Your codex isn’t chirping any warnings."

rows.original: Mushroom Park
rows.raw: "Mushroom Park"

rows.original: A carpet of small toadstools devours the hard packed earth here. They’re so densely packed that you can’t see a single mote of brown between the blue-tinged fungus. Passing myr pay them no mind, running and jumping on them as a terran would grass, clearly enjoying the springy, organic rug. The elevator up to the DMZ and airstrip is just southwest of here, ensconced securely in this beauteous park.
rows.translation: 一层小伞菌如地毯般吞没了这里坚实的泥地。它们密集得令人看不到蓝色菌群之间哪怕一丁点棕色。路过的米尔人毫不在意，像地球人踩过草坪一样在上面奔跑跳跃，显然很享受这张富有弹性的有机地毯。通往非军事区和机场的升降梯就在这里的西南方，稳稳坐落于这座美丽的公园中。
rows.raw: "A carpet of small toadstools devours the hard packed earth here. They’re so densely packed that you can’t see a single mote of brown between the blue-tinged fungus. Passing myr pay them no mind, running and jumping on them as a terran would grass, clearly enjoying the springy, organic rug. The elevator up to the DMZ and airstrip is just southwest of here, ensconced securely in this beauteous park."

rows.original: Mushroom Park
rows.raw: "Mushroom Park"

rows.original: Two twenty-foot mushrooms cross over the onyx-paved roadway that bridges the city to the central elevator shaft. Their caps bend vertically where they press against one another; they’ve grown so close together that it’s difficult to tell them apart. Pairs of gold myr often pass below the fungal arch, their expressions hopeful and their mannerisms animated. Perhaps they’re excited at a chance to join a galactic fraternity, or simply pleased that nuclear apocalypse has been temporarily avoided. You can enter the great elevator to the south.
rows.translation: 两株二十英尺高的蘑菇横跨在连接城市与中央升降梯井的缟玛瑙铺面道路上。两顶菌盖彼此挤压之处竖直弯曲；它们长得如此贴近，几乎难以区分。成双成对的金米尔人经常从真菌拱门下经过，个个神情满怀希望，举止兴奋活泼。或许他们正为有机会加入银河大家庭而激动，也可能只是庆幸核末日暂时得以避免。你可以从南边进入大升降梯。
rows.raw: "Two twenty-foot mushrooms cross over the onyx-paved roadway that bridges the city to the central elevator shaft. Their caps bend vertically where they press against one another; they’ve grown so close together that it’s difficult to tell them apart. Pairs of gold myr often pass below the fungal arch, their expressions hopeful and their mannerisms animated. Perhaps they’re excited at a chance to join a galactic fraternity, or simply pleased that nuclear apocalypse has been temporarily avoided. You can enter the great elevator to the south."

rows.original: Mushroom Park
rows.raw: "Mushroom Park"

rows.original: Were you on terra, or any other number of human-inhabited worlds, a place like this would be deep in the shade, dark and forgotten. On Myrmedion, the glowing mushrooms provide all the light you’d ever need. A dense grove of these would be the brightest spot for miles. As it is, you’re pretty sure this is the best-lit spot in the park thanks to the mushrooms’ natural bioluminescence. The gold myr seem to agree. Swing sets have been anchored into the undersides of the glowing caps for their young to play in, though you see more than one grown adult making use of them as well.
rows.translation: 如果你身处地球，或任何其他人类居住的世界，这样的地方都会深藏阴影之中，黑暗而被遗忘。但在米尔米迪恩，发光蘑菇能提供你所需的全部光线。只要有一片茂密菌林，那里就会成为方圆数英里最明亮的地点。就目前而言，凭借蘑菇天然的生物荧光，这里无疑是公园中光线最充足的地方。金米尔人似乎也认同这一点。他们把秋千固定在发光菌盖下方，供幼童玩耍，不过你也看到不止一个成年人正在使用。
rows.raw: "Were you on terra, or any other number of human-inhabited worlds, a place like this would be deep in the shade, dark and forgotten. On Myrmedion, the glowing mushrooms provide all the light you’d ever need. A dense grove of these would be the brightest spot for miles. As it is, you’re pretty sure this is the best-lit spot in the park thanks to the mushrooms’ natural bioluminescence. The gold myr seem to agree. Swing sets have been anchored into the undersides of the glowing caps for their young to play in, though you see more than one grown adult making use of them as well."

rows.original: Mushroom Park
rows.raw: "Mushroom Park"

rows.original: Swarms of beetles zip above the onyx pavers, heading to any number of bioluminescent mushrooms. Their whole bodies glow, painted with the same bluish-purple ambience as the surrounding fungal life. Sometimes, they’ll form incredible patterns in the air in response to some stimulus beyond your perception - maybe air currents? Most myr pay them no mind, but here and there you can see an occasional awestruck smile.
rows.translation: 成群甲虫在缟玛瑙铺路砖上方飞掠，奔向四处的生物荧光蘑菇。它们全身发光，染着与周围真菌生命相同的蓝紫色幽光。有时，它们会响应某种超出你感知范围的刺激，在空中组成不可思议的图案 - 也许是气流？大多数米尔人都不在意它们，但偶尔也能看到一张惊叹不已的笑脸。
rows.raw: "Swarms of beetles zip above the onyx pavers, heading to any number of bioluminescent mushrooms. Their whole bodies glow, painted with the same bluish-purple ambience as the surrounding fungal life. Sometimes, they’ll form incredible patterns in the air in response to some stimulus beyond your perception - maybe air currents? Most myr pay them no mind, but here and there you can see an occasional awestruck smile."

rows.original: Mushroom Park
rows.raw: "Mushroom Park"

rows.original: There are fewer large mushrooms here than in other parts of the park. The largest isn’t even very bright, bent nearly to the ground in a way that shields this area from curious onlookers. The ground is uneven with deep, foot-shaped furrows. You suspect this place was once wet enough to render the dirt into mud, and some great disturbance took place. At the very least, a large number of myr congregated in this locale.
rows.translation: 这里的大型蘑菇比公园其他区域少。最大的一株甚至不怎么明亮，几乎贴地弯曲，恰好遮住了好奇旁观者望向这片区域的视线。地面被一道道深邃的足形沟槽弄得凹凸不平。你怀疑这里曾经湿润得足以让泥土化为烂泥，之后又发生过某种巨大的骚动。至少，曾有大批米尔人聚集在这个地方。
rows.raw: "There are fewer large mushrooms here than in other parts of the park. The largest isn’t even very bright, bent nearly to the ground in a way that shields this area from curious onlookers. The ground is uneven with deep, foot-shaped furrows. You suspect this place was once wet enough to render the dirt into mud, and some great disturbance took place. At the very least, a large number of myr congregated in this locale."

rows.original: South Road
rows.raw: "South Road"

rows.original: A smooth-walled building with multiple ovoid towers looms over this street to the east. A blood-red banner wraps around the top of one, tied off like a gigantic bandage. A newly added holographic display writes its purpose plain in floating, glowing letters in the sky: it’s a hospital, or what passes for one around here. On the other side of the black-paved path is a more severe, but just as graceful, building. No glowing signs declare what function it serves.
rows.translation: 东边一栋外墙光滑、拥有数座卵形塔楼的建筑高高俯瞰着这条街。一面血红旗帜缠绕着其中一座塔楼的顶部，像巨大的绷带一样扎紧。新加装的全息显示屏以悬浮发光文字在空中清楚写明了建筑的用途：这里是一家医院，或至少是当地所谓的医院。黑色铺面道路另一侧则是一栋风格更为严肃、但同样优雅的建筑。没有任何发光标牌说明它的用途。
rows.raw: "A smooth-walled building with multiple ovoid towers looms over this street to the east. A blood-red banner wraps around the top of one, tied off like a gigantic bandage. A newly added holographic display writes its purpose plain in floating, glowing letters in the sky: it’s a hospital, or what passes for one around here. On the other side of the black-paved path is a more severe, but just as graceful, building. No glowing signs declare what function it serves."

rows.original: Irellia’s Way
rows.raw: "Irellia’s Way"

rows.original: Polished granite stones provide the surface for this east-west thoroughfare. A few rumbling, primitive vehicles trundle by, but most of the traffic on the subterranean highway is done by bare, chitinous feet. An impressive palace stands a ways down to the road to the west, the dwelling place of Queen Irellia. Other, more mundane homes occupy the rest of the street’s south side.
rows.translation: 打磨光滑的花岗岩铺成了这条东西向主干道的路面。几辆隆隆作响的原始车辆缓慢驶过，但这条地下公路上的大部分交通都由赤裸的甲壳足承担。西边沿路不远处矗立着一座气派非凡的宫殿，那是伊蕾莉娅女王的居所。其余更为普通的住宅占据了街道南侧剩下的区域。
rows.raw: "Polished granite stones provide the surface for this east-west thoroughfare. A few rumbling, primitive vehicles trundle by, but most of the traffic on the subterranean highway is done by bare, chitinous feet. An impressive palace stands a ways down to the road to the west, the dwelling place of Queen Irellia. Other, more mundane homes occupy the rest of the street’s south side."

rows.original: Irellia’s Way
rows.raw: "Irellia’s Way"

rows.original: GMEREHOSPITAL
rows.raw: "GMEREHOSPITAL"

rows.original: A carefully tended-to garden of various mushrooms lines the way north to a pair of crystalline double doors. A newly-installed holo-projector reads, “Hospital”. The gold myr aren’t wasting any time in picking up technology from the rest of the universe. More mundane dwellings line the south side of the street, carved from hollowed out stalagmites or stone that has somehow been molded into smoothly rounded domes.
rows.translation: 一座精心照料、栽种着各种蘑菇的花园沿道路向北延伸，通往一对水晶双开门。新安装的全息投影仪上写着：“医院”。金米尔人正争分夺秒地吸收宇宙其他地区的技术。街道南侧排列着更为普通的住宅，有些由掏空的石笋雕成，有些则是以某种方式塑造成圆润穹顶的石屋。
rows.raw: "A carefully tended-to garden of various mushrooms lines the way north to a pair of crystalline double doors. A newly-installed holo-projector reads, “Hospital”. The gold myr aren’t wasting any time in picking up technology from the rest of the universe. More mundane dwellings line the south side of the street, carved from hollowed out stalagmites or stone that has somehow been molded into smoothly rounded domes."

rows.original: Foot traffic along this east-west thoroughfare is impressively dense, perhaps due to the hospital located just to the north. You do seem to be in a particularly nice part of the city. Many of the dwellings on the south side of the road are decorated with well-tended fungii or elaborate paintwork. Even the hospital structure to the north is painted a matte white. If it were not so obviously rough and porous, you could almost mistake it for the kind of composite buildings favored in the core.
rows.translation: 这条东西向主干道上的人流密集得惊人，或许是因为北边就有一家医院。你所在的似乎确实是城中格外体面的区域。道路南侧许多住宅都装饰着精心照料的真菌或复杂彩绘。就连北边的医院建筑也被漆成了哑光白色。若不是表面如此明显地粗糙多孔，你几乎会把它错认成核心区偏爱的复合材料建筑。

rows.original: Fortress Column
rows.raw: "Fortress Column"

rows.original:
A naturally-formed column stretches up from this street corner all the way to the roof of Gildenmere’s immense cavern. The flowing stone is riddled with parapets and barred windows, more than a few of which contain rifles and primitive artillery pieces. Such a strongpoint would be hard for invaders to take, and still harder to wipe out. Bringing down a support that size would be no easy task without high-grade explosives, and doing so would risk burying invader and defender alike in millions of tons of rock.

Irellia’s Way leads west from here. Crystamere Road heads north.
rows.translation:
一根天然形成的石柱从这个街角一路向上，直抵吉尔登米尔巨大洞窟的穹顶。流动状岩石上遍布垛口与装有铁栏的窗户，其中不少架着步枪和原始火炮。这样的据点对入侵者来说难以攻取，更难彻底摧毁。若无高级炸药，要炸倒如此巨大的支柱绝非易事；而真这么做，又可能让入侵者和防守者一起被数百万吨岩石掩埋。

伊蕾莉娅大道从这里向西延伸。晶海路则通往北方。
