rows.raw: "Crystamere Road"

rows.original:
This particular road is paved with hundreds upon thousands of glittering crystals of all shapes and sizes, fitted together with almost perfect precision, presenting a smooth unbroken face. Some kind of exotic jade mortar pins them all together (and prevents you from snagging yourself a shiny souvenir). It’s for the best. You aren’t sure what you’d do with such a prize anyhow - maybe barter with a primitive rube for a magical potion?

A side road splits off towards the east where a number of weapon-wielding soldiers have set up a checkpoint. You’d have to get closer to see what they’re about.
rows.translation:
这条道路以数以千计、形状大小各异的闪亮水晶铺成，彼此几乎完美地严丝合缝，形成平整无缝的表面。某种奇异的翡翠色砂浆将它们牢牢固定在一起（也阻止你顺手拿走一件闪亮纪念品）。这样最好。反正你也不知道这种宝物能拿来做什么 - 或许可以跟某个原始土包子换一瓶魔法药水？

一条支路向东分岔，那里有几名手持武器的士兵设立了检查站。你得走近些才能看清他们究竟在做什么。

rows.original: The naturally occurring mushrooms that light much of the city are in sparse numbers here, leaving much of the gemstone street in shadow. The massive hospital building to the west doesn’t help much either. Somehow it manages to block out all the light from the mushroom grove near the great elevator without providing any of its own. A few street lamps have been placed to keep visibility up, but you’d still rather there be more available light.
rows.translation: 这附近天然生长、为城中大部分区域照明的蘑菇十分稀少，使宝石街的大半都笼罩在阴影中。西边那座巨大的医院也没帮上什么忙。它不知怎的挡住了大升降梯附近蘑菇林投来的所有光线，自己却一点光也不提供。这里安了几盏路灯来维持能见度，但你还是希望光线能再充足些。

A few street lamps have been placed to keep visibility up, but you’d still rather there be more available light."

rows.raw: "Crystamere Road"

rows.original: There’s plenty of traffic here thanks to the intersection of two different streets. The crystal-lined Crystamere Road meets with an unlabeled avenue paved in black, volcanic rock. You could follow the sable street toward the mushroom gardens and the mammoth elevator at its heart, or stick on the glittering, north-south thoroughfare. This far away, you can really enjoy what a feat of engineering that elevator is. These primitive insect-people built such a thing without knowledge of lasers, antigravity sleds, or high-quality alloys.
rows.translation: 两条道路在此交汇，因而车水马龙。水晶镶边的晶海路与一条没有路标、由黑色火山岩铺成的大道相交。你可以沿着乌黑的街道前往蘑菇园和园心的巨型升降梯，也可以继续走这条闪闪发光的南北干道。隔着这么远，你更能体会那座升降梯是何等惊人的工程奇迹。这些原始的昆虫人既不懂激光、反重力载具，也没有优质合金，却造出了这种东西。

rows.original: This part of the city is low on light but high on foot traffic. Luckily, the pavement itself is made from thousands of glittering stones painstakingly interlocked together, so what little illumination does make it here is reflected into gentle, soft-hued rainbows of every color. Many of the buildings here have small pots with glowing mushrooms or window planters to help brighten the mood.
rows.translation: 城里的这一带光线昏暗，人流却很密集。好在路面本身由数千块闪亮的石头费尽心力地拼接而成，因此照到这里的些许光芒会被反射成柔和淡雅、色彩纷呈的虹光。许多建筑都摆着栽有发光蘑菇的小花盆或窗台花槽，为这里增添几分明快气氛。

rows.original: A interborough boulevard forks off from Crystamere Road toward a barricade to the east. You’d have to get closer to make out the details, but it looks like the local military forces have a checkpoint erected for some reason or another. There’s no shortage of shops along the glittering thoroughfare, but there’s a serious lack of shopping in your immediate area. You do see an open store a little ways to the south, though it doesn’t match the local architecture in the slightest.
rows.translation: 一条跨区大道从晶海路岔出，通往东边的一道路障。你得走近些才能看清细节，不过当地军队似乎出于某种原因在那里设了检查站。这条闪亮的大道两旁店铺不少，但你眼前这一带却没什么可逛的。南边稍远处倒有一家营业中的商店，只是它与当地建筑风格完全不搭。

rows.original: Crystamere Road and Halcyon Way come together alongside the edge of the city, marked by a cavern wall that arcs up into a darkness broken only by small patches of glowing lichen. A smaller, myr-made wall blocks travel to the east. The latter is covered in crude scrawlings in characters you can’t comprehend, not even with your augmented auto translators. Whatever scripts are at use here have not yet been uploaded to the galactic lexicons.
rows.translation: 晶海路与宁和大道在城市边缘交汇；这里以洞壁为界，洞壁拱入黑暗之中，只有一小片一小片的发光地衣将其打破。另一堵由米尔人建造的矮墙挡住了向东的道路。后者上面满是你看不懂的潦草字符，就连增强型自动翻译器也无能为力。这里使用的文字尚未录入银河词库。

rows.original: Halcyon way butts directly against the edge of the city’s cavern wall, leaving it feeling dark and cramped, like the arched stone could cave in on you at any second. The luminous mushrooms that light much of the rest of the city are sparse here. Small bits of glowing lichen are a pale substitute. On the south side of the roadway stands a shop with a rickety-looking awning but a well-painted sign: Underground Outfitters.
rows.translation: 宁和大道直抵城市洞穴的边缘，显得阴暗又逼仄，仿佛拱形岩顶随时都会塌到你头上。为城中其余大部分区域照明的发光蘑菇在这里很稀少，零星的发光地衣只是苍白的替代品。道路南侧有一家商店，雨篷看起来摇摇欲坠，招牌倒是漆得很漂亮：地下装备店。

rows.original: A path of pure black intersects with Halcyon way, surrounded by a hexagon paved in gold-hued bricks. They don’t have the shining glamor of true gold, but the appearance is close enough to be magnificent all the same. Four mushrooms of immense size lie just beyond the edge of the ring, bathing it all in a brilliant, blue glow. A quartet of statues, each depicting a bare-breasted queen, stand in the center. They lactate thick streams of water into an incessantly bubbling fountain. The locals pay it no mind, but almost every rusher you spot spends a little time gawking.
rows.translation: 一条纯黑色的道路与宁和大道相交，交叉处是一个铺着金黄色砖块的六边形广场。这些砖没有真金那般璀璨耀眼，但外观已足够相似，同样显得富丽堂皇。四株巨大的蘑菇立在环形区域外缘，把这里沐浴在明亮的蓝光之中。中央立着四尊雕像，每一尊都刻画着袒露乳房的女王。她们从乳房中泌出粗大的水流，注入不断冒泡的喷泉。当地人对此视若无睹，但你见到的几乎每个星球开拓者都会驻足瞠目。

rows.original: You nearly trip over a hole in the otherwise well-maintained road. Looking around, you spot others like it, places where the paving is crushed or peeled out of the way. Further south is a gutted crater of a building, the few surviving walls scorching black by flame or blown open by concussive force. A bomb went off here not long ago. The myr try their best to ignore or avoid it, but they cannot hide the fear in their inky, alien eyes.
rows.translation: 你差点被保养良好的路面上一个坑绊倒。环顾四周，你还看见了好几个类似的坑洞，都是铺路材料被压碎或掀开的地方。更南边是一栋被炸空的建筑残骸，幸存的几面墙不是被火焰熏得焦黑，就是被冲击力轰开。不久前这里发生过爆炸。米尔人竭力装作没看见，或干脆绕开这里，但他们墨色的异族双眼藏不住恐惧。

rows.raw: "Halcyon Way"

rows.original: A rattle-trap vehicle trundles by, coughing more smoke than an asthmatic chain-smoker. The crowd parts nervously before it, unused to cars at this point in their technological development. The roadway doesn’t even have sidewalks, designed only for foot traffic. There is a restaurant to the south, or what passes a restaurant here, anyway. Its signage is a statue of positively elephantine proportions. It’s a myr, but one whose breasts are wildly outsized. Behind it is an abdomen big enough to immobilize a greater creature.
rows.translation: 一辆破破烂烂的车轰隆驶过，冒出的烟比患哮喘的老烟枪还多。人群紧张地向两侧分开；以他们目前的科技发展程度，显然还不习惯汽车。道路甚至没有人行道，本来就只为步行而设计。南边有一家餐馆——姑且算是餐馆吧。招牌是一尊体态堪称象一般庞大的雕像。那是个米尔人，但乳房大得离谱，身后的腹部也庞大得足以让体型更大的生物都动弹不得。

rows.raw: "City Corner"

rows.original: This corner splits between Halcyon Way to the east Girella’s Avenue to the south. Both roads are thick with myr, but the crowds south have far more off-worlders mixed in. There’s not much to see here but a cavern wall and the back side of a building.
rows.translation: 这个街角将道路分为向东的宁和大道和向南的吉蕾拉大道。两条路上都挤满了米尔人，不过南边的人群中混着更多外星人。这里除了洞壁和一栋建筑的背面外，没什么可看的。

rows.original: City Corner
rows.raw: "City Corner"

rows.original: Girella’s Avenue intersects with another, westward-traveling road here. The latter leads toward another section of the city, but a wartime checkpoint has been established a short ways down it. You doubt they’ll let you through if you head that way. Girella’s Avenue comes to an end to the north at the corner of another street. Maybe you’ll have more luck that way.
rows.translation: 吉蕾拉大道在这里与另一条向西延伸的道路交汇。后者通往城市的另一区域，但不远处设有战时检查站。如果往那边走，他们恐怕不会让你通过。吉蕾拉大道向北延伸到另一个街角便到了尽头。也许从那边走会更顺利。

The latter leads toward another section of the city, but a wartime checkpoint has been established a short ways down it. You doubt they’ll let you through if you head that way. Girella’s Avenue comes to an end to the north at the corner of another street. Maybe you’ll have more luck that way."

rows.original: Girella’s Avenue
rows.raw: "Girella’s Avenue"

rows.original: More streetlamps burn here than anywhere else in the city, bathing the region in so much yellowish-white glow that you can almost forget the luminescent blue that’s so common everywhere else. You have to blink a few times to adjust to the brightness. Once you do, you realize why there are so many lights set up here - a club of some sort is positioned to the west. A sign labels it “The Honey Nozzle”. Maybe the lights attract myr like moths to a flame, or perhaps they’ve been set up to make surface races more comfortable.
rows.translation: 这里的路灯比城中任何地方都多，黄白色的光芒如此明亮，几乎让你忘了其他区域随处可见的荧蓝色。你眨了好几次眼才适应亮度。适应之后，你便明白这里为何装了这么多灯——西边有一家俱乐部。招牌上写着“蜜汁喷口”。也许这些灯会像火焰吸引飞蛾一样吸引米尔人，又或许它们只是为了让地表种族感觉更舒服。
rows.raw: "More streetlamps burn here than anywhere else in the city, bathing the region in so much yellowish-white glow that you can almost forget the luminescent blue that’s so common everywhere else. You have to blink a few times to adjust to the brightness. Once you do, you realize why there are so many lights set up here - a club of some sort is positioned to the west. A sign labels it “The Honey Nozzle”. Maybe the lights attract myr like moths to a flame, or perhaps they’ve been set up to make surface races more comfortable."

rows.original: Girella’s Avenue
rows.raw: "Girella’s Avenue"

rows.original: A great number of streetlamps have been set up to the north to draw attention to a club of some sort. There’s also a black-paved road to the east, leading towards a mushroom garden and the towering elevator at the center of it. A residential stalactite blocks travel west. It’s a huge, almost palatial thing, but so many voices come from the open windows that it must be used as some kind of communal dwelling.
rows.translation: 北边架设了大量路灯，目的是吸引人们注意某家俱乐部。东边还有一条黑色路面的道路，通往一座蘑菇园和园心高耸的升降梯。西边被一座住宅钟乳石挡住。那东西巨大得近乎宫殿，但敞开的窗中传来如此多的声音，想必是某种公共住宅。
rows.raw: "A great number of streetlamps have been set up to the north to draw attention to a club of some sort. There’s also a black-paved road to the east, leading towards a mushroom garden and the towering elevator at the center of it. A residential stalactite blocks travel west. It’s a huge, almost palatial thing, but so many voices come from the open windows that it must be used as some kind of communal dwelling."

rows.original: Girella’s Avenue
rows.raw: "Girella’s Avenue"

rows.original: A rigid fence of crystal blocks off an open field to the east. A number of unusual posts and strange markings mar the area. You think it might be used for some kind of sport. The adjoining structure is a massive affair - one of the largest in the city. It too hides behind a fence. The entrance must be elsewhere. Girella’s Avenue continues north and south.
rows.translation: 一道坚硬的水晶围栏封住了东边的空地，场内立着许多不同寻常的柱子，还有各种奇怪标记。你觉得那里可能用于某种运动。相邻的建筑规模庞大，是城里最大的建筑之一，同样藏在围栏后面。入口一定在别处。吉蕾拉大道继续向南北延伸。
rows.raw: "A rigid fence of crystal blocks off an open field to the east. A number of unusual posts and strange markings mar the area. You think it might be used for some kind of sport. The adjoining structure is a massive affair - one of the largest in the city. It too hides behind a fence. The entrance must be elsewhere. Girella’s Avenue continues north and south."

rows.original: Girella’s Avenue
rows.raw: "Girella’s Avenue"

rows.original: A score of military ants, obvious in their uniforms, march past to the west, toward a military checkpoint that’s been set up to gate off another section of the city. Nearby civilians look on with a mixture of respect and fear, the horrors of war a long ways from forgotten. A crystal fence blocks off the building to the east. Girella’s Avenue ends a little ways to the south where it intersects with another road.
rows.translation: 约二十名一眼就能从制服认出的蚁族士兵向西列队行进，前往封锁城市另一区域的军事检查站。附近的平民带着敬畏交织的神情看着他们，战争的恐怖显然远未被遗忘。一道水晶围栏挡住了东边的建筑。吉蕾拉大道在南边不远处与另一条道路相交并就此终止。
rows.raw: "A score of military ants, obvious in their uniforms, march past to the west, toward a military checkpoint that’s been set up to gate off another section of the city. Nearby civilians look on with a mixture of respect and fear, the horrors of war a long ways from forgotten. A crystal fence blocks off the building to the east. Girella’s Avenue ends a little ways to the south where it intersects with another road."

rows.original: City Corner
rows.raw: "City Corner"

rows.original: The polished granite of Irellia’s Way butts squarely against Girella’s avenue directly underfoot. An imposing, palatial structure of polished white stone and shaped columns towers over everything to the south. You can see the entrance a short ways east of here. A fluttering, alien bug rests on the crystal fence to the northeast, regarding you.
rows.translation: 脚下，伊蕾莉亚之路光滑的花岗岩路面与吉蕾拉大道笔直相接。南边一座由光洁白石和塑形石柱建成的威严宫殿高高耸立，俯瞰周围的一切。入口就在东边不远处。一只振翅飞舞的异星小虫停在东北方的水晶围栏上，正打量着你。
rows.raw: "The polished granite of Irellia’s Way butts squarely against Girella’s avenue directly underfoot. An imposing, palatial structure of polished white stone and shaped columns towers over everything to the south. You can see the entrance a short ways east of here. A fluttering, alien bug rests on the crystal fence to the northeast, regarding you."

rows.original: Irellia’s Way
rows.raw: "Irellia’s Way"

rows.original: The street is incredibly crowded here. Myr of every age, shape, and size push past you on their way to the buildings on either side of the road. The one to the south is the more important of the two, a grand facade of polished white and handworked architecture. There’s no sign or placard, but it’s obvious that the place is home to one of the queens. A pair of guards stand by the entrance, looking coolly in your direction. On the north, there’s a wide-open crystal gate with the word “thollum” inscribed on the sides.
rows.translation: 这里的街道拥挤至极。各种年龄、体形和身材的米尔人从你身旁挤过，赶往道路两侧的建筑。南边那座更为重要，拥有光洁白石与手工雕琢建筑结构的宏伟外观。这里没有招牌或告示，但显然是某位女王的居所。两名卫兵守在入口旁，冷冷地望着你。北边则有一扇敞开的宽阔水晶门，门柱两侧刻着“托勒姆”一词。
rows.raw: "The street is incredibly crowded here. Myr of every age, shape, and size push past you on their way to the buildings on either side of the road. The one to the south is the more important of the two, a grand facade of polished white and handworked architecture. There’s no sign or placard, but it’s obvious that the place is home to one of the queens. A pair of guards stand by the entrance, looking coolly in your direction. On the north, there’s a wide-open crystal gate with the word “thollum” inscribed on the sides."

rows.original: Irellia’s Way
rows.raw: "Irellia’s Way"

rows.original: A palace for Queen Irellia rises up to the south, but there’s no entrance to it from where you’re standing now. You’d have to follow the road west towards the severe looking guards if you wanted to get in. North, behind a fence of glittering crystal, is a similarly large structure, though this one is far more plain. Young myr run about in front of it or read from old-style books, like the cavemen on Terra must have.
rows.translation: 伊蕾莉亚女王的宫殿矗立在南边，但从你现在站的位置无法进入。想进去的话，你得沿路向西，走到那些神情严厉的卫兵那里。北边闪亮的水晶围栏后也有一座同样庞大的建筑，不过朴素得多。年轻的米尔人在门前跑来跑去，或捧着旧式书本阅读，就像泰拉上的穴居人过去那样。

You’d have to follow the road west towards the severe looking guards if you wanted to get in. North, behind a fence of glittering crystal, is a similarly large structure, though this one is far more plain. Young myr run about in front of it or read from old-style books, like the cavemen on Terra must have."

rows.raw: "Southwest Checkpoint"

rows.original: DEAD ROAD W2
rows.raw: "DEAD ROAD W2"

rows.original: GOLD_BUNKER
rows.raw: "GOLD_BUNKER"

rows.original: A blockade, complete with tank traps, armed guards, and floodlights, sits astride the road. Guards armed with spears and shields are stopping and checking everyone that goes by, even frisking most of them. At the sight of you, their antennae twitch, and weapons are readied. You get the impression that offworlders aren’t welcome in that part of the city. You’ll have to head back east.
rows.translation: 一道完整的封锁线横跨道路，坦克路障、武装卫兵和探照灯一应俱全。手持长矛与盾牌的卫兵拦下每一个经过的人进行盘查，甚至会搜大多数人的身。看到你时，他们的触角抽动起来，武器也纷纷举起。你感觉外星人在城市的那一带并不受欢迎。你只能往东折返。

rows.original: A half-dozen soldiers block the way west on this road. They aren’t particularly alert; guarding a road all day will do that to a person - man or myr, but they’re still checking every passerby for appropriate documentation. A glance at some of the signs they’ve set up tells all you need to know. Off-worlders aren’t welcome to leave this part of the city without dispensation from the neighboring queen. From the sound of it, Queen Girella is a tad xenophobic.
rows.translation: 六名士兵封锁了这条路的西侧。他们并不特别警觉；整天守着一条路，任谁都会如此——不论是人类还是米尔人，不过他们仍在检查每位路人的相应证件。看一眼他们立起的几块标牌，你就明白了一切。未经邻近女王许可，外星人不得离开城市的这一带。听起来，吉蕾拉女王多少有点排外。

They aren’t particularly alert; guarding a road all day will do that to a person - man or myr, but they’re still checking every passerby for appropriate documentation. From the sound of it, Queen Girella is a tad xenophobic."

rows.raw: "Northeast Checkpoint"

rows.raw: "DEAD ROAD E1"

rows.original: Uniformed gold myr obstruct the road to the east, blocking it with parked vehicles bearing an exceeding foreign crest. You aren’t sure if it’s a symbol of their armed forces, a queen’s sigil, or something else entirely. Nor do you think you’ll get to find out what it’s for; they’re only letting myr pass through the checkpoint. Offworlders like yourself aren’t welcome. Well, at least you can head west back onto the glittering path of Crystamere Road.
rows.translation: 身穿制服的金米尔人封锁了东边的道路，还用几辆绘有极其陌生徽记的车辆堵住路面。你无法确定那是军队标志、女王徽记，还是完全不同的东西。你大概也没机会弄清楚；检查站只允许米尔人通行。像你这样的外星人并不受欢迎。好吧，至少你还能向西返回晶海路那条闪亮的小径。

rows.raw: "Southeast Checkpoint"

rows.original: DEAD ROAD E2
rows.raw: "DEAD ROAD E2"

rows.original: Ant-girls wielding swords and wicked-looking hammers bar passage to the east. Unlike their civilian countrywomen, they’re dressed to the nines in well-fit, military uniforms. The other myr don’t pay them much mind, even when they’re stopped and asked to present proof of citizenship. One stern look in your direction tells you all you need to know: they won’t let aliens pass. You’re restricted to this part of the city.
rows.translation: 手持长剑和狰狞战锤的蚁女挡住了向东的通路。与她们的平民同胞不同，这些人穿着剪裁合身的军装，打扮得一丝不苟。其他米尔人并不太在意她们，就算被拦下来要求出示公民身份证明也一样。她们朝你投来的一道严厉目光已经说明了一切：她们不会允许外星人通过。你的活动范围只限于城市这一带。

The other myr don’t pay them much mind, even when they’re stopped and asked to present proof of citizenship. rows.original: DEAD ROAD E2
rows.raw: "DEAD ROAD E2"

rows.original: Black-Paved Path
rows.raw: "Black-Paved Path"

rows.original: This onyx roadway links the elevator at the center of the mushroom park to another glittering road a ways to the east. What few buildings to the north face this street seem to be smaller, private dwellings, but to the south, a medical structure of interlinked, rounded spires looms. At its base, a pair of crystal doors swing, frequented by wounded or sicked myr.
rows.translation: 这条缟玛瑙色道路连接着蘑菇公园中央的升降梯和东边稍远处的另一条闪亮大道。北侧面朝街道的寥寥几栋建筑似乎都是较小的私人住宅，南边则耸立着一座由多座圆形尖塔相连而成的医疗设施。底部一对水晶门不断开合，负伤或患病的米尔人频繁进出。

What few buildings to the north face this street seem to be smaller, private dwellings, but to the south, a medical structure of interlinked, rounded spires looms. At its base, a pair of crystal doors swing, frequented by wounded or sicked myr."

rows.original: Black-Paved Path
rows.raw: "Black-Paved Path"

rows.original: This sable street bridges Girella’s Avenue and the elevator at the center of this part of the city. If you look far into the cavern, you can see other similar elevators, likely linking up to some of the other airfields that make up the DMZ. Large numbers of Myr are streaming to the northwest, towards a number of bright lights. South of here, there’s a crystal fence around a yard of mushrooms. It reminds you of an alien version of a football field.
rows.translation: 这条乌黑的街道连接着吉蕾拉大道和城中这一带中央的升降梯。朝洞穴深处望去，你还能看到其他类似的升降梯，它们可能分别通往组成非军事区的其他机场。大批米尔人正涌向西北方的一片明亮灯光。南边有一道水晶围栏，围住一片长满蘑菇的院子，让你联想到异星版的足球场。
rows.raw: "This sable street bridges Girella’s Avenue and the elevator at the center of this part of the city. It reminds you of an alien version of a football field."

rows.original: Black-Paved Path
rows.raw: "Black-Paved Path"

rows.original: Groups of gold myr soldiers, resplendent with their freshly issued military garb and gleaming weapons, march past you, heading north on their way to wall. Some bear fear in their inky eyes, but others brows are furrowed with determination. You can’t say that you envy them. Trench combat isn’t a fate you’d wish on anyone - well... maybe your cousin. The city gates lie north, the great elevator to the south.
rows.translation: 一队队金米尔士兵穿着刚配发的光鲜军服、扛着闪亮的武器，从你身旁列队经过，向北赶赴城墙。有些人墨色的眼中带着恐惧，另一些人却坚定地皱着眉。你可一点也不羡慕她们。堑壕战这种命运你不会希望任何人遭遇——好吧……也许你的表亲除外。城门在北边，大升降梯在南边。

Some bear fear in their inky eyes, but others brows are furrowed with determination. You can’t say that you envy them. Trench combat isn’t a fate you’d wish on anyone - well... maybe your cousin. The city gates lie north, the great elevator to the south."

rows.original: Silken Serenity
rows.raw: "Silken Serenity"

rows.original: Palace Entrance
rows.raw: "Palace Entrance"

rows.original: The gold myr guards on either side of the palace’s entrance eye you coolly, their hands resting on the hilts of what appear to be giant, ceremonial sledgehammers. They do not move to block your passage, but you get the distinct feeling than any untoward move on your part would result in a swift ass-kicking or a whole mess of trouble. Just to the north is a broad street. Inside the structure to the south is an impressive, vaulted hall, complete with marble flooring embroidered carpets.
rows.translation: 宫殿入口两侧的金米尔卫兵冷冷地打量着你，双手搭在看似巨型礼仪大锤的柄上。她们没有上前阻拦，但你强烈感觉到，自己若有任何不轨之举，不是立刻挨一顿狠揍，就是惹上一大堆麻烦。北边紧邻一条宽阔街道。南边建筑内部是一座气派的拱顶大厅，铺着大理石地面与刺绣地毯。

rows.original: Palace Hall
rows.raw: "Palace Hall"

rows.original: This palace’s central hall sits beneath an impressively vaulted ceiling of white marble. The floor is hewn from the same material, decorated in places with resplendent carpets. Posts for displaying works of art or other valuables ring the area, their charges long gone, perhaps stowed away to protect them from danger or sold to support the war effort. An open entrance to the north leads back into the city. There are a number of other doorways in just about every direction, but all are guarded fiercely.
rows.translation: 宫殿中央大厅上方是令人惊叹的白色大理石拱顶。地面也由同种材料凿成，几处铺着华美的地毯。用于陈列艺术品或其他贵重物品的展台环绕四周，但展品早已不见，也许是为免遭危险而被收存起来，也可能被卖掉支援战争。北边敞开的入口通回城里。其他各个方向还有不少门，但无一不受到严密把守。

rows.original: Irellia’s Chambers
rows.raw: "Irellia’s Chambers"

rows.original: Flickering blue lights bathe the chamber in gentle, subdued tones. A closer glance reveals the light sources aren’t lights at all, but small terrariums housing tiny glowing mushrooms and exotic bugs that pulse with their own luminance. Curtains block her other rooms from view, though you spot a shower to the south behind a curtain tall enough to hide a giant. The main hall lies west, past a doorway and a pair of guards.
rows.translation: 摇曳的蓝光为房间染上柔和沉静的色调。仔细一看，光源根本不是灯，而是一个个小型生态缸，里面养着微微发光的蘑菇和会自行闪烁的奇异昆虫。帘幕遮住了其他房间，不过南边有一道高得足以藏住巨人的帘子，你从后面瞥见了一间淋浴室。穿过西边的门口和一对卫兵就是主厅。

A closer glance reveals the light sources aren’t lights at all, but small terrariums housing tiny glowing mushrooms and exotic bugs that pulse with their own luminance. rows.original: The Honey Nozzle
rows.raw: "The Honey Nozzle"

rows.original: Flickering fluorescent tubes illuminate this surprisingly well-kept club, bathing its stone-worked interior in hues that range from dulcet to garish. Plenty of tables have been set up, but most are empty. The bulk of the crowd is over by the bars - all three of them, served by dapper-looking males, or surrounding the expansive, stone-carved stage that protrudes into the center of the chamber. A sturdy set of stones leads east back to the street.
rows.translation: 闪烁的荧光灯管照亮这家维护得出奇好的俱乐部，让石砌内部在柔和与刺眼的各色光彩间变换。这里摆了许多桌子，但大多空着。人群主要聚在吧台旁——足足有三个吧台，全由衣着考究的男性服务——或围在那座伸向大厅中央、由石头雕出的宽阔舞台周围。一段坚固的石阶向东通回街道。

rows.original:
The airfield in Kressia is much like the one you saw at the DMZ, a wide open tarmac full of military-colored, armed aircraft. Between you and the terminal are several armed guards, more red-chitined myrmedion with rifles resting on their shoulder. Unlike those found at the DMZ, though, these women have their masks slung on their belts, revealing actually quite attractive faces etched with stern expressions. Behind them sits a huge, glass-domed building - the access down to Kressia.

A few red myr civilians gather up passengers for the next flight out, while others usher you towards the terminal to the west.
rows.translation:
克蕾西亚的机场和你在非军事区见过的很相似：一片开阔的停机坪上停满涂着军用色彩的武装飞行器。你和航站楼之间站着几名武装卫兵，又是些红色甲壳、肩扛步枪的米尔密耳冬。与非军事区那些人不同，这些女人把面具挂在腰带上，露出其实颇为漂亮、却写满严肃神情的脸。她们身后是一座巨大的玻璃穹顶建筑——通往地下克蕾西亚的入口。

几名红米尔平民正为下一班离港航班招揽乘客，其他人则引导你前往西边的航站楼。

rows.original:
The inside of the airfield terminal is more of the same from the outside: armed guards standing around, passively watching the crowd going in and out. You’re shuffled into a line and your documents examined, treated just like any other myr coming through. After a short check, you’re cleared to come and go from the city.

To the west lie several long elevator shafts down to the city proper. Stepping a little closer, you can see the dizzying drop down to the hollowed-out depths that support the myr city. Dozens of tiny lights flicker in the darkness, a field of tiny yellow specks in the distance.

The tarmac doors are to the east, opening and closing in quick succession as uniformed myr soldiers and wealthy-looking civilians of both colors come and go.
rows.translation:
机场航站楼内部与外面大同小异：武装卫兵四处站岗，漠然注视着进出的人群。你被赶进队伍，证件接受检查，待遇和任何经过这里的米尔人没什么两样。简短核验后，你获准自由进出城市。

西边有几条长长的升降梯井通往城市主体。稍微靠近，你就能看见那令人眩晕的落差，一路深入支撑米尔城市的中空地下深处。数十点微光在黑暗中闪烁，宛如远方一片细小的黄色星海。

停机坪大门在东边，随着穿制服的米尔士兵和两色都有、衣着富贵的平民来来往往而接连迅速开合。

rows.original:
This building is a wide open, gorgeously adorned terminal that looks like it might belong more in Old Earth’s roaring twenties than the spartan alien city deep underground. Light streams down from huge chandeliers, and the few armed guards around are vastly overwhelmed by streams of both red and gold myr coming and going from the surface, plus more than a few U.G.C. scouts and pioneers lounging around in cafes and on benches.

A huge glass dome makes up the ceiling, giving anyone with the desire to look a particularly impressive view of the huge, hollowed-out shaft that connects Kressia to the surface. You can see many elevators coming down and going up and going down, all packed with people.
rows.translation:
这是一座宽敞开阔、装潢华丽的航站楼，与其说属于地下深处那座简朴的异星城市，倒不如说像来自旧地球喧嚣的二十年代。巨型枝形吊灯洒下光芒，寥寥几名武装卫兵完全淹没在往返地表的红、金米尔人潮中，还有不少银河联合邦联的侦察员和开拓者在咖啡馆与长椅上闲坐。

巨大的玻璃穹顶构成天花板，让任何愿意抬头的人都能欣赏连接克蕾西亚与地表的巨大中空竖井。你能看到许多升降梯满载人群，上上下下，往来不息。

rows.original:
The gates that separate Kressia from the trenchlines outside are newly erected, sliding gates supporting rolls of concertina wire. A couple of soldiers are standing to either side, each with a full trench coat and gas mask set. The rest of the city looms large to the north. To the south, through the gates, you see a heavy concrete bunker facing the trenches.

Seeing you about, the guards offer to open the gates and let you by.

A huge concrete bunker stands between the gates and the trenches, bristling with weapons bolted into the firing ports.
rows.translation:
分隔克蕾西亚与外围战壕区的城门是新近搭建的，上方架着一卷卷蛇腹形铁丝网的滑动门。两侧各站着几名士兵，每人都配有全套堑壕大衣和防毒面具。城市其余部分在北边巍然展开。透过南边的城门，你能看到一座面朝战壕的厚重混凝土碉堡。

卫兵看见你在附近，主动表示可以开门放你过去。

一座巨大的混凝土碉堡立在城门与战壕之间，射击孔中固定着密密麻麻的武器。

rows.original: The pillbox guarding the gates of Kressia is a small but surprisingly cozy accommodation. The central chamber’s got several carpets and cushions spread out, and some chairs lining the walls. A viewport gives a wide view of the craggy approach to Kressia, interrupted by a trio of heavy machine-guns bolted to the concrete.
rows.translation: 守卫克蕾西亚城门的碉堡虽然不大，内部却出奇舒适。中央房间铺着几张地毯和软垫，墙边摆有椅子。一扇观察窗提供了通往克蕾西亚崎岖道路的广阔视野，只是视线被三挺固定在混凝土上的重机枪打断。

The central chamber’s got several carpets and cushions spread out, and some chairs lining the walls. A viewport gives a wide view of the craggy approach to Kressia, interrupted by a trio of heavy machine-guns bolted to the concrete."

rows.original: A long street connects a bustling city square to the airfield. Several strange, boxy-looking primitive vehicles zip by you on the road. Most are open-faced, carrying myr of both colors wearing goggles and caps to protect their eyes and feelers. The city center lies to the west of you, and the terminal entrance to the east.
rows.translation: 一条长街连接着热闹的城市广场与机场。几辆外形古怪、四四方方的原始车辆从你身旁飞驰而过。大多是敞篷车，载着两种颜色的米尔人；她们戴着护目镜和帽子，以保护眼睛与触须。市中心在西边，航站楼入口在东边。

Most are open-faced, carrying myr of both colors wearing goggles and caps to protect their eyes and feelers. The city center lies to the west of you, and the terminal entrance to the east."

rows.original: A T-bone intersection in the road connects three streets in front of a row of apartments and a colorfully-adorned candy store. The street sign indicates the city airfield lies to the east, and the road to Gildenmere to the south.
rows.translation: 公寓楼和一家装饰得五彩缤纷的糖果店前，三条街道组成了一个丁字路口。路牌显示城市机场在东边，通往吉尔登米尔的道路在南边。

rows.raw: "Street"

rows.original:
Civilian traffic here is starting to give way to Federation military presence. While the military seems to be trying to keep to themselves here in town, you can see a few sandbag redoubts up ahead as well as parked armored cars bearing heavy machineguns on turrets. They seem to be defending a northern tunnel that branches off further west.

Several Federation infantrymen and officers are walking to and fro here. Whenever they see them, gold myr pedestrians cross to the other side of the street.
rows.translation:
这里的平民交通开始让位于联邦的军事存在。军队虽似乎尽量不打扰城内居民，但你仍能看到前方几处沙袋掩体，以及停放着的装甲车，其炮塔上架着重机枪。它们似乎在防守一条从更西边分出的北向隧道。

几名联邦步兵和军官在此来回走动。金米尔路人每次看见他们，都会穿到街道另一侧。

Whenever they see them, gold myr pedestrians cross to the other side of the street."

rows.original: The street here is largely devoid of anybody. The locals of Kressia seem to avoid the area, leaving the street barren. Those that do have to come this way hurry past a huge, wrought iron gate to the north, built into the edge of the bowl-like Kressia cavern. A smaller tunnel leads off beyond the gate towards a large manor house built in its own, smaller cavern. Several cars, including a few painted in a military fashion, are parked along the tunnel walls, and a handful of soldiers are walking to and from the mansion.
rows.translation: 这里的街道几乎空无一人。克蕾西亚当地人似乎有意避开这一带，让街面显得一片荒凉。那些不得不经过此处的人，也会匆匆走过北边那扇嵌在碗形洞穴边缘的巨大锻铁门。门后是一条较小的隧道，通向建在另一座小洞穴中的大庄园。隧道壁旁停着好几辆汽车，其中几辆涂有军用色彩；还有少数士兵往返于宅邸。

rows.translation: 这里的平民交通开始让位于联邦的军事存在。军队虽似乎尽量不打扰城内居民，但你仍能看到前方几处沙袋掩体，以及停放着的装甲车，其炮塔上架着重机枪。它们似乎在防守一条从更东边分出的北向隧道。\n\n街边开着几家精致气派的小店，包括钟表店、裁缝店和一家时髦咖啡馆，吸引了好几位富裕的金米尔人。
rows.raw: "Civilian traffic here is starting to give way to Federation military presence. While the military seems to be trying to keep to themselves here in town, you can see a few sandbag redoubts up ahead as well as parked armored cars bearing heavy machineguns on turrets. They seem to be defending a northern tunnel that branches off further east.\\n\\nSeveral small, posh-looking shops are set up along the street here, including watchmakers and dressmakers and a trendy cafe that seems to be attracting several wealthy gold myr."

rows.original: Street
rows.raw: "Street"

rows.original: The corner of the street gives way to a huge, marble structure that dives down into the earth, connected to the sidewalk by a sweeping marble staircase. A large sign touts it as the city bath house.
rows.translation: 街角让位于一座向地下延伸的巨大大理石建筑，一道宽阔的大理石阶梯将其与人行道相连。巨大的招牌宣称这里是城市浴场。
rows.raw: "The corner of the street gives way to a huge, marble structure that dives down into the earth, connected to the sidewalk by a sweeping marble staircase. A large sign touts it as the city bath house."

rows.original: Street
rows.raw: "Street"

rows.original: The street here is lined with shops, varying from “expensive” to “decadent”.
rows.translation: 街道两旁店铺林立，档次从“昂贵”一路高到“奢靡”。
rows.raw: "The street here is lined with shops, varying from “expensive” to “decadent”."

rows.original: Street
rows.raw: "Street"

rows.original:
The storefronts here are largely abandoned. The reason’s obvious: some huge explosion caved in a part of the cavern ceiling. A light beam shoots down from the hole in the cave roof onto the floor and several destroyed stores.

A footpath off to the east leads into the city park, called “Queen’s Solace”.
rows.translation:
这里沿街的店面大多已经废弃。原因显而易见：一场猛烈爆炸震塌了部分洞顶。一束光从洞顶缺口射下，照在地面和几家被毁的商店上。

东边有一条步道通往城市公园，名叫“女王之慰”。

A light beam shoots down from the hole in the cave roof onto the floor and several destroyed stores.\n\nA footpath off to the east leads into the city park, called “Queen’s Solace”."

rows.original: Street
rows.raw: "Street"

rows.original: More Federation soldiers are standing around here, perhaps a squad’s worth, all armed. They seem fairly relaxed, though, and give you friendly nods as you pass by. Still, most gold myr who come by avoid the guards here, scurrying by with eyes down at their feet.
rows.translation: 更多联邦士兵站在这里，大约有一个班，而且全副武装。不过他们看起来相当放松，你经过时还会友好地点头示意。即便如此，经过这里的金米尔人大多仍会避开卫兵，低头盯着脚下匆匆走过。
rows.raw: "More Federation soldiers are standing around here, perhaps a squad’s worth, all armed. They seem fairly relaxed, though, and give you friendly nods as you pass by. Still, most gold myr who come by avoid the guards here, scurrying by with eyes down at their feet."

rows.original: Street
rows.raw: "Street"

rows.original:
The corner of the street here is built into the side of the cave, with jagged rock overlooking the road. Electric lights flicker dimly over a short, aborted tunnel that seems to have intended to go westward. A sign indicates that a new shopping mall would be here next year, followed by another sign that says construction is canceled due to the declaration of war.

The city gates lie to the south-east, and the airfield to the northeast, a directional sign points out.

One of the signs on the merchant row indicates a “Survival Shop”. Some Federation soldiers are coming in and out of it, arms full of warm-looking clothing or admiring knives, guns, and axes.
rows.translation:
这里的街角嵌在洞穴侧壁，崎岖岩石俯临道路。昏暗闪烁的电灯照着一条短短的废弃隧道，它似乎原本打算向西延伸。一块标牌表示明年这里将建起新的购物中心，紧随其后的另一块却说工程因宣战而取消。

方向牌指出，城门在东南方，机场在东北方。

商店街的一块招牌写着“生存用品店”。一些联邦士兵进进出出，有人怀抱着看起来很暖和的衣物，有人则在欣赏刀具、枪械和斧头。

rows.original: Street
rows.raw: "Street"

rows.original: This street is narrow and almost completely devoid of traffic. Nobody seems to want to venture too close to the city gates, likely because of the Federation garrison there. Some graffiti decorates the smaller shops here, many of which have closed.
rows.translation: 这条街很窄，几乎完全没有人流。似乎谁也不愿过分靠近城门，想必是因为那里驻扎着联邦军队。涂鸦装点着这里较小的商店，其中许多已经关门。
rows.raw: "This street is narrow and almost completely devoid of traffic. Nobody seems to want to venture too close to the city gates, likely because of the Federation garrison there. Some graffiti decorates the smaller shops here, many of which have closed."

rows.original: Street
rows.raw: "Street"

rows.original: A four-way intersection leads south to the city gates, north to the Queen’s Solace city park, and east towards Kressia’s airfield. A large series of dirt-filled trenches decorate the corners just off the sidewalks, filled with some very pretty, pink-glowing fungi.
rows.translation: 一个十字路口向南通往城门，向北通往“女王之慰”城市公园，向东则前往克蕾西亚机场。人行道外侧的各个街角挖着一连串填满泥土的长沟，里面长满了非常漂亮、散发粉色光芒的真菌。
rows.raw: "A four-way intersection leads south to the city gates, north to the Queen’s Solace city park, and east towards Kressia’s airfield. A large series of dirt-filled trenches decorate the corners just off the sidewalks, filled with some very pretty, pink-glowing fungi."

rows.original: Street
rows.raw: "Street"

rows.original: The street here is largely dominated by a parked Federation army vehicle that looks like a cross between a tank and a fuel truck, and reeks of promethium. A handful of red myr troops are huddled around the vehicle, squabbling over how to repair it.
rows.translation: 街道几乎被一辆停放的联邦军车占据，那东西看起来像坦克和油罐车的混合体，还散发着浓烈的钷味。几名红米尔士兵围在车辆旁，为该怎么修好它争执不休。
rows.raw: "The street here is largely dominated by a parked Federation army vehicle that looks like a cross between a tank and a fuel truck, and reeks of promethium. A handful of red myr troops are huddled around the vehicle, squabbling over how to repair it."

rows.raw: "Street"

rows.raw: "FAZIAN_RESCUE_ROOM"

rows.original: FAZIAN_RESCUE_ROOM
rows.raw: "FAZIAN_RESCUE_ROOM"

rows.original: A corner store here offers massages, hair treatments, and honey milkings for cheap. It seems to be closed at the moment, though, and most of its windows are covered with recruitment posters for the Republic Defense Force. Graffiti on the walls condemns the Federation occupation, and the war in general.
rows.translation: 街角的一家店以低价提供按摩、美发护理和蜂蜜挤取服务。不过此刻似乎没有营业，大部分窗户都贴满共和国防卫军的征兵海报。墙上的涂鸦谴责联邦占领，也谴责这场战争本身。

It seems to be closed at the moment, though, and most of its windows are covered with recruitment posters for the Republic Defense Force. Graffiti on the walls condemns the Federation occupation, and the war in general."

rows.original: A large building to the east advertises a “thollum,” a titanic domed structure that reaches several stories high, almost half way up to the ceiling of the great cavern. Several marble statues stand proudly along the steps up to the doors, many carrying books or scrolls.
rows.translation: 东边一座巨型建筑自称“托勒姆”，那是一座高达数层的庞大穹顶建筑，几乎延伸到大洞穴一半的高度。通往大门的阶梯两旁傲然矗立着数尊大理石雕像，其中许多手持书本或卷轴。
rows.raw: "A large building to the east advertises a “thollum,” a titanic domed structure that reaches several stories high, almost half way up to the ceiling of the great cavern. Several marble statues stand proudly along the steps up to the doors, many carrying books or scrolls."

rows.original: Street
rows.raw: "Street"

rows.original: This street has a small footpath branching off towards a city park, labeled “Queen’s Solace”. A lot of gold myr are hanging around here, coming and going from several housing blocks off to the east and north.
rows.translation: 这条街分出一条通往城市公园的步道，标牌上写着“女王之慰”。许多金米尔人在附近逗留，从东面和北面的几栋住宅楼中进进出出。
rows.raw: "This street has a small footpath branching off towards a city park, labeled “Queen’s Solace”. A lot of gold myr are hanging around here, coming and going from several housing blocks off to the east and north."

rows.original: Street
rows.raw: "Street"

rows.original: This street connects the main thoroughfare in the north with the road to the city gates down south. A sign indicates Kressia’s airfield lies to the northeast, and the city park to the southwest.
rows.translation: 这条街连接北边的主干道和南边通往城门的道路。路牌显示克蕾西亚机场在东北方，城市公园在西南方。
rows.raw: "This street connects the main thoroughfare in the north with the road to the city gates down south. A sign indicates Kressia’s airfield lies to the northeast, and the city park to the southwest."

rows.original: Street
rows.raw: "Street"

rows.original: The edge of the bowl-like cavern that Kressia lies in approaches, culminating in a long, windling tunnel leading south. A pair of a large, wrought-iron gates covered in concertina wire have been erected south of you, and several Scarlet Federation soldiers patrol the road. While they’ve gone to great lengths to disguise them, you can see a few pillboxes tucked into nearby alleyways, or sandbagged machinegun nests in the windows of an abandoned apartment building.
rows.translation: 克蕾西亚所在碗形洞穴的边缘逐渐逼近，最终收束为一条蜿蜒向南的长隧道。你南边立着一对覆盖蛇腹形铁丝网的大型锻铁门，几名猩红联邦士兵正在道路上巡逻。他们煞费苦心地加以伪装，但你仍能看到几座藏在附近小巷中的碉堡，以及废弃公寓窗内用沙袋垒起的机枪阵地。
rows.raw: "The edge of the bowl-like cavern that Kressia lies in approaches, culminating in a long, windling tunnel leading south. A pair of a large, wrought-iron gates covered in concertina wire have been erected south of you, and several Scarlet Federation soldiers patrol the road. While they’ve gone to great lengths to disguise them, you can see a few pillboxes tucked into nearby alleyways, or sandbagged machinegun nests in the windows of an abandoned apartment building."

rows.original: Street
rows.raw: "Street"

rows.original: The Queen’s Solace park is quiet and relaxing, much less crowded than the rest of the city you’ve seen so far. A busker is playing some strange wind instrument to herself, and several small children are traipsing about under a caregiver’s supervision.
rows.translation: “女王之慰”公园宁静而舒适，比你目前见过的城市其他区域清静得多。一名街头艺人独自吹奏着某种奇怪的管乐器，几个小孩则在看护者的照看下到处蹦跳。
rows.raw: "The Queen’s Solace park is quiet and relaxing, much less crowded than the rest of the city you’ve seen so far. A busker is playing some strange wind instrument to herself, and several small children are traipsing about under a caregiver’s supervision."

rows.original: red myr
rows.raw: "red myr"

rows.original: Seeing you coming, the women gather up the children and scoot them off before you get too close.
rows.translation: 看到你走来，那些女人连忙把孩子们聚到一起，赶在你靠近前带他们离开。
rows.raw: " Seeing you coming, the women gather up the children and scoot them off before you get too close."

rows.raw: "Street"

rows.original: The Queen’s Solace park is quiet and relaxing, much less crowded than the rest of the city you’ve seen so far. A large fountain stands here, depicting several gold myr women with huge breasts spraying arcs of water rather than nectar. A few off-duty Federation soldiers are standing near it, giggling to each other and pointing at the statues’ tits.
rows.translation: “女王之慰”公园宁静而舒适，比你目前见过的城市其他区域清静得多。这里立着一座大喷泉，描绘几名乳房硕大的金米尔女人，只是喷出弧形水柱的并非花蜜。几名休假的联邦士兵站在旁边，一边窃笑，一边指着雕像的奶子。
rows.raw: "The Queen’s Solace park is quiet and relaxing, much less crowded than the rest of the city you’ve seen so far. A large fountain stands here, depicting several gold myr women with huge breasts spraying arcs of water rather than nectar. A few off-duty Federation soldiers are standing near it, giggling to each other and pointing at the statues’ tits."

rows.original: Street
rows.raw: "Street"

rows.original: The Queen’s Solace park is quiet and relaxing, much less crowded than the rest of the city you’ve seen so far. Several myr of both gold and red persuasions are lounging around, clearly avoiding each other but all making the most of the fungal gardens and quiet ambience.
rows.translation: “女王之慰”公园宁静而舒适，比你目前见过的城市其他区域清静得多。几名金、红两色米尔人在此休憩，显然彼此避让，却都尽情享受着真菌花园和宁静氛围。
rows.raw: "The Queen’s Solace park is quiet and relaxing, much less crowded than the rest of the city you’ve seen so far. Several myr of both gold and red persuasions are lounging around, clearly avoiding each other but all making the most of the fungal gardens and quiet ambience."

rows.original: Street
rows.raw: "Street"

rows.original: The Queen’s Solace park is quiet and relaxing, much less crowded than the rest of the city you’ve seen so far. Several gold myr are gathered around, reading a variety of books and taking turns reading passages aloud.
rows.translation: “女王之慰”公园宁静而舒适，比你目前见过的城市其他区域清静得多。几名金米尔人聚在一起阅读各种书籍，轮流高声朗诵段落。
rows.raw: "The Queen’s Solace park is quiet and relaxing, much less crowded than the rest of the city you’ve seen so far. Several gold myr are gathered around, reading a variety of books and taking turns reading passages aloud."

rows.original: KRESSIA MEDICAL
rows.raw: "KRESSIA MEDICAL"

rows.original:
You can see that a statue once stood here, some sort of towering marble monument that stretched up to the heights of the cavern. A pair of stone hands still grasp the craggy top of the cavern, chiseled off from the wrists down. Its feet still stand on a wide pedestal, surrounded by rubble and what you assume to be some sort of police line, cordoning it off. Graffiti has been sprayed over the marble in spite of the warnings, which your translator quickly shifts to messages like “Fuck the Reds!” and “Go home Federation!”

Several gold myr are milling around, sitting in benches and reading. A few military police stand in the background, mostly out of sight but keeping an eye on the statue for possible vandalism.
rows.translation:
你看得出这里过去曾立着一尊雕像，那似乎是一座高耸的大理石纪念碑，一直延伸到洞穴高处。一双石手依然抓着崎岖的洞顶，却从手腕以下被凿断。它的双脚也仍立在宽阔基座上，周围散落着碎石，还围着你猜测是警戒线之类的东西。尽管有警告，大理石上仍被喷满涂鸦，你的翻译器很快将其转换成“操死红佬！”和“联邦滚回家！”之类的信息。

几名金米尔人在附近闲晃，坐在长椅上看书。几名宪兵待在背景中，大多藏在视线之外，但仍盯着雕像以防有人破坏。

A few military police stand in the background, mostly out of sight but keeping an eye on the statue for possible vandalism."

rows.original: A sign has been posted up outside one of the buildings here, labeling it as a “Federation Supply and Trading Post. Offworlders, inquire within.” Several other planet-rushers are coming and going from the building, in addition to red myr troops - and even a few golds.

rows.original: Kressia Survival Shop
rows.raw: "Kressia Survival Shop"

rows.original: The shop’s interior is rather small, but surprisingly cozy compared to the uncomfortably cool city outside. A fire crackles in a hearth against the west wall, just beside a staircase that leads up to another floor. The shop’s main show floor is a haphazard array of display cases and clothing racks laden with military-style jackets and coats. A few primitive firearms are on offer under a glass case, though there’s plenty of knives, hatchets, and swords for you to peruse.
rows.translation: 店铺内部相当狭小，但与外面寒气逼人的城市相比却出奇温馨。西墙壁炉里的火焰噼啪作响，旁边就是通往上一层的楼梯。商店主要展区杂乱摆着陈列柜和衣架，上面挂满军装风格的夹克与大衣。玻璃柜下出售少量原始枪械，不过也有许多刀、短柄斧和长剑供你挑选。

rows.original: Bath Walk
rows.raw: "Bath Walk"

rows.original:
The corner of the street gives way to a huge, marble structure that dives down into the earth, connected to the sidewalk by a sweeping marble staircase. A large sign touts it as the city bath house.

The bath house is open for business, it seems. Several people are wandering in and out, a healthy mix of both gold and red myr. The golds you see on the marble stairs are in various states of undress, some naked outright and others in skimpy robes that leave little to the imagination. Their red counterparts take in the view with as much arousal as disdain.
rows.translation:
街角让位于一座向地下延伸的巨大大理石建筑，一道宽阔的大理石阶梯将其与人行道相连。巨大的招牌宣称这里是城市浴场。

浴场似乎正在营业。好些人进进出出，其中红、金米尔人比例相当均衡。你在大理石阶梯上看到的金米尔人衣着程度各异，有些全身赤裸，另一些则披着几乎遮不住什么的单薄浴袍。红米尔同伴欣赏着这幅景色，眼中的欲望与鄙夷不相上下。

rows.original: Bath House Foyer
rows.raw: "Bath House Foyer"

rows.original:
The main room of the bath house is as opulent as you might have expected from a gold myr palace of pleasure: the structure seems to be made entirely of polished marble, gleaming white in the flicker of the electric lights mounted in the chandeliers. Despite the technological apparatus illuminating the hall, several sconces full of candles burn in alcoves set in regular intervals along the walls. The air is heavy with the luxurious smells of burning incense, bath salts, and just a hint of rich honey.

Myr of both colorations are lounging around the lobby, either waiting their turns for the baths or wrapped up in toasty bathrobes after a dip. While most are keeping themselves discreetly segregated, there are a few red myr enjoying the attentions of their golden trench wives, or free golds flirtatiously teasing unsuspecting Federation soldiers.

A matronly gold myr woman in a revealing white robe stands behind a simple stone desk near the front door, her pillowy lips turned up into an ever-present smile. The hood of her robe is drawn up, and a veil covers her eyes down to the ridge of her nose, effectively blinding her. She seems to be the person you’d talk to about using the facilities here.
rows.translation:
浴场主厅如你对金米尔欢愉宫殿的预期一般奢华：建筑仿佛完全由抛光大理石打造，在枝形吊灯上的电灯闪烁下泛着洁白光泽。尽管大厅由科技设备照明，墙壁上等距分布的壁龛中仍有装满蜡烛的烛台燃烧着。空气中弥漫着燃香、浴盐的奢华气味，还有一丝浓郁蜂蜜的芬芳。

两种颜色的米尔人都在大厅里休息，要么等待轮到自己入浴，要么泡完澡后裹着暖和的浴袍。大多数人谨慎地彼此隔开，但也有少数红米尔人在享受金色战壕妻子的侍奉，或是自由金米尔人挑逗着毫无防备的联邦士兵。

一名颇具贵妇气质的金米尔女人站在前门附近简朴的石桌后，身穿暴露的白色长袍，柔软丰润的嘴唇始终挂着微笑。她拉起了长袍兜帽，面纱遮住双眼直至鼻梁，完全阻断了她的视线。想使用这里的设施，似乎就该找她交谈。

rows.original: Path To Manor
rows.raw: "Path To Manor"

rows.original:
You find a major road that leads away from the rest of the city, to an open part of the cavern where you can clearly see an impressive manor illuminated by countless lights around and above it. The façade clearly once bore all manner of decorations and expressions of architectural cleverness, but much of that was blasted away in the invasion. The occupying forces have made an effort to clean up the mess and shore up the building’s integrity, but it does not look as though restoring the more gaudy elements of its design is a priority.

The Federation presence is much stronger here, and only thickens farther up the path. Something tells you that while the ostentatious abode was likely built for a queen, whoever is residing there now has far different affiliations. You’ll likely encounter at least one security check if you continue north toward the manor.
rows.translation:
你发现一条远离城市其余部分的主路，通往洞穴中的一片开阔区域；在那里，你可以清楚看到一座令人印象深刻的庄园，四周和上方都被无数灯光照亮。其正面显然曾经布满各种装饰，尽显建筑巧思，但大部分都在入侵中被炸毁。占领军努力清理了废墟并加固建筑结构，却似乎无意优先修复设计中那些更加浮华的部分。

联邦在这里的存在感强得多，越沿路前进就越浓厚。你觉得这座炫耀奢华的宅邸多半是为某位女王而建，但如今的居住者显然属于截然不同的阵营。如果继续向北前往庄园，你很可能至少会遇到一道安检。

rows.original: Manor Entrance
rows.raw: "Manor Entrance"

rows.original: Manor Interior
rows.raw: "Manor Interior"

rows.original:
You enter the manor’s main hall, flanked on all sides by corridors and stairways that lead every which way. Servants make their way through, and you can see the occasional soldier passing by on whatever duties they’re up to.

The front door is to your south, and the main hall continues on northward. Most of the soldiers seem to be filtering in and out of a passage to the west, so you assume something important is that way. Additionally, a large stairway to the east clearly leads down into the cellar.
rows.translation:
你进入庄园主厅，四周全是通往各个方向的走廊与楼梯。仆人们穿行其中，偶尔还能看到士兵忙着各自的任务从旁经过。

大门在南边，主厅继续向北延伸。大多数士兵似乎都从西边的通道进进出出，因此你猜那边一定有什么重要事物。此外，东边一道宽阔楼梯显然通往酒窖。

rows.original: Manor Interior
rows.raw: "Manor Interior"

rows.original:
Continuing along, you find yourself in an absolutely breathtaking high-ceilinged section of the main hall, with doors and rooms along the sides and sweeping arches above that serve as both decoration and architectural support. Small, dim lightbulbs dangle from strings that criss-cross the ceiling like an intricate web, which you find an ironic design choice considering the Terran insect which springs to your mind upon thinking of myr. The effect is profound and impressive, however: it’s like walking through a twilit valley, with the faint stars just appearing above your head. You imagine this level of lighting is more comfortable for the subterranean myr.

The corridor continues along in both directions, with the main rooms to the south of you and the more private sections in the back.
rows.translation:
继续前行，你来到主厅中一段美得令人窒息的高顶区域。两侧分布着门与房间，上方横跨的宽阔拱架既是装饰，也是建筑支撑。细小昏暗的灯泡悬在纵横交错的线绳上，宛如一张精巧蛛网；想到米尔人时，你脑中浮现的泰拉昆虫令这种设计显得颇具讽刺意味。不过效果确实深刻而惊艳：仿佛漫步在暮色山谷，淡淡星光刚在头顶显现。你想，这样的亮度对居于地下的米尔人应该更加舒适。

走廊向两个方向继续延伸，主要房间位于你南边，更私密的区域则在后方。

rows.original: Manor Interior
rows.raw: "Manor Interior"

rows.original:
You’re in the far end of the manor’s main hall, at the back of the building. This section is where the larger, more opulent private rooms are located. It’s far quieter here than in the other areas of the building. You see a few maids and servants flittering about, cleaning or straightening things which already seemed impeccably neat to you. Perhaps they just find it prudent to look busy.

The master bedroom is to the east. If you go south, you can head back down to the rest of the manor.
rows.translation:
你身处庄园主厅的最深处，也就是建筑后方。这一带分布着更宽敞、更奢华的私人房间，比建筑其他区域安静许多。几名女仆和佣人在周围轻快走动，清洁或整理着在你看来已经无可挑剔的东西。也许她们只是觉得装出忙碌的样子比较明智。

主卧室在东边。向南走则能返回庄园其他区域。

rows.translation: 你身处庄园主厅的最深处，也就是建筑后方。这一带分布着更宽敞、更奢华的私人房间，比建筑其他区域安静许多。几名女仆和佣人在周围轻快走动，清洁或整理着在你看来已经无可挑剔的东西。也许她们只是觉得装出忙碌的样子比较明智。\n\n主卧室在东边。向南走则能返回庄园其他区域。
rows.raw: "You’re in the far end of the manor’s main hall, at the back of the building. This section is where the larger, more opulent private rooms are located. It’s far quieter here than in the other areas of the building. You see a few maids and servants flittering about, cleaning or straightening things which already seemed impeccably neat to you. Perhaps they just find it prudent to look busy.\\n\\nThe master bedroom is to the east. If you go south, you can head back down to the rest of the manor."

rows.original: Master Bedroom
rows.raw: "Master Bedroom"

rows.original: The manor’s master bedroom is as opulent as you might expect from the former abode of a gold myr queen: the bed is massive, more than 12 feet long, and set beneath a tremendous canopy. The bedsheets are a luxurious silk, cream white with gemstone patterns inlaid through them. Small statues make up the bedposts, each of a hugely buxom gold myr queen. The walls are inlaid with gold, flickering brilliantly in the light of a crystal chandelier.
rows.translation: 庄园主卧室的奢华程度正如一位金米尔女王的旧居应有的模样：床铺极其巨大，长度超过十二英尺，置于硕大的华盖之下。床单由奢华丝绸制成，呈乳白色，并织入宝石图案。床柱由小型雕像构成，每尊都是胸部极其丰满的金米尔女王。墙壁镶着黄金，在水晶枝形吊灯的光线中灿烂闪烁。
rows.raw: "The manor’s master bedroom is as opulent as you might expect from the former abode of a gold myr queen: the bed is massive, more than 12 feet long, and set beneath a tremendous canopy. The bedsheets are a luxurious silk, cream white with gemstone patterns inlaid through them. Small statues make up the bedposts, each of a hugely buxom gold myr queen. The walls are inlaid with gold, flickering brilliantly in the light of a crystal chandelier."

rows.original: Manor Kitchen
rows.raw: "Manor Kitchen"

rows.original: A small kitchen is set up here, equipped with several polished steel utensils, grills, even an electric icebox. There doesn’t appear to be a staff working at present, or any guards for that matter. Still, you can see evidence of several boxes of food stored away.
rows.translation: 这里设有一间小厨房，配备多种抛光钢制厨具、烤架，甚至还有电冰箱。目前似乎没有工作人员，甚至也没有卫兵。不过你能看到好几箱食物储藏在此的痕迹。
rows.raw: "A small kitchen is set up here, equipped with several polished steel utensils, grills, even an electric icebox. There doesn’t appear to be a staff working at present, or any guards for that matter. Still, you can see evidence of several boxes of food stored away."

rows.original: Manor Cellar
rows.raw: "Manor Cellar"

rows.original: At the bottom of the large stairway is a cramped cellar. It might be sort of cheeky to call it a basement, since the entire city is underground, but this area certainly feels more chthonic than everywhere else. The walls, ceiling, and floor are all the same bare stone the place was carved out of. At least the stone seems to have been smoothed over and polished, though the last touch-up was likely decades ago. Lamps are scattered about on wall-mounted sconces every few meters, meaning you can at least see where you’re going. The passages here are more winding and tunnel-like than those upstairs, and many of them have been sealed off. From what you can gather, this cellar runs beneath the entire manor, connecting various rooms with underground accesses and hidden pathways. However, you can only access a small portion of the entire basement, as most of it is sealed off and guarded. This section still sees use as a storage space, however. The manor’s wine cellar is still accessible, although much of its stock was either destroyed or raided by Federation troops during the invasion.
rows.translation: 宽阔楼梯底部是一间狭窄酒窖。整座城市本就位于地下，把这里称为地下室或许有些自作聪明，但这个区域确实比其他地方更有幽冥之感。墙壁、天花板与地面全都是开凿此地时留下的同一种裸岩。至少石面似乎经过磨平和抛光，只不过上一次修整可能已是几十年前。每隔几米，墙装灯座上便散布着灯具，至少让你能够看清道路。 这里的通道比楼上更加曲折，也更像隧道，其中许多已经封闭。根据你的观察，这座酒窖延伸至整座庄园下方，通过地下入口与秘密通道连接各个房间。不过你只能进入整片地下室的一小部分，其余大多都被封死并有人把守。 然而，这一带仍被用作储藏空间。庄园的葡萄酒窖依然可以进入，不过大部分藏酒要么被毁，要么在入侵期间遭联邦部队劫掠。

The manor’s wine cellar is still accessible, although much of its stock was either destroyed or raided by Federation troops during the invasion."

rows.original: Manor War Room
rows.raw: "Manor War Room"

rows.original: Down
rows.raw: "Down"

rows.original: Manor War Room
rows.raw: "Manor War Room"

rows.original: Up
rows.raw: "Up"

rows.original: Narrow Passage
rows.raw: "Narrow Passage"

rows.original: A winding, narrow passage leads between the gates of Kressia, visible to the east, and the winding caves of No Myr’s Land. Sandbags are piled up on either side, and several Federation troops are sitting behind machineguns on tripods. They eye you warily as you pass, but keep their hands well away from their weapons.
rows.translation: 一条蜿蜒狭窄的通道连接着东边依稀可见的克蕾西亚城门与无人米尔地的曲折洞穴。两侧堆满沙袋，几名联邦士兵坐在三脚架机枪后方。你经过时，他们警惕地盯着你，但双手始终远离武器。
rows.raw: "A winding, narrow passage leads between the gates of Kressia, visible to the east, and the winding caves of No Myr’s Land. Sandbags are piled up on either side, and several Federation troops are sitting behind machineguns on tripods. They eye you warily as you pass, but keep their hands well away from their weapons."

rows.original: Narrow Passage
rows.raw: "Narrow Passage"

rows.original: The cave here narrows down to a pinch size, barely wide enough for two people to walk through abreast. This isn’t a natural phenomenon, you think: the sides of the cavern look to have been collapsed by high explosives, then dug out again to make a very narrow passage. You can see several machine guns to the north, all aimed straight for the narrow opening. It would be murder to try and march an army through here!
rows.translation: 这里的洞穴收窄成一个瓶颈，勉强只够两人并肩通过。你认为这并非自然现象：洞穴两侧看起来曾被烈性炸药炸塌，随后又重新挖开，形成一条极窄的通道。你能看到北边有几挺机枪，全都直指狭窄开口。想让一支军队从这里行进，简直是送死！
rows.raw: "The cave here narrows down to a pinch size, barely wide enough for two people to walk through abreast. This isn’t a natural phenomenon, you think: the sides of the cavern look to have been collapsed by high explosives, then dug out again to make a very narrow passage. You can see several machine guns to the north, all aimed straight for the narrow opening. It would be murder to try and march an army through here!"

rows.original: Small Cavern
rows.raw: "Small Cavern"

rows.original: The cavern here makes a three-way intersection, leading east to west and southwards. More than a little debris has been scattered around, evidence of recent battles between the Federation and Republic: shell casings litter the rocky ground, and the stone is stained darkly. Barbed wire and tank traps have been shredded, left as little more than bits of barely-visible metal covered by dust and sand.
rows.translation: 洞穴在这里形成三岔路口，分别通往东、西、南三个方向。四周散落着不少残骸，证明联邦与共和国近期曾在此交战：弹壳遍布岩石地面，石头也染上深色污迹。铁丝网和坦克路障被撕得粉碎，只剩被尘土与沙粒掩埋、几乎看不见的金属碎片。
rows.raw: "The cavern here makes a three-way intersection, leading east to west and southwards. More than a little debris has been scattered around, evidence of recent battles between the Federation and Republic: shell casings litter the rocky ground, and the stone is stained darkly. Barbed wire and tank traps have been shredded, left as little more than bits of barely-visible metal covered by dust and sand."

rows.original: Narrow Passage
rows.raw: "Narrow Passage"

rows.original: A fairly narrow passage connects the road to Kressia to a small foot-path, advertised by a rusty sign as the “scenic route to our lovely capitol,” heading off to the east. You can see evidence of fairly recent traversal, and the foot-path the sign touts has been widened out by pickaxes to make room for armored vehicles to slip through. Several red myr propaganda posters have been plastered to the cavern walls, as well as a large bounty sign for a particularly lethal gold myr sniper whose name is indecipherable.
rows.translation: 一条颇为狭窄的通道连接着前往克蕾西亚的道路与一条小径；一块锈迹斑斑的标牌将向东延伸的小径宣传为“通往我们可爱首都的观光路线”。这里看得出不久前有人通行过，标牌上说的步道也被十字镐拓宽，足以让装甲车辆穿行。洞壁上贴满红米尔宣传海报，还有一张巨额悬赏令，通缉某位极其致命的金米尔狙击手，但她的名字已经无法辨认。
rows.raw: "A fairly narrow passage connects the road to Kressia to a small foot-path, advertised by a rusty sign as the “scenic route to our lovely capitol,” heading off to the east. You can see evidence of fairly recent traversal, and the foot-path the sign touts has been widened out by pickaxes to make room for armored vehicles to slip through. Several red myr propaganda posters have been plastered to the cavern walls, as well as a large bounty sign for a particularly lethal gold myr sniper whose name is indecipherable."

rows.original: Near Kressia
rows.raw: "Near Kressia"

rows.original: To the south, you can see the beginnings of the Scarlet Federation military presence in the dark depths of “no myr’s land”: vehicles and bunkers, all abandoned during the cease-fire your government caused. The passage to the west grows smaller and thinner, barely wide enough for a single vehicle to pass through. A sign bolted to the cavern wall reads “Nearing Kressia, the friendliest city near the surface!” followed by the picture of a particularly voluptuous gold ant advertising a famous bath house.
rows.translation: 南边，你能看到“无人米尔地”黑暗深处猩红联邦军事存在的开端：车辆与碉堡，全都在你的政府促成停火后遭到遗弃。向西的通道愈发狭小，勉强只够一辆车通过。钉在洞壁上的标牌写着“即将抵达克蕾西亚，最靠近地表的友善城市！”，后面还画着一只格外性感丰满的金色蚁女，为某家著名浴场做广告。
rows.raw: "To the south, you can see the beginnings of the Scarlet Federation military presence in the dark depths of “no myr’s land”: vehicles and bunkers, all abandoned during the cease-fire your government caused. The passage to the west grows smaller and thinner, barely wide enough for a single vehicle to pass through. A sign bolted to the cavern wall reads “Nearing Kressia, the friendliest city near the surface!” followed by the picture of a particularly voluptuous gold ant advertising a famous bath house."

rows.original: Cracked Cavern
rows.raw: "Cracked Cavern"

rows.original: The roof of the cavern has been cracked open here, no doubt by a huge-caliber cannon fired by the gold myr. Light shines down on the ruins of a supply base and vehicle pool, most of which is in ruins. Husks of cargo vehicles have been pushed to the side of the cavern, making room for the new supply route that must have followed.
rows.translation: 这里的洞顶被炸开一道裂口，无疑是金米尔人的大口径火炮造成的。光线向下照亮一座补给基地和车辆场的遗迹，其中大部分已经化为废墟。货运车辆的残骸被推到洞穴一侧，为后来形成的新补给路线让出空间。
rows.raw: "The roof of the cavern has been cracked open here, no doubt by a huge-caliber cannon fired by the gold myr. Light shines down on the ruins of a supply base and vehicle pool, most of which is in ruins. Husks of cargo vehicles have been pushed to the side of the cavern, making room for the new supply route that must have followed."

rows.original: Command Bunker
rows.raw: "Command Bunker"

rows.original:
The heart of the Federation line begins here: a command bunker has been built as near to the surface as they could get it, elevated on a rise of rock and sporting several radio antennas that go all the way up to a small crack in the surface stone. Looks like most of the actual equipment’s been packed up and taken home, but tables and a few electrical generators remain, giving power to the base.

The trenches begin in earnest here, connecting the command bunker to the front lines with a network of serpentine dug-outs and shallow trenches. Looks like the fighting never reached this far north.
rows.translation:
联邦防线的核心从这里开始：一座指挥碉堡建在尽可能靠近地表的位置，高踞于岩石坡地上，竖着几根无线电天线，一直延伸到地表岩层的一条小裂缝中。看来真正的设备大多已经打包装好运回国了，不过桌子和几台发电机仍留在原地，为基地提供电力。

战壕从此处真正铺展开来，一张蛇形掩体和浅战壕组成的网络将指挥碉堡与前线相连。看来战斗从未推进到如此靠北的位置。

Looks like most of the actual equipment’s been packed up and taken home, but tables and a few electrical generators remain, giving power to the base.\n\nThe trenches begin in earnest here, connecting the command bunker to the front lines with a network of serpentine dug-outs and shallow trenches. Looks like the fighting never reached this far north."

rows.original: Trench Line
rows.raw: "Trench Line"

rows.original: The trench line that runs to the south a ways seems to culminate here, giving way to several large supply caches that have long since been cleared out, thanks to the cease-fire. Still, you can see bunkers dug down into the cavern, protected by metal and stone coverings. You poke your head into a few of them, but no luck - nothing worth salvaging, unless you like moldy rations.
rows.translation: 向南延伸一段距离的战壕线似乎终止于此，化作几处早因停火而被清空的大型补给储藏点。你仍能看到向洞穴下方挖出的碉堡，上方有金属与石料构成的掩体保护。你把头探进其中几座，却没什么运气——里面没有值得回收的东西，除非你喜欢发霉的口粮。
rows.raw: "The trench line that runs to the south a ways seems to culminate here, giving way to several large supply caches that have long since been cleared out, thanks to the cease-fire. Still, you can see bunkers dug down into the cavern, protected by metal and stone coverings. You poke your head into a few of them, but no luck - nothing worth salvaging, unless you like moldy rations."

rows.original: Wrecked Trench
rows.raw: "Wrecked Trench"

rows.original: The trench here is dominated by the presence of a huge, horribly damaged armored vehicle - some kind of motorized cannon, maybe, judging by the tremendous size of the gun its sporting. The cannon barrel’s been destroyed, though, and it looks like the vehicle took a direct hit to the flank. You’re forced to shimmey under it to get anywhere.
rows.translation: 战壕里最显眼的是一辆巨大且损毁严重的装甲车辆——从它那门尺寸惊人的火炮来看，也许是某种机动炮。炮管已经被毁，车体侧面看起来还挨了一发直击。要去任何地方，你都不得不从它下面扭动着钻过去。
rows.raw: "The trench here is dominated by the presence of a huge, horribly damaged armored vehicle - some kind of motorized cannon, maybe, judging by the tremendous size of the gun its sporting. The cannon barrel’s been destroyed, though, and it looks like the vehicle took a direct hit to the flank. You’re forced to shimmey under it to get anywhere."

rows.original: Sloping Cavern
rows.raw: "Sloping Cavern"

rows.original: Trenches run along a sloping cavern, running higher north and deeper to the west. While most of the trenches have been covered with boards and stone slabs to allow you and other explorers to move over them, it’s still slow and difficult to pick your way across the defensive line.
rows.translation: 战壕沿倾斜的洞穴延伸，越往北地势越高，向西则更深。虽然大部分战壕已经铺上木板和石板，方便你和其他探索者从上面通过，但穿越防线时仍然缓慢而艰难。
rows.raw: "Trenches run along a sloping cavern, running higher north and deeper to the west. While most of the trenches have been covered with boards and stone slabs to allow you and other explorers to move over them, it’s still slow and difficult to pick your way across the defensive line."

rows.original: Old Trenches
rows.raw: "Old Trenches"

rows.original: The southern tip of the Federation trenches begins here, with bunkers and machineguns pointed dead south along the long, open passage. While the trenches have been abandoned now, you can see plenty of evidence of long occupation: food cans and ammunition crates lying about in the second line, intermixed with spotter’s posts and the closest of the cannon emplacements, surrounded by thin concrete walls.
rows.translation: 联邦战壕的南端从这里开始，碉堡和机枪全都笔直瞄准南边的开阔长通道。尽管战壕如今已经废弃，你仍能看到长期驻扎留下的大量痕迹：第二道防线里散落着食品罐头和弹药箱，期间夹杂着观察哨，以及最靠近前线、由薄混凝土墙环绕的火炮阵地。
rows.raw: "The southern tip of the Federation trenches begins here, with bunkers and machineguns pointed dead south along the long, open passage. While the trenches have been abandoned now, you can see plenty of evidence of long occupation: food cans and ammunition crates lying about in the second line, intermixed with spotter’s posts and the closest of the cannon emplacements, surrounded by thin concrete walls."

rows.original: Cavern
rows.raw: "Cavern"

rows.original: The barbed wire here is almost impassible, connecting to the trenches in the north. You can see scorch marks burned into the stone, like waves of flamethrowers had been used all at once.
rows.translation: 这里的铁丝网几乎无法穿越，并向北与战壕相连。你能看到岩石上烧出的焦痕，仿佛曾有成排火焰喷射器同时开火。
rows.raw: "The barbed wire here is almost impassible, connecting to the trenches in the north. You can see scorch marks burned into the stone, like waves of flamethrowers had been used all at once."

rows.original: Cavern
rows.raw: "Cavern"

rows.original: The cavern here is a three-way intersection, a breakpoint in the lengthy cavern that runs to the north and south. Some equipment is piled up here, mostly wires and mechanical devices foreign to you, which seem to lead off to the side passage leading west.
rows.translation: 洞穴在此形成三岔路口，是纵贯南北的漫长洞穴中的一个分岔点。这里堆着一些设备，主要是你不认识的电线和机械装置，它们似乎一路通向西边的支路。
rows.raw: "The cavern here is a three-way intersection, a breakpoint in the lengthy cavern that runs to the north and south. Some equipment is piled up here, mostly wires and mechanical devices foreign to you, which seem to lead off to the side passage leading west."

rows.original: Cavern
rows.raw: "Cavern"

rows.original: No myr’s land is the only phrase to describe this long, barren stretch of cavern. While the passage is wide open and high-vaulted, there’s nothing but devastation to be found wherever you look. It’s difficult to pick your way through the mass of barbed wire and piled sandbags, but at least the fungus on the top of the cavern makes it easy to see.
rows.translation: 无人米尔之地——只有这个词能形容这段漫长而荒芜的洞穴。通道虽宽阔开敞、穹顶高耸，目光所及却只有满目疮痍。密布的铁丝网和堆叠的沙袋令人寸步难行，不过洞顶的真菌至少让这里一览无余。
rows.raw: "No myr’s land is the only phrase to describe this long, barren stretch of cavern. While the passage is wide open and high-vaulted, there’s nothing but devastation to be found wherever you look. It’s difficult to pick your way through the mass of barbed wire and piled sandbags, but at least the fungus on the top of the cavern makes it easy to see."

rows.original: Caverns
rows.raw: "Caverns"

rows.original: The caverns here slope upwards the further north you get, and diving deep to the west. You can imagine the craters pock-marking the passage were hard-won between the husks of armored vehicles and a busted-up cannon sitting behind some sand-bags.
rows.translation: 这里的洞穴越往北地势越高，向西则陡然下潜。通道中遍布的弹坑，夹在装甲车辆残骸与一门沙袋掩体后方的破损火炮之间，想必都是苦战留下的痕迹。
rows.raw: "The caverns here slope upwards the further north you get, and diving deep to the west. You can imagine the craters pock-marking the passage were hard-won between the husks of armored vehicles and a busted-up cannon sitting behind some sand-bags."

rows.original: Cavern
rows.raw: "Cavern"

rows.original: The cavern curves south and west here, a blasted wasteland of barbed wire and tank obstacles intermixes with craters and debris. Evidence of weeks of fighting adorns the dark passage.
rows.translation: 洞穴在此向南、向西弯曲，铁丝网、反坦克障碍、弹坑与残骸混杂成一片焦土。黑暗的通道里到处都是持续数周战斗留下的痕迹。
rows.raw: "The cavern curves south and west here, a blasted wasteland of barbed wire and tank obstacles intermixes with craters and debris. Evidence of weeks of fighting adorns the dark passage."

rows.original: Cavern
rows.raw: "Cavern"

rows.original: North-pointing trenches dominate this section of the long cavern, culminating in a pair of large gun nests at the head of an infantry trenches. You can see ample evidence of battle here, with craters blowing into the trench and an ocean of shellcasings on the floor. A dark, rusty red stains the stone everywhere you look.
rows.translation: 指向北方的战壕占据了这段漫长洞穴，并在步兵战壕前端汇聚成两座大型机枪巢。这里有大量战斗痕迹：弹坑炸进战壕，地面上铺着海量弹壳。目光所及之处，岩石都染上了暗沉的铁锈红。
rows.raw: "North-pointing trenches dominate this section of the long cavern, culminating in a pair of large gun nests at the head of an infantry trenches. You can see ample evidence of battle here, with craters blowing into the trench and an ocean of shellcasings on the floor. A dark, rusty red stains the stone everywhere you look."

rows.original: Caverns
rows.raw: "Caverns"

rows.original:
A straight, long cavern runs from north to south far further than you can see. Trenches have been dug out of the footpath, deep enough to completely submerge yourself in. Machinegun nests and bunkers dot the line.

Simple stone slabs have been tossed over the trench line, allowing passage over them without much trouble.
rows.translation:
一条笔直的长洞穴自北向南延伸，远得看不到尽头。步道上挖出了深深的战壕，足以让你整个人没入其中。沿线散布着机枪巢和掩体。

简陋的石板被架在战壕上方，让人可以轻松跨越。
rows.raw: "A straight, long cavern runs from north to south far further than you can see. Trenches have been dug out of the footpath, deep enough to completely submerge yourself in. Machinegun nests and bunkers dot the line.\n\nSimple stone slabs have been tossed over the trench line, allowing passage over them without much trouble."

rows.original: Caverns
rows.raw: "Caverns"

rows.original: The caverns are wide open and a bit rough around your [pc.feet] here, slowing your progress. It’s a steep incline to the north, sloping down to the west. The path is worn in places, evidence of thousands upon thousands of footfalls over the years.
rows.translation: 这里的洞穴十分开阔，但你[pc.feet]周围的地面有些崎岖，拖慢了前进速度。北面是一段陡坡，向西则逐渐下斜。道路有些地方已经磨损，证明多年来曾有成千上万双脚从这里踏过。
rows.raw: "The caverns are wide open and a bit rough around your [pc.feet] here, slowing your progress. It’s a steep incline to the north, sloping down to the west. The path is worn in places, evidence of thousands upon thousands of footfalls over the years."

rows.original: Underground Road
rows.raw: "Underground Road"

rows.original:
A very large sign dominates the curving cavern around you, saying in big friendly letters “NOW LEAVING GILDENMERE”. In smaller letters, it gives directions and distance to the “friendliest city near the surface” of Kressia, a long walk to the northeast, or a short drive to the northwest along the highway.

It looks like you’re at the very start of a long and winding footpath leading between the two cities. It might have been nice once, with the cultivated gardens of glowing fungus mixing with electrical lights around you. The view’s only ruined by the total lack of sun and stars, and the array of sandbags encircling a pair of pillboxes hewn out of the rock, firing ports pointed northwards. The fortifications have been abandoned in the ceasefire, it appears.
rows.translation:
一块巨大的标牌占据了你周围弯曲的洞穴，上面用友好的大字写着“即将离开吉尔登米尔”。较小的文字则标出了前往克雷西亚的方向和距离，那座“最靠近地表的友善城市”位于东北方，步行路途漫长；也可以沿公路向西北行驶，很快便能抵达。

看来你正位于连接两座城市的漫长蜿蜒步道起点。这条路过去或许很漂亮，人工培育的发光真菌花园与电灯交相辉映。可惜这里既没有太阳也没有星空，还摆着一圈沙袋，围住两座从岩石中凿出的碉堡，射击孔全都朝向北方。看来这些防御工事已在停火后被弃置。

The fortifications have been abandoned in the ceasefire, it appears."

rows.original: Underground Road
rows.raw: "Underground Road"

rows.original:
A road has been built through these caverns, which are wide open and well-illuminated by electrical lights whose wires lead south. The road is in good shape, well maintained and repaired. You can see some damage, likely from bombs, but its been covered over with new pavement.

There obviously used to be a large tunnel leading south, evidenced by a concrete structure labeled “Welcome to Gildenmere”. The tunnel’s collapsed, however, completely barring passage this way. Probably smart - a tank column could have rolled right through.
rows.translation:
一条公路穿过这些宽阔的洞穴，电灯照得四周通明，电线一路向南延伸。路况很好，显然一直有人维护修补。你能看见一些可能由炸弹造成的损伤，但都已铺上新路面盖住了。

这里过去显然有一条通往南方的大隧道，旁边还留着一座写有“欢迎来到吉尔登米尔”的混凝土建筑。不过隧道已经坍塌，彻底堵死了这条路。这或许很明智——否则一支坦克纵队便能长驱直入。

The tunnel’s collapsed, however, completely barring passage this way. Probably smart - a tank column could have rolled right through."

rows.original: Underground Tunnel
rows.raw: "Underground Tunnel"

rows.original: An earthen-hewn tunnel has been hastily carved out here, allowing the people of Gildenmere access to the trenches. The passage is narrow and uneven, making it difficult to see more than a few feet ahead and to keep your footing at more than a slow walk. Marching an army through here, especially under fire, would be murder.
rows.translation: 这里仓促凿出了一条泥土隧道，让吉尔登米尔的居民能够进入战壕。通道狭窄而崎岖，不仅很难看清几英尺外的东西，走得稍快些也难以站稳。要让一支军队从这里行军，尤其是在炮火之下，无异于送死。
rows.raw: "An earthen-hewn tunnel has been hastily carved out here, allowing the people of Gildenmere access to the trenches. The passage is narrow and uneven, making it difficult to see more than a few feet ahead and to keep your footing at more than a slow walk. Marching an army through here, especially under fire, would be murder."

rows.original: Narrow Bend
rows.raw: "Narrow Bend"

rows.original: Scorch-marks scar the walls and ground to the north and east, half-buried beneath walls of tank-sized boulders. With those ways explosively sealed, the only ways open are the tunnel to the south and a narrow, twisting passage to the west. The latter of which is poorly illuminated and even more poorly paved - the perfect chokepoint. You swear you can see eyes peeping at you out of the darkness, though when you call out, no answer is forthcoming. This area is not safe.
rows.translation: 北面和东面的墙壁与地面布满焦痕，半掩在坦克大小的巨石墙下。那两条路已被爆破封死，如今只剩通往南方的隧道，以及西面一条狭窄曲折的通道。后者照明糟糕，路面更是破烂不堪，正是完美的咽喉要道。你发誓自己看见有眼睛从黑暗中窥视着你，可你出声呼喊时，却始终无人回应。这片区域并不安全。
rows.raw: "Scorch-marks scar the walls and ground to the north and east, half-buried beneath walls of tank-sized boulders. With those ways explosively sealed, the only ways open are the tunnel to the south and a narrow, twisting passage to the west. The latter of which is poorly illuminated and even more poorly paved - the perfect chokepoint. You swear you can see eyes peeping at you out of the darkness, though when you call out, no answer is forthcoming. This area is not safe."

rows.original: Abandoned Suburbs
rows.raw: "Abandoned Suburbs"

rows.original: With the city of Gildenmere just to the south, secure behind mountain-like gates, these abandoned caves seem that much lonelier. What was once a bustling suburb is now an abandoned ghost town. Once proud dwellings lie empty and abandoned, likely infested with wild cave creatures, their facades beginning to crack from lack of care and disuse. To the north, the cave bends sharply.
rows.translation: 吉尔登米尔城就在南面，安稳地藏在山岳般的城门后，这些废弃洞穴因此显得更加孤寂。曾经繁华的郊区如今已成鬼城。昔日气派的住所空空荡荡，或许早已被野生洞穴生物占据；由于年久失修，外墙也开始开裂。北面的洞穴急转而去。
rows.raw: "With the city of Gildenmere just to the south, secure behind mountain-like gates, these abandoned caves seem that much lonelier. What was once a bustling suburb is now an abandoned ghost town. Once proud dwellings lie empty and abandoned, likely infested with wild cave creatures, their facades beginning to crack from lack of care and disuse. To the north, the cave bends sharply."

rows.original: Dawngate
rows.raw: "Dawngate"

rows.original: You stand beneath Gildenmere’s Dawngate, the northern entrance to the city. It gets its name from the brilliant orange bricks that make up the immense arch and surrounding fortification. Giant, greasy cogs and mechanisms stand at the ready, staffed by dozens of army ants and ready to close steel-plated bulwarks. Just south is the city proper. To the north are abandoned suburbs, another casualty of the war.
rows.translation: 你站在吉尔登米尔的曙光门下，这里是城市的北入口。城门因构成巨大拱门及周围防御工事的亮橙色砖块而得名。巨大的油腻齿轮和机械装置严阵以待，数十名兵蚁驻守其间，随时准备合拢镀钢壁垒。正南方就是城区，北面则是废弃郊区，又一个战争的牺牲品。
rows.raw: "You stand beneath Gildenmere’s Dawngate, the northern entrance to the city. It gets its name from the brilliant orange bricks that make up the immense arch and surrounding fortification. Giant, greasy cogs and mechanisms stand at the ready, staffed by dozens of army ants and ready to close steel-plated bulwarks. Just south is the city proper. To the north are abandoned suburbs, another casualty of the war."

rows.original: Underground Road
rows.raw: "Underground Road"

rows.original:
A road has been built through these caverns, which are wide open and well-illuminated by electrical lights whose wires lead south. The road itself is in disrepair, and in places is covered with tank obstacles and sandbags. A last-ditch defense against an overwhelming war machine.

The road curves here, north to east. A billboard rests against the cave wall, illuminated by several small lamps. Your automatic translators help you suss out that it’s advertising a particularly potent brand of honey-wine, manufactured exclusively by virginal gold myr.
rows.translation:
一条公路穿过这些宽阔的洞穴，电灯照得四周通明，电线一路向南延伸。公路本身已经失修，有些地方还布满反坦克障碍和沙袋，是抵挡势不可当战争机器的最后一道防线。

道路在这里由北向东转弯。一块广告牌靠在洞壁上，由几盏小灯照亮。自动翻译器帮你看懂了内容：它在推销一种格外烈的蜂蜜酒，而且只由处女金米尔酿造。

一部分洞壁已经坍塌，看起来是炸弹所致。爆炸在西面打开了一条通道，露出一片泥土洞穴网络，进一步通往米瑞利昂的深处。谁知道它会通向哪里...

Several civilian vehicles have been left here, bailed out due to some emergency months ago.

rows.raw: "Tunnel Road"

The passage here branches in three parts: south along the road, north into an open cave mouth that looks recently opened, and east towards a huge marble stairwell.

这里的通道分成三路：沿公路向南，向北进入一个似乎才刚打开的宽阔洞口，或向东前往一座巨大的大理石楼梯。
