rows.original: A Cavern
rows.raw: "A Cavern"

rows.original: A dark maw of a cavern opens up on the side of the road. The collapse of the wall looks fairly recent, and admits entry into a large, dark, dank cavern. It smells awful in here - there’s a horrid smell wafting up from a crack in the floor, not unlike sulfur. Yuck.
rows.translation: 公路旁张开一个黑暗的洞口。墙壁似乎不久前才坍塌，露出一座巨大、阴暗而潮湿的洞穴。这里气味难闻——一股可怕的恶臭从地板裂缝里飘上来，很像硫磺。真恶心。
rows.raw: "A dark maw of a cavern opens up on the side of the road. The collapse of the wall looks fairly recent, and admits entry into a large, dark, dank cavern. It smells awful in here - there’s a horrid smell wafting up from a crack in the floor, not unlike sulfur. Yuck."

rows.original: The Tunnels
rows.raw: "The Tunnels"

rows.original: Several stone pillars surround the well-made stairwell leading up and to the north. Emptied-out crates of military provisions are scattered around, evidence of the hastily-erected defensive lines surrounding you. The Republic clearly never expected the war to get this far south.
rows.translation: 几根石柱环绕着一条修筑精良、向北上行的楼梯。四周散落着已经搬空的军需箱，证明附近的防线是在仓促间建立起来的。共和国显然从未料到战争会推进到如此靠南的地方。
rows.raw: "Several stone pillars surround the well-made stairwell leading up and to the north. Emptied-out crates of military provisions are scattered around, evidence of the hastily-erected defensive lines surrounding you. The Republic clearly never expected the war to get this far south."

rows.original: Curved Canyon
rows.raw: "Curved Canyon"

rows.original: A winding, curved canyon slopes downward. The path ahead is carved in stone, grand and well-lit by glowing lines of cultivated fungus. Stairs lead down and to the south, or up towards the defensive line in the north.
rows.translation: 一条蜿蜒弯曲的峡谷向下倾斜。前方道路凿于石中，宏伟壮观，并由人工培育真菌形成的发光线条照亮。楼梯向南下行，或向北通往防线。
rows.raw: "A winding, curved canyon slopes downward. The path ahead is carved in stone, grand and well-lit by glowing lines of cultivated fungus. Stairs lead down and to the south, or up towards the defensive line in the north."

rows.original: Defensive Line
rows.raw: "Defensive Line"

rows.original: A heavily fortified defensive line has been built here - a normal trench reinforced with concrete and sandbags. Gun mounts have been bolted into the stone and concrete, though the weapons have been dragged away back into the city with their owners. A curve takes you eastwards and down towards Republic territory; north into the blasted trenches, the front line between the red and gold myr forces.
rows.translation: 这里建起了一道戒备森严的防线，一条普通战壕以混凝土和沙袋加固。石头和混凝土上固定着枪架，不过武器已被主人拖回城内。道路转向东方，向下进入共和国领土；向北则通往被炮火摧毁的战壕，那里是红、金米尔军队之间的前线。
rows.raw: "A heavily fortified defensive line has been built here - a normal trench reinforced with concrete and sandbags. Gun mounts have been bolted into the stone and concrete, though the weapons have been dragged away back into the city with their owners. A curve takes you eastwards and down towards Republic territory; north into the blasted trenches, the front line between the red and gold myr forces."

rows.original: An Intersection
rows.raw: "An Intersection"

rows.original:
This three-way intersection connects you between two wide open passages, dotted with lingering evidence of explosions and violence. The ground is dotted with bullet holes and craters, flung between two trenches in the north and south.

The east shows you a small, well-carved passage. Smoother and better-worn than most of the other caverns around here, you think this passage might have been a street or thoroughfare at some point, rather than being built exclusively as a military trench.
rows.translation:
这处三岔路口连接着两条开阔通道，四处残留着爆炸与暴力的痕迹。地面布满弹孔和弹坑，它们是在南北两条战壕之间交火留下的。

东面是一条狭小、修整良好的通道。这里比周围大多数洞穴都更平整，踩踏痕迹也更明显；你猜它过去可能是一条街道或干道，而非专为军事战壕修建。
rows.raw: "This three-way intersection connects you between two wide open passages, dotted with lingering evidence of explosions and violence. The ground is dotted with bullet holes and craters, flung between two trenches in the north and south.\n\nThe east shows you a small, well-carved passage. Smoother and better-worn than most of the other caverns around here, you think this passage might have been a street or thoroughfare at some point, rather than being built exclusively as a military trench."

rows.original: Tunnels
rows.raw: "Tunnels"

rows.original: Smoother and better-worn than most of the other caverns around here, you think this passage might have been a street or thoroughfare at some point, rather than being built exclusively as a military trench. The cave here splits off into a small northern passage with stone steps leading up closer to the surface.
rows.translation: 这里比周围大多数洞穴都更平整，踩踏痕迹也更明显；你猜它过去可能是一条街道或干道，而非专为军事战壕修建。洞穴在这里分出一条向北的小通道，石阶通往更靠近地表的地方。

The cave here splits off into a small northern passage with stone steps leading up closer to the surface."

rows.original: Radio Bunker
rows.raw: "Radio Bunker"

rows.original: An Intersection
rows.raw: "An Intersection"

rows.original: This three-way intersection connects you between two wide open passages, dotted with lingering evidence of explosions and violence. The ground is dotted with bullet holes and craters, flung between two trenches in the north and south. A third passage leads off to the west, into a smaller and darker cave.
rows.translation: 这处三岔路口连接着两条开阔通道，四处残留着爆炸与暴力的痕迹。地面布满弹孔和弹坑，它们是在南北两条战壕之间交火留下的。第三条通道向西延伸，通往一座更狭小、更黑暗的洞穴。
rows.raw: "This three-way intersection connects you between two wide open passages, dotted with lingering evidence of explosions and violence. The ground is dotted with bullet holes and craters, flung between two trenches in the north and south. A third passage leads off to the west, into a smaller and darker cave."

rows.original: A Trench
rows.raw: "A Trench"

rows.original: A long defensive line was set up in this curving cavern at one point, including a trench dug shoulder deep into the earth and reinforced with sandbags and machinegun nests. It looks like the guns used to point north, but the tripods and empty ammo canisters are angled south now. You wonder how many times this trench was juggled back and forth between the armies...
rows.translation: 这座弯曲洞穴里曾设置过一道漫长防线，包括一条深及肩膀、以沙袋和机枪巢加固的战壕。枪口原本似乎朝北，但如今三脚架和空弹药箱却转向了南方。你不禁想知道，这条战壕究竟在两军之间易手过多少次...
rows.raw: "A long defensive line was set up in this curving cavern at one point, including a trench dug shoulder deep into the earth and reinforced with sandbags and machinegun nests. It looks like the guns used to point north, but the tripods and empty ammo canisters are angled south now. You wonder how many times this trench was juggled back and forth between the armies..."

rows.original: Subterranean River
rows.raw: "Subterranean River"

rows.original: A subterranean river runs down a sloping passage from the north, spiraling towards a crack in the cave floor that drains the river down into a deeper cavern far below you. The water pools into a small lake, overgrown with fungus and plant-life; a few small creatures can be seen wandering along the banks, lapping at the surprisingly clear water.
rows.translation: 一条地下河从北面沿斜坡流下，盘旋着汇入洞穴地板的裂缝，再排入你脚下很远处的更深洞穴。河水汇成一座小湖，周围长满真菌和植物；几只小生物在岸边徘徊，舔饮着出奇清澈的湖水。
rows.raw: "A subterranean river runs down a sloping passage from the north, spiraling towards a crack in the cave floor that drains the river down into a deeper cavern far below you. The water pools into a small lake, overgrown with fungus and plant-life; a few small creatures can be seen wandering along the banks, lapping at the surprisingly clear water."

rows.original: At A Stream
rows.raw: "At A Stream"

rows.original: A well-eroded tunnel leads north to south from here, divided in half by what amounts to a subterranean river. A craggy, cracked lip has formed in the stone to the north and east, and a stream about two feet wide rushes between the two of them. The river runs straight down the southern passage, making you keep to one side or the other of the cave.
rows.translation: 一条侵蚀严重的隧道由此南北延伸，一条地下河将它分成两半。北面和东面的岩石上形成了一道崎岖开裂的边缘，一股约两英尺宽的溪流在两者之间奔涌。河水径直流入南方通道，迫使你只能沿洞穴的一侧前进。
rows.raw: "A well-eroded tunnel leads north to south from here, divided in half by what amounts to a subterranean river. A craggy, cracked lip has formed in the stone to the north and east, and a stream about two feet wide rushes between the two of them. The river runs straight down the southern passage, making you keep to one side or the other of the cave."

rows.original: A Crater
rows.raw: "A Crater"

rows.original: This curving U-section of cave is sharply angled, going deeper the further south you go. A large crater dominates the ground, forcing you to stick to the edge of the cave to avoid falling in. Some of the cavern ceiling has collapsed, letting streams of light beam down and light your way.
rows.translation: 这段U形弯洞角度很陡，越向南走地势越低。地面中央有一个巨大弹坑，迫使你贴着洞壁行走，以免掉进去。部分洞顶已经坍塌，几束光线从中倾泻而下，为你照亮道路。
rows.raw: "This curving U-section of cave is sharply angled, going deeper the further south you go. A large crater dominates the ground, forcing you to stick to the edge of the cave to avoid falling in. Some of the cavern ceiling has collapsed, letting streams of light beam down and light your way."

rows.original: A Wreck
rows.raw: "A Wreck"

rows.original: This curving U-section of cave is sharply angled, going deeper the further south you go. A large, armored vehicle that looks like the local equivalent of a tank is bailed out here. Looks like it’s been here for a while: most of the hull is rusted, and the cannon’s been ruptured by an explosion. Thousands of shell casings surround the wreckage, making it hard to move anywhere without slipping on them.
rows.translation: 这段U形弯洞角度很陡，越向南走地势越低。一辆似乎相当于本地坦克的大型装甲车被遗弃在这里。看来它已经停放很久：大半车体都已生锈，火炮也被爆炸撕裂。残骸周围散落着数千枚弹壳，让人走到哪里都很容易打滑。
rows.raw: "This curving U-section of cave is sharply angled, going deeper the further south you go. A large, armored vehicle that looks like the local equivalent of a tank is bailed out here. Looks like it’s been here for a while: most of the hull is rusted, and the cannon’s been ruptured by an explosion. Thousands of shell casings surround the wreckage, making it hard to move anywhere without slipping on them."

rows.original: At A Stream
rows.raw: "At A Stream"

rows.original: The cavern here is broken up into two parts, divided by what amounts to a subterranean river. A craggy, cracked lip has formed in the stone to the north and south, and a stream about two feet wide rushes between the two of them. A battered and rusted-out bolt-action rifle is sitting in the water, completely forgotten and ruined by months of wear.
rows.translation: 这里的洞穴被一条地下河分成两部分。北面和南面的岩石上形成了一道崎岖开裂的边缘，一股约两英尺宽的溪流在两者之间奔涌。一支破损锈蚀的栓动步枪躺在水中，早已被人遗忘，并在数月侵蚀下彻底报废。
rows.raw: "The cavern here is broken up into two parts, divided by what amounts to a subterranean river. A craggy, cracked lip has formed in the stone to the north and south, and a stream about two feet wide rushes between the two of them. A battered and rusted-out bolt-action rifle is sitting in the water, completely forgotten and ruined by months of wear."

rows.original: Tunnels
rows.raw: "Tunnels"

rows.original: The caverns curve downwards to west here, and up to the north. The further you go westward, the darker and danker the passage becomes. The glowing fungi that clings to the ceilings grows thinner and weaker, hanging down in limp tendrils of coiling plant-matter.
rows.translation: 这里的洞穴向西下斜，向北上升。越往西走，通道就越黑暗潮湿。依附在洞顶的发光真菌也变得更加稀疏衰弱，松垮的卷曲植物组织如触须般垂落。
rows.raw: "The caverns curve downwards to west here, and up to the north. The further you go westward, the darker and danker the passage becomes. The glowing fungi that clings to the ceilings grows thinner and weaker, hanging down in limp tendrils of coiling plant-matter."

rows.original: Tunnels
rows.raw: "Tunnels"

rows.original: To the north, you can see a wide-open intersection covered in bits of battlefield equipment. A sign points north “To Kressia”. To the south, though, it’s nothing but trenches and battlefield ahead. You can see evidence of months’ of fighting partially hidden in the dust, trodden into the ground by thousands of boots.
rows.translation: 北面是一处宽阔路口，遍地都是战场装备碎片。一块标牌指向北方，写着“前往克雷西亚”。而南方只有战壕与战场。尘土下半掩着数月战斗的痕迹，又被成千上万双军靴踩进地面。
rows.raw: "To the north, you can see a wide-open intersection covered in bits of battlefield equipment. A sign points north “To Kressia”. To the south, though, it’s nothing but trenches and battlefield ahead. You can see evidence of months’ of fighting partially hidden in the dust, trodden into the ground by thousands of boots."

rows.original: Sloping Passage
rows.raw: "Sloping Passage"

rows.original:
This tunnel branches off from the carved-out myr tunnels above, sloping unevenly downwards. The tunnel seems naturally formed, roughly carved out by the forces of nature rather than myrmedion drills. Patches of glowing fungus adorn the walls, casting a deep green light over your path.

To the east, you can see craggy hole in the myr tunnels that allowed you access here. The tunnel sags down to the south, delving deeper into the bowels of the planet.
rows.translation:
这条隧道从上方米尔开凿的隧道分出，沿着凹凸不平的地面向下倾斜。它似乎是自然形成的，由自然之力粗略塑造，而非米尔米迪恩钻机开凿。墙上点缀着一片片发光真菌，将道路映成深绿色。

东面可以看见米尔隧道上崎岖的洞口，你正是从那里进来的。隧道向南下陷，深入星球腹地。
rows.raw: "This tunnel branches off from the carved-out myr tunnels above, sloping unevenly downwards. The tunnel seems naturally formed, roughly carved out by the forces of nature rather than myrmedion drills. Patches of glowing fungus adorn the walls, casting a deep green light over your path.\n\nTo the east, you can see craggy hole in the myr tunnels that allowed you access here. The tunnel sags down to the south, delving deeper into the bowels of the planet."

The tunnel sags down to the south, delving deeper into the bowels of the planet."

rows.original: Stone Pillars
rows.raw: "Stone Pillars"

rows.original: The caverns here are wide and open, giving access to a sloping passage to the far north, and a further access westward. Several pillars of rough stone connect the ceiling and floor, many of which are covered in glowing moss and crude cave drawings. You can see evidence of several humanoids passing through here, coming up from the depths below.
rows.translation: 这里的洞穴宽阔空旷，最北面有一条向上的斜坡，西面还有另一条通路。数根粗糙石柱连接着洞顶与地面，许多柱子覆盖着发光苔藓和简陋洞穴壁画。你能看见几个人形生物从下方深处经过这里的痕迹。
rows.raw: "The caverns here are wide and open, giving access to a sloping passage to the far north, and a further access westward. Several pillars of rough stone connect the ceiling and floor, many of which are covered in glowing moss and crude cave drawings. You can see evidence of several humanoids passing through here, coming up from the depths below."

rows.original: Long Corridor
rows.raw: "Long Corridor"

rows.original: The caverns are wide and open, connecting the long passage going east to west. You can see a faint glimmer of light to the east, coming down from the myr tunnels above. Several pillars of rough stone connect the ceiling and floor, many of which are covered in glowing moss and crude cave drawings.
rows.translation: 洞穴宽阔空旷，连接着东西向的长通道。东面有一丝微光，从上方的米尔隧道照下来。数根粗糙石柱连接着洞顶与地面，许多柱子覆盖着发光苔藓和简陋洞穴壁画。
rows.raw: "The caverns are wide and open, connecting the long passage going east to west. You can see a faint glimmer of light to the east, coming down from the myr tunnels above. Several pillars of rough stone connect the ceiling and floor, many of which are covered in glowing moss and crude cave drawings."

rows.original: Glowing Lake
rows.raw: "Glowing Lake"

rows.original: The caverns are wide and open, connecting the long passage stretching out to the east. To the north, you can see a shelf of rock overlooking a black precipice, down into the deepest depths of the bug planet. A large pool of water sits in a basin nearby - it’s nearly crystal clear, and illuminated by a ceiling covered in glowing moss. Water pours down from a crack in the cavern, a small rivulet of liquid that burbles pleasantly.
rows.translation: 洞穴宽阔空旷，与向东延伸的长通道相连。北面有一处岩架，俯瞰着漆黑深渊，直通这颗虫族星球最幽深的地底。附近盆地里有一大池水，几乎清澈见底，在满是发光苔藓的洞顶照耀下闪着光。水从洞穴裂缝中流下，形成一股潺潺作响、悦耳动听的小溪。
rows.raw: "The caverns are wide and open, connecting the long passage stretching out to the east. To the north, you can see a shelf of rock overlooking a black precipice, down into the deepest depths of the bug planet. A large pool of water sits in a basin nearby - it’s nearly crystal clear, and illuminated by a ceiling covered in glowing moss. Water pours down from a crack in the cavern, a small rivulet of liquid that burbles pleasantly."

rows.original: Caves Descent
rows.raw: "Caves Descent"

rows.original: A shelf of rock looms precariously over what seems like a bottomless pit to the west. The abyss ahead of you is black, lightless, an all-consuming void. Several pitons have been hammered into the rock near the cliff’s edge, dangling ropes down into the depths. You could climb down into the deepest recesses of Myrellion’s caves from here.
rows.translation: 一处岩架摇摇欲坠地悬在西面看似无底的深坑之上。眼前的深渊漆黑无光，仿佛吞噬一切的虚空。悬崖边的岩石中敲入了几枚岩钉，绳索垂入深处。你可以从这里爬进米瑞利昂洞穴最深处。
rows.raw: "A shelf of rock looms precariously over what seems like a bottomless pit to the west. The abyss ahead of you is black, lightless, an all-consuming void. Several pitons have been hammered into the rock near the cliff’s edge, dangling ropes down into the depths. You could climb down into the deepest recesses of Myrellion’s caves from here."

rows.original: Wetraxxel Den
rows.raw: "Wetraxxel Den"

rows.original: This cave branches off from the main passage you’ve been following. This side branch doesn’t seem to be nearly as well-maintained as the myr caves, much more crudely mined out and rougher-hewed. The dark passage leads westward, deeper into these rougher caverns.
rows.translation: 这座洞穴从你一直行进的主通道分出。侧洞的维护状况远不如米尔洞穴，开凿得更加粗糙，岩壁也更不平整。黑暗通道向西延伸，深入这片粗陋洞穴。
rows.raw: "This cave branches off from the main passage you’ve been following. This side branch doesn’t seem to be nearly as well-maintained as the myr caves, much more crudely mined out and rougher-hewed. The dark passage leads westward, deeper into these rougher caverns."

rows.original: Wetraxxel Den
rows.raw: "Wetraxxel Den"

rows.original:
The rough-hewn cavern opens up a little more here, spreading out to the north and west. Fungus is growing on the walls here, a glowing blue breed that sheds a faint illumination across the sand-colored stones. The way the fungus is growing, in distinctly swirling, nearly circular patterns makes it seem almost as if somebody has been cultivating it.

A few small cave drawings also adorn the walls. Crude, simple cave paintings drawn in coal or some kind of animal blood, perhaps.
rows.translation:
粗凿的洞穴在这里稍微开阔，向北和向西伸展。墙上生长着一种发蓝光的真菌，为沙色岩石洒下微弱光芒。真菌以明显的旋涡状、近乎圆形的图案生长，看起来几乎像是有人刻意培育。

墙上还点缀着几幅小型洞穴壁画，或许是用煤炭或某种动物血液画成的粗糙简笔画。
rows.raw: "The rough-hewn cavern opens up a little more here, spreading out to the north and west. Fungus is growing on the walls here, a glowing blue breed that sheds a faint illumination across the sand-colored stones. The way the fungus is growing, in distinctly swirling, nearly circular patterns makes it seem almost as if somebody has been cultivating it.\n\nA few small cave drawings also adorn the walls. Crude, simple cave paintings drawn in coal or some kind of animal blood, perhaps."

rows.original: Wetraxxel Den
rows.raw: "Wetraxxel Den"

rows.original: The passage here curves gently, connecting from south to west. The cave here is damp and dark, overgrown with fungus. Every step makes a wet, squelching sound as you proceed through the cramped caves.
rows.translation: 通道在此轻柔转弯，连接南方与西方。这里阴暗潮湿，遍布真菌。你穿行于狭窄洞穴时，每走一步都会发出湿漉漉的挤压声。
rows.raw: "The passage here curves gently, connecting from south to west. The cave here is damp and dark, overgrown with fungus. Every step makes a wet, squelching sound as you proceed through the cramped caves."

rows.original: Wetraxxel Den
rows.raw: "Wetraxxel Den"

rows.original: What might have been a three-way intersection of caverns here has largely collapsed, preventing you from proceeding southwards. The only open passages are north, towards what appears to be a fungal garden and east into a darker, dank passage.
rows.translation: 这里原本或许是洞穴的三岔路口，但大部分已经坍塌，无法继续向南。开放的通道只剩北面通往一座似乎是真菌花园的地方，以及东面通往更加阴暗潮湿的通道。
rows.raw: "What might have been a three-way intersection of caverns here has largely collapsed, preventing you from proceeding southwards. The only open passages are north, towards what appears to be a fungal garden and east into a darker, dank passage."

rows.original: Wetraxxel Den
rows.raw: "Wetraxxel Den"

rows.original:
A long passage runs east to west here, almost perfectly circular like it was drilled out by a machine. Huge amounts of fungus grow from the cave walls and ceiling, some of it glowing faintly, others smelling strangely sweet and growing in thick clumps. Somebody has clearly been cultivating the fungus here, almost like a garden.

A huge mushroom is growing here, almost the size of a tree. Chunks have been cut out of its hat, harvested for its meat. A passage curves down south from where you stand, leading towards the entrance to the circle.
rows.translation:
一条长通道在此东西延伸，截面几乎完美呈圆形，仿佛由机器钻成。洞壁与洞顶长着大量真菌，有些散发微光，有些带着奇异甜香并结成厚厚的丛簇。显然有人在这里培育真菌，把这里变得宛如花园。

这里长着一朵巨型蘑菇，几乎有树那么大。菌盖已被切去几块，作为食材采收。你所在之处有一条通道向南弯下，通往这片环形区域的入口。
rows.raw: "A long passage runs east to west here, almost perfectly circular like it was drilled out by a machine. Huge amounts of fungus grow from the cave walls and ceiling, some of it glowing faintly, others smelling strangely sweet and growing in thick clumps. Somebody has clearly been cultivating the fungus here, almost like a garden.\n\nA huge mushroom is growing here, almost the size of a tree. Chunks have been cut out of its hat, harvested for its meat. A passage curves down south from where you stand, leading towards the entrance to the circle."

rows.raw: "Wetraxxel Den"

A long passage runs east to west here, almost perfectly circular like it was drilled out by a machine. Huge amounts of fungus grow from the cave walls and ceiling, some of it glowing faintly, others smelling strangely sweet and growing in thick clumps. Somebody has clearly been cultivating the fungus here, almost like a garden.

Glowing red fungus hangs down from the ceiling in dangling, seaweed-like tendrils. The fungal tendrils brush across your cheeks with every step you take.

发出红光的真菌从洞顶垂下，形成海草般的触须。你每走一步，真菌触须都会拂过脸颊。

A right-angle turn leads down into a long passage, or eastwards towards the entrance to this sub-section of the caves.

一处直角弯道向下通往长廊，或向东通往这片洞穴分区的入口。

rows.original: Wetraxxel Den
rows.raw: "Wetraxxel Den"

rows.original: The caves here looks surprisingly well lived-in. The walls are rough and jagged, but worn down by frequent foot traffic. Cave paintings and crude drawings wander north to south, creating a simplistic mural showing hunts and births and strange subterranean creatures.
rows.translation: 这里的洞穴出奇地富有生活气息。墙壁粗糙参差，但频繁的脚步已经将其磨平。洞穴壁画和粗陋图画由北向南延伸，组成一幅简朴壁画，描绘狩猎、分娩和奇异的地下生物。
rows.raw: "The caves here looks surprisingly well lived-in. The walls are rough and jagged, but worn down by frequent foot traffic. Cave paintings and crude drawings wander north to south, creating a simplistic mural showing hunts and births and strange subterranean creatures."

rows.original: Wetraxxel Den
rows.raw: "Wetraxxel Den"

rows.original: A three-way intersection connects the long north-south passageway to a much smaller passage to the west. The breakaway cave culminates in a large, red-painted door surrounded by the same glowing blue fungus as you saw in the entranceway to this small network of caves. The door is surprisingly well made, constructed from polished stone and bearing a single rope latch to open it. A small keyhole rests above the latch.
rows.translation: 一处三岔路口把南北向长通道与西面一条小得多的通道连接起来。岔洞尽头是一扇涂成红色的大门，周围生长着与你在这片小型洞穴网络入口处见过的同种蓝色发光真菌。大门工艺出奇精良，由抛光石材制成，只有一道绳闩用于开启。门闩上方有一个小钥匙孔。
rows.raw: "A three-way intersection connects the long north-south passageway to a much smaller passage to the west. The breakaway cave culminates in a large, red-painted door surrounded by the same glowing blue fungus as you saw in the entranceway to this small network of caves. The door is surprisingly well made, constructed from polished stone and bearing a single rope latch to open it. A small keyhole rests above the latch."

rows.original: A wicked-looking staff leans against the wall next to the door.
rows.translation: 一根造型邪恶的法杖斜靠在门边墙上。
rows.raw: "\n\nA wicked-looking staff leans against the wall next to the door."

rows.original: Wetraxxel Den
rows.raw: "Wetraxxel Den"

rows.original: The caves here looks surprisingly well lived-in. The walls are rough and jagged, but worn down by frequent foot traffic. Water runs down from a crack in the cave wall, spilling down at a pretty good pace. A small pool forms at the bottom, deep enough to dip your hands into, before draining away into a small hole and deeper into the earth.
rows.translation: 这里的洞穴出奇地富有生活气息。墙壁粗糙参差，但频繁的脚步已经将其磨平。水从洞壁裂缝中流下，流速相当快。下方形成一座小水池，深得足以把双手浸进去，随后水流又从一个小洞排走，深入地下。
rows.raw: "The caves here looks surprisingly well lived-in. The walls are rough and jagged, but worn down by frequent foot traffic. Water runs down from a crack in the cave wall, spilling down at a pretty good pace. A small pool forms at the bottom, deep enough to dip your hands into, before draining away into a small hole and deeper into the earth."

rows.original: Wetraxxel Den
rows.raw: "Wetraxxel Den"

rows.original: A gently sloping cavern winds up and north, or down and eastward. What amounts to a scarecrow has been set up here, a humanoid figure stuffed with an unidentifiable substance and plated with discarded chitin armor. A menacing face has been drawn on it in red paint, with large fang-like teeth bared at you. Clearly meant to ward off intruders.
rows.translation: 一座平缓倾斜的洞穴蜿蜒向北上升，或向东下降。这里立着一个类似稻草人的东西：一具塞满不明物质的人形，外覆废弃的甲壳护甲。上面用红漆画着一张凶恶面孔，露出硕大的尖牙，显然是用来吓退闯入者的。
rows.raw: "A gently sloping cavern winds up and north, or down and eastward. What amounts to a scarecrow has been set up here, a humanoid figure stuffed with an unidentifiable substance and plated with discarded chitin armor. A menacing face has been drawn on it in red paint, with large fang-like teeth bared at you. Clearly meant to ward off intruders."

rows.original: Wetraxxel Den
rows.raw: "Wetraxxel Den"

rows.original: This section of cave seems to go a little deeper than the rest, slowly sloping upwards in the west but delving deeper down to the east, vanishing into darkness. The slope is gentle, but you still find yourself thankful for the occasional handholds that have been conspicuously chiseled into the cavern walls.
rows.translation: 这段洞穴似乎比其余部分更深，向西缓缓上升，向东则不断下探，消失在黑暗中。坡度很缓，但你仍庆幸洞壁上有人特意凿出了一些可供抓握的凹槽。
rows.raw: "This section of cave seems to go a little deeper than the rest, slowly sloping upwards in the west but delving deeper down to the east, vanishing into darkness. The slope is gentle, but you still find yourself thankful for the occasional handholds that have been conspicuously chiseled into the cavern walls. "

rows.original: Wetraxxel Den
rows.raw: "Wetraxxel Den"

rows.original: This cavern is deep and dark, making almost impossible to see save for flickering bits of light streaming in from the west. The floor is wet with... something... and you find yourself lifting your [pc.legs] high to avoid the muck. A curved slope takes you up north, or else westwards into a shadowy incline.
rows.translation: 这座洞穴又深又暗，除了西面流入的点点闪光外，几乎什么都看不见。地面被...某种东西...浸湿，你不得不高高抬起[pc.legs]，以免踩进污泥。弯曲斜坡向北上行，也可以向西进入一道昏暗斜坡。
rows.raw: "This cavern is deep and dark, making almost impossible to see save for flickering bits of light streaming in from the west. The floor is wet with... something... and you find yourself lifting your [pc.legs] high to avoid the muck. A curved slope takes you up north, or else westwards into a shadowy incline."

rows.original: Wetraxxel Den
rows.raw: "Wetraxxel Den"

rows.original: A few patches of dark blue fungus illuminate the curving incline here. The passage leads to a dark, dank cave to the south, or eastward toward the entrance to the caverns.
rows.translation: 几簇深蓝色真菌照亮了这里弯曲的斜坡。通道通往南面阴暗潮湿的洞穴，或向东通往洞穴入口。
rows.raw: "A few patches of dark blue fungus illuminate the curving incline here. The passage leads to a dark, dank cave to the south, or eastward toward the entrance to the caverns. "

rows.original: Wetraxxel Den
rows.raw: "Wetraxxel Den"

rows.original: The curving passage here slopes gently south and downwards, connecting the entrance passage to a darker, deeper cavern that seems to be bathed in shadows. The darkness westwards is pierced only by bits of dangling blue, luminescent fungus.
rows.translation: 这里的弯曲通道缓缓向南下斜，将入口通道与一座更黑暗、更幽深，仿佛浸没在阴影中的洞穴连接起来。西面的黑暗只有几簇垂落的蓝色发光真菌将其刺破。
rows.raw: "The curving passage here slopes gently south and downwards, connecting the entrance passage to a darker, deeper cavern that seems to be bathed in shadows. The darkness westwards is pierced only by bits of dangling blue, luminescent fungus."

rows.original: Wetraxxel Chamber
rows.raw: "Wetraxxel Chamber"

rows.original: Harem
rows.raw: "Harem"

rows.original: Wetraxxel
rows.raw: "Wetraxxel"

rows.original: Chamber
rows.raw: " Chamber"

rows.original: Ascension Point
rows.raw: "Ascension Point"

rows.original:
You stand at the foot of a towering cliff face. Above you, you can vaguely make out the shelf of rock you came down from against the black backdrop of the dark caves. A wide, stony passage leads westward from here, flanked by columns of stone that look almost like Greek pillars, leading you deeper into the planet’s heart.

Strange, blurred colors smear the walls of the cavern. On closer inspection, it looks as if centuries of pictographs and writing have been written and rewritten on the black stone. The result is a formless, but aesthetically pleasing fresco on all sides.
rows.translation:
你站在一面高耸悬崖脚下。上方依稀能看见你下来时经过的岩架，在漆黑洞穴的背景中若隐若现。一条宽阔石道从此向西延伸，两旁排列着几乎像希腊柱的石柱，引你深入星球心脏。

奇异而模糊的色彩涂抹在洞壁上。仔细观察，漆黑岩石上似乎叠写着数百年的象形图案和文字，最终在四面形成一幅没有明确形态却颇具美感的壁画。
rows.raw: "You stand at the foot of a towering cliff face. Above you, you can vaguely make out the shelf of rock you came down from against the black backdrop of the dark caves. A wide, stony passage leads westward from here, flanked by columns of stone that look almost like Greek pillars, leading you deeper into the planet’s heart.\n\nStrange, blurred colors smear the walls of the cavern. On closer inspection, it looks as if centuries of pictographs and writing have been written and rewritten on the black stone. The result is a formless, but aesthetically pleasing fresco on all sides."

The result is a formless, but aesthetically pleasing fresco on all sides."

rows.original: Depths Intersection
rows.raw: "Depths Intersection"

rows.original: A three-way intersection has formed here, with the west-east tunnel branching off into a northern passage, its walls covered in the same glowing fungus from the upper caves. To the west, you can see what looks like some kind of armored vehicle.
rows.translation: 这里形成一处三岔路口，东西向隧道分出一条北向通道，墙上覆盖着与上层洞穴相同的发光真菌。西面可以看见某种类似装甲车辆的东西。
rows.raw: "A three-way intersection has formed here, with the west-east tunnel branching off into a northern passage, its walls covered in the same glowing fungus from the upper caves. To the west, you can see what looks like some kind of armored vehicle."

rows.original: Armored Husk
rows.raw: "Armored Husk"

rows.original:
An abandoned armored car sits here, rusting with the passage of time. It’s not a tank per se, just a four-wheel motor car with heavy plates bolted to it. You can see evidence of a weapons mount on it, though the gun’s long since been looted. There’s no indication left as to which side of the war the derelict fought on, or how it got all the way down here.

On closer inspection, you can see the car’s interior is all but flooded with empty shell casings.
rows.translation:
一辆废弃装甲车停在这里，随岁月流逝逐渐锈蚀。严格来说，它并非坦克，只是一辆在车身上固定了厚重装甲板的四轮机动车。你能看见武器基座留下的痕迹，不过火炮早已被洗劫。这里没有任何线索能说明这辆残骸曾为战争哪一方效力，或它是如何一路来到如此深的地方。

仔细观察，你发现车内几乎被空弹壳淹没。
rows.raw: "An abandoned armored car sits here, rusting with the passage of time. It’s not a tank per se, just a four-wheel motor car with heavy plates bolted to it. You can see evidence of a weapons mount on it, though the gun’s long since been looted. There’s no indication left as to which side of the war the derelict fought on, or how it got all the way down here.\n\nOn closer inspection, you can see the car’s interior is all but flooded with empty shell casings."

There’s no indication left as to which side of the war the derelict fought on, or how it got all the way down here.\\n\\nOn closer inspection, you can see the car’s interior is all but flooded with empty shell casings."

rows.original: Mushroom Forest
rows.raw: "Mushroom Forest"

rows.original: A series of shelf-like mushrooms line the walls of this room, tiny terraces upon which bone-white insects sit, completely still until you approach them. In your presence, the tiny invertebrates glow red and skitter beneath the fungus, still alight. As you stride through the room, the shelves of fungus turn into red-light lamps, an interesting, albeit eerie effect.
rows.translation: 这间洞室的墙壁排列着一层层架状蘑菇，骨白色的小虫一动不动地伏在微型平台上，直到你靠近。你一出现，这些小型无脊椎动物便发出红光，钻进真菌下方，却依旧亮着。随着你大步穿过房间，层层真菌宛如变成一盏盏红灯，效果有趣却也诡异。
rows.raw: "A series of shelf-like mushrooms line the walls of this room, tiny terraces upon which bone-white insects sit, completely still until you approach them. In your presence, the tiny invertebrates glow red and skitter beneath the fungus, still alight. As you stride through the room, the shelves of fungus turn into red-light lamps, an interesting, albeit eerie effect."

rows.original: Hanging Fungus
rows.raw: "Hanging Fungus"

rows.original: Fungus hangs in unhealthy-looking streamers in this cave. Fleshy strips of barely-glowing fungus tatter down to the floor, often connected to each other by skin-like membranes. You shudder a bit as you make your way through the strangely flesh-like curtains, trying hard to ignore the way they feel like hands on your skin.
rows.translation: 这座洞穴里垂挂着看起来很不健康的真菌飘带。微微发光的肉质长条破破烂烂地垂到地面，彼此之间往往还连着皮膜般的薄层。你穿过这些诡异的肉帘时微微颤抖，努力忽略它们触碰肌肤时仿佛一只只手的感觉。
rows.raw: "Fungus hangs in unhealthy-looking streamers in this cave. Fleshy strips of barely-glowing fungus tatter down to the floor, often connected to each other by skin-like membranes. You shudder a bit as you make your way through the strangely flesh-like curtains, trying hard to ignore the way they feel like hands on your skin."

rows.original: QUADOMME_2U23_MET
rows.raw: "QUADOMME_2U23_MET"

rows.original: Fungal Depths
rows.raw: "Fungal Depths"

rows.original: A papery rasp fills this section of tunnel and as you walk through, you happen to glance up halfway through the cavern and realize that the ceiling is moving. A moment of peering at it reveals the horrifying truth--it’s covered in segmented coils, wound over each other in countless, slithering layers, all bristling with spiny, twitching legs. You don’t see a head or even an end, so it’s unclear if it’s a colony of something or just one monstrous organism. You’d rather not find out and hurry your way through the otherwise empty cave.
rows.translation: 这段隧道里充斥着纸张摩擦般的沙沙声。走到洞穴中段时，你偶然抬头，才发现洞顶正在移动。凝视片刻后，骇人的真相显露出来--上面覆盖着一圈圈分节躯体，它们层层缠绕、无数次交叠，长满带刺且不断抽动的细腿。你既看不见头，也找不到末端，因此无法判断那是一群生物，还是某个庞然怪物。你宁愿永远不知道，赶紧穿过这座除此之外空无一物的洞穴。
rows.raw: "A papery rasp fills this section of tunnel and as you walk through, you happen to glance up halfway through the cavern and realize that the ceiling is moving. A moment of peering at it reveals the horrifying truth--it’s covered in segmented coils, wound over each other in countless, slithering layers, all bristling with spiny, twitching legs. You don’t see a head or even an end, so it’s unclear if it’s a colony of something or just one monstrous organism. You’d rather not find out and hurry your way through the otherwise empty cave."

rows.original: Pillar Arch
rows.raw: "Pillar Arch"

rows.original: The stone pillars that line the passage from here to the ascent point begin to grow more and more bent, until at the northernmost edge of the cavern several of them have formed a towering archway that is covered with a healthy coat of glowing blue fungus. Whether this is a naturally-wrought wonder or made by the hands of the creatures the dwell down here, you can’t say.
rows.translation: 从这里通往上升点的道路两侧排列着石柱，它们变得越来越弯，直到洞穴最北端，几根石柱共同构成一座高耸拱门，上面覆盖着一层生机勃勃的蓝色发光真菌。你无法判断这是天然形成的奇观，还是居住在地底的生物亲手打造。
rows.raw: "The stone pillars that line the passage from here to the ascent point begin to grow more and more bent, until at the northernmost edge of the cavern several of them have formed a towering archway that is covered with a healthy coat of glowing blue fungus. Whether this is a naturally-wrought wonder or made by the hands of the creatures the dwell down here, you can’t say."

rows.original: Pillar Arch
rows.raw: "Pillar Arch"

rows.original:
You can see the remnants of a very large tunnel stretching north, though a cave-in has blocked your passage in that direction. Several cave-drawings adorn the stonework nearby, depicting what kind of looks like a tribe of stick figures, all of whom are drawn with a very impressive third leg.

The remaining passages curve south, back towards the ascent, or westwards down a sharp incline. And here you thought you couldn’t get any deeper...
rows.translation:
北面仍能看见一条非常宽阔的隧道遗迹，不过坍方堵住了那条路。附近石壁上有几幅洞穴画，描绘着一群像是部落成员的火柴人，每个都画着一条格外壮观的第三条腿。

剩余通道向南弯回上升点，或向西沿陡坡下行。你刚才还以为这里已经不可能更深了...
rows.raw: "You can see the remnants of a very large tunnel stretching north, though a cave-in has blocked your passage in that direction. Several cave-drawings adorn the stonework nearby, depicting what kind of looks like a tribe of stick figures, all of whom are drawn with a very impressive third leg.\n\nThe remaining passages curve south, back towards the ascent, or westwards down a sharp incline. And here you thought you couldn’t get any deeper..."

And here you thought you couldn’t get any deeper...
