And here you thought you couldn’t get any deeper..."

rows.original: Sloping Passage
rows.raw: "Sloping Passage"

rows.original: This east-west passage slopes sharply downwards. Several uneven handholds have been worn out by the passage of thousands over the years, making the going fairly easy.
rows.translation: 这条东西向通道陡然下斜。多年来，成千上万名过路者磨出了几个凹凸不平的抓握点，使前进变得相当轻松。
rows.raw: "This east-west passage slopes sharply downwards. Several uneven handholds have been worn out by the passage of thousands over the years, making the going fairly easy."

rows.original: Underground Well
rows.raw: "Underground Well"

rows.original: You stand in the middle of a three-way intersection, with a northern passage breaking off from the east-west one. The intersection seems to have been formed around a small well of water, burbling up from below. You can see some iron buckets and clay jugs scattered around. Clearly the locals are using this... they must have scattered at your approach.
rows.translation: 你站在一处三岔路口中央，一条北向通道从东西向通道分出。路口似乎围绕一眼小泉形成，泉水从地下汩汩涌出。周围散落着一些铁桶和陶罐，显然本地人一直在使用这里...他们一定是在你靠近时四散躲开了。
rows.raw: "You stand in the middle of a three-way intersection, with a northern passage breaking off from the east-west one. The intersection seems to have been formed around a small well of water, burbling up from below. You can see some iron buckets and clay jugs scattered around. Clearly the locals are using this... they must have scattered at your approach."

rows.original: Underground Well
rows.raw: "Underground Well"

rows.original: A large hexapedal insect about the size of a water buffalo has died here, collapsed with a spear in its side. Several thousand smaller insects are streaming over its body, slowly breaking it down.
rows.translation: 一只水牛大小的六足巨虫死在这里，倒下时侧身还插着一支长矛。数千只小虫正在尸体上涌动，慢慢将其分解。
rows.raw: "A large hexapedal insect about the size of a water buffalo has died here, collapsed with a spear in its side. Several thousand smaller insects are streaming over its body, slowly breaking it down."

rows.original: QUADOMME_2S13_MET
rows.raw: "QUADOMME_2S13_MET"

rows.original: Branching Path
rows.raw: "Branching Path"

rows.original: Dense Passage
rows.raw: "Dense Passage"

rows.original: Spongy toadstools strobe with pulses of yellow as you’re forced to step on them to pass by. You can see an open area at the end of the short hallway, but it still takes you a while to maneuver through the dense fungus.
rows.translation: 你不得不踩着海绵般的伞菌通过，它们在脚下闪烁出阵阵黄光。短走廊尽头是一片开阔区域，但你仍花了好一会儿，才穿过这些密集真菌。
rows.raw: "Spongy toadstools strobe with pulses of yellow as you’re forced to step on them to pass by. You can see an open area at the end of the short hallway, but it still takes you a while to maneuver through the dense fungus."

rows.original: Fungal Passage
rows.raw: "Fungal Passage"

rows.original: Immense crystal monoliths lie in the background of this giant chamber. Mushrooms the size of buildings pulse with soft colors that reflect in the transparent gems. Clouds of tiny spores flutter around in the open air.
rows.translation: 巨大的水晶方尖碑矗立在这座庞大洞室深处。建筑物大小的蘑菇发出柔和脉动的彩光，映照在透明宝石上。无数细小孢子如云雾般飘浮在空中。
rows.raw: "Immense crystal monoliths lie in the background of this giant chamber. Mushrooms the size of buildings pulse with soft colors that reflect in the transparent gems. Clouds of tiny spores flutter around in the open air."

rows.original: Long Passage
rows.raw: "Long Passage"

rows.original: A lengthy passage runs east to west, surprisingly slender and smooth. Perhaps this cavern was man-made... or at least refined by local miners.
rows.translation: 一条狭长平滑的通道东西延伸。或许这座洞穴由人力开凿...至少也被本地矿工修整过。
rows.raw: "A lengthy passage runs east to west, surprisingly slender and smooth. Perhaps this cavern was man-made... or at least refined by local miners."

rows.original: Long Passage
rows.raw: "Long Passage"

rows.original: The long passage continues, a narrow passage stretching on and on through the darkness. Thick coverings of cave drawings coat the walls, obscured behind rows of dark stalagmites.
rows.translation: 狭窄的长通道继续延伸，在黑暗中仿佛永无止境。洞穴壁画密密麻麻地覆盖墙壁，却被一排排黑色石笋遮挡。
rows.raw: "The long passage continues, a narrow passage stretching on and on through the darkness. Thick coverings of cave drawings coat the walls, obscured behind rows of dark stalagmites."

rows.original: Long Passage
rows.raw: "Long Passage"

rows.original: A lengthy eastern passage widens out into a circular chamber, running north to south. The cragginess of this cave makes it barely navigable. You manage to hop from one safe foothold to the next, almost losing your balance when something skitters out of the darkness and over your [pc.foot]. It disappears when you try to get a closer look at it. You continue across the crags at a somewhat more hurried pace.
rows.translation: 狭长的东侧通道拓宽成一座南北向圆形洞室。这座洞穴崎岖得几乎无法通行。你从一个安全落脚点跳向下一个，某个东西突然从黑暗中窜出，爬过你的[pc.foot]，害你差点失去平衡。等你想仔细看时，它已经消失。你以更匆忙的步伐继续越过崎岖岩地。
rows.raw: "A lengthy eastern passage widens out into a circular chamber, running north to south. The cragginess of this cave makes it barely navigable. You manage to hop from one safe foothold to the next, almost losing your balance when something skitters out of the darkness and over your [pc.foot]. It disappears when you try to get a closer look at it. You continue across the crags at a somewhat more hurried pace."

rows.original: Northern Reach
rows.raw: "Northern Reach"

rows.original: The passage winds north to south, connecting the craggy chamber south of you to a long tunnel that seems to wind west from here. You can see a pillar of light shining down from above through a crack in the ceiling.
rows.translation: 通道南北蜿蜒，将南面的崎岖洞室与一条似乎从此向西延伸的长隧道连接起来。你能看见一道光柱从洞顶裂缝中照下。
rows.raw: "The passage winds north to south, connecting the craggy chamber south of you to a long tunnel that seems to wind west from here. You can see a pillar of light shining down from above through a crack in the ceiling."

rows.original: Pillar of Light
rows.raw: "Pillar of Light"

rows.original: You’re standing directly under a tremendous crack in the ceiling of the cavern, some hundred feet above you. It looks like the ground above was shattered by some great impact, barreling down to the west.
rows.translation: 你正站在洞顶一道巨大裂缝下方，裂缝位于约百英尺高处。上方地面似乎曾遭受某种巨大冲击而破碎，冲击痕迹一路向西贯穿。
rows.raw: "You’re standing directly under a tremendous crack in the ceiling of the cavern, some hundred feet above you. It looks like the ground above was shattered by some great impact, barreling down to the west."

rows.original: Derelict Approach
rows.raw: "Derelict Approach"

rows.original: You’re standing between a crack in the cavern ceiling, from which shines down a beam of light from on high, and a huge impact crater blasted into the stone to the west. You can see bits of metal debris scattered across the stone floor already, and you carefully tread around them.
rows.translation: 你站在洞顶裂缝和西面巨大冲击坑之间。高处有一道光束从裂缝照下，巨坑则被猛烈冲击炸进岩石。你已经能看见金属碎片散落在石质地面上，于是小心避开它们。
rows.raw: "You’re standing between a crack in the cavern ceiling, from which shines down a beam of light from on high, and a huge impact crater blasted into the stone to the west. You can see bits of metal debris scattered across the stone floor already, and you carefully tread around them."

rows.original: FEIAN_AT_LOCATION
rows.raw: "FEIAN_AT_LOCATION"

rows.original: Crash Site
rows.raw: "Crash Site"

rows.original: Sitting underneath a bright light streaming down from the ceiling, almost like a spotlight, sits a huge probe marked with the U.G.C. Scout Authority emblem. The probe is badly damaged, and bits of its hull have been looted by the locals.
rows.translation: 一道亮光从洞顶照下，仿佛聚光灯；正下方摆着一枚巨型探测器，上面标有U.G.C.侦察局徽记。探测器损毁严重，部分外壳已被本地人拆走。
rows.raw: "Sitting underneath a bright light streaming down from the ceiling, almost like a spotlight, sits a huge probe marked with the U.G.C. Scout Authority emblem. The probe is badly damaged, and bits of its hull have been looted by the locals."

rows.original: Pillar Northeast
rows.raw: "Pillar Northeast"

rows.original: You stand in a wide, largely open cavern chamber. In the center of the chamber is a huge stone pillar, stretching up from floor to ceiling, and covered in cave drawings and softly glowing fungus. You can see several insectile humanoids scamper off as you make your way through the cavern, clearly not interested in a fight.
rows.translation: 你站在一座宽阔而大体空旷的洞室中。洞室中央是一根从地面直抵洞顶的巨大石柱，覆盖着洞穴壁画和柔和发光的真菌。几名昆虫般的人形生物在你穿过洞穴时飞快跑开，显然无意战斗。
rows.raw: "You stand in a wide, largely open cavern chamber. In the center of the chamber is a huge stone pillar, stretching up from floor to ceiling, and covered in cave drawings and softly glowing fungus. You can see several insectile humanoids scamper off as you make your way through the cavern, clearly not interested in a fight."

rows.original: Pillar Northwest
rows.raw: "Pillar Northwest"

rows.original: Trading Post
rows.raw: "Trading Post"

rows.original: Queen’s Road North
rows.raw: "Queen’s Road North"

rows.original: Several stone pillars line the passage on either side, clearly hand-carved and polished to a shine. Rather than glowing fungus coating the walls, several small clay sconces have been bolted onto the pillars, filled with colonies of the glowing fungus that sheds a soft, warm light across the tunnel. To the west, you can see what looks like a pair of heavy gates, flanked by a pair of large sconces filled with pulsing, glowing fungus.
rows.translation: 道路两旁排列着数根石柱，显然经过人工雕凿并打磨得光可鉴人。墙上没有覆盖发光真菌，取而代之的是固定在石柱上的小型陶制壁灯，里面培育着发光真菌群落，为隧道洒下柔和温暖的光芒。西面似乎有一对厚重城门，两侧各立着一座装满脉动发光真菌的大型壁灯。
rows.raw: "Several stone pillars line the passage on either side, clearly hand-carved and polished to a shine. Rather than glowing fungus coating the walls, several small clay sconces have been bolted onto the pillars, filled with colonies of the glowing fungus that sheds a soft, warm light across the tunnel. To the west, you can see what looks like a pair of heavy gates, flanked by a pair of large sconces filled with pulsing, glowing fungus."

rows.original: Gate Exterior
rows.raw: "Gate Exterior"

rows.original: Gate Interior
rows.raw: "Gate Interior"

rows.original: Palace Thoroughfare
rows.raw: "Palace Thoroughfare"

rows.original: Royal Hallway
rows.raw: "Royal Hallway"

rows.original: A curving passage connects the entrance hallway to a long, foreboding passage flanked by pillars and fungal lanterns and several large crossed spears set into the stone. An imposing gate stands to the south, made of steel and embossed with a glyph that must symbolize the queen.
rows.translation: 一条弯曲通道把入口走廊与一条阴森长廊连接起来，沿途排列着石柱、真菌灯笼，以及几组嵌入石中的交叉长矛。南面矗立着一扇气势逼人的钢铁大门，上面压印的符号想必代表女王。
rows.raw: "A curving passage connects the entrance hallway to a long, foreboding passage flanked by pillars and fungal lanterns and several large crossed spears set into the stone. An imposing gate stands to the south, made of steel and embossed with a glyph that must symbolize the queen."

rows.original: Royal Gateway
rows.raw: "Royal Gateway"

rows.original: Throne Stairs
rows.raw: "Throne Stairs"

rows.original: PLAT190 USED AS NYREA BRIBE
rows.raw: "PLAT190 USED AS NYREA BRIBE"

rows.original: Beyond the gate lies a twisting passage heading westward, with sharp steps taking you even deeper into the stone in Myrellion’s heart. Flickering lanterns light your way, and the sounds of speech below tell you that you’re not the only one here...
rows.translation: 大门后是一条向西蜿蜒的通道，陡峭阶梯带你深入米瑞利昂心脏的岩石之中。闪烁的灯笼为你照明，下方传来的说话声告诉你，这里并非只有你一人...
rows.raw: "Beyond the gate lies a twisting passage heading westward, with sharp steps taking you even deeper into the stone in Myrellion’s heart. Flickering lanterns light your way, and the sounds of speech below tell you that you’re not the only one here..."

rows.original: Throne Room
rows.raw: "Throne Room"

rows.original: Queen’s Fountain
rows.raw: "Queen’s Fountain"

rows.original: Queen’s Chambers
rows.raw: "Queen’s Chambers"

rows.original: Circle Tunnel
rows.raw: "Circle Tunnel"

rows.original: This long, smooth passage is nearly circular in the way it’s been drilled out, suggesting the nyrea put a great deal of time and effort into their construction. A flat walking path connects the fountain chamber south with a curving passage ahead, leading towards a large set of stairs.
rows.translation: 这条光滑长廊的截面几乎被钻成正圆，说明尼瑞娅人投入了大量时间与精力修建。平坦步道把南面的喷泉洞室与前方弯道连接起来，通往一组宽阔阶梯。
rows.raw: "This long, smooth passage is nearly circular in the way it’s been drilled out, suggesting the nyrea put a great deal of time and effort into their construction. A flat walking path connects the fountain chamber south with a curving passage ahead, leading towards a large set of stairs."

rows.original: Stairwell
rows.raw: "Stairwell"

rows.original: Harem Chamber
rows.raw: "Harem Chamber"

rows.original: Pillar Southeast
rows.raw: "Pillar Southeast"

rows.original: You stand in a wide, largely open cavern chamber. In the center of the chamber is a huge stone pillar, stretching up from floor to ceiling, and covered in cave drawings and softly glowing fungus. Several crystals are jutting out for the rock, reflecting the glistening fungal light.
rows.translation: 你站在一座宽阔而大体空旷的洞室中。洞室中央是一根从地面直抵洞顶的巨大石柱，覆盖着洞穴壁画和柔和发光的真菌。几簇水晶从岩石中伸出，反射着闪烁的真菌光芒。
rows.raw: "You stand in a wide, largely open cavern chamber. In the center of the chamber is a huge stone pillar, stretching up from floor to ceiling, and covered in cave drawings and softly glowing fungus. Several crystals are jutting out for the rock, reflecting the glistening fungal light."

rows.original: QUADOMME_2M15_MET
rows.raw: "QUADOMME_2M15_MET"

rows.original: Pillar Southwest
rows.raw: "Pillar Southwest"

rows.original: You stand in a wide, largely open cavern chamber. In the center of the chamber is a huge stone pillar, stretching up from floor to ceiling, and covered in cave drawings and softly glowing fungus. A curving passage is to the south, vanishing into the dark.
rows.translation: 你站在一座宽阔而大体空旷的洞室中。洞室中央是一根从地面直抵洞顶的巨大石柱，覆盖着洞穴壁画和柔和发光的真菌。南面有一条弯曲通道，消失在黑暗中。
rows.raw: "You stand in a wide, largely open cavern chamber. In the center of the chamber is a huge stone pillar, stretching up from floor to ceiling, and covered in cave drawings and softly glowing fungus. A curving passage is to the south, vanishing into the dark."

rows.original: Twisting Passage
rows.raw: "Twisting Passage"

rows.original: A twisting passage leads from the south to a wide open chamber, centered around a pillar. The southern passage is dark, almost blindingly so, with no hint of the bioluminescent entities you’ve grown accustomed to here in the depths.
rows.translation: 一条曲折通道从南面通往一座以石柱为中心的开阔洞室。南侧通道漆黑无比，几乎伸手不见五指，完全看不到你在这片深处已经习惯的生物发光体。
rows.raw: "A twisting passage leads from the south to a wide open chamber, centered around a pillar. The southern passage is dark, almost blindingly so, with no hint of the bioluminescent entities you’ve grown accustomed to here in the depths."

rows.original: Twisting Corridor
rows.raw: "Twisting Corridor"

rows.original: The twisting passage you’re traveling through is dark, and the going is slow. You occasionally trip over stalagmites and potholes in the path, forced to all but feel your way along the walls. You can hear skittering sounds, tiny movements along the stone floor, but never quite manage to lay eyes on the sources...
rows.translation: 你正在穿行的曲折通道一片漆黑，行进十分缓慢。你偶尔会被路上的石笋和坑洞绊到，只得贴着墙壁摸索前进。石质地面上不断传来窸窣声和细小动静，但你始终无法看清声音的来源...
rows.raw: "The twisting passage you’re traveling through is dark, and the going is slow. You occasionally trip over stalagmites and potholes in the path, forced to all but feel your way along the walls. You can hear skittering sounds, tiny movements along the stone floor, but never quite manage to lay eyes on the sources..."

rows.original: Ancient Skeleton
rows.raw: "Ancient Skeleton"

rows.original: The skeleton of a great, ten-legged beast is splayed out along the edge of this passage, half-consumed by the stone. Spear-like teeth grin at you from a cheekless face, black sockets where its eyes once regarding you coolly.
rows.translation: 一头巨大十足野兽的骨架沿通道边缘摊开，半截已被岩石吞没。长矛般的牙齿从没有脸颊的面孔中朝你狞笑，曾经容纳双眼的黑洞冷冷地注视着你。
rows.raw: "The skeleton of a great, ten-legged beast is splayed out along the edge of this passage, half-consumed by the stone. Spear-like teeth grin at you from a cheekless face, black sockets where its eyes once regarding you coolly."

rows.original: Twisting Passage
rows.raw: "Twisting Passage"

rows.original: The tunnels here snake back and forth, almost serpentine in the way it winds around. The darkness here is abated by legions of small, glowing rodents scurrying around. They’re almost cute, if you like six-eyed creatures with large reptilian tails.
rows.translation: 这里的隧道蜿蜒曲折，盘绕的方式几乎像蛇一样。成群发光的小型啮齿动物四处窜动，驱散了这里的黑暗。如果你喜欢长着六只眼睛和粗大爬虫尾巴的生物，它们看起来几乎还挺可爱的。
rows.raw: "The tunnels here snake back and forth, almost serpentine in the way it winds around. The darkness here is abated by legions of small, glowing rodents scurrying around. They’re almost cute, if you like six-eyed creatures with large reptilian tails."

rows.original: QUADOMME_2I21_MET
rows.raw: "QUADOMME_2I21_MET"

rows.original: Twisting Depths
rows.raw: "Twisting Depths"

rows.original: This “L”-shaped tunnel dives deep down near the elbow, making you walk down a steep incline, and back up again to get out. Twisting, vine-like fungal growths cling to the depths of the ditch, soaking up water that’s pooling there from a crack in the ceiling above.
rows.translation: 这条“L”形隧道在拐角附近陡然下探，迫使你沿陡坡向下，再爬回去才能离开。藤蔓般扭曲的真菌攀附在沟渠深处，吸收着从上方天花板裂缝渗下、积聚在那里的水。
rows.raw: "This “L”-shaped tunnel dives deep down near the elbow, making you walk down a steep incline, and back up again to get out. Twisting, vine-like fungal growths cling to the depths of the ditch, soaking up water that’s pooling there from a crack in the ceiling above."

rows.original: Twisting Passage
rows.raw: "Twisting Passage"

rows.original: A particularly dark passage westward spills out into a brightly-lit cavern to the south. Murky rivulets of water run down the walls here, thick and polluted. Something tells you you’re underneath a myr city high above...
rows.translation: 一条格外黑暗的通道向西延伸，南边则豁然通向一座灯火通明的洞穴。浑浊的细流沿着这里的墙壁淌下，又稠又脏。直觉告诉你，自己正位于上方某座米尔城市的地下……
rows.raw: "A particularly dark passage westward spills out into a brightly-lit cavern to the south. Murky rivulets of water run down the walls here, thick and polluted. Something tells you you’re underneath a myr city high above..."

rows.original: Lake Passage
rows.raw: "Lake Passage"

rows.original: The tunnel twists here, going north to east. Part of the wall has collapsed, however, revealing the shores of an underground river which quickly spills out into a lake. The surface of the water is crystal clear, easily letting you see all the way to the bottom, and illuminated by floating strands of some bioluminescent plant - they’re almost like lily pads, though much more slender and flexible, floating like tendrils through the water.
rows.translation: 隧道在这里由北转向东。不过，一部分墙壁已经坍塌，露出一条地下河的河岸；河水很快汇入一座湖泊。水面清澈如晶，可以轻易一眼望到底，漂浮的生物发光植物丝缕照亮了水下——它们有些像睡莲叶，但远为纤细柔韧，如触须般随水漂荡。
rows.raw: "The tunnel twists here, going north to east. Part of the wall has collapsed, however, revealing the shores of an underground river which quickly spills out into a lake. The surface of the water is crystal clear, easily letting you see all the way to the bottom, and illuminated by floating strands of some bioluminescent plant - they’re almost like lily pads, though much more slender and flexible, floating like tendrils through the water."

rows.original: Lake Shore
rows.raw: "Lake Shore"

rows.original: You stand at the shore of an underground lake, wide and deep. The surface of the water is crystal clear, easily letting you see all the way to the bottom, and illuminated by floating strands of some bioluminescent plant - they’re almost like lily pads, though much more slender and flexible, floating like tendrils through the water.
rows.translation: 你站在一座宽阔深邃的地下湖岸边。水面清澈如晶，可以轻易一眼望到底，漂浮的生物发光植物丝缕照亮了水下——它们有些像睡莲叶，但远为纤细柔韧，如触须般随水漂荡。
rows.raw: "You stand at the shore of an underground lake, wide and deep. The surface of the water is crystal clear, easily letting you see all the way to the bottom, and illuminated by floating strands of some bioluminescent plant - they’re almost like lily pads, though much more slender and flexible, floating like tendrils through the water."

rows.original: QUADOMME_2K27_MET
rows.raw: "QUADOMME_2K27_MET"

rows.original: Shallow Lake
rows.raw: "Shallow Lake"

rows.original: You’ve waded out into the shallow portions of the subterranean lake, admiring the hanging fangs of sharpened stone that drip clear water down into the lake. The surface of the water is crystal clear, easily letting you see all the way to the bottom, and illuminated by floating strands of some bioluminescent plant - they’re almost like lily pads, though much more slender and flexible, floating like tendrils through the water.
rows.translation: 你已涉入地下湖的浅水区，一边欣赏着悬垂的尖锐石牙，看清水从上面滴入湖中。水面清澈如晶，可以轻易一眼望到底，漂浮的生物发光植物丝缕照亮了水下——它们有些像睡莲叶，但远为纤细柔韧，如触须般随水漂荡。
rows.raw: "You’ve waded out into the shallow portions of the subterranean lake, admiring the hanging fangs of sharpened stone that drip clear water down into the lake. The surface of the water is crystal clear, easily letting you see all the way to the bottom, and illuminated by floating strands of some bioluminescent plant - they’re almost like lily pads, though much more slender and flexible, floating like tendrils through the water."

rows.original: Deep Lake
rows.raw: "Deep Lake"

rows.original: The deepest parts of the lake stretch out before you, a wide-open and circular cavern with a vaulted ceiling reaching high above. The ceiling glitters with crystals, but the coat of glowing fungus that you’ve waded through thus far is fairly sparse here, making the cavern dark and foreboding. Even the water, clear as it is, is black and opaque now.
rows.translation: 湖泊最深处在你面前铺展开来，形成一座开阔的圆形洞穴，穹顶高高耸立。天花板上的晶体熠熠生辉，但一路涉水至此所见的发光真菌层在这里相当稀疏，使洞穴显得黑暗而不祥。就连湖水虽然依旧清澈，如今也黑得不透光。
rows.raw: "The deepest parts of the lake stretch out before you, a wide-open and circular cavern with a vaulted ceiling reaching high above. The ceiling glitters with crystals, but the coat of glowing fungus that you’ve waded through thus far is fairly sparse here, making the cavern dark and foreboding. Even the water, clear as it is, is black and opaque now."

rows.original: Crevasse
rows.raw: "Crevasse"

rows.original: This passage has been shattered by the movements of the earth, torn open to reveal a deep crevasse. Stalactites hang down from above, giving you just enough hand-hold to leap across the hole.
rows.translation: 这条通道被大地的运动撕裂，敞开成一道深邃裂谷。钟乳石从上方垂下，恰好为你提供足够的着力点，让你能跃过裂口。
rows.raw: "This passage has been shattered by the movements of the earth, torn open to reveal a deep crevasse. Stalactites hang down from above, giving you just enough hand-hold to leap across the hole."

rows.original: Twisting Deep
rows.raw: "Twisting Deep"

rows.original: The wall of the tunnel has collapsed to the south, revealing a sloping passage going deeper down. The passage is relatively smooth, and seems oddly slick...
rows.translation: 隧道南侧的墙壁已经坍塌，露出一条向更深处倾斜的通道。通道相当平滑，而且滑得有些古怪……
rows.raw: "The wall of the tunnel has collapsed to the south, revealing a sloping passage going deeper down. The passage is relatively smooth, and seems oddly slick..."

rows.original: Slimy Passage
rows.raw: "Slimy Passage"

rows.original: Gooey Sluice
rows.raw: "Gooey Sluice"

rows.original: This passage is much thinner than the rest, and the ground is coating with a trickling river of slippery liquid. You tread carefully, remembering what happened on your first trip through the passage as you make your way to the crystal goo village.
rows.translation: 这条通道比其他地方狭窄得多，地面覆着一层潺潺流动的滑腻液体。你谨慎迈步，一边想起第一次穿过这里时发生的事，一边朝水晶胶质村落前进。
rows.raw: "This passage is much thinner than the rest, and the ground is coating with a trickling river of slippery liquid. You tread carefully, remembering what happened on your first trip through the passage as you make your way to the crystal goo village."

rows.original: Crystal Goo Village
rows.raw: "Crystal Goo Village"

rows.original: Ganraen Prison
rows.raw: "Ganraen Prison"

rows.original:
Crystalline cages hold a number of myr of varying colors, along with some of the more exotic myrmedion life forms. You know from personal experience that the ganraen harvest fluids from their captives before releasing them back to where they came from.

There is a spare bed here you can use if you need to rest.
rows.translation:
水晶笼中关着许多颜色各异的米尔，以及一些更奇特的米尔米迪恩生物。根据亲身经历，你知道甘雷尔人会从俘虏身上采集体液，然后再把她们放回原来的地方。

这里有一张空床，需要休息的话可以使用。
rows.raw: "Crystalline cages hold a number of myr of varying colors, along with some of the more exotic myrmedion life forms. You know from personal experience that the ganraen harvest fluids from their captives before releasing them back to where they came from.\n\nThere is a spare bed here you can use if you need to rest."

rows.original: Crystalline cages hold a number of myr of varying colors, along with some of the more exotic myrmedion life forms. You know from personal experience that the ganraen harvest fluids from their captives before releasing them back to where they came from.\n\nThere is a spare bed here you can use if you need to rest.
rows.translation: 水晶笼中关着许多颜色各异的米尔，以及一些更奇特的米尔米迪恩生物。根据亲身经历，你知道甘雷尔人会从俘虏身上采集体液，然后再把她们放回原来的地方。\n\n这里有一张空床，需要休息的话可以使用。
rows.raw: "Crystalline cages hold a number of myr of varying colors, along with some of the more exotic myrmedion life forms. You know from personal experience that the ganraen harvest fluids from their captives before releasing them back to where they came from.\\n\\nThere is a spare bed here you can use if you need to rest."

rows.original: Southern Turn
rows.raw: "Southern Turn"

rows.original: A long passage stretches out to the north, going on for what seems like an eternity in the darkness. To the west is a path riddled with cracks and holes, possibly the victim of a recent earthquake.
rows.translation: 一条漫长的通道向北延伸，在黑暗中仿佛永无尽头。西边的路径布满裂缝与坑洞，或许是近期某场地震的受害者。
rows.raw: "A long passage stretches out to the north, going on for what seems like an eternity in the darkness. To the west is a path riddled with cracks and holes, possibly the victim of a recent earthquake."

rows.original: Jagged Passage
rows.raw: "Jagged Passage"

rows.original: This passage slopes downwards, from north to a deeper south. The ground here is particularly uneven, making the going hard and slow - your [pc.feet] constantly snag against jagged outcroppings, or nearly trip you over invisible cracks.
rows.translation: 这条通道从北向更深的南方倾斜而下。这里的地面格外崎岖，使前进变得困难而缓慢——你的[pc.feet]不断被嶙峋的岩石凸起勾住，或差点让你被看不见的裂缝绊倒。
rows.raw: "This passage slopes downwards, from north to a deeper south. The ground here is particularly uneven, making the going hard and slow - your [pc.feet] constantly snag against jagged outcroppings, or nearly trip you over invisible cracks."

rows.original: Mossy Passage
rows.raw: "Mossy Passage"

rows.original: This passage slopes downwards, from north to a deeper south. A glowing blue moss is covering the walls all around you - floor, ceiling, every inch of rock seems covered with the stuff. Small creatures move through the moss, glowing the same color.
rows.translation: 这条通道从北向更深的南方倾斜而下。发着蓝光的苔藓覆盖着你周围的墙壁——地面、天花板，仿佛每一寸岩石都被这种东西盖住。小生物在苔藓间穿行，发出同样颜色的光。
rows.raw: "This passage slopes downwards, from north to a deeper south. A glowing blue moss is covering the walls all around you - floor, ceiling, every inch of rock seems covered with the stuff. Small creatures move through the moss, glowing the same color."

rows.original: Craggy Passage
rows.raw: "Craggy Passage"

rows.original: This passage slopes downwards, from north to a deeper south. The westward wall has been shattered by some kind of impact, scattering rock and debris all over. The ground is cracked and hard to traverse, and the walls are covered with jagged, painful points.
rows.translation: 这条通道从北向更深的南方倾斜而下。西侧墙壁似乎被某种冲击撞碎，岩石与碎屑散落得到处都是。地面开裂，难以通行，墙壁上则布满嶙峋而扎人的尖角。
rows.raw: "This passage slopes downwards, from north to a deeper south. The westward wall has been shattered by some kind of impact, scattering rock and debris all over. The ground is cracked and hard to traverse, and the walls are covered with jagged, painful points."

rows.original: River Passage
rows.raw: "River Passage"

rows.original: This passage slopes downwards, from north to a deeper south. A river flows through this passage, bisecting the tunnel from east to west. Several small creatures, the local equivalent of fish, swim through it.
rows.translation: 这条通道从北向更深的南方倾斜而下。一条河流横穿此处，从东向西将隧道一分为二。几只相当于本地鱼类的小生物在河中游动。
rows.raw: "This passage slopes downwards, from north to a deeper south. A river flows through this passage, bisecting the tunnel from east to west. Several small creatures, the local equivalent of fish, swim through it."

rows.original: Sloping Curve
rows.raw: "Sloping Curve"

rows.original: You can see the well to the east, a small circle of stone that draws your attention away from the dark, smooth passage south of you. The southbound tunnel slopes down sharply, deeper into the bowels of Myrellion and into darkness.
rows.translation: 你能看到东边的水井，一圈小小的石头将你的注意力从南边黑暗平滑的通道上引开。南行隧道陡然向下倾斜，深入米瑞利昂腹地，没入黑暗之中。
rows.raw: "You can see the well to the east, a small circle of stone that draws your attention away from the dark, smooth passage south of you. The southbound tunnel slopes down sharply, deeper into the bowels of Myrellion and into darkness."

rows.original: LYRALLA
rows.raw: "LYRALLA"

rows.original: _NUDE
rows.raw: "_NUDE"

rows.original: Lyralla
rows.translation: 莱拉
rows.raw: "Lyralla"

rows.original: Fenoxo Fenfen
rows.raw: "Fenoxo Fenfen"

rows.original: The short walk up to her desk gives you plenty of time to get a feel for the four-armed diplomat. Her most striking feature - or features - are her cybernetics, starting with a glowing red eye and including an ill-fitting, terran-style robotic arm. Her other three limbs are intact, three slim arms wrapped in polished chitin, delicately shifting a sea of paperwork into organized, book-sized atolls.
rows.translation: 走到她桌前的短短一段路，已经足够让你大致了解这位四臂外交官。她最引人注目的特征——或者说诸多特征——是身上的义体：从一只发着红光的眼睛，到一条不太合身的泰伦风格机械臂。她其余三条肢体完好无损，三只纤细手臂包裹着光洁甲壳，灵巧地将如海般的文件整理成一本本书大小的环礁。
rows.raw: "The short walk up to her desk gives you plenty of time to get a feel for the four-armed diplomat. Her most striking feature - or features - are her cybernetics, starting with a glowing red eye and including an ill-fitting, terran-style robotic arm. Her other three limbs are intact, three slim arms wrapped in polished chitin, delicately shifting a sea of paperwork into organized, book-sized atolls."

rows.original: For clothes, she sports a gleaming white robe that’s fastened by a gold-embossed belt. The top hangs open casually, almost indecently, exposing far more amber titflesh than it has any right to.
rows.translation: 衣着方面，她穿着一件闪亮的白袍，用一条金色压纹腰带系紧。上身随意地敞开着，近乎有伤风化，露出的琥珀色乳肉多得简直不合情理。
rows.raw: "\n\nFor clothes, she sports a gleaming white robe that’s fastened by a gold-embossed belt. The top hangs open casually, almost indecently, exposing far more amber titflesh than it has any right to."

rows.original: The ambassador
rows.translation: 这位大使
rows.raw: "\n\nThe ambassador"

rows.original: , Lyralla,
rows.translation: ，莱拉拉，
rows.raw: ", Lyralla,"

rows.original: notices your stare at that exact moment. She smiles warmly despite your roving eyes and extends a hand, diplomatically drawing your eyes away from her immodest canyon of cleavage. “Hello, and on behalf of the Council of Queens, allow me to extend you a warm welcome to our troubled planet, offworlder. My name is Lyralla.”
rows.translation: 恰在此刻注意到你的凝视。尽管你的目光四处游移，她仍热情地微笑并伸出一只手，用外交手腕将你的视线从那道毫不端庄的乳沟峡谷上引开。“你好。谨代表女王议会，请允许我向你这位外世界人致以热烈欢迎，欢迎来到我们这颗饱受动荡的星球。我叫莱拉拉。”
rows.raw: " notices your stare at that exact moment. She smiles warmly despite your roving eyes and extends a hand, diplomatically drawing your eyes away from her immodest canyon of cleavage. “Hello, and on behalf of the Council of Queens, allow me to extend you a warm welcome to our troubled planet, offworlder. My name is Lyralla.”"

rows.original: You pause before realizing that she’s speaking near-fluent English - you aren’t just hearing an auto-translated version of her native tongue relayed by the microsurgeons in your blood. “You speak English?” The disbelieving statement is out before you have time to think about it.
rows.translation: 你愣了一下，才意识到她说的是近乎流利的英语——并非只是你血液中的微型外科机器人将她的母语自动翻译后传达给你。“你会说英语？”难以置信的话语在你来得及思考之前便脱口而出。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou pause before realizing that she’s speaking near-fluent English - you aren’t just hearing an auto-translated version of her native tongue relayed by the microsurgeons in your blood. “You speak English?” The disbelieving statement is out before you have time to think about it."

rows.original: Lyralla nods serenely while tugging her robe into a more modest position. The garment doesn’t look like it was made for an individual with so much up top, though you can’t imagine an ambassador being given anything less than the finest clothing a species has to offer.
rows.translation: 莱拉拉平静地点头，同时拉扯长袍，让它遮得更严实些。这件衣服看起来并非为上围如此丰满的人设计，不过你也无法想象，一位大使会得到低于其种族最高水准的服装。
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla nods serenely while tugging her robe into a more modest position. The garment doesn’t look like it was made for an individual with so much up top, though you can’t imagine an ambassador being given anything less than the finest clothing a species has to offer."

rows.original: “Of course. What kind of ambassador would I be if I did not learn the most common galactic tongues?” She makes a clicking noise against the roof of her mouth. “A cursory examination of public records reveals mistranslations as a serious contributor in over two dozen recent conflicts among your peoples.” Her artificial eye audibly whirrs as it focuses on you, its organic mate black and silent. “If I am to be the connecting tunnel between my people and the galaxy as a whole, then I am going to do everything I can to ensure that the supports are built on strong foundations, not shifting sands.”
rows.translation: “当然。若连最常见的几种银河语言都不学习，我还算什么大使？”她用舌头抵着上颚发出咔哒声。“只需粗略查阅公开记录，便会发现误译是你们各族近期二十多场冲突的重要诱因。”她的机械眼对准你时发出清晰的嗡鸣声，另一只生物眼则漆黑无声。“若要成为连接我的人民与整个银河的隧道，我就会竭尽全力，确保支撑建在坚实的地基上，而不是流沙之中。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course. What kind of ambassador would I be if I did not learn the most common galactic tongues?” She makes a clicking noise against the roof of her mouth. “A cursory examination of public records reveals mistranslations as a serious contributor in over two dozen recent conflicts among your peoples.” Her artificial eye audibly whirrs as it focuses on you, its organic mate black and silent. “If I am to be the connecting tunnel between my people and the galaxy as a whole, then I am going to do everything I can to ensure that the supports are built on strong foundations, not shifting sands.”"

rows.original: You cock your head. “A tunnel?”
rows.translation: 你歪了歪头。“隧道？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou cock your head. “A tunnel?”"

rows.original: Grinning now, she offers, “I believe a bridge may be a more apt metaphor. Our people dwell below ground and have less experience with such structures. I still have much to learn - your name, for instance.”
rows.translation: 她这才露出笑容，解释道：“我想，桥梁或许是更恰当的比喻。我的人民居住在地下，对这种结构不太熟悉。我仍有许多东西需要学习——例如你的名字。”
rows.raw: "\n\nGrinning now, she offers, “I believe a bridge may be a more apt metaphor. Our people dwell below ground and have less experience with such structures. I still have much to learn - your name, for instance.”"

rows.original: You
rows.translation: 你
rows.raw: "\n\nYou "

rows.original: introduce yourself and shake her hand, a gesture she seems to already have adapted to.
rows.translation: 介绍自己，并与她握手；她似乎已经适应了这种礼节。
rows.raw: "introduce yourself and shake her hand, a gesture she seems to already have adapted to."

rows.original: introduce yourself as Captain [pc.name] Steele and strike a ludicrously exaggerated pose.
rows.translation: 自称是[pc.name]·斯蒂尔船长，并摆出一个夸张得荒唐的姿势。
rows.raw: "introduce yourself as Captain [pc.name] Steele and strike a ludicrously exaggerated pose."

rows.original: tersely inform her of your name.
rows.translation: 简短地告诉她你的名字。
rows.raw: "tersely inform her of your name."

rows.original: She places her lower arms’ elbows on the desk and interlaces her fingers, resting her chin upon them as she smiles up at you. “An interesting name for an interesting [pc.man]. Tell me, what can I do for you?”
rows.translation: 她将下方两条手臂的肘部支在桌上，十指交扣，把下巴枕在上面，抬头朝你微笑。“有趣的名字，很适合一位有趣的[pc.man]。告诉我，我能为你做些什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe places her lower arms’ elbows on the desk and interlaces her fingers, resting her chin upon them as she smiles up at you. “An interesting name for an interesting [pc.man]. Tell me, what can I do for you?”"

rows.original: Lyralla shrugs, her metallic shoulder clicking audibly. “Is there something else you need then? It is nice to practice my linguistics on someone aside from Juro.”
rows.translation: 莱拉拉耸耸肩，金属肩膀发出清晰的咔哒声。“那么，你还有别的需要吗？能跟朱罗之外的人练习语言学也很不错。”
rows.raw: "Lyralla shrugs, her metallic shoulder clicking audibly. “Is there something else you need then? It is nice to practice my linguistics on someone aside from Juro.”"

rows.original: Lyralla gives you a friendly wave with her robotic arm as you approach, trusting her remaining organic ones to set aside the paperwork and tablets she had been examining. <i>“
rows.translation: 你走近时，莱拉拉用机械臂友好地朝你挥手，剩下的生物手臂则把方才查看的文件与平板收至一旁。<i>“
rows.raw: "Lyralla gives you a friendly wave with her robotic arm as you approach, trusting her remaining organic ones to set aside the paperwork and tablets she had been examining. <i>“"

rows.original: I was reviewing ancient histories. It’s amazing how many times you went to war without provoking extinction level events!
rows.translation: 我刚才在研读古代史。你们竟然经历了那么多场战争，却没有引发灭绝级事件，真令人惊讶！
rows.raw: "I was reviewing ancient histories. It’s amazing how many times you went to war without provoking extinction level events!"

rows.original: I was just reviewing a proposed trade agreement. Word is getting out about our honey. Some place called New Texas seems to want to exchange surplus grain for it. They’ll even provide us with the milkers!
rows.translation: 我刚才在审阅一份拟议中的贸易协议。我们的蜂蜜已经声名在外了。一个叫新德克萨斯的地方似乎想用过剩粮食来交换。他们甚至会给我们提供挤奶器！
rows.raw: "I was just reviewing a proposed trade agreement. Word is getting out about our honey. Some place called New Texas seems to want to exchange surplus grain for it. They’ll even provide us with the milkers!"

rows.original: Comma splices! Comma splices everywhere! How can Ambassador Juro butcher your language so casually? Language is an art unto itself! Surely he can see that.” She snorts and tosses one last tablet away. “Sometimes I have to wonder how he got his position.
rows.translation: 逗号拼接句！到处都是逗号拼接句！朱罗大使怎么能如此随意地糟蹋你们的语言？语言本身就是一门艺术！他肯定看得出来吧。”她哼了一声，将最后一块平板丢到一旁。“有时我真想不通他是怎么得到这个职位的。
rows.raw: "Comma splices! Comma splices everywhere! How can Ambassador Juro butcher your language so casually? Language is an art unto itself! Surely he can see that.” She snorts and tosses one last tablet away. “Sometimes I have to wonder how he got his position."

rows.original: I was just looking over a proposal from KihaCorp. They’d like to use our likeness for a VI. I think the Council will have to pass a ruling on this one.
rows.translation: 我刚才在看基哈公司的一份提案。他们想以我们的形象制作一款虚拟智能。我想女王议会得对此作出裁决。
rows.raw: "I was just looking over a proposal from KihaCorp. They’d like to use our likeness for a VI. I think the Council will have to pass a ruling on this one."

rows.original: Did you know that pointing the innermost finger at some varieties of ausar is considered insulting in the same way that terrans regard upraised middle digits? There’s so much to learn!
rows.translation: 你知道吗，对某些奥萨人伸出最靠内侧的手指，会被视作一种侮辱，就和泰伦人看待竖中指一样？要学的东西实在太多了！
rows.raw: "Did you know that pointing the innermost finger at some varieties of ausar is considered insulting in the same way that terrans regard upraised middle digits? There’s so much to learn!"

rows.original: I just got word that a small trading fleet will be stopping by. I wonder if all the food in the U.G.C. is as bland as that stuff Juro eats.
rows.translation: 我刚收到消息，一支小型贸易舰队将会到访。不知道银河联合邦联的食物是不是都和朱罗吃的那些东西一样寡淡。
rows.raw: "I just got word that a small trading fleet will be stopping by. I wonder if all the food in the U.G.C. is as bland as that stuff Juro eats."

rows.original: There’s so much out there... more than I ever imagined. Maybe someday, once the reds are taken care of, I’ll get a chance to see your universe.
rows.translation: 外面的世界有那么多东西……比我想象的还要多。也许有一天，等红方的问题解决后，我会有机会亲眼看看你们的宇宙。
rows.raw: "There’s so much out there... more than I ever imagined. Maybe someday, once the reds are taken care of, I’ll get a chance to see your universe."

rows.original: I’ve just come across a wonderful word: canoodling. It means hugging and kissing, but together, all in one small set of syllables. It is... elegant and touching. My people do not have such a term.
rows.translation: 我刚遇到一个很美妙的词：亲昵。它指的是拥抱与亲吻，两者合一，却只用寥寥几个音节。这个词……既优雅又动人。我的人民没有这样的词。
rows.raw: "I’ve just come across a wonderful word: canoodling. It means hugging and kissing, but together, all in one small set of syllables. It is... elegant and touching. My people do not have such a term."

rows.original: ” She smiles warmly at you. “Is there something I can help you with, [pc.name]?”
rows.translation: ”她热情地朝你微笑。“有什么是我能帮你的，[pc.name]？”
rows.raw: "” She smiles warmly at you. “Is there something I can help you with, [pc.name]?”"

rows.original: Appearance
rows.translation: 外貌
rows.raw: "Appearance"

rows.original: Talk
rows.translation: 交谈
rows.raw: "Talk"

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: Lyralla is a gold myr first and foremost, and that means she has the same antennae poking up out of her black, bob-cut hair as the rest of her species. One is shorter than the other, its tip seared off by fire and healed imperfectly. Just below it is her injured eye. U.G.C. medics have fitted her with a prosthetic, but it’s a clunky, general purpose model. The iris glows red and whirrs noisily when focusing, lending its user a disconcertingly menacing air. It looks disturbingly out of place on the ambassador’s otherwise cheery face. The other eye is a solid black sphere, an unmistakable reminder that you’re looking at an alien.
rows.translation: 莱拉拉首先是一名金米尔，因此和同族一样，两根触角从她齐耳剪短的黑发间伸出。其中一根比另一根短，末梢曾被火焰烧断，愈合得并不完美。受伤的眼睛就在它下方。银河联合邦联的医务人员为她装上了义眼，但那是个笨重的通用型号。虹膜泛着红光，聚焦时还会发出嘈杂的嗡鸣，使佩戴者显出令人不安的凶狠气息。它出现在大使原本开朗的脸上，显得格格不入得令人不适。另一只眼睛则是一颗纯黑球体，清楚提醒着你，眼前的是一名外星人。
rows.raw: "Lyralla is a gold myr first and foremost, and that means she has the same antennae poking up out of her black, bob-cut hair as the rest of her species. One is shorter than the other, its tip seared off by fire and healed imperfectly. Just below it is her injured eye. U.G.C. medics have fitted her with a prosthetic, but it’s a clunky, general purpose model. The iris glows red and whirrs noisily when focusing, lending its user a disconcertingly menacing air. It looks disturbingly out of place on the ambassador’s otherwise cheery face. The other eye is a solid black sphere, an unmistakable reminder that you’re looking at an alien."

rows.original: Her body is covered in a white, gold-trimmed robe that hangs loosely everywhere but around her bust. Lyralla’s breasts are a few sizes too big for such a garment, tugging the neckline down until “plunging” seems a conservative estimate of its state. Four voluminous sleeves hang around her slender limbs. The cuffs only reach about halfway down her forearms, revealing plenty of gleaming chitin and shiny chrome.
rows.translation: 她身上裹着一件白色金边长袍，除了胸部之外，其他地方都宽松地垂落着。莱拉拉的乳房对这件衣服而言大了好几个罩杯，将领口向下扯得厉害，以至于用“深V”形容都显得保守。四只宽大的袖子垂在她纤细的肢体周围。袖口只到前臂的一半，露出大片闪亮甲壳与锃亮镀铬金属。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer body is covered in a white, gold-trimmed robe that hangs loosely everywhere but around her bust. Lyralla’s breasts are a few sizes too big for such a garment, tugging the neckline down until “plunging” seems a conservative estimate of its state. Four voluminous sleeves hang around her slender limbs. The cuffs only reach about halfway down her forearms, revealing plenty of gleaming chitin and shiny chrome."

rows.original: One of her arms, the upper left, is clearly artificial. It has none of the feminine grace of its three sisters, all hard metal and synthetic tendons. You recognize it as a Reaper Armaments model, the kind of prosthetic favored by the military, used to get dismembered soldiers back into fighting shape. Word has it that some marines have undergone voluntarily limb replacement surgeries in order to benefit from the enhanced strength and recoil compensation afforded by these robotic arms. Lyralla can be seen frowning at hers from time to time, but she uses it as naturally as her other three hands.
rows.translation: 她左上方的手臂显然是人造的。它全无另外三条手臂的女性柔美，只有坚硬金属与合成肌腱。你认出这是收割者军械的一款型号，是军方偏爱的义肢，用来让失去肢体的士兵恢复战斗能力。传闻有些陆战队员甚至主动接受肢体替换手术，以利用这些机械臂所带来的力量增强与后坐力补偿。莱拉拉偶尔会皱眉看着自己的机械臂，但使用起来与其余三只手一样自然。
rows.raw: "\n\nOne of her arms, the upper left, is clearly artificial. It has none of the feminine grace of its three sisters, all hard metal and synthetic tendons. You recognize it as a Reaper Armaments model, the kind of prosthetic favored by the military, used to get dismembered soldiers back into fighting shape. Word has it that some marines have undergone voluntarily limb replacement surgeries in order to benefit from the enhanced strength and recoil compensation afforded by these robotic arms. Lyralla can be seen frowning at hers from time to time, but she uses it as naturally as her other three hands."

rows.original: Her desk blocks any sight of the rest of her most of the time, but there’s no hiding the big bump of her ant-like abdomen, hanging out the back of a specially cut hole in her silky robe to dangle over the back of her stool. Similarly, whenever she shifts position, you can hear the metallic clinking of her two prosthetic legs.
rows.translation: 她的桌子通常挡住你观察其余身体的视线，但她蚂蚁般腹部隆起的大块轮廓根本藏不住；它从丝质长袍特意裁出的孔洞伸出，垂在凳子后方。同样，每当她变换姿势，你都能听见两条义腿发出的金属碰撞声。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer desk blocks any sight of the rest of her most of the time, but there’s no hiding the big bump of her ant-like abdomen, hanging out the back of a specially cut hole in her silky robe to dangle over the back of her stool. Similarly, whenever she shifts position, you can hear the metallic clinking of her two prosthetic legs."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一页
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “I wanna like, learn some stuff about... stuff!” you announce.
rows.translation: “人家想学点，那个……东西！”你宣布道。
rows.raw: "“I wanna like, learn some stuff about... stuff!” you announce."

rows.original: “I uh... have some questions,” you explain.
rows.translation: “我呃……有几个问题，”你解释道。
rows.raw: "“I uh... have some questions,” you explain."

rows.original: “Well, I have a few questions,” you say with a friendly grin.
rows.translation: “嗯，我有几个问题，”你友好地咧嘴说道。
rows.raw: "“Well, I have a few questions,” you say with a friendly grin."

rows.original: “I have a few things I’d like to figure out,” you smirk, “...besides your contact information.”
rows.translation: “有几件事我想弄明白，”你坏笑道，“……除了你的联系方式。”
rows.raw: "“I have a few things I’d like to figure out,” you smirk, “...besides your contact information.”"

rows.original: “I have a few things I need to discuss with you,” you explain.
rows.translation: “有几件事我需要和你讨论，”你解释道。
rows.raw: "“I have a few things I need to discuss with you,” you explain."

rows.original: Lyralla
rows.translation: 莱拉拉
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla"

rows.original: nods eagerly. “Certainly. Sharing knowledge is my passion. It was even before I became an ambassador.”
rows.translation: 热切地点头。“当然可以。分享知识是我的热情所在。在成为大使之前便是如此。”
rows.raw: " nods eagerly. “Certainly. Sharing knowledge is my passion. It was even before I became an ambassador.”"

rows.original: ’s antennae wiggle nervously. “I’m afraid you’d need to be a dignitary of some rank to have access to my diplomatic connections.” She smiles, her artificial eye twitching. Was that an attempt at a wink? “But I’d love to answer some of your more mundane questions.”
rows.translation: 的触角紧张地扭动着。“恐怕你得是具有一定级别的要员，才有资格使用我的外交联络渠道。”她微微一笑，机械眼抽动了一下。那是在试着眨眼吗？“不过，我很乐意回答你那些比较日常的问题。”
rows.raw: "’s antennae wiggle nervously. “I’m afraid you’d need to be a dignitary of some rank to have access to my diplomatic connections.” She smiles, her artificial eye twitching. Was that an attempt at a wink? “But I’d love to answer some of your more mundane questions.”"

rows.original: You ask about ‘the red.’ What’s the deal with her?
rows.translation: 你问起了“那个红方”。她究竟是怎么回事？
rows.raw: "You ask about ‘the red.’ What’s the deal with her?"

rows.original: Lyralla shakes her head. “She’s a lost cause. Would you believe I tried to make peace with her when she first got set up here? I thought... you know, if we could make peace, one woman to other, it’d be the first step towards stopping the fighting.”
rows.translation: 莱拉拉摇摇头。“她已经无可救药了。你能相信吗？她刚在这里安顿下来时，我曾试图与她和解。我当时想……你知道的，若我们能以女人对女人的方式达成和平，这就会是停止战争的第一步。”
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla shakes her head. “She’s a lost cause. Would you believe I tried to make peace with her when she first got set up here? I thought... you know, if we could make peace, one woman to other, it’d be the first step towards stopping the fighting.”"

rows.original: “How’d it go?”
rows.translation: “结果怎么样？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“How’d it go?”"

rows.original: “About as well as you might think. She pulled out a gun and threatened to shoot me. She said I was a ‘fucking spy’. Can you believe it?” All four of Lyralla’s arms shake with anger . “Apparently the reds are so addicted to violence and brutality that negotiations can only exist as a front for information gathering.” She slumps back in her chair. “I guess the only thing they understand are threats and military might. It is fortunate Juro and your people appeared when they did, or a lot more of my people might have needed these cybernetics.”
rows.translation: “差不多和你想的一样。她拔出枪威胁要射杀我，还说我是个‘该死的间谍’。你敢相信吗？”莱拉拉的四条手臂气得发抖。“显然，红方已经沉迷暴力与野蛮到了极点，认为谈判只能是搜集情报的幌子。”她瘫回椅子里。“我猜她们唯一能理解的就是威胁与军事实力。幸好朱罗和你们的人及时现身，否则我的人民中恐怕会有更多人需要这些义体。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“About as well as you might think. She pulled out a gun and threatened to shoot me. She said I was a ‘fucking spy’. Can you believe it?” All four of Lyralla’s arms shake with anger . “Apparently the reds are so addicted to violence and brutality that negotiations can only exist as a front for information gathering.” She slumps back in her chair. “I guess the only thing they understand are threats and military might. It is fortunate Juro and your people appeared when they did, or a lot more of my people might have needed these cybernetics.”"

rows.original: The ant-girl rotates her silvery hand before her mismatched eyes, a sour grimace painted on her inhuman features. “I know I was chosen for a reason, but... talking to Nehzara makes my job feel like a hopeless, pointless thing.”
rows.translation: 蚁女在那双不相称的眼睛前转动银色手掌，非人面庞上挂着苦涩的阴沉表情。“我知道自己获选是有原因的，可是……与内扎拉交谈，会让我觉得这份工作既无望又毫无意义。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe ant-girl rotates her silvery hand before her mismatched eyes, a sour grimace painted on her inhuman features. “I know I was chosen for a reason, but... talking to Nehzara makes my job feel like a hopeless, pointless thing.”"

rows.original: It might be best to change the topic.
rows.translation: 最好还是换个话题。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt might be best to change the topic."

rows.original: “So that Juro guy... you like him?”
rows.translation: “所以，那个叫朱罗的家伙……你喜欢他？”
rows.raw: "“So that Juro guy... you like him?”"

rows.original: Lyralla sits bolt upright, crossing a pair of arms above and below her bosom to steady its errant jiggling. “No, of course not! Not like you mean, anyway! Our relationship is friendly, professional, and appropriate to our stations - nothing more!” Her skin turns coppery from a deep blush, and her antennae dance along with it, nervously waggling.
rows.translation: 莱拉拉猛地坐直，一双手臂分别交叉在胸部上下，稳住那阵不受控制的晃动。“不，当然不！至少不是你所说的那种喜欢！我们的关系友好、专业，也符合各自身份——没有别的！”她因深深的羞红而变成铜色，触角也随之舞动，紧张地摇摆着。
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla sits bolt upright, crossing a pair of arms above and below her bosom to steady its errant jiggling. “No, of course not! Not like you mean, anyway! Our relationship is friendly, professional, and appropriate to our stations - nothing more!” Her skin turns coppery from a deep blush, and her antennae dance along with it, nervously waggling."

rows.original: Leaning back disbelievingly, you cock your head to the side.
rows.translation: 你难以置信地向后一仰，歪着脑袋。
rows.raw: "\n\nLeaning back disbelievingly, you cock your head to the side."

rows.original: The golden diplomat glowers at you. “Look, it would be completely improper for us to have anything other than a deep and mutual respect. It doesn’t matter how handsome he is or what his race can do with their balls.” Clapping her hands over her mouth, Lyralla swivels frantically in her chair, looking for a way out. She turns back to you after a moment, her head drooping low, defeated. Even her antennae seem flat and lifeless. “He’s a good man, [pc.name]. It can’t be more than that. Not until this mess is all over. If it’s ever over.”
rows.translation: 金色外交官怒视着你。“听着，我们之间若有超出深厚相互尊重之外的关系，就完全不合规矩。他有多英俊，或者他的种族能用他们的睾丸做什么，都不重要。”莱拉拉双手捂住嘴，在椅子上慌乱地左右转动，寻找脱身之法。片刻后，她重新转向你，脑袋垂得低低的，彻底认输。就连触角也显得瘫软无力。“他是个好人，[pc.name]。不能再有别的了。至少在这一团乱麻结束前不行——如果它真有结束的一天。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe golden diplomat glowers at you. “Look, it would be completely improper for us to have anything other than a deep and mutual respect. It doesn’t matter how handsome he is or what his race can do with their balls.” Clapping her hands over her mouth, Lyralla swivels frantically in her chair, looking for a way out. She turns back to you after a moment, her head drooping low, defeated. Even her antennae seem flat and lifeless. “He’s a good man, [pc.name]. It can’t be more than that. Not until this mess is all over. If it’s ever over.”"

rows.original: You ask her how she wound up here, like this.
rows.translation: 你问她是如何落到如今这般境地的。
rows.raw: "You ask her how she wound up here, like this."

rows.original: Lyralla pauses, considering for a moment. “That’s... not a question I expected, to be honest. Surely you’d want to know about how my people live, what we eat, or even how we reproduce, no?” She looks a little uncomfortable, fidgeting in her chair, a motion that only serves to make the top of her robe drift that much more open.
rows.translation: 莱拉拉停下来思考了一会儿。“说实话，这个问题……我没料到。你肯定会想了解我的人民如何生活、吃些什么，甚至怎样繁殖，不是吗？”她看起来有些不自在，在椅子上坐立不安；这个动作只让长袍上襟敞得更开。
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla pauses, considering for a moment. “That’s... not a question I expected, to be honest. Surely you’d want to know about how my people live, what we eat, or even how we reproduce, no?” She looks a little uncomfortable, fidgeting in her chair, a motion that only serves to make the top of her robe drift that much more open."

rows.original: You brazenly check out her tits until you realize that the blushing myrmedion is awaiting a response. “Uh... no?” you guess.
rows.translation: 你肆无忌惮地盯着她的奶子，直到意识到这位脸红的米尔米迪恩人还在等你回答。“呃……不想？”你猜测道。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou brazenly check out her tits until you realize that the blushing myrmedion is awaiting a response. “Uh... no?” you guess."

rows.original: You
rows.translation: 你
rows.raw: "\n\nYou "

rows.original: struggle to not stare at her cleavage but ultimately fail. There’s just too much delicious boob on display. Still, you manage to keep enough of your oversexed wits about you to answer, “No.”
rows.translation: 努力不去盯着她的乳沟，却最终失败。展露在外的诱人奶子实在太多了。不过，你仍勉强保持了足够清醒的色鬼理智，回答道：“不想。”
rows.raw: "struggle to not stare at her cleavage but ultimately fail. There’s just too much delicious boob on display. Still, you manage to keep enough of your oversexed wits about you to answer, “No.”"

rows.original: struggle to not stare at her deliciously full cleavage, barely dragging your eyes back up to her face in time to answer, “No.”
rows.translation: 努力不去盯着她诱人而丰满的乳沟，勉强及时将目光拉回她脸上，回答道：“不想。”
rows.raw: "struggle to not stare at her deliciously full cleavage, barely dragging your eyes back up to her face in time to answer, “No.”"

rows.original: easily avoid an interplanetary incident by keeping your eyes above her neck and answering, “No.”
rows.translation: 轻松地将视线保持在她脖子以上，避免引发一场星际事件，并回答道：“不想。”
rows.raw: "easily avoid an interplanetary incident by keeping your eyes above her neck and answering, “No.”"

rows.original: Lyralla places her lower palms together, bringing them up in front of her mouth while she tries not to blush. “Okay... if you say so. I just uh... had to be sure.” Her upper limbs reach around to tug her robe into a more chaste position.
rows.translation: 莱拉拉将下方的一双手掌合拢，举到嘴前，努力不让自己脸红。“好吧……既然你这么说。我只是呃……得确认一下。”她用上方的手臂伸过去拉扯长袍，让衣着变得更端庄。
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla places her lower palms together, bringing them up in front of her mouth while she tries not to blush. “Okay... if you say so. I just uh... had to be sure.” Her upper limbs reach around to tug her robe into a more chaste position."

rows.original: It’s far easier to remember that there’s a conversation now.
rows.translation: 现在要记住你们还在交谈可容易多了。
rows.raw: " It’s far easier to remember that there’s a conversation now."

rows.original: She shifts on her chair, her abdomen bouncing excitedly behind her. “Well, it’s kind of a crazy story. One day, I’m working at the knowledge house-” She pauses. “Perhaps library would be a more familiar term, though there are several distinct differences.”
rows.translation: 她在椅子上挪动身体，身后的腹部兴奋地弹跳着。“嗯，这故事有些疯狂。有一天，我正在知识馆工作——”她停顿了一下。“或许‘图书馆’是你更熟悉的说法，不过两者有几个明显区别。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe shifts on her chair, her abdomen bouncing excitedly behind her. “Well, it’s kind of a crazy story. One day, I’m working at the knowledge house-” She pauses. “Perhaps library would be a more familiar term, though there are several distinct differences.”"

rows.original: You nod. So she was something of their version of a librarian.
rows.translation: 你点点头。看来她相当于她们那里的图书管理员。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod. So she was something of their version of a librarian."

rows.original: “Anyway, I got word that I had been pulled for the draft. I was going to have to trade my time in the lore halls in for time in the trenches. The reds were making a big push for Kressia, and as you can imagine, we were starting to run low on able-bodied fighters.” Her metallic hand fiddles with an errant strand of obsidian hair. “They couldn’t even use me in the records department. No one ever gets shot in records.”
rows.translation: “总之，我收到消息，自己被征召入伍了。我不得不放弃在知识殿堂度过的时光，转而待在战壕里。红方正向克雷西亚大举推进，而你也能想象，我们能上阵作战的人开始所剩无几。”她的金属手拨弄着一缕散乱的黑曜石色头发。“她们甚至不肯把我安排到档案部门。档案部门从来没人会挨枪子。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyway, I got word that I had been pulled for the draft. I was going to have to trade my time in the lore halls in for time in the trenches. The reds were making a big push for Kressia, and as you can imagine, we were starting to run low on able-bodied fighters.” Her metallic hand fiddles with an errant strand of obsidian hair. “They couldn’t even use me in the records department. No one ever gets shot in records.”"

rows.original: “It must have been horrible,
rows.translation: “那一定很可怕，
rows.raw: "\n\n“It must have been horrible,"

rows.original: ” you
rows.translation: ”你
rows.raw: "” you "

rows.original: flatly
rows.translation: 平淡地
rows.raw: "flatly "

rows.original: reply.
rows.translation: 答道。
rows.raw: "reply."

rows.original: “There are so many words to describe hardship, and yet none of them seem correct.” Lyralla looks down at her desk. “We sat in our trenches with our guns and our axes, dreading the day that the reds would come upon us and butcher us by the hundred.” She wipes a tear from her good eye. “Every day, they’d fire hellscream missiles into our trenches. Every day we’d have to hear that awful banshee wail and dread that it would land on us.”
rows.translation: “描述苦难的词那么多，却没有一个显得准确。”莱拉拉低头看着桌面。“我们拿着枪和斧头坐在战壕中，恐惧红方来袭、将我们成百上千地屠杀的那一天。”她擦去好眼中流出的一滴泪。“她们每天都向我们的战壕发射狱啸导弹。我们每天都得听着那可怕的女妖尖啸，害怕它会落在自己头上。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“There are so many words to describe hardship, and yet none of them seem correct.” Lyralla looks down at her desk. “We sat in our trenches with our guns and our axes, dreading the day that the reds would come upon us and butcher us by the hundred.” She wipes a tear from her good eye. “Every day, they’d fire hellscream missiles into our trenches. Every day we’d have to hear that awful banshee wail and dread that it would land on us.”"

rows.original: She shudders. “It turned out I would never have to fight a red. One of those missiles hit my position just before your people arrived in orbit. I only lived because Mella, one of the girls in my unit, saw it coming and tackled some of us to the ground.” Lyralla turns her head away. “She didn’t make it, but I did. Somehow I did.”
rows.translation: 她打了个寒颤。“结果，我一次也没和红方交过手。就在你们的人抵达轨道前，一枚导弹击中了我的阵地。我能活下来，只因为我所在部队里一个叫梅拉的姑娘看见它飞来，把我们几个人扑倒在地。”莱拉拉将头转向一旁。“她没能活下来，但我活下来了。不知怎的，我活下来了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe shudders. “It turned out I would never have to fight a red. One of those missiles hit my position just before your people arrived in orbit. I only lived because Mella, one of the girls in my unit, saw it coming and tackled some of us to the ground.” Lyralla turns her head away. “She didn’t make it, but I did. Somehow I did.”"

rows.original: You look down, unsure of what to say.
rows.translation: 你垂下目光，不知该说些什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou look down, unsure of what to say."

rows.original: The gold-hued cyborg goes on. “Your fleet offered medical assistance to the wounded once the cease-fire was established. I volunteered, feeling I had nothing more to live for. I might as well spare my sisters having to gamble on the generosity of aliens. I had no idea about all this.” She glances over towards Juro, a fond look on her face, but her arms are gesturing to the varied races as a whole.
rows.translation: 这位金色义体人继续说道：“停火协议达成后，你们的舰队向伤员提供医疗援助。我自愿去了，觉得自己已经没什么活下去的理由。不妨由我替姐妹们承受向外星人的慷慨心下注的风险。我完全不知道外面还有这一切。”她朝朱罗的方向看去，脸上流露出喜爱之情，不过她的手臂指向的是形形色色的所有种族。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe gold-hued cyborg goes on. “Your fleet offered medical assistance to the wounded once the cease-fire was established. I volunteered, feeling I had nothing more to live for. I might as well spare my sisters having to gamble on the generosity of aliens. I had no idea about all this.” She glances over towards Juro, a fond look on her face, but her arms are gesturing to the varied races as a whole."

rows.original: “The technology you have... it’s incredible - almost magical. And yet you barely seem aware of the daily treasures you interact with. I had resigned myself to living the rest of my life half-blind in a chair, forgotten in some dark corner, and your people gave me my life back.” She pulls the sleeve on her metal limb back, exposing the ugly prosthetic. “It may make a lot of noise and scare away any male myr, but it lets me feel something close to whole. I had given up on that.” She looks at Juro once more, red eye focusing noisily. “Now I have a galaxy’s worth of information at my fingertips and marvelous company too... so long as that red stays in her hole.”
rows.translation: “你们拥有的技术……简直不可思议——几乎就像魔法。然而，你们似乎几乎意识不到自己每天都在接触怎样的珍宝。我本已认命，余生只能半盲地坐在椅子上，被遗忘在某个黑暗角落，而你们的人让我重获新生。”她将金属肢体上的袖子向后拉，露出丑陋的义肢。“它也许会发出很多噪音，吓跑所有米尔男性，但它让我感觉自己接近完整。我本已放弃这种希望。”她再次看向朱罗，红色眼睛发出嘈杂的聚焦声。“如今，整个银河的信息都触手可及，还有绝佳的陪伴……只要对面那个红方老实待在她的洞里。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The technology you have... it’s incredible - almost magical. And yet you barely seem aware of the daily treasures you interact with. I had resigned myself to living the rest of my life half-blind in a chair, forgotten in some dark corner, and your people gave me my life back.” She pulls the sleeve on her metal limb back, exposing the ugly prosthetic. “It may make a lot of noise and scare away any male myr, but it lets me feel something close to whole. I had given up on that.” She looks at Juro once more, red eye focusing noisily. “Now I have a galaxy’s worth of information at my fingertips and marvelous company too... so long as that red stays in her hole.”"

rows.original: The Red?
rows.translation: 红方？
rows.raw: "The Red?"

rows.original: The Red?
rows.translation: 红方？
rows.raw: "The Red?"

rows.original: Ask Lyralla about the red ambassador - the one she seems pissed off at.
rows.translation: 向莱拉拉询问那位红方大使——她似乎很恼火的那个人。
rows.raw: "Ask Lyralla about the red ambassador - the one she seems pissed off at."

rows.original: Cybernetics?
rows.translation: 义体？
rows.raw: "Cybernetics?"

rows.original: You steer the topic toward the cybernetic parts she has now.
rows.translation: 你把话题引向她如今拥有的义体部件。
rows.raw: "You steer the topic toward the cybernetic parts she has now."

rows.original: “What’s it like?” She holds the glittering metal up before her glowing eye. “It’s constant pain and your body never behaving like you think it should... and it’s wonderful too.” Lyralla blinks at you. “It’s a long way from perfect. The doctors haven’t gotten our nervous system perfectly mapped yet. Sometimes I wind up breaking things I mean to pick up. Other times just waking up in the morning gives me a migraine headache.” She rubs the back of her neck nervously. “All the headaches in the world are worth it, though.”
rows.translation: “是什么感觉？”她将闪亮的金属手举到发光的眼睛前。“身体无时无刻不在疼痛，也永远不会像你以为的那样行动……可它同时又很美妙。”莱拉拉朝你眨眨眼。“它离完美还差得远。医生们还没能完整绘制我们的神经系统。有时我会不小心弄坏本想拿起来的东西。有时光是早晨醒来，就会让我偏头痛发作。”她紧张地揉着后颈。“不过，就算全世界的头痛加在一起，也是值得的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What’s it like?” She holds the glittering metal up before her glowing eye. “It’s constant pain and your body never behaving like you think it should... and it’s wonderful too.” Lyralla blinks at you. “It’s a long way from perfect. The doctors haven’t gotten our nervous system perfectly mapped yet. Sometimes I wind up breaking things I mean to pick up. Other times just waking up in the morning gives me a migraine headache.” She rubs the back of her neck nervously. “All the headaches in the world are worth it, though.”"

rows.original: The ant-girl points at the sign on the far wall. “See that sign? I can read it. It says ‘No unauthorized entry.’” Lyralla beams. “This eye - ugly as it is - it lets me see better than the real one ever could. My people have poor vision. Few of my sisters would be capable of such a feat.”
rows.translation: 蚁女指向远处墙上的标牌。“看到那块牌子了吗？我能读懂。上面写着‘未经授权，禁止入内’。”莱拉拉喜笑颜开。“这只眼睛——虽然很丑——却让我比真眼看得更清楚。我的人民视力很差，很少有姐妹能做到这种事。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe ant-girl points at the sign on the far wall. “See that sign? I can read it. It says ‘No unauthorized entry.’” Lyralla beams. “This eye - ugly as it is - it lets me see better than the real one ever could. My people have poor vision. Few of my sisters would be capable of such a feat.”"

rows.original: “What about your arm? Or legs?”
rows.translation: “那你的手臂呢？或者腿？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What about your arm? Or legs?”"

rows.original: Lyralla shrugs. “They do what they’re supposed to. I’m stronger, I guess, but who cares? Physical strength is a weapon of last resort, the sort of thing only a brainless brute would care about. What good does lifting heavy things do against a missile? How useful is brawn against an invisible gas?” She leans in close, confident once more. “We wouldn’t need it at all if the red across the hall could be talked to like a civilized creature - like Juro or you.”
rows.translation: 莱拉拉耸耸肩。“它们能完成该做的事。我想，我确实更强壮了，可谁在乎呢？体力是最后手段的武器，只有没脑子的蛮人才会在意。抬起重物对付导弹有什么用？蛮力面对看不见的毒气又能派上什么用场？”她靠近过来，重新恢复自信。“若对面那个红方能像文明生物一样沟通——像朱罗或你一样——我们根本就不需要这些。”
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla shrugs. “They do what they’re supposed to. I’m stronger, I guess, but who cares? Physical strength is a weapon of last resort, the sort of thing only a brainless brute would care about. What good does lifting heavy things do against a missile? How useful is brawn against an invisible gas?” She leans in close, confident once more. “We wouldn’t need it at all if the red across the hall could be talked to like a civilized creature - like Juro or you.”"

rows.original: An air of finality hangs over that. Is there anything else you’d like to talk to her about?
rows.translation: 话题似乎就此盖棺定论。你还有别的事想和她谈吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nAn air of finality hangs over that. Is there anything else you’d like to talk to her about?"

rows.original: The Red?
rows.translation: 红方？
rows.raw: "The Red?"

rows.original: The Red?
rows.translation: 红方？
rows.raw: "The Red?"

rows.original: Ask Lyralla about the red ambassador - the one she seems pissed off at.
rows.translation: 向莱拉拉询问那位红方大使，也就是那个似乎惹恼了她的人。
rows.raw: "Ask Lyralla about the red ambassador - the one she seems pissed off at."

rows.original: Juro
rows.translation: 朱罗
rows.raw: "Juro"

rows.original: Juro
rows.translation: 朱罗
rows.raw: "Juro"

rows.translation: 向莱拉拉询问朱罗，那位银河联合邦联的外交官。她似乎很喜欢他。
rows.raw: "Ask Lyralla about Juro, the U.G.C. diplomat. She appears quite fond of him."

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: Cybernetics?
rows.translation: 义体？
rows.raw: "Cybernetics?"

rows.original: Ask Lyralla more about her parts. What’s it like having a metal arm and robotic eye?
rows.translation: 进一步询问莱拉拉身上那些义体。拥有一条金属手臂和一只机械眼是什么感觉？
rows.raw: "Ask Lyralla more about her parts. What’s it like having a metal arm and robotic eye?"

rows.original: Juro
rows.translation: 朱罗
rows.raw: "Juro"

rows.original: Juro
rows.translation: 朱罗
rows.raw: "Juro"

rows.original: Ask Lyralla about Juro, the U.G.C. diplomat. She appears quite fond of him.
rows.translation: 向莱拉拉询问朱罗，那位银河联合邦联的外交官。她似乎很喜欢他。
rows.raw: "Ask Lyralla about Juro, the U.G.C. diplomat. She appears quite fond of him."

rows.original: Like, how’d you get this cool job?
rows.translation: 话说，你是怎么得到这份酷炫工作的？
rows.raw: "Like, how’d you get this cool job?"

rows.original: How’d you score this job?
rows.translation: 你是怎么得到这份工作的？
rows.raw: "How’d you score this job?"

rows.original: So how’d you wind up chosen as the diplomat for your people?
rows.translation: 所以，你最后是怎么被选为自己族人的外交官的？
rows.raw: "So how’d you wind up chosen as the diplomat for your people?"

rows.original: Lyralla straightens in her chair, smiling. <i>“
rows.translation: 莱拉拉在椅子上坐直身子，微笑着。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla straightens in her chair, smiling. <i>“"

rows.original: I guess I can tell you one more time.
rows.translation: 我想我可以再告诉你一次。
rows.raw: "I guess I can tell you one more time."

rows.original: I suppose I managed to avoid discussing the circumstances of my appointment, didn’t I?
rows.translation: 看来我确实设法避开了自己受任经过的话题，对吧？
rows.raw: "I suppose I managed to avoid discussing the circumstances of my appointment, didn’t I?"

rows.original: I’ll spare you the grizzlier parts of the story.
rows.translation: 我就不讲故事里那些比较血腥的部分了。
rows.raw: "I’ll spare you the grizzlier parts of the story."

rows.original: ” Her lower arms rest comfortably on her desk, the upper pair falling across her chest to hide some of her golden bosom. “I was already here having my wounds tended to by your doctors.” The buxom diplomat grins. “They’re quite the capable bunch, I must admit.” Pride and thankfulness war for control of the pitch of her voice, neither able to beat out the other entirely.
rows.translation: ”她下方的一双手臂舒适地搭在桌上，上方的一双则横在胸前，遮住一部分金色的丰满乳房。“当时我已经在这里接受你们医生的伤势治疗了。”这位丰满的外交官咧嘴一笑。“我必须承认，他们确实很有本事。”自豪与感激争相主导她的语调，却谁也没能彻底压过另一方。
rows.raw: "” Her lower arms rest comfortably on her desk, the upper pair falling across her chest to hide some of her golden bosom. “I was already here having my wounds tended to by your doctors.” The buxom diplomat grins. “They’re quite the capable bunch, I must admit.” Pride and thankfulness war for control of the pitch of her voice, neither able to beat out the other entirely."

rows.original: You follow the gold myr’s gaze toward a few passing medics.
rows.translation: 你顺着这名金米尔的目光望向几位路过的医护人员。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou follow the gold myr’s gaze toward a few passing medics."

rows.original: “I came out from under the anesthetic one day; my eye had just been fitted, you see.” She waves at her optical implant. “And I was needing something to do. My new legs weren’t healed enough for me to be on them for more than a few minutes at a time yet.”
rows.translation: “有一天，我从麻醉中醒来；你看，我的眼睛刚刚装好。”她朝自己的光学植入体挥了挥手。“而且我需要找点事情做。我的新腿还没恢复到能让我一次站上几分钟以上。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I came out from under the anesthetic one day; my eye had just been fitted, you see.” She waves at her optical implant. “And I was needing something to do. My new legs weren’t healed enough for me to be on them for more than a few minutes at a time yet.”"

rows.original: Looking lower, you spy a bit of chrome under the edge of her desk.
rows.translation: 视线下移，你瞥见她桌沿下露出的一点铬色金属。
rows.raw: "\n\nLooking lower, you spy a bit of chrome under the edge of her desk."

rows.original: Lyralla is either oblivious to your roaming eyes or used to the curiosity. If it bothers her, she doesn’t show it. “I was asking for something to read when Juro came by. He changed everything.”
rows.translation: 莱拉拉要么没注意到你游移的目光，要么早已习惯别人的好奇。即使这令她不快，她也没有表现出来。“我正想要些读物时，朱罗过来了。他改变了一切。”
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla is either oblivious to your roaming eyes or used to the curiosity. If it bothers her, she doesn’t show it. “I was asking for something to read when Juro came by. He changed everything.”"

rows.original: You cock your head to the side. <i>“Juro?
rows.translation: 你把头歪向一边。<i>“朱罗？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou cock your head to the side. <i>“Juro? "

rows.original: Was that like, the cute, fuzzy guy?
rows.translation: 是那个可爱又毛茸茸的家伙吗？
rows.raw: "Was that like, the cute, fuzzy guy?"

rows.original: The kui-tan over there?
rows.translation: 那边那个奎坦人？
rows.raw: "The kui-tan over there?"

rows.original: “Yeah, that’s him.” Lyralla’s robotic eye whirs, dilating as it loses focus.
rows.translation: “对，就是他。”莱拉拉的机械眼嗡嗡作响，瞳孔因失去焦点而放大。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, that’s him.” Lyralla’s robotic eye whirs, dilating as it loses focus."

rows.original: She’s going to need to get used to having such an easy-to-read eye if she wants to keep her job. It’s obvious she has feelings for him.
rows.translation: 如果莱拉拉想保住这份工作，她就得习惯拥有一只这么容易被看透的眼睛。她显然对他有好感。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe’s going to need to get used to having such an easy-to-read eye if she wants to keep her job. It’s obvious she has feelings for him."

rows.original: The ant-woman blithely continues on. “I am unsure if it was pity that brought him to talk with me or a deeper commonality of spirit, but when I requested reading materials, he was the one to bring them to me.” Her smile widens as she remembers. “He had the tomes I requested as well as a tablet loaded with some of his own favorite selections. I doubt he’s ever carried such a heavy load before! He nearly toppled just getting into the door to my room.”
rows.translation: 这位蚁女若无其事地继续说道。“我不知道他是出于怜悯才来找我谈话，还是因为我们在精神上有更深的共鸣，但当我提出想要读物时，正是他把书送到了我面前。”回忆起来，她的笑容愈发灿烂。“他不仅带来了我指定的典籍，还带了一块装有他个人爱读作品的平板。我怀疑他以前从没搬过这么重的东西！他光是走进我的病房就差点摔倒。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe ant-woman blithely continues on. “I am unsure if it was pity that brought him to talk with me or a deeper commonality of spirit, but when I requested reading materials, he was the one to bring them to me.” Her smile widens as she remembers. “He had the tomes I requested as well as a tablet loaded with some of his own favorite selections. I doubt he’s ever carried such a heavy load before! He nearly toppled just getting into the door to my room.”"

rows.raw: "\n\nYou "
