rows.translation: 轻笑
rows.raw: "chuckle"

rows.original: giggle
rows.translation: 咯咯笑
rows.raw: "giggle"

rows.original: , imagining the bookish kui-tan trying to wrangle so many primitive texts at once.
rows.translation: ，想象着那个书卷气十足的奎坦人试图一次搬动那么多原始书籍的模样。
rows.raw: ", imagining the bookish kui-tan trying to wrangle so many primitive texts at once."

rows.original: Lyralla laughs with you. “Yes, he was quite the sight. He’s a good man, that one. He only dropped The Karkashane Rhythms. Quite a feat for one of a race without four arms.”
rows.translation: 莱拉拉也和你一起笑了起来。“是啊，那副模样可真值得一看。他是个好人。他只掉了那本《卡卡沙恩韵律》。对一个没有四条手臂的种族来说，这已经是了不起的壮举了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla laughs with you. “Yes, he was quite the sight. He’s a good man, that one. He only dropped The Karkashane Rhythms. Quite a feat for one of a race without four arms.”"

rows.original: The myr do have a discrete advantage in that department.
rows.translation: 米尔在这方面确实拥有明显优势。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe myr do have a discrete advantage in that department."

rows.original: “He had been using his lunch breaks to talk to the wounded - from both sides, trying to size us up, cheer us up, and get to know us a little better,” Lyralla explains. “That day, we talked until the third time his subordinates called for him. We compared histories both ancient and modern, and somehow even wasted a quarter of the hour on talk of weather formations.”
rows.translation: “他一直利用午休时间与伤员交谈，双方的伤员都聊，试着摸清我们的底细、鼓舞我们，也进一步了解我们，”莱拉拉解释道。“那天，我们一直聊到他的下属第三次来叫他。我们比较了古代和近现代的历史，不知怎么还浪费了整整一刻钟来谈天气形态。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“He had been using his lunch breaks to talk to the wounded - from both sides, trying to size us up, cheer us up, and get to know us a little better,” Lyralla explains. “That day, we talked until the third time his subordinates called for him. We compared histories both ancient and modern, and somehow even wasted a quarter of the hour on talk of weather formations.”"

rows.original: “Maybe you should have become a meteorologist,” you quip.
rows.translation: “也许你本该成为气象学家，”你打趣道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Maybe you should have become a meteorologist,” you quip."

rows.original: “That’s a lot of time to talk about clouds,” you respond.
rows.translation: “花这么长时间聊云，够夸张的，”你答道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s a lot of time to talk about clouds,” you respond."

rows.original: Lyralla’s gold-tanned skin darkens copper. <i>“
rows.translation: 莱拉拉被晒成金色的皮肤泛起铜红。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla’s gold-tanned skin darkens copper. <i>“"

rows.original: Oh, I could never.
rows.translation: 噢，我可做不来。
rows.raw: "Oh, I could never."

rows.original: It is, isn’t it?
rows.translation: 确实挺久的，对吧？
rows.raw: "It is, isn’t it?"

rows.original: We did hit it off, though. He came back the next day like clockwork, asking which books I had read. When I told him that I’d need a whole new batch of tomes, he nearly fainted,” she giggles. “Of course, I didn’t need more books - I had a tablet full of hundreds still to read. We talked about a few of them, and I even convinced him to give a few of our philosophers’ manuscripts a once-over.”
rows.translation: 不过我们确实很合得来。第二天，他像钟表一样准时回来，问我读了哪些书。当我告诉他自己需要一整批新典籍时，他差点晕过去，”她咯咯笑道。“当然，我其实并不需要更多书，平板里还有几百本没读。我们聊了其中几本，我甚至说服他抽空读一读我们几位哲学家的手稿。”
rows.raw: " We did hit it off, though. He came back the next day like clockwork, asking which books I had read. When I told him that I’d need a whole new batch of tomes, he nearly fainted,” she giggles. “Of course, I didn’t need more books - I had a tablet full of hundreds still to read. We talked about a few of them, and I even convinced him to give a few of our philosophers’ manuscripts a once-over.”"

rows.original: “Not too shabby.”
rows.translation: “还真不赖。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not too shabby.”"

rows.original: “Not too shabby indeed! I guess the breadth of my knowledge impressed him, because he was back a third time, suggesting I petition the Council of Queens for the position of ambassador. He even wrote up a recommendation.” Lyralla’s excitement is almost contagious. “All that time memorizing dusty old tomes turned out to be useful for something besides answering inane questions. I got word that I had been selected the next day.”
rows.translation: “确实很不赖！我猜我广博的知识给他留下了深刻印象，因为他第三次回来时，建议我向女王议会申请大使职位。他甚至还写了一封推荐信。”莱拉拉的兴奋几乎能感染旁人。“那些花在背诵尘封旧典上的时间，终于除了回答无聊问题外还有了别的用处。第二天，我就收到自己获选的消息。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not too shabby indeed! I guess the breadth of my knowledge impressed him, because he was back a third time, suggesting I petition the Council of Queens for the position of ambassador. He even wrote up a recommendation.” Lyralla’s excitement is almost contagious. “All that time memorizing dusty old tomes turned out to be useful for something besides answering inane questions. I got word that I had been selected the next day.”"

rows.original: What? “Wouldn’t there be hundreds of other candidates to wade through?”
rows.translation: 什么？“难道不该有几百名其他候选人需要筛选吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat? “Wouldn’t there be hundreds of other candidates to wade through?”"

rows.original: Lyralla openly smirks. “I would have thought so too, but it turned out they were split over two other candidates when my request arrived. Each had strong ties to powerful queens. The Council had been deadlocked for days, bickering endlessly. Politics as usual. My Queen is young - seen as weak enough that she and her brood could be easily controlled by either side. I was the eleventh hour compromise.” The myr’s smile looks a little more wan than before. “Every day I receive missives from my Queen about the pressure her rivals have her under, but I do my best for her and my people. Besides, we’ve gained no small amount of prestige from being the primary liaison between our people and the aliens with enough firepower to flatten our world.”
rows.translation: 莱拉拉毫不掩饰地露出得意笑容。“我原本也这么想，可事实证明，我的申请送达时，她们正为另外两名候选人争执不下。两人都与有权势的女王关系密切。议会已经僵持了好几天，没完没了地争吵。政治一向如此。我的女王很年轻，大家都认为她软弱到足以让任何一方轻易控制她和她的族群。我成了最后关头的折中人选。”这名米尔的笑容比先前黯淡了一些。“我每天都会收到女王的信件，讲述她的对手给她施加的压力，但我会为她和我的人民竭尽全力。况且，作为我们族人与那些拥有足以夷平我们世界之火力的外星人之间的主要联络人，我们也赢得了相当可观的声望。”
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla openly smirks. “I would have thought so too, but it turned out they were split over two other candidates when my request arrived. Each had strong ties to powerful queens. The Council had been deadlocked for days, bickering endlessly. Politics as usual. My Queen is young - seen as weak enough that she and her brood could be easily controlled by either side. I was the eleventh hour compromise.” The myr’s smile looks a little more wan than before. “Every day I receive missives from my Queen about the pressure her rivals have her under, but I do my best for her and my people. Besides, we’ve gained no small amount of prestige from being the primary liaison between our people and the aliens with enough firepower to flatten our world.”"

rows.original: Well, that’s something.
rows.translation: 好吧，这也算是件好事。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, that’s something."

rows.original: The robed diplomat pauses to consider her words for a moment, calming herself. “That’s the long and short of it. Is there anything else you’d like to ask?”
rows.translation: 这位身穿长袍的外交官停下来斟酌片刻，让自己平静下来。“事情大致就是这样。你还有什么想问的吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe robed diplomat pauses to consider her words for a moment, calming herself. “That’s the long and short of it. Is there anything else you’d like to ask?”"

rows.original: You ask her about her Queen. That’s like her mother, right?
rows.translation: 你向她询问她的女王。那就像是她的母亲，对吧？
rows.raw: "You ask her about her Queen. That’s like her mother, right?"

rows.original: Chuckling, Lyralla answers, “Yes and no. The term ‘mother’ in your tongue is weighted down by connotations of personal nurturing and closeness.” Her eyes twinkle. “This is why mastery of language is so important to what I do. So many misunderstandings could have arisen in our discussion if I wasn’t in the process of learning your tongues.” She leans over, her large tits nearly spilling out of her robe. “Yes, she gave me life, but no, she did not raise me, at least not directly.”
rows.translation: 莱拉拉轻笑着回答：“是，也不是。在你们的语言里，‘母亲’这个词承载着亲自养育与亲密关系的含义。”她眼中闪烁着光芒。“这正是精通语言对我的工作如此重要的原因。如果我没有在学习你们的语言，我们的谈话中可能已经产生了许多误解。”她俯过身来，硕大的乳房几乎要从长袍里溢出。“没错，是她赐予我生命，但不，她并没有养育我，至少没有亲自养育。”
rows.raw: "\n\nChuckling, Lyralla answers, “Yes and no. The term ‘mother’ in your tongue is weighted down by connotations of personal nurturing and closeness.” Her eyes twinkle. “This is why mastery of language is so important to what I do. So many misunderstandings could have arisen in our discussion if I wasn’t in the process of learning your tongues.” She leans over, her large tits nearly spilling out of her robe. “Yes, she gave me life, but no, she did not raise me, at least not directly.”"

rows.original: “Who did?”
rows.translation: “那是谁养育了你？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Who did?”"

rows.original: “The thollum.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The thollum.”"

rows.original: You try to wrap your head around the strange word. The autotranslators in your blood don’t offer up any suitable comparisons.
rows.translation: 你试图理解这个陌生的词。你血液里的自动翻译器也找不到任何合适的对应概念。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou try to wrap your head around the strange word. The autotranslators in your blood don’t offer up any suitable comparisons."

rows.original: Lyralla explains, “Thollums are roughly analogous to boarding schools, large extended families, and technical colleges. We are raised in classes of our sister siblings, educated in general disciplines until we choose one to focus on. The drones are raised elsewhere, of course. Their presence would be immensely distracting from our education.” She titters. “I’ll never understand why so many terrans try to get any learning done around the opposite gender after puberty. It’s pointless!”
rows.translation: 莱拉拉解释道：“托勒姆大致相当于寄宿学校、庞大的大家庭和技术学院的结合体。我们与同胞姐妹一起分班成长，先接受通识教育，直到选定一个专业方向。当然，雄蜂会在其他地方长大。他们的存在会严重干扰我们的学业。”她窃笑起来。“我永远无法理解，为什么那么多泰伦人会在青春期后还试图和异性待在一起学习。那根本不可能！”
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla explains, “Thollums are roughly analogous to boarding schools, large extended families, and technical colleges. We are raised in classes of our sister siblings, educated in general disciplines until we choose one to focus on. The drones are raised elsewhere, of course. Their presence would be immensely distracting from our education.” She titters. “I’ll never understand why so many terrans try to get any learning done around the opposite gender after puberty. It’s pointless!”"

rows.original: Thinking back, it does make a certain kind of sense.
rows.translation: 回想起来，这确实有几分道理。
rows.raw: "\n\nThinking back, it does make a certain kind of sense."

rows.original: But why would you want to learn when there’s so much
rows.translation: 不过身边有这么多
rows.raw: " But why would you want to learn when there’s so much "

rows.translation: 肉棒
rows.raw: "dick"

rows.translation: 骚穴
rows.raw: "pussy"

rows.translation: 时，谁还会想学习呢？

rows.translation: 莱拉拉摇摇头，对你的反应报以微笑。“看来我确实跑题了。你究竟想了解我的女王哪方面的事？”
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla shakes her head and smiles at your reaction. “Surely I’ve gotten off base here. What exactly did you want to know about my Queen?”"

rows.original: Meet Her?
rows.translation: 见她？
rows.raw: "Meet Her?"

rows.original: You
rows.translation: 你

rows.translation: 莱拉拉好奇地看着你，摇了摇头。“伊蕾莉娅女王不是那种会接待社交拜访的人，尤其是如今她承受着这么大的政治压力。我想她正忙着……嗯——”她移开视线，下颌一阵绷紧又放松。“我不确定自己该不该说。对你们许多世界的人而言，这个话题是禁忌。”

rows.original: Lyralla sighs and graces you with a tired smile. “It isn’t just some... lewd... pleasure-seeking thing.” She pauses and chews her lower lip. “At least, I don’t think so. The higher the portion of the population you produce, the more power you have to rule it. Queen Irellia’s initial holdings were small, owing to a low egg count from her first matings, but she has tirelessly courted more drones, kept her body working around the clock nonstop to catch up to the others.”
rows.translation: 莱拉拉叹了口气，疲惫地朝你笑了笑。“这不只是某种……淫荡的……寻欢作乐。”她停下来咬了咬下唇。“至少我认为不是。我的意思是，她或许喜欢这么做。我从没亲自见过她，但重点不在这里。对女王而言，她们的投票权与自己仍然活着的子嗣数量直接成正比。你孕育的人口占比越高，就拥有越大的权力来统治他们。伊蕾莉娅女王最初的领地很小，因为她头几次交配产下的卵不多，但她不知疲倦地争取更多雄蜂，让身体昼夜不停地运转，以追赶其他女王。”

rows.original: “Yes. She’s already overtaken other queens around her own age, and lately her egg yields are through the roof. If she continues like this... our family may one day be the most powerful in all of Gildenmere.” Lyrella pauses uncomfortably. “Assuming there’s still a Gildenmere.”
rows.translation: “是的。她已经超越了其他与她年龄相仿的女王，最近的产卵量更是高得惊人。如果她继续这样下去……我们的家族或许有一天会成为整个吉尔登米尔最强大的家族。”莱拉拉不自在地停顿了一下。“前提是吉尔登米尔依然存在。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes. She’s already overtaken other queens around her own age, and lately her egg yields are through the roof. If she continues like this... our family may one day be the most powerful in all of Gildenmere.” Lyrella pauses uncomfortably. “Assuming there’s still a Gildenmere.”"

rows.original: “Full names often are, but only because they are so full of meaning. She was given the name Ildris Nere from her thollum’s registrar. Most myr only ever have two names, their assigned name and their Queen’s name. For instance, I am Lyralla Irellia. Queen Irellia’s mother’s is Queen Nere. She still sits on the council.”
rows.translation: “全名往往都很长，但只是因为其中蕴含的意义太丰富了。她的托勒姆注册员给她取名伊尔德里斯·奈蕾。大多数米尔一生只有两个名字，一个是被指定的名字，另一个是自己女王的名字。比如，我叫莱拉拉·伊蕾莉娅。伊蕾莉娅女王的母亲是奈蕾女王。她至今仍在议会任职。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Full names often are, but only because they are so full of meaning. She was given the name Ildris Nere from her thollum’s registrar. rows.translation: 你身体前倾，对她们命名方式中明显的相似与差异产生了兴趣。“那其他名字呢？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lean forward, intrigued by the similarities and obvious differences in their naming scheme. “But what about the other names?”"

rows.original: Lyralla smiles. “It’s good to have an eager pupil. Every queen chooses a Queen Name, the title that she will go by on the council and that her children will bear for her. Obviously Queen Irellia has chosen Irellia as her title, and I bear it for her as my second name.” She steeples her lower fingers. “The last and final part of her name is vas Uldred. Vas indicates a dwelling or physical location. It is used in this instance to indicate that the following word is her house. The seat of power. The place in the city from which she reigns.”
rows.translation: 莱拉拉微笑道：“有个求知若渴的学生真好。每位女王都会选择一个女王名，也就是她在议会使用的称号，以及她的孩子为她承载的名字。显然，伊蕾莉娅女王选择了伊蕾莉娅作为自己的称号，而我也以它作为第二个名字来代表她。”她将下方双手的指尖并拢。“她名字最后一部分是瓦斯·乌尔德雷德。瓦斯表示住所或实际地点。在这里，它用来说明后面的词是她的家宅、权力中心，也是她统治这座城市的地方。”
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla smiles. “It’s good to have an eager pupil. Every queen chooses a Queen Name, the title that she will go by on the council and that her children will bear for her. Obviously Queen Irellia has chosen Irellia as her title, and I bear it for her as my second name.” She steeples her lower fingers. “The last and final part of her name is vas Uldred. Vas indicates a dwelling or physical location. It is used in this instance to indicate that the following word is her house. The seat of power. The place in the city from which she reigns.”"

rows.original: Lyralla sighs. “Cultural diversity can be such a bother. What seems obvious to me is utterly alien to you.” She holds out all four hands, shaking the upper left one first. “Okay, first up is her chosen queen name - Irellia. It’s what most people will call her and what her children, like me will bear as our second name.”
rows.translation: 莱拉拉叹了口气。“文化差异有时候真麻烦。在我看来理所当然的事情，对你而言却完全陌生。”她伸出四只手，先晃了晃左上方那只。“好吧，首先是她自选的女王名——伊蕾莉娅。大多数人都会这样称呼她，她的孩子，比如我，也会把它作为第二个名字。”

It’s what most people will call her and what her children, like me will bear as our second name.”"

rows.original: She lowers that hand and makes a cupping motion with her metallic one, as if it could hold the next part. “Second is Ildris. That’s the name she was assigned in her thollum.”
rows.translation: 她放下那只手，又用金属手掌做出托捧的动作，仿佛能把名字的下一部分盛在其中。“第二个是伊尔德里斯。这是她在托勒姆里获授的名字。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe lowers that hand and makes a cupping motion with her metallic one, as if it could hold the next part. “Second is Ildris. That’s the name she was assigned in her thollum.”"

rows.original: The smiling diplomat drops that hand with a noisy clank, leaving only her lower two remaining. She motions with part of the remaining pair while she explains, “Next is Nere. If she weren’t a queen, it would be what you might call a last name. Our last name’s are our mother’s chosen queen name instead of a father’s family name.”
rows.translation: 面带微笑的外交官把那只手也放下，伴随一声响亮的金属撞击，只剩下方两只手还举着。她用其中一只比划着解释道：“接下来是奈蕾。如果她不是女王，这大概就是你们所谓的姓氏。我们的姓氏取自母亲自选的女王名，而不是父亲的家族名。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe smiling diplomat drops that hand with a noisy clank, leaving only her lower two remaining. She motions with part of the remaining pair while she explains, “Next is Nere. If she weren’t a queen, it would be what you might call a last name. Our last name’s are our mother’s chosen queen name instead of a father’s family name.”"

rows.original: Lowering that hand, she leaves herself with one outward-splayed palm. “The final part of her name is two parts: vas followed by the name of their house. The house name usually refers to specific structure within the Queen’s home city, but for some particularly blessed queens it can refer to a wider area of the city or even an entire settlement if she’s the only fertile female in the area.”
rows.translation: 她又放下那只手，只留一只手掌向外摊开。“她名字的最后一部分由两部分组成：先是瓦斯，后面接她家宅的名字。家宅名通常指女王故乡城市中的某座特定建筑；但对一些格外蒙福的女王而言，它也可能指城市中更大的一片区域，甚至整座聚落——前提是她是当地唯一具有生育能力的女性。”

Just think, you already understand more about us than most of the galaxy. The more we share, the closer we can work together for the betterment of all. Now, was there something else you wanted to discuss?”

rows.original: Lyralla snorts. “Have you seen any of those goose-stepping, Scarlet Federation goons? It doesn’t take much to see who the real bad guy is here. They won’t even show their faces here in the DMZ, hiding behind those absurd masks of theirs! As if we would gas our OWN people just to kill a diplomat and a few troopers - preposterous!” The diplomat is scowling for once, a smoldering pit of anger burning in her one inky eye.
rows.translation: 莱拉拉嗤了一声。“你见过那些迈着正步的猩红联邦暴徒吗？谁才是真正的恶人，一眼就看得出来。她们在非军事区连脸都不敢露，躲在那些荒谬的面具后面！说得好像我们会为了杀一个外交官和几个士兵，就给自己的人民下毒气一样——荒谬！”这位外交官难得怒容满面，唯一那只墨黑眼眸里燃着一团闷烧的怒火。
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla snorts. “Have you seen any of those goose-stepping, Scarlet Federation goons? It doesn’t take much to see who the real bad guy is here. They won’t even show their faces here in the DMZ, hiding behind those absurd masks of theirs! As if we would gas our OWN people just to kill a diplomat and a few troopers - preposterous!” The diplomat is scowling for once, a smoldering pit of anger burning in her one inky eye."

rows.original: You take a step back and carefully consider your next question. “What’d they do?”
rows.translation: 你后退一步，仔细斟酌下一个问题。“她们做了什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a step back and carefully consider your next question. “What’d they do?”"

rows.original: “They shot down some of our scouts - the planes hadn’t even left our borders. Blasted reds were probably too nearsighted or too poorly educated to realize that they weren’t being invaded. I hear they don’t even have thollums over there. They just punt their young directly into their military.” Lyralla’s antennae twitch. “They claim that our scouts shot first of course. The audacity of it all.”
rows.translation: “她们击落了我们的几架侦察机——那些飞机甚至还没离开我国边境。那些该死的红军大概不是近视得太厉害，就是没受过足够教育，连我们根本没在入侵都看不出来。听说她们那里甚至没有托勒姆，只会把年轻人直接踢进军队。”莱拉拉的触角抽动了一下。“当然，她们声称是我们的侦察兵先开火。真是厚颜无耻。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“They shot down some of our scouts - the planes hadn’t even left our borders. Blasted reds were probably too nearsighted or too poorly educated to realize that they weren’t being invaded. I hear they don’t even have thollums over there. They just punt their young directly into their military.” Lyralla’s antennae twitch. “They claim that our scouts shot first of course. The audacity of it all.”"

rows.original: How do you respond?
rows.translation: 你要如何回应？
rows.raw: "\n\nHow do you respond?"

rows.original: What Next?
rows.translation: 接下来呢？
rows.raw: "What Next?"

rows.original: “What happened next?”
rows.translation: “接下来发生了什么？”
rows.raw: "“What happened next?”"

rows.original: Lyralla gives you a haunted look. “Isn’t it obvious? They declared war and launched an all-out offensive. They must have been preparing for something like this for years. The shelling started within a few hours. Their troops rolled out shortly after, butchering and slaving as they went. Did you know...” Her voice drops to a hushed whisper, “...they make their captives into sex slaves with that awful venom of theirs?”
rows.translation: 莱拉拉向你投来心有余悸的目光。“这还不明显吗？她们宣战并发动了全面攻势。她们肯定为这种事准备了好几年。炮击在几小时内就开始了，部队随后出动，一路屠杀、奴役。你知道吗...”她压低嗓音，近乎耳语道：“...她们会用那种可怕的毒液，把俘虏变成性奴？”
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla gives you a haunted look. “Isn’t it obvious? They declared war and launched an all-out offensive. They must have been preparing for something like this for years. The shelling started within a few hours. Their troops rolled out shortly after, butchering and slaving as they went. Did you know...” Her voice drops to a hushed whisper, “...they make their captives into sex slaves with that awful venom of theirs?”"

rows.original: “Really?”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Really?”"

rows.original: You try to keep an open mind after hearing Nehzera’s side of the story.
rows.translation: 听过内赫扎拉那一方的说法后，你努力保持开放的态度。
rows.raw: " You try to keep an open mind after hearing Nehzera’s side of the story."

rows.original: “Really,” the cybernetic ant deadpans. “First chance they get, they slather them up in spit to take the fight out of them, then take advantage of the poor girls until they’re too hungry for more to remember those red bitches murdered their sisters.” A shiver wracks the diplomat. “That’s the worst part of it, really - how dehumanizing it all is. Even if they weren’t making their captives into sex slaves, they’d be just as bad off. The Scarlet Federation has no room for individuality. No room for freedom. No room for love.” She looks wistfully into the distance. “It’s worse than terrible. I don’t think there’s a word in either of our languages that can correctly describe it.”
rows.translation: “是吗，”机械化的蚁人面无表情地说道。“一逮到机会，她们就往俘虏身上涂满唾液，消磨她们的反抗意志；然后不停蹂躏这些可怜姑娘，直到她们饥渴得只想再来，连那些红皮贱人杀害过自己姐妹都忘了。”外交官打了个寒颤。“其实最糟糕的正是这一点——整件事把人性剥夺得多么彻底。就算她们没有把俘虏变成性奴，处境也不会好多少。猩红联邦容不下个性，容不下自由，也容不下爱。”她若有所思地望向远方。“这比可怕还要糟糕。我想，我们两种语言中都没有一个词能准确形容它。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Really,” the cybernetic ant deadpans. “First chance they get, they slather them up in spit to take the fight out of them, then take advantage of the poor girls until they’re too hungry for more to remember those red bitches murdered their sisters.” A shiver wracks the diplomat. “That’s the worst part of it, really - how dehumanizing it all is. Even if they weren’t making their captives into sex slaves, they’d be just as bad off. The Scarlet Federation has no room for individuality. No room for freedom. No room for love.” She looks wistfully into the distance. “It’s worse than terrible. I don’t think there’s a word in either of our languages that can correctly describe it.”"

rows.original: Shifting nervously, you can’t help but acknowledge her with a curt nod. “But what about the war? What happened?”
rows.translation: 你不安地挪了挪身体，只能简短地点头表示认可。“那战争呢？后来怎么样了？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShifting nervously, you can’t help but acknowledge her with a curt nod. “But what about the war? What happened?”"

rows.original: The gold-robed ex-soldier blinks a few times. “Right.. the war. The reds... well, they were far readier for this than we were. We had a bigger population and base of industry, but that’s no substitute for having a well-trained, well-equipped army. They rolled right over a few of our cities. Our token police forces barely stood a chance.”
rows.translation: 身披金袍的退役军人眨了几下眼。“对..战争。红军...唉，她们比我们准备充分得多。我们人口更多，工业基础也更强，但这些替代不了一支训练有素、装备精良的军队。她们轻易碾过了我们几座城市。我们象征性的警备部队几乎毫无胜算。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe gold-robed ex-soldier blinks a few times. “Right.. the war. The reds... well, they were far readier for this than we were. We had a bigger population and base of industry, but that’s no substitute for having a well-trained, well-equipped army. They rolled right over a few of our cities. Our token police forces barely stood a chance.”"

rows.original: “How’d you stop them then?”
rows.translation: “那你们后来是怎么拦住她们的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“How’d you stop them then?”"

rows.original: “We didn’t... not completely. The Council started a draft to get our military up and running, and while the reds were busy filling up on ‘trench wives,’ we were busy digging trenches and developing weapons. We were busy teaching our weavers to stitch wounds shut, our machinists to make guns, and our workers to swing warhammers instead of... hammers.” She coughs. “I assure you that it sounds far more clever in our tongue.”
rows.translation: “我们没有...至少没能完全拦住。议会开始征兵，着手组建军队；红军忙着用那些‘战壕妻子’，填饱欲望时，我们则忙着挖战壕、研发武器。我们教织工缝合伤口，教机械师造枪，也教工人挥舞战锤，而不是...锤子。”她咳了一声。“我向你保证，用我们的语言说出来要机智得多。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We didn’t... not completely. The Council started a draft to get our military up and running, and while the reds were busy filling up on ‘trench wives,’ we were busy digging trenches and developing weapons. We were busy teaching our weavers to stitch wounds shut, our machinists to make guns, and our workers to swing warhammers instead of... hammers.” She coughs. “I assure you that it sounds far more clever in our tongue.”"

rows.original: You recall the gas and nukes you’ve heard mentioned in passing. “What about all the chemical and nuclear weapons?”
rows.translation: 你想起偶然听人提到过的毒气和核武器。“那些化学武器和核武器又是怎么回事？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou recall the gas and nukes you’ve heard mentioned in passing. “What about all the chemical and nuclear weapons?”"

rows.original: Lyralla pushes back from her desk, scowling. “Weapons of last resort. Next to Gildenmere, Kressia was our second biggest city. We deployed nerve gas to try and stem the red tide, thinking that it would be so terrible that it could finally bring an end to the fighting.” She shakes her head sadly. “It didn’t. The reds swarmed in anywhere we didn’t gas, focusing their attacks into deadly spears. They made protective breathing masks not long after, allowing them to ignore the gasses almost completely. Kressia fell within a week of that discovery. No amount of trenches, mines, or determination could stop them.”
rows.translation: 莱拉拉从桌前向后退开，怒容满面。“那是最后的手段。克雷西亚是我们仅次于吉尔登米尔的第二大城市。我们投放神经毒气，试图阻挡红色浪潮，以为这种手段足够可怕，终于能让战斗结束。”她悲伤地摇了摇头。“但没有。红军从所有没有毒气的地方蜂拥而入，把攻势汇聚成致命的矛尖。没过多久，她们就造出了防护呼吸面具，几乎可以完全无视毒气。那项发明出现后不到一周，克雷西亚便陷落了。无论战壕、地雷还是决心，都挡不住她们。”
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla pushes back from her desk, scowling. “Weapons of last resort. Next to Gildenmere, Kressia was our second biggest city. We deployed nerve gas to try and stem the red tide, thinking that it would be so terrible that it could finally bring an end to the fighting.” She shakes her head sadly. “It didn’t. The reds swarmed in anywhere we didn’t gas, focusing their attacks into deadly spears. They made protective breathing masks not long after, allowing them to ignore the gasses almost completely. Kressia fell within a week of that discovery. No amount of trenches, mines, or determination could stop them.”"

rows.original: She rubs at her forehead with one set of hands while wringing the other pair. “I’m pretty sure they were just going to nuke Gildenmere rather than waste the soldiers it would take to conquer it... then you showed up, giving us the time to discover those weapons ourselves. If they think they can wipe us off the map with waves of fire, they’ll find themselves having to live out of radioactive craters.”
rows.translation: 她用一双手揉着额头，另一双手则不安地绞在一起。“我很确定，她们原本打算直接用核弹摧毁吉尔登米尔，免得浪费攻城所需的士兵...然后你出现了，给了我们发现同类武器的时间。如果她们以为能用火海把我们从地图上抹去，那就会发现自己也只能住进放射性弹坑里。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe rubs at her forehead with one set of hands while wringing the other pair. “I’m pretty sure they were just going to nuke Gildenmere rather than waste the soldiers it would take to conquer it... then you showed up, giving us the time to discover those weapons ourselves. If they think they can wipe us off the map with waves of fire, they’ll find themselves having to live out of radioactive craters.”"

rows.original: You wince.
rows.translation: 你皱起脸。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wince."

rows.original: “Yeah, I’d prefer not to be melted into glass too.” Lyralla straightens, her face heavy with sadness. “I wish I could have filled that summary with more victories.”
rows.translation: “对，我也不想被熔成玻璃。”莱拉拉挺直身体，脸上满是悲伤。“真希望这段概述里能有更多胜利。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, I’d prefer not to be melted into glass too.” Lyralla straightens, her face heavy with sadness. “I wish I could have filled that summary with more victories.”"

rows.original: What Next?
rows.translation: 接下来呢？
rows.raw: "What Next?"

rows.original: The reds seem pretty barbaric. What happened next?
rows.translation: 红军似乎相当野蛮。接下来发生了什么？
rows.raw: "The reds seem pretty barbaric. What happened next?"

rows.original: Well...
rows.translation: 这个嘛...
rows.raw: "Well..."

rows.original: You point out that there isn’t any evidence one way or the other. Besides, wouldn’t ants crazy enough to take to the sky be less reliable the kind that stay on the ground, defending their homeland?
rows.translation: 你指出，双方都没有确凿证据。再说了，一群疯狂到敢飞上天空的蚁人，难道不会比留在地面保卫家园的同族更不可靠吗？
rows.raw: "You point out that there isn’t any evidence one way or the other. Besides, wouldn’t ants crazy enough to take to the sky be less reliable the kind that stay on the ground, defending their homeland?"

rows.original: Lyralla points a finger and stops, pausing to consider her next words. Her antennae lower until they’re pointed at you like little horns. “Even if that were true - that our scouts had strayed off course or turned violent of their own accord, it never would’ve turned into a war if those scarlet witches knew anything about diplomacy. Reparations could have been made and peace sustained if not for their wanton bloodlust. You can’t seriously believe that we would want such desolation for our peoples, can you?”
rows.translation: 莱拉拉伸出一根手指，又停下来斟酌接下来的话。她的触角垂低，像两根小角一样指着你。“就算真是那样——就算我们的侦察兵偏离航线，或擅自诉诸暴力——如果那些猩红女巫懂得半点外交，这件事也绝不会演变成战争。只要不是她们嗜血成性，本可以支付赔偿、维持和平。你不会真以为我们想让自己的人民遭受如此毁灭吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla points a finger and stops, pausing to consider her next words. Her antennae lower until they’re pointed at you like little horns. “Even if that were true - that our scouts had strayed off course or turned violent of their own accord, it never would’ve turned into a war if those scarlet witches knew anything about diplomacy. Reparations could have been made and peace sustained if not for their wanton bloodlust. You can’t seriously believe that we would want such desolation for our peoples, can you?”"

rows.original: Yes
rows.translation: 是
rows.raw: "Yes"

rows.original: Lyralla shakes her head at you. “I would have thought that your alien eyes could see things more clearly than most. I was mistaken. Good day.”
rows.translation: 莱拉拉朝你摇头。“我还以为你那双外星人的眼睛会比大多数人看得更清楚。看来我错了。再见。”
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla shakes her head at you. “I would have thought that your alien eyes could see things more clearly than most. I was mistaken. Good day.”"

rows.original: The gold myr diplomat buries herself in her documents once more. It would seem this interview is at a close.
rows.translation: 金米尔外交官重新埋首于文件之中。看来这次访谈到此为止了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe gold myr diplomat buries herself in her documents once more. It would seem this interview is at a close."

rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.translation: 否
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: “No, of course not.”
rows.translation: “不，当然不是。”
rows.raw: "“No, of course not.”"

rows.original: Lyralla sags into her chair. “That’s a relief. It’s hard enough to get aid with the reds muddling up the waters and telling everyone that we’re responsible for all this.” She rubs at her temples. “Was there something more pleasant we could discuss?”
rows.translation: 莱拉拉瘫进椅子里。“那就好。红军已经把水搅得够浑了，到处宣称这一切都是我们的责任，害得我们很难争取援助。”她揉着太阳穴。“我们能谈点更愉快的事情吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla sags into her chair. “That’s a relief. It’s hard enough to get aid with the reds muddling up the waters and telling everyone that we’re responsible for all this.” She rubs at her temples. “Was there something more pleasant we could discuss?”"

rows.original: Well...
rows.translation: 这个嘛...
rows.raw: "Well..."

rows.original: Could the golds have shot first? Myr are supposed to be short-sighted subterranean creatures. Wouldn’t ones that wanted to fly be extreme eccentrics?
rows.translation: 会不会是金米尔先开了火？米尔应该是视力不佳的地下生物。那些想要飞行的米尔，难道不会是极端古怪的异类吗？
rows.raw: "Could the golds have shot first? Myr are supposed to be short-sighted subterranean creatures. Wouldn’t ones that wanted to fly be extreme eccentrics?"

rows.translation: 我能去参观你们的城市吗？那里肯定酷毙了！

rows.original: Lyralla coal-black eyes twinkle. “Oh, are you going to be a tourist now? Another visitor down to visit The Honeypot?” The name has the ring of a proper place. She smiles a little more broadly. “You realize that our society is far more libertine than at the UGC’s core, yes? It is not uncommon for my people to walk about totally uncovered, nor is it frowned upon to share physical affection in public.”
rows.translation: 莱拉拉煤黑色的眼睛闪闪发亮。“哦，你现在打算当游客了？又一位要去参观‘蜜罐’的访客？”这个名字听起来像个正式地名。她笑得更灿烂了些。“你明白，我们的社会比银河联合邦联核心地区开放得多，对吧？我的人民赤身裸体地走在外面并不少见，在公共场合表达肉体上的亲昵也不会遭人非议。”
rows.raw: "\n\nLyralla coal-black eyes twinkle. “Oh, are you going to be a tourist now? Another visitor down to visit The Honeypot?” The name has the ring of a proper place. She smiles a little more broadly. “You realize that our society is far more libertine than at the UGC’s core, yes? It is not uncommon for my people to walk about totally uncovered, nor is it frowned upon to share physical affection in public.”"

rows.original: “Like, just cause the core is all prudish doesn’t... uh...” You blink a few times to buy time to try to finish the rest of the sentence, then give up entirely. “The words got all tangled up in my head! I... um... I’ve been places where fucking in public is totally cool. I’ll like it there!”
rows.translation: “核心区保守不代表...呃...”你眨了几下眼，争取时间想把后半句话说完，最后还是彻底放弃。“这些话在我脑子里全搅成一团了！我...呃...去过一些可以当众做爱、大家也完全不在意的地方。我会喜欢那里的！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Like, just cause the core is all prudish doesn’t... uh...” You blink a few times to buy time to try to finish the rest of the sentence, then give up entirely. “The words got all tangled up in my head! I... um... I’ve been places where fucking in public is totally cool. I’ll like it there!”"

rows.original: “Please, Lyralla. Whatever it’s like here, it can’t be as openly sexual as New Texas. The whole planet smells like fucking.” You grin a little wider. “I think I can handle the sight of a few pairs of breasts or a canoodling couple.”
rows.translation: “拜托，莱拉拉。无论这里什么样，都不可能比新德州更明目张胆地色情。整个星球闻起来都像有人在做爱。”你笑得更灿烂了些。“几对乳房或一对亲热的情侣，我想自己还是应付得来的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Please, Lyralla. Whatever it’s like here, it can’t be as openly sexual as New Texas. The whole planet smells like fucking.” You grin a little wider. “I think I can handle the sight of a few pairs of breasts or a canoodling couple.”"

rows.original: <i>“Thanks for the warning. It seems like everywhere I go, everyone’s a gone a little sex-crazy.
rows.translation: <i>“谢谢提醒。好像无论我走到哪里，每个人都有点性欲过剩。

rows.translation: 边缘地带的空气里肯定有什么东西！”

rows.original: little scaly creatures obsessed with breeding. I can probably handle seeing a few gold myr bouncing around in the nude.”
rows.translation: 痴迷繁殖的矮小鳞片生物。看几只金米尔赤身裸体地蹦来蹦去，我大概应付得来。”
rows.raw: "little scaly creatures obsessed with breeding. I can probably handle seeing a few gold myr bouncing around in the nude.”"

rows.original: “You really ought to dispense with the warning. Anybody brave enough to fly out here isn’t going to be afraid of seeing a little T and A. In fact, a lot of people flew out here for it. So why don’t you make with the rubber stamping so I can be on my way.”
rows.translation: “你真的没必要警告我。敢飞到这里的人，绝不会因为看到一点乳房和屁股就害怕。事实上，很多人就是为这个飞来的。所以赶快盖章，让我上路吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You really ought to dispense with the warning. Anybody brave enough to fly out here isn’t going to be afraid of seeing a little T and A. In fact, a lot of people flew out here for it. So why don’t you make with the rubber stamping so I can be on my way.”"

rows.original: . “Very well. Please be aware that while you are in our city local law supersedes UGC legislation... at least until the Council approves integration measures.” She hands you a pamphlet with one of her biological arms. “The details are in there, but just try not to rape anyone, kill anybody, or steal anything.” She smiles. “Our languages have similar enough words for those concepts.”
rows.translation: 。“好吧。请注意，你在我们城市期间，当地法律优先于银河联合邦联的法规...至少在议会批准整合措施之前如此。”她用一只生物手臂递给你一本小册子。“具体细节都写在里面，不过只要别强奸、杀害或偷窃任何人就好。”她微微一笑。“我们的语言对这些概念有足够相近的词汇。”

rows.original: Sure thing!

rows.raw: "Sure thing!"

rows.original: Thanks for the heads up.

rows.raw: "Thanks for the heads up."

rows.original: It’ll be tough to go a few hours without murdering anyone, but I think I’ll manage.
rows.translation: 几个小时不杀人确实很难，但我想我能忍住。
rows.raw: "It’ll be tough to go a few hours without murdering anyone, but I think I’ll manage."

rows.original: Shouldn’t be a problem.
rows.translation: 应该没问题。
rows.raw: "Shouldn’t be a problem."

rows.raw: "\n\nThe gold ambassador "

rows.original: sighs. “You’re lucky I can pick up on sarcasm.”
rows.translation: 叹了口气。“你该庆幸我听得懂讽刺。”
rows.raw: "sighs. “You’re lucky I can pick up on sarcasm.”"

rows.original: nods. “Good. Stay out of trouble.”
rows.translation: 点点头。“很好。别惹麻烦。”
rows.raw: "nods. “Good. Stay out of trouble.”"

rows.original: She pulls a card out of her desk and hands it to you. It’s little more than a printed pass on some sweet-scented cardstock. You probably could’ve whipped one of these up with your ship’s computer if you wanted.
rows.translation: 她从桌子里拿出一张卡片递给你。那不过是一张印在带有甜香的卡纸上的通行证。如果你愿意，大概用飞船电脑就能伪造一张。
rows.raw: " She pulls a card out of her desk and hands it to you. It’s little more than a printed pass on some sweet-scented cardstock. You probably could’ve whipped one of these up with your ship’s computer if you wanted."

rows.translation: 你现在可以进入吉尔登米尔城了。

rows.raw: "Request a pass that will let you enter the gold myr city, Gildenmere."
