rows.original: after a long, tense moment. You get the feeling she was somehow taking your measure by appraising your equipment. The smile on her face is too emotionless, too ambiguous to give you any good indication of exactly what she thinks of her first impression of you.
rows.translation: ，结束了漫长而紧张的审视。你感觉她似乎在通过评估你的装备来衡量你。她脸上的笑容过于冷淡、过于模棱两可，让你完全看不出她对你的第一印象究竟如何。
rows.raw: " after a long, tense moment. You get the feeling she was somehow taking your measure by appraising your equipment. The smile on her face is too emotionless, too ambiguous to give you any good indication of exactly what she thinks of her first impression of you."

rows.original: Well, it couldn’t have been anything too bad.
rows.translation: 不过，应该不至于太糟。
rows.raw: " Well, it couldn’t have been anything too bad."

rows.original: Hopefully she likes what she sees; keeping up a body like yours isn’t easy!
rows.translation: 希望她喜欢眼前所见；保持你这样的身材可不容易！
rows.raw: " Hopefully she likes what she sees; keeping up a body like yours isn’t easy!"

rows.original: If she’s sizing you up because she thinks you’re prey, she’d better think again.
rows.translation: 如果她是在把你当猎物估量，那她最好重新想想。
rows.raw: " If she’s sizing you up because she thinks you’re prey, she’d better think again."

rows.original: The officer speaks up again after a moment of mutual examination. “Hm. You’re exactly like the grapevine said, Steele. Uncannily so.” She inhales quietly but deeply, holding her breath in for a moment before suddenly exhaling and springing out of her chair.
rows.translation: 两人互相审视片刻后，军官再次开口。“嗯。你和传闻中一模一样，斯蒂尔。相似得不可思议。”她安静地深吸一口气，屏息片刻，随后突然呼气，从椅子上一跃而起。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe officer speaks up again after a moment of mutual examination. “Hm. You’re exactly like the grapevine said, Steele. Uncannily so.” She inhales quietly but deeply, holding her breath in for a moment before suddenly exhaling and springing out of her chair."

rows.original: You tense
rows.translation: 你绷紧身体
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tense"

rows.original: ever-so-slightly
rows.translation: ，只是极其轻微地，
rows.raw: " ever-so-slightly"

rows.original: at the unannounced movement, taken aback by the agility and grace of her action. She moved almost too quickly to track, and all without disturbing her chair as she left it. You’re fully aware of how strong myr are as well, so that level of coordinated swiftness is somewhat alarming. The marshal may be a commander rather than a front-line soldier, but it’s quite clear she didn’t let herself go to seed because of it.
rows.translation: 被这毫无预兆的动作吓了一跳。她的动作敏捷优雅，快得几乎让人无法捕捉，而且离开椅子时甚至没碰动它。你也十分清楚米尔人有多强壮，因此这种协调的迅捷多少令人不安。元帅或许是指挥官，而非前线士兵，但很明显，她并未因此放任自己荒废。
rows.raw: " at the unannounced movement, taken aback by the agility and grace of her action. She moved almost too quickly to track, and all without disturbing her chair as she left it. You’re fully aware of how strong myr are as well, so that level of coordinated swiftness is somewhat alarming. The marshal may be a commander rather than a front-line soldier, but it’s quite clear she didn’t let herself go to seed because of it."

rows.original: “I have not yet introduced myself,” she declares with a subtle smile, evidently pleased by your reaction. “I am Field Marshal Sellera, appointed commander of the Kressia Occupation Army and the highest-ranking officer currently prosecuting the ongoing Gildenmere campaign.” The expression on her face grows into a wicked grin
rows.translation: “我还没有自我介绍，”她带着若有若无的微笑宣布，显然很满意你的反应。“我是陆军元帅塞勒拉，克雷西亚占领军的受命指挥官，也是目前负责推进吉尔登米尔战役的最高级军官。”她脸上的表情逐渐变成邪气的笑容
rows.raw: "\n\n“I have not yet introduced myself,” she declares with a subtle smile, evidently pleased by your reaction. “I am Field Marshal Sellera, appointed commander of the Kressia Occupation Army and the highest-ranking officer currently prosecuting the ongoing Gildenmere campaign.” The expression on her face grows into a wicked grin"

rows.original: gold myr
rows.raw: "gold myr"

rows.original: as she sizes up your gold myr features
rows.translation: ，同时打量你金米尔人的特征，
rows.raw: " as she sizes up your gold myr features"

rows.original: , and she takes short, measured steps toward you along the table’s edge. “Of course, we’re only a mere ‘occupation army’ because half my constituent corps are scattered around the theater holding defensive positions while your people insist on a ceasefire. I commanded the entirety of the primary offensive force prior to your arrival.”
rows.translation: 并沿桌边迈着短促、经过精确控制的步伐走向你。“当然，我们如今只是区区一支‘占领军’，是因为在你们的人坚持停火期间，我麾下半数军团都分散在整个战区、固守防御阵地。你们到来之前，我指挥的是整个主力进攻部队。”
rows.raw: ", and she takes short, measured steps toward you along the table’s edge. “Of course, we’re only a mere ‘occupation army’ because half my constituent corps are scattered around the theater holding defensive positions while your people insist on a ceasefire. I commanded the entirety of the primary offensive force prior to your arrival.”"

rows.original: Wow. A real bigshot, then. If what she says is true, then the imposing woman walking in your direction is a noble among the ruling class of the Scarlet Federation, someone who commands generals and determines the course of an entire war. Her importance would be comparable to one of the highest queens among her enemy’s culture. Most of all, she doesn’t even appear that old, though you’ve already noticed that myr age somewhat differently from humans. She’s either got friends in very high places, or she’s some sort of prodigy.
rows.translation: 哇。那她可真是个大人物。如果她所言属实，那么这个朝你走来的威严女人，就是猩红联邦统治阶级中的贵族；她指挥将军，决定整场战争的走向。她的重要性，足以与敌方文化中地位最高的女王之一相提并论。最重要的是，她看起来甚至没有那么年长，尽管你已经发现米尔人的衰老方式与人类略有不同。她要么在高层有极硬的关系，要么就是某种天才。
rows.raw: "\n\nWow. A real bigshot, then. If what she says is true, then the imposing woman walking in your direction is a noble among the ruling class of the Scarlet Federation, someone who commands generals and determines the course of an entire war. Her importance would be comparable to one of the highest queens among her enemy’s culture. Most of all, she doesn’t even appear that old, though you’ve already noticed that myr age somewhat differently from humans. She’s either got friends in very high places, or she’s some sort of prodigy."

rows.original: “And don’t think I spent all my time sitting in a cozy chair issuing orders, Steele,” the marshal continues, now only an arm’s length away from you. She casually gestures toward the wall as she says this, and you flick your gaze over in that direction to see what it is she wants you to look at. Your eyes come to rest on an absolutely ludicrously sized double-bladed axe mounted in an ornate frame at chest-height. You know myr warriors are fond of big weapons, but that’s just obscene!
rows.translation: “而且别以为我只会坐在舒适的椅子上发号施令，斯蒂尔，”元帅继续说道，此时离你只有一臂之遥。她说话时随意朝墙边一指，你顺着方向瞥去，想看看她要你注意什么。你的视线落在一把尺寸荒谬得离谱的双刃斧上，它装在华丽框架中，悬于齐胸高度。你知道米尔战士偏爱大型武器，但这也太夸张了！
rows.raw: "\n\n“And don’t think I spent all my time sitting in a cozy chair issuing orders, Steele,” the marshal continues, now only an arm’s length away from you. She casually gestures toward the wall as she says this, and you flick your gaze over in that direction to see what it is she wants you to look at. Your eyes come to rest on an absolutely ludicrously sized double-bladed axe mounted in an ornate frame at chest-height. You know myr warriors are fond of big weapons, but that’s just obscene!"

rows.original: “Oh, that’s ornamental,” she reveals with a small laugh. “I carry it during public appearances. It’ll chop through you just fine, but I wouldn’t want to use it in combat. I’d be cut down in the time it took to recover from a single swing.” You breathe a sigh of relief. You didn’t want to believe anyone on this planet could possibly be capable of actually wielding that thing in battle. That would be genuinely terrifying.
rows.translation: “哦，那只是装饰品，”她轻笑着透露。“我在公开露面时会带着它。它当然能把你劈开，但我可不想在战斗中使用；一次挥击后还没来得及收势，我就会被砍倒。”你松了口气。你不愿相信这颗星球上真有人能在战场上挥舞那东西，那会着实令人恐惧。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, that’s ornamental,” she reveals with a small laugh. “I carry it during public appearances. It’ll chop through you just fine, but I wouldn’t want to use it in combat. I’d be cut down in the time it took to recover from a single swing.” You breathe a sigh of relief. You didn’t want to believe anyone on this planet could possibly be capable of actually wielding that thing in battle. That would be genuinely terrifying."

rows.original: Sellera pulls out a chair at the side of the table, near the closer end, and waves at the opposite chair, beckoning you to do the same. You comply, finding that the large table gives you just enough space to feel separated from her while still seeming close and intimate. “So, Captain Steele,” she says carefully, sitting back and taking a slow, prolonged breath. “I’ll get to the point. Why are you in Kressia?”
rows.translation: 塞勒拉拉开桌侧靠近这一端的一把椅子，又朝对面的椅子挥手，示意你也坐下。你照做了；宽大的桌子给了你刚好足够的距离感，同时又不失亲近。“那么，斯蒂尔船长，”她谨慎地说道，向后靠坐，缓慢地深吸了一口气。“我直入正题。你为什么来克雷西亚？”
rows.raw: "\n\nSellera pulls out a chair at the side of the table, near the closer end, and waves at the opposite chair, beckoning you to do the same. You comply, finding that the large table gives you just enough space to feel separated from her while still seeming close and intimate. “So, Captain Steele,” she says carefully, sitting back and taking a slow, prolonged breath. “I’ll get to the point. Why are you in Kressia?”"

rows.original: Mission
rows.translation: 任务
rows.raw: "Mission"

rows.original: You take a few moments and explain your frontier-spanning mission to obtain your rightful inheritance, coming into contact with all sorts of strange creatures and individuals as you follow the Planet Rush.
rows.translation: 你花了片刻解释自己横跨边疆、为了取得合法遗产而进行的任务，以及追寻星球淘金潮期间遇到的各种奇异生物与人物。
rows.raw: "You take a few moments and explain your frontier-spanning mission to obtain your rightful inheritance, coming into contact with all sorts of strange creatures and individuals as you follow the Planet Rush."

rows.original: Sellera nods as you go on, apparently fascinated by your tale. Her lips turn up into a genuine smile when you finish. “So your father has made you embark on some manner of campaign, a quest, to claim the fruits of your family’s fortune and success?” She’s practically beaming now! “I like this idea. To succeed your father, you must prove yourself his equal, or better. It’s not simply handed to you on a silver platter. You must claim your place in the world.”
rows.translation: 你继续讲述时，塞勒拉不断点头，显然被你的故事吸引。等你讲完，她唇角扬起真诚的笑容。“所以，你父亲让你踏上一场类似战役或者说征途的旅程，以此取得家族财富与成功的果实？”她现在简直容光焕发！“我喜欢这个主意。要继承父亲，你必须证明自己与他相当，甚至更胜一筹。这不是用银盘子直接端给你的；你必须亲手夺取自己在世界上的位置。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSellera nods as you go on, apparently fascinated by your tale. Her lips turn up into a genuine smile when you finish. “So your father has made you embark on some manner of campaign, a quest, to claim the fruits of your family’s fortune and success?” She’s practically beaming now! “I like this idea. To succeed your father, you must prove yourself his equal, or better. It’s not simply handed to you on a silver platter. You must claim your place in the world.”"

rows.original: “Yes,” she continues, “the more I think about it, the more I admire the idea. I think, if I’d met him, I might just like your sire, Steele.” The marshal lightly bites the tip of one of her fingers, eyes going distant as she presumably imagines an older, more experienced
rows.translation: “没错，”她继续说道，“我越想越欣赏这个主意。我想，如果见过他，我或许会很喜欢你的父亲，斯蒂尔。”元帅轻咬一根手指的指尖，目光飘向远处，大概是在想象一个更年长、更有经验的
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes,” she continues, “the more I think about it, the more I admire the idea. I think, if I’d met him, I might just like your sire, Steele.” The marshal lightly bites the tip of one of her fingers, eyes going distant as she presumably imagines an older, more experienced"

m
f

rows.translation: 你时。
rows.raw: " you."

rows.original: Well, you’re not exactly sure how you should take that. Fantasizing about your dead dad right in front of you? That’s pretty gross.
rows.translation: 好吧，你不太确定该怎么理解这件事。当着你的面幻想你死去的老爸？真恶心。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, you’re not exactly sure how you should take that. Fantasizing about your dead dad right in front of you? That’s pretty gross."

rows.original: Interrupting her with
rows.translation: 你用
rows.raw: "\n\nInterrupting her with"

rows.original: an understated clearing of your throat
rows.translation: 一声克制的清嗓
rows.raw: " an understated clearing of your throat"

rows.original: a comically exaggerated cough
rows.translation: 一阵滑稽夸张的咳嗽
rows.raw: " a comically exaggerated cough"

rows.original: a blunt and straightforward clearing of your throat
rows.translation: 一声直截了当的清嗓
rows.raw: " a blunt and straightforward clearing of your throat"

rows.original: , you ask if she knows anything about
rows.translation: 打断她，询问她是否知道
rows.raw: ", you ask if she knows anything about"

rows.original: how the probe made it all the way into the caverns
rows.translation: 探针是怎么一路进入洞穴的
rows.raw: " how the probe made it all the way into the caverns"

rows.original: where the probe could be
rows.translation: 探针可能在哪里
rows.raw: " where the probe could be"

rows.original: . If anyone would know, the commander of every single soldier in Kressia is a very likely candidate.
rows.translation: 。要说有谁会知道，指挥克雷西亚每一名士兵的人无疑是极有可能的人选。
rows.raw: ". If anyone would know, the commander of every single soldier in Kressia is a very likely candidate."

rows.original: “I cannot say that I have any information on the topic,” Sellera replies. Her response seems genuine; if she’s lying, she’s doing a very good job of it. You can’t think of a reason for her to lie, though. It’s not as if your father’s probe has any military use, so it’s doubtful the marshal would be interested in it.
rows.translation: “关于这个话题，我不能说自己掌握任何情报，”塞勒拉回答。她的反应似乎很真诚；如果是在撒谎，那她演得实在很好。不过你也想不到她撒谎的理由。你父亲的探针并没有军事用途，元帅应该不会对它感兴趣。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I cannot say that I have any information on the topic,” Sellera replies. Her response seems genuine; if she’s lying, she’s doing a very good job of it. You can’t think of a reason for her to lie, though. It’s not as if your father’s probe has any military use, so it’s doubtful the marshal would be interested in it."

rows.original: After a moment of silent thought, the marshal seems to remember something. Leaning forward, she says, “Shortly before First Contact, we received reports from our surface scouts of a massive impact in the plains west of the Kressia airfield. We assumed it was Republic artillery, though the blast was much larger, and buried deeper, than their guns normally do. The lead scout, one of my more... liberated... commandos by the name of Thyrsa, mentioned it had created a tunnel that appeared to lead deeper underground than our standard tunnels. It is possible that impact was your probe landing. I cannot guarantee that, however.
rows.translation: 沉默思索片刻后，元帅似乎想起了什么。她向前倾身，说道：“第一次接触前不久，我们收到地表侦察兵的报告，称克雷西亚机场以西的平原发生了一次猛烈撞击。我们以为那是共和国的炮击，不过爆炸远比她们的火炮通常造成的更大，埋得也更深。领队侦察兵是我手下一名比较...开放...的突击队员，名叫瑟莎；她提到撞击形成了一条隧道，似乎比我们的标准隧道通向更深的地下。那次撞击有可能就是你的探针坠落，但我无法保证。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a moment of silent thought, the marshal seems to remember something. Leaning forward, she says, “Shortly before First Contact, we received reports from our surface scouts of a massive impact in the plains west of the Kressia airfield. We assumed it was Republic artillery, though the blast was much larger, and buried deeper, than their guns normally do. The lead scout, one of my more... liberated... commandos by the name of Thyrsa, mentioned it had created a tunnel that appeared to lead deeper underground than our standard tunnels. It is possible that impact was your probe landing. I cannot guarantee that, however."

rows.original: “I’m sorry I can’t answer your questions on that front, Steele,” she says in what comes close to an actual tone of regret. “Is there anything else you’d like to know?”
rows.translation: “很抱歉，在这件事上我无法回答你的问题，斯蒂尔，”她说道，语气几乎算得上真心遗憾。“还有其他想知道的吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m sorry I can’t answer your questions on that front, Steele,” she says in what comes close to an actual tone of regret. “Is there anything else you’d like to know?”"

rows.original: Your Mission
rows.translation: 你的任务
rows.raw: "Your Mission"

rows.original: Tell Sellera you’re here searching for a way to get your father’s fortune and prove your worth.
rows.translation: 告诉塞勒拉，你来这里是为了寻找取得父亲遗产、证明自身价值的方法。
rows.raw: "Tell Sellera you’re here searching for a way to get your father’s fortune and prove your worth."

rows.original: Sightseeing
rows.translation: 观光
rows.raw: "Sightseeing"

rows.original: Well, that’s a good question. What exactly are you doing in Kressia? You take a quick moment to think about it and decide to give the most honest answer: you just wanted to see the place.
rows.translation: 嗯，这确实是个好问题。你来克雷西亚究竟是做什么的？你迅速思考片刻，决定给出最诚实的答案：你只是想来看看。
rows.raw: "Well, that’s a good question. What exactly are you doing in Kressia? You take a quick moment to think about it and decide to give the most honest answer: you just wanted to see the place."

rows.original: By the expression on Sellera’s face, she’s a little taken aback by this answer. “Your reason is... you came on an impulse?”
rows.translation: 从塞勒拉的表情看，这个答案让她有些吃惊。“你的理由是...一时冲动？”
rows.raw: "\n\nBy the expression on Sellera’s face, she’s a little taken aback by this answer. “Your reason is... you came on an impulse?”"

rows.original: That’s not entirely correct. Sure, some impulse may have been involved, but you knew what you were doing and made a conscious decision to travel to Kressia. It wasn’t as if you just let your [pc.legsNoun] simply carry you along and you wound up here. When she doesn’t get that, either, you do your best to explain the concept of tourism to her and ask if the myr don’t have an analogue.
rows.translation: 这并不完全准确。当然，其中或许有些冲动成分，但你清楚自己在做什么，也有意识地决定前往克雷西亚。又不是任由自己的[pc.legsNoun]带着你乱走，最后莫名其妙来到这里。她还是无法理解，于是你竭力向她解释旅游的概念，并询问米尔人是否没有类似活动。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s not entirely correct. Sure, some impulse may have been involved, but you knew what you were doing and made a conscious decision to travel to Kressia. It wasn’t as if you just let your [pc.legsNoun] simply carry you along and you wound up here. When she doesn’t get that, either, you do your best to explain the concept of tourism to her and ask if the myr don’t have an analogue."

rows.original: “Yes and no,” she replies, crossing her arms over her chest. “We certainly travel between cities from time to time, perhaps going to see monuments or museums or showcases of great art and engineering while we are there, but... it isn’t nearly so pronounced as to warrant an entire industry devoted to it. Nothing worthy of being referred to as such, in any case.”
rows.translation: “既是，也不是，”她抱臂回答。“我们当然偶尔会在城市之间旅行，或许会顺便参观纪念碑、博物馆，以及展示伟大艺术与工程的展览，但...它远没有盛行到足以支撑一个专门为此服务的完整产业。无论如何，还称不上产业。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes and no,” she replies, crossing her arms over her chest. “We certainly travel between cities from time to time, perhaps going to see monuments or museums or showcases of great art and engineering while we are there, but... it isn’t nearly so pronounced as to warrant an entire industry devoted to it. Nothing worthy of being referred to as such, in any case.”"

rows.original: Smiling, you suggest that with the entire population of the UGC as potential tourists, maybe that will change. If there are such great works of art and engineering in the Federation, surely there are others who’d want to see them.
rows.translation: 你微笑着表示，银河联合邦联的全体人口都是潜在游客，也许这种情况会有所改变。既然联邦拥有如此杰出的艺术与工程作品，肯定也会有其他人想来亲眼看看。
rows.raw: "Smiling, you suggest that with the entire population of the UGC as potential tourists, maybe that will change. If there are such great works of art and engineering in the Federation, surely there are others who’d want to see them."

rows.original: Smirking, you answer that you are an alien, after all. As far as you’re concerned, the myr are the weird ones. As things stand, you’re probably just the first of a new phenomenon for Myrellion.
rows.translation: 你坏笑着回答，毕竟你本来就是外星人。在你看来，米尔人才是奇怪的那一方。照目前的情况来看，你大概只是米瑞利昂新现象的第一例。
rows.raw: "Smirking, you answer that you are an alien, after all. As far as you’re concerned, the myr are the weird ones. As things stand, you’re probably just the first of a new phenomenon for Myrellion."

rows.original: Sighing, you remark that it shouldn’t be surprising the Federation wouldn’t be willing to pull the sticks out of their asses long enough to go enjoy themselves. Maybe with the new contact with the UGC, they’ll have the opportunity to see a third way of life that isn’t theirs or the Golds’.
rows.translation: 你叹了口气，表示联邦连把屁股里的棍子拔出来、好好享受一下都不肯，这并不令人意外。也许随着银河联合邦联的首次接触，他们将有机会见识既非自身、也非金米尔式的第三种生活方式。
rows.raw: "Sighing, you remark that it shouldn’t be surprising the Federation wouldn’t be willing to pull the sticks out of their asses long enough to go enjoy themselves. Maybe with the new contact with the UGC, they’ll have the opportunity to see a third way of life that isn’t theirs or the Golds’."

rows.original: Sellera nods slowly, mulling it over in her head. “Perhaps, Steele. Perhaps. Your arrival certainly means change for all of us... for better or worse. Now, with that enlightening conversation out of the way, is there anything else you’d like to discuss?”
rows.translation: 塞莱拉缓缓点头，在脑中思索着。“也许吧，斯蒂尔。也许。你的到来无疑意味着我们所有人都会迎来改变...无论好坏。那么，这场颇有启发的谈话就先到这里，你还有别的事情想讨论吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nSellera nods slowly, mulling it over in her head. “Perhaps, Steele. Perhaps. Your arrival certainly means change for all of us... for better or worse. Now, with that enlightening conversation out of the way, is there anything else you’d like to discuss?”"

rows.original: Sightseeing
rows.translation: 观光
rows.raw: "Sightseeing"

rows.original: Tell Sellera you’re just the first fruit of Myrellion’s new tourist industry, taking in the sights and experiences of the whole planet.
rows.translation: 告诉塞莱拉，你只是米瑞利昂新兴旅游业结出的第一枚果实，正在领略整颗星球的风光与体验。
rows.raw: "Tell Sellera you’re just the first fruit of Myrellion’s new tourist industry, taking in the sights and experiences of the whole planet."

rows.original: Exploration
rows.translation: 探索
rows.raw: "Exploration"

rows.original: There’s a definite note of pride in your voice as you answer her question. You’re just fulfilling the heartfelt dream of everyone who’s ever looked up at the stars and longed to see the edges of eternity. You’re exploring the edges of civilized space, boldly going into the great black unknown. Perhaps you even phrase it in a slightly less cheesy fashion. The crux of it is that you’re an explorer, and you’re seeking out whatever new sights and discoveries you can.
rows.translation: 你的回答中带着明显的自豪。你不过是在实现每个仰望星空、渴望看见永恒边界之人的由衷梦想。你正在探索文明空间的边缘，勇敢踏入漆黑而未知的浩瀚领域。也许你实际措辞没这么俗套，但核心意思是：你是一名探索者，正在寻找一切崭新的景象与发现。
rows.raw: "There’s a definite note of pride in your voice as you answer her question. You’re just fulfilling the heartfelt dream of everyone who’s ever looked up at the stars and longed to see the edges of eternity. You’re exploring the edges of civilized space, boldly going into the great black unknown. Perhaps you even phrase it in a slightly less cheesy fashion. The crux of it is that you’re an explorer, and you’re seeking out whatever new sights and discoveries you can."

rows.original: This elicits a mixed response from the field marshal. She takes a moment to ponder over your answer, and then takes a long, leggy step forward.
rows.translation: 这番回答让陆军元帅的反应有些复杂。她花了片刻思考你的话，随后迈开修长的双腿，向前跨出一大步。
rows.raw: "\n\nThis elicits a mixed response from the field marshal. She takes a moment to ponder over your answer, and then takes a long, leggy step forward."

rows.original: You find yourself backing up into the wall as she leans in to look
rows.translation: 当她俯身
rows.raw: "\n\nYou find yourself backing up into the wall as she leans in to look"

rows.original: up
rows.translation: 抬头望向
rows.raw: " up"

rows.original: straight
rows.translation: 直直看向
rows.raw: " straight"

rows.original: down
rows.translation: 低头望向
rows.raw: " down"

rows.original: at you and stare into your eyes. An intense moment passes while you feel as if your very soul is being measured. Then it’s over and she turns around, sauntering back over to her previous position to lean against the table and face you once more.
rows.translation: 你并凝视你的双眼时，你发现自己正后退着贴上墙壁。一段令人紧张的时间过去，你感觉自己的灵魂仿佛都在接受衡量。随后一切结束，她转过身，悠然走回原位，再次倚着桌子面对你。
rows.raw: " at you and stare into your eyes. An intense moment passes while you feel as if your very soul is being measured. Then it’s over and she turns around, sauntering back over to her previous position to lean against the table and face you once more."

rows.original: “You have passion,” Sellera says approvingly. “A drive to do something for yourself. Fire. I respect this. It’s a very... appealing character trait.” She licks her lips slowly as she looks you up and down once more. Why do you get the feeling of being sized up for dinner every time she does that? You’re starting to imagine you’re the ant here, and you waltzed into a spider’s web.
rows.translation: “你很有激情，”塞莱拉赞许道。“拥有为自己做一番事业的动力。火焰。我尊重这一点。这是一种非常...迷人的性格特质。”她再次上下打量你，同时缓缓舔着嘴唇。为什么她每次这样做，你都会觉得自己正被估量着够不够当晚餐？你开始觉得自己才是这里的蚂蚁，而且还跳着华尔兹闯进了蜘蛛网。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You have passion,” Sellera says approvingly. “A drive to do something for yourself. Fire. I respect this. It’s a very... appealing character trait.” She licks her lips slowly as she looks you up and down once more. Why do you get the feeling of being sized up for dinner every time she does that? You’re starting to imagine you’re the ant here, and you waltzed into a spider’s web."

rows.original: An awkward silence follows before she speaks up again. “In any case, Steele... since you’ve come all the way here to see me, is there anything else you’d like to know?”
rows.translation: 一阵尴尬的沉默过后，她再次开口。“总之，斯蒂尔...既然你大老远来到这里见我，还有什么想知道的吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nAn awkward silence follows before she speaks up again. “In any case, Steele... since you’ve come all the way here to see me, is there anything else you’d like to know?”"

rows.original: Exploration
rows.translation: 探索
rows.raw: "Exploration"

rows.original: Tell Sellera you’re interested in going where no man, or woman, or [herm|npc|f], or whatever has gone before, meeting new species and exploring new frontiers.
rows.translation: 告诉塞莱拉，你想前往从未有人——无论男人、女人、[herm|npc|f]还是其他什么人——抵达过的地方，认识新的物种，探索新的边疆。
rows.raw: "Tell Sellera you’re interested in going where no man, or woman, or [herm|npc|f], or whatever has gone before, meeting new species and exploring new frontiers."

rows.original: You find yourself in a dimmer level than the one above. Standing before you are two guards in front of the administration office of Field Marshal Sellera.
rows.translation: 你来到比上层更加昏暗的一层。塞莱拉陆军元帅的行政办公室门前站着两名卫兵。
rows.raw: "You find yourself in a dimmer level than the one above. Standing before you are two guards in front of the administration office of Field Marshal Sellera."

rows.original: Do you need enter and speak to her about anything?
rows.translation: 你需要进去和她谈些什么吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nDo you need enter and speak to her about anything?"

rows.original: Sellera
rows.translation: 塞莱拉
rows.raw: "Sellera"

rows.original: Approach Sellera
rows.translation: 接近塞莱拉
rows.raw: "Approach Sellera"

rows.original: May as well visit the marshal while you’re here.
rows.translation: 既然来了，不妨拜访一下元帅。
rows.raw: "May as well visit the marshal while you’re here."

rows.original: VERUSHA
rows.raw: "VERUSHA"

rows.original: MYR_RED_GUARD
rows.raw: "MYR_RED_GUARD"

rows.original: Verusha & Red Myr
rows.translation: 维鲁莎与红米尔
rows.raw: "Verusha & Red Myr"

rows.original: Argument!
rows.translation: 争执！
rows.raw: "Argument!"

rows.original: You hear some kind of argument happening in a nearby alleyway, so you glance towards it. It’s just some hyena-morph arguing with a red myr. A few seconds later you realize it’s not just any hyena morph - it’s Verusha. While she’s wearing a rather heavy-looking suit of armor instead of her usual topless look, there’s no denying it. The height, the voice, the cybernetic limbs - it’s definitely her.
rows.translation: 你听到附近巷子里似乎有人争吵，于是朝那边望去。只是一名鬣狗拟态人与一个红米尔在争执。几秒后你才意识到，那并非普通的鬣狗拟态人——而是维鲁莎。虽然她穿着一套看起来相当厚重的护甲，不是平日袒胸露乳的打扮，但绝不会认错。身高、声音、机械义肢——肯定是她。
rows.raw: "You hear some kind of argument happening in a nearby alleyway, so you glance towards it. It’s just some hyena-morph arguing with a red myr. A few seconds later you realize it’s not just any hyena morph - it’s Verusha. While she’s wearing a rather heavy-looking suit of armor instead of her usual topless look, there’s no denying it. The height, the voice, the cybernetic limbs - it’s definitely her."

rows.original: The argument between Verusha and the red myr is getting rather heated, but before things can escalate any further, the myr pulls out a small bag which Verusha snatches from her. This seems to satisfy Verusha as she pockets the bag and turns away from the red officer.
rows.translation: 维鲁莎和红米尔的争执愈发激烈，但在事态进一步升级之前，那个米尔拿出一个小袋子，被维鲁莎一把夺走。这似乎令维鲁莎满意了；她把袋子塞进口袋，转身离开红米尔军官。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe argument between Verusha and the red myr is getting rather heated, but before things can escalate any further, the myr pulls out a small bag which Verusha snatches from her. This seems to satisfy Verusha as she pockets the bag and turns away from the red officer."

rows.original: Now would be an opportunity to talk to her if you want to.
rows.translation: 如果你想，现在正是和她说话的机会。
rows.raw: "\n\nNow would be an opportunity to talk to her if you want to."

rows.original: Talk
rows.translation: 交谈
rows.raw: "Talk"

rows.original: “Hey, Verusha, over here!” you yell at her, waving as she turns her attention towards you.
rows.translation: “嘿，维鲁莎，这边！”你朝她喊道，一边挥手；她随即把注意力转向你。
rows.raw: "“Hey, Verusha, over here!” you yell at her, waving as she turns her attention towards you."

rows.original: She walks towards you, pushing a couple of myr girls out of her way. “What are you doing around here, Steele?” she asks when she gets close enough.
rows.translation: 她朝你走来，推开挡路的几个米尔女孩。“你在这儿干什么，斯蒂尔？”走近后她问道。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe walks towards you, pushing a couple of myr girls out of her way. “What are you doing around here, Steele?” she asks when she gets close enough."

joinAfter.expression:
reclaimedProbeMyrellion()
                    ? "Just chasing some alien tail."
                    : "Looking for one of my father’s probes."

rows.original: Just chasing some alien tail.
rows.translation: 只是来追追外星美臀。
rows.raw: "Just chasing some alien tail."

rows.original: Looking for one of my father’s probes.
rows.translation: 来找我父亲的一枚探针。
rows.raw: "Looking for one of my father’s probes."

rows.original: ” you answer. “What was that argument about?”
rows.translation: ”你回答。“刚才那场争执是怎么回事？”
rows.raw: "” you answer. “What was that argument about?”"

rows.original: “The bug-bitch refused to pay the agreed amount, saying that I didn’t complete the job properly,” she growls, “but no need for you to worry about that.” She scratches her chin, “Say, Steele, since I have done my job... would you care to go to that bathhouse? I’ve heard some good things about it but haven’t had a chance to try it out myself.”
rows.translation: “那个虫娘贱货拒绝支付约好的金额，说我没有好好完成工作，”她低吼道，“不过你不用操心。”她挠了挠下巴。“对了，斯蒂尔，既然我的工作已经完成了...你愿意去那家浴场吗？我听说那里挺不错，只是一直没机会亲自试试。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The bug-bitch refused to pay the agreed amount, saying that I didn’t complete the job properly,” she growls, “but no need for you to worry about that.” She scratches her chin, “Say, Steele, since I have done my job... would you care to go to that bathhouse? I’ve heard some good things about it but haven’t had a chance to try it out myself.”"

rows.original: Bath House
rows.translation: 浴场
rows.raw: "Bath House"

rows.original: “Sounds good,” you tell her.
rows.translation: “听起来不错，”你告诉她。
rows.raw: "“Sounds good,” you tell her."

rows.original: Verusha is more talkative than usual. She still doesn’t really talk about herself but she shares some info on employers and jobs she’s had recently. You’re surprised at how many of her employers talk openly about the job when she’s around.
rows.translation: 维鲁莎比平时健谈。她依旧不怎么谈论自己，却分享了一些最近雇主和工作的消息。令你惊讶的是，她在场时竟有那么多雇主会毫不避讳地谈论工作。
rows.raw: "\n\nVerusha is more talkative than usual. She still doesn’t really talk about herself but she shares some info on employers and jobs she’s had recently. You’re surprised at how many of her employers talk openly about the job when she’s around."

rows.original: Soon you get to the bath house. Verusha opens the door for you. “Bitches first,” she chuckles.
rows.translation: 没过多久，你们来到浴场。维鲁莎替你开门。“贱货优先，”她咯咯笑道。
rows.raw: "\n\nSoon you get to the bath house. Verusha opens the door for you. “Bitches first,” she chuckles."

rows.original: You roll your eyes and step inside.
rows.translation: 你翻了个白眼，迈步走进去。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou roll your eyes and step inside."

rows.original: The gold matron at the desk turns as you approach her. “A private bath for two,” Verusha says, handing some federation silver to the matron.
rows.translation: 柜台后的金米尔主母在你们走近时转过身来。“两人私人浴池，”维鲁莎一边说，一边把几枚联邦银币交给主母。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe gold matron at the desk turns as you approach her. “A private bath for two,” Verusha says, handing some federation silver to the matron."

rows.original: Another sister of the order comes to lead the two of you to a free bath.
rows.translation: 教团的另一位姐妹过来，领你们前往一间空闲浴室。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnother sister of the order comes to lead the two of you to a free bath. "
